class UpsertIntent[T: DatabaseObjectRow](IntentStep[T]):
    """L4: Insert or update a model instance."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "upsert", "intent"})

    def __init__(
        self: UpsertIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        instance: ObjectServerRef[T],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_UpsertIntentConfig[T]],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.instance = instance
        self.config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)

    def dependencies(self: UpsertIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies: frozenset[str] = self.instance.dependencies() | self.config.after_refs
        return dependencies

    def commit_dependency_ref_id(self: UpsertIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        return ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw")

    def lower(self: UpsertIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import get_versioned_staging_ctx
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.upsert import UpsertStep, _UpsertStepConfig

        config_value = self.config
        conflict_cols = list(config_value.conflict_columns) if config_value.conflict_columns else None
        on_conflict_str = config_value.on_conflict

        sc = get_versioned_staging_ctx(self.model_cls, ctx)
        if sc is not None:
            if config_value.on_conflict_where is not None:
                msg = "Versioned upsert does not yet support on_conflict_where"
                raise NotImplementedError(msg)
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_versioning_extended import (
                VersionedUpsertIntent,
                _VersionedUpsertIntentConfig,
            )

            return _as_steps(
                VersionedUpsertIntent(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self.model_cls,
                    cast("Any", config_value.literal_instance),
                    cast(
                        "Any",
                        _VersionedUpsertIntentConfig(
                            staging_ctx=sc,
                            conflict_columns=tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None,
                            on_conflict=cast("Mapping[Any, object] | None", on_conflict_str),
                            after_refs=config_value.after_refs,
                        ),
                    ),
                ).lower(ctx),
            )

        _reject_nonversioned_delta_upsert(self.model_cls)
        preimage_steps: list[QueryExecuteStep[T]] = []
        preimage_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        write_after_refs = config_value.after_refs
        if ctx.emit_table_event_intents and _table_event_dispatch_needed(self.model_cls, "UPSERT"):
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import QueryExecuteStep, _QueryExecuteStepConfig

            preimage_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.preimage")
            preimage_steps.append(
                QueryExecuteStep(
                    preimage_ref,
                    self.model_cls,
                    _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                        query_spec=_build_upsert_target_match_query_spec(
                            self.model_cls,
                            (config_value.literal_instance,),
                            tuple(conflict_cols or ("sys_id",)),
                        ),
                        after_refs=config_value.after_refs,
                    ),
                )
            )
            write_after_refs = config_value.after_refs | frozenset({preimage_ref})
        from l5100_fts.fts_config import FTSIndexImplementation, get_fts_config

        fts_config = get_fts_config(self.model_cls)
        requires_polyfill_fts_readback = fts_config is not None and fts_config.implementation is FTSIndexImplementation.POLYFILL
        requires_table_event_readback = (
            config_value.on_conflict_where is None
            and ctx.emit_table_event_intents
            and _table_event_dispatch_needed(self.model_cls, "UPSERT")
        )
        selected_readback = (
            requires_polyfill_fts_readback
            or requires_table_event_readback
            or not (
                ctx.has_returning_clause
                and not (
                    bool(conflict_cols) and ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_conflict_transport is DmlConflictTransport.INSERTED_VALUES
                )
            )
        )
        return [
            *preimage_steps,
            UpsertStep(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                _UpsertStepConfig(
                    instance=config_value.literal_instance,
                    conflict_columns=tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None,
                    on_conflict=on_conflict_str,
                    on_conflict_where=config_value.on_conflict_where,
                    after_refs=write_after_refs,
                    return_raw_rows=config_value.return_raw_rows,
                    publish_selected_binding=selected_readback,
                    permission_context_ref=config_value.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=config_value.permission_context_type,
                ),
            ),
            *RecordTableEventIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_subscription_dispatch"),
                self.model_cls,
                _RecordTableEventConfig(
                    event_type="UPSERT",
                    write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.selected" if selected_readback else f"{self.ref_id}.raw"),
                    old_rows_ref=preimage_ref,
                    replayable_visible_rows=selected_readback or config_value.on_conflict_where is None,
                    visible_rows_cardinality=Cardinality.OPTIONAL_ONE,
                ),
            ).lower(ctx),
            *_embedding_auto_queue_steps_from_raw_ref(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.selected" if selected_readback else f"{self.ref_id}.raw"),
                self.model_cls,
                "UPSERT",
            ),
        ]


class UpsertDeferredIntent[T](IntentStep[T]):
    """L4: Upsert from a symbolic object ref."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "upsert", "intent"})

    def __init__(
        self: UpsertDeferredIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        source: ObjectServerRef[T],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_UpsertConfigPayload],
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.source = source
        source_ref = source.ref_id
        if source_ref is None:
            msg = "UpsertDeferredIntent requires a symbolic object ref"
            raise NotImplementedError(msg)
        self.source_ref = ServerPlanRefId(source_ref)
        self.config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)
        self._after_refs = after_refs

    def dependencies(self: UpsertDeferredIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.source.dependencies() | self._after_refs

    def result_row_publication_ref(self) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        """Return the exact SQL relation containing the selected upsert row."""
        return ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.selected")

    def commit_dependency_ref_id(self: UpsertDeferredIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        return ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw")

    def lower(self: UpsertDeferredIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from l2070_batching.seeded_constants import read_seeded_constant_from_ctx

        found, input_row = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(ctx, self.source_ref)
        if found:
            if not isinstance(input_row, self.model_cls) or not isinstance(input_row, DatabaseObjectRow):
                raise TypeError("Upsert input does not match its declared row model")
            return UpsertIntent(
                self.ref_id,
                type(input_row),
                ServerRefs.object(input_row),
                ServerRefs.scalar(
                    _UpsertIntentConfig(
                        literal_instance=input_row,
                        conflict_columns=self.config.conflict_columns,
                        on_conflict=self.config.on_conflict,
                        after_refs=self._after_refs,
                        permission_context_ref=self.config.permission_context_ref,
                        permission_context_type=self.config.permission_context_type,
                    )
                ),
            ).lower(ctx)
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import get_versioned_staging_ctx
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.upsert import UpsertStep, _UpsertStepConfig

        config_value = self.config
        conflict_cols = list(config_value.conflict_columns) if config_value.conflict_columns else None
        on_conflict_str = config_value.on_conflict

        sc = get_versioned_staging_ctx(self.model_cls, ctx)
        if sc is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_versioning_extended import (
                _lower_deferred_versioned_upsert,
            )

            return _as_steps(
                _lower_deferred_versioned_upsert(
                    ctx=ctx,
                    ref_id=self.ref_id,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    staging_ctx=sc,
                    source_ref=self.source_ref,
                    conflict_columns=conflict_cols,
                    on_conflict=on_conflict_str,
                    after_refs=self._after_refs,
                ),
            )
        _reject_nonversioned_delta_upsert(self.model_cls)
        return [
            UpsertStep(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                _UpsertStepConfig(
                    source_ref=self.source_ref,
                    conflict_columns=tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None,
                    on_conflict=on_conflict_str,
                    after_refs=self._after_refs,
                    permission_context_ref=config_value.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=config_value.permission_context_type,
                ),
            ),
            *RecordTableEventIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_subscription_dispatch"),
                self.model_cls,
                _RecordTableEventConfig(
                    event_type="UPSERT",
                    write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw" if ctx.has_returning_clause else f"{self.ref_id}.selected"),
                ),
            ).lower(ctx),
            *(
                _embedding_auto_queue_steps(self.ref_id, self.model_cls, "UPSERT")
                if ctx.sql_render_dialect().supports_returning()
                else _embedding_auto_queue_steps_from_raw_ref(ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.selected"), self.model_cls, "UPSERT")
            ),
        ]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _PreparedDeltaInsertIfAbsent:
    """Physical owner-write metadata produced by delta candidate preparation."""

    supplemental_write_values: tuple[_SupplementalWriteValues, ...]
    authored_return_assignments: tuple[AuthoredReturnAssignments, ...]
    required_source_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = ()

    def require_candidate_count(
        self,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        candidate_count: int,
    ) -> None:
        """Fail before SQL lowering if prepared metadata is not row-aligned."""
        supplemental_count = len(self.supplemental_write_values)
        authored_count = len(self.authored_return_assignments)
        if supplemental_count == candidate_count and authored_count == candidate_count:
            return
        msg = (
            f"Delta insert-if-absent preparation for {model_cls.__name__} is not row-aligned: "
            f"candidates={candidate_count}, supplemental_rows={supplemental_count}, "
            f"authored_return_rows={authored_count}"
        )
        raise ProgrammingError(msg)


def _staged_delta_finalized_values(
    instance: DatabaseObjectRow,
    configs: Sequence[LargeColumnConfig],
) -> tuple[tuple[LargeColumnConfig, FinalizedStagedField], ...]:
    from l7000_versioned_schema.staged_field_operations import (
        DeltaFinalizedStagedField,
        MaterializedStagedField,
    )

    matches: list[tuple[LargeColumnConfig, FinalizedStagedField]] = []
    for config in configs:
        value = getattr(instance, config.column, None)
        if isinstance(value, MaterializedStagedField | DeltaFinalizedStagedField):
            matches.append((config, value))
    return tuple(matches)


def _lower_staged_delta_insert_if_absent[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    *,
    intent: UpsertManyIntent[T],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    config_value: _UpsertManyIntentConfig[T],
    delta_configs: Sequence[LargeColumnConfig],
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    conflict_names = config_value.conflict_columns or ("sys_id",)
    last_index_by_conflict_key: dict[tuple[DatabaseScalar, ...], int] = {}
    distinct_null_indices: list[int] = []
    for index, instance in enumerate(config_value.literal_instances):
        raw_key: tuple[DatabaseScalar, ...] = tuple(getattr(instance, name) for name in conflict_names)
        if any(value is None for value in raw_key):
            distinct_null_indices.append(index)
            continue
        try:
            hash(raw_key)
        except TypeError as exc:
            msg = f"Insert-if-absent conflict key {conflict_names!r} contains a non-scalar value."
            raise ProgrammingError(msg) from exc
        last_index_by_conflict_key[raw_key] = index
    retained_indices = tuple(sorted((*distinct_null_indices, *last_index_by_conflict_key.values())))
    discarded_indices = tuple(index for index in range(len(config_value.literal_instances)) if index not in retained_indices)
    # Publish retained last-value candidates first. Process discarded staged
    # candidates afterwards so normal manifest validation and graph cleanup
    # remain authoritative without letting them win an owner conflict.
    ordered_indices = retained_indices + discarded_indices
    ordered_instances = tuple(config_value.literal_instances[index] for index in ordered_indices)
    effective_config = _replace_upsert_many_instances(config_value, intent.model_cls, ordered_instances)
    staged = tuple((instance, _staged_delta_finalized_values(instance, delta_configs)) for instance in ordered_instances)
    if not any(value for _instance, value in staged):
        return ()

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.staged_delta_reentry import FlattenStagedDeltaInsertResultsStep

    if len(staged) == 1 and staged[0][1]:
        steps = list(
            _lower_one_staged_delta_insert_if_absent(
                intent=intent,
                ctx=ctx,
                config_value=effective_config,
                staged_value=staged[0][1],
            ),
        )
    else:
        steps = []
    result_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
    for index, (instance, staged_value) in enumerate(staged if not steps else ()):
        child_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}.candidate_{index}")
        child_config = _replace_upsert_many_instances(effective_config, intent.model_cls, (instance,))
        child_intent = UpsertManyIntent(
            child_ref,
            intent.model_cls,
            ServerRefs.object_sequence([instance]),
            ServerRefs.scalar(child_config),
        )
        if not staged_value:
            steps.extend(child_intent.lower(ctx))
        else:
            steps.extend(
                _lower_one_staged_delta_insert_if_absent(
                    intent=child_intent,
                    ctx=ctx,
                    config_value=child_config,
                    staged_value=staged_value,
                ),
            )
        result_refs.append(child_ref)
    if result_refs:
        steps.append(
            FlattenStagedDeltaInsertResultsStep[T](
                intent.ref_id,
                tuple(result_refs),
                intent.model_cls,
            ),
        )
    return steps


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _PreparedStagedDeltaFieldGraph:
    """Typed references produced for one staged field's delta graph."""

    steps: tuple[ServerPlanStep[Any], ...]
    value_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    write_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]
    content_value_id: SysId
    payload: StagedPayloadMaterialization


def _prepare_staged_delta_field_graph[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    *,
    model_cls: type[T],
    row_sys_id: SysId,
    large_config: LargeColumnConfig,
    finalized: FinalizedStagedField,
    executing_session_id: SessionId,
    graph_prefix: ServerPlanRefId,
) -> _PreparedStagedDeltaFieldGraph:
    """Build one signed graph defined in ``docs/design/LARGE_COLUMN_DELTA_STORAGE.rst``."""
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.grammar_fetchone import (
        GrammarRowResultMode,
        GrammarRowStep,
        _GrammarRowConfig,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.staged_delta_reentry import (
        PrepareStagedDeltaStorageStep,
        ProjectPreparedDeltaRowsStep,
        StagedPayloadMaterialization,
        staged_delta_reentry_resource_budget,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.upsert_many import _UpsertManyStepConfig, UpsertManyRawResultStep
    from impl.common.l2510_delta_storage.delta_model import ContentChunkRange, ContentDedupChunk, ContentValue
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.staged_field_streaming import (
        SqlReadOwnedStagedFieldManifest,
        SqlReadOwnedStagedFieldPayload,
    )
    from impl.common.l2510_delta_storage.staged_preparation import StagedFieldDeltaPreparationRequest
    from l2070_batching.python_reentry import PythonReentryOperationId, PythonReentrySpec
    from l2070_batching.publication import RelationContract
    from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import model_sql_column_type_hints
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import producer_publication_columns
    from l7000_versioned_schema.staged_field_streams import StagedFieldStream, StagedFieldStreamPayload

    delta_config = large_config.delta_storage
    if delta_config is None or not delta_config.enabled:
        raise ValueError("The staged field does not use delta storage.")
    if finalized.model_cls is not model_cls:
        raise ValueError("The finalized staged field does not belong to the insert model.")

    manifest_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{graph_prefix}.staged_manifest")
    payload_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{graph_prefix}.staged_payload")
    prepared_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{graph_prefix}.prepared_delta")
    value_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{graph_prefix}.content_value_rows")
    chunk_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{graph_prefix}.chunk_rows")
    range_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{graph_prefix}.range_rows")
    value_write_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{graph_prefix}.content_value_write")
    chunk_write_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{graph_prefix}.chunk_write")
    range_write_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{graph_prefix}.range_write")

    input_models = (StagedFieldStream, StagedFieldStreamPayload)
    input_relations: list[RelationContract] = []
    for input_model in input_models:
        columns = producer_publication_columns(input_model)
        hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(input_model, columns)
        if hints is None:
            raise TypeError(f"{input_model.__name__} has no SQL relation type hints.")
        input_relations.append(RelationContract(columns=columns, column_type_hints=hints))
    output_models = (ContentValue, ContentDedupChunk, ContentChunkRange)
    output_relations: list[RelationContract] = []
    for output_model in output_models:
        columns = producer_publication_columns(output_model)
        hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(output_model, columns)
        if hints is None:
            raise TypeError(f"{output_model.__name__} has no SQL relation type hints.")
        output_relations.append(RelationContract(columns=columns, column_type_hints=hints))

    reentry = PythonReentrySpec(
        operation=PythonReentryOperationId.STAGED_FIELD_DELTA_PREPARE_V1,
        input_refs=(manifest_ref, payload_ref),
        input_relations=tuple(input_relations),
        input_relation_names=("StagedFieldStream", "StagedFieldStreamPayload"),
        application_ref=prepared_ref,
        output_refs=(value_ref, chunk_ref, range_ref),
        output_relations=tuple(output_relations),
        output_relation_names=("ContentValue", "ContentDedupChunk", "ContentChunkRange"),
        budget=staged_delta_reentry_resource_budget(finalized.size_bytes, delta_config.min_chunk_size),
    )
    content_value_id = SysId(finalized.upload_id)
    request = StagedFieldDeltaPreparationRequest(
        upload_id=finalized.upload_id,
        owner_session_id=finalized.owner_session_id,
        executing_session_id=executing_session_id,
        source_table=SqlTableName(get_table_name(model_cls)),
        source_column=ContentColumnName(large_config.column),
        row_sys_id=row_sys_id,
        expected_size=finalized.size_bytes,
        expected_sha256=finalized.sha256,
        content_value_id=content_value_id,
        payload=b"",
        config=delta_config,
    )
    chunk_count = field(ContentDedupChunk.ref_count)
    chunk_conflict_update: dict[object, object] = {}
    chunk_conflict_update[chunk_count] = chunk_count + EXCLUDED(chunk_count)
    hydrated_row = _GrammarRowConfig(result_mode=GrammarRowResultMode.HYDRATE_ONE)
    steps: tuple[ServerPlanStep[Any], ...] = (
        GrammarRowStep(
            manifest_ref,
            SqlReadOwnedStagedFieldManifest(
                stream_id=finalized.upload_id,
                owner_session_id=executing_session_id,
            ),
            model_cls=StagedFieldStream,
            config=hydrated_row,
        ),
        GrammarRowStep(
            payload_ref,
            SqlReadOwnedStagedFieldPayload(
                stream_id=finalized.upload_id,
                owner_session_id=executing_session_id,
            ),
            model_cls=StagedFieldStreamPayload,
            config=hydrated_row,
        ),
        PrepareStagedDeltaStorageStep(
            prepared_ref,
            manifest_ref=manifest_ref,
            payload_ref=payload_ref,
            request=request,
            reentry=reentry,
        ),
        ProjectPreparedDeltaRowsStep(
            value_ref,
            prepared_ref=prepared_ref,
            model_cls=ContentValue,
            row_kind="content_value",
            reentry=reentry,
        ),
        ProjectPreparedDeltaRowsStep(
            chunk_ref,
            prepared_ref=prepared_ref,
            model_cls=ContentDedupChunk,
            row_kind="chunks",
            reentry=reentry,
        ),
        ProjectPreparedDeltaRowsStep(
            range_ref,
            prepared_ref=prepared_ref,
            model_cls=ContentChunkRange,
            row_kind="ranges",
            reentry=reentry,
        ),
        UpsertManyRawResultStep(
            value_write_ref,
            ContentValue,
            _UpsertManyStepConfig(
                instances_ref=value_ref,
                conflict_columns=("source_table", "source_column", "row_sys_id", "revision_id"),
            ),
        ),
        UpsertManyRawResultStep(
            chunk_write_ref,
            ContentDedupChunk,
            _UpsertManyStepConfig(
                instances_ref=chunk_ref,
                conflict_columns=("chunk_hash_short", "chunk_hash_high"),
                on_conflict=chunk_conflict_update,
                after_refs=frozenset({value_write_ref}),
            ),
        ),
        UpsertManyRawResultStep(
            range_write_ref,
            ContentChunkRange,
            _UpsertManyStepConfig(
                instances_ref=range_ref,
                conflict_columns=("content_value_id", "ordinal"),
                after_refs=frozenset({chunk_write_ref}),
            ),
        ),
    )
    return _PreparedStagedDeltaFieldGraph(
        steps=steps,
        value_ref=value_ref,
        write_refs=frozenset({value_write_ref, chunk_write_ref, range_write_ref}),
        content_value_id=content_value_id,
        payload=StagedPayloadMaterialization(
            payload_ref=payload_ref,
            column=ContentColumnName(large_config.column),
            content_type=large_config.content_type,
        ),
    )


def _lower_one_staged_delta_insert_if_absent[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    *,
    intent: UpsertManyIntent[T],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    config_value: _UpsertManyIntentConfig[T],
    staged_value: tuple[tuple[LargeColumnConfig, FinalizedStagedField], ...],
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    if not staged_value:
        raise ProgrammingError("Staged delta lowering requires at least one finalized field.")
    if len(staged_value) > 1:
        return _lower_multi_staged_delta_insert_if_absent(
            intent=intent,
            ctx=ctx,
            config_value=config_value,
            staged_values=staged_value,
        )
    if not config_value.literal_instances:
        raise ProgrammingError("Staged delta lowering requires one literal owner candidate.")
    instance = config_value.literal_instances[0]
    large_config, finalized = next(iter(staged_value))
    if large_config.delta_storage is None or not large_config.delta_storage.enabled:
        raise ValueError("The staged field does not use delta storage.")
    if finalized.model_cls is not intent.model_cls:
        raise ValueError("The finalized staged field does not belong to the insert model.")
    executing_session_id = _session_id_from_lowering_ctx(ctx)
    if executing_session_id is None:
        raise ProgrammingError("Staged delta insertion requires a concrete session identity.")

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_content_delta_storage import (
        build_delta_orphan_cleanup_steps,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.staged_delta_reentry import MaterializeStagedDeltaInsertResultStep

    graph_prefix = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}.{finalized.upload_id}")
    owner_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{graph_prefix}.owner_write")
    graph = _prepare_staged_delta_field_graph(
        model_cls=intent.model_cls,
        row_sys_id=instance.sys_id,
        large_config=large_config,
        finalized=finalized,
        executing_session_id=executing_session_id,
        graph_prefix=graph_prefix,
    )
    prepared_instance = BaseModel.model_copy(instance, update={str(large_config.column): None})
    if not isinstance(prepared_instance, intent.model_cls):
        raise TypeError("Staged delta preparation changed the owner model type.")
    pointer_column = large_column_pointer_name(large_config.column)
    prepared_delta = _PreparedDeltaInsertIfAbsent(
        supplemental_write_values=((_SupplementalWriteValue(SqlColumnName(pointer_column), graph.content_value_id),),),
        authored_return_assignments=((),),
        required_source_refs=(graph.value_ref,),
    )
    prepared_config = _replace_upsert_many_instances(
        config_value,
        intent.model_cls,
        (prepared_instance,),
        after_refs=config_value.after_refs | graph.write_refs,
        prepared_delta_insert=prepared_delta,
    )
    conflict_cols = tuple(config_value.conflict_columns) if config_value.conflict_columns else None
    steps = list(graph.steps)
    owner_steps = UpsertManyIntent(
        owner_ref,
        intent.model_cls,
        ServerRefs.object_sequence([prepared_instance]),
        ServerRefs.scalar(prepared_config),
    ).lower(ctx)
    cleanup_steps, cleanup_after_refs = build_delta_orphan_cleanup_steps(
        ref_prefix=ServerPlanRefId(graph_prefix),
        model_cls=intent.model_cls,
        configs=(large_config,),
        after_ref=owner_ref,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_staged_field_streaming import OrdinaryStagedFieldAbortResultIntent

    steps.extend(owner_steps)
    steps.extend(cleanup_steps)
    staged_cleanup_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{graph_prefix}.staged_cleanup")
    steps.extend(
        OrdinaryStagedFieldAbortResultIntent(
            staged_cleanup_ref,
            stream_id=finalized.upload_id,
            owner_session_id=finalized.owner_session_id,
            after_refs=cleanup_after_refs,
        ).lower(ctx),
    )
    steps.append(
        MaterializeStagedDeltaInsertResultStep[T](
            intent.ref_id,
            owner_ref=owner_ref,
            payloads=(graph.payload,),
            after_refs=(staged_cleanup_ref,),
            model_cls=intent.model_cls,
        ),
    )
    return steps


def _lower_multi_staged_delta_insert_if_absent[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    *,
    intent: UpsertManyIntent[T],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    config_value: _UpsertManyIntentConfig[T],
    staged_values: tuple[tuple[LargeColumnConfig, FinalizedStagedField], ...],
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Lower all staged fields before one atomic owner insertion."""
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_content_delta_storage import build_delta_orphan_cleanup_steps
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_staged_field_streaming import OrdinaryStagedFieldAbortResultIntent
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.staged_delta_reentry import (
        MaterializeStagedDeltaInsertResultStep,
        StagedPayloadMaterialization,
    )

    if not staged_values:
        raise ProgrammingError("Multi-field staged delta lowering requires at least one finalized field.")
    if not config_value.literal_instances:
        raise ProgrammingError("Multi-field staged delta lowering requires one literal owner candidate.")
    instance = config_value.literal_instances[0]
    executing_session_id = _session_id_from_lowering_ctx(ctx)
    if executing_session_id is None:
        raise ProgrammingError("Staged delta insertion requires a concrete session identity.")

    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    graph_write_refs: set[ServerPlanRefId] = set()
    supplemental_values: list[_SupplementalWriteValue] = []
    payloads: list[StagedPayloadMaterialization] = []
    owner_required_source_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
    for large_config, finalized in staged_values:
        graph = _prepare_staged_delta_field_graph(
            model_cls=intent.model_cls,
            row_sys_id=instance.sys_id,
            large_config=large_config,
            finalized=finalized,
            executing_session_id=executing_session_id,
            graph_prefix=ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}.{finalized.upload_id}"),
        )
        steps.extend(graph.steps)
        graph_write_refs.update(graph.write_refs)
        owner_required_source_refs.append(graph.value_ref)
        supplemental_values.append(
            _SupplementalWriteValue(
                SqlColumnName(large_column_pointer_name(large_config.column)),
                graph.content_value_id,
            ),
        )
        payloads.append(graph.payload)

    prepared_instance = BaseModel.model_copy(
        instance,
        update={config.column: None for config, _finalized in staged_values},
    )
    if not isinstance(prepared_instance, intent.model_cls):
        raise TypeError("Staged delta preparation changed the owner model type.")
    prepared_config = _replace_upsert_many_instances(
        config_value,
        intent.model_cls,
        (prepared_instance,),
        after_refs=config_value.after_refs | frozenset(graph_write_refs),
        prepared_delta_insert=_PreparedDeltaInsertIfAbsent(
            supplemental_write_values=(tuple(supplemental_values),),
            authored_return_assignments=((),),
            required_source_refs=tuple(owner_required_source_refs),
        ),
    )
    owner_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}.owner_write")
    steps.extend(
        UpsertManyIntent(
            owner_ref,
            intent.model_cls,
            ServerRefs.object_sequence([prepared_instance]),
            ServerRefs.scalar(prepared_config),
        ).lower(ctx),
    )
    cleanup_steps, cleanup_after_refs = build_delta_orphan_cleanup_steps(
        ref_prefix=ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}.cleanup"),
        model_cls=intent.model_cls,
        configs=tuple(config for config, _finalized in staged_values),
        after_ref=owner_ref,
    )
    steps.extend(cleanup_steps)
    staged_cleanup_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
    for index, (_config, finalized) in enumerate(staged_values):
        cleanup_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}.staged_cleanup_{index}")
        steps.extend(
            OrdinaryStagedFieldAbortResultIntent(
                cleanup_ref,
                stream_id=finalized.upload_id,
                owner_session_id=finalized.owner_session_id,
                after_refs=cleanup_after_refs,
            ).lower(ctx),
        )
        staged_cleanup_refs.append(cleanup_ref)
    steps.append(
        MaterializeStagedDeltaInsertResultStep[T](
            intent.ref_id,
            owner_ref=owner_ref,
            payloads=tuple(payloads),
            after_refs=tuple(staged_cleanup_refs),
            model_cls=intent.model_cls,
        ),
    )
    return steps


class UpsertManyIntent[T: DatabaseObjectRow](IntentStep[list[T]]):
    """L4: Insert or update multiple model instances."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "upsert", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.MANY

    def dependencies(self: UpsertManyIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        refs = self.config.after_refs
        if self.config.permission_context_ref is not None:
            refs = refs | frozenset({self.config.permission_context_ref})
        return self.instances.dependencies() | frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in refs)

    def __init__(
        self: UpsertManyIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[T],
        instances: ObjectSequenceServerRef[T],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_UpsertManyIntentConfig[T]],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls: type[T] = model_cls
        self.instances = instances
        self.config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)

    def lower(self: UpsertManyIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import get_versioned_staging_ctx
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import (
            CollectResultsStep,
            FlattenResultSequencesStep,
            FlattenResultsStep,
            MaterializedFlattenResultsAfterDepsStep,
            StaticValueAfterDepsStep,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.insert_many_raw import _rows_per_statement
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_validation import SessionValidationStep
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.upsert import UpsertStep, _UpsertStepConfig
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.upsert_many import (
            UpsertManyStep,
            _UpsertManyStepConfig,
            _resolve_conflict_cols_from_plan,
            _unique_conflict_targets_from_model,
            retained_upsert_candidate_indices_for_targets,
        )

        config_value = self.config
        conflict_cols = list(config_value.conflict_columns) if config_value.conflict_columns else None
        on_conflict_str = config_value.on_conflict

        if not config_value.literal_instances:
            if ctx.session_id is None:
                return [CollectResultsStep(self.ref_id, [])]
            validation_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_session_revalidation")
            return [
                SessionValidationStep(
                    validation_ref,
                    _session_revalidation_identity(ctx.session_id),
                ),
                StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    [],
                    [str(validation_ref)],
                ),
            ]
        sc = get_versioned_staging_ctx(self.model_cls, ctx)
        if sc is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_versioning_extended import (
                VersionedUpsertManyIntent,
                _VersionedUpsertManyConfig,
            )

            return _as_steps(
                VersionedUpsertManyIntent(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self.model_cls,
                    ServerRefs.object_sequence(list(config_value.literal_instances)),
                    cast(
                        "Any",
                        _VersionedUpsertManyConfig(
                            staging_ctx=sc,
                            conflict_columns=tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None,
                            on_conflict=cast("Mapping[Any, object] | None", on_conflict_str),
                            literal_instances=cast(
                                "tuple[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId], ...]",
                                config_value.literal_instances,
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ).lower(ctx),
            )
        large_column_configs = tuple(get_large_column_configs(self.model_cls))
        delta_configs = tuple(
            config for config in large_column_configs if config.delta_storage is not None and config.delta_storage.enabled
        )
        if delta_configs and not config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only:
            _reject_nonversioned_delta_upsert(self.model_cls)
        if delta_configs and config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only:
            staged_steps = _lower_staged_delta_insert_if_absent(
                intent=self,
                ctx=ctx,
                config_value=config_value,
                delta_configs=delta_configs,
            )
            if staged_steps:
                return staged_steps
        non_delta_large_columns = tuple(
            config.column for config in large_column_configs if config.delta_storage is None or not config.delta_storage.enabled
        )
        if delta_configs and non_delta_large_columns and config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only:
            columns = ", ".join(non_delta_large_columns)
            raise ValueError(
                f"Delta insert-if-absent for {self.model_cls.__name__} does not support models that "
                f"also use non-delta large-column storage: {columns}",
            )
        if delta_configs and config_value.prepared_delta_insert is None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import (
                RuntimeSourceAfterDepsStep,
                RuntimeSourceSequenceValue,
            )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_content_delta_storage import (
                build_delta_orphan_cleanup_steps,
            )

            last_index_by_sys_id = {instance.sys_id: index for index, instance in enumerate(config_value.literal_instances)}
            retained_indices = tuple(sorted(last_index_by_sys_id.values()))
            authored_instances = tuple(config_value.literal_instances[index] for index in retained_indices)
            prepared_instances, supplemental_values, spill_steps = _spill_literal_large_column_instances(
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.delta_spill"),
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                instances=authored_instances,
                ctx=ctx,
            )
            write_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.delta_write")
            if supplemental_values is None:
                msg = f"Delta insert-if-absent preparation produced no pointer rows for {self.model_cls.__name__}"
                raise ProgrammingError(msg)
            prepared_authored_returns = _authored_large_column_return_assignments(
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                instances=authored_instances,
                configs=delta_configs,
            )
            # See docs/design/LARGE_COLUMN_DELTA_STORAGE.rst. Re-enter lowering
            # with explicit prepared state; no runtime transformation is allowed
            # between content publication, owner insertion, and orphan cleanup.
            prepared_delta_insert = _PreparedDeltaInsertIfAbsent(
                supplemental_write_values=supplemental_values,
                authored_return_assignments=prepared_authored_returns,
            )
            write_config = _replace_upsert_many_instances(
                config_value,
                self.model_cls,
                prepared_instances,
                after_refs=config_value.after_refs | frozenset(step.ref_id for step in spill_steps),
                prepared_delta_insert=prepared_delta_insert,
            )
            write_steps = UpsertManyIntent(
                write_ref,
                self.model_cls,
                ServerRefs.object_sequence(list(prepared_instances)),
                ServerRefs.scalar(write_config),
            ).lower(ctx)
            cleanup_steps, cleanup_after_refs = build_delta_orphan_cleanup_steps(
                ref_prefix=self.ref_id,
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                configs=delta_configs,
                after_ref=write_ref,
            )
            return [
                *spill_steps,
                *write_steps,
                *cleanup_steps,
                RuntimeSourceAfterDepsStep[list[T]](
                    self.ref_id,
                    source_ref=write_ref,
                    after_refs=tuple(cleanup_after_refs),
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    sequence_value=RuntimeSourceSequenceValue(True),
                ),
            ]

        literal_instances = config_value.literal_instances
        preimage_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        preimage_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        write_after_refs = config_value.after_refs
        if ctx.emit_table_event_intents and _table_event_dispatch_needed(self.model_cls, "UPSERT"):
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import QueryExecuteStep, _QueryExecuteStepConfig

            preimage_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.preimage")
            preimage_steps.append(
                QueryExecuteStep(
                    preimage_ref,
                    self.model_cls,
                    _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                        query_spec=_build_upsert_target_match_query_spec(
                            self.model_cls,
                            literal_instances,
                            tuple(conflict_cols or ("sys_id",)),
                        ),
                        after_refs=config_value.after_refs,
                    ),
                )
            )
            write_after_refs = config_value.after_refs | frozenset({preimage_ref})
        if config_value.prepared_delta_insert is not None:
            config_value.prepared_delta_insert.require_candidate_count(
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                candidate_count=len(literal_instances),
            )
        # Ordinary upsert on backends without authoritative bulk RETURNING
        # reselects each conflict row to preserve its return-existing contract.
        # Insert-if-absent stays a bulk operation so compilation can read back
        # only submitted sys_ids that were actually inserted.
        from l2070_batching.backend_profile import DmlConflictTransport

        lacks_authoritative_bulk_returning = (
            not ctx.has_returning_clause or ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_conflict_transport is DmlConflictTransport.INSERTED_VALUES
        )
        if (
            config_value.prepared_delta_insert is None
            and lacks_authoritative_bulk_returning
            and (not config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only or _table_event_dispatch_needed(self.model_cls, "UPSERT"))
        ):
            no_returning_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = list(preimage_steps)
            no_returning_source_refs: list[str] = []
            no_returning_raw_refs: list[str] = []
            for idx, inst in enumerate(literal_instances):
                sub_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_upsert_{idx}"
                no_returning_steps.append(
                    UpsertStep(
                        ServerPlanRefId(sub_ref),
                        self.model_cls,
                        _UpsertStepConfig(
                            instance=inst,
                            conflict_columns=tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None,
                            on_conflict=on_conflict_str,
                            after_refs=write_after_refs,
                            conflict_do_nothing=config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only,
                            publish_selected_binding=True,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
                authoritative_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{sub_ref}.selected")
                no_returning_steps.extend(
                    RecordTableEventIntent(
                        ServerPlanRefId(f"{sub_ref}_subscription_dispatch"),
                        self.model_cls,
                        _RecordTableEventConfig(
                            event_type="UPSERT",
                            write_ref_id=authoritative_ref,
                            old_rows_ref=preimage_ref,
                        ),
                    ).lower(ctx),
                )
                no_returning_steps.extend(
                    _embedding_auto_queue_steps_from_raw_ref(
                        authoritative_ref,
                        self.model_cls,
                        "UPSERT",
                    ),
                )
                no_returning_source_refs.append(sub_ref)
                no_returning_raw_refs.append(f"{sub_ref}.raw")
            if config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only:
                no_returning_steps.append(
                    FlattenResultsStep(self.ref_id, no_returning_raw_refs),
                )
            else:
                no_returning_steps.append(
                    CollectResultsStep(
                        self.ref_id,
                        no_returning_source_refs,
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        collect_runtime=True,
                    ),
                )
            return no_returning_steps
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
            _resolve_write_row_plan,
            get_write_metadata_plan_from_catalog,
        )

        write_plan = get_write_metadata_plan_from_catalog(ctx.planning_catalog, self.model_cls)
        prepared_delta_state = config_value.prepared_delta_insert
        supplemental_write_values = None if prepared_delta_state is None else prepared_delta_state.supplemental_write_values
        authored_return_assignments = None if prepared_delta_state is None else prepared_delta_state.authored_return_assignments
        required_source_refs = () if prepared_delta_state is None else prepared_delta_state.required_source_refs
        supplemental_rows = supplemental_write_values or tuple(() for _instance in literal_instances)
        row_plans = tuple(
            _resolve_write_row_plan(write_plan, inst, supplemental_values=supplemental)
            for inst, supplemental in zip(literal_instances, supplemental_rows, strict=True)
        )
        if config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only:
            if conflict_cols is None:
                from l2070_batching.compilation import require_planning_catalog

                conflict_targets = tuple(
                    sorted(
                        _unique_conflict_targets_from_model(
                            model_cls=self.model_cls,
                            planning_catalog=require_planning_catalog(
                                ctx,
                                site="UpsertManyIntent targetless candidate resolution",
                            ),
                            write_plan=write_plan,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            else:
                conflict_targets = (tuple(_resolve_conflict_cols_from_plan(write_plan, conflict_cols)),)
            retained_indices = retained_upsert_candidate_indices_for_targets(row_plans, conflict_targets)
            if len(retained_indices) < len(literal_instances):
                literal_instances = tuple(literal_instances[index] for index in retained_indices)
                row_plans = tuple(row_plans[index] for index in retained_indices)
                if supplemental_write_values is not None:
                    supplemental_write_values = tuple(supplemental_write_values[index] for index in retained_indices)
                if authored_return_assignments is not None:
                    authored_return_assignments = tuple(authored_return_assignments[index] for index in retained_indices)
        row_signatures = tuple(row_plan.columns for row_plan in row_plans)
        first_signature = row_signatures[0]
        if any(signature != first_signature for signature in row_signatures[1:]):
            individual_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = list(preimage_steps)
            individual_source_refs: list[str] = []
            for idx, inst in enumerate(literal_instances):
                sub_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_upsert_{idx}"
                if authored_return_assignments is not None:
                    supplemental = None if supplemental_write_values is None else (supplemental_write_values[idx],)
                    individual_steps.append(
                        UpsertManyStep(
                            ServerPlanRefId(sub_ref),
                            self.model_cls,
                            _UpsertManyStepConfig(
                                instances=(inst,),
                                conflict_columns=(tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None),
                                on_conflict=on_conflict_str,
                                after_refs=write_after_refs,
                                write_column_count=(len(row_signatures[idx]) + 2 * len(authored_return_assignments[idx])),
                                do_nothing_inserted_only=config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only,
                                supplemental_write_values=supplemental,
                                authored_return_assignments=(authored_return_assignments[idx],),
                                required_source_refs=required_source_refs,
                                permission_context_ref=config_value.permission_context_ref,
                                permission_context_type=config_value.permission_context_type,
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                else:
                    individual_steps.append(
                        UpsertStep(
                            ServerPlanRefId(sub_ref),
                            self.model_cls,
                            _UpsertStepConfig(
                                instance=inst,
                                conflict_columns=(tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None),
                                on_conflict=on_conflict_str,
                                after_refs=write_after_refs,
                                conflict_do_nothing=config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only,
                                permission_context_ref=config_value.permission_context_ref,
                                permission_context_type=config_value.permission_context_type,
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                individual_steps.extend(
                    RecordTableEventIntent(
                        ServerPlanRefId(f"{sub_ref}_subscription_dispatch"),
                        self.model_cls,
                        _RecordTableEventConfig(
                            event_type="UPSERT",
                            write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{sub_ref}.raw"),
                            old_rows_ref=preimage_ref,
                        ),
                    ).lower(ctx),
                )
                individual_steps.extend(
                    _embedding_auto_queue_steps(
                        ServerPlanRefId(sub_ref),
                        self.model_cls,
                        "UPSERT",
                        materialized_write_ref=not ctx.has_returning_clause,
                        source_rows=cast("tuple[DatabaseObjectRow, ...]", (inst,)),
                    ),
                )
                individual_source_refs.append(sub_ref)
            if authored_return_assignments is not None:
                individual_steps.append(FlattenResultsStep(self.ref_id, individual_source_refs))
            else:
                individual_steps.append(CollectResultsStep(self.ref_id, individual_source_refs))
            return individual_steps
        write_column_count = len(first_signature)
        returning_params_per_row = 0 if authored_return_assignments is None else 2 * len(authored_return_assignments[0])
        params_per_row = write_column_count + returning_params_per_row
        rows_per_stmt = _rows_per_statement(
            ctx.backend_type,
            params_per_row,
            len(literal_instances),
        )
        if 0 < rows_per_stmt < len(literal_instances):
            chunk_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = list(preimage_steps)
            chunk_source_refs: list[str] = []
            chunk_raw_source_refs: list[str] = []
            for idx, start in enumerate(range(0, len(literal_instances), rows_per_stmt)):
                sub_ref = f"{self.ref_id}.upsert_chunk_{idx}"
                chunk_source_refs.append(sub_ref)
                chunk_raw_source_refs.append(f"{sub_ref}.raw")
                chunk_steps.append(
                    UpsertManyStep(
                        ServerPlanRefId(sub_ref),
                        self.model_cls,
                        _UpsertManyStepConfig(
                            instances=literal_instances[start : start + rows_per_stmt],
                            conflict_columns=tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None,
                            on_conflict=on_conflict_str,
                            write_column_count=params_per_row,
                            do_nothing_inserted_only=config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only,
                            after_refs=write_after_refs,
                            supplemental_write_values=(
                                None if supplemental_write_values is None else supplemental_write_values[start : start + rows_per_stmt]
                            ),
                            authored_return_assignments=(
                                None
                                if authored_return_assignments is None
                                else authored_return_assignments[start : start + rows_per_stmt]
                            ),
                            required_source_refs=required_source_refs,
                            permission_context_ref=config_value.permission_context_ref,
                            permission_context_type=config_value.permission_context_type,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
                chunk_steps.extend(
                    RecordTableEventIntent(
                        ServerPlanRefId(f"{sub_ref}_subscription_dispatch"),
                        self.model_cls,
                        _RecordTableEventConfig(
                            event_type="UPSERT",
                            write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{sub_ref}.raw"),
                            old_rows_ref=preimage_ref,
                        ),
                    ).lower(ctx),
                )
                chunk_steps.extend(
                    _embedding_auto_queue_steps_from_raw_ref(
                        ServerPlanRefId(sub_ref),
                        self.model_cls,
                        "INSERT",
                    )
                    if config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only
                    else _embedding_auto_queue_steps_from_raw_ref(
                        ServerPlanRefId(sub_ref),
                        self.model_cls,
                        "UPSERT",
                    ),
                )
            if config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only:
                # Each chunk returns only rows it inserted. Preserve the exact
                # logical sequence products so physical lowering can compose
                # them without substituting authored literals for database winners.
                chunk_steps.append(
                    FlattenResultSequencesStep(
                        self.ref_id,
                        self.model_cls,
                        tuple(
                            ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                                ServerPlanRefId(source_ref),
                                variant="object_sequence",
                                type_hint=self.model_cls,
                            )
                            for source_ref in chunk_source_refs
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            elif ctx.sql_render_dialect().supports_returning() and ctx.backend_profile.traits.supports_data_modifying_ctes:
                chunk_steps.append(FlattenResultsStep(self.ref_id, chunk_raw_source_refs))
            else:
                chunk_steps.append(
                    MaterializedFlattenResultsAfterDepsStep(
                        self.ref_id,
                        list(literal_instances),
                        chunk_source_refs,
                    ),
                )
            return chunk_steps

        return [
            *preimage_steps,
            UpsertManyStep(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                _UpsertManyStepConfig(
                    instances=literal_instances,
                    conflict_columns=tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None,
                    on_conflict=on_conflict_str,
                    write_column_count=params_per_row,
                    do_nothing_inserted_only=config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only,
                    after_refs=write_after_refs,
                    supplemental_write_values=supplemental_write_values,
                    authored_return_assignments=authored_return_assignments,
                    required_source_refs=required_source_refs,
                    permission_context_ref=config_value.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=config_value.permission_context_type,
                ),
            ),
            *RecordTableEventIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_subscription_dispatch"),
                self.model_cls,
                _RecordTableEventConfig(
                    # Named reconciliation APIs preserve the established
                    # UPSERT subscription channel even when the SQL conflict
                    # action itself is DO NOTHING.
                    event_type="UPSERT",
                    write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw"),
                    old_rows_ref=preimage_ref,
                ),
            ).lower(ctx),
            *(
                # Side effects must consume the authoritative inserted-row
                # relation, never the submitted literals. This is essential on
                # MySQL where INSERT IGNORE reports conflicts without RETURNING.
                _embedding_auto_queue_steps_from_raw_ref(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self.model_cls,
                    "INSERT",
                )
                if config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only
                else _embedding_auto_queue_steps_from_raw_ref(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self.model_cls,
                    "UPSERT",
                )
            ),
        ]


class UpsertManyCountIntent[T: DatabaseObjectRow](IntentStep[int]):
    """L4: Insert or update multiple instances when only the affected count is needed."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "upsert", "intent", "count"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.SCALAR

    def __init__(
        self: UpsertManyCountIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[T],
        instances: ObjectSequenceServerRef[T],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_UpsertManyIntentConfig[T]],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls: type[T] = model_cls
        self.instances = instances
        self.config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)

    def dependencies(self: UpsertManyCountIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.instances.dependencies() | frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in self.config.after_refs)

    def lower(self: UpsertManyCountIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import get_versioned_staging_ctx
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import (
            RuntimeCountSequenceItemsStep,
            RuntimeSourceAfterDepsStep,
            StaticValueAfterDepsStep,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import (
            QueryExecuteStep,
            _QueryExecuteStepConfig,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_validation import SessionValidationStep
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.upsert_many import (
            UpsertManyRawResultStep,
            _UpsertManyStepConfig,
        )

        config_value = self.config
        conflict_cols = list(config_value.conflict_columns) if config_value.conflict_columns else None
        on_conflict_str = config_value.on_conflict

        if not config_value.literal_instances:
            if ctx.session_id is None:
                return [
                    StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                        self.ref_id,
                        0,
                        [str(ref_id) for ref_id in config_value.after_refs],
                    ),
                ]
            count_result_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_count_result")
            revalidation_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_session_revalidation")
            return [
                StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                    count_result_ref,
                    0,
                    [str(ref_id) for ref_id in config_value.after_refs],
                ),
                SessionValidationStep(
                    revalidation_ref,
                    _session_revalidation_identity(ctx.session_id),
                    after_refs=(count_result_ref,),
                ),
                RuntimeSourceAfterDepsStep[int](
                    self.ref_id,
                    source_ref=count_result_ref,
                    after_refs=(revalidation_ref,),
                ),
            ]
        sc = get_versioned_staging_ctx(self.model_cls, ctx)
        if sc is not None:
            msg = "UpsertManyCountIntent does not support versioned staging contexts"
            raise NotImplementedError(msg)
        _reject_nonversioned_delta_upsert(self.model_cls)
        auto_queue_needed = bool(_configured_vector_indexes(self.model_cls))
        write_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_write")
        visible_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_visible_rows")
        count_result_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_count_result")
        key_columns = tuple(conflict_cols or ("sys_id",))
        readback_instances = _upsert_count_readback_instances(
            config_value.literal_instances,
            key_columns,
            config_value.on_conflict,
        )
        visible_rows_spec = replace(
            _build_upsert_target_match_query_spec(
                self.model_cls,
                readback_instances,
                key_columns,
            ),
            permission_context_ref=config_value.permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=config_value.permission_context_type,
        )
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
            UpsertManyRawResultStep(
                write_ref,
                self.model_cls,
                _UpsertManyStepConfig(
                    instances=config_value.literal_instances,
                    conflict_columns=tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None,
                    on_conflict=on_conflict_str,
                    after_refs=config_value.after_refs,
                    return_count=False,
                    permission_context_ref=config_value.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=config_value.permission_context_type,
                ),
            ),
            QueryExecuteStep(
                visible_rows_ref,
                self.model_cls,
                _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                    query_spec=cast("Any", visible_rows_spec),
                    after_refs=frozenset({write_ref}),
                ),
            ),
            RuntimeCountSequenceItemsStep(
                self.ref_id if ctx.session_id is None else count_result_ref,
                source_ref=visible_rows_ref,
            ),
        ]
        if ctx.session_id is not None:
            revalidation_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_session_revalidation")
            steps.extend(
                (
                    SessionValidationStep(
                        revalidation_ref,
                        _session_revalidation_identity(ctx.session_id),
                        after_refs=(count_result_ref,),
                    ),
                    RuntimeSourceAfterDepsStep[int](
                        self.ref_id,
                        source_ref=count_result_ref,
                        after_refs=(revalidation_ref,),
                    ),
                ),
            )
        if auto_queue_needed:
            steps.extend(
                _embedding_auto_queue_steps_from_raw_ref(
                    visible_rows_ref,
                    self.model_cls,
                    "UPSERT",
                ),
            )
        steps.extend(
            RecordTableEventIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_subscription_dispatch"),
                self.model_cls,
                _RecordTableEventConfig(
                    event_type="UPSERT",
                    write_ref_id=visible_rows_ref,
                ),
            ).lower(ctx),
        )
        return steps


class UpsertManyDeferredIntent[T](IntentStep[list[T]]):
    """L4: Upsert many from a symbolic object-sequence ref."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "upsert", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.MANY

    def __init__(
        self: UpsertManyDeferredIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        instances: ObjectSequenceServerRef[Any],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_UpsertConfigPayload],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.instances = instances
        instances_ref = self.instances.ref_id
        if instances_ref is None:
            msg = "UpsertManyDeferredIntent requires a symbolic object-sequence ref"
            raise NotImplementedError(msg)
        self.instances_ref = ServerPlanRefId(instances_ref)
        self.config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)

    def dependencies(self: UpsertManyDeferredIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.instances.dependencies()

    def lower(self: UpsertManyDeferredIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import get_versioned_staging_ctx
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.upsert_many import UpsertManyStep, _UpsertManyStepConfig

        config_value = self.config
        conflict_cols = list(config_value.conflict_columns) if config_value.conflict_columns else None
        on_conflict_str = config_value.on_conflict

        sc = get_versioned_staging_ctx(self.model_cls, ctx)
        if sc is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_versioning_extended import (
                VersionedUpsertManyBatchIntent,
                _VersionedUpsertManyBatchConfig,
            )

            return _as_steps(
                VersionedUpsertManyBatchIntent(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self.model_cls,
                    self.instances,
                    cast(
                        "Any",
                        _VersionedUpsertManyBatchConfig(
                            staging_ctx=sc,
                            conflict_columns=tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None,
                            on_conflict=cast(
                                Mapping[Any, Any] | None,
                                on_conflict_str,
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ).lower(ctx),
            )
        if config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only and any(
            config.delta_storage is not None and config.delta_storage.enabled for config in get_large_column_configs(self.model_cls)
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"Delta insert-if-absent for {self.model_cls.__name__} requires a literal candidate sequence; "
                "symbolic rows cannot be content-chunked during static planning",
            )
        _reject_nonversioned_delta_upsert(self.model_cls)
        return [
            UpsertManyStep(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                _UpsertManyStepConfig(
                    instances_ref=self.instances_ref,
                    conflict_columns=tuple(conflict_cols) if conflict_cols is not None else None,
                    on_conflict=on_conflict_str,
                    do_nothing_inserted_only=config_value.do_nothing_inserted_only,
                    permission_context_ref=config_value.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=config_value.permission_context_type,
                ),
            ),
            *RecordTableEventIntent(
