def _staged_edge_touch_exists(
    *,
    staged_table: SqlTableName,
    branch_binding: _EdgeBranchBinding,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    type_name_filter: TypeNameFilter,
    publish_scope: PublishScopeDescriptor | None,
    branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId] | None,
) -> SqlExists:
    staged_source = _staged_read_table(ctx, staged_table, scope=publish_scope)
    conditions: list[SqlRenderable]
    if publish_scope is not None:
        if branch_ref is None:
            msg = "Publish-scoped edge validation requires a branch server reference"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        selector = _selector_from_publish_scope(scope=publish_scope, branch_id=branch_ref)
        conditions = [
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                branch_binding.branch_param,
            ),
            selector.match_expr(column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), ctx=ctx),
            selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=str(staged_source),
                outer_qualifier=str(staged_source),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
        ]
    else:
        conditions = [
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                branch_binding.branch_param,
            ),
        ]
    _append_optional_type_name_filter(
        conditions,
        column_ref=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name")),
        type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
    )
    return SqlExists(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableIdent(staged_source)),
            where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*conditions)),
            limit=1,
        ),
    )


def _staged_edge_scope_touch_exists(
    *,
    staged_table: SqlTableName,
    sparse_table: SqlTableName,
    branch_binding: _EdgeBranchBinding,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    type_name_filter: TypeNameFilter,
    publish_scope: PublishScopeDescriptor | None,
    branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId] | None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    direct_touch = _staged_edge_touch_exists(
        staged_table=staged_table,
        branch_binding=branch_binding,
        ctx=ctx,
        type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
        publish_scope=publish_scope,
        branch_ref=branch_ref,
    )
    if not type_name_filter:
        return direct_touch

    staged_alias = "scope_staged"
    sparse_alias = "scope_sparse"
    staged_source = _staged_read_table(ctx, staged_table, scope=publish_scope)
    sparse_source = SqlTableName(ctx.overlay_cte_by_table.get(str(sparse_table), str(sparse_table)))
    staged_conditions: list[SqlRenderable]
    if publish_scope is not None:
        if branch_ref is None:
            msg = "Publish-scoped edge validation gate requires a branch server reference"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        selector = _selector_from_publish_scope(scope=publish_scope, branch_id=branch_ref)
        staged_conditions = [
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), staged_alias),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                branch_binding.branch_param,
            ),
            selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier=staged_alias,
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=str(staged_source),
                outer_qualifier=staged_alias,
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
        ]
    else:
        staged_conditions = [
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=staged_alias),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                branch_binding.branch_param,
            ),
        ]
    prior_scope_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            branch_binding.branch_param,
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=staged_alias),
        ),
    ]
    _append_optional_type_name_filter(
        prior_scope_conditions,
        column_ref=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
        type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
    )
    staged_conditions.append(
        SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
                from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(sparse_source), SqlAliasName(sparse_alias))),
                where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*prior_scope_conditions)),
                limit=1,
            ),
        ),
    )
    prior_touch = SqlExists(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_source), SqlAliasName(staged_alias))),
            where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*staged_conditions)),
            limit=1,
        ),
    )
    return sql_or(direct_touch, prior_touch)


def _staged_node_change_touch_exists(
    *,
    node_staged_tables: Sequence[SqlTableName],
    branch_binding: _EdgeBranchBinding,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    publish_scope: PublishScopeDescriptor | None,
    branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
) -> SqlRenderable:
    exists_exprs: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for table_index, node_staged_table in enumerate(node_staged_tables):
        staged_source = _staged_read_table(ctx, node_staged_table, scope=publish_scope)
        staged_alias = SqlAliasName(f"deleted_node_touch_{table_index}")
        if publish_scope is None:
            conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_binding.branch_param,
                ),
            ]
        else:
            selector = _selector_from_publish_scope(scope=publish_scope, branch_id=branch_ref)
            conditions = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_binding.branch_param,
                ),
                selector.match_expr(
                    column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                    qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                selector.latest_row_expr(
                    staged_table=str(staged_source),
                    outer_qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
            ]
        exists_exprs.append(
            SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
                    from_clause=SqlFrom(
                        SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_source), staged_alias),
                    ),
                    where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*conditions)),
                    limit=1,
                ),
            ),
        )
    return sql_or(*exists_exprs) if exists_exprs else SqlParam(False)


class _SelectedPublicationRows:
    """Statement-owned effective rows, shared before concrete-type filtering."""

    def __init__(
        self: _SelectedPublicationRows,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
        branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
        owner: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> None:
        self._ctx = ctx
        self._branch_ref = branch_ref
        self._owner = owner
        self._sources: dict[tuple[SqlTableName, PublishScopeDescriptor], SqlTableName] = {}
        self._columns: dict[SqlTableName, set[SqlColumnName]] = {}

    def source(
        self: _SelectedPublicationRows,
        table: SqlTableName,
        scope: PublishScopeDescriptor,
        columns: Sequence[SqlColumnName],
    ) -> SqlTableName:
        key = (table, scope)
        name = self._sources.get(key)
        if name is None:
            name = SqlTableName(
                bounded_identifier_with_suffix(
                    SchemaObjectName(str(self._owner)),
                    SchemaObjectSuffix(f"_selected_{len(self._sources)}"),
                )
            )
            self._sources[key] = name
            self._columns[name] = set()
        self._columns[name].update(columns)
        return name

    def _definition(
        self: _SelectedPublicationRows,
        table: SqlTableName,
        scope: PublishScopeDescriptor,
        name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> TreeSqlCteDefinition:
        source = _staged_read_table(self._ctx, table, scope=scope)
        selector = _selector_from_publish_scope(scope=scope, branch_id=self._branch_ref)
        alias = SqlAliasName("selected_publication_row")
        branch = _normalize_edge_branch_binding(lazy_branch=self._branch_ref, ctx=self._ctx)
        query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(column, str(alias)) for column in sorted(self._columns[name])]),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(source), alias)),
            where=SqlWhereClause(
                sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(alias)),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        branch.branch_param,
                    ),
                    selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=str(alias),
                        ctx=self._ctx,
                    ),
                )
            ),
        )
        if not is_latest_wins_staged_source(str(source), self._ctx):
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlWindow
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import OrderDirection

            selected_columns = sorted(self._columns[name])
            ranked = SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        *(SqlColumnRef(column, str(alias)) for column in selected_columns),
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlWindow(
                                func=SqlFuncCall("DENSE_RANK", []),
                                partition_by=[SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(alias))],
                                order_by=[
                                    SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), str(alias)), OrderDirection.DESC)
                                    for column in ("sys_staged_commit_id", "sys_deleted")
                                ],
                            ),
                            SqlAliasName("publication_rank"),
                        ),
                    ]
                ),
                from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(source), alias)),
                where=SqlWhereClause(
                    sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(alias)), BinaryOp.EQ, branch.branch_param),
                        selector.match_expr(column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), qualifier=str(alias), ctx=self._ctx),
                    )
                ),
            )
            query = SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(column) for column in selected_columns]),
                from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(ranked, SqlTableName("ranked_selection"))),
                where=SqlWhereClause(SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("publication_rank")), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(1))),
            )
        return TreeSqlCteDefinition(
            str(name),
            query,
            materialized=True,
            dependency_names=frozenset({str(source)}) if source != table else frozenset(),
        )

    def wrap(self: _SelectedPublicationRows, query: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
        definitions = [self._definition(table, scope, name) for (table, scope), name in self._sources.items()]
        return SqlCte(definitions, query) if definitions else query


def _staged_edge_sys_ids_stmt(
    *,
    staged_table: SqlTableName,
    branch_binding: _EdgeBranchBinding,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    type_name_filter: TypeNameFilter,
    publish_scope: PublishScopeDescriptor | None,
    branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId] | None,
    selected_rows: _SelectedPublicationRows | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    staged_source = _staged_read_table(ctx, staged_table, scope=publish_scope)
    staged_alias = SqlAliasName("active_edge")
    conditions: list[SqlRenderable]
    if selected_rows is not None and publish_scope is not None:
        columns = [SqlColumnName("sys_id")]
        if type_name_filter:
            columns.append(SqlColumnName("type_name"))
        staged_source = selected_rows.source(staged_table, publish_scope, columns)
        conditions = []
    elif publish_scope is not None:
        if branch_ref is None:
            msg = "Publish-scoped edge candidates require a branch server reference"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        selector = _selector_from_publish_scope(scope=publish_scope, branch_id=branch_ref)
        conditions = [
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                branch_binding.branch_param,
            ),
            selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=str(staged_source),
                outer_qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
        ]
    else:
        conditions = [
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=str(staged_alias)),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                branch_binding.branch_param,
            ),
        ]
    _append_optional_type_name_filter(
        conditions,
        column_ref=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), qualifier=str(staged_alias)),
        type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
    )
    return SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=str(staged_alias))],
        ),
        from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_source), staged_alias)),
        where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*conditions)) if conditions else None,
    )


def _staged_changed_node_keys_stmt(
    *,
    node_staged_tables: Sequence[SqlTableName],
    branch_binding: _EdgeBranchBinding,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    publish_scope: PublishScopeDescriptor | None,
    branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId] | None,
    selected_rows: _SelectedPublicationRows | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    deleted_node_queries: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for table_index, node_staged_table in enumerate(node_staged_tables):
        staged_source = _staged_read_table(ctx, node_staged_table, scope=publish_scope)
        staged_alias = SqlAliasName(f"active_deleted_node_{table_index}")
        conditions: list[SqlRenderable]
        if selected_rows is not None and publish_scope is not None:
            staged_source = selected_rows.source(
                node_staged_table,
                publish_scope,
                tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in ("sys_id", "graph_sys_id", "sys_deleted")),
            )
            conditions = []
        elif publish_scope is not None:
            if branch_ref is None:
                msg = "Publish-scoped node deletion candidates require a branch server reference"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            selector = _selector_from_publish_scope(scope=publish_scope, branch_id=branch_ref)
            conditions = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(staged_alias)),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_binding.branch_param,
                ),
                selector.match_expr(
                    column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                    qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                selector.latest_row_expr(
                    staged_table=str(staged_source),
                    outer_qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
            ]
        else:
            conditions = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=str(staged_alias)),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_binding.branch_param,
                ),
            ]
        deleted_node_queries.append(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), qualifier=str(staged_alias)),
                        SqlColumnAlias(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=str(staged_alias)),
                            SqlAliasName("node_sys_id"),
                        ),
                        SqlColumnAlias(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=str(staged_alias)),
                            SqlAliasName("node_deleted"),
                        ),
                    ],
                ),
                from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_source), staged_alias)),
                where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*conditions)) if conditions else None,
            ),
        )
    return _union_renderables(deleted_node_queries) if deleted_node_queries else None


def _dangling_candidate_condition(
    *,
    edge_id: SqlColumnRef,
    source_id: SqlColumnRef,
    edge_graph_id: SqlColumnRef,
    target_id: SqlColumnRef,
    staged_edge_ids: SqlRenderable,
    deleted_node_keys: SqlRenderable | None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    staged_edge_changed = SqlIn(edge_id, staged_edge_ids)
    if deleted_node_keys is None:
        return staged_edge_changed

    def _endpoint_deleted(endpoint_id: SqlColumnRef, *, alias: SqlAliasName) -> SqlExists:
        return SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
                from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(deleted_node_keys, SqlTableName(alias))),
                where=SqlWhereClause(
                    sql_and(
                        sql_or(
                            SqlUnaryOp(
                                UnaryOp.NOT,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_deleted"), qualifier=str(alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), qualifier=str(alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                edge_graph_id,
                            ),
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), qualifier=str(alias)),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            endpoint_id,
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )

    return sql_or(
        staged_edge_changed,
        _endpoint_deleted(source_id, alias=SqlAliasName("deleted_source")),
        _endpoint_deleted(target_id, alias=SqlAliasName("deleted_target")),
    )


_BRANCH_PHYSICAL_KEYS_TABLE = SqlTableName("sys_branch_physical_keys")
_GRAPH_NODE_PHYSICAL_KEYS_TABLE = SqlTableName("sys_graph_node_physical_keys")


def _dense_deleted_node_keys_stmt(
    deleted_node_keys: SqlRenderable,
    branch_binding: _EdgeBranchBinding,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Resolve each deleted graph/node key before probing compact adjacency."""
    node_source = SqlTableName(ctx.overlay_cte_by_table.get(_GRAPH_NODE_PHYSICAL_KEYS_TABLE, _GRAPH_NODE_PHYSICAL_KEYS_TABLE))
    branch_source = SqlTableName(ctx.overlay_cte_by_table.get(_BRANCH_PHYSICAL_KEYS_TABLE, _BRANCH_PHYSICAL_KEYS_TABLE))
    return SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), "deleted_key"),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), "deleted_key"),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_key"), "node_key_map"),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), "node_key_map"), SqlAliasName("node_key")),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), "branch_key_map"), SqlAliasName("branch_ord")),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_deleted"), "deleted_key"),
            ]
        ),
        from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(deleted_node_keys, SqlTableName("deleted_key"))),
        joins=[
            SqlJoin(JoinKind.CROSS, SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(node_source), SqlAliasName("node_key_map"))),
            SqlJoin(JoinKind.CROSS, SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(branch_source), SqlAliasName("branch_key_map"))),
        ],
        where=SqlWhereClause(
            sql_and(
                sql_or(
                    SqlUnaryOp(
                        UnaryOp.NOT,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_deleted"), "deleted_key"),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), "node_key_map"),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), "deleted_key"),
                    ),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), "node_key_map"),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), "deleted_key"),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_sys_id"), "branch_key_map"),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_binding.branch_param,
                ),
            )
        ),
    )


def _branch_tip_affected_edge_ids_stmt(
    *,
    edge_tip_source: SqlTableName,
    branch_binding: _EdgeBranchBinding,
    lookup_transport: GraphCandidateLookupTransport,
    dense_keys: bool,
    staged_edge_ids: SqlRenderable,
    deleted_node_keys: SqlRenderable | None,
    type_name_filter: TypeNameFilter,
    revision_cutoff: RevisionId | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Probe final TIP adjacency and retain each candidate's exact endpoint key.

    Distinct candidate records prevent MariaDB from converting a union inside
    IN into correlated probes against a full edge scan. A changed edge has null
    endpoint markers; incident candidates are rechecked after identity lookup.
    """
    candidates: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), "selected_edge"),
                    SqlColumnAlias(SqlCast(SQL_EXPR_NULL, SqlCastTargetType(base_type="UUID")), SqlAliasName("candidate_graph_sys_id")),
                    SqlColumnAlias(SqlCast(SQL_EXPR_NULL, SqlCastTargetType(base_type="UUID")), SqlAliasName("candidate_node_sys_id")),
                ]
            ),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(staged_edge_ids, SqlTableName("selected_edge"))),
        )
    ]
    if deleted_node_keys is not None:
        for endpoint in ("source_sys_id", "target_sys_id"):
            conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), "incident"),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_binding.branch_param,
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), "incident"),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), "deleted"),
                ),
            ]
            if dense_keys:
                # Exact UUIDs travel with each candidate and are checked after
                # final identity resolution, so they cannot select a broad UUID index.
                conditions = []
                for physical, candidate in (
                    ("branch_ord", "branch_ord"),
                    ("graph_key", "graph_key"),
                ):
                    conditions.append(
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(physical), "incident"),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(candidate), "deleted"),
                        )
                    )
            endpoint_column = ("source_node_key" if endpoint == "source_sys_id" else "target_node_key") if dense_keys else endpoint
            endpoint_ref = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(endpoint_column), "incident")
            deleted_key_ref = SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName("node_key" if dense_keys else "node_sys_id"),
                "deleted",
            )
            if lookup_transport is GraphCandidateLookupTransport.PARAMETERIZED_LATERAL and revision_cutoff is None:
                # A one-point range preserves endpoint ordering in the planner.
                # Stale statistics can otherwise favor the opposite index prefix.
                conditions.extend(
                    [
                        SqlBinaryOp(endpoint_ref, BinaryOp.GE, deleted_key_ref),
                        SqlBinaryOp(endpoint_ref, BinaryOp.LE, deleted_key_ref),
                    ]
                )
            else:
                conditions.append(SqlBinaryOp(endpoint_ref, BinaryOp.EQ, deleted_key_ref))
            _append_optional_type_name_filter(
                conditions,
                column_ref=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), "incident"),
                type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
            )
            if revision_cutoff is not None:
                conditions.extend(
                    [
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"), "incident"), BinaryOp.LE, SqlParam(revision_cutoff)
                        ),
                        sql_or(
                            SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), "incident")),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), "incident"),
                                BinaryOp.GT,
                                SqlParam(revision_cutoff),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ]
                )
            incident_source: SqlRenderable = SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(edge_tip_source), SqlAliasName("incident"))
            if lookup_transport is GraphCandidateLookupTransport.PARAMETERIZED_LATERAL:
                incident_query: SqlRenderable = SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), "incident"),
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), "incident"),
                        ],
                    ),
                    from_clause=SqlFrom(incident_source),
                    where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*conditions)),
                    order_by=SqlOrderByClause([SqlOrderByItem(endpoint_ref)]),
                    offset=0,
                )
                if revision_cutoff is not None:
                    incident_query = SqlUnionAll(
                        [
                            SqlSelect(
                                select=SqlStar(),
                                from_clause=SqlFrom(
                                    SqlSubqueryTableRef(
                                        SqlSelect(
                                            select=SqlSelectList(
                                                [
                                                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), "incident"),
                                                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), "incident"),
                                                ],
                                            ),
                                            from_clause=SqlFrom(incident_source),
                                            where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*conditions[:-1], end_condition)),
                                            order_by=SqlOrderByClause(
                                                [
                                                    SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), "incident")),
                                                    SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"), "incident")),
                                                ]
                                            ),
                                            offset=0,
                                        ),
                                        SqlTableName("window_probe"),
                                    )
                                ),
                            )
                            for end_condition in (
                                SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), "incident")),
                                SqlBinaryOp(
                                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), "incident"),
                                    BinaryOp.GT,
                                    SqlParam(revision_cutoff),
                                ),
                            )
                        ]
                    )
                    incident_query = SqlSelect(
                        select=SqlStar(),
                        from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(incident_query, SqlTableName("incident_windows"))),
                        offset=0,
                    )
                incident_source = SqlSubqueryTableRef(incident_query, SqlTableName("incident"), lateral=True)
            candidates.append(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), "incident"),
                            SqlColumnAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), "deleted"), SqlAliasName("candidate_graph_sys_id")
                            ),
                            SqlColumnAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), "deleted"), SqlAliasName("candidate_node_sys_id")),
                        ]
                    ),
                    from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(deleted_node_keys, SqlTableName("deleted"))),
                    joins=[SqlJoin(JoinKind.CROSS, incident_source)],
                    where=None
                    if lookup_transport is GraphCandidateLookupTransport.PARAMETERIZED_LATERAL
                    else SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*conditions)),
                )
            )

            changed_incident = SqlAliasName("changed_incident")
            changed_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_deleted"), "deleted")),
            ]
            if dense_keys:
                changed_conditions.append(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_ord"), str(changed_incident)),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_ord"), "deleted"),
                    )
                )
                changed_endpoint = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(endpoint_column), str(changed_incident))
                changed_key = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_key"), "deleted")
            else:
                changed_conditions.append(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(changed_incident)),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        branch_binding.branch_param,
                    )
                )
                changed_endpoint = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(endpoint), str(changed_incident))
                changed_key = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), "deleted")
            changed_conditions.append(SqlBinaryOp(changed_endpoint, BinaryOp.EQ, changed_key))
            _append_optional_type_name_filter(
                changed_conditions,
                column_ref=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), str(changed_incident)),
                type_name_filter=type_name_filter,
            )
            if revision_cutoff is not None:
                changed_conditions.extend(
                    [
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"), str(changed_incident)),
                            BinaryOp.LE,
                            SqlParam(revision_cutoff),
                        ),
                        sql_or(
                            SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), str(changed_incident))),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), str(changed_incident)),
                                BinaryOp.GT,
                                SqlParam(revision_cutoff),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ]
                )
            candidates.append(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(changed_incident)),
                            SqlColumnAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(changed_incident)),
                                SqlAliasName("candidate_graph_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlColumnAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), "deleted"),
                                SqlAliasName("candidate_node_sys_id"),
                            ),
                        ]
                    ),
                    from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(deleted_node_keys, SqlTableName("deleted"))),
                    joins=[
                        SqlJoin(
                            JoinKind.CROSS,
                            SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(edge_tip_source), changed_incident),
                        )
                    ],
                    where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*changed_conditions)),
                )
            )
    return SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), "candidates")
                for column in ("sys_id", "candidate_graph_sys_id", "candidate_node_sys_id")
            ]
        ),
        from_clause=SqlFrom(
            SqlSubqueryTableRef(
                _union_renderables(candidates),
                SqlTableName("candidates"),
            )
        ),
        distinct=True,
    )


def _covered_historical_incident_candidates(
    *,
    fallback: SqlRenderable,
    staged_edge_ids: SqlRenderable,
    deleted_node_keys: SqlRenderable,
    edge_base_table: SqlTableName,
    edge_sparse_table: SqlTableName,
    revision_branch_index_table: SqlTableName,
    revision_cutoff: RevisionId,
    lookup_transport: GraphCandidateLookupTransport,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Use postings only when every applicable branch has explicit coverage."""
    digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{edge_base_table}:{revision_cutoff}".encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    ancestors_name = SqlCteName(f"incident_ancestors_{digest}")
    cutoffs_name = SqlTableName(f"incident_cutoffs_{digest}")
    ancestors = lower_revision_ancestry_cte(
        cte_name=ancestors_name,
        seed=revision_cutoff,
        revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
        max_depth=None,
        track_depth=False,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.incident_history_candidates import (
        incident_ancestor_cutoff_query,
        incident_history_candidate_query,
    )

    cutoffs = incident_ancestor_cutoff_query(
        SqlSelect(select=[SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("rev_id"))], from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(str(ancestors_name)))),
        SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(revision_branch_index_table)),
        SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_revision_physical_keys"))),
        cte_prefix=SqlTableName(f"incident_scope_{digest}"),
    )
    posting_candidates = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlStar(),
        from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(
            incident_history_candidate_query(
                SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_graph_incident_postings"))),
                SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(cutoffs_name)),
                deleted_node_keys,
                edge_table=edge_base_table,
                cte_prefix=SqlTableName(f"incident_candidates_{digest}"),
                lateral_probes=lookup_transport is GraphCandidateLookupTransport.PARAMETERIZED_LATERAL,
            ),
            SqlTableName("posting_candidates"),
        ),
    )
    selected_candidates = SqlSelect(
        select=[
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), "selected_edge"),
            SqlColumnAlias(SqlCast(SQL_EXPR_NULL, SqlCastTargetType(base_type="UUID")), SqlAliasName("candidate_graph_sys_id")),
            SqlColumnAlias(SqlCast(SQL_EXPR_NULL, SqlCastTargetType(base_type="UUID")), SqlAliasName("candidate_node_sys_id")),
        ],
        from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(staged_edge_ids, SqlTableName("selected_edge")),
    )
    coverage = "incident_coverage"
    cutoff = "incident_cutoff"
    missing_coverage = SqlExists(
        SqlSelect(
            select=[SqlParam(1)],
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(cutoffs_name), SqlAliasName(cutoff)),
            where=SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlParam(1)],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_graph_incident_posting_coverage")), SqlAliasName(coverage)),
                    where=sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), coverage),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), cutoff),
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("edge_table_name"), coverage), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(str(edge_base_table))
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                negated=True,
            ),
        )
    )

    def gated(source: SqlRenderable, *, require_missing: bool) -> SqlSelect:
        return SqlSelect(
            select=SqlStar(),
            from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(source, SqlTableName("candidate_source")),
            where=missing_coverage
            if require_missing
            else SqlExists(SqlSelect(select=[SqlParam(1)], where=missing_coverage), negated=True),
        )

    historical_edge_alias = SqlAliasName("historical_changed_edge")
    historical_node_alias = SqlAliasName("historical_changed_node")
    historical_changed_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlUnaryOp(
            UnaryOp.NOT,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_deleted"), str(historical_node_alias)),
        ),
        SqlIn(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"), str(historical_edge_alias)),
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("rev_id"))],
                from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(str(ancestors_name))),
            ),
        ),
        sql_or(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(historical_edge_alias)),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(historical_node_alias)),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(historical_edge_alias)),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(historical_node_alias)),
            ),
        ),
    ]
    historical_changed_candidates = SqlSelect(
        select=[
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(historical_edge_alias)),
            SqlColumnAlias(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(historical_edge_alias)),
                SqlAliasName("candidate_graph_sys_id"),
            ),
            SqlColumnAlias(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(historical_node_alias)),
                SqlAliasName("candidate_node_sys_id"),
            ),
        ],
        from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(edge_sparse_table), historical_edge_alias),
        joins=[
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.CROSS,
                SqlSubqueryTableRef(deleted_node_keys, SqlTableName(historical_node_alias)),
            ),
        ],
        where=sql_and(*historical_changed_conditions),
        distinct=True,
    )
    changed_node_fallback = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlStar(),
        from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(fallback, SqlTableName("changed_node_fallback")),
        where=SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlParam(1)],
                from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(deleted_node_keys, SqlTableName("changed_node")),
                where=SqlUnaryOp(
                    UnaryOp.NOT,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_deleted"), "changed_node"),
                ),
                limit=1,
            ),
        ),
    )
    covered = _union_renderables(
        (selected_candidates, posting_candidates, historical_changed_candidates, changed_node_fallback),
    )
    uncovered = _union_renderables((fallback, historical_changed_candidates))
    return SqlCte(
        [ancestors, TreeSqlCteDefinition(str(cutoffs_name), cutoffs)],
        SqlUnionAll([gated(covered, require_missing=False), gated(uncovered, require_missing=True)]),
        recursive=True,
    )

def _auxiliary_ctes_for_staged_reads(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    table_names: Sequence[str],
    dependency_refs: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
) -> list[tuple[str, object]] | None:
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
    seen_aliases: set[str] = set()
    for ref_id, query in collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, dependency_refs) or ():
        if ref_id in seen_aliases:
            continue
        seen_aliases.add(ref_id)
        auxiliary_ctes.append((ref_id, query))
    for table_name in table_names:
        if not str(table_name).endswith("_staged"):
            continue
        staged_source = resolve_staged_source(SqlTableName(table_name), ctx)
        for cte_ref in ctx.cte_refs.values():
            if (
                isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference)
                and cte_ref.ref_id == staged_source
                and cte_ref.auxiliary_query is not None
                and cte_ref.ref_id not in seen_aliases
            ):
                seen_aliases.add(cte_ref.ref_id)
                auxiliary_ctes.append((cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query))
                break
    return auxiliary_ctes or None


def _prepend_auxiliary_ctes_to_select_with_cte(
    stmt: SqlRenderable,
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, object]] | None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if not auxiliary_ctes:
        return stmt
    return cast("SqlRenderable", _DialectAwareAuxiliaryCteSelect(stmt, tuple(auxiliary_ctes)))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _DialectAwareAuxiliaryCteSelect:
    stmt: SqlRenderable
    auxiliary_ctes: tuple[tuple[str, object], ...]

    def render(self: _DialectAwareAuxiliaryCteSelect, dialect: Any) -> Any:
        return _build_auxiliary_cte_select(
            self.stmt,
            self.auxiliary_ctes,
            materialized=dialect.serverplan_auxiliary_cte_materialized_hint(),
        ).render(dialect)


def _build_auxiliary_cte_select(
    stmt: SqlRenderable,
    auxiliary_ctes: tuple[tuple[str, object], ...],
    *,
    materialized: bool | None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if isinstance(stmt, SqlSelectWithCte):
        with_clause = stmt._with_clause
        select = stmt._select
        recursive = with_clause._recursive
        existing_ctes = list(with_clause._ctes)
    else:
        select = stmt
        recursive = False
        existing_ctes = []
    return SqlSelectWithCte(
        SqlWithClause(
            [
                *(SqlCteDefinition(alias, cast(SqlRenderable, query), materialized=materialized) for alias, query in auxiliary_ctes),
                *existing_ctes,
            ],
            recursive=recursive,
        ),
        select,
    )


def _visible_node_ids_stmt(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    node_sparse_table: SqlTableName,
    node_staged_table: SqlTableName,
    branch_binding: _EdgeBranchBinding,
    revision_id_raw: RevisionId,
    publish_scope: PublishScopeDescriptor | None = None,
    branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId] | None = None,
    candidate_ids: SqlRenderable | None = None,
) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, tuple[tuple[str, SqlRenderable], ...]]:
    """Return visible node ids for the branch, plus CTEs the statement must define.

    A branch whose tip is not confirmed materialized reads its nodes through
    revision ancestry, because rows inherited from a branch point are physically
    stored under the ancestor branch. Filtering those by ``branch_id`` equality
    hides them, and edge validation then reports a live node as dangling.
    """
    node_sparse_name = str(node_sparse_table)
    staged_source = _staged_read_table(ctx, node_staged_table, scope=publish_scope)

    branch_cond = SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        branch_binding.branch_param,
    )
    if publish_scope is not None:
        if branch_ref is None:
            msg = "Publish-scoped node visibility requires a branch server reference"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        selector = _selector_from_publish_scope(scope=publish_scope, branch_id=branch_ref)
        selected_condition = sql_and(
            branch_cond,
            selector.match_expr(column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), ctx=ctx),
        )
        latest_condition = selector.latest_row_expr(
            staged_table=str(staged_source),
            outer_qualifier=str(staged_source),
            ctx=ctx,
        )
    else:
        selected_condition = branch_cond
        latest_condition = SqlParam(True)
    staged_ids = _select_sys_id_stmt(
        table_name=staged_source,
        where_conditions=(selected_condition,),
    )

    def select_node_keys(
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        *,
        where_conditions: Sequence[SqlRenderable],
    ) -> SqlSelect:
        return SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id")),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                ],
            ),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableIdent(table_name)),
            where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*where_conditions)),
        )

    staged_visible = select_node_keys(
        staged_source,
        where_conditions=(
            selected_condition,
            latest_condition,
            SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"))),
            *((SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), candidate_ids),) if candidate_ids is not None else ()),
        ),
    )
    not_staged = SqlIn(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
        staged_ids,
        negated=True,
    )
    extra_ctes: tuple[tuple[str, SqlRenderable], ...] = ()
    sparse_without_staged: SqlRenderable
    if ctx.branch_tip_materialized:
        sparse_without_staged = select_node_keys(
            node_sparse_table,
            where_conditions=(
                _sparse_visibility_expr(branch_binding, revision_id_raw),
                not_staged,
                *((SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), candidate_ids),) if candidate_ids is not None else ()),
            ),
        )
        if (
            candidate_ids is not None
            and ctx.backend_profile.traits.graph_candidate_lookup_transport is GraphCandidateLookupTransport.PARAMETERIZED_LATERAL
        ):
            probe: SqlRenderable = select_node_keys(
                node_sparse_table,
                where_conditions=(
                    _sparse_visibility_expr(branch_binding, revision_id_raw),
                    not_staged,
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), "candidate_node")
                    ),
                ),
            )
            probe = SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), "visible_candidate_node"),
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), "visible_candidate_node"),
                    ],
                ),
                from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(probe, SqlTableName("visible_candidate_node"))),
                offset=0,
            )
            sparse_without_staged = SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), "node_match"),
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), "node_match"),
                    ],
                ),
                from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(candidate_ids, SqlTableName("candidate_node"))),
                joins=[SqlJoin(JoinKind.CROSS, SqlSubqueryTableRef(probe, SqlTableName("node_match"), lateral=True))],
            )
    else:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_sparse import (
            SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned,
        )

        candidate_where = (
            SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), node_sparse_name), candidate_ids) if candidate_ids is not None else None
        )
        ancestry = SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned(
            table=node_sparse_table,
            revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
            branch_id=branch_binding.branch_param,
            revision_id=SqlParam(revision_id_raw),
            include_deleted=False,
            extra_where=candidate_where,
            ranking_where=candidate_where,
        )
        ancestor_ctes, visible_body = ancestry.split_for_outer_cte()
        visible_name = bounded_identifier_with_suffix(
            SchemaObjectName(node_sparse_name),
            SchemaObjectSuffix("_edge_visible"),
        )
        extra_ctes = (
            *((str(cte.name), cte.query) for cte in ancestor_ctes),
            (visible_name, visible_body),
        )
        sparse_without_staged = select_node_keys(
            SqlTableName(visible_name),
            where_conditions=(not_staged,),
        )
    return _union_renderables([staged_visible, sparse_without_staged]), extra_ctes


def _union_renderables(queries: Sequence[SqlRenderable]) -> SqlRenderable:
    if not queries:
        return SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlCast(SQL_EXPR_NULL, SqlCastTargetType(base_type="UUID")),
                        alias=SqlAliasName("sys_id"),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            where=SqlFalseCondition(),
        )
    if len(queries) == 1:
        return queries[0]
    return SqlUnionAll(list(queries))
