            tables.add(SqlTableName(self._publish_scope.staged_commits_table))
        return frozenset(str(table) for table in tables)

    def tables_written(self: CheckGraphIdentityBatchStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self: CheckGraphIdentityBatchStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        branch_binding = _normalize_edge_branch_binding(lazy_branch=self._lazy_branch, ctx=ctx)
        selector = (
            _selector_from_publish_scope(
                scope=self._publish_scope,
                branch_id=self._lazy_branch,
            )
            if self._publish_scope is not None
            else None
        )

        def selected_conditions(alias: SqlAliasName, staged_source: SqlTableName) -> list[SqlRenderable]:
            conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(alias)),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_binding.branch_param,
                ),
            ]
            if selector is not None:
                conditions.extend(
                    (
                        selector.match_expr(
                            column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                            qualifier=str(alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        selector.latest_row_expr(
                            staged_table=str(staged_source),
                            outer_qualifier=str(alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            return conditions

        violations: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        for index, table in enumerate(self._tables):
            selected_alias = SqlAliasName(f"identity_selected_{index}")
            prior_alias = SqlAliasName(f"identity_prior_{index}")
            staged_source = _staged_read_table(
                ctx,
                table.staged_table,
                scope=self._publish_scope,
            )

            def selected_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
                return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(selected_alias))

            violation_body = SqlSelect(
                select=[
                    SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(str(table.base_table)), SqlAliasName("edge_base")),
                    SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam("graph_identity"), SqlAliasName("result_kind")),
                    SqlColumnAlias(selected_col("sys_id"), SqlAliasName("source_sys_id")),
                    SqlColumnAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(prior_alias)),
                        SqlAliasName("target_sys_id"),
                    ),
                ],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_source), selected_alias),
                joins=[
                    SqlJoin(
                        JoinKind.INNER,
                        SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(table.sparse_table), prior_alias),
                        on=SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(prior_alias)),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            selected_col("sys_id"),
                        ),
                    ),
                ],
                where=sql_and(
                    *selected_conditions(selected_alias, staged_source),
                    SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, selected_col("sys_deleted")),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        selected_col("graph_sys_id"),
                        BinaryOp.NE,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(prior_alias)),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            violations.append(violation_body)

            if table.has_type_name:
                discriminator_violation = SqlSelect(
                    select=[
                        SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(str(table.base_table)), SqlAliasName("edge_base")),
                        SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam("polymorphic_discriminator"), SqlAliasName("result_kind")),
                        SqlColumnAlias(selected_col("sys_id"), SqlAliasName("source_sys_id")),
                        SqlColumnAlias(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(prior_alias)),
                            SqlAliasName("target_sys_id"),
                        ),
                    ],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_source), selected_alias),
                    joins=[
                        SqlJoin(
                            JoinKind.INNER,
                            SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(table.sparse_table), prior_alias),
                            on=SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(prior_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                selected_col("sys_id"),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ],
                    where=sql_and(
                        *selected_conditions(selected_alias, staged_source),
                        SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, selected_col("sys_deleted")),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            selected_col("type_name"),
                            BinaryOp.NE,
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), str(prior_alias)),
                        ),
                    ),
                )
                violations.append(discriminator_violation)

        violations_alias = SqlTableName("graph_identity_violations")
        grammar = SqlSelect(
            select=[
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("edge_base"), str(violations_alias)),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("result_kind"), str(violations_alias)),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(violations_alias)),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(violations_alias)),
            ],
            from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(_union_renderables(violations), violations_alias),
            limit=1,
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=_edge_violation_post_op(
                "graph member",
                violation_kind="graph_identity",
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=_auxiliary_ctes_for_staged_reads(
                ctx,
                tuple(self.tables_read()),
                self.dependencies(),
            ),
        )


class AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """L0: Insert missing reciprocal edges into staged for symmetric auto-create."""

    def __init__(
        self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._edge_staged_table = config.edge_staged_table
        self._edge_sparse_table = config.edge_sparse_table
        self._branch_table = config.branch_table
        self._data_columns = list(config.data_columns)
        self._branch_ref = config.branch_ref
        self._publish_scope = config.publish_scope
        self._type_name_filter = config.type_name_filter
        self._dependencies = config.depends_on

    def dependencies(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._dependencies | _server_ref_dependencies(self._branch_ref)

    @property
    def level(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def step_tags(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "edge_constraints", "symmetric", "grammar"})

    def tables_read(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        tables = {
            self._edge_staged_table,
            self._edge_sparse_table,
            self._branch_table,
            SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
        }
        if self._publish_scope.staged_commits_table is not None:
            tables.add(SqlTableName(self._publish_scope.staged_commits_table))
        return frozenset(tables)

    def tables_written(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._edge_staged_table})

    def compile(
        self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        branch_binding = _normalize_edge_branch_binding(lazy_branch=self._branch_ref, ctx=ctx)
        src_alias = SqlAliasName("s")
        rev_alias = SqlAliasName("r")
        published_alias = SqlAliasName("published_reverse")
        staged_table = _staged_read_table(ctx, self._edge_staged_table, scope=self._publish_scope)
        selector = _selector_from_publish_scope(
            scope=self._publish_scope,
            branch_id=self._branch_ref,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_sparse import (
            SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned,
        )

        digest = hashlib.sha256(str(self.ref_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
        prior_visible_name = SqlTableName(f"sym_prior_{digest}")
        reverse_visible_name = SqlTableName(f"sym_reverse_{digest}")
        tip_revision = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("tip_revision_sys_id"))],
                from_=SqlTableIdent(self._branch_table),
                where=SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, branch_binding.branch_param),
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
        selected_ids = SqlSelect(
            select=[SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(src_alias))],
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), src_alias),
            where=sql_and(
                selector.match_expr(
                    column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                    qualifier=str(src_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                selector.latest_row_expr(
                    staged_table=str(staged_table),
                    outer_qualifier=str(src_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
            ),
        )
        sparse_sys_id = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(self._edge_sparse_table))
        prior_ancestry = SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned(
            table=self._edge_sparse_table,
            revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
            branch_id=branch_binding.branch_param,
            revision_id=tip_revision,
            include_deleted=False,
            extra_where=SqlIn(sparse_sys_id, selected_ids),
            ranking_where=SqlIn(sparse_sys_id, selected_ids),
            ancestor_cte_name=SqlCteName(f"sym_prior_anc_{digest}"),
        )
        prior_ancestry_ctes, prior_visible_body = prior_ancestry.split_for_outer_cte()

        sparse_graph = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(self._edge_sparse_table))
        sparse_source = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(self._edge_sparse_table))
        sparse_target = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(self._edge_sparse_table))
        reverse_of_selected = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlParam(1)],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), src_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=str(src_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=str(staged_table),
                        outer_qualifier=str(src_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        sparse_graph,
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(src_alias)),
                    ),
                    sql_or(
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_source,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(src_alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_target,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(src_alias)),
                            ),
                        ),
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_source,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(src_alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_target,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(src_alias)),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
        prior_candidate_alias = SqlAliasName("prior_candidate")
        reverse_of_prior = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlParam(1)],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(prior_visible_name), prior_candidate_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        sparse_graph,
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(prior_candidate_alias)),
                    ),
                    sql_or(
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_source,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(prior_candidate_alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_target,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(prior_candidate_alias)),
                            ),
                        ),
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_source,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(prior_candidate_alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_target,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(prior_candidate_alias)),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
        reverse_ancestry = SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned(
            table=self._edge_sparse_table,
            revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
            branch_id=branch_binding.branch_param,
            revision_id=tip_revision,
            include_deleted=False,
            extra_where=sql_or(reverse_of_selected, reverse_of_prior),
            ranking_where=sql_or(reverse_of_selected, reverse_of_prior),
            ancestor_cte_name=SqlCteName(f"sym_reverse_anc_{digest}"),
        )
        reverse_ancestry_ctes, reverse_visible_body = reverse_ancestry.split_for_outer_cte()

        def src_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(src_alias))

        def rev_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(rev_alias))

        reverse_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=str(staged_table),
                outer_qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("branch_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("branch_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("graph_sys_id")),
            SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, rev_col("sys_deleted")),
            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("target_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("source_sys_id")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            reverse_conditions,
            column_ref=rev_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        reverse_subquery = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(
                SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), rev_alias),
            ),
            where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*reverse_conditions)),
        )

        def published_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(published_alias))

        published_reverse_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlBinaryOp(published_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("graph_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(published_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("target_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(published_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("source_sys_id")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            published_reverse_conditions,
            column_ref=published_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        published_reverse_conditions.append(
            SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlParam(1)],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), rev_alias),
                    where=sql_and(
                        selector.match_expr(
                            column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                            qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        selector.latest_row_expr(
                            staged_table=str(staged_table),
                            outer_qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, published_col("sys_id")),
                        sql_or(
                            rev_col("sys_deleted"),
                            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.NE, src_col("graph_sys_id")),
                            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.NE, src_col("target_sys_id")),
                            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.NE, src_col("source_sys_id")),
                        ),
                    ),
                    limit=1,
                ),
                negated=True,
            ),
        )
        published_reverse_subquery = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(
                SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), published_alias),
            ),
            where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*published_reverse_conditions)),
        )

        def final_orientation_count(
            *,
            graph: SqlRenderable,
            source: SqlRenderable,
            target: SqlRenderable,
            upper_sys_id: SqlRenderable | None,
            alias_suffix: str,
        ) -> SqlRenderable:
            visible_alias = SqlAliasName(f"final_visible_{alias_suffix}")
            staged_alias = SqlAliasName(f"final_staged_{alias_suffix}")
            override_alias = SqlAliasName(f"final_override_{alias_suffix}")

            def visible_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
                return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(visible_alias))

            def staged_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
                return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(staged_alias))

            def override_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
                return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(override_alias))

            selected_override = SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlParam(1)],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), override_alias),
                    where=sql_and(
                        selector.match_expr(
                            column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                            qualifier=str(override_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        selector.latest_row_expr(
                            staged_table=str(staged_table),
                            outer_qualifier=str(override_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(override_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, visible_col("sys_id")),
                    ),
                    limit=1,
                ),
                negated=True,
            )
            visible_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                selected_override,
                SqlBinaryOp(visible_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, graph),
                SqlBinaryOp(visible_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, source),
                SqlBinaryOp(visible_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, target),
            ]
            staged_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                selector.match_expr(
                    column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                    qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                selector.latest_row_expr(
                    staged_table=str(staged_table),
                    outer_qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, staged_col("sys_deleted")),
                SqlBinaryOp(staged_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, graph),
                SqlBinaryOp(staged_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, source),
                SqlBinaryOp(staged_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, target),
            ]
            if upper_sys_id is not None:
                visible_conditions.append(
                    SqlBinaryOp(visible_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.LE, upper_sys_id),
                )
                staged_conditions.append(
                    SqlBinaryOp(staged_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.LE, upper_sys_id),
                )
            _append_optional_type_name_filter(
                visible_conditions,
                column_ref=visible_col("type_name"),
                type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
            )
            _append_optional_type_name_filter(
                staged_conditions,
                column_ref=staged_col("type_name"),
                type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
            )
            visible_count = SqlSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), visible_alias),
                    where=sql_and(*visible_conditions),
                ),
            )
            staged_count = SqlSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), staged_alias),
                    where=sql_and(*staged_conditions),
                ),
            )
            return SqlBinaryOp(visible_count, BinaryOp.ADD, staged_count)

        generation_visible_alias = SqlAliasName("generation_visible")
        generation_selected_alias = SqlAliasName("generation_selected")
        generation_override_alias = SqlAliasName("generation_override")
        generation_commit_alias = SqlAliasName("generation_commit")

        def generation_visible_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(generation_visible_alias))

        def generation_selected_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(generation_selected_alias))

        def generation_override_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(generation_override_alias))

        def generation_commit_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(generation_commit_alias))

        selected_generation_commit = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[generation_commit_col("sys_staged_commit_id")],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), generation_commit_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=str(generation_commit_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=str(staged_table),
                        outer_qualifier=str(generation_commit_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        generation_commit_col("graph_sys_id"),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        generation_visible_col("graph_sys_id"),
                    ),
                    sql_or(
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                generation_commit_col("source_sys_id"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                generation_visible_col("source_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                generation_commit_col("target_sys_id"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                generation_visible_col("target_sys_id"),
                            ),
                        ),
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                generation_commit_col("source_sys_id"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                generation_visible_col("target_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                generation_commit_col("target_sys_id"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                generation_visible_col("source_sys_id"),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
        generation_visible_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlParam(1)],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), generation_override_alias),
                    where=sql_and(
                        selector.match_expr(
                            column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                            qualifier=str(generation_override_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        selector.latest_row_expr(
                            staged_table=str(staged_table),
                            outer_qualifier=str(generation_override_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            generation_override_col("sys_id"),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            generation_visible_col("sys_id"),
                        ),
                    ),
                    limit=1,
                ),
                negated=True,
            ),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            generation_visible_conditions,
            column_ref=generation_visible_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        generation_selected_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier=str(generation_selected_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=str(staged_table),
                outer_qualifier=str(generation_selected_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, generation_selected_col("sys_deleted")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            generation_selected_conditions,
            column_ref=generation_selected_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        generation_source_columns: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlColumnAlias(branch_binding.branch_param, SqlAliasName("branch_id")),
            generation_visible_col("sys_id"),
            SqlColumnAlias(selected_generation_commit, SqlAliasName("sys_staged_commit_id")),
            SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(False), SqlAliasName("sys_deleted")),
            *(generation_visible_col(column) for column in self._data_columns),
        ]
        generation_sources = SqlUnionAll(
            [
                SqlSelect(
                    select=generation_source_columns,
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), generation_visible_alias),
                    where=sql_and(*generation_visible_conditions),
                ),
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[
                        generation_selected_col("branch_id"),
                        generation_selected_col("sys_id"),
                        generation_selected_col("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        generation_selected_col("sys_deleted"),
                        *(generation_selected_col(column) for column in self._data_columns),
                    ],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), generation_selected_alias),
                    where=sql_and(*generation_selected_conditions),
                ),
            ],
        )

        source_final_rank = final_orientation_count(
            graph=src_col("graph_sys_id"),
            source=src_col("source_sys_id"),
            target=src_col("target_sys_id"),
            upper_sys_id=src_col("sys_id"),
            alias_suffix="source_rank",
        )
        reverse_final_count = final_orientation_count(
            graph=src_col("graph_sys_id"),
            source=src_col("target_sys_id"),
            target=src_col("source_sys_id"),
            upper_sys_id=None,
            alias_suffix="reverse_count",
        )

        where_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlBinaryOp(src_col("branch_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, branch_binding.branch_param),
            SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, src_col("sys_deleted")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            where_conditions,
            column_ref=src_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        where_conditions.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(source_final_rank, BinaryOp.GT, reverse_final_count),
        )

        target_columns = [
            "branch_id",
            "sys_id",
            "sys_staged_commit_id",
            "sys_deleted",
            *self._data_columns,
        ]
        select_exprs: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            src_col("branch_id"),
            SqlGeneratedSysId(),
            src_col("sys_staged_commit_id"),
            SqlParam(False),
        ]
        for col in self._data_columns:
            if col in {"source_sys_id", "source_node_key"}:
                select_exprs.append(src_col("target_sys_id" if col == "source_sys_id" else "target_node_key"))
            elif col in {"target_sys_id", "target_node_key"}:
                select_exprs.append(src_col("source_sys_id" if col == "target_sys_id" else "source_node_key"))
            else:
                select_exprs.append(src_col(col))

        new_reciprocal_rows = SqlSelect(
            select=select_exprs,
            from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(generation_sources, SqlTableName(str(src_alias))),
            where=sql_and(*where_conditions),
        )

        prior_alias = SqlAliasName("prior_forward")
        obsolete_alias = SqlAliasName("obsolete_reverse")

        def prior_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(prior_alias))

        def obsolete_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(obsolete_alias))

        peer_prior_alias = SqlAliasName("peer_prior")
        reverse_peer_alias = SqlAliasName("reverse_peer")

        def peer_prior_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(peer_prior_alias))

        def reverse_peer_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(reverse_peer_alias))

        prior_peer_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlBinaryOp(peer_prior_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, prior_col("graph_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(peer_prior_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, prior_col("source_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(peer_prior_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, prior_col("target_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(peer_prior_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.LE, prior_col("sys_id")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            prior_peer_conditions,
            column_ref=peer_prior_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        selected_change_global_rank = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), peer_prior_alias),
                where=sql_and(*prior_peer_conditions),
            ),
        )

        def selected_stable_reverse_before_rank(
            *,
            graph: SqlRenderable,
            source: SqlRenderable,
            target: SqlRenderable,
            source_rank: SqlRenderable,
            alias_suffix: str,
        ) -> SqlSubquery:
            reserved_alias = SqlAliasName(f"reserved_reverse_{alias_suffix}")
            rank_alias = SqlAliasName(f"reserved_rank_{alias_suffix}")

            def reserved_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
                return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(reserved_alias))

            def rank_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
                return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(rank_alias))

            reserved_rank = SqlSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), rank_alias),
                    where=sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(rank_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, graph),
                        SqlBinaryOp(rank_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, target),
                        SqlBinaryOp(rank_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, source),
                        SqlBinaryOp(rank_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.LE, reserved_col("sys_id")),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            historical_reserved = SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlParam(1)],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), rank_alias),
                    where=sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(rank_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, reserved_col("sys_id")),
                        SqlBinaryOp(rank_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, graph),
                        SqlBinaryOp(rank_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, target),
                        SqlBinaryOp(rank_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, source),
                    ),
                    limit=1,
                ),
            )
            return SqlSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), reserved_alias),
                    where=sql_and(
                        selector.match_expr(
                            column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                            qualifier=str(reserved_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        selector.latest_row_expr(
                            staged_table=str(staged_table),
                            outer_qualifier=str(reserved_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, reserved_col("sys_deleted")),
                        SqlBinaryOp(reserved_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, graph),
                        SqlBinaryOp(reserved_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, target),
                        SqlBinaryOp(reserved_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, source),
                        historical_reserved,
                        SqlBinaryOp(reserved_rank, BinaryOp.LT, source_rank),
                    ),
                ),
            )

        selected_change_rank = SqlBinaryOp(
            selected_change_global_rank,
            BinaryOp.SUB,
            selected_stable_reverse_before_rank(
                graph=prior_col("graph_sys_id"),
                source=prior_col("source_sys_id"),
                target=prior_col("target_sys_id"),
                source_rank=selected_change_global_rank,
                alias_suffix="change",
            ),
        )
        obsolete_reverse_peer_unselected = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlParam(1)],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), rev_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=str(staged_table),
                        outer_qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, reverse_peer_col("sys_id")),
                    SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, rev_col("sys_deleted")),
                    SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, reverse_peer_col("graph_sys_id")),
                    SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, reverse_peer_col("source_sys_id")),
                    SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, reverse_peer_col("target_sys_id")),
                ),
                limit=1,
            ),
            negated=True,
        )
        reverse_peer_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlBinaryOp(reverse_peer_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, obsolete_col("graph_sys_id")),
            obsolete_reverse_peer_unselected,
            SqlBinaryOp(reverse_peer_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, obsolete_col("source_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(reverse_peer_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, obsolete_col("target_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(reverse_peer_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.LE, obsolete_col("sys_id")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            reverse_peer_conditions,
            column_ref=reverse_peer_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        obsolete_reverse_rank = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), reverse_peer_alias),
                where=sql_and(*reverse_peer_conditions),
            ),
        )

        obsolete_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier=str(src_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=str(staged_table),
                outer_qualifier=str(src_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, src_col("sys_deleted")),
            SqlBinaryOp(prior_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("sys_id")),
            sql_or(
                SqlBinaryOp(prior_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.NE, src_col("graph_sys_id")),
                SqlBinaryOp(prior_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.NE, src_col("source_sys_id")),
                SqlBinaryOp(prior_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.NE, src_col("target_sys_id")),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(obsolete_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, prior_col("graph_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(obsolete_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, prior_col("target_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(obsolete_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, prior_col("source_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(obsolete_reverse_rank, BinaryOp.EQ, selected_change_rank),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            obsolete_conditions,
            column_ref=prior_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            obsolete_conditions,
            column_ref=obsolete_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        selected_obsolete_reciprocal = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlParam(1)],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), rev_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=str(staged_table),
                        outer_qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, obsolete_col("sys_id")),
                ),
                limit=1,
            ),
            negated=True,
        )
        obsolete_conditions.append(selected_obsolete_reciprocal)
        obsolete_reciprocal_rows = SqlSelect(
            select=[
                src_col("branch_id"),
                obsolete_col("sys_id"),
                src_col("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                SqlParam(True),
                *(obsolete_col(column) for column in self._data_columns),
            ],
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), src_alias),
            joins=[
                SqlJoin(JoinKind.CROSS, SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(prior_visible_name), prior_alias)),
                SqlJoin(JoinKind.CROSS, SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), obsolete_alias)),
            ],
            where=sql_and(*obsolete_conditions),
            distinct=True,
        )

        remaining_alias = SqlAliasName("remaining_reverse")

        def remaining_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(remaining_alias))

        selected_remaining = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlParam(1)],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), rev_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=str(staged_table),
                        outer_qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, remaining_col("sys_id")),
                ),
                limit=1,
            ),
            negated=True,
        )
        deleted_peer_alias = SqlAliasName("deleted_peer")

        def deleted_peer_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(deleted_peer_alias))

        deleted_peer_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlBinaryOp(deleted_peer_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("graph_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(deleted_peer_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("source_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(deleted_peer_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("target_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(deleted_peer_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.LE, src_col("sys_id")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            deleted_peer_conditions,
            column_ref=deleted_peer_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        selected_delete_global_rank = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), deleted_peer_alias),
                where=sql_and(*deleted_peer_conditions),
            ),
        )
        selected_delete_rank = SqlBinaryOp(
            selected_delete_global_rank,
            BinaryOp.SUB,
            selected_stable_reverse_before_rank(
                graph=src_col("graph_sys_id"),
                source=src_col("source_sys_id"),
                target=src_col("target_sys_id"),
                source_rank=selected_delete_global_rank,
                alias_suffix="delete",
            ),
        )
        reverse_peer_unselected = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlParam(1)],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), rev_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=str(staged_table),
                        outer_qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, reverse_peer_col("sys_id")),
                    SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, rev_col("sys_deleted")),
                    SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, reverse_peer_col("graph_sys_id")),
                    SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, reverse_peer_col("source_sys_id")),
                    SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, reverse_peer_col("target_sys_id")),
                ),
                limit=1,
            ),
            negated=True,
        )
        deleted_reverse_peer_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlBinaryOp(reverse_peer_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, remaining_col("graph_sys_id")),
            reverse_peer_unselected,
            SqlBinaryOp(reverse_peer_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, remaining_col("source_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(reverse_peer_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, remaining_col("target_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(reverse_peer_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.LE, remaining_col("sys_id")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            deleted_reverse_peer_conditions,
            column_ref=reverse_peer_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        deleted_reverse_rank = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), reverse_peer_alias),
                where=sql_and(*deleted_reverse_peer_conditions),
            ),
        )
        delete_reciprocal_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier=str(src_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=str(staged_table),
                outer_qualifier=str(src_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            src_col("sys_deleted"),
            SqlBinaryOp(remaining_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("graph_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(remaining_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("target_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(remaining_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("source_sys_id")),
            selected_remaining,
            SqlBinaryOp(deleted_reverse_rank, BinaryOp.EQ, selected_delete_rank),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            delete_reciprocal_conditions,
            column_ref=remaining_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        deleted_reciprocal_rows = SqlSelect(
            select=[
                src_col("branch_id"),
                remaining_col("sys_id"),
                src_col("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                SqlParam(True),
                *(remaining_col(column) for column in self._data_columns),
            ],
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), src_alias),
            joins=[
                SqlJoin(JoinKind.CROSS, SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), remaining_alias)),
            ],
            where=sql_and(*delete_reciprocal_conditions),
            distinct=True,
        )

        def with_visible_ancestry(statement: SqlRenderable) -> SqlCte:
            return SqlCte(
                [
                    *prior_ancestry_ctes,
                    TreeSqlCteDefinition(str(prior_visible_name), prior_visible_body),
                    *reverse_ancestry_ctes,
                    TreeSqlCteDefinition(str(reverse_visible_name), reverse_visible_body),
                ],
                statement,
                recursive=True,
            )

        cleanup_transitions = SqlInsert(
            SqlTableIdent(staged_table),
            columns=SqlColumnNameList(tuple(SqlColumnName(name) for name in target_columns)),
            source=SqlSelect(
                select=SqlStar(),
                from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(
                    SqlUnionAll([obsolete_reciprocal_rows, deleted_reciprocal_rows]),
                    SqlTableName("symmetric_cleanup_rows"),
                ),
            ),
        )
        create_reciprocals = SqlInsert(
            SqlTableIdent(staged_table),
            columns=SqlColumnNameList(tuple(SqlColumnName(name) for name in target_columns)),
            source=new_reciprocal_rows,
        )
        grammar = SqlStatementBatch(
            statements=(
                with_visible_ancestry(cleanup_transitions),
                with_visible_ancestry(create_reciprocals),
            ),
            category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.DEPENDENCY_GRAPH,
            relationships=(SqlStatementRelationship(0, 1, SqlStatementRelationshipKind.DATA_VISIBILITY),),
        )
        return CompiledStep(grammar=grammar, needs_returning=False)


class _CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStepCteRow(BaseModel):
    edge_base: str
    result_kind: str
    source_sys_id: SysId
    target_sys_id: SysId
    edge_count: int


class CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[None]):
    """Detect duplicate edges for multiple table/type groups with one statement."""

    def cte_publication_contract(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("edge_base", "result_kind", "source_sys_id", "target_sys_id", "edge_count")
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
            text_columns=frozenset({"edge_base", "result_kind"}),
            uuid_columns=frozenset({"source_sys_id", "target_sys_id"}),
            bigint_columns=frozenset({"edge_count"}),
        )
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def __init__(
        self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _BatchedDuplicateEdgeValidationConfig,
        lazy_branch: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        if not config.entries:
            msg = "CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep requires at least one edge entry"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self._entries = config.entries
        self._lazy_branch = lazy_branch
        self._revision_id_raw = config.revision_id_raw
        self._validation_needed_ref = config.validation_needed_ref
        self._dependencies = config.depends_on

    def dependencies(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = self._dependencies | _server_ref_dependencies(self._lazy_branch)
        if self._validation_needed_ref is not None:
            deps = deps | frozenset({str(self._validation_needed_ref)})
        return deps

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def requires_prior_statement_visibility_after_writes(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.tables_read()

    @property
    def level(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def is_read_only(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def step_tags(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "validation", "grammar"})

    def tables_read(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        tables: set[str] = set()
        for entry in self._entries:
            tables.update(
                _edge_validation_read_tables(
                    entry.edge_sparse_table,
                    entry.edge_staged_table,
                    entry.publish_scope,
                ),
            )
        return frozenset(tables)

    def tables_written(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self: CheckDuplicateEdgesBatchStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        branch_binding = _normalize_edge_branch_binding(lazy_branch=self._lazy_branch, ctx=ctx)
        validation_needed_expr = _validation_needed_sql_expr(self._validation_needed_ref, ctx)
        duplicate_queries: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        for idx, entry in enumerate(self._entries):
            visible_edges = _build_visible_edge_pair_multiset_stmt(
                edge_sparse_table=entry.edge_sparse_table,
                edge_staged_table=entry.edge_staged_table,
                branch_binding=branch_binding,
                revision_id_raw=self._revision_id_raw,
                ctx=ctx,
                type_name_filter=entry.type_name_filter,
                publish_scope=entry.publish_scope,
                branch_ref=self._lazy_branch,
                restrict_sparse_to_staged_pairs=True,
            )
            edge_alias = SqlTableName(f"_dup_visible_edges_{idx}")
            graph_col = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(edge_alias))
            source_col = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(edge_alias))
