class ExecuteGraphBindingsStep(_BaseExecuteGraphStep[list[GraphBindingRow]]):
    optimizer_projection_owned = True

    def result_cardinality(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def step_tags(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        tags = {"read", "graph", "query", "bindings"}
        if self._pattern.order_by:
            tags.add("ordered_result")
        return frozenset(tags)

    def json_aggregation_order_by(
        self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep,
    ) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
        """Preserve graph row order inside backends that aggregate transport JSON."""
        recursive_path = (
            self._pattern.paths[0]
            if len(self._pattern.paths) == 1
            and (self._pattern.paths[0].quantifier.min_hops != 1 or self._pattern.paths[0].quantifier.max_hops != 1)
            else None
        )
        columns: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        for clause in self._pattern.order_by:
            field_path = clause.expression
            if not isinstance(field_path, str):
                continue
            output_column = field_path
            if "." in field_path:
                variable_name, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
                if (
                    recursive_path is not None
                    and variable_name == recursive_path.edge.variable
                    and field_name
                    in {
                        "sys_id",
                        "graph_sys_id",
                        "source_sys_id",
                        "target_sys_id",
                        "type_name",
                    }
                ):
                    edge_projection = next(
                        (
                            projection
                            for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection) and projection.edge_variable == variable_name
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    output_column = (
                        _binding_edge_alias(edge_projection.binding_name, field_name)
                        if edge_projection is not None
                        else f"__pt_{variable_name}_{field_name}"
                    )
                elif (
                    recursive_path is not None
                    and variable_name == recursive_path.edge.variable
                    and field_name
                    not in {
                        "sys_id",
                        "graph_sys_id",
                        "source_sys_id",
                        "target_sys_id",
                        "type_name",
                    }
                ):
                    output_column = f"__pt_{variable_name}_{field_name}"
                elif recursive_path is not None and variable_name == recursive_path.target.variable:
                    scalar_projection = next(
                        (
                            projection
                            for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection) and projection.field_path == field_path
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    output_column = (
                        scalar_projection.binding_name
                        if scalar_projection is not None
                        else get_db_column_name(recursive_path.target.node_type, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
                    )
                elif field_name == "sys_id":
                    projection = next(
                        (
                            candidate
                            for candidate in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if (isinstance(candidate, NodeBindingProjection) and candidate.node_variable == variable_name)
                            or (isinstance(candidate, EdgeBindingProjection) and candidate.edge_variable == variable_name)
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                        output_column = _binding_node_sys_id_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                        )
                    elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                        output_column = _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            "sys_id",
                        )
                    else:
                        output_column = f"__order_{variable_name}__{field_name}"
                else:
                    output_column = f"__order_{variable_name}__{field_name}"
            columns.append((output_column, str(clause.direction)))
        return tuple(columns)

    def _cte_output_columns(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        columns: list[str] = []
        for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                columns.append(_binding_node_sys_id_alias(projection.binding_name))
            elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                columns.extend(
                    (
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "graph_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "source_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "target_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "type_name"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            PROJECTED_EDGE_SOURCE_KEY_COLUMN,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            elif isinstance(projection, DepthBindingProjection):
                columns.append(projection.binding_name)
            elif isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection):
                columns.append(projection.binding_name)
        columns.extend(column_name for column_name, _direction in self.json_aggregation_order_by())
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns)) if columns else None

    def cte_column_type_hints(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
        columns = self._cte_output_columns()
        if columns is None:
            return None
        jsonb_columns: set[str] = set()
        uuid_columns: set[str] = set()
        timestamptz_columns: set[str] = set()
        date_columns: set[str] = set()
        bool_columns: set[str] = set()
        integer_columns: set[str] = set()
        bigint_columns: set[str] = set()
        double_columns: set[str] = set()
        text_columns: set[str] = set()
        bytea_columns: set[str] = set()
        hint_targets = (
            ("jsonb_columns", jsonb_columns),
            ("uuid_columns", uuid_columns),
            ("timestamptz_columns", timestamptz_columns),
            ("date_columns", date_columns),
            ("bool_columns", bool_columns),
            ("integer_columns", integer_columns),
            ("bigint_columns", bigint_columns),
            ("double_columns", double_columns),
            ("text_columns", text_columns),
            ("bytea_columns", bytea_columns),
        )
        variable_models: dict[str, type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = {
            variable: node.node_type for variable, node in self._nodes.items()
        }
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(self._pattern):
            variable_models[path.source.variable] = path.source.node_type
            variable_models[path.target.variable] = path.target.node_type
            for step in _iter_path_expression_steps(path.expression):
                if step.source_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.source_binding] = step.source_type
                if step.target_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.target_binding] = step.target_type
                if step.edge_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.edge_binding] = step.edge_types[0]

        def add_field_hint(output_column: str, field_path: str) -> bool:
            if "." not in field_path:
                return False
            variable, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
            model_cls = variable_models.get(variable)
            if model_cls is None or field_name not in model_cls.model_fields:
                return False
            db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            source_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, (db_column,))
            if source_hints is None:
                return False
            for attribute, target in hint_targets:
                if db_column in getattr(source_hints, attribute):
                    target.add(output_column)
                    return True
            return False

        for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                uuid_columns.add(_binding_node_sys_id_alias(projection.binding_name))
            elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                uuid_columns.update(
                    {
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "graph_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "source_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "target_sys_id"),
                    },
                )
                text_columns.update(
                    {
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "type_name"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            PROJECTED_EDGE_SOURCE_KEY_COLUMN,
                        ),
                    },
                )
            elif isinstance(projection, DepthBindingProjection):
                integer_columns.add(projection.binding_name)
            elif isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection) and not add_field_hint(
                projection.binding_name,
                projection.field_path,
            ):
                text_columns.add(projection.binding_name)

        order_columns = self.json_aggregation_order_by()
        string_order_clauses = tuple(clause for clause in self._pattern.order_by if isinstance(clause.expression, str))
        for clause, (column_name, _direction) in zip(
            string_order_clauses,
            order_columns,
            strict=True,
        ):
            typed_columns = set().union(*(target for _attribute, target in hint_targets))
            if column_name in typed_columns:
                continue
            if not isinstance(clause.expression, str) or not add_field_hint(
                column_name,
                clause.expression,
            ):
                text_columns.add(column_name)

        return SqlColumnTypeHints(
            jsonb_columns=frozenset(jsonb_columns),
            uuid_columns=frozenset(uuid_columns),
            timestamptz_columns=frozenset(timestamptz_columns),
            date_columns=frozenset(date_columns),
            bool_columns=frozenset(bool_columns),
            integer_columns=frozenset(integer_columns),
            bigint_columns=frozenset(bigint_columns),
            double_columns=frozenset(double_columns),
            text_columns=frozenset(text_columns),
            bytea_columns=frozenset(bytea_columns),
        )

    def executor_publication_projection_columns(
        self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep,
    ) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        """Publish result and ordering columns required by batched transport."""
        return self._cte_output_columns()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        # Graph bindings publish CTE contracts, so the helper names reflect the
        # SQL-visible publication invariant rather than runtime binding shape.
        columns = self._cte_output_columns()
        column_type_hints = self.cte_column_type_hints()
        if columns is None:
            if column_type_hints is not None and column_type_hints.has_any():
                msg = f"{type(self).__name__} declares SQL column type hints without an explicit cte_output_columns() contract."
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=GraphBindingRow,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(GraphBindingRow),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[GraphBindingRow]]:
        dispatched = self._compile_persisted_policy_dispatch(ctx)
        if dispatched is not None:
            return dispatched
        from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledStep as CompiledStepFactory

        builder = self._build_graph_query_builder(ctx)
        compile_plans = self._build_traversal_compile_plans(
            ctx,
            nested_scope=GraphNestedPatternScope.INCLUDE_NESTED,
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStepFactory(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=builder._build_bindings_grammar(compile_plans=compile_plans),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=graph_bindings_post_op(
                _graph_binding_materialization_spec(
                    nodes=self._nodes,
                    pattern=self._pattern,
                ),
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=self._collect_auxiliary_ctes(ctx),
            needs_recursive_with=True,
        )


class ExecuteGraphAggregateStep(_BaseExecuteGraphStep[list[dict[str, object]]]):
    def result_cardinality(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def step_tags(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "graph", "query", "aggregate"})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        group_field_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
        for group_field in self._pattern.group_by:
            field_name = str(group_field).rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
            group_field_counts[field_name] = group_field_counts.get(field_name, 0) + 1

        aggregation_aliases = {aggregation.alias for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations}
        group_leaf_names = {str(group_field).rsplit(".", 1)[-1] for group_field in self._pattern.group_by}

        def aggregation_output_name(alias: str) -> str:
            return f"aggregate_{alias}" if alias in group_leaf_names else alias

        def output_name(raw: object) -> str:
            value = str(raw)
            if "." not in value and value in aggregation_aliases:
                return aggregation_output_name(value)
            field_name = value.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
            if (group_field_counts.get(field_name, 0) > 1 or field_name in aggregation_aliases) and "." in value:
                variable_name = value.split(".", 1)[0]
                return f"{variable_name}_{field_name}"
            return field_name

        if self._pattern.overview_aggregation is not None:
            columns = tuple(self._pattern.overview_aggregation.output_columns)
        elif self._pattern.select_fields:
            columns = tuple(select_field.alias or output_name(select_field.expression) for select_field in self._pattern.select_fields)
        else:
            columns = tuple(
                [output_name(field) for field in self._pattern.group_by]
                + [aggregation.alias for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations],
            )
        columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))
        if not columns:
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()

        aggregation_columns = {
            aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias)
            for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations
            if aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias) in columns
        }
        group_columns = set(columns) - aggregation_columns
        typed_columns: dict[str, set[str]] = {
            attribute: set()
            for attribute in (
                "jsonb_columns",
                "uuid_columns",
                "timestamptz_columns",
                "date_columns",
                "time_columns",
                "numeric_columns",
                "bool_columns",
                "integer_columns",
                "bigint_columns",
                "double_columns",
                "text_columns",
                "bytea_columns",
            )
        }
        variable_models: dict[str, type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = {
            variable: node.node_type for variable, node in self._nodes.items()
        }
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(self._pattern):
            variable_models[path.source.variable] = path.source.node_type
            variable_models[path.target.variable] = path.target.node_type
            if path.edge.variable is not None:
                variable_models[path.edge.variable] = path.edge.edge_type

        def add_field_type(output_column: str, field_path: str) -> str | None:
            if "." not in field_path:
                return None
            variable_name, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
            model_cls = variable_models.get(variable_name)
            if model_cls is None:
                return None
            db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            source_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, (db_column,))
            if source_hints is None:
                return None
            for attribute, target in typed_columns.items():
                if db_column in getattr(source_hints, attribute):
                    target.add(output_column)
                    return attribute
            return None

        for group_field in self._pattern.group_by:
            output_column = output_name(group_field)
            if add_field_type(output_column, group_field) is None:
                typed_columns["text_columns"].add(output_column)
        hinted_group_columns = set().union(*typed_columns.values())
        typed_columns["text_columns"].update(group_columns - hinted_group_columns)

        for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations:
            output_column = aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias)
            if output_column not in aggregation_columns:
                continue
            function = aggregation.function.upper()
            if function == "COUNT":
                typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add(output_column)
                continue
            if function in {"AVG", "STDDEV", "VARIANCE"}:
                typed_columns["double_columns"].add(output_column)
                continue
            source_attribute = add_field_type(output_column, aggregation.expression) if isinstance(aggregation.expression, str) else None
            if source_attribute is None:
                typed_columns["double_columns"].add(output_column)
            elif function == "SUM" and source_attribute == "integer_columns":
                typed_columns["integer_columns"].discard(output_column)
                typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add(output_column)

        if self._pattern.overview_aggregation is not None:
            typed_columns["text_columns"].update({"kind", "type_name"})
            typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add("count")
            typed_columns["text_columns"].discard("count")
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
            bigint_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bigint_columns"]),
            double_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["double_columns"]),
            jsonb_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["jsonb_columns"]),
            uuid_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["uuid_columns"]),
            timestamptz_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["timestamptz_columns"]),
            date_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["date_columns"]),
            time_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["time_columns"]),
            numeric_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["numeric_columns"]),
            bool_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bool_columns"]),
            integer_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["integer_columns"]),
            text_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["text_columns"]),
            bytea_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bytea_columns"]),
        ).filtered(set(columns))
        source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        _contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            columns,
            column_type_hints,
        )
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(_contract_model_cls),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=None if source_tables is None else frozenset(str(table) for table in source_tables),
        )

    def compile(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
        dispatched = self._compile_persisted_policy_dispatch(ctx)
        if dispatched is not None:
            return dispatched
        from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledStep as CompiledStepFactory

        builder = self._build_graph_query_builder(ctx)
        compile_plans = self._build_traversal_compile_plans(ctx)
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStepFactory(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=builder._build_aggregate_grammar(compile_plans=compile_plans),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            auxiliary_ctes=self._collect_auxiliary_ctes(ctx),
            needs_recursive_with=True,
        )


def _graph_intent_dependency_contract(
    *,
    dependencies: frozenset[str],
    sql_visible: frozenset[str],
    auth_scope: frozenset[str],
) -> StepDependencyContract:
    return StepDependencyContract(
        consumed_refs=frozenset(
            ConsumedRef(
                ref=ref,
                source=DependencySource.GRAPH_CONFIG,
                required_for=frozenset(
                    {
                        DependencyUse.ORDERING,
                        *((DependencyUse.SQL_VISIBLE,) if ref in sql_visible else ()),
                        *((DependencyUse.AUTH_SCOPE,) if ref in auth_scope else ()),
                    },
                ),
            )
            for ref in dependencies
        ),
        transport=TransportDependencyPolicy.TRANSPORTABLE,
        materialization=MaterializationDependencyPolicy.NONE,
        reason="graph visibility and relation dependencies are explicit",
    )


class SelectVisibleGraphIntent[GraphT: Graph[Any]](
    VersionedSelectOneIntent[GraphT],
):
    """Permission-filtered graph-row producer with explicit visibility facts."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        graph_type: type[GraphT],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedSelectOneConfig],
        *,
        snapshot_revision_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id, model_cls=graph_type, config=config)
        self.graph_type = graph_type
        self.snapshot_revision_ref = snapshot_revision_ref

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies = set(super().dependencies())
        if self.snapshot_revision_ref is not None:
            dependencies.add(str(self.snapshot_revision_ref))
        return frozenset(dependencies)

    def graph_visibility_contract(self) -> GraphVisibilityProducerContract:
        graph_id_ref = self.sys_id.ref_id
        revision_ref = self.snapshot_revision_ref if self.snapshot_revision_ref is not None else self.revision_id.ref_id
        branch_ref = None if self.branch_id is None else self.branch_id.ref_id
        if graph_id_ref is None or revision_ref is None:
            msg = "graph visibility inputs must be symbolic refs"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return GraphVisibilityProducerContract(
            role=GraphVisibilityProducerRole.VISIBLE_GRAPH_ROWS,
            graph_type=self.graph_type,
            output_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw_rows"),
            source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(graph_id_ref),
            graph_id_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw_rows.sys_id"),
            revision_ref=ServerPlanRefId(revision_ref),
            branch_anchor_ref=(None if branch_ref is None else ServerPlanRefId(branch_ref)),
        )

class RequirePermittedGraphRowStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[object]):
    """SQL-visible graph guard that preserves the permitted graph relation."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        error_message: str,
        publication_contract: CtePublicationContract,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._error_message = error_message
        self._publication_contract = publication_contract

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"validation", "permission", "graph", "sql_projection"})

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return None

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        source_tables = self._publication_contract.source_tables
        if source_tables is None:
            raise ValueError("Graph validation publication must declare its source tables")
        return source_tables

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref)})

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        return self._publication_contract

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[object]:
        delegate = RequirePermittedRowStep[object](
            self.ref_id,
            config=_RequirePermittedRowConfig(
                source_ref=self._source_ref,
                error_message=self._error_message,
                columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in self._publication_contract.columns),
            ),
        )
        compiled = delegate.compile(ctx)
        from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract

        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self._publication_contract,
        )
        return replace(
            compiled,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        )

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _SqlBranchTipRevisionExpr(SqlRenderable):
    branch_expr: SqlRenderable
    branch_table: SqlTableName

    def render(self, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlSubquery
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

        return SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("tip_revision_sys_id")),
                from_=self.branch_table,
                where=SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    self.branch_expr,
                ),
                limit=1,
            )
        ).render(dialect)


@pure_lazy
def _copy_graph_pattern(pattern: GraphQueryPattern) -> GraphQueryPattern:
    """Copy a pattern and normalize symbolic operands without executing them."""
    from l1000_schema.typed_field import Expression, freeze_semantic_expression_value
    from l2060_query_builder.plan_query_builder import _normalize_expression_server_values

    def copy_element(element: GraphPatternElement) -> GraphPatternElement:
        if isinstance(element, FilterCondition):
            expression = freeze_semantic_expression_value(
                _normalize_expression_server_values(element.expression),
            )
            assert isinstance(expression, Expression)
            return FilterCondition(expression=expression)
        if isinstance(element, PathPattern):
            return deepcopy(element)
        if isinstance(element, ExistsCondition):
            return ExistsCondition(
                pattern=_copy_graph_pattern(element.pattern),
                negated=element.negated,
            )
        if isinstance(element, MinusBlock):
            return MinusBlock(pattern=_copy_graph_pattern(element.pattern))
        if isinstance(element, OptionalBlock):
            return OptionalBlock(pattern=_copy_graph_pattern(element.pattern))
        if isinstance(element, UnionBlock):
            return UnionBlock(
                branches=tuple(_copy_graph_pattern(branch) for branch in element.branches),
            )
        msg = f"Unsupported graph pattern element: {type(element).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)

    return GraphQueryPattern(
        elements=tuple(copy_element(element) for element in pattern.elements),
        select_fields=deepcopy(pattern.select_fields),
        order_by=deepcopy(pattern.order_by),
        path_result_order_by=deepcopy(pattern.path_result_order_by),
        group_by=list(pattern.group_by),
        aggregations=deepcopy(pattern.aggregations),
        overview_aggregation=deepcopy(pattern.overview_aggregation),
        having=deepcopy(pattern.having),
        binding_projections=deepcopy(pattern.binding_projections),
        induced_subgraph=pattern.induced_subgraph,
        limit=pattern.limit,
        offset=pattern.offset,
        distinct=pattern.distinct,
    )


def _graph_model_compiled_artifacts(
    model_cls: type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]],
) -> tuple[Any, Any, SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract

    from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_field_helper import (
        get_all_select_columns,
    )
    from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_widening import (
        get_polymorphic_db_column_name,
    )

    columns = tuple(
        get_polymorphic_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in get_all_select_columns(model_cls)
    )
    hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, columns)
    if hints is None:
        msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for graph node model {model_cls.__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    projection_model = cte_projection_row_model(
        f"{model_cls.__name__}GraphNodeProjection",
        columns,
        hints,
    )
    return compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
        CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=hints,
            model_cls=projection_model,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.projection_over_model(
                source_model_cls=model_cls,
                projection_lineage=tuple((column, column) for column in columns),
            ),
            relation_role=("graph_node" if issubclass(model_cls, GraphNode) else "graph_edge"),
            source_tables=frozenset({get_table_name(model_cls)}),
        ),
    )


def _prefixed_graph_node_type_hints(
    node_type: type[GraphNode],
    node_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...],
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    raw_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(node_type, node_columns)
    if raw_hints is None:
        msg = (
            f"Graph node model {node_type.__name__} has incomplete SQL column type hints; "
            "declare a supported type for every transported field"
        )
        raise TypeError(msg)

    def prefixed(columns: frozenset[str]) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(f"__node_{column}" for column in columns)

    return SqlColumnTypeHints(
        jsonb_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.jsonb_columns),
        uuid_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.uuid_columns),
        timestamptz_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.timestamptz_columns),
        date_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.date_columns),
        time_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.time_columns),
        numeric_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.numeric_columns),
        bool_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.bool_columns),
        integer_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.integer_columns),
        bigint_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.bigint_columns),
        double_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.double_columns),
        text_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.text_columns),
        bytea_columns=prefixed(raw_hints.bytea_columns),
    )

def _merge_graph_result_type_hints(
    node_hints: SqlColumnTypeHints,
    edge_hints: SqlColumnTypeHints,
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    return SqlColumnTypeHints(
        jsonb_columns=node_hints.jsonb_columns | edge_hints.jsonb_columns,
        uuid_columns=node_hints.uuid_columns | edge_hints.uuid_columns | frozenset({"__entity_id"}),
        timestamptz_columns=node_hints.timestamptz_columns | edge_hints.timestamptz_columns,
        date_columns=node_hints.date_columns | edge_hints.date_columns,
        time_columns=node_hints.time_columns | edge_hints.time_columns,
        numeric_columns=node_hints.numeric_columns | edge_hints.numeric_columns,
        bool_columns=node_hints.bool_columns | edge_hints.bool_columns,
        integer_columns=node_hints.integer_columns | edge_hints.integer_columns,
        bigint_columns=node_hints.bigint_columns | edge_hints.bigint_columns,
        double_columns=node_hints.double_columns | edge_hints.double_columns,
        text_columns=node_hints.text_columns | edge_hints.text_columns | frozenset({"__entity_kind"}),
        bytea_columns=node_hints.bytea_columns | edge_hints.bytea_columns,
    )


def _graph_result_compiled_artifacts(
    node_type: type[GraphNode],
    edge_type: type[GraphEdge],
    node_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...],
    edge_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...],
) -> tuple[CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    node_hints = _prefixed_graph_node_type_hints(node_type, node_columns)
    fields: list[CompiledOutputField] = [
        CompiledOutputField(
            output_name="__entity_kind",
            output_column="__entity_kind",
            source_db_column="__entity_kind",
            role="graph_entity_kind",
            is_model_backed=False,
            include_in_json=False,
            include_in_hydration=False,
        ),
        CompiledOutputField(
            output_name="__entity_id",
            output_column="__entity_id",
            source_db_column="__entity_id",
            role="graph_entity_id",
            is_model_backed=False,
            include_in_json=False,
            include_in_hydration=False,
        ),
    ]
    for column in node_columns:
        column_name = str(column)
        fields.append(
            CompiledOutputField(
                output_name=f"__node_{column_name}",
                output_column=f"__node_{column_name}",
                source_db_column=column_name,
                role="graph_node_transport",
                is_model_backed=False,
                include_in_json=False,
                include_in_hydration=False,
            ),
        )
    fields.extend(
        CompiledOutputField(
            output_name=f"__edge_{column}",
            output_column=f"__edge_{column}",
            source_db_column=str(column),
            role="graph_edge_transport",
            is_model_backed=False,
            include_in_json=False,
            include_in_hydration=False,
        )
        for column in edge_columns
    )
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(fields))
    result_relation = DeclaredResultRelation(
        columns=tuple(
            DeclaredResultColumn(
                output_name=field.output_name,
                output_column=field.output_column,
                visibility="internal" if field.output_name.startswith("__") else "public",
            )
            for field in fields
        ),
        terminal_materialization_shape=output_shape.cte_output_columns,
    )
    edge_hints = _prefixed_graph_edge_type_hints(edge_type, edge_columns)
    output_columns = frozenset(output_shape.cte_output_columns)
    merged_hints = _merge_graph_result_type_hints(node_hints, edge_hints).filtered(set(output_columns))
    typed_columns = frozenset().union(*merged_hints.as_tuple())
    untyped_columns = output_columns - typed_columns

    def transport_field(column: str) -> str:
        return column.removeprefix("__node_").removeprefix("__edge_")

    uuid_columns = {
        column
        for column in untyped_columns
        if transport_field(column)
        in {
            "sys_id",
            "graph_sys_id",
            "branch_id",
            "revision_id",
            "staged_commit_id",
            "sys_valid_from_revision_id",
            "sys_valid_to_revision_id",
            "source_sys_id",
            "target_sys_id",
        }
    }
    bool_columns = {column for column in untyped_columns if transport_field(column) in {"deleted", "sys_deleted"}}
    timestamptz_columns = {
        column
        for column in untyped_columns
        if transport_field(column) in {"created_at", "updated_at", "sys_created_at", "sys_updated_at"}
    }
    remaining_columns = untyped_columns - uuid_columns - bool_columns - timestamptz_columns
    complete_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
        jsonb_columns=merged_hints.jsonb_columns,
        uuid_columns=merged_hints.uuid_columns | frozenset(uuid_columns),
        timestamptz_columns=merged_hints.timestamptz_columns | frozenset(timestamptz_columns),
        date_columns=merged_hints.date_columns,
        time_columns=merged_hints.time_columns,
        numeric_columns=merged_hints.numeric_columns,
        bool_columns=merged_hints.bool_columns | frozenset(bool_columns),
        integer_columns=merged_hints.integer_columns,
        bigint_columns=merged_hints.bigint_columns,
        double_columns=merged_hints.double_columns,
        text_columns=merged_hints.text_columns | frozenset(remaining_columns),
        bytea_columns=merged_hints.bytea_columns,
    )
    return output_shape, result_relation, complete_hints


def _is_current_revision_sentinel(value: object | None) -> bool:
    if value is None:
        return False
    return str(value) == "current"


class GraphPathEvidenceRelationRow(GraphPathEvidenceRow):
    """Exact SQL-visible publication row for composed path evidence."""

    result_ordinal: int


def _graph_path_evidence_columns_and_hints() -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    """Derive path publication types from the semantic evidence relation."""
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.graph_path_relation_plan import (
        GraphPathRelationSchemas,
    )

    evidence_schema = GraphPathRelationSchemas().evidence
    columns = tuple(str(column.column_id) for column in evidence_schema.columns)
    model_columns = tuple(GraphPathEvidenceRelationRow.model_fields)
    if columns != model_columns:
        msg = f"Graph path evidence schema {columns!r} does not match publication model {model_columns!r}"
        raise TypeError(msg)

    typed_columns: dict[str, set[str]] = {
        "uuid": set(),
        "int": set(),
        "bigint": set(),
        "bool": set(),
        "text": set(),
    }
    for column in evidence_schema.columns:
        type_hint = str(column.type_hint)
        target = typed_columns.get(type_hint)
        if target is None:
            msg = f"Graph path evidence column {column.column_id!s} has unsupported type hint {type_hint!r}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        target.add(str(column.column_id))
    return columns, SqlColumnTypeHints(
        uuid_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["uuid"]),
        integer_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["int"]),
        bigint_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bigint"]),
        bool_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bool"]),
        text_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["text"]),
    )


def _graph_path_required_int(row: Mapping[str, GraphTransportValue], field_name: str) -> int:
    value = row.get(field_name)
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int | str):
        msg = f"Graph path evidence field {field_name!r} requires an integer; received {type(value).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return int(value)


def _graph_path_required_id(row: Mapping[str, GraphTransportValue], field_name: str) -> SysId:
    value = row.get(field_name)
    if not isinstance(value, str | UUID | SysId):
        msg = f"Graph path evidence field {field_name!r} requires a UUID; received {type(value).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return SysId(value)


def _process_graph_path_evidence_rows(
    raw_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, GraphTransportValue]],
) -> list[GraphPathEvidenceRow]:
    ordered_rows = sorted(
        raw_rows,
        key=lambda row: (
            _graph_path_required_int(row, "result_ordinal"),
            _graph_path_required_int(row, "logical_step_ordinal"),
            _graph_path_required_int(row, "segment_ordinal"),
            _graph_path_required_int(row, "constituent_ordinal"),
        ),
    )
    evidence: list[GraphPathEvidenceRow] = []
    for raw_row in ordered_rows:
        row = dict(raw_row)
        projection_key = row.get("projected_source_key")
        row.pop("result_ordinal", None)
        if row.get("constituent_kind") == "edge" and row.get("constituent_sys_id") is None:
            edge_row = {
                "graph_sys_id": row.get("graph_sys_id"),
                "source_sys_id": row.get("source_sys_id"),
                "target_sys_id": row.get("target_sys_id"),
                "type_name": row.get("concrete_type_name"),
            }
            projected_id = projected_edge_row_sys_id(
                edge_row,
                projection_key,
                declared_type_name=ProjectedEdgeTypeName(str(row["declared_type_name"])),
            )
            if projected_id is None:
                msg = "Projected path evidence is missing its deterministic identity inputs"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            row["constituent_sys_id"] = projected_id

        for field_name in (
            "anchor_sys_id",
            "terminal_sys_id",
            "constituent_sys_id",
        ):
            row[field_name] = _graph_path_required_id(row, field_name)
        for field_name in (
            "predecessor_sys_id",
            "source_sys_id",
            "target_sys_id",
        ):
            value = row.get(field_name)
            row[field_name] = None if value is None else _graph_path_required_id(row, field_name)
        row["graph_sys_id"] = GraphId(
            _graph_path_required_id(row, "graph_sys_id").unwrap_to_uuid(),
        )
        for field_name in (
            "depth",
            "logical_step_id",
            "logical_step_ordinal",
            "relation_branch_ordinal",
            "segment_ordinal",
            "constituent_ordinal",
        ):
            row[field_name] = _graph_path_required_int(row, field_name)
        for field_name in ("projected", "terminal_constituent_edge"):
            value = row.get(field_name)
            if not isinstance(value, bool | int):
                msg = f"Graph path evidence field {field_name!r} requires a boolean; received {type(value).__name__}"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            row[field_name] = bool(value)
        evidence.append(GraphPathEvidenceRow.model_validate(row))
    return evidence

    selected_revision_tip_status: SelectedRevisionTipStatus = SelectedRevisionTipStatus.NOT_CURRENT_TIP,
) -> _ResolveGraphExecutionCtxConfig:
    return _ResolveGraphExecutionCtxConfig(
        graph_id_ref=graph_id_ref,
        graph_type=graph_type,
        revision_literal=revision_literal,
        revision_ref_id=revision_ref_id,
        branch_anchor_literal=branch_anchor_literal,
        branch_anchor_ref_id=branch_anchor_ref_id,
        prefer_tip_strategy=prefer_tip_strategy,
        tip_materialization=tip_materialization,
        branch_table=branch_table,
        revision_branch_index_table=revision_branch_index_table,
        revision_parent_table=revision_parent_table,
        tip_materialization_ref_id=tip_materialization_ref_id,
        tip_revision_ref_id=tip_revision_ref_id,
        predicted_source=predicted_source,
        predicted_tip_materialization=predicted_tip_materialization,
        route_hint_identity=route_hint_identity,
        include_staged_working_set=include_staged_working_set,
        requires_stable_route_snapshot=requires_stable_route_snapshot,
        selected_revision_tip_status=selected_revision_tip_status,
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _GraphCompileContextConfig:
    """Symbolic graph execution-context inputs carried by graph terminal steps.

    The terminal step synthesizes :class:`SqlGraphExecutionCtx` during ``compile()``
    from this config plus ``CompilationContext`` (backend / dialect / cached
    revision + branch on the active transaction). No ``ResolvedRefs`` access
    happens in ``preprocess()`` or ``compile()``; prerequisite refs declared
    here keep the ServerPlan dependency graph intact so any upstream scalar
    producers still run before the terminal.
    """

    graph_id_ref: ScalarServerRef[GraphId]
    revision_literal: RevisionId | None
    revision_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None
    branch_anchor_literal: BranchId | None
    branch_anchor_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None
    prefer_tip_strategy: bool
    tip_materialization: BranchTipMaterialization
    branch_table: SqlTableName | None = None
    revision_branch_index_table: SqlTableName | None = None
    revision_parent_table: SqlTableName | None = None
    force_application_versioning: bool = False
    include_staged_working_set: bool = False
    requires_stable_route_snapshot: bool = True
    inherited_branch_visibility: bool = False
    selected_revision_tip_status: SelectedRevisionTipStatus = SelectedRevisionTipStatus.NOT_CURRENT_TIP
    tip_materialization_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    tip_revision_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    predicted_source: PublishedVersionSource | None = None
    predicted_tip_materialization: BranchTipMaterialization | None = None
    route_hint_identity: BranchReadHintIdentity | None = None
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        graph_id_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            self.graph_id_ref,
            site="_GraphCompileContextConfig.dependencies",
        )
        deps = set(graph_id_shape.dependency_refs) | {
            str(ref_id)
            for ref_id in (
                self.revision_ref_id,
                self.branch_anchor_ref_id,
                self.tip_materialization_ref_id,
                self.tip_revision_ref_id,
                self.permission_context_ref,
            )
            if ref_id is not None
        }
        return frozenset(deps)

    def has_branch_anchor_prereq(self) -> bool:
        return self.branch_anchor_literal is not None or self.branch_anchor_ref_id is not None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _GraphResultVisibilityConfig:
    """Permission-aware graph source owned by one graph-result intent."""

    graph_id_ref: ScalarServerRef[GraphId]
    graph_type: type[Graph]
    revision_id_ref: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId]
    domain: type[VersioningDomain]
    error_message: str
    preferred_source: PublishedVersionSource | None = None
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        graph_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            self.graph_id_ref,
            site="_GraphResultVisibilityConfig.graph_id_ref",
        )
        revision_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            self.revision_id_ref,
            site="_GraphResultVisibilityConfig.revision_id_ref",
        )
        dependencies = {
            *graph_shape.dependency_refs,
            *revision_shape.dependency_refs,
        }
        if self.permission_context_ref is not None:
            dependencies.add(str(self.permission_context_ref))
        return frozenset(dependencies)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _GraphExecuteConfig:
    graph_id_ref: GraphId | ScalarServerRef[GraphId]

    result_node_type: type[GraphNode[Any]]

    sql_visible_after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] | None = None
    auth_scope_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()

def _graph_execute_config_sql_visible_dependencies(
    config: _GraphExecuteConfig,
) -> frozenset[str]:
    graph_id_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
        config.graph_id_ref,
        site="_graph_execute_config_sql_visible_dependencies",
    )
    after_refs = config.after_refs if config.sql_visible_after_refs is None else config.sql_visible_after_refs
    dependencies = (
        config.compile_context.dependencies() | graph_id_shape.dependency_refs | frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in after_refs)
    )
    return frozenset(ref_id for ref_id in dependencies if not ref_id.partition(".")[0].startswith("seed_"))

def _build_graph_execution_ctx(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    graph_id_ref: GraphId | ScalarServerRef[GraphId],
    graph_type: type[Graph[Any]],
    compile_context: _GraphCompileContextConfig,
) -> SqlGraphExecutionCtx:
    """Synthesize :class:`SqlGraphExecutionCtx` from compile-time inputs only.

    Reads are limited to ``CompilationContext`` attributes published by the
    executor (``backend_type``, ``dialect``, ``revision_id``, ``branch_id``,
    ``cte_refs``) and the terminal step's static config. Symbolic ref IDs
    from the compile context are lowered to :class:`SqlRenderable`
    expressions via :func:`lower_scalar_server_ref`, so the generated SQL
    references upstream CTE fields directly rather than materializing runtime
    values. No ``ResolvedRefs`` or ``materialized_pipeline`` access occurs
    here, keeping this path clear of the SPT-010 / SPT-024 runtime-value
    tripwires.
    """
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SysIdValue
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import (
        lower_scalar_server_ref,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam
    from l2070_batching.server_ref import ScalarServerRef, ServerRefs
    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import BranchId as _BranchId
    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import RevisionId
    from l7200_versioned_transactions.graph_lazy_sql import (
        GraphSqlVersioningMode,
        SqlGraphExecutionCtx as _Ctx,
    )
    from l7200_versioned_transactions.graph_lazy_sql import (
        resolve_graph_versioning_mode,
    )

    backend_type = ctx.backend_type
    dialect_name = type(ctx.dialect).__name__
    speculated_source = compile_context.predicted_source if ctx.backend_profile.traits.supports_guarded_route_speculation else None
    selected_policy = ctx.selected_branch_policy_ref_id is not None and speculated_source is None
    revision_is_current_branch_tip = (
        speculated_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP
        if speculated_source is not None
        else compile_context.selected_revision_tip_status is SelectedRevisionTipStatus.CURRENT_TIP
        or (selected_policy and ctx.branch_tip_materialized)
    )
    prefer_tip_strategy = (
        speculated_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP
        if speculated_source is not None
        else ctx.prefer_tip_strategy
        if selected_policy
        else compile_context.prefer_tip_strategy
    )
    tip_materialization = (
        compile_context.predicted_tip_materialization
        if speculated_source is not None and compile_context.predicted_tip_materialization is not None
        else BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED
        if selected_policy and ctx.branch_tip_materialized
        else BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS
        if selected_policy
        else compile_context.tip_materialization
    )

    revision_literal = compile_context.revision_literal
    revision_ref_id = compile_context.revision_ref_id
    revision_id: RevisionId | None
    if revision_literal is not None and not _is_current_revision_sentinel(revision_literal):
        revision_id = RevisionId(str(revision_literal))
        revision_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
    elif revision_literal is not None:
        revision_id = RevisionId.current()
        revision_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
    elif revision_ref_id is not None:
        ctx_revision = ctx.revision_id
        if ctx.cte_refs is not None and str(revision_ref_id) in ctx.cte_refs:
            revision_ref: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId] = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                revision_ref_id,
                variant="scalar",
            )
            revision_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(revision_ref, ctx, default_field="revision_id")
            revision_id = RevisionId(str(ctx_revision)) if ctx_revision is not None else None
        elif ctx_revision is not None and not _is_current_revision_sentinel(ctx_revision):
            revision_id = RevisionId(str(ctx_revision))
            revision_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
        elif prefer_tip_strategy and (
            tip_materialization is BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS
            or compile_context.branch_anchor_literal is not None
            or compile_context.branch_anchor_ref_id is not None
            or ctx.branch_id is not None
        ):
            revision_id = RevisionId.current()
            revision_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
        else:
            revision_ref = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                revision_ref_id,
                variant="scalar",
            )
            revision_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(revision_ref, ctx, default_field="revision_id")
            revision_id = None
    elif ctx.revision_id is not None and not _is_current_revision_sentinel(ctx.revision_id):
        revision_id = RevisionId(str(ctx.revision_id))
        revision_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
    elif (
        compile_context.branch_anchor_literal is not None or compile_context.branch_anchor_ref_id is not None or ctx.branch_id is not None
    ):
        revision_id = RevisionId.current()
        revision_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(revision_id.unwrap_to_str()))
    else:
        msg = "Graph is not visible in the current versioned read context"
        raise db_exc.PermissionError(msg)

    branch_anchor_literal = compile_context.branch_anchor_literal
    branch_anchor_ref_id = compile_context.branch_anchor_ref_id
    branch_anchor: _BranchId | None
    branch_anchor_expr: SqlRenderable | None
    if branch_anchor_literal is not None:
        branch_anchor = branch_anchor_literal
        branch_anchor_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(branch_anchor.unwrap_to_str()))
    elif branch_anchor_ref_id is not None:
        if ctx.cte_refs is not None and str(branch_anchor_ref_id) in ctx.cte_refs:
            branch_anchor_ref: ScalarServerRef[_BranchId] = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                branch_anchor_ref_id,
                variant="scalar",
            )
            branch_anchor_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(
                branch_anchor_ref,
                ctx,
                default_field="branch_id",
            )
            branch_anchor = None
        elif ctx.branch_id is not None:
            branch_anchor = _BranchId(str(ctx.branch_id))
            branch_anchor_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(branch_anchor.unwrap_to_str()))
        else:
            branch_anchor_ref = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                branch_anchor_ref_id,
                variant="scalar",
            )
            branch_anchor_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(
                branch_anchor_ref,
                ctx,
                default_field="branch_id",
            )
            branch_anchor = None
    elif ctx.branch_id is not None:
        branch_anchor = _BranchId(str(ctx.branch_id))
        branch_anchor_expr = SqlParam(SysIdValue(branch_anchor.unwrap_to_str()))
    else:
        branch_anchor = None
        branch_anchor_expr = None

    has_branch_anchor = branch_anchor_expr is not None
    ctx_revision_is_concrete = ctx.revision_id is not None and not _is_current_revision_sentinel(ctx.revision_id)
    revision_literal_is_concrete = revision_literal is not None and not _is_current_revision_sentinel(revision_literal)
    has_explicit_revision_selector = (
        revision_literal_is_concrete or ctx.explicit_revision_id is not None or revision_ref_id is not None or ctx_revision_is_concrete
    )
    has_revision_anchor = has_explicit_revision_selector and not revision_is_current_branch_tip
    if (
        prefer_tip_strategy
        and tip_materialization is BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED
        and has_branch_anchor
        and not has_revision_anchor
        and revision_ref_id is None
        and revision_literal is None
        and ctx.explicit_revision_id is None
        and not ctx_revision_is_concrete
    ):
        tip_revision_ref_id = compile_context.tip_revision_ref_id
        if tip_revision_ref_id is None:
            raise RuntimeError("TIP graph execution requires a persisted tip-revision ref")
        tip_revision_ref: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId] = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
            tip_revision_ref_id,
            variant="scalar",
        )
        revision_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(
            tip_revision_ref,
            ctx,
            default_field="revision_id",
        )
    inherited_branch_visibility = (
        compile_context.inherited_branch_visibility
        or has_explicit_revision_selector
        or (has_branch_anchor and prefer_tip_strategy and tip_materialization is BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS)
    )
    if compile_context.force_application_versioning:
        versioning_mode = GraphSqlVersioningMode.APPLICATION
    elif speculated_source is not None:
        versioning_mode = GraphSqlVersioningMode.TIP if speculated_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP else GraphSqlVersioningMode.SPARSE
    else:
        versioning_mode = resolve_graph_versioning_mode(
            has_branch_anchor=has_branch_anchor,
            prefer_tip_strategy=(prefer_tip_strategy and not has_revision_anchor),
            tip_materialization=tip_materialization,
        )

    graph_recursive_transport = ctx.backend_profile.traits.graph_recursive_transport
    graph_distinct_transport = ctx.backend_profile.traits.graph_distinct_transport
    return _Ctx(
        graph_id=graph_id_ref,
        revision_id=revision_id,
        branch_anchor=branch_anchor,
        graph_type=graph_type,
        versioning_mode=versioning_mode,
        dialect_name=dialect_name,
        supports_recursive_cte=graph_recursive_transport is GraphRecursiveTransport.RECURSIVE_CTE,
        supports_distinct_on=graph_distinct_transport is GraphDistinctTransport.DISTINCT_ON,
        dolt_commit_hash=None,
        inherited_branch_visibility=inherited_branch_visibility,
        revision_is_current=revision_id is not None and revision_id.is_current(),
        revision_expr=revision_expr,
        branch_anchor_expr=branch_anchor_expr,
        include_staged_working_set=compile_context.include_staged_working_set,
        revision_branch_index_table=compile_context.revision_branch_index_table,
        revision_parent_table=compile_context.revision_parent_table,
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)

    """Minimal compile-time backend shape required by SqlGraphQueryBuilder."""

    backend_type: BackendType


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CompileOnlyGraphTxnStub:
    """Compile-only transaction stub; runtime APIs must never be added here."""

    backend_stub: CompileOnlyGraphBackendStub

    @property
    def _conn(self: CompileOnlyGraphTxnStub) -> CompileOnlyGraphBackendStub:
