            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({"__exists"})),
            grammar=SqlSelectExistsFromSubquery(grammar),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
                "__exists",
                scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.BOOL,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=self._collect_auxiliary_ctes(ctx),
            needs_recursive_with=True,
        )


class ExecuteGraphBindingsStep(_BaseExecuteGraphStep[list[GraphBindingRow]]):
    optimizer_projection_owned = True

    def result_cardinality(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def step_tags(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        tags = {"read", "graph", "query", "bindings"}
        if self._pattern.order_by:
            tags.add("ordered_result")
        return frozenset(tags)

    def json_aggregation_order_by(
        self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep,
    ) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
        """Preserve graph row order inside backends that aggregate transport JSON."""
        recursive_path = (
            self._pattern.paths[0]
            if len(self._pattern.paths) == 1
            and (self._pattern.paths[0].quantifier.min_hops != 1 or self._pattern.paths[0].quantifier.max_hops != 1)
            else None
        )
        columns: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        for clause in self._pattern.order_by:
            field_path = clause.expression
            if not isinstance(field_path, str):
                continue
            output_column = field_path
            if "." in field_path:
                variable_name, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
                if (
                    recursive_path is not None
                    and variable_name == recursive_path.edge.variable
                    and field_name
                    in {
                        "sys_id",
                        "graph_sys_id",
                        "source_sys_id",
                        "target_sys_id",
                        "type_name",
                    }
                ):
                    edge_projection = next(
                        (
                            projection
                            for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection) and projection.edge_variable == variable_name
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    output_column = (
                        _binding_edge_alias(edge_projection.binding_name, field_name)
                        if edge_projection is not None
                        else f"__pt_{variable_name}_{field_name}"
                    )
                elif (
                    recursive_path is not None
                    and variable_name == recursive_path.edge.variable
                    and field_name
                    not in {
                        "sys_id",
                        "graph_sys_id",
                        "source_sys_id",
                        "target_sys_id",
                        "type_name",
                    }
                ):
                    output_column = f"__pt_{variable_name}_{field_name}"
                elif recursive_path is not None and variable_name == recursive_path.target.variable:
                    scalar_projection = next(
                        (
                            projection
                            for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection) and projection.field_path == field_path
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    output_column = (
                        scalar_projection.binding_name
                        if scalar_projection is not None
                        else get_db_column_name(recursive_path.target.node_type, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
                    )
                elif field_name == "sys_id":
                    projection = next(
                        (
                            candidate
                            for candidate in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if (isinstance(candidate, NodeBindingProjection) and candidate.node_variable == variable_name)
                            or (isinstance(candidate, EdgeBindingProjection) and candidate.edge_variable == variable_name)
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                        output_column = _binding_node_sys_id_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                        )
                    elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                        output_column = _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            "sys_id",
                        )
                    else:
                        output_column = f"__order_{variable_name}__{field_name}"
                else:
                    output_column = f"__order_{variable_name}__{field_name}"
            columns.append((output_column, str(clause.direction)))
        return tuple(columns)

    def _cte_output_columns(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        columns: list[str] = []
        for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                columns.append(_binding_node_sys_id_alias(projection.binding_name))
            elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                columns.extend(
                    (
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "graph_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "source_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "target_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "type_name"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            PROJECTED_EDGE_SOURCE_KEY_COLUMN,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            elif isinstance(projection, DepthBindingProjection):
                columns.append(projection.binding_name)
            elif isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection):
                columns.append(projection.binding_name)
        columns.extend(column_name for column_name, _direction in self.json_aggregation_order_by())
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns)) if columns else None

    def cte_column_type_hints(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
        columns = self._cte_output_columns()
        if columns is None:
            return None
        jsonb_columns: set[str] = set()
        uuid_columns: set[str] = set()
        timestamptz_columns: set[str] = set()
        date_columns: set[str] = set()
        bool_columns: set[str] = set()
        integer_columns: set[str] = set()
        bigint_columns: set[str] = set()
        double_columns: set[str] = set()
        text_columns: set[str] = set()
        bytea_columns: set[str] = set()
        hint_targets = (
            ("jsonb_columns", jsonb_columns),
            ("uuid_columns", uuid_columns),
            ("timestamptz_columns", timestamptz_columns),
            ("date_columns", date_columns),
            ("bool_columns", bool_columns),
            ("integer_columns", integer_columns),
            ("bigint_columns", bigint_columns),
            ("double_columns", double_columns),
            ("text_columns", text_columns),
            ("bytea_columns", bytea_columns),
        )
        variable_models: dict[str, type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = {
            variable: node.node_type for variable, node in self._nodes.items()
        }
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(self._pattern):
            variable_models[path.source.variable] = path.source.node_type
            variable_models[path.target.variable] = path.target.node_type
            for step in _iter_path_expression_steps(path.expression):
                if step.source_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.source_binding] = step.source_type
                if step.target_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.target_binding] = step.target_type
                if step.edge_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.edge_binding] = step.edge_types[0]

        def add_field_hint(output_column: str, field_path: str) -> bool:
            if "." not in field_path:
                return False
            variable, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
            model_cls = variable_models.get(variable)
            if model_cls is None or field_name not in model_cls.model_fields:
                return False
            db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            source_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, (db_column,))
            if source_hints is None:
                return False
            for attribute, target in hint_targets:
                if db_column in getattr(source_hints, attribute):
                    target.add(output_column)
                    return True
            return False

        for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                uuid_columns.add(_binding_node_sys_id_alias(projection.binding_name))
            elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                uuid_columns.update(
                    {
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "graph_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "source_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "target_sys_id"),
                    },
                )
                text_columns.update(
                    {
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "type_name"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            PROJECTED_EDGE_SOURCE_KEY_COLUMN,
                        ),
                    },
                )
            elif isinstance(projection, DepthBindingProjection):
                integer_columns.add(projection.binding_name)
            elif isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection) and not add_field_hint(
                projection.binding_name,
                projection.field_path,
            ):
                text_columns.add(projection.binding_name)

        order_columns = self.json_aggregation_order_by()
        string_order_clauses = tuple(clause for clause in self._pattern.order_by if isinstance(clause.expression, str))
        for clause, (column_name, _direction) in zip(
            string_order_clauses,
            order_columns,
            strict=True,
        ):
            typed_columns = set().union(*(target for _attribute, target in hint_targets))
            if column_name in typed_columns:
                continue
            if not isinstance(clause.expression, str) or not add_field_hint(
                column_name,
                clause.expression,
            ):
                text_columns.add(column_name)

        return SqlColumnTypeHints(
            jsonb_columns=frozenset(jsonb_columns),
            uuid_columns=frozenset(uuid_columns),
            timestamptz_columns=frozenset(timestamptz_columns),
            date_columns=frozenset(date_columns),
            bool_columns=frozenset(bool_columns),
            integer_columns=frozenset(integer_columns),
            bigint_columns=frozenset(bigint_columns),
            double_columns=frozenset(double_columns),
            text_columns=frozenset(text_columns),
            bytea_columns=frozenset(bytea_columns),
        )

    def executor_publication_projection_columns(
        self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep,
    ) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        """Publish result and ordering columns required by batched transport."""
        return self._cte_output_columns()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        # Graph bindings publish CTE contracts, so the helper names reflect the
        # SQL-visible publication invariant rather than runtime binding shape.
        columns = self._cte_output_columns()
        column_type_hints = self.cte_column_type_hints()
        if columns is None:
            if column_type_hints is not None and column_type_hints.has_any():
                msg = f"{type(self).__name__} declares SQL column type hints without an explicit cte_output_columns() contract."
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=GraphBindingRow,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(GraphBindingRow),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[GraphBindingRow]]:
        dispatched = self._compile_persisted_policy_dispatch(ctx)
        if dispatched is not None:
            return dispatched
        from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledStep as CompiledStepFactory

        builder = self._build_graph_query_builder(ctx)
        compile_plans = self._build_traversal_compile_plans(
            ctx,
            nested_scope=GraphNestedPatternScope.INCLUDE_NESTED,
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStepFactory(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=builder._build_bindings_grammar(compile_plans=compile_plans),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=graph_bindings_post_op(
                _graph_binding_materialization_spec(
                    nodes=self._nodes,
                    pattern=self._pattern,
                ),
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=self._collect_auxiliary_ctes(ctx),
            needs_recursive_with=True,
        )


class ExecuteGraphAggregateStep(_BaseExecuteGraphStep[list[dict[str, object]]]):
    def result_cardinality(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def step_tags(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "graph", "query", "aggregate"})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        group_field_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
        for group_field in self._pattern.group_by:
            field_name = str(group_field).rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
            group_field_counts[field_name] = group_field_counts.get(field_name, 0) + 1

        aggregation_aliases = {aggregation.alias for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations}
        group_leaf_names = {str(group_field).rsplit(".", 1)[-1] for group_field in self._pattern.group_by}

        def aggregation_output_name(alias: str) -> str:
            return f"aggregate_{alias}" if alias in group_leaf_names else alias

        def output_name(raw: object) -> str:
            value = str(raw)
            if "." not in value and value in aggregation_aliases:
                return aggregation_output_name(value)
            field_name = value.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
            if (group_field_counts.get(field_name, 0) > 1 or field_name in aggregation_aliases) and "." in value:
                variable_name = value.split(".", 1)[0]
                return f"{variable_name}_{field_name}"
            return field_name

        if self._pattern.overview_aggregation is not None:
            columns = tuple(self._pattern.overview_aggregation.output_columns)
        elif self._pattern.select_fields:
            columns = tuple(select_field.alias or output_name(select_field.expression) for select_field in self._pattern.select_fields)
        else:
            columns = tuple(
                [output_name(field) for field in self._pattern.group_by]
                + [aggregation.alias for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations],
            )
        columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))
        if not columns:
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()

        aggregation_columns = {
            aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias)
            for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations
            if aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias) in columns
        }
        group_columns = set(columns) - aggregation_columns
        typed_columns: dict[str, set[str]] = {
            attribute: set()
            for attribute in (
                "jsonb_columns",
                "uuid_columns",
                "timestamptz_columns",
                "date_columns",
                "time_columns",
                "numeric_columns",
                "bool_columns",
                "integer_columns",
                "bigint_columns",
                "double_columns",
                "text_columns",
                "bytea_columns",
            )
        }
        variable_models: dict[str, type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = {
            variable: node.node_type for variable, node in self._nodes.items()
        }
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(self._pattern):
            variable_models[path.source.variable] = path.source.node_type
            variable_models[path.target.variable] = path.target.node_type
            if path.edge.variable is not None:
                variable_models[path.edge.variable] = path.edge.edge_type

        def add_field_type(output_column: str, field_path: str) -> str | None:
            if "." not in field_path:
                return None
            variable_name, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
            model_cls = variable_models.get(variable_name)
            if model_cls is None:
                return None
            db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            source_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, (db_column,))
            if source_hints is None:
                return None
            for attribute, target in typed_columns.items():
                if db_column in getattr(source_hints, attribute):
                    target.add(output_column)
                    return attribute
            return None

        for group_field in self._pattern.group_by:
            output_column = output_name(group_field)
            if add_field_type(output_column, group_field) is None:
                typed_columns["text_columns"].add(output_column)
        hinted_group_columns = set().union(*typed_columns.values())
        typed_columns["text_columns"].update(group_columns - hinted_group_columns)

        for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations:
            output_column = aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias)
            if output_column not in aggregation_columns:
                continue
            function = aggregation.function.upper()
            if function == "COUNT":
                typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add(output_column)
                continue
            if function in {"AVG", "STDDEV", "VARIANCE"}:
                typed_columns["double_columns"].add(output_column)
                continue
            source_attribute = add_field_type(output_column, aggregation.expression) if isinstance(aggregation.expression, str) else None
            if source_attribute is None:
                typed_columns["double_columns"].add(output_column)
            elif function == "SUM" and source_attribute == "integer_columns":
                typed_columns["integer_columns"].discard(output_column)
                typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add(output_column)

        if self._pattern.overview_aggregation is not None:
            typed_columns["text_columns"].update({"kind", "type_name"})
            typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add("count")
            typed_columns["text_columns"].discard("count")
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
            bigint_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bigint_columns"]),
            double_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["double_columns"]),
            jsonb_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["jsonb_columns"]),
            uuid_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["uuid_columns"]),
            timestamptz_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["timestamptz_columns"]),
            date_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["date_columns"]),
            time_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["time_columns"]),
            numeric_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["numeric_columns"]),
            bool_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bool_columns"]),
            integer_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["integer_columns"]),
            text_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["text_columns"]),
            bytea_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bytea_columns"]),
        ).filtered(set(columns))
        source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        _contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            columns,
            column_type_hints,
        )
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(_contract_model_cls),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=None if source_tables is None else frozenset(str(table) for table in source_tables),
        )

    def compile(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
        dispatched = self._compile_persisted_policy_dispatch(ctx)
        if dispatched is not None:
            return dispatched
        from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledStep as CompiledStepFactory

        builder = self._build_graph_query_builder(ctx)
        compile_plans = self._build_traversal_compile_plans(ctx)
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStepFactory(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=builder._build_aggregate_grammar(compile_plans=compile_plans),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            auxiliary_ctes=self._collect_auxiliary_ctes(ctx),
            needs_recursive_with=True,
        )


def _graph_intent_dependency_contract(
    *,
    dependencies: frozenset[str],
    sql_visible: frozenset[str],
    auth_scope: frozenset[str],
) -> StepDependencyContract:
    return StepDependencyContract(
        consumed_refs=frozenset(
            ConsumedRef(
                ref=ref,
                source=DependencySource.GRAPH_CONFIG,
                required_for=frozenset(
                    {
                        DependencyUse.ORDERING,
                        *((DependencyUse.SQL_VISIBLE,) if ref in sql_visible else ()),
                        *((DependencyUse.AUTH_SCOPE,) if ref in auth_scope else ()),
                    },
                ),
            )
            for ref in dependencies
        ),
        transport=TransportDependencyPolicy.TRANSPORTABLE,
        materialization=MaterializationDependencyPolicy.NONE,
        reason="graph visibility and relation dependencies are explicit",
    )


class SelectVisibleGraphIntent[GraphT: Graph[Any]](
    VersionedSelectOneIntent[GraphT],
):
    """Permission-filtered graph-row producer with explicit visibility facts."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        graph_type: type[GraphT],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedSelectOneConfig],
        *,
        snapshot_revision_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id, model_cls=graph_type, config=config)
        self.graph_type = graph_type
        self.snapshot_revision_ref = snapshot_revision_ref

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies = set(super().dependencies())
        if self.snapshot_revision_ref is not None:
            dependencies.add(str(self.snapshot_revision_ref))
        return frozenset(dependencies)

    def graph_visibility_contract(self) -> GraphVisibilityProducerContract:
        graph_id_ref = self.sys_id.ref_id
        revision_ref = self.snapshot_revision_ref if self.snapshot_revision_ref is not None else self.revision_id.ref_id
        branch_ref = None if self.branch_id is None else self.branch_id.ref_id
        if graph_id_ref is None or revision_ref is None:
            msg = "graph visibility inputs must be symbolic refs"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return GraphVisibilityProducerContract(
            role=GraphVisibilityProducerRole.VISIBLE_GRAPH_ROWS,
            graph_type=self.graph_type,
            output_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw_rows"),
            source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(graph_id_ref),
            graph_id_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw_rows.sys_id"),
            revision_ref=ServerPlanRefId(revision_ref),
            branch_anchor_ref=(None if branch_ref is None else ServerPlanRefId(branch_ref)),
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _PublishGraphSnapshotConfig:
    graph_type: type[Graph[Any]]
    snapshot: GraphSnapshotInput


class PublishGraphSnapshotIntent(IntentStep[GraphSnapshotInput]):
    """Publish one immutable graph snapshot planning fact."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "graph", "snapshot", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.SCALAR
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        config: ScalarServerRef[_PublishGraphSnapshotConfig],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        snapshot = self._config.snapshot
        refs = {str(snapshot.graph_id_ref), str(snapshot.revision_ref)}
        if snapshot.branch_anchor_ref is not None:
            refs.add(str(snapshot.branch_anchor_ref))
        return frozenset(refs)

    def schema_model_dependencies(self) -> tuple[type, ...]:
        return (self._config.graph_type,)

    def graph_visibility_contract(self) -> GraphVisibilityProducerContract:
        snapshot = self._config.snapshot
        return GraphVisibilityProducerContract(
            role=GraphVisibilityProducerRole.SNAPSHOT,
            graph_type=self._config.graph_type,
            output_ref=self.ref_id,
            graph_id_ref=snapshot.graph_id_ref,
            revision_ref=snapshot.revision_ref,
            branch_anchor_ref=snapshot.branch_anchor_ref,
        )

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        del ctx
        snapshot = self._config.snapshot
        return (
            StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                self.ref_id,
                snapshot,
                list(self.dependencies()),
            ),
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _RequirePermittedGraphRowIntentConfig:
    graph_type: type[Graph[Any]]

class RequirePermittedGraphRowStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[object]):
    """SQL-visible graph guard that preserves the permitted graph relation."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        error_message: str,
        publication_contract: CtePublicationContract,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._error_message = error_message
        self._publication_contract = publication_contract

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"validation", "permission", "graph", "sql_projection"})

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return None

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        source_tables = self._publication_contract.source_tables
        if source_tables is None:
            raise ValueError("Graph validation publication must declare its source tables")
        return source_tables

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref)})

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        return self._publication_contract

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[object]:
        delegate = RequirePermittedRowStep[object](
            self.ref_id,
            config=_RequirePermittedRowConfig(
                source_ref=self._source_ref,
                error_message=self._error_message,
                columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in self._publication_contract.columns),
            ),
        )
        compiled = delegate.compile(ctx)
        from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract

        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self._publication_contract,
        )
        return replace(
            compiled,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        )

def freeze_relationship_compilation_for_reuse(
    compilation: RelationshipCompilation,
) -> RelationshipCompilation:
    """Copy formatter metadata while removing transaction-local ref handles."""
    include_refs = {key: dataclass_replace(ref, result_ref=None) for key, ref in compilation.include_compilation.include_refs.items()}
    two_hop_refs = {
        key: dataclass_replace(
            ref,
            target_result_ref=cast("ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity]", None),
        )
        for key, ref in compilation.two_hop_refs.items()
    }
    derived_refs = {
        key: dataclass_replace(
            ref,
            lookup_result_ref=cast("ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity]", None),
        )
        for key, ref in compilation.derived_refs.items()
    }
    return RelationshipCompilation(
        include_compilation=CompilationResult(include_refs=include_refs),
        two_hop_refs=two_hop_refs,
        derived_refs=derived_refs,
        child_compilations={
            key: freeze_relationship_compilation_for_reuse(child) for key, child in compilation.child_compilations.items()
        },
        embedded_refs=dict(compilation.embedded_refs),
    )

    source_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[E],

def _build_include_hydration_payload[E: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](
    source_ref_id: str | None,
    literal_source_entities: tuple[E, ...],
    source_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
    edges: tuple[CompiledIncludeRef, ...],
    hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> IncludeHydrationPayload[E]:
    if literal_source_entities:
        source_entities = list(literal_source_entities)
    elif source_ref_id is None:
        source_entities = list(literal_source_entities)
    else:
        source_entities = list(cast(Sequence[E], runtime_refs.get(source_ref_id) or ()))
    if source_model_cls is not None:
        source_entities = [
            cast(E, hydrator(source_model_cls, entity)) if isinstance(entity, dict) else entity for entity in source_entities
        ]
    compilation = CompilationResult(include_refs={edge.ref_key: edge for edge in edges})

    def load_edge_rows(ref: CompiledIncludeRef) -> Sequence[IncludeEntity]:
        if ref.result_ref_id not in runtime_refs:
            available_refs = tuple(str(key) for key in runtime_refs.keys())
            msg = (
                "include hydration edge result is missing from runtime refs "
                f"(edge={ref.ref_key!r}, result_ref_id={ref.result_ref_id!r}, "
                f"available_refs={available_refs!r}). IncludeLoadIntent lowering must schedule "
                "all include edge query steps before _BuildIncludeHydrationPayloadStep."
            )
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return cast(Sequence[IncludeEntity], runtime_refs[ref.result_ref_id] or ())

    include_data = group_include_data(
        source_entities,
        compilation,
        lambda ref: [_normalize_loaded_include_entity(row, ref.target_model) for row in load_edge_rows(ref)],
    )
    return IncludeHydrationPayload(
        source_entities=tuple(source_entities),
        include_data={entity_id: field_map for entity_id, field_map in include_data.items()},
    )


@pure_lazy
def describe_include_binding(include: IncludeSpec) -> IncludeBinding | None:
    """Return the canonical impl-owned relationship metadata for an include spec."""
    from l2080_lazy_orm.has_many import HasMany
    from l2080_lazy_orm.through import Through
    from l2100_include.include import Include
    from l2100_include.include_many import IncludeMany, IncludeThrough

    binding: IncludeBinding | None = None
    if isinstance(include, Include):
        rel = cast(BelongsTo[Any, Any], object.__getattribute__(include, "_relationship"))
        attr_name = rel._attr_name  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        if attr_name is None:
            return None
        binding = IncludeBinding(
            kind="belongs_to",
            field_name=attr_name,
            source_key_field=rel.fk_field,
            is_many=False,
            target_model=rel.target,
            nested_includes=tuple(include.nested_includes),
            descriptor=rel,
        )
    elif isinstance(include, IncludeMany):
        rel_many = cast(HasMany[Any], object.__getattribute__(include, "_relationship"))
        attr_name = rel_many._attr_name  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        if attr_name is None:
            return None
        binding = IncludeBinding(
            kind="has_many",
            field_name=attr_name,
            source_key_field=rel_many._foreign_key,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            is_many=True,
            target_model=rel_many._target_cls,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            nested_includes=tuple(include.nested_includes),
            descriptor=rel_many,
            filter_expression=object.__getattribute__(include, "_filter_expression"),
            order_by_clauses=tuple(object.__getattribute__(include, "_order_by_clauses")),
            top=object.__getattribute__(include, "_top"),
            skip=object.__getattribute__(include, "_skip"),
        )
    elif isinstance(include, IncludeThrough):
        rel_through = cast(Through[Any], object.__getattribute__(include, "_relationship"))
        attr_name = rel_through._attr_name  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        if attr_name is None:
            return None
        binding = IncludeBinding(
            kind="through",
            field_name=attr_name,
            source_key_field=rel_through._owner_key,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            is_many=True,
            target_model=rel_through._junction_cls,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            nested_includes=tuple(include.nested_includes),
            descriptor=rel_through,
            filter_expression=object.__getattribute__(include, "_filter_expression"),
            order_by_clauses=tuple(object.__getattribute__(include, "_order_by_clauses")),
            top=object.__getattribute__(include, "_top"),
            skip=object.__getattribute__(include, "_skip"),
        )

    return binding


@pure_lazy
def iter_include_bindings(includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec]) -> list[IncludeBinding]:
    """Normalize public include specs into canonical impl-owned bindings."""
    bindings: list[IncludeBinding] = []
    for include in includes:
        binding = describe_include_binding(include)
        if binding is not None:
            bindings.append(binding)
    return bindings


def build_include_descriptor_map(
    includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec],
) -> dict[str, RelationshipDescriptor]:
    """Return the descriptor instance for each included field."""
    return {binding.field_name: binding.descriptor for binding in iter_include_bindings(includes)}


@pure_lazy
def _relationship_requests_from_includes(
    includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec],
) -> tuple[_RelationshipRequest, ...]:
    requests: list[_RelationshipRequest] = []
    for binding in iter_include_bindings(includes):
        requests.append(
            _RelationshipRequest(
                field_name=binding.field_name,
                kind=binding.kind,
                target_model=binding.target_model,
                nested_requests=_relationship_requests_from_includes(binding.nested_includes),
                nested_include_specs=tuple(binding.nested_includes),
                visibility="junction" if binding.kind == "through" else "target",
                source_key_field=binding.source_key_field,
                filter_expression=binding.filter_expression,
                order_by_clauses=binding.order_by_clauses,
                top=binding.top,
                skip=binding.skip,
            ),
        )
    return tuple(requests)


def include_source_projection_fields(includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec]) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Return top-level source fields needed to plan the requested includes."""
    return frozenset(
        _include_filter_binding(request).source_projection_field
        for request in _relationship_requests_from_includes(includes)
        if request.kind in {"belongs_to", "has_many", "through"}
    )


def relationship_selection_source_projection_fields(
    relationships: Sequence[RelationshipSelection],
) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Return top-level source fields required by relationship selections."""
    fields: set[str] = set()
    for request in _relationship_requests_from_selections(relationships):
        if request.kind in {"belongs_to", "has_many", "through", "two_hop"}:
            fields.add(_include_filter_binding(request).source_projection_field)
        elif request.kind == "embedded" and request.source_key_field is not None:
            fields.add(request.source_key_field)
        else:
            fields.add("sys_id")
    return frozenset(fields)


@pure_lazy
def _relationship_requests_from_selections(
    relationships: Sequence[RelationshipSelection],
) -> tuple[_RelationshipRequest, ...]:
    requests: list[_RelationshipRequest] = []
    for relationship in relationships:
        nested_requests = (
            *_relationship_requests_from_includes(relationship.nested_includes),
            *_relationship_requests_from_selections(relationship.nested_relationships),
        )
        storage_kind = relationship.contract.storage_kind
        if storage_kind == RelationshipStorageKind.FOREIGN_KEY:
            filter_column = relationship.contract.target_fk_field if relationship.is_list else relationship.contract.target_key_field
            source_projection_field = (
                relationship.contract.source_key_field if relationship.is_list else relationship.contract.source_fk_field
            )
            if not relationship.is_list and filter_column is None:
                filter_column = "sys_id"
            if relationship.is_list and source_projection_field is None:
                source_projection_field = "sys_id"
            if filter_column is None or source_projection_field is None:
                msg = f"Relationship {relationship.field_name!r} is missing foreign-key metadata"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            requests.append(
                _RelationshipRequest(
                    field_name=relationship.field_name,
                    kind="has_many" if relationship.is_list else "belongs_to",
                    target_model=relationship.target_model,
                    nested_requests=tuple(nested_requests),
                    filter_expression=relationship.filter_expression,
                    order_by_clauses=relationship.order_by_clauses,
                    count_requested=relationship.count_requested,
                    top=relationship.top,
                    skip=relationship.skip,
                    target_field_names=relationship.target_field_names,
                    source_key_field=filter_column,
                    source_projection_field=source_projection_field,
                ),
            )
            continue
        if storage_kind in {RelationshipStorageKind.JUNCTION, RelationshipStorageKind.EDGE}:
            if relationship.junction_model is None or relationship.contract.target_fk_field is None:
                msg = f"Relationship {relationship.field_name!r} is missing junction lowering metadata"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            requests.append(
                _RelationshipRequest(
                    field_name=relationship.field_name,
                    kind="two_hop",
                    target_model=relationship.target_model,
                    nested_requests=tuple(nested_requests),
                    filter_expression=relationship.filter_expression,
                    order_by_clauses=relationship.order_by_clauses,
                    count_requested=relationship.count_requested,
                    top=relationship.top,
                    skip=relationship.skip,
                    target_field_names=relationship.target_field_names,
                    junction_model=relationship.junction_model,
                    source_key_field=relationship.contract.source_fk_field,
                    target_fk_field=relationship.contract.target_fk_field,
                    is_many_override=relationship.is_list,
                    include_junction_payload=relationship.include_junction_payload,
                ),
            )
            continue
        if storage_kind == RelationshipStorageKind.DERIVED:
            if (
                relationship.lookup_model is None
                or relationship.contract.lookup_field is None
                or relationship.contract.lookup_key is None
            ):
                msg = f"Relationship {relationship.field_name!r} is missing derived lowering metadata"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            requests.append(
                _RelationshipRequest(
                    field_name=relationship.field_name,
                    kind="derived",
                    target_model=relationship.target_model,
                    nested_requests=tuple(nested_requests),
                    filter_expression=relationship.filter_expression,
                    order_by_clauses=relationship.order_by_clauses,
                    count_requested=relationship.count_requested,
                    top=relationship.top,
                    skip=relationship.skip,
                    target_field_names=relationship.target_field_names,
                    lookup_model=relationship.lookup_model,
                    lookup_field=relationship.contract.lookup_field,
                    lookup_key=relationship.contract.lookup_key,
                ),
            )
            continue
        if storage_kind == RelationshipStorageKind.EMBEDDED:
            requests.append(
                _RelationshipRequest(
                    field_name=relationship.field_name,
                    kind="embedded",
                    target_model=relationship.target_model,
                    nested_requests=tuple(nested_requests),
                    filter_expression=relationship.filter_expression,
                    order_by_clauses=relationship.order_by_clauses,
                    count_requested=relationship.count_requested,
                    top=relationship.top,
                    skip=relationship.skip,
                    target_field_names=relationship.target_field_names,
                    visibility="embedded",
                    source_key_field=relationship.contract.descriptor_attr or relationship.field_name,
                ),
            )
            continue
        _raise_unhandled_relationship_storage_kind(storage_kind)
    return tuple(requests)


def hydrate_entities_from_include_data(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec],
    include_data: IncludeDataMap,
) -> None:
    """Apply grouped include data back onto relationship descriptors."""
    descriptor_map = build_include_descriptor_map(includes)
    visiting: set[str] = set()
    for entity in entities:
        _hydrate_entity_include_data(
            entity,
            descriptor_map=descriptor_map,
            include_data=include_data,
            visiting=visiting,
        )


def _hydrate_entity_include_data(
    entity: IncludeEntity,
    *,
    descriptor_map: dict[str, Any],
    include_data: IncludeDataMap,
    visiting: set[str],
) -> None:
    entity_id = _include_entity_id(entity)
    if entity_id in visiting:
        return
    visiting.add(entity_id)
    entity_related = include_data.get(entity_id, {})
    for field_name, value in entity_related.items():
        descriptor = descriptor_map.get(field_name)
        if descriptor is not None:
            descriptor.__set__(entity, value)
        _hydrate_nested_include_value(
            value,
            descriptor_map=descriptor_map,
            include_data=include_data,
            visiting=visiting,
        )
    visiting.remove(entity_id)


def _hydrate_nested_include_value(
    value: object,
    *,
    descriptor_map: dict[str, Any],
    include_data: IncludeDataMap,
    visiting: set[str],
) -> None:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        for item in value:
            _hydrate_nested_include_value(
                item,
                descriptor_map=descriptor_map,
                include_data=include_data,
                visiting=visiting,
            )
        return
    if isinstance(value, (dict, DatabaseObjectRow)) or hasattr(value, "sys_id") or hasattr(value, "id"):
        _hydrate_entity_include_data(
            cast(IncludeEntity, value),
            descriptor_map=descriptor_map,
            include_data=include_data,
            visiting=visiting,
        )


def _include_field_value(entity: IncludeEntity, field_name: str) -> object | None:
    """Read include-related fields from either model instances or dict-backed rows."""
    if isinstance(entity, dict):
        return entity.get(field_name)
    try:
        value = getattr(entity, field_name, None)
    except AttributeError:
        value = None
    if value is not None:
        return cast("object", value)
    model_dump = getattr(entity, "model_dump", None)
    if callable(model_dump):
        dumped = model_dump(by_alias=False)
        if isinstance(dumped, dict):
            return dumped.get(field_name)
    return None


def _include_entity_id(entity: IncludeEntity) -> str:
    sys_id = _include_field_value(entity, "sys_id")
    if sys_id is None:
        sys_id = _include_field_value(entity, "id")
    return _include_id_key(sys_id)


def _include_ref_owner_key(entity: IncludeEntity, ref: CompiledIncludeRef) -> str:
    if ref.owner_key_field in {"", "sys_id", "id"}:
        return _include_entity_id(entity)
    return _include_id_key(_include_field_value(entity, ref.owner_key_field))


def _include_ref_target_key(entity: IncludeEntity, ref: CompiledIncludeRef) -> str:
    if ref.source_key_field in {"", "sys_id", "id"}:
        return _include_entity_id(entity)
    return _include_id_key(_include_field_value(entity, ref.source_key_field))


def _include_id_key(value: object) -> str:
    """Normalize branded/raw ids before using them as relationship map keys."""
    for method_name in ("unwrap_to_sql", "unwrap_to_str", "unwrap_to_int"):
        unwrap = getattr(value, method_name, None)
        if callable(unwrap):
            value = unwrap()
            break
    return str(value)


@pure_lazy
def _select_full_model_fields(query: Any, model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]) -> Any:
    if not hasattr(query, "project"):
        return query
    excluded_fields = {"sys_staged_commit_id"}
    if issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
        excluded_fields.update({"sys_revision_id", "sys_deleted"})
    fields: list[Any] = []
    for field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
        if field_name in excluded_fields:
            continue
        if field_name == "sys_deleted":
            fields.append(Expression(value=False).as_(SchemaObjectName("sys_deleted")))
            continue
        field_descriptor = getattr(model_cls, field_name)
        if isinstance(field_descriptor, Field):
            fields.append(field_descriptor)
            continue
        fields.append(Expression(field=field_name).as_(SchemaObjectName(field_name)))
    if issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow) and "sys_deleted" not in model_cls.model_fields:
        fields.append(Expression(value=False).as_(SchemaObjectName("sys_deleted")))
    return query.project(*fields)


@pure_lazy
def _select_projected_model_fields(
    query: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
    field_names: frozenset[str],
) -> Any:
    if not field_names:
        return _select_full_model_fields(query, model_cls)
    if not hasattr(query, "project"):
        return query
    projected_names = {"sys_id", *field_names}
    fields: list[Any] = []
    for field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
        if field_name not in projected_names or field_name == "sys_staged_commit_id":
            continue
        field_descriptor = getattr(model_cls, field_name)
        if isinstance(field_descriptor, Field):
            fields.append(field_descriptor)
            continue
        fields.append(Expression(field=field_name).as_(SchemaObjectName(field_name)))
    if not fields:
        fields = [getattr(model_cls, "sys_id")]
    return query.project(*fields)


@pure_lazy
def _include_result_field_names(
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    binding: _IncludeFilterBinding,
) -> frozenset[str]:
    nested_source_fields = _nested_request_source_projection_fields(request.nested_requests)
    if request.kind not in {"has_many", "through"}:
        return request.target_field_names | nested_source_fields
    return request.target_field_names | nested_source_fields | frozenset({binding.filter_column})


@pure_lazy
def _nested_request_source_projection_fields(
    requests: Sequence[_RelationshipRequest],
) -> frozenset[str]:
    fields: set[str] = set()
    for request in requests:
        if request.kind == "embedded":
            fields.add(request.source_key_field or request.field_name)
        elif request.kind in {"belongs_to", "has_many", "through"}:
            fields.add(_include_filter_binding(request).source_projection_field)
        else:
            fields.add("sys_id")
    return frozenset(fields)


@pure_lazy
def _select_key_only_model_fields(query: Any, model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]) -> Any:
    if not hasattr(query, "project"):
        return query
    return query.project(getattr(model_cls, "sys_id"))


@pure_lazy
def _select_relationship_key_fields(
    query: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
    source_field_name: str,
    target_field_name: str,
) -> Any:
    if not hasattr(query, "project"):
        return query
    fields: list[Any] = []
    projected_field_names: set[str] = set()
    if issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
        field_names = (
            ("sys_id", "created_at", "updated_at", "graph_sys_id")
            if issubclass(model_cls, GraphEdge)
            else (
                "sys_id",
                "created_at",
                "updated_at",
            )
        )
        for field_name in field_names:
            if field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
                fields.append(getattr(model_cls, field_name))
                projected_field_names.add(field_name)
    if source_field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
        if source_field_name not in projected_field_names:
            fields.append(Expression(field=source_field_name).as_(SchemaObjectName(source_field_name)))
            projected_field_names.add(source_field_name)
    else:
        fields.append(typed_field(source_field_name))
    if target_field_name != source_field_name:
        if target_field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
            if target_field_name not in projected_field_names:
                fields.append(Expression(field=target_field_name).as_(SchemaObjectName(target_field_name)))
                projected_field_names.add(target_field_name)
        else:
            fields.append(typed_field(target_field_name))
    if issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
        fields.append(Expression(value=False).as_(SchemaObjectName("sys_deleted")))
    return query.project(*fields)


def _normalize_loaded_include_entity(
    entity: IncludeEntity,
    target_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
) -> IncludeEntity:
    if not isinstance(entity, dict):
        return entity
    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.row_converter import convert_row_to_model

    normalized_entity = dict(entity)
    for deleted_key in ("sys_deleted", "deleted"):
        if normalized_entity.get(deleted_key) == "sys_deleted":
            normalized_entity[deleted_key] = False
    try:
        return cast(
            IncludeEntity,
            convert_row_to_model(
                target_model,
                normalized_entity,
                conn=None,
                select_columns=[str(column_name) for column_name in normalized_entity],
                hydrate_large_columns=False,
            ),
        )
    except ValidationError:
        return normalized_entity


def _plan_result_include_list(
    plan_results: PlanResults,
    result_id: str,
    model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> list[IncludeEntity]:
    value = plan_results[result_id]
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        msg = f"Relationship result {result_id!r} must be a list, got {type(value).__name__}."
        raise TypeError(msg)
    normalized: list[IncludeEntity] = []
    for row in value:
        if isinstance(row, model):
            normalized.append(row)
        elif isinstance(row, dict):
            normalized.append(_normalize_loaded_include_entity(row, model))
        else:
            msg = f"Relationship result {result_id!r} must contain {model.__name__} or dict rows, got {type(row).__name__}."
            raise TypeError(msg)
    return normalized


def _plan_result_raw_dict_list(
    plan_results: PlanResults,
    result_id: str,
) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    value = plan_results[result_id]
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        msg = f"Relationship result {result_id!r} must be a list, got {type(value).__name__}."
        raise TypeError(msg)
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for row in value:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            msg = f"Relationship result {result_id!r} must contain dict rows, got {type(row).__name__}."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        rows.append(row)
    return rows


def group_include_data(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    compilation: CompilationResult,
    load_rows: Callable[[CompiledIncludeRef], Sequence[IncludeEntity]],
) -> IncludeDataMap:
    """Group include rows by owner id for GraphQL formatting and hydration."""
    include_data: IncludeDataMap = {}

    top_level: dict[str, CompiledIncludeRef] = {}
    nested: dict[str, CompiledIncludeRef] = {}
    for key, ref in compilation.include_refs.items():
        if ref.parent_path is None:
            top_level[key] = ref
        else:
            nested[key] = ref

    for ref in top_level.values():
        related_list = [_normalize_loaded_include_entity(row, ref.target_model) for row in load_rows(ref)]
        if ref.is_has_many:
            grouped: dict[str, list[IncludeEntity]] = {}
            for row in related_list:
                fk_val = _include_field_value(row, ref.source_key_field)
                grouped.setdefault(_include_id_key(fk_val), []).append(row)
            for entity in entities:
                eid = _include_entity_id(entity)
                owner_key = _include_ref_owner_key(entity, ref)
                include_data.setdefault(eid, {})[ref.field_name] = _apply_include_list_pagination(
                    grouped.get(owner_key, []),
                    skip=ref.skip,
                    top=ref.top,
                )
        else:
            by_id: dict[str, IncludeEntity] = {_include_ref_target_key(row, ref): row for row in related_list}
            for entity in entities:
                eid = _include_entity_id(entity)
                fk_val = _include_field_value(entity, ref.owner_key_field)
                include_data.setdefault(eid, {})[ref.field_name] = by_id.get(_include_id_key(fk_val)) if fk_val is not None else None

    for ref in nested.values():
        parent_path = ref.parent_path
        if parent_path is None:
            continue
        parent_ref = compilation.include_refs.get(parent_path)
        parent_entities = (
            list(entities)
            if parent_ref is None
            else [_normalize_loaded_include_entity(row, parent_ref.target_model) for row in load_rows(parent_ref)]
        )
        related_list = [_normalize_loaded_include_entity(row, ref.target_model) for row in load_rows(ref)]
        if ref.is_has_many:
            grouped_nested: dict[str, list[IncludeEntity]] = {}
            for row in related_list:
                fk_val = _include_field_value(row, ref.source_key_field)
                grouped_nested.setdefault(_include_id_key(fk_val), []).append(row)
            for entity in parent_entities:
                pid = _include_entity_id(entity)
                owner_key = _include_ref_owner_key(entity, ref)
                include_data.setdefault(pid, {})[ref.field_name] = _apply_include_list_pagination(
                    grouped_nested.get(owner_key, []),
                    skip=ref.skip,
                    top=ref.top,
                )
        else:
            by_id_nested: dict[str, IncludeEntity] = {_include_ref_target_key(row, ref): row for row in related_list}
            for entity in parent_entities:
                pid = _include_entity_id(entity)
                fk_val_nested = _include_field_value(entity, ref.owner_key_field)
                include_data.setdefault(pid, {})[ref.field_name] = (
                    by_id_nested.get(_include_id_key(fk_val_nested)) if fk_val_nested is not None else None
                )

    return include_data


def _apply_include_list_pagination(
    values: object,
    *,
    skip: int | None,
    top: int | None,
) -> list[IncludeEntity]:
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        return []
    start = skip or 0
    paged = values[start:]
    if top is not None:
        paged = paged[:top]
    return paged


def distribute_plan_results(
    plan_results: PlanResults,
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    compilation: CompilationResult,
) -> IncludeDataMap:
    """Group plan results into the canonical include-data mapping."""
    return group_include_data(
        entities,
        compilation,
        lambda ref: _plan_result_include_list(plan_results, ref.result_ref_id, ref.target_model),
    )


@pure_lazy
def compile_two_hop_relationship_into_plan(
    server_plan: ServerPlan,
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    result_prefix: str,
    field_name: str,
    junction_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    target_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    source_fk_field: str,
    target_fk_field: str,
    is_list: bool,
) -> TwoHopRelationshipRef:
    """Compile a junction-table relationship into dependent ServerPlan queries."""
    junction_query = server_plan.query(junction_model)
    _require_dependent_query_support(junction_query, target_model=junction_model)
    junction_query = junction_query.filter_by_ref(
        source_fk_field,
        parent_ref.field("sys_id"),
    )
    use_key_only_junction = not request.include_junction_payload
    if not use_key_only_junction:
        junction_query = _select_full_model_fields(junction_query, junction_model)
    else:
        junction_query = _select_relationship_key_fields(
            junction_query,
            junction_model,
            source_fk_field,
            target_fk_field,
        )
    junction_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(server_plan._next_ref())
    junction_ref = cast(
        ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
        server_plan._add_server_step(
            QueryExecuteRawIntent(
                ref_id=junction_ref_id,
                model_cls=junction_model,
                config=_QueryExecuteRawConfig(
                    query_spec=junction_query._build_spec(),
                    raw_access_authorized=False,
                    direct_raw_terminal=True,
                ),
            ),
            dict,
            variant="object_sequence",
        ),
    )
    junction_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_j_{field_name}"
    server_plan.return_result(junction_result_id, junction_ref)
    junction_payload_result_id: str | None = None
    if request.include_junction_payload:
        junction_payload_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_j_payload_{field_name}"
        server_plan.return_result(junction_payload_result_id, junction_ref)
    target_query = server_plan.query(target_model)
    _require_dependent_query_support(target_query, target_model=target_model)
    target_query = target_query.filter_by_ref(
        "sys_id",
        junction_ref.field(target_fk_field),
    )
    target_query = _apply_request_query_shape(
        target_query,
        _request_without_list_pagination(request) if is_list else request,
    )
    target_query = _select_projected_model_fields(
        target_query,
        target_model,
        request.target_field_names | _nested_request_source_projection_fields(request.nested_requests),
    )
    target_ref = cast(
        ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
        target_query.execute_raw_later(),
    )
    target_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_t_{field_name}"
    server_plan.return_result(target_result_id, target_ref)
    count_target_result_id: str | None = None
    if request.count_requested and is_list:
        count_target_query = server_plan.query(target_model)
        _require_dependent_query_support(count_target_query, target_model=target_model)
        count_target_query = count_target_query.filter_by_ref(
            "sys_id",
            junction_ref.field(target_fk_field),
        )
        count_target_query = _apply_request_query_shape(
            count_target_query,
            _request_without_pagination(request),
        )
        count_target_query = _select_key_only_model_fields(count_target_query, target_model)
        count_target_ref = cast(
            ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
            count_target_query.execute_raw_later(),
        )
        count_target_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_t_count_{field_name}"
        server_plan.return_result(count_target_result_id, count_target_ref)

    return TwoHopRelationshipRef(
        field_name=field_name,
        junction_key_result_id=junction_result_id,
        junction_payload_result_id=junction_payload_result_id,
        junction_key_rows_are_raw=use_key_only_junction,
        target_result_id=target_result_id,
        target_result_ref=target_ref,
        count_target_result_id=count_target_result_id,
        junction_model=junction_model,
        source_fk_field=source_fk_field,
        target_fk_field=target_fk_field,
        target_model=target_model,
        is_list=is_list,
        top=request.top,
        skip=request.skip,
        include_junction_payload=request.include_junction_payload,
    )


def build_two_hop_relationship_data(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    junction_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    target_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    field_name: str,
    source_fk_field: str,
    target_fk_field: str,
    is_list: bool,
    top: int | None = None,
    skip: int | None = None,
    include_junction_payload: bool = False,
    junction_payload_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity] = (),
) -> IncludeDataMap:
    """Group junction and target rows into the canonical relationship map."""
    source_ids_by_target_id: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    junction_by_source_target: dict[tuple[str, str], IncludeEntity] = {}
    sole_source_id = _include_entity_id(entities[0]) if len(entities) == 1 else None
    for junction_row in junction_rows:
        source_value = _include_field_value(junction_row, source_fk_field)
        target_value = _include_field_value(junction_row, target_fk_field)
        if target_value is None:
            continue
        if source_value is None:
            if sole_source_id is None:
                continue
            source_id = sole_source_id
        else:
            source_id = _include_id_key(source_value)
        target_id = _include_id_key(target_value)
        source_ids_by_target_id.setdefault(target_id, []).append(source_id)
    for junction_payload_row in junction_payload_rows:
        source_value = _include_field_value(junction_payload_row, source_fk_field)
        target_value = _include_field_value(junction_payload_row, target_fk_field)
        if source_value is None or target_value is None:
            continue
        junction_by_source_target.setdefault(
            (_include_id_key(source_value), _include_id_key(target_value)),
            junction_payload_row,
        )
    relationship_data: IncludeDataMap = {}

    for target in target_rows:
        target_id = _include_entity_id(target)
        for source_id in source_ids_by_target_id.get(target_id, ()):
            relationship_data.setdefault(source_id, {})
            if is_list:
                existing_value = relationship_data[source_id].setdefault(field_name, [])
                if isinstance(existing_value, list):
                    existing_value.append(target)
            else:
                relationship_data[source_id][field_name] = target

    for entity in entities:
        entity_id = _include_entity_id(entity)
        if entity_id not in relationship_data:
            relationship_data[entity_id] = {}
        if is_list:
            paged_items = _apply_include_list_pagination(
                relationship_data[entity_id].setdefault(field_name, []),
                skip=skip,
                top=top,
            )
            relationship_data[entity_id][field_name] = paged_items
            if include_junction_payload:
                relationship_data[entity_id][junction_payload_many_key(field_name)] = [
                    edge
                    for item in paged_items
                    if (edge := junction_by_source_target.get((entity_id, _include_entity_id(item)))) is not None
                ]
        else:
            relationship_data[entity_id].setdefault(field_name, None)
            if include_junction_payload:
                related_entity = relationship_data[entity_id].get(field_name)
                edge = (
                    junction_by_source_target.get((entity_id, _include_entity_id(related_entity)))
                    if isinstance(related_entity, (DatabaseObjectRow, dict))
                    else None
                )
                relationship_data[entity_id][junction_payload_one_key(field_name)] = edge

    return relationship_data


def build_two_hop_relationship_counts(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    junction_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    target_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    source_fk_field: str,
    target_fk_field: str,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    target_ids = {_include_entity_id(target) for target in target_rows}
    counts = {_include_entity_id(entity): 0 for entity in entities}
    for junction_row in junction_rows:
        source_id = _include_id_key(_include_field_value(junction_row, source_fk_field))
        target_id = _include_id_key(_include_field_value(junction_row, target_fk_field))
        if target_id in target_ids:
            counts[source_id] = counts.get(source_id, 0) + 1
    return counts


@pure_lazy
def compile_json_array_derived_relationship_into_plan(
    server_plan: ServerPlan,
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    result_prefix: str,
    field_name: str,
    lookup_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    lookup_field: str,
    lookup_key: str,
) -> JsonArrayDerivedRelationshipRef:
    """Compile a JSON-array membership relationship into a ServerPlan query."""
    lookup_query = server_plan.query(lookup_model)
    filtered_query = lookup_query.filter_json_array_contains_ref(
        lookup_field,
        lookup_key,
        parent_ref.field("sys_id"),
    )
    filtered_query = _apply_request_query_shape(
        filtered_query,
        _request_without_list_pagination(request) if request.is_many else request,
    )
    filtered_query = _select_projected_model_fields(
        filtered_query,
        lookup_model,
        request.target_field_names | frozenset({lookup_field}) | _nested_request_source_projection_fields(request.nested_requests),
    )
    lookup_ref = cast(ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity], filtered_query.execute_raw_later())
    lookup_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_{field_name}"
    server_plan.return_result(lookup_result_id, lookup_ref)
    count_lookup_result_id: str | None = None
    if request.count_requested:
        count_lookup_query = lookup_query.filter_json_array_contains_ref(
            lookup_field,
            lookup_key,
            parent_ref.field("sys_id"),
        )
        count_lookup_query = _apply_request_query_shape(
            count_lookup_query,
            _request_without_pagination(request),
        )
        count_lookup_query = _select_projected_model_fields(
            count_lookup_query,
            lookup_model,
            frozenset({"sys_id", lookup_field}),
        )
        count_lookup_ref = cast(
            ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
            count_lookup_query.execute_raw_later(),
        )
        count_lookup_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_{field_name}_count"
        server_plan.return_result(count_lookup_result_id, count_lookup_ref)

    return JsonArrayDerivedRelationshipRef(
        field_name=field_name,
        lookup_result_id=lookup_result_id,
        lookup_result_ref=lookup_ref,
        count_lookup_result_id=count_lookup_result_id,
        lookup_model=lookup_model,
        lookup_field=lookup_field,
        lookup_key=lookup_key,
        top=request.top,
        skip=request.skip,
    )


def build_json_array_derived_relationship_data(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    lookup_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    field_name: str,
    lookup_field: str,
    lookup_key: str,
    top: int | None = None,
    skip: int | None = None,
) -> IncludeDataMap:
    """Group rows whose JSON-array field refers to the source entities."""
    entity_ids = {_include_entity_id(entity) for entity in entities}
    relationship_data: IncludeDataMap = {}

    for row in lookup_rows:
        lookup_field_value = _include_field_value(row, lookup_field)
        if lookup_field_value is None:
            continue
        if isinstance(lookup_field_value, JSONType):
            lookup_field_value = lookup_field_value.unwrap()
        if not isinstance(lookup_field_value, list):
            continue
        matched_entity_ids: set[str] = set()
        for item in lookup_field_value:
            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                ref_id = _include_id_key(item.get(lookup_key, ""))
            else:
                ref_id = _include_id_key(item)
            if ref_id not in entity_ids:
                continue
            if ref_id in matched_entity_ids:
                continue
            matched_entity_ids.add(ref_id)
            relationship_data.setdefault(ref_id, {}).setdefault(field_name, [])
            field_value = relationship_data[ref_id][field_name]
            if isinstance(field_value, list):
                field_value.append(row)

    for entity in entities:
        entity_id = _include_entity_id(entity)
        field_values = relationship_data.setdefault(entity_id, {}).setdefault(field_name, [])
        relationship_data[entity_id][field_name] = _apply_include_list_pagination(
            field_values,
            skip=skip,
            top=top,
        )

    return relationship_data


def build_json_array_derived_relationship_counts(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    lookup_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    lookup_field: str,
    lookup_key: str,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    entity_ids = {_include_entity_id(entity) for entity in entities}
    counts = {entity_id: 0 for entity_id in entity_ids}
    for row in lookup_rows:
        lookup_field_value = _include_field_value(row, lookup_field)
        if lookup_field_value is None:
            continue
        if isinstance(lookup_field_value, JSONType):
            lookup_field_value = lookup_field_value.unwrap()
        if not isinstance(lookup_field_value, list):
            continue
        matched_entity_ids: set[str] = set()
        for item in lookup_field_value:
            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                ref_id = _include_id_key(item.get(lookup_key, ""))
            else:
                ref_id = _include_id_key(item)
            if ref_id not in entity_ids:
                continue
            if ref_id in matched_entity_ids:
                continue
            matched_entity_ids.add(ref_id)
            counts[ref_id] = counts.get(ref_id, 0) + 1
    return counts


@pure_lazy
def _include_filter_binding(request: _RelationshipRequest) -> _IncludeFilterBinding:
    if request.source_key_field is None:
        msg = f"Relationship {request.field_name!r} is missing include binding metadata"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if request.source_projection_field is not None:
        return _IncludeFilterBinding(
            filter_column=request.source_key_field,
            source_projection_field=request.source_projection_field,
        )
    if request.kind in {"has_many", "through"}:
        return _IncludeFilterBinding(
            filter_column=request.source_key_field,
            source_projection_field="sys_id",
        )
    return _IncludeFilterBinding(
        filter_column="sys_id",
        source_projection_field=request.source_key_field,
    )


@pure_lazy
def _compile_include_request_level(
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    requests: Sequence[_RelationshipRequest],
    source_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
    emit_include: Callable[
        [_RelationshipRequest, _IncludeFilterBinding, str],
        CompiledIncludeRef,
    ],
    parent_path: str = "",
) -> tuple[_PlannedIncludeRequest, ...]:
    planned: list[_PlannedIncludeRequest] = []
    for request in requests:
        if request.kind not in {"belongs_to", "has_many", "through"}:
            continue
        if (
            request.kind == "belongs_to"
            and source_model_cls is not None
            and request.source_key_field is not None
            and request.source_key_field not in getattr(source_model_cls, "model_fields", {})
        ):
            continue
        binding = _include_filter_binding(request)
        ref_key = f"{parent_path}__{request.field_name}" if parent_path else request.field_name
        planned.append(
            _PlannedIncludeRequest(
                request=request,
                edge=emit_include(request, binding, ref_key),
            ),
        )
    return tuple(planned)


@pure_lazy
def _compile_include_request_into_plan(
    server_plan: ServerPlan,
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    binding: _IncludeFilterBinding,
    ref_key: str,
    load_cache: dict[_RelationshipLoadCacheKey, _CachedRelationshipLoad] | None = None,
) -> CompiledIncludeRef:
    cache_key = _relationship_load_cache_key(parent_ref, request, binding)
    cached_load = None if load_cache is None else load_cache.get(cache_key)
    result_ref_id = f"inc_{ref_key}"
    if cached_load is not None:
        server_plan.return_result(result_ref_id, cached_load.result_ref)
        return CompiledIncludeRef(
            ref_key=ref_key,
            field_name=request.field_name,
            source_key_field=binding.filter_column,
            owner_key_field=binding.source_projection_field,
            target_model=request.target_model,
            is_has_many=request.kind in {"has_many", "through"},
            result_ref_id=result_ref_id,
            result_ref=cached_load.result_ref,
            count_result_ref_id=cached_load.count_result_ref_id,
            parent_path=parent_path_from_ref_key(ref_key),
            top=request.top,
            skip=request.skip,
        )
    if (
        request.kind == "belongs_to"
        and binding.filter_column == "sys_id"
        and not (request.filter_expression or request.order_by_clauses or request.skip is not None or request.top is not None)
    ):
        include_ref = cast(
            ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
            server_plan.select_many(
                request.target_model,
                cast("ScalarSequenceServerRef[SysId]", parent_ref.field(binding.source_projection_field)),
            ),
        )
    else:
        include_query: Any = server_plan.query(request.target_model)
        _require_dependent_query_support(include_query, target_model=request.target_model)
        include_query = include_query.filter_by_ref(
            binding.filter_column,
