        )
        related_list = [_normalize_loaded_include_entity(row, ref.target_model) for row in load_rows(ref)]
        if ref.is_has_many:
            grouped_nested: dict[str, list[IncludeEntity]] = {}
            for row in related_list:
                fk_val = _include_field_value(row, ref.source_key_field)
                grouped_nested.setdefault(_include_id_key(fk_val), []).append(row)
            for entity in parent_entities:
                pid = _include_entity_id(entity)
                owner_key = _include_ref_owner_key(entity, ref)
                include_data.setdefault(pid, {})[ref.field_name] = _apply_include_list_pagination(
                    grouped_nested.get(owner_key, []),
                    skip=ref.skip,
                    top=ref.top,
                )
        else:
            by_id_nested: dict[str, IncludeEntity] = {_include_ref_target_key(row, ref): row for row in related_list}
            for entity in parent_entities:
                pid = _include_entity_id(entity)
                fk_val_nested = _include_field_value(entity, ref.owner_key_field)
                include_data.setdefault(pid, {})[ref.field_name] = (
                    by_id_nested.get(_include_id_key(fk_val_nested)) if fk_val_nested is not None else None
                )

    return include_data


def _apply_include_list_pagination(
    values: object,
    *,
    skip: int | None,
    top: int | None,
) -> list[IncludeEntity]:
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        return []
    start = skip or 0
    paged = values[start:]
    if top is not None:
        paged = paged[:top]
    return paged


def distribute_plan_results(
    plan_results: PlanResults,
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    compilation: CompilationResult,
) -> IncludeDataMap:
    """Group plan results into the canonical include-data mapping."""
    return group_include_data(
        entities,
        compilation,
        lambda ref: _plan_result_include_list(plan_results, ref.result_ref_id, ref.target_model),
    )


@pure_lazy
def compile_two_hop_relationship_into_plan(
    server_plan: ServerPlan,
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    result_prefix: str,
    field_name: str,
    junction_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    target_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    source_fk_field: str,
    target_fk_field: str,
    is_list: bool,
) -> TwoHopRelationshipRef:
    """Compile a junction-table relationship into dependent ServerPlan queries."""
    junction_query = server_plan.query(junction_model)
    _require_dependent_query_support(junction_query, target_model=junction_model)
    junction_query = junction_query.filter_by_ref(
        source_fk_field,
        parent_ref.field("sys_id"),
    )
    use_key_only_junction = not request.include_junction_payload
    if not use_key_only_junction:
        junction_query = _select_full_model_fields(junction_query, junction_model)
    else:
        junction_query = _select_relationship_key_fields(
            junction_query,
            junction_model,
            source_fk_field,
            target_fk_field,
        )
    junction_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(server_plan._next_ref())
    junction_ref = cast(
        ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
        server_plan._add_server_step(
            QueryExecuteRawIntent(
                ref_id=junction_ref_id,
                model_cls=junction_model,
                config=_QueryExecuteRawConfig(
                    query_spec=junction_query._build_spec(),
                    raw_access_authorized=False,
                    direct_raw_terminal=True,
                ),
            ),
            dict,
            variant="object_sequence",
        ),
    )
    junction_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_j_{field_name}"
    server_plan.return_result(junction_result_id, junction_ref)
    junction_payload_result_id: str | None = None
    if request.include_junction_payload:
        junction_payload_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_j_payload_{field_name}"
        server_plan.return_result(junction_payload_result_id, junction_ref)
    target_query = server_plan.query(target_model)
    _require_dependent_query_support(target_query, target_model=target_model)
    target_query = target_query.filter_by_ref(
        "sys_id",
        junction_ref.field(target_fk_field),
    )
    target_query = _apply_request_query_shape(
        target_query,
        _request_without_list_pagination(request) if is_list else request,
    )
    target_query = _select_projected_model_fields(
        target_query,
        target_model,
        request.target_field_names | _nested_request_source_projection_fields(request.nested_requests),
    )
    target_ref = cast(
        ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
        target_query.execute_raw_later(),
    )
    target_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_t_{field_name}"
    server_plan.return_result(target_result_id, target_ref)
    count_target_result_id: str | None = None
    if request.count_requested and is_list:
        count_target_query = server_plan.query(target_model)
        _require_dependent_query_support(count_target_query, target_model=target_model)
        count_target_query = count_target_query.filter_by_ref(
            "sys_id",
            junction_ref.field(target_fk_field),
        )
        count_target_query = _apply_request_query_shape(
            count_target_query,
            _request_without_pagination(request),
        )
        count_target_query = _select_key_only_model_fields(count_target_query, target_model)
        count_target_ref = cast(
            ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
            count_target_query.execute_raw_later(),
        )
        count_target_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_t_count_{field_name}"
        server_plan.return_result(count_target_result_id, count_target_ref)

    return TwoHopRelationshipRef(
        field_name=field_name,
        junction_key_result_id=junction_result_id,
        junction_payload_result_id=junction_payload_result_id,
        junction_key_rows_are_raw=use_key_only_junction,
        target_result_id=target_result_id,
        target_result_ref=target_ref,
        count_target_result_id=count_target_result_id,
        junction_model=junction_model,
        source_fk_field=source_fk_field,
        target_fk_field=target_fk_field,
        target_model=target_model,
        is_list=is_list,
        top=request.top,
        skip=request.skip,
        include_junction_payload=request.include_junction_payload,
    )


def build_two_hop_relationship_data(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    junction_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    target_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    field_name: str,
    source_fk_field: str,
    target_fk_field: str,
    is_list: bool,
    top: int | None = None,
    skip: int | None = None,
    include_junction_payload: bool = False,
    junction_payload_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity] = (),
) -> IncludeDataMap:
    """Group junction and target rows into the canonical relationship map."""
    source_ids_by_target_id: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    junction_by_source_target: dict[tuple[str, str], IncludeEntity] = {}
    sole_source_id = _include_entity_id(entities[0]) if len(entities) == 1 else None
    for junction_row in junction_rows:
        source_value = _include_field_value(junction_row, source_fk_field)
        target_value = _include_field_value(junction_row, target_fk_field)
        if target_value is None:
            continue
        if source_value is None:
            if sole_source_id is None:
                continue
            source_id = sole_source_id
        else:
            source_id = _include_id_key(source_value)
        target_id = _include_id_key(target_value)
        source_ids_by_target_id.setdefault(target_id, []).append(source_id)
    for junction_payload_row in junction_payload_rows:
        source_value = _include_field_value(junction_payload_row, source_fk_field)
        target_value = _include_field_value(junction_payload_row, target_fk_field)
        if source_value is None or target_value is None:
            continue
        junction_by_source_target.setdefault(
            (_include_id_key(source_value), _include_id_key(target_value)),
            junction_payload_row,
        )
    relationship_data: IncludeDataMap = {}

    for target in target_rows:
        target_id = _include_entity_id(target)
        for source_id in source_ids_by_target_id.get(target_id, ()):
            relationship_data.setdefault(source_id, {})
            if is_list:
                existing_value = relationship_data[source_id].setdefault(field_name, [])
                if isinstance(existing_value, list):
                    existing_value.append(target)
            else:
                relationship_data[source_id][field_name] = target

    for entity in entities:
        entity_id = _include_entity_id(entity)
        if entity_id not in relationship_data:
            relationship_data[entity_id] = {}
        if is_list:
            paged_items = _apply_include_list_pagination(
                relationship_data[entity_id].setdefault(field_name, []),
                skip=skip,
                top=top,
            )
            relationship_data[entity_id][field_name] = paged_items
            if include_junction_payload:
                relationship_data[entity_id][junction_payload_many_key(field_name)] = [
                    edge
                    for item in paged_items
                    if (edge := junction_by_source_target.get((entity_id, _include_entity_id(item)))) is not None
                ]
        else:
            relationship_data[entity_id].setdefault(field_name, None)
            if include_junction_payload:
                related_entity = relationship_data[entity_id].get(field_name)
                edge = (
                    junction_by_source_target.get((entity_id, _include_entity_id(related_entity)))
                    if isinstance(related_entity, (DatabaseObjectRow, dict))
                    else None
                )
                relationship_data[entity_id][junction_payload_one_key(field_name)] = edge

    return relationship_data


def build_two_hop_relationship_counts(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    junction_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    target_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    source_fk_field: str,
    target_fk_field: str,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    target_ids = {_include_entity_id(target) for target in target_rows}
    counts = {_include_entity_id(entity): 0 for entity in entities}
    for junction_row in junction_rows:
        source_id = _include_id_key(_include_field_value(junction_row, source_fk_field))
        target_id = _include_id_key(_include_field_value(junction_row, target_fk_field))
        if target_id in target_ids:
            counts[source_id] = counts.get(source_id, 0) + 1
    return counts


@pure_lazy
def compile_json_array_derived_relationship_into_plan(
    server_plan: ServerPlan,
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    result_prefix: str,
    field_name: str,
    lookup_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    lookup_field: str,
    lookup_key: str,
) -> JsonArrayDerivedRelationshipRef:
    """Compile a JSON-array membership relationship into a ServerPlan query."""
    lookup_query = server_plan.query(lookup_model)
    filtered_query = lookup_query.filter_json_array_contains_ref(
        lookup_field,
        lookup_key,
        parent_ref.field("sys_id"),
    )
    filtered_query = _apply_request_query_shape(
        filtered_query,
        _request_without_list_pagination(request) if request.is_many else request,
    )
    filtered_query = _select_projected_model_fields(
        filtered_query,
        lookup_model,
        request.target_field_names | frozenset({lookup_field}) | _nested_request_source_projection_fields(request.nested_requests),
    )
    lookup_ref = cast(ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity], filtered_query.execute_raw_later())
    lookup_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_{field_name}"
    server_plan.return_result(lookup_result_id, lookup_ref)
    count_lookup_result_id: str | None = None
    if request.count_requested:
        count_lookup_query = lookup_query.filter_json_array_contains_ref(
            lookup_field,
            lookup_key,
            parent_ref.field("sys_id"),
        )
        count_lookup_query = _apply_request_query_shape(
            count_lookup_query,
            _request_without_pagination(request),
        )
        count_lookup_query = _select_projected_model_fields(
            count_lookup_query,
            lookup_model,
            frozenset({"sys_id", lookup_field}),
        )
        count_lookup_ref = cast(
            ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
            count_lookup_query.execute_raw_later(),
        )
        count_lookup_result_id = f"{result_prefix}_{field_name}_count"
        server_plan.return_result(count_lookup_result_id, count_lookup_ref)

    return JsonArrayDerivedRelationshipRef(
        field_name=field_name,
        lookup_result_id=lookup_result_id,
        lookup_result_ref=lookup_ref,
        count_lookup_result_id=count_lookup_result_id,
        lookup_model=lookup_model,
        lookup_field=lookup_field,
        lookup_key=lookup_key,
        top=request.top,
        skip=request.skip,
    )


def build_json_array_derived_relationship_data(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    lookup_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    field_name: str,
    lookup_field: str,
    lookup_key: str,
    top: int | None = None,
    skip: int | None = None,
) -> IncludeDataMap:
    """Group rows whose JSON-array field refers to the source entities."""
    entity_ids = {_include_entity_id(entity) for entity in entities}
    relationship_data: IncludeDataMap = {}

    for row in lookup_rows:
        lookup_field_value = _include_field_value(row, lookup_field)
        if lookup_field_value is None:
            continue
        if isinstance(lookup_field_value, JSONType):
            lookup_field_value = lookup_field_value.unwrap()
        if not isinstance(lookup_field_value, list):
            continue
        matched_entity_ids: set[str] = set()
        for item in lookup_field_value:
            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                ref_id = _include_id_key(item.get(lookup_key, ""))
            else:
                ref_id = _include_id_key(item)
            if ref_id not in entity_ids:
                continue
            if ref_id in matched_entity_ids:
                continue
            matched_entity_ids.add(ref_id)
            relationship_data.setdefault(ref_id, {}).setdefault(field_name, [])
            field_value = relationship_data[ref_id][field_name]
            if isinstance(field_value, list):
                field_value.append(row)

    for entity in entities:
        entity_id = _include_entity_id(entity)
        field_values = relationship_data.setdefault(entity_id, {}).setdefault(field_name, [])
        relationship_data[entity_id][field_name] = _apply_include_list_pagination(
            field_values,
            skip=skip,
            top=top,
        )

    return relationship_data


def build_json_array_derived_relationship_counts(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    lookup_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    lookup_field: str,
    lookup_key: str,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    entity_ids = {_include_entity_id(entity) for entity in entities}
    counts = {entity_id: 0 for entity_id in entity_ids}
    for row in lookup_rows:
        lookup_field_value = _include_field_value(row, lookup_field)
        if lookup_field_value is None:
            continue
        if isinstance(lookup_field_value, JSONType):
            lookup_field_value = lookup_field_value.unwrap()
        if not isinstance(lookup_field_value, list):
            continue
        matched_entity_ids: set[str] = set()
        for item in lookup_field_value:
            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                ref_id = _include_id_key(item.get(lookup_key, ""))
            else:
                ref_id = _include_id_key(item)
            if ref_id not in entity_ids:
                continue
            if ref_id in matched_entity_ids:
                continue
            matched_entity_ids.add(ref_id)
            counts[ref_id] = counts.get(ref_id, 0) + 1
    return counts


@pure_lazy
def _include_filter_binding(request: _RelationshipRequest) -> _IncludeFilterBinding:
    if request.source_key_field is None:
        msg = f"Relationship {request.field_name!r} is missing include binding metadata"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if request.source_projection_field is not None:
        return _IncludeFilterBinding(
            filter_column=request.source_key_field,
            source_projection_field=request.source_projection_field,
        )
    if request.kind in {"has_many", "through"}:
        return _IncludeFilterBinding(
            filter_column=request.source_key_field,
            source_projection_field="sys_id",
        )
    return _IncludeFilterBinding(
        filter_column="sys_id",
        source_projection_field=request.source_key_field,
    )


@pure_lazy
def _compile_include_request_level(
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    requests: Sequence[_RelationshipRequest],
    source_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
    emit_include: Callable[
        [_RelationshipRequest, _IncludeFilterBinding, str],
        CompiledIncludeRef,
    ],
    parent_path: str = "",
) -> tuple[_PlannedIncludeRequest, ...]:
    planned: list[_PlannedIncludeRequest] = []
    for request in requests:
        if request.kind not in {"belongs_to", "has_many", "through"}:
            continue
        if (
            request.kind == "belongs_to"
            and source_model_cls is not None
            and request.source_key_field is not None
            and request.source_key_field not in getattr(source_model_cls, "model_fields", {})
        ):
            continue
        binding = _include_filter_binding(request)
        ref_key = f"{parent_path}__{request.field_name}" if parent_path else request.field_name
        planned.append(
            _PlannedIncludeRequest(
                request=request,
                edge=emit_include(request, binding, ref_key),
            ),
        )
    return tuple(planned)


@pure_lazy
def _compile_include_request_into_plan(
    server_plan: ServerPlan,
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    binding: _IncludeFilterBinding,
    ref_key: str,
    load_cache: dict[_RelationshipLoadCacheKey, _CachedRelationshipLoad] | None = None,
) -> CompiledIncludeRef:
    cache_key = _relationship_load_cache_key(parent_ref, request, binding)
    cached_load = None if load_cache is None else load_cache.get(cache_key)
    result_ref_id = f"inc_{ref_key}"
    if cached_load is not None:
        server_plan.return_result(result_ref_id, cached_load.result_ref)
        return CompiledIncludeRef(
            ref_key=ref_key,
            field_name=request.field_name,
            source_key_field=binding.filter_column,
            owner_key_field=binding.source_projection_field,
            target_model=request.target_model,
            is_has_many=request.kind in {"has_many", "through"},
            result_ref_id=result_ref_id,
            result_ref=cached_load.result_ref,
            count_result_ref_id=cached_load.count_result_ref_id,
            parent_path=parent_path_from_ref_key(ref_key),
            top=request.top,
            skip=request.skip,
        )
    if (
        request.kind == "belongs_to"
        and binding.filter_column == "sys_id"
        and not (request.filter_expression or request.order_by_clauses or request.skip is not None or request.top is not None)
    ):
        include_ref = cast(
            ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
            server_plan.select_many(
                request.target_model,
                cast("ScalarSequenceServerRef[SysId]", parent_ref.field(binding.source_projection_field)),
            ),
        )
    else:
        include_query: Any = server_plan.query(request.target_model)
        _require_dependent_query_support(include_query, target_model=request.target_model)
        include_query = include_query.filter_by_ref(
            binding.filter_column,
            parent_ref.field(binding.source_projection_field),
        )
        include_query = _apply_request_query_shape(
            include_query,
            _request_without_list_pagination(request) if request.is_many else request,
        )
        include_query = _select_projected_model_fields(
            include_query,
            request.target_model,
            _include_result_field_names(request, binding),
        )
        include_ref = cast(ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity], include_query.execute_raw_later())
    result_ref_id = f"inc_{ref_key}"
    server_plan.return_result(result_ref_id, include_ref)
    count_result_ref_id: str | None = None
    if request.count_requested and request.kind in {"has_many", "through"}:
        count_query: Any = server_plan.query(request.target_model)
        _require_dependent_query_support(count_query, target_model=request.target_model)
        count_query = count_query.filter_by_ref(
            binding.filter_column,
            parent_ref.field(binding.source_projection_field),
        )
        count_query = _apply_request_query_shape(count_query, _request_without_pagination(request))
        aggregate_query = count_query.group_by(Expression(field=binding.filter_column)).aggregate(count=COUNT())
        count_result_ref_id = f"inc_count_{ref_key}"
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_aggregation import (
            AggregateIntent,
            _AggregateIntentConfig,
        )

        aggregate_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(server_plan._next_ref())
        server_plan.return_result(
            count_result_ref_id,
            server_plan._add_server_step(
                AggregateIntent(
                    ref_id=aggregate_ref_id,
                    model_cls=request.target_model,
                    config=_AggregateIntentConfig(query_spec=aggregate_query._build_spec()),
                ),
                dict,
                variant="object_sequence",
            ),
        )
    if load_cache is not None:
        load_cache[cache_key] = _CachedRelationshipLoad(
            result_ref=include_ref,
            count_result_ref_id=count_result_ref_id,
        )
    return CompiledIncludeRef(
        ref_key=ref_key,
        field_name=request.field_name,
        source_key_field=binding.filter_column,
        owner_key_field=binding.source_projection_field,
        target_model=request.target_model,
        is_has_many=request.kind in {"has_many", "through"},
        result_ref_id=result_ref_id,
        result_ref=include_ref,
        count_result_ref_id=count_result_ref_id,
        parent_path=parent_path_from_ref_key(ref_key),
        top=request.top,
        skip=request.skip,
    )


@pure_lazy
def _relationship_load_cache_key(
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    binding: _IncludeFilterBinding,
) -> _RelationshipLoadCacheKey:
    parent_ref_id = parent_ref.ref_id
    if parent_ref_id is None:
        msg = "Relationship load planning requires a symbolic parent reference"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return (
        str(parent_ref_id),
        request.kind,
        request.target_model,
        binding.filter_column,
        binding.source_projection_field,
        repr(request.filter_expression),
        request.order_by_clauses,
        request.top,
        request.skip,
        _include_result_field_names(request, binding),
    )


@pure_lazy
def parent_path_from_ref_key(ref_key: str) -> str | None:
    parent_ref_key, separator, _field_name = ref_key.rpartition("__")
    return parent_ref_key if separator else None


@pure_lazy
def _apply_request_query_shape(query: Any, request: _RelationshipRequest) -> Any:
    if request.filter_expression is not None:
        query = query.filter(request.filter_expression)
    for field_name, direction in request.order_by_clauses:
        query = query.order_by(
            typed_field(field_name),
            direction="DESC" if direction == "desc" else "ASC",
        )
    if request.skip is not None and request.skip > 0:
        query = query.offset(request.skip)
    if request.top is not None:
        query = query.limit(request.top)
    return query


@pure_lazy
def _request_without_pagination(request: _RelationshipRequest) -> _RelationshipRequest:
    return dataclass_replace(
        request,
        order_by_clauses=(),
        top=None,
        skip=None,
    )


@pure_lazy
def _request_without_list_pagination(request: _RelationshipRequest) -> _RelationshipRequest:
    return dataclass_replace(
        request,
        top=None,
        skip=None,
    )


def _request_cross_branch_order_by(
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
) -> list[tuple[Expression[Any, DatabaseObjectRow], str]]:
    return [
        (Expression(field=field_name), "DESC" if direction == "desc" else "ASC") for field_name, direction in request.order_by_clauses
    ]


def _request_query_spec_order_by(
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlOrderDirection]]:
    return [
        (field_name, SqlOrderDirection("DESC" if direction == "desc" else "ASC")) for field_name, direction in request.order_by_clauses
    ]


@pure_lazy
def compile_relationships_into_plan(
    server_plan: ServerPlan,
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    result_prefix: str,
    includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec],
    relationships: Sequence[RelationshipSelection],
) -> RelationshipCompilation:
    """Compile all selected relationships through the shared contract surface."""
    request_candidates = (
        *_relationship_requests_from_includes(includes),
        *_relationship_requests_from_selections(relationships),
    )
    requests_by_key: dict[tuple[str, RelationshipRequestKind, type[DatabaseObjectRow]], _RelationshipRequest] = {}
    for request in request_candidates:
        requests_by_key.setdefault(
            (request.field_name, request.kind, request.target_model),
            request,
        )
    requests = tuple(requests_by_key.values())
    return _compile_relationship_requests_into_plan(
        server_plan,
        parent_ref,
        result_prefix=result_prefix,
        requests=tuple(requests),
    )


@pure_lazy
def _compile_relationship_requests_into_plan(
    server_plan: ServerPlan,
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    result_prefix: str,
    requests: Sequence[_RelationshipRequest],
    parent_path: str = "",
    load_cache: dict[_RelationshipLoadCacheKey, _CachedRelationshipLoad] | None = None,
) -> RelationshipCompilation:
    if load_cache is None:
        load_cache = {}
    two_hop_refs: dict[str, TwoHopRelationshipRef] = {}
    derived_refs: dict[str, JsonArrayDerivedRelationshipRef] = {}
    child_compilations: dict[str, RelationshipCompilation] = {}
    embedded_refs: dict[str, EmbeddedRelationshipRef] = {}
    include_compilation = CompilationResult()
    planned_includes = _compile_include_request_level(
        parent_ref,
        requests=requests,
        source_model_cls=None,
        emit_include=lambda request, binding, ref_key: _compile_include_request_into_plan(
            server_plan,
            parent_ref,
            request=request,
            binding=binding,
            ref_key=ref_key,
            load_cache=load_cache,
        ),
        parent_path=parent_path,
    )
    include_compilation.include_refs.update({planned.edge.ref_key: planned.edge for planned in planned_includes})
    for planned in planned_includes:
        if planned.request.nested_requests:
            nested_source_ref = planned.edge.result_ref
            if nested_source_ref is None:
                msg = f"Include edge {planned.edge.ref_key!r} has no symbolic result ref for nested planning"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            nested_compilation = _compile_relationship_requests_into_plan(
                server_plan,
                nested_source_ref,
                result_prefix=f"{result_prefix}_{planned.request.field_name}",
                requests=planned.request.nested_requests,
                parent_path=planned.edge.ref_key,
                load_cache=load_cache,
            )
            include_compilation.include_refs.update(nested_compilation.include_compilation.include_refs)
            two_hop_refs.update(nested_compilation.two_hop_refs)
            derived_refs.update(nested_compilation.derived_refs)
            child_compilations.update(nested_compilation.child_compilations)
            embedded_refs.update(nested_compilation.embedded_refs)

    for request in requests:
        if request.kind in {"belongs_to", "has_many", "through"}:
            continue
        if request.kind == "two_hop":
            if request.junction_model is None or request.source_key_field is None or request.target_fk_field is None:
                msg = f"Relationship {request.field_name!r} is missing junction lowering metadata"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            relationship_ref = compile_two_hop_relationship_into_plan(
                server_plan,
                parent_ref,
                request=request,
                result_prefix=result_prefix,
                field_name=request.field_name,
                junction_model=request.junction_model,
                target_model=request.target_model,
                source_fk_field=request.source_key_field,
                target_fk_field=request.target_fk_field,
                is_list=request.is_many,
            )
            two_hop_refs[request.field_name] = relationship_ref
            if request.nested_requests:
                child_compilations[request.field_name] = _compile_relationship_requests_into_plan(
                    server_plan,
                    relationship_ref.target_result_ref,
                    result_prefix=f"{result_prefix}_{request.field_name}",
                    requests=request.nested_requests,
                    load_cache=load_cache,
                )
            continue
        if request.kind == "derived":
            if request.lookup_model is None or request.lookup_field is None or request.lookup_key is None:
                msg = f"Relationship {request.field_name!r} is missing derived lowering metadata"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            derived_ref = compile_json_array_derived_relationship_into_plan(
                server_plan,
                parent_ref,
                request=request,
                result_prefix=result_prefix,
                field_name=request.field_name,
                lookup_model=request.lookup_model,
                lookup_field=request.lookup_field,
                lookup_key=request.lookup_key,
            )
            derived_refs[request.field_name] = derived_ref
            if request.nested_requests:
                child_compilations[request.field_name] = _compile_relationship_requests_into_plan(
                    server_plan,
                    derived_ref.lookup_result_ref,
                    result_prefix=f"{result_prefix}_{request.field_name}",
                    requests=request.nested_requests,
                    load_cache=load_cache,
                )
            continue
        if request.kind == "embedded":
            embedded_refs[request.field_name] = EmbeddedRelationshipRef(
                field_name=request.field_name,
                source_field=request.source_key_field or request.field_name,
                filter_expression=request.filter_expression,
                order_by_clauses=request.order_by_clauses,
                count_requested=request.count_requested,
                top=request.top,
                skip=request.skip,
            )
            if request.nested_requests:
                child_compilations[request.field_name] = _compile_relationship_requests_into_plan(
                    server_plan,
                    parent_ref,
                    result_prefix=f"{result_prefix}_{request.field_name}",
                    requests=request.nested_requests,
                    load_cache=load_cache,
                )
            continue
        msg = f"Unhandled relationship request kind: {request.kind}"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)

    return RelationshipCompilation(
        include_compilation=include_compilation,
        two_hop_refs=two_hop_refs,
        derived_refs=derived_refs,
        child_compilations=child_compilations,
        embedded_refs=embedded_refs,
    )


def distribute_relationship_results(
    plan_results: PlanResults,
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    compilation: RelationshipCompilation,
) -> IncludeDataMap:
    """Group compiled relationship results into formatter data."""
    include_data = distribute_plan_results(plan_results, entities, compilation.include_compilation)
    _merge_include_count_results(
        plan_results,
        entities,
        compilation.include_compilation,
        include_data,
    )
    for relationship_ref in compilation.two_hop_refs.values():
        junction_rows = (
            plan_results.get_list(relationship_ref.junction_key_result_id, dict)
            if relationship_ref.junction_key_rows_are_raw
            else _plan_result_include_list(
                plan_results,
                relationship_ref.junction_key_result_id,
                relationship_ref.junction_model,
            )
        )
        junction_payload_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity] = (
            _plan_result_raw_dict_list(
                plan_results,
                relationship_ref.junction_payload_result_id,
            )
            if relationship_ref.junction_payload_result_id is not None
            else ()
        )
        field_data = build_two_hop_relationship_data(
            entities,
            junction_rows,
            _plan_result_include_list(
                plan_results,
                relationship_ref.target_result_id,
                relationship_ref.target_model,
            ),
            field_name=relationship_ref.field_name,
            source_fk_field=relationship_ref.source_fk_field,
            target_fk_field=relationship_ref.target_fk_field,
            is_list=relationship_ref.is_list,
            top=relationship_ref.top,
            skip=relationship_ref.skip,
            include_junction_payload=relationship_ref.include_junction_payload,
            junction_payload_rows=junction_payload_rows,
        )
        _merge_include_data(include_data, field_data)
        if relationship_ref.count_target_result_id is not None and relationship_ref.is_list:
            _merge_include_count_values(
                include_data,
                entities,
                field_name=relationship_ref.field_name,
                counts=build_two_hop_relationship_counts(
                    entities,
                    junction_rows,
                    _plan_result_include_list(
                        plan_results,
                        relationship_ref.count_target_result_id,
                        relationship_ref.target_model,
                    ),
                    source_fk_field=relationship_ref.source_fk_field,
                    target_fk_field=relationship_ref.target_fk_field,
                ),
            )
        child_compilation = compilation.child_compilations.get(relationship_ref.field_name)
        if child_compilation is not None:
            child_entities = _plan_result_include_list(
                plan_results,
                relationship_ref.target_result_id,
                relationship_ref.target_model,
            )
            child_data = distribute_relationship_results(plan_results, child_entities, child_compilation)
            _merge_include_data(include_data, child_data)
    for derived_ref in compilation.derived_refs.values():
        field_data = build_json_array_derived_relationship_data(
            entities,
            _plan_result_include_list(
                plan_results,
                derived_ref.lookup_result_id,
                derived_ref.lookup_model,
            ),
            field_name=derived_ref.field_name,
            lookup_field=derived_ref.lookup_field,
            lookup_key=derived_ref.lookup_key,
            top=derived_ref.top,
            skip=derived_ref.skip,
        )
        _merge_include_data(include_data, field_data)
        if derived_ref.count_lookup_result_id is not None:
            _merge_include_count_values(
                include_data,
                entities,
                field_name=derived_ref.field_name,
                counts=build_json_array_derived_relationship_counts(
                    entities,
                    _plan_result_include_list(
                        plan_results,
                        derived_ref.count_lookup_result_id,
                        derived_ref.lookup_model,
                    ),
                    lookup_field=derived_ref.lookup_field,
                    lookup_key=derived_ref.lookup_key,
                ),
            )
        child_compilation = compilation.child_compilations.get(derived_ref.field_name)
        if child_compilation is not None:
            child_entities = _plan_result_include_list(
                plan_results,
                derived_ref.lookup_result_id,
                derived_ref.lookup_model,
            )
            child_data = distribute_relationship_results(plan_results, child_entities, child_compilation)
            _merge_include_data(include_data, child_data)
    for embedded_field, embedded_ref in compilation.embedded_refs.items():
        field_data = build_embedded_relationship_data(
            entities,
            field_name=embedded_field,
            source_field=embedded_ref.source_field,
            filter_expression=embedded_ref.filter_expression,
            order_by_clauses=embedded_ref.order_by_clauses,
            top=embedded_ref.top,
            skip=embedded_ref.skip,
        )
        _merge_include_data(include_data, field_data)
        if embedded_ref.count_requested:
            _merge_include_count_values(
                include_data,
                entities,
                field_name=embedded_field,
                counts=build_embedded_relationship_counts(
                    entities,
                    source_field=embedded_ref.source_field,
                    filter_expression=embedded_ref.filter_expression,
                ),
            )
        child_compilation = compilation.child_compilations.get(embedded_field)
        if child_compilation is not None:
            nested_child_entities = _collect_embedded_child_entities(
                field_data,
                field_name=embedded_field,
            )
            child_data = distribute_relationship_results(
                plan_results,
                nested_child_entities,
                child_compilation,
            )
            _merge_include_data(include_data, child_data)
    return include_data


def _merge_include_data(dest: IncludeDataMap, src: IncludeDataMap) -> None:
    for entity_id, fields in src.items():
        dest.setdefault(entity_id, {}).update(fields)


def _merge_include_count_values(
    include_data: IncludeDataMap,
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    field_name: str,
    counts: Mapping[str, int],
    owner_key_field: str = "sys_id",
) -> None:
    count_key = f"{field_name}@count"
    for entity in entities:
        entity_id = _include_entity_id(entity)
        count_lookup_key = entity_id
        if owner_key_field not in {"", "sys_id", "id"}:
            count_lookup_key = _include_id_key(_include_field_value(entity, owner_key_field))
        include_data.setdefault(entity_id, {})[count_key] = counts.get(count_lookup_key, 0)


def _merge_include_count_results(
    plan_results: PlanResults,
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    compilation: CompilationResult,
    include_data: IncludeDataMap,
) -> None:
    top_level: dict[str, CompiledIncludeRef] = {}
    nested: dict[str, CompiledIncludeRef] = {}
    for key, ref in compilation.include_refs.items():
        if ref.parent_path is None:
            top_level[key] = ref
        else:
            nested[key] = ref

    for ref in top_level.values():
        _merge_include_ref_count_results(plan_results, entities, ref, include_data)
    for ref in nested.values():
        parent_path = ref.parent_path
        parent_ref = compilation.include_refs.get(parent_path) if parent_path is not None else None
        parent_entities = (
            list(entities)
            if parent_ref is None
            else [
                _normalize_loaded_include_entity(row, parent_ref.target_model)
                for row in _plan_result_include_list(
                    plan_results,
                    parent_ref.result_ref_id,
                    parent_ref.target_model,
                )
            ]
        )
        _merge_include_ref_count_results(plan_results, parent_entities, ref, include_data)


def _merge_include_ref_count_results(
    plan_results: PlanResults,
    parent_entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    ref: CompiledIncludeRef,
    include_data: IncludeDataMap,
) -> None:
    if ref.count_result_ref_id is None or not ref.is_has_many:
        return
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for row in plan_results.get_list(ref.count_result_ref_id, dict):
        fk_val = row.get(ref.source_key_field)
        if fk_val is None:
            continue
        count_value = row.get("count", 0)
        counts[_include_id_key(fk_val)] = int(count_value)
    _merge_include_count_values(
        include_data,
        parent_entities,
        field_name=ref.field_name,
        counts=counts,
        owner_key_field=ref.owner_key_field,
    )


def build_embedded_relationship_data(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    field_name: str,
    source_field: str,
    filter_expression: Expression | None = None,
    order_by_clauses: Sequence[RelationshipOrderClause] = (),
    top: int | None = None,
    skip: int | None = None,
) -> IncludeDataMap:
    """Project embedded relationship payloads into the canonical include-data map."""
    order_by_clauses = tuple(order_by_clauses)
    relationship_data: IncludeDataMap = {}
    for entity in entities:
        relationship_data.setdefault(_include_entity_id(entity), {})[field_name] = _shape_embedded_relationship_value(
            _include_field_value(entity, source_field),
            filter_expression=filter_expression,
            order_by_clauses=order_by_clauses,
            top=top,
            skip=skip,
        )
    return relationship_data


def build_embedded_relationship_counts(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    source_field: str,
    filter_expression: Expression | None = None,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Count embedded relationship payloads after filtering and before pagination."""
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for entity in entities:
        shaped = _shape_embedded_relationship_value(
            _include_field_value(entity, source_field),
            filter_expression=filter_expression,
            order_by_clauses=(),
            top=None,
            skip=None,
        )
        if isinstance(shaped, list):
            counts[_include_entity_id(entity)] = len(shaped)
        elif shaped is None:
            counts[_include_entity_id(entity)] = 0
        else:
            counts[_include_entity_id(entity)] = 1
    return counts


def _shape_embedded_relationship_value(
    value: object,
    *,
    filter_expression: Expression | None,
    order_by_clauses: tuple[RelationshipOrderClause, ...],
    top: int | None,
    skip: int | None,
) -> IncludeHydratedValue:
    normalized = _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(value)
    if isinstance(normalized, dict) and "id" in normalized and "sys_id" not in normalized:
        normalized = {**normalized, "sys_id": normalized["id"]}
    elif isinstance(normalized, list):
        normalized = [
            {**item, "sys_id": item["id"]} if isinstance(item, dict) and "id" in item and "sys_id" not in item else item
            for item in normalized
        ]
    if not isinstance(normalized, list):
        if isinstance(normalized, (dict, DatabaseObjectRow)) and not _embedded_item_matches_filter(
            normalized,
            filter_expression,
        ):
            return None
        return cast("IncludeHydratedValue", normalized)
    items = [
        item
        for item in normalized
        if isinstance(item, (dict, DatabaseObjectRow)) and _embedded_item_matches_filter(item, filter_expression)
    ]
    for field_name, direction in reversed(order_by_clauses):
        items.sort(
            key=lambda item, sort_field=field_name: str(_include_field_value(item, sort_field) or ""),
            reverse=direction == "desc",
        )
    return _apply_include_list_pagination(items, skip=skip, top=top)


def _embedded_item_matches_filter(item: IncludeEntity, expression: Expression | None) -> bool:
    if expression is None:
        return True
    supported_operators = frozenset(
        {"=", "eq", "!=", "<>", "ne", ">", "gt", ">=", "gte", "<", "lt", "<=", "lte", "contains", "like", "in", "is null", "is not null"}
    )
    if expression.operator is not None and expression.operator.lower() not in supported_operators:
        raise UnsupportedOperationError(f"Embedded relationship filter does not support operator {expression.operator!r}")
    context = item if isinstance(item, dict) else item.model_dump()
    return bool(expression.evaluate(context))


def _collect_embedded_child_entities(
    field_data: IncludeDataMap,
    *,
    field_name: str,
) -> list[IncludeEntity]:
    """Flatten embedded payloads into child entities for nested distribution."""
    child_entities: list[IncludeEntity] = []
    for fields in field_data.values():
        value = _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(fields.get(field_name))
        if isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value:
                normalized = _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(item)
                if isinstance(normalized, (dict, DatabaseObjectRow)):
                    child_entities.append(normalized)
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (dict, DatabaseObjectRow)):
            child_entities.append(value)
    return child_entities


def _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(value: object) -> object:
    if isinstance(value, JSONType):
        return value.unwrap()
    if isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            decoded = json.loads(value)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return value
        return decoded
    return value


def format_embedded_relationship_value(
    value: object,
    selections: Sequence[EmbeddedRelationshipSelection],
    *,
    serialize_scalar: Callable[[object], object],
) -> object:
    """Format embedded relationship payloads through the shared include pipeline."""
    normalized_value = _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(value)
    if normalized_value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(normalized_value, Mapping):
        result: dict[str, object] = {}
        for selection in selections:
            lookup_name = selection.name
            if selection.name == "id" and "id" not in normalized_value and "sys_id" in normalized_value:
                lookup_name = "sys_id"
            elif selection.name == "sys_id" and "sys_id" not in normalized_value and "id" in normalized_value:
                lookup_name = "id"
            nested_value = _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(normalized_value.get(lookup_name))
            if selection.nested:
                result[selection.output_name] = format_embedded_relationship_value(
                    nested_value,
                    selection.nested,
                    serialize_scalar=serialize_scalar,
                )
            else:
                result[selection.output_name] = serialize_scalar(nested_value)
        return result
    if isinstance(normalized_value, list):
        return [
            format_embedded_relationship_value(
                item,
                selections,
                serialize_scalar=serialize_scalar,
            )
            for item in normalized_value
        ]
    return serialize_scalar(normalized_value)


@pure_lazy
def _raise_unhandled_relationship_storage_kind(storage_kind: RelationshipStorageKind) -> NoReturn:
    msg = f"Unhandled relationship storage kind: {storage_kind.value}"
    raise NotImplementedError(msg)


@pure_lazy
def _require_dependent_query_support(query: object, *, target_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> None:
    """Fail loudly when a direct plan builder cannot express dependent includes."""
    if callable(getattr(query, "filter_by_ref", None)) and callable(
        getattr(query, "execute_later", None),
    ):
        return
    msg = (
        "Direct include planning requires dependent query support for "
        f"{target_model.__name__}; no fallback include execution path exists."
    )
    raise TypeError(msg)


def compile_includes_into_plan(
    server_plan: ServerPlan,
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec],
) -> CompilationResult:
    """Compile standard include specs into dependent ServerPlan queries.

    ``IncludeThrough`` remains a caller-owned special case so existing junction
    planning paths do not double-enqueue through-loading work here.
    """
    return _compile_relationship_requests_into_plan(
        server_plan,
        parent_ref,
        result_prefix="include",
        requests=tuple(request for request in _relationship_requests_from_includes(includes) if request.kind != "through"),
    ).include_compilation


class _BuildIncludeHydrationPayloadStep[E: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](
    NonPublishingStep[IncludeHydrationPayload[E]],
):
    """L0 step that prepares include hydration payloads from loaded refs."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _ApplyIncludeHydrationConfig[E],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_entities_ref = config.source_entities_ref
        self._source_model_cls = config.source_model_cls
        self._includes = config.includes
        self._edges = config.edges
        self._literal_source_entities = config.literal_source_entities

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def executor_visible_published_rows(
        self: _BuildIncludeHydrationPayloadStep[E],
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, object], ...]:
        """Runtime-only payload step; no SQL-visible rows."""
        return ()

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"apply", "include", "hydrate"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = {str(ref) for ref in self._source_entities_ref.dependencies()}
        for edge in self._edges:
            deps.add(edge.result_ref_id)
        return frozenset(deps)

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[IncludeHydrationPayload[E]]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(
        self,
        resolved: TerminalResolvedValues,
        hydrator: Hydrator,
    ) -> IncludeHydrationPayload[E]:
        source_ref_id = self._source_entities_ref.ref_id
        runtime_ref_ids = tuple(edge.result_ref_id for edge in self._edges)
        literal_source_entities: tuple[E, ...] = self._literal_source_entities
        if source_ref_id is not None:
            runtime_ref_ids = (source_ref_id, *runtime_ref_ids)
        else:
            literal_source_entities = tuple(_literal_include_entities(self._source_entities_ref))

        if not runtime_ref_ids:
            msg = "include hydration requires at least one SQL-visible source or edge relation."
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return _build_include_hydration_payload(
            source_ref_id,
            literal_source_entities,
            self._source_model_cls,
            _include_edges_for_post_op(self._edges),
            hydrator,
            resolved,
        )


class _ProjectIncludeHydrationEntitiesStep[E: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](NonPublishingStep[list[E]]):
    """Apply include hydration and return the source entities."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        payload_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        includes: tuple[IncludeSpec, ...] = (),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._payload_ref = payload_ref
        self._includes = includes

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"apply", "include", "hydrate", "project"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._payload_ref)})

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[E]]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: TerminalResolvedValues) -> list[E]:
        payload = resolved.get(str(self._payload_ref))
        if not isinstance(payload, IncludeHydrationPayload):
            msg = f"Expected IncludeHydrationPayload for {self._payload_ref}, got {type(payload).__name__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        entities = list(cast("tuple[E, ...]", payload.source_entities))
        hydrate_entities_from_include_data(
            entities,
            self._includes,
            payload.include_data,
        )
        return entities


class IncludeLoadIntent[E: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](IntentStep[list[E]]):
    """L4 intent that loads includes for a parent entity sequence."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "include", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.MANY
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        config: _IncludeLoadConfig[E],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._config = config
        self._source_entities = self._config.source_entities
        self._includes = self._config.includes
        self._hydration_source_entities = self._config.hydration_source_entities
        self._workspace_id = self._config.workspace_id
        self._source_model_cls = self._config.source_model_cls
        self._session_id = self._config.session_id
        self._permission_context_ref = self._config.permission_context_ref
        self._permission_context_type = self._config.permission_context_type
        self._literal_source_entities = self._config.literal_source_entities
        base_ref = int(ref_id.split("_")[1].split(".")[0])
        self._ref_seed = 10_000_000 + (base_ref * 1_000)

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(
            {
                *self._source_entities.dependencies(),
                *(
                    ()
                    if self._permission_context_ref is None
                    else (str(self._permission_context_ref),)
                ),
            }
        )

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        return _lower_include_load_intent(
            ctx=ctx,
            allocator=_IncludeRefAllocator(self._ref_seed),
            final_ref_id=self.ref_id,
            source_ref=cast(ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity], self._source_entities),
            source_model_cls=self._source_model_cls,
            includes=self._includes,
            workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
            session_id=self._session_id,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
            literal_source_entities=self._literal_source_entities,
            hydration_source_ref=cast(
                ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity] | None,
                self._hydration_source_entities,
            ),
        )


def _lower_include_load_intent(
    *,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    allocator: _IncludeRefAllocator,
    final_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    source_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    source_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
    includes: tuple[IncludeSpec, ...],
    workspace_id: WorkspaceId | None,
    session_id: str | None,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None,
    literal_source_entities: tuple[IncludeEntity, ...] = (),
    hydration_source_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity] | None = None,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    resolved_source_model_cls = source_model_cls
    if source_ref.ref_id is None:
        msg = "include source must carry a ref_id"
        raise TypeError(msg)

    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    requests = _relationship_requests_from_includes(includes)
    planned_includes = _compile_include_request_level(
        source_ref,
        requests=requests,
        source_model_cls=resolved_source_model_cls,
        emit_include=lambda request, binding, ref_key: _compile_include_request_into_lowered_steps(
            ctx=ctx,
            allocator=allocator,
            source_ref=source_ref,
            workspace_id=workspace_id,
            session_id=session_id,
            permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
            steps=steps,
            request=request,
            binding=binding,
            ref_key=ref_key,
        ),
    )
    edges = tuple(planned.edge for planned in planned_includes)
    payload_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{final_ref_id}_include_payload")
    steps.append(
        _BuildIncludeHydrationPayloadStep(
            payload_ref_id,
            config=_ApplyIncludeHydrationConfig(
                source_entities_ref=cast(
                    ObjectSequenceServerRef[Any],
                    hydration_source_ref if hydration_source_ref is not None else source_ref,
                ),
                source_model_cls=resolved_source_model_cls,
                includes=includes,
                edges=_include_edges_for_post_op(edges),
                literal_source_entities=cast(tuple[Any, ...], literal_source_entities),
            ),
        ),
    )
    steps.append(
        _ProjectIncludeHydrationEntitiesStep(
            final_ref_id,
            payload_ref_id,
            includes,
        ),
    )
    for planned in planned_includes:
        if not planned.request.nested_include_specs:
            continue
        nested_source_ref = planned.edge.result_ref
        if nested_source_ref is None:
            msg = f"Include edge {planned.edge.ref_key!r} has no symbolic result ref for nested lowering"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        steps.extend(
            _lower_include_load_intent(
                ctx=ctx,
                allocator=allocator,
                final_ref_id=allocator.next_ref(),
                source_ref=nested_source_ref,
                source_model_cls=planned.request.target_model,
                includes=planned.request.nested_include_specs,
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
                literal_source_entities=(),
                hydration_source_ref=cast(
                    ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
                    ServerRefs.from_ref_id(ServerPlanRefId(planned.edge.result_ref_id), variant="object_sequence"),
                ),
            ),
        )
    return steps


def _compile_include_request_into_lowered_steps(
    *,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    allocator: _IncludeRefAllocator,
    source_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    workspace_id: WorkspaceId | None,
    session_id: str | None,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None,
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    binding: _IncludeFilterBinding,
    ref_key: str,
) -> CompiledIncludeRef:
    result_ref = allocator.next_ref()
    steps.extend(
        _build_include_query_step(
            ctx=ctx,
            ref_id=result_ref,
            model_cls=request.target_model,
            filter_column=SqlColumnName(binding.filter_column),
            filter_value=_project_include_source_values(
                source_ref,
                SqlColumnName(binding.source_projection_field),
            ),
            workspace_id=workspace_id,
            request=request,
            session_id=session_id,
            permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
        ),
    )
    nested_source_ref = result_ref
    if request.kind in {"has_many", "through"} and request.nested_include_specs:
        nested_source_ref = allocator.next_ref()
        steps.extend(
            _build_include_query_step(
                ctx=ctx,
                ref_id=nested_source_ref,
                model_cls=request.target_model,
                filter_column=SqlColumnName(binding.filter_column),
                filter_value=_project_include_source_values(
                    source_ref,
                    SqlColumnName(binding.source_projection_field),
                ),
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                request=request,
                session_id=session_id,
                permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
            ),
        )
    result_ref_handle = cast(
        ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
        ServerRefs.from_ref_id(nested_source_ref, variant="object_sequence"),
    )
    return CompiledIncludeRef(
        ref_key=ref_key,
        field_name=request.field_name,
        source_key_field=binding.filter_column,
        owner_key_field=binding.source_projection_field,
        target_model=request.target_model,
        is_has_many=request.kind in {"has_many", "through"},
        result_ref_id=str(result_ref),
        result_ref=result_ref_handle,
        top=request.top,
        skip=request.skip,
    )


def _build_include_query_step(
    *,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    filter_column: SqlColumnName,
    filter_value: IncludeFilterValue,
    workspace_id: WorkspaceId | None,
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import is_versioned_operation
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
        lower_spill_read_for_backend,
        should_lower_spill_read,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_query_steps import (
        build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps,
        VersionedQueryFromSpecStep,
        _VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig,
        lower_versioned_spill_aware_query_read_steps,
    )

    operator = "IN" if isinstance(filter_value, list | ScalarSequenceServerRef) else "="
    paged_request = _request_without_list_pagination(request) if request.is_many else request

    if workspace_id is not None and issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
        versioning_domain = ctx.versioning_domain
        if versioning_domain is None:
            versioning_domain = getattr(model_cls, "__versioning_domain__", None)
            assert versioning_domain is None or isinstance(versioning_domain, type)
        if versioning_domain is None:
            versioning_domain = require_versioning_domain(
                ctx,
                site="lower_include_query_steps",
            )
        cross_branch_spec = CrossBranchQuerySpec(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            workspace_id=workspace_id,
            tips_only=True,
            filters=[
                QueryFilter(column=str(filter_column), operator=operator, value=filter_value),
                *([QueryFilter(expression=paged_request.filter_expression)] if paged_request.filter_expression is not None else []),
            ],
            order_by=_request_cross_branch_order_by(paged_request),
            limit=paged_request.top,
            offset=paged_request.skip or 0,
            session_id=session_id if session_id is not None else (None if ctx.session_id is None else str(ctx.session_id)),
            versioning_domain=versioning_domain,
            tip_materialization=(
                BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED if ctx.branch_tip_materialized else BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS
            ),
        )
        return [
            CrossBranchExecuteStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
                model_cls,
                branch_spec=cross_branch_spec,
                config=_CrossBranchExecuteConfig(),
            ),
        ]

    query_spec = QuerySpec(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        select_columns=None,
        distinct=False,
        joins=[],
        filters=[
            QueryFilter(column=str(filter_column), operator=operator, value=filter_value),
            *([QueryFilter(expression=paged_request.filter_expression)] if paged_request.filter_expression is not None else []),
        ],
        order_by=_request_query_spec_order_by(paged_request),
        limit=paged_request.top,
        offset=paged_request.skip,
        group_by=[],
        aggregations=[],
        having=[],
        window_functions=[],
        permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
        permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query_extended import (
        _build_session_user_resolution_steps,
    )

    if is_versioned_operation(model_cls, ctx):
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import _build_session_user_resolution

        leading_steps, user_id_ref_id = _build_session_user_resolution(
            owner_ref_id=ref_id,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            ctx=ctx,
            permission_filtering_enabled=True,
        )
        if ctx.branch_id is not None:
            if should_lower_spill_read(
                ctx=ctx,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                query_spec=query_spec,
                raw_mode=False,
                versioned=True,
            ):
                return [
                    *leading_steps,
                    *lower_versioned_spill_aware_query_read_steps(
                        ref_id=ref_id,
                        model_cls=model_cls,
                        query_spec=query_spec,
                        branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    ),
                ]
            return [
                *leading_steps,
                *build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
                    ref_id=ref_id,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    config=_VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                        query_spec=query_spec,
                        branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        assert ctx.lazy_revision is not None
        assert ctx.branch_table is not None
        resolve_ref, resolve_step = ctx.get_or_create_branch_resolve(ref_id)
        result: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        result.extend(leading_steps)
        if resolve_step is not None:
            result.append(resolve_step)
        if should_lower_spill_read(
            ctx=ctx,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            query_spec=query_spec,
            raw_mode=False,
            versioned=True,
        ):
            result.extend(
                lower_versioned_spill_aware_query_read_steps(
                    ref_id=ref_id,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    query_spec=query_spec,
                    branch_ref_id=resolve_ref,
                    revision_id=ctx.lazy_revision,
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        else:
            result.extend(
                build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
                    ref_id=ref_id,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    config=_VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                        query_spec=query_spec,
                        branch_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref),
                        revision_ref_id=(None if ctx.lazy_revision.ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(ctx.lazy_revision.ref_id)),
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    ),
                ),
            )
        return result

    leading_steps, user_id_ref_id = _build_session_user_resolution_steps(
        ref_id=ref_id,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        ctx=ctx,
    )
    steps = lower_spill_read_for_backend(
        ctx=ctx,
        ref_id=ref_id,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        query_spec=query_spec,
        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
    )
    if steps:
        return [*leading_steps, *steps]
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import _QueryExecuteStepConfig

    return [
        *leading_steps,
        QueryExecuteStep(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                query_spec=query_spec,
                raw_mode=False,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                always_publish_executor_binding=True,
            ),
        ),
    ]

) -> IncludeFilterValue:
    if source_ref.ref_id is None:

        raise TypeError(msg)
    return source_ref.field(str(field_name))

    lookup_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None = None
    lookup_field: str | None = None
    lookup_key: str | None = None
    is_many_override: bool | None = None
    include_junction_payload: bool = False

    @property
    def is_many(self) -> bool:
        if self.is_many_override is not None:
            return self.is_many_override
        return self.kind in {"has_many", "through", "two_hop", "derived"}


@dataclass(slots=True)
class RelationshipCompilation:
    """Compiled relationship refs and formatter metadata."""

    include_compilation: CompilationResult
    two_hop_refs: dict[str, TwoHopRelationshipRef] = dataclass_field(default_factory=dict)
    derived_refs: dict[str, JsonArrayDerivedRelationshipRef] = dataclass_field(default_factory=dict)
    child_compilations: dict[str, RelationshipCompilation] = dataclass_field(default_factory=dict)
    embedded_refs: dict[str, EmbeddedRelationshipRef] = dataclass_field(default_factory=dict)


def freeze_relationship_compilation_for_reuse(
    compilation: RelationshipCompilation,
) -> RelationshipCompilation:
    """Copy formatter metadata while removing transaction-local ref handles."""
    include_refs = {key: dataclass_replace(ref, result_ref=None) for key, ref in compilation.include_compilation.include_refs.items()}
    two_hop_refs = {
        key: dataclass_replace(
            ref,
            target_result_ref=cast("ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity]", None),
        )
        for key, ref in compilation.two_hop_refs.items()
    }
    derived_refs = {
        key: dataclass_replace(
            ref,
            lookup_result_ref=cast("ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity]", None),
        )
        for key, ref in compilation.derived_refs.items()
    }
    return RelationshipCompilation(
        include_compilation=CompilationResult(include_refs=include_refs),
        two_hop_refs=two_hop_refs,
        derived_refs=derived_refs,
        child_compilations={
            key: freeze_relationship_compilation_for_reuse(child) for key, child in compilation.child_compilations.items()
        },
        embedded_refs=dict(compilation.embedded_refs),
    )

def _literal_include_entities[E: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](
    source_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[E],
) -> Sequence[E]:
    del source_ref
    msg = "include source without ref_id must be a published sequence ref"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _build_include_hydration_payload[E: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](
    source_ref_id: str | None,
    literal_source_entities: tuple[E, ...],
    source_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
    edges: tuple[CompiledIncludeRef, ...],
    hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> IncludeHydrationPayload[E]:
    if literal_source_entities:
        source_entities = list(literal_source_entities)
    elif source_ref_id is None:
        source_entities = list(literal_source_entities)
    else:
        source_entities = list(cast(Sequence[E], runtime_refs.get(source_ref_id) or ()))
    if source_model_cls is not None:
        source_entities = [
            cast(E, hydrator(source_model_cls, entity)) if isinstance(entity, dict) else entity for entity in source_entities
        ]
    compilation = CompilationResult(include_refs={edge.ref_key: edge for edge in edges})

    def load_edge_rows(ref: CompiledIncludeRef) -> Sequence[IncludeEntity]:
        if ref.result_ref_id not in runtime_refs:
            available_refs = tuple(str(key) for key in runtime_refs.keys())
            msg = (
                "include hydration edge result is missing from runtime refs "
                f"(edge={ref.ref_key!r}, result_ref_id={ref.result_ref_id!r}, "
                f"available_refs={available_refs!r}). IncludeLoadIntent lowering must schedule "
                "all include edge query steps before _BuildIncludeHydrationPayloadStep."
            )
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return cast(Sequence[IncludeEntity], runtime_refs[ref.result_ref_id] or ())

    include_data = group_include_data(
        source_entities,
        compilation,
        lambda ref: [_normalize_loaded_include_entity(row, ref.target_model) for row in load_edge_rows(ref)],
    )
    return IncludeHydrationPayload(
        source_entities=tuple(source_entities),
        include_data={entity_id: field_map for entity_id, field_map in include_data.items()},
    )


@pure_lazy
def describe_include_binding(include: IncludeSpec) -> IncludeBinding | None:
    """Return the canonical impl-owned relationship metadata for an include spec."""
    from l2080_lazy_orm.has_many import HasMany
    from l2080_lazy_orm.through import Through
    from l2100_include.include import Include
    from l2100_include.include_many import IncludeMany, IncludeThrough

    binding: IncludeBinding | None = None
    if isinstance(include, Include):
        rel = cast(BelongsTo[Any, Any], object.__getattribute__(include, "_relationship"))
        attr_name = rel._attr_name  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        if attr_name is None:
            return None
        binding = IncludeBinding(
            kind="belongs_to",
            field_name=attr_name,
            source_key_field=rel.fk_field,
            is_many=False,
            target_model=rel.target,
            nested_includes=tuple(include.nested_includes),
            descriptor=rel,
        )
    elif isinstance(include, IncludeMany):
        rel_many = cast(HasMany[Any], object.__getattribute__(include, "_relationship"))
        attr_name = rel_many._attr_name  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        if attr_name is None:
            return None
        binding = IncludeBinding(
            kind="has_many",
            field_name=attr_name,
            source_key_field=rel_many._foreign_key,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            is_many=True,
            target_model=rel_many._target_cls,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            nested_includes=tuple(include.nested_includes),
            descriptor=rel_many,
            filter_expression=object.__getattribute__(include, "_filter_expression"),
            order_by_clauses=tuple(object.__getattribute__(include, "_order_by_clauses")),
            top=object.__getattribute__(include, "_top"),
            skip=object.__getattribute__(include, "_skip"),
        )
    elif isinstance(include, IncludeThrough):
        rel_through = cast(Through[Any], object.__getattribute__(include, "_relationship"))
        attr_name = rel_through._attr_name  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        if attr_name is None:
            return None
        binding = IncludeBinding(
            kind="through",
            field_name=attr_name,
            source_key_field=rel_through._owner_key,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            is_many=True,
            target_model=rel_through._junction_cls,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            nested_includes=tuple(include.nested_includes),
            descriptor=rel_through,
            filter_expression=object.__getattribute__(include, "_filter_expression"),
            order_by_clauses=tuple(object.__getattribute__(include, "_order_by_clauses")),
            top=object.__getattribute__(include, "_top"),
            skip=object.__getattribute__(include, "_skip"),
        )

    return binding


@pure_lazy
def iter_include_bindings(includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec]) -> list[IncludeBinding]:
    """Normalize public include specs into canonical impl-owned bindings."""
    bindings: list[IncludeBinding] = []
    for include in includes:
        binding = describe_include_binding(include)
        if binding is not None:
            bindings.append(binding)
    return bindings


def build_include_descriptor_map(
    includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec],
) -> dict[str, RelationshipDescriptor]:
    """Return the descriptor instance for each included field."""
    return {binding.field_name: binding.descriptor for binding in iter_include_bindings(includes)}


@pure_lazy
def _relationship_requests_from_includes(
    includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec],
) -> tuple[_RelationshipRequest, ...]:
    requests: list[_RelationshipRequest] = []
    for binding in iter_include_bindings(includes):
        requests.append(
            _RelationshipRequest(
                field_name=binding.field_name,
                kind=binding.kind,
                target_model=binding.target_model,
                nested_requests=_relationship_requests_from_includes(binding.nested_includes),
                nested_include_specs=tuple(binding.nested_includes),
                visibility="junction" if binding.kind == "through" else "target",
                source_key_field=binding.source_key_field,
                filter_expression=binding.filter_expression,
