class _LiteralUpsertPayloadStep(MaybeSqlRelationPublisherStep[dict[str, object]]):
    """Publish a concrete upsert row as a SQL-visible prerequisite relation."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
        instance: object,
        planning_catalog: object | None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._instance = instance
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
            get_write_metadata_plan_from_catalog,
        )

        self._write_plan: WriteMetadataPlan = get_write_metadata_plan_from_catalog(planning_catalog, model_cls)
        initial_columns, _initial_values = _prepare_upsert_columns_and_values(
            model_cls,
            instance,
            planning_catalog,
        )
        self._columns = initial_columns
        self._values: tuple[object, ...] = ()
        dependencies = collect_instance_deps(self._instance) | frozenset(
            server_value_deps(self._instance),
        )
        if isinstance(self._instance, LazyResult):
            dependencies |= lazy_param_deps(self._instance)
        self._dependencies = dependencies

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"project", "upsert", "payload"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._dependencies

    def supports_ordered_sql_statement_batch(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _LiteralUpsertPayloadStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = self._columns
        if columns is None:
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...]) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
            hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, columns)
            if hints is None:
                return None
            if not hints.covers(columns):
                return None
            return hints

        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = self._model_cls
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[dict[str, object]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import lower_scalar_server_ref
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_cte_helpers import SqlPublishedRowsQuery, SqlSelectExpressions
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam
        from impl.common.l2300_json_serialization import get_json_columns
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import (
            CompiledOutputShape,
            DeclaredResultRelation,
            synthetic_output_field,
        )
        from l2070_batching.server_ref import ScalarServerRef

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
            cast_postgres_expr_for_db_column,
            extract_columns_and_values_from_plan,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._prepare_instance import prepare_instance_for_upsert_lazy

        prepared = prepare_instance_for_upsert_lazy(self._model_cls, cast("DatabaseObjectRow[Any]", self._instance))
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_crud import _apply_trust_for_lowering

        prepared = _apply_trust_for_lowering(ctx, self._model_cls, prepared)
        _columns, values = extract_columns_and_values_from_plan(
            self._write_plan,
            prepared,
            backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
            include_sibling_nulls=True,
        )
        self._columns = tuple(_columns)
        self._values = tuple(values)

        json_columns = {
            column_name
            for field_name in get_json_columns(self._model_cls)
            for column_name in (field_name, get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
        } | set(self.cte_publication_contract().column_type_hints.jsonb_columns)

        def _literal_payload_value(column: str, value: object) -> object:
            if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is not DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
                return value

            from impl.common.l2100_sql_params.sql_param_normalization import normalize_postgres_json_bind_value

            if column not in json_columns or value is None:
                return value
            return normalize_postgres_json_bind_value(value)

        items: list[tuple[SqlRenderable, str]] = []
        row: dict[str, object] = {}
        has_scalar_refs = False
        for column, value in zip(self._columns, self._values, strict=True):
            if isinstance(value, ScalarServerRef):
                has_scalar_refs = True
                expr: SqlRenderable = lower_scalar_server_ref(value, ctx)
            else:
                payload_value = _literal_payload_value(column, value)
                row[column] = payload_value
                expr = SqlParam(payload_value)
                expr = cast_postgres_expr_for_db_column(
                    backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
                    write_plan=self._write_plan,
                    db_column=column,
                    expr=expr,
                )
            items.append((expr, column))

        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in self._columns))

class UpsertStep[T](ServerPlanStep[T]):
    """ServerPlan step for inserting or updating a single record."""

    def __init__(
        self: UpsertStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
        config: _UpsertStepConfig,
    ) -> None:
        """Initialize UpsertStep.

        Args:
            ref_id: Reference ID for this step's result
            model_cls: The DatabaseObjectRow subclass
            instance: The model instance to upsert (may contain ServerRef field values)
            conflict_columns: Columns to check for conflicts (None for primary key)
            on_conflict: Conflict resolution actions (None for default)
        """
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]] = model_cls
        self._instance = config.instance
        self._source_ref = config.source_ref
        self._payload_ref = config.payload_ref
        self._conflict_columns = config.conflict_columns
        self._on_conflict = config.on_conflict
        self._on_conflict_where = config.on_conflict_where
        self._after_refs = config.after_refs or frozenset()
        self._conflict_do_nothing = config.conflict_do_nothing
        self._return_raw_rows = config.return_raw_rows
        self._ordered_statement_transport = config.ordered_statement_transport
        self._publish_selected_binding = config.publish_selected_binding
        self._permission_context_ref = config.permission_context_ref
        self._permission_context_type = config.permission_context_type

    @property
    def level(self: UpsertStep) -> int:
        return 1

    def step_tags(self: UpsertStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Return semantic tags for this step."""
        return frozenset({"write", "upsert", "grammar"})

    def is_read_only(self: UpsertStep) -> bool:
        """Return False - upserts modify data."""
        return False

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self: UpsertStep) -> bool:
        return bool(self.dependencies())

    def execution_role(self: UpsertStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def result_cardinality(self: UpsertStep) -> Cardinality:
        """Return ONE - upsert returns a single row."""
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def additional_batch_binding_ref_ids(self: UpsertStep) -> tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]:
        if not self._publish_selected_binding:
            return ()
        return (ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.selected"),)

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: UpsertStep) -> bool:
        """The lowered raw upsert step owns executor-visible publication."""
        return False

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: UpsertStep) -> bool:
        """Author-level upsert wrappers do not publish their own ref."""
        return False

    def commit_dependency_ref_id(self: UpsertStep) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        """Return the raw write ref effect-only consumers should depend on."""
        return ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw")

    def tables_read(self: UpsertStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Upsert FK reads are exposed through catalog-backed optimizer facts."""
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: UpsertStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Return the table name this step writes to."""
        if not isinstance(self._model_cls, type):
            msg = f"UpsertStep expected model class, got {type(self._model_cls).__module__}.{type(self._model_cls).__qualname__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        return frozenset({get_table_config(self._model_cls).plural})

    def dependencies(self: UpsertStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        from l2055_lazy_result.lazy_param import server_value_deps
        from l2055_lazy_result.lazy_result import LazyResult

        deps: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
        if self._source_ref is not None:
            deps = deps | frozenset({self._source_ref})
        if self._payload_ref is not None:
            deps = deps | frozenset({self._payload_ref})
        if self._instance is not None:
            deps = deps | collect_instance_deps(self._instance)
            deps = deps | frozenset(server_value_deps(self._instance))
        if isinstance(self._instance, LazyResult):
            from l2055_lazy_result.lazy_param import lazy_param_deps

            deps = deps | lazy_param_deps(self._instance)
        if self._permission_context_ref is not None:
            deps = deps | frozenset({str(self._permission_context_ref)})
        return deps | frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in self._after_refs)

    def foreign_key_checks(
        self: UpsertStep,
        planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None,
    ) -> frozenset[ForeignKeyCheckFact]:
        instance = self._instance
        return foreign_key_checks_for_instance(self._model_cls, instance, planning_catalog)

    def foreign_key_read_tables(
        self: UpsertStep,
        planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None,
    ) -> frozenset[str]:
        return insert_fk_read_tables(self._model_cls, planning_catalog)

    def write_key_facts(
        self: UpsertStep,
        planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None,
    ) -> frozenset[WriteKeyFact]:
        instance = self._instance
        return write_key_facts_for_instance(
            self.ref_id,
            self._model_cls,
            instance,
            planning_catalog,
        )

    def lower(self: UpsertStep, ctx: LoweringContext) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.row_hydration import (
            HydrateFirstResolvedRowStep,
            SourceRefIsStepId,
        )

        payload_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_upsert_payload")
        raw_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw")
        # Raw-row action terminals may use standalone RETURNING support.
        # Model-returning upserts retain authoritative selected readback when
        # DML relations cannot cross statement boundaries.
        returns_existing_row = self._conflict_do_nothing or (isinstance(self._on_conflict, Mapping) and not self._on_conflict)
        supports_insert_returning = ctx.has_returning_clause and not (
            self._conflict_columns and ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_conflict_transport is DmlConflictTransport.INSERTED_VALUES
        )
        raw_step_returns_rows = (
            supports_insert_returning and not self._publish_selected_binding and (self._return_raw_rows or not returns_existing_row)
        )
        result_ref = raw_ref if raw_step_returns_rows else ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.selected")
        payload_columns = _upsert_payload_columns(self._model_cls, ctx.planning_catalog)
        payload_step: ServerPlanStep[Any]
        if self._source_ref is not None:
            payload_step = _PrepareDeferredUpsertPayloadStep(
                payload_ref,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                source_ref=self._source_ref,
                config=_DeferredUpsertPayloadConfig(payload_columns=payload_columns),
            )
        elif self._instance is not None:
            payload_step = _LiteralUpsertPayloadStep(
                payload_ref,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                instance=self._instance,
                planning_catalog=ctx.planning_catalog,
            )
        else:
            msg = "UpsertStep requires either a concrete instance or an explicit source_ref"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)

        direct_literal_returning = self._return_raw_rows and self._instance is not None and supports_insert_returning
        from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import get_query_permission_plan

        permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(self._model_cls, action="insert")
        filtered_insert = (
            permission_plan is not None
            and permission_plan.filter_rows
            and (ctx.permission_filtering_enabled or permission_plan.filter_reserved_sessions)
        )
        raw_config = _UpsertStepConfig(
            instance=self._instance if direct_literal_returning else None,
            payload_ref=None if direct_literal_returning else payload_ref,
            conflict_columns=self._conflict_columns,
            on_conflict=self._on_conflict,
            on_conflict_where=self._on_conflict_where,
            after_refs=self._after_refs,
            conflict_do_nothing=self._conflict_do_nothing,
            ordered_statement_transport=(
                not direct_literal_returning and (not ctx.has_returning_clause or (filtered_insert and not self._conflict_do_nothing))
            ),
            return_raw_rows=self._return_raw_rows,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
            *([] if direct_literal_returning else [payload_step]),
            UpsertRawResultStep(
                raw_ref,
                self._model_cls,
                raw_config,
            ),
        ]
        if not raw_step_returns_rows:
            from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

            steps.append(
                _SelectUpsertRowsFromPayloadStep(
                    result_ref,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    config=_UpsertPayloadSelectionConfig(
                        payload_ref=payload_ref,
                        write_ref=raw_ref,
                        conflict_columns=tuple(
                            SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(column)))
                            for column in (self._conflict_columns or ("sys_id",))
                        ),
                        include_permission_assertion=False,
                    ),
                ),
            )
        if self._return_raw_rows:
            # Raw-row consumers take the SQL rows as-is; hydrating them into a
            # model here would be work the caller immediately discards.
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import (
                RuntimeSourceAfterDepsStep,
                RuntimeSourceSequenceValue,
            )

            steps.append(
                RuntimeSourceAfterDepsStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    source_ref=result_ref,
                    after_refs=(raw_ref,),
                    sequence_value=RuntimeSourceSequenceValue(True),
                ),
            )
            return steps
        steps.append(
            HydrateFirstResolvedRowStep(
                self.ref_id,
                source_ref=result_ref,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                source_ref_is_step_id=SourceRefIsStepId(True),
                runtime_only_materialization=not supports_insert_returning and not returns_existing_row,
                executor_runtime_materialization=not supports_insert_returning,
            ),
        )
        return steps

    def compile(self: UpsertStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[T]:
        del ctx
        msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must be lowered before compile()"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self: UpsertRawResultStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def requires_prior_statement_visibility_after_writes(self: UpsertRawResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.tables_written()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: UpsertRawResultStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = getattr(self, "_compiled_publication_columns", None)
        if columns is None:
            from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import returnable_db_columns

            columns = returnable_db_columns(self._model_cls)
        column_type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, tuple(columns))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = self._model_cls
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
            empty_result_allowed=(self._conflict_do_nothing or (isinstance(self._on_conflict, Mapping) and not self._on_conflict)),
        )

    def step_tags(self: UpsertRawResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "upsert", "grammar", "raw"})

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: UpsertRawResultStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: UpsertRawResultStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def lower(self: UpsertRawResultStep, ctx: LoweringContext) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        del ctx
        return [self]

    def compile(self: UpsertRawResultStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[object]]:
        permission_ctx = _upsert_compilation_context(
            ctx,
            self._permission_context_ref,
            self._permission_context_type,
        )
        closed_post_op = row_dicts_post_op() if self._return_raw_rows else query_execute_rows_post_op(self._model_cls, raw_mode=False)
        if self._payload_ref is not None:
            binding = _resolve_payload_binding(ctx, self._payload_ref)
            if binding is not None and binding.columns:
                columns = _filter_upsert_columns_to_existing_schema(
                    self._model_cls,
                    binding.columns,
                    ctx,
                )
                compiled = _compile_payload_cte_upsert(
                    self._model_cls,
                    payload_ref=self._payload_ref,
                    binding=binding,
                    columns=columns,
                    conflict_columns=self._conflict_columns,
                    on_conflict=cast(Mapping[str, object] | None, self._on_conflict),
                    on_conflict_where=self._on_conflict_where,
                    ctx=permission_ctx,
                    closed_post_op=closed_post_op,
                    conflict_do_nothing=self._conflict_do_nothing,
                )
                if compiled.output_shape is not None:
                    self._compiled_publication_columns = compiled.output_shape.cte_output_columns
                return _append_upsert_permission_context_cte(compiled, permission_ctx, self._permission_context_ref)
            _raise_missing_payload_binding(self._payload_ref)
        if self._instance is None:
            msg = "UpsertRawResultStep requires either payload_ref or a concrete instance"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        columns, values = _prepare_upsert_columns_and_values(
            self._model_cls,
            self._instance,
            ctx.planning_catalog,
            backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
        )
        compiled = _compile_literal_upsert(
            self._model_cls,
            columns=columns,
            values=values,
            conflict_columns=self._conflict_columns,
            on_conflict=cast(Mapping[str, object] | None, self._on_conflict),
            on_conflict_where=self._on_conflict_where,
            ctx=permission_ctx,
            closed_post_op=closed_post_op,
        )
        if compiled.output_shape is not None:
            self._compiled_publication_columns = compiled.output_shape.cte_output_columns
        return _append_upsert_permission_context_cte(compiled, permission_ctx, self._permission_context_ref)

class _FkCascadeMode(StrEnum):
    SINGLE = "single"
    BULK = "bulk"


def _require_fk_cascade_depth(depth: int, mode: _FkCascadeMode, limit: int) -> None:
    if depth <= limit:
        return
    msg = f"Versioned FK {mode.value} cascade exceeded the schema bound of {limit} relationships"
    raise ProgrammingError(msg)


class _FkChildIdentity(str):
    """Stable deduplication identity for one physical or conditional child."""


def _fk_relationships_for_physical_parent(
    fk_map: dict[type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]], list[FKRelationship]],
    parent_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
) -> list[FKRelationship]:
    """Return one relationship per physical child constraint."""
    parent_table = get_table_name(parent_model)
    relationships: list[FKRelationship] = []
    seen: set[tuple[_FkChildIdentity, str, str, str]] = set()
    for candidates in fk_map.values():
        for relationship in candidates:
            parent_matches = (
                issubclass(parent_model, relationship.parent_model)
                if relationship.conditional_parent_type
                else get_table_name(relationship.parent_model) == parent_table
            )
            if not parent_matches:
                continue
            child_identity = _FkChildIdentity(
                (
                    f"model:{relationship.child_model.__module__}.{relationship.child_model.__qualname__}"
                    if relationship.conditional_parent_type
                    else f"table:{get_table_name(relationship.child_model)}"
                ),
            )
            key = (
                child_identity,
                relationship.child_field,
                relationship.parent_field,
                relationship.on_delete.upper().replace("_", " "),
            )
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            relationships.append(relationship)
    return relationships

def _require_versioned_update_payload_contract(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    apply_update_rules: bool,
) -> CteReference:
    if apply_update_rules:
        msg = (
            "_PrepareVersionedUpdateByIdApplyPayloadStep cannot apply update hooks while "
            "building a SQL row-patch relation; hook mutation must lower through explicit "
            "plan effect steps."
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(source_ref))
    if isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference):
        return cte_ref
    available_refs = ", ".join(sorted(ctx.cte_refs))
    msg = (
        "_PrepareVersionedUpdateByIdApplyPayloadStep requires a SQL-visible source relation; "
        "versioned update payload patching must lower to SQL assignments rather than Python row mutation. "
        f"missing={source_ref!s}; available=({available_refs})"
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)

def _require_dynamic_delete_result_refs(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    staged_delete_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    tombstone_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    check_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    step_name: str,
) -> tuple[CteReference, CteReference, CteReference | None]:
    staged_cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(staged_delete_ref)
    tombstone_cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(tombstone_ref)
    check_cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(check_ref) if check_ref is not None else None
    if (
        isinstance(staged_cte_ref, CteReference)
        and isinstance(tombstone_cte_ref, CteReference)
        and (check_ref is None or isinstance(check_cte_ref, CteReference))
    ):
        return staged_cte_ref, tombstone_cte_ref, check_cte_ref
    missing_refs = [
        str(ref)
        for ref, cte_ref in (
            (staged_delete_ref, staged_cte_ref),
            (tombstone_ref, tombstone_cte_ref),
            (check_ref, check_cte_ref),
        )
        if ref is not None and not isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference)
    ]
    msg = f"{step_name} requires SQL-visible child bindings for versioned delete result refs: {', '.join(missing_refs)}"
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_delete_returning_source_cte(

def _require_versioned_delete_count_refs(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    staged_delete_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    tombstone_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    step_name: str,
) -> tuple[CteReference, CteReference]:
    staged_cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(staged_delete_ref) or ctx.cte_refs.get(str(staged_delete_ref))
    tombstone_cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(tombstone_ref) or ctx.cte_refs.get(str(tombstone_ref))
    if not isinstance(staged_cte_ref, CteReference) and not isinstance(tombstone_cte_ref, CteReference):
        fused_ref = _versioned_delete_fused_child_ref(staged_delete_ref, tombstone_ref)
        if fused_ref is not None:
            fused_cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(fused_ref) or ctx.cte_refs.get(ServerPlanRefId(fused_ref))
            if isinstance(fused_cte_ref, CteReference):
                staged_cte_ref = fused_cte_ref
                tombstone_cte_ref = fused_cte_ref
    if isinstance(staged_cte_ref, CteReference) and not isinstance(tombstone_cte_ref, CteReference):
        alternate_tombstone_refs = [
            ref for key, ref in ctx.cte_refs.items() if str(key) != str(staged_delete_ref) and isinstance(ref, CteReference)
        ]
        if len(alternate_tombstone_refs) == 1:
            tombstone_cte_ref = alternate_tombstone_refs[0]
    if isinstance(staged_cte_ref, CteReference) and isinstance(tombstone_cte_ref, CteReference):
        return staged_cte_ref, tombstone_cte_ref
    available = ", ".join(sorted(str(key) for key in ctx.cte_refs))
    msg = (
        f"{step_name} requires SQL-visible child bindings for both staged delete and tombstone results. "
        f"Expected {staged_delete_ref!s} and {tombstone_ref!s}; available CTE refs: {available}"
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _versioned_delete_fused_child_ref(
    staged_delete_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    tombstone_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
) -> str | None:
    staged_text = str(staged_delete_ref)
    tombstone_text = str(tombstone_ref)
    staged_suffix = "_delete_staged"
    tombstone_suffix = "_tombstone"
    if not staged_text.endswith(staged_suffix) or not tombstone_text.endswith(tombstone_suffix):
        return None
    staged_prefix = staged_text[: -len(staged_suffix)]
    tombstone_prefix = tombstone_text[: -len(tombstone_suffix)]
    return staged_prefix if staged_prefix == tombstone_prefix else None


def _versioned_data_db_columns(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    *,
    include_generated_storage_columns: bool,
    excluded_fields: Sequence[str] = ("sys_id", "revision_id", "staged_commit_id", "deleted"),
) -> list[str]:
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import returnable_db_columns, versioned_data_field_plans

    if include_generated_storage_columns:
        columns = list(
            returnable_db_columns(
                model_cls,
                excluded_fields=excluded_fields,
                include_polymorphic=False,
            ),
        )
    else:
        columns = [
            plan.db_column
            for plan in versioned_data_field_plans(
                model_cls,
                excluded_fields=excluded_fields,
                include_polymorphic=False,
            )
        ]
    for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        logical_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column))
        columns = [column for column in columns if column != logical_column]
        pointer_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)))
        if pointer_column not in columns:
            columns.append(pointer_column)
    return columns

def _declared_model_values(row: BaseModel) -> dict[str, _DeclaredModelValue]:
    """Read storage fields under ``docs/NER1540_BATCH_RETURN_CONTRACT.rst``."""
