        )
        return tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                (
                    *base_columns,
                    *_staged_generated_hash_columns(base_columns),
                ),
            ),
        )

    def semantic_publication_type_hints(self) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        columns = self.semantic_publication_columns()
        hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._staging_ctx.staged_model, columns)
        if hints is None:
            msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._staging_ctx.staged_model.__name__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
            columns,
            hints,
            framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
        ).require_complete(columns)

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return not self._dependency_only or self._publish_write_result

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return not self._dependency_only or self._publish_write_result

    def preprocess(self: _VersionedUpdateByIdApplyRawStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> None:
        del resolved

    def compile(
        self: _VersionedUpdateByIdApplyRawStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]] | None]:
        cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._prepared_ref))
        if cte_ref is None:
            cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(self._cte_select_ref)
        if cte_ref is None:
            cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(self._select_ref)
        if cte_ref is not None:
            return cast(CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]] | None], self._compile_from_cte(ctx, cte_ref))
        msg = (
            "VersionedUpdateById apply runtime materialization was deleted with the special IR path. "
            "Lower this path to ordinary SQL/CTE-visible steps before compile()."
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)

    def _compile_missing(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep(
            params=None,
            needs_returning=False,
            closed_post_op=literal_post_op(cast("list[dict[str, Any]]", [])),
        )

    def _compile_from_cte(
        self: _VersionedUpdateByIdApplyRawStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
        cte_ref: CteReference,
    ) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        """Build INSERT INTO staged SELECT ... FROM <cte> AS m when CTE-bound as raw rows."""
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import (
            SqlCoalesceExpr,
            SqlQualifiedColumnExpr,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast
        from impl.common.l2300_json_serialization import coerce_for_json, get_json_columns

        from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import versioned_data_field_plans

        sc = self._staging_ctx
        model_cls = self._model_cls
        staged_model = sc.staged_model
        branch_expr: SqlRenderable
        if sc.literal_branch is not None:
            branch_expr = SqlParam(sc.literal_branch)
        else:
            branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId] = coerce_versioned_branch_ref(sc.lazy_branch)
            branch_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(branch_ref, ctx)
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
            branch_expr = SqlCast(branch_expr, _UUID_CAST_TARGET)
        available_source_columns = frozenset(cte_ref.columns or ())
        source_columns_declared = bool(available_source_columns)

        def _source_column_for_field(field_name: str) -> str | None:
            db_column = get_db_column_name(staged_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            if not source_columns_declared or db_column in available_source_columns:
                return db_column
            model_db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            if model_db_column in available_source_columns:
                return model_db_column
            if field_name in available_source_columns:
                return field_name
            return None

        def _can_project_data_field(field_name: str) -> bool:
            if field_name in {"created_at", "updated_at"} or field_name in self._updates:
                return True
            db_column = get_db_column_name(staged_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            return not source_columns_declared or db_column in available_source_columns

        from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import (
            postgres_h14_code_for_writable_field,
            postgres_storage_cast_type_for_writable_field,
        )

        data_field_plans = tuple(
            plan
            for plan in versioned_data_field_plans(
                staged_model,
                excluded_fields=(
                    "sys_id",
                    "revision_id",
                    "staged_commit_id",
                    "deleted",
                    *_GRAPH_HASH32_FIELD_NAMES,
                ),
                include_polymorphic=True,
            )
            if _can_project_data_field(plan.field_name)
        )
        data_fields: list[str] = [plan.field_name for plan in data_field_plans]
        postgres_cast_types_by_field: dict[str, SqlCastBaseType | None] = {
            plan.field_name: postgres_storage_cast_type_for_writable_field(plan) for plan in data_field_plans
        }
        postgres_h14_fields = frozenset(plan.field_name for plan in data_field_plans if postgres_h14_code_for_writable_field(plan))
        seen_data_fields = set(data_fields)
        for large_column_config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
            large_column_field_name = str(large_column_config.column)
            if large_column_field_name not in seen_data_fields and _can_project_data_field(large_column_field_name):
                data_fields.append(large_column_field_name)
                seen_data_fields.add(large_column_field_name)
            pointer_field_name = large_column_pointer_name(ContentColumnName(large_column_config.column))
            if pointer_field_name not in seen_data_fields and _can_project_data_field(pointer_field_name):
                data_fields.append(pointer_field_name)
                seen_data_fields.add(pointer_field_name)
        all_fields: list[str] = ["branch_id", "sys_id", "staged_commit_id", "deleted", *data_fields]

        expr_converter = ExpressionToGrammar(model_cls, table_alias="m")
        json_cols = get_json_columns(staged_model)

        now = datetime.now(UTC)

        insert_cols: list[str] = []
        select_exprs: list[SqlRenderable] = []

        def _cast_postgres_data_field_if_needed(field_name: str, expr: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
            db_column = get_db_column_name(staged_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            source_hints = cte_ref.column_type_hints
            annotation_types = _resolved_field_annotation_types(
                staged_model,
                field_name,
            )
            is_decimal_field = any(
                annotation is Decimal or (isinstance(annotation, type) and issubclass(annotation, Decimal))
                for annotation in annotation_types
            )
            numeric_source_columns = (
                source_hints.numeric_columns | source_hints.integer_columns | source_hints.bigint_columns | source_hints.double_columns
            )
            if is_decimal_field and db_column not in numeric_source_columns:
                from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_json import (
                    SqlJsonDecimalNumeric,
                )

                expr = SqlJsonDecimalNumeric(expr)
            if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is not DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
                return expr
            if field_name in postgres_h14_fields:
                if db_column in source_hints.postgres_bit_columns:
                    return expr
                from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.matching_h14 import SqlH14BytesToBit

                return SqlH14BytesToBit(SqlCast(expr, _BYTEA_CAST_TARGET))
            cast_type = postgres_cast_types_by_field.get(field_name)
            if cast_type is None:
                return expr
            return SqlCast(expr, SqlCastTargetType(base_type=cast_type))

        for field_name in all_fields:
            db_col = get_db_column_name(staged_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            insert_cols.append(db_col)

            if field_name == "branch_id":
                select_exprs.append(branch_expr)
            elif field_name == "staged_commit_id":
                staged_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlParam(sc.staged_commit_id_raw)
                if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
                    staged_expr = SqlCast(staged_expr, _UUID_CAST_TARGET)
                select_exprs.append(staged_expr)
            elif field_name == "deleted":
                select_exprs.append(SqlParam(False))
            elif field_name == "created_at":
                source_column = _source_column_for_field(field_name)
                if source_column is not None:
                    source_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(source_column))
                    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
                        source_expr = SqlCast(source_expr, _TIMESTAMPTZ_CAST_TARGET)
                    select_exprs.append(SqlCoalesceExpr(source_expr, SqlParam(now)))
                else:
                    select_exprs.append(SqlParam(now))
            elif field_name == "updated_at":
                select_exprs.append(SqlParam(now))
            elif field_name in self._updates:
                value = self._updates[field_name]
                if isinstance(value, Expression):
                    select_exprs.append(_cast_postgres_data_field_if_needed(field_name, expr_converter.convert(value)))
                elif isinstance(value, TypedField):
                    source_db_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(value.name))
                    select_exprs.append(
                        _cast_postgres_data_field_if_needed(
                            field_name,
                            SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(source_db_col)),
                        ),
                    )
                else:

        projected: list[object] = []
        for raw_row in rows:

            for field_name, db_column in zip(data_field_names, data_db_columns, strict=True):

        return projected

        normalized_change_detection = tuple(

        branch = _staging_branch_source_for_lowering(sc, ctx)

        _register_lowered_commit_dependency_ref(
            ctx,

        )
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        steps.extend(
            _build_sql_native_raw_staged_insert_steps(

                sc=sc,
                branch=branch,
                columns=self._config.columns,

                db_column_source=self._config.db_column_source,
                raw_row_facts=self._raw_row_facts,

                publish_literal_relation=not self._config.emit_side_effects,
                change_detection_columns=normalized_change_detection,
            ),
        )
        has_auto_queued_vector_indexes = _model_has_auto_queued_vector_indexes(self.model_cls)
        if self._config.emit_side_effects:
            steps.extend(

                    ctx,

                        write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw"),
                        previous_rows_ref=previous_rows_ref,
                        materialized_write_ref=has_auto_queued_vector_indexes,

                                db_column_source=self._config.db_column_source,
                            )
                            if has_auto_queued_vector_indexes

class _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep(NonPublishingStep[bool]):
    """Combine staged-delete count and tip tombstone result into a bool."""

    def __init__(
        self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        staged_delete_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        tombstone_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        check_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._staged_delete_ref = staged_delete_ref
        self._tombstone_ref = tombstone_ref
        self._check_ref = check_ref
        self._after_refs = after_refs
        self._staged_delete_count = 0
        self._tombstoned = False

    @property
    def level(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def emits_sql_for_accounting(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> bool | None:
        return False

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def completes_deferred_batch_result(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"compute", "runtime_projection"})

    def tables_read(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = {self._staged_delete_ref, self._tombstone_ref}
        if self._check_ref is not None:
            deps.add(self._check_ref)
        return _deps_with_after_refs({str(dep) for dep in deps}, self._after_refs)

    def compile(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[bool]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> bool:
        values = (
            resolved.get(str(self._staged_delete_ref)),
            resolved.get(str(self._tombstone_ref)),
        )
        if self._check_ref is None:
            return self._combine_delete_results(values)
        return self._combine_delete_results_with_check((*values, resolved.get(str(self._check_ref))))

    def _combine_delete_results(self, values: tuple[object, ...]) -> bool:
        staged_result, tombstone_result = values
        staged_delete_count = (
            int(staged_result) if isinstance(staged_result, int) else len(staged_result) if isinstance(staged_result, Sequence) else 0
        )
        tombstoned = bool(tombstone_result) if isinstance(tombstone_result, bool) else False
        return staged_delete_count > 0 or tombstoned

    def _combine_delete_results_with_check(self, values: tuple[object, ...]) -> bool:
        # When the existence check resolved to ``None`` the target row does
        # not exist and no staged delete or tip tombstone can meaningfully
        # have taken effect. The tombstone's raw post_op always reports
        # ``True`` once the INSERT grammar runs, so we must suppress that
        # signal when the selected row was absent. This matches the
        # ``delete_by_id`` contract of returning ``False`` for missing rows.
        staged_result, tombstone_result, check_result = values
        if not check_result:
            return False
        staged_delete_count = (
            int(staged_result) if isinstance(staged_result, int) else len(staged_result) if isinstance(staged_result, Sequence) else 0
        )
        tombstoned = bool(tombstone_result) if isinstance(tombstone_result, bool) else False
        return staged_delete_count > 0 or tombstoned

        branch_col = get_db_column_name(self._staged_model, DynamicFieldName("branch_id"))
        staged_commit_col = get_db_column_name(self._staged_model, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id"))

            staged_commit_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_expr,
                ),
            ]
            if self._staged_visibility is StagedVisibility.CONNECTION:
                staged_commit_conditions.append(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("connection_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(self._connection_id_raw),

                )
            staged_commit_predicate = SqlIn(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(staged_commit_col)),
                SqlSelect(

                    from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableIdent(self._staged_commit_table_name)),
                    where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*staged_commit_conditions)),

            )
            if self._staged_visibility is StagedVisibility.TRANSACTION:
                staged_commit_predicate = sql_or(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(staged_commit_col)),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,

            SqlSelect(

                        SqlBinaryOp(

                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_col)),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            branch_expr,
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(staged_commit_col)),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlParam(self._staged_commit_id_raw.unwrap_to_sql()),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        staged_commit_value = SqlCase(
            whens=(
                (
                    current_staged_exists,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(staged_commit_col)),

            ),
            else_=SqlParam(self._staged_commit_id_raw.unwrap_to_sql()),
        )

        stmt = compile_mutation_spec(
            UpdateSpec(
                target=physical_source(self._staged_model, self._staged_table_name, QuerySourceRole.STAGED),
                model_cls=self._staged_model,
                assignments=(
                    MutationAssignment(deleted_col, SqlBooleanLiteral(True)),
                    MutationAssignment(staged_commit_col, staged_commit_value),

                predicates=(),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(unwrap_literal_sql_value(self._sys_id)),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_col)),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        branch_expr,
                    ),
                    staged_commit_predicate,
                ),
                returning=((SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(1), SqlAliasName("count")),) if supports_returning else ()),
            ),
            compilation_context=ctx,
        )

            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.delete_many import _delete_count_relation

            stmt = _delete_count_relation(stmt, cte_name=SqlCteName(f"{self.ref_id}_marked_rows"))

        auxiliary_ctes = collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.dependencies()) or []
        branch_expr_cte_name = getattr(branch_expr, "_cte_name", None)
        if isinstance(branch_expr_cte_name, str):
            branch_expr_cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(branch_expr_cte_name)
            if branch_expr_cte_ref is not None and branch_expr_cte_ref.auxiliary_query is not None:
                if not any(name == branch_expr_cte_ref.ref_id for name, _query in auxiliary_ctes):
                    auxiliary_ctes.append((branch_expr_cte_ref.ref_id, branch_expr_cte_ref.auxiliary_query))

        from l2070_batching.output_shape import CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, synthetic_output_field

        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in contract.columns))
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_5006,
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
            needs_returning=False,
