def _build_sql_native_raw_staged_insert_steps(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    sc: VersionedStagingCtx,
    branch: VersionedBranchSource,
    columns: Sequence[str],
    rows: object,
    db_column_source: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
    raw_row_facts: RawRowFacts | None = None,
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    isolate_from_sql_batch: bool = False,
    publish_literal_relation: bool = False,
    change_detection_columns: tuple[str, ...] = (),
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Build staged-table writes from raw rows without prepared staging payloads."""
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import StaticValueAfterDepsStep

    field_names = normalize_versioned_raw_field_names(model_cls, columns, db_column_source)
    if "sys_id" not in field_names:
        msg = "Versioned raw staged inserts require a sys_id column"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_ensure_staged_commit")

    raw_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}.raw")
    if isinstance(rows, DeferredRawRowSource):
        projected_count = rows.row_count or 0
    else:
        projected_count = len(_require_raw_row_sequence(rows))
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
        EnsureStagedCommitStep(
            ensure_ref,
            sc.domain,
            branch,
            config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(sc),
        ),
        _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep(
            raw_ref,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            staging_ctx=sc,
            branch=branch,
            field_names=field_names,
            rows=rows,
            raw_row_facts=raw_row_facts,
            isolate_from_sql_batch=isolate_from_sql_batch,
            change_detection_columns=change_detection_columns,
            after_refs=frozenset({ensure_ref, *after_refs}),
            sqlite_returns_rows=False,
        ),
    ]
    if change_detection_columns:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_lazy_support import ResolvedLenStep

        steps.append(
            ResolvedLenStep(
                ref_id,
                source_ref=str(raw_ref),
                after_refs=frozenset({raw_ref}),
            ),
        )
    else:
        steps.append(
            StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                ref_id,
                projected_count,
                [str(raw_ref)],
                publish_literal_relation=publish_literal_relation,
            ),
        )
    return steps


def _require_raw_row_sequence(rows: object) -> Sequence[Sequence[object]]:
    if not isinstance(rows, Sequence):
        msg = "Versioned raw staged inserts require a reusable sequence of raw rows"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return cast("Sequence[Sequence[object]]", rows)


def _raw_staged_key_part(value: object) -> str:
    unwrap_to_uuid = getattr(value, "unwrap_to_uuid", None)
    if callable(unwrap_to_uuid):
        return str(unwrap_to_uuid())
    unwrap_to_str = getattr(value, "unwrap_to_str", None)
    if callable(unwrap_to_str):
        return str(unwrap_to_str())
    return str(value)


def _coalesce_literal_raw_rows_by_sys_id(
    field_names: Sequence[str],
    rows: Sequence[Sequence[object]],
    *,
    raw_row_facts: RawRowFacts | None = None,
) -> Sequence[Sequence[object]]:
    try:
        sys_id_index = tuple(field_names).index("sys_id")
    except ValueError:
        return rows

    facts_prove_literal_ids = (
        raw_row_facts is not None and not raw_row_facts.has_symbolic_cells and not raw_row_facts.has_runtime_bind_slots
    )
    coalesced: dict[str, Sequence[object]] = {}
    for row in rows:
        if facts_prove_literal_ids:
            key_value = row[sys_id_index]
        else:
            sys_id_fact = raw_cell_fact(row[sys_id_index])
            if sys_id_fact.symbolic_key is not None or sys_id_fact.has_deferred_bind_slot:
                return rows
            key_value = sys_id_fact.param_value
        coalesced[_raw_staged_key_part(key_value)] = row
    if len(coalesced) == len(rows):
        return rows
    return tuple(coalesced.values())


def _model_source_rows_for_side_effects(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    *,
    columns: Sequence[str],
    rows: object,
    db_column_source: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
) -> tuple[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId], ...]:
    field_names = normalize_versioned_raw_field_names(model_cls, columns, db_column_source)
    return tuple(
        cast("Any", model_cls).model_construct(
            **{field_name: value for field_name, value in zip(field_names, row, strict=True)},
        )
        for row in _require_raw_row_sequence(rows)
    )


def _build_raw_row_facts(rows: object) -> RawRowFacts | None:
    if isinstance(rows, DeferredRawRowSource):
        return None
    if not isinstance(rows, Sequence) or isinstance(rows, str | bytes):
        return None

    return build_raw_row_facts(cast("Sequence[Sequence[object]]", rows))


def _raw_row_dependencies(rows: object, raw_row_facts: RawRowFacts | None = None) -> frozenset[str]:
    if isinstance(rows, DeferredRawRowSource):
        return frozenset({str(rows.source_ref)})
    facts = raw_row_facts or _build_raw_row_facts(rows)
    return frozenset() if facts is None else facts.dependency_refs


def _raw_source_rows_for_side_effects(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    *,
    columns: Sequence[str],
    rows: object,
    db_column_source: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
) -> tuple[tuple[object, ...], ...]:
    field_names = normalize_versioned_raw_field_names(model_cls, columns, db_column_source)
    raw_rows = _require_raw_row_sequence(rows)
    coalesced_rows = _coalesce_literal_raw_rows_by_sys_id(field_names, raw_rows)
    return tuple(tuple(row) for row in coalesced_rows)


def _unknown_staged_sys_id_write_fact(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    staged_table_name: str,
) -> frozenset[WriteKeyFact]:
    return frozenset(
        {
            WriteKeyFact(
                producer_ref=ref_id,
                table=staged_table_name,
                columns=("sys_id",),
                key_values=frozenset(),
                has_unknown_key_values=True,
            ),
        },
    )


class _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[int]):
    """Stage raw versioned rows by projecting caller-provided raw rows in SQL."""

    def __init__(
        self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
        branch: VersionedBranchSource,
        field_names: VersionedRawStagedFieldNames,
        rows: object,
        raw_row_facts: RawRowFacts | None = None,
        isolate_from_sql_batch: bool = False,
        change_detection_columns: tuple[str, ...] = (),
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
        sqlite_returns_rows: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._staging_ctx = staging_ctx
        self._branch = branch
        self._field_names = tuple(field_names)
        self._rows = rows
        self._raw_row_facts = raw_row_facts or _build_raw_row_facts(rows)
        self._isolate_from_sql_batch = isolate_from_sql_batch
        self._change_detection_columns = change_detection_columns
        self._after_refs = after_refs
        self._sqlite_returns_rows = sqlite_returns_rows

    @property
    def level(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def execution_role(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def _requires_statement_batch_isolation(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> bool:
        if isinstance(self._rows, DeferredRawRowSource):
            return False
        rows = _require_raw_row_sequence(self._rows)
        return self._isolate_from_sql_batch or len(rows) * len(self._field_names) > 900

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> bool:
        return not self._requires_statement_batch_isolation()

    def requires_runtime_sequential_batch(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> bool:
        return self._requires_statement_batch_isolation()

    def step_tags(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "insert", "versioned", "raw", "staged", "sql_projection"})

    def tables_read(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def write_key_facts(
        self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep,
        planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None,
    ) -> frozenset[WriteKeyFact]:
        del planning_catalog
        if "sys_id" not in self._field_names:
            return _unknown_staged_sys_id_write_fact(
                self.ref_id,
                self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name,
            )
        sys_id_index = self._field_names.index("sys_id")
        if self._raw_row_facts is None:
            return _unknown_staged_sys_id_write_fact(
                self.ref_id,
                self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name,
            )
        if len(self._raw_row_facts.columns) <= sys_id_index or self._raw_row_facts.columns[sys_id_index].has_symbolic_cells:
            return _unknown_staged_sys_id_write_fact(
                self.ref_id,
                self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name,
            )
        rows = _require_raw_row_sequence(self._rows)
        key_values: set[KeyTupleValue] = set()
        for row in rows:
            if len(row) <= sys_id_index:
                return _unknown_staged_sys_id_write_fact(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name,
                )
            sys_id = unwrap_literal_sql_value(row[sys_id_index])
            if not isinstance(sys_id, Hashable):
                return _unknown_staged_sys_id_write_fact(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name,
                )
            key_values.add(KeyTupleValue((LiteralKeyValue(sys_id),)))
        return frozenset(
            {
                WriteKeyFact(
                    producer_ref=self.ref_id,
                    table=self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name,
                    columns=("sys_id",),
                    key_values=frozenset(key_values),
                ),
            },
        )

    def cte_ordered_after_write_tables(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def provided_staged_sources(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def refreshes_staged_sources(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = _staged_sql_relation_columns(
            self._staging_ctx.staged_model,
            extra_columns=(
                "branch_id",
                *self._staging_ctx.common_columns,
                "sys_staged_commit_id",
                "sys_deleted",
                _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN,
            ),
        )

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...] | None) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            assert columns is not None
            hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._staging_ctx.staged_model, columns)
            if hints is None:
                msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._staging_ctx.staged_model.__name__}"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                columns,
                hints,
                framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
            ).filtered(set(columns))

        column_type_hints = (
            combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                columns,
                _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(
                    tuple(column for column in columns if column != _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN),
                ),
                SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN})),
            )
            .filtered(set(columns))
            .require_complete(columns)
        )
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        _contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            contract_columns,
            column_type_hints,
        )
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_contract=_versioned_model_projection_contract(self._staging_ctx.staged_model, contract_columns),
            relation_role=VERSIONED_STAGED_WRITE_PAYLOAD_ROLE,
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def semantic_publication_columns(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return _staged_sql_relation_columns(
            self._staging_ctx.staged_model,
            extra_columns=(
                "branch_id",
                *self._staging_ctx.common_columns,
                "sys_staged_commit_id",
                "sys_deleted",
                _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN,
            ),
        )

    def semantic_publication_type_hints(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        columns = self.semantic_publication_columns()
        model_columns = tuple(column for column in columns if column != _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN)
        hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._staging_ctx.staged_model, model_columns)
        if hints is None:
            msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._staging_ctx.staged_model.__name__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
            columns,
            hints,
            framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
            SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN})),
        ).require_complete(columns)

    def dependencies(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return (
            versioned_branch_dependencies(self._staging_ctx.lazy_branch)
            | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs)
            | _raw_row_dependencies(
                self._rows,
                self._raw_row_facts,
            )
        )

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return versioned_branch_dependencies(self._staging_ctx.lazy_branch) | _raw_row_dependencies(
            self._rows,
            self._raw_row_facts,
        )

    def executor_visible_published_rows(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep) -> None:
        return None

    def compile(self: _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[int]:
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlTableName
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import SqlQualifiedColumnExpr
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast, SqlFuncCall
        from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import versioned_data_field_plans

        sc = self._staging_ctx
        raw_field_set = set(self._field_names)
        staged_model = sc.staged_model

        branch_expr: SqlRenderable
        if sc.literal_branch is not None:
            branch_expr = SqlParam(sc.literal_branch)
        else:
            branch_expr = lower_versioned_branch_source(
                self._branch,
                ctx,
                site="_VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep.branch",
            )
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
            branch_expr = SqlCast(branch_expr, _UUID_CAST_TARGET)

        from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import postgres_storage_cast_type_for_writable_field

        cast_field_plans = versioned_data_field_plans(
            self._model_cls,
            excluded_fields=(
                "revision_id",
                "staged_commit_id",
                "deleted",
                *_GRAPH_HASH32_FIELD_NAMES,
            ),
            include_polymorphic=is_polymorphic_class(self._model_cls),
        )
        available_staged_columns = set(sc.common_columns)
        data_field_plans = [
            plan
            for plan in cast_field_plans
            if plan.field_name != "sys_id"
            and (
                plan.field_name in {"created_at", "updated_at"}
                or plan.field_name in available_staged_columns
                or plan.db_column in available_staged_columns
            )
        ]
        data_fields = [plan.field_name for plan in data_field_plans]
        for large_config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls):
            pointer_field = large_column_pointer_name(ContentColumnName(large_config.column))
            if pointer_field in raw_field_set and pointer_field in available_staged_columns and pointer_field not in data_fields:
                data_fields.append(pointer_field)
        postgres_cast_types_by_field = {plan.field_name: postgres_storage_cast_type_for_writable_field(plan) for plan in cast_field_plans}
        all_fields = ["branch_id", "sys_id", "staged_commit_id", "deleted", *data_fields]
        json_cols = get_json_columns(self._model_cls)

        insert_cols: list[str] = []
        select_exprs: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        deferred_source_binding: CteReference | None = None
        deferred_source_columns: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
        if isinstance(self._rows, DeferredRawRowSource):
            source_binding = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._rows.source_ref)) if ctx.cte_refs is not None else None
            if not isinstance(source_binding, CteReference):
                raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                    site_name=type(self).__name__,
                    trigger=f"raw versioned insert for {self._rows.source_ref!r} without a published CTE",
                    blocked_path="materializing deferred raw seed rows in Python",
                    result_contract="deferred raw rows must be a SQL-visible relation",
                    implementation_requirements=(
                        "Publish missing seed rows as an upstream CTE.",
                        "Pass DeferredRawRowSource(source_ref=...) into VersionedRawInsertManyIntent.",
                        "Do not convert deferred row sources to Python lists before lowering.",
                    ),
                )
            deferred_source_binding = source_binding
            deferred_source_columns = frozenset(source_binding.columns or ())

        def _cast_postgres_data_field_if_needed(field_name: str, expr: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
            if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is not DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
                return expr
            cast_type = postgres_cast_types_by_field.get(field_name)
            if cast_type == "UUID":
                return SqlCast(expr, _UUID_CAST_TARGET)
            if cast_type == "TIMESTAMPTZ":
                return SqlCast(expr, _TIMESTAMPTZ_CAST_TARGET)
            if cast_type == "DOUBLE PRECISION":
                return SqlCast(expr, _DOUBLE_CAST_TARGET)
            return expr

        for field_name in all_fields:
            insert_cols.append(get_db_column_name(staged_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
            if field_name == "branch_id":
                select_exprs.append(branch_expr)
                continue
            if field_name == "staged_commit_id":
                staged_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlParam(sc.staged_commit_id_raw)
                if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
                    staged_expr = SqlCast(staged_expr, _UUID_CAST_TARGET)
                select_exprs.append(staged_expr)
                continue
            if field_name == "deleted":
                select_exprs.append(SqlParam(False))
                continue
            source_db_column = get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            if field_name in raw_field_set or (isinstance(self._rows, DeferredRawRowSource) and source_db_column in raw_field_set):
                source_column = field_name
                if isinstance(self._rows, DeferredRawRowSource) and source_db_column in deferred_source_columns:
                    source_column = source_db_column
                source_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(source_column))
                if field_name in json_cols and _should_cast_json_to_jsonb(ctx):
                    source_expr = SqlCast(source_expr, _JSONB_CAST_TARGET)
                source_expr = _cast_postgres_data_field_if_needed(field_name, source_expr)
                select_exprs.append(source_expr)
                continue
            if field_name in {"created_at", "updated_at"}:
                select_exprs.append(SqlFuncCall("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP", []))
                continue
            field_info = self._model_cls.model_fields.get(field_name)
            default_value = None if field_info is None or field_info.default is PydanticUndefined else field_info.default
            serialized_default = serialize_json_fields(
                self._model_cls,
                {field_name: default_value},
                backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
            )[field_name]
            default_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlParam(serialized_default)
            if field_name in json_cols and _should_cast_json_to_jsonb(ctx):
                default_expr = SqlCast(default_expr, _JSONB_CAST_TARGET)
            select_exprs.append(_cast_postgres_data_field_if_needed(field_name, default_expr))

        raw_rows_count: int
        source_cte_name = f"{self.ref_id}_raw_source"
        source_query: SqlRenderable | None
        raw_row_chunks: list[list[tuple[object, ...]]] | None = None
        postgres_source_column_types = (
            postgres_raw_bulk_column_types(
                self._model_cls,
                self._field_names,
            )
            if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS
            else None
        )
        mariadb_source_column_types: tuple[str | None, ...] | None = None
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.DRIVER_NATIVE:
            model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, self._field_names)
            if model_hints is not None:
                mariadb_source_column_types = tuple("BINARY" if name in model_hints.bytea_columns else None for name in self._field_names)
        sqlite_packed_source_hints: SqlColumnTypeHints | None = None
        if (
            ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.STRING_UUIDS
            and self._raw_row_facts is not None
            and not self._raw_row_facts.has_symbolic_cells
        ):
            model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, self._field_names)
            if model_hints is not None:
                sqlite_packed_source_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    self._field_names,
                    model_hints,
                    framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
                ).require_complete(self._field_names)

        def _build_raw_source_query(rows: Sequence[Sequence[object]]) -> SqlRenderable:
            json_indices = tuple((index, field_name) for index, field_name in enumerate(self._field_names) if field_name in json_cols)
            if json_indices:
                normalized_rows: list[tuple[object, ...]] = []
                for row in rows:
                    values = list(row)
                    literal_json_values: dict[str, object] = {}
                    for index, field_name in json_indices:
                        values[index] = unwrap_json_value(values[index])
                        fact = raw_cell_fact(values[index])
                        if fact.symbolic_key is not None:
                            continue
                        if isinstance(fact.param_value, SerializedJsonText):
                            values[index] = fact.param_value
                            continue
                        literal_json_values[field_name] = fact.param_value
                    if literal_json_values:
                        serialized = serialize_json_fields(
                            self._model_cls,
                            literal_json_values,
                            backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
                        )
                        for index, field_name in json_indices:
                            if field_name in serialized:
                                values[index] = serialized[field_name]
                    normalized_rows.append(tuple(values))
                rows = normalized_rows
            if sqlite_packed_source_hints is not None:
                return SqlitePackedRowsQuery(
                    columns=self._field_names,
                    rows=rows,
                    type_hints=sqlite_packed_source_hints,
                )
            if postgres_source_column_types is not None:
                return build_postgres_projected_row_select(
                    rows=rows,
                    db_columns=self._field_names,
                    column_types=postgres_source_column_types,
                    ctx=ctx,
                    row_facts=self._raw_row_facts,
                )
            source_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, self._field_names)
            return build_projected_row_select(
                rows=rows,
                db_columns=self._field_names,
                ctx=ctx,
                row_facts=self._raw_row_facts,
                column_types=mariadb_source_column_types,
                json_columns=source_hints.jsonb_columns if source_hints is not None else frozenset(),
            )

        deferred_source_auxiliary: tuple[str, SqlRenderable] | None = None
        if isinstance(self._rows, DeferredRawRowSource):
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._auxiliary_ctes import resolve_auxiliary_cte_binding

            source_binding = resolve_auxiliary_cte_binding(ctx, self._rows.source_ref)
            if not isinstance(source_binding, CteReference):
                raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                    site_name=type(self).__name__,
                    trigger=f"raw versioned insert for {self._rows.source_ref!r} without a published CTE",
                    blocked_path="materializing deferred raw seed rows in Python",
                    result_contract="deferred raw rows must be a SQL-visible relation",
                    implementation_requirements=(
                        "Publish missing seed rows as an upstream CTE.",
                        "Pass DeferredRawRowSource(source_ref=...) into VersionedRawInsertManyIntent.",
                        "Do not convert deferred row sources to Python lists before lowering.",
                    ),
                )
            source_cte_name = str(source_binding.ref_id)
            source_query = None
            if source_binding.auxiliary_query is not None:
                deferred_source_auxiliary = (
                    source_cte_name,
                    source_binding.auxiliary_query,
                )
            raw_rows_count = self._rows.row_count if self._rows.row_count is not None else 0
        else:
            raw_rows = _require_raw_row_sequence(self._rows)
            raw_rows = _coalesce_literal_raw_rows_by_sys_id(
                self._field_names,
                raw_rows,
                raw_row_facts=self._raw_row_facts,
            )
            normalized_raw_rows: tuple[tuple[Any, ...], ...] = tuple(tuple(row) for row in raw_rows)
            raw_rows = normalized_raw_rows
            raw_row_chunks = (
                [list(normalized_raw_rows)]
                if sqlite_packed_source_hints is not None
                else chunk_rows_for_raw_write_statement(
                    ctx.backend_type,
                    len(self._field_names),
                    normalized_raw_rows,
                    bulk_transport=ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_bulk_transport,
                    fixed_param_headroom=32,
                )
            )
            source_query = _build_raw_source_query(raw_rows) if len(raw_row_chunks) <= 1 else None
            raw_rows_count = len(raw_rows)

        supports_returning = ctx.sql_render_dialect().supports_insert_returning() and (
            ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is not DmlParameterTransport.STRING_UUIDS
            or self._sqlite_returns_rows
            or not ctx.sql_render_dialect().supports_returning()
        )
        publication_contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        assert publication_contract is not None

        contract_returning_columns = tuple(contract_column_refs(publication_contract))
        del contract_returning_columns

        returning_columns = self.semantic_publication_columns()
        if returning_columns is None:
            msg = "versioned upsert requires executor-visible returning columns"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        def _returning_projection(column: str) -> SqlRenderable:
            if column == _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN:
                return SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlBooleanLiteral(False),
                    SqlAliasName(_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN),
                )
            return SqlSelectAlias(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)),
                alias=SqlAliasName(column),
            )

        change_detection_auxiliary: tuple[str, SqlRenderable] | None = None
        unchanged_row_gate: SqlRenderable | None = None
        if self._change_detection_columns:
            merged_cte_name = _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(self.ref_id, "current_rows")
            change_detection_auxiliary = (
                merged_cte_name,
                _build_versioned_batch_merged_cte(
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    staging_ctx=sc,
                    ctx=ctx,
                    include_deleted=False,
                ),
            )
            existing_alias = SqlAliasName("existing")
            unchanged_predicates: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))), existing_alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind("sys_id")),
                ),
            ]
            for field_name in self._change_detection_columns:
                db_column = SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
                existing_value = SqlColumnRef(db_column, existing_alias)
                incoming_value = SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(field_name))
                unchanged_predicates.append(
                    sql_or(
                        SqlBinaryOp(existing_value, BinaryOp.EQ, incoming_value),
                        sql_and(SqlIsNull(existing_value), SqlIsNull(incoming_value)),
                    ),
                )
            unchanged_row_gate = SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList([SqlLiteral(1)]),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(
                        SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(merged_cte_name)),
                        existing_alias,
                    ),
                    where=sql_and(*unchanged_predicates),
                ),
                negated=True,
            )

        def _insert_from_source(source_name: str) -> SqlInsertFromSelect:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlIsNull

            branch_gate: SqlRenderable | None = None
            branch_dependencies = versioned_branch_dependencies(sc.lazy_branch)
            if sc.literal_branch is None and branch_dependencies:
                branch_gate = SqlIsNull(branch_expr, negated=True)
            conflict_columns = [
                get_db_column_name(staged_model, DynamicFieldName("branch_id")),
                get_db_column_name(staged_model, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")),
                get_db_column_name(staged_model, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id")),
            ]
            update_columns = [column for column in insert_cols if column not in set(conflict_columns)]
            returning = (
                SqlReturningClause(tuple(_returning_projection(column) for column in returning_columns)) if supports_returning else None
            )
            source_gates = tuple(gate for gate in (branch_gate, unchanged_row_gate) if gate is not None)
            source_where = sql_and(*source_gates) if source_gates else None
            return SqlInsertFromSelect(
                target_table=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
                target_columns=insert_cols,
                source_table=SqlTableName(source_name),
                select_exprs=select_exprs,
                source_alias=SqlAliasName("m"),
                where=source_where,
                returning=returning,
                conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
                update_columns=update_columns,
            )

        dependency_auxiliary_ctes = collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(
            ctx,
            versioned_branch_dependencies(sc.lazy_branch),
            _raw_row_dependencies(self._rows, self._raw_row_facts),
        )
        if raw_row_chunks is not None and len(raw_row_chunks) > 1:
            cte_prefix = source_cte_name
            statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
            for chunk_index, chunk in enumerate(raw_row_chunks):
                chunk_source_cte_name = f"{cte_prefix}_{chunk_index}"
                cte_defs = [
                    *(SqlCteDefinition(name, query, materialized=True) for name, query in (dependency_auxiliary_ctes or [])),
                    *(
                        (SqlCteDefinition(*change_detection_auxiliary, materialized=True),)
                        if change_detection_auxiliary is not None
                        else ()
                    ),
                    SqlCteDefinition(
                        chunk_source_cte_name,
                        _build_raw_source_query(chunk),
                        materialized=True,
                    ),
                ]
                statements.append(
                    SqlInsertWithCte(
                        SqlWithClause(cte_defs, recursive=True),
                        _insert_from_source(chunk_source_cte_name),
                    )
                )
            grammar: SqlRenderable = SqlStatementBatch(
                statements,
                category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.BUDGET_SPLIT,
                needs_returning_per_stmt=[supports_returning] * len(statements),
                collect_results_per_stmt=[supports_returning] * len(statements),
            )
            auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] = []
        else:
            grammar = _insert_from_source(source_cte_name)
            auxiliary_ctes = [
                *(dependency_auxiliary_ctes or []),
                *((change_detection_auxiliary,) if change_detection_auxiliary is not None else ()),
            ]
            if source_query is not None:
                auxiliary_ctes.append((source_cte_name, source_query))
            elif deferred_source_auxiliary is not None:
                auxiliary_ctes.append(deferred_source_auxiliary)
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, synthetic_output_field

        output_columns = publication_contract.columns
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in output_columns))
        sql_visible_publication_query: SqlRenderable | None = None
        if not supports_returning:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.query.stmt_dynamic import SqlDynamicSelectStmt
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlStatementLocalWith

            source_ids = SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                from_table=SqlTableName(source_cte_name),
                columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
            )
            projection = SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlBooleanLiteral(False),
                        SqlAliasName(column),
                    )
                    if column == _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN
                    else SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)),
                        SqlAliasName(column),
                    )
                    for column in output_columns
                ],
            )
            readback_query: SqlRenderable = SqlSelect(
                select=projection,
                from_=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlIn(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                        source_ids,
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            if auxiliary_ctes:
                readback_query = SqlStatementLocalWith(
                    auxiliary_ctes,
                    readback_query,
                    recursive=True,
                )
            sql_visible_publication_query = readback_query
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=supports_returning,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=publication_contract.column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op() if supports_returning else literal_post_op(raw_rows_count),
            compiled_sql_publication=compiled_sql_publication_from_query(
                ref_id=self.ref_id,
                query=sql_visible_publication_query,
                contract=publication_contract,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        )


def _build_versioned_select_many_config_from_branch_source(
    *,
    sys_ids: Sequence[SysId],
    branch_source: BranchId | ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
) -> _VersionedSelectManyConfig:
    sys_id_ref = ServerRefs.scalar_sequence(list(sys_ids))
    if isinstance(branch_source, ScalarServerRef):
        branch_ref_id = branch_source.ref_id
        if branch_ref_id is None:
            msg = "VersionedSelectManyStep requires a symbolic branch ref"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return _VersionedSelectManyConfig(
            sys_ids=sys_id_ref,
            branch_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(branch_ref_id),
        )
    return _VersionedSelectManyConfig(
        sys_ids=sys_id_ref,
        branch_id=str(branch_source),
    )

class _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """Raise when a prior lookup resolved to ``None`` and otherwise return ``None``."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = config.source_ref
        self._dependency_ref = config.dependency_ref or config.source_ref
        self._error_message = config.error_message
        self._missing_is_false = config.missing_is_false

    @property
    def level(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"validation", "versioned"})

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep) -> bool | None:
        return False

    def tables_read(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._dependency_ref})

    def preprocess(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> None:
        del resolved

    def compile(self: _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        binding = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._source_ref))
        if not isinstance(binding, CteReference):
            cte_keys = tuple(sorted(str(key) for key in ctx.cte_refs.keys())) if ctx.cte_refs is not None else ()
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=(
                    f"compile-time missing-object validation for {self._source_ref!r} "
                    f"without a published CTE binding; dependency_ref={self._dependency_ref!r}; "
                    f"missing_is_false={self._missing_is_false!r}; available_cte_refs={cte_keys!r}"
                ),
                blocked_path="runtime projection of object rows for validation",
                result_contract="missing-object validation must count an explicit SQL-visible source relation",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the source lookup as an upstream CTE before validation.",
                    "Validate existence by counting the source CTE in SQL.",
                    "Do not materialize object rows through runtime refs for this validation.",
                ),
            )
        where_frag = None
        if self._missing_is_false and binding.scalar_value_column is not None:
            where_frag = SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(binding.scalar_value_column.to_sql_column_name()),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(True),
            )
        count_query = SqlCountQuery(SqlTableName(binding.ref_id), where_frag=where_frag)
        assertion_columns = ("ok", "error_code", "message")
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import DeclaredResultRelation

        output_shape = output_shape_for_synthetic_columns(assertion_columns)
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=expected_count_assertion_query(
                count_query,
                expected_count=1,
                error_message=self._error_message,
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=expected_count_assertion_post_op(self._error_message),
            auxiliary_ctes=([(binding.ref_id, binding.auxiliary_query)] if binding.auxiliary_query is not None else None),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                bool_columns=frozenset({"ok"}),
                text_columns=frozenset({"error_code", "message"}),
            ),
        )

def _updated_fields_touch_embedding_source_fields(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    updated_fields: frozenset[str],
) -> bool:
    vector_indexes = _configured_vector_indexes(model_cls)
    if not vector_indexes:
        return False
    if not updated_fields:
        return False
    from l5200_vector_index.embedding_content_hash import get_embedding_source_fields

    for index_name in vector_indexes:
        if updated_fields & frozenset(get_embedding_source_fields(model_cls, index_name)):
            return True
    return False

def _physical_owner_update_query(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    query_spec: QuerySpec,
) -> QuerySpec:
    from l1000_schema.typed_field import field as query_field
    from l2060_query_builder.query_contracts import QueryFilter

    owner_table = get_table_name(model_cls)
    physical_type_names = tuple(
        canonical_polymorphic_type_name(candidate)
        for candidate in get_all_concrete_subtypes(model_cls)
        if get_table_name(candidate) == owner_table
    )
    return replace(
        query_spec,
        filters=[
            *query_spec.filters,
            QueryFilter(expression=query_field("type_name").is_in(physical_type_names)),
        ],
    )


def _build_point_update_raw_steps(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    query_spec: QuerySpec,
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_query_steps import (
        _VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig,
        build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps,
    )

    if ctx.branch_id is None and ctx.lazy_branch is None and ctx.lazy_revision is None:
        staging_branch = staging_ctx.literal_branch or staging_ctx.lazy_branch
        staging_branch_ref_id = getattr(staging_branch, "ref_id", None)
        branch_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        query_branch_id = str(staging_branch) if isinstance(staging_branch, BranchId) else None
        query_branch_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(str(staging_branch_ref_id)) if staging_branch_ref_id is not None else None
        query_revision_id = None
        query_revision_ref_id = None
    else:
        (
            branch_steps,
            query_branch_id,
            query_branch_ref_id,
            query_revision_id,
            query_revision_ref_id,
        ) = _versioned_query_branch_and_revision_inputs(
            ctx=ctx,
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_resolve_branch"),
        )
    if query_revision_id is None and query_revision_ref_id is None:
        query_revision_id, query_revision_ref_id = ctx_revision_source(ctx)
    return [
        *branch_steps,
        *build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
            ref_id=ref_id,
            model_cls=model_cls,

def _shape_versioned_update_intent_inputs[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    model_cls: type[T],

    *,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
) -> tuple[ObjectServerRef[T], _VersionedUpdateIntentConfig]:
    update_values = _build_literal_update_assignment_values(model_cls, instance)
    for generated_field in ("revision_id", "staged_commit_id", "deleted"):

        replace(
            _shape_versioned_update_by_id_intent_config(
                model_cls,
                instance.sys_id,
                update_values,
                staging_ctx,
                source_value=instance,
            ),

            permission_context_type=permission_context_type,

    )

def _unwrap_runtime_str(value: object) -> str | None:
    """Return a concrete string for branded ids and simple runtime values."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    unwrap_to_str = getattr(value, "unwrap_to_str", None)
    if callable(unwrap_to_str):
        return str(unwrap_to_str())
    unwrap_to_sql = getattr(value, "unwrap_to_sql", None)
    if callable(unwrap_to_sql):
        return str(unwrap_to_sql())
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    return str(value)


def _require_literal_branch_sql_value(
    branch: VersionedBranchSource,
    *,
    site: str,
    ctx: CompilationContext | LoweringContext | None = None,
) -> object:
    """Return a concrete SQL bind value for versioned branch-scoped grammar builders."""
    if isinstance(branch, ServerRef):
        ref_id = branch.ref_id
        if ref_id is not None:
            found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(ref_id))
            if found_seed:
                return unwrap_literal_sql_value(seed_value)
            if ctx is not None and str(ref_id).startswith("seed_") and ctx.branch_id is not None:
                return unwrap_literal_sql_value(BranchId(ctx.branch_id))
        msg = (
            f"{site} requires a concrete branch_id when constructing raw SQL grammar. "
            "Publish the branch as a compile-visible value before using this path."
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return unwrap_literal_sql_value(branch)


def _coerce_runtime_model_row[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    model_cls: type[T],
    value: object,
    hydrator: object | None = None,
) -> T | None:
    """Coerce a resolved runtime value back into the expected model type."""
    if value is None or isinstance(value, CteReference):
        return None
    if isinstance(value, model_cls):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, DatabaseObjectRow):
        return cast(T, value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.row_converter import convert_row_to_model

        sql_conn = getattr(hydrator, "sql_conn", None)
        return cast(
            T,
            convert_row_to_model(
                model_cls,
                dict(value),
                conn=sql_conn,
                hydrate_large_columns=sql_conn is not None,
            ),
        )
    return None


class _PrepareVersionedUpdateByIdApplyPayloadStep[T: DatabaseObjectRow](SqlRelationPublisherStep[object | None]):
    """Materialize the runtime payload for non-CTE update-by-id apply."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[T],
        config: _PrepareVersionedUpdateByIdApplyPayloadConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._updates = dict(config.updates.values)
        self._source_ref = config.source_ref
        self._staging_ctx = config.staging_ctx
        self._apply_update_rules = config.apply_update_rules
        self._branch_source = config.staging_ctx.literal_branch or config.staging_ctx.lazy_branch

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.dependencies()

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"project", "versioned", "update"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _PrepareVersionedUpdateByIdApplyPayloadStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = _versioned_application_raw_columns(self._model_cls)
        column_type_hints = _versioned_application_raw_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, columns)
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        normalized_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)

        return projection_over_model_contract(
            columns=normalized_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            source_model_cls=self._model_cls,
            projection_lineage=tuple((column, column) for column in normalized_columns),
            relation_role=VERSIONED_STAGED_WRITE_PAYLOAD_ROLE,
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def semantic_publication_columns(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return _versioned_application_raw_columns(self._model_cls)

    def semantic_publication_type_hints(self) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        return _versioned_application_raw_column_type_hints(
            self._model_cls,
            self.semantic_publication_columns(),
        )

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps: set[str] = {str(self._source_ref)}
        if isinstance(self._branch_source, ServerRef):
            deps.update(self._branch_source.dependencies())
        for value in self._updates.values():
            if isinstance(value, SqlRuntimeBindSlot):
                deps.add(str(value.ref_id))
            elif isinstance(value, ServerRef):
                deps.update(value.dependencies())
        return frozenset(deps)

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[object | None]:
        cte_ref = _require_versioned_update_payload_contract(
            ctx,
            source_ref=self._source_ref,
            apply_update_rules=self._apply_update_rules,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import (
            CompiledOutputField,
            CompiledOutputShape,
            DeclaredResultRelation,
            synthetic_output_field,
        )
        from l2070_batching.post_op import row_dicts_post_op

        converter = ExpressionToGrammar(self._model_cls, table_alias="src")
        updates = serialize_json_fields(
            self._model_cls,
            {key: value for key, value in self._updates.items() if not isinstance(value, SqlRuntimeBindSlot | ServerRef)},
            backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
        )
        updates.update({key: value for key, value in self._updates.items() if isinstance(value, SqlRuntimeBindSlot | ServerRef)})
        updates = filter_generated_updates(self._model_cls, updates)
        json_columns = get_json_columns(self._model_cls)
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_json import SqlJsonLiteral

        overrides: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for field_name, value in updates.items():
            db_column = get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            if isinstance(value, SqlRuntimeBindSlot | ScalarServerRef):
                from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import lower_scalar_server_ref

                scalar = ServerRefs.scalar(value) if isinstance(value, SqlRuntimeBindSlot) else value
                expression = lower_scalar_server_ref(scalar, ctx)
                if field_name in json_columns and _should_cast_json_to_jsonb(ctx):
                    expression = SqlCast(expression, _JSONB_CAST_TARGET)
                overrides[db_column] = expression
            elif isinstance(value, Expression):
                overrides[db_column] = converter.convert(value)
            elif isinstance(value, TypedField):
                overrides[db_column] = SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(value.name))),
                    "src",
                )
            else:
                if hasattr(value, "unwrap_to_str"):
                    value = value.unwrap_to_str()
                overrides[db_column] = SqlJsonLiteral(value) if field_name in json_columns else SqlParam(value)

        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        available_source_columns = tuple(cte_ref.columns or contract.columns)
        available_source_column_set = set(available_source_columns)
        tombstone_column = (
            "sys_deleted"
            if "sys_deleted" in available_source_column_set
            else ("deleted" if "deleted" in available_source_column_set else None)
        )
        projectable_columns = set(contract.columns)
        source_hints = cte_ref.column_type_hints
        for field_name in getattr(self._model_cls, "model_fields", {}):
            db_column = get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            if db_column in projectable_columns and db_column in available_source_column_set:
                source_expression: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(db_column),
                    "src",
                )
                annotation_types = _resolved_field_annotation_types(
                    self._model_cls,
                    field_name,
                )
                is_decimal_field = any(
                    annotation is Decimal or (isinstance(annotation, type) and issubclass(annotation, Decimal))
                    for annotation in annotation_types
                )
                numeric_source_columns = (
                    source_hints.numeric_columns
                    | source_hints.integer_columns
                    | source_hints.bigint_columns
                    | source_hints.double_columns
                )
                if is_decimal_field and db_column not in numeric_source_columns:
                    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_json import (
                        SqlJsonDecimalNumeric,
                    )

                    source_expression = SqlJsonDecimalNumeric(source_expression)
                overrides.setdefault(db_column, source_expression)
        for column in contract.columns:
            if column not in available_source_column_set:
                overrides.setdefault(column, SqlParam(None))
        source_columns = contract.columns
        read_metadata = build_read_metadata_plan(self._model_cls)
        field_by_output = {field.cte_output_column: field for field in read_metadata.field_plans}
        field_by_db = {field.db_column: field for field in read_metadata.field_plans}
        output_fields: list[CompiledOutputField] = []
        for column in source_columns:
            field_plan = field_by_output.get(column) or field_by_db.get(column)
            if field_plan is None:
                output_fields.append(synthetic_output_field(column))
                continue
            output_fields.append(
                CompiledOutputField(
                    output_name=field_plan.field_name,
                    output_column=column,
                    source_db_column=field_plan.db_column,
                    is_json=field_plan.is_json,
                    is_binary=field_plan.is_binary,
                    role=field_plan.role,
                    model_field_name=field_plan.field_name,
                    owner_cls=field_plan.owner_cls,
                    is_model_backed=True,
                ),
            )
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(output_fields))
        projection_grammar: SqlRenderable = SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides(
            source_cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(cte_ref.ref_id),
            source_columns=source_columns,
            overrides=overrides,
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
            postgres_bit_source_columns=frozenset(str(column) for column in source_hints.postgres_bit_columns),
            where_conditions=(
                (
                    SqlUnaryOp(
                        UnaryOp.NOT,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(tombstone_column), "src"),
                    ),
                )
                if tombstone_column is not None
                else ()
            ),
        )
        if cte_ref.auxiliary_query is not None:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlStatementLocalWith

            projection_grammar = SqlStatementLocalWith(
                ((cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query),),
                projection_grammar,
            )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=projection_grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
        )


def _versioned_commit_effect_owner[StepType: type[ServerPlanStep[Any]]](step_type: StepType) -> StepType:
    """Mark a semantic step as an explicit versioned commit-effect owner."""
    step_type.versioned_commit_effect_owner = True
    return step_type


@_versioned_commit_effect_owner
class VersionedInsertIntent[T](IntentStep[T]):
    """L4: Versioned insert — lowers to staging table insert.

    The lowering:
    1. Dedup instances by sys_id (pure)
    2. Build staging tuples with branch_id, staged_commit_id (pure)
    3. Replace staged rows via semantic staged replacement intent
    5. Track modification for rippling
    """

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "insert", "versioned", "intent"})

    def __init__(
        self: VersionedInsertIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        instance: ObjectServerRef[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedInsertIntentConfig],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.instance = instance
        self.config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)
        self.staging_ctx = self.config.staging_ctx

    def dependencies(self: VersionedInsertIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies = set(self.instance.dependencies())
        dependencies.update(self.config.after_refs)
        if self.config.permission_context_ref is not None:
            dependencies.add(self.config.permission_context_ref)
        return frozenset(str(ref) for ref in dependencies)

    def tables_written(self: VersionedInsertIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({get_table_name(self.staging_ctx.staged_model)})

    def commit_dependency_ref_id(self: VersionedInsertIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        return versioned_insert_write_effect_ref(self.ref_id)

    def staged_row_cardinality(self: VersionedInsertIntent) -> StagedRowCardinality:
        """Declare that one unconditional literal insert produces one staged row."""
        return StagedRowCardinality.AT_LEAST_ONE

    def lower(self: VersionedInsertIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        sc = _staging_ctx_for_lowering(self.staging_ctx, ctx)
        instance_shape: PlanningServerValueShape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            self.instance,
            site=f"{type(self).__name__}.lower",
        )
        instance_ref_id = instance_shape.symbolic_ref_id
        if instance_ref_id is None:
            instance_value = self.config.literal_instance
        else:
            found, instance_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(None, ServerPlanRefId(instance_ref_id))
            if not found:
                # Permission guards and reusable request templates may wrap a
                # concrete model in a symbolic dependency. The literal model is
                # still the lowering payload; its fields can remain SQL runtime
                # slots until executor binding.
                instance_value = self.config.literal_instance
        if not isinstance(instance_value, self.model_cls):
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} requires a seeded model instance during lowering"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        ctx._lowering_cache[f"literal_sys_id_for_step:{self.ref_id}"] = instance_value.sys_id
        symbolic_branch_insert = sc.literal_branch is None and sc.lazy_branch is not None
        staged_write_ref = versioned_insert_write_effect_ref(self.ref_id)
        _register_lowered_commit_dependency_ref(ctx, semantic_ref=self.ref_id, dependency_ref=staged_write_ref)
        permission_steps, user_id_ref_id = _versioned_permission_resolution_steps(
            self.ref_id,
            self.model_cls,
            ctx,
        )
        permission_validation_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = list(permission_steps)
        permission_after_refs = self.config.after_refs
        if user_id_ref_id is not None:
            permission_validation_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_validate_permission")
            permission_validation_steps.append(
                _ValidateVersionedUpsertManyPermissionStep(
                    permission_validation_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    after_refs=self.config.after_refs,
                    staging_ctx=sc,
                    batch_plan=_build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan(
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        instances=(
                            prepare_versioned_instance_for_staging(
                                self.model_cls,
                                instance_value,
                                sc,
                            ),
                        ),
                        staging_ctx=sc,
                        ctx=ctx,
                        conflict_columns=("sys_id",),
                        on_conflict=None,
                    ),
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    permission_context_ref=self.config.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=self.config.permission_context_type,
                    config=_VersionedPermissionValidationConfig(
                        permission_error_message=(f"Cannot insert {self.model_cls.__name__} object: write permission denied"),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            permission_after_refs |= frozenset({permission_validation_ref})
        steps, _prepared = _build_staging_steps(
            str(staged_write_ref),
            self.model_cls,
            instance_value,
            sc,
            backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
            branch_source=_staging_branch_source_for_lowering(sc, ctx),
            delete_existing=False,
            ensure_staged_commit=_should_emit_staged_commit_ensure(sc, ctx),
            explicit_return_value=instance_value,
        )
        anchored_steps = _anchor_intent_after_refs(steps, permission_after_refs)
        post_write_config = replace(
            self.config.post_write,
            source_rows=self.config.post_write.source_rows or (instance_value,),
            branch_id=sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
            staged_commit_id=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
        )
        from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs

        if get_large_column_configs(self.model_cls):
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import (
                StaticValueAfterDepsStep,
            )

            return [
                *permission_validation_steps,
                *anchored_steps,
                StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(self.ref_id),
                    instance_value,
                    [str(staged_write_ref)],
                    publish_literal_relation=True,
                ),
                *_versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self.model_cls,
                    "INSERT",
                    ctx,
                    write_ref_id=staged_write_ref,
                    config=replace(
                        post_write_config,
                        table_event_relation_replayable=(
                            ctx.backend_profile.traits.same_plan_write_transport is SamePlanWriteTransport.DATA_MODIFYING_CTE
                        ),
                        materialized_write_ref=True,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        if symbolic_branch_insert or sc.literal_branch is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import StaticValueAfterDepsStep

            readback_step = StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                self.ref_id,
                instance_value,
                [str(staged_write_ref)],
                publish_literal_relation=True,
            )
            return [
                *permission_validation_steps,
                *anchored_steps,
                readback_step,
                *_versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self.model_cls,
                    "INSERT",
                    ctx,
                    write_ref_id=staged_write_ref,
                    config=replace(
                        post_write_config,
                        table_event_relation_replayable=(
                            ctx.backend_profile.traits.same_plan_write_transport is SamePlanWriteTransport.DATA_MODIFYING_CTE
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ]

        return [
            *permission_validation_steps,
            *anchored_steps,
            ReturnSourceAfterDepsStep(
                self.ref_id,
                ReturnSourceAfterDepsConfig(
                    source_ref=staged_write_ref,
                    after_refs=(staged_write_ref,),
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    source_ref_is_alias_of_after_ref=True,
                ),
            ),
            *_versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                "INSERT",
                ctx,
                write_ref_id=staged_write_ref,
                config=replace(
                    post_write_config,
                    table_event_relation_replayable=(
                        ctx.backend_profile.traits.same_plan_write_transport is SamePlanWriteTransport.DATA_MODIFYING_CTE
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ]

                model_cls=self.model_cls,

@_versioned_commit_effect_owner
class VersionedUpdateIntent[T](IntentStep[T]):
    """L4: Versioned update — checks existence then re-stages.

    Lowers to: VersionedSelectOneStep (existence check) + ``ConditionalStep``:
    - If exists: EnsureStagedCommit + InsertManyRaw (re-stage with canonical ref_id)
    - If not exists: raise ValueError via ErrorStep

    When ``source_lazy`` is provided, the instance is resolved during
    preprocess (inside the pipeline), not eagerly.
    """

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "update", "versioned", "intent"})

    def __init__(
        self: VersionedUpdateIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        source: ObjectServerRef[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedUpdateIntentConfig],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.source = source
        self.config_ref = config
        self.config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)
        self.staging_ctx = self.config.staging_ctx

    def tables_read(self: VersionedUpdateIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        sc = self.staging_ctx
        return frozenset({sc.staged_table_name, sc.tip_table_name})

    def tables_written(self: VersionedUpdateIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self.staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def commit_dependency_ref_id(self: VersionedUpdateIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        return versioned_update_write_effect_ref(self.ref_id)

    def additional_batch_binding_ref_ids(self: VersionedUpdateIntent) -> tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]:
        """Declare the physical update effect used by branch publication."""
        return (self.commit_dependency_ref_id(),)

    def lower(self: VersionedUpdateIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        """Lower to: existence check -> ConditionalStep(re-stage or raise).

        The ConditionalStep checks the condition BEFORE running child steps.
        If the object doesn't exist, on_false raises ValueError and the staging
        steps never execute.
        """

        sys_id = self.config.sys_id
        apply_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_apply")
        lookup_ref = versioned_update_published_refs(apply_ref).lookup_rows_relation
        model_name = self.model_cls.__name__
        err_msg = f"Cannot update non-existent object {model_name} with sys_id={sys_id}"
        missing_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_missing")
        delegated_steps = list(
            VersionedUpdateByIdIntent(
                ref_id=apply_ref,
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                config=replace(
                    self.config,
                    pre_write_refs=frozenset({missing_ref}),
                ),
            ).lower(ctx),
        )
        ctx.register_lowered_effect_binding(
            self.commit_dependency_ref_id(),
            versioned_update_write_effect_ref(apply_ref),
        )
        delegated_after_refs = [step.ref_id for step in delegated_steps if step.ref_id != apply_ref]
        missing_step = _RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectStep(
            missing_ref,
            config=_RaiseIfMissingVersionedObjectConfig(
                source_ref=lookup_ref,
                error_message=err_msg,
            ),
        )
        producer_position = next(
            (index for index, step in enumerate(delegated_steps) if step.ref_id == lookup_ref),
            None,
        )
        if producer_position is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} did not lower lookup producer {lookup_ref}"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        guard_position = next(index for index, step in enumerate(delegated_steps) if str(missing_ref) in step.dependencies())
        if producer_position >= guard_position:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} lowered lookup consumer before producer {lookup_ref}"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        delegated_steps.insert(guard_position, missing_step)
        source_dependencies = tuple(self.source.dependencies())
        if len(source_dependencies) == 1:
            result_source_ref = ServerPlanRefId(source_dependencies[0])
        elif not source_dependencies and self.source.ref_id is not None and self.source.ref_id.startswith("seed_"):
            result_source_ref = ServerPlanRefId(self.source.ref_id)
        else:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} requires one source relation, got {source_dependencies!r}"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return [
            *delegated_steps,
            RuntimeSourceAfterDepsStep(
                self.ref_id,
                source_ref=result_source_ref,
                after_refs=(versioned_update_write_effect_ref(apply_ref), *delegated_after_refs, missing_ref),
            ),
        ]

class VersionedUpdateDeferredIntent[T](IntentStep[T]):
    """L4: Versioned update from a symbolic object ref."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "update", "versioned", "intent"})

    def __init__(
