    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        sc = self.staging_ctx
        normalized_conflicts = (
            normalize_versioned_raw_field_names(
                self.model_cls,
                self._config.conflict_columns,
                self._config.db_column_source,
            )
            if self._config.conflict_columns is not None
            else ("sys_id",)
        )
        if tuple(normalized_conflicts) != ("sys_id",):
            if isinstance(self._config.rows, DeferredRawRowSource):
                msg = "Deferred versioned raw conflict matching requires a complete typed model relation"
                raise NotImplementedError(msg)
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_lazy_support import ResolvedLenStep

            source_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw_model_rows")
            batch_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.matched_upsert")
            matched_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
                _VersionedRawModelRowsStep(
                    source_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    columns=self._config.columns,
                    rows=self._config.rows,
                    db_column_source=self._config.db_column_source,
                ),
            ]
            matched_steps.extend(
                _lower_versioned_upsert_many_batch_intent(
                    ref_id=batch_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    instances=cast(
                        "ObjectSequenceServerRef[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]",
                        ServerRefs.from_ref_id(source_ref, variant="object_sequence"),
                    ),
                    staging_ctx=sc,
                    conflict_columns=tuple(normalized_conflicts),
                    on_conflict=None,
                    after_refs=self._config.after_refs,
                    post_write_event_type="UPSERT",
                    ctx=ctx,
                    return_rows=True,
                ),
            )
            matched_steps.append(
                ResolvedLenStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    source_ref=str(source_ref),
                    after_refs=frozenset({batch_ref}),
                ),
            )
            _register_lowered_commit_dependency_ref(
                ctx,
                semantic_ref=self.ref_id,
                dependency_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{batch_ref}_insert_batch"),
            )
            return matched_steps
        normalized_change_detection = tuple(
            normalize_versioned_raw_field_names(
                self.model_cls,
                self._config.change_detection_columns,
                self._config.db_column_source,
            ),
        )
        branch = _staging_branch_source_for_lowering(sc, ctx)
        field_names = normalize_versioned_raw_field_names(
            self.model_cls,
            self._config.columns,
            self._config.db_column_source,
        )
        previous_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        _register_lowered_commit_dependency_ref(
            ctx,
            semantic_ref=self.ref_id,
            dependency_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw"),
        )
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        steps.extend(
            _build_sql_native_raw_staged_insert_steps(
                self.ref_id,
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                sc=sc,
                branch=branch,
                columns=self._config.columns,
                rows=self._config.rows,
                db_column_source=self._config.db_column_source,
                raw_row_facts=self._raw_row_facts,
                after_refs=self._config.after_refs,
                isolate_from_sql_batch=self._config.isolate_from_sql_batch,
                publish_literal_relation=not self._config.emit_side_effects,
                change_detection_columns=normalized_change_detection,
            ),
        )
        has_auto_queued_vector_indexes = _model_has_auto_queued_vector_indexes(self.model_cls)
        if self._config.emit_side_effects:
            steps.extend(
                _versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self.model_cls,
                    "UPSERT",
                    ctx,
                    config=_VersionedPostWriteSideEffectsConfig(
                        write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw"),
                        previous_rows_ref=previous_rows_ref,
                        materialized_write_ref=has_auto_queued_vector_indexes,
                        source_rows=(
                            _model_source_rows_for_side_effects(
                                self.model_cls,
                                columns=self._config.columns,
                                rows=self._config.rows,
                                db_column_source=self._config.db_column_source,
                            )
                            if has_auto_queued_vector_indexes
                            else ()
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )
        return steps

class _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep(NonPublishingStep[bool]):
    """Combine staged-delete count and tip tombstone result into a bool."""

    def __init__(
        self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        staged_delete_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        tombstone_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        check_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._staged_delete_ref = staged_delete_ref
        self._tombstone_ref = tombstone_ref
        self._check_ref = check_ref
        self._after_refs = after_refs
        self._staged_delete_count = 0
        self._tombstoned = False

    @property
    def level(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def emits_sql_for_accounting(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> bool | None:
        return False

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def completes_deferred_batch_result(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"compute", "runtime_projection"})

    def tables_read(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = {self._staged_delete_ref, self._tombstone_ref}
        if self._check_ref is not None:
            deps.add(self._check_ref)
        return _deps_with_after_refs({str(dep) for dep in deps}, self._after_refs)

    def compile(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[bool]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self: _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> bool:
        values = (
            resolved.get(str(self._staged_delete_ref)),
            resolved.get(str(self._tombstone_ref)),
        )
        if self._check_ref is None:
            return self._combine_delete_results(values)
        return self._combine_delete_results_with_check((*values, resolved.get(str(self._check_ref))))

    def _combine_delete_results(self, values: tuple[object, ...]) -> bool:
        staged_result, tombstone_result = values
        staged_delete_count = (
            int(staged_result) if isinstance(staged_result, int) else len(staged_result) if isinstance(staged_result, Sequence) else 0
        )
        tombstoned = bool(tombstone_result) if isinstance(tombstone_result, bool) else False
        return staged_delete_count > 0 or tombstoned

    def _combine_delete_results_with_check(self, values: tuple[object, ...]) -> bool:
        # When the existence check resolved to ``None`` the target row does
        # not exist and no staged delete or tip tombstone can meaningfully
        # have taken effect. The tombstone's raw post_op always reports
        # ``True`` once the INSERT grammar runs, so we must suppress that
        # signal when the selected row was absent. This matches the
        # ``delete_by_id`` contract of returning ``False`` for missing rows.
        staged_result, tombstone_result, check_result = values
        if not check_result:
            return False
        staged_delete_count = (
            int(staged_result) if isinstance(staged_result, int) else len(staged_result) if isinstance(staged_result, Sequence) else 0
        )
        tombstoned = bool(tombstone_result) if isinstance(tombstone_result, bool) else False
        return staged_delete_count > 0 or tombstoned

class _MarkStagedRowsDeletedStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[int]):

    ) -> None:

        self._staged_table_name = staged_table_name
        self._staged_commit_table_name = staged_commit_table_name

        self._lazy_branch = lazy_branch
        self._staged_commit_id_raw = staged_commit_id_raw

    @property

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _MarkStagedRowsDeletedStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("count",)
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({"count"}))
        _contract_model_cls = _MarkStagedRowsDeletedStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def cte_relation_role(self: _MarkStagedRowsDeletedStep) -> str:
        return "count_only"

    def dependencies(self: _MarkStagedRowsDeletedStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies = getattr(self._lazy_branch, "dependencies", None)
        if callable(dependencies):
            typed_dependencies = cast(Callable[[], frozenset[str]], dependencies)
            return self._after_refs | typed_dependencies()
        return self._after_refs

    def tables_read(self: _MarkStagedRowsDeletedStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._staged_table_name)})

    def tables_written(self: _MarkStagedRowsDeletedStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._staged_table_name)})

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: _MarkStagedRowsDeletedStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def compile(self: _MarkStagedRowsDeletedStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[int]:
        branch_col = get_db_column_name(self._staged_model, DynamicFieldName("branch_id"))
        staged_commit_col = get_db_column_name(self._staged_model, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id"))
        deleted_col = get_db_column_name(self._staged_model, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))
        supports_returning = _supports_returning_clause(ctx)
        branch_expr = lower_scalar_source(self._lazy_branch, ctx, default_field=branch_col)
        staged_commit_predicate: SqlRenderable = SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(staged_commit_col)),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(self._staged_commit_id_raw.unwrap_to_sql()),
        )
        if self._staged_visibility in {StagedVisibility.CONNECTION, StagedVisibility.TRANSACTION}:
            staged_commit_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_expr,
                ),
            ]
            if self._staged_visibility is StagedVisibility.CONNECTION:
                staged_commit_conditions.append(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("connection_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(self._connection_id_raw),
                    ),
                )
            staged_commit_predicate = SqlIn(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(staged_commit_col)),
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"))]),
                    from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableIdent(self._staged_commit_table_name)),
                    where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*staged_commit_conditions)),
                ),
            )
            if self._staged_visibility is StagedVisibility.TRANSACTION:
                staged_commit_predicate = sql_or(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(staged_commit_col)),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(self._staged_commit_id_raw.unwrap_to_sql()),
                    ),
                    staged_commit_predicate,
                )

        current_staged_exists = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
                from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableIdent(self._staged_table_name)),
                where=SqlWhereClause(
                    sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlParam(unwrap_literal_sql_value(self._sys_id)),
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_col)),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            branch_expr,
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(staged_commit_col)),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlParam(self._staged_commit_id_raw.unwrap_to_sql()),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        staged_commit_value = SqlCase(
            whens=(
                (
                    current_staged_exists,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(staged_commit_col)),
                ),
            ),
            else_=SqlParam(self._staged_commit_id_raw.unwrap_to_sql()),
        )

        stmt = compile_mutation_spec(
            UpdateSpec(
                target=physical_source(self._staged_model, self._staged_table_name, QuerySourceRole.STAGED),
                model_cls=self._staged_model,
                assignments=(
                    MutationAssignment(deleted_col, SqlBooleanLiteral(True)),
                    MutationAssignment(staged_commit_col, staged_commit_value),
                ),
                predicates=(),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(unwrap_literal_sql_value(self._sys_id)),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_col)),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        branch_expr,
                    ),
                    staged_commit_predicate,
                ),
                returning=((SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(1), SqlAliasName("count")),) if supports_returning else ()),
            ),
            compilation_context=ctx,
        )
        if supports_returning and ctx.supports_data_modifying_ctes:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.delete_many import _delete_count_relation

            stmt = _delete_count_relation(stmt, cte_name=SqlCteName(f"{self.ref_id}_marked_rows"))

        auxiliary_ctes = collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.dependencies()) or []
        branch_expr_cte_name = getattr(branch_expr, "_cte_name", None)
        if isinstance(branch_expr_cte_name, str):
            branch_expr_cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(branch_expr_cte_name)
            if branch_expr_cte_ref is not None and branch_expr_cte_ref.auxiliary_query is not None:
                if not any(name == branch_expr_cte_ref.ref_id for name, _query in auxiliary_ctes):
                    auxiliary_ctes.append((branch_expr_cte_ref.ref_id, branch_expr_cte_ref.auxiliary_query))

        __opa002_grammar_5006 = stmt
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, synthetic_output_field

        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in contract.columns))
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_5006,
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
            needs_returning=False,
            closed_post_op=_delete_count_post_op(),
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes or None,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VersionedDeletePhysicalOwner:
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _VersionedDeletePhysicalOwnersConfig:
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx
    owners: tuple[VersionedDeletePhysicalOwner, ...]
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]


@_versioned_commit_effect_owner
class VersionedDeletePhysicalOwnersIntent(IntentStep[bool]):
    """Delete an identity from its declared physical tables."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "delete", "versioned", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.SCALAR

    def __init__(
        self: VersionedDeletePhysicalOwnersIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        sys_id: ScalarServerRef[SysId],
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedDeletePhysicalOwnersConfig],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.sys_id = sys_id
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        resolved_config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)
        self.staging_ctx = resolved_config.staging_ctx
        self.owners = resolved_config.owners
        self.after_refs = resolved_config.after_refs

    def dependencies(self: VersionedDeletePhysicalOwnersIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return (
            self.after_refs
            | self.sys_id.dependencies()
            | versioned_branch_dependencies(self.staging_ctx.lazy_branch)
            | _staging_revision_dependencies(self.staging_ctx)
        )

    def tables_read(self: VersionedDeletePhysicalOwnersIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(
            table
            for owner in self.owners
            for table in (
                owner.staging_ctx.tip_table_name,
                owner.staging_ctx.staged_table_name,
                str(get_versioned_table_names(owner.model_cls).sparse),
            )
        )

    def tables_written(self: VersionedDeletePhysicalOwnersIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(owner.staging_ctx.staged_table_name for owner in self.owners)

    def commit_dependency_ref_id(self: VersionedDeletePhysicalOwnersIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        """Return the canonical physical-owner tombstone effect."""
        return ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.tombstone")

    def staged_commit_ids_for_effect(self: VersionedDeletePhysicalOwnersIntent) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Return all exact staged-commit identities used by physical owners."""
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(owner.staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw for owner in self.owners))

    def staged_row_cardinality(self: VersionedDeletePhysicalOwnersIntent) -> StagedRowCardinality:
        """A physical-owner delete can match no visible row."""
        return StagedRowCardinality.MAY_BE_EMPTY

    def lower(
        self: VersionedDeletePhysicalOwnersIntent,
        ctx: LoweringContext,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        after_refs = self.after_refs
        pre_hook = _delete_hook_validator_from_ctx(ctx, self.model_cls)
        post_hook = _after_delete_hook_from_ctx(ctx, self.model_cls)
        selected_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_preimage")
        if pre_hook is not None or post_hook is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import QueryExecuteIntent, _QueryExecuteConfig
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_select_one import build_versioned_select_one_query_spec
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.row_hydration import HydrateFirstResolvedRowStep

            selected_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{selected_ref}.raw_rows")
            query_steps = QueryExecuteIntent(
                selected_rows_ref,
                self.model_cls,
                _QueryExecuteConfig(
                    query_spec=build_versioned_select_one_query_spec(self.model_cls, sys_id=self.sys_id),
                    raw_mode=True,
                    after_refs=after_refs,
                    always_publish_executor_binding=True,
                ),
            ).lower(ctx)
            steps.extend(query_steps)
            source_step = next(step for step in query_steps if step.ref_id == selected_rows_ref)
            source_contract = source_step.cte_publication_contract()
            assert source_contract is not None
            steps.append(
                HydrateFirstResolvedRowStep(
                    selected_ref,
                    source_ref=selected_rows_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    cte_output_columns=source_contract.columns,
                    cte_column_type_hints=source_contract.column_type_hints,
                )
            )
            after_refs |= frozenset({selected_ref})
        if pre_hook is not None:
            hook_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_pre_delete_hook")
            steps.append(
                ApplyDeleteHookStep(
                    hook_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    selected_ref=selected_ref,
                    pre_delete_hook=pre_hook,
                    hook_registry=getattr(ctx, "auto_api_hook_registry", None),
                )
            )
            after_refs |= frozenset({hook_ref})
        deletion_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        count_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        id_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(self.sys_id, site=type(self).__name__)
        for index, owner in enumerate(self.owners):
            owner_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_owner_{index}")
            matched_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{owner_ref}_matched_rows")
            if id_shape.has_literal_value and isinstance(id_shape.literal_value, SysId):
                config = _VersionedDeleteManyConfig(
                    sys_ids=(id_shape.literal_value,),
                    staging_ctx=owner.staging_ctx,
                    after_refs=after_refs,
                    matched_source_ref=matched_ref,
                )
            else:
                from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_lazy_support import (
                    MatchVersionedRowsByKeyToLiteralSequenceStep,
                    _MatchVersionedRowsByKeyConfig,
                )

                permission_steps, user_id_ref = _versioned_permission_resolution_steps(owner_ref, owner.model_cls, ctx)
                steps.extend(permission_steps)
                steps.append(
                    MatchVersionedRowsByKeyToLiteralSequenceStep(
                        matched_ref,
                        model_cls=owner.model_cls,
                        staging_ctx=owner.staging_ctx,
                        config=_MatchVersionedRowsByKeyConfig(
                            source_field_names=("sys_id",),
                            source_rows=(),
                            key_field_names=("sys_id",),
                            source_id_ref=self.sys_id,
                            after_refs=after_refs,
                        ),
                    )
                )
                owner_after_refs = after_refs | frozenset({matched_ref})
                config = _VersionedDeleteManyConfig(
                    sys_ids=(),
                    source_ref=matched_ref,
                    staging_ctx=owner.staging_ctx,
                    after_refs=owner_after_refs,
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref,
                )
            steps.extend(VersionedDeleteManyIntent(owner_ref, owner.model_cls, ServerRefs.scalar(config)).lower(ctx))
            deletion_refs.append(ServerPlanRefId(f"{owner_ref}.tombstone"))
            count_refs.append(owner_ref)
        assert count_refs
        ctx.register_lowered_effect_binding(self.commit_dependency_ref_id(), deletion_refs[-1])
        previous_ref = count_refs[0]
        for index, count_ref in enumerate(count_refs):
            result_ref = (
                self.ref_id if index == len(count_refs) - 1 and post_hook is None else ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_result_{index}")
            )
            steps.append(
                _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep(
                    result_ref,
                    staged_delete_ref=count_ref,
                    tombstone_ref=previous_ref,
                    after_refs=frozenset(deletion_refs),
                )
            )
            previous_ref = result_ref
        if post_hook is not None:
            hook_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_after_delete_hook")
            steps.append(
                ApplyAfterDeleteHookStep(
                    hook_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    selected_ref=selected_ref,
                    delete_ref=previous_ref,
                    after_delete_hook=post_hook,
                )
            )
            steps.append(
                _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    staged_delete_ref=previous_ref,
                    tombstone_ref=previous_ref,
                    after_refs=frozenset({hook_ref}),
                )
            )
        return steps


@_versioned_commit_effect_owner
class VersionedDeleteIntent[T](IntentStep[bool]):
    """L4: Versioned delete via ``ConditionalStep``.

    Lowering produces:
    1. EnsureStagedCommitStep (idempotent)
    2. VersionedSelectOneStep (reads staged + tip)
    3. ``ConditionalStep``:
       - If found and not deleted: delete staged + tombstone from tip
       - If not found: return False
    """

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "delete", "versioned", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.SCALAR

    def __init__(
        self: VersionedDeleteIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        sys_id: ScalarServerRef[SysId],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedDeleteIntentConfig],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.sys_id: SysId = _require_seeded_config(sys_id, type(self).__name__)
        resolved_config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)
        self.staging_ctx = resolved_config.staging_ctx
        self.after_refs = resolved_config.after_refs
        self.dependency_only = bool(resolved_config.dependency_only)
        self.permission_context_ref = resolved_config.permission_context_ref
        self.permission_context_type = resolved_config.permission_context_type

    def tables_read(self: VersionedDeleteIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self.staging_ctx.tip_table_name})

    def tables_written(self: VersionedDeleteIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self.staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def commit_dependency_ref_id(self: VersionedDeleteIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        """Return the exact tombstone effect required by branch publication.

        See ``docs/design/VERSIONED_COMMIT_EFFECT_FRONTIER.rst``.
        """
        return ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.tombstone")

    def additional_batch_binding_ref_ids(self: VersionedDeleteIntent) -> tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]:
        """Declare the physical selection and tombstone relations used by dependents."""
        return (
            self.commit_dependency_ref_id(),
            VersionedSelectPublishedRefs(ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_check")).raw_select_relation,
        )

    def lower(self: VersionedDeleteIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        """Lower to: EnsureStagedCommit + check + ConditionalStep(delete | False)."""

        after_refs = _resolve_lowered_commit_dependency_refs(ctx, self.after_refs)
        pre_delete_hook = _delete_hook_validator_from_ctx(ctx, self.model_cls)
        after_delete_hook = _after_delete_hook_from_ctx(ctx, self.model_cls)
        has_delete_hooks = pre_delete_hook is not None or after_delete_hook is not None
        has_fk_dependents = bool(
            _fk_relationships_for_physical_parent(
                get_fk_map(self.staging_ctx.domain),
                self.model_cls,
            ),
        )
        if (
            not has_delete_hooks
            and not self.dependency_only
            and (
                ctx.backend_profile.traits.versioned_staging_transport is VersionedStagingTransport.SAME_STATEMENT_RELATION
                or (not ctx.branch_tip_materialized and has_fk_dependents)
            )
        ):
            bulk_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.bulk")
            _register_lowered_commit_dependency_ref(
                ctx,
                semantic_ref=self.commit_dependency_ref_id(),
                dependency_ref=bulk_ref,
            )
            bulk_steps = list(
                VersionedDeleteManyIntent(
                    bulk_ref,
                    self.model_cls,
                    ServerRefs.scalar(
                        _VersionedDeleteManyConfig(
                            sys_ids=(self.sys_id,),
                            staging_ctx=self.staging_ctx,
                            after_refs=after_refs,
                            permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
                            permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
                            expected_count=None,
                            matched_source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(
                                f"{self.ref_id}_check.raw_select",
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ).lower(ctx),
            )
            bulk_steps.append(
                _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    staged_delete_ref=bulk_ref,
                    tombstone_ref=bulk_ref,
                ),
            )
            return bulk_steps
        permission_steps, user_id_ref_id = _versioned_permission_resolution_steps(
            self.ref_id,
            self.model_cls,
            ctx,
        )
        permission_validation_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = list(permission_steps)
        permission_validation_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        if user_id_ref_id is not None:
            permission_validation_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_validate_permission")
            permission_source = _VersionedBatchLiteralSource(
                source_columns=[_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN, "sys_id"],
                write_rows=[(0, self.sys_id.unwrap_to_str())],
                return_rows=[(0, self.sys_id.unwrap_to_str())],
            )
            permission_validation_steps.append(
                _ValidateVersionedUpsertManyPermissionStep(
                    permission_validation_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    after_refs=after_refs,
                    staging_ctx=self.staging_ctx,
                    batch_plan=_PreparedVersionedUpsertBatchPlan(
                        source=permission_source,
                        conflict_columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
                        target_columns=[],
                        data_field_names=(),
                        data_db_columns=(),
                        column_select_exprs=(),
                        on_conflict=None,
                        do_nothing=False,
                        is_empty=False,
                    ),
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
                    config=_VersionedPermissionValidationConfig(
                        validate_payload=False,
                        existing_action="delete",
                        permission_error_message=(f"Cannot delete {self.model_cls.__name__} object: write permission denied"),
                    ),
                ),
            )
        permission_after_refs = (
            after_refs | frozenset({permission_validation_ref}) if permission_validation_ref is not None else after_refs
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.stage_tombstone import (
            StageTombstoneStep,
            StagedTombstoneConflictScope,
        )

        sc = _staging_ctx_for_lowering(self.staging_ctx, ctx)
        _register_lowered_commit_dependency_ref(
            ctx,
            semantic_ref=self.ref_id,
            dependency_ref=self.commit_dependency_ref_id(),
        )
        raw_sys_id = unwrap_literal_sql_value(self.sys_id)
        if not isinstance(raw_sys_id, str | UUID | SysId | SqlRuntimeBindSlot):
            msg = f"Versioned delete requires a SQL-bindable sys_id, got {type(raw_sys_id).__name__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        # Request-owned physical templates carry target ids as runtime bind
        # slots. They remain SQL values, never Python-resolved planner inputs.
        sv = cast("SysId", raw_sys_id) if isinstance(raw_sys_id, SqlRuntimeBindSlot) else SysId(raw_sys_id)

        ensure_staged_commit_step = EnsureStagedCommitStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_ensure_staged_commit"),
            sc.domain,
            sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
            config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(sc, after_refs=permission_after_refs),
        )

        # 1. Idempotent: ensure staged commit record
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [ensure_staged_commit_step, *permission_validation_steps]

        # 2. Condition: versioned select_one (sees staged + tip).
        # Result is a row (truthy) or None (falsy).
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_select_one import (
            VersionedSelectOneRawStep,
            build_versioned_select_one_query_spec,
            lower_versioned_spill_aware_select_one_steps,
        )

        check_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_check")
        check_selected_raw_ref = versioned_select_published_refs(check_ref).raw_rows_relation
        query_spec = replace(
            build_versioned_select_one_query_spec(self.model_cls, sys_id=sv),
            permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
        )
        steps.extend(
            lower_versioned_spill_aware_select_one_steps(
                ctx=ctx,
                ref_id=check_ref,
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                query_spec=query_spec,
                raw_step=VersionedSelectOneRawStep(
                    ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{check_ref}.raw"),
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    sys_id=sv,
                    config=_build_versioned_select_one_raw_config(
                        sc,
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                        permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
                        permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        pre_delete_hook_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        if pre_delete_hook is not None:
            pre_delete_hook_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_pre_delete_hook")
            steps.append(
                ApplyDeleteHookStep(
                    pre_delete_hook_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    selected_ref=check_ref,
                    pre_delete_hook=pre_delete_hook,
                    hook_registry=getattr(ctx, "auto_api_hook_registry", None),
                ),
            )

        # 3. Child steps: mark staged rows as deleted + insert a published-row tombstone.
        # Missing objects naturally produce no staged update and no tombstone.
        delete_step_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_delete_staged")
        tombstone_ref = self.commit_dependency_ref_id()
        tombstone_condition_ref = versioned_select_published_refs(check_ref).raw_select_relation
        raw_tombstone_step: ServerPlanStep[Any] = StageTombstoneStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(tombstone_ref),
            condition_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(tombstone_condition_ref),
            model_cls=self.model_cls,
            staged_model=sc.staged_model,
            staged_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
            lazy_branch=coerce_versioned_branch_ref(sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch),
            staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
            branch_scope_token=sc.branch_scope_token,
            literal_branch=sc.literal_branch,
            conflict_scope=StagedTombstoneConflictScope.CURRENT_STAGED_COMMIT,
            after_refs=frozenset({delete_step_ref}),
        )
        tombstone_step = raw_tombstone_step
        if_true: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []

        fk_steps = self._build_fk_enforcement_steps(
            sc,
            sv,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_generated_storage_columns=should_include_generated_storage_columns(ctx),
        )
        fk_step_refs = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id) for step in fk_steps)
        steps.extend(fk_steps)

        delete_step = _MarkStagedRowsDeletedStep(
            delete_step_ref,
            staged_model=sc.staged_model,
            staged_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
            staged_commit_table_name=SqlTableName(get_table_name(sc.domain.staged_commit_model)),
            sys_id=sv,
            lazy_branch=sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
            staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
            connection_id_raw=ConnectionId(sc.connection_id_raw),
            staged_visibility=sc.staged_visibility,
            after_refs=frozenset(
                {check_selected_raw_ref} | ({pre_delete_hook_ref} if pre_delete_hook_ref is not None else set()),
            ),
        )
        if_true.extend([delete_step, tombstone_step])
        side_effect_steps = _versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
            check_ref,
            self.model_cls,
            "DELETE",
            ctx,
            config=_VersionedPostWriteSideEffectsConfig(
                staged_commit_id=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                write_ref_id=check_selected_raw_ref,
                table_event_ref_id=check_selected_raw_ref,
                previous_rows_ref=check_selected_raw_ref,
                materialized_write_ref=False,
            ),
        )
        if_true.extend(side_effect_steps)
        side_effect_refs = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id) for step in side_effect_steps)

        # 4. Execute the child delete/tombstone steps after the resolved existence
        # check and compute the boolean result from their resolved outputs. This
        # mirrors the existing dynamic-delete runtime result step and avoids the
        # SQL-gated conditional batch path for the write surface.
        steps.extend(if_true)
        after_delete_hook_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        if after_delete_hook is not None:
            after_delete_hook_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_after_delete_hook")
            steps.append(
                ApplyAfterDeleteHookStep(
                    after_delete_hook_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    selected_ref=check_ref,
                    delete_ref=delete_step_ref,
                    after_delete_hook=after_delete_hook,
                ),
            )
        result_after_refs = frozenset(
            {check_selected_raw_ref}
            | fk_step_refs
            | side_effect_refs
            | ({after_delete_hook_ref} if after_delete_hook_ref is not None else set()),
        )
        if self.dependency_only:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import StaticValueAfterDepsStep

            steps.append(
                StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    True,
                    [
                        str(delete_step_ref),
                        str(tombstone_ref),
                        str(check_selected_raw_ref),
                        *(str(ref) for ref in fk_step_refs),
                        *(str(ref) for ref in side_effect_refs),
                        *((str(after_delete_hook_ref),) if after_delete_hook_ref is not None else ()),
                    ],
                ),
            )
        else:
            steps.append(
                _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    staged_delete_ref=delete_step_ref,
                    tombstone_ref=tombstone_ref,
                    check_ref=check_selected_raw_ref,
                    after_refs=result_after_refs,
                ),
            )

        if after_refs:
            steps = [_step_with_after_refs(step, after_refs) for step in steps]
        return steps

    def _build_fk_enforcement_steps(
        self: VersionedDeleteIntent,
        sc: VersionedStagingCtx,
        sys_id_value: SysId,
        ctx: LoweringContext,
        *,
        include_generated_storage_columns: GeneratedStorageColumnInclusion = (GeneratedStorageColumnInclusion(False)),
    ) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        """Build FK enforcement steps from domain metadata. Pure."""

        domain = sc.domain
        fk_map = get_fk_map(domain)
        if not fk_map:
            return []
        fk_expansion_depth_limit = sum(len(relationships) for relationships in fk_map.values())

        def _child_data_cols(child_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]) -> list[str]:
            cols = _versioned_data_db_columns(
                child_model,
                excluded_fields=(
                    "sys_id",
                    "revision_id",
                    "staged_commit_id",
                    "deleted",
                    *_GRAPH_HASH32_FIELD_NAMES,
                ),
                include_generated_storage_columns=include_generated_storage_columns,
            )
            for db_col in _collect_large_column_pointer_db_columns(child_model):
                if db_col not in cols:
                    cols.append(db_col)
            return cols

        def _build_select_ids_subquery(
            model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
            fk_field: str,
            parent_id_raw: SysId,
            lazy_branch: VersionedBranchSource,
            parent_subquery: SqlRenderable | None = None,
            depth: int = 0,
        ) -> SqlRenderable:
            """Build SELECT sys_id from visible published and staged children."""
            table_names = get_versioned_table_names(model_cls)
            sparse_table = str(table_names.sparse)
            staged_table = str(table_names.staged)
            db_fk_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(fk_field))
            fk_col_expr = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_fk_col))
            branch_source = BranchId(ctx.branch_id) if ctx.branch_id is not None else lazy_branch
            branch_sql_value = lower_versioned_branch_source(
                branch_source,
                ctx,
                site="_build_select_ids_subquery",
            )

            if parent_subquery is not None:
                fk_filter: Any = SqlIn(fk_col_expr, parent_subquery)
            else:
                fk_filter = SqlBinaryOp(fk_col_expr, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(parent_id_raw))

            published_source_table = SqlTableName(sparse_table)
            published_ctes: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []
            sparse_revision_source = _lower_sparse_revision_source(ctx)
            if not ctx.branch_tip_materialized and sparse_revision_source is not None:
                visible_name = f"{sparse_table}_{self.ref_id}_child_ids_{depth}"
                published_source_table = SqlTableName(visible_name)
                published_ctes.append(
                    (
                        visible_name,
                        SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned(
                            table=SqlTableName(sparse_table),
                            revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
                            branch_id=branch_sql_value,
                            revision_id=sparse_revision_source,
                            include_deleted=False,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
                published_where: Any = fk_filter
            else:
                published_where = sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        branch_sql_value,
                    ),
                    fk_filter,
                    SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"))),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(False),
                    ),
                )
            staged_where = sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_sql_value,
                ),
                fk_filter,
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlParam(False),
                ),
            )
            union = SqlUnionAll(
                [
                    SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                        from_table=published_source_table,
                        columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
                        where_conditions=[published_where],
                    ),
                    SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                        from_table=SqlTableName(staged_table),
                        columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
                        where_conditions=[staged_where],
                    ),
                ],
            )
            if published_ctes:
                return SqlCte(published_ctes, union)
            return union

        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        idx = 0
        fk_branch_tip_materialized = (
            sc.branch_tip_materialization is BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED
        ) and ctx.branch_tip_materialized

        def _relationships_for(
            parent_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        ) -> list[FKRelationship]:
            return _fk_relationships_for_physical_parent(fk_map, parent_model)

        def _walk_cascade(
            parent_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
            parent_id_raw: SysId,
            parent_subquery: SqlRenderable | None,
            parent_id_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
            depth: int,
            traversed_edges: frozenset[tuple[str, str, str]] = frozenset(),
        ) -> None:
            """Recursively walk FK graph, producing steps deepest-first."""
            nonlocal idx
            _require_fk_cascade_depth(depth, _FkCascadeMode.SINGLE, fk_expansion_depth_limit)

            relationships = _relationships_for(parent_model)

            # Group CASCADE relationships by child model so that when the
            # same child has multiple FK columns to the same parent (e.g.,
            # GraphEdge.source_sys_id + GraphEdge.target_sys_id → Node),
            # we produce a single tombstone step with an OR filter.
            # This avoids duplicate tombstones for self-loop edges.
            cascade_by_child: dict[
                tuple[type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]], str],
                list[FKRelationship],
            ] = {}
            for rel in relationships:
                on_delete = rel.on_delete.upper()
                if on_delete == "CASCADE":
                    cascade_by_child.setdefault((rel.child_model, rel.parent_field), []).append(rel)

            for rel in relationships:
                on_delete = rel.on_delete.upper()
                child_model = rel.child_model
                child_table_names = get_versioned_table_names(child_model)
                child_staged = str(child_table_names.staged)
                child_tip = str(child_table_names.tip)
                child_data = _child_data_cols(child_model)
                ref_prefix = f"{self.ref_id}_fk{idx}"
                idx += 1
                parent_value_column = SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(rel.parent_model, DynamicFieldName(rel.parent_field)))
                effective_parent_source_ref = parent_id_source_ref

                if on_delete == "RESTRICT":
                    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.fk_cascade_step import (
                        RestrictCheckStep,
                        _RestrictCheckConfig,
                    )

                    steps.append(
                        RestrictCheckStep(
                            ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_restrict"),
                            parent_model_cls=parent_model,
                            child_model_cls=child_model,
                            lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                            config=_RestrictCheckConfig(
                                child_fk_field=rel.child_field,
                                parent_sys_id_raw=parent_id_raw,
                                parent_value_column=parent_value_column,
                                parent_id_source_ref=effective_parent_source_ref,
                                lazy_revision=sc.lazy_revision,
                                branch_tip_materialized=fk_branch_tip_materialized,
                            ),
                        ),
                    )

                elif on_delete == "CASCADE":
                    # If this child model has multiple CASCADE FKs to the same
                    # parent (e.g., source_sys_id + target_sys_id), only emit
                    # the step once — on the first FK. The step will OR all
                    # FK fields together.
                    sibling_rels = cascade_by_child.get((child_model, rel.parent_field), [])
                    if len(sibling_rels) > 1 and rel is not sibling_rels[0]:
                        continue

                    fk_fields = [r.child_field for r in sibling_rels] if len(sibling_rels) > 1 else None

                    child_id_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
                    relationship_edge = (
                        get_table_name(parent_model),
                        get_table_name(child_model),
                        str(rel.child_field),
                    )
                    recursive_same_model = get_table_name(child_model) == get_table_name(parent_model)
                    if _relationships_for(child_model) and (recursive_same_model or relationship_edge not in traversed_edges):
                        child_id_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_child_ids")
                        steps.append(
                            _VersionedDeleteManyChildIdsStep(
                                child_id_ref,
                                child_model_cls=child_model,
                                child_fk_field=_VersionedDeleteChildFkFieldName(rel.child_field),
                                parent_sys_id_raw=parent_id_raw,
                                parent_id_source_ref=parent_id_source_ref,
                                staging_ctx=sc,
                                recursive_same_model=recursive_same_model,
                                recursive_parent_value_column=(parent_value_column if recursive_same_model else None),
                            )
                        )
                    child_subquery = None
                    descendant_start = len(steps)
                    if child_id_ref is not None and not recursive_same_model:
                        _walk_cascade(
                            child_model,
                            parent_id_raw,
                            child_subquery,
                            child_id_ref,
                            depth + 1,
                            traversed_edges | frozenset({relationship_edge}),
                        )
                    descendant_refs = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id) for step in steps[descendant_start:])
                    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.fk_cascade_step import (
                        CascadeTombstoneStep,
                        DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep,
                        _CascadeTombstoneConfig,
                    )

                    cascade_config = _CascadeTombstoneConfig(
                        child_fk_field=rel.child_field,
                        parent_sys_id_raw=parent_id_raw,
                        parent_model_cls=parent_model,
                        staged_table_name=SqlTableName(child_staged),
                        tip_table_name=SqlTableName(child_tip),
                        data_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(name) for name in child_data),
                        staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                        parent_id_subquery=parent_subquery,
                        parent_id_source_ref=(
                            child_id_ref
                            if recursive_same_model and child_id_ref is not None and parent_value_column == SqlColumnName("sys_id")
                            else effective_parent_source_ref
                            if not recursive_same_model
                            else None
                        ),
                        parent_value_source_ref=(
                            child_id_ref
                            if recursive_same_model and child_id_ref is not None and parent_value_column != SqlColumnName("sys_id")
                            else None
                        ),
                        excluded_child_id_source_ref=(effective_parent_source_ref if recursive_same_model else None),
                        excluded_child_sys_id_raw=(
                            parent_id_raw if recursive_same_model and effective_parent_source_ref is None else None
                        ),
                        parent_value_column=parent_value_column,
                        additional_fk_fields=tuple(fk_fields) if fk_fields is not None else None,
                        lazy_revision=sc.lazy_revision,
                        branch_tip_materialized=fk_branch_tip_materialized,
                        staged_visibility=sc.staged_visibility,
                        staged_commit_table_name=SqlTableName(get_table_name(sc.domain.staged_commit_model)),
                        connection_id_param=SqlParam(SqlConnectionIdValue(sc.connection_id_raw)),
                        sparse_ancestor_cte_name=SqlCteName(
                            _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(self.ref_id, "cascade_ancestors"),
                        ),
                    )
                    staged_child_delete_step: ServerPlanStep[Any] = DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep(
                        ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_cascade_staged"),
                        child_model_cls=child_model,
                        lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                        config=cascade_config,
                    )
                    published_child_tombstone_step: ServerPlanStep[Any] = CascadeTombstoneStep(
                        ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_cascade"),
                        child_model_cls=child_model,
                        lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                        config=cascade_config,
                    )
                    child_delete_after_refs = descendant_refs
                    if child_id_ref is not None:
                        child_delete_after_refs = child_delete_after_refs | frozenset({child_id_ref})
                    if child_delete_after_refs:
                        staged_child_delete_step = _step_with_after_refs(
                            staged_child_delete_step,
                            child_delete_after_refs,
                        )
                        published_child_tombstone_step = _step_with_after_refs(
                            published_child_tombstone_step,
                            child_delete_after_refs,
                        )
                    steps.append(staged_child_delete_step)
                    steps.append(published_child_tombstone_step)

                elif on_delete in ("SET NULL", "SET_NULL", "SET DEFAULT", "SET_DEFAULT"):
                    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.fk_cascade_step import (
                        SetNullMatchingStagedChildrenStep,
                        SetNullStagingStep,
                        _SetNullStagingConfig,
                    )

                    staged_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_setnull_staged")
                    common_config = _SetNullStagingConfig(
                        child_fk_field=rel.child_field,
                        parent_sys_id_raw=parent_id_raw,
                        parent_model_cls=parent_model,
                        staged_table_name=SqlTableName(child_staged),
                        tip_table_name=SqlTableName(child_tip),
                        data_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(name) for name in child_data),
                        staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                        parent_id_source_ref=effective_parent_source_ref,
                        parent_value_column=parent_value_column,
                        lazy_revision=sc.lazy_revision,
                        branch_tip_materialized=fk_branch_tip_materialized,
                        replacement_value=(rel.default_value if on_delete in ("SET DEFAULT", "SET_DEFAULT") else None),
                        staged_visibility=sc.staged_visibility,
                        staged_commit_table_name=SqlTableName(get_table_name(sc.domain.staged_commit_model)),
                        connection_id_param=SqlParam(SqlConnectionIdValue(sc.connection_id_raw)),
                    )
                    steps.append(
                        SetNullMatchingStagedChildrenStep(
                            staged_ref,
                            child_model_cls=child_model,
                            lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                            config=common_config,
                        ),
                    )
                    steps.append(
                        SetNullStagingStep(
                            ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_setnull"),
                            child_model_cls=child_model,
                            lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                            config=replace(common_config, after_refs=frozenset({staged_ref})),
                        ),
                    )

        _walk_cascade(self.model_cls, sys_id_value, None, None, 0)
        return steps


@_versioned_commit_effect_owner
class VersionedDeleteDeferredIntent[T](IntentStep[bool]):
    """L4: Versioned delete where the object id remains symbolic."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "delete", "versioned", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.SCALAR

    def __init__(
        self: VersionedDeleteDeferredIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        sys_id: ScalarServerRef[SysId],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedDeleteIntentConfig],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.sys_id = sys_id
        resolved_config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)
        self.staging_ctx = resolved_config.staging_ctx

    def tables_read(self: VersionedDeleteDeferredIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self.staging_ctx.tip_table_name})

    def tables_written(self: VersionedDeleteDeferredIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self.staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def commit_dependency_ref_id(self: VersionedDeleteDeferredIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        return ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.tombstone")

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self: VersionedDeleteDeferredIntent) -> bool:
        return True

    def lower(
        self: VersionedDeleteDeferredIntent,
        ctx: LoweringContext,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        sc = self.staging_ctx

        ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_ensure_staged_commit")
        delete_step_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_delete_staged"
        tombstone_ref = str(self.commit_dependency_ref_id())
        delete_spec = build_delete_staged_spec_with_server_ref(
            sc.staged_model,
            sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
            sc.staged_commit_id_raw,
            self.sys_id,
        )
        projection_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        sys_id_ref = self.sys_id.ref_id
        if sys_id_ref is not None and "." in str(sys_id_ref):
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.field_projection import (
                ProjectScalarFieldStep,
                _ProjectScalarFieldConfig,
            )

            source_ref, field_name = str(sys_id_ref).rsplit(".", 1)
            projection_steps.append(
                ProjectScalarFieldStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(sys_id_ref),
                    config=_ProjectScalarFieldConfig(
                        source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{source_ref}.hydrated"),
                        field_name=field_name,
                    ),
                ),
            )
        return [
            *projection_steps,
            EnsureStagedCommitStep(
                ensure_ref,
                sc.domain,
                sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
                config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(sc),
            ),
            QueryDeleteStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(delete_step_ref),
                sc.staged_model,
                _QueryDeleteStepConfig(query_spec=delete_spec),
            ),
            TombstoneFromTipStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(tombstone_ref),
                sys_id=self.sys_id,
                staged_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
                sparse_table_name=sc.sparse_table_name_value,
                tip_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.tip_table_name),
                staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                lazy_branch=coerce_versioned_branch_ref(sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch),
                common_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(col) for col in sc.common_columns),
                staged_model=sc.staged_model,
                tip_model=sc.tip_model,
                literal_branch=sc.literal_branch,
                after_refs=frozenset({ensure_ref, ServerPlanRefId(delete_step_ref)}),
            ),
            _DynamicVersionedDeleteResultStep(
                self.ref_id,
                staged_delete_ref=ServerPlanRefId(delete_step_ref),
                tombstone_ref=ServerPlanRefId(tombstone_ref),
            ),
        ]


class _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep(MaybeSqlRelationPublisherStep[dict[str, str | int | float | bool | None] | None]):
    """Project the selected versioned row into the requested return payload."""

    def __init__(
        self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[Any],
        config: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._returning_columns = config.returning_columns
        self._compiled_cte_contract: CtePublicationContract | None = None

    @property
    def level(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def publishes_sql_projection_alias_only(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "returning", "versioned", "sql_projection"})

    def tables_read(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._source_ref})

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref)})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        if self._compiled_cte_contract is not None:
            return self._compiled_cte_contract

        def _legacy_cte_output_columns() -> tuple[str, ...]:
            if self._returning_columns is not None:
                return tuple(self._returning_columns)
            return _versioned_application_output_columns(self._model_cls)

        columns = _legacy_cte_output_columns()
        column_type_hints = _versioned_application_raw_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, columns)
        if columns is None:
            if column_type_hints is not None and column_type_hints.has_any():
                msg = f"{type(self).__name__} declares SQL column type hints without an explicit cte_output_columns() contract."
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            relation_contract=_versioned_model_projection_contract(self._model_cls, contract_columns),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def batch_result_alias_labels(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return ()

    def batch_result_labels(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return (str(self.ref_id),)

    def internal_plan_state(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> PlanPayloadState:
        return {
            **super().internal_plan_state(),
            "_source_ref": self._source_ref,
            "_model_cls": self._model_cls,
            "_returning_columns": self._returning_columns,
        }

    def internal_plan_ref_state(self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep) -> PlanPayloadState:
        return self.internal_plan_state()

    def compile(
        self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[dict[str, str | int | float | bool | None] | None]:
        if ctx.cte_refs is not None and self._source_ref in ctx.cte_refs:
            return self._compile_from_cte(ctx)
        msg = f"{type(self).__name__} requires SQL-visible source binding for versioned delete returning ref {self._source_ref!r}."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)

    def execute_runtime(
        self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
    ) -> dict[str, str | int | float | bool | None] | None:
        resolved_value = resolved.get(str(self._source_ref), None)
        if isinstance(resolved_value, list):
            if not resolved_value:
                return None
            resolved_value = resolved_value[0]
        return self._project_resolved_value(resolved_value)

    def _project_resolved_value(
        self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep,
        resolved_value: object,
    ) -> dict[str, str | int | float | bool | None] | None:
        if resolved_value is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(resolved_value, BaseModel):
            data = dict(resolved_value.model_dump())
        elif isinstance(resolved_value, dict):
            data = dict(resolved_value)
        else:
            msg = f"_ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep expected model or dict source, got {type(resolved_value).__name__}."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if self._returning_columns is not None:
            data = {key: data.get(key) for key in self._returning_columns}
        return cast(dict[str, str | int | float | bool | None], data)

    def _compile_from_cte(
        self: _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[dict[str, str | int | float | bool | None] | None]:
        returning_columns = self._returning_columns
        cte_ref = _require_delete_returning_source_cte(ctx, self._source_ref)
        cte_ref_id = cte_ref.ref_id
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlFrom, SqlSelectList, SqlTableAlias

        source_columns = cte_ref.columns
        if source_columns is None:
            msg = (
                f"{type(self).__name__} requires source CTE {self._source_ref!r} to publish "
                "a column contract before projecting versioned delete-returning payloads."
            )
            raise AssertionError(msg)
        output_columns = returning_columns or _versioned_application_output_columns(self._model_cls)
        source_columns_by_output = {
            column: str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(column))) for column in output_columns
        }
        missing_columns = tuple(
            column for column, source_column in source_columns_by_output.items() if source_column not in source_columns
        )
        if missing_columns:
            msg = (
                f"{type(self).__name__} cannot project {missing_columns!r} from source CTE "
                f"{self._source_ref!r}; published columns are {source_columns!r}."
            )
            raise AssertionError(msg)
        source_type_hints = cte_ref.column_type_hints
        if source_type_hints is None:
            msg = (
                f"{type(self).__name__} requires source CTE {self._source_ref!r} to publish "
                "SQL column type hints with its column contract."
            )
            raise AssertionError(msg)
        output_type_hints = source_type_hints.filtered(set(output_columns))
        model_output_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, output_columns)
        if model_output_hints is not None:
            try:
                model_output_hints.require_complete(output_columns)
            except ValueError:
                pass
            else:
                output_type_hints = model_output_hints
        output_type_hints.require_complete(output_columns)
        self._compiled_cte_contract = CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(output_columns),
            column_type_hints=output_type_hints,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.source_cte(source_cte_ref=str(self._source_ref)),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=cte_ref.source_tables,
        )
        self._cte_publication_contract_cache_valid = False
        self._publication_contract_cache_valid = False
        select_columns: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        for column in output_columns:
            source_column = source_columns_by_output[column]
            if source_column in source_columns:
                column_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(source_column),
                    qualifier=SqlAliasName(cte_ref_id),
                )
                if column in output_type_hints.double_columns and (
                    ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_conflict_transport is DmlConflictTransport.INSERTED_VALUES
                    or source_column in source_type_hints.numeric_columns
                ):
                    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast
                    from l1000_schema.typed_field import SqlCastTargetType

                    column_expr = SqlCast(
                        column_expr,
                        SqlCastTargetType(base_type="DOUBLE"),
                    )
                select_columns.append(SqlSelectAlias(column_expr, SqlAliasName(column)))
            else:
                select_columns.append(SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(None), SqlAliasName(column)))
        if not select_columns:
            select_columns = [SqlStar()]
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import (
            CompiledOutputShape,
            DeclaredResultRelation,
            synthetic_output_field,
        )

        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in output_columns))
        stmt = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(select_columns),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(cte_ref_id)))),
            where=SqlWhereClause(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__exists"), qualifier=SqlAliasName(cte_ref_id)),
            ),
            limit=1,
        )
        auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, Any]] | None = None
        if cte_ref.auxiliary_query is not None:
            auxiliary_ctes = [(cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query)]
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=stmt,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_OBJECT,
                    raw_mode=True,
                    select_columns=tuple(output_columns) if output_columns else None,
                ),
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=output_type_hints,
        )


@_versioned_commit_effect_owner
class VersionedDeleteReturningIntent(IntentStep[dict[str, str | int | float | bool | None] | None]):
    """L4: Delete a versioned row and return the requested columns."""

    def __init__(

        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,

    ) -> None:

        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.sys_id_ref = sys_id
        self.sys_id: SysId = _require_seeded_config(sys_id, type(self).__name__)

        self.returning_columns = self._config.returning_columns
        self.staging_ctx = self._config.staging_ctx

    def dependencies(self: VersionedDeleteReturningIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({*self.sys_id_ref.dependencies(), *(str(ref) for ref in self._config.after_refs)})

    def tables_read(self: VersionedDeleteReturningIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        sc = self._config.staging_ctx
        return frozenset({sc.staged_table_name, sc.tip_table_name})
