        return frozenset({self.staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def commit_dependency_ref_id(self: VersionedDeleteReturningIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        return ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.tombstone")

    def lower(
        self: VersionedDeleteReturningIntent,
        ctx: LoweringContext,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.stage_tombstone import StageTombstoneStep

        sc = self.staging_ctx
        literal_sys_id = self.sys_id
        sv = self.sys_id_ref
        sys_id_str = literal_sys_id.unwrap_to_str()
        select_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_check"
        select_published_refs = versioned_select_published_refs(ServerPlanRefId(select_ref))
        select_raw_ref = select_published_refs.raw_select_relation
        select_rows_ref = select_published_refs.raw_rows_relation
        select_condition_ref = select_published_refs.existence_condition
        delete_step_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_delete_staged"
        delete_guard_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_delete_if_found"
        tombstone_ref = str(self.commit_dependency_ref_id())

        permission_steps, user_id_ref_id = _versioned_permission_resolution_steps(
            self.ref_id,
            self.model_cls,
            ctx,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_select_one import (
            VersionedSelectOneRawStep,
            build_versioned_select_one_query_spec,
            lower_versioned_spill_aware_select_one_steps,
        )

        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
            *permission_steps,
            EnsureStagedCommitStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_ensure_staged_commit"),
                sc.domain,
                sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
                config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(sc),
            ),
        ]
        query_spec = build_versioned_select_one_query_spec(self.model_cls, sys_id=sv)
        steps.extend(
            lower_versioned_spill_aware_select_one_steps(
                ctx=ctx,
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(select_ref),
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                query_spec=query_spec,
                raw_step=VersionedSelectOneRawStep(
                    ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{select_ref}.raw"),
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    sys_id=sv,
                    config=_build_versioned_select_one_raw_config(
                        sc,
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                        after_refs=self._config.after_refs,
                    ),
                ),
                include_hydrated=False,
            ),
        )

        fk_steps = VersionedDeleteIntent(
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_fk"),
            model_cls=self.model_cls,
            sys_id=cast("Any", literal_sys_id),
            config=cast("Any", _VersionedDeleteIntentConfig(staging_ctx=sc)),
        )._build_fk_enforcement_steps(
            sc,
            literal_sys_id,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_generated_storage_columns=should_include_generated_storage_columns(ctx),
        )
        steps.extend(fk_steps)

        delete_spec = build_delete_staged_spec(
            sc.staged_model,
            sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
            sc.staged_commit_id_raw,
            [sys_id_str],
        )
        inline_write_guards = _uses_inline_versioned_write_guards(ctx)
        delete_step = QueryDeleteStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(delete_step_ref),
            sc.staged_model,
            _QueryDeleteStepConfig(
                query_spec=delete_spec,
                after_refs=frozenset({self.ref_id}),
            ),
        )
        tombstone_dependency = frozenset({delete_step_ref}) if inline_write_guards else frozenset({delete_guard_ref})
        raw_tombstone_step: ServerPlanStep[Any] = (
            TombstoneFromTipStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(tombstone_ref),
                sys_id=sv,
                staged_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
                sparse_table_name=sc.sparse_table_name_value,
                tip_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.tip_table_name),
                staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                lazy_branch=coerce_versioned_branch_ref(sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch),
                common_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(col) for col in sc.common_columns),
                staged_model=sc.staged_model,
                tip_model=sc.tip_model,
                literal_branch=sc.literal_branch,
                after_refs=frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(dep) for dep in tombstone_dependency),
            )
            if ctx.branch_tip_materialized
            else StageTombstoneStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(tombstone_ref),
                condition_ref_id=select_raw_ref,
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                staged_model=sc.staged_model,
                staged_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
                lazy_branch=coerce_versioned_branch_ref(sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch),
                staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                branch_scope_token=sc.branch_scope_token,
                literal_branch=sc.literal_branch,
                after_refs=frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(dep) for dep in tombstone_dependency),
            )
        )
        tombstone_step = raw_tombstone_step
        value_step = _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep(
            self.ref_id,
            source_ref=select_rows_ref,
            model_cls=self.model_cls,
            config=_ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueConfig(
                returning_columns=self.returning_columns,
            ),
        )
        side_effect_steps = _versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
            self.ref_id,
            self.model_cls,
            "DELETE",
            ctx,
            config=_VersionedPostWriteSideEffectsConfig(
                staged_commit_id=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                write_ref_id=select_rows_ref,
                table_event_ref_id=select_rows_ref,
                previous_rows_ref=select_rows_ref,
                materialized_write_ref=False,
                table_event_relation_replayable=True,
            ),
        )
        if inline_write_guards:
            steps.extend([value_step, delete_step, tombstone_step, *side_effect_steps])
            return steps
        steps.append(value_step)
        steps.append(
            build_one_sided_conditional(
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(delete_guard_ref),
                condition_ref=ServerPlanRefId(select_condition_ref),
                if_true_steps=[delete_step],
            ),
        )
        steps.append(tombstone_step)
        steps.extend(side_effect_steps)
        return steps

class _EmptyVersionedDeleteReturningRowsStep(NonPublishingStep[list[dict[str, object]]]):
    """Return one empty projection for each row deleted by the source effect."""

    def __init__(self, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId, *, count_ref: ServerPlanRefId) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._count_ref = count_ref

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def is_executor_owned_runtime_step(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"project", "runtime_projection", "versioned", "delete_many_returning"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._count_ref)})

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
        raw_count = resolved.get(str(self._count_ref), 0)
        count_column = LockedColumnName("count")
        if isinstance(raw_count, int):
            count = raw_count
        elif isinstance(raw_count, list):
            count = 0
            for row in raw_count:
                if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
                    raise TypeError("Delete-many count transport rows must be mappings")
                value = row.get(count_column.to_row_key())
                if not isinstance(value, int):
                    raise TypeError("Delete-many count transport rows must contain an integer 'count' value")
                count += value
        else:
            raise TypeError("Delete-many count transport must be an integer or count-row sequence")
        return [{} for _ in range(count)]

        self: VersionedDeleteManyReturningIntent,
        ctx: LoweringContext,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        return _lower_versioned_delete_many_returning_intent(
            ref_id=self.ref_id,
            model_cls=self.model_cls,
            config=self._config,
            ctx=ctx,
        )


def _lower_versioned_delete_many_returning_intent(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    config: _VersionedDeleteManyReturningConfig,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import CollectResultsStep

    if not config.sys_ids:
        return [ReturnValueStep(ref_id, [])]

    unique_sys_ids = tuple(dict.fromkeys(config.sys_ids))
    if len(unique_sys_ids) > 400:
        chunk_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        chunk_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        chunk_after_refs = config.after_refs
        for chunk_index, start in enumerate(range(0, len(unique_sys_ids), 400)):
            chunk_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_chunk_{chunk_index}")
            chunk_refs.append(chunk_ref)
            chunk_steps.extend(
                _lower_versioned_delete_many_returning_intent(
                    ref_id=chunk_ref,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    config=replace(
                        config,
                        sys_ids=unique_sys_ids[start : start + 400],
                        after_refs=chunk_after_refs,
                    ),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
            )
            chunk_after_refs = frozenset({chunk_ref})
        chunk_steps.append(
            _ConcatVersionedBulkResultChunksStep(
                ref_id,
                source_refs=tuple(chunk_refs),
            ),
        )
        return chunk_steps
    delete_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_delete")
    if config.returning_columns == ():
        delete_steps = list(
            VersionedDeleteManyIntent(
                delete_ref,
                model_cls,
                cast(
                    "Any",
                    _VersionedDeleteManyConfig(
                        sys_ids=unique_sys_ids,
                        staging_ctx=_staging_ctx_for_lowering(config.staging_ctx, ctx),
                        after_refs=config.after_refs,
                        permission_context_ref=config.permission_context_ref,
                        permission_context_type=config.permission_context_type,
                        count_execution_role=StepExecutionRole.SQL,
                    ),
                ),
            ).lower(ctx),
        )
        delete_steps.append(
            _EmptyVersionedDeleteReturningRowsStep(
                ref_id,
                count_ref=delete_ref,
            ),
        )
        return delete_steps
    permission_steps, user_id_ref_id = _versioned_permission_resolution_steps(
        ref_id,
        model_cls,
        ctx,
    )
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = list(permission_steps)
    select_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
    value_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []

    sc = _staging_ctx_for_lowering(config.staging_ctx, ctx)
    for index, sys_id in enumerate(unique_sys_ids):
        select_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_select_{index}")
        value_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_value_{index}")
        select_refs.append(select_ref)
        value_refs.append(value_ref)
        steps.append(
            VersionedSelectOneRawStep(
                select_ref,
                model_cls,
                sys_id,
                _build_versioned_select_one_raw_config(
                    sc,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    permission_context_ref=config.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=config.permission_context_type,
                ),
            ),
        )
        steps.append(
            _ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueStep(
                value_ref,
                source_ref=select_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                config=_ResolvedVersionedDeleteReturningValueConfig(
                    returning_columns=config.returning_columns,
                ),
            ),
        )

    steps.extend(
        VersionedDeleteManyIntent(
            delete_ref,
            model_cls,
            cast(
                "Any",
                _VersionedDeleteManyConfig(
                    sys_ids=unique_sys_ids,
                    staging_ctx=sc,
                    after_refs=frozenset(select_refs),
                    permission_context_ref=config.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=config.permission_context_type,
                    count_execution_role=StepExecutionRole.SQL,
                ),
            ),
        ).lower(ctx),
    )
    steps.append(
        CollectResultsStep(
            ref_id,
            [str(value_ref) for value_ref in value_refs],
            drop_none=True,
            after_refs=frozenset({delete_ref}),
            collect_runtime=True,
        ),
    )
    return _anchor_intent_after_refs(steps, config.after_refs)


@_versioned_commit_effect_owner
class VersionedDeleteManyIntent[T](IntentStep[int]):
    """L4: Versioned delete many — bulk operations for efficiency."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "delete", "versioned", "intent", "bulk"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.SCALAR

    def __init__(
        self: VersionedDeleteManyIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedDeleteManyConfig],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self._config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)
        self.sys_ids = list(
            dict.fromkeys(sys_id.unwrap_to_str() for sys_id in self._config.sys_ids),
        )
        self.staging_ctx = self._config.staging_ctx
        self.after_refs = self._config.after_refs
        self.source_ref = self._config.source_ref
        self.user_id_ref_id = self._config.user_id_ref_id
        self.permission_context_ref = self._config.permission_context_ref
        self.permission_context_type = self._config.permission_context_type
        self.expected_count = self._config.expected_count
        self.matched_source_ref = self._config.matched_source_ref

    def additional_batch_binding_ref_ids(self: VersionedDeleteManyIntent) -> tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]:
        return (
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_ensure"),
            self.commit_dependency_ref_id(),
        )

    def tables_read(self: VersionedDeleteManyIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self.staging_ctx.tip_table_name})

    def tables_written(self: VersionedDeleteManyIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        if not self.sys_ids and self.source_ref is None:
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset({self.staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def commit_dependency_ref_id(self: VersionedDeleteManyIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        """Return the exact bulk tombstone effect consumed by branch publication.

        See ``docs/design/VERSIONED_COMMIT_EFFECT_FRONTIER.rst``.
        """
        return ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.tombstone")

    def lower(self: VersionedDeleteManyIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        """Lower to bulk operations: one SQL per operation type, not per item."""
        if not self.sys_ids and self.source_ref is None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.return_value import ReturnValueStep

            return [ReturnValueStep(self.ref_id, 0)]
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.commit_branch_steps import (
            DeleteStagedForCommitStep,
            _DeleteStagedForCommitConfig,
            _StagedCommitSelector,
        )

        sc = _staging_ctx_for_lowering(self.staging_ctx, ctx)
        _register_lowered_commit_dependency_ref(
            ctx,
            semantic_ref=self.ref_id,
            dependency_ref=self.commit_dependency_ref_id(),
        )
        include_generated_storage_columns = should_include_generated_storage_columns(ctx)
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        requested_count = self.expected_count if self.source_ref is not None else len(self.sys_ids)
        source_ref = self.source_ref

        # 1. Ensure staged commit
        steps.append(
            EnsureStagedCommitStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_ensure"),
                sc.domain,
                sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
                config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(sc),
            ),
        )
        ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_ensure")
        if self.user_id_ref_id is None:
            permission_steps, user_id_ref_id = _versioned_permission_resolution_steps(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                ctx,
                after_refs=frozenset({ensure_ref}),
            )
        else:
            permission_steps, user_id_ref_id = [], self.user_id_ref_id
        steps.extend(permission_steps)

        count_cap = requested_count if requested_count is not None else _UNBOUNDED_DELETE_COUNT
        seeded_source_sys_ids: tuple[SysId, ...] | None = None
        published_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        cascade_source_ref_override: ServerPlanRefId | None = None

        if source_ref is not None:
            found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(None, ServerPlanRefId(source_ref))
            if found_seed:
                from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_lazy_support import (
                    MatchVersionedRowsByKeyToLiteralSequenceStep,
                    _MatchVersionedRowsByKeyConfig,
                )

                if not isinstance(seed_value, Sequence) or isinstance(seed_value, str | bytes | bytearray):
                    msg = f"{type(self).__name__} expected seeded sys_id sequence for {source_ref!r}, got {type(seed_value).__name__}"
                    raise TypeError(msg)
                published_sys_ids: list[SysId] = []
                for sys_id in seed_value:
                    if isinstance(sys_id, SysId):
                        published_sys_ids.append(sys_id)
                        continue
                    literal_sys_id = unwrap_literal_sql_value(sys_id)
                    published_sys_ids.append(literal_sys_id if isinstance(literal_sys_id, SysId) else SysId(str(literal_sys_id)))
                seeded_source_sys_ids = tuple(published_sys_ids)
                if ctx.branch_tip_materialized:
                    published_source_ref = self.matched_source_ref or ServerPlanRefId(
                        f"{self.ref_id}_matched_source_ids",
                    )
                    steps.append(
                        MatchVersionedRowsByKeyToLiteralSequenceStep(
                            published_source_ref,
                            model_cls=self.model_cls,
                            staging_ctx=sc,
                            config=_MatchVersionedRowsByKeyConfig(
                                source_field_names=("sys_id",),
                                source_rows=tuple((sys_id,) for sys_id in seeded_source_sys_ids),
                                key_field_names=("sys_id",),
                                after_refs=frozenset({ensure_ref}),
                                permission_action="delete" if user_id_ref_id is not None else "none",
                                user_id_ref_id=(
                                    user_id_ref_id
                                    if user_id_ref_id is not None
                                    else ServerPlanRefId("__system_session_permission_user_ref")
                                ),
                                permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
                                permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                else:
                    requested_count = len(seeded_source_sys_ids)
                    source_ref = None
                    cascade_source_ref_override = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_published_parent_ids")
                    steps.append(_PublishedSysIdRowsStep(cascade_source_ref_override, sys_ids=seeded_source_sys_ids))
        elif self.sys_ids:
            seeded_source_sys_ids = tuple(SysId(sys_id) for sys_id in self.sys_ids)
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_lazy_support import (
                MatchVersionedRowsByKeyToLiteralSequenceStep,
                _MatchVersionedRowsByKeyConfig,
            )

            published_source_ref = self.matched_source_ref or ServerPlanRefId(
                f"{self.ref_id}_matched_source_ids",
            )
            steps.append(
                MatchVersionedRowsByKeyToLiteralSequenceStep(
                    published_source_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    staging_ctx=sc,
                    config=_MatchVersionedRowsByKeyConfig(
                        source_field_names=("sys_id",),
                        source_rows=tuple((sys_id,) for sys_id in seeded_source_sys_ids),
                        key_field_names=("sys_id",),
                        after_refs=frozenset({ensure_ref}),
                        permission_action="delete" if user_id_ref_id is not None else "none",
                        user_id_ref_id=(
                            user_id_ref_id if user_id_ref_id is not None else ServerPlanRefId("__system_session_permission_user_ref")
                        ),
                        permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
                        permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
                    ),
                ),
            )

        delete_permission_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        if user_id_ref_id is not None and (seeded_source_sys_ids or source_ref is not None):
            delete_permission_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_validate_permission")
            permission_source: _VersionedBatchSource
            if seeded_source_sys_ids:
                permission_rows: list[_BatchSourceRow] = [
                    (index, sys_id.unwrap_to_uuid()) for index, sys_id in enumerate(seeded_source_sys_ids)
                ]
                permission_source = _VersionedBatchLiteralSource(
                    source_columns=[_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN, "sys_id"],
                    write_rows=permission_rows,
                    return_rows=permission_rows,
                )
            else:
                assert source_ref is not None
                permission_source = _VersionedBatchCteSource(
                    step_ref=source_ref,
                    source_columns=["sys_id"],
                )
            steps.append(
                _ValidateVersionedUpsertManyPermissionStep(
                    delete_permission_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    after_refs=frozenset({ensure_ref}),
                    staging_ctx=sc,
                    batch_plan=_PreparedVersionedUpsertBatchPlan(
                        source=permission_source,
                        conflict_columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
                        target_columns=[],
                        data_field_names=(),
                        data_db_columns=(),
                        column_select_exprs=(),
                        on_conflict=None,
                        do_nothing=False,
                        is_empty=False,
                    ),
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
                    config=_VersionedPermissionValidationConfig(
                        validate_payload=False,
                        existing_action="delete",
                        permission_error_message=(f"Cannot delete {self.model_cls.__name__} object(s): write permission denied"),
                    ),
                ),
            )

        matched_count_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        matched_count_source_ref = self.matched_source_ref or published_source_ref or source_ref
        if matched_count_source_ref is not None and self._config.count_execution_role is not StepExecutionRole.SQL:
            matched_count_ref = self.ref_id
            steps.append(
                _VersionedMatchedSourceCountStep(
                    matched_count_ref,
                    source_ref=matched_count_source_ref,
                ),
            )

        cleanup_sys_ids = seeded_source_sys_ids if seeded_source_sys_ids is not None else tuple(SysId(value) for value in self.sys_ids)
        if self.matched_source_ref is not None:
            cleanup_source_ref = published_source_ref
        elif cleanup_sys_ids:
            cleanup_source_ref = None
        else:
            cleanup_source_ref = published_source_ref if published_source_ref is not None else source_ref

        delete_staged_selector = _StagedCommitSelector.explicit_ids(
            staged_commit_ids=(StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),),
        )
        if source_ref is not None or sc.staged_visibility is StagedVisibility.CONNECTION:
            delete_staged_selector = _StagedCommitSelector.branch_scope(
                staged_commits_table=get_table_name(sc.domain.staged_commit_model),
                lazy_branch=sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
                branch_scope_token=sc.branch_scope_token,
                connection_id_raw=ConnectionId(sc.connection_id_raw),
            )

        subscription_source_ref = published_source_ref or source_ref
        subscription_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        if subscription_source_ref is not None:
            subscription_steps = _versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_delete_events"),
                self.model_cls,
                "DELETE",
                ctx,
                config=_VersionedPostWriteSideEffectsConfig(
                    write_ref_id=subscription_source_ref,
                    table_event_ref_id=subscription_source_ref,
                    previous_rows_ref=subscription_source_ref,
                    materialized_write_ref=False,
                ),
            )
            steps.extend(subscription_steps)
        subscription_refs = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id) for step in subscription_steps)

        # Capture event preimages before staged cleanup; delivery still follows commit.
        delete_staged_dependencies = frozenset({ensure_ref}) | self.after_refs | subscription_refs
        if delete_permission_ref is not None:
            delete_staged_dependencies |= frozenset({delete_permission_ref})
        if published_source_ref is not None:
            delete_staged_dependencies |= frozenset({published_source_ref})
        if matched_count_ref is not None:
            delete_staged_dependencies |= frozenset({matched_count_ref})
        steps.append(
            DeleteStagedForCommitStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_delete_staged"),
                SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
                sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
                delete_staged_selector,
                config=_DeleteStagedForCommitConfig(
                    sys_ids=tuple(str(sys_id) for sys_id in cleanup_sys_ids),
                    sys_ids_source_ref=cleanup_source_ref,
                ),
                publication_model_cls=self.model_cls,
                depends_on=delete_staged_dependencies,
            ),
        )

        # 3. FK enforcement (bulk — one step per FK relationship)

        fk_map = get_fk_map(sc.domain)
        fk_expansion_depth_limit = sum(len(relationships) for relationships in fk_map.values())
        model_table = get_table_name(self.model_cls)
        first_parent_sys_id = SysId(self.sys_ids[0]) if self.sys_ids else SysId("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")
        bulk_parent_sys_ids = seeded_source_sys_ids or tuple(SysId(value) for value in self.sys_ids)
        fk_idx = 0
        fk_branch_tip_materialized = (
            sc.branch_tip_materialization is BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED
        ) and ctx.branch_tip_materialized
        force_cascade_tip_source = fk_branch_tip_materialized

        def _relationships_for(
            parent_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        ) -> list[FKRelationship]:
            return _fk_relationships_for_physical_parent(fk_map, parent_model)

        def _child_data_cols(child_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]) -> list[str]:
            return _versioned_data_db_columns(
                child_model,
                excluded_fields=(
                    "sys_id",
                    "revision_id",
                    "staged_commit_id",
                    "deleted",
                    *_GRAPH_HASH32_FIELD_NAMES,
                ),
                include_generated_storage_columns=include_generated_storage_columns,
            )

        def _walk_bulk_cascade(
            parent_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
            parent_id_source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
            depth: int,
            traversed_edges: frozenset[tuple[str, str, str]] = frozenset(),
        ) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
            nonlocal fk_idx
            _require_fk_cascade_depth(depth, _FkCascadeMode.BULK, fk_expansion_depth_limit)
            emitted_refs: set[ServerPlanRefId] = set()
            relationships = _relationships_for(parent_model)
            for rel in relationships:
                on_delete = rel.on_delete.upper()
                child_model = rel.child_model
                child_table_names = get_versioned_table_names(child_model)
                child_staged = str(child_table_names.staged)
                child_tip = str(child_table_names.tip)
                child_data_cols = _child_data_cols(child_model)
                ref_prefix = f"{self.ref_id}_fk{fk_idx}"
                fk_idx += 1
                parent_value_column = SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(rel.parent_model, DynamicFieldName(rel.parent_field)))

                if on_delete == "RESTRICT":
                    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.fk_cascade_step import (
                        RestrictCheckStep,
                        _RestrictCheckConfig,
                    )

                    steps.append(
                        RestrictCheckStep(
                            ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_restrict"),
                            parent_model_cls=parent_model,
                            child_model_cls=child_model,
                            lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                            config=_RestrictCheckConfig(
                                child_fk_field=rel.child_field,
                                parent_sys_id_raw=first_parent_sys_id,
                                parent_sys_ids_raw=bulk_parent_sys_ids,
                                parent_value_column=parent_value_column,
                                parent_id_source_ref=parent_id_source_ref,
                                lazy_revision=sc.lazy_revision,
                                branch_tip_materialized=fk_branch_tip_materialized,
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                    emitted_refs.add(ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_restrict"))
                elif on_delete == "CASCADE":
                    child_id_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
                    descendant_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()
                    relationship_edge = (
                        get_table_name(parent_model),
                        get_table_name(child_model),
                        str(rel.child_field),
                    )
                    recursive_same_model = get_table_name(child_model) == get_table_name(parent_model)
                    if _relationships_for(child_model) and (recursive_same_model or relationship_edge not in traversed_edges):
                        child_id_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_child_ids")
                        steps.append(
                            _VersionedDeleteManyChildIdsStep(
                                child_id_ref,
                                child_model_cls=child_model,
                                child_fk_field=_VersionedDeleteChildFkFieldName(rel.child_field),
                                parent_sys_id_raw=first_parent_sys_id,
                                parent_id_source_ref=parent_id_source_ref,
                                staging_ctx=sc,
                                force_tip_source=force_cascade_tip_source,
                                recursive_same_model=recursive_same_model,
                                recursive_parent_value_column=(parent_value_column if recursive_same_model else None),
                            )
                        )
                        emitted_refs.add(child_id_ref)
                        if not recursive_same_model:
                            descendant_refs = _walk_bulk_cascade(
                                child_model,
                                child_id_ref,
                                depth + 1,
                                traversed_edges | frozenset({relationship_edge}),
                            )
                    cascade_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_cascade")
                    staged_cascade_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_cascade_staged")
                    cleanup_deps = descendant_refs if child_id_ref is None else frozenset({child_id_ref}) | descendant_refs
                    from l9600_graphs.graph import GraphEdge, GraphNode

                    child_event_ref = None
                    if issubclass(child_model, (GraphNode, GraphEdge)):
                        child_event_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_event_rows")
                        steps.append(
                            _VersionedDeleteManyChildIdsStep(
                                child_event_ref,
                                child_model_cls=child_model,
                                child_fk_field=_VersionedDeleteChildFkFieldName(rel.child_field),
                                parent_sys_id_raw=first_parent_sys_id,
                                parent_id_source_ref=parent_id_source_ref,
                                staging_ctx=sc,
                                force_tip_source=force_cascade_tip_source,
                                capture_rows=True,
                            )
                        )
                        cleanup_deps |= frozenset({child_event_ref})
                    cascade_config = _CascadeTombstoneConfig(
                        child_fk_field=rel.child_field,
                        parent_sys_id_raw=first_parent_sys_id,
                        parent_model_cls=parent_model,
                        parent_sys_ids_raw=bulk_parent_sys_ids,
                        staged_table_name=SqlTableName(child_staged),
                        tip_table_name=SqlTableName(child_tip),
                        data_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(name) for name in child_data_cols),
                        staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                        parent_id_source_ref=(
                            child_id_ref
                            if recursive_same_model and child_id_ref is not None and parent_value_column == SqlColumnName("sys_id")
                            else parent_id_source_ref
                            if not recursive_same_model
                            else None
                        ),
                        parent_value_source_ref=(
                            child_id_ref
                            if recursive_same_model and child_id_ref is not None and parent_value_column != SqlColumnName("sys_id")
                            else None
                        ),
                        excluded_child_id_source_ref=(parent_id_source_ref if recursive_same_model else None),
                        excluded_child_sys_id_raw=(
                            first_parent_sys_id if recursive_same_model and parent_id_source_ref is None else None
                        ),
                        parent_value_column=parent_value_column,
                        lazy_revision=sc.lazy_revision,
                        force_tip_source=force_cascade_tip_source,
                        branch_tip_materialized=fk_branch_tip_materialized,
                        staged_visibility=sc.staged_visibility,
                        staged_commit_table_name=SqlTableName(get_table_name(sc.domain.staged_commit_model)),
                        connection_id_param=SqlParam(SqlConnectionIdValue(sc.connection_id_raw)),
                        sparse_ancestor_cte_name=SqlCteName(
                            _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(self.ref_id, "cascade_ancestors"),
                        ),
                    )
                    staged_cascade_step: ServerPlanStep[Any] = DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep(
                        staged_cascade_ref,
                        child_model_cls=child_model,
                        lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                        config=cascade_config,
                    )
                    if cleanup_deps:
                        staged_cascade_step = _step_with_after_refs(staged_cascade_step, cleanup_deps)
                    cascade_step: ServerPlanStep[Any] = CascadeTombstoneStep(
                        cascade_ref,
                        child_model_cls=child_model,
                        lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                        config=cascade_config,
                    )
                    cascade_step = _step_with_after_refs(cascade_step, frozenset({staged_cascade_ref}))
                    steps.append(staged_cascade_step)
                    steps.append(cascade_step)
                    if child_event_ref is not None:
                        steps.extend(
                            _versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
                                cascade_ref,
                                child_model,
                                "DELETE",
                                ctx,
                                config=_VersionedPostWriteSideEffectsConfig(
                                    staged_commit_id=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                                    write_ref_id=cascade_ref,
                                    table_event_ref_id=child_event_ref,
                                    force_table_event_intent=True,
                                ),
                            )
                        )
                    emitted_refs.update(descendant_refs)
                    emitted_refs.add(staged_cascade_ref)
                    emitted_refs.add(cascade_ref)
                elif on_delete in ("SET NULL", "SET_NULL", "SET DEFAULT", "SET_DEFAULT"):
                    staged_setnull_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_setnull_staged")
                    setnull_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_setnull")
                    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.write_side_effect_intents import _has_matching_table_subscriptions

                    before_ref = None
                    if ctx.emit_table_event_intents and _has_matching_table_subscriptions(child_model, "UPDATE"):
                        before_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_before")
                        steps.append(
                            _VersionedDeleteManyChildIdsStep(
                                before_ref,
                                child_model_cls=child_model,
                                child_fk_field=_VersionedDeleteChildFkFieldName(rel.child_field),
                                parent_sys_id_raw=first_parent_sys_id,
                                parent_id_source_ref=parent_id_source_ref,
                                staging_ctx=sc,
                                force_tip_source=force_cascade_tip_source,
                                capture_rows=True,
                            )
                        )
                    common_config = _SetNullStagingConfig(
                        child_fk_field=rel.child_field,
                        parent_sys_id_raw=first_parent_sys_id,
                        parent_model_cls=parent_model,
                        parent_sys_ids_raw=bulk_parent_sys_ids,
                        staged_table_name=SqlTableName(child_staged),
                        tip_table_name=SqlTableName(child_tip),
                        data_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(name) for name in child_data_cols),
                        staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                        parent_id_source_ref=parent_id_source_ref,
                        parent_value_column=parent_value_column,
                        lazy_revision=sc.lazy_revision,
                        branch_tip_materialized=fk_branch_tip_materialized,
                        replacement_value=(rel.default_value if on_delete in ("SET DEFAULT", "SET_DEFAULT") else None),
                        staged_visibility=sc.staged_visibility,
                        staged_commit_table_name=SqlTableName(get_table_name(sc.domain.staged_commit_model)),
                        connection_id_param=SqlParam(SqlConnectionIdValue(sc.connection_id_raw)),
                    )
                    steps.append(
                        _step_with_after_refs(
                            SetNullMatchingStagedChildrenStep(
                                staged_setnull_ref,
                                child_model_cls=child_model,
                                lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                                config=common_config,
                            ),
                            frozenset({before_ref}) if before_ref is not None else frozenset(),
                        ),
                    )
                    steps.append(
                        SetNullStagingStep(
                            setnull_ref,
                            child_model_cls=child_model,
                            lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                            config=replace(common_config, after_refs=frozenset({staged_setnull_ref})),
                        ),
                    )
                    if before_ref is not None:
                        after_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_after")
                        steps.append(
                            _step_with_after_refs(
                                _VersionedDeleteManyChildIdsStep(
                                    after_ref,
                                    child_model_cls=child_model,
                                    child_fk_field=_VersionedDeleteChildFkFieldName("sys_id"),
                                    parent_sys_id_raw=first_parent_sys_id,
                                    parent_id_source_ref=before_ref,
                                    staging_ctx=sc,
                                    force_tip_source=force_cascade_tip_source,
                                    capture_rows=True,
                                ),
                                frozenset({setnull_ref}),
                            )
                        )
                        steps.extend(
                            _versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
                                setnull_ref,
                                child_model,
                                "UPDATE",
                                ctx,
                                config=replace(
                                    _build_versioned_post_write_side_effects_config(
                                        child_model,
                                        write_ref_id=setnull_ref,
                                        table_event_ref_id=after_ref,
                                        previous_rows_ref=before_ref,
                                    ),
                                    table_event_preimage_ref=before_ref,
                                ),
                            )
                        )
                    emitted_refs.add(staged_setnull_ref)
                    emitted_refs.add(setnull_ref)

            return frozenset(emitted_refs)

        literal_cascade_ids = (
            seeded_source_sys_ids if seeded_source_sys_ids is not None else tuple(SysId(value) for value in self.sys_ids)
        )
        cascade_source_ref = (
            cascade_source_ref_override
            if cascade_source_ref_override is not None
            else None
            if len(literal_cascade_ids) == 1
            else published_source_ref
            if published_source_ref is not None
            else source_ref
        )
        if cascade_source_ref is None and len(literal_cascade_ids) > 1:
            cascade_source_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_cascade_ids")
            steps.append(
                _PublishedSysIdRowsStep(
                    cascade_source_ref,
                    sys_ids=literal_cascade_ids,
                ),
            )
        fk_start_index = len(steps)
        _walk_bulk_cascade(self.model_cls, cascade_source_ref, 0)
        fk_dependency_refs = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id) for step in steps[fk_start_index:])

        # 4. Bulk tombstone: INSERT INTO staged from the visible matched source.
        #    The matched relation preserves both published rows and prior staged
        #    inserts before step 2 removes their old staged representations.
        base_table = get_table_name(self.model_cls)
        data_cols = _versioned_data_db_columns(
            self.model_cls,
            excluded_fields=(
                "sys_id",
                "revision_id",
                "staged_commit_id",
                "deleted",
                "created_at",
                "updated_at",
                *_GRAPH_HASH32_FIELD_NAMES,
            ),
            include_generated_storage_columns=include_generated_storage_columns,
        )

        for db_col in _collect_large_column_pointer_db_columns(self.model_cls):
            if db_col not in data_cols:
                data_cols.append(db_col)

        tombstone_ref = str(self.commit_dependency_ref_id())
        tombstone_source_ref = published_source_ref if published_source_ref is not None else source_ref
        if tombstone_source_ref is None:
            steps.append(
                _VersionedDeleteManyByIdsTombstoneStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(tombstone_ref),
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    sys_ids=(
                        seeded_source_sys_ids if seeded_source_sys_ids is not None else tuple(SysId(sys_id) for sys_id in self.sys_ids)
                    ),
                    staging_ctx=sc,
                    data_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(name) for name in data_cols),
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    after_refs=frozenset(
                        {
                            ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_delete_staged"),
                            *fk_dependency_refs,
                            *((matched_count_ref,) if matched_count_ref is not None else ()),
                        },
                    ),
                ),
            )
        else:
            steps.append(
                _VersionedDeleteManyBySourceTombstoneStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(tombstone_ref),
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    source_ref=tombstone_source_ref,
                    after_refs=frozenset(
                        {
                            ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_delete_staged"),
                            *fk_dependency_refs,
                            *((matched_count_ref,) if matched_count_ref is not None else ()),
                        },
                    ),
                    staging_ctx=sc,
                    data_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(name) for name in data_cols),
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                ),
            )

        # 5. The total delete count = staged cleanup (non-tombstone rows removed in
        #    step 2) + tombstone rows inserted from tip (step 4).
        #    Step 2 ref: {self.ref_id}_delete_staged, Step 4 ref: tombstone_ref
        if matched_count_ref is None:
            steps.append(
                _VersionedDeleteCountStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    config=_VersionedDeleteCountConfig(
                        staged_delete_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_delete_staged"),
                        tombstone_ref=ServerPlanRefId(tombstone_ref),
                        num_requested=count_cap,
                        matched_source_ref=published_source_ref,
                        side_effect_refs=fk_dependency_refs,
                        error_on_shortfall=(
                            f"Cannot delete non-existent {self.model_cls.__name__} object(s) in batch"
                            if source_ref is not None and requested_count is not None
                            else None
                        ),
                        execution_role=self._config.count_execution_role,
                    ),
                ),
            )

        event_rows_ref = published_source_ref or source_ref
        if event_rows_ref is not None:
            steps.extend(
                _versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self.model_cls,
                    "DELETE",
                    ctx,
                    config=_VersionedPostWriteSideEffectsConfig(
                        staged_commit_id=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                        write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(event_rows_ref),
                        table_event_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(event_rows_ref),
                        previous_rows_ref=ServerPlanRefId(event_rows_ref),
                        materialized_write_ref=False,
                    ),
                )
            )
        if self.after_refs:
            return [_step_with_after_refs(step, self.after_refs) for step in steps]
        return steps


class _VersionedDeleteCountStepCteRow(BaseModel):
    count: int


class _VersionedMatchedSourceCountStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[int]):
    """Materialize a matched-source count before versioned delete side effects."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref)})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=("count",),
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({"count"})),
            model_cls=_VersionedDeleteCountStepCteRow,
            relation_role="count_only",
            scalar_control_kind=ScalarControlKind.AFFECTED_COUNT,
            scalar_value_column=LockedColumnName("count"),
        )

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[int]:
        source = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._source_ref))
        assert isinstance(source, CteReference), f"{type(self).__name__} requires SQL-visible source {self._source_ref!r}."
        count_query = SqlCountQuery(SqlTableName(source.ref_id))
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=count_query,
            needs_returning=True,
            auxiliary_ctes=([(source.ref_id, source.auxiliary_query)] if source.auxiliary_query is not None else None),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
                "count",
                first_row_scalar=True,
                default_value=0,
                use_default_on_empty=True,
            ),
        )


class _VersionedDeleteCountStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[int]):
    def staging_bypass_delete_count_refs(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> StagingBypassDeleteCountRefs | None:
        return StagingBypassDeleteCountRefs(
            tombstone_ref=self._tombstone_ref,
            staged_delete_ref=self._staged_delete_ref,
        )

    """Collects delete count from staged cleanup + tombstone insert.

    The staged cleanup removes prior staged rows (including uncommitted inserts).
    The tombstone insert creates tombstones for committed objects in tip.
    The total delete count is the sum of both, capped at num_requested.
    """

    def __init__(
        self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        config: _VersionedDeleteCountConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._staged_delete_ref = config.staged_delete_ref
        self._tombstone_ref = config.tombstone_ref
        self._num_requested = config.num_requested
        self._matched_source_ref = config.matched_source_ref
        self._side_effect_refs = config.side_effect_refs
        self._error_on_shortfall = config.error_on_shortfall
        self._execution_role = config.execution_role
        self._runtime_only = config.execution_role is not StepExecutionRole.SQL

    @property
    def level(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return self._execution_role

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> bool:
        return self._execution_role is StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> bool:
        return self._runtime_only

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        if self._runtime_only:
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset({self._staged_delete_ref, self._tombstone_ref})

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("count",)
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({"count"}))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _VersionedDeleteCountStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
            scalar_control_kind=ScalarControlKind.AFFECTED_COUNT,
            scalar_value_column=LockedColumnName("count"),
        )

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> bool:
        return not self._runtime_only

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> bool:
        return not self._runtime_only

    def step_tags(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        tags = {"compute", "count"}
        if self._runtime_only:
            tags.add("runtime_projection")
        else:
            tags.add("sql_projection")
        return frozenset(tags)

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> bool | None:
        """Delete count reduces materialized child write results."""
        return False

    def emits_sql_for_accounting(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> bool | None:
        return not self._runtime_only

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_contract(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> BatchPostprocessReductionContract | None:
        return None

    def tables_read(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        raw_after_refs: object = getattr(self, "_after_refs", frozenset())
        assert isinstance(raw_after_refs, frozenset)
        after_refs = frozenset(str(ref) for ref in raw_after_refs)
        matched_source_refs = (
            frozenset({self._matched_source_ref}) if self._runtime_only and self._matched_source_ref is not None else frozenset()
        )
        return frozenset(
            {
                self._staged_delete_ref,
                self._tombstone_ref,
                *matched_source_refs,
                *self._side_effect_refs,
                *after_refs,
            },
        )

    def preprocess(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> None:
        del resolved

    def execute_runtime(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> int:
        matched_value = resolved.get(str(self._matched_source_ref)) if self._matched_source_ref is not None else None
        matched_count = None
        if matched_value is not None:
            matched_count = _versioned_delete_distinct_sys_id_count(matched_value)
            if matched_count is None:
                matched_count = _versioned_delete_count_value(matched_value)
        staged_value = resolved.get(str(self._staged_delete_ref), 0)
        tombstone_value = resolved.get(str(self._tombstone_ref), 0)
        distinct_count = (
            matched_count if matched_count is not None else _versioned_delete_distinct_sys_id_count(staged_value, tombstone_value)
        )
        logical_count = (
            distinct_count
            if distinct_count is not None
            else max(_versioned_delete_count_value(staged_value), _versioned_delete_count_value(tombstone_value))
        )
        result = min(int(self._num_requested), int(logical_count))
        if self._error_on_shortfall is not None and result != int(self._num_requested):
            raise ValueError(self._error_on_shortfall)
        return result

    def compile(self: _VersionedDeleteCountStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[int]:
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, synthetic_output_field

        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in contract.columns))
        if self._runtime_only:
            return CompiledStep(
                output_shape=output_shape,
                result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
                column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
            )

        staged_cte_ref, tombstone_cte_ref = _require_versioned_delete_count_refs(
            ctx,
            staged_delete_ref=self._staged_delete_ref,
            tombstone_ref=self._tombstone_ref,
            step_name=type(self).__name__,
        )
        staged_cte_name = staged_cte_ref.ref_id if staged_cte_ref is not None else None
        tombstone_cte_name = tombstone_cte_ref.ref_id if tombstone_cte_ref is not None else None

        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectAlias, SqlSelectList
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast, SqlFuncCall, SqlSubquery
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlCte

        def _scalar_or_count_expr(
            cte_name: str | None,
            cte_ref: CteReference | None,
        ) -> SqlRenderable:
            if cte_name is None:
                return SqlParam(0)
            scalar_column = cte_ref.scalar_value_column if cte_ref is not None else None
            scalar_kind = cte_ref.scalar_control_kind if cte_ref is not None else None
            if scalar_column is not None:
                scalar_value: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(scalar_column.to_sql_column_name())
                if scalar_kind in {ScalarControlKind.AFFECTED_COUNT, ScalarControlKind.ROW_COUNT}:
                    scalar_value = SqlFuncCall(
                        "COALESCE",
                        [SqlFuncCall("SUM", [scalar_value]), SqlParam(0)],
                    )
                scalar_select = SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList([scalar_value]),
                    from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(cte_name)),
                )
                return SqlSubquery(scalar_select)
            return SqlSubquery(SqlCountQuery(SqlTableName(cte_name)))

        provider = require_versioned_lowering_provider(ctx)
        clamp_func = provider.count_clamp_function_name()
        if (
            staged_cte_name is not None
            and tombstone_cte_name is not None
            and staged_cte_ref is not None
            and tombstone_cte_ref is not None
            and "sys_id" in (staged_cte_ref.columns or ())
            and "sys_id" in (tombstone_cte_ref.columns or ())
        ):
            union_cte_name = f"{self.ref_id}_deleted_sys_ids"
            sys_id_column = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"))
            union_query = SqlUnionAll(
                [
                    SqlSelect(
                        select=SqlSelectList([sys_id_column]),
                        from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(staged_cte_name)),
                    ),
                    SqlSelect(
                        select=SqlSelectList([sys_id_column]),
                        from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(tombstone_cte_name)),
                    ),
                ],
            )
            distinct_count = SqlFuncCall(
                "COUNT",
                [SqlDistinct(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")))],
            )
            logical_count = SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlCast(
                                SqlFuncCall(
                                    clamp_func,
                                    [SqlParam(self._num_requested), distinct_count],
                                ),
                                _BIGINT_CAST_TARGET,
                            ),
                            alias=SqlAliasName("count"),
                        ),
                    ],
                ),
                from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(union_cte_name)),
            )
            grammar: SqlRenderable = SqlCte([(union_cte_name, union_query)], logical_count)
            auxiliary_ctes = []
            for cte_ref in (staged_cte_ref, tombstone_cte_ref):
                if cte_ref.auxiliary_query is None:
                    continue
                aux_entry = (cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query)
                if aux_entry not in auxiliary_ctes:
                    auxiliary_ctes.append(aux_entry)
            return CompiledStep(
                grammar=grammar,
                needs_returning=True,
                closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
                    first_row_scalar=True,
                    default_value=0,
                    use_default_on_empty=True,
                ),
                auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes or None,
                output_shape=output_shape,
                result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
                column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
            )
        staged_expr = _scalar_or_count_expr(staged_cte_name, staged_cte_ref)
        tombstone_expr = _scalar_or_count_expr(tombstone_cte_name, tombstone_cte_ref)
        logical_delete_count = SqlCase(
            whens=((SqlBinaryOp(staged_expr, BinaryOp.GT, tombstone_expr), staged_expr),),
            else_=tombstone_expr,
        )
        grammar = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlCast(
                            SqlFuncCall(
                                clamp_func,
                                [SqlParam(self._num_requested), logical_delete_count],
                            ),
                            _BIGINT_CAST_TARGET,
                        ),
                        alias=SqlAliasName("count"),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
        )
        branch_auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
        for cte_ref in (staged_cte_ref, tombstone_cte_ref):
            if cte_ref is None or cte_ref.auxiliary_query is None:
                continue
            aux_entry = (cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query)
            if aux_entry not in branch_auxiliary_ctes:
                branch_auxiliary_ctes.append(aux_entry)
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
                first_row_scalar=True,
                default_value=0,
                use_default_on_empty=True,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=branch_auxiliary_ctes or None,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
        )
