        )

        branch_source = self._staging_ctx.literal_branch or self._staging_ctx.lazy_branch
        resolved_user_ref = (
            ServerPlanRefId(resolved_user_id.ref_id) if isinstance(resolved_user_id, CteReference) else self._user_id_ref_id
        )
        from l4000_permissions.graph_type_resolution import find_graph_types_for_model

        graph_sources = {
            graph_type: _build_versioned_batch_merged_cte(
                model_cls=graph_type,
                staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
                ctx=ctx,
                include_deleted=False,
                use_model_tables=True,
            )
            for graph_type in find_graph_types_for_model(self._staging_ctx.domain, self._model_cls)
        }
        return _compile_graph_inherited_with_ref(
            self._model_cls,
            SqlCteFieldRef(resolved_user_ref, SqlColumnName("user_id")),
            str(permission_source_name),
            action="insert",
            domain=self._staging_ctx.domain,
            version_anchor=BranchTipPermissionAnchor(
                domain=self._staging_ctx.domain,
                branch_id_sql=lower_versioned_branch_source(
                    branch_source,
                    ctx,
                    site="versioned batch upsert payload permission",
                ),
                tip_materialized=ctx.branch_tip_materialized,
                graph_sources=graph_sources,
            ),
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.upsert import (
            _upsert_permission_denied_message,
            upsert_permission_assertion_post_op,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import (
            SqlCoalesceExpr,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.predicates import sql_not
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import DeclaredResultRelation

        source_columns, source_rows, source_cte_name, use_input_ord = _resolve_versioned_batch_source(
            source=self._batch_plan.source,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_return_rows=False,
        )
        merged_cte = _build_versioned_batch_merged_cte(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_deleted=False,
        )
        shared_cte_name = _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(self.ref_id, "permission_shared_latest_staged")
        shared_staged = merged_cte.bind_shared_staged_cte(SqlGrammarKind(shared_cte_name))
        resolved_user_id = ctx.cte_refs.get(self._user_id_ref_id)
        existing_permission_filter = compile_dml_permission_filter(
            self._model_cls,
            ctx,
            action=self._existing_action,
            target_table_name=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
            table_alias="m",
            resolved_user_id=resolved_user_id,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        permission_source_name = source_cte_name or _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(
            self.ref_id,
            "permission_source",
        )
        from l4000_permissions.graph_inherited_scheme import GraphInheritedPermissionScheme
        from l4000_permissions.permission_registry import get_permission_scheme

        payload_permission_filter: SqlRenderable | None
        if not self._validate_payload:
            payload_permission_filter = None
        elif isinstance(
            get_permission_scheme(self._model_cls),
            GraphInheritedPermissionScheme,
        ):
            from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
                graph_inherited_permissions_require_filter,
            )

            requires_graph_filter = graph_inherited_permissions_require_filter(
                self._model_cls,
                domain=self._staging_ctx.domain,
                action="insert",
            )
            payload_permission_filter = (
                self._compile_graph_payload_permission_filter(
                    ctx,
                    resolved_user_id=resolved_user_id,
                    permission_source_name=SqlGrammarKind(permission_source_name),
                )
                if requires_graph_filter
                else None
            )
        elif not self._validate_payload_for_non_graph_scheme:
            payload_permission_filter = None
        else:
            payload_permission_filter = compile_dml_permission_filter(
                self._model_cls,
                ctx,
                action="insert",
                target_table_name=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
                table_alias=permission_source_name,
                resolved_user_id=resolved_user_id,
                user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
                permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
            )
        source_definition: tuple[str, SqlRenderable] | None = None
        if source_cte_name is None:
            assert source_rows is not None
            published_columns = tuple(source_columns)
            model_columns = tuple(column for column in published_columns if column != _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN)
            model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, model_columns)
            assert model_hints is not None, f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._model_cls.__name__}"
            source_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                published_columns,
                model_hints,
                SqlColumnTypeHints(
                    integer_columns=frozenset({_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN}),
                ),
            )
            source_definition = (
                permission_source_name,
                SqlRequestInputRowsQuery.from_ordered_rows(
                    columns=published_columns,
                    rows=source_rows,
                    type_hints=source_hints,
                ),
            )
        permission_join_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in self._batch_plan.conflict_columns)
        permission_uuid_columns = _versioned_postgres_uuid_columns(
            self._model_cls,
            self._batch_plan.conflict_columns,
        )
        unauthorized_queries: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        if existing_permission_filter is not None:
            unauthorized_queries.append(
                SqlVersionedBatchProjectMatchedRows(
                    merged_view=shared_staged.merged_view,
                    join_columns=list(permission_join_columns),
                    selected_columns=[("src", "sys_id")],
                    source_columns=source_columns,
                    source_rows=None,
                    postgres_uuid_columns=permission_uuid_columns,
                    source_cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(permission_source_name),
                    use_input_ord=False,
                    permission_filter=sql_not(
                        SqlCoalesceExpr(existing_permission_filter, SqlBooleanLiteral(False)),
                    ),
                ),
            )
        if payload_permission_filter is not None:
            unauthorized_queries.append(
                SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                    SqlTableName(permission_source_name),
                    columns=(SqlColumnName("sys_id"),),
                    where_conditions=(
                        sql_not(
                            SqlCoalesceExpr(payload_permission_filter, SqlBooleanLiteral(False)),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )
        permission_error_message = self._permission_error_message or _upsert_permission_denied_message(
            self._model_cls,
        )
        unauthorized_source: SqlRenderable
        if unauthorized_queries:
            unauthorized_source = SqlUnionAll(unauthorized_queries)
        else:
            unauthorized_source = SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlParam(None),
                            SqlAliasName("sys_id"),
                        ),
                    ],
                ),
                where=SqlWhereClause(SqlBooleanLiteral(False)),
            )
        permission_assertion = no_rows_assertion_query(
            unauthorized_source,
            error_message=permission_error_message,
        )
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            *(_versioned_batch_source_auxiliary_ctes(source=self._batch_plan.source, ctx=ctx) or []),
            *(collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()) or []),
        ]
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlStatementLocalWith

        grammar: SqlRenderable = SqlStatementLocalWith(
            [
                *auxiliary_ctes,
                *(() if source_definition is None else (source_definition,)),
                (shared_cte_name, shared_staged.cte_body),
            ],
            permission_assertion,
        )
        assertion_columns = ("ok", "error_code", "message")
        output_shape = output_shape_for_synthetic_columns(assertion_columns)
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            closed_post_op=upsert_permission_assertion_post_op(self._model_cls),
            auxiliary_ctes=None,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                bool_columns=frozenset({"ok"}),
                text_columns=frozenset({"error_code", "message"}),
            ),
        )


class _DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchWriteStep[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](MaybeSqlRelationPublisherStep[None]):
    """Execute one batch delete or insert phase for versioned upsert_many."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[T],
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
        staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
        phase: Literal["delete", "insert"],
        batch_plan: _PreparedVersionedUpsertBatchPlan,
        user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        isolate_from_sql_batch: bool = False,
        permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._after_refs = after_refs
        self._staging_ctx = staging_ctx
        self._phase = phase
        self._batch_plan = batch_plan
        self._user_id_ref_id = user_id_ref_id
        self._isolate_from_sql_batch = isolate_from_sql_batch
        self._permission_context_ref = permission_context_ref
        self._permission_context_type = permission_context_type

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        if self._phase == "insert" and self._batch_plan.do_nothing:
            return Cardinality.MANY
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def requires_runtime_sequential_batch(self) -> bool:
        """Keep explicitly ordered symbolic writes out of fused SQL batches."""
        return self._isolate_from_sql_batch

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return not self._isolate_from_sql_batch

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "upsert", "versioned", "batch", self._phase})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        sc = self._staging_ctx
        return frozenset({sc.staged_table_name, sc.tip_table_name})

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def provided_staged_sources(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchWriteStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        if self._batch_plan.is_empty or (self._phase == "delete" and self._batch_plan.do_nothing):
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=("sys_id",),
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"})),
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.table_projection(
                source_table=self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name,
                projection_lineage=(("sys_id", "sys_id"),),
            ),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=self.tables_written(),
        )

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._after_refs | self._owned_sql_visible_dependencies()

    def _owned_sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        user_deps = frozenset() if self._user_id_ref_id is None else frozenset({self._user_id_ref_id})
        if self._permission_context_ref is not None:
            user_deps |= frozenset({self._permission_context_ref})
        return _versioned_batch_sql_dependencies(
            source=self._batch_plan.source,
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            additional_dependencies=user_deps,
        )

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Declare every relation imported by the statement-local write program."""
        return self._owned_sql_visible_dependencies()

    def imported_dependency_refs(self) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
        user_refs = frozenset() if self._user_id_ref_id is None else frozenset({self._user_id_ref_id})
        if self._permission_context_ref is not None:
            user_refs |= frozenset({self._permission_context_ref})
        return _versioned_batch_imported_dependency_refs(
            source=self._batch_plan.source,
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            additional_dependencies=user_refs,
        )

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self._owned_sql_visible_dependencies())

    def supports_ordered_sql_statement_batch(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        """Publish authoritative inserted IDs for conflict-do-nothing writes."""
        return self._phase == "insert" and self._batch_plan.do_nothing

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        prepared = self._batch_plan
        if prepared.is_empty or (self._phase == "delete" and prepared.do_nothing):
            return self._compile_noop(ctx)
        if self._phase == "delete":
            return self._compile_delete(ctx)
        return self._compile_insert(ctx)

    def _compile_noop(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        del ctx
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        if contract.publishes_relation:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_cte_helpers import (
                SqlTypedEmptyRowsQuery,
            )

            output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
                contract,
            )
            return CompiledStep(
                grammar=SqlTypedEmptyRowsQuery(
                    columns=contract.columns,
                    type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
                ),
                needs_returning=True,
                output_shape=output_shape,
                result_relation=result_relation,
                column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
                closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            )

        __opa002_grammar_8552 = SqlNoOpStatement()
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = no_result_compiled_artifacts()
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_8552,
            closed_post_op=literal_post_op(None),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        )

    def _compile_delete(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        prepared = self._batch_plan
        assert prepared is not None, "_DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchWriteStep.compile() before preprocess()"
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import (
            SqlVersionedBatchUpsertDeleteStaged,
            SqlWithSingleCte,
        )

        source_columns, source_rows, source_cte_name, _use_input_ord = _resolve_versioned_batch_source(
            source=prepared.source,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_return_rows=False,
        )
        source_rows_obj = cast(list[tuple[object, ...]] | None, source_rows)
        merged_cte = _build_versioned_batch_merged_cte(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_deleted=True,
        )
        shared_cte_name = _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(self.ref_id, "shared_latest_staged")
        shared_staged = merged_cte.bind_shared_staged_cte(SqlGrammarKind(shared_cte_name))

        permission_filter = compile_dml_permission_filter(
            self._model_cls,
            ctx,
            action="update",
            target_table_name=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
            table_alias="m",
            resolved_user_id=ctx.cte_refs.get(self._user_id_ref_id) if ctx.cte_refs is not None and self._user_id_ref_id else None,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        identity_column = str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")))
        conflict_columns = [
            SqlColumnName("sys_id") if str(column) == identity_column else SqlColumnName(column) for column in prepared.conflict_columns
        ]
        delete_staged = SqlVersionedBatchUpsertDeleteStaged(
            staged_table=SqlTableName(self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name),
            # The staged commit id is globally unique and fully scopes this
            # replacement. Avoid carrying a lazy branch CTE into the nested
            # source subquery on SQLite.
            branch_id=None,
            staged_commit_id=self._staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw,
            merged_view=shared_staged.merged_view,
            conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
            source_columns=source_columns,
            source_rows=source_rows_obj,
            source_cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(source_cte_name) if source_cte_name is not None else None,
            permission_filter=permission_filter,
            returning=_supports_returning_clause(ctx),
            postgres_uuid_columns=_versioned_postgres_uuid_columns(
                self._model_cls,
                tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in conflict_columns),
            ),
        )
        grammar: SqlRenderable
        if conflict_columns == [SqlColumnName("sys_id")] and permission_filter is None:
            grammar = delete_staged
        else:
            grammar = SqlWithSingleCte(
                cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(shared_cte_name),
                cte_body=shared_staged.cte_body,
                inner=delete_staged,
            )
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            *(_versioned_batch_source_auxiliary_ctes(source=prepared.source, ctx=ctx) or []),
            *(collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self._owned_sql_visible_dependencies()) or []),
        ]
        if auxiliary_ctes:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlStatementLocalWith

            grammar = SqlStatementLocalWith(auxiliary_ctes, grammar)
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=_supports_returning_clause(ctx),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=literal_post_op(None),
            auxiliary_ctes=None,
        )

    def _compile_insert(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        prepared = self._batch_plan
        assert prepared is not None, "_DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchWriteStep.compile() before preprocess()"
        source_columns, source_rows, source_cte_name, _use_input_ord = _resolve_versioned_batch_source(
            source=prepared.source,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_return_rows=False,
        )
        source_rows_obj = cast(list[tuple[object, ...]] | None, source_rows)
        merged_cte = _build_versioned_batch_merged_cte(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_deleted=True,
        )
        column_select_exprs = _build_versioned_batch_column_exprs(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            data_field_names=prepared.data_field_names,
            data_db_columns=prepared.data_db_columns,
            on_conflict=prepared.on_conflict,
        )
        shared_cte_name = _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(self.ref_id, "shared_latest_staged")
        shared_staged = merged_cte.bind_shared_staged_cte(SqlGrammarKind(shared_cte_name))

        permission_filter = compile_dml_permission_filter(
            self._model_cls,
            ctx,
            action="update",
            target_table_name=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
            table_alias="m",
            resolved_user_id=ctx.cte_refs.get(self._user_id_ref_id) if ctx.cte_refs is not None and self._user_id_ref_id else None,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            *(_versioned_batch_source_auxiliary_ctes(source=prepared.source, ctx=ctx) or []),
            *(collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self._owned_sql_visible_dependencies()) or []),
        ]
        identity_column = str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")))
        conflict_columns = [
            SqlColumnName("sys_id") if str(column) == identity_column else SqlColumnName(column) for column in prepared.conflict_columns
        ]

        def _insert_statement(rows: list[tuple[object, ...]] | None) -> SqlRenderable:
            return SqlStatementLocalWith(
                [*auxiliary_ctes, (shared_cte_name, shared_staged.cte_body)],
                SqlVersionedBatchUpsertInsertStaged(
                    staged_table=SqlTableName(self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name),
                    target_columns=prepared.target_columns,
                    column_select_exprs=column_select_exprs,
                    merged_view=shared_staged.merged_view,
                    conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
                    source_columns=source_columns,
                    source_rows=rows,
                    source_cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(source_cte_name) if source_cte_name is not None else None,
                    do_nothing=prepared.do_nothing,
                    permission_filter=permission_filter,
                    returning=_supports_returning_clause(ctx),
                    postgres_uuid_columns=_versioned_postgres_uuid_columns(
                        self._model_cls,
                        tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in conflict_columns),
                    ),
                ),
            )

        grammar: SqlRenderable = _insert_statement(source_rows_obj)
        supports_returning = _supports_returning_clause(ctx)
        uses_immediate_row_count = prepared.do_nothing and not supports_returning and source_rows_obj is not None
        if uses_immediate_row_count:

            from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlFunctionName
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_compound_write import (
                SqlStatementBatch,
                SqlStatementBatchCategory,

                SqlStatementRelationshipKind,

            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_conditions import SqlInInlineList
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectList

        insert_return_filter = (
            inserted_in_this_commit
            if insert_permission_filter is None
            else SqlBinaryOp(inserted_in_this_commit, BinaryOp.AND, insert_permission_filter)
        )
        if permission_filter is not None:
            permission_filter = SqlBinaryOp(permission_filter, BinaryOp.OR, insert_return_filter)
        inserted_rows_cte: SqlCteName | None = None
        if self._inserted_rows_ref is not None:
            inserted_binding = ctx.cte_refs.get(self._inserted_rows_ref) if ctx.cte_refs is not None else None
            if isinstance(inserted_binding, CteReference):
                inserted_rows_cte = SqlCteName(inserted_binding.ref_id)

        base_contract = self._base_cte_publication_contract()
        output_columns = base_contract.columns
        identity_column = str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")))
        conflict_columns = tuple(
            SqlColumnName("sys_id") if str(column) == identity_column else column for column in prepared.conflict_columns
        )
        grammar = SqlWithSingleCte(
            cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(shared_cte_name),
            cte_body=shared_staged.cte_body,
            inner=SqlVersionedBatchUpsertReturn(
                merged_view=shared_staged.merged_view,
                conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
                source_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in source_columns),
                source_rows=None if source_rows_obj is None else tuple(source_rows_obj),
                source_cte_name=SqlCteName(source_cte_name) if source_cte_name is not None else None,
                use_input_ord=use_input_ord,
                permission_filter=permission_filter,
                do_nothing_conflict_marker=prepared.do_nothing,
                inserted_rows_cte=inserted_rows_cte,
                return_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in output_columns),
                return_column_sources={
                    SqlColumnName(identity_column): SqlColumnName("sys_id"),
                },
                authored_return_columns=prepared.authored_return_columns,
                authored_binary_return_columns=prepared.authored_binary_return_columns,
                postgres_uuid_columns=_versioned_postgres_uuid_columns(
                    self._model_cls,
                    tuple(dict.fromkeys((*conflict_columns, SqlColumnName("sys_id")))),
                ),
            ),
        )

        projected_columns = _declared_projection_columns(grammar)
        visible_return_columns = tuple(projected_columns or output_columns)
        if tuple(visible_return_columns) != tuple(output_columns):
            projected_column_set = set(visible_return_columns)
            overrides = {
                column: SqlInlineLiteral(False) if column in {_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN, "sys_deleted"} else SQL_EXPR_NULL
                for column in output_columns
                if column not in projected_column_set
            }
            return_cte_name = SqlGrammarKind(f"{str(self.ref_id).replace('.', '_')}_contract_rows")
            grammar = SqlWithSingleCte(
                cte_name=return_cte_name,
                cte_body=grammar,
                inner=SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides(
                    source_cte_name=return_cte_name,
                    source_columns=output_columns,
                    overrides=overrides,
                ),
            )
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            *(_versioned_batch_source_auxiliary_ctes(source=prepared.source, ctx=ctx) or []),
            *(collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()) or []),
        ]

        from l2070_batching.output_shape import (
            CompiledOutputShape,
            DeclaredResultRelation,
            synthetic_output_field,
        )

        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in output_columns))
        compiled: CompiledStep[list[_BatchSourceValue]] = CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=base_contract.column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes or None,
        )
        return wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns(
            compiled,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            force_inline=True,
            include_internal_sparse_columns=True,
        )

    def _compile_source_return_projection(
        self,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[list[object]]:
        source = self._batch_plan.source
        assert isinstance(source, _VersionedBatchCteSource)
        cte_ref = _resolve_versioned_batch_source_cte_binding(source=source, ctx=ctx)
        if not isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference):
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"batch source {source.step_ref!r} has no published CTE binding",
                blocked_path="versioned batch update return from runtime source rows",
                result_contract="batch update return rows must be SQL-visible",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the updated source as a CTE.",
                    "For permissioned updates, use the intent-owned filtered source.",
                    "Do not return source rows from the transaction mixin.",
                ),
            )

        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import (
            SqlAliasName,
            SqlColumnName,
            SqlTableName,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import (
            CompiledOutputShape,
            DeclaredResultRelation,
            synthetic_output_field,
        )

        output_columns = self.cte_publication_contract().columns
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
            tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in output_columns),
        )
        source_columns = frozenset(str(column) for column in (cte_ref.columns or ()))
        select_items: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        for column in output_columns:
            if column == _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN:
                select_items.append(
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlBooleanLiteral(False),
                        SqlAliasName(_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN),
                    ),
                )
            elif column in source_columns:
                select_items.append(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)))
            elif column == "sys_revision_id":
                select_items.append(
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlCast(SqlParam(None), _UUID_CAST_TARGET),
                        SqlAliasName(column),
                    ),
                )
            elif column == "sys_staged_commit_id":
                select_items.append(
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlCast(
                            SqlParam(self._staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw),
                            _UUID_CAST_TARGET,
                        ),
                        SqlAliasName(column),
                    ),
                )
            elif column == "sys_deleted":
                select_items.append(
                    SqlSelectAlias(SqlBooleanLiteral(False), SqlAliasName(column)),
                )
            else:
                select_items.append(
                    SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(None), SqlAliasName(column)),
                )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=SqlSelect(
                SqlSelectList(select_items),
                from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(cte_ref.ref_id)),
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            auxiliary_ctes=([(cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query)] if cte_ref.auxiliary_query is not None else None),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=self.cte_publication_contract().column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
        )

@_versioned_commit_effect_owner
class VersionedUpsertIntent[T](IntentStep[T]):
    """L4: Versioned upsert — pure SQL conflict detection and merging.

    Performs conflict detection, ``on_conflict`` expression evaluation,
    and instance merging entirely in SQL via INSERT ... SELECT with
    LEFT JOIN on the versioned merged view.

    Lowering produces 4 L0 steps:

    1. EnsureStagedCommitStep — idempotent staged commit record
    2. VersionedUpsertDeleteStagedStep — DELETE conflicting staged rows
    3. VersionedUpsertInsertStagedStep — INSERT INTO staged ... SELECT
       with CASE WHEN / COALESCE logic for on_conflict
    4. VersionedUpsertReturnStep — read back result from merged view
    """

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "upsert", "versioned", "intent"})

    def __init__(
        self: VersionedUpsertIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],

    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.instance = _require_seeded_config(instance, type(self).__name__)
        self._config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)
        self.staging_ctx = self._config.staging_ctx
        self.conflict_columns = _normalize_upsert_field_names(
            self._config.conflict_columns,
            context="versioned upsert conflict_columns",
        )
        self.on_conflict = _normalize_upsert_on_conflict_mapping(

            context="versioned upsert on_conflict",
        )
        self.after_refs = self._config.after_refs
        self.permission_context_ref = self._config.permission_context_ref
        self.permission_context_type = self._config.permission_context_type

    def dependencies(self: VersionedUpsertIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        context_refs = frozenset({str(self.permission_context_ref)}) if self.permission_context_ref is not None else frozenset()
        return frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in self.after_refs) | context_refs

    def tables_read(self: VersionedUpsertIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        sc = self.staging_ctx
        return frozenset({sc.staged_table_name, sc.tip_table_name})

    def tables_written(self: VersionedUpsertIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
