def _require_versioned_delete_count_refs(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    staged_delete_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    tombstone_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    step_name: str,
) -> tuple[CteReference, CteReference]:
    staged_cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(staged_delete_ref) or ctx.cte_refs.get(str(staged_delete_ref))
    tombstone_cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(tombstone_ref) or ctx.cte_refs.get(str(tombstone_ref))
    if not isinstance(staged_cte_ref, CteReference) and not isinstance(tombstone_cte_ref, CteReference):
        fused_ref = _versioned_delete_fused_child_ref(staged_delete_ref, tombstone_ref)
        if fused_ref is not None:
            fused_cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(fused_ref) or ctx.cte_refs.get(ServerPlanRefId(fused_ref))
            if isinstance(fused_cte_ref, CteReference):
                staged_cte_ref = fused_cte_ref
                tombstone_cte_ref = fused_cte_ref
    if isinstance(staged_cte_ref, CteReference) and not isinstance(tombstone_cte_ref, CteReference):
        alternate_tombstone_refs = [
            ref for key, ref in ctx.cte_refs.items() if str(key) != str(staged_delete_ref) and isinstance(ref, CteReference)
        ]
        if len(alternate_tombstone_refs) == 1:
            tombstone_cte_ref = alternate_tombstone_refs[0]
    if isinstance(staged_cte_ref, CteReference) and isinstance(tombstone_cte_ref, CteReference):
        return staged_cte_ref, tombstone_cte_ref
    available = ", ".join(sorted(str(key) for key in ctx.cte_refs))
    msg = (
        f"{step_name} requires SQL-visible child bindings for both staged delete and tombstone results. "
        f"Expected {staged_delete_ref!s} and {tombstone_ref!s}; available CTE refs: {available}"
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _versioned_delete_fused_child_ref(
    staged_delete_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    tombstone_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
) -> str | None:
    staged_text = str(staged_delete_ref)
    tombstone_text = str(tombstone_ref)
    staged_suffix = "_delete_staged"
    tombstone_suffix = "_tombstone"
    if not staged_text.endswith(staged_suffix) or not tombstone_text.endswith(tombstone_suffix):
        return None
    staged_prefix = staged_text[: -len(staged_suffix)]
    tombstone_prefix = tombstone_text[: -len(tombstone_suffix)]
    return staged_prefix if staged_prefix == tombstone_prefix else None


def _versioned_data_db_columns(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    *,
    include_generated_storage_columns: bool,
    excluded_fields: Sequence[str] = ("sys_id", "revision_id", "staged_commit_id", "deleted"),
) -> list[str]:
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import returnable_db_columns, versioned_data_field_plans

    if include_generated_storage_columns:
        columns = list(
            returnable_db_columns(
                model_cls,
                excluded_fields=excluded_fields,
                include_polymorphic=False,
            ),
        )
    else:
        columns = [
            plan.db_column
            for plan in versioned_data_field_plans(
                model_cls,
                excluded_fields=excluded_fields,
                include_polymorphic=False,
            )
        ]
    for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        logical_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column))
        columns = [column for column in columns if column != logical_column]
        pointer_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)))
        if pointer_column not in columns:
            columns.append(pointer_column)
    return columns


def _staging_branch_source_for_lowering(
    sc: VersionedStagingCtx,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
) -> Any:
    if ctx.branch_id is not None:
        return BranchId(ctx.branch_id)
    if sc.literal_branch is not None:
        return sc.literal_branch
    lazy_ref_id = sc.lazy_branch.ref_id
    if lazy_ref_id is not None:
        found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(lazy_ref_id))
        if found_seed:
            return seed_value if isinstance(seed_value, BranchId) else BranchId(str(seed_value))
    return sc.lazy_branch


def _staging_ctx_for_lowering(
    sc: VersionedStagingCtx,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
) -> VersionedStagingCtx:
    branch_source = _staging_branch_source_for_lowering(sc, ctx)
    common_columns = sc.common_columns
    if not should_include_generated_storage_columns(ctx):
        common_columns = [column for column in common_columns if column not in _GRAPH_HASH32_FIELD_NAMES]
    if branch_source is sc.lazy_branch and common_columns == sc.common_columns:
        return sc
    return VersionedStagingCtx(
        staged_model=sc.staged_model,
        tip_model=sc.tip_model,
        common_columns=common_columns,
        type_ids=sc.type_ids,
        lazy_branch=branch_source,
        staged_commit_id_raw=sc.staged_commit_id_raw,
        domain=sc.domain,
        connection_id_raw=sc.connection_id_raw,
        session_id_raw=sc.session_id_raw,
        lazy_revision=sc.lazy_revision,
        branch_tip_materialization=sc.branch_tip_materialization,
        staged_visibility=sc.staged_visibility,
        branch_scope_token=sc.branch_scope_token,
        literal_branch=branch_source if isinstance(branch_source, BranchId) else sc.literal_branch,
        sparse_table_name_value=sc.sparse_table_name_value,
    )

    if ctx.lazy_revision is None:

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import lower_scalar_server_ref

    revision_source = lower_scalar_server_ref(ctx.lazy_revision, cast("CompilationContext", ctx))
    return cast("RevisionId | SqlRenderable | None", revision_source)


def _compile_sparse_revision_source_from_staging(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    sc: VersionedStagingCtx,
) -> RevisionId | SqlRenderable | None:
    sparse_revision_source = _compile_sparse_revision_source(ctx)
    if sparse_revision_source is not None:
        return sparse_revision_source
    if sc.lazy_revision is None:
        return None
    return cast("RevisionId | SqlRenderable | None", lower_scalar_server_ref(sc.lazy_revision, ctx))


def _lower_sparse_revision_source(ctx: LoweringContext) -> object | None:
    if ctx.revision_id is not None:
        revision: object = RevisionId(ctx.revision_id)
        return revision
    lazy_revision: object | None = ctx.lazy_revision
    return lazy_revision


def _staging_revision_dependencies(sc: VersionedStagingCtx) -> frozenset[str]:
    if sc.lazy_revision is None:
        return frozenset()
    return lazy_param_deps(sc.lazy_revision)


def _discard_compiled_result[T](compiled: CompiledStep[T]) -> CompiledStep[None]:
    return cast(
        CompiledStep[None],
        replace(cast(CompiledStep[Any], compiled), closed_post_op=literal_post_op(None)),
    )


type _BatchScalarValue = str | int | float | bool | bytes | UUID | date | datetime | time | timedelta | Decimal | None
type _BatchJsonValue = _BatchScalarValue | list["_BatchJsonValue"] | dict[str, "_BatchJsonValue"]
type _BatchParamValue = _BatchScalarValue | _BatchJsonValue
type _DeclaredModelValue = _BatchParamValue | BaseModel


def _declared_model_values(row: BaseModel) -> dict[str, _DeclaredModelValue]:
    """Read storage fields under ``docs/NER1540_BATCH_RETURN_CONTRACT.rst``."""
    return {field_name: getattr(row, field_name) for field_name in type(row).model_fields}


def _explicit_batch_return_row_values(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    row: object,
    backend_type: BackendType,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    if isinstance(row, DatabaseObjectRow):
        row_model_cls = type(row)
        values = _declared_model_values(row)
    elif isinstance(row, BaseModel):
        row_model_cls = model_cls
        values = _declared_model_values(row)
    elif isinstance(row, Mapping):
        row_model_cls = model_cls
        values = dict(row)
    else:
        msg = f"explicit batch return row must be a model or mapping, got {type(row).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    serialized = serialize_json_fields(row_model_cls, values, backend_type=backend_type)
    return {get_db_column_name(row_model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)): value for field_name, value in serialized.items()}


def _typed_explicit_batch_return_param(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    column: str,
    value: object,
    *,
    backend_type: BackendType,
) -> SqlParam:
    def _param(param_value: object, type_name: str | None = None) -> SqlParam:
        node = SqlParam(param_value) if type_name is None else SqlParam(param_value, SqlTypeName(type_name))
        assert isinstance(node, SqlParam)
        return node

    if dml_parameter_transport_for_backend(backend_type) is not DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
        return _param(value)

    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import (
        postgres_storage_cast_type_for_writable_field,
        writable_field_plans,
    )

    for field_plan in writable_field_plans(
        model_cls,
        include_polymorphic=is_polymorphic_class(model_cls),
    ):
        if field_plan.field_name != column and field_plan.db_column != column:
            continue
        cast_type = postgres_storage_cast_type_for_writable_field(field_plan)
        if cast_type == "UUID":
            return _param(value, cast_type)
        break
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return _param(value, "BOOLEAN")
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return _param(value, "BIGINT")
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return _param(value, "DOUBLE PRECISION")
    if isinstance(value, dict | list):
        return _param(value, "JSONB")
    return _param(value)


def _explicit_batch_return_rows_query(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    rows: Sequence[object],
    backend_type: BackendType,
    staged_commit_id_raw: object,
    additional_columns: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> SqlRenderable:
    from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import model_sql_column_type_hints

    if not rows:
        msg = "explicit batch return query requires at least one row"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    row_dicts = [_explicit_batch_return_row_values(model_cls=model_cls, row=row, backend_type=backend_type) for row in rows]
    row_dicts = [
        {
            **row_values,
            "sys_revision_id": None,
            "sys_staged_commit_id": staged_commit_id_raw,
            "sys_deleted": False,
            _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN: False,
        }
        for row_values in row_dicts
    ]
    columns = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            (
                *_versioned_application_raw_columns(model_cls),
                *additional_columns,
                *(column for row_values in row_dicts for column in row_values),
            ),
        ),
    )
    type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, columns)
    bool_columns = frozenset({_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN})
    if type_hints is not None:
        bool_columns = frozenset({*type_hints.bool_columns, _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN})
    queries = [
        SqlSelectExpressions(
            [
                (
                    _typed_explicit_batch_return_param(model_cls, column, row_values.get(column), backend_type=backend_type),
                    column,
                )
                for column in columns
            ],
            jsonb_columns=None if type_hints is None else type_hints.jsonb_columns,
            timestamptz_columns=None if type_hints is None else type_hints.timestamptz_columns,
            uuid_columns=None if type_hints is None else type_hints.uuid_columns,
            bool_columns=bool_columns,
            integer_columns=None if type_hints is None else type_hints.integer_columns,
            bigint_columns=None if type_hints is None else type_hints.bigint_columns,
            double_columns=None if type_hints is None else type_hints.double_columns,
        )
        for row_values in row_dicts
    ]
    if len(queries) == 1:
        return queries[0]
    return SqlUnionAll(queries)


def _versioned_permission_resolution_steps(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    *,
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    cache_scope: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[ServerPlanStep[Any]], ServerPlanRefId | None]:
    """Resolve ``session_id -> user_id`` before versioned permission checks."""

    if ctx.session_id is None or not ctx.permission_filtering_enabled:
        return [], None
    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_cls)
    if permission_plan is not None and not permission_plan.requires_user_id:
        return [], None

    cache_key = "permission_session_user_resolution_ref"
    if cache_scope is not None:
        cache_key = f"{cache_key}:{cache_scope}"
    cached_ref = ctx._lowering_cache.get(cache_key)
    if isinstance(cached_ref, ServerPlanRefId):
        return [], cached_ref

    session_ref = ctx.session_id if isinstance(ctx.session_id, ScalarServerRef) else ServerRefs.scalar(SessionId(str(ctx.session_id)))
    user_id_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_resolve_uid")
    if not after_refs:
        ctx._lowering_cache[cache_key] = user_id_ref_id
    return (
        cast(
            list[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
            [
                SessionUserIdStep(
                    user_id_ref_id,
                    cast("ScalarServerRef[Any]", session_ref),
                    after_refs=after_refs,
                ),
            ],
        ),
        user_id_ref_id,
    )


def _build_versioned_select_one_raw_config(
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None = None,
    branch_id: str | None,
    user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    permission_bypass: bool = False,
    include_deleted: bool = False,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
) -> Any:
    """Build the raw select-one config expected by ``VersionedSelectOneRawStep``."""

    branch_shape: PlanningServerValueShape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
        staging_ctx.lazy_branch,
        site="_build_versioned_select_one_raw_config.branch",
    )
    branch_ref_id = branch_shape.symbolic_ref_id
    effective_branch_id = branch_id
    if effective_branch_id is None:
        effective_branch_id = _unwrap_runtime_str(staging_ctx.literal_branch)
    if effective_branch_id is None and not isinstance(staging_ctx.lazy_branch, ServerRef):
        effective_branch_id = _unwrap_runtime_str(staging_ctx.lazy_branch)
    type_ids = tuple(staging_ctx.type_ids) if staging_ctx.type_ids is not None else None
    common_columns = tuple(staging_ctx.common_columns)
    if model_cls is not None:
        concrete_type_names = _concrete_polymorphic_subtype_names(model_cls)
        if concrete_type_names is not None:
            type_ids = concrete_type_names
        from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_field_helper import (
            get_all_select_columns,
        )

        family_columns: list[str] = []
        for field_name in get_all_select_columns(model_cls):
            try:
                db_column = str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
            except (AttributeError, ValueError):
                db_column = field_name
            if db_column not in family_columns:
                family_columns.append(db_column)
        common_columns = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                (
                    *(column for column in common_columns if column in family_columns),
                    *family_columns,
                ),
            ),
        )
    return _RawVersionedSelectOneConfig(
        staged_table_name=SqlTableName(staging_ctx.staged_table_name),
        tip_table_name=SqlTableName(staging_ctx.tip_table_name),
        common_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(name) for name in common_columns),
        branch_id=effective_branch_id,
        branch_ref_id=None if branch_ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(branch_ref_id),
        branch_scope_token=staging_ctx.branch_scope_token,
        type_ids=type_ids,
        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
        permission_bypass=permission_bypass,
        include_deleted=include_deleted,
        permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
        permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
        after_refs=after_refs,
    )


def _concrete_polymorphic_subtype_names(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> tuple[Any, ...] | None:
    model_table = get_table_name(model_cls)
    for base in model_cls.__mro__[1:]:
        if not getattr(base, "__polymorphic__", False):
            continue
        try:
            base_table = get_table_name(base)
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        if base_table != model_table:
            continue
        registered = getattr(base, "__polymorphic_registered_subtypes__", ())
        if model_cls in registered:
            type_names = collect_polymorphic_type_names(model_cls)
            return tuple(type_names) if type_names else None
    return None


def _normalize_upsert_field_name(value: _UpsertFieldIdentifier, *, context: str) -> str:
    """Normalize a versioned upsert field identifier to a field-name string."""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    field_name = getattr(value, "name", None)
    if isinstance(field_name, str):
        return field_name
    msg = f"{context} must be str or typed field/column, got {type(value).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _normalize_upsert_field_names(
    values: Sequence[_UpsertFieldIdentifier] | None,
    *,
    context: str,
) -> list[str] | None:
    """Normalize versioned upsert field identifiers."""
    if values is None:
        return None
    return [_normalize_upsert_field_name(value, context=f"{context}[{idx}]") for idx, value in enumerate(values)]


def _normalize_upsert_on_conflict_mapping(
    values: Mapping[_UpsertFieldIdentifier, object] | None,
    *,
    context: str,
) -> dict[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None:
    """Normalize and validate versioned upsert assignments at the API boundary."""
    if values is None:
        return None
    normalized: dict[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] = {}
    for index, (key, value) in enumerate(values.items()):
        if not isinstance(value, (Expression, _NamedFieldRef)):
            msg = f"{context}[{index}] must be an expression or typed field, got {type(value).__name__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        normalized[_normalize_upsert_field_name(key, context=f"{context}[{index}]")] = value
    return normalized


def _widen_upsert_mapping[V](
    values: Mapping[str, V] | None,
) -> dict[_UpsertFieldIdentifier, V] | None:
    """Widen normalized string keys for the typed-field-compatible config boundary."""
    if values is None:
        return None
    widened: dict[_UpsertFieldIdentifier, V] = {}
    widened.update(values)
    return widened


def _normalize_batch_on_conflict_mapping(
    values: Mapping[_UpsertFieldIdentifier, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None,
    *,
    context: str,
) -> dict[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None:
    """Normalize batch upsert ``on_conflict`` keys and keep narrow value types."""
    if values is None:
        return None
    return {_normalize_upsert_field_name(key, context=f"{context}[{idx}]"): value for idx, (key, value) in enumerate(values.items())}


def _build_staging_steps(
    ref_prefix: str,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    instance: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId],
    sc: VersionedStagingCtx,
    *,
    backend_type: BackendType,
    branch_source: VersionedBranchSource | None = None,
    delete_existing: bool,
    ensure_staged_commit: bool,
    explicit_return_value: object = _UNSET_COMPILE_VALUE,
) -> tuple[list[ServerPlanStep[Any]], DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]:
    """Build the common staging steps shared by insert and update intents.

    The staged replacement receives ``ref_prefix`` as its ref_id (the canonical
    ref_id for the intent). This keeps downstream refs stable while allowing
    backends to choose the physical write shape.

    Returns (steps, normalized_instance) where steps contains:

    1. EnsureStagedCommitStep
    2. ReplaceStagedRowsIntent (delete old staged row if needed, then insert
       replacement rows while preserving the Python return value)
    """
    branch = branch_source if branch_source is not None else sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch
    sys_id_list, normalized, pre_dumped = dedup_inserts(model_cls, [instance])
    prepared = normalized[0]
    columns, tuples = build_staging_columns_and_tuples(
        normalized,
        model_cls,
        sc.staged_model,
        branch,
        sc.staged_commit_id_raw,
        common_columns=sc.common_columns,
        pre_dumped=pre_dumped,
        backend_type=backend_type,
    )
    tuples, spill_steps = spill_large_columns_from_tuples(
        model_cls,
        columns,
        tuples,
        ref_prefix,
        backend_type=backend_type,
    )

    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = list(spill_steps)
    staged_write_after_refs = {ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id) for step in spill_steps}

    if ensure_staged_commit:
        ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_ensure_staged_commit")
        staged_write_after_refs.add(ensure_ref)
        steps.append(
            EnsureStagedCommitStep(
                ensure_ref,
                sc.domain,
                branch,
                config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(sc),
            ),
        )

    steps.append(
        ReplaceStagedRowsIntent(
            ServerPlanRefId(ref_prefix),
            config=_ReplaceStagedRowsConfig(
                staged_model=sc.staged_model,
                branch_id=coerce_versioned_branch_ref(branch),
                literal_branch_id=branch if isinstance(branch, BranchId) else None,
                staged_commit_id=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                branch_scope_token=sc.branch_scope_token,
                sys_ids=tuple(SysId(str(sys_id)) for sys_id in sys_id_list) if delete_existing else (),
                columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in columns),
                rows=tuple(tuples),
                db_column_source=sc.staged_model,
                return_value=(
                    dict(zip(columns, tuples[0], strict=True)) if explicit_return_value is _UNSET_COMPILE_VALUE else explicit_return_value
                ),
                after_refs=frozenset(staged_write_after_refs),
            ),
        ),
    )

    return steps, prepared


def _build_staging_steps_many(
    ref_prefix: str,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    instances: Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    sc: VersionedStagingCtx,

    branch = branch_source if branch_source is not None else sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch
    payload, normalized = prepare_versioned_staging_payload_from_instances(
        model_cls,

        instances,
        branch,
        sc.staged_commit_id_raw,
        common_columns=sc.common_columns,

def _build_staging_steps_from_payload(
    ref_prefix: str,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    sc: VersionedStagingCtx,
    payload: PreparedVersionedStagingPayload,
    *,
    branch_source: VersionedBranchSource | None = None,
    delete_existing: bool,
    ensure_staged_commit: bool,
    change_detection_columns: tuple[str, ...] = (),
    isolate_from_sql_batch: bool = False,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Build staged replacement steps from an already-shaped payload."""
    branch = branch_source if branch_source is not None else sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch
    spill_steps = build_large_column_spill_steps(
        model_cls,
        payload.spill_plan,
        write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(ref_prefix),
    )
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = list(spill_steps)
    staged_write_after_refs = {ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id) for step in spill_steps}
    if ensure_staged_commit:
        ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_ensure_staged_commit")
        staged_write_after_refs.add(ensure_ref)
        steps.append(
            EnsureStagedCommitStep(
                ensure_ref,
                sc.domain,
                branch,
                config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(sc),
            ),
        )
    steps.append(
        ReplaceStagedRowsIntent(
            ServerPlanRefId(ref_prefix),
            config=_ReplaceStagedRowsConfig(
                staged_model=sc.staged_model,
                branch_id=coerce_versioned_branch_ref(branch),
                literal_branch_id=branch if isinstance(branch, BranchId) else None,
                staged_commit_id=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                branch_scope_token=sc.branch_scope_token,
                sys_ids=tuple(SysId(str(sys_id)) for sys_id in payload.sys_ids) if delete_existing else (),
                columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in payload.columns),
                rows=payload.rows,
                db_column_source=sc.staged_model,
                return_value=payload.return_value,
                raw_row_facts=payload.raw_row_facts,
                change_detection_columns=change_detection_columns,
                after_refs=frozenset(staged_write_after_refs),
                isolate_from_sql_batch=isolate_from_sql_batch,
            ),
        ),
    )
    return steps


def _versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    event_type: Literal["INSERT", "UPDATE", "UPSERT", "DELETE"],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    *,
    write_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    config: _VersionedPostWriteSideEffectsConfig | None = None,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Attach post-write side effects for versioned staging writes."""
    if config is not None and not config.emit_side_effects:
        return []
    if config is None and not _has_versioned_post_write_side_effects(
        model_cls,
        event_type,
        emit_table_event_intents=ctx.emit_table_event_intents,
    ):
        return []

    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    from l9600_graphs.dynamic_types import DynamicTypeSchema

    configured_write_ref = None if config is None else config.write_ref_id
    configured_table_event_ref = None if config is None else config.table_event_ref_id
    configured_table_event_completion_ref = None if config is None else config.table_event_completion_ref_id
    configured_table_event_after_refs = frozenset() if config is None else config.table_event_after_refs
    configured_previous_rows_ref = None if config is None else config.previous_rows_ref
    table_event_preimage_ref = None if config is None else config.table_event_preimage_ref
    table_event_previous_rows_ref = config.table_event_previous_rows_ref or configured_previous_rows_ref if config is not None else None
    configured_materialized_write_ref = None if config is None else config.materialized_write_ref
    configured_branch_id = None if config is None else config.branch_id
    side_effect_write_ref = ServerPlanRefId(write_ref_id or configured_write_ref or ref_id)
    materialized_write_ref = (
        configured_materialized_write_ref if configured_materialized_write_ref is not None else not ctx.has_returning_clause
    )
    visible_side_effect_write_ref = ServerPlanRefId(ref_id) if materialized_write_ref else side_effect_write_ref
    table_event_write_ref = ServerPlanRefId(configured_table_event_ref or visible_side_effect_write_ref)
    table_event_type: Literal["INSERT", "UPDATE", "UPSERT", "DELETE"] = event_type

    if event_type != "DELETE" and model_cls is DynamicTypeSchema:
        metadata = None if config is None else config.dynamic_schema_metadata
        if metadata is None:
            msg = "DynamicTypeSchema versioned side effects require concrete post-write metadata during lowering."
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        metadata_dependency_ref = ctx.resolve_lowered_effect_ref(ServerPlanRefId(ref_id))
        if metadata_dependency_ref == ServerPlanRefId(ref_id):
            metadata_dependency_ref = side_effect_write_ref
        steps.append(
            _RegisterDynamicSchemaPolymorphicMetadataStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_register_dynamic_schema_metadata"),
                source_ref=metadata_dependency_ref,
                metadata=metadata,
            ),
        )
    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    publishes_table_events = (
        not table_name.startswith("sys_")
        and getattr(
            model_cls,
            "__subscription_notifications__",
            True,
        )
        is not False
    )
    if (
        (config is not None and config.force_table_event_intent)
        or (publishes_table_events and table_event_type == "UPSERT")
        or write_side_effect_intents._has_matching_table_subscriptions(model_cls, table_event_type)
        or write_side_effect_intents._has_matching_staged_table_subscriptions(model_cls, table_event_type)
    ):
        writer_steps, writer_ref = write_side_effect_intents.subscription_writer_steps(ctx, ref_id)
        steps.extend(writer_steps)
        steps.append(
            _TableEventSubscriptionLifecycleStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_subscription_dispatch"),
                model_cls,
                _TableEventSubscriptionLifecycleConfig(
                    event_type=table_event_type,
                    visible_rows_ref=table_event_write_ref,
                    writer_ref=writer_ref,
                    staged_commit_id=config.staged_commit_id if config is not None else None,
                    replayable_visible_rows=(config.table_event_relation_replayable if config is not None else False),
                    old_rows_ref=(
                        table_event_preimage_ref or table_event_previous_rows_ref or table_event_write_ref
                        if table_event_type == "UPDATE"
                        else None
                    ),
                    completion_ref=configured_table_event_completion_ref,
                    after_refs=configured_table_event_after_refs,
                    literal_rows=(() if config is None else config.source_rows),
                    capture_mutation_rows=(ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_result_transport is not DmlResultTransport.RETURNING_RELATION),
                    branch_id=(
                        configured_branch_id
                        if configured_branch_id is not None
                        else BranchId(ctx.branch_id)
                        if ctx.branch_id is not None
                        else ctx.lazy_branch
                    ),
                    allow_sql_batch_transport=(
                        (config.table_event_relation_replayable if config is not None else False)
                        or ctx.backend_profile.traits.table_event_lifecycle_transport
                        is TableEventLifecycleTransport.ORDERED_BATCH_RUNTIME
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )

    staged_remote_publication = (
        ctx.backend_profile.traits.versioned_staging_transport is VersionedStagingTransport.SAME_STATEMENT_RELATION
        and getattr(model_cls, "__staged_cross_process_notifications__", False) is True
    )
    notification_table_exists = ctx.cached_table_exists(SqlTableName("sys_notifications"))
    if staged_remote_publication and notification_table_exists is not False:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import get_versioned_staging_ctx

        staging_ctx = get_versioned_staging_ctx(model_cls, ctx)
        if staging_ctx is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Cross-process staged publication requires versioned staging identity")
        steps.append(
            write_side_effect_intents._TransactionalTableNotificationStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_staged_remote_notification"),
                model_cls,
                table_event_type,
                table_event_write_ref,
                relation_contract=write_side_effect_intents._exact_notification_relation_contract(model_cls),
                old_rows_ref=(configured_previous_rows_ref if table_event_type in {"UPDATE", "UPSERT"} else None),
                staged_branch_id=(configured_branch_id if configured_branch_id is not None else staging_ctx.lazy_branch),
                staged_commit_id=str(
                    config.staged_commit_id
                    if config is not None and config.staged_commit_id is not None
                    else staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw
                ),
                graph_routes=write_side_effect_intents._exact_graph_notification_routes(model_cls),
                executor_materialized=(
                    not (config.table_event_relation_replayable if config is not None else False)
                    or ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_result_transport is not DmlResultTransport.RETURNING_RELATION
                ),
            ),
        )

    if table_event_type in {"UPDATE", "DELETE"} and configured_previous_rows_ref is not None:
        from l5000_subscriptions.cross_process import cross_process_runtime_active

        if cross_process_runtime_active():
            steps.append(
                _TableEventSubscriptionLifecycleStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_remote_{table_event_type.lower()}_wake"),
                    model_cls,
                    _TableEventSubscriptionLifecycleConfig(
                        event_type=table_event_type,
                        visible_rows_ref=configured_previous_rows_ref,
                        remote_only=True,
                        branch_id=(
                            configured_branch_id
                            if configured_branch_id is not None
                            else BranchId(ctx.branch_id)
                            if ctx.branch_id is not None
                            else ctx.lazy_branch
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            )

    if event_type != "DELETE" and get_fts_config(model_cls) is not None:
        fts_operation: Literal["insert", "update"] = "insert" if event_type == "INSERT" else "update"
        steps.extend(
            MaintainFtsIndexIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_fts_polyfill"),
                model_cls,
                _MaintainFtsIndexConfig(
                    operation=fts_operation,
                    write_ref_id=visible_side_effect_write_ref,
                    literal_rows=(() if config is None else config.source_rows),
                ),
            ).lower(ctx),
        )

    emit_embedding_auto_queue = True if config is None else config.emit_embedding_auto_queue
    embedding_source_rows = () if config is None else config.source_rows
    if emit_embedding_auto_queue and _configured_vector_indexes(model_cls):
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.embedding_auto_queue_intent import (
            EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent,
            _EmbeddingAutoQueueConfig,
        )

        steps.extend(
            EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_embedding_queue"),
                model_cls,
                config=_EmbeddingAutoQueueConfig(
                    write_ref_id=side_effect_write_ref,
                    event_type=event_type,
                    after_refs=(frozenset({visible_side_effect_write_ref}) if embedding_source_rows else frozenset()),
                    previous_rows_ref=configured_previous_rows_ref,
                    materialized_write_ref=materialized_write_ref,
                    source_rows=embedding_source_rows,
                ),
            ).lower(ctx),
        )

    return steps


_VERSIONED_POST_WRITE_SIDE_EFFECTS_CACHE: dict[
    tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], str, bool],
    bool,
] = {}
_VERSIONED_POST_WRITE_SIDE_EFFECTS_CACHE_LOCK = Lock()


def _has_versioned_post_write_side_effects(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    event_type: Literal["INSERT", "UPDATE", "UPSERT", "DELETE"],
    *,
    emit_table_event_intents: bool,
) -> bool:
    cache_key = (model_cls, event_type, emit_table_event_intents)
    with _VERSIONED_POST_WRITE_SIDE_EFFECTS_CACHE_LOCK:
        cached = _VERSIONED_POST_WRITE_SIDE_EFFECTS_CACHE.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached
    from l9600_graphs.dynamic_types import DynamicTypeSchema

    result = event_type != "DELETE" and model_cls is DynamicTypeSchema
    result = result or emit_table_event_intents
    result = result or getattr(model_cls, "__staged_cross_process_notifications__", False) is True
    result = result or (event_type != "DELETE" and get_fts_config(model_cls) is not None)
    result = result or bool(_configured_vector_indexes(model_cls))
    with _VERSIONED_POST_WRITE_SIDE_EFFECTS_CACHE_LOCK:
        if len(_VERSIONED_POST_WRITE_SIDE_EFFECTS_CACHE) >= 512:
            _VERSIONED_POST_WRITE_SIDE_EFFECTS_CACHE.clear()
        _VERSIONED_POST_WRITE_SIDE_EFFECTS_CACHE[cache_key] = result
    return result


_VERSIONED_BATCH_DATA_COLUMNS_CACHE: LocalMetadataCache[tuple[tuple[str, ...], tuple[SqlColumnName, ...]]] = LocalMetadataCache(
    name="schema_artifact:versioned_batch_data_columns",
    max_entries=512,
    invalidation_policy=LocalMetadataInvalidationPolicy.SCHEMA_GENERATION,
)


def _known_model_updates[UpdatesItemT](
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    updates: Mapping[str, UpdatesItemT],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    model_fields = cached_model_fields(model_cls)
    return {field_name: value for field_name, value in updates.items() if field_name in model_fields}


def _collect_versioned_batch_data_columns(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
) -> tuple[list[str], list[SqlColumnName]]:
    """Collect writable versioned data fields and their DB column names."""
    data_field_names, data_db_columns = _collect_versioned_batch_data_columns_cached(model_cls)
    return list(data_field_names), list(data_db_columns)


def _versioned_physical_models(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
) -> tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...]:
    """Return the registered model family owned by one physical table policy."""
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import (
        collect_physical_table_model_field_maps,
        table_root_class,
    )

    table_root = table_root_class(model_cls)
    candidates = (
        (table_root, model_cls)
        if table_root is not None and table_root is not model_cls
        else tuple(
            candidate
            for candidate, _fields in collect_physical_table_model_field_maps(
                model_cls,
            )
        )
    )
    models: list[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]] = []
    for candidate in candidates:
        if not issubclass(candidate, DatabaseObjectRow):
            msg = f"Physical table model {candidate.__name__} for {model_cls.__name__} is not a DatabaseObjectRow"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        models.append(candidate)
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(models))


def _collect_versioned_batch_data_columns_for_source(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    source_columns: Sequence[str] | None,
) -> tuple[list[str], list[SqlColumnName], list[str]]:
    """Return CTE-backed batch columns without asking for unpublished source fields."""
    data_field_names, data_db_columns = _collect_versioned_batch_data_columns(model_cls)
    fields_by_db_column = dict(zip(data_db_columns, data_field_names, strict=True))
    for source_model in _versioned_physical_models(model_cls):
        source_field_names, source_db_columns = _collect_versioned_batch_data_columns(source_model)
        for field_name, db_column in zip(source_field_names, source_db_columns, strict=True):
            prior_field = fields_by_db_column.get(db_column)
            if prior_field is not None and prior_field != field_name:
                msg = (
                    f"Physical column {db_column!s} maps to both {prior_field!r} and "
                    f"{field_name!r} in the {model_cls.__name__} model family"
                )
                raise ValueError(msg)
            fields_by_db_column[db_column] = field_name
    data_db_columns = list(fields_by_db_column)
    data_field_names = [fields_by_db_column[db_column] for db_column in data_db_columns]
    if source_columns is None:
        return data_field_names, data_db_columns, ["sys_id", *data_db_columns]

    source_column_set = set(source_columns)
    filtered_pairs = [
        (field_name, db_column)
        for field_name, db_column in zip(data_field_names, data_db_columns, strict=True)
        if db_column in source_column_set
    ]
    filtered_field_names = [field_name for field_name, _db_column in filtered_pairs]
    filtered_db_columns = [db_column for _field_name, db_column in filtered_pairs]
    resolved_source_columns: list[str] = [
        column
        for column in source_columns
        if column == _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN or column == "sys_id" or column in set(filtered_db_columns)
    ]
    return filtered_field_names, filtered_db_columns, resolved_source_columns


def _collect_versioned_batch_data_columns_cached(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], tuple[SqlColumnName, ...]]:
    """Collect writable versioned data fields and their DB column names."""
    cache_key = f"{model_cls.__module__}.{model_cls.__qualname__}:{id(model_cls)}"
    cached = _VERSIONED_BATCH_DATA_COLUMNS_CACHE.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import versioned_data_field_plans

    field_plans = tuple(versioned_data_field_plans(model_cls, include_polymorphic=True))
    field_columns = {plan.field_name: plan.db_column for plan in field_plans}
    data_field_names: list[str] = [plan.field_name for plan in field_plans if plan.field_name not in _GRAPH_HASH32_FIELD_NAMES]

    staged_model_fields = set(getattr(model_cls, "model_fields", {}).keys())
    if getattr(model_cls, "__polymorphic__", False):
        if "type_name" not in data_field_names and "type_name" in staged_model_fields:
            data_field_names.append("type_name")
    for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        for field_name in (str(config.column), large_column_pointer_name(config.column)):
            if field_name not in data_field_names:
                data_field_names.append(field_name)
    result = (
        tuple(data_field_names),
        tuple(
            SqlColumnName(
                field_columns[field_name] if field_name in field_columns else get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            )
            for field_name in data_field_names
        ),
    )
    _VERSIONED_BATCH_DATA_COLUMNS_CACHE.set(
        cache_key,
        result,
        tags=[schema_global_tag()],
    )
    return result


def _deps_with_after_refs(base_deps: frozenset[str] | set[str], after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]) -> frozenset[str]:
    return frozenset(base_deps) | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in after_refs)


def _step_with_after_refs[T: ServerPlanStep[Any]](step: T, after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]) -> T:
    if after_refs:
        existing: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] | tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = getattr(
            step,
            "_after_refs",
            frozenset(),
        )
        assert isinstance(existing, (frozenset, tuple)), (
            f"{type(step).__name__} stores _after_refs as {type(existing).__name__}, expected frozenset or tuple"
        )
        merged = frozenset(existing) | after_refs
        if isinstance(existing, tuple):
            object.__setattr__(step, "_after_refs", tuple(sorted(merged, key=str)))
        else:
            object.__setattr__(step, "_after_refs", merged)
    return step


def _anchor_intent_after_refs[StepsItemT](
    steps: Sequence[ServerPlanStep[StepsItemT]],
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    if not after_refs or not steps:
        return steps
    anchored = list(steps)
    anchored[0] = _DependencyRemapStep(anchored[0], after_refs)
    return anchored


class _DependencyRemapStep[T](MaybeSqlRelationPublisherStep[T]):
    """Delegate a lowered step while rewriting dependency refs."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        step: ServerPlanStep[T],
        extra_deps: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
        *,
        replace_deps: Mapping[ServerPlanRefId, ServerPlanRefId] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(step.ref_id)
        self._step = step
        self._extra_deps = extra_deps
        self._replace_deps = dict(replace_deps or {})

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = set(self._step.dependencies())
        for old_ref, new_ref in self._replace_deps.items():
            old_text = str(old_ref)
            if old_text in deps:
                deps.remove(old_text)
                deps.add(str(new_ref))
        deps.update(str(ref) for ref in self._extra_deps)
        return frozenset(deps)

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = set(self._step.sql_visible_dependencies())
        for old_ref, new_ref in self._replace_deps.items():
            old_text = str(old_ref)
            if old_text in deps:
                deps.remove(old_text)
                deps.add(str(new_ref))
        return frozenset(deps)

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return self._step.level

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        if self._step.level == 0:
            return [self]
        return [
            _DependencyRemapStep(
                step,
                self._extra_deps,
                replace_deps=self._replace_deps,
            )
            for step in self._step.lower(ctx)
        ]

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[T]:
        if not self._replace_deps:
            return self._step.compile(ctx)
        remapped_cte_refs = dict(ctx.cte_refs)
        for old_ref, new_ref in self._replace_deps.items():
            replacement = ctx.cte_refs.get(new_ref)
            if replacement is not None:
                remapped_cte_refs[old_ref] = replacement
        return self._step.compile(replace(ctx, cte_refs=remapped_cte_refs))

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return self._step.result_cardinality()

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self) -> bool:
        declares = getattr(self._step, "declares_consumed_rows_reduction", None)
        if callable(declares):
            return bool(declares())
        return bool(declares)

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._step.tables_read()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._step.tables_written()

    def write_key_facts(self, planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None) -> frozenset[WriteKeyFact]:
        return self._step.write_key_facts(planning_catalog)

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _DependencyRemapStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        """Preserve the wrapped producer's complete publication contract."""
        return self._step.cte_publication_contract()

    def publication_result_ref(self: _DependencyRemapStep) -> ServerPlanRefId | None:
        """Preserve the wrapped producer's exact result relation identity."""
        return self._step.publication_result_ref()

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return self._step.publishes_executor_visible_binding()

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return self._step.always_publishes_executor_visible_binding()

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return self._step.consumes_executor_visible_dependencies()

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return self._step.supports_sql_batch_transport()

    def requires_runtime_sequential_batch(self) -> bool:
        return self._step.requires_runtime_sequential_batch()

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self) -> bool:
        return self._step.requires_materialized_inputs()

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return self._step.requires_prior_step_boundary()

    def emits_sql_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return self._step.emits_sql_for_accounting()

    def cte_rewritable_read_tables(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._step.cte_rewritable_read_tables()

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return self._step.is_read_only()

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return self._step.execution_role()

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._step.step_tags()

    def internal_plan_ref_state(self) -> PlanPayloadState:
        return self._step.internal_plan_ref_state()


class _TakeFirstResolvedItemStep[T](NonPublishingStep[T]):
    """Project the first item from a resolved list result."""

    def collection_passthrough_source_ref(
        self,
        expected_terminal_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> ServerPlanRefId | None:
        if self.ref_id != expected_terminal_ref:
            return None
        return self._source_ref

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]] | None = None,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._original_source_ref = source_ref
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._after_refs = after_refs

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"project", "first"})

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = {str(self._source_ref)}
        if self._original_source_ref != self._source_ref:
            deps.add(str(self._original_source_ref))
        return _deps_with_after_refs(deps, self._after_refs)

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[T]:
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import (
            CompiledOutputShape,
            DeclaredResultRelation,
            synthetic_output_field,
        )

        source_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._source_ref))
        if source_cte is None and self._original_source_ref != self._source_ref:
            source_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._original_source_ref))
        if not isinstance(source_cte, CteReference):
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"first-item projection for {self._source_ref!r} without a published CTE",
                blocked_path="runtime-ref list indexing in post-op",
                result_contract="versioned singleton returns must select their first row from SQL",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the batch result as a SQL-visible CTE.",
                    "Compile first-item selection as SELECT ... LIMIT 1 over that CTE.",
                    "Do not read Python runtime_refs to choose the first item.",
                ),
            )
        if not source_cte.columns:
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"first-item projection for {self._source_ref!r} without declared CTE columns",
                blocked_path="SELECT * projection without a declared ServerPlan output shape",
                result_contract="versioned singleton returns must expose an explicit SQL result relation",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the batch child result with concrete CTE output columns.",
                    "Compile first-item selection with those columns.",
                    "Do not recover by hydrating an unshaped runtime row.",
                ),
            )
        output_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in source_cte.columns)
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in output_columns))
        if source_cte.column_type_hints is None:
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"first-item source {self._source_ref!r} has no SQL column type hints",
                blocked_path="untyped first-item projection fallback",
                result_contract="first-item projections must preserve complete SQL column type hints.",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the source CTE with column_type_hints.",
                    "Filter hints to the first-item output columns before materialization.",
                    "Do not infer first-item result types from runtime row values.",
                ),
            )
        column_type_hints = source_cte.column_type_hints.filtered(set(output_columns)).require_complete(output_columns)
        result_relation = DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape)
        return cast(
            "CompiledStep[T]",
            CompiledStep(
                grammar=SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                    from_table=SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id),
                    columns=[SqlColumnName(column) for column in output_columns],
                    limit=1,
                ),
                needs_returning=True,
                auxiliary_ctes=([(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else None),
                output_shape=output_shape,
                column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
                result_relation=result_relation,
                closed_post_op=optional_single_row_post_op(
                    self._model_cls,
                ),
            ),
        )


class _DedupeVersionedUpdateManyResultStep[T](NonPublishingStep[list[T]]):
    """Project update-many results to one row per object, preferring staged rows."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"project", "dedupe", "runtime_projection", "versioned", "update_many"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref)})

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[T]]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> list[T]:
        source = resolved.get(str(self._source_ref))
        if source is None:
            msg = (
                f"Missing versioned update-many result source {self._source_ref!r}; "
                f"available={tuple(sorted(str(key) for key in resolved))!r}"
            )
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(source, Sequence) or isinstance(source, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
            return cast("list[T]", source if isinstance(source, list) else [])
        by_sys_id: dict[object, object] = {}
        order: list[object] = []
        for row in source:
            sys_id = getattr(row, "sys_id", None)
            if sys_id is None and isinstance(row, Mapping):
                sys_id = row.get("sys_id")
            if sys_id is None:
                order.append(id(row))
                by_sys_id[id(row)] = row
                continue
            if sys_id not in by_sys_id:
                order.append(sys_id)
            by_sys_id[sys_id] = row
        return cast("list[T]", [by_sys_id[key] for key in order])


class _ConcatVersionedBulkResultChunksStep[T](NonPublishingStep[list[T]]):
    """Concatenate bounded bulk-operation chunks in their original input order."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_refs = source_refs

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def is_executor_owned_runtime_step(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"project", "runtime_projection", "versioned", "bulk", "chunk_concat"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._source_refs)

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[T]]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> list[T]:
        rows: list[T] = []
        for source_ref in self._source_refs:
            value = resolved.get(str(source_ref), ())
            if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
                rows.extend(cast("Sequence[T]", value))
        return rows

    )

def _build_sql_native_raw_staged_insert_steps(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    sc: VersionedStagingCtx,
    branch: VersionedBranchSource,
    columns: Sequence[str],
    rows: object,
    db_column_source: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
    raw_row_facts: RawRowFacts | None = None,
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    isolate_from_sql_batch: bool = False,
    publish_literal_relation: bool = False,
    change_detection_columns: tuple[str, ...] = (),
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Build staged-table writes from raw rows without prepared staging payloads."""
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import StaticValueAfterDepsStep

    field_names = normalize_versioned_raw_field_names(model_cls, columns, db_column_source)
    if "sys_id" not in field_names:
        msg = "Versioned raw staged inserts require a sys_id column"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_ensure_staged_commit")

    raw_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}.raw")
    if isinstance(rows, DeferredRawRowSource):
        projected_count = rows.row_count or 0
    else:
        projected_count = len(_require_raw_row_sequence(rows))
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
        EnsureStagedCommitStep(
            ensure_ref,
            sc.domain,
            branch,
            config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(sc),
        ),
        _VersionedRawStagedInsertSqlStep(
            raw_ref,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            staging_ctx=sc,
            branch=branch,
            field_names=field_names,
            rows=rows,
            raw_row_facts=raw_row_facts,
            isolate_from_sql_batch=isolate_from_sql_batch,
            change_detection_columns=change_detection_columns,
            after_refs=frozenset({ensure_ref, *after_refs}),
            sqlite_returns_rows=False,
        ),
    ]
    if change_detection_columns:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_lazy_support import ResolvedLenStep

        steps.append(
            ResolvedLenStep(
                ref_id,
                source_ref=str(raw_ref),
                after_refs=frozenset({raw_ref}),
            ),
        )
    else:
        steps.append(
            StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                ref_id,
                projected_count,
                [str(raw_ref)],
                publish_literal_relation=publish_literal_relation,
            ),
        )
    return steps


def _require_raw_row_sequence(rows: object) -> Sequence[Sequence[object]]:
    if not isinstance(rows, Sequence):
        msg = "Versioned raw staged inserts require a reusable sequence of raw rows"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return cast("Sequence[Sequence[object]]", rows)


def _raw_staged_key_part(value: object) -> str:
    unwrap_to_uuid = getattr(value, "unwrap_to_uuid", None)
    if callable(unwrap_to_uuid):
        return str(unwrap_to_uuid())
    unwrap_to_str = getattr(value, "unwrap_to_str", None)
    if callable(unwrap_to_str):
        return str(unwrap_to_str())
    return str(value)


def _coalesce_literal_raw_rows_by_sys_id(
    field_names: Sequence[str],
    rows: Sequence[Sequence[object]],
    *,
    raw_row_facts: RawRowFacts | None = None,
) -> Sequence[Sequence[object]]:
    try:
        sys_id_index = tuple(field_names).index("sys_id")
    except ValueError:
        return rows

    facts_prove_literal_ids = (
        raw_row_facts is not None and not raw_row_facts.has_symbolic_cells and not raw_row_facts.has_runtime_bind_slots
    )
    coalesced: dict[str, Sequence[object]] = {}
    for row in rows:
        if facts_prove_literal_ids:
            key_value = row[sys_id_index]
        else:
            sys_id_fact = raw_cell_fact(row[sys_id_index])
            if sys_id_fact.symbolic_key is not None or sys_id_fact.has_deferred_bind_slot:
                return rows
            key_value = sys_id_fact.param_value
        coalesced[_raw_staged_key_part(key_value)] = row
    if len(coalesced) == len(rows):
        return rows
    return tuple(coalesced.values())


def _model_source_rows_for_side_effects(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    *,
    columns: Sequence[str],
    rows: object,
    db_column_source: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
) -> tuple[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId], ...]:
    field_names = normalize_versioned_raw_field_names(model_cls, columns, db_column_source)
    return tuple(
        cast("Any", model_cls).model_construct(
            **{field_name: value for field_name, value in zip(field_names, row, strict=True)},
        )
        for row in _require_raw_row_sequence(rows)
    )


def _build_raw_row_facts(rows: object) -> RawRowFacts | None:
    if isinstance(rows, DeferredRawRowSource):
        return None
    if not isinstance(rows, Sequence) or isinstance(rows, str | bytes):
        return None

    return build_raw_row_facts(cast("Sequence[Sequence[object]]", rows))


def _raw_row_dependencies(rows: object, raw_row_facts: RawRowFacts | None = None) -> frozenset[str]:
    if isinstance(rows, DeferredRawRowSource):
        return frozenset({str(rows.source_ref)})
    facts = raw_row_facts or _build_raw_row_facts(rows)
    return frozenset() if facts is None else facts.dependency_refs


def _raw_source_rows_for_side_effects(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    *,
    columns: Sequence[str],
    rows: object,
    db_column_source: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
) -> tuple[tuple[object, ...], ...]:
    field_names = normalize_versioned_raw_field_names(model_cls, columns, db_column_source)
    raw_rows = _require_raw_row_sequence(rows)
    coalesced_rows = _coalesce_literal_raw_rows_by_sys_id(field_names, raw_rows)
    return tuple(tuple(row) for row in coalesced_rows)
