    def compile(self: UpsertManyRawStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[Any]:
        """Compile multi-row INSERT ... ON CONFLICT for raw column/row data."""

        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
            map_python_columns_to_db_columns_from_plan,
            resolve_conflict_db_columns_from_plan,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._projected_row_source import (
            auxiliary_ctes_for_raw_row_dependencies,
            build_postgres_raw_bulk_rows,
            build_projected_row_select,
            has_symbolic_row_cells,
            postgres_raw_bulk_column_types,
        )
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlTypeName
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_compound_write import (
            SqlStatementBatch,
            SqlStatementBatchCategory,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_upsert import SqlUpsertExcludedValue
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.identifier_fragments import SqlColumnRef
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
            SqlColumnList,
            SqlOnConflict,
            SqlPlaceholderRows,
            SqlReturningClause,
            SqlSelectAlias,
            SqlSetItem,
            SqlValuesSource,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import ConflictAction
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlInlineLiteral
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlInsert
        from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.mutation_grammar import compile_mutation_spec
        from l2060_query_builder.plan_composition import param, query, table as plan_table, unnest, write

        table = SqlTableName(self._table_name)

        db_source = self._db_column_source
        source_write_plan = self._write_plan(ctx, db_source)
        model_write_plan = source_write_plan if db_source is self._model_cls else self._write_plan(ctx, self._model_cls)
        db_columns = map_python_columns_to_db_columns_from_plan(source_write_plan, self._columns)

        col_list = SqlColumnList(
            [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(c)) for c in db_columns],
        )

        conflict_cols_raw = resolve_conflict_db_columns_from_plan(
            model_write_plan,
            self._conflict_columns,
        )
        _require_declared_unique_conflict_target(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            planning_catalog=require_planning_catalog(ctx, site="UpsertManyRawStep.compile"),
            write_plan=model_write_plan,
            conflict_columns=conflict_cols_raw,
        )
        conflict_cols = map_python_columns_to_db_columns_from_plan(source_write_plan, conflict_cols_raw)
        change_detection_cols = map_python_columns_to_db_columns_from_plan(
            source_write_plan,
            self._change_detection_columns,
        )
        missing_change_detection_cols = [column for column in change_detection_cols if column not in db_columns]
        if missing_change_detection_cols:
            msg = f"Change detection columns not in provided columns: {missing_change_detection_cols}"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        rows = list(self._rows)
        row_facts = self.raw_row_facts()
        conflict_positions = _conflict_key_positions(db_columns, conflict_cols)
        if len(rows) > 1 and conflict_positions is not None:
            seen: dict[tuple[Any, ...], int] = {}
            for idx, row in enumerate(rows):
                key = _row_plan_conflict_key(row, conflict_positions)
                seen[key] = idx
            if len(seen) < len(rows):
                rows = [rows[i] for i in sorted(seen.values())]
                from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps import _raw_row_facts

                row_facts = _raw_row_facts.build_raw_row_facts(rows)

        dialect = ctx.sql_render_dialect()
        custom_update = _build_custom_update(
            self._model_cls,
            self._on_conflict,
            db_column_source=db_source,
        )
        custom_update = _substitute_do_nothing_with_noop_update(custom_update, conflict_cols)
        conflict_where = _build_change_detection_conflict_where(
            table_name=SqlTableName(self._table_name),
            columns=change_detection_cols,
        )

        exclude_from_update: set[str] = set(conflict_cols) | {"sys_id"}
        update_col_names: list[str] = [c for c in db_columns if c not in exclude_from_update]
        mysql_change_detection_set_items = (
            _build_mysql_change_detection_set_items(
                table_name=SqlTableName(self._table_name),
                update_col_names=update_col_names,
                change_detection_cols=change_detection_cols,
            )
            if dialect.uses_on_duplicate_key_syntax()
            else None
        )
        if mysql_change_detection_set_items is not None:
            conflict_where = None

        count_returning_columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*conflict_cols, "sys_id")))[:1]
        returning_columns = (
            self._explicit_return_columns()
            if self._return_value is not _UNSET or self._staged_write is not None
            else count_returning_columns
        )
        existing_return_columns = (
            set(db_columns) if self._return_value is not _UNSET or self._staged_write is not None else set(returning_columns)
        )

        def _returning_projection(column: str) -> SqlRenderable:
            if column == _STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN:
                return SqlSelectAlias(SqlInlineLiteral(False), SqlAliasName(column))
            if column in existing_return_columns:
                return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column))
            return SqlSelectAlias(SqlInlineLiteral(None), SqlAliasName(column))

        returning = SqlReturningClause([_returning_projection(column) for column in returning_columns])
        supports_returning = dialect.supports_insert_returning()
        json_columns: frozenset[str] = frozenset(
            {
                *(field_plan.db_column for field_plan in source_write_plan.field_plans if field_plan.is_json),
                *(field_plan.db_column for field_plan in model_write_plan.field_plans if field_plan.is_json),
            }
        )
        postgres_json_columns: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
        postgres_h14_columns: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
            from impl.common.l2300_json_serialization.json_serialization import get_json_columns

            type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, tuple(db_columns))
            postgres_json_column_set = set(get_json_columns(self._model_cls))
            postgres_json_column_set.update(json_columns)
            if type_hints is not None:
                postgres_json_column_set.update(type_hints.jsonb_columns)
            postgres_json_columns = frozenset(postgres_json_column_set)
            postgres_h14_columns = frozenset(
                field_plan.db_column
                for write_plan in (source_write_plan, model_write_plan)
                for field_plan in write_plan.field_plans
                if field_plan.postgres_h14_code
            )

        def _upsert_param(column: str, value: object) -> object:
            if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is not DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
                from l1000_schema.json_type import to_json_sql_param_value

                return to_json_sql_param_value(value, is_json_column=column in json_columns)
            if column in postgres_h14_columns and isinstance(value, bytes):
                return "".join(f"{byte:08b}" for byte in value)
            if column not in postgres_json_columns or value is None:
                return value
            if isinstance(value, JSONType):
                return value.unwrap_to_sql()
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_params.sql_param_normalization import normalize_postgres_json_bind_value

            return normalize_postgres_json_bind_value(value)

        def _normalized_rows_for_binding[BatchItemT](batch: list[tuple[BatchItemT, ...]]) -> list[tuple[Any, ...]]:
            return [tuple(_upsert_param(column, value) for column, value in zip(db_columns, row, strict=True)) for row in batch]

        def _should_use_bound_values[BatchItemT](batch: Sequence[tuple[BatchItemT, ...]]) -> bool:
            return should_use_bound_values_transport(
                ctx.backend_type,
                len(db_columns),
                batch,
                bulk_transport=ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_bulk_transport,
            )

        def _build_conflict() -> tuple[Any, tuple[Any, ...] | None, tuple[Any, ...] | None]:
            set_items: tuple[Any, ...] | None = None
            update_columns_arg: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...] | None = None
            action = ConflictAction.DO_UPDATE
            if custom_update is not None and len(custom_update) == 0:
                action = ConflictAction.DO_NOTHING
            elif custom_update is not None:
                set_items = tuple(
                    SqlSetItem(
                        SqlColumnName(col),
                        SqlUpsertExcludedValue(SqlColumnName(col)) if expr is None else expr,
                    )
                    for col, expr in custom_update
                )
            elif mysql_change_detection_set_items is not None:
                set_items = mysql_change_detection_set_items
            else:
                update_columns_arg = tuple(coerce_sql_column_name(column) for column in update_col_names)
            return action, set_items, update_columns_arg

        def _build_stmt[BatchItemT](
            batch: list[tuple[BatchItemT, ...]],
            *,
            include_returning: bool,
            parameter_cast_types: Sequence[str] | None = None,
        ) -> tuple[SqlInsert, tuple[Any, ...]]:
            action, set_items, update_columns_arg = _build_conflict()
            uuid_cast_indices = (
                frozenset(index for index, cast_type in enumerate(parameter_cast_types) if cast_type.upper() == "UUID")
                if parameter_cast_types is not None
                else frozenset()
            )
            json_cast_indices = (
                frozenset(index for index, column in enumerate(db_columns) if column in postgres_json_columns)
                if parameter_cast_types is not None
                else frozenset()
            )
            stmt = SqlInsert(
                table=table,
                columns=col_list,
                values=SqlValuesSource(
                    SqlPlaceholderRows(
                        columns=len(db_columns),
                        rows=len(batch),
                        uuid_cast_indices=uuid_cast_indices,
                        json_cast_indices=json_cast_indices,
                    ),
                ),
                on_conflict=SqlOnConflict(
                    tuple(coerce_sql_column_name(column) for column in conflict_cols),
                    action,
                    set_items=set_items,
                    where=conflict_where,
                    update_columns=update_columns_arg,
                ),
                returning=returning if include_returning else None,
            )
            assert isinstance(stmt, SqlInsert)
            batch_params = tuple(_upsert_param(column, value) for row in batch for column, value in zip(db_columns, row, strict=True))
            return stmt, batch_params

        def _build_unnest_upsert(
            *,
            array_params: Sequence[object],
            column_types: Sequence[str],
            include_returning: bool,
        ) -> SqlRenderable:
            bulk_rows = unnest(
                *(param(array_param) for array_param in array_params),
                types=tuple(SqlTypeName(column_type) for column_type in column_types),
                columns=tuple(db_columns),
                alias="__bulk_src",
            )
            insert_builder = (
                write(plan_table(self._model_cls))
                .insert()
                .columns(*db_columns)
                .from_query(query(bulk_rows).project(*(bulk_rows.column(column) for column in db_columns)))
            )
            if custom_update is not None and len(custom_update) == 0:
                insert_builder.on_conflict_do_nothing(*conflict_cols)
            elif custom_update is not None:
                insert_builder.on_conflict_update(
                    *conflict_cols,
                    set={
                        column: SqlUpsertExcludedValue(SqlColumnName(column)) if expr is None else expr for column, expr in custom_update
                    },
                )
            else:
                insert_builder.on_conflict_update_columns(
                    *conflict_cols,
                    update_columns=tuple(update_col_names),
                )
            if conflict_where is not None:
                insert_builder.on_conflict_where(conflict_where)
            if include_returning:
                insert_builder.returning(*(_returning_projection(column) for column in returning_columns))
            compiled_mutation = compile_mutation_spec(
                insert_builder.to_mutation_spec(),
                compilation_context=ctx,
            )
            return compiled_mutation

        from l1000_schema.schema_def import DatabaseObjectRow

        needs_returning = supports_returning and (self._return_value is _UNSET or self._staged_write is not None)
        uses_effective_row_count = False
        closed_post_op = (
            exact_single_row_post_op()
            if self._staged_write is not None and self._return_value is not _UNSET
            else literal_post_op(materialize_explicit_return_value(self._return_value))
            if self._return_value is not _UNSET
            else CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_SCALAR,
                ),
            )
        )
        grammar: SqlRenderable
        params: tuple[Any, ...] | None
        params = None
        auxiliary_ctes = None
        column_types = None
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_bulk_transport is DmlBulkTransport.PAYLOAD_AWARE_BOUND_VALUES and rows:
            column_types = postgres_raw_bulk_column_types(
                self._model_cls,
                db_columns,
                write_plan=model_write_plan,
            )
        if column_types is not None:
            row_source = build_postgres_raw_bulk_rows(
                rows=_normalized_rows_for_binding(rows),
                db_columns=db_columns,
                column_types=column_types,
                ctx=ctx,
                row_facts=row_facts,
            )
            action, set_items, update_columns_arg = _build_conflict()
            can_use_bound_values_transport = True
            prefer_values_transport = (
                self._return_value is not _UNSET and can_use_bound_values_transport and not self._isolate_from_sql_batch
            )
            if row_source.array_params is not None:
                row_chunks = _chunk_rows_by_payload_byte_budget(rows)
                if prefer_values_transport:
                    if len(row_chunks) > 1:
                        values_statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
                        values_params_per_stmt: list[tuple[Any, ...] | None] = []
                        values_needs_returning_per_stmt: list[bool] = []
                        for chunk in row_chunks:
                            chunk_stmt, chunk_params = _build_stmt(
                                chunk,
                                include_returning=needs_returning,
                                parameter_cast_types=(column_types if self._after_refs else None),
                            )
                            values_statements.append(chunk_stmt)
                            values_params_per_stmt.append(chunk_params)
                            values_needs_returning_per_stmt.append(needs_returning)
                        grammar = SqlStatementBatch(
                            values_statements,
                            category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.BUDGET_SPLIT,
                            params_per_stmt=values_params_per_stmt,
                            external_params_first=[True] * len(values_statements),
                            needs_returning_per_stmt=values_needs_returning_per_stmt,
                        )
                    else:
                        grammar, params = _build_stmt(
                            rows,
                            include_returning=needs_returning,
                            parameter_cast_types=(column_types if self._after_refs else None),
                        )
                elif len(row_chunks) > 1:
                    if (
                        self._return_value is _UNSET
                        and can_use_bound_values_transport
                        and all(_should_use_bound_values(chunk) for chunk in row_chunks)
                    ):
                        needs_returning = False
                    statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
                    params_per_stmt: list[tuple[Any, ...] | None] = []
                    external_params_first: list[bool] = []
                    needs_returning_per_stmt: list[bool] = []
                    for chunk in row_chunks:
                        if prefer_values_transport and _should_use_bound_values(chunk):
                            chunk_stmt, chunk_params = _build_stmt(
                                chunk,
                                include_returning=needs_returning,
                            )
                            statements.append(chunk_stmt)
                            params_per_stmt.append(chunk_params)
                            external_params_first.append(True)
                            needs_returning_per_stmt.append(needs_returning)
                            continue
                        if not needs_returning and can_use_bound_values_transport and _should_use_bound_values(chunk):
                            chunk_stmt, chunk_params = _build_stmt(
                                chunk,
                                include_returning=False,
                            )
                            statements.append(chunk_stmt)
                            params_per_stmt.append(chunk_params)
                            external_params_first.append(True)
                            needs_returning_per_stmt.append(False)
                            uses_effective_row_count = self._return_value is _UNSET
                            continue
                        chunk_source = build_postgres_raw_bulk_rows(
                            rows=chunk,
                            db_columns=db_columns,
                            column_types=column_types,
                            ctx=ctx,
                            row_facts=row_facts,
                        )
                        assert chunk_source.array_params is not None
                        statements.append(
                            _build_unnest_upsert(
                                array_params=chunk_source.array_params,
                                column_types=chunk_source.column_types,
                                include_returning=needs_returning,
                            ),
                        )
                        params_per_stmt.append(None)
                        external_params_first.append(False)
                        needs_returning_per_stmt.append(needs_returning)
                    needs_returning = any(needs_returning_per_stmt)
                    grammar = SqlStatementBatch(
                        statements,
                        category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.BUDGET_SPLIT,
                        params_per_stmt=params_per_stmt,
                        external_params_first=external_params_first,
                        needs_returning_per_stmt=needs_returning_per_stmt,
                    )
                elif not needs_returning and can_use_bound_values_transport and _should_use_bound_values(rows):
                    grammar, params = _build_stmt(rows, include_returning=False)
                    needs_returning = False
                    uses_effective_row_count = self._return_value is _UNSET
                else:
                    grammar = _build_unnest_upsert(
                        array_params=row_source.array_params,
                        column_types=row_source.column_types,
                        include_returning=needs_returning,
                    )
            else:
                assert row_source.select_source is not None
                grammar = SqlInsert(
                    table=table,
                    columns=col_list,
                    values=row_source.select_source,
                    on_conflict=SqlOnConflict(
                        tuple(coerce_sql_column_name(column) for column in conflict_cols),
                        action,
                        set_items=set_items,
                        where=conflict_where,
                        update_columns=update_columns_arg,
                    ),
                    returning=returning if needs_returning else None,
                )
                auxiliary_ctes = auxiliary_ctes_for_raw_row_dependencies(
                    ctx=ctx,
                    row_facts=row_facts,
                )
        else:
            if has_symbolic_row_cells(rows, row_facts=row_facts):
                if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_bulk_transport is DmlBulkTransport.PAYLOAD_AWARE_BOUND_VALUES:
                    msg = (
                        "SQL-native symbolic raw upserts require explicit bulk column SQL types; "
                        f"could not determine array types for columns {tuple(self._columns)!r} "
                        f"on {self._db_column_source.__name__}."
                    )
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                action, set_items, update_columns_arg = _build_conflict()
                grammar = SqlInsert(
                    table=table,
                    columns=col_list,
                    values=build_projected_row_select(
                        rows=_normalized_rows_for_binding(rows),
                        db_columns=db_columns,
                        ctx=ctx,
                        row_facts=row_facts,
                    ),
                    on_conflict=SqlOnConflict(
                        tuple(coerce_sql_column_name(column) for column in conflict_cols),
                        action,
                        set_items=set_items,
                        where=conflict_where,
                        update_columns=update_columns_arg,
                    ),
                    returning=returning if needs_returning else None,
                )
                params = None
                auxiliary_ctes = auxiliary_ctes_for_raw_row_dependencies(
                    ctx=ctx,
                    row_facts=row_facts,
                )
            else:
                grammar, params = _build_stmt(rows, include_returning=needs_returning)
        if not needs_returning:
            closed_post_op = (
                exact_single_row_post_op()
                if self._staged_write is not None and self._return_value is not _UNSET
                else literal_post_op(materialize_explicit_return_value(self._return_value))
                if self._return_value is not _UNSET
                else literal_post_op(len(rows))
            )
        elif uses_effective_row_count:
            closed_post_op = CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_SCALAR,
                ),
            )

        explicit_return_columns = (
            self._explicit_return_columns()
            if needs_returning and (self._return_value is not _UNSET or self._staged_write is not None)
            else None
        )
        compiled_output_shape = None
        compiled_type_hints = None
        if explicit_return_columns is not None:
            from l2070_batching.planning_catalog import output_shape_for_synthetic_columns

            compiled_output_shape = output_shape_for_synthetic_columns(explicit_return_columns)
            hint_model_cls = self._explicit_return_model_cls()
            model_return_columns = tuple(column for column in explicit_return_columns if column != _STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN)
            model_type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(hint_model_cls, model_return_columns)
            compiled_type_hints = (
                None
                if model_type_hints is None
                else combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    explicit_return_columns,
                    model_type_hints,
                    framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
                    SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({_STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN})),
                ).require_complete(explicit_return_columns)
            )
        elif self._return_value is _UNSET:
            from l2070_batching.planning_catalog import output_shape_for_synthetic_columns

            compiled_output_shape = output_shape_for_synthetic_columns(returning_columns)
            compiled_type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, returning_columns)

        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            params=params,
            needs_returning=needs_returning,
            external_params_first=False,
            closed_post_op=closed_post_op,
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
            output_shape=compiled_output_shape,
            result_relation=(
                DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(compiled_output_shape) if compiled_output_shape is not None else None
            ),
            column_type_hints=compiled_type_hints,
        )

def _require_non_versioned_upsert_many_model(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> None:
    if "staged_commit_id" not in model_cls.model_fields:
        return
    msg = "UpsertManyRawResultStep cannot compile for versioned models yet"
    raise NotImplementedError(msg)


def _require_concrete_upsert_many_instances(instances: object) -> Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow]:
    from l2055_lazy_result.lazy_result import LazyResult
    from l2070_batching.server_ref import ObjectSequenceServerRef

    if isinstance(instances, (LazyResult, ObjectSequenceServerRef)):
        msg = (
            "UpsertManyRawResultStep.compile() no longer resolves lazy/server payloads from "
            "compile-time materialization; rebuild bulk upsert on explicit prerequisite refs"
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    resolved_instances = cast("Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow]", instances)
    if not any(collect_instance_deps(instance) for instance in resolved_instances):
        return resolved_instances
    msg = (
        "UpsertManyRawResultStep.compile() no longer resolves embedded ServerRef values from "
        "compile-time materialization; publish prerequisite refs before bulk upsert compile()."
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_literal_assignment_override_count(
    literal_assignment_overrides: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]] | None,
    row_plans: Sequence[_ResolvedWriteRowPlan],
) -> None:
    if literal_assignment_overrides is None or len(literal_assignment_overrides) == len(row_plans):
        return
    msg = (
        "literal_assignment_overrides must match the resolved upsert row count: "
        f"rows={len(row_plans)}, overrides={len(literal_assignment_overrides)}"
    )
    raise ValueError(msg)


type _UpsertRowMetadataName = Literal["supplemental rows", "authored return rows"]


def _require_upsert_row_metadata_count(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    metadata_name: _UpsertRowMetadataName,
    metadata_count: int,
    row_count: int,
) -> None:
    """Reject partially aligned physical metadata before SQL construction."""
    if metadata_count == row_count:
        return
    msg = (
        f"{model_cls.__name__} bulk upsert {metadata_name} must match its candidate count: "
        f"candidates={row_count}, {metadata_name}={metadata_count}"
    )
    raise ValueError(msg)


def _authored_return_values_by_column(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    assignments: Sequence[AuthoredReturnAssignments],
    returning_columns: Sequence[SqlColumnName],
) -> tuple[dict[SqlColumnName, DatabaseValue], ...]:
    """Validate and index authored logical values for SQL result projection."""
    allowed_columns = frozenset(returning_columns)
    expected_signature = tuple(assignment.column for assignment in assignments[0]) if assignments else ()
    indexed_rows: list[dict[SqlColumnName, DatabaseValue]] = []
    for row_index, row_assignments in enumerate(assignments):
        signature = tuple(assignment.column for assignment in row_assignments)
        if signature != expected_signature:
            msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} authored return columns must be uniform across candidates: candidate={row_index}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        indexed: dict[SqlColumnName, DatabaseValue] = {}
        for assignment in row_assignments:
            if assignment.column not in allowed_columns:
                msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} cannot project unknown authored return column {str(assignment.column)!r}"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            if assignment.column in indexed:
                msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} has duplicate authored return column {str(assignment.column)!r} for candidate {row_index}"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            indexed[assignment.column] = assignment.value
        indexed_rows.append(indexed)
    return tuple(indexed_rows)


def _require_uniform_upsert_many_columns(
    row_plans: Sequence[_ResolvedWriteRowPlan],
) -> None:
    canonical_columns = row_plans[0].columns
    for row_plan in row_plans[1:]:
        if row_plan.columns == canonical_columns:
            continue
        msg = (
            "UpsertManyStep requires a uniform write column signature across all rows. "
            f"expected={canonical_columns!r}, actual={row_plan.columns!r}"
        )
        raise ValueError(msg)


def _require_upsert_many_conflict_where_supported(
    conflict_where: SqlRenderable | None,
    dialect: Any,
) -> None:
    if conflict_where is None or not dialect.uses_on_duplicate_key_syntax():
        return
    msg = "UpsertManyStep conflict WHERE is not supported on MySQL-family backends"
    raise NotImplementedError(msg)


def _require_upsert_many_returning_supported(supports_returning: bool) -> None:
    if supports_returning:
        return
    msg = (
        "Upsert-many without SQL returning must be represented as a declared write result "
        "relation; runtime-ref rows-or-singleton fallback is not allowed."
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_upsert_many_cte_binding(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    instances_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
) -> Any:
    if ctx.cte_refs is not None and instances_ref in ctx.cte_refs:
        return ctx.cte_refs[instances_ref]
    msg = (
        "UpsertManyRawResultStep.compile() requires the deferred instances relation "
        f"{instances_ref!r} to be SQL-visible via ctx.cte_refs. Publish the prerequisite "
        "sequence as a CTE-bound relation before compile()."
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_upsert_many_binding_columns(
    binding: Any,
    instances_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if binding.columns is not None and binding.columns:
        return tuple(binding.columns)
    msg = (
        f"UpsertManyRawResultStep instances binding {instances_ref!r} must declare its "
        "output columns so compile() can project them into the INSERT source."

    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_upsert_many_writable_columns(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    instances_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    columns: Sequence[str],
    writable_db_columns: Sequence[str],
    binding_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> None:
    if columns:
        return
    msg = (
        f"UpsertManyRawResultStep instances binding {instances_ref!r} exposes no writable "
        f"columns for {model_cls.__name__}; expected overlap with {tuple(writable_db_columns)!r}, "
        f"got {tuple(binding_columns)!r}."
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_upsert_many_binding_conflict_columns(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    instances_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    conflict_cols: Sequence[str],
    binding_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> None:
    binding_column_set = set(binding_columns)
    missing_conflict = [column for column in conflict_cols if column not in binding_column_set]
    if not missing_conflict:
        return
    msg = (
        f"UpsertManyRawResultStep instances binding {instances_ref!r} is missing conflict "
        f"columns required by {model_cls.__name__}: {', '.join(missing_conflict)}."
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _build_custom_update(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    on_conflict: _ConflictUpdateMap | None,
    *,
    db_column_source: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None = None,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable | None]] | None:
    """Build custom update expressions from on_conflict dict."""
    if on_conflict is None:
        return None
    assert isinstance(on_conflict, Mapping)

    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.expression_grammar import ExpressionToGrammar
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name
    from l1000_schema.typed_field import Expression
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import is_writable_field

    db_source = db_column_source or model_cls
    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    converter = ExpressionToGrammar(db_source, table_alias=table_name)
    custom_update: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable | None]] = []
    for field_name, expr in on_conflict.items():
        candidate_name = getattr(field_name, "name", None)
        py_field_name = candidate_name if isinstance(candidate_name, str) else str(field_name)
        if not is_writable_field(db_source, py_field_name):
            continue
        db_col: str = get_db_column_name(db_source, DynamicFieldName(py_field_name))
        if expr is None:
            custom_update.append((db_col, None))
            continue
        if isinstance(expr, Expression):
            custom_update.append((db_col, converter.convert(expr)))
            continue
        custom_update.append((db_col, None))
    return custom_update


def _build_conflict_where(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    on_conflict_where: object | None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    """Build an optional conflict-side WHERE clause from an expression."""
    if on_conflict_where is None:
        return None

    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.expression_grammar import ExpressionToGrammar
    from l1000_schema.typed_field import Expression

    if isinstance(on_conflict_where, Expression):
        table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        converter = ExpressionToGrammar(model_cls, table_alias=table_name)
        conflict_where: SqlRenderable | None = converter.convert(on_conflict_where)
        return conflict_where
    if isinstance(on_conflict_where, SqlRenderable):
        return on_conflict_where

    msg = f"on_conflict_where must be an Expression or SqlRenderable, got {type(on_conflict_where).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _build_change_detection_conflict_where(
    *,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    columns: Sequence[str],
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    """Build a NULL-safe SQL predicate that updates only changed conflict rows."""
    if not columns:
        return None
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_upsert import (
        SqlUpsertExcludedValue,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, sql_or

    comparisons = tuple(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=SqlTableName(table_name)),
            BinaryOp.IS_DISTINCT_FROM,
            SqlUpsertExcludedValue(SqlColumnName(column)),
        )
        for column in columns
    )
    return sql_or(*comparisons)


def _build_mysql_change_detection_set_items(
    *,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    update_col_names: Sequence[str],
    change_detection_cols: Sequence[str],
) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, ...] | None:
    """Build MySQL-family conditional assignments for change-detection upserts."""
    if not change_detection_cols:
        return None
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_upsert import (
        SqlUpsertExcludedValue,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSetItem
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp, UnaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCase
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlUnaryOp, sql_and

    unchanged_checks = tuple(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=SqlTableName(table_name)),
            BinaryOp.IS_NOT_DISTINCT_FROM,
            SqlUpsertExcludedValue(SqlColumnName(column)),
        )
        for column in change_detection_cols
    )
    changed_condition = SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, sql_and(*unchanged_checks))
    return tuple(
        SqlSetItem(
            SqlColumnName(column),
            SqlCase(
                whens=((changed_condition, SqlUpsertExcludedValue(SqlColumnName(column))),),
                else_=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=SqlTableName(table_name)),
                dialect_conditional=True,
            ),
        )
        for column in update_col_names
    )


def _none_if_sql_true_literal(expr: SqlRenderable | None, dialect: Any) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    if expr is None:
        return None
    rendered = expr.render(dialect)
    if rendered._params:
        return expr
    sql = rendered._sql.strip().upper()
    if sql in {"TRUE", "1"}:
        return None
    tokens = sql.replace("(", " ").replace(")", " ").split()
    if tokens and all(token in {"TRUE", "AND"} for token in tokens) and any(token == "TRUE" for token in tokens):
        return None
    return expr


def _cte_binding_returning_output_shape(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],

    db_to_field = {

def _conflict_key_positions(
    columns: Sequence[str],
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> tuple[int, ...] | None:
    """Return conflict-key column positions when all keys are present."""
    if not all(column in columns for column in conflict_columns):
        return None

def _unique_conflict_targets_from_model(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog,
    write_plan: _WriteMetadataPlan,
) -> set[tuple[str, ...]]:
    table_shape = planning_catalog.table_for_model(model_cls)
    table_config = table_shape.table_config

    def _db_columns(columns: Sequence[object]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        result: list[str] = []
        for column in columns:
            if not isinstance(column, str):
                continue
            result.append(write_plan.field_to_db_column.get(column, column))
        return tuple(result)

    targets: set[tuple[str, ...]] = {tuple(write_plan.default_conflict_db_columns)}
    for field_name, field_info in cached_model_fields(model_cls).items():
        field_extra = field_info.json_schema_extra
        if isinstance(field_extra, dict) and field_extra.get("unique") is True:
            targets.add((write_plan.field_to_db_column.get(field_name, field_name),))
    primary_key = table_config.primary_key
    if primary_key is not None:
        primary_key_columns = _db_columns(getattr(primary_key, "columns", ()))
        if primary_key_columns:
            targets.add(primary_key_columns)
    for index in table_config.indexes:
        if not getattr(index, "unique", False):
            continue
        if getattr(index, "where", None) is not None or getattr(index, "expressions", None):
            continue
        index_columns = _db_columns(getattr(index, "columns", ()))
        if index_columns:
            targets.add(index_columns)
    for constraint in table_config.constraints:
        if not getattr(constraint, "unique", False):
            continue
        constraint_columns = _db_columns(getattr(constraint, "columns", ()))
        if constraint_columns:
            targets.add(constraint_columns)
    for field_name, field_info in model_cls.model_fields.items():
        json_schema_extra = field_info.json_schema_extra
        if not isinstance(json_schema_extra, Mapping):
            continue
        if not bool(json_schema_extra.get("unique")):
            continue
        targets.add((write_plan.field_to_db_column.get(field_name, get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))),))
    return targets


def _require_declared_unique_conflict_target(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog,
    write_plan: _WriteMetadataPlan,
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> None:
    conflict_target = tuple(conflict_columns)
    if conflict_target == (get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")),):
        return
    declared_targets = _unique_conflict_targets_from_model(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        planning_catalog=planning_catalog,
        write_plan=write_plan,
    )
    if any(
        len(declared_target) == len(conflict_target) and frozenset(declared_target) == frozenset(conflict_target)
        for declared_target in declared_targets
    ):
        # Conflict-target inference is based on the indexed column set. SQL
        # callers can name a composite unique target in either column order.
        return
    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    msg = (
        f"Upsert conflict columns for {table_name} are not backed by a declared primary key, "
        f"unique index, or unique constraint: {conflict_target!r}. Declare "
        "Index(..., unique=True) or UniqueConstraint(...) on the model before using "
        "upsert_many/insert_if_absent_many with these conflict columns."
    )
    raise ValueError(msg)


def retained_upsert_candidate_indices(
    row_plans: Sequence[_ResolvedWriteRowPlan],
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    """Return global last-winner indexes for one explicit conflict target."""
    return retained_upsert_candidate_indices_for_targets(row_plans, (conflict_columns,))


def retained_upsert_candidate_indices_for_targets(
    row_plans: Sequence[_ResolvedWriteRowPlan],
    conflict_targets: Sequence[Sequence[str]],
) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    """Return last-winner indexes across all targetless unique constraints."""
    if len(row_plans) < 2:
        return tuple(range(len(row_plans)))
    target_positions: list[tuple[int, ...]] = []
    for conflict_target in conflict_targets:
        positions = _conflict_key_positions(row_plans[0].columns, conflict_target)
        if positions is None:
            msg = f"Conflict target columns are missing from the resolved write row: {tuple(conflict_target)!r}."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        target_positions.append(positions)
    if not target_positions:
        msg = "Candidate resolution requires at least one declared conflict target."
        raise ValueError(msg)

    seen_keys: list[set[tuple[Hashable, ...]]] = [set() for _positions in target_positions]
    retained_reversed: list[int] = []
    for index in range(len(row_plans) - 1, -1, -1):
        row_plan = row_plans[index]
        keys = tuple(
            None
            if any(row_plan.values[position] is None for position in positions)
            else _row_plan_conflict_key(row_plan.values, positions)
            for positions in target_positions
        )
        if any(key is not None and key in seen for key, seen in zip(keys, seen_keys, strict=True)):
            continue
        retained_reversed.append(index)
        for key, seen in zip(keys, seen_keys, strict=True):
            if key is not None:
                seen.add(key)
    return tuple(reversed(retained_reversed))


def _row_plan_conflict_key(
    values: Sequence[object],
    conflict_positions: Sequence[int],
) -> tuple[Hashable, ...]:
    """Project a stable, hashable key from resolved row-plan values."""
    return tuple(_hashable_conflict_key_component(values[position]) for position in conflict_positions)


def _hashable_conflict_key_component(value: object) -> Hashable:
    from datetime import UTC, datetime

    from l2070_batching.server_ref import (
        ServerRef,
        inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning,
    )

    if isinstance(value, ServerRef):
        shape: PlanningServerValueShape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            value,
            site="upsert_many.conflict_key",
        )
        if shape.symbolic_ref_id is not None:
            return ("server_ref", str(shape.symbolic_ref_id))
        msg = "upsert_many conflict keys require ServerRef values with ref_ids"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    for method_name in ("unwrap_to_uuid", "unwrap_to_int", "unwrap_to_str", "unwrap_to_sql"):
        unwrap = getattr(value, method_name, None)
        if callable(unwrap):
            return _hashable_conflict_key_component(unwrap())
    if isinstance(value, UUID):
        return ("uuid", str(value))
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is not None and value.utcoffset() is not None:
            return ("aware_datetime", value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat())
        return ("naive_datetime", value.isoformat())
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return tuple(
            sorted(
                ((_hashable_conflict_key_component(key), _hashable_conflict_key_component(item)) for key, item in value.items()),
                key=repr,
            ),
        )
    if isinstance(value, list | tuple):
        return tuple(_hashable_conflict_key_component(item) for item in value)
    if isinstance(value, set | frozenset):
        return tuple(sorted((_hashable_conflict_key_component(item) for item in value), key=repr))
    if isinstance(value, Hashable):
        return value
    msg = f"Upsert conflict key value type {type(value).__name__!r} has no stable hashable representation."
    raise TypeError(msg)
