    def _explicit_return_model_cls(self: UpsertManyRawStep) -> type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None:
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import DatabaseObjectRow

        if isinstance(self._return_value, DatabaseObjectRow):
            return type(self._return_value)
        if isinstance(self._return_value, Sequence) and not isinstance(self._return_value, str | bytes):
            first = next(iter(self._return_value), None)
            if isinstance(first, DatabaseObjectRow):
                return type(first)
        return None

    def _explicit_return_columns(self: UpsertManyRawStep) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        model_cls = self._explicit_return_model_cls()
        if model_cls is None:
            return ("count",)
        if self._staged_write is not None:
            return staged_producer_publication_columns(
                model_cls,
                extra_columns=("branch_id", "sys_staged_commit_id", "sys_deleted", _STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN),
            )
        return producer_publication_columns(model_cls)

    def cte_publication_contract(self: UpsertManyRawStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        def _legacy_cte_output_columns() -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
            if self._staged_write is not None and self._return_value is _UNSET:
                return staged_producer_publication_columns(
                    self._model_cls,
                    extra_columns=("branch_id", "sys_staged_commit_id", "sys_deleted", _STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN),
                )
            if self._return_value is not _UNSET:
                return self._explicit_return_columns()
            return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*(str(column) for column in (self._conflict_columns or ())), "sys_id")))[:1]

        columns = _legacy_cte_output_columns()
        explicit_scalar_return = self._return_value is not _UNSET and self._explicit_return_model_cls() is None

        def _catalog_physical_column_hints(
            model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
            columns: tuple[str, ...],
        ) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            field_hints: list[SqlColumnTypeHints] = []
            for field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
                db_column = str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
                if db_column not in columns:
                    continue
                logical_hint = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, (field_name,))
                if logical_hint is not None:
                    field_hints.append(logical_hint.rename_column(field_name, db_column))
            normalized_columns = self._normalized_columns or tuple(self._columns)
            for logical_column, physical_column in zip(self._columns, normalized_columns, strict=True):
                if physical_column not in columns or logical_column == physical_column:
                    continue
                logical_hint = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, (logical_column,))
                if logical_hint is not None:
                    field_hints.append(logical_hint.rename_column(logical_column, physical_column))
            return combine_sql_column_type_hints(columns, *field_hints)

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...] | None) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
            if self._return_value is not _UNSET:
                assert columns is not None
                explicit_model_cls = self._explicit_return_model_cls()
                if explicit_model_cls is None:
                    return SqlColumnTypeHints(integer_columns=frozenset({"count"}))
                hint_model_cls = self._model_cls if self._staged_write is not None else explicit_model_cls
                model_columns = tuple(column for column in columns if column != _STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN)
                model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(hint_model_cls, model_columns)
                if model_hints is None:
                    return None
                return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    columns,
                    model_hints,
                    _catalog_physical_column_hints(explicit_model_cls, columns),
                    framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
                    SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({_STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN})),
                ).require_complete(columns)
            assert columns is not None
            model_columns = tuple(column for column in columns if column != _STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN)
            model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, model_columns)
            if model_hints is None:
                return None
            return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                columns,
                model_hints,
                _catalog_physical_column_hints(self._db_column_source, columns),
                framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
                SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({_STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN})),
            ).require_complete(columns)

        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if columns is None:
            if column_type_hints is not None and column_type_hints.has_any():
                msg = f"{type(self).__name__} declares SQL column type hints without an explicit cte_output_columns() contract."
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = (
            _UpsertManyRawStepCteRow
            if explicit_scalar_return
            else cte_projection_row_model(
                f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
                columns,
                column_type_hints,
            )
        )
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
            scalar_control_kind=(ScalarControlKind.AFFECTED_COUNT if explicit_scalar_return else None),
            scalar_value_column=(LockedColumnName("count") if explicit_scalar_return else None),
        )

            return cache.write_plan
        write_plan = get_write_metadata_plan_from_catalog(ctx.planning_catalog, model_cls)
        self._write_plan_cache = _WritePlanCache(

    def compile(self: UpsertManyRawStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[Any]:
        """Compile multi-row INSERT ... ON CONFLICT for raw column/row data."""

        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
            map_python_columns_to_db_columns_from_plan,
            resolve_conflict_db_columns_from_plan,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._projected_row_source import (
            auxiliary_ctes_for_raw_row_dependencies,
            build_postgres_raw_bulk_rows,
            build_projected_row_select,
            has_symbolic_row_cells,
            postgres_raw_bulk_column_types,
        )
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlTypeName
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_compound_write import (
            SqlStatementBatch,
            SqlStatementBatchCategory,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_upsert import SqlUpsertExcludedValue
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.identifier_fragments import SqlColumnRef
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
            SqlColumnList,
            SqlOnConflict,
            SqlPlaceholderRows,
            SqlReturningClause,
            SqlSelectAlias,
            SqlSetItem,
            SqlValuesSource,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import ConflictAction
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlInlineLiteral
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlInsert
        from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.mutation_grammar import compile_mutation_spec
        from l2060_query_builder.plan_composition import param, query, table as plan_table, unnest, write

        table = SqlTableName(self._table_name)

        db_source = self._db_column_source
        source_write_plan = self._write_plan(ctx, db_source)
        model_write_plan = source_write_plan if db_source is self._model_cls else self._write_plan(ctx, self._model_cls)
        db_columns = map_python_columns_to_db_columns_from_plan(source_write_plan, self._columns)

        col_list = SqlColumnList(
            [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(c)) for c in db_columns],
        )

        conflict_cols_raw = resolve_conflict_db_columns_from_plan(
            model_write_plan,
            self._conflict_columns,
        )
        _require_declared_unique_conflict_target(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            planning_catalog=require_planning_catalog(ctx, site="UpsertManyRawStep.compile"),
            write_plan=model_write_plan,
            conflict_columns=conflict_cols_raw,
        )
        conflict_cols = map_python_columns_to_db_columns_from_plan(source_write_plan, conflict_cols_raw)
        change_detection_cols = map_python_columns_to_db_columns_from_plan(
            source_write_plan,
            self._change_detection_columns,
        )
        missing_change_detection_cols = [column for column in change_detection_cols if column not in db_columns]
        if missing_change_detection_cols:
            msg = f"Change detection columns not in provided columns: {missing_change_detection_cols}"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        rows = list(self._rows)
        row_facts = self.raw_row_facts()
        conflict_positions = _conflict_key_positions(db_columns, conflict_cols)
        if len(rows) > 1 and conflict_positions is not None:
            seen: dict[tuple[Any, ...], int] = {}
            for idx, row in enumerate(rows):
                key = _row_plan_conflict_key(row, conflict_positions)
                seen[key] = idx
            if len(seen) < len(rows):
                rows = [rows[i] for i in sorted(seen.values())]
                from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps import _raw_row_facts

                row_facts = _raw_row_facts.build_raw_row_facts(rows)

        dialect = ctx.sql_render_dialect()
        custom_update = _build_custom_update(
            self._model_cls,
            self._on_conflict,
            db_column_source=db_source,
        )
        custom_update = _substitute_do_nothing_with_noop_update(custom_update, conflict_cols)
        conflict_where = _build_change_detection_conflict_where(
            table_name=SqlTableName(self._table_name),
            columns=change_detection_cols,
        )

        exclude_from_update: set[str] = set(conflict_cols) | {"sys_id"}
        update_col_names: list[str] = [c for c in db_columns if c not in exclude_from_update]
        mysql_change_detection_set_items = (
            _build_mysql_change_detection_set_items(
                table_name=SqlTableName(self._table_name),
                update_col_names=update_col_names,
                change_detection_cols=change_detection_cols,
            )
            if dialect.uses_on_duplicate_key_syntax()
            else None
        )
        if mysql_change_detection_set_items is not None:
            conflict_where = None

        count_returning_columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*conflict_cols, "sys_id")))[:1]
        returning_columns = (
            self._explicit_return_columns()
            if self._return_value is not _UNSET or self._staged_write is not None
            else count_returning_columns
        )
        existing_return_columns = (
            set(db_columns) if self._return_value is not _UNSET or self._staged_write is not None else set(returning_columns)
        )

        def _returning_projection(column: str) -> SqlRenderable:
            if column == _STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN:
                return SqlSelectAlias(SqlInlineLiteral(False), SqlAliasName(column))
            if column in existing_return_columns:
                return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column))
            return SqlSelectAlias(SqlInlineLiteral(None), SqlAliasName(column))

        returning = SqlReturningClause([_returning_projection(column) for column in returning_columns])
        supports_returning = dialect.supports_insert_returning()
        json_columns: frozenset[str] = frozenset(
            {
                *(field_plan.db_column for field_plan in source_write_plan.field_plans if field_plan.is_json),
                *(field_plan.db_column for field_plan in model_write_plan.field_plans if field_plan.is_json),
            }
        )
        postgres_json_columns: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
        postgres_h14_columns: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
            from impl.common.l2300_json_serialization.json_serialization import get_json_columns

            type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, tuple(db_columns))
            postgres_json_column_set = set(get_json_columns(self._model_cls))
            postgres_json_column_set.update(json_columns)
            if type_hints is not None:
                postgres_json_column_set.update(type_hints.jsonb_columns)
            postgres_json_columns = frozenset(postgres_json_column_set)
            postgres_h14_columns = frozenset(
                field_plan.db_column
                for write_plan in (source_write_plan, model_write_plan)
                for field_plan in write_plan.field_plans
                if field_plan.postgres_h14_code
            )

        def _upsert_param(column: str, value: object) -> object:
            if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is not DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
                from l1000_schema.json_type import to_json_sql_param_value

                return to_json_sql_param_value(value, is_json_column=column in json_columns)
            if column in postgres_h14_columns and isinstance(value, bytes):
                return "".join(f"{byte:08b}" for byte in value)
            if column not in postgres_json_columns or value is None:
                return value
            if isinstance(value, JSONType):
                return value.unwrap_to_sql()
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_params.sql_param_normalization import normalize_postgres_json_bind_value

            return normalize_postgres_json_bind_value(value)

        def _normalized_rows_for_binding[BatchItemT](batch: list[tuple[BatchItemT, ...]]) -> list[tuple[Any, ...]]:
            return [tuple(_upsert_param(column, value) for column, value in zip(db_columns, row, strict=True)) for row in batch]

        def _should_use_bound_values[BatchItemT](batch: Sequence[tuple[BatchItemT, ...]]) -> bool:
            return should_use_bound_values_transport(
                ctx.backend_type,
                len(db_columns),
                batch,
                bulk_transport=ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_bulk_transport,
            )

        def _build_conflict() -> tuple[Any, tuple[Any, ...] | None, tuple[Any, ...] | None]:
            set_items: tuple[Any, ...] | None = None
            update_columns_arg: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...] | None = None
            action = ConflictAction.DO_UPDATE
            if custom_update is not None and len(custom_update) == 0:
                action = ConflictAction.DO_NOTHING
            elif custom_update is not None:
                set_items = tuple(
                    SqlSetItem(
                        SqlColumnName(col),
                        SqlUpsertExcludedValue(SqlColumnName(col)) if expr is None else expr,
                    )
                    for col, expr in custom_update
                )
            elif mysql_change_detection_set_items is not None:
                set_items = mysql_change_detection_set_items
            else:
                update_columns_arg = tuple(coerce_sql_column_name(column) for column in update_col_names)
            return action, set_items, update_columns_arg

        def _build_stmt[BatchItemT](
            batch: list[tuple[BatchItemT, ...]],
            *,
            include_returning: bool,
            parameter_cast_types: Sequence[str] | None = None,
        ) -> tuple[SqlInsert, tuple[Any, ...]]:
            action, set_items, update_columns_arg = _build_conflict()
            uuid_cast_indices = (
                frozenset(index for index, cast_type in enumerate(parameter_cast_types) if cast_type.upper() == "UUID")
                if parameter_cast_types is not None
                else frozenset()
            )
            json_cast_indices = (
                frozenset(index for index, column in enumerate(db_columns) if column in postgres_json_columns)
                if parameter_cast_types is not None
                else frozenset()
            )
            stmt = SqlInsert(
                table=table,
                columns=col_list,
                values=SqlValuesSource(
                    SqlPlaceholderRows(
                        columns=len(db_columns),
                        rows=len(batch),
                        uuid_cast_indices=uuid_cast_indices,
                        json_cast_indices=json_cast_indices,
                    ),
                ),
                on_conflict=SqlOnConflict(
                    tuple(coerce_sql_column_name(column) for column in conflict_cols),
                    action,
                    set_items=set_items,
                    where=conflict_where,
                    update_columns=update_columns_arg,
                ),
                returning=returning if include_returning else None,
            )
            assert isinstance(stmt, SqlInsert)
            batch_params = tuple(_upsert_param(column, value) for row in batch for column, value in zip(db_columns, row, strict=True))
            return stmt, batch_params

        def _build_unnest_upsert(
            *,
            array_params: Sequence[object],
            column_types: Sequence[str],
            include_returning: bool,
        ) -> SqlRenderable:
            bulk_rows = unnest(
                *(param(array_param) for array_param in array_params),
                types=tuple(SqlTypeName(column_type) for column_type in column_types),
                columns=tuple(db_columns),
                alias="__bulk_src",
            )
            insert_builder = (
                write(plan_table(self._model_cls))
                .insert()
                .columns(*db_columns)
                .from_query(query(bulk_rows).project(*(bulk_rows.column(column) for column in db_columns)))
            )
            if custom_update is not None and len(custom_update) == 0:
                insert_builder.on_conflict_do_nothing(*conflict_cols)
            elif custom_update is not None:
                insert_builder.on_conflict_update(
                    *conflict_cols,
                    set={
                        column: SqlUpsertExcludedValue(SqlColumnName(column)) if expr is None else expr for column, expr in custom_update
                    },
                )
            else:
                insert_builder.on_conflict_update_columns(
                    *conflict_cols,
                    update_columns=tuple(update_col_names),
                )
            if conflict_where is not None:
                insert_builder.on_conflict_where(conflict_where)
            if include_returning:
                insert_builder.returning(*(_returning_projection(column) for column in returning_columns))
            compiled_mutation = compile_mutation_spec(
                insert_builder.to_mutation_spec(),
                compilation_context=ctx,
            )
            return compiled_mutation

        from l1000_schema.schema_def import DatabaseObjectRow

        needs_returning = supports_returning and (self._return_value is _UNSET or self._staged_write is not None)
        uses_effective_row_count = False
        closed_post_op = (
            exact_single_row_post_op()
            if self._staged_write is not None and self._return_value is not _UNSET
            else literal_post_op(materialize_explicit_return_value(self._return_value))
            if self._return_value is not _UNSET
            else CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_SCALAR,
                ),
            )
        )
        grammar: SqlRenderable
        params: tuple[Any, ...] | None
        params = None
        auxiliary_ctes = None
        column_types = None
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_bulk_transport is DmlBulkTransport.PAYLOAD_AWARE_BOUND_VALUES and rows:
            column_types = postgres_raw_bulk_column_types(
                self._model_cls,
                db_columns,
                write_plan=model_write_plan,
            )
        if column_types is not None:
            row_source = build_postgres_raw_bulk_rows(
                rows=_normalized_rows_for_binding(rows),
                db_columns=db_columns,
                column_types=column_types,
                ctx=ctx,
                row_facts=row_facts,
            )
            action, set_items, update_columns_arg = _build_conflict()
            can_use_bound_values_transport = True
            prefer_values_transport = (
                self._return_value is not _UNSET and can_use_bound_values_transport and not self._isolate_from_sql_batch
            )
            if row_source.array_params is not None:
                row_chunks = _chunk_rows_by_payload_byte_budget(rows)
                if prefer_values_transport:
                    if len(row_chunks) > 1:
                        values_statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
                        values_params_per_stmt: list[tuple[Any, ...] | None] = []
                        values_needs_returning_per_stmt: list[bool] = []
                        for chunk in row_chunks:
                            chunk_stmt, chunk_params = _build_stmt(
                                chunk,
                                include_returning=needs_returning,
                                parameter_cast_types=(column_types if self._after_refs else None),
                            )
                            values_statements.append(chunk_stmt)
                            values_params_per_stmt.append(chunk_params)
                            values_needs_returning_per_stmt.append(needs_returning)
                        grammar = SqlStatementBatch(
                            values_statements,
                            category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.BUDGET_SPLIT,
                            params_per_stmt=values_params_per_stmt,
                            external_params_first=[True] * len(values_statements),
                            needs_returning_per_stmt=values_needs_returning_per_stmt,
                        )
                    else:
                        grammar, params = _build_stmt(
                            rows,
                            include_returning=needs_returning,
                            parameter_cast_types=(column_types if self._after_refs else None),
                        )
                elif len(row_chunks) > 1:
                    if (
                        self._return_value is _UNSET
                        and can_use_bound_values_transport
                        and all(_should_use_bound_values(chunk) for chunk in row_chunks)
                    ):
                        needs_returning = False
                    statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
                    params_per_stmt: list[tuple[Any, ...] | None] = []
                    external_params_first: list[bool] = []
                    needs_returning_per_stmt: list[bool] = []
                    for chunk in row_chunks:
                        if prefer_values_transport and _should_use_bound_values(chunk):
                            chunk_stmt, chunk_params = _build_stmt(
                                chunk,
                                include_returning=needs_returning,
                            )
                            statements.append(chunk_stmt)
                            params_per_stmt.append(chunk_params)
                            external_params_first.append(True)
                            needs_returning_per_stmt.append(needs_returning)
                            continue
                        if not needs_returning and can_use_bound_values_transport and _should_use_bound_values(chunk):
                            chunk_stmt, chunk_params = _build_stmt(
                                chunk,
                                include_returning=False,
                            )
                            statements.append(chunk_stmt)
                            params_per_stmt.append(chunk_params)
                            external_params_first.append(True)
                            needs_returning_per_stmt.append(False)
                            uses_effective_row_count = self._return_value is _UNSET
                            continue
                        chunk_source = build_postgres_raw_bulk_rows(
                            rows=chunk,
                            db_columns=db_columns,
                            column_types=column_types,
                            ctx=ctx,
                            row_facts=row_facts,
                        )
                        assert chunk_source.array_params is not None
                        statements.append(
                            _build_unnest_upsert(
                                array_params=chunk_source.array_params,
                                column_types=chunk_source.column_types,
                                include_returning=needs_returning,
                            ),
                        )
                        params_per_stmt.append(None)
                        external_params_first.append(False)
                        needs_returning_per_stmt.append(needs_returning)
                    needs_returning = any(needs_returning_per_stmt)
                    grammar = SqlStatementBatch(
                        statements,
                        category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.BUDGET_SPLIT,
                        params_per_stmt=params_per_stmt,
                        external_params_first=external_params_first,
                        needs_returning_per_stmt=needs_returning_per_stmt,
                    )
                elif not needs_returning and can_use_bound_values_transport and _should_use_bound_values(rows):
                    grammar, params = _build_stmt(rows, include_returning=False)
                    needs_returning = False
                    uses_effective_row_count = self._return_value is _UNSET
                else:
                    grammar = _build_unnest_upsert(
                        array_params=row_source.array_params,
                        column_types=row_source.column_types,
                        include_returning=needs_returning,
                    )
            else:
                assert row_source.select_source is not None
                grammar = SqlInsert(
                    table=table,
                    columns=col_list,
                    values=row_source.select_source,
                    on_conflict=SqlOnConflict(
                        tuple(coerce_sql_column_name(column) for column in conflict_cols),
                        action,
                        set_items=set_items,
                        where=conflict_where,
                        update_columns=update_columns_arg,
                    ),
                    returning=returning if needs_returning else None,
                )
                auxiliary_ctes = auxiliary_ctes_for_raw_row_dependencies(
                    ctx=ctx,
                    row_facts=row_facts,
                )
        else:
            if has_symbolic_row_cells(rows, row_facts=row_facts):
                if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_bulk_transport is DmlBulkTransport.PAYLOAD_AWARE_BOUND_VALUES:
                    msg = (
                        "SQL-native symbolic raw upserts require explicit bulk column SQL types; "
                        f"could not determine array types for columns {tuple(self._columns)!r} "
                        f"on {self._db_column_source.__name__}."
                    )
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                action, set_items, update_columns_arg = _build_conflict()
                grammar = SqlInsert(
                    table=table,
                    columns=col_list,
                    values=build_projected_row_select(
                        rows=_normalized_rows_for_binding(rows),
                        db_columns=db_columns,
                        ctx=ctx,
                        row_facts=row_facts,
                    ),
                    on_conflict=SqlOnConflict(
                        tuple(coerce_sql_column_name(column) for column in conflict_cols),
                        action,
                        set_items=set_items,
                        where=conflict_where,
                        update_columns=update_columns_arg,
                    ),
                    returning=returning if needs_returning else None,
                )
                params = None
                auxiliary_ctes = auxiliary_ctes_for_raw_row_dependencies(
                    ctx=ctx,
                    row_facts=row_facts,
                )
            else:
                grammar, params = _build_stmt(rows, include_returning=needs_returning)
        if not needs_returning:
            closed_post_op = (
                exact_single_row_post_op()
                if self._staged_write is not None and self._return_value is not _UNSET
                else literal_post_op(materialize_explicit_return_value(self._return_value))
                if self._return_value is not _UNSET
                else literal_post_op(len(rows))
            )
        elif uses_effective_row_count:
            closed_post_op = CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_SCALAR,
                ),
            )

        explicit_return_columns = (
            self._explicit_return_columns()
            if needs_returning and (self._return_value is not _UNSET or self._staged_write is not None)
            else None
        )
        compiled_output_shape = None
        compiled_type_hints = None
        if explicit_return_columns is not None:
            from l2070_batching.planning_catalog import output_shape_for_synthetic_columns

            compiled_output_shape = output_shape_for_synthetic_columns(explicit_return_columns)
            hint_model_cls = self._explicit_return_model_cls()
            model_return_columns = tuple(column for column in explicit_return_columns if column != _STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN)
            model_type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(hint_model_cls, model_return_columns)
            compiled_type_hints = (
                None
                if model_type_hints is None
                else combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    explicit_return_columns,
                    model_type_hints,
                    framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
                    SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({_STAGED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN})),
                ).require_complete(explicit_return_columns)
            )
        elif self._return_value is _UNSET:
            from l2070_batching.planning_catalog import output_shape_for_synthetic_columns

            compiled_output_shape = output_shape_for_synthetic_columns(returning_columns)
            compiled_type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, returning_columns)

        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            params=params,
            needs_returning=needs_returning,
            external_params_first=False,
            closed_post_op=closed_post_op,
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
            output_shape=compiled_output_shape,
            result_relation=(
                DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(compiled_output_shape) if compiled_output_shape is not None else None
            ),
            column_type_hints=compiled_type_hints,
        )

def _coerce_source_sys_id(value: object) -> SysId:
    if isinstance(value, SysId):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str | uuid.UUID):
        return SysId(value)
    msg = f"Expected SysId-compatible source id, got {type(value)}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _coerce_queue_message_id(value: object) -> QueueMessageId:
    if isinstance(value, QueueMessageId):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str | uuid.UUID):
        return QueueMessageId(value)
    msg = f"Expected QueueMessageId-compatible value, got {type(value)}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _normalize_source_sys_ids(items: object) -> list[SysId]:
    if items is None:
        return []
    source_items = list(items) if isinstance(items, Sequence) and not isinstance(items, str | bytes | bytearray) else [items]
    object_ids: list[SysId] = []
    for item in source_items:
        if item is None:
            continue
        object_id = item.get("sys_id") if isinstance(item, dict) else getattr(item, "sys_id", item)
        if object_id is not None:
            object_ids.append(_coerce_source_sys_id(object_id))
    return object_ids


def _normalize_source_object_id_strings(items: object) -> list[str]:
    return [object_id.unwrap_to_sql() for object_id in _normalize_source_sys_ids(items)]


def _normalize_source_rows[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    items: object,
    model_cls: type[T],
) -> list[T]:
    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.row_converter import convert_row_to_model

    if items is None:
        return []
    source_items = list(items) if isinstance(items, Sequence) and not isinstance(items, str | bytes | bytearray) else [items]
    rows: list[T] = []
    for item in source_items:
        if isinstance(item, model_cls):
            rows.append(item)
        elif isinstance(item, dict):
            rows.append(
                cast(
                    T,
                    convert_row_to_model(
                        model_cls,
                        dict(item),
                        conn=None,
                        hydrate_large_columns=False,
                    ),
                ),
            )
    return rows


class _SqlMaterializedWriteRowsSelect(SqlDmlBase):
    """Render literal materialized rows as a portable SELECT/UNION relation."""

    __slots__ = ("_columns", "_rows")

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        columns: Sequence[str],
        rows: Sequence[Sequence[object]],
    ) -> None:
        self._columns = tuple(columns)
        self._rows = tuple(tuple(row) for row in rows)

    def render(self, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        grammar: SqlFragment | None = None
        for row_index, row in enumerate(self._rows):
            row_fragment = _SQL_SELECT_SPACE
            for column_index, (db_column, value) in enumerate(
                zip(self._columns, row, strict=True),
            ):
                if column_index > 0:
                    row_fragment = row_fragment + _SQL_COMMA_SPACE
                row_fragment = row_fragment + SqlParam(value).render(dialect)
                if row_index == 0:
                    row_fragment = row_fragment + _SQL_AS_SPACE + SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlColumnName(db_column)).render(dialect)
            grammar = row_fragment if grammar is None else grammar + _SQL_UNION_ALL + row_fragment
        assert grammar is not None
        return grammar


class _MaterializedWriteRowsCteStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[list[DatabaseObjectRow]]):
    """Publish materialized rows as a SQL-visible CTE."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        rows: Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        if not rows:
            msg = "_MaterializedWriteRowsCteStep requires at least one row"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._rows = tuple(rows)
        self._field_names = tuple(model_cls.model_fields.keys())
        self._db_columns = tuple(_normalize_db_columns(model_cls, list(self._field_names)))

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "materialized", "cte", "write_rows"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _MaterializedWriteRowsCteStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = self._db_columns

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...] | None) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, self._db_columns)
            if hints is None:
                msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._model_cls.__name__}"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return hints

        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = self._model_cls
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[DatabaseObjectRow]]:
        postgres_json_columns: set[str] = set()
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
            from impl.common.l2300_json_serialization import get_json_columns

            postgres_json_columns = {
                column_name
                for json_field_name in get_json_columns(self._model_cls)
                for column_name in (
                    json_field_name,
                    get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(json_field_name)),
                )
            }

        def param_value(field_name: str, db_column: str, value: object) -> object:
            if db_column not in postgres_json_columns and field_name not in postgres_json_columns:
                return value
            from impl.common.l2300_json_serialization import coerce_for_json
            from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb

            return Jsonb(coerce_for_json(value))

        row_values = [
            [
                param_value(
                    field_name,
                    db_column,
                    get_field_value(row, DynamicFieldName(field_name)),
                )
                for field_name, db_column in zip(self._field_names, self._db_columns, strict=True)
            ]
            for row in self._rows
        ]
        grammar = _SqlMaterializedWriteRowsSelect(
            columns=self._db_columns,
            rows=row_values,
        )
        __opa002_grammar_537 = grammar
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract()
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_537,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=literal_post_op(list(self._rows)),
        )


def _filter_unchanged_embedding_rows[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    *,
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
    previous_rows: Sequence[T],
    current_rows: Sequence[T],
) -> list[T]:
    if not previous_rows or not current_rows:
        return list(current_rows)
    source_fields = get_embedding_source_fields(type(current_rows[0]), index_name)
    if not source_fields:
        return list(current_rows)
    previous_by_id = {row.sys_id: row for row in previous_rows}
    changed_rows: list[T] = []
    for row in current_rows:
        previous = previous_by_id.get(row.sys_id)
        if previous is None:
            changed_rows.append(row)
            continue
        if any(
            get_field_value(previous, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) != get_field_value(row, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            for field_name in source_fields
        ):
            changed_rows.append(row)
    return changed_rows


def _annotation_contains_type(annotation: object, target_type: type[object]) -> bool:
    if annotation is target_type:
        return True
    origin = get_origin(annotation)
    if origin is Annotated:
        args = get_args(annotation)
        return _annotation_contains_type(args[0], target_type) if args else False
    if origin is None:
        return False
    return any(_annotation_contains_type(arg, target_type) for arg in get_args(annotation))


def _resolved_field_annotation(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_name: str,
) -> object | None:
    field_info = model_cls.model_fields.get(field_name)
    if field_info is None:
        return None
    resolved_hints = cached_runtime_type_hints(model_cls)
    annotation = resolved_hints.get(ReflectionAttributeName(field_name), field_info.annotation)
    resolved_annotation: object | None = field_info.annotation if isinstance(annotation, str) else annotation
    return resolved_annotation

def _expr_equals_any(
    base_expr: Expression[Any, DatabaseObjectRow] | TypedField[Any, DatabaseObjectRow],
    values: Sequence[SysId],
) -> Expression[Any, DatabaseObjectRow]:
    """Build an OR chain without relying on typed ``Field.in_`` support."""
    if not values:
        msg = "values must be non-empty"
        raise ValueError(msg)

    expr = cast("Expression[Any, DatabaseObjectRow]", base_expr == values[0])
    for value in values[1:]:
        expr = expr | cast("Expression[Any, DatabaseObjectRow]", base_expr == value)
    return expr

def _compile_delete_with_sql_count(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    where_clause: SqlConditionalClause,
    deleted_cte_name: str,
    trigger_cte_name: str | None = None,
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None = None,
) -> CompiledStep[int]:
    table = SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(table_name))
    count_stmt: SqlRenderable = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT_STAR),
                    alias=SqlAliasName("count"),
                )
            ]
        ),
        from_=table,
        where=where_clause,
    )
    delete_stmt: SqlRenderable = SqlDelete(
        table=table,
        where=where_clause,
    )
    if trigger_cte_name is not None:
        count_stmt = gate_grammar_for_cte(count_stmt, trigger_cte_name)
        delete_stmt = gate_grammar_for_cte(delete_stmt, trigger_cte_name)
    if ctx.supports_data_modifying_ctes:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_cte import SqlDmlWithReturningOne
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlCte

        __opa002_grammar_674 = SqlCte(
            [(deleted_cte_name, SqlDmlWithReturningOne(delete_stmt))],
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT_STAR),
                            alias=SqlAliasName("count"),
                        )
                    ]
                ),
                from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(deleted_cte_name)),
            ),
        )
        output_shape, column_type_hints = _single_bigint_output_contract("count", "delete_count")
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_674,
            needs_returning=True,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
            closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
                "count",
                default_value=0,
                use_default_on_empty=True,
                scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.INT,
            ),
        )
    __opa002_grammar_698 = SqlStatementBatch(
        [count_stmt, delete_stmt],
        category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.ORDERED_SEMANTIC,
        needs_returning_per_stmt=[True, False],
        result_labels_per_stmt=[None, "__ignored_delete_rowcount"],
    )
    output_shape, column_type_hints = _single_bigint_output_contract("count", "delete_count")
    return CompiledStep(
        output_shape=output_shape,
        grammar=__opa002_grammar_698,
        needs_returning=True,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
            "count",
            default_value=0,
            use_default_on_empty=True,
            scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.INT,
        ),
    )


def _compile_delete_embedding_refs_step(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    ref_model_cls: type[EmbeddingRef] = EmbeddingRef,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
    object_ids: Sequence[SysId],
    should_delete: bool,
    revision_id: RevisionId | None,
    branch_id: BranchId | None,
) -> CompiledStep[int]:
    if not should_delete or not object_ids:
        return _compile_zero_count_step("__delete_count")

    expr: Expression = (
        (field(ref_model_cls.source_table) == get_table_name(model_cls))
        & (field(ref_model_cls.field_name) == index_name)
        & field(ref_model_cls.source_id).is_in(tuple(object_ids))
    )
    if branch_id is not None:
        expr = expr & (field(ref_model_cls.branch_id) == branch_id)
    else:
        expr = expr & field(ref_model_cls.branch_id).is_null()
    if revision_id is not None:
        expr = expr & (field(ref_model_cls.revision_id) == revision_id)
    else:

def _build_materialized_embedding_queue_rows(
    *,
    write_result: object,
    metadata: object,
    previous_result: object | None = None,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
) -> list[_MaterializedPreparedQueueRow]:
    if isinstance(write_result, CteReference) or isinstance(metadata, CteReference):
        msg = (
            "Materialized embedding queue insert received unresolved CTE inputs; "
            "this path must execute after concrete row materialization"
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if write_result is None:
        return []

    instances = _normalize_source_rows(write_result, model_cls)
    if previous_result is not None and not isinstance(previous_result, CteReference):
        previous_rows = _normalize_source_rows(previous_result, model_cls)
        instances = _filter_unchanged_embedding_rows(
            index_name=index_name,
            previous_rows=previous_rows,
            current_rows=instances,
        )
    if not instances:
        return []

    normalized_metadata = _normalize_materialized_embedding_metadata(metadata)
    model_hint = _resolve_materialized_model_hint(
        metadata=normalized_metadata,
        canonical_model_hint=EmbeddingHandlerRegistry.get_canonical_model(model_cls, index_name),
    )
    content_hash_nonce = (
        normalize_content_hash_nonce(getattr(normalized_metadata, "content_hash_nonce", None))
        if normalized_metadata is not None
        else None
    )
    rows: list[_MaterializedPreparedQueueRow] = []
    for instance in instances:
        parts = compute_embedding_task_plan_parts(
            model_cls,
            instance,
            index_name,
            model_hint=model_hint,
            content_hash_nonce=content_hash_nonce,
        )
        rows.append(
            (
                instance.sys_id,
                str(instance.sys_id),
                parts.model_hint,
                parts.precision_hint,
                parts.content_hash_short,
                parts.content_hash_high,
                parts.content,
                False,
            ),
        )
    return rows

def _build_materialized_prepare_write_source_query(
    *,

    write_cte: CteReference,
    previous_cte: CteReference | None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    write_alias = SqlAliasName("__emb_current_write_rows")
    if previous_cte is None:
        return SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlStar()]),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(write_cte.ref_id)), write_alias),
        )

    previous_alias = SqlAliasName("__emb_previous_write_rows")
    sys_id_column = SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")))
    changed_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(sys_id_column, qualifier=previous_alias)),
    ]
    for field_name in get_embedding_source_fields(model_cls, index_name):
        db_column = SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
        changed_conditions.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(db_column, qualifier=write_alias),
                BinaryOp.IS_DISTINCT_FROM,
                SqlColumnRef(db_column, qualifier=previous_alias),
            ),
        )

    if current_columns is None:
        msg = "materialized embedding queue write CTE must publish columns when previous rows are compared"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=write_alias),
                    SqlAliasName(column),
                )
                for column in current_columns
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(write_cte.ref_id)), write_alias),
        joins=[
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.LEFT,
                SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(previous_cte.ref_id)), previous_alias),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(sys_id_column, qualifier=write_alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(sys_id_column, qualifier=previous_alias),
                ),
            ),
        ],
        where=SqlWhereClause(sql_or(*changed_conditions)),
    )

def _normalize_materialized_embedding_metadata(metadata: object) -> EmbeddingMetadata | None:
    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.row_converter import convert_row_to_model

    candidate = metadata
    if isinstance(candidate, Sequence) and not isinstance(candidate, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
        if not candidate:
            return None
        candidate = candidate[0]
    if isinstance(candidate, EmbeddingMetadata):
        return candidate
    if isinstance(candidate, dict):
        return cast(
            EmbeddingMetadata,
            convert_row_to_model(
                EmbeddingMetadata,
                dict(candidate),
                conn=None,
                hydrate_large_columns=False,
            ),
        )
    return None

def _extract_queue_message_ids(raw_result: Sequence[object]) -> list[QueueMessageId]:
    message_ids: list[QueueMessageId] = []
    for row in raw_result:
        if isinstance(row, QueueMessageId):
            message_ids.append(row)
            continue
        if isinstance(row, str):
            message_ids.append(QueueMessageId(row))
            continue
        row_dict = _row_object_dict(row)
        if row_dict is None:
            continue
        sys_id = row_dict.get("sys_id")
        if isinstance(sys_id, QueueMessageId):
            message_ids.append(sys_id)
            continue
        if isinstance(sys_id, uuid.UUID | str):
            message_ids.append(QueueMessageId(str(sys_id)))
    return message_ids


def _row_object_dict(row: object) -> dict[str, object] | None:
    if isinstance(row, Mapping):
        return {str(key): value for key, value in row.items()}
    if hasattr(row, "keys") and hasattr(row, "__getitem__"):
        row_like = cast(_RowObjectLike, row)
        return {str(key): row_like[key] for key in row_like}
    return None

    """Emit ``INSERT ... SELECT`` for embedding queue rows chained from prior queue rows."""
    from l2070_batching.output_shape import CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, synthetic_output_field

    previous_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(previous_queue_ref))
    if not isinstance(previous_cte, CteReference):
        raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
            site_name="_compile_embedding_queue_insert_after_previous_payload_rows",
            trigger=f"previous queue ref {previous_queue_ref!r} has no published CTE binding",
            blocked_path=("embedding queue chaining must compile from an explicit prior queue rowset."),
            result_contract=("embedding queue chaining must consume an explicit previous queue ref."),
            implementation_requirements=(
                "Publish the prior queue rowset in the same batch before this terminal compiles.",
                "Do not fall back to ambient queue table state when a previous queue ref contract exists.",
            ),
        )
    auth_token = ctx.queue_insert_auth_serialized
    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    current_timestamp_expr = SqlFuncCall("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP", [])
    queued_at_expr = _build_queued_at_expr(ctx)

    auth_token_expr: SqlRenderable = NULL if auth_token is None else SqlParam(auth_token)
    projected_rows = _build_embedding_queue_projected_rows(
        current_timestamp_expr=current_timestamp_expr,
        table_name=SqlTableName(table_name),
        index_name=index_name,
        event_type=event_type,
        queue_batch_ref=queue_batch_ref,
        queued_at_expr=queued_at_expr,
        revision_id_payload_expr=revision_id_payload_expr,
        branch_id_payload_expr=branch_id_payload_expr,
        payload_source_rows=payload_source_rows,
        payload_source_alias=payload_source_alias,
        auth_token_expr=auth_token_expr,
    )
    latest_sequence_expr = _build_latest_queue_sequence_expr(
        ctx=ctx,
        metadata_ref=metadata_ref,
        table_name=SqlTableName(table_name),
        index_name=index_name,
    )
    target_columns = [
        "sys_id",
        "created_at",
        "updated_at",
        "queue_name",
        "priority",
        "sequence_id",
        "payload_json",
        "retry_count",
        "max_retries",
        "visibility_timeout_seconds",
        "source_table_name",
        "source_object_id",
        "auth_token",
    ]
    insert_columns = _normalize_db_columns(QueueMessage, target_columns)
    returning_columns = _queue_insert_returning_columns()
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in returning_columns))
    compiled: CompiledStep[list[QueueMessageId]] = CompiledStep(
        grammar=SqlInsertFromSelectStmt(
            target=get_table_name(QueueMessage),
            columns=SqlColumnListFragment(
                [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name)) for column_name in insert_columns],
            ),
            source=SqlSubqueryTableRef(projected_rows, projected_alias),
            select_columns=SqlColumnListFragment(
                [
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("created_at"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("updated_at"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("queue_name"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("priority"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        latest_sequence_expr,
                        BinaryOp.ADD,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__sequence_offset"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                    ),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("payload_json"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("retry_count"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("max_retries"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName("visibility_timeout_seconds"),
                        qualifier=projected_alias,
                    ),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_table_name"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_object_id"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("auth_token"), qualifier=projected_alias),
                ],
            ),
            returning=SqlReturningClause(
                [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name)) for column_name in returning_columns],
            ),
        ),
        needs_returning=True,
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=_queue_insert_returning_type_hints(),
    )

    return replace(
        compiled,
        closed_post_op=raw_rows_post_op(),
    )


def _build_materialized_embedding_queue_insert_sql_step(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    rows: Sequence[_MaterializedPreparedQueueRow],
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
    event_type: str,
    queue_batch_ref: EmbeddingQueueBatchRef,
    revision_id: RevisionId | None,
    branch_id: BranchId | None,
    metadata_ref: ServerPlanRefId = ServerPlanRefId("__embedding_metadata"),
) -> CompiledStep[list[QueueMessageId]]:
    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    source_alias = SqlTableName("__emb_materialized_payload_parts")
    source_query = _build_materialized_embedding_queue_source_query(rows)
    payload_source_rows = _build_skip_compute_payload_rows(
        source_rows=source_query,
        source_alias=source_alias,
        model_cls=model_cls,

        branch_id=branch_id,
        revision_id=revision_id,
        canonical_model_hint=None,

    )
    return _compile_embedding_queue_insert_after_payload_rows(
        ctx=ctx,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        index_name=index_name,
        metadata_ref=metadata_ref,
        event_type=event_type,

        revision_id=revision_id,

        payload_source_alias=SqlTableName("__emb_materialized_payload_source"),
        projected_alias=SqlTableName("__emb_materialized_queue_rows"),
    )


def _build_queued_at_expr(ctx: CompilationContext) -> SqlRenderable:
    return ctx.sql_render_dialect().serverplan_embedding_queued_at_expr()


def _build_dynamic_model_hint_expr(metadata_alias: SqlTableName) -> SqlRenderable:
    metadata_model_expr = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("model"), qualifier=metadata_alias)
    metadata_provider_expr = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("provider"), qualifier=metadata_alias)
    return SqlCase(
        whens=[
            (
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName("algorithm_established"),
                        qualifier=metadata_alias,
                    ),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlParam(True),
                ),
                SqlCase(
                    whens=[
                        (
                            sql_or(
                                SqlIsNull(metadata_model_expr),
                                SqlBinaryOp(
                                    metadata_model_expr,
                                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                                    SqlInlineLiteral(""),
                                ),
                            ),
                            NULL,
                        ),
                        (
                            sql_or(
                                SqlIsNull(metadata_provider_expr),
                                SqlBinaryOp(
                                    metadata_provider_expr,
                                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                                    SqlInlineLiteral(""),
                                ),
                            ),
                            metadata_model_expr,
                        ),
                    ],
                    else_=SqlFuncCall(
                        "CONCAT",
                        [
                            metadata_provider_expr,
                            SqlInlineLiteral(":"),
                            metadata_model_expr,
                        ],
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ],
        else_=NULL,
    )


def _build_embedding_queue_write_source_query(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
    write_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    previous_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    object_ids: Sequence[SysId],
    source_rows: Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    write_cte = resolve_sql_visible_relation(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(write_ref))
    sys_id_column_name = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))
    write_cte_is_row_shaped = write_cte is not None and (sys_id_column_name in {str(column) for column in write_cte.columns})
    if write_cte is not None and write_cte_is_row_shaped:
        current_alias = SqlTableName("__emb_current_write")
        previous_cte = resolve_sql_visible_relation(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(previous_rows_ref)) if previous_rows_ref is not None else None
        if previous_rows_ref is not None and previous_cte is None:
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name="_build_embedding_queue_write_source_query",
                trigger=f"previous rows ref {previous_rows_ref!r} has no SQL-visible rowset",
                blocked_path="embedding queue write-source construction cannot skip previous-row filtering once requested",
                result_contract="previous-row comparisons must use a declared SQL-visible relation.",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish previous rows as an explicit CTE before embedding queue construction.",
                    "Do not fall back to unfiltered queue insertion when previous rows are unavailable.",
                ),
            )
        where: SqlRenderable | None = None
        source_fields = get_embedding_source_fields(model_cls, index_name)
        if previous_cte is not None and source_fields:
            previous_alias = SqlTableName("__emb_previous_write")
            sys_id_column = SqlColumnName(sys_id_column_name)
            unchanged_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(sys_id_column, qualifier=previous_alias),
                    BinaryOp.IS_NOT_DISTINCT_FROM,
                    SqlColumnRef(sys_id_column, qualifier=current_alias),
                ),
            ]
            unchanged_conditions.extend(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(source_field))), qualifier=previous_alias),
                    BinaryOp.IS_NOT_DISTINCT_FROM,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(source_field))), qualifier=current_alias),
                )
                for source_field in source_fields
            )
            unchanged_row_query = SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(1), SqlAliasName("__unchanged"))]),
                from_=SqlAliasedTableRef(
                    SqlTableName(previous_cte.ref_id),
                    SqlAliasName(str(previous_alias)),
                ),
                where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*unchanged_conditions)),
            )
            where = SqlExists(unchanged_row_query, negated=True)
        return SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlStar()]),
            from_=SqlAliasedTableRef(
                SqlTableName(write_cte.ref_id),
                SqlAliasName(str(current_alias)),
            ),
            where=where,
        )
    if write_cte is not None:
        raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
            site_name="_build_embedding_queue_write_source_query",
            trigger=f"write ref {write_ref!r} is SQL-visible but lacks required row columns",
            blocked_path="embedding queue write-source construction cannot switch to literal/object-id fallback for a malformed write CTE",
            result_contract="write-row sources must publish at least the model sys_id column with complete type hints.",
            implementation_requirements=(
                "Fix the write producer publication contract for the current write rows.",
                "Do not reconstruct write rows from runtime values or object-id probes.",
            ),
        )
    if source_rows:
        return _build_materialized_write_source_query_from_rows(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            index_name=index_name,
            rows=source_rows,
        )
    if object_ids:
        return _build_materialized_write_source_query_for_index(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            object_ids=object_ids,
        )
    return None

    return SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(SqlGeneratedSysId(), SqlAliasName("sys_id")),
                SqlSelectAlias(current_timestamp_expr, SqlAliasName("created_at")),
                SqlSelectAlias(current_timestamp_expr, SqlAliasName("updated_at")),
                SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(EMBEDDING_QUEUE.name), SqlAliasName("queue_name")),
                SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(0), SqlAliasName("priority")),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlWindow(
                        func_name="ROW_NUMBER",
                        args=[],
                        order_by=[

                                SqlColumnRef(
                                    SqlColumnName("__order_sys_id"),
                                    qualifier=payload_source_alias,
                                ),
                                OrderDirection.ASC,
                            ),
                        ],
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName("__sequence_offset"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlCompactJsonTextObject(
                        [
                            ("table_name", SqlCast(SqlParam(table_name), _TEXT_CAST_TARGET)),
                            ("index_name", SqlCast(SqlParam(index_name), _TEXT_CAST_TARGET)),
                            (
                                "object_id",
                                SqlCast(
                                    SqlColumnRef(
                                        SqlColumnName("source_object_id"),

                            ),
                            ("event_type", SqlCast(SqlParam(event_type), _TEXT_CAST_TARGET)),

                            ("revision_id", revision_id_payload_expr),

                            (
                                "precision_hint",

                                    SqlColumnName("precision_hint"),
                                    qualifier=payload_source_alias,
                                ),
                            ),
                            (
                                "content_hash_short",
                                SqlColumnRef(
                                    SqlColumnName("content_hash_short"),
                                    qualifier=payload_source_alias,
                                ),
                            ),
                            (
                                "content_hash_high",
                                SqlCase(
                                    whens=[
                                        (
                                            SqlIsNull(
                                                SqlColumnRef(
                                                    SqlColumnName("content_hash_high"),
                                                    qualifier=payload_source_alias,
                                                ),
                                            ),
                                            NULL,
                                        ),
                                    ],
                                    else_=SqlSignedBigIntHex(
                                        SqlColumnRef(
                                            SqlColumnName("content_hash_high"),
                                            qualifier=payload_source_alias,
                                        ),
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                            (
                                "skip_compute",
                                SqlJsonBoolWrap(
                                    SqlColumnRef(
                                        SqlColumnName("skip_compute"),
                                        qualifier=payload_source_alias,
                                    ),
                                ),
                            ),
                        ],
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName("payload_json"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(0), SqlAliasName("retry_count")),
                SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(EMBEDDING_QUEUE.max_retries), SqlAliasName("max_retries")),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlParam(EMBEDDING_QUEUE.visibility_timeout_seconds),
                    SqlAliasName("visibility_timeout_seconds"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlCast(SqlParam(table_name), _TEXT_CAST_TARGET),
                    SqlAliasName("source_table_name"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName("source_object_id"),
                        qualifier=payload_source_alias,

                SqlSelectAlias(auth_token_expr, SqlAliasName("auth_token")),

        from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(payload_source_rows, payload_source_alias),
