def _compile_permission_where_with_resolved_user(
    *,
    model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    session_id: Any,
    resolved_user_id: ResolvedPermissionUserId | SqlRenderable,
    table_alias: str,
    missing_user_message: str,
    version_anchor: PermissionVersionAnchor,
    compilation_context: CompilationContext,
    session_id_sql: SqlRenderable | None,
    session_vars: Mapping[str | tuple[type, str], SqlRenderable] | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    """Build permission SQL from an explicit CTE-backed or concrete user source."""
    from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import get_query_permission_plan

    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_type)
    typed_session_id = _normalize_literal_session_id(session_id)
    if permission_plan is None or not permission_plan.filters_session(typed_session_id):
        return None
    if permission_plan.requires_user_id and resolved_user_id is None:
        raise RuntimeError(missing_user_message)

    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.protocols import SqlRenderable
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlFrom, SqlSelectList
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlSubquery
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
    from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
        compile_versioned_permission_where_with_user_id_sql,
    )
    from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference
    from l4000_permissions.rbac_ids import UserId

    if isinstance(resolved_user_id, SqlRenderable):
        user_id_expr: SqlRenderable = resolved_user_id
    elif isinstance(resolved_user_id, CteReference):
        user_id_expr = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("user_id"))]),
                from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(resolved_user_id.ref_id))),
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
    else:
        user_id_expr = SqlParam(
            resolved_user_id.unwrap_to_str() if isinstance(resolved_user_id, UserId) else None,
        )

    permission_where: SqlRenderable | None = compile_versioned_permission_where_with_user_id_sql(
        model_type,
        user_id_expr,
        table_alias,
        version_anchor=version_anchor,
        session_id_sql=session_id_sql,
        session_vars=session_vars,
        compilation_context=compilation_context,
    )
    return permission_where

    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts._expressions_fts import SqlTsQueryMode
    from l5100_fts.fts_query import FTSSearchMode

    if mode == FTSSearchMode.PHRASE:
        return str(SqlTsQueryMode.PHRASE)
    if mode in {FTSSearchMode.BOOLEAN, FTSSearchMode.PREFIX}:
        return str(SqlTsQueryMode.BOOLEAN)
    return str(SqlTsQueryMode.PLAIN)


def _build_postgres_natural_query_text_expr(query_expr: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlFuncCall, SqlTrimExpr
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam

    stripped_operators = SqlTrimExpr(query_expr)
    for token in ("&", "|", "!", ":", "*", "(", ")", "<", ">"):
        stripped_operators = SqlFuncCall(
            "REPLACE",
            [
                stripped_operators,
                SqlParam(token),
                SqlParam(" "),
            ],
        )
    normalized_whitespace = SqlFuncCall(
        "REGEXP_REPLACE",
        [
            SqlTrimExpr(stripped_operators),
            SqlParam(r"\s+"),
            SqlParam(" "),
            SqlParam("g"),
        ],
    )
    return SqlFuncCall(
        "REPLACE",
        [
            SqlTrimExpr(normalized_whitespace),
            SqlParam(" "),
            SqlParam(" | "),
        ],
    )


def _build_postgres_boolean_query_text_expr(query_expr: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlFuncCall
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam

    normalized = query_expr
    for source, target in (
        (" AND ", " & "),
        (" OR ", " | "),
        (" NOT ", " ! "),
    ):
        normalized = SqlFuncCall(
            "REPLACE",
            [
                normalized,
                SqlParam(source),
                SqlParam(target),
            ],
        )
    return normalized


def _build_postgres_prefix_query_text_expr(query_expr: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam

    if isinstance(query_expr, SqlParam):
        terms = [match.group(0) for match in re.finditer(r"\w+", str(query_expr.value), flags=re.UNICODE)]
        return SqlParam(FtsQueryText(" & ".join(f"{term}:*" for term in terms)))
    return _build_postgres_boolean_query_text_expr(query_expr)


def _build_postgres_tsquery_expr(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_expr: SqlRenderable,
    mode: FTSSearchMode | None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts._expressions_fts import SqlTsQueryMode, SqlTsQueryParamExpr
    from l5100_fts.fts_query import FTSSearchMode

    if mode == FTSSearchMode.NATURAL:
        return SqlTsQueryParamExpr(
            language=SqlGrammarKind(_fts_language_for_model(model_cls)),
            query_expr=_build_postgres_natural_query_text_expr(query_expr),
            mode=SqlTsQueryMode.BOOLEAN,
        )
    if mode == FTSSearchMode.BOOLEAN:
        return SqlTsQueryParamExpr(
            language=SqlGrammarKind(_fts_language_for_model(model_cls)),
            query_expr=_build_postgres_boolean_query_text_expr(query_expr),
            mode=SqlTsQueryMode.BOOLEAN,
        )
    if mode == FTSSearchMode.PREFIX:
        return SqlTsQueryParamExpr(
            language=SqlGrammarKind(_fts_language_for_model(model_cls)),
            query_expr=_build_postgres_prefix_query_text_expr(query_expr),
            mode=SqlTsQueryMode.BOOLEAN,
        )
    return SqlTsQueryParamExpr(
        language=SqlGrammarKind(_fts_language_for_model(model_cls)),
        query_expr=query_expr,
        mode=SqlGrammarKind(_tsquery_mode_from_search_mode(mode)),
    )

def _wrap_native_fts_raw_projection(
    *,
    grammar: SqlRenderable,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    rank_source_alias: str,
    rank_output_alias: str = "__fts_rank",
) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectAlias, SqlSelectList, SqlTableAlias
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
    from l1000_schema.column_utils import cached_db_column_name
    from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    source_alias = SqlAliasName("fts_payload")
    selected_columns = [cached_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in model_cls.model_fields]
    selected_columns.extend(
        get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)))
        for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
    )
    select_items: list[SqlRenderable] = [

            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=source_alias),
            SqlAliasName(column),
        )
        for column in dict.fromkeys(selected_columns)
    ]
    select_items.append(
        SqlSelectAlias(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(rank_source_alias), qualifier=source_alias),
            SqlAliasName(rank_output_alias),

    )
    return SqlSelect(
        SqlSelectList(select_items),

def _compile_terminal_search_projection(
    *,
    grammar: SqlRenderable,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    inline_large_columns: bool,
    query_spec: QuerySpec[Any] | None = None,
    raw_mode: bool = True,
) -> CompiledStep[object]:
    from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    closed_post_op = row_dicts_post_op()
    __opa002_grammar_444 = grammar
    columns = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            (
                *(str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))) for field_name in model_cls.model_fields),
                *(
                    str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column))))
                    for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )
    published_columns = (*columns, "_fts_rank")
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
        tuple(synthetic_output_field(column, role="fts_terminal") for column in published_columns),
    )
    model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, columns)
    column_type_hints = (
        None
        if model_hints is None
        else combine_sql_column_type_hints(
            published_columns,
            model_hints,
            SqlColumnTypeHints(double_columns=frozenset({"_fts_rank"})),
        )
    )
    if column_type_hints is None:
        msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {model_cls.__name__} FTS terminal projection."
        # FTS terminal projection preserves explicit SQL type metadata.
        raise ProgrammingError(msg)
    compiled = CompiledStep(
        output_shape=output_shape,
        grammar=__opa002_grammar_444,
        needs_returning=True,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        closed_post_op=closed_post_op,
    )
    if inline_large_columns:
        compiled = wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns(
            compiled,
            model_cls=model_cls,
        )
        if query_spec is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
                inline_large_column_query_post_op,
            )

            compiled = replace(
                compiled,
                closed_post_op=inline_large_column_query_post_op(
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    query_spec=query_spec,
                    result_mode="many",
                    raw_mode=raw_mode,
                ),
            )
    return cast(CompiledStep[object], compiled)

def _searched_fields_are_private_only(
    field_names: Sequence[str],
    private_fields: Sequence[str],
) -> bool:
    private_field_set = frozenset(private_fields)
    searched = frozenset(field_names)
    return bool(searched) and not searched.isdisjoint(private_field_set) and searched.issubset(private_field_set)


def _effective_fts_fields_for_column_visibility(
    field_names: Sequence[str],
    masking_info: tuple[str, list[str]] | None,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if masking_info is None:
        return tuple(field_names)
    _owner_field, private_fields = masking_info
    private_field_set = frozenset(private_fields)
    searched = tuple(field_names)
    public_fields = tuple(field_name for field_name in searched if field_name not in private_field_set)
    private_requested = any(field_name in private_field_set for field_name in searched)
    if private_requested and public_fields:
        return public_fields
    return searched


def _combine_where_clauses(
    left: SqlRenderable | None,
    right: SqlRenderable | None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    if left is None:
        return right
    if right is None:
        return left
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import sql_and

    return sql_and(left, right)


def _native_fts_private_field_owner_filter(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_names: Sequence[str],
    masking_info: tuple[str, list[str]] | None,
    user_id_expr: SqlRenderable | None,
    table_alias: str,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    if masking_info is None:
        return None
    owner_field, private_fields = masking_info
    if not _searched_fields_are_private_only(field_names, private_fields):
        return None
    assert user_id_expr is not None

    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    return SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(owner_field))), qualifier=table_alias),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        user_id_expr,
    )


def _wrap_native_fts_projection_with_column_masking(
    *,
    grammar: SqlRenderable,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    masking_info: tuple[str, list[str]] | None,
    user_id_expr: SqlRenderable | None,
    rank_alias: str = "_fts_rank",
) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
        SqlItemList,
        SqlOrderByClause,
        SqlOrderByItem,
        SqlSelectAlias,
        SqlSubqueryTableRef,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import OrderDirection
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.field_reference_policy import build_sql_field_reference_policy
    from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    source_alias = "fts_rows"
    field_policy = (
        build_sql_field_reference_policy(
            get_db_column=lambda field_name: get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)),
            table_alias=source_alias,
            column_masking=masking_info,
            column_masking_user_grammar=user_id_expr,
        )
        if masking_info is not None and user_id_expr is not None
        else None
    )
    select_items: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
        db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
        if field_policy is not None:
            projected_field = field_policy.observable_field(field_name, db_col=db_column)
        else:
            projected_field = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_column), qualifier=source_alias)
        select_items.append(SqlSelectAlias(projected_field, SqlAliasName(db_column)))
    for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        pointer_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)))
        select_items.append(
            SqlSelectAlias(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(pointer_column), qualifier=source_alias),
                SqlAliasName(pointer_column),
            ),
        )
    select_items.append(
        SqlSelectAlias(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(rank_alias), qualifier=source_alias),
            SqlAliasName(rank_alias),
        ),
    )
    return SqlSelect(
        SqlItemList(select_items),
        SqlSubqueryTableRef(grammar, SqlTableName(source_alias)),
        order_by=SqlOrderByClause(
            [
                SqlOrderByItem(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(rank_alias), qualifier=source_alias),
                    OrderDirection.DESC,
                ),
            ],
        ),
    )


def _native_query_input_column_name(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    column: object,
) -> str:
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    expression = getattr(column, "expression", None)
    if expression is not None:
        column = expression
    if isinstance(column, tuple):
        column = column[0]
    field_name = getattr(column, "field", None) or getattr(column, "name", None)
    if field_name is None:
        field_name = str(column)
    return str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(str(field_name))))


def _wrap_native_fts_query_shape(
    *,
    grammar: SqlRenderable,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_inputs: _VersionedFtsQueryInputs | None,
    limit: int | None,
    offset: int,
    rank_alias: str = "_fts_rank",
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if query_inputs is None:
        return grammar

    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
        SqlItemList,
        SqlOrderByClause,
        SqlOrderByItem,
        SqlSelectAlias,
        SqlSubqueryTableRef,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import OrderDirection
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
    from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    source_alias = "fts_shaped"
    selected_columns: tuple[str, ...]
    if query_inputs.select_columns is None:
        selected_columns = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                (
                    *(str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))) for field_name in model_cls.model_fields),
                    *(
                        str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column))))
                        for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
    else:
        selected_columns = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(_native_query_input_column_name(model_cls, select_column) for select_column in query_inputs.select_columns),
        )
    select_items: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlSelectAlias(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name), qualifier=source_alias),
            SqlAliasName(column_name),
        )
        for column_name in selected_columns
    ]
    select_items.append(
        SqlSelectAlias(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(rank_alias), qualifier=source_alias),
            SqlAliasName(rank_alias),
        ),
    )

    order_items: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlOrderByItem(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(rank_alias), qualifier=source_alias),
            OrderDirection.DESC,
        ),
    ]
    for order_entry in query_inputs.order_by:
        order_column = _native_query_input_column_name(model_cls, order_entry)
        direction_value = str(order_entry[1] if isinstance(order_entry, tuple) else getattr(order_entry, "direction", "ASC"))
        order_items.append(
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(order_column), qualifier=source_alias),
                OrderDirection.DESC if direction_value.upper() == "DESC" else OrderDirection.ASC,
            ),
        )

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.search_cursor_sql import build_search_cursor_where

    cursor_where = build_search_cursor_where(
        query_inputs.to_query_spec(model_cls=model_cls),
        score_column=rank_alias,
        source_alias=source_alias,
        model_cls=model_cls,
    )

    return SqlSelect(
        SqlItemList(select_items),
        SqlSubqueryTableRef(grammar, SqlTableName(source_alias)),
        where=cursor_where,
        order_by=SqlOrderByClause(order_items),
        limit=limit,
        offset=None if cursor_where is not None else offset if offset > 0 else None,
    )

def _lowering_context_has_table_match_native_fts_index(
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> bool:
    """Return whether the table-match transport has a native FTS table for this model."""
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is not FtsSqlTransport.TABLE_MATCH:
        return False
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
    from l5100_fts.fts_naming import fts_table_name

    model_table = get_table_name(model_cls)
    cached_native_exists = ctx.cached_native_fts_index_exists(model_table)
    if cached_native_exists is True:
        return True
    cached_exists = ctx.cached_table_exists(SqlTableName(fts_table_name(model_table)))
    if cached_exists is True:
        return True
    txn_handle = ctx.executor_txn_handle
    if txn_handle is not None:
        from _internal.transaction_helpers import get_transaction_connection

        conn = get_transaction_connection(cast(Any, txn_handle))
        native_cache = getattr(conn, "_native_fts_index_exists_cache", None)
        if isinstance(native_cache, dict):
            cached_native = native_cache.get((model_table, "all"))
            if cached_native is True:
                return True
    return bool(ctx.has_native_fts)


class RouteFtsSearchIntent(IntentStep[object]):
    """Lower search to the correct native or polyfill intent."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "fts", "search", "route", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.MANY
    intent_read_only = True
    _model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]
    _config: _RouteFtsSearchConfig

    def __init__(self, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)

    @classmethod
    def build(
        cls,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _RouteFtsSearchConfig,
    ) -> RouteFtsSearchIntent:
        intent = cls(ref_id)
        intent._model_cls = model_cls
        intent._config = config
        return intent

    def with_after_refs(
        self,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
    ) -> RouteFtsSearchIntent:
        """Return this semantic route with explicit acquisition dependencies."""
        return self.build(
            self.ref_id,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            config=replace(self._config, after_refs=self._config.after_refs | after_refs),
        )

    def schema_model_dependencies(self: RouteFtsSearchIntent) -> tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], ...]:
        """Declare the logical FTS model needed by local read-through routing."""
        return (self._model_cls,)

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name

        return _fts_table_event_dependencies(get_table_name(self._model_cls))

    def dependency_contract(self: RouteFtsSearchIntent) -> StepDependencyContract:
        refs = frozenset(str(ref) for ref in (*self._config.query_source.dependencies(), *self._config.after_refs))
        return StepDependencyContract.from_refs(
            refs,
            source=DependencySource.DIRECT_FIELD,
            required_for=frozenset({DependencyUse.ORDERING, DependencyUse.TRANSPORT_GRAPH}),
            transport=TransportDependencyPolicy.TRANSPORTABLE,
            reason="route FTS query source",
        )

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[object]]:
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
        from l5100_fts.fts_config import FTSIndexImplementation, get_fts_config

        config = get_fts_config(self._model_cls)
        implementation = config.implementation if config is not None else FTSIndexImplementation.AUTO
        has_native_fts = False
        if implementation is not FTSIndexImplementation.POLYFILL:
            has_native_fts = (
                _lowering_context_has_table_match_native_fts_index(ctx, self._model_cls)
                if ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.TABLE_MATCH
                else ctx.has_native_fts
            )
        if implementation is FTSIndexImplementation.NATIVE and not has_native_fts:
            msg = f"{self._model_cls.__name__} is configured for native FTS, but {ctx.backend_type.value} has no native FTS route"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)

        if has_native_fts and ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is not FtsSqlTransport.NONE:
            payload_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_payload_raw")
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query_extended import (
                _append_search_payload_projection_steps,
            )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.search_payload import (
                ProjectSearchPayloadResultsStep,
                ProjectSearchPayloadWithMetaStep,
            )

            def _build_projection_step(
                final_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
                materialized_payload_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
            ) -> ServerPlanStep[Any]:
                if self._config.projection == "with_meta":
                    return ProjectSearchPayloadWithMetaStep(final_ref, materialized_payload_ref)
                return ProjectSearchPayloadResultsStep(final_ref, materialized_payload_ref)

            should_hydrate_payload = not self._config.raw_mode
            return [
                NativeFtsTerminalStep(
                    payload_ref,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    query_source=self._config.query_source,
                    config=_NativeFtsTerminalConfig(
                        literal_query_text=self._config.literal_query_text,
                        literal_sqlite_fts_query=self._config.literal_sqlite_fts_query,
                        field_names=self._config.field_names,
                        mode=self._config.mode,
                        query_inputs=self._config.query_inputs,
                        limit=self._config.limit,
                        offset=self._config.offset,
                        data_table_name=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
                        session_id=self._config.session_id,
                        projection=self._config.projection,
                        raw_mode=self._config.raw_mode,
                        defer_large_columns=self._config.defer_large_columns,
                        permission_context_ref=self._config.permission_context_ref,
                        permission_context_type=self._config.permission_context_type,

class FTSSearchStep(MaybeSqlRelationPublisherStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]):
    """L0: Single-query BM25 search with data materialization.

    Compiles to a CTE query that:
    1. Computes term frequencies from the inverted index
    2. Computes avg_doc_length from the metadata table
    3. Calculates BM25 scores using IDF cache + metadata
    4. JOINs with the data table to return full rows with _fts_rank
    """

    def cte_publication_contract(self: FTSSearchStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

        data_columns = tuple(get_db_column_name(self._model_type, DynamicFieldName(column)) for column in self._data_columns)
        columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*data_columns, "_fts_rank")))
        model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_type, data_columns)
        if model_hints is None:
            msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._model_type.__name__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        column_type_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
            columns,
            model_hints,
            SqlColumnTypeHints(double_columns=frozenset({"_fts_rank"})),
        )
        if columns is None:
            if column_type_hints is not None and column_type_hints.has_any():
                msg = f"{type(self).__name__} declares SQL column type hints without an explicit cte_output_columns() contract."
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=cte_projection_row_model(
                f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
                contract_columns,
                column_type_hints,
            ),
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.projection_over_model(
                source_model_cls=self._model_type,
                projection_lineage=tuple(
                    (column, "fts_rank:_fts_rank" if column == "_fts_rank" else column) for column in contract_columns
                ),
            ),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def __init__(
        self: FTSSearchStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        query_ref: ScalarServerRef[FtsQueryText],
        config: _FtsSearchConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_type = model_type
        self._model_cls = model_type
        self._query_ref = query_ref
        self._field_names = list(config.field_names)
        self._literal_query_tokens = config.literal_query_tokens
        self._mode = config.mode
        self._limit = config.limit
        self._offset = config.offset
        self._index_table_name = config.index_table_name
        self._metadata_table_name = config.metadata_table_name
        self._idf_cache_table_name = config.idf_cache_table_name
        self._data_table_name = config.data_table_name
        self._data_columns = list(config.data_columns)
        self._k1 = config.k1
        self._b = config.b
        self._after_refs = config.after_refs
        self._literal_query_text = config.literal_query_text
        self._projection: Literal["results", "with_meta"] = "results"

    @property
    def level(self: FTSSearchStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: FTSSearchStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self: FTSSearchStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self: FTSSearchStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(
            {
                self._index_table_name,
                self._metadata_table_name,
                self._idf_cache_table_name,
                self._data_table_name,
            },
        )

    def tables_written(self: FTSSearchStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self: FTSSearchStep) -> bool:
        return bool(self._query_ref.dependencies())

    def step_tags(self: FTSSearchStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "fts", "search", "query"})

    def dependencies(self: FTSSearchStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({*self._query_ref.dependencies(), *self._after_refs})

    def compile(self: FTSSearchStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        if self._literal_query_tokens is None:
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name="FTSSearchStep.compile",
                trigger="polyfill FTS search requires literal query tokens but only received a symbolic query ref",
                blocked_path="compile-time tokenization of symbolic FTS query input",
                result_contract=(
                    "polyfill FTSSearchStep must compile from pre-tokenized literal input or a future SQL-visible token source"
                ),
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Tokenize literal query strings in _lazy() before the intent is enqueued.",
                    "Keep symbolic query refs on SQL-native search paths or add an explicit SQL-visible token source step.",
                    "Do not inspect ServerRef literal values during compile().",
                ),
            )
        literal_query_tokens = self._literal_query_tokens
        assert literal_query_tokens is not None
        tokens = list(literal_query_tokens)
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.session_subqueries import (
            SqlSessionUserIdSubquery,
        )
        from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
            compile_permission_where_with_user_expr,
        )
        from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import get_query_permission_plan

        permission_where: SqlRenderable | None = None
        permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(self._model_type)
        permission_session_id: SessionId | None
        if isinstance(ctx.session_id, ScalarServerRef):
            permission_session_id = SessionId.unresolved()
        else:
            permission_session_id = _normalize_literal_session_id(ctx.session_id)
        if permission_plan is not None and permission_plan.filters_session(permission_session_id):
            if permission_session_id is None:
                from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
                    compile_permission_deny_all,
                )

                permission_where = compile_permission_deny_all()
            else:
                session_sql = session_id_expr(ctx.session_id, ctx)
                permission_where = compile_permission_where_with_user_expr(
                    self._model_type,
                    session_id=permission_session_id,
                    user_id_expr=SqlSessionUserIdSubquery(session_sql),
                    session_id_sql=session_sql,
                    table_alias="d",
                    session_vars=ctx.permission_session_vars or None,
                    compilation_context=ctx,
                )

        grammar = _build_fts_search_grammar(
            tokens=tokens,
            query_text=self._literal_query_text,
            mode=self._mode,
            fields=self._field_names,
            index_table=str(self._index_table_name),
            metadata_table=str(self._metadata_table_name),
            idf_cache_table=str(self._idf_cache_table_name),
            data_table=str(self._data_table_name),
            data_columns=self._data_columns,
            k1=self._k1,
            b=self._b,
            limit=self._limit,
            offset=self._offset,
            permission_where=permission_where,
        )

        __opa002_grammar_924 = grammar
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_924,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
        )


def _build_fts_search_grammar(
    *,
    tokens: list[str],
    query_text: str | None,
    mode: FTSSearchMode,
    fields: list[str],
    index_table: str,
    metadata_table: str,
    idf_cache_table: str,
    data_table: str,
    data_columns: list[str],
    k1: float,
    b: float,
    limit: int | None,
    offset: int,
    permission_where: SqlRenderable | None,
) -> Any:
    """Build a single CTE query for BM25 search + data materialization.

    Generates::

        WITH term_freq AS (
            SELECT content_hash, token, SUM(frequency) AS tf
            FROM fts_index WHERE token IN (...) AND field_name IN (...)
            GROUP BY content_hash, token
        ),
        avg_stats AS (
            SELECT AVG(doc_length) AS avg_dl FROM fts_metadata
        ),
        bm25_scores AS (
            SELECT t.content_hash,
                SUM(COALESCE(idf.idf, 0) * (t.tf * (k1+1)) /
                    (t.tf + k1*(1-b + b*(m.doc_length / a.avg_dl))))
                AS bm25_score
            FROM term_freq t
            JOIN fts_metadata m ON t.content_hash = m.content_hash
            CROSS JOIN avg_stats a
            LEFT JOIN fts_idf_cache idf ON t.token = idf.token
            GROUP BY t.content_hash
            ORDER BY bm25_score DESC
            [LIMIT ? OFFSET ?]
        )
        SELECT d.*, bs.bm25_score AS _fts_rank
        FROM data_table d
        JOIN bm25_scores bs ON d.sys_fts_content_hash = bs.content_hash
        ORDER BY bs.bm25_score DESC
    """
    del data_columns
    from impl.common.l5150_fts_polyfill.polyfill_search_grammar import SqlPolyfillFtsSearch

    return SqlPolyfillFtsSearch(
        tokens=tokens,
        query_text=query_text,
        mode=mode,
        fields=fields,
        index_table=index_table,
        metadata_table=metadata_table,
        idf_cache_table=idf_cache_table,
        data_table=data_table,
        k1=k1,
        b=b,
        limit=limit,
        offset=offset,
        permission_where=permission_where,
    )

    def level(self) -> int:

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:

    def cte_publication_contract(self: NativeFtsTerminalStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        def _legacy_cte_output_columns() -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
            from l1000_schema.column_utils import cached_db_column_name

            from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name

            columns = [
                cached_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in self._model_cls.model_fields
            ]
            columns.extend(
                cached_db_column_name(
                    self._model_cls,
                    DynamicFieldName(str(large_column_pointer_name(config.column))),
                )
                for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls)
            )
            columns.append(SqlColumnName("_fts_rank"))
            return tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))

        columns = _legacy_cte_output_columns()

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...] | None) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
            if columns is None:
                return None
            base_columns = tuple(column for column in columns if column != "_fts_rank")
            model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, base_columns)
            if model_hints is None:
                msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._model_cls.__name__} native FTS rows"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                columns,
                model_hints,
                SqlColumnTypeHints(double_columns=frozenset({"_fts_rank"})),
            )

        column_type_hints: SqlColumnTypeHints | None
        if not self._defer_large_columns or self._raw_mode:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
                _inline_large_column_output_shape,
                inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints,
            )

            assert columns is not None
            base_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
                tuple(synthetic_output_field(column, role="fts_terminal") for column in columns),
            )
            inline_shape = _inline_large_column_output_shape(base_shape, self._model_cls)
            assert inline_shape is not None
            columns = inline_shape.cte_output_columns
            base_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(
                tuple(column for column in columns if not column.startswith("__nera_inline_large_column__"))
            )
            assert base_hints is not None
            column_type_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                columns,
                base_hints,
                inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls),
            )
        else:
            column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if columns is None:
            if column_type_hints is not None and column_type_hints.has_any():
                msg = f"{type(self).__name__} declares SQL column type hints without an explicit cte_output_columns() contract."
                raise TypeError(msg)

        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints,
        )
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.projection_over_model(
                source_model_cls=_contract_model_cls,

                *(() if self._permission_context_ref is None else (str(self._permission_context_ref),)),

                sqlite_query = _build_fts5_query(self._literal_query_text, effective_field_names, self._mode)
            if sqlite_query is None:
                raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                    site_name="NativeFtsTerminalStep.compile",
                    trigger=(
                        "SQLite native FTS search requires a precomputed literal FTS5 query string but received only a symbolic query ref"
                    ),
                    blocked_path="compile-time SQLite FTS5 query shaping from symbolic FTS input",
                    result_contract=("SQLite native FTS compilation must receive an explicit FTS5 query string on the literal path"),
                    implementation_requirements=(
                        "Shape SQLite FTS5 query strings in _lazy() for literal Python query inputs.",

            assert sqlite_query is not None
            if not sqlite_query.strip():

                    grammar=SqlNoOpStatement(),
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    inline_large_columns=False,
                )
            if session_id is None:
                permission_where = compile_permission_deny_all() if permission_plan is not None else None
            else:
                user_id_expr = SqlSessionUserIdSubquery(session_id_expr(ctx.session_id, ctx))
                if ctx.versioning_domain is not None:

            permission_where = _combine_where_clauses(
                permission_where,
                _build_native_fts_extra_where(
                    query_inputs=self._query_inputs,

                    table_alias="c",
                ),
            )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.hybrid_document_rank import hybrid_document_rank

            if self._literal_query_text is None:
                raise NotImplementedError("Document-local SQLite FTS ranking requires literal query text")
            document_rank = hybrid_document_rank(
                self._model_cls,
                ctx,
                query=self._literal_query_text,
                fields=tuple(effective_field_names),
                mode=self._mode,
                table_name=data_table_name,
                table_alias="c",
            )
            grammar = SqlAppendLimitOffset(
                SqlFts5SearchSelect(
                    SqlTableName(f"{data_table_name}_fts"),
                    data_table_name,
                    fts_query=FtsQueryText(sqlite_query),
                    rank_alias="_fts_rank",
                    rank_expression=SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr(document_rank, backend="polyfill"),
                    order_expression=document_rank,
                    order_direction="DESC",
                    extra_where=permission_where,
                ),
                limit=scan_limit,
                offset=scan_offset,
            )
            grammar = _wrap_native_fts_projection_with_column_masking(
                grammar=grammar,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                masking_info=masking_info,
                user_id_expr=user_id_expr,
            )
        elif ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.MATCH_AGAINST:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.hybrid_document_rank import hybrid_document_rank

            literal_query_text = self._literal_query_text
            if literal_query_text is None:
                raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                    site_name="NativeFtsTerminalStep.compile",
                    trigger="MariaDB native FTS compilation received only a symbolic query ref",
                    blocked_path="compile-time MariaDB MATCH query shaping from symbolic FTS input",
                    result_contract="MariaDB native FTS compilation must receive a literal query string",
                    implementation_requirements=(
                        "Thread literal query text from the public search call into NativeFtsTerminalStep.",
                        "Add a SQL-visible MariaDB boolean/natural query-shaping expression before accepting symbolic queries.",
                        "Do not route MariaDB native search to polyfill tables when native FULLTEXT artifacts were created.",
                    ),
                )
            if session_id is None:
                permission_where = compile_permission_deny_all() if permission_plan is not None else None
            else:
                user_id_expr = SqlSessionUserIdSubquery(session_id_expr(ctx.session_id, ctx))
                if ctx.versioning_domain is not None:
                    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
                        versioned_permission_anchor,
                    )

                        self._model_cls,

                        table_alias=_native_table_alias(),

                else:

                permission_where = _combine_where_clauses(

            if literal_query_text is None:
                msg = "MariaDB native FTS requires a literal query text"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            permission_where = _combine_where_clauses(
                permission_where,
                _build_native_fts_extra_where(
                    query_inputs=self._query_inputs,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    table_alias=_native_table_alias(),
                ),
            )
            grammar = _build_mariadb_native_fts_grammar(
                query_text=literal_query_text,
                field_names=effective_field_names,
                table_name=SqlTableName(data_table_name),

            grammar = _wrap_native_fts_projection_with_column_masking(
                grammar=grammar,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                masking_info=masking_info,
                user_id_expr=user_id_expr,
                rank_alias="_fts_rank",
            )
        else:
            provider = _get_fts_pushdown_provider(ctx)
            query_expr = _build_postgres_tsquery_expr(
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                query_expr=lower_scalar_server_ref(self._query_ref, ctx),
                mode=self._mode,
            )
            if session_id is None:
                permission_where = compile_permission_deny_all() if permission_plan is not None else None
            else:
                user_id_expr = SqlSessionUserIdSubquery(session_id_expr(ctx.session_id, ctx))
                if ctx.versioning_domain is not None:
                    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
                        versioned_permission_anchor,
                    )

                    permission_where = compile_versioned_permission_where_with_user_expr(
                        self._model_cls,
                        session_id=session_id,
                        user_id_expr=user_id_expr,
                        session_id_sql=session_id_expr(ctx.session_id, ctx),
                        table_alias=_native_table_alias(),

                        session_vars=session_vars,

                else:
                    permission_where = compile_permission_where_with_user_expr(
                        self._model_cls,
                        session_id=session_id,
                        user_id_expr=user_id_expr,

                        table_alias=_native_table_alias(),
                        session_vars=session_vars,
                        compilation_context=ctx,
                    )
                permission_where = _combine_where_clauses(
                    permission_where,
                    _native_fts_private_field_owner_filter(
                        model_cls=self._model_cls,
                        field_names=field_names,
                        masking_info=masking_info,
                        user_id_expr=user_id_expr,
                        table_alias=_native_table_alias(),
                    ),
                )
            permission_where = _combine_where_clauses(
                permission_where,
                _build_native_fts_extra_where(
                    query_inputs=self._query_inputs,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    table_alias=_native_table_alias(),
                ),
            )
            grammar = provider.compile_native_search(
                query_expr=query_expr,
                field_names=effective_field_names,
                table_name=data_table_name,
                model_type=self._model_cls,
                limit=scan_limit,
                offset=scan_offset,
                extra_where=permission_where,
            )
            grammar = _wrap_native_fts_raw_projection(
                grammar=grammar,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                rank_source_alias="_fts_rank",
                rank_output_alias="_fts_rank",
            )
            if session_id is not None:
                grammar = _wrap_native_fts_projection_with_column_masking(
                    grammar=grammar,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    masking_info=masking_info,
                    user_id_expr=user_id_expr,
                    rank_alias="_fts_rank",
                )
        grammar = _wrap_native_fts_query_shape(
            grammar=grammar,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            query_inputs=self._query_inputs,
            limit=limit,
            offset=offset,
            rank_alias="_fts_rank",
        )
        compiled = _compile_terminal_search_projection(
            grammar=grammar,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            inline_large_columns=(not self._defer_large_columns or self._raw_mode),
            query_spec=(None if self._query_inputs is None else self._query_inputs.to_query_spec(model_cls=self._model_cls)),
            raw_mode=self._raw_mode,
        )
        if self._permission_context_ref is None:
            return compiled
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import (
            _permission_context_ref_auxiliary_ctes,
        )

        permission_ctes = _permission_context_ref_auxiliary_ctes(
            self._permission_context_ref,
            ctx,
        )
        return replace(
            compiled,
            auxiliary_ctes=(*(compiled.auxiliary_ctes or ()), *permission_ctes),
        )


class _EmptyFTSResultStepCteRow(BaseModel):
    sys_id: SysId
    score: float


class _EmptyFTSResultStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]):
    """L0: Returns empty FTS results. Used when revision_ids=[] (no accessible revisions)."""

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _EmptyFTSResultStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("sys_id", "score")
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"}), double_columns=frozenset({"score"}))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _EmptyFTSResultStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.projection_over_model(
                source_model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
                projection_lineage=tuple((str(column), str(column)) for column in columns),
            ),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    @property
    def level(self: _EmptyFTSResultStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _EmptyFTSResultStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self: _EmptyFTSResultStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: _EmptyFTSResultStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def tables_read(self: _EmptyFTSResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _EmptyFTSResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def step_tags(self: _EmptyFTSResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "fts", "query"})

    def compile(self: _EmptyFTSResultStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        del ctx
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=literal_post_op([]),
        )

def _build_versioned_fts_extra_where(
    *,
    query_inputs: _VersionedFtsQueryInputs | None,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None,
    table_alias: str = "s",
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    if query_inputs is None:
        return None

    unsupported_shape = (
        bool(query_inputs.joins)
        or bool(query_inputs.group_by)
        or bool(query_inputs.aggregations)
        or bool(query_inputs.having)
        or bool(query_inputs.window_functions)
    )
    if unsupported_shape:
        msg = "Versioned FTS payload search currently supports only row-shaped query specs"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_versioned import (
        _build_polymorphic_type_condition,
        _normalize_versioned_query_spec_type_filter,
        _rebind_permission_grammar_for_versioned_source,
        _replace_query_spec_attrs,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import sql_and
    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.query_grammar import QueryGrammarBuilder

    spec = _replace_query_spec_attrs(
        query_inputs.to_query_spec(model_cls=model_cls),
        search=replace(
            query_inputs.to_query_spec(model_cls=model_cls).search_op,
            fts_query=None,
            fts_fields=(),
            fts_mode=None,
        ),
        select_columns=None,
        limit=None,
        offset=None,
        order_by=[],
    )
    spec = _normalize_versioned_query_spec_type_filter(
        _rebind_permission_grammar_for_versioned_source(
            spec,
            model_cls,
            table_alias=table_alias,
        ),
        model_cls,
    )

    where_renderable: SqlRenderable | None = None
    has_permission_grammar = getattr(spec, "permission_grammar", None) is not None
    if getattr(spec, "filters", None) or has_permission_grammar:
        where_clause = QueryGrammarBuilder(
            spec,
            table_alias=table_alias,
            planning_catalog=planning_catalog,
        ).build_where_clause()
        if where_clause is not None:
            where_renderable = where_clause.condition

    type_condition = _build_polymorphic_type_condition(model_cls, qualifier=table_alias)
    if type_condition is not None:
        where_renderable = sql_and(where_renderable, type_condition) if where_renderable is not None else type_condition
    return where_renderable


def _build_native_fts_extra_where(
    *,
    query_inputs: _VersionedFtsQueryInputs | None,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    table_alias: str,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    if query_inputs is None:
        return None

    unsupported_shape = (
        bool(query_inputs.joins)
        or bool(query_inputs.group_by)
        or bool(query_inputs.aggregations)
        or bool(query_inputs.having)
        or bool(query_inputs.window_functions)
    )
    if unsupported_shape:
        msg = "Native FTS search currently supports only row-shaped query specs"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_versioned import (
        _replace_query_spec_attrs,
        _rebind_permission_grammar_for_versioned_source,
    )
    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.query_grammar import QueryGrammarBuilder

    spec = _replace_query_spec_attrs(
        query_inputs.to_query_spec(model_cls=model_cls),
        search=replace(
            query_inputs.to_query_spec(model_cls=model_cls).search_op,
            fts_query=None,
            fts_fields=(),
            fts_mode=None,
        ),
        select_columns=None,
        limit=None,
        offset=None,
        order_by=[],
    )
    spec = _rebind_permission_grammar_for_versioned_source(spec, model_cls, table_alias=table_alias)

    if not getattr(spec, "filters", None) and not has_permission_grammar:
