        return frozenset({self._table})

    def planning_fingerprint(self: UpsertRevisionBranchAnchorStep) -> tuple[object, ...] | None:
        return _commit_step_fingerprint(
            self,
            "dialect-generated-sys-id-v2",
            str(self._table),
            self._anchor_reason,
            self._anchor_depth,
            _sorted_deps(self.dependencies()),
            env_sensitive=True,
        )

    def compile(self: UpsertRevisionBranchAnchorStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
            SqlColumnList,
            SqlOnConflict,
            SqlValuesClause,
            SqlValuesRow,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import ConflictAction

        column_order = [
            "sys_id",
            "revision_sys_id",
            "branch_sys_id",
            "anchor_reason",
            "anchor_depth",
        ]
        cols = SqlColumnList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(c)) for c in column_order])
        values = SqlValuesClause(
            [
                SqlValuesRow(
                    [
                        SqlDialectGeneratedSysId() if self._sys_id is None else SqlParam(self._sys_id),
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._revision_id, ctx),
                        _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_ref, ctx),
                        SqlParam(self._anchor_reason.value),
                        SqlParam(self._anchor_depth),
                    ],
                ),
            ],
        )
        on_conflict = SqlOnConflict(
            columns=(SqlColumnName("revision_sys_id"), SqlColumnName("branch_sys_id")),
            action=ConflictAction.DO_UPDATE,
            update_columns=(SqlColumnName("anchor_reason"), SqlColumnName("anchor_depth")),
        )
        stmt = SqlInsert(
            table=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(self._table)),
            columns=cols,
            values=values,
            on_conflict=on_conflict,
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=stmt,
            auxiliary_ctes=_auxiliary_ctes_for_scalar_refs(
                ctx,
                self._revision_id,
                self._branch_ref,
            ),
        )


def _staged_branch_selector_where(
    *,
    staged_table_name: SqlTableName,
    branch_id: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    source_qualifier: str | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    effective_staged = source_qualifier or _resolve_staged_source(staged_table_name, ctx)
    return sql_and(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), effective_staged),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(branch_id, ctx),
        ),
        selector.match_expr(
            column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
            qualifier=effective_staged,
            ctx=ctx,
        ),
    )

        self._branch_source_ref = branch_source_ref

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return self._sql_transport is not False

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        relation_dependencies = frozenset(
            ref for ref in (self._graph_key_source_ref, self._node_key_source_ref, self._branch_source_ref) if ref is not None
        )
        return _commit_publish_dependencies(
            self._dependencies | relation_dependencies,
            self._branch_id,
            sql_visible_dependencies=self._selector.dependencies(),
        )

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _commit_publish_sql_visible_dependencies(
            self._branch_id,
            sql_visible_dependencies=(
                *self._selector.dependencies(),
                *(ref for ref in (self._graph_key_source_ref, self._node_key_source_ref, self._branch_source_ref) if ref is not None),
            ),
        )

    def preprocess(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> None:
        del resolved

    @property
    def level(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "versioned", "publish", "affected_rows"})

    def is_affected_rows_result(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def tables_read(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return (
            frozenset({self._staged_table})
            | self._selector.tables_read()
            | _physical_projection_tables_read(self._physical_projection_columns)
        )

    def tables_written(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def staged_read_descriptor(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> StagedReadRequirement | None:
        return StagedReadRequirement(
            source_keys=(
                StagedSourceKey(
                    staged_table_name=self._staged_table,
                    branch_scope_token=self._selector._branch_scope_token,
                ),
            ),
            scope=_scope_descriptor_from_selector(self._branch_id, self._selector),
        )

    def cte_publication_contract(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(("sys_id", "branch_id", "sys_staged_commit_id", "sys_deleted", *(str(column) for column in self._data_columns)))
        )
        table_hints = _table_column_type_hints(
            self._staged_table,
            columns,
            model_cls=self._publication_model_cls,
        )
        column_type_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
            columns,
            table_hints,
            framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
        )
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        normalized_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        from l2070_batching.cte_contracts import projection_over_model_contract

        if self._publication_model_cls is None:
            return CtePublicationContract(
                publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
                columns=normalized_columns,
                column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
                relation_contract=CteRelationContract.table_projection(
                    source_table=str(self._staged_table),
                    projection_lineage=tuple((column, column) for column in normalized_columns),
                ),
                relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
                source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
            )
        return projection_over_model_contract(
            columns=normalized_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            source_model_cls=self._publication_model_cls,
            projection_lineage=tuple((column, column) for column in normalized_columns),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(self: AffectedStagedRowsStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        effective_staged = _resolve_staged_source(self._staged_table, ctx)
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        source_qualifier = str(effective_staged)
        select_items: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        for column_name in contract.columns:
            expression: SqlRenderable
            if column_name == "graph_key" and column_name in self._physical_projection_columns:
                base_key = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), _GRAPH_BASE_KEY_ALIAS)
                expression = (
                    SqlCoalesceExpr(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), _GRAPH_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS),
                        base_key,
                    )
                    if self._graph_key_source_ref is not None
                    else base_key
                )
            elif column_name == "source_node_key" and column_name in self._physical_projection_columns:
                expression = _resolved_graph_node_key_expr(
                    inserted_source_available=self._node_key_source_ref is not None,
                    inserted_alias=_SOURCE_NODE_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS,
                    base_alias=_SOURCE_NODE_BASE_KEY_ALIAS,
                )
            elif column_name == "target_node_key" and column_name in self._physical_projection_columns:
                expression = _resolved_graph_node_key_expr(
                    inserted_source_available=self._node_key_source_ref is not None,
                    inserted_alias=_TARGET_NODE_INSERTED_KEY_ALIAS,
                    base_alias=_TARGET_NODE_BASE_KEY_ALIAS,
                )
            else:
                expression = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name), source_qualifier)
            select_items.append(SqlSelectAlias(expression, SqlAliasName(column_name)))
        branch_expr: SqlRenderable = _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_id, ctx)
        branch_source_cte: tuple[str, SqlRenderable] | None = None
        if self._branch_source_ref is not None:
            from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference

            branch_source = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._branch_source_ref))
            if not isinstance(branch_source, CteReference) or branch_source.auxiliary_query is None:
                raise ValueError("Affected staged rows require a replayable SQL-visible branch source")
            branch_source_cte = (branch_source.ref_id, branch_source.auxiliary_query)
            branch_expr = SqlSubquery(
                SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                    from_table=SqlTableName(branch_source.ref_id),
                    columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
                    limit=1,
                ),
            )
        stmt = SqlSelect(
            select_list=SqlSelectList(select_items),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(effective_staged)),
            joins=(
                *_publish_graph_physical_key_joins(
                    ctx=ctx,
                    source_qualifier=source_qualifier,
                    data_columns=contract.columns,
                    physical_projection_columns=self._physical_projection_columns,
                    inserted_source_ref=self._graph_key_source_ref,
                ),
                *_publish_graph_node_physical_key_joins(
                    ctx=ctx,
                    source_qualifier=source_qualifier,
                    data_columns=contract.columns,
                    physical_projection_columns=self._physical_projection_columns,
                    inserted_source_ref=self._node_key_source_ref,
                ),
            ),
            where=SqlWhereClause(
                sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=source_qualifier),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        branch_expr,
                    ),
                    self._selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=source_qualifier,
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    self._selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=effective_staged,
                        outer_qualifier=source_qualifier,
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = _compiled_artifacts_from_contract(contract)
        grammar: SqlRenderable = SqlCte([branch_source_cte], stmt) if branch_source_cte is not None else stmt
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            auxiliary_ctes=_auxiliary_ctes_for_dependencies(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            needs_returning=True,
        )


@final
class SelectVersionedCommitDeltaRowsStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]):
    """Select one final old/new delta per row from a commit-owned source."""

    __slots__ = ("_depends_on", "_local_model_classes", "_source", "_writer_ref")

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source: VersionedCommitDeltaSource,
        depends_on: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
        local_model_classes: tuple[type[Any], ...] = (),
        writer_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source = source
        self._depends_on = depends_on
        self._local_model_classes = local_model_classes
        self._writer_ref = writer_ref

    @property
    def source(self) -> VersionedCommitDeltaSource:
        return self._source

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "versioned", "commit_delta", "publication"})

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies = frozenset({self._source.sparse_publish_tail}) | self._depends_on
        if self._writer_ref is not None:
            dependencies = dependencies | frozenset({self._writer_ref})
        return _commit_publish_dependencies(
            dependencies,
            self._source.branch_ref,
            self._source.revision_ref,
        )

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._source.staged_table, self._source.sparse_table}) | self._source.selector.tables_read()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def requires_prior_statement_visibility_after_writes(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._source.staged_table, self._source.sparse_table})

    def staged_read_descriptor(self) -> StagedReadRequirement | None:
        return StagedReadRequirement(
            source_keys=(
                StagedSourceKey(
                    staged_table_name=self._source.staged_table,
                    branch_scope_token=self._source.selector._branch_scope_token,
                ),
            ),
            scope=_scope_descriptor_from_selector(
                self._source.branch_ref,
                self._source.selector,
            ),
        )

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        data_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in self._source.delta_columns)
        columns = (
            "sys_id",
            "event_class",
            "branch_id",
            "revision_id",
            *(name for column in data_columns for name in (f"old_{column}", f"new_{column}")),
        )
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
            uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id", "branch_id", "revision_id"}),
            text_columns=frozenset(columns) - {"sys_id", "branch_id", "revision_id"},
        )
        projection_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            columns,
            column_type_hints,
        )
        relation_contract = CteRelationContract.semantic_row(projection_model_cls)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            columns=columns,
            model_cls=projection_model_cls,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            relation_contract=relation_contract,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=frozenset({str(self._source.staged_table), str(self._source.sparse_table)}),
        )

    def _local_effects(self, result: object) -> Sequence[PipelineLifecycleEffect]:
        if not self._local_model_classes:
            return ()
        if not isinstance(result, Sequence) or isinstance(result, str | bytes | bytearray):
            raise TypeError("Versioned commit delta rows must be a sequence")
        columns = self.cte_publication_contract().columns
        normalized_rows: list[object] = []
        for row in result:
            if isinstance(row, Mapping):
                normalized_rows.append(row)
                continue
            if not isinstance(row, Sequence) or isinstance(row, str | bytes | bytearray):
                raise TypeError("A versioned commit delta row must be a mapping or positional row")
            if len(row) != len(columns):
                raise ValueError("A positional versioned commit delta row has the wrong column count")
            normalized_rows.append(dict(zip(columns, row, strict=True)))
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.write_side_effect_intents import (
            build_versioned_commit_local_event_effects,
        )

        return build_versioned_commit_local_event_effects(
            model_classes=self._local_model_classes,
            rows=tuple(normalized_rows),
            writer_ref=self._writer_ref,
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.notification import (
            SqlVersionedCommitDeltaSelect,
        )

        from impl.common.l2100_sql_params.runtime_bind_slot import SqlRuntimeBindSlot

        def _runtime_scalar(
            value: ScalarServerRef[Any],
        ) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, ServerPlanRefId | None]:
            shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
                value,
                site="SelectVersionedCommitDeltaRowsStep.compile",
            )
            if shape.symbolic_ref_id is None:
                return _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(value, ctx), None
            if get_scalar_server_ref_binding(value, ctx) is not None:
                return _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(value, ctx), None
            found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(
                ctx,
                shape.symbolic_ref_id,
            )
            if found_seed:
                return SqlParam(unwrap_literal_sql_value(seed_value)), None
            base_ref, separator, field_name = str(shape.symbolic_ref_id).partition(".")
            ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(base_ref)
            slot = SqlRuntimeBindSlot(
                ref_id,
                field_name=(SqlColumnName(field_name) if separator else None),
            )
            return SqlParam(slot), ref_id

        branch_expr, branch_runtime_ref = _runtime_scalar(self._source.branch_ref)
        if self._source.branch_relation_ref is not None:
            branch_relation = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._source.branch_relation_ref))
            if branch_relation is None:
                raise ValueError("Commit delta requires a SQL-visible branch relation")
            branch_expr = SqlSubquery(
                SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                    from_table=SqlTableName(branch_relation.ref_id),
                    columns=[SqlColumnName("branch_id")],
                    limit=1,
                ),
            )
            branch_runtime_ref = None
        revision_expr, revision_runtime_ref = _runtime_scalar(self._source.revision_ref)
        effective_staged = _resolve_staged_source(self._source.staged_table, ctx)
        grammar = SqlVersionedCommitDeltaSelect(
            staged_table=SqlTableName(effective_staged),
            sparse_table=self._source.sparse_table,
            branch_expr=branch_expr,
            revision_expr=revision_expr,
            selector_expr=self._source.selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier="final",
                ctx=ctx,
                branch_expr_override=branch_expr,
            ),
            latest_row_expr=self._source.selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=effective_staged,
                outer_qualifier="final",
                ctx=ctx,
                branch_expr_override=branch_expr,
            ),
            data_columns=self._source.delta_columns,
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = _compiled_artifacts_from_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            runtime_ref_ids=tuple(ref_id for ref_id in (branch_runtime_ref, revision_runtime_ref) if ref_id is not None),
            auxiliary_ctes=_combine_auxiliary_ctes(
                _auxiliary_ctes_for_scalar_refs(
                    ctx,
                    self._source.branch_ref,
                    self._source.revision_ref,
                ),
                _auxiliary_ctes_for_sources(
                    ctx,
                    None if self._source.branch_relation_ref is None else str(self._source.branch_relation_ref),
                ),
            ),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            needs_returning=True,
            lifecycle_effects=(
                ResultBoundLifecycleEffects(
                    self._local_effects,
                    phase=PipelineLifecyclePhase.BEFORE_COMMIT_TRANSACTIONAL,
                ),
            )
            if self._local_model_classes
            else (),
        )


@final
class PublishVersionedCommitNotificationsStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """Insert bounded durable envelopes from one commit-owned delta relation."""

    __slots__ = ("_notification_ids", "_source", "_standalone_publication")

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source: VersionedCommitDeltaSource,
    ) -> None:
        from l2200_notification.polling_channel import NotificationRowId

        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source = source
        self._notification_ids = tuple(str(NotificationRowId.new()) for _ in range(3))
        self._standalone_publication = False

    @property
    def source(self) -> VersionedCommitDeltaSource:
        return self._source

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "versioned", "commit_notification", "publication"})

    def configure_backend_scheduling(self, profile: ServerPlanBackendProfile) -> None:
        self._standalone_publication = profile.traits.versioned_staging_transport is VersionedStagingTransport.MATERIALIZED_RELATION

    def requires_standalone_physical_request(self) -> bool:
        return self._standalone_publication

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _commit_publish_dependencies(
            frozenset({self._source.sparse_publish_tail}),
            self._source.branch_ref,
            self._source.revision_ref,
        )

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        graph_sparse_tables = frozenset(
            SqlTableName(derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(route.graph_table))))).sparse)
            for route in self._source.graph_routes
        )
        return (
            frozenset({self._source.staged_table, self._source.sparse_table}) | self._source.selector.tables_read() | graph_sparse_tables
        )

    def requires_prior_statement_visibility_after_writes(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._source.staged_table, self._source.sparse_table}) | frozenset(
            SqlTableName(derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(route.graph_table))))).sparse)
            for route in self._source.graph_routes
        )

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"sys_notifications"})

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.notification import (
            SqlVersionedCommitDeltaSelect,
            build_versioned_commit_notification_publication,
        )
        from l2200_notification.polling_channel import NOTIFICATION_TTL_SECONDS
        from l5000_subscriptions.cross_process import subscription_notification_sender_id
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_params.runtime_bind_slot import SqlRuntimeBindSlot

        def _runtime_scalar(
            value: ScalarServerRef[Any],
        ) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, ServerPlanRefId | None]:
            shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
                value,
                site="PublishVersionedCommitNotificationsStep.compile",
            )
            if shape.symbolic_ref_id is None:
                return _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(value, ctx), None
            if get_scalar_server_ref_binding(value, ctx) is not None:
                return _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(value, ctx), None
            found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(
                ctx,
                shape.symbolic_ref_id,
            )
            if found_seed:
                return SqlParam(unwrap_literal_sql_value(seed_value)), None
            base_ref, separator, field_name = str(shape.symbolic_ref_id).partition(".")
            ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(base_ref)
            slot = SqlRuntimeBindSlot(
                ref_id,
                field_name=(SqlColumnName(field_name) if separator else None),
            )
            return SqlParam(slot), ref_id

        branch_expr, _branch_runtime_ref = _runtime_scalar(self._source.branch_ref)
        if self._source.branch_relation_ref is not None:
            branch_relation = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._source.branch_relation_ref))
            if branch_relation is None:
                raise ValueError("Commit publication requires a SQL-visible branch relation")
            branch_expr = SqlSubquery(
                SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                    from_table=SqlTableName(branch_relation.ref_id),
                    columns=[SqlColumnName("branch_id")],
                    limit=1,
                ),
            )
        revision_expr, _revision_runtime_ref = _runtime_scalar(self._source.revision_ref)
        delta_relation = SqlTableName(f"{self.ref_id}_delta")
        route_projection_column_list: list[SqlColumnName] = []
        if self._source.graph_routes:
            route_projection_column_list.append(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"))
        route_projection_column_list.extend(
            route.type_discriminator_column for route in self._source.graph_routes if route.type_discriminator_column is not None
        )
        route_projection_columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys(route_projection_column_list))
        delta_query = SqlVersionedCommitDeltaSelect(
            staged_table=self._source.staged_table,
            sparse_table=self._source.sparse_table,
            branch_expr=branch_expr,
            revision_expr=revision_expr,
            selector_expr=self._source.selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier="final",
                ctx=ctx,
                branch_expr_override=branch_expr,
            ),
            latest_row_expr=self._source.selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=str(self._source.staged_table),
                outer_qualifier="final",
                ctx=ctx,
                branch_expr_override=branch_expr,
            ),
            data_columns=self._source.delta_columns,
            projected_data_columns=route_projection_columns,
        )
        semantic_columns = tuple(
            column
            for column in self._source.delta_columns
            if not str(column).startswith("sys_") and column != SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id")
        )
        graph_routes = tuple(
            (
                (str(route.graph_table), route.object_kind)
                if route.type_discriminator_column is None or route.type_discriminator_value is None
                else (
                    str(route.graph_table),
                    route.object_kind,
                    str(route.type_discriminator_column),
                    route.type_discriminator_value,
                )
            )
            for route in self._source.graph_routes
        )
        if graph_routes and SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id") not in self._source.delta_columns:
            raise RuntimeError("Versioned graph commit publication requires graph_sys_id")
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=build_versioned_commit_notification_publication(
                backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
                notifications_table=SqlTableName("sys_notifications"),
                delta_relation=delta_relation,
                semantic_columns=semantic_columns,
                notification_ids=self._notification_ids,
                sender_id=str(subscription_notification_sender_id()),
                table_name=str(self._source.logical_table),
                ttl_seconds=NOTIFICATION_TTL_SECONDS,
                max_changes_per_envelope=16 if graph_routes else 8,
                graph_routes=graph_routes,
                delta_query=delta_query,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=_combine_auxiliary_ctes(
                _auxiliary_ctes_for_scalar_refs(
                    ctx,
                    self._source.branch_ref,
                    self._source.revision_ref,
                ),
                _auxiliary_ctes_for_sources(
                    ctx,
                    None if self._source.branch_relation_ref is None else str(self._source.branch_relation_ref),
                ),
            ),
        )


@final
class ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """L1: Rebuild branch-tip graph auxiliary tables after sparse/tip publish."""

    __slots__ = ("_branch_ref", "_dependencies", "_domain", "_tree_table_names")

    def __init__(
        self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep,
        ref_id: StepRefId,
        *,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch_ref: BranchRefInput,
        depends_on: DependencyRefs = frozenset(),
        tree_table_names: frozenset[str] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._domain = domain
        self._branch_ref = _normalize_branch_ref(branch_ref)
        self._dependencies = depends_on
        self._tree_table_names = tree_table_names

    @property
    def level(self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep) -> int:
        return 1

    def result_cardinality(self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def execution_role(self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def step_tags(self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "graph_auxiliary", "reconcile", "sql"})

    def dependencies(self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._dependencies | _collect_ref_dependencies(self._branch_ref)

    @property
    def domain(self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep) -> type[VersioningDomain]:
        return self._domain

    @property
    def branch_ref(self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep) -> ScalarServerRef[BranchId]:
        return self._branch_ref

    def tables_read(self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(
            {
                GRAPH_VISIBLE_NODES_TIP_TABLE,
                CONTAINS_TREE_COMPONENT_TIP_TABLE,
                CONTAINS_TREE_STATE_TIP_TABLE,
            },
        )

    def lower(
        self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep,
        ctx: LoweringContext,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        sources = collect_graph_auxiliary_reconciliation_table_sources(self._domain)
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        deps = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(dep) for dep in self.dependencies())

        if sources.graph_node_tip_sources:
            visible_tip_tables = tuple(SqlTableName(source.tip_table_name) for source in sources.graph_node_tip_sources)
            delete_visible_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.visible.delete")
            steps.append(
                _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep(
                    delete_visible_ref,
                    branch_ref=self._branch_ref,
                    grammar_factory=_GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory(
                        kind="delete_visible",
                        retained_tip_tables=visible_tip_tables,
                    ),
                    tables_read=frozenset(),
                    tables_written=frozenset({SqlTableName(GRAPH_VISIBLE_NODES_TIP_TABLE)}),
                    depends_on=deps,
                ),
            )
            deps = frozenset({delete_visible_ref})
            for index, source in enumerate(sources.graph_node_tip_sources):
                ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.visible.insert.{index}")
                tip_table = SqlTableName(source.tip_table_name)
                steps.append(
                    _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep(
                        ref_id,
                        branch_ref=self._branch_ref,
                        grammar_factory=_GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory(
                            kind="insert_visible_from_tip",
                            tip_table=tip_table,
                        ),
                        tables_read=frozenset({SqlTableName(source.tip_table_name)}),
                        tables_written=frozenset({SqlTableName(GRAPH_VISIBLE_NODES_TIP_TABLE)}),
                        depends_on=deps,
                    ),
                )
                deps = frozenset({ref_id})

        tree_edge_tip_sources = (
            sources.tree_edge_tip_sources
            if ctx.backend_profile.traits.tree_validation_transport is not TreeValidationTransport.NONE
            else sources.tree_edge_tip_sources[:0]
        )
        if self._tree_table_names is not None:
            tree_edge_tip_sources = tuple(source for source in tree_edge_tip_sources if source.edge_table_name in self._tree_table_names)

        for index, tree_source in enumerate(tree_edge_tip_sources):
            component_delete_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.tree.{index}.components.delete")
            state_insert_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.tree.{index}.state.insert")
            component_insert_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.tree.{index}.components.insert")
            edge_table_name = tree_source.tree_state_scope_key
            tip_table = SqlTableName(tree_source.tip_table_name)
            steps.extend(
                (
                    _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep(
                        component_delete_ref,
                        branch_ref=self._branch_ref,
                        grammar_factory=_GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory(
                            kind="delete_tree_components",
                            edge_table_name=edge_table_name,
                            tip_table=tip_table,
                            type_name_filter=tree_source.type_name_filter,
                        ),
                        tables_read=frozenset({tip_table}),
                        tables_written=frozenset({SqlTableName(CONTAINS_TREE_COMPONENT_TIP_TABLE)}),
                        depends_on=deps,
                    ),
                    _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep(
                        state_insert_ref,
                        branch_ref=self._branch_ref,
                        grammar_factory=_GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory(
                            kind="insert_tree_state",
                            edge_table_name=edge_table_name,
                            tip_table=tip_table,
                            type_name_filter=tree_source.type_name_filter,
                        ),
                        tables_read=frozenset({SqlTableName(tree_source.tip_table_name)}),
                        tables_written=frozenset({SqlTableName(CONTAINS_TREE_STATE_TIP_TABLE)}),
                        depends_on=frozenset({component_delete_ref}),
                    ),
                    _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep(
                        component_insert_ref,
                        branch_ref=self._branch_ref,
                        grammar_factory=_GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory(
                            kind="insert_tree_components",
                            edge_table_name=edge_table_name,
                        ),
                        tables_read=frozenset({SqlTableName(CONTAINS_TREE_STATE_TIP_TABLE)}),
                        tables_written=frozenset({SqlTableName(CONTAINS_TREE_COMPONENT_TIP_TABLE)}),
                        depends_on=frozenset({state_insert_ref}),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            deps = frozenset({component_insert_ref})

        if not steps:
            return [
                _GraphAuxiliaryNoopStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    depends_on=frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(dep) for dep in self.dependencies()),
                ),
            ]
        steps[-1].ref_id = self.ref_id
        return steps

    def compile(self: ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        del ctx
        msg = "ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep must be lowered before compilation"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory:
    kind: Literal[
        "delete_visible",
        "insert_visible_from_tip",
        "delete_visible_affected_nodes",
        "insert_visible_from_tip_affected_nodes",
        "insert_visible_from_staged_affected_nodes",
        "delete_tree_components",
        "delete_tree_state",
        "reset_deleted_tree_state",
        "insert_tree_state",
        "insert_tree_components",
    ]
    edge_table_name: str | None = None
    tip_table: SqlTableName | None = None
    retained_tip_tables: tuple[SqlTableName, ...] = ()
    staged_table: SqlTableName | None = None
    selector: _StagedCommitSelector | None = None
    affected_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    type_name_filter: tuple[str, ...] = ()

    def __call__(self: _GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory, branch_expr: SqlRenderable, ctx: CompilationContext) -> SqlRenderable:
        if self.kind == "delete_visible":
            if self.retained_tip_tables:
                retained_tip_tables = tuple(
                    SqlTableName(ctx.overlay_cte_by_table.get(str(tip_table), str(tip_table))) for tip_table in self.retained_tip_tables
                )
                return SqlDeleteGraphVisibleNodeTipsAbsentFromTipSources(
                    branch_expr=branch_expr,
                    retained_tip_tables=retained_tip_tables,
                )
            return SqlDeleteGraphVisibleNodeTipsForBranch(branch_expr)
        if self.kind == "insert_visible_from_tip":
            if self.tip_table is None:
                msg = "insert_visible_from_tip requires tip_table"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            tip_table = SqlTableName(ctx.overlay_cte_by_table.get(str(self.tip_table), str(self.tip_table)))
            return SqlInsertGraphVisibleNodeTipsFromTip(
                tip_table=tip_table,
                branch_expr=branch_expr,
            )
        if self.kind == "delete_visible_affected_nodes":
            affected_source = _affected_rows_source_table(self.affected_rows_ref, ctx)
            source_filter = (
                self._selected_affected_source_filter(ctx, source_alias=SqlAliasName("affected"))
                if affected_source is None
                else SqlParam(True)
            )
            return SqlDeleteGraphVisibleNodeTipsForAffectedNodes(
                retained_tip_tables=tuple(
                    SqlTableName(ctx.overlay_cte_by_table.get(str(table), str(table))) for table in self.retained_tip_tables
                ),
                branch_expr=branch_expr,
                affected_node_relation=self._affected_node_relation(ctx),
                source_filter=source_filter,
            )
        if self.kind == "insert_visible_from_tip_affected_nodes":
            if self.tip_table is None:
                msg = "insert_visible_from_tip_affected_nodes requires tip_table"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            tip_table = SqlTableName(ctx.overlay_cte_by_table.get(str(self.tip_table), str(self.tip_table)))
            return SqlInsertGraphVisibleNodeTipsFromTipForAffectedNodes(
                tip_table=tip_table,
                branch_expr=branch_expr,
                affected_node_ids=self._affected_node_ids(ctx),
                affected_node_relation=self._affected_node_relation(ctx),
            )
        if self.kind == "insert_visible_from_staged_affected_nodes":
            if self.staged_table is None or self.selector is None:
                msg = "insert_visible_from_staged_affected_nodes requires staged_table and selector"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            affected_source = _affected_rows_source_table(self.affected_rows_ref, ctx)
            effective_staged = affected_source or _resolve_staged_source(SqlTableName(self.staged_table), ctx)
            staged_alias = "n"
            source_conditions: list[SqlExpr] = []
            if affected_source is None:
                source_conditions.extend(
                    (
                        self.selector.match_expr(
                            column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                            qualifier=staged_alias,
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        self.selector.latest_row_expr(
                            staged_table=effective_staged,
                            outer_qualifier=staged_alias,
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            source_conditions.append(
                SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), staged_alias)),
            )
            source_filter = sql_and(*source_conditions)
            return SqlInsertGraphVisibleNodeTipsFromStagedForAffectedNodes(
                staged_table=SqlTableName(effective_staged),
                branch_expr=branch_expr,
                source_filter=source_filter,
            )
        if self.kind == "delete_tree_components":
            return self._delete_tree_aux(CONTAINS_TREE_COMPONENT_TIP_TABLE, branch_expr, ctx)
        if self.kind == "delete_tree_state":
            return self._delete_tree_aux(CONTAINS_TREE_STATE_TIP_TABLE, branch_expr, ctx)
        if self.kind == "reset_deleted_tree_state":
            if self.staged_table is None or self.selector is None or self.edge_table_name is None:
                msg = "reset_deleted_tree_state requires staged_table, selector, and edge_table_name"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            source_alias = SqlAliasName("deleted_edge")
            effective_staged = _resolve_staged_source(self.staged_table, ctx)
            target_id = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(source_alias))
            conditions: list[SqlExpr] = [
                self.selector.match_expr(
                    column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                    qualifier=str(source_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), str(source_alias)),
            ]
            if self.type_name_filter:
                conditions.append(
                    SqlIn(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), str(source_alias)),
                        [SqlParam(type_name) for type_name in self.type_name_filter],
                    ),
                )
            columns = (
                "sys_id",
                "branch_id",
                "graph_sys_id",
                "edge_table_name",
                "edge_table_hash32",
                "node_sys_id",
                "parent_sys_id",
                "root_sys_id",
                "depth",
                "path_hash_short",
                "path_hash_high",
                "parent_path_hash_short",
                "parent_path_hash_high",
            )
            return SqlInsertFromSelect(
                target_table=SqlTableName(CONTAINS_TREE_STATE_TIP_TABLE),
                target_columns=columns,
                source_table=SqlTableName(effective_staged),
                source_alias=source_alias,
                select_exprs=(
                    target_id,
                    branch_expr,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(source_alias)),
                    SqlParam(self.edge_table_name),
                    _edge_table_hash_expr(self.edge_table_name),
                    target_id,
                    SqlParam(None),
                    target_id,
                    SqlParam(0),
                    SqlParam(0),
                    SqlParam(0),
                    SqlParam(None),
                    SqlParam(None),
                ),
                where=sql_and(*conditions),
                conflict_columns=("branch_id", "graph_sys_id", "edge_table_name", "node_sys_id"),
                update_columns=columns[0:1] + columns[4:5] + columns[6:],
            )
        if self.kind == "insert_tree_state":
            if self.tip_table is None or self.edge_table_name is None:
                msg = "insert_tree_state requires tip_table and edge_table_name"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            tip_table = SqlTableName(ctx.overlay_cte_by_table.get(str(self.tip_table), str(self.tip_table)))
            return SqlInsertContainsTreeStateFromTip(
                tip_table=tip_table,
                edge_table_name=self.edge_table_name,
                branch_expr=branch_expr,
                type_name_filter=self.type_name_filter,
            )
        if self.kind == "insert_tree_components":
            if self.edge_table_name is None:
                msg = "insert_tree_components requires edge_table_name"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            return SqlInsertContainsTreeComponentsFromState(
                branch_expr=branch_expr,
                edge_table_name=self.edge_table_name,
            )
        raise AssertionError(self.kind)

    def _delete_tree_aux(
        self: _GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory,
        target_table: str,
        branch_expr: SqlRenderable,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> SqlRenderable:
        if self.edge_table_name is None:
            msg = f"{self.kind} requires edge_table_name"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        tip_table = self.tip_table
        if tip_table is not None:
            tip_table = SqlTableName(ctx.overlay_cte_by_table.get(str(tip_table), str(tip_table)))
        return SqlDeleteContainsTreeAuxRowsForBranch(
            target_table=SqlTableName(target_table),
            branch_expr=branch_expr,
            edge_table_name=self.edge_table_name,
            tip_table=tip_table,
            type_name_filter=self.type_name_filter,
        )

    def _affected_node_relation(self: _GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory, ctx: CompilationContext) -> SqlTableName:
        if self.staged_table is None or self.selector is None:
            msg = f"{self.kind} requires staged_table and selector"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        affected_source = _affected_rows_source_table(self.affected_rows_ref, ctx)
        return SqlTableName(
            affected_source or _resolve_staged_source(SqlTableName(self.staged_table), ctx),
        )

    def _selected_affected_source_filter(
        self: _GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
        *,
        source_alias: SqlAliasName,
    ) -> SqlRenderable:
        if self.selector is None:
            msg = f"{self.kind} requires a staged-commit selector"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        effective_staged = self._affected_node_relation(ctx)
        return sql_and(
            self.selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier=str(source_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            self.selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=effective_staged,
                outer_qualifier=str(source_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
        )

    def _affected_node_ids(self: _GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory, ctx: CompilationContext) -> SqlRenderable:
        if self.staged_table is None or self.selector is None:
            msg = f"{self.kind} requires staged_table and selector"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        affected_source = _affected_rows_source_table(self.affected_rows_ref, ctx)
        effective_staged = self._affected_node_relation(ctx)
        staged_alias = SqlAliasName("staged")
        conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        if affected_source is None:
            conditions.append(
                self._selected_affected_source_filter(ctx, source_alias=staged_alias),
            )
        return SqlSelect(
            select_list=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(staged_alias))]),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(effective_staged)), staged_alias),
            where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*conditions) if conditions else SQL_EXPR_ALWAYS_TRUE),
            distinct=True,
        )


class _GraphAuxiliarySqlStepCteRow(BaseModel):
    count: int


class _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep(ServerPlanStep[None]):
    """Terminal graph auxiliary maintenance SQL step."""

    __slots__ = (
        "_branch_ref",
        "_dependencies",
        "_grammar_factory",
        "_tables_read",
        "_tables_written",
    )

    def __init__(
        self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
        grammar_factory: _GraphAuxiliaryGrammarFactory,
        tables_read: frozenset[SqlTableName],
        tables_written: frozenset[SqlTableName],
        depends_on: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._branch_ref = branch_ref
        self._grammar_factory = grammar_factory
        self._tables_read = tables_read
        self._tables_written = tables_written
        self._dependencies = depends_on

    @property
    def level(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def execution_role(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def step_tags(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "graph_auxiliary", "grammar"})

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def _requires_materialized_conditional_output(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> bool:
        """Keep graph auxiliary side effects in their ordered request."""
        return False

    def requires_runtime_sequential_batch(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> bool:
        return self._grammar_factory.kind == "insert_tree_components"

    def requires_prior_statement_visibility_after_writes(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        if self.graph_visible_nodes_overlay_action() == "insert":
            return self.tables_written()
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _commit_publish_dependencies(self._dependencies, self._branch_ref)

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _commit_publish_sql_visible_dependencies(self._branch_ref)

    def tables_read(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(str(table_name) for table_name in self._tables_read)

    def tables_written(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(str(table_name) for table_name in self._tables_written)

    def cte_relation_role(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> str | None:
        if self.graph_visible_nodes_overlay_action() is not None:
            return None
        return "count_only"

    def graph_visible_nodes_overlay_action(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> str | None:
        if self._grammar_factory.kind in {"delete_visible", "delete_visible_affected_nodes"}:
            return "delete"
        if self._grammar_factory.kind in {
            "insert_visible_from_tip",
            "insert_visible_from_tip_affected_nodes",
            "insert_visible_from_staged_affected_nodes",
        }:
            return "insert"
        return None

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def publication_source_kind(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> PublicationSourceKind:
        return PublicationSourceKind.RUNTIME_OWNED_ARTIFACT if False else super().publication_source_kind()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns: tuple[str, ...]
        if self.graph_visible_nodes_overlay_action() is not None:
            columns = ("count", "branch_id", "graph_sys_id", "node_sys_id")
            column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
                bigint_columns=frozenset({"count"}),
                uuid_columns=frozenset({"branch_id", "graph_sys_id", "node_sys_id"}),
            )
        else:
            columns = ("count",)
            column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({"count"}))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _GraphAuxiliarySqlStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def staged_read_descriptor(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep) -> StagedReadRequirement | None:
        if self._grammar_factory.staged_table is None or self._grammar_factory.selector is None:
            return None
        return _captured_staging_read(self._grammar_factory.staged_table, self._branch_ref, self._grammar_factory.selector)

    def compile(self: _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        branch_expr = _sql_param_or_cte_scalar(self._branch_ref, ctx)
        staged_auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None = None
        if self._grammar_factory.staged_table is not None:
            staged_auxiliary_ctes = _auxiliary_ctes_for_sources(
                ctx,
                _resolve_staged_source(SqlTableName(self._grammar_factory.staged_table), ctx),
            )
        affected_auxiliary_ctes = _auxiliary_ctes_for_sources(
            ctx,
            str(self._grammar_factory.affected_rows_ref) if self._grammar_factory.affected_rows_ref is not None else None,
            _affected_rows_source_table(self._grammar_factory.affected_rows_ref, ctx),
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = _compiled_artifacts_from_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        if not self.supports_sql_batch_transport():
            return CompiledStep(
                grammar=self._grammar_factory(branch_expr, ctx),
                output_shape=output_shape,
                result_relation=result_relation,
                column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
                auxiliary_ctes=_combine_auxiliary_ctes(
                    _auxiliary_ctes_for_dependencies(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()),
                    staged_auxiliary_ctes,
                    affected_auxiliary_ctes,
                ),
            )

        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            grammar=self._grammar_factory(branch_expr, ctx),
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            needs_returning=self.graph_visible_nodes_overlay_action() is not None,
            auxiliary_ctes=_combine_auxiliary_ctes(
                _auxiliary_ctes_for_dependencies(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()),
                staged_auxiliary_ctes,
                affected_auxiliary_ctes,
            ),
        )


class _GraphAuxiliaryNoopStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """Terminal no-op preserving graph auxiliary dependency ordering."""

    __slots__ = ("_dependencies",)

    def __init__(
        self: _GraphAuxiliaryNoopStep,

@pure_lazy
def _has_pending_symbolic_speculative_publish_scope(
    txn: LazyVersionedWriteTransaction,
) -> bool:
    return txn._has_pending_symbolic_speculative_publish_scope()


def _resolve_committed_versioned_branch_anchor[ResultT](
    txn: LazyVersionedWriteTransaction,
    resolved: Mapping[str, ResultT] | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Resolve the owned result before facts become durable authority.

    See ``docs/design/NER_1381_SPECULATIVE_PUBLICATION_ARCHITECTURE.rst``.
    """
    if txn._branch_anchor is None and _has_pending_symbolic_speculative_publish_scope(txn):
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioning_intent_steps import VersionedWriteBranchCtx

        write_context = txn._write_branch_context_result
        if write_context is None or resolved is None:
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError("Committed symbolic branch context requires a resolved BranchId")
        owned_refs = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(ref) for ref in resolved)
        ref_id = write_context.plan_owned_result_ref(owned_refs)
        resolved_context = resolved.get(str(ref_id)) if ref_id is not None else None
        if not isinstance(resolved_context, VersionedWriteBranchCtx):
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError("Committed symbolic branch context requires a resolved VersionedWriteBranchCtx")
        if not isinstance(resolved_context.branch_id, BranchId):
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError("Committed symbolic branch context requires a resolved BranchId")
        txn._branch_anchor = resolved_context.branch_id


@external_io_boundary
def _mark_versioned_commit_state[ResultT](
    txn: LazyVersionedWriteTransaction,
    resolved: Mapping[str, ResultT] | None = None,
) -> None:
    _resolve_committed_versioned_branch_anchor(txn, resolved)
    txn.owning_transaction_committed()
    txn._state = TransactionState.COMMITTED
    txn._has_pending_lazy_commit = False


def _published_branch_read_hint_effects(
    txn: LazyVersionedWriteTransaction,
    commit_context: CommitBranchCtx,
    resolved: Mapping[str, object],
) -> tuple[PipelineLifecycleEffect, ...]:
    """Build post-commit cache effects from resolved ServerPlan authority."""
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.cache_steps import (
        build_branch_read_hint_effects,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioning_intent_steps import (
        VersionedWriteBranchCtx,
    )
    from l1400_types.type_surface_contracts import DatabaseIdentity, VersioningDomainName
    from l2000_connection.connection_cache_identity import connection_cache_identity
    from l7000_versioned_schema.branch_read_hint_cache import (
        BranchReadHint,
        BranchReadHintIdentity,
        BranchReadWorkspaceScopeMissing,
    )

    materialization: BranchTipMaterialization | None = None
    write_context = txn._write_branch_context_result
    if write_context is not None:
        owned_refs = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(ref) for ref in resolved)
        ref_id = write_context.plan_owned_result_ref(owned_refs)
        resolved_context = resolved.get(str(ref_id)) if ref_id is not None else None
        if isinstance(resolved_context, VersionedWriteBranchCtx):
            materialization = resolved_context.tip_materialization
    materialization_source = txn._branch_tip_materialization
    if materialization is None and isinstance(materialization_source, BranchTipMaterialization):
        materialization = materialization_source
    if materialization is None:
        return ()
    base_txn = txn.base_write_transaction
    conn = getattr(base_txn, "_conn", None)
    if conn is None:
        return ()
    identity = BranchReadHintIdentity(
        database_scope=connection_cache_identity(DatabaseIdentity(conn.database_identity)),
        versioning_domain=VersioningDomainName(txn.domain.name),
        workspace_id=(BranchReadWorkspaceScopeMissing.GLOBAL if txn.domain.workspace_id is None else txn.domain.workspace_id),
        branch_id=commit_context.branch_id,
    )
    return build_branch_read_hint_effects(
        identity,
        BranchReadHint(
            branch_id=commit_context.branch_id,
            tip_materialization=materialization,
            tip_revision_id=commit_context.new_revision_id,
        ),
    )


@external_io_boundary
def _mark_versioned_branch_published(
    txn: LazyVersionedWriteTransaction,
    effect: VersionedBranchPublishedMarkEffect,
    resolved: dict[str, object],
) -> tuple[PipelineLifecycleEffect, ...]:
    committed_cache_effects: tuple[PipelineLifecycleEffect, ...] = ()
    if effect.commit_ctx_ref is None:
        txn.mark_branch_published()
    else:
        commit_context = resolved.get(str(effect.commit_ctx_ref))
        while isinstance(commit_context, tuple | list) and len(commit_context) == 1:
            commit_context = commit_context[0]
        if not isinstance(commit_context, CommitBranchCtx):
            msg = (
                f"Published branch lifecycle requires CommitBranchCtx for {effect.commit_ctx_ref!r}, got {type(commit_context).__name__}"
            )
            raise TypeError(msg)
        txn.mark_branch_published_for_staged_commits(commit_context.staged_commit_ids)
        from l5000_subscriptions.deferred_dispatch import attribute_published_events

        attribute_published_events(
            txn,
            commit_context.branch_id,
            commit_context.new_revision_id,
            commit_context.staged_commit_ids,
        )
        committed_cache_effects = _published_branch_read_hint_effects(
            txn,
            commit_context,
            resolved,
        )
    from l5000_subscriptions.dispatcher import dispatch_branch_event

    try:
        branch_id = txn.branch_id
    except db_exc.ProgrammingError:
        write_context = getattr(txn, "_write_branch_context_result", None)
        ref_id = str(getattr(write_context, "_step_ref_id", ""))
        resolved_context = resolved.get(ref_id)
        resolved_branch_id = getattr(resolved_context, "branch_id", None)
        if resolved_branch_id is None and isinstance(resolved_context, dict):
            resolved_branch_id = resolved_context.get("branch_id")
        if not isinstance(resolved_branch_id, BranchId):
            msg = "Published symbolic branch context did not materialize an exact BranchId"
            raise db_exc.ProgrammingError(msg)
        branch_id = resolved_branch_id
    dispatch_branch_event("COMMIT", branch_id)
    return committed_cache_effects


@final
class UpdateLogEntriesIntent(IntentStep[None]):
    """L4: Stamp log entries with revision_id for a batch of staged commits.

    Lowers to :class:`UpdateLogEntriesStep` for SQL backends, or to
    an empty list (no-op) for backends that do not have log tables
    (MongoDB, Neo4j, DoltDB).
    """

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "update", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.NONE

    __slots__ = ("_log_table", "_revision_id", "_staged_commit_ids")

    def __init__(
        self: UpdateLogEntriesIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        log_table_name: SqlTableName,
        revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
        config: _UpdateLogEntriesConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._log_table = log_table_name
        self._revision_id = _normalize_revision_ref(revision_id)
        self._staged_commit_ids = tuple(config.staged_commit_ids)

    def tables_written(self: UpdateLogEntriesIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._log_table})

    def lower(
        self: UpdateLogEntriesIntent,
        ctx: object,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[None]]:
        if not self._staged_commit_ids:
            return []
        if not _supports_log_entry_updates(ctx):
            return []
        return [
            UpdateLogEntriesStep(
                ref_id=f"{self.ref_id}_direct",
                log_table_name=self._log_table,
                revision_id=self._revision_id,
                selector=_StagedCommitSelector.explicit_ids(
                    staged_commit_ids=self._staged_commit_ids,
                ),
            ),
        ]

def freeze_relationship_compilation_for_reuse(
    compilation: RelationshipCompilation,
) -> RelationshipCompilation:
    """Copy formatter metadata while removing transaction-local ref handles."""
    include_refs = {key: dataclass_replace(ref, result_ref=None) for key, ref in compilation.include_compilation.include_refs.items()}
    two_hop_refs = {
        key: dataclass_replace(
            ref,
            target_result_ref=cast("ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity]", None),
        )
        for key, ref in compilation.two_hop_refs.items()
    }
    derived_refs = {
        key: dataclass_replace(
            ref,
            lookup_result_ref=cast("ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity]", None),
        )
        for key, ref in compilation.derived_refs.items()
    }
    return RelationshipCompilation(
        include_compilation=CompilationResult(include_refs=include_refs),
        two_hop_refs=two_hop_refs,
        derived_refs=derived_refs,
        child_compilations={
            key: freeze_relationship_compilation_for_reuse(child) for key, child in compilation.child_compilations.items()
        },
        embedded_refs=dict(compilation.embedded_refs),
    )

def _build_include_hydration_payload[E: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](
    source_ref_id: str | None,
    literal_source_entities: tuple[E, ...],
    source_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
    edges: tuple[CompiledIncludeRef, ...],
    hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> IncludeHydrationPayload[E]:
    if literal_source_entities:
        source_entities = list(literal_source_entities)
    elif source_ref_id is None:
        source_entities = list(literal_source_entities)
    else:
        source_entities = list(cast(Sequence[E], runtime_refs.get(source_ref_id) or ()))
    if source_model_cls is not None:
        source_entities = [
            cast(E, hydrator(source_model_cls, entity)) if isinstance(entity, dict) else entity for entity in source_entities
        ]
    compilation = CompilationResult(include_refs={edge.ref_key: edge for edge in edges})

    def load_edge_rows(ref: CompiledIncludeRef) -> Sequence[IncludeEntity]:
        if ref.result_ref_id not in runtime_refs:
            available_refs = tuple(str(key) for key in runtime_refs.keys())
            msg = (
                "include hydration edge result is missing from runtime refs "
                f"(edge={ref.ref_key!r}, result_ref_id={ref.result_ref_id!r}, "
                f"available_refs={available_refs!r}). IncludeLoadIntent lowering must schedule "
                "all include edge query steps before _BuildIncludeHydrationPayloadStep."
            )
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return cast(Sequence[IncludeEntity], runtime_refs[ref.result_ref_id] or ())

    include_data = group_include_data(
        source_entities,
        compilation,
        lambda ref: [_normalize_loaded_include_entity(row, ref.target_model) for row in load_edge_rows(ref)],
    )
    return IncludeHydrationPayload(
        source_entities=tuple(source_entities),
        include_data={entity_id: field_map for entity_id, field_map in include_data.items()},
    )


@pure_lazy
def describe_include_binding(include: IncludeSpec) -> IncludeBinding | None:
    """Return the canonical impl-owned relationship metadata for an include spec."""
    from l2080_lazy_orm.has_many import HasMany
    from l2080_lazy_orm.through import Through
    from l2100_include.include import Include
    from l2100_include.include_many import IncludeMany, IncludeThrough

    binding: IncludeBinding | None = None
    if isinstance(include, Include):
        rel = cast(BelongsTo[Any, Any], object.__getattribute__(include, "_relationship"))
        attr_name = rel._attr_name  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        if attr_name is None:
            return None
        binding = IncludeBinding(
            kind="belongs_to",
            field_name=attr_name,
            source_key_field=rel.fk_field,
            is_many=False,
            target_model=rel.target,
            nested_includes=tuple(include.nested_includes),
            descriptor=rel,
        )
    elif isinstance(include, IncludeMany):
        rel_many = cast(HasMany[Any], object.__getattribute__(include, "_relationship"))
        attr_name = rel_many._attr_name  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        if attr_name is None:
            return None
        binding = IncludeBinding(
            kind="has_many",
            field_name=attr_name,
            source_key_field=rel_many._foreign_key,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            is_many=True,
            target_model=rel_many._target_cls,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            nested_includes=tuple(include.nested_includes),
            descriptor=rel_many,
            filter_expression=object.__getattribute__(include, "_filter_expression"),
            order_by_clauses=tuple(object.__getattribute__(include, "_order_by_clauses")),
            top=object.__getattribute__(include, "_top"),
            skip=object.__getattribute__(include, "_skip"),
        )
    elif isinstance(include, IncludeThrough):
        rel_through = cast(Through[Any], object.__getattribute__(include, "_relationship"))
        attr_name = rel_through._attr_name  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
        if attr_name is None:
            return None
        binding = IncludeBinding(
            kind="through",
            field_name=attr_name,
            source_key_field=rel_through._owner_key,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            is_many=True,
            target_model=rel_through._junction_cls,  # pyright: ignore[reportPrivateUsage]
            nested_includes=tuple(include.nested_includes),
            descriptor=rel_through,
            filter_expression=object.__getattribute__(include, "_filter_expression"),
            order_by_clauses=tuple(object.__getattribute__(include, "_order_by_clauses")),
            top=object.__getattribute__(include, "_top"),
            skip=object.__getattribute__(include, "_skip"),
        )

    return binding


@pure_lazy
def iter_include_bindings(includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec]) -> list[IncludeBinding]:
    """Normalize public include specs into canonical impl-owned bindings."""
    bindings: list[IncludeBinding] = []
    for include in includes:
        binding = describe_include_binding(include)
        if binding is not None:
            bindings.append(binding)
    return bindings


def build_include_descriptor_map(
    includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec],
) -> dict[str, RelationshipDescriptor]:
    """Return the descriptor instance for each included field."""
    return {binding.field_name: binding.descriptor for binding in iter_include_bindings(includes)}


@pure_lazy
def _relationship_requests_from_includes(
    includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec],
) -> tuple[_RelationshipRequest, ...]:
    requests: list[_RelationshipRequest] = []
    for binding in iter_include_bindings(includes):
        requests.append(
            _RelationshipRequest(
                field_name=binding.field_name,
                kind=binding.kind,
                target_model=binding.target_model,
                nested_requests=_relationship_requests_from_includes(binding.nested_includes),
                nested_include_specs=tuple(binding.nested_includes),
                visibility="junction" if binding.kind == "through" else "target",
                source_key_field=binding.source_key_field,
                filter_expression=binding.filter_expression,
                order_by_clauses=binding.order_by_clauses,
                top=binding.top,
                skip=binding.skip,
            ),
        )
    return tuple(requests)


def include_source_projection_fields(includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec]) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Return top-level source fields needed to plan the requested includes."""
    return frozenset(
        _include_filter_binding(request).source_projection_field
        for request in _relationship_requests_from_includes(includes)
        if request.kind in {"belongs_to", "has_many", "through"}
    )


def relationship_selection_source_projection_fields(
    relationships: Sequence[RelationshipSelection],
) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Return top-level source fields required by relationship selections."""
    fields: set[str] = set()
    for request in _relationship_requests_from_selections(relationships):
        if request.kind in {"belongs_to", "has_many", "through", "two_hop"}:
            fields.add(_include_filter_binding(request).source_projection_field)
        elif request.kind == "embedded" and request.source_key_field is not None:
            fields.add(request.source_key_field)
        else:
            fields.add("sys_id")
    return frozenset(fields)


@pure_lazy
def _relationship_requests_from_selections(
    relationships: Sequence[RelationshipSelection],
) -> tuple[_RelationshipRequest, ...]:
    requests: list[_RelationshipRequest] = []
    for relationship in relationships:
        nested_requests = (
            *_relationship_requests_from_includes(relationship.nested_includes),
            *_relationship_requests_from_selections(relationship.nested_relationships),
        )
        storage_kind = relationship.contract.storage_kind
        if storage_kind == RelationshipStorageKind.FOREIGN_KEY:
            filter_column = relationship.contract.target_fk_field if relationship.is_list else relationship.contract.target_key_field
            source_projection_field = (
                relationship.contract.source_key_field if relationship.is_list else relationship.contract.source_fk_field
            )
            if not relationship.is_list and filter_column is None:
                filter_column = "sys_id"
            if relationship.is_list and source_projection_field is None:
                source_projection_field = "sys_id"
            if filter_column is None or source_projection_field is None:
                msg = f"Relationship {relationship.field_name!r} is missing foreign-key metadata"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            requests.append(
                _RelationshipRequest(
                    field_name=relationship.field_name,
                    kind="has_many" if relationship.is_list else "belongs_to",
                    target_model=relationship.target_model,
                    nested_requests=tuple(nested_requests),
                    filter_expression=relationship.filter_expression,
                    order_by_clauses=relationship.order_by_clauses,
                    count_requested=relationship.count_requested,
                    top=relationship.top,
                    skip=relationship.skip,
                    target_field_names=relationship.target_field_names,
                    source_key_field=filter_column,
                    source_projection_field=source_projection_field,
                ),
            )
            continue
        if storage_kind in {RelationshipStorageKind.JUNCTION, RelationshipStorageKind.EDGE}:
            if relationship.junction_model is None or relationship.contract.target_fk_field is None:
                msg = f"Relationship {relationship.field_name!r} is missing junction lowering metadata"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            requests.append(
                _RelationshipRequest(
                    field_name=relationship.field_name,
                    kind="two_hop",
                    target_model=relationship.target_model,
                    nested_requests=tuple(nested_requests),
                    filter_expression=relationship.filter_expression,
                    order_by_clauses=relationship.order_by_clauses,
                    count_requested=relationship.count_requested,
                    top=relationship.top,
                    skip=relationship.skip,
                    target_field_names=relationship.target_field_names,
                    junction_model=relationship.junction_model,
                    source_key_field=relationship.contract.source_fk_field,
                    target_fk_field=relationship.contract.target_fk_field,
                    is_many_override=relationship.is_list,
                    include_junction_payload=relationship.include_junction_payload,
                ),
            )
            continue
        if storage_kind == RelationshipStorageKind.DERIVED:
            if (
                relationship.lookup_model is None
                or relationship.contract.lookup_field is None
                or relationship.contract.lookup_key is None
            ):
                msg = f"Relationship {relationship.field_name!r} is missing derived lowering metadata"
                raise ValueError(msg)
