    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def cte_ordered_after_write_tables(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def invalidated_staged_sources(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        user_deps = frozenset() if self._user_id_ref_id is None else frozenset({self._user_id_ref_id})
        return (
            self._after_refs
            | frozenset({self._source_ref})
            | user_deps
            | versioned_branch_dependencies(self._staging_ctx.lazy_branch)
            | _staging_revision_dependencies(self._staging_ctx)
        )

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        user_deps = frozenset() if self._user_id_ref_id is None else frozenset({str(self._user_id_ref_id)})
        return (
            frozenset({str(self._source_ref)})
            | user_deps
            | versioned_branch_dependencies(self._staging_ctx.lazy_branch)
            | _staging_revision_dependencies(self._staging_ctx)
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[int]:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import (
            SqlPostgresUuidCast,
            SqlVersionedBatchTombstoneInsertStaged,
        )

        source_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(self._source_ref) if ctx.cte_refs is not None else None
        if source_cte is None:
            found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(self._source_ref))
            if found_seed:
                if not isinstance(seed_value, Sequence) or isinstance(seed_value, str | bytes | bytearray):
                    msg = f"{type(self).__name__} expected seeded sys_id sequence, got {type(seed_value).__name__}"
                    raise TypeError(msg)
                seeded_sys_id_list: list[SysId] = []
                for sys_id in seed_value:
                    if isinstance(sys_id, SysId):
                        seeded_sys_id_list.append(sys_id)
                        continue
                    literal_sys_id = unwrap_literal_sql_value(sys_id)
                    seeded_sys_id_list.append(literal_sys_id if isinstance(literal_sys_id, SysId) else SysId(str(literal_sys_id)))
                seeded_sys_ids = tuple(seeded_sys_id_list)
                return _VersionedDeleteManyByIdsTombstoneStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    sys_ids=seeded_sys_ids,
                    staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
                    data_columns=self._data_columns,
                    user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
                ).compile(ctx)
            raise_runtime_replanning_forbidden(
                step_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"tombstone compile for {self._source_ref!r} without a published CTE binding",
                blocked_path="planner-time materialization of matched delete ids before compiling versioned tombstones",
                result_contract="versioned delete-many tombstones must consume SQL-visible source id relations",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the matched delete ids as an upstream CTE before compiling tombstones.",
                    "Join that CTE to the tip table inside SQL to emit tombstones.",
                    "Do not read resolved delete ids in Python during compile().",
                ),
            )
        branch_sql_value = lower_versioned_branch_source(
            self._staging_ctx.literal_branch or self._staging_ctx.lazy_branch,
            ctx,
            site=f"{type(self).__name__}.compile",
        )
        sparse_revision_source = _compile_sparse_revision_source_from_staging(ctx, self._staging_ctx)
        semantic_data_column_names = [str(column) for column in self._data_columns if str(column) not in _GRAPH_HASH32_FIELD_NAMES]
        source_column_set = frozenset(str(column) for column in (source_cte.columns or ()))
        source_identity_column = str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")))
        source_columns = [source_identity_column]
        copy_data_from_source = sparse_revision_source is not None
        if (
            not ctx.branch_tip_materialized
            and sparse_revision_source is not None
            and source_column_set
            and all(column in source_column_set for column in semantic_data_column_names)
        ):
            source_columns.extend(column for column in semantic_data_column_names if column not in source_columns)
            copy_data_from_source = True
        source_inserted_column = (
            SqlColumnName("__inserted")
            if (copy_data_from_source and "__inserted" in source_column_set and ctx.backend_profile.traits.supports_data_modifying_ctes)
            else None
        )
        inline_source_query = (
            source_cte.auxiliary_query
            if ctx.backend_profile.traits.commit_admission_transport is CommitAdmissionTransport.MATERIALIZED_PREDICATE
            and source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None
            else None
        )
        data_column_overrides: dict[str, SqlRenderable] = {}
        if copy_data_from_source:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_json import SqlJsonDecimalNumeric
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef

            source_hints = source_cte.column_type_hints
            for field_name in self._model_cls.model_fields:
                db_column = get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
                if db_column not in semantic_data_column_names:
                    continue
                annotation_types = _resolved_field_annotation_types(
                    self._model_cls,
                    field_name,
                )
                if not any(
                    annotation is Decimal or (isinstance(annotation, type) and issubclass(annotation, Decimal))
                    for annotation in annotation_types
                ):
                    continue
                source_expression: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(db_column),
                    qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"),
                )
                numeric_source_columns = (
                    source_hints.numeric_columns
                    | source_hints.integer_columns
                    | source_hints.bigint_columns
                    | source_hints.double_columns
                )
                if db_column not in numeric_source_columns:
                    source_expression = SqlJsonDecimalNumeric(source_expression)
                data_column_overrides[db_column] = source_expression

        grammar = SqlVersionedBatchTombstoneInsertStaged(
            staged_table=SqlTableName(self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name),
            tip_table=SqlTableName(self._staging_ctx.tip_table_name),
            branch_id=branch_sql_value,
            staged_commit_id=self._staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw,
            staged_commit_column=SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id"))),
            deleted_column=SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))),
            data_columns=semantic_data_column_names,
            data_column_overrides=data_column_overrides,
            tip_branch_column=SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName("branch_id"))),
            tip_deleted_column=None,
            source_columns=source_columns,
            source_rows=None,
            source_identity_column=SqlColumnName(source_identity_column),
            source_cte_name=None if inline_source_query is not None else SqlGrammarKind(source_cte.ref_id),
            source_query=inline_source_query,
            source_inserted_column=source_inserted_column,
            copy_data_from_source=copy_data_from_source,
        )

        compiled = TombstoneGrammarStep(
            self.ref_id,
            stmt=grammar,
            config=_TombstoneGrammarConfig(
                tombstone_sys_ids=(),
                tip_table=SqlTableName(self._staging_ctx.tip_table_name),
                data_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in semantic_data_column_names),
                lazy_branch=self._staging_ctx.lazy_branch,
                staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId(self._staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw),
                reads=frozenset({SqlTableName(self._staging_ctx.tip_table_name)}),
                writes=frozenset({SqlTableName(self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name)}),
            ),
        ).compile(ctx)
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            *(compiled.auxiliary_ctes or []),
            *(
                [(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)]
                if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None and inline_source_query is None
                else []
            ),
            *(
                collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(
                    ctx,
                    versioned_branch_dependencies(self._staging_ctx.lazy_branch) | _staging_revision_dependencies(self._staging_ctx),
                )
                or []
            ),
        ]
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, synthetic_output_field

        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in contract.columns))
        return replace(
            compiled,
            auxiliary_ctes=tuple(auxiliary_ctes),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
        )

            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,

        return frozenset({table_names.tip, table_names.sparse})

    def cte_ordered_after_write_tables(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def write_key_facts(self, planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None) -> frozenset[WriteKeyFact]:

        key_values = frozenset(KeyTupleValue((LiteralKeyValue(unwrap_literal_sql_value(sys_id)),)) for sys_id in self._sys_ids)
        return frozenset(
            {
                WriteKeyFact(
                    producer_ref=self.ref_id,

            dict.fromkeys(
                get_db_column_name(self._staging_ctx.staged_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
                for field_name in self._staging_ctx.staged_model.model_fields
            ),
        )

    def semantic_publication_type_hints(self) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        columns = self.semantic_publication_columns()
        hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._staging_ctx.staged_model, columns)
        if hints is None:
            msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._staging_ctx.staged_model.__name__} tombstone rows"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        hints.require_complete(columns)
        return hints

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        user_deps = frozenset() if self._user_id_ref_id is None else frozenset({self._user_id_ref_id})
        return (
            user_deps
            | versioned_branch_dependencies(self._staging_ctx.lazy_branch)
            | _staging_revision_dependencies(self._staging_ctx)
            | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs)
        )

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        user_deps = frozenset() if self._user_id_ref_id is None else frozenset({str(self._user_id_ref_id)})
        return (
            user_deps | versioned_branch_dependencies(self._staging_ctx.lazy_branch) | _staging_revision_dependencies(self._staging_ctx)
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[int]:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import (
            SqlPostgresUuidCast,
        )

        sc = self._staging_ctx
        branch_sql_value = lower_versioned_branch_source(
            sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
            ctx,
            site=f"{type(self).__name__}.compile",
        )
        table_names = get_versioned_table_names(self._model_cls)
        sparse_revision_source = _compile_sparse_revision_source_from_staging(ctx, sc)
        reads_sparse_revision = sparse_revision_source is not None
        source_table_name = str(
            table_names.sparse if (reads_sparse_revision or not ctx.branch_tip_materialized) else table_names.tip,
        )
        source_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] = []
        staged_commit_col = get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id"))
        deleted_col = get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))
        data_cols = [str(column) for column in self._data_columns]
        target_columns = ["branch_id", "sys_id", staged_commit_col, deleted_col, *data_cols]
        select_exprs: list[Any] = [
            branch_sql_value,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
            SqlParam(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
            SqlParam(True),
            *[SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(col)) for col in data_cols],
        ]
        conflict_columns = ("branch_id", "sys_id", staged_commit_col)
        select_expr_by_target_col = {
            target_col: select_expr for target_col, select_expr in zip(target_columns, select_exprs, strict=True)
        }
        id_exprs = [SqlParam(sys_id.unwrap_to_str()) for sys_id in self._sys_ids]
        id_filter: SqlRenderable = SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), id_exprs) if id_exprs else SQL_FALSE_CONDITION
        where = sql_and(
            SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, branch_sql_value),
            id_filter,
        )

        permission_filter = compile_dml_permission_filter(
            self._model_cls,
            ctx,
            action="delete",
            target_table_name=source_table_name,
            resolved_user_id=ctx.cte_refs.get(self._user_id_ref_id) if ctx.cte_refs is not None and self._user_id_ref_id else None,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
        )
        if permission_filter is not None:
            where = sql_and(where, permission_filter)
        if reads_sparse_revision:
            assert sparse_revision_source is not None
            visible_source_name = f"{source_table_name}_delete_many_visible"
            source_ctes.append(
                (
                    visible_source_name,
                    SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned(
                        table=SqlTableName(source_table_name),
                        revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
                        branch_id=branch_sql_value,
                        revision_id=sparse_revision_source,
                        include_deleted=False,
                    ),
                ),
            )
            source_table_name = visible_source_name
            where = id_filter
        elif not ctx.branch_tip_materialized:
            valid_to_col = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"))
            where = sql_and(
                where,
                SqlIsNull(valid_to_col),
                SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted")), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(False)),
            )
        grammar = SqlInsertFromSelect(
            target_table=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
            target_columns=target_columns,
            source_table=SqlTableName(source_table_name),
            select_exprs=select_exprs,
            where=where,
            returning=SqlReturningClause((SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(1), SqlAliasName("count")),)),
            conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
            update_columns=(deleted_col,),
            distinct=True,
            distinct_on=tuple(SqlPostgresUuidCast(select_expr_by_target_col[column]) for column in conflict_columns),
        )
        stmt: SqlRenderable = SqlCte(source_ctes, grammar) if source_ctes else grammar
        compiled = TombstoneGrammarStep(
            self.ref_id,
            stmt=stmt,
            config=_TombstoneGrammarConfig(
                tombstone_sys_ids=self._sys_ids,
                tip_table=SqlTableName(source_table_name),
                data_columns=self._data_columns,
                lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
                reads=frozenset({SqlTableName(source_table_name)}),
                writes=frozenset({SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name)}),
            ),
        )
        compiled_step = compiled.compile(ctx)
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            *(compiled_step.auxiliary_ctes or []),
            *(collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.dependencies()) or []),
        ]
        return replace(
            compiled_step,
            auxiliary_ctes=tuple(auxiliary_ctes) or None,
        )


def _versioned_delete_count_value(value: object) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, list):
        if len(value) == 1:
            row = value[0]
            row_dict = dict(row) if not isinstance(row, dict) else row
            if len(row_dict) == 1:
                scalar = next(iter(row_dict.values()))
                if isinstance(scalar, int):
                    return scalar
        return len(value)
    return 0


def _versioned_delete_distinct_sys_id_count(*values: object) -> int | None:
    sys_ids: set[str] = set()
    saw_row_sequence = False
    for value in values:
        if not isinstance(value, list):
            return None
        saw_row_sequence = True
        for row in value:
            row_dict = dict(row) if not isinstance(row, dict) else row
            sys_id = row_dict.get("sys_id")
            if sys_id is None:
                return None
            sys_ids.add(str(sys_id))
    if not saw_row_sequence:
        return None
    return len(sys_ids)


def _vdmi_build_ids_subquery(
    intent: VersionedDeleteManyIntent,
    sc: VersionedStagingCtx,
) -> object:
    """Build a SELECT that returns all sys_ids (for IN subqueries)."""

    if intent.source_ref is not None:
        source_ref = intent.source_ref
        cte_name = str(source_ref)
        return SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
            from_table=SqlTableName(cte_name),
            columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
        )

    del sc
    return [SqlParam(sid) for sid in intent.sys_ids]


def _vdmi_build_child_ids_sparse_subquery(
    *,
    child_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    fk_field: str,
    parent_id_source: object,
    sc: VersionedStagingCtx,
    ctx: CompilationContext | LoweringContext,
) -> object:
    """Build a sparse-history child id source for recursive bulk cascades."""

    branch_sql_value = lower_versioned_branch_source(
        sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
        ctx,
        site="_vdmi_build_child_ids_sparse_subquery",
    )
    fk_col = get_db_column_name(child_model, DynamicFieldName(fk_field))
    parent_filter = SqlIn(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(fk_col)),
        cast("Any", parent_id_source),
    )
    child_table_names = get_versioned_table_names(child_model)
    sparse_table = str(child_table_names.sparse)
    staged_table = str(child_table_names.staged)
    published_source_table = SqlTableName(sparse_table)
    published_ctes: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []
    if not ctx.branch_tip_materialized and ctx.revision_id is not None:
        visible_name = f"{sparse_table}_bulk_child_ids_visible"
        published_source_table = SqlTableName(visible_name)
        published_ctes.append(
            (
                visible_name,
                SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned(
                    table=SqlTableName(sparse_table),
                    revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
                    branch_id=branch_sql_value,
                    revision_id=RevisionId(ctx.revision_id),
                    include_deleted=False,
                ),
            ),
        )
        published_where: Any = parent_filter
    else:
        published_where = sql_and(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                branch_sql_value,
            ),
            parent_filter,
            SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"))),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted")),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(False),
            ),
        )
    staged_where = sql_and(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            branch_sql_value,
        ),
        parent_filter,
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id")),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw)),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted")),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(False),
        ),
    )
    child_ids = SqlUnionAll(
        [
            SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                from_table=published_source_table,
                columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
                where_conditions=[published_where],
            ),
            SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                from_table=SqlTableName(staged_table),
                columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
                where_conditions=[staged_where],
            ),
        ],
    )
    if published_ctes:
        return SqlCte(published_ctes, child_ids)
    return child_ids


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _PreparedVersionedUpsertRow[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]:
    """Normalized row data shared by single and batch versioned upserts."""

    instance: T
    instance_data: dict[str, _BatchParamValue]
    data_field_names: list[str]
    data_db_columns: list[SqlColumnName]
    json_db_columns: frozenset[str]
    conflict_db_cols: list[SqlColumnName]
    conflict_values: list[_BatchParamValue]
    do_nothing: bool


type _BatchSourceValue = _BatchParamValue | SqlRenderable
type _BatchSourceRow = tuple[_BatchSourceValue, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _VersionedBatchLiteralSource:
    """Concrete batch rows from literal instances (lowered or materialized)."""

    source_columns: list[str]
    write_rows: list[_BatchSourceRow]
    return_rows: list[_BatchSourceRow]
    use_input_ord: Literal[True] = True


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _VersionedBatchCteSource:
    """Source rows provided by an upstream query CTE."""

    step_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    source_columns: list[str]
    use_input_ord: bool = False


type _VersionedBatchSource = _VersionedBatchLiteralSource | _VersionedBatchCteSource


def _versioned_batch_dependency_refs(
    *,
    source: _VersionedBatchSource,
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    additional_dependencies: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
    """Apply the dependency contract in ``docs/NER1540_BATCH_RETURN_CONTRACT.rst``."""
    source_refs = frozenset({source.step_ref}) if isinstance(source, _VersionedBatchCteSource) else frozenset()
    context_refs = frozenset(
        ServerPlanRefId(ref_id)
        for ref_id in (versioned_branch_dependencies(staging_ctx.lazy_branch) | _staging_revision_dependencies(staging_ctx))
    )
    return source_refs | additional_dependencies | context_refs


def _versioned_batch_sql_dependencies(
    *,
    source: _VersionedBatchSource,
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    additional_dependencies: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Return every SQL relation consumed by a versioned batch statement."""
    return frozenset(
        str(ref_id)
        for ref_id in _versioned_batch_dependency_refs(
            source=source,
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            additional_dependencies=additional_dependencies,
        )
    )


def _versioned_batch_imported_dependency_refs(
    *,
    source: _VersionedBatchSource,
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    additional_dependencies: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
    """Return batch SQL dependencies that can enter through a parent scope."""
    return _versioned_batch_dependency_refs(
        source=source,
        staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
        additional_dependencies=additional_dependencies,
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _PreparedVersionedUpsertBatchPlan:
    """Concrete typed inputs for a versioned batch upsert."""

    source: _VersionedBatchSource
    conflict_columns: list[SqlColumnName]
    target_columns: list[str]
    data_field_names: tuple[str, ...]
    data_db_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...]
    column_select_exprs: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...]
    on_conflict: Mapping[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None
    do_nothing: bool
    is_empty: bool
    explicit_return_value: object | None = None
    spill_plan: PreparedLargeColumnSpillPlan = PreparedLargeColumnSpillPlan()
    authored_return_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...] = ()
    authored_binary_return_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...] = ()


def _normalize_conflict_key_component(value: object) -> str:
    """Coerce conflict-key values into a stable hashable string."""
    unwrap = getattr(value, "unwrap_to_str", None)
    if callable(unwrap):
        return str(unwrap())
    if isinstance(value, dict | list):
        return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, default=str)
    return str(value)


def _prepare_versioned_upsert_row[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    *,
    model_cls: type[T],
    instance: T,
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str] | None,
    on_conflict: Mapping[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None,
    backend_type: BackendType | None = None,
    physical_values: Mapping[str, _BatchParamValue] | None = None,
) -> _PreparedVersionedUpsertRow[T]:
    """Normalize a single versioned upsert row."""
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import versioned_data_field_plans

    _, normalized, _ = dedup_inserts(model_cls, [instance])
    prepared_instance = cast(T, normalized[0])

    data_field_plans = tuple(
        versioned_data_field_plans(
            model_cls,
            include_polymorphic=False,
        ),
    )
    data_field_names: list[str] = [plan.field_name for plan in data_field_plans]
    json_db_columns = frozenset(plan.db_column for plan in data_field_plans if plan.is_json)

    staged_model_fields = set(getattr(model_cls, "model_fields", {}).keys())
    if getattr(model_cls, "__polymorphic__", False):
        if "type_name" not in data_field_names and "type_name" in staged_model_fields:
            data_field_names.append("type_name")

    data_db_columns = [get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in data_field_names]
    for large_column_config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        pointer_field = large_column_pointer_name(large_column_config.column)
        pointer_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(pointer_field))
        if pointer_column not in data_db_columns:
            data_field_names.append(pointer_field)
            data_db_columns.append(pointer_column)
    instance_data = cast(
        dict[str, _BatchParamValue],
        serialize_json_fields(
            type(prepared_instance),
            _declared_model_values(prepared_instance),
            backend_type=backend_type,
        ),
    )

    if physical_values is not None:
        for field_name, db_column in zip(data_field_names, data_db_columns, strict=True):
            if db_column in physical_values:
                instance_data[field_name] = physical_values[db_column]

    instance_type = type(prepared_instance)
    if getattr(instance_type, "__polymorphic__", False):
        if "type_name" in staged_model_fields:
            instance_data["type_name"] = canonical_polymorphic_type_name(instance_type)

    def _unwrap_value(val: object) -> _BatchParamValue:
        unwrap = getattr(val, "unwrap_to_str", None)
        if callable(unwrap):
            return cast(_BatchParamValue, unwrap())
        return cast(_BatchParamValue, val)

    conflict_columns_py = list(conflict_columns or ["sys_id"])
    conflict_db_cols = [get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(c)) for c in conflict_columns_py]
    conflict_values = [_unwrap_value(instance_data.get(c)) for c in conflict_columns_py]
    do_nothing = on_conflict is not None and len(on_conflict) == 0
    return _PreparedVersionedUpsertRow(
        instance=prepared_instance,
        instance_data=instance_data,
        data_field_names=data_field_names,
        data_db_columns=data_db_columns,
        json_db_columns=json_db_columns,
        conflict_db_cols=conflict_db_cols,
        conflict_values=conflict_values,
        do_nothing=do_nothing,
    )


def _build_versioned_batch_column_exprs(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    data_field_names: Sequence[str],
    data_db_columns: Sequence[SqlColumnName],
    on_conflict: Mapping[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None,
) -> list[SqlRenderable]:
    """Build the per-column SELECT expressions for batch upsert insert."""
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import (
        SqlCaseWhenExpr,
        SqlCoalesceExpr,
        SqlPostgresUuidCast,
        SqlQualifiedColumnExpr,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast

    sys_id_src_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
    sys_id_src_expr = SqlPostgresUuidCast(sys_id_src_expr)
    branch_sql_value = lower_versioned_branch_source(
        staging_ctx.literal_branch or staging_ctx.lazy_branch,
        ctx,
        site="_build_versioned_batch_column_exprs",
    )

    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import (
        postgres_storage_cast_type_for_writable_field,
        versioned_data_field_plans,
    )

    postgres_cast_types_by_db_column = {
        get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(plan.field_name)): postgres_storage_cast_type_for_writable_field(plan)
        for plan in versioned_data_field_plans(
            model_cls,
            excluded_fields=(
                "sys_id",
                "revision_id",
                "staged_commit_id",
                "deleted",
                *_GRAPH_HASH32_FIELD_NAMES,
            ),
            include_polymorphic=True,
        )
    }
    converter = BatchUpsertExpressionConverter(
        model_cls,
        postgres_cast_types_by_db_column=postgres_cast_types_by_db_column,
    )
    column_exprs: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        branch_sql_value,
        SqlCoalesceExpr(
            SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind("sys_id")),
            sys_id_src_expr,
        ),
        SqlParam(staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw),
        SqlParam(False),
    ]

    for field_name, db_col in zip(data_field_names, data_db_columns, strict=True):
        src_col: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_col), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
            src_col = converter.cast_source_column_if_needed(db_col, src_col)
        if on_conflict is not None and not on_conflict:
            # INSERT-if-absent filters merged rows below, so every surviving row
            # is new. Do not reference logical columns that the merged physical
            # projection intentionally replaces with large-column pointers.
            column_exprs.append(src_col)
            continue
        if on_conflict is not None and field_name in on_conflict:
            expr_val: _BatchOnConflictValue = on_conflict[field_name]
            sql_expr: SqlRenderable
            if isinstance(expr_val, Expression):
                sql_expr = converter.convert(expr_val)
            elif isinstance(expr_val, (TypedField, _NamedFieldRef)):
                sql_expr = SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(expr_val.name))))
            column_exprs.append(
                SqlCaseWhenExpr(
                    condition=SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind("sys_id")),
                    then_expr=sql_expr,
                    else_expr=src_col,
                ),
            )
            continue
        if on_conflict is not None:
            if field_name == "created_at":
                column_exprs.append(SqlCoalesceExpr(SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(db_col)), src_col))
            else:
                column_exprs.append(
                    SqlCaseWhenExpr(
                        condition=SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind("sys_id")),
                        then_expr=SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(db_col)),
                        else_expr=src_col,
                    ),
                )
            continue
        if field_name == "created_at":
            column_exprs.append(SqlCoalesceExpr(SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(db_col)), src_col))
        else:
            column_exprs.append(src_col)
    return column_exprs


def _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan_common(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    source: _VersionedBatchSource,
    data_field_names: Sequence[str],
    data_db_columns: Sequence[SqlColumnName],
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str] | None,
    on_conflict: Mapping[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None,
    is_empty: bool,
) -> _PreparedVersionedUpsertBatchPlan:
    """Build the common typed batch-upsert plan shape."""

    conflict_db_cols = [get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(col)) for col in list(conflict_columns or ["sys_id"])]
    staged_commit_db_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id"))
    deleted_db_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))
    target_columns = ["branch_id", "sys_id", staged_commit_db_col, deleted_db_col, *data_db_columns]
    do_nothing = on_conflict is not None and len(on_conflict) == 0
    return _PreparedVersionedUpsertBatchPlan(
        source=source,
        conflict_columns=conflict_db_cols,
        target_columns=target_columns,
        data_field_names=tuple(data_field_names),
        data_db_columns=tuple(data_db_columns),
        column_select_exprs=(),
        on_conflict=on_conflict,
        do_nothing=do_nothing,
        is_empty=is_empty,
    )


def _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    *,
    model_cls: type[T],
    instances: Sequence[T],
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str] | None,
    on_conflict: Mapping[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None,
) -> _PreparedVersionedUpsertBatchPlan:
    """Build batch inputs for a materialized source sequence."""
    if not instances:
        return _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan_common(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            source=_VersionedBatchLiteralSource(source_columns=[], write_rows=[], return_rows=[]),
            data_field_names=[],
            data_db_columns=[],
            conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
            on_conflict=on_conflict,
            is_empty=True,
        )

    staged_instances = [prepare_versioned_instance_for_staging(model_cls, inst, staging_ctx) for inst in instances]
    large_column_configs = get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
    delta_configs = tuple(config for config in large_column_configs if config.delta_storage is not None and config.delta_storage.enabled)
    if delta_configs and on_conflict is not None and not on_conflict:
        branch = staging_ctx.literal_branch or staging_ctx.lazy_branch
        payload, _normalized = prepare_versioned_staging_payload_from_instances(
            model_cls,
            staging_ctx.staged_model,
            staged_instances,
            branch,
            staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw,
            common_columns=staging_ctx.common_columns,
            backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
            return_many=True,
        )
        data_field_names = list(payload.columns[4:])
        data_db_columns = [get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in data_field_names]
        conflict_field_names = list(conflict_columns or ["sys_id"])
        conflict_indexes: list[int] = []
        for field_name in conflict_field_names:
            db_column = str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
            column_name = field_name if field_name in payload.columns else db_column
            conflict_indexes.append(payload.columns.index(column_name))
        last_literal_index_by_key: dict[tuple[str, ...], int] = {}
        nullable_indexes: set[int] = set()
        for index, authored_row_values in enumerate(payload.authored_rows):
            raw_key = tuple(authored_row_values[column_index] for column_index in conflict_indexes)
            if any(value is None for value in raw_key):
                nullable_indexes.add(index)
                continue
            key = tuple(_normalize_conflict_key_component(value) for value in raw_key)
            last_literal_index_by_key[key] = index
        surviving_indexes = tuple(
            index
            for index, authored_row_values in enumerate(payload.authored_rows)
            if index in nullable_indexes
            or last_literal_index_by_key[
                tuple(_normalize_conflict_key_component(authored_row_values[column_index]) for column_index in conflict_indexes)
            ]
            == index
        )
        pointer_field_names = frozenset(str(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)) for config in large_column_configs)

        def _return_row(index: int) -> _BatchSourceRow:
            physical_row = payload.rows[index]
            authored_row = payload.authored_rows[index]
            return (
                index,
                authored_row[1],
                *(
                    physical_row[column_index] if field_name in pointer_field_names else authored_row[column_index]
                    for column_index, field_name in enumerate(payload.columns[4:], start=4)
                ),
            )

        source = _VersionedBatchLiteralSource(
            source_columns=[_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN, "sys_id", *data_db_columns],
            write_rows=[(index, payload.rows[index][1], *payload.rows[index][4:]) for index in surviving_indexes],
            return_rows=[_return_row(index) for index in surviving_indexes],
        )
        plan = _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan_common(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            source=source,
            data_field_names=data_field_names,
            data_db_columns=data_db_columns,
            conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
            on_conflict=on_conflict,
            is_empty=False,
        )
        return replace(
            plan,
            spill_plan=payload.spill_plan,
            authored_return_columns=tuple(
                get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column)) for config in large_column_configs
            ),
            authored_binary_return_columns=tuple(
                get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column))
                for config in large_column_configs
                if config.content_type == "binary"
            ),
        )
    physical_rows: list[dict[str, _BatchParamValue]] | None = None
    spill_plan = PreparedLargeColumnSpillPlan()
    if large_column_configs:
        physical_payload, _normalized = prepare_versioned_staging_payload_from_instances(
            model_cls,
            staging_ctx.staged_model,
            staged_instances,
            _staging_branch_source_for_lowering(staging_ctx, ctx),
            staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw,
            backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
            common_columns=staging_ctx.common_columns,
            return_many=True,
        )
        spill_plan = physical_payload.spill_plan
        physical_rows = [dict(zip(physical_payload.columns, row, strict=True)) for row in physical_payload.rows]
        if conflict_columns is not None:
            resolved_conflicts: list[str] = []
            pointer_by_content = {str(config.column): large_column_pointer_name(config.column) for config in large_column_configs}
            for column in conflict_columns:
                pointer = pointer_by_content.get(column)
                if pointer is None:
                    resolved_conflicts.append(column)
                    continue
                pointer_presence = {row.get(pointer) is not None for row in physical_rows}
                if pointer_presence == {True}:
                    resolved_conflicts.append(pointer)
                elif pointer_presence == {False}:
                    resolved_conflicts.append(column)
                else:
                    resolved_conflicts.extend((column, pointer))
            conflict_columns = resolved_conflicts
    prepared_rows = [
        _prepare_versioned_upsert_row(
            model_cls=type(instance) if is_polymorphic_class(model_cls) else model_cls,
            instance=instance,
            conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
            on_conflict=on_conflict,
            backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
            physical_values=None if physical_rows is None else physical_rows[index],
        )
        for index, instance in enumerate(staged_instances)
    ]
    first_row = prepared_rows[0]
    field_name_by_db_column: dict[str, str] = {}
    for prepared_row in prepared_rows:
        for field_name, db_column in zip(
            prepared_row.data_field_names,
            prepared_row.data_db_columns,
            strict=True,
        ):
            field_name_by_db_column.setdefault(db_column, field_name)
    if is_polymorphic_class(model_cls):
        for instance in instances:
            for field_plan in versioned_data_field_plans(
                type(instance),
                include_polymorphic=False,
            ):
                field_name_by_db_column.setdefault(
                    field_plan.db_column,
                    field_plan.field_name,
                )
    data_db_columns = [SqlColumnName(column) for column in field_name_by_db_column]
    data_field_names = [field_name_by_db_column[column] for column in data_db_columns]
    json_db_columns = frozenset(column for prepared_row in prepared_rows for column in prepared_row.json_db_columns)
    source_columns = [_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN, "sys_id", *data_db_columns]
    from impl.common.l2300_json_serialization.json_serialization import get_json_columns

    json_cols = get_json_columns(model_cls)

    def _normalize_source_value(
        value: _BatchParamValue,
        field_name: str | None = None,
        db_col: str | None = None,
    ) -> _BatchSourceValue:
        unwrap_to_uuid = getattr(value, "unwrap_to_uuid", None)
        if callable(unwrap_to_uuid):
            unwrapped = unwrap_to_uuid()
            if not isinstance(unwrapped, UUID):
                msg = "Batch source UUID unwrapping must return UUID"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return unwrapped
        is_json_value = field_name in json_cols or db_col in json_db_columns
        if is_json_value:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_json import SqlJsonLiteral

            return SqlJsonLiteral(value)
        return value

    return_rows: list[_BatchSourceRow] = [
        (
            idx,
            _normalize_source_value(row.instance_data.get("sys_id")),
            *(
                _normalize_source_value(row.instance_data.get(field_name), field_name, db_col)
                for field_name, db_col in zip(data_field_names, data_db_columns, strict=True)
            ),
        )
        for idx, row in enumerate(prepared_rows)
    ]

    last_index_by_key: dict[tuple[str, ...], int] = {}
    for idx, row in enumerate(prepared_rows):
        key = tuple(_normalize_conflict_key_component(value) for value in row.conflict_values)
        last_index_by_key[key] = idx
    write_rows = [
        row
        for idx, row in enumerate(return_rows)
        if last_index_by_key[tuple(_normalize_conflict_key_component(value) for value in prepared_rows[idx].conflict_values)] == idx
    ]

    plan = _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan_common(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
        ctx=ctx,
        source=_VersionedBatchLiteralSource(
            source_columns=source_columns,
            write_rows=write_rows,
            return_rows=write_rows,
        ),
        data_field_names=data_field_names,
        data_db_columns=data_db_columns,
        conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
        on_conflict=on_conflict,
        is_empty=False,
    )
    return replace(plan, spill_plan=spill_plan)


def _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan_from_cte(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    source_step_ref: str,
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str] | None,
    on_conflict: Mapping[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None,
    source_columns: list[str] | None = None,
    source_order: _VersionedBatchSourceOrder,
) -> _PreparedVersionedUpsertBatchPlan:
    """Build batch inputs for an upstream query-backed source sequence."""
    data_field_names, data_db_columns, resolved_source_columns = _collect_versioned_batch_data_columns_for_source(
        model_cls,
        source_columns,
    )
    use_input_ord = source_order is _VersionedBatchSourceOrder.INPUT_ORDINAL
    if use_input_ord and _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN not in resolved_source_columns:
        msg = f"Versioned ordered batch source {source_step_ref!r} requires source column '_input_ord' in its publication contract"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan_common(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
        ctx=ctx,
        source=_VersionedBatchCteSource(
            step_ref=ServerPlanRefId(source_step_ref),
            source_columns=resolved_source_columns,
            use_input_ord=use_input_ord,
        ),
        data_field_names=data_field_names,
        data_db_columns=data_db_columns,
        conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
        on_conflict=on_conflict,
        is_empty=False,
    )


def _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan_from_symbolic_source[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    *,
    model_cls: type[T],
    instances: ObjectSequenceServerRef[T],
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str] | None,
    on_conflict: Mapping[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None,
    source_order: _VersionedBatchSourceOrder,
    source_columns: tuple[str, ...] | None,
) -> _PreparedVersionedUpsertBatchPlan:
    """Build the batch upsert plan during lowering from a symbolic sequence source."""
    ref_id = instances.ref_id
    if ref_id is None:
        msg = "Versioned batch plan requires a symbolic object-sequence source ref"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan_from_cte(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        source_step_ref=ref_id,
        staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
        ctx=ctx,
        conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
        on_conflict=on_conflict,
        source_columns=None if source_columns is None else list(source_columns),
        source_order=source_order,
    )


def _resolve_versioned_batch_source(
    *,
    source: _VersionedBatchSource,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    include_return_rows: bool,
) -> tuple[list[str], list[_BatchSourceRow] | None, str | None, bool]:
    """Resolve a typed batch source into grammar inputs."""
    if isinstance(source, _VersionedBatchLiteralSource):
        rows = source.return_rows if include_return_rows else source.write_rows
        return source.source_columns, rows, None, source.use_input_ord

    cte_ref = _resolve_versioned_batch_source_cte_binding(source=source, ctx=ctx)
    if cte_ref is None:
        msg = f"Pending lazy versioned batch upsert sources require a CTE-backed input; missing CTE binding for {source.step_ref}"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    return source.source_columns, None, cte_ref.ref_id, source.use_input_ord


def _versioned_batch_source_auxiliary_ctes(
    *,
    source: _VersionedBatchSource,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> list[tuple[str, Any]] | None:
    if not isinstance(source, _VersionedBatchCteSource):
        return None
    cte_ref = _resolve_versioned_batch_source_cte_binding(source=source, ctx=ctx)
    if cte_ref is None or cte_ref.auxiliary_query is None:
        return None
    return [(cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query)]


def _resolve_versioned_batch_source_cte_binding(
    *,
    source: _VersionedBatchCteSource,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> CteReference | None:
    if ctx.cte_refs is None:
        return None

    required_columns = frozenset(source.source_columns)

    def _matches(binding: object) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(binding, CteReference):
            return False
        if binding.columns is None:
            return True
        return required_columns.issubset(binding.columns)

    direct = ctx.cte_refs.get(source.step_ref)
    if _matches(direct) and isinstance(direct, CteReference) and direct.auxiliary_query is not None:
        return direct

    prefix = f"{source.step_ref}."
    first_match: CteReference | None = direct if isinstance(direct, CteReference) and _matches(direct) else None
    for ref_id, binding in ctx.cte_refs.items():
        if ref_id.startswith(prefix) and _matches(binding):
            if binding.auxiliary_query is not None:
                return binding
            if first_match is None:
                first_match = binding

    if first_match is not None:
        return first_match

    return direct if isinstance(direct, CteReference) else None


class _FilterVersionedBatchSourceStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[list[dict[str, object]]]):
    """Publish a permission-filtered symbolic versioned batch update source."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        source_columns: Sequence[SqlColumnName],
        permission_action: Literal["update"],
        user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._staging_ctx = staging_ctx
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._source_columns = tuple(source_columns)
        self._permission_action = permission_action
        self._user_id_ref_id = user_id_ref_id
        self._after_refs = after_refs

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"project", "versioned", "permission", "batch", "cte"})

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def supports_ordered_sql_statement_batch(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        sc = self._staging_ctx
        return frozenset({sc.staged_table_name, sc.tip_table_name})

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def _batch_source(self) -> _VersionedBatchCteSource:
        return _VersionedBatchCteSource(
            step_ref=self._source_ref,
            source_columns=[str(column) for column in self._source_columns],
            use_input_ord=_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN in self._source_columns,
        )

    def _owned_sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _versioned_batch_sql_dependencies(
            source=self._batch_source(),
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            additional_dependencies=frozenset({self._user_id_ref_id}),
        )

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._owned_sql_visible_dependencies() | self._after_refs

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._owned_sql_visible_dependencies()

    def imported_dependency_refs(self) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
        return _versioned_batch_imported_dependency_refs(
            source=self._batch_source(),
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            additional_dependencies=frozenset({self._user_id_ref_id}),
        )

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _FilterVersionedBatchSourceStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = tuple((str(column) for column in self._source_columns))

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...] | None) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            assert columns is not None
            model_columns = tuple(column for column in columns if column != _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN)
            hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, model_columns)
            if hints is None:
                msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._model_cls.__name__}"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                columns,
                hints,
                SqlColumnTypeHints(
                    integer_columns=frozenset({_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN}),
                ),
            )

        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        normalized_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)

        return projection_over_model_contract(
            columns=normalized_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            source_model_cls=self._model_cls,
            projection_lineage=tuple((column, column) for column in normalized_columns),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
        source_cte = _resolve_versioned_batch_source_cte_binding(
            source=self._batch_source(),
            ctx=ctx,
        )
        if not isinstance(source_cte, CteReference):
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"batch source {self._source_ref!r} has no published CTE binding",
                blocked_path="permission-filtered versioned batch source from runtime rows",
                result_contract="permission filtering must consume SQL-visible source rows",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the matched update source as a CTE.",
                    "Filter that relation in SQL with compile_dml_permission_filter().",
                    "Do not split permission filtering into the transaction mixin.",
                ),
            )

        from l2070_batching.output_shape import (
            CompiledOutputShape,
            DeclaredResultRelation,
            synthetic_output_field,
        )

        merged_cte = _build_versioned_batch_merged_cte(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_deleted=False,
        )
        shared_cte_name = _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(
            self.ref_id,
            "permission_shared_latest_staged",
        )
        shared_staged = merged_cte.bind_shared_staged_cte(SqlGrammarKind(shared_cte_name))
        permission_filter = compile_dml_permission_filter(
            self._model_cls,
            ctx,
            action=cast("Literal['delete', 'insert', 'update']", self._permission_action),
            target_table_name=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
            table_alias="m",
            resolved_user_id=ctx.cte_refs.get(self._user_id_ref_id),
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
        )
        publication_contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        assert publication_contract is not None
        output_columns = publication_contract.columns
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
            tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in output_columns),
        )
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            *([(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else []),
            *(collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()) or []),
        ]

        grammar: SqlRenderable = SqlStatementLocalWith(
            [*auxiliary_ctes, (shared_cte_name, shared_staged.cte_body)],
            SqlVersionedBatchProjectMatchedRows(
                merged_view=shared_staged.merged_view,
                join_columns=["sys_id"],
                selected_columns=[("src", column) for column in output_columns],
                source_columns=list(output_columns),
                source_rows=None,
                postgres_uuid_columns=(SqlColumnName("sys_id"),),
                source_cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(source_cte.ref_id),
                use_input_ord=_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN in output_columns,
                permission_filter=permission_filter,
            ),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=publication_contract.column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            auxiliary_ctes=None,
        )


def _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(ref_id: ServerPlanRefId, suffix: str) -> str:
    """Build a deterministic SQL-safe CTE name within backend identifier limits."""
    candidate = f"{str(ref_id).replace('-', '_').replace('.', '_')}_{suffix}"
    if len(candidate.encode()) <= 63:
        return candidate
    digest = hashlib.sha256(candidate.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    prefix = candidate.encode()[:50].decode(errors="ignore")
    return f"{prefix}_{digest}"


def _build_versioned_batch_merged_cte(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    include_deleted: bool,
    use_model_tables: bool = False,
) -> SqlVersionedMergedCte:
    sys_id_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))
    branch_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("branch_id"))
    staged_commit_id_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id"))
    revision_id_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("revision_id"))
    deleted_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))
    branch_sql_value = lower_versioned_branch_source(
        staging_ctx.literal_branch or staging_ctx.lazy_branch,
        ctx,
        site="_build_versioned_batch_merged_cte",
    )
    staged_table_name = staging_ctx.staged_table_name
    tip_table_name = staging_ctx.tip_table_name
    data_columns = staging_ctx.common_columns
    if use_model_tables:
        from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_table_info import get_versioned_table_names
        from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import returnable_db_columns

        names = get_versioned_table_names(model_cls)
        staged_table_name = str(names.staged)
        tip_table_name = str(names.tip)
        excluded = {revision_id_col, staged_commit_id_col, deleted_col}
        data_columns = [column for column in returnable_db_columns(model_cls) if column not in excluded]
        if branch_col not in data_columns:
            data_columns.append(branch_col)
    reads_tipless_published_state = not ctx.branch_tip_materialized
    if reads_tipless_published_state:
        from l3250_migrations.versioned_table_helpers import (
            VersionedTableType,
            get_auxiliary_table_name,
        )

        published_table = str(
            get_auxiliary_table_name(model_cls, VersionedTableType.SPARSE),
        )
    else:
        published_table = tip_table_name
    published_sparse_revision_id = (
        RevisionId(str(ctx.revision_id)) if reads_tipless_published_state and ctx.revision_id is not None else None
    )
    published_source_is_visible = False
    leading_ctes: tuple[tuple[str, SqlRenderable], ...] = ()
    if reads_tipless_published_state and published_sparse_revision_id is not None:
        visible_published_name = f"{published_table}_visible_published"
        leading_ctes = (
            (
                visible_published_name,
                SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned(
                    table=SqlTableName(published_table),
                    revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
                    branch_id=branch_sql_value,
                    revision_id=published_sparse_revision_id,
                    include_deleted=include_deleted,
                ),
            ),
        )
        published_table = visible_published_name
        published_sparse_revision_id = None
        published_source_is_visible = True
    published_revision_source_column = "sys_valid_from_revision_id" if reads_tipless_published_state else revision_id_col
    published_sparse_branch_index_table = (
        None if not reads_tipless_published_state else get_table_name(staging_ctx.domain.revision_branch_index_model)
    )
    common_columns = list(
        dict.fromkeys(
            (
                *(column for column in data_columns if column not in _GRAPH_HASH32_FIELD_NAMES),
                *(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column)) for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)),
            ),
        ),
    )
    projection_columns = tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in common_columns)
    return SqlVersionedMergedCte(
        tip_table=SqlTableName(published_table),
        staged_table=SqlTableName(resolve_staged_source(SqlTableName(staged_table_name), ctx)),
        read_projection=catalog_versioned_merged_projection(
            model_cls,
            projection_columns,
            support_source_columns=projection_columns,
        ),
        branch_id=branch_sql_value,
        staged_commit_id=_merged_cte_staged_commit_scope(ctx),
        branch_column=SqlColumnName(branch_col),
        staged_commit_id_column=SqlColumnName(staged_commit_id_col),
        revision_id_column=SqlColumnName(revision_id_col),
        tip_revision_source_column=SqlColumnName(published_revision_source_column),
        deleted_column=SqlColumnName(deleted_col),
        include_deleted=include_deleted,
        leading_ctes=leading_ctes,
        staged_visibility_filter=_merged_cte_staged_visibility_filter(ctx),
        published_sparse_revision_id=published_sparse_revision_id,
        published_sparse_open_row=(
            reads_tipless_published_state and published_sparse_revision_id is None and not published_source_is_visible
        ),
        published_sparse_branch_index_table=published_sparse_branch_index_table,
        published_source_is_visible=published_source_is_visible,
    )

class _ValidateDeferredVersionedUpdateManyExistsStep[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](SqlRelationPublisherStep[bool]):

        self,

        staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
        model_cls: type[T],
        batch_plan: _PreparedVersionedUpsertBatchPlan,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._after_refs = after_refs
        self._staging_ctx = staging_ctx
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._batch_plan = batch_plan

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "update", "versioned", "batch", "validate"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        sc = self._staging_ctx
        return frozenset({sc.staged_table_name, sc.tip_table_name})

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _ValidateDeferredVersionedUpdateManyExistsStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("ok", "error_code", "message")
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({"ok"}), text_columns=frozenset({"error_code", "message"}))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _ValidateDeferredVersionedUpdateManyExistsStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def _owned_sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _versioned_batch_sql_dependencies(
            source=self._batch_plan.source,
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            additional_dependencies=frozenset(),
        )

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._after_refs | self._owned_sql_visible_dependencies()

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._owned_sql_visible_dependencies()

    def imported_dependency_refs(self) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
        return _versioned_batch_imported_dependency_refs(
            source=self._batch_plan.source,
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            additional_dependencies=frozenset(),
        )

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self._owned_sql_visible_dependencies())

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[bool]:
        prepared = self._batch_plan
        assert prepared is not None, "_ValidateDeferredVersionedUpdateManyExistsStep.compile() before preprocess()"
        if prepared.is_empty:
            output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
                self.cte_publication_contract(),
            )
            return CompiledStep(
                output_shape=output_shape,
                result_relation=result_relation,
                column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
                closed_post_op=literal_post_op(True),
            )

        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import (
            SqlVersionedBatchMissingCount,
            SqlWithSingleCte,
        )

        source_columns, source_rows, source_cte_name, _use_input_ord = _resolve_versioned_batch_source(
            source=prepared.source,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_return_rows=True,
        )
        merged_cte = _build_versioned_batch_merged_cte(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_deleted=False,
        )
        shared_cte_name = _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(self.ref_id, "shared_latest_staged")
        shared_staged = merged_cte.bind_shared_staged_cte(SqlGrammarKind(shared_cte_name))
        grammar = SqlWithSingleCte(
            cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(shared_cte_name),
            cte_body=shared_staged.cte_body,
            inner=SqlVersionedBatchMissingCount(
                merged_view=shared_staged.merged_view,
                source_columns=source_columns,
                source_rows=cast(list[tuple[object, ...]] | None, source_rows),
                source_cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(source_cte_name) if source_cte_name is not None else None,
            ),
        )
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            *(_versioned_batch_source_auxiliary_ctes(source=prepared.source, ctx=ctx) or []),
            *(collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self._owned_sql_visible_dependencies()) or []),
        ]
        assertion_columns = ("ok", "error_code", "message")
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import DeclaredResultRelation

        output_shape = output_shape_for_synthetic_columns(assertion_columns)
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=zero_count_assertion_query(
                grammar,
                error_message=f"Cannot update non-existent {self._model_cls.__name__} object(s) in batch",
                count_column="cnt",
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(
                f"Cannot update non-existent {self._model_cls.__name__} object(s) in batch",
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes or None,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                bool_columns=frozenset({"ok"}),
                text_columns=frozenset({"error_code", "message"}),
            ),
        )

                include_deleted=False,

        }
        return _compile_graph_inherited_with_ref(
            self._model_cls,
            SqlCteFieldRef(resolved_user_ref, SqlColumnName("user_id")),
            str(permission_source_name),
            action="insert",
            domain=self._staging_ctx.domain,
            version_anchor=BranchTipPermissionAnchor(
                domain=self._staging_ctx.domain,
                branch_id_sql=lower_versioned_branch_source(
                    branch_source,

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.upsert import (
            _upsert_permission_denied_message,
            upsert_permission_assertion_post_op,

        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import (
            SqlCoalesceExpr,

        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.predicates import sql_not
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import DeclaredResultRelation

        source_columns, source_rows, source_cte_name, use_input_ord = _resolve_versioned_batch_source(

        )

            model_cls=self._model_cls,

        existing_permission_filter = compile_dml_permission_filter(
            self._model_cls,
            ctx,
            action=self._existing_action,
            target_table_name=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
            table_alias="m",
            resolved_user_id=resolved_user_id,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        permission_source_name = source_cte_name or _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(
            self.ref_id,
            "permission_source",
        )
        from l4000_permissions.graph_inherited_scheme import GraphInheritedPermissionScheme
        from l4000_permissions.permission_registry import get_permission_scheme

        payload_permission_filter: SqlRenderable | None
        if not self._validate_payload:
            payload_permission_filter = None
        elif isinstance(
            get_permission_scheme(self._model_cls),
            GraphInheritedPermissionScheme,
        ):
            from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
                graph_inherited_permissions_require_filter,
            )

            requires_graph_filter = graph_inherited_permissions_require_filter(
                self._model_cls,
                domain=self._staging_ctx.domain,
                action="insert",
            )
            payload_permission_filter = (
                self._compile_graph_payload_permission_filter(
                    ctx,
                    resolved_user_id=resolved_user_id,
                    permission_source_name=SqlGrammarKind(permission_source_name),
                )
                if requires_graph_filter
                else None
            )
        elif not self._validate_payload_for_non_graph_scheme:
            payload_permission_filter = None
        else:
            payload_permission_filter = compile_dml_permission_filter(
                self._model_cls,
                ctx,
                action="insert",
                target_table_name=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
                table_alias=permission_source_name,
                resolved_user_id=resolved_user_id,
                user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
                permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
            )
        source_definition: tuple[str, SqlRenderable] | None = None
        if source_cte_name is None:
            assert source_rows is not None
            published_columns = tuple(source_columns)
            model_columns = tuple(column for column in published_columns if column != _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN)
            model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, model_columns)
            assert model_hints is not None, f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._model_cls.__name__}"
            source_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                published_columns,
                model_hints,

                    integer_columns=frozenset({_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN}),
                ),
            )
            source_definition = (
                permission_source_name,
                SqlRequestInputRowsQuery.from_ordered_rows(
                    columns=published_columns,
                    rows=source_rows,
                    type_hints=source_hints,

            )
        permission_join_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in self._batch_plan.conflict_columns)
        permission_uuid_columns = _versioned_postgres_uuid_columns(
            self._model_cls,
            self._batch_plan.conflict_columns,
        )
        unauthorized_queries: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        if existing_permission_filter is not None:
            unauthorized_queries.append(
                SqlVersionedBatchProjectMatchedRows(
                    merged_view=shared_staged.merged_view,
                    join_columns=list(permission_join_columns),
                    selected_columns=[("src", "sys_id")],
                    source_columns=source_columns,
                    source_rows=None,
                    postgres_uuid_columns=permission_uuid_columns,
                    source_cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(permission_source_name),
                    use_input_ord=False,
                    permission_filter=sql_not(
                        SqlCoalesceExpr(existing_permission_filter, SqlBooleanLiteral(False)),
                    ),
                ),
            )
        if payload_permission_filter is not None:
            unauthorized_queries.append(
                SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                    SqlTableName(permission_source_name),
                    columns=(SqlColumnName("sys_id"),),
                    where_conditions=(
                        sql_not(
                            SqlCoalesceExpr(payload_permission_filter, SqlBooleanLiteral(False)),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )
        permission_error_message = self._permission_error_message or _upsert_permission_denied_message(
            self._model_cls,
        )
        unauthorized_source: SqlRenderable
        if unauthorized_queries:
            unauthorized_source = SqlUnionAll(unauthorized_queries)
        else:
            unauthorized_source = SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlParam(None),
                            SqlAliasName("sys_id"),
                        ),
                    ],
                ),
                where=SqlWhereClause(SqlBooleanLiteral(False)),
            )
        permission_assertion = no_rows_assertion_query(
            unauthorized_source,
            error_message=permission_error_message,
        )
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            *(_versioned_batch_source_auxiliary_ctes(source=self._batch_plan.source, ctx=ctx) or []),
            *(collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()) or []),
        ]
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlStatementLocalWith

        grammar: SqlRenderable = SqlStatementLocalWith(
            [
                *auxiliary_ctes,
                *(() if source_definition is None else (source_definition,)),
                (shared_cte_name, shared_staged.cte_body),
            ],
            permission_assertion,
        )
        assertion_columns = ("ok", "error_code", "message")
        output_shape = output_shape_for_synthetic_columns(assertion_columns)
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            closed_post_op=upsert_permission_assertion_post_op(self._model_cls),
            auxiliary_ctes=None,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                bool_columns=frozenset({"ok"}),
                text_columns=frozenset({"error_code", "message"}),
            ),
        )
