        source_columns, source_rows, source_cte_name, use_input_ord = _resolve_versioned_batch_source(
            source=prepared.source,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_return_rows=True,
        )
        source_rows_obj = cast(list[tuple[object, ...]] | None, source_rows)
        merged_cte = _build_versioned_batch_merged_cte(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            staging_ctx=self._staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_deleted=False,
        )
        shared_cte_name = _sanitize_versioned_batch_cte_name(self.ref_id, "shared_latest_staged")
        shared_staged = merged_cte.bind_shared_staged_cte(SqlGrammarKind(shared_cte_name))

        permission_filter = compile_dml_permission_filter(
            self._model_cls,
            ctx,
            action="update",
            target_table_name=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
            table_alias="m",
            resolved_user_id=ctx.cte_refs.get(self._user_id_ref_id) if ctx.cte_refs is not None and self._user_id_ref_id else None,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        insert_permission_filter = compile_dml_permission_filter(
            self._model_cls,
            ctx,
            action="insert",
            target_table_name=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
            table_alias="m",
            resolved_user_id=ctx.cte_refs.get(self._user_id_ref_id) if ctx.cte_refs is not None and self._user_id_ref_id else None,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        inserted_in_this_commit = SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("m")),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(self._staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw),
        )
        insert_return_filter = (
            inserted_in_this_commit
            if insert_permission_filter is None
            else SqlBinaryOp(inserted_in_this_commit, BinaryOp.AND, insert_permission_filter)
        )
        if permission_filter is not None:
            permission_filter = SqlBinaryOp(permission_filter, BinaryOp.OR, insert_return_filter)
        inserted_rows_cte: SqlCteName | None = None
        if self._inserted_rows_ref is not None:
            inserted_binding = ctx.cte_refs.get(self._inserted_rows_ref) if ctx.cte_refs is not None else None
            if isinstance(inserted_binding, CteReference):
                inserted_rows_cte = SqlCteName(inserted_binding.ref_id)

        base_contract = self._base_cte_publication_contract()
        output_columns = base_contract.columns
        identity_column = str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")))
        conflict_columns = tuple(
            SqlColumnName("sys_id") if str(column) == identity_column else column for column in prepared.conflict_columns
        )
        grammar = SqlWithSingleCte(
            cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(shared_cte_name),
            cte_body=shared_staged.cte_body,
            inner=SqlVersionedBatchUpsertReturn(
                merged_view=shared_staged.merged_view,
                conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
                source_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in source_columns),
                source_rows=None if source_rows_obj is None else tuple(source_rows_obj),
                source_cte_name=SqlCteName(source_cte_name) if source_cte_name is not None else None,
                use_input_ord=use_input_ord,
                permission_filter=permission_filter,
                do_nothing_conflict_marker=prepared.do_nothing,
                inserted_rows_cte=inserted_rows_cte,
                return_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in output_columns),
                return_column_sources={
                    SqlColumnName(identity_column): SqlColumnName("sys_id"),
                },
                authored_return_columns=prepared.authored_return_columns,
                authored_binary_return_columns=prepared.authored_binary_return_columns,
                postgres_uuid_columns=_versioned_postgres_uuid_columns(
                    self._model_cls,
                    tuple(dict.fromkeys((*conflict_columns, SqlColumnName("sys_id")))),
                ),
            ),
        )

        projected_columns = _declared_projection_columns(grammar)
        visible_return_columns = tuple(projected_columns or output_columns)
        if tuple(visible_return_columns) != tuple(output_columns):
            projected_column_set = set(visible_return_columns)
            overrides = {
                column: SqlInlineLiteral(False) if column in {_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN, "sys_deleted"} else SQL_EXPR_NULL
                for column in output_columns
                if column not in projected_column_set
            }
            return_cte_name = SqlGrammarKind(f"{str(self.ref_id).replace('.', '_')}_contract_rows")
            grammar = SqlWithSingleCte(
                cte_name=return_cte_name,
                cte_body=grammar,
                inner=SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides(
                    source_cte_name=return_cte_name,
                    source_columns=output_columns,
                    overrides=overrides,
                ),
            )
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            *(_versioned_batch_source_auxiliary_ctes(source=prepared.source, ctx=ctx) or []),
            *(collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.sql_visible_dependencies()) or []),
        ]

        from l2070_batching.output_shape import (
            CompiledOutputShape,
            DeclaredResultRelation,
            synthetic_output_field,
        )

        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in output_columns))
        compiled: CompiledStep[list[_BatchSourceValue]] = CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=base_contract.column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes or None,
        )
        return wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns(
            compiled,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            force_inline=True,
            include_internal_sparse_columns=True,
        )

    def _compile_source_return_projection(
        self,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[list[object]]:
        source = self._batch_plan.source
        assert isinstance(source, _VersionedBatchCteSource)
        cte_ref = _resolve_versioned_batch_source_cte_binding(source=source, ctx=ctx)
        if not isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference):
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"batch source {source.step_ref!r} has no published CTE binding",
                blocked_path="versioned batch update return from runtime source rows",
                result_contract="batch update return rows must be SQL-visible",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the updated source as a CTE.",
                    "For permissioned updates, use the intent-owned filtered source.",
                    "Do not return source rows from the transaction mixin.",
                ),
            )

        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import (
            SqlAliasName,
            SqlColumnName,
            SqlTableName,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import (
            CompiledOutputShape,
            DeclaredResultRelation,
            synthetic_output_field,
        )

        output_columns = self.cte_publication_contract().columns
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
            tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in output_columns),
        )
        source_columns = frozenset(str(column) for column in (cte_ref.columns or ()))
        select_items: list[SqlRenderable] = []
        for column in output_columns:
            if column == _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN:
                select_items.append(
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlBooleanLiteral(False),
                        SqlAliasName(_VERSIONED_UPSERT_INSERTED_COLUMN),
                    ),
                )
            elif column in source_columns:
                select_items.append(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)))
            elif column == "sys_revision_id":
                select_items.append(
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlCast(SqlParam(None), _UUID_CAST_TARGET),
                        SqlAliasName(column),
                    ),
                )
            elif column == "sys_staged_commit_id":
                select_items.append(
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlCast(
                            SqlParam(self._staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw),
                            _UUID_CAST_TARGET,
                        ),
                        SqlAliasName(column),
                    ),
                )
            elif column == "sys_deleted":
                select_items.append(
                    SqlSelectAlias(SqlBooleanLiteral(False), SqlAliasName(column)),
                )
            else:
                select_items.append(
                    SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(None), SqlAliasName(column)),
                )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=SqlSelect(
                SqlSelectList(select_items),
                from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(cte_ref.ref_id)),
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            auxiliary_ctes=([(cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query)] if cte_ref.auxiliary_query is not None else None),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=self.cte_publication_contract().column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
        )

@_versioned_commit_effect_owner
class VersionedUpsertIntent[T](IntentStep[T]):
    """L4: Versioned upsert — pure SQL conflict detection and merging.

    Performs conflict detection, ``on_conflict`` expression evaluation,
    and instance merging entirely in SQL via INSERT ... SELECT with
    LEFT JOIN on the versioned merged view.

    Lowering produces 4 L0 steps:

    1. EnsureStagedCommitStep — idempotent staged commit record
    2. VersionedUpsertDeleteStagedStep — DELETE conflicting staged rows
    3. VersionedUpsertInsertStagedStep — INSERT INTO staged ... SELECT
       with CASE WHEN / COALESCE logic for on_conflict
    4. VersionedUpsertReturnStep — read back result from merged view
    """

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "upsert", "versioned", "intent"})

    def __init__(
        self: VersionedUpsertIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        instance: ObjectServerRef[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedUpsertIntentConfig],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.instance = _require_seeded_config(instance, type(self).__name__)
        self._config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)
        self.staging_ctx = self._config.staging_ctx
        self.conflict_columns = _normalize_upsert_field_names(
            self._config.conflict_columns,
            context="versioned upsert conflict_columns",
        )
        self.on_conflict = _normalize_upsert_on_conflict_mapping(
            self._config.on_conflict,
            context="versioned upsert on_conflict",
        )
        self.after_refs = self._config.after_refs
        self.permission_context_ref = self._config.permission_context_ref
        self.permission_context_type = self._config.permission_context_type

    def dependencies(self: VersionedUpsertIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        context_refs = frozenset({str(self.permission_context_ref)}) if self.permission_context_ref is not None else frozenset()
        return frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in self.after_refs) | context_refs

    def tables_read(self: VersionedUpsertIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        sc = self.staging_ctx
        return frozenset({sc.staged_table_name, sc.tip_table_name})

    def tables_written(self: VersionedUpsertIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self.staging_ctx.staged_table_name})

    def commit_dependency_ref_id(self: VersionedUpsertIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        return ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_insert_batch")

    def additional_batch_binding_ref_ids(self: VersionedUpsertIntent) -> tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]:
        return (self.commit_dependency_ref_id(),)

    def lower(self: VersionedUpsertIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        """Lower to pure-SQL staging steps.

        All conflict detection, expression evaluation, and instance
        merging happens in SQL.  No Python branching in post_op.
        """
        return _lower_versioned_upsert(self, ctx)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _PreparedVersionedUpsertPlan[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]:
    """Concrete grammar inputs for one versioned upsert."""

    instance: T
    do_nothing: bool
    delete_grammar: Any
    insert_grammar: Any
    where_renderable: Any


def _build_versioned_upsert_plan[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    *,
    model_cls: type[T],
    instance: T,
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str] | None,
    on_conflict: Mapping[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None,
    ctx: LoweringContext | None = None,
    read_all_branch_staged: bool = False,
    branch_tip_materialized: bool = True,
    physical_values: Mapping[str, _BatchParamValue] | None = None,
) -> _PreparedVersionedUpsertPlan[T]:
    """Build the concrete SQL plan for a single versioned upsert."""
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import (
        SqlCaseWhenExpr,
        SqlCoalesceExpr,
        SqlQualifiedColumnExpr,
        SqlVersionedUpsertDeleteStaged,
        SqlVersionedUpsertInsertStaged,
    )

    sc = staging_ctx
    prepared_row = _prepare_versioned_upsert_row(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        instance=instance,
        conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
        on_conflict=on_conflict,
        backend_type=ctx.backend_type if ctx is not None else None,
        physical_values=physical_values,
    )
    prepared_instance = prepared_row.instance
    instance_data = prepared_row.instance_data
    data_field_names = prepared_row.data_field_names
    data_db_columns = prepared_row.data_db_columns
    json_db_columns = prepared_row.json_db_columns

    def _unwrap_value(val: object) -> object:
        unwrap = getattr(val, "unwrap_to_str", None)
        if callable(unwrap):
            return unwrap()
        return val

    new_sys_id = _unwrap_value(instance_data.get("sys_id"))
    assert new_sys_id is not None

    conflict_db_cols = prepared_row.conflict_db_cols
    conflict_values = cast(list[object], prepared_row.conflict_values)
    do_nothing = prepared_row.do_nothing
    branch_sql_value = _require_literal_branch_sql_value(
        sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
        site="_compile_single_versioned_upsert",
        ctx=ctx,
    )

    sys_id_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))
    branch_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("branch_id"))
    staged_commit_id_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id"))
    revision_id_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("revision_id"))
    deleted_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))
    staged_read_scope = None if read_all_branch_staged else sc.staged_commit_id_raw
    from l1050_polymorphism.type_filter_helper import collect_polymorphic_dispatch_subtypes
    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import BranchTipMaterialization

    resolved_tip_materialization = resolve_branch_tip_materialization_for_tests(
        BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED if branch_tip_materialized else BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS,
    )
    reads_tipless_published_state = resolved_tip_materialization == BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS
    published_table_name = sc.tip_table_name if not reads_tipless_published_state else str(get_versioned_table_names(model_cls).sparse)
    published_revision_source_column = revision_id_col if not reads_tipless_published_state else "sys_valid_from_revision_id"
    merged_read_columns = tuple(
        SqlColumnName(column)
        for column in dict.fromkeys(
            (
                *sc.common_columns,
                *(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column)) for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)),
            ),
        )
    )
    merged_cte = SqlVersionedMergedCte(
        tip_table=SqlTableName(published_table_name),
        staged_table=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
        read_projection=catalog_versioned_merged_projection(
            model_cls,
            merged_read_columns,
            source_models=(model_cls, *collect_polymorphic_dispatch_subtypes(model_cls)),
            support_source_columns=merged_read_columns,
        ),
        branch_id=branch_sql_value,
        staged_commit_id=staged_read_scope,
        branch_column=SqlColumnName(branch_col),
        staged_commit_id_column=SqlColumnName(staged_commit_id_col),
        revision_id_column=SqlColumnName(revision_id_col),
        tip_revision_source_column=SqlColumnName(published_revision_source_column),
        deleted_column=SqlColumnName(deleted_col),
        include_deleted=True,
        published_sparse_open_row=reads_tipless_published_state,
        published_sparse_branch_index_table=(
            None if not reads_tipless_published_state else get_table_name(sc.domain.revision_branch_index_model)
        ),
    )

    where_parts: list[Any] = []
    for db_col, val in zip(conflict_db_cols, conflict_values, strict=True):
        where_parts.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_col)),
                BinaryOp.IS_NOT_DISTINCT_FROM,
                SqlParam(val),
            ),
        )
    where_renderable = where_parts[0]
    for where_part in where_parts[1:]:
        where_renderable = sql_and(where_renderable, where_part)

    excluded_cast_types: dict[str, SqlCastTargetType] = {}
    for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        content_cast = _BYTEA_CAST_TARGET if config.content_type == "binary" else SqlCastTargetType(base_type="TEXT")
        excluded_cast_types[str(config.column)] = content_cast
        excluded_cast_types[str(large_column_pointer_name(config.column))] = SqlCastTargetType(base_type="TEXT")
    converter = UpsertExpressionConverter(
        model_cls,
        prepared_instance,
        table_alias="m",
        physical_values=instance_data,
        excluded_cast_types=excluded_cast_types,
    )

    staged_commit_db_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id"))
    deleted_db_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))
    target_columns: list[str] = [
        "branch_id",
        "sys_id",
        staged_commit_db_col,
        deleted_db_col,
        *data_db_columns,
    ]

    column_exprs: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlParam(branch_sql_value),
        SqlCoalesceExpr(
            SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind("sys_id")),
            SqlParam(new_sys_id),
        ),
        SqlParam(sc.staged_commit_id_raw),
        SqlParam(False),
    ]
    from impl.common.l2300_json_serialization.json_serialization import get_json_columns

    json_cols = get_json_columns(model_cls)

    def _literal_value_expr(field_name: str, db_col: str, value: object) -> SqlRenderable:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast

        expr: SqlRenderable = SqlParam(value)
        field_info = model_cls.model_fields.get(field_name)
        is_json_value = (
            field_name in json_cols
            or db_col in json_cols
            or (field_info is not None and is_json_field(field_info))
            or db_col in json_db_columns
        )
        if is_json_value and ctx is not None and _should_cast_json_to_jsonb(ctx) and value is not None:
            expr = SqlCast(expr, _JSONB_CAST_TARGET)
        if field_info is not None and value is not None:
            annotation_types = _resolved_field_annotation_types(
                model_cls,
                field_name,
            )
            if any(
                annotation is Decimal or (isinstance(annotation, type) and issubclass(annotation, Decimal))
                for annotation in annotation_types
            ):
                expr = SqlCast(expr, SqlCastTargetType(base_type="NUMERIC"))
        return expr

    for i, field_name in enumerate(data_field_names):
        db_col = data_db_columns[i]
        raw_val = _unwrap_value(instance_data.get(field_name))

        if on_conflict is not None and field_name in on_conflict:
            expr_val = on_conflict[field_name]
            if isinstance(expr_val, Expression):
                if expr_val.function == "EXCLUDED" and field_name not in model_cls.model_fields:
                    sql_expr = _literal_value_expr(field_name, db_col, raw_val)
                else:
                    sql_expr = converter.convert(expr_val)
            elif isinstance(expr_val, (TypedField, _NamedFieldRef)):
                sql_expr = SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(expr_val.name))))
            else:
                sql_expr = _literal_value_expr(field_name, db_col, expr_val)

            column_exprs.append(
                SqlCaseWhenExpr(
                    condition=SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind("sys_id")),
                    then_expr=sql_expr,
                    else_expr=_literal_value_expr(field_name, db_col, raw_val),
                ),
            )
        elif on_conflict is not None:
            if field_name == "created_at":
                existing_db_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
                column_exprs.append(
                    SqlCoalesceExpr(
                        SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(db_col)),
                        SqlParam(raw_val),
                    ),
                )
            else:
                column_exprs.append(
                    SqlCaseWhenExpr(
                        condition=SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind("sys_id")),
                        then_expr=SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(db_col)),
                        else_expr=_literal_value_expr(field_name, db_col, raw_val),
                    ),
                )
        elif field_name == "created_at":
            existing_db_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            column_exprs.append(
                SqlCoalesceExpr(
                    SqlQualifiedColumnExpr(SqlGrammarKind(db_col)),
                    SqlParam(raw_val),
                ),
            )
        else:
            column_exprs.append(_literal_value_expr(field_name, db_col, raw_val))

    return _PreparedVersionedUpsertPlan(
        instance=prepared_instance,
        do_nothing=do_nothing,
        delete_grammar=SqlVersionedUpsertDeleteStaged(
            staged_table=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
            branch_id=branch_sql_value,
            staged_commit_id=sc.staged_commit_id_raw,
            merged_view=merged_cte,
            conflict_columns=conflict_db_cols,
            conflict_values=conflict_values,
        ),
        insert_grammar=SqlVersionedUpsertInsertStaged(
            staged_table=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
            target_columns=target_columns,
            column_select_exprs=column_exprs,
            merged_view=merged_cte,
            conflict_columns=conflict_db_cols,
            conflict_values=conflict_values,
            do_nothing=do_nothing,
        ),
        where_renderable=where_renderable,
    )


def _lower_deferred_versioned_upsert[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    *,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[T],
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str] | None,
    on_conflict: Mapping[str, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None,
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Lower a symbolic single-row upsert through the batch symbolic path."""
    batch_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_batch")
    return [
        *VersionedUpsertManyBatchIntent(
            batch_ref,
            model_cls,
            cast(
                ObjectSequenceServerRef[T],
                ServerRefs.from_ref_id(source_ref, variant="object_sequence"),
            ),
            cast(
                "Any",
                _VersionedUpsertManyBatchConfig(
                    staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
                    after_refs=after_refs,
                    conflict_columns=tuple(conflict_columns) if conflict_columns is not None else None,
                    on_conflict=cast(
                        Mapping[_UpsertFieldIdentifier, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None,
                        on_conflict,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ).lower(ctx),
        _TakeFirstResolvedItemStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
            source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{batch_ref}.raw_rows"),
            model_cls=model_cls,
        ),
    ]


def _lower_versioned_update_many_batch_intent[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[T],
    instances: ObjectSequenceServerRef[T],
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
    literal_instances: tuple[T, ...] | None,
    source_existence_prevalidated: bool,
    user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None,
    source_order: _VersionedBatchSourceOrder,
    source_columns: tuple[str, ...] | None,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    if literal_instances is not None:
        deduped_instances: dict[str, T] = {}
        for instance in literal_instances:
            deduped_instances[str(instance.sys_id)] = instance
        literal_instances = tuple(deduped_instances.values())
    if literal_instances == ():
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import StaticValueAfterDepsStep

        return [
            StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                ref_id,
                [],
                [str(dependency_ref) for dependency_ref in sorted(after_refs, key=str)],
            ),
        ]
    if literal_instances is not None and len(literal_instances) > 400:
        chunk_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        chunk_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        chunk_after_refs = after_refs
        for chunk_index, start in enumerate(range(0, len(literal_instances), 400)):
            chunk_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_chunk_{chunk_index}")
            chunk_refs.append(chunk_ref)
            chunk_steps.extend(
                _lower_versioned_update_many_batch_intent(
                    ref_id=chunk_ref,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    instances=instances,
                    staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
                    after_refs=chunk_after_refs,
                    literal_instances=tuple(literal_instances[start : start + 400]),
                    source_existence_prevalidated=source_existence_prevalidated,
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
                    source_order=source_order,
                    source_columns=source_columns,
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
            )
            chunk_after_refs = frozenset({chunk_ref})
        chunk_steps.append(
            _ConcatVersionedBulkResultChunksStep(
                ref_id,
                source_refs=tuple(chunk_refs),
            ),
        )
        return chunk_steps
    ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_ensure_staged_commit")
    validate_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_validate_existing")
    delete_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_delete_batch")
    insert_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_insert_batch")
    return_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_batch_return")
    if user_id_ref_id is None:
        permission_steps, user_id_ref_id = _versioned_permission_resolution_steps(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            ctx,
            after_refs=frozenset({ensure_ref}),
        )
    else:
        permission_steps = []
    if literal_instances is None:
        batch_plan = _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan_from_symbolic_source(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            instances=instances,
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            conflict_columns=["sys_id"],
            on_conflict=None,
            source_order=source_order,
            source_columns=source_columns,
        )
    else:
        batch_plan = _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            instances=literal_instances,
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            conflict_columns=["sys_id"],
            on_conflict=None,
        )
        batch_plan = replace(
            batch_plan,
            explicit_return_value=[
                prepare_versioned_instance_for_staging(model_cls, instance, staging_ctx) for instance in literal_instances
            ],
        )
    if batch_plan.is_empty:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.return_value import ReturnValueStep

        return _anchor_intent_after_refs([ReturnValueStep(ref_id, [])], after_refs)
    permission_validation_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    permission_validation_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    if user_id_ref_id is not None:
        permission_validation_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_validate_permission")
        permission_validation_steps.append(
            _ValidateVersionedUpsertManyPermissionStep(
                permission_validation_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                after_refs=frozenset({ensure_ref}),
                staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
                batch_plan=batch_plan,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
                config=_VersionedPermissionValidationConfig(
                    validate_payload_for_non_graph_scheme=False,
                    permission_error_message=(f"Cannot update {model_cls.__name__} object(s): write permission denied"),
                ),
            ),
        )
    if literal_instances is None and user_id_ref_id is not None and isinstance(batch_plan.source, _VersionedBatchCteSource):
        filtered_source_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_permission_filtered_source")
        staging_columns = frozenset(str(column) for column in staging_ctx.common_columns)
        filtered_source_columns = [
            column
            for column in batch_plan.source.source_columns
            if column in {"sys_id", _VERSIONED_UPSERT_INPUT_ORD_COLUMN} or column in staging_columns
        ]
        filter_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
            _FilterVersionedBatchSourceStep(
                filtered_source_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
                source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(batch_plan.source.step_ref),
                source_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in filtered_source_columns),
                permission_action="update",
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                after_refs=frozenset({ensure_ref}),
            ),
        ]
        batch_plan = _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan_from_cte(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            source_step_ref=str(filtered_source_ref),
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            conflict_columns=["sys_id"],
            on_conflict=None,
            source_columns=filtered_source_columns,
            source_order=(
                _VersionedBatchSourceOrder.INPUT_ORDINAL if batch_plan.source.use_input_ord else _VersionedBatchSourceOrder.UNORDERED
            ),
        )
    else:
        filter_steps = []
    validation_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    write_after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(
        {ensure_ref, *((permission_validation_ref,) if permission_validation_ref is not None else ())},
    )
    if not source_existence_prevalidated:
        validation_steps.append(
            _ValidateDeferredVersionedUpdateManyExistsStep(
                validate_ref,
                after_refs=frozenset(),
                staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                batch_plan=batch_plan,
            ),
        )
        write_after_refs = frozenset(
            {
                ensure_ref,
                validate_ref,
                *((permission_validation_ref,) if permission_validation_ref is not None else ()),
            },
        )
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
        EnsureStagedCommitStep(
            ensure_ref,
            staging_ctx.domain,
            staging_ctx.literal_branch or staging_ctx.lazy_branch,
            config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(staging_ctx),
        ),
        *permission_steps,
        *permission_validation_steps,
        *filter_steps,
        *validation_steps,
        _DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchWriteStep(
            delete_ref,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            after_refs=write_after_refs,
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            phase="delete",
            batch_plan=batch_plan,
            user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
            permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
        ),
        _DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchWriteStep(
            insert_ref,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            after_refs=frozenset({*write_after_refs, delete_ref}),
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            phase="insert",
            batch_plan=batch_plan,
            user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
            permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
        ),
        _DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchReturnStep(
            return_ref,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            after_refs=frozenset({insert_ref}),
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            batch_plan=batch_plan,
            user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
            permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
        ),
        *_versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            "UPDATE",
            ctx,
            write_ref_id=versioned_write_raw_rows_source_ref(return_ref),
        ),
        _DedupeVersionedUpdateManyResultStep(
            ref_id,
            # The intent ref's runtime binding is caller-visible: after-deps
            # guards snapshot it mid-execution, so it must carry the hydrated
            # models from the return step, not the raw transport rows.
            source_ref=return_ref,
        ),
    ]
    return _anchor_intent_after_refs(steps, after_refs)


def _lower_versioned_upsert_many_batch_intent[T: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[T],
    instances: ObjectSequenceServerRef[T],
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
    conflict_columns: Sequence[_UpsertFieldIdentifier] | None,
    on_conflict: Mapping[_UpsertFieldIdentifier, _BatchOnConflictValue] | None,
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
    post_write_event_type: Literal["INSERT", "UPDATE", "UPSERT"],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    literal_instances: tuple[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId], ...] | None = None,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
    return_rows: bool = True,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    staging_ctx = _staging_ctx_for_lowering(staging_ctx, ctx)
    ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_ensure_staged_commit")
    delete_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_delete_batch")
    insert_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_insert_batch")
    normalized_conflict_columns = (
        None
        if conflict_columns is None
        else [_normalize_upsert_field_name(value, context="batch conflict column") for value in conflict_columns]
    )
    normalized_on_conflict = (
        None
        if on_conflict is None
        else {_normalize_upsert_field_name(key, context="batch on_conflict key"): value for key, value in on_conflict.items()}
    )
    normalized_on_conflict = _include_large_column_pointer_updates(model_cls, normalized_on_conflict)
    if literal_instances is None:
        normalized_conflict_columns = _include_large_column_storage_conflicts(model_cls, normalized_conflict_columns)
    delta_configs = tuple(
        config for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls) if config.delta_storage is not None and config.delta_storage.enabled
    )
    delta_columns = frozenset(config.column for config in delta_configs)
    conflicting_delta_columns = delta_columns.intersection(normalized_conflict_columns or ())
    if normalized_on_conflict == {} and conflicting_delta_columns:
        columns = ", ".join(sorted(conflicting_delta_columns))
        raise ValueError(f"Versioned insert-if-absent cannot use a delta-stored large-column conflict key: {columns}")
    if literal_instances is None and delta_configs and normalized_on_conflict == {}:
        msg = f"Versioned delta insert-if-absent for {model_cls.__name__} requires a literal candidate sequence"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if literal_instances is None:
        batch_plan = _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan_from_symbolic_source(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            instances=instances,
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            conflict_columns=normalized_conflict_columns,
            on_conflict=normalized_on_conflict,
            source_order=_VersionedBatchSourceOrder.UNORDERED,
            source_columns=None,
        )
    else:
        batch_plan = _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            instances=literal_instances,
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            ctx=ctx,
            conflict_columns=normalized_conflict_columns,
            on_conflict=normalized_on_conflict,
        )
    spill_steps = build_large_column_spill_steps(
        model_cls,
        batch_plan.spill_plan,
        write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_large_columns"),
    )
    spill_dependencies = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id) for step in spill_steps)
    if _should_emit_staged_commit_ensure(staging_ctx, ctx):
        ensure_dependencies = frozenset({ensure_ref})
    else:
        ensure_dependencies = frozenset()
    ordered_after_refs = ensure_dependencies | after_refs
    isolate_ordered_writes = bool(after_refs)
    permission_steps, user_id_ref_id = _versioned_permission_resolution_steps(
        ref_id,
        model_cls,
        ctx,
        after_refs=after_refs,
    )
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    if ensure_dependencies:
        steps.append(
            EnsureStagedCommitStep(
                ensure_ref,
                staging_ctx.domain,
                staging_ctx.literal_branch or staging_ctx.lazy_branch,
                config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(staging_ctx),
            ),
        )
    steps.extend(permission_steps)
    steps.extend(_anchor_intent_after_refs(spill_steps, after_refs))
    write_dependencies = ordered_after_refs | spill_dependencies
    if user_id_ref_id is not None:
        permission_validation_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_validate_permission")
        steps.append(
            _ValidateVersionedUpsertManyPermissionStep(
                permission_validation_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                after_refs=write_dependencies,
                staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
                batch_plan=batch_plan,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
            ),
        )
        write_dependencies |= frozenset({permission_validation_ref})
    insert_dependencies = write_dependencies
    if not batch_plan.do_nothing:
        steps.append(
            _DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchWriteStep(
                delete_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                after_refs=write_dependencies,
                staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
                phase="delete",
                batch_plan=batch_plan,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                isolate_from_sql_batch=isolate_ordered_writes,
                permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
            ),
        )
        insert_dependencies |= frozenset({delete_ref})
    steps.append(
        _DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchWriteStep(
            insert_ref,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            after_refs=insert_dependencies,
            staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
            phase="insert",
            batch_plan=batch_plan,
            user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
            isolate_from_sql_batch=isolate_ordered_writes,
            permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
        ),
    )
    completion_dependencies = frozenset({insert_ref})
    if spill_steps:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_content_delta_storage import (
            build_delta_orphan_cleanup_steps,
        )
        from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_table_info import get_versioned_table_names

        table_names = get_versioned_table_names(model_cls)
        cleanup_steps, completion_dependencies = build_delta_orphan_cleanup_steps(
            ref_prefix=ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_large_columns"),
            model_cls=model_cls,
            configs=get_large_column_configs(model_cls),
            after_ref=insert_ref,
            owner_tables=(table_names.staged, table_names.tip, table_names.sparse),
        )
        steps.extend(cleanup_steps)
    if return_rows:
        steps.append(
            _DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchReturnStep(
                ref_id,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                after_refs=completion_dependencies,
                staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
                batch_plan=batch_plan,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                inserted_rows_ref=insert_ref if batch_plan.do_nothing else None,
                permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
            ),
        )
    steps.extend(
        _versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            post_write_event_type,
            ctx,
            write_ref_id=versioned_write_raw_rows_source_ref(ref_id) if return_rows else insert_ref,
            config=(
                _VersionedPostWriteSideEffectsConfig(
                    write_ref_id=(versioned_write_raw_rows_source_ref(ref_id) if return_rows else insert_ref),
                    table_event_ref_id=(versioned_write_raw_rows_source_ref(ref_id) if return_rows else insert_ref),
                    table_event_completion_ref_id=(versioned_write_raw_rows_source_ref(ref_id) if return_rows else insert_ref),
                    table_event_after_refs=(frozenset({ref_id}) if return_rows else frozenset()),
                    table_event_relation_replayable=return_rows,
                    branch_id=staging_ctx.literal_branch or staging_ctx.lazy_branch,
                )
            ),
        ),
    )
    return steps


def _lower_versioned_upsert_many_intent(
    intent: VersionedUpsertManyIntent[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import (
        CollectResultsStep,
        StaticValueAfterDepsStep,
    )

    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    return_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
    write_effect_refs: list[str] = []
    sc = _staging_ctx_for_lowering(intent.staging_ctx, ctx)
    steps.append(
        EnsureStagedCommitStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_ensure_staged_commit"),
            sc.domain,
            sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
            config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(sc),
        ),
    )

    literal_instances = intent.literal_instances
    if literal_instances is None:
        msg = "VersionedUpsertManyIntent requires literal instances"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)

    conflict_field_names = (
        ("sys_id",)
        if intent.conflict_columns is None
        else tuple(
            _normalize_upsert_field_name(column, context="versioned upsert-many conflict column") for column in intent.conflict_columns
        )
    )
    winning_instances: list[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]] = []
    seen_conflict_keys: list[tuple[object, ...]] = []
    for instance in reversed(literal_instances):
        conflict_key = tuple(getattr(instance, field_name) for field_name in conflict_field_names)
        # SQL unique constraints treat a key containing NULL as distinct from
        # another NULL-bearing key. Do not collapse values the database would
        # permit as separate targets.
        if any(value is None for value in conflict_key):
            winning_instances.append(instance)
            continue
        if conflict_key in seen_conflict_keys:
            continue
        seen_conflict_keys.append(conflict_key)
        winning_instances.append(instance)
    literal_instances = tuple(reversed(winning_instances))

    for index, instance in enumerate(literal_instances):
        sub_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_item{index}")
        sub_ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{sub_ref}_ensure_staged_commit")
        shared_ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_ensure_staged_commit")
        concrete_model_cls = type(instance)
        sub_intent = VersionedUpsertIntent(
            ref_id=sub_ref,
            model_cls=concrete_model_cls,
            instance=cast("Any", instance),
            config=cast(
                "Any",
                _VersionedUpsertIntentConfig(
                    staging_ctx=sc,
                    conflict_columns=None if intent.conflict_columns is None else tuple(intent.conflict_columns),
                    on_conflict=_widen_upsert_mapping(intent.on_conflict),
                    post_write=_VersionedPostWriteSideEffectsConfig(emit_side_effects=False),
                ),
            ),
        )
        sub_steps = sub_intent.lower(ctx)
        collect_ref = sub_ref
        for step in sub_steps:
            if step.durable_staged_commit_id() == StagedCommitId(sc.staged_commit_id_raw):
                continue
            passthrough_source_ref = step.collection_passthrough_source_ref(sub_ref)
            if passthrough_source_ref is not None:
                collect_ref = passthrough_source_ref
                continue
            steps.append(
                _DependencyRemapStep(
                    step,
                    frozenset(),
                    replace_deps={sub_ensure_ref: shared_ensure_ref},
                ),
            )
        return_refs.append(collect_ref)
        write_effect_refs.append(str(sub_ref))

    steps.append(
        StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
            versioned_upsert_many_write_effect_ref(intent.ref_id),
            None,
            write_effect_refs,
        ),
    )
    event_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_event_rows")
    steps.append(
        StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
            event_rows_ref,
            tuple(literal_instances),
            write_effect_refs,
            publish_literal_relation=True,
        ),
    )
    steps.extend(
        _versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
            intent.ref_id,
            intent.model_cls,
            "UPSERT",
            ctx,
            config=_VersionedPostWriteSideEffectsConfig(
                write_ref_id=intent.ref_id,
                table_event_ref_id=event_rows_ref,
                table_event_relation_replayable=True,
                materialized_write_ref=True,
                source_rows=tuple(literal_instances),
            ),
        ),
    )
    steps.append(
        CollectResultsStep(
            intent.ref_id,
            [str(ref) for ref in return_refs],
            model_cls=intent.model_cls,
            collect_runtime=True,
        ),
    )
    return _anchor_intent_after_refs(steps, intent.after_refs)


def _lower_versioned_upsert(
    intent: VersionedUpsertIntent[Any],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Build the 4 L0 steps for versioned upsert.

    Pure function — no I/O.  All conflict resolution, expression
    evaluation, and instance merging is expressed in SQL grammar.
    """

    sc = _staging_ctx_for_lowering(intent.staging_ctx, ctx)
    model_cls = intent.model_cls
    staged_instance = prepare_versioned_instance_for_staging(
        model_cls,
        intent.instance,
        sc,
    )
    permission_steps, user_id_ref_id = _versioned_permission_resolution_steps(
        intent.ref_id,
        model_cls,
        ctx,
        after_refs=intent.after_refs,
    )
    authored_conflict_columns = (
        None
        if intent.conflict_columns is None
        else [_normalize_upsert_field_name(column, context="upsert conflict column") for column in intent.conflict_columns]
    )
    normalized_conflict_columns = _include_large_column_pointer_conflicts(
        model_cls,
        authored_conflict_columns,
    )
    normalized_on_conflict = _include_large_column_pointer_updates(
        model_cls,
        (
            None
            if intent.on_conflict is None
            else {_normalize_upsert_field_name(key, context="upsert on_conflict key"): value for key, value in intent.on_conflict.items()}
        ),
    )
    if sc.literal_branch is None and sc.lazy_branch is not None:
        batch_return_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_return_batch")
        event_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_event_rows")
        ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_ensure_staged_commit")
        delete_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_delete_batch")
        insert_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_insert_batch")
        batch_plan = _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            instances=(staged_instance,),
            staging_ctx=sc,
            ctx=ctx,
            conflict_columns=authored_conflict_columns,
            on_conflict=normalized_on_conflict,
        )
        spill_steps = build_large_column_spill_steps(
            model_cls,
            batch_plan.spill_plan,
            write_ref_id=insert_ref,
        )
        spill_dependencies = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(str(step.ref_id)) for step in spill_steps)
        permission_validation_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_validate_permission")
        write_after_refs = frozenset({ensure_ref}) | spill_dependencies
        lazy_permission_validation_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        if user_id_ref_id is not None:
            lazy_permission_validation_steps.append(
                _ValidateVersionedUpsertManyPermissionStep(
                    permission_validation_ref,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    after_refs=write_after_refs,
                    staging_ctx=sc,
                    batch_plan=batch_plan,
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    permission_context_ref=intent.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=intent.permission_context_type,
                ),
            )
            write_after_refs |= frozenset({permission_validation_ref})
        lazy_branch_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
            *spill_steps,
            EnsureStagedCommitStep(
                ensure_ref,
                sc.domain,
                sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
                config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(sc),
            ),
            *permission_steps,
            *lazy_permission_validation_steps,
            _DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchWriteStep(
                delete_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                after_refs=write_after_refs,
                staging_ctx=sc,
                phase="delete",
                batch_plan=batch_plan,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                isolate_from_sql_batch=True,
            ),
            _DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchWriteStep(
                insert_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                after_refs=write_after_refs | frozenset({delete_ref}),
                staging_ctx=sc,
                phase="insert",
                batch_plan=batch_plan,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                isolate_from_sql_batch=True,
            ),
            _DeferredVersionedUpsertManyBatchReturnStep(
                batch_return_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                after_refs=frozenset({insert_ref}),
                staging_ctx=sc,
                batch_plan=(replace(batch_plan, do_nothing=False) if batch_plan.do_nothing else batch_plan),
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
            ),
            _TakeFirstResolvedItemStep(
                intent.ref_id,
                source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{batch_return_ref}.raw_rows"),
                model_cls=model_cls,
            ),
            _PublishedLiteralModelRowStep(
                event_rows_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                row=staged_instance,
            ),
            *_versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
                intent.ref_id,
                model_cls,
                "UPSERT",
                ctx,
                config=replace(
                    intent._config.post_write,
                    write_ref_id=insert_ref,
                    table_event_ref_id=event_rows_ref,
                    table_event_relation_replayable=True,
                    materialized_write_ref=True,
                    source_rows=(staged_instance,),
                ),
            ),
        ]
        return list(_anchor_intent_after_refs(lazy_branch_steps, intent.after_refs))
    spill_plan = PreparedLargeColumnSpillPlan()
    physical_values: dict[str, _BatchParamValue] | None = None
    if get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        physical_payload, _normalized = prepare_versioned_staging_payload_from_instances(
            model_cls,
            sc.staged_model,
            [staged_instance],
            _staging_branch_source_for_lowering(sc, ctx),
            sc.staged_commit_id_raw,
            backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
            common_columns=sc.common_columns,
            return_many=False,
        )
        spill_plan = physical_payload.spill_plan
        physical_values = dict(zip(physical_payload.columns, physical_payload.rows[0], strict=True))
        normalized_conflict_columns = _include_large_column_pointer_conflicts(
            model_cls,
            authored_conflict_columns,
            physical_values=physical_values,
        )
    prepared = _build_versioned_upsert_plan(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        instance=staged_instance,
        staging_ctx=sc,
        ctx=ctx,
        conflict_columns=normalized_conflict_columns,
        on_conflict=normalized_on_conflict,
        read_all_branch_staged=ctx.is_write_transaction,
        branch_tip_materialized=ctx.branch_tip_materialized,
        physical_values=physical_values,
    )
    ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_ensure_staged_commit")
    delete_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_delete_batch")
    insert_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_insert_batch")
    event_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_event_rows")
    spill_steps = build_large_column_spill_steps(
        model_cls,
        spill_plan,
        write_ref_id=insert_ref,
    )
    spill_dependencies = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(str(step.ref_id)) for step in spill_steps)
    insert_after_refs = frozenset({ensure_ref}) | spill_dependencies
    permission_validation_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    if user_id_ref_id is not None:
        permission_batch_plan = _build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            instances=(staged_instance,),
            staging_ctx=sc,
            ctx=ctx,
            conflict_columns=normalized_conflict_columns,
            on_conflict=normalized_on_conflict,
        )
        permission_validation_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent.ref_id}_validate_permission")
        permission_validation_steps.append(
            _ValidateVersionedUpsertManyPermissionStep(
                permission_validation_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                after_refs=insert_after_refs,
                staging_ctx=sc,
                batch_plan=permission_batch_plan,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                permission_context_ref=intent.permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=intent.permission_context_type,
            ),
        )
        insert_after_refs |= frozenset({permission_validation_ref})
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
        *spill_steps,
        EnsureStagedCommitStep(
            ensure_ref,
            sc.domain,
            sc.literal_branch or sc.lazy_branch,
            config=_ensure_staged_commit_config(sc),
        ),
        *permission_steps,
        *permission_validation_steps,
    ]
    if not prepared.do_nothing:
        steps.append(
            VersionedUpsertDeleteStagedStep(
                delete_ref,
                _VersionedUpsertDeleteStagedConfig(
                    grammar=prepared.delete_grammar,
                    staged_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
                    after_refs=frozenset({ensure_ref}),
                ),
            ),
        )
        insert_after_refs = frozenset({ensure_ref, delete_ref}) | spill_dependencies
    steps.extend(
        [
            (
                VersionedUpsertInsertStagedStep
                if ctx.backend_profile.traits.versioned_staging_transport is VersionedStagingTransport.SAME_STATEMENT_RELATION
                else _PortableVersionedUpsertInsertStagedStep
            )(
                insert_ref,
                _VersionedUpsertInsertStagedConfig(
                    grammar=prepared.insert_grammar,
                    staged_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
                    tip_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.tip_table_name),
                    publication_model_cls=sc.staged_model,
                    publication_source_model_cls=model_cls,
                    publication_columns=tuple(
                        dict.fromkeys(
                            (
                                "branch_id",
                                *sc.common_columns,
                                get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id")),
                                get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted")),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                    after_refs=insert_after_refs,
                ),
            ),
            VersionedUpsertReturnStep(
                intent.ref_id,
                model_cls,
                _VersionedUpsertReturnConfig(
                    staged_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.staged_table_name),
                    tip_table_name=SqlTableName(sc.tip_table_name),
                    data_columns=tuple(
                        SqlColumnName(name)
                        for name in dict.fromkeys(
                            (
                                *sc.common_columns,
                                *(
                                    get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column))
                                    for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
                                ),
                            ),
                        )
                    ),
                    storage_model_cls=sc.staged_model,
                    lazy_branch=sc.lazy_branch,
                    where_renderable=prepared.where_renderable,
                    literal_branch=(
                        sc.literal_branch if sc.literal_branch is not None or ctx.branch_id is None else BranchId(ctx.branch_id)
                    ),
                    type_filter_column=(
                        SqlColumnName("type_id") if sc.type_ids and all(str(type_id).isdigit() for type_id in sc.type_ids) else None
                    ),
                    type_filter_ids=(
                        tuple(int(type_id) for type_id in sc.type_ids)
                        if sc.type_ids and all(str(type_id).isdigit() for type_id in sc.type_ids)
                        else None
                    ),
                    after_refs=frozenset({insert_ref}),
                ),
            ),
            _PublishedLiteralModelRowStep(
                event_rows_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                row=staged_instance,
            ),
            *_versioned_post_write_side_effect_steps(
                intent.ref_id,
                model_cls,
                "UPSERT",
                ctx,
                config=replace(
                    intent._config.post_write,
                    write_ref_id=insert_ref,
                    table_event_ref_id=event_rows_ref,
                    table_event_relation_replayable=True,
                    materialized_write_ref=True,
                    source_rows=(staged_instance,),
                ),
            ),
        ],
    )
    return list(_anchor_intent_after_refs(steps, intent.after_refs))


class VersionedSelectOneIntent[T](IntentStep[T | None]):
    """L4: Versioned select one at an explicit revision."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "versioned", "select_one", "intent"})
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(
        self: VersionedSelectOneIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedSelectOneConfig],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self._config = _require_seeded_config(config, type(self).__name__)
        self.sys_id = self._config.sys_id
        self.revision_id = self._config.revision_id
        self.domain = self._config.domain
        self.include_deleted = self._config.include_deleted
        self.branch_id = self._config.branch_id

    def with_preferred_source(
        self: VersionedSelectOneIntent[T],
        source: PublishedVersionSource,
        *,
        revision_id: RevisionId | None = None,
        branch_id: BranchId | None = None,
    ) -> VersionedSelectOneIntent[T]:
        """Return the same visibility read bound to one checked physical source."""
        config = replace(
            self._config,
            preferred_source=source,
            revision_id=self._config.revision_id if revision_id is None else ServerRefs.scalar(revision_id),
            branch_id=self._config.branch_id if branch_id is None else ServerRefs.scalar(branch_id),
            policy_ref_id=None,
            historical_snapshot=True,
        )
        return VersionedSelectOneIntent(
            self.ref_id,
            self.model_cls,
            ServerRefs.scalar(config),
        )

    def dependencies(self: VersionedSelectOneIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        branch_dependencies = frozenset() if self.branch_id is None else self.branch_id.dependencies()
        policy_dependencies = frozenset({str(self._config.policy_ref_id)}) if self._config.policy_ref_id is not None else frozenset()
        context_dependencies = (
            frozenset({str(self._config.permission_context_ref)}) if self._config.permission_context_ref is not None else frozenset()
        )
        return (
            self.sys_id.dependencies()
            | self.revision_id.dependencies()
            | branch_dependencies
            | policy_dependencies
            | context_dependencies
        )

    def dependency_contract(self: VersionedSelectOneIntent) -> StepDependencyContract:
        return StepDependencyContract.from_refs(
            self.dependencies(),
            source=DependencySource.DIRECT_FIELD,
            required_for=frozenset({DependencyUse.ORDERING, DependencyUse.TRANSPORT_GRAPH}),
            transport=TransportDependencyPolicy.TRANSPORTABLE,
            reason="versioned select-one identity and revision sources",
        )

    def raw_payload_source_ref(self: VersionedSelectOneIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        """Return the exact raw relation published by the lowered select."""
        return versioned_select_published_refs(self.ref_id).raw_select_relation

    def additional_batch_binding_ref_ids(self: VersionedSelectOneIntent) -> tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]:
        return (self.raw_payload_source_ref(),)

    def tables_read(self: VersionedSelectOneIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        info = get_versioned_read_info(self.model_cls)
        return frozenset(
            {
                info.sparse_table,
                get_table_name(self.domain.branch_model),
                get_table_name(self.domain.revision_branch_index_model),
            },
        )

    def lower(self: VersionedSelectOneIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_select_one import (
            VersionedReadSelectOneRawStep,
            VersionedSelectOneRawStep,
            _VersionedReadSelectOneConfig,
            _VersionedSelectOneConfig,
            build_versioned_select_one_query_spec,
            lower_versioned_spill_aware_select_one_steps,
        )

        policy_ref_id = self._config.policy_ref_id
        info = get_versioned_read_info(self.model_cls)
        resolve_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_resolve_branch")
        permission_steps, user_id_ref_id = _versioned_permission_resolution_steps(
            self.ref_id,
            self.model_cls,
            ctx,
        )
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = list(permission_steps)
        uses_current_lazy_revision = ctx.prefer_tip_merged and not ctx.is_write_transaction and ctx.explicit_revision_id is None
        intent_revision_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            self.revision_id,
            site=f"{self.ref_id}_versioned_select_one.revision",
        )
        if ctx.explicit_revision_id is None and ctx.lazy_revision is not None:
            transaction_revision_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
                ctx.lazy_revision,
                site=f"{self.ref_id}_versioned_select_one.transaction_revision",
            )
            uses_current_lazy_revision = uses_current_lazy_revision or (
                intent_revision_shape.symbolic_ref_id is not None
                and intent_revision_shape.symbolic_ref_id == transaction_revision_shape.symbolic_ref_id
            )
        force_tip_source = self._config.preferred_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP
        force_sparse_source = self._config.preferred_source is PublishedVersionSource.SPARSE
        current_context_revision = ctx.explicit_revision_id is None or ctx.explicit_revision_id == "current"
        if (
            not uses_current_lazy_revision
            and current_context_revision
            and intent_revision_shape.has_literal_value
            and intent_revision_shape.literal_value == RevisionId.current()
        ):
            uses_current_lazy_revision = True
        if not uses_current_lazy_revision and ctx.explicit_revision_id is None:
            revision_ref_id = intent_revision_shape.symbolic_ref_id
            if revision_ref_id is not None:
                found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(revision_ref_id))
                if not found_seed:
                    found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(None, ServerPlanRefId(revision_ref_id))
                uses_current_lazy_revision = found_seed and seed_value is None
            else:
                uses_current_lazy_revision = intent_revision_shape.has_literal_value and intent_revision_shape.literal_value is None
        if (
            policy_ref_id is None
            and ctx.explicit_revision_id is None
            and not self._config.historical_snapshot
            and not ctx.is_write_transaction
            and ctx.lazy_branch_tip_materialization is not None
        ):
            policy_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
                ctx.lazy_branch_tip_materialization, site="versioned point-read policy"
            )
            if not policy_shape.has_literal_value:
                policy_ref_id = ctx.lazy_branch_tip_materialization.ref_id
        # An explicit semantic branch input has priority over ambient routing.
        branch_id: BranchId | None = None
        branch_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        if self.branch_id is not None:
            declared_branch_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
                self.branch_id,
                site=f"{self.ref_id}_versioned_select_one.declared_branch",
            )
            if declared_branch_shape.has_literal_value and declared_branch_shape.literal_value is not None:
                branch_id = BranchId(str(declared_branch_shape.literal_value))
            elif declared_branch_shape.symbolic_ref_id is not None:
                seeded_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(declared_branch_shape.symbolic_ref_id)
                found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(ctx, seeded_ref_id)
                if found_seed and seed_value is not None:
                    branch_id = seed_value if isinstance(seed_value, BranchId) else BranchId(str(seed_value))
                else:
                    branch_ref_id = seeded_ref_id
        if branch_id is None and branch_ref_id is None and uses_current_lazy_revision and ctx.branch_id is not None:
            branch_id = BranchId(ctx.branch_id)
        if branch_id is None and branch_ref_id is None and uses_current_lazy_revision and ctx.lazy_branch is not None:
            branch_shape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
                ctx.lazy_branch,
                site=f"{self.ref_id}_versioned_select_one.branch",
            )
            if branch_shape.has_literal_value and branch_shape.literal_value is not None:
                branch_id = BranchId(str(branch_shape.literal_value))
        if branch_id is None and branch_ref_id is None and uses_current_lazy_revision and ctx.lazy_branch is not None:
            branch_ref_id = resolve_ref
            steps.append(PublishResolvedBranchStep(resolve_ref, ctx.lazy_branch))
        elif branch_id is None and branch_ref_id is None:
            branch_ref_id = resolve_ref
            steps.append(
                ResolveBranchForRevisionStep(
                    resolve_ref,
                    self.revision_id,
                    branch_table=get_table_name(self.domain.branch_model),
                    index_table=get_table_name(self.domain.revision_branch_index_model),
                    branch_id_column=get_db_column_name(self.domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")),
                    tip_revision_column=get_db_column_name(
                        self.domain.branch_model,
                        DynamicFieldName("tip_revision_sys_id"),
                    ),
                    deleted_column=get_db_column_name(self.domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("deleted")),
                ),
            )
        query_spec = build_versioned_select_one_query_spec(
            self.model_cls,
            sys_id=self.sys_id,
            include_deleted=self.include_deleted,
        )
        concrete_type_names = _concrete_polymorphic_subtype_names(self.model_cls)
        revision_after_refs = (
            frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(dependency) for dependency in ctx.lazy_revision.dependencies())
            if ctx.prefer_tip_merged and not ctx.is_write_transaction and ctx.lazy_revision is not None
            else frozenset()
        )
        if (
            uses_current_lazy_revision
            and not force_sparse_source
            and (branch_id is not None or branch_ref_id is not None)
            and (ctx.is_write_transaction or ctx.prefer_tip_merged)
            and current_context_revision
            and ctx.staging_ctx_factory is not None
        ):
            staging_ctx = ctx.staging_ctx_factory(self.model_cls)
            if not isinstance(staging_ctx, VersionedStagingCtx):
                msg = "staging_ctx_factory must return VersionedStagingCtx"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            sc = _staging_ctx_for_lowering(staging_ctx, ctx)
            return [
                *steps,
                *lower_versioned_spill_aware_select_one_steps(
                    ctx=ctx,
                    ref_id=self.ref_id,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    query_spec=query_spec,
                    raw_step=VersionedSelectOneRawStep(
                        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw"),
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        sys_id=self.sys_id,
                        config=_build_versioned_select_one_raw_config(
                            sc,
                            model_cls=self.model_cls,
                            branch_id=None if branch_id is None else str(branch_id),
                            user_id_ref_id=(None if user_id_ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id)),
                            after_refs=revision_after_refs,
                            include_deleted=self.include_deleted,
                            permission_context_ref=self._config.permission_context_ref,
                            permission_context_type=self._config.permission_context_type,
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        if (
            (uses_current_lazy_revision or force_tip_source)
            and not force_sparse_source
            and (branch_id is not None or branch_ref_id is not None)
            and (force_tip_source or ctx.branch_tip_materialized or ctx.prefer_tip_merged)
            and (force_tip_source or current_context_revision)
        ):
            return [
                *steps,
                *lower_versioned_spill_aware_select_one_steps(
                    ctx=ctx,
                    ref_id=self.ref_id,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    query_spec=query_spec,
                    raw_step=VersionedSelectOneRawStep(
                        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw"),
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        sys_id=self.sys_id,
                        config=_VersionedSelectOneConfig(
                            staged_table_name=SqlTableName(info.staged_table),
                            tip_table_name=SqlTableName(info.tip_table),
                            common_columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(name) for name in info.common_columns),
                            branch_id=None if branch_id is None else str(branch_id),
                            branch_ref_id=branch_ref_id,
                            type_ids=concrete_type_names,
                            user_id_ref_id=(None if user_id_ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id)),
                            include_deleted=self.include_deleted,
                            permission_context_ref=self._config.permission_context_ref,
                            permission_context_type=self._config.permission_context_type,
                            after_refs=revision_after_refs,
                            use_context_permission_anchors=not force_tip_source,
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        read_revision_ref = None if uses_current_lazy_revision else self.revision_id
        if read_revision_ref is None and ctx.lazy_revision is not None:
            read_revision_ref = ctx.lazy_revision
        return [
            *steps,
            *lower_versioned_spill_aware_select_one_steps(
                ctx=ctx,
                ref_id=self.ref_id,
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                query_spec=query_spec,
                raw_step=VersionedReadSelectOneRawStep(
                    ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw"),
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    sys_id=self.sys_id,
                    config=_VersionedReadSelectOneConfig(
                        policy_ref_id=policy_ref_id,
                        historical_snapshot=self._config.historical_snapshot or ctx.explicit_revision_id is not None,
                        sparse_table_name=SqlTableName(info.sparse_table),
                        branch_id=None if branch_id is None else BranchId(branch_id),
                        branch_ref_id=branch_ref_id,
                        revision_ref=read_revision_ref,
                        type_ids=concrete_type_names,
                        user_id_ref_id=(None if user_id_ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id)),
                        include_deleted=self.include_deleted,
                        permission_context_ref=self._config.permission_context_ref,
                        permission_context_type=self._config.permission_context_type,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ]
