def _build_fts_sql_components_from_score_cte(
    *,
    score_cte_ref_id: str,
    table_alias: str,
    include_revision_id: bool,
    tips_only: bool,
    tips_read_from_sparse: bool = False,
    include_branch_id: bool = True,
    visible_branch_alias: SqlAliasName | None = None,
    allow_physical_branch_fallback: bool = False,
) -> SqlFTSComponents:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlTableAlias
    from l5100_fts.fts_components import SqlFTSJoinStyle

    scores_alias = SqlAliasName("fs")
    table_alias_name = SqlAliasName(table_alias)
    where_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=table_alias_name),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("object_id"), qualifier=scores_alias),
        ),
    ]
    if include_branch_id:
        branch_column = (
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=visible_branch_alias)
            if visible_branch_alias is not None
            else SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=table_alias_name)
        )
        direct_branch_match: SqlRenderable = SqlBinaryOp(
            branch_column,
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=scores_alias),
        )
        if allow_physical_branch_fallback and visible_branch_alias is not None:
            preferred_alias = SqlAliasName("preferred_fs")
            preferred_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("object_id"), qualifier=preferred_alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=table_alias_name),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=preferred_alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_column,
                ),
            ]
            if include_revision_id:
                revision_column = SqlColumnName(
                    "sys_revision_id" if tips_only and not tips_read_from_sparse else "sys_valid_from_revision_id"
                )
                preferred_conditions.append(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(CROSS_BRANCH_SCORE_REVISION_ID_COLUMN), qualifier=preferred_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(revision_column, qualifier=table_alias_name),
                    )
                )
            direct_branch_match = sql_or(
                direct_branch_match,
                sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=table_alias_name),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=scores_alias),
                    ),
                    SqlExists(
                        SqlSelect(
                            [SqlParam(1)],
                            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(score_cte_ref_id)), preferred_alias),
                            where=sql_and(*preferred_conditions),
                        ),
                        negated=True,
                    ),
                ),
            )
        where_conditions.append(direct_branch_match)
    if include_revision_id:
        revision_column = SqlColumnName(
            "sys_revision_id" if tips_only and not tips_read_from_sparse else "sys_valid_from_revision_id",
        )
        score_revision_column = SqlColumnName(CROSS_BRANCH_SCORE_REVISION_ID_COLUMN)
        where_conditions.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(revision_column, qualifier=table_alias_name),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlColumnRef(score_revision_column, qualifier=scores_alias),
            ),
        )
    return SqlFTSComponents(
        join_clause=SqlTableAlias(
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(score_cte_ref_id)),
            alias=scores_alias,
        ),
        where_clause=sql_and(*where_conditions),
        rank_expression=sql_aliased_column(
            scores_alias,
            SqlColumnName("rank"),
        ),
        join_style=SqlFTSJoinStyle.JOIN_ON_CONDITION,
        rank_alias="__fts_rank",
    )


def _build_cross_branch_sql_components_from_score_cte(
    *,
    score_cte_ref_id: str,
    table_alias: str,
    branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
) -> SqlVectorSearchComponents:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlTableAlias
    from l5200_vector_index.vector_search_components import SqlVectorSearchComponents

    scores_alias = SqlAliasName("vs")
    table_alias_name = SqlAliasName(table_alias)
    join_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=table_alias_name),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("object_id"), qualifier=scores_alias),
        ),
    ]
    visible_branch = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("b"))
    score_branch = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=scores_alias)
    branch_match: SqlRenderable = SqlBinaryOp(visible_branch, BinaryOp.EQ, score_branch)
    if branch_spec.search_op.rrf_enabled and _cross_branch_uses_inherited_branch_visibility(branch_spec):
        preferred_alias = SqlAliasName("preferred_vs")
        preferred_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("object_id"), qualifier=preferred_alias),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=table_alias_name),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=preferred_alias),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                visible_branch,
            ),
        ]
        if not (branch_spec.tips_only and not _cross_branch_effectively_tipless(branch_spec)):
            preferred_conditions.append(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_id"), qualifier=preferred_alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"), qualifier=table_alias_name),
                )
            )
        branch_match = sql_or(
            branch_match,
            sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=table_alias_name),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    score_branch,
                ),
                SqlExists(
                    SqlSelect(
                        [SqlParam(1)],
                        from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(score_cte_ref_id)), preferred_alias),
                        where=sql_and(*preferred_conditions),
                    ),
                    negated=True,
                ),
            ),
        )
    join_conditions.append(branch_match)
    if not (branch_spec.tips_only and not _cross_branch_effectively_tipless(branch_spec)):
        revision_column = SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id")
        join_conditions.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(revision_column, qualifier=table_alias_name),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName("revision_id"),
                    qualifier=scores_alias,
                ),
            ),
        )
    join_condition = sql_and(*join_conditions)
    return SqlVectorSearchComponents(
        join_clause=SqlTableAlias(
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(score_cte_ref_id)),
            alias=scores_alias,
        ),
        where_clause=join_condition,
        score_expression=sql_aliased_column(
            scores_alias,
            SqlColumnName("score"),
        ),
        score_alias="__vector_score",
    )

def _require_seeded_config[T](config: T | ScalarServerRef[T], owner: str) -> T:
    if not isinstance(config, ServerRef):
        return config
    config_shape: PlanningServerValueShape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
        config,
        site=f"{owner}._require_seeded_config",
    )
    ref_id = config_shape.symbolic_ref_id
    if ref_id is None:
        msg = f"{owner} requires a seeded config ref"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    found, config_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(None, ServerPlanRefId(ref_id))
    if not found:
        msg = f"{owner} requires a seeded config ref"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    return cast("T", config_value)


def branch_ids_from_workspace_branch_rows(branches: object) -> list[Any]:
    """Extract branch id values from a ``ListBranchesStep`` result sequence."""

    from l1200_versioned_ids import BranchId

    if not isinstance(branches, Sequence) or isinstance(branches, str | bytes | bytearray):
        msg = f"ListBranchesStep result must be a non-string sequence of branch rows, got {type(branches).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    out: list[BranchId] = []
    for row in branches:
        sid = getattr(row, "sys_id", None)
        if sid is None:
            continue
        out.append(sid if isinstance(sid, BranchId) else BranchId(str(sid)))
    return out

def _compile_cross_branch_filters(
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
    branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
    *,
    table_alias: str | None = None,
) -> list[Any]:
    """Convert filters from a CrossBranchQuerySpec to SQL conditions.

    Args:
        model_cls: The model class being queried
        branch_spec: The CrossBranchQuerySpec
        table_alias: Optional table alias for qualified column references (e.g., "t")
    """
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.builders import not_in
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_conditions import (
        SqlInListParam,
    )

    def _make_col_expr(col_name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
        if table_alias is not None:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(col_name), qualifier=table_alias)
        return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(col_name))

    def _unwrap_filter_value(value: object) -> object:
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [_unwrap_filter_value(item) for item in value]
        if hasattr(value, "unwrap_to_sql"):
            return cast(Any, value).unwrap_to_sql()
        if hasattr(value, "unwrap_to_str"):
            return cast(Any, value).unwrap_to_str()
        if hasattr(value, "unwrap_to_int"):
            return cast(Any, value).unwrap_to_int()
        return value

    conditions: list[Any] = []
    for filter_item in branch_spec.filters:
        expr: Any = filter_item
        while isinstance(expr, QueryFilter):
            if expr.expression is not None:
                expr = expr.expression
                break
            if expr.column is not None and expr.operator is not None:
                db_col = (
                    get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(expr.column)) if expr.column in model_cls.model_fields else expr.column
                )
                col_expr = _make_col_expr(db_col)
                value = expr.value
                if isinstance(value, ServerRef):
                    msg = (
                        "Cross-branch filter compilation requires ServerRef-backed filters "
                        "to be rewritten to SQL-visible CTE predicates before this helper runs."
                    )
                    raise NotImplementedError(msg)
                value = _unwrap_filter_value(value)
                if expr.operator == "IN" or isinstance(value, list):
                    values = value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]
                    conditions.append(SqlInListParam(col_expr, values))
                elif expr.operator == "NOT IN":
                    values = value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]
                    conditions.append(not_in(col_expr, values))
                elif expr.operator == "=":
                    conditions.append(SqlBinaryOp(col_expr, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(value)))
                elif expr.operator == "!=":
                    conditions.append(SqlBinaryOp(col_expr, BinaryOp.NE, SqlParam(value)))
                elif expr.operator == "<":
                    conditions.append(SqlBinaryOp(col_expr, BinaryOp.LT, SqlParam(value)))
                elif expr.operator == "<=":
                    conditions.append(SqlBinaryOp(col_expr, BinaryOp.LE, SqlParam(value)))
                elif expr.operator == ">":
                    conditions.append(SqlBinaryOp(col_expr, BinaryOp.GT, SqlParam(value)))
                elif expr.operator == ">=":
                    conditions.append(SqlBinaryOp(col_expr, BinaryOp.GE, SqlParam(value)))
                else:
                    msg = f"Cross-branch compilation not implemented for simple filter operator {expr.operator!r}"
                    raise NotImplementedError(msg)
                expr = None
                break
            expr = None
            break

        if expr is not None and isinstance(expr, Expression):
            from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.expression_grammar import ExpressionToGrammar

            converter = ExpressionToGrammar(
                model_cls,
                table_alias=table_alias,
                field_name_mapper=lambda field_name: polymorphic_read_column_name(model_cls, field_name),
                owner_field_ref_factory=lambda owner, field_name: SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(polymorphic_read_column_name(owner, field_name)),
                    qualifier=table_alias,
                ),
            )
            conditions.append(converter.convert(expr))

    return conditions


def _get_data_table_name(
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
    branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
) -> str:
    """Return the appropriate table name: _tip for tips-only, _sparse for historical."""

    names = get_versioned_table_names(model_cls)
    tips_only: bool = getattr(branch_spec, "tips_only", True)
    if tips_only and _cross_branch_effectively_tipless(branch_spec):
        return names.sparse
    return names.tip if tips_only else names.sparse

def _build_cross_branch_where(
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
    branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
    *,
    table_alias: str | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    """Build WHERE condition for cross-branch queries (shared by select/count/exists).

    Args:
        model_cls: The model class being queried
        branch_spec: The CrossBranchQuerySpec
        table_alias: Optional table alias for qualified column references.
            Required when JOINing with the branch table to avoid ambiguity.
    """
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.ddl.ddl_misc import SqlBooleanLiteral

    conditions: list[Any] = []

    # Tip tables do NOT have a deleted column (soft-deleted objects are removed
    # from tip tables entirely). Only sparse tables have sys_deleted.
    tips_only: bool = getattr(branch_spec, "tips_only", True)
    if not tips_only and not getattr(branch_spec, "include_deleted", False):
        # Sparse table: the DB column is sys_deleted (from db_column metadata)
        deleted_db_col: str = "sys_deleted"
        if table_alias is not None:
            deleted_col: Any = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(deleted_db_col), qualifier=table_alias)
        else:
            deleted_col = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(deleted_db_col))
        conditions.append(SqlBinaryOp(deleted_col, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlBooleanLiteral(False)))
        if table_alias is not None:
            tip_table = get_versioned_table_names(model_cls).tip
            conditions.append(
                SqlIn(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=table_alias),
                    SqlSelect(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                        SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(tip_table)),
                        where=SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=table_alias),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )

    type_names = collect_polymorphic_type_names(model_cls) if _model_has_type_name_field(model_cls) else ()
    if type_names:
        from l1000_schema.column_utils import get_db_column_name

        type_name_db_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("type_name"))
        if table_alias is not None:
            type_name_col = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(type_name_db_col), qualifier=table_alias)
        else:
            type_name_col = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(type_name_db_col))
        if len(type_names) == 1:
            conditions.append(SqlBinaryOp(type_name_col, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(type_names[0])))
        else:
            conditions.append(SqlIn(type_name_col, [SqlParam(v) for v in type_names]))

    # User filters (simple equality + Expression-based)
    conditions.extend(
        _compile_cross_branch_filters(model_cls, branch_spec, table_alias=table_alias),
    )

    if not conditions:
        return None
    combined: SqlRenderable = cast("SqlRenderable", conditions[0])
    for cond in conditions[1:]:
        combined = sql_and(combined, cond)
    return combined


def _build_cross_branch_order_by(
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
    branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
    *,
    table_alias: str | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    """Build ORDER BY clause for cross-branch queries.

    Args:
        model_cls: The model class being queried
        branch_spec: The CrossBranchQuerySpec
        table_alias: Optional table alias for qualified column references
    """
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlOrderByClause, SqlOrderByItem

    if not branch_spec.order_by:
        return None
    items: list[Any] = []
    field_policy = build_sql_field_reference_policy(
        get_db_column=lambda field_name: polymorphic_read_column_name(model_cls, field_name),
        table_alias=table_alias,
        column_masking=branch_spec.column_masking,
        column_masking_user_grammar=branch_spec.column_masking_user_grammar,
    )
    converter = build_observable_expression_converter(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        table_alias=table_alias,
        field_policy=field_policy,
    )
    for order_operand, direction in branch_spec.order_by:
        if isinstance(order_operand, Expression):
            col_expr = converter.convert(order_operand)
        else:
            field_name = order_operand.name if isinstance(order_operand, Field) else order_operand
            owner = (
                order_operand.owner
                if isinstance(order_operand, Field) and isinstance(getattr(order_operand, "owner", None), type)
                else model_cls
            )
            db_col = polymorphic_read_column_name(owner, field_name)
            col_expr = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_col), qualifier=table_alias)
        items.append(SqlOrderByItem(col_expr, direction))
    return SqlOrderByClause(items) if items else None


def _build_branch_join_and_workspace_where(
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
    branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
    data_table_alias: str,
    branch_alias: str,
    *,
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, SqlRenderable | None]:
    """Build branch table JOIN clause and workspace WHERE conditions.

    All cross-branch queries must JOIN with the branch table to:
    1. Filter by workspace_id
    2. Exclude soft-deleted branches (b.sys_deleted = 0)

    Returns:
        Tuple of (join_clause, combined_where_expr_or_None).
        Parameters are embedded in grammar nodes via SqlParam.
    """
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.ddl.ddl_misc import SqlBooleanLiteral
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlJoin, SqlTableAlias
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp, JoinKind

    t_alias = SqlAliasName(data_table_alias)
    b_alias = SqlAliasName(branch_alias)

    if not issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
        msg = f"Cross-branch queries require versioned model, got {model_cls.__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    branch_table = get_table_name(domain.branch_model)

    # INNER JOIN branches b ON t.branch_id = b.sys_id
    join_clause = SqlJoin(
        JoinKind.INNER,
        SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(branch_table), alias=b_alias),
        condition=SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=t_alias),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=b_alias),
        ),
    )

    # Workspace filter: b.workspace_id = ?
    conditions: list[Any] = []
    workspace_id = getattr(branch_spec, "workspace_id", None)
    if workspace_id is not None:
        conditions.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("workspace_id"), qualifier=b_alias),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(workspace_id.unwrap_to_str()),
            ),
        )

    # Branch must not be deleted: b.sys_deleted = FALSE
    conditions.append(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=b_alias),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlBooleanLiteral(False),
        ),
    )

    permission_where = getattr(branch_spec, "permission_where_renderable", None)
    if permission_where is not None:
        conditions.append(permission_where)

    branch_filter = getattr(branch_spec, "branch_filter", None)
    if branch_filter is not None:
        from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.expression_grammar import ExpressionToGrammar

        branch_converter = ExpressionToGrammar(domain.branch_model, table_alias=branch_alias)
        conditions.append(branch_converter.convert(branch_filter))

    # User-level WHERE (deleted filter for sparse, user filters, etc.)
    user_where: Any = _build_cross_branch_where(
        model_cls,
        branch_spec,
        table_alias=data_table_alias,
    )
    if user_where is not None:
        conditions.append(user_where)

    # Combine all conditions
    combined: Any | None = None
    if conditions:
        combined = conditions[0]
        for cond in conditions[1:]:
            assert combined is not None
            combined = sql_and(combined, cond)

    return join_clause, combined


def _join_eq(
    left_table: SqlAliasName | SqlTableName,
    left_col: SqlColumnName,
    right_table: SqlAliasName | SqlTableName,
    right_col: SqlColumnName,
) -> SqlBinaryOp:
    """Create an equality condition for JOIN ON: left.col = right.col."""
    return SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(left_col, qualifier=left_table),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        SqlColumnRef(right_col, qualifier=right_table),
    )
