def _validate_cross_branch_pagination_ordering(
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
    branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
) -> tuple[DynamicFieldName, SqlColumnName, SqlOrderDirection]:
    """Return ``(python_field, db_column, direction)`` for canonical pagination."""
    if not branch_spec.order_by:
        msg = "keyset_paginate() requires at least one order_by() clause"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if len(branch_spec.order_by) > 1:
        msg = f"Cross-branch keyset_paginate() currently supports one order_by() clause, got {len(branch_spec.order_by)}"
        raise ValueError(msg)

    order_operand, direction = branch_spec.order_by[0]
    owner: type[DatabaseObjectRow] = model_cls
    if isinstance(order_operand, str):
        field_name = order_operand
    elif isinstance(order_operand, Field):
        field_name = order_operand.name
        owner_value = getattr(order_operand, "owner", None)
        if isinstance(owner_value, type) and issubclass(owner_value, DatabaseObjectRow):
            owner = owner_value
    elif order_operand.field is not None and order_operand.operator is None:
        field_name = order_operand.field
        owner_value = getattr(order_operand, "owner", None)
        if isinstance(owner_value, type) and issubclass(owner_value, DatabaseObjectRow):
            owner = owner_value
    else:
        msg = "Cross-branch keyset_paginate() requires ordering by a model field"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    search_score_columns = {"_fts_rank", "_vector_score", "_rrf_score"}
    order_db_col = SqlColumnName(
        field_name if field_name in search_score_columns else polymorphic_read_column_name(owner, field_name),
    )
    return DynamicFieldName(field_name), order_db_col, SqlOrderDirection(direction)


def _published_cross_branch_score_alias(order_db_col: str) -> str:
    alias_map = {
        "_fts_rank": "__fts_rank",
        "_vector_score": "__vector_score",
        "_rrf_score": "__rrf_score",
    }
    return alias_map.get(order_db_col, order_db_col)


def _cross_branch_page_output_columns(branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    columns = _cross_branch_data_output_columns(branch_spec)
    if branch_spec.search_op.vector_index_name and not branch_spec.search_op.rrf_enabled:
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*columns, "__vector_score", CROSS_BRANCH_BRANCH_ID_COLUMN, CROSS_BRANCH_REVISION_ID_COLUMN)))
    return columns


def _cross_branch_page_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...]) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    return SqlColumnTypeHints(
        bool_columns=frozenset({"__has_more"}),
        double_columns=frozenset({"__vector_score"}) & frozenset(columns),
        uuid_columns=frozenset({CROSS_BRANCH_BRANCH_ID_COLUMN, CROSS_BRANCH_REVISION_ID_COLUMN}) & frozenset(columns),
    )


def _cross_branch_vector_page_order(
    order_column: str,
    direction: str,
) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
    columns = [
        ("__vector_score", "DESC"),
        (order_column, direction),
        (CROSS_BRANCH_BRANCH_ID_COLUMN, "ASC"),
        ("sys_id", "ASC"),
        (CROSS_BRANCH_REVISION_ID_COLUMN, "ASC"),
    ]
    return tuple(columns)


def _cross_branch_page_order_items(
    ordering: Sequence[tuple[str, str]],
    alias: SqlAliasName,
    *,
    backward: bool,
) -> list[SqlOrderByItem]:
    items: list[SqlOrderByItem] = []
    for column, direction in ordering:
        effective = flip_direction(direction) if backward else direction
        items.append(
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=alias),
                OrderDirection.ASC if effective == "ASC" else OrderDirection.DESC,
                nulls=NullsOrder.FIRST if effective == "ASC" else NullsOrder.LAST,
            )
        )
    return items


def _cross_branch_page_seek(
    ordering: Sequence[tuple[str, str]],
    after: tuple[Any, ...],
    *,
    backward: bool,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if len(after) != len(ordering):
        raise ValueError("Continuation key does not match the complete cross-branch ordering")
    prefixes: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    alternatives: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for (column, direction), value in zip(ordering, after, strict=True):
        effective = flip_direction(direction) if backward else direction
        col = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=SqlAliasName("t"))
        if value is None:
            if effective == "ASC":
                alternatives.append(sql_and(*prefixes, SqlIsNull(col, negated=True)))
            prefixes.append(SqlIsNull(col))
            continue
        if hasattr(value, "unwrap_to_str"):
            value = value.unwrap_to_str()
        comparison: SqlRenderable = SqlBinaryOp(
            col,
            BinaryOp.GT if effective == "ASC" else BinaryOp.LT,
            SqlParam(value),
        )
        if effective == "DESC":
            comparison = SqlBinaryOp(comparison, BinaryOp.OR, SqlIsNull(col))
        alternatives.append(sql_and(*prefixes, comparison))
        prefixes.append(SqlBinaryOp(col, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(value)))
    result: SqlRenderable = SqlBinaryOp(SqlParam(1), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(0))
    for alternative in alternatives:
        result = SqlBinaryOp(result, BinaryOp.OR, alternative)
    return result


def _wrap_cross_branch_page_candidate(
    candidate: SqlRenderable,
    *,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
    order_column: str,
    identity_column: str,
    direction: str,
    backward: bool,
    limit: int,
    complete_order: Sequence[tuple[str, str]] | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Trim, orient, and annotate one SQL-owned page relation."""
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
        SqlFrom,
        SqlOrderByClause,
        SqlOrderByItem,
        SqlSelectAlias,
        SqlSelectList,
        SqlSubqueryTableRef,
        SqlWhereClause,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlFuncCall, SqlWindow
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam, SqlStar

    candidate_alias = SqlAliasName("page_candidate")
    ranked_alias = SqlAliasName("ranked_page")
    effective_direction = flip_direction(direction) if backward else direction
    effective_tree_direction = OrderDirection.ASC if effective_direction == "ASC" else OrderDirection.DESC
    final_tree_direction = OrderDirection.ASC if direction == "ASC" else OrderDirection.DESC
    effective_nulls = NullsOrder.FIRST if effective_direction == "ASC" else NullsOrder.LAST
    final_nulls = NullsOrder.FIRST if direction == "ASC" else NullsOrder.LAST
    ranked_order = [
        SqlOrderByItem(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(order_column), qualifier=candidate_alias),
            effective_tree_direction,
            nulls=effective_nulls,
        ),
        SqlOrderByItem(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(identity_column), qualifier=candidate_alias),
            effective_tree_direction,
        ),
    ]
    if complete_order is not None:
        ranked_order = _cross_branch_page_order_items(
            complete_order,
            candidate_alias,
            backward=backward,
        )
    ranked = SqlSelect(
        SqlSelectList(
            [
                *(
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=candidate_alias),
                        SqlAliasName(column),
                    )
                    for column in columns
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlWindow(SqlFuncCall("ROW_NUMBER", []), order_by=ranked_order),
                    SqlAliasName("__page_position"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlWindow(SqlFuncCall("COUNT", [SqlStar()])),
                    SqlAliasName("__candidate_count"),
                ),
            ],
        ),
        SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(candidate, SqlTableName(str(candidate_alias)))),
    )
    return SqlSelect(
        SqlSelectList(
            [
                *(
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=ranked_alias),
                        SqlAliasName(column),
                    )
                    for column in columns
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__candidate_count"), qualifier=ranked_alias),
                        BinaryOp.GT,
                        SqlParam(limit),
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName("__has_more"),
                ),
            ],
        ),
        SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(ranked, SqlTableName(str(ranked_alias)))),
        where=SqlWhereClause(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__page_position"), qualifier=ranked_alias),
                BinaryOp.LE,
                SqlParam(limit),
            ),
        ),
        order_by=SqlOrderByClause(
            _cross_branch_page_order_items(complete_order, ranked_alias, backward=False)
            if complete_order is not None
            else [
                SqlOrderByItem(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(order_column), qualifier=ranked_alias),
                    final_tree_direction,
                    nulls=final_nulls,
                ),
                SqlOrderByItem(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(identity_column), qualifier=ranked_alias),
                    final_tree_direction,
                ),
            ],
        ),
    )


def _compile_cross_branch_paginated_select(
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
    branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    limit: int,
    after: tuple[Any, ...] | None,
    backward: bool,
    fts_scores_cte_ref: str | None = None,
    vector_scores_cte_ref: str | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Compile canonical cross-branch keyset pagination SQL."""
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
        SqlFrom,
        SqlOrderByClause,
        SqlOrderByItem,
        SqlSelectList,
        SqlSubqueryTableRef,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef

    _, order_db_col, direction = _validate_cross_branch_pagination_ordering(model_cls, branch_spec)
    identity_db_col = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))
    page_columns = _cross_branch_page_output_columns(branch_spec)
    projected_columns = tuple(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier="t") for column in page_columns)
    builder = _CrossBranchSqlContext(branch_spec, ctx.sql_render_dialect())
    if branch_spec.search_op.rrf_enabled:
        published_order_db_col = _published_cross_branch_score_alias(order_db_col)
        inner_spec = replace(branch_spec, order_by=[], limit=None, offset=0)
        inner_builder = _CrossBranchSqlContext(inner_spec, ctx.sql_render_dialect())
        inner_stmt = inner_builder._hybrid_select_stmt(
            _resolve_cross_branch_fts_sql_components(
                inner_spec,
                fts_scores_cte_ref=fts_scores_cte_ref,
            ),
            _resolve_cross_branch_vector_sql_components(
                inner_spec,
                vector_scores_cte_ref=vector_scores_cte_ref,
            ),
            _build_cross_branch_rrf_config(inner_spec),
        )
        effective_direction = flip_direction(direction) if backward else direction
        tree_dir = OrderDirection.ASC if effective_direction == "ASC" else OrderDirection.DESC
        nulls = NullsOrder.FIRST if effective_direction == "ASC" else NullsOrder.LAST
        where_renderable = (
            builder._build_keyset_condition(
                "t",
                published_order_db_col,
                effective_direction,
                identity_db_col,
                after,
            )
            if after is not None
            else None
        )
        return _wrap_cross_branch_page_candidate(
            SqlSelect(
                SqlSelectList(projected_columns),
                SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(inner_stmt, SqlTableName("t"))),
                where=where_renderable,
                order_by=SqlOrderByClause(
                    [
                        SqlOrderByItem(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(published_order_db_col), qualifier=SqlAliasName("t")),
                            tree_dir,
                            nulls=nulls,
                        ),
                        SqlOrderByItem(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(identity_db_col), qualifier=SqlAliasName("t")),
                            tree_dir,
                        ),
                    ],
                ),
                limit=limit + 1,
            ),
            columns=page_columns,
            order_column=published_order_db_col,
            identity_column=identity_db_col,
            direction=direction,
            backward=backward,
            limit=limit,
        )
    if branch_spec.search_op.vector_index_name and branch_spec.search_op.vector_query_vec is not None:
        published_order_db_col = _published_cross_branch_score_alias(order_db_col)
        complete_order = _cross_branch_vector_page_order(published_order_db_col, direction)
        inner_spec = replace(branch_spec, limit=None, offset=0)
        inner_builder = _CrossBranchSqlContext(inner_spec, ctx.sql_render_dialect())
        inner_stmt = inner_builder._vector_select_stmt(
            _resolve_cross_branch_vector_sql_components(
                inner_spec,
                vector_scores_cte_ref=vector_scores_cte_ref,
            ),
            include_metadata=True,
        )
        where_renderable = _cross_branch_page_seek(complete_order, after, backward=backward) if after is not None else None
        return _wrap_cross_branch_page_candidate(
            SqlSelect(
                SqlSelectList(projected_columns),
                SqlFrom(SqlSubqueryTableRef(inner_stmt, SqlTableName("t"))),
                where=where_renderable,
                order_by=SqlOrderByClause(
                    _cross_branch_page_order_items(complete_order, SqlAliasName("t"), backward=backward),
                ),
                limit=limit + 1,
            ),
            columns=page_columns,
            order_column=published_order_db_col,
            identity_column=identity_db_col,
            direction=direction,
            backward=backward,
            limit=limit,
            complete_order=complete_order,
        )
    if branch_spec.search_op.fts_query:
        _check_cross_branch_compilable(
            branch_spec,
            has_fts_support=True,
        )
        published_order_db_col = _published_cross_branch_score_alias(order_db_col)
        return _wrap_cross_branch_page_candidate(
            builder._fts_keyset_select_stmt(
                _resolve_cross_branch_fts_sql_components(
                    branch_spec,
                    fts_scores_cte_ref=fts_scores_cte_ref,
                ),
                order_db_col=published_order_db_col,
                order_direction=direction,
                identity_db_col=identity_db_col,
                limit=limit,
                after=after,
                backward=backward,
            ),
            columns=page_columns,
            order_column=published_order_db_col,
            identity_column=identity_db_col,
            direction=direction,
            backward=backward,
            limit=limit,
        )
    _check_cross_branch_compilable(branch_spec, has_fts_support=False)
    return _wrap_cross_branch_page_candidate(
        builder._keyset_select_stmt(
            order_db_col=order_db_col,
            order_direction=direction,
            identity_db_col=identity_db_col,
            limit=limit,
            after=after,
            backward=backward,
        ),
        columns=page_columns,
        order_column=order_db_col,
        identity_column=identity_db_col,
        direction=direction,
        backward=backward,
        limit=limit,
    )


def _cross_branch_private_field_names(
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
) -> frozenset[str]:
    from l1000_schema.column_visibility import ColumnVisibility, get_field_visibility

    return frozenset(
        field_name
        for field_name in model_cls.model_fields
        if get_field_visibility(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) != ColumnVisibility.PUBLIC
    ) | frozenset(
        {
            VERSIONED_ROW_REVISION_ID_COLUMN,
            "sys_staged_commit_id",
            "sys_deleted",
            CROSS_BRANCH_REVISION_ID_COLUMN,
            CROSS_BRANCH_BRANCH_ID_COLUMN,
            CROSS_BRANCH_BRANCH_NAME_COLUMN,
        },
    )


def _cross_branch_scalar_references_private_fields(
    branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
) -> bool:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import _expression_references_any_field

    private_fields: frozenset[str] = _cross_branch_private_field_names(model_cls)
    if not private_fields:
        return False

    fts_columns: frozenset[str] = frozenset(branch_spec.search_op.fts_fields or ())
    if _cross_branch_fts_searches_only_private_fields(branch_spec, model_cls):
        return True
    if branch_spec.search_op.fts_query and not fts_columns:
        return True

    for filter_obj in getattr(branch_spec, "filters", ()) or ():
        expression = getattr(filter_obj, "expression", None)
        if expression is not None and _expression_references_any_field(expression, private_fields):
            return True
        column = getattr(filter_obj, "column", None)
        if column is not None and str(column) in private_fields:
            return True
        if _expression_references_any_field(filter_obj, private_fields):
            return True
    return False


def _cross_branch_fts_searches_only_private_fields(
    branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
) -> bool:
    if not branch_spec.search_op.fts_query:
        return False
    private_fields = _cross_branch_private_field_names(model_cls)
    if not private_fields:
        return False
    fts_columns: frozenset[str] = frozenset(branch_spec.search_op.fts_fields or ())
    if not fts_columns:
        return True
    return not fts_columns.isdisjoint(private_fields) and fts_columns.issubset(private_fields)


def _apply_cross_branch_permission_where(
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
    branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
    user_id_ref_id: str | None,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    attach_column_masking: bool = True,
    prefer_session_user_subquery: bool = False,
) -> CrossBranchQuerySpec:
    """Return a terminal-local spec with permission SQL attached when needed."""
    from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
        compile_permission_where_with_user_expr,
        compile_versioned_permission_where_with_user_expr,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import session_id_expr
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SQL_EXPR_NULL
    from l1300_session.session import SessionId
    from l2055_lazy_result.permission_state import coerce_permission_state
    from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import (
        _try_get_permission_scheme,
        get_query_permission_plan,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._permission_filter import get_column_masking_info

    permission_state = coerce_permission_state(getattr(branch_spec, "permission_state", "auto"))
    if permission_state == "bypass":
        return branch_spec
    if permission_state == "resolved":
        return branch_spec
    if permission_state == "attached" and getattr(branch_spec, "permission_predicate_attached", False):
        return branch_spec
    existing_permission_where = getattr(branch_spec, "permission_where_renderable", None)
    session_id = getattr(branch_spec, "session_id", None)
    skip_permission_filtering = bool(getattr(branch_spec, "skip_permission_filtering", False))
    if session_id is None or skip_permission_filtering:
        return branch_spec
    domain = _require_cross_branch_versioning_domain(
        branch_spec,
        site="_attach_cross_branch_permissions",
    )
    tips_only = bool(getattr(branch_spec, "tips_only", True))
    historical = not tips_only

    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_cls)
    typed_session_id = SessionId(session_id)
    has_bound_permission_context = branch_spec.permission_context_ref is not None and branch_spec.permission_context_type is not None
    branch_permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(domain.branch_model)
    revision_permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(domain.revision_model)
    model_permission_active = permission_plan is not None and (
        permission_plan.filters_session(typed_session_id) or has_bound_permission_context
    )
    branch_permission_active = branch_permission_plan is not None and (
        branch_permission_plan.filters_session(typed_session_id) or has_bound_permission_context
    )
    revision_permission_active = revision_permission_plan is not None and (
        revision_permission_plan.filters_session(typed_session_id) or has_bound_permission_context
    )
    if not model_permission_active and not branch_permission_active and not revision_permission_active:
        return branch_spec

    permission_ctx = replace(
        ctx,
        policy_authority_rejection=PolicyAuthorityRejection(
            "Cross-branch queries cannot use policy authority relations",
        ),
    )
    revision_permission_where: SqlRenderable | None = None
    if revision_permission_active:
        assert revision_permission_plan is not None
        if revision_permission_plan.requires_user_id:
            if user_id_ref_id is None and not prefer_session_user_subquery:
                return branch_spec
            revision_user_expr = _compile_cross_branch_user_id_expr(
                user_id_ref_id,
                permission_ctx,
                session_id=session_id,
                prefer_session_user_subquery=prefer_session_user_subquery,
            )
        else:
            revision_user_expr = SQL_EXPR_NULL
        revision_alias = SqlAliasName("r_permission")
        revision_predicate = compile_permission_where_with_user_expr(
            domain.revision_model,
            typed_session_id,
            revision_user_expr,
            table_alias=str(revision_alias),
            action="read",
            session_id_sql=session_id_expr(ctx.session_id, ctx),
            session_vars=_cross_branch_session_vars(branch_spec, ctx),
            compilation_context=permission_ctx,
        )
        if revision_predicate is not None:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.identifiers import SqlIntegerLiteral

            revision_permission_where = SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlIntegerLiteral(1),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(
                        SqlTableIdent(get_table_name(domain.revision_model)),
                        revision_alias,
                    ),
                    where=sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=revision_alias),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlColumnRef(
                                SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"),
                                qualifier=SqlAliasName("t"),
                            ),
                        ),
                        revision_predicate,
                    ),
                ),
            )

    if not model_permission_active:
        combined_permission_where = revision_permission_where
        if branch_permission_active:
            assert branch_permission_plan is not None
            if branch_permission_plan.requires_user_id:
                if user_id_ref_id is None and not prefer_session_user_subquery:
                    return branch_spec
                branch_user_expr = _compile_cross_branch_user_id_expr(
                    user_id_ref_id,
                    permission_ctx,
                    session_id=session_id,
                    prefer_session_user_subquery=prefer_session_user_subquery,
                )
            else:
                branch_user_expr = SQL_EXPR_NULL
            branch_permission_where = compile_permission_where_with_user_expr(
                domain.branch_model,
                typed_session_id,
                branch_user_expr,
                table_alias="b",
                action="read",
                session_id_sql=session_id_expr(ctx.session_id, ctx),
                session_vars=_cross_branch_session_vars(branch_spec, ctx),
                compilation_context=permission_ctx,
            )
            if branch_permission_where is not None:
                combined_permission_where = (
                    branch_permission_where
                    if combined_permission_where is None
                    else sql_and(combined_permission_where, branch_permission_where)
                )
        if existing_permission_where is not None:
            combined_permission_where = (
                existing_permission_where
                if combined_permission_where is None
                else sql_and(existing_permission_where, combined_permission_where)
            )
        if combined_permission_where is None:
            return branch_spec
        return replace(
            branch_spec,
            permission_where_renderable=combined_permission_where,
            permission_predicate_attached=True,
        )

    assert permission_plan is not None
    scheme = _try_get_permission_scheme(model_cls)
    if not permission_plan.requires_user_id:
        perm_where = compile_versioned_permission_where_with_user_expr(
            model_cls,
            typed_session_id,
            SQL_EXPR_NULL,
            table_alias="t",
            session_id_sql=session_id_expr(ctx.session_id, ctx),
            version_anchor=_cross_branch_permission_anchor(
                domain,
                table_alias="t",
                historical=historical,
            ),
            session_vars=_cross_branch_session_vars(branch_spec, ctx),
            compilation_context=replace(
                permission_ctx,
                versioning_domain=domain,
                query_versioned_scope=(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier="t"),
                    (SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"), qualifier="t") if historical else None),
                ),
            ),
        )
        column_masking: tuple[str, list[str]] | None = None
        masking_user_expr: SqlRenderable | None = None
    else:
        if user_id_ref_id is None and not prefer_session_user_subquery:
            return branch_spec
        tips_only = bool(getattr(branch_spec, "tips_only", True))
        historical = not tips_only or (tips_only and _cross_branch_effectively_tipless(branch_spec))
        masking_user_expr = _compile_cross_branch_user_id_expr(
            user_id_ref_id,
            permission_ctx,
            session_id=session_id,
            prefer_session_user_subquery=prefer_session_user_subquery,
        )
        perm_where = _compile_permission_where_for_cross_branch(
            model_cls,
            user_id_ref_id,
            "t",
            permission_ctx,
            session_id=session_id,
            historical=historical,
            domain=domain,

class CrossBranchCursorPaginateStep[T: VersionedObjectRow[SysId]](NonPublishingStep[Any]):
    """Canonical cursor pagination step for cross-branch queries."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[T],
        *,
        branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
        config: _CrossBranchTokenPaginateConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._branch_spec = branch_spec
        self._limit = config.limit
        self._after = config.after_token
        self._before = config.before_token

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 2

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "cross_branch", "cursor_paginate"})

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({get_table_name(self._model_cls)})

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _cross_branch_query_spec_deps(self._branch_spec)

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep]:
        from impl.common.l2080_cursor_pagination import decode_cursor, resolve_pagination_direction

        if self._limit < 1:
            msg = "limit must be positive"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        branch_spec = _catalog_scoped_branch_spec(self._branch_spec, ctx)
        order_python_name, order_db_col, direction = _validate_cross_branch_pagination_ordering(
            self._model_cls,
            branch_spec,
        )
        cursor_token, backward = resolve_pagination_direction(
            self._after,
            self._before,
            method_name=ConnectionMethodName("cursor_paginate"),
        )
        ordering_columns: list[_OrderingColumn] = (
            list(_cross_branch_vector_page_order(_published_cross_branch_score_alias(order_db_col), direction))
            if branch_spec.search_op.vector_index_name and not branch_spec.search_op.rrf_enabled
            else [(str(order_db_col), str(direction))]
        )
        cursor_ordering = ordering_columns[:-1] if len(ordering_columns) > 1 else ordering_columns
        composite_after = decode_cursor(cursor_token, cursor_ordering) if cursor_token is not None else None
        branch_steps, prereq_refs = _lower_with_search_component_prereqs(
            self.ref_id,
            self._model_cls,
            branch_spec,
            ctx,
        )
        preceding, uid_ref = _lower_terminal_session_user_id(
            ref_id=self.ref_id,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            branch_spec=branch_spec,
            prereq_refs=prereq_refs,
            ctx=ctx,
        )
        raw_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw_rows")
        raw_step = _TerminalCrossBranchCursorPaginateStep(
            raw_ref,
            self._model_cls,
            branch_spec,
            paginate_config=_TerminalCrossBranchCursorPaginateConfig(
                limit=self._limit,
                after=composite_after,
                backward=backward,
            ),
            refs=_CrossBranchTerminalRefs(
                user_id_ref_id=uid_ref,
                fts_ref_id=prereq_refs.fts_ref_id,
                vector_ref_id=prereq_refs.vector_ref_id,
                vector_branch_ids_ref_id=prereq_refs.vector_branch_ids_ref_id,
            ),
        )
        return [
            *branch_steps,
            *preceding,
            raw_step,
            _HydrateCrossBranchRowsStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.hydrated_rows"),
                source_ref_id=raw_ref,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                select_fields=branch_spec.select_fields,
            ),
            _BuildCrossBranchCursorPageStep(
                self.ref_id,
                source_ref_id=raw_ref,
                config=_CrossBranchCursorPageConfig(
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    select_fields=branch_spec.select_fields,
                    limit=self._limit,
                    order_python_name=order_python_name,
                    ordering_columns=ordering_columns,
                    backward=backward,
                ),
            ),
        ]

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[Any]:
        del ctx
        raise TypeError(
            f"{type(self).__name__} is level {self.level} and must be lowered to terminal steps before compile() is called.",
        )

class CrossBranchRowsScalarStep[T: VersionedObjectRow[SysId]](NonPublishingStep[T | None]):
    """Project a scalar row result from an already plan-backed row sequence."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        rows_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        config: _CrossBranchRowsScalarConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._rows_ref_id = rows_ref_id
        self._mode = config.mode
        self._model_name = config.model_name

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "cross_branch", "rows_scalar", "runtime_projection", "terminal_projection"})

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def emits_sql_for_accounting(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._rows_ref_id})

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[T | None]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: TerminalResolvedValues) -> T | None:
        rows = cast("Sequence[T]", _coerce_runtime_sequence(resolved[self._rows_ref_id]))
        while (
            len(rows) == 1
            and isinstance(rows[0], Sequence)
            and not isinstance(rows[0], VersionedObjectRow | Mapping | str | bytes | bytearray)
        ):
            rows = cast("Sequence[T]", _coerce_runtime_sequence(rows[0]))
        if self._mode == "first_or_none":
            return rows[0] if rows else None
        if self._mode == "one_or_none":
            if len(rows) > 1:
                msg = "Expected at most one result, got more than one"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            return rows[0] if rows else None
        if not rows:
            msg = f"Expected exactly one {self._model_name} result, got zero"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if len(rows) > 1:
            msg = f"Multiple {self._model_name} rows found in cross-branch query"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return rows[0]

class _TerminalCrossBranchWithMetaStep[T: VersionedObjectRow[SysId]](
    SqlRelationPublisherStep[list[dict[str, Any]]],
):
    """Level-0 with-meta step with permission WHERE compiled symbolically."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[T],
        branch_spec: CrossBranchQuerySpec,
        *,
        refs: _CrossBranchTerminalRefs | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        resolved_refs = refs or _CrossBranchTerminalRefs()
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._branch_spec = branch_spec
        self._user_id_ref_id = resolved_refs.user_id_ref_id
        self._fts_ref_id = resolved_refs.fts_ref_id
        self._vector_ref_id = resolved_refs.vector_ref_id
        self._vector_branch_ids_ref_id = resolved_refs.vector_branch_ids_ref_id

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "cross_branch", "execute_with_meta", "query"})

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({get_table_name(self._model_cls)})

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps: set[str] = set(_cross_branch_query_spec_deps(self._branch_spec))
        if self._user_id_ref_id is not None:
            deps.add(self._user_id_ref_id)
        if self._fts_ref_id is not None:
            deps.add(self._fts_ref_id)
        if self._vector_ref_id is not None:
            deps.add(self._vector_ref_id)
        if self._vector_branch_ids_ref_id is not None:
            deps.add(self._vector_branch_ids_ref_id)
        return frozenset(deps)

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _TerminalCrossBranchWithMetaStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                (
                    *_cross_branch_data_output_columns(self._branch_spec),
                    *_cross_branch_score_support_columns(
                        branch_spec=self._branch_spec,
                        fts_ref_id=self._fts_ref_id,
                        vector_ref_id=self._vector_ref_id,
                    ),
                    CROSS_BRANCH_BRANCH_ID_COLUMN,
                    CROSS_BRANCH_BRANCH_NAME_COLUMN,
                    CROSS_BRANCH_REVISION_ID_COLUMN,
                ),
            ),
        )

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...]) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            data_columns = _cross_branch_data_output_columns(self._branch_spec)
            model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, data_columns)
            if model_hints is None:
                msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._model_cls.__name__} cross-branch output"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            meta_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
                uuid_columns=frozenset(
                    {
                        CROSS_BRANCH_BRANCH_ID_COLUMN,
                        CROSS_BRANCH_REVISION_ID_COLUMN,
                    },
                ),
                text_columns=frozenset({CROSS_BRANCH_BRANCH_NAME_COLUMN}),
                double_columns=frozenset(
                    _cross_branch_score_support_columns(
                        branch_spec=self._branch_spec,
                        fts_ref_id=self._fts_ref_id,
                        vector_ref_id=self._vector_ref_id,
                    ),
                ),
            )
            combined_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(columns, model_hints, meta_hints)
            if combined_hints is None:
                msg = f"Could not combine SQL column type hints for {self._model_cls.__name__} cross-branch output"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return combined_hints

        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        from l2070_batching.step import cte_projection_row_model

        _contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints,
        )
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(
        self,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        _warn_missing_cross_branch_index_for_step(self, self._model_cls, self._branch_spec)
        prepared_spec = _prepare_cross_branch_terminal_spec(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            branch_spec=self._branch_spec,
            ctx=ctx,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
            prefer_session_user_subquery=self._user_id_ref_id is None,
        )
        sql_ir = _compile_cross_branch_select_with_meta(
            self._model_cls,
            prepared_spec,
            ctx,
            fts_scores_cte_ref=_lookup_cross_branch_fts_scores_cte_ref(
                self._fts_ref_id,
                ctx,
            ),
            vector_scores_cte_ref=_lookup_cross_branch_vector_scores_cte_ref(
                self._vector_ref_id,
                ctx,
            ),
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioning_intent_steps import (
            _collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes,
        )

        return _compiled_step_from_sql_ir(
            sql_ir,
            publication_contract=self.cte_publication_contract(),
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            auxiliary_ctes=_collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, *self.dependencies()),
        )

def test_commit_metadata_skips_unmarked_auxiliary_physical_names() -> None:
    @register_table(plural="phase2_semantic_sequence_widgets", singular="phase2_semantic_sequence_widget")
    class _SemanticSequenceWidget(VersionedObjectRow[SysId]):
        name: str = Field(default="")

    @register_table(
        plural="phase2_semantic_sequence_widgets_sparse",
        singular="phase2_semantic_sequence_widget_sparse",
    )
    class _SemanticSequenceWidgetSparse(DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]):
        name: str = Field(default="")
        branch_ord: int = Field(default=0)
        sys_valid_from_seq: int = Field(default=0)
        sys_valid_to_seq: int | None = Field(default=None)

    @register_table(
        plural="phase2_semantic_sequence_widgets_tip",
        singular="phase2_semantic_sequence_widget_tip",
    )
    class _SemanticSequenceWidgetTip(DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]):
        name: str = Field(default="")
        branch_ord: int = Field(default=0)
        sys_revision_seq: int = Field(default=0)

    assert not _is_framework_physical_data_column(_SemanticSequenceWidgetSparse, SqlColumnName("branch_ord"))
    assert not _is_framework_physical_data_column(None, SqlColumnName("branch_ord"))

    del _SemanticSequenceWidgetSparse, _SemanticSequenceWidgetTip

    class _SemanticSequenceDomain(DefaultDomain):
        name = "phase2_semantic_sequence_unit"

        @classmethod
        def all_versioned_models(cls) -> list[type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]]]:
            del cls
            return [_SemanticSequenceWidget]

    table_entries, _edge_tables, _symmetric_entries = _commit_branch_domain_metadata(
        _SemanticSequenceDomain,
    )

    entry_by_table = {table_name: (sparse_cols, tip_cols) for table_name, _models, sparse_cols, tip_cols in table_entries}
    sparse_cols, tip_cols = entry_by_table["phase2_semantic_sequence_widgets"]

    assert "name" in sparse_cols
    assert "name" in tip_cols
    assert "branch_ord" not in sparse_cols
    assert "sys_valid_from_seq" not in sparse_cols
    assert "sys_valid_to_seq" not in sparse_cols
    assert "branch_ord" not in tip_cols
    assert "sys_revision_seq" not in tip_cols

def test_commit_branch_uses_sparse_dangling_authority_for_tree_graph(
    backend_type: BackendType,
) -> None:
    suffix = backend_type.value

    @register_table(plural=f"commit_aux_order_{suffix}_nodes", singular=f"commit_aux_order_{suffix}_node")

        @classmethod

            return [_CommitAuxOrderNode, _CommitAuxOrderEdge]

    intent = make_commit_branch_intent(
        ServerPlanRefId("commit_aux_order"),
        domain=_CommitAuxOrderDomain,
        branch_id=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchId.new()),
        session_id=ServerRefs.scalar(SessionId.schema()),
        allow_empty=True,
        revision_metadata=_test_revision_metadata(),
        scope_kind="branch_scoped",
    )

    lowering_ctx = make_lowering_context(
        make_backend_profile(backend_type),
        is_versioned=True,
        branch_table="sys_branches",
        branch_id=BranchId.new().unwrap_to_str(),
    )
    lowered = list(intent.lower(lowering_ctx))
    visible_aux_steps = [
        step
        for step in lowered
        if isinstance(step, _GraphAuxiliarySqlStep)
        and step._grammar_factory.kind in {"delete_visible_affected_nodes", "insert_visible_from_tip_affected_nodes"}
    ]
    validation_index = next(index for index, step in enumerate(lowered) if isinstance(step, ValidateEdgeConstraintsIntent))
    validation_step = cast(ValidateEdgeConstraintsIntent, lowered[validation_index])
    fully_lowered = _fully_lower(lowered, lowering_ctx)

    assert len(visible_aux_steps) >= 1
    assert any(isinstance(step, ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep) for step in lowered)
    assert max(lowered.index(step) for step in visible_aux_steps) < validation_index
    validation_deps = validation_step.dependencies()
    assert "commit_aux_order_update_tip" in validation_deps
    lowered_by_ref = {str(step.ref_id): step for step in lowered}
    validation_closure = _dependency_closure(str(validation_step.ref_id), lowered_by_ref)
    assert any(str(step.ref_id) in validation_closure for step in visible_aux_steps)
    assert validation_step.dangling_validation_authority == "branch_tip"
    assert not any(isinstance(step, CheckDanglingEdgesBatchStep) for step in fully_lowered)
    tip_dangling_step = next(step for step in fully_lowered if isinstance(step, CheckBranchTipDanglingEdgesBatchStep))
    assert tip_dangling_step.requires_prior_statement_visibility_after_writes() == frozenset(
        {
            f"commit_aux_order_{suffix}_edges_tip",
            f"commit_aux_order_{suffix}_edges_sparse",
            f"commit_aux_order_{suffix}_edges_staged",
            f"commit_aux_order_{suffix}_nodes_staged",
            SqlTableName(f"phase2_commit_aux_order_{suffix}_domain_staged_commits"),
            GRAPH_VISIBLE_NODES_TIP_TABLE,
            SqlTableName(f"phase2_commit_aux_order_{suffix}_domain_branches"),
            "sys_revision_parents",
            "sys_branch_physical_keys",
            "sys_graph_node_physical_keys",
        },
    )

    if backend_type == BackendType.POSTGRES:
        optimized = optimize_steps_with_group_check(
            fully_lowered,
            ctx=make_optimization_context(
                profile=make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES),
                is_write_transaction=True,
                is_versioned=True,
                branch_id=lowering_ctx.branch_id,
            ),
        )
        for optimized_step in optimized:
            if not isinstance(optimized_step, PhysicalStatementGroup):
                continue
            assert not (
                any(isinstance(child, UpsertTipFromStagedStep) for child in optimized_step.children)
                and any(isinstance(child, CheckBranchTipDanglingEdgesBatchStep) for child in optimized_step.children)
            )

    @register_table(edge_constraints=EdgeConstraints(tree_mode=True))
    class _AliasCollisionRightEdge(_AliasCollisionEdge):
        pass

    class _AliasCollisionDomain(DefaultDomain):
        name = "phase2_poly_tree_alias_collision_domain"

        @classmethod
        def all_versioned_models(cls) -> list[type]:
            return [

                _AliasCollisionEdge,
                _AliasCollisionLeftEdge,
                _AliasCollisionRightEdge,
            ]

            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="PreviousTreeEdge.*identifies both"):
                list(commit_intent.lower(_lowering_ctx()))

    finally:

def _assert_step_types_in_order(
    steps: Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
    expected_types: Sequence[type[ServerPlanStep[Any]]],
) -> None:
    actual_types = [type(step) for step in steps]
    search_from = 0
    for expected_type in expected_types:
        for idx in range(search_from, len(actual_types)):
            if actual_types[idx] is expected_type:
                search_from = idx + 1
                break
        else:
            msg = f"{expected_type.__name__} not found in order in {actual_types!r}"
            raise AssertionError(msg)

def test_chunked_delta_insert_preserves_semantic_sequence_collection_until_physical_lowering(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(insert_many_raw, "_rows_per_statement", lambda *_args, **_kwargs: 2)
    instances = tuple(_Phase2Widget(sys_id=SysId.new(), name=f"created-{idx}") for idx in range(3))
    config = replace(
        _shape_upsert_many_intent_config(
            _Phase2Widget,
            ("sys_id",),
            None,
            instances,
            do_nothing_inserted_only=True,
        ),
        prepared_delta_insert=_PreparedDeltaInsertIfAbsent(
            supplemental_write_values=((), (), ()),
            authored_return_assignments=((), (), ()),
        ),
    )
    intent = UpsertManyIntent(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_1"),
        _Phase2Widget,
        ServerRefs.object_sequence(list(instances)),
        config=ServerRefs.scalar(config),
    )
    sqlite_ctx = make_lowering_context(
        make_backend_profile(BackendType.SQLITE),
        session_id=SessionId.system(),
    )
    postgres_ctx = make_lowering_context(
        make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES),
        session_id=SessionId.system(),
    )

    sqlite_lowered = list(intent.lower(sqlite_ctx))
    postgres_lowered = list(intent.lower(postgres_ctx))

    sqlite_collector = next(step for step in sqlite_lowered if isinstance(step, FlattenResultSequencesStep))
    postgres_collector = next(step for step in postgres_lowered if isinstance(step, FlattenResultSequencesStep))
    expected_dependencies = frozenset({"step_1.upsert_chunk_0", "step_1.upsert_chunk_1"})
    assert sqlite_collector.dependencies() == expected_dependencies
    assert postgres_collector.dependencies() == expected_dependencies
    transport = sqlite_collector.planning_contract().result_transport
    assert transport.kind is ResultTransportKind.COLLECT_VALUES
    assert transport.cardinality is Cardinality.MANY
    assert transport.collection_source_refs == tuple(sqlite_collector.source_refs)
    assert transport.collection_flatten is True
    assert transport.collection_model_cls is _Phase2Widget

    executor = object.__new__(SqlBackendExecutor)
    sqlite_physical = executor.lower_step(sqlite_collector, sqlite_ctx)
    postgres_physical = executor.lower_step(postgres_collector, postgres_ctx)

    assert len(sqlite_physical) == 1
    assert isinstance(sqlite_physical[0], MaterializedFlattenSequenceResultsAfterDepsStep)
    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="was not materialized"):
        sqlite_physical[0].execute_runtime({})
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="must be a sequence"):
        sqlite_physical[0].execute_runtime({str(sqlite_collector.source_refs[0]): instances[0]})
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="item 0 must be _Phase2Widget"):
        sqlite_physical[0].execute_runtime({str(sqlite_collector.source_refs[0]): [SimpleNamespace()]})
    materialized_sources = {str(source_ref): [instances[index]] for index, source_ref in enumerate(sqlite_collector.source_refs)}
    assert sqlite_physical[0].execute_runtime(materialized_sources) == list(instances[:2])
    assert len(postgres_physical) == 1
    assert isinstance(postgres_physical[0], FlattenResultsStep)

    unsupported_base = make_backend_profile(BackendType.SQLITE)
    unsupported_profile = replace(
        unsupported_base,
        traits=replace(
            unsupported_base.traits,
            same_plan_write_transport=SamePlanWriteTransport.NONE,
        ),
    )
    unsupported_ctx = make_lowering_context(unsupported_profile)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="requires DATA_MODIFYING_CTE or ORDERED_STATEMENTS"):
        executor.lower_step(sqlite_collector, unsupported_ctx)

def test_json_aggregation_promoted_recursive_auxiliary_uses_recursive_with_tdd_red() -> None:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.codegen.json_aggregation import JsonAggregationCodegen
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.base import render_to_sql
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectList
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from l2070_batching.output_shape import CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, synthetic_output_field

    class _JsonAggregationReadStep(NonPublishingStep[Any]):
        _model_cls = _Phase2Widget

        def __init__(self, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId, *, deps: frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> None:
            super().__init__(ref_id)
            self._deps = deps

        @property
        def level(self) -> int:
            return 0

        def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
            return frozenset({"read"})

        def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
            return True

        def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
            return StepExecutionRole.SQL

        def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
            return True

        def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
            return Cardinality.MANY

        def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
            return frozenset({"phase2_widgets"})

        def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
            return frozenset()

        def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
            return self._deps

        def compile(self, ctx: Any) -> Any:
            del ctx
            output_columns = ("sys_id", "sys_created_at", "sys_updated_at", "name")
            output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in output_columns))
            return CompiledStep(
                grammar=SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_created_at")),
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_updated_at")),
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("name")),
                        ],
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableName("phase2_widgets"),
                ),
                needs_returning=True,
                output_shape=output_shape,
                result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
                column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                    uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"}),
                    timestamptz_columns=frozenset({"sys_created_at", "sys_updated_at"}),
                    text_columns=frozenset({"name"}),
                ),
            )

    ctx = make_compilation_context(make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES))
    cte_name = ServerPlanRefId("_visible_ancestors")
    ctx.cte_refs["visible_source"] = CteReference(
        ServerPlanRefId(cte_name),
        auxiliary_query=lower_revision_ancestry_cte(
            revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
            seed=RevisionId("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"),
            cte_name=SqlCteName(cte_name),
        ),
        columns=("rev_id", "depth"),
        column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=frozenset({"rev_id"}), integer_columns=frozenset({"depth"})),
        recursive=True,
    )

    ir = JsonAggregationCodegen().compile_batch(
        (
            _JsonAggregationReadStep(ServerPlanRefId("read_with_aux"), deps=frozenset({"visible_source"})),
            _JsonAggregationReadStep(ServerPlanRefId("read_without_aux")),
        ),
        ctx,
    )
    sql, _params = render_to_sql(ir.grammar, PostgresDialect())

    assert sql.startswith("WITH RECURSIVE")
    assert '"_visible_ancestors" AS' in sql

def test_commit_branch_fetch_steps_publish_fetch_result_contract() -> None:
    def declared_hint_columns(hints: Any) -> frozenset[str]:
        return (
            hints.uuid_columns
            | hints.text_columns
            | hints.integer_columns
            | hints.bigint_columns
            | hints.bool_columns
            | hints.jsonb_columns
            | hints.timestamptz_columns
            | hints.date_columns
            | hints.double_columns
            | hints.bytea_columns
        )

    branch_ref = ServerRefs.scalar(BranchId.new())
    options = _FetchBranchOptions(use_for_update=True, allow_empty=True)
    tip_step = FetchBranchTipStep(ServerPlanRefId("fetch_tip"), DefaultDomain, branch_ref, options)
    staged_step = FetchBranchAndStagedBranchScopedStep(ServerPlanRefId("fetch_staged"), DefaultDomain, branch_ref, options)
    connection_step = FetchBranchAndStagedConnectionScopedStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("fetch_connection_staged"),
        DefaultDomain,
        branch_ref,
        ServerRefs.scalar(ConnectionId("conn_1")),
        options,
    )

    tip_contract = _require_publication_contract(tip_step)
    staged_contract = _require_publication_contract(staged_step)
    connection_contract = _require_publication_contract(connection_step)
    tip_hints = tip_contract.column_type_hints
    staged_hints = staged_contract.column_type_hints
    connection_hints = connection_contract.column_type_hints
    assert {"branch_id", "current_tip_revision_id"}.issubset(tip_contract.columns)
    assert tip_hints.uuid_columns == frozenset({"branch_id", "current_tip_revision_id"})
    assert "_branch_tip" in staged_hints.uuid_columns
    raw_staged_hints = sql_column_type_hints_for_published_rows(
        columns=staged_contract.columns,
        rows=[],
        declared_hints=(staged_hints,),
        require_complete=False,
    )
    raw_connection_hints = sql_column_type_hints_for_published_rows(
        columns=connection_contract.columns,
        rows=[],
        declared_hints=(connection_hints,),
        require_complete=False,
    )
    raw_staged_hints.require_complete(staged_contract.columns)
    raw_connection_hints.require_complete(connection_contract.columns)
    assert declared_hint_columns(raw_staged_hints).issubset(frozenset(staged_contract.columns))
    assert declared_hint_columns(raw_connection_hints).issubset(frozenset(connection_contract.columns))

    runtime_fetch_columns = ("current_tip_revision_id",)
    runtime_hints = sql_column_type_hints_for_published_rows(
        columns=runtime_fetch_columns,
        rows=[{"current_tip_revision_id": RevisionId.new()}],
        declared_hints=(connection_contract.column_type_hints,),
        require_complete=False,
    )
    runtime_hints.require_complete(runtime_fetch_columns)
    assert runtime_hints.uuid_columns == frozenset({"current_tip_revision_id"})
    assert runtime_hints.jsonb_columns == frozenset()

    binding_spec = _batch_binding_spec_for_step(connection_step)
    assert binding_spec.column_type_hints is not None
    binding_spec.column_type_hints.require_complete(connection_contract.columns)
    assert binding_spec.column_type_hints == connection_contract.column_type_hints

class _FakeVersionedWriteTxn:
    def __init__(self: _FakeVersionedWriteTxn) -> None:
        self._base_txn = object()
        self._owns_base_txn = False

    @property
    def base_write_transaction(self: _FakeVersionedWriteTxn) -> object:
        return self._base_txn

    @property
    def owns_base_transaction(self: _FakeVersionedWriteTxn) -> bool:
        return self._owns_base_txn


class _SealAfterInitVersionedWriteTxn:
    def __init__(self: _SealAfterInitVersionedWriteTxn) -> None:
        self._sealed = False
        self._base_txn_obj = object()
        self._base_txn_reads = 0
        self._owns_base_txn_reads = 0

    def seal(self: _SealAfterInitVersionedWriteTxn) -> None:
        self._sealed = True

    @property
    def base_write_transaction(self: _SealAfterInitVersionedWriteTxn) -> object:
        self._base_txn_reads += 1
        if self._sealed:
            raise AssertionError("CommitBranchIntent.lower() re-read base_write_transaction")
        return self._base_txn_obj

    @property
    def owns_base_transaction(self: _SealAfterInitVersionedWriteTxn) -> bool:
        self._owns_base_txn_reads += 1
        if self._sealed:
            raise AssertionError("CommitBranchIntent.lower() re-read owns_base_transaction")
        return False

        fully_lowered,
        ctx=make_optimization_context(
            profile=make_backend_profile(BackendType.SQLITE),
        ),

def _dependency_closure(
    ref_id: str,
    by_ref: dict[str, ServerPlanStep[Any]],
) -> set[str]:
    closure: set[str] = set()
    pending = list(by_ref[ref_id].dependencies())
    while pending:
        dependency = str(pending.pop())
        if dependency in closure:
            continue
        closure.add(dependency)
        dependency_step = by_ref.get(dependency)
        if dependency_step is not None:
            pending.extend(str(dep) for dep in dependency_step.dependencies())
    return closure

    unlocked_steps = [
        FetchBranchAndStagedBranchScopedStep(

            unlocked,

        FetchBranchAndStagedBranchScopedWithExpectedTipStep(

            branch_id,
            unlocked,
            expected_tip,
        ),
        FetchBranchAndStagedConnectionScopedStep(
            ServerPlanRefId("connection_unlocked"),
            DefaultDomain,
            branch_id,
            connection_id,
            unlocked,
        ),
        FetchBranchAndStagedConnectionScopedWithExpectedTipStep(
            ServerPlanRefId("connection_tip_unlocked"),
            DefaultDomain,
            branch_id,
            connection_id,
            unlocked,
            expected_tip,
        ),
    ]
    locked_steps = [
        FetchBranchAndStagedBranchScopedStep(
            ServerPlanRefId("branch_locked"),
            DefaultDomain,
            branch_id,
            locked,
        ),
        FetchBranchAndStagedBranchScopedWithExpectedTipStep(

        ),
        FetchBranchAndStagedConnectionScopedStep(

            DefaultDomain,
            branch_id,
            connection_id,

def _fully_lower(
    steps: Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]] | SubPlan,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Recursively lower all intents (level > 0) to level-0 steps."""
    result: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    for step in steps:
        if isinstance(step, ConditionalStep):
            result.append(step)
            result.extend(_fully_lower(step.then_plan, ctx))
            result.extend(_fully_lower(step.else_plan, ctx))
        elif step.level > 0:
            children = list(step.lower(ctx))
            result.extend(_fully_lower(children, ctx))
        else:
            result.append(step)
    return result

def test_tipless_resolve_or_create_branch_reuses_model_column_cache(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    versioning_intent_steps_module._MODEL_DB_COLUMNS_CACHE.clear()
    versioning_intent_steps_module._MODEL_DB_COLUMN_MAP_CACHE.clear()
    versioning_intent_steps_module._REQUIRED_CONTRACT_COLUMN_TYPE_HINTS_CACHE.clear()

    calls: list[tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]], str]] = []
    original = versioning_intent_steps_module.get_db_column_name

    def counting_get_db_column_name(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]], field_name: DynamicFieldName) -> str:
        calls.append((model_cls, field_name))
        return original(model_cls, field_name)

    monkeypatch.setattr(versioning_intent_steps_module, "get_db_column_name", counting_get_db_column_name)
    intent = ResolveOrCreateSeededBranchIntent(
        ServerPlanRefId("resolve_or_create"),
        domain=_Phase2SeedBranchDomain,
        branch_name=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchName("feature/test")),
        workspace_id=ServerRefs.scalar(WorkspaceId.default()),

        tip_materialization=cast(Any, BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS),
        branchpoint_materialization=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchPointMaterialization.INHERITED),
    )
    lowered = list(intent.lower(_lowering_ctx()))
    hot_steps = [step for step in lowered if isinstance(step, _FetchBranchByNameStep | InsertBranchRowStep)]
    assert hot_steps

    for step in hot_steps:
        step.cte_publication_contract()
        step.compile(_ctx())
    calls_after_first_compile = list(calls)

    for step in hot_steps:
        step.cte_publication_contract()
        step.compile(_ctx())

    assert calls == calls_after_first_compile

def test_lower_all_populates_sql_visible_dotted_dependency_demands_for_versioned_reads() -> None:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_query_steps import VersionedQueryFromSpecStep

    class _LowerOnlyBackend:
        def lower_step(self, step: ServerPlanStep[Any], ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
            return step.lower(ctx)

    class _DottedSqlConsumer(ServerPlanStep[None]):
        @property
        def level(self) -> int:
            return 0

        def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> Any:
            del ctx
            raise AssertionError("compile is not needed for lowering-policy tests")

        def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
            return Cardinality.NONE

        def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
            return True

        def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
            return StepExecutionRole.SQL

        def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
            return frozenset({"bounded_rows.name"})

        def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
            return True

        def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
            return frozenset({"phase2_widgets"})

        def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
            return frozenset()

        def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
            return frozenset({"query"})

    intent = QueryExecuteIntent(
        ServerPlanRefId("bounded_rows"),
        _Phase2Widget,
        _QueryExecuteConfig(query_spec=_bounded_versioned_query_spec()),
    )
    lowered = lower_all(
        [intent, _DottedSqlConsumer("consumer")],
        _lowering_ctx(branch_id=BranchId.new().unwrap_to_str()),
        backend=cast(Any, _LowerOnlyBackend()),
    )

    assert any(
        isinstance(step, VersionedQueryFromSpecStep)
        and str(step.ref_id) == "bounded_rows"
        and "name" in step.cte_publication_contract().columns
        for step in lowered
    )
    assert not any(isinstance(step, MaterializeResolvedModelSequenceStep) for step in lowered)

def test_deleted_node_validation_ignores_unrelated_graph_edge_tables() -> None:
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import Column, NO_FOREIGN_KEY
    from l9600_graphs.graph import NodeId
    from l9600_graphs.graph_definition import GraphDefinition

    class _AffectedGraph(Graph):
        class SqlTable:
            plural = "affected_graphs"
            singular = "affected_graph"

    @register_table(plural="affected_nodes", singular="affected_node")
    class _AffectedNode(GraphNode, enforce_single_table=False):
        pass

    @register_table(
        plural="affected_edges",
        singular="affected_edge",
        edge_constraints=EdgeConstraints(allow_dangling=False),
    )
    class _AffectedEdge(GraphEdge, enforce_single_table=False):
        source_sys_id: NodeId[Any] = Column(foreign_key=NO_FOREIGN_KEY)
        target_sys_id: NodeId[Any] = Column(foreign_key=NO_FOREIGN_KEY)

    class _UnrelatedGraph(Graph):
        class SqlTable:
            plural = "unrelated_graphs"
            singular = "unrelated_graph"

    @register_table(plural="unrelated_nodes", singular="unrelated_node")
    class _UnrelatedNode(GraphNode, enforce_single_table=False):
        pass

    @register_table(
        plural="unrelated_edges",
        singular="unrelated_edge",
        edge_constraints=EdgeConstraints(allow_dangling=False),
    )
    class _UnrelatedEdge(GraphEdge, enforce_single_table=False):
        source_sys_id: NodeId[Any] = Column(foreign_key=NO_FOREIGN_KEY)
        target_sys_id: NodeId[Any] = Column(foreign_key=NO_FOREIGN_KEY)

    class _DisjointGraphDomain(DefaultDomain):
        name = "disjoint_graph_edge_validation_test"
        graphs = [
            GraphDefinition(
                graph_type=_AffectedGraph,
                node_types=[_AffectedNode],
                edge_types=[_AffectedEdge],
            ),
            GraphDefinition(
                graph_type=_UnrelatedGraph,
                node_types=[_UnrelatedNode],
                edge_types=[_UnrelatedEdge],
            ),
        ]

        @classmethod
        def all_versioned_models(cls) -> list[type]:
            return [
                _AffectedGraph,
                _AffectedNode,
                _AffectedEdge,
                _UnrelatedGraph,
                _UnrelatedNode,
                _UnrelatedEdge,
            ]

    intent = ValidateEdgeConstraintsIntent(
        ServerPlanRefId("deleted_node_validation"),
        config=_ValidateEdgeConstraintsConfig(
            domain=_DisjointGraphDomain,
            lazy_branch=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchId.new()),
            new_revision_id=RevisionId.new(),

def _apply_trust_for_lowering[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    ctx: LoweringContext | CompilationContext,
    model_cls: type[T],
    instance: T,
) -> T:
    """Apply trust rules without substituting an unresolved identifier for an actor."""
    from l4500_trust.trust_registry import (
        inject_trust_defaults,
        inject_trust_defaults_for_authenticated_actor,
    )

    if ctx.session_id is None:
        return instance
    if isinstance(ctx.session_id, SessionId):
        return inject_trust_defaults(model_cls, instance, ctx.session_id)
    if isinstance(ctx.session_id, ScalarServerRef) or session_sql_source_or_none(ctx.session_id) is not None:
        return inject_trust_defaults_for_authenticated_actor(model_cls, instance)
    raise TypeError(f"Trust preparation requires a typed session source, got {type(ctx.session_id).__name__}.")


def _session_revalidation_identity(
    session_id: PlanningSessionId,

    """Return a session identity that the validation step can compile."""
    from l2070_batching.lazy_session_source import session_sql_source_or_none

    if isinstance(session_id, SessionId):

    if isinstance(session_id, ScalarServerRef):
        return session_id

    if source is not None:

    msg = f"Bulk-operation session revalidation requires a concrete or deferred session source, got {type(session_id).__name__}."
    raise TypeError(msg)

def _delete_hook_validator_from_ctx(
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> DeleteRowValidator | None:
    hook_registry = _hook_registry_from_lowering_ctx(ctx)
    session_id = _session_id_from_lowering_ctx(ctx)
    if hook_registry is None or session_id is None:
        return None
    from l9900_auto_api.hooks import WriteOperation

    hook_caps = hook_registry.capabilities_for_model(model_cls)
    if not hook_caps.needs_delete_preimage:
        return None

    def _validate(existing: DatabaseObjectRow) -> None:
        hook_registry.run_before_delete(model_cls, existing)
        hook_registry.run_before_write(
            model_cls,
            existing,
            session_id,
            WriteOperation.DELETE,
        )

    return _validate

    hook_registry = _hook_registry_from_lowering_ctx(ctx)

    hook_caps = hook_registry.capabilities_for_model(model_cls)
    if not hook_caps.needs_delete_preimage:
        return None

    def _run_after_delete(existing: DatabaseObjectRow) -> None:

def _lower_delete_returning_intent(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    sys_id: ScalarServerRef[SysId],
    returning_columns: tuple[str, ...] | None,
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    *,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import get_versioned_staging_ctx

    sc = get_versioned_staging_ctx(model_cls, ctx)
    if sc is not None:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_versioning_extended import (
            VersionedDeleteReturningDeferredIntent,
            VersionedDeleteReturningIntent,
            _VersionedDeleteReturningConfig,
        )

        if sys_id.ref_id is not None:
            return _as_steps(
                VersionedDeleteReturningDeferredIntent(
                    ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    sys_id=sys_id,
                    config=cast(
                        "Any",
                        _VersionedDeleteReturningConfig(
                            returning_columns=returning_columns,
                            staging_ctx=sc,
                            after_refs=after_refs,
                        ),
                    ),
                ).lower(ctx),
            )
        return _as_steps(
            VersionedDeleteReturningIntent(
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
                model_cls=model_cls,
                sys_id=sys_id,
                config=cast(
                    "Any",
                    _VersionedDeleteReturningConfig(
                        returning_columns=returning_columns,
                        staging_ctx=sc,
                        after_refs=after_refs,
                    ),
                ),
            ).lower(ctx),
        )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_delete import QueryDeleteStep, _QueryDeleteStepConfig
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import returnable_db_columns

    large_column_configs = get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
    delete_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}.delete") if large_column_configs else ServerPlanRefId(ref_id)
    sid = sys_id

    user_id_ref_id: str | None = None
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    if _requires_session_user_resolution(
        model_cls,
        ctx.session_id,
        permission_filtering_enabled=ctx.permission_filtering_enabled,
    ):
        assert ctx.session_id is not None
        user_id_ref_id = f"{ref_id}_resolve_uid"
        steps.append(
            SessionUserIdStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id),
                _session_scalar_ref_from_lowering_ctx(ctx),
            ),
        )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.write_side_effect_intents import _table_event_dispatch_needed

    delete_after_refs = after_refs
    selected_raw_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    event_source = delete_ref
    dispatch_needed = _table_event_dispatch_needed(model_cls, "DELETE")
    if large_column_configs or dispatch_needed:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import QueryExecuteStep, _QueryExecuteStepConfig

        preimage_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}.event_preimage" if dispatch_needed else f"{ref_id}.selected_raw")
        steps.append(
            QueryExecuteStep(
                preimage_ref,
                model_cls,
                _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                    query_spec=_build_sys_id_query_spec(
                        model_cls,
                        sid,
                        permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                        permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
                    ),
                    raw_mode=True,
                    after_refs=after_refs,
                    user_id_ref_id=(None if user_id_ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id)),
                    force_hydrate_large_columns=bool(large_column_configs),
                ),
            )
        )
        delete_after_refs = frozenset({*after_refs, preimage_ref})
        if large_column_configs:
            selected_raw_ref = preimage_ref
        if dispatch_needed:
            event_source = preimage_ref
    steps.extend(
        [
            QueryDeleteStep(
                delete_ref,
                model_cls,
                _QueryDeleteStepConfig(
                    query_spec=_build_sys_id_query_spec(
                        model_cls,
                        sid,
                        permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                        permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
                    ),
                    after_refs=delete_after_refs,
                    user_id_ref_id=(None if user_id_ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id)),
                    cte_returning_columns=(
                        returnable_db_columns(model_cls, include_polymorphic=False) if returning_columns is None else returning_columns
                    ),
                    returns_deleted_rows=True,
                    returns_first_deleted_row=True,
                ),
            ),
        ],
    )
    result_after_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (delete_ref,)
    delta_configs = tuple(config for config in large_column_configs if config.delta_storage is not None and config.delta_storage.enabled)
    if delta_configs:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_content_delta_storage import (
            build_delta_orphan_cleanup_steps,
        )

        cleanup_steps, cleanup_after_refs = build_delta_orphan_cleanup_steps(
            ref_prefix=ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
            model_cls=model_cls,
            configs=delta_configs,
            after_ref=delete_ref,
        )
        steps.extend(cleanup_steps)
        result_after_refs = tuple(cleanup_after_refs)
    steps.extend(
        _embedding_delete_cleanup_steps(
            ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
            model_cls,
            delete_ref,
            trigger_ref=str(delete_ref),
        ),
    )
    steps.extend(
        RecordTableEventIntent(
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}.subscription_dispatch"),
            model_cls,
            _RecordTableEventConfig(
                event_type="DELETE",
                write_ref_id=event_source,
                completion_ref=delete_ref,
            ),
        ).lower(ctx),
    )
    if selected_raw_ref is not None:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.row_hydration import HydrateFirstResolvedRowMappingStep

        projection_columns = tuple(
            DynamicFieldName(column) for column in (tuple(model_cls.model_fields) if returning_columns is None else returning_columns)
        )
        steps.append(
            HydrateFirstResolvedRowMappingStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
                source_ref=selected_raw_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                mapping_columns=projection_columns,
                after_refs=result_after_refs,
            )
        )
    return steps
