class DeleteIntent[T](IntentStep[bool]):
    """L4: Delete a model instance by sys_id."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "delete", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.SCALAR

    def __init__(
        self: DeleteIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        sys_id: ScalarServerRef[SysId],
        *,
        config: _DeleteIntentConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.sys_id: SysId = _require_seeded_config(sys_id, type(self).__name__)
        self.config = config
        self.after_refs = config.after_refs
        self.permission_context_ref = config.permission_context_ref
        self.permission_context_type = config.permission_context_type

    def dependencies(self: DeleteIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies = {str(ref_id) for ref_id in self.after_refs}
        if self.permission_context_ref is not None:
            dependencies.add(str(self.permission_context_ref))
        return frozenset(dependencies)

    def lower(self: DeleteIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import get_versioned_staging_ctx
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_delete import (
            QueryDeleteStep,
            _QueryDeleteStepConfig,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.row_hydration import (
            DispatchWithRuntimeFlag,
            HydrateFirstResolvedRowStep,
            ResolveDeletedSelectedRowResultStep,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.select_one_raw import SelectOneRawStep
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

        sc = get_versioned_staging_ctx(self.model_cls, ctx)
        if sc is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_versioning_extended import (
                VersionedDeleteIntent,
                _VersionedDeleteIntentConfig,
            )

            return _as_steps(
                VersionedDeleteIntent(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self.model_cls,
                    cast("Any", self.sys_id),
                    cast(
                        "Any",
                        _VersionedDeleteIntentConfig(
                            staging_ctx=sc,
                            after_refs=self.after_refs,
                            permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
                            permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
                        ),
                    ),
                ).lower(ctx),
            )
        user_id_ref_id: str | None = None
        selected_raw_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_selected_raw"
        deleted_row_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_deleted_row"
        hook_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_pre_delete_hook"
        delete_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_delete"
        sid = self.sys_id
        pre_delete_hook = _delete_hook_validator_from_ctx(ctx, self.model_cls)
        after_delete_hook = _after_delete_hook_from_ctx(ctx, self.model_cls)

        class _UnbatchedDeleteByIdStep(QueryDeleteStep):
            def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: _UnbatchedDeleteByIdStep) -> bool:
                return pre_delete_hook is None

            def supports_ordered_sql_statement_batch(self: _UnbatchedDeleteByIdStep) -> bool:
                return True

            def requires_runtime_sequential_batch(self: _UnbatchedDeleteByIdStep) -> bool:
                return pre_delete_hook is not None

            def ordered_transport_inlines_dependencies(self: _UnbatchedDeleteByIdStep) -> bool:
                return True

        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        if _requires_session_user_resolution(
            self.model_cls, ctx.session_id, permission_filtering_enabled=ctx.permission_filtering_enabled
        ):
            user_id_ref_id = self.ref_id + "_resolve_uid"
            assert ctx.session_id is not None
            steps.append(
                SessionUserIdStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id),
                    _session_scalar_ref_from_lowering_ctx(ctx),
                ),
            )
        steps.append(
            SelectOneRawStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(selected_raw_ref),
                self.model_cls,
                sid,
                permission_state_override=QueryPermissionState.BYPASS,
                after_refs=self.after_refs,
            ),
        )
        delete_after_refs = {ServerPlanRefId(selected_raw_ref), *self.after_refs}
        if pre_delete_hook is not None:
            steps.append(
                ApplyDeleteHookStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(hook_ref),
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    selected_ref=ServerPlanRefId(selected_raw_ref),
                    pre_delete_hook=pre_delete_hook,
                    hook_registry=_hook_registry_from_lowering_ctx(ctx),
                ),
            )
            delete_after_refs.add(ServerPlanRefId(hook_ref))
        steps.append(
            HydrateFirstResolvedRowStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(deleted_row_ref),
                source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(selected_raw_ref),
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                runtime_only_materialization=True,
            ),
        )
        steps.append(
            _UnbatchedDeleteByIdStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(delete_ref),
                self.model_cls,
                _QueryDeleteStepConfig(
                    query_spec=_build_sys_id_query_spec(
                        self.model_cls,
                        sid,
                        permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
                        permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
                    ),
                    after_refs=frozenset(delete_after_refs),
                    user_id_ref_id=(None if user_id_ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id)),
                    preimage_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(selected_raw_ref),
                ),
            ),
        )
        if after_delete_hook is not None:
            after_delete_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_after_delete_hook")
            steps.append(
                ApplyAfterDeleteHookStep(
                    after_delete_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    selected_ref=ServerPlanRefId(selected_raw_ref),
                    delete_ref=ServerPlanRefId(delete_ref),
                    after_delete_hook=after_delete_hook,
                ),
            )
        from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_spec import QuerySpec
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_content_delta_storage import (
            DeltaDecrementChunkReferencesStep,
            DeltaDeleteUnreferencedChunksStep,
        )
        from impl.common.l2510_delta_storage.delta_model import ContentValue
        from l1000_schema.typed_field import Expression
        from l2060_query_builder.query_contracts import QueryFilter

        source_table = str(get_table_name(self.model_cls))
        for config in get_large_column_configs(self.model_cls):
            if config.delta_storage is None or not config.delta_storage.enabled:
                continue
            owner_filter: Expression[Any, ContentValue] = Expression(
                field="source_table",
                operator="=",
                value=source_table,
            )
            owner_filter = owner_filter & Expression(
                field="source_column",
                operator="=",
                value=str(config.column),
            )
            owner_filter = owner_filter & Expression(
                field="row_sys_id",
                operator="=",
                value=self.sys_id,
            )
            decrement_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_{config.column}_delta_decrement")
            value_cleanup_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_{config.column}_delta_cleanup")
            steps.append(
                DeltaDecrementChunkReferencesStep(
                    decrement_ref,
                    source_table=SqlTableName(source_table),
                    source_column=ContentColumnName(config.column),
                    row_sys_id=self.sys_id,
                    after_refs=frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(delete_ref)}),
                ),
            )
            steps.append(
                QueryDeleteStep(
                    value_cleanup_ref,
                    ContentValue,
                    _QueryDeleteStepConfig(
                        query_spec=QuerySpec(
                            model_cls=ContentValue,
                            select_columns=None,
                            distinct=False,
                            joins=[],
                            filters=[QueryFilter(expression=owner_filter)],
                            order_by=[],
                            limit=None,
                            offset=None,
                            group_by=[],
                            aggregations=[],
                            having=[],
                            window_functions=[],
                            permission_state=QueryPermissionState.BYPASS,
                        ),
                        after_refs=frozenset({decrement_ref}),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            steps.append(
                DeltaDeleteUnreferencedChunksStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_{config.column}_delta_prune"),
                    after_refs=frozenset({value_cleanup_ref}),
                ),
            )
        steps.append(
            ResolveDeletedSelectedRowResultStep(
                self.ref_id,
                source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(delete_ref),
                selected_ref=ServerPlanRefId(selected_raw_ref),
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                dispatch_with_runtime=DispatchWithRuntimeFlag(True),
            ),
        )
        steps.extend(
            RecordTableEventIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_subscription_dispatch"),
                self.model_cls,
                _RecordTableEventConfig(
                    event_type="DELETE",
                    write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(selected_raw_ref),
                    after_refs=frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(delete_ref)}),
                    replayable_visible_rows=True,
                    visible_rows_cardinality=Cardinality.ONE,
                ),
            ).lower(ctx),
        )
        steps.extend(
            _embedding_delete_cleanup_steps(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                ServerPlanRefId(selected_raw_ref),
                trigger_ref=self.ref_id,
            ),
        )
        steps.extend(
            _lower_write_effect_steps_if_configured(
                ctx=ctx,
                ref_prefix=self.ref_id,
                hook_registry=_hook_registry_from_lowering_ctx(ctx),
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                operation="delete",
                old_row_ref=ServerPlanRefId(deleted_row_ref),
                new_row_ref=None,
                after_refs=frozenset({self.ref_id}),
            ),
        )
        return steps

    def dependencies(self: DeleteDeferredIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies = {str(ref_id) for ref_id in self.sys_id.dependencies()}
        dependencies.update(str(ref_id) for ref_id in self.after_refs)
        if self.permission_context_ref is not None:
            dependencies.add(str(self.permission_context_ref))
        return frozenset(dependencies)

    def lower(self: DeleteDeferredIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import get_versioned_staging_ctx
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_delete import (
            QueryDeleteStep,
            _QueryDeleteStepConfig,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.row_hydration import (
            DispatchWithRuntimeFlag,
            ResolveDeletedSelectedRowResultStep,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.select_one_raw import SelectOneRawStep
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

        if self.sys_id.ref_id is None:
            msg = "DeleteDeferredIntent requires a symbolic sys_id ref"
            raise NotImplementedError(msg)
        sys_id = _literal_insert_sys_id_ref_from_lowering_cache(self.sys_id, ctx)
        sc = get_versioned_staging_ctx(self.model_cls, ctx)
        if sc is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_versioning_extended import (
                VersionedDeleteDeferredIntent,
                _VersionedDeleteIntentConfig,
            )

            return _as_steps(
                VersionedDeleteDeferredIntent(
                    self.ref_id,
                    self.model_cls,
                    sys_id,
                    cast(
                        "Any",
                        _VersionedDeleteIntentConfig(
                            staging_ctx=sc,
                            after_refs=self.after_refs,
                            permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
                            permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
                        ),
                    ),
                ).lower(ctx),
            )
        user_id_ref_id: str | None = None
        select_ref = f"{self.ref_id}.select"
        delete_ref = f"{self.ref_id}.delete"

        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        if _requires_session_user_resolution(
            self.model_cls, ctx.session_id, permission_filtering_enabled=ctx.permission_filtering_enabled
        ):
            user_id_ref_id = self.ref_id + "_resolve_uid"
            assert ctx.session_id is not None
            steps.append(
                SessionUserIdStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id),
                    _session_scalar_ref_from_lowering_ctx(ctx),
                ),
            )
        steps.extend(
            [
                SelectOneRawStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(select_ref),
                    self.model_cls,
                    sys_id,
                    permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
                    permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
                ),
                QueryDeleteStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(delete_ref),
                    self.model_cls,
                    _QueryDeleteStepConfig(
                        query_spec=_build_sys_id_query_spec(
                            self.model_cls,
                            sys_id,
                            permission_context_ref=self.permission_context_ref,
                            permission_context_type=self.permission_context_type,
                        ),
                        after_refs=frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(select_ref), *self.after_refs}),
                        user_id_ref_id=(None if user_id_ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id)),
                        preimage_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(select_ref),
                    ),
                ),
                ResolveDeletedSelectedRowResultStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(delete_ref),
                    selected_ref=ServerPlanRefId(select_ref),
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    dispatch_with_runtime=DispatchWithRuntimeFlag(True),
                ),
            ],
        )
        steps.extend(
            _embedding_delete_cleanup_steps(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                ServerPlanRefId(select_ref),
                trigger_ref=self.ref_id,
            ),
        )
        steps.extend(
            _lower_write_effect_steps_if_configured(
                ctx=ctx,
                ref_prefix=self.ref_id,
                hook_registry=_hook_registry_from_lowering_ctx(ctx),
                model_cls=self.model_cls,
                operation="delete",
                old_row_ref=ServerPlanRefId(select_ref),
                new_row_ref=None,
                after_refs=frozenset({self.ref_id}),
            ),
        )
        return steps
