                    SqlColumnAlias(selected_col("sys_id"), SqlAliasName("source_sys_id")),
                    SqlColumnAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(prior_alias)),
                        SqlAliasName("target_sys_id"),
                    ),
                ],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_source), selected_alias),
                joins=[
                    SqlJoin(
                        JoinKind.INNER,
                        SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(table.sparse_table), prior_alias),
                        on=SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(prior_alias)),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            selected_col("sys_id"),
                        ),
                    ),
                ],
                where=sql_and(
                    *selected_conditions(selected_alias, staged_source),
                    SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, selected_col("sys_deleted")),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        selected_col("graph_sys_id"),
                        BinaryOp.NE,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(prior_alias)),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            violations.append(violation_body)

            if table.has_type_name:
                discriminator_violation = SqlSelect(
                    select=[
                        SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(str(table.base_table)), SqlAliasName("edge_base")),
                        SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam("polymorphic_discriminator"), SqlAliasName("result_kind")),
                        SqlColumnAlias(selected_col("sys_id"), SqlAliasName("source_sys_id")),
                        SqlColumnAlias(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(prior_alias)),
                            SqlAliasName("target_sys_id"),
                        ),
                    ],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_source), selected_alias),
                    joins=[
                        SqlJoin(
                            JoinKind.INNER,
                            SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(table.sparse_table), prior_alias),
                            on=SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(prior_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                selected_col("sys_id"),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ],
                    where=sql_and(
                        *selected_conditions(selected_alias, staged_source),
                        SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, selected_col("sys_deleted")),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            selected_col("type_name"),
                            BinaryOp.NE,
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), str(prior_alias)),
                        ),
                    ),
                )
                violations.append(discriminator_violation)

        violations_alias = SqlTableName("graph_identity_violations")
        grammar = SqlSelect(
            select=[
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("edge_base"), str(violations_alias)),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("result_kind"), str(violations_alias)),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(violations_alias)),
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(violations_alias)),
            ],
            from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(_union_renderables(violations), violations_alias),
            limit=1,
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=_edge_violation_post_op(
                "graph member",
                violation_kind="graph_identity",
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=_auxiliary_ctes_for_staged_reads(
                ctx,
                tuple(self.tables_read()),
                self.dependencies(),
            ),
        )


class AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """L0: Insert missing reciprocal edges into staged for symmetric auto-create."""

    def __init__(
        self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._edge_staged_table = config.edge_staged_table
        self._edge_sparse_table = config.edge_sparse_table
        self._branch_table = config.branch_table
        self._data_columns = list(config.data_columns)
        self._branch_ref = config.branch_ref
        self._publish_scope = config.publish_scope
        self._type_name_filter = config.type_name_filter
        self._dependencies = config.depends_on

    def dependencies(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._dependencies | _server_ref_dependencies(self._branch_ref)

    @property
    def level(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def step_tags(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "edge_constraints", "symmetric", "grammar"})

    def tables_read(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        tables = {
            self._edge_staged_table,
            self._edge_sparse_table,
            self._branch_table,
            SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
        }
        if self._publish_scope.staged_commits_table is not None:
            tables.add(SqlTableName(self._publish_scope.staged_commits_table))
        return frozenset(tables)

    def tables_written(self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._edge_staged_table})

    def compile(
        self: AutoCreateSymmetricReciprocalsInStagedStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        branch_binding = _normalize_edge_branch_binding(lazy_branch=self._branch_ref, ctx=ctx)
        src_alias = SqlAliasName("s")
        rev_alias = SqlAliasName("r")
        published_alias = SqlAliasName("published_reverse")
        staged_table = _staged_read_table(ctx, self._edge_staged_table, scope=self._publish_scope)
        selector = _selector_from_publish_scope(
            scope=self._publish_scope,
            branch_id=self._branch_ref,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_sparse import (
            SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned,
        )

        digest = hashlib.sha256(str(self.ref_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
        prior_visible_name = SqlTableName(f"sym_prior_{digest}")
        reverse_visible_name = SqlTableName(f"sym_reverse_{digest}")
        tip_revision = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("tip_revision_sys_id"))],
                from_=SqlTableIdent(self._branch_table),
                where=SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, branch_binding.branch_param),
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
        selected_ids = SqlSelect(
            select=[SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(src_alias))],
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), src_alias),
            where=sql_and(
                selector.match_expr(
                    column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                    qualifier=str(src_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                selector.latest_row_expr(
                    staged_table=str(staged_table),
                    outer_qualifier=str(src_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
            ),
        )
        sparse_sys_id = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(self._edge_sparse_table))
        prior_ancestry = SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned(
            table=self._edge_sparse_table,
            revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
            branch_id=branch_binding.branch_param,
            revision_id=tip_revision,
            include_deleted=False,
            extra_where=SqlIn(sparse_sys_id, selected_ids),
            ranking_where=SqlIn(sparse_sys_id, selected_ids),
            ancestor_cte_name=SqlCteName(f"sym_prior_anc_{digest}"),
        )
        prior_ancestry_ctes, prior_visible_body = prior_ancestry.split_for_outer_cte()

        sparse_graph = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(self._edge_sparse_table))
        sparse_source = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(self._edge_sparse_table))
        sparse_target = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(self._edge_sparse_table))
        reverse_of_selected = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlParam(1)],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), src_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=str(src_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=str(staged_table),
                        outer_qualifier=str(src_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        sparse_graph,
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(src_alias)),
                    ),
                    sql_or(
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_source,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(src_alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_target,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(src_alias)),
                            ),
                        ),
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_source,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(src_alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_target,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(src_alias)),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
        prior_candidate_alias = SqlAliasName("prior_candidate")
        reverse_of_prior = SqlExists(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlParam(1)],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(prior_visible_name), prior_candidate_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        sparse_graph,
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(prior_candidate_alias)),
                    ),
                    sql_or(
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_source,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(prior_candidate_alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_target,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(prior_candidate_alias)),
                            ),
                        ),
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_source,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_sys_id"), str(prior_candidate_alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                sparse_target,
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(prior_candidate_alias)),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
        reverse_ancestry = SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned(
            table=self._edge_sparse_table,
            revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
            branch_id=branch_binding.branch_param,
            revision_id=tip_revision,
            include_deleted=False,
            extra_where=sql_or(reverse_of_selected, reverse_of_prior),
            ranking_where=sql_or(reverse_of_selected, reverse_of_prior),
            ancestor_cte_name=SqlCteName(f"sym_reverse_anc_{digest}"),
        )
        reverse_ancestry_ctes, reverse_visible_body = reverse_ancestry.split_for_outer_cte()

        def src_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(src_alias))

        def rev_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(rev_alias))

        reverse_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=str(staged_table),
                outer_qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("branch_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("branch_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("graph_sys_id")),
            SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, rev_col("sys_deleted")),
            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("target_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("source_sys_id")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            reverse_conditions,
            column_ref=rev_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        reverse_subquery = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(
                SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), rev_alias),
            ),
            where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*reverse_conditions)),
        )

        def published_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(published_alias))

        published_reverse_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlBinaryOp(published_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("graph_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(published_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("target_sys_id")),
            SqlBinaryOp(published_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, src_col("source_sys_id")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            published_reverse_conditions,
            column_ref=published_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        published_reverse_conditions.append(
            SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlParam(1)],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), rev_alias),
                    where=sql_and(
                        selector.match_expr(
                            column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                            qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        selector.latest_row_expr(
                            staged_table=str(staged_table),
                            outer_qualifier=str(rev_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, published_col("sys_id")),
                        sql_or(
                            rev_col("sys_deleted"),
                            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.NE, src_col("graph_sys_id")),
                            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.NE, src_col("target_sys_id")),
                            SqlBinaryOp(rev_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.NE, src_col("source_sys_id")),
                        ),
                    ),
                    limit=1,
                ),
                negated=True,
            ),
        )
        published_reverse_subquery = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(
                SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), published_alias),
            ),
            where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*published_reverse_conditions)),
        )

        def final_orientation_count(
            *,
            graph: SqlRenderable,
            source: SqlRenderable,
            target: SqlRenderable,
            upper_sys_id: SqlRenderable | None,
            alias_suffix: str,
        ) -> SqlRenderable:
            visible_alias = SqlAliasName(f"final_visible_{alias_suffix}")
            staged_alias = SqlAliasName(f"final_staged_{alias_suffix}")
            override_alias = SqlAliasName(f"final_override_{alias_suffix}")

            def visible_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
                return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(visible_alias))

            def staged_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
                return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(staged_alias))

            def override_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
                return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(override_alias))

            selected_override = SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlParam(1)],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), override_alias),
                    where=sql_and(
                        selector.match_expr(
                            column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                            qualifier=str(override_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        selector.latest_row_expr(
                            staged_table=str(staged_table),
                            outer_qualifier=str(override_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(override_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, visible_col("sys_id")),
                    ),
                    limit=1,
                ),
                negated=True,
            )
            visible_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                selected_override,
                SqlBinaryOp(visible_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, graph),
                SqlBinaryOp(visible_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, source),
                SqlBinaryOp(visible_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, target),
            ]
            staged_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                selector.match_expr(
                    column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                    qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                selector.latest_row_expr(
                    staged_table=str(staged_table),
                    outer_qualifier=str(staged_alias),
                    ctx=ctx,
                ),
                SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, staged_col("sys_deleted")),
                SqlBinaryOp(staged_col("graph_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, graph),
                SqlBinaryOp(staged_col("source_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, source),
                SqlBinaryOp(staged_col("target_sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, target),
            ]
            if upper_sys_id is not None:
                visible_conditions.append(
                    SqlBinaryOp(visible_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.LE, upper_sys_id),
                )
                staged_conditions.append(
                    SqlBinaryOp(staged_col("sys_id"), BinaryOp.LE, upper_sys_id),
                )
            _append_optional_type_name_filter(
                visible_conditions,
                column_ref=visible_col("type_name"),
                type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
            )
            _append_optional_type_name_filter(
                staged_conditions,
                column_ref=staged_col("type_name"),
                type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
            )
            visible_count = SqlSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), visible_alias),
                    where=sql_and(*visible_conditions),
                ),
            )
            staged_count = SqlSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), staged_alias),
                    where=sql_and(*staged_conditions),
                ),
            )
            return SqlBinaryOp(visible_count, BinaryOp.ADD, staged_count)

        generation_visible_alias = SqlAliasName("generation_visible")
        generation_selected_alias = SqlAliasName("generation_selected")
        generation_override_alias = SqlAliasName("generation_override")
        generation_commit_alias = SqlAliasName("generation_commit")

        def generation_visible_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(generation_visible_alias))

        def generation_selected_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(generation_selected_alias))

        def generation_override_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(generation_override_alias))

        def generation_commit_col(name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), str(generation_commit_alias))

        selected_generation_commit = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=[generation_commit_col("sys_staged_commit_id")],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), generation_commit_alias),
                where=sql_and(
                    selector.match_expr(
                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        qualifier=str(generation_commit_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    selector.latest_row_expr(
                        staged_table=str(staged_table),
                        outer_qualifier=str(generation_commit_alias),
                        ctx=ctx,
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        generation_commit_col("graph_sys_id"),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        generation_visible_col("graph_sys_id"),
                    ),
                    sql_or(
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                generation_commit_col("source_sys_id"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                generation_visible_col("source_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                generation_commit_col("target_sys_id"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                generation_visible_col("target_sys_id"),
                            ),
                        ),
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                generation_commit_col("source_sys_id"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                generation_visible_col("target_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                generation_commit_col("target_sys_id"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                generation_visible_col("source_sys_id"),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
        generation_visible_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlParam(1)],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), generation_override_alias),
                    where=sql_and(
                        selector.match_expr(
                            column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                            qualifier=str(generation_override_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        selector.latest_row_expr(
                            staged_table=str(staged_table),
                            outer_qualifier=str(generation_override_alias),
                            ctx=ctx,
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            generation_override_col("sys_id"),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            generation_visible_col("sys_id"),
                        ),
                    ),
                    limit=1,
                ),
                negated=True,
            ),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            generation_visible_conditions,
            column_ref=generation_visible_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        generation_selected_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            selector.match_expr(
                column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                qualifier=str(generation_selected_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            selector.latest_row_expr(
                staged_table=str(staged_table),
                outer_qualifier=str(generation_selected_alias),
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, generation_selected_col("sys_deleted")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            generation_selected_conditions,
            column_ref=generation_selected_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        generation_source_columns: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlColumnAlias(branch_binding.branch_param, SqlAliasName("branch_id")),
            generation_visible_col("sys_id"),
            SqlColumnAlias(selected_generation_commit, SqlAliasName("sys_staged_commit_id")),
            SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(False), SqlAliasName("sys_deleted")),
            *(generation_visible_col(column) for column in self._data_columns),
        ]
        generation_sources = SqlUnionAll(
            [
                SqlSelect(
                    select=generation_source_columns,
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(reverse_visible_name), generation_visible_alias),
                    where=sql_and(*generation_visible_conditions),
                ),
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[
                        generation_selected_col("branch_id"),
                        generation_selected_col("sys_id"),
                        generation_selected_col("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        generation_selected_col("sys_deleted"),
                        *(generation_selected_col(column) for column in self._data_columns),
                    ],
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(staged_table), generation_selected_alias),
                    where=sql_and(*generation_selected_conditions),
                ),
            ],
        )

        source_final_rank = final_orientation_count(
            graph=src_col("graph_sys_id"),
            source=src_col("source_sys_id"),
            target=src_col("target_sys_id"),
            upper_sys_id=src_col("sys_id"),
            alias_suffix="source_rank",
        )
        reverse_final_count = final_orientation_count(
            graph=src_col("graph_sys_id"),
            source=src_col("target_sys_id"),
            target=src_col("source_sys_id"),
            upper_sys_id=None,
            alias_suffix="reverse_count",
        )

        where_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            SqlBinaryOp(src_col("branch_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, branch_binding.branch_param),
            SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, src_col("sys_deleted")),
        ]
        _append_optional_type_name_filter(
            where_conditions,
            column_ref=src_col("type_name"),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        where_conditions.append(
            SqlBinaryOp(source_final_rank, BinaryOp.GT, reverse_final_count),
        )

        target_columns = [
            "branch_id",
            "sys_id",
            "sys_staged_commit_id",
            "sys_deleted",
            *self._data_columns,

            ),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(
                SqlTableIdent(effective_parent_edges_name),
                SqlAliasName("depth_edges"),
            ),
        ),
    )
    path_type = SqlCastTargetType(base_type="VARCHAR", length=16384)
    walk_cte = SqlCteDefinition(
        f"{ancestor_walk_name}(start_target_id, graph_sys_id, node_sys_id, previous_node_sys_id, depth, path_text)",
        SqlUnionAll(
            [
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(parent_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("start_target_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(parent_alias)),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("parent_sys_id"), str(parent_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("node_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(parent_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("previous_node_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(1), SqlAliasName("depth")),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlCast(
                                    SqlFuncCall(
                                        "CONCAT",
                                        [
                                            SqlCast(
                                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(parent_alias)),
                                                SqlCastTargetType(base_type="VARCHAR"),
                                            ),
                                            SqlParam(","),
                                            SqlCast(
                                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("parent_sys_id"), str(parent_alias)),
                                                SqlCastTargetType(base_type="VARCHAR"),
                                            ),
                                        ],
                                    ),
                                    path_type,
                                ),
                                SqlAliasName("path_text"),
                            ),
                        ],
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(
                        SqlTableIdent(effective_parent_edges_name),
                        parent_alias,
                    ),
                ),
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("start_target_id"), str(walk_alias)),
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(walk_alias)),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("parent_sys_id"), str(parent_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("node_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(walk_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("previous_node_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlBinaryOp(
                                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("depth"), str(walk_alias)),
                                    BinaryOp.ADD,
                                    SqlParam(1),
                                ),
                                SqlAliasName("depth"),
                            ),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlCast(
                                    SqlFuncCall(
                                        "CONCAT",
                                        [
                                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("path_text"), str(walk_alias)),
                                            SqlParam(","),
                                            SqlCast(
                                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("parent_sys_id"), str(parent_alias)),
                                                SqlCastTargetType(base_type="VARCHAR"),
                                            ),
                                        ],
                                    ),
                                    path_type,
                                ),
                                SqlAliasName("path_text"),
                            ),
                        ],
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(ancestor_walk_name), walk_alias),
                    joins=[
                        SqlJoin(
                            JoinKind.INNER,
                            SqlTableAlias(
                                SqlTableIdent(effective_parent_edges_name),
                                parent_alias,
                            ),
                            sql_and(
                                SqlBinaryOp(
                                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(parent_alias)),
                                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(walk_alias)),
                                ),
                                SqlBinaryOp(
                                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(parent_alias)),
                                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(walk_alias)),
                                ),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ],
                    where=SqlWhereClause(
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(walk_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.NE,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("start_target_id"), str(walk_alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("depth"), str(walk_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.LT,
                                max_depth_expr,
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ],
        ),
    )
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
        null_text: SqlRenderable = SqlCast(SqlRawExpression("NULL"), SqlCastTargetType(base_type="TEXT"))
    else:
        null_text = SqlRawExpression("NULL")
    return SqlSelectWithCte(
        SqlWithClause(
            [*source_ctes, effective_parent_cte, conflicting_targets_cte, walk_cte],
            recursive=True,
        ),
        SqlUnionAll(
            [
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(str(edge_base)), SqlAliasName("edge_base")),
                            SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam("parent_conflict"), SqlAliasName("result_kind")),
                            SqlSelectAlias(SqlRawExpression("NULL"), SqlAliasName("source_sys_id")),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(conflict_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("target_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("parent_count"), str(conflict_alias)),
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("parent_ids"), str(conflict_alias)),
                            SqlSelectAlias(null_text, SqlAliasName("path_text")),
                        ],
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(
                        SqlTableIdent(conflicting_targets_name),
                        conflict_alias,
                    ),
                ),
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList(
                        [
                            SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(str(edge_base)), SqlAliasName("edge_base")),
                            SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam("cycle_detected"), SqlAliasName("result_kind")),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("previous_node_sys_id"), str(walk_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("source_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlSelectAlias(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("start_target_id"), str(walk_alias)),
                                SqlAliasName("target_sys_id"),
                            ),
                            SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(0), SqlAliasName("parent_count")),
                            SqlSelectAlias(null_text, SqlAliasName("parent_ids")),
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("path_text"), str(walk_alias)),
                        ],
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(ancestor_walk_name), walk_alias),
                    where=SqlWhereClause(
                        sql_or(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(walk_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("start_target_id"), str(walk_alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("depth"), str(walk_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.GE,
                                max_depth_expr,
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ],
        ),
    )


class _CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStepCteRow(BaseModel):
    edge_base: str
    result_kind: str
    source_sys_id: SysId
    target_sys_id: SysId
    parent_count: int
    parent_ids: str
    path_text: str | None


class CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[None]):
    """L0: Validate single-parent and cycles against the full dirty-graph parent map."""

    def cte_publication_contract(self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = (
            "edge_base",
            "result_kind",
            "source_sys_id",
            "target_sys_id",
            "parent_count",
            "parent_ids",
            "path_text",
        )
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
            text_columns=frozenset({"edge_base", "result_kind", "parent_ids", "path_text"}),
            uuid_columns=frozenset({"source_sys_id", "target_sys_id"}),
            bigint_columns=frozenset({"parent_count"}),
        )
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def __init__(
        self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep,
        ref_id: StepRefId,
        *,
        edge_tip_table: TableNameInput,
        edge_staged_table: TableNameInput,
        edge_base_table: TableNameInput,
        lazy_branch: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
        publish_scope: PublishScopeDescriptor,
        depends_on: DependencyRefs = frozenset(),
        type_name_filter: TypeNameFilterInput = (),
        affected_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        validate_full_tip: bool = False,
        branch_lookup: tuple[SqlTableName, ScalarServerRef[WorkspaceId], ScalarServerRef[BranchName]] | None = None,
        additional_branch_lookup: (tuple[SqlTableName, ScalarServerRef[WorkspaceId], ScalarServerRef[BranchName]] | None) = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._edge_tip_table = edge_tip_table
        self._edge_staged_table = edge_staged_table
        self._edge_base_table = edge_base_table
        self._lazy_branch = lazy_branch
        self._publish_scope = publish_scope
        self._dependencies = depends_on
        self._type_name_filter = _normalize_type_name_filter(type_name_filter)
        self._affected_rows_ref = affected_rows_ref
        self._validate_full_tip = validate_full_tip
        self._branch_lookup = branch_lookup
        self._additional_branch_lookup = additional_branch_lookup

    def dependencies(self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = self._dependencies | _server_ref_dependencies(self._lazy_branch)
        if self._affected_rows_ref is not None:
            deps = deps | frozenset({self._affected_rows_ref})
        for branch_lookup in (self._branch_lookup, self._additional_branch_lookup):
            if branch_lookup is not None:
                _, workspace_id, branch_name = branch_lookup
                deps = deps | workspace_id.dependencies() | branch_name.dependencies()
        return deps

    @property
    def level(self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def is_read_only(self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep) -> bool:
        return self._affected_rows_ref is not None and not self._validate_full_tip

    def step_tags(self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "validation", "grammar", "tree", "graph_scoped_rebuild"})

    def tables_read(self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        tables = {
            self._edge_tip_table,
            self._edge_staged_table,
            CONTAINS_TREE_STATE_TIP_TABLE,
        }
        if not self._validate_full_tip:
            tables.add(SqlTableName(derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(self._edge_base_table))).sparse))
        if self._publish_scope.staged_commits_table is not None:
            tables.add(self._publish_scope.staged_commits_table)
        return frozenset(tables)

    def tables_written(self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def staged_read_descriptor(self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep) -> StagedReadRequirement | None:
        return _scoped_staged_read(SqlTableName(self._edge_staged_table), self._publish_scope)

    def compile(
        self: CheckDirtyGraphTreeValidityStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.provider_helpers import (
            require_versioned_lowering_provider,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.commit_branch_steps import (
            _build_touched_tree_target_query,
            _edge_table_identity_expr,
            _affected_rows_source_table,
            _resolve_staged_source,
            _type_name_filter_conditions,
        )

        branch_value = self._lazy_branch
        branch_expr = lower_scalar_source(branch_value, ctx, default_field="branch_id")
        selector = _selector_from_publish_scope(scope=self._publish_scope, branch_id=self._lazy_branch)
        edge_base = self._edge_base_table
        state_scope_key = tree_state_scope_key(str(edge_base), self._type_name_filter)
        cte_digest = hashlib.sha256(str(self.ref_id).encode("utf-8"), usedforsecurity=False).hexdigest()[:12]
        cte_prefix = f"tree_{cte_digest}"

        def _cte_name(name: str) -> SqlTableName:
            return SqlTableName(f"{cte_prefix}_{name}")

        touched_targets_name = _cte_name("touched_targets")
        existing_targets_name = _cte_name("existing_targets")
        new_targets_name = _cte_name("new_targets")
        candidate_parent_edges_name = _cte_name("candidate_parent_edges")
        conflicting_targets_name = _cte_name("conflicting_targets")
        staged_parent_edges_name = _cte_name("staged_parent_edges")
        boundary_nodes_name = _cte_name("boundary_nodes")
        persisted_parent_edges_name = _cte_name("persisted_parent_edges")
        effective_parent_edges_name = _cte_name("effective_parent_edges")
        ancestor_walk_name = _cte_name("ancestor_walk")
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_cte import (
            SqlCteDefinition,
            SqlSelectWithCte,
            SqlUnionAll,
            SqlWithClause,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
            SqlGroupByClause,
            SqlJoin,
            SqlSelectAlias,
            SqlSelectList,
            SqlTableAlias,
            SqlWhereClause,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp, JoinKind, UnaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast, SqlFuncCall, SqlSubquery
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam, SqlStar
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import (
            SqlBinaryOp,
            SqlIsNull,
            SqlUnaryOp,
            sql_and,
        )
        from l1000_schema.typed_field import SqlCastTargetType

        def _branch_lookup_expr(
            lookup: tuple[SqlTableName, ScalarServerRef[WorkspaceId], ScalarServerRef[BranchName]],
        ) -> SqlRenderable:
            branch_table, workspace_id, branch_name = lookup
            return SqlSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"))]),
                    from_=SqlTableIdent(branch_table),
                    where=SqlWhereClause(
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("workspace_id")),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                lower_scalar_source(workspace_id, ctx),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("name")),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                lower_scalar_source(branch_name, ctx),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted")),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlParam(False),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )

        branch_exprs: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...] = ()
        if self._branch_lookup is not None:
            branch_expr = _branch_lookup_expr(self._branch_lookup)
            branch_exprs = (branch_expr,)
        if self._additional_branch_lookup is not None:
            branch_exprs = (*branch_exprs, _branch_lookup_expr(self._additional_branch_lookup))

        affected_source = (
            str(self._edge_tip_table) if self._validate_full_tip else _affected_rows_source_table(self._affected_rows_ref, ctx)
        )
        effective_staged = affected_source or _resolve_staged_source(self._edge_staged_table, ctx)
        selected_definitions: list[SqlCteDefinition] = []
        if affected_source is None and not is_latest_wins_staged_source(effective_staged, ctx):
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlWindow
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import OrderDirection

            ranked_name = SqlTableName(f"{ancestor_walk_name}_ranked")
            selected_name = SqlTableName(f"{ancestor_walk_name}_selected")
            selected_columns = (
                "branch_id",
                "sys_id",
                "sys_staged_commit_id",
                "sys_deleted",
                "graph_sys_id",
                "source_sys_id",
                "target_sys_id",
                *(("type_name",) if self._type_name_filter else ()),
            )
            rank_expr = SqlWindow(
                func=SqlFuncCall("DENSE_RANK", []),
                partition_by=[SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")), SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"))],
                order_by=[
                    SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name)), OrderDirection.DESC)
                    for name in ("sys_staged_commit_id", "sys_deleted")
                ],
            )
            selected_definitions.extend(
                [
                    SqlCteDefinition(
                        str(ranked_name),
                        SqlSelect(
                            select_list=SqlSelectList(
                                [
                                    *(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name)) for name in selected_columns),
                                    SqlSelectAlias(rank_expr, SqlAliasName("publication_rank")),
                                ]
                            ),
                            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(effective_staged)),
                            where=sql_and(
                                SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, branch_expr),
                                selector.match_expr(column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"), ctx=ctx),
                            ),
                        ),
                        materialized=True,
                    ),
                    SqlCteDefinition(
                        str(selected_name),
                        SqlSelect(
                            select_list=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name)) for name in selected_columns]),
                            from_=SqlTableIdent(ranked_name),
                            where=SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("publication_rank")), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(1)),
                        ),
                        materialized=True,
                    ),
                ]
            )
            from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference

            ctx = replace(
                ctx,
                staged_source_cte_by_table={
                    **ctx.staged_source_cte_by_table,
                    str(self._edge_staged_table): ServerPlanRefId(str(selected_name)),
                },
                cte_refs={
                    **ctx.cte_refs,
                    str(selected_name): CteReference(
                        ServerPlanRefId(str(selected_name)),
                        columns=selected_columns,
                        column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                            uuid_columns=frozenset(
                                {
                                    "branch_id",
                                    "sys_id",
                                    "sys_staged_commit_id",
                                    "graph_sys_id",
                                    "source_sys_id",
                                    "target_sys_id",
                                }
                            ),
                            bool_columns=frozenset({"sys_deleted"}),
                            text_columns=(frozenset({"type_name"}) if self._type_name_filter else frozenset()),
                        ),
                    ),
                },
            )
            effective_staged = str(selected_name)
        validation_needed_expr = (
            None
            if self._validate_full_tip
            else _staged_edge_scope_touch_exists(
                staged_table=SqlTableName(self._edge_staged_table),
                sparse_table=SqlTableName(derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(self._edge_base_table))).sparse),
                branch_binding=_EdgeBranchBinding(branch_expr),
                ctx=ctx,
                type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
                publish_scope=self._publish_scope,
                branch_ref=self._lazy_branch,
            )
        )
        touched_targets = _build_touched_tree_target_query(
            staged_table_name=self._edge_staged_table,
            tip_table_name=self._edge_tip_table,
            branch_id=branch_value,
            selector=selector,
            ctx=ctx,
            include_deleted=True,
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
            affected_rows_ref=self._affected_rows_ref,
            affected_source_override=affected_source if self._validate_full_tip else None,
            affected_branch_exprs=branch_exprs if self._validate_full_tip else (),
            validation_needed_expr=validation_needed_expr,
        )
        materialized = True
        touched_cte = SqlCteDefinition(
            f"{touched_targets_name}(node_sys_id, graph_sys_id)",
            touched_targets,
            materialized=materialized,
        )
        existing_targets_alias = SqlAliasName("et")
        tree_state_lookup_alias = SqlAliasName("tsl")
        new_targets_alias = SqlAliasName("nt")
        walk_alias = SqlAliasName("w")
        edge_alias = SqlAliasName("e")
        candidate_alias = SqlAliasName("cp")
        conflict_alias = SqlAliasName("ct")
        staged_parent_alias = SqlAliasName("sp")
        staged_delete_alias = SqlAliasName("sd")
        boundary_alias = SqlAliasName("b")
        touched_state_alias = SqlAliasName("tt")
        persisted_parent_alias = SqlAliasName("p")
        edge_type_conditions = _type_name_filter_conditions(
            column_ref=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), str(edge_alias)),
            type_name_filter=self._type_name_filter,
        )
        full_tip_branch_conditions: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...] = (
            (
                sql_or(
                    *(
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(edge_alias)),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            scoped_branch_expr,
                        )
                        for scoped_branch_expr in branch_exprs or (branch_expr,)
                    ),
                ),
            )
            if self._validate_full_tip
            else ()
        )

        def _persisted_parent_is_visible(state_alias: SqlAliasName) -> SqlExists:
            persisted_override_alias = SqlAliasName("persisted_override")
            return SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(
                        SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(effective_staged)),
                        persisted_override_alias,
                    ),
                    where=SqlWhereClause(
                        sql_and(
                            *(
                                ()
                                if self._validate_full_tip
                                else (
                                    selector.match_expr(
                                        column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
                                        qualifier=str(persisted_override_alias),
                                        ctx=ctx,
                                    ),
                                    selector.latest_row_expr(
                                        staged_table=effective_staged,
                                        outer_qualifier=str(persisted_override_alias),
                                        ctx=ctx,
                                    ),
                                )
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(persisted_override_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(state_alias)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("target_sys_id"), str(persisted_override_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(state_alias)),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                negated=True,
            )

        existing_targets_cte = SqlCteDefinition(
            f"{existing_targets_name}(node_sys_id, graph_sys_id)",
            SqlSelect(
                select_list=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("node_sys_id"), str(existing_targets_alias)),
                            SqlAliasName("node_sys_id"),
                        ),
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(existing_targets_alias)),
                            SqlAliasName("graph_sys_id"),
                        ),
                    ],
                ),
                from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(touched_targets_name), existing_targets_alias),
                joins=[
                    SqlJoin(
                        JoinKind.INNER,
                        SqlTableAlias(
                            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(CONTAINS_TREE_STATE_TIP_TABLE)),
                            tree_state_lookup_alias,
                        ),
                        sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), str(tree_state_lookup_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                branch_expr,
                            ),
                            _edge_table_identity_expr(tree_state_lookup_alias, state_scope_key),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(tree_state_lookup_alias)),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("graph_sys_id"), str(existing_targets_alias)),

    for key, value in changes.items():

def _collect_spec_deps_for_user_ref(
    query_spec: Any,
    *,
    unbound_user_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
) -> frozenset[str]:
    deps = _collect_spec_deps(query_spec)
    if unbound_user_ref_id is None:
        return deps
    user_ref_text = str(unbound_user_ref_id)
    return frozenset(dep for dep in deps if dep != user_ref_text and not dep.startswith(user_ref_text + "."))


def _add_runtime_dependency_ref(deps: set[str], ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | str | None) -> None:
    if ref_id is None:
        return
    ref_text = str(ref_id)
    if ref_text.startswith("seed_"):
        return
    deps.add(ref_text)
    base_ref, separator, _field_name = ref_text.partition(".")
    if separator:
        deps.add(base_ref)


def _discard_self_and_ancestor_deps(deps: set[str], ref_id: ServerPlanRefId) -> None:
    ref_text = str(ref_id)
    deps.discard(ref_text)
    for dep in tuple(deps):
        if ref_text.startswith(dep + "."):
            deps.discard(dep)


def _synthetic_step_ref_id(base_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | str, suffix: str) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{base_ref_id}:{suffix}".encode("utf-8")).digest()
    return ServerPlanRefId(f"step_{int.from_bytes(digest[:8], 'big')}")


def _bounded_sql_relation_name(name: str, *, max_length: int = 60) -> str:
    if len(name) <= max_length:
        return name
    digest = hashlib.sha256(name.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]
    return f"{name[: max_length - len(digest) - 1]}_{digest}"


def _grammar_needs_recursive_with(grammar: SqlRenderable) -> bool:
    if bool(getattr(grammar, "_recursive", False)):
        return True
    with_clause = getattr(grammar, "_with_clause", None)
    return bool(getattr(with_clause, "_recursive", False))


def _cte_definitions_need_recursive(ctes: Sequence[tuple[str, SqlRenderable] | object]) -> bool:
    for definition in ctes:
        if bool(getattr(definition, "recursive", False)):
            return True
        query = getattr(definition, "query", None)
        if query is None:
            try:
                _alias, query = cast("tuple[str, SqlRenderable]", definition)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                continue
        if bool(getattr(query, "_recursive", False)):
            return True
    return False


def _split_leading_ctes(
    grammar: SqlRenderable,
) -> tuple[list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]], SqlRenderable, bool]:
    split_for_outer_cte = getattr(grammar, "split_for_outer_cte", None)
    if not callable(split_for_outer_cte):
        return [], grammar, False
    definitions, final_query = cast(
        tuple[Sequence[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]], object],
        split_for_outer_cte(),
    )
    definition_list = list(definitions)
    return (
        definition_list,
        cast(SqlRenderable, final_query),
        _grammar_needs_recursive_with(grammar) or _cte_definitions_need_recursive(definition_list),
    )


def _query_spec_leading_ctes(query_spec: Any) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]]:
    from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_spec import get_query_sql_cte_definitions

    return [(cte_name, cte_query) for cte_name, cte_query in get_query_sql_cte_definitions(query_spec)]


def _dedupe_auxiliary_ctes(
    ctes: Sequence[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]]:
    if not ctes:
        return []
    deduped: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] = []
    seen_names: set[str] = set()
    seen_queries: set[int] = set()
    for cte_name, cte_query in ctes:
        if cte_name in seen_names or id(cte_query) in seen_queries:
            continue
        seen_names.add(cte_name)
        seen_queries.add(id(cte_query))
        deduped.append((cte_name, cte_query))
    return deduped


def _query_spec_has_expression_projection(query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow] | None) -> bool:
    return any(
        isinstance(column, AliasedExpression)
        and (column.expression.field is None or column.expression.function is not None or column.expression.operator is not None)
        for column in (getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None) or ())
    )


def _query_spec_has_computed_columns(query_spec: Any) -> bool:
    """Return True when the query spec projects computed aggregate/window rows."""
    if query_spec is None:
        return False
    return bool(
        getattr(query_spec, "aggregates", None)
        or getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", None)
        or getattr(query_spec, "windows", None)
        or getattr(query_spec, "window_functions", None)
        or getattr(query_spec, "group_by", None)
        or _query_spec_has_expression_projection(query_spec),
    )


def _query_spec_returns_raw_rows(query_spec: Any, raw_mode: bool = False) -> bool:
    """Return True when results should remain dict rows instead of model hydration."""
    if raw_mode:
        return True
    if _query_spec_has_computed_columns(query_spec):
        return True
    if query_spec is not None:
        if getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None):
            return True
        select = getattr(query_spec, "select", None)
        if select is not None and getattr(select, "columns", None):
            return True
    return False


def _query_spec_has_json_function_filter(query_spec: Any) -> bool:
    def _expr_has_json_function(value: object) -> bool:
        function = getattr(value, "function", None)
        if function is not None and "JSON_GET_" in str(function):
            return True
        for attr in ("left", "right"):
            child = getattr(value, attr, None)
            if child is not None and _expr_has_json_function(child):
                return True
        for child in getattr(value, "args", ()) or ():
            if _expr_has_json_function(child):
                return True
        for child in getattr(value, "expressions", ()) or ():
            if _expr_has_json_function(child):
                return True
        return False

    for query_filter in getattr(query_spec, "filters", ()) or ():
        expression = getattr(query_filter, "expression", None)
        if expression is not None and _expr_has_json_function(expression):
            return True
    return False


def _row_to_python_dict(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow], row: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Convert DB column keys to Python field names while preserving computed aliases."""

    row_dict = dict(row) if not isinstance(row, dict) else dict(row)
    db_to_python = _raw_row_db_to_python_name_map(model_cls)
    if not db_to_python or not any(key in db_to_python for key in row_dict):
        return row_dict
    converted = dict_from_db_columns(
        model_cls,
        {SqlColumnName(str(key)): value for key, value in row_dict.items()},
    )
    model_db_columns = {get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in model_cls.model_fields}
    for key, value in row_dict.items():
        dynamic_key = DynamicFieldName(str(key))
        if key not in model_db_columns and dynamic_key not in converted:
            converted[dynamic_key] = value
    converted_dict = {str(key): value for key, value in converted.items()}
    return converted_dict


def _numeric_computed_aliases(
    query_spec: QuerySpec | None,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> frozenset[str]:
    if query_spec is None:
        return frozenset()
    aliases: set[str] = set()
    for agg in getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", ()) or ():
        alias = getattr(agg, "alias", None)
        if isinstance(alias, str):
            hints = _aggregate_alias_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, agg.function, agg.expression, alias)
            if alias in (hints.integer_columns | hints.bigint_columns | hints.double_columns):
                aliases.add(alias)
    window_hints = _window_function_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, getattr(query_spec, "window_functions", ()) or ())
    if window_hints is not None:
        aliases.update(window_hints.integer_columns | window_hints.bigint_columns | window_hints.double_columns)
    return frozenset(aliases)


def _coerce_numeric_computed_aliases(
    row: dict[str, Any],
    aliases: frozenset[str],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not aliases:
        return row
    converted = dict(row)
    for alias in aliases:
        value = converted.get(alias)
        if not isinstance(value, str):
            continue
        try:
            converted[alias] = int(value)
            continue
        except ValueError:
            pass
        try:
            converted[alias] = float(value)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return converted


def _raw_row_db_to_python_name_map_cache() -> ObjectCache[dict[str, str]]:
    manager = get_cache_manager()
    if not manager.has_cache(_RAW_ROW_DB_TO_PYTHON_NAME_MAP_CACHE_NAME):
        with suppress(ValueError):
            manager.register(
                _RAW_ROW_DB_TO_PYTHON_NAME_MAP_CACHE_NAME,
                ObjectCache[dict[str, str]](
                    CacheConfig(eviction_policy="lru"),
                    name=_RAW_ROW_DB_TO_PYTHON_NAME_MAP_CACHE_NAME,
                    max_entries=4096,
                ),
            )
    cache = manager.get_cache(_RAW_ROW_DB_TO_PYTHON_NAME_MAP_CACHE_NAME)
    assert isinstance(cache, ObjectCache)
    return cache


def _raw_row_db_to_python_name_map_key(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> str:
    return f"{model_cls.__module__}:{model_cls.__qualname__}:{id(model_cls)}"


def _raw_row_db_to_python_name_map(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Return the cached DB columns whose Python field names differ."""

    cache = _raw_row_db_to_python_name_map_cache()
    cache_key = _raw_row_db_to_python_name_map_key(model_cls)
    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        cached_mapping: dict[str, str] = cached
        return cached_mapping
    mapping: dict[str, str] = {}
    for field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
        db_column_name = str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
        if db_column_name != field_name:
            mapping[str(db_column_name)] = field_name
    cache.set(cache_key, mapping)
    return mapping


def _versioned_storage_tables(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Return the physical tables a versioned query may read.

    Write-path reads merge staged+tip, while revision reads use sparse tables.
    The optimizer needs the union of these physical read targets so it can
    preserve read-after-write boundaries across both execution modes.
    """

    from l3250_migrations.versioned_table_helpers import (
        VersionedTableType,
        get_auxiliary_table_name,
    )

    try:
        return frozenset(str(get_auxiliary_table_name(model_cls, table_type)) for table_type in VersionedTableType)
    except TypeError:
        base_table = get_table_name(model_cls)
        return frozenset(f"{base_table}_{table_type.value}" for table_type in VersionedTableType)

def _compile_branch_inputs(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    branch_ref_id: str | None,
) -> tuple[str | None, CteReference | None]:
    """Read branch inputs from compile-time CTEs only."""

    def _literal_from_published_branch(binding: CteReference, field_name: str) -> str | None:
        auxiliary_query = binding.auxiliary_query
        rows_attr = getattr(auxiliary_query, "published_rows", None)
        if rows_attr is None:
            return None
        rows = rows_attr() if callable(rows_attr) else rows_attr
        if not isinstance(rows, Sequence) or isinstance(rows, str | bytes | bytearray):
            return None
        if len(rows) > 1:
            raise ProgrammingError("Branch scalar publication requires at most one row")
        if not rows:
            return None
        row = rows[0]
        if isinstance(row, Mapping):
            value = row.get(field_name)
        elif isinstance(row, Sequence) and not isinstance(row, str | bytes | bytearray) and binding.columns is not None:
            columns = tuple(binding.columns)
            if len(row) != len(columns) or field_name not in columns:
                return None
            value = row[columns.index(field_name)]
        else:
            return None
        return None if value is None else str(value)

    if branch_ref_id is None:
        raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
            site_name="_compile_branch_inputs",
            trigger="versioned query compile() received no explicit branch ref",
            blocked_path="ambient branch lookup from CompilationContext",
            result_contract="versioned query compilation must consume an explicit branch literal or SQL-visible CTE ref",
            implementation_requirements=(
                "Resolve branch inputs before constructing versioned query terminal steps.",
                "Thread the resulting branch_ref_id or typed branch literal through step config.",
                "Do not read ctx.branch_id or planner materialization during versioned query compilation.",
            ),
        )
    resolved_binding = resolve_sql_visible_ref(
        ctx,
        ServerPlanRefId(branch_ref_id),
        default_field="branch_id",
    )
    if resolved_binding is not None:
        branch_cte_ref = resolved_binding.binding
        literal_branch_id = _literal_from_published_branch(branch_cte_ref, resolved_binding.field_name)
        if literal_branch_id is not None:
            return literal_branch_id, branch_cte_ref
        return None, branch_cte_ref

    raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
        site_name="_compile_branch_inputs",
        trigger=f"branch ref {branch_ref_id!r} has no CTE binding during compile()",
        blocked_path="planner-time branch ref resolution outside explicit SQL-visible inputs",
        result_contract="versioned query compilation must derive branch identity from an upstream published CTE ref",
        implementation_requirements=(
            "Publish branch resolution as an explicit upstream ref before versioned query compile().",
            "Thread batch-visible branch refs through ctx.cte_refs instead of planner materialization.",
            "Do not resolve branch ids from ctx.materialized_pipeline in versioned query compilation.",
        ),
    )

def _query_permissions_are_already_bound(query_spec: Any) -> bool:
    if query_spec is None:
        return False
    from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_spec import (
        QueryPermissionState,
        get_query_permission_state,
        query_has_attached_permission_grammar,
        query_has_explicit_permission_bypass,
        query_has_resolved_permission_check,
    )

    if query_has_explicit_permission_bypass(query_spec):
        return True
    if query_has_resolved_permission_check(query_spec):
        return True
    if get_query_permission_state(query_spec) is QueryPermissionState.ATTACHED:
        if not query_has_attached_permission_grammar(query_spec):
            msg = "Explicit attached permission state requires a permission_grammar"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        return True
    return bool(query_has_attached_permission_grammar(query_spec))


def _query_needs_permission_user_ref(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    *,
    action: PermissionAction = PermissionAction("read"),
) -> bool:
    if action == PermissionAction("read") and _query_permissions_are_already_bound(query_spec):
        return False
    from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import (
        _try_get_permission_scheme,
        get_query_permission_plan,
    )

    permission_scheme = _try_get_permission_scheme(model_cls)
    if permission_scheme is None:
        return False
    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_cls, action=action)
    return permission_plan is not None and permission_plan.requires_user_id


def _build_permission_user_ref_steps(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    existing_user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    permission_action: PermissionAction = PermissionAction("read"),
) -> tuple[list[ServerPlanStep[Any]], ServerPlanRefId | None]:
    if existing_user_id_ref_id is not None or not _query_needs_permission_user_ref(
        query_spec,
        model_cls,
        action=permission_action,
    ):
        return [], existing_user_id_ref_id
    session_id = getattr(ctx, "session_id", None)
    if session_id is None:
        return [], None
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

    user_id_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_resolve_uid")
    session_ref = session_id if isinstance(session_id, ScalarServerRef) else ServerRefs.scalar(session_id)
    return [
        SessionUserIdStep(
            user_id_ref_id,
            cast("ScalarServerRef[Any]", session_ref),
        ),
    ], user_id_ref_id
