def _resolve_query_permission_user_cte(
    *,
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    step_name: str,
    permission_action: PermissionAction = PermissionAction("read"),
) -> CteReference | SqlRenderable | None:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import session_user_id_expr
    from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import (
        _try_get_permission_scheme,
        get_query_permission_plan,
    )

    if permission_action == PermissionAction("read") and _query_permissions_are_already_bound(query_spec):
        return None
    permission_scheme = _try_get_permission_scheme(model_cls)
    if permission_scheme is None:
        return None
    session_id = getattr(ctx, "session_id", None)
    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_cls, action=permission_action)
    if permission_plan is not None and not permission_plan.requires_user_id:
        return None
    if user_id_ref_id is None:
        if isinstance(session_id, ScalarServerRef):
            return session_user_id_expr(session_id, ctx)
        raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
            site_name=step_name,
            trigger="guarded versioned query compile() received no published permission user ref",
            blocked_path="compile-time permission-user fallback from ctx.session_id/ctx.txn",
            result_contract=("guarded versioned query compilation must consume an explicit SQL-visible user-id source"),
            implementation_requirements=(
                "Publish a SessionUserIdStep (or equivalent prerequisite) before the guarded query terminal.",
                "Thread the resulting user_id_ref_id through the versioned query step config and dependencies.",
                "Do not compile guarded permission SQL from ambient session state or transaction lookups.",
            ),
        )
    binding = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(user_id_ref_id)) if ctx.cte_refs is not None else None
    if not isinstance(binding, CteReference):
        raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
            site_name=step_name,
            trigger=f"permission user ref {user_id_ref_id!r} has no CTE binding during compile()",
            blocked_path="planner-time permission-user resolution outside explicit SQL-visible inputs",
            result_contract="guarded versioned query compilation must read permission user ids from ctx.cte_refs",
            implementation_requirements=(
                "Ensure the upstream SessionUserIdStep survives lowering and batching.",
                "Thread the published user_id_ref_id into every dependent versioned query terminal.",
                "Do not fall back to ctx.session_id, ctx.txn, or planner materialization for permission users.",
            ),
        )
    if "user_id" not in binding.columns:
        raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
            site_name=step_name,
            trigger=f"permission user ref {user_id_ref_id!r} does not publish a user_id column",
            blocked_path="permission-user SQL cannot infer user identity from a weak CTE binding",
            result_contract="guarded versioned query compilation must read a declared user_id column.",
            implementation_requirements=(
                "Publish permission-user prerequisites with columns=('user_id',) and complete type hints.",
                "Do not pass a name-only or wrong-shaped CTE binding for permission checks.",
            ),
        )
    return binding

def _compile_resolved_ids(
    sys_ids: list[Any] | ScalarSequenceServerRef[Any],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> list[str]:
    """Compile the concrete sys_id list for versioned raw selects."""
    if isinstance(sys_ids, ScalarSequenceServerRef):
        sys_ids_shape: PlanningServerValueShape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            sys_ids,
            site="_compile_resolved_ids",
        )
        ref_id = sys_ids_shape.symbolic_ref_id
        if ref_id is None:
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name="_compile_resolved_ids",
                trigger="versioned sys-id sequence ref has no symbolic id",
                blocked_path="planner-time sys-id resolution for versioned raw selects",
                result_contract="versioned raw select compilation must bind a concrete sys-id list without pipeline fallback",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish dynamic sys-id sequences through an explicit SQL-visible step before compile().",
                    "Do not read sys-id sequences from ctx.materialized_pipeline during versioned query compile().",
                    "Keep opaque sequence refs out of this compile path until raw selects accept explicit SQL-visible sequence sources.",
                ),
            )
        found, literal_ids = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(ref_id))
        if not found:
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name="_compile_resolved_ids",
                trigger=f"versioned sys-id sequence ref {sys_ids.ref_id!r} cannot be compiled from an opaque sequence ref",
                blocked_path="planner-time sys-id resolution for versioned raw selects",
                result_contract="versioned raw select compilation must bind a concrete sys-id list without pipeline fallback",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish dynamic sys-id sequences through an explicit SQL-visible step before compile().",
                    "Do not read sys-id sequences from ctx.materialized_pipeline during versioned query compile().",
                    "Keep opaque sequence refs out of this compile path until raw selects accept explicit SQL-visible sequence sources.",
                ),
            )
        raw_values = list(cast("list[Any]", literal_ids))
    else:
        raw_values = list(sys_ids)

    compiled_ids: list[str] = []
    for value in raw_values:
        if isinstance(value, ServerRef):
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name="_compile_resolved_ids",
                trigger=f"sys-id element {value.ref_id!r} is unresolved during compile()",
                blocked_path="planner-time per-row sys-id fallback for versioned raw selects",
                result_contract="versioned raw select compilation must receive concrete sys_id literals",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Lower dynamic sys-id elements into explicit upstream SQL-visible refs before compile().",
                    "Do not resolve per-row sys-id refs from planner materialization during compile().",
                    "Compile the final SELECT only after sys-id inputs are concrete.",
                ),
            )
        compiled_ids.append(str(value))
    return compiled_ids


def _resolve_sql_visible_id_source(

) -> tuple[str, str, CteReference] | None:

    revision_ref_text = str(revision_ref_id)
    binding = _find_cte_scalar_binding(
        ServerPlanRefId(revision_ref_text),
        ctx,
        default_field="revision_id",
    )
    if binding is not None:
        cte_name, field_name = binding
        return SqlCteFieldRef(ServerPlanRefId(cte_name), SqlColumnName(field_name))
    if revision_ref_text.startswith("seed_"):
        found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(revision_ref_text))
        if found_seed:
            return SqlParam(_stringify_scalar(seed_value))
    raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
        site_name="_effective_query_revision_override",
        trigger=f"{step_name} received revision ref {revision_ref_id!r} without SQL-visible override support",
        blocked_path="planner-time revision override resolution for versioned query compilation",
        result_contract=f"{step_name} must compile with an explicit revision override or inherit ctx.revision_id",
        implementation_requirements=(
            "Thread revision overrides through explicit SQL-visible lowering before compile().",
            "Publish revision override refs as CTE-visible scalar outputs before dependent queries compile.",
            "Do not resolve revision overrides from planner materialization.",
        ),
    )


def _effective_query_revision_override(
    revision_id: RevisionId | None,
    revision_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    step_name: str,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    if revision_ref_id is not None:
        return _lower_revision_override_ref(revision_ref_id, ctx, step_name=step_name)
    if revision_id is None:
        return None
    is_current = getattr(revision_id, "is_current", None)
    if callable(is_current) and is_current():
        return None
    if revision_id is not None:
        return SqlParam(_stringify_scalar(revision_id))
    raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
        site_name=step_name,
        trigger="versioned query compile() received no explicit revision literal or ref",
        blocked_path="ambient revision lookup from CompilationContext",
        result_contract=f"{step_name} must compile with an explicit revision override or SQL-visible revision ref",
        implementation_requirements=(
            "Resolve revision inputs before constructing versioned query terminal steps.",
            "Thread revision_id or revision_ref_id through step config.",
            "Do not read ctx.revision_id during versioned query compilation.",
        ),
    )


def _group_by_inner_projection(column: Any, index: int, model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> Any:
    if isinstance(column, AliasedField):
        return AS(column.field, SchemaObjectName(f"__group_by_{index}"))
    if isinstance(column, AliasedExpression):
        return AliasedExpression(column.expression, SchemaObjectName(f"__group_by_{index}"))
    if isinstance(column, Expression) and column.field is not None and column.function is None and column.operator is None:
        field_name = DynamicFieldName(column.field)
        if field_name not in model_cls.model_fields:
            field_name = get_python_field_name(model_cls, SqlColumnName(field_name))
        return AS(
            get_model_field(model_cls, field_name),
            SchemaObjectName(f"__group_by_{index}"),
        )
    if isinstance(column, Expression):
        return AliasedExpression(column, SchemaObjectName(f"__group_by_{index}"))
    if isinstance(column, Field):
        return AS(column, SchemaObjectName(f"__group_by_{index}"))
    if isinstance(column, str):
        return AS(get_model_field(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(column)), SchemaObjectName(f"__group_by_{index}"))
    return AS(column, SchemaObjectName(f"__group_by_{index}"))


def _group_by_projection_table_name(column: Any, model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> str | None:
    if isinstance(column, AliasedField):
        owner = column.field.owner if isinstance(getattr(column.field, "owner", None), type) else None
        return str(get_table_name(owner)) if owner is not None else str(get_table_name(model_cls))
    if isinstance(column, AliasedExpression):
        expression_owner = getattr(column.expression, "owner", None)
        owner = expression_owner if isinstance(expression_owner, type) else None
        return str(get_table_name(owner)) if owner is not None else str(get_table_name(model_cls))
    owner = getattr(column, "owner", None) if isinstance(getattr(column, "owner", None), type) else None
    return str(get_table_name(owner)) if owner is not None else str(get_table_name(model_cls))


def _projection_identity(column: Any) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    if isinstance(column, AliasedField):
        return _projection_identity(column.field)
    if isinstance(column, AliasedExpression):
        return _projection_identity(column.expression)
    if isinstance(column, Field):
        owner = column.owner if isinstance(getattr(column, "owner", None), type) else None
        return ("field", str(id(owner)), str(column.name))
    if isinstance(column, Expression) and column.field is not None and column.function is None and column.operator is None:
        owner = getattr(column, "owner", None)
        return ("expr_field", str(id(owner if isinstance(owner, type) else None)), str(column.field))
    if isinstance(column, str):
        return ("str", "", column)
    return ("other", "", repr(column))


def _group_by_output_alias(column: Any, index: int, model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> str:
    if isinstance(column, AliasedField):
        return str(column.alias)
    if isinstance(column, AliasedExpression):
        return str(column.alias)
    if isinstance(column, str):
        return str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(column)))
    if isinstance(column, Field):
        owner = column.owner if isinstance(getattr(column, "owner", None), type) else model_cls
        owner_model = cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow]", owner)
        return (
            str(get_db_column_name(owner_model, DynamicFieldName(column.name)))
            if column.name in owner_model.model_fields
            else str(column.name)
        )
    if isinstance(column, Expression) and column.field is not None and column.function is None and column.operator is None:
        expression_owner = getattr(column, "owner", None)
        owner_model = cast(
            "type[DatabaseObjectRow]",
            expression_owner if isinstance(expression_owner, type) else model_cls,
        )
        if column.field in owner_model.model_fields:
            return str(column.field)
        python_field_name = get_python_field_name(owner_model, SqlColumnName(column.field))
        return str(python_field_name) if python_field_name in owner_model.model_fields else str(column.field)
    return f"__group_by_{index}"


def _computed_query_output_shape(
    base_shape: CompiledOutputShape | None,
    query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow],
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> CompiledOutputShape | None:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.versioned_tombstone_projection import (
        VersionedTombstoneProjectionContract,
    )

    tombstone_contract = VersionedTombstoneProjectionContract(
        include_deleted=query_spec.include_deleted,
    )
    fields = [
        synthetic_output_field(
            _group_by_output_alias(column, index, model_cls),
            role="group_by",
        )
        for index, column in enumerate(query_spec.group_by)
    ]
    fields.extend(synthetic_output_field(str(aggregation.alias), role="aggregate") for aggregation in query_spec.aggregations)
    fields.extend(synthetic_output_field(alias, role="window") for _expression, alias in query_spec.window_functions)
    if not fields:
        if _query_spec_has_expression_projection(query_spec):
            return CompiledOutputShape(
                tuple(synthetic_output_field(alias) for alias in _selected_projection_output_aliases(query_spec, model_cls)),
            )
        return base_shape
    if query_spec.window_functions and not query_spec.group_by:
        if base_shape is None:
            return CompiledOutputShape(tuple(fields))
        if tombstone_contract.includes_tombstone_metadata:
            base_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
                tuple(
                    replace(
                        field,
                        output_column=str(
                            tombstone_contract.public_output_column(
                                SqlColumnName(field.output_column),
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                    for field in base_shape.fields
                ),
            )
        return base_shape.with_fields(fields)
    return CompiledOutputShape(tuple(fields))


def _window_source_field_name(arg: Any) -> str | None:
    """Model field referenced by a window/aggregate argument, if any."""
    name = getattr(arg, "name", None)
    if isinstance(name, str) and name:
        return name
    field_name = getattr(arg, "field", None)
    if isinstance(field_name, str) and field_name:
        return field_name
    return None


def _referenced_field_sql_type_hints(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_name: str,
    alias: str,
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    """Hints for an alias whose value carries a referenced model field's type."""
    db_column = str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))) if field_name in model_cls.model_fields else field_name
    source_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, (db_column,))
    cast_target = source_hints.cast_target_for_column(db_column) if source_hints is not None else None
    if cast_target is None:
        msg = (
            f"Window/aggregate expression for alias {alias!r} references field "
            f"{field_name!r} on {model_cls.__name__} with no declared SQL type."
        )
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return sql_column_type_hints_for_declared_sql_types({SqlColumnName(alias): RawSqlText(cast_target.base_type)})


_RANKING_WINDOW_FUNCTIONS = frozenset({"ROW_NUMBER", "RANK", "DENSE_RANK"})
_OFFSET_WINDOW_FUNCTIONS = frozenset({"LAG", "LEAD"})
_COUNTING_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS = frozenset({"COUNT", "COUNT_DISTINCT"})
# SUM/AVG produce arithmetic results; DOUBLE is the declared transport cast
# for these aggregates regardless of the argument's exact numeric type.
_ARITHMETIC_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS = frozenset({"SUM", "AVG"})
# MIN/MAX preserve their argument's type exactly, so the alias inherits the
# referenced model field's declared SQL type.
_ORDER_PRESERVING_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS = frozenset({"MIN", "MAX"})


def _aggregate_alias_sql_column_type_hints(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    function: str,
    expression: Any,
    alias: str,
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    """Declared hints for one aggregate alias, derived from the function kind.

    The type comes constructively from the declared aggregate function and,
    for order-preserving aggregates, the model field the argument references.
    Nothing is inferred from the alias name.
    """
    func_name = function.upper()
    if func_name in _COUNTING_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS:
        return SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({alias}))
    if func_name in _ARITHMETIC_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS:
        return SqlColumnTypeHints(double_columns=frozenset({alias}))
    if func_name in _ORDER_PRESERVING_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS:
        if isinstance(expression, Expression) and expression.function == "CAST":
            from l1000_schema.typed_field import parse_cast_target_type

            args = expression.args or []
            if len(args) != 2:
                raise TypeError("CAST aggregate argument requires an explicit target type")
            target = parse_cast_target_type(args[1].value)
            return sql_column_type_hints_for_declared_sql_types({SqlColumnName(alias): RawSqlText(target.base_type)})
        source_field = _window_source_field_name(expression)
        if source_field is None:
            msg = f"{func_name} aggregate for alias {alias!r} does not reference a model field; declare its SQL type explicitly."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        source_owner = getattr(expression, "owner", None)
        owner_model = source_owner if isinstance(source_owner, type) and issubclass(source_owner, DatabaseObjectRow) else model_cls
        from decimal import Decimal
        from typing import get_args

        annotation = owner_model.model_fields[source_field].annotation
        annotation_types = (annotation, *get_args(annotation))
        if any(
            candidate is Decimal or (isinstance(candidate, type) and issubclass(candidate, Decimal)) for candidate in annotation_types
        ):
            return sql_column_type_hints_for_declared_sql_types({SqlColumnName(alias): RawSqlText("NUMERIC")})
        return _referenced_field_sql_type_hints(owner_model, source_field, alias)
    msg = f"Aggregate function {function!r} for alias {alias!r} has no declared SQL type mapping."
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _group_by_alias_sql_column_type_hints(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    column: Any,
    index: int,
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    alias = _group_by_output_alias(column, index, model_cls)
    expression = column.expression if isinstance(column, AliasedExpression) else column
    if isinstance(column, AliasedField):
        expression = column.field
    if isinstance(expression, Expression):
        if expression.function is not None:
            function_name = expression.function.upper()
            if function_name in {"LOWER", "UPPER", "TRIM", "LTRIM", "RTRIM", "SUBSTR", "CONCAT"}:
                return SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=frozenset({alias}))
            if function_name == "LENGTH":
                return SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({alias}))
        if contains_graph_predicates(expression):
            return SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({alias}))
        if isinstance(expression.value, bool):
            return SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({alias}))
    source_field = _window_source_field_name(expression)
    if source_field is None and isinstance(expression, Field):
        source_field = str(expression.name)
    if source_field is None and isinstance(expression, str):
        source_field = expression
    if source_field is None:
        msg = f"Group-by expression for alias {alias!r} does not reference a model field or known typed SQL function."
        raise TypeError(msg)
    owner = getattr(expression, "owner", None)
    owner_model = cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow]", owner if isinstance(owner, type) else model_cls)
    return _referenced_field_sql_type_hints(owner_model, source_field, alias)


def _window_function_sql_column_type_hints(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    window_functions: Sequence[tuple[Any, str]],
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
    """Declared hints for window-function aliases.

    Types derive constructively from the declared window function kind and the
    model field its argument references; nothing comes from alias names.
    """
    if not window_functions:
        return None
    hints: list[SqlColumnTypeHints] = []
    for window_expr, alias in window_functions:
        alias_name = str(alias)
        func = getattr(window_expr, "func", None)
        func_name = str(getattr(func, "name", "") or "").upper()
        if func_name in _RANKING_WINDOW_FUNCTIONS:
            hints.append(SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({alias_name})))
            continue
        if func_name in _OFFSET_WINDOW_FUNCTIONS:
            args = getattr(func, "args", None) or []
            source_field = _window_source_field_name(args[0]) if args else None
            if source_field is None:
                msg = (
                    f"{func_name} window expression for alias {alias_name!r} does not "
                    f"reference a model field; declare its SQL type explicitly."
                )
                raise TypeError(msg)
            hints.append(_referenced_field_sql_type_hints(model_cls, source_field, alias_name))
            continue
        if func_name in (_COUNTING_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS | _ARITHMETIC_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS | _ORDER_PRESERVING_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS):
            args = getattr(func, "args", None) or []
            hints.append(
                _aggregate_alias_sql_column_type_hints(
                    model_cls,
                    func_name,
                    args[0] if args else None,
                    alias_name,
                ),
            )
            continue
        # Aggregate-over expressions (SUM/AVG/COUNT/MIN/MAX ... OVER (...)).
        agg_function = str(getattr(window_expr, "function", "") or "").upper()
        if agg_function in (_COUNTING_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS | _ARITHMETIC_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS | _ORDER_PRESERVING_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS):
            hints.append(
                _aggregate_alias_sql_column_type_hints(
                    model_cls,
                    agg_function,
                    window_expr,
                    alias_name,
                ),
            )
            continue
        msg = f"Window expression for alias {alias_name!r} ({window_expr!r}) has no declared SQL type mapping."
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
        tuple(str(alias) for _expr, alias in window_functions),
        *hints,
    )


def _compiled_output_shape_type_hints(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    output_shape: CompiledOutputShape | None,
    query_spec: Any | None = None,
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
    def _drop_text_overlaps(hints: SqlColumnTypeHints) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        non_text_columns = (
            hints.jsonb_columns
            | hints.uuid_columns
            | hints.timestamptz_columns
            | hints.date_columns
            | hints.time_columns
            | hints.numeric_columns
            | hints.bool_columns
            | hints.integer_columns
            | hints.bigint_columns
            | hints.double_columns
            | hints.bytea_columns
        )
        return SqlColumnTypeHints(
            jsonb_columns=hints.jsonb_columns,
            uuid_columns=hints.uuid_columns,
            timestamptz_columns=hints.timestamptz_columns,
            date_columns=hints.date_columns,
            time_columns=hints.time_columns,
            numeric_columns=hints.numeric_columns,
            bool_columns=hints.bool_columns,
            integer_columns=hints.integer_columns,
            bigint_columns=hints.bigint_columns,
            double_columns=hints.double_columns,
            text_columns=frozenset(hints.text_columns - non_text_columns),
            bytea_columns=hints.bytea_columns,
            postgres_vector_columns=hints.postgres_vector_columns,
        )

    if output_shape is None:
        return None
    columns = output_shape.cte_output_columns
    from l2070_batching.publication import hinted_columns

    source_projection = getattr(query_spec, "source_read_projection", None)
    source_hints_fn = getattr(source_projection, "sql_column_type_hints", None)
    source_hints = (
        cast("SqlColumnTypeHints", source_hints_fn()).filtered(set(columns)) if callable(source_hints_fn) else SqlColumnTypeHints()
    )
    source_columns = hinted_columns(source_hints)
    model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(
        model_cls,
        tuple(column for column in columns if column not in source_columns),
    )
    hints: list[SqlColumnTypeHints] = [source_hints] if source_hints.has_any() else []
    if model_hints is not None:
        hints.append(model_hints)
    owner_projections: dict[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], list[tuple[str, str]]] = {}
    for output_field in output_shape.fields:
        owner_cls = output_field.owner_cls if isinstance(output_field.owner_cls, type) else model_cls
        field_name = output_field.model_field_name or output_field.output_name
        if field_name in getattr(owner_cls, "model_fields", {}):
            assert issubclass(owner_cls, DatabaseObjectRow)
            owner_projections.setdefault(owner_cls, []).append((field_name, output_field.output_column))
            continue
        source_column = output_field.source_db_column
        if source_column is None:
            continue
        for candidate_field in getattr(owner_cls, "model_fields", {}):
            if source_column == get_db_column_name(owner_cls, DynamicFieldName(candidate_field)):
                assert issubclass(owner_cls, DatabaseObjectRow)
                owner_projections.setdefault(owner_cls, []).append((candidate_field, output_field.output_column))
                break
    # Resolve each owner's annotations once, then rename its declared field hints.
    # A list of projections preserves multiple aliases for the same source field.
    # See docs/design/SERVERPLAN_RESULT_DECODING.rst; no cross-compile schema cache.
    for owner_cls, projections in owner_projections.items():
        owner_hints = model_field_sql_column_type_hints(owner_cls, {field_name: field_name for field_name, _column in projections})
        hints.extend(owner_hints.rename_column(field_name, column) for field_name, column in projections if column not in source_columns)
    if query_spec is not None:
        selected_hints = _simple_select_projection_type_hints(model_cls, query_spec)
        if selected_hints is not None:
            hints.append(selected_hints.filtered(set(columns)))
        group_hints = [
            _group_by_alias_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, group_column, index)
            for index, group_column in enumerate(getattr(query_spec, "group_by", ()) or ())
        ]
        if group_hints:
            hints.append(
                combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    tuple(
                        _group_by_output_alias(group_column, index, model_cls)
                        for index, group_column in enumerate(getattr(query_spec, "group_by", ()) or ())
                    ),
                    *group_hints,
                ),
            )
        window_hints = _window_function_sql_column_type_hints(
            model_cls,
            tuple(getattr(query_spec, "window_functions", ()) or ()),
        )
        if window_hints is not None:
            hints.append(window_hints)
    # Framework-owned physical columns in the projection (versioning
    # adjuncts such as branch_id / sys_valid_*_revision_id) resolve through
    # the framework's declared physical column contract.
    covered = set()
    for hint in hints:
        covered |= set().union(*hint.as_tuple())
    fts_hash_columns = {"sys_fts_hash_short", "sys_fts_hash_high"} & (set(columns) - covered)
    if fts_hash_columns:
        hints.append(
            sql_column_type_hints_for_declared_sql_types(
                {SqlColumnName(column): RawSqlText("BIGINT") for column in sorted(fts_hash_columns)},
            ),
        )
        covered |= fts_hash_columns
    framework_hints = framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints().filtered(set(columns) - covered)
    if framework_hints.has_any():
        hints.append(framework_hints)
    if not hints:
        return None
    return _drop_text_overlaps(combine_sql_column_type_hints(columns, *hints))


def _all_public_result_relation(output_shape: CompiledOutputShape) -> DeclaredResultRelation:
    from l1000_schema.physical_adjuncts import is_framework_physical_adjunct_column

    return DeclaredResultRelation(
        tuple(
            DeclaredResultColumn(
                output_name=field.output_name,
                output_column=field.output_column,
                visibility=("internal" if is_framework_physical_adjunct_column(SqlColumnName(field.output_column)) else "public"),
                terminal_output_name=field.model_field_name or field.output_name,
            )
            for field in output_shape.fields
        ),
    )


_AGGREGATE_PROJECTION_FUNCTIONS = frozenset({"AVG", "COUNT", "JSON_AGG", "MAX", "MIN", "SUM"})


def _contains_aggregate_projection(value: Any) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, AliasedExpression):
        return _contains_aggregate_projection(value.expression)
    if not isinstance(value, Expression):
        return False
    if value.function is not None and str(value.function).upper() in _AGGREGATE_PROJECTION_FUNCTIONS:
        return True
    return any(
        _contains_aggregate_projection(child) for child in (*value.args, value.left, value.right, value.value) if child is not None
    )


def _query_spec_has_aggregate_projection(query_spec: Any) -> bool:
    return any(_contains_aggregate_projection(column) for column in getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", ()) or ())


def _collect_expression_projection_fields(value: Any, output: list[Any]) -> None:
    if isinstance(value, AliasedField):
        output.append(value.field)
        return
    if isinstance(value, AliasedExpression):
        _collect_expression_projection_fields(value.expression, output)
        return
    if isinstance(value, Field):
        output.append(value)
        return
    if not isinstance(value, Expression):
        return
    if value.field is not None and value.function is None and value.operator is None:
        output.append(value)
        return
    for attr_name in ("left", "right"):
        child = getattr(value, attr_name, None)
        if child is not None:
            _collect_expression_projection_fields(child, output)
    for arg in getattr(value, "args", ()) or ():
        _collect_expression_projection_fields(arg, output)


def _aggregate_inner_projection_columns(query_spec: Any) -> list[Any]:
    projections: list[Any] = []
    for aggregation in getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", ()) or ():
        source_expression = getattr(aggregation, "source_expression", None)
        expression = getattr(aggregation, "expression", None)
        _collect_expression_projection_fields(source_expression, projections)
        if expression is not source_expression:
            _collect_expression_projection_fields(expression, projections)
    return projections


def _selected_projection_field_names(query_spec: Any) -> set[str]:
    names: set[str] = set()
    for column in getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", ()) or ():
        if isinstance(column, AliasedField):
            names.add(column.name)
            continue
        if isinstance(column, AliasedExpression):
            expression = column.expression
            if expression.field is not None and expression.function is None and expression.operator is None:
                names.add(expression.field)
            continue
        if isinstance(column, Field):
            names.add(column.name)
            continue
        if isinstance(column, Expression) and column.field is not None and column.function is None and column.operator is None:
            names.add(column.field)
            continue
        if isinstance(column, str):
            names.add(column)
    return names


@pure_lazy
def _selected_projection_output_aliases(query_spec: Any, model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    declared_aliases = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "projection_output_aliases", ()) or ())
    if declared_aliases:
        return declared_aliases
    aliases: list[str] = []
    for column in getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", ()) or ():
        if isinstance(column, str):
            aliases.append(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(column)) if column in model_cls.model_fields else column)
            continue
        if isinstance(column, (AliasedField, AliasedExpression)):
            aliases.append(column.alias)
            continue
        if isinstance(column, Field):
            owner_model = cast(
                "type[DatabaseObjectRow]",
                column.owner if isinstance(getattr(column, "owner", None), type) else model_cls,
            )
            aliases.append(polymorphic_read_column_name(owner_model, column.name))
            continue
        if isinstance(column, Expression) and column.field is not None and column.function is None and column.operator is None:
            owner_model = cast(
                "type[DatabaseObjectRow]",
                column.owner if isinstance(getattr(column, "owner", None), type) else model_cls,
            )
            aliases.append(polymorphic_read_column_name(owner_model, column.field))
    return tuple(aliases)


def _raw_projection_has_complete_output_aliases(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> bool:
    select_columns = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", ()) or ())
    declared_aliases = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "projection_output_aliases", ()) or ())
    return (bool(declared_aliases) or any(isinstance(column, AliasedExpression) for column in select_columns)) and len(
        _selected_projection_output_aliases(query_spec, model_cls)
    ) == len(select_columns)


def _query_spec_for_model_materialization(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> Any:
    select_columns = getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None)
    if not select_columns:
        return query_spec
    selected_aliases = {SqlColumnName(alias) for alias in _selected_projection_output_aliases(query_spec, model_cls)}
    required_columns = {get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in model_cls.model_fields}
    required_columns.difference_update(
        {
            SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"),
            SqlColumnName("sys_revision_id"),
            SqlColumnName("sys_staged_commit_id"),
        },
    )
    missing_columns = tuple(sorted(required_columns - selected_aliases))
    if not missing_columns:
        return query_spec
    msg = f"Full-model materialization projection omits required model columns: {missing_columns}"
    raise ValueError(msg)


def _query_spec_with_public_projection(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    public_columns: tuple[str, ...],
) -> Any:
    """Add referenced support fields required by the public SQL projection."""
    select_columns = getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None)
    if not select_columns:
        return query_spec
    query_spec = _query_spec_without_duplicate_projection_fields(query_spec, model_cls)
    select_columns = getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None)
    assert select_columns
    selected_aliases = set(_selected_projection_output_aliases(query_spec, model_cls))
    referenced_fields: dict[str, Field[Any, Any]] = {}

    def _collect_referenced_fields(expr: Any) -> None:
        if isinstance(expr, Field):
            owner = expr.owner if isinstance(getattr(expr, "owner", None), type) else model_cls
            if expr.name in getattr(owner, "model_fields", {}):
                referenced_fields.setdefault(get_db_column_name(owner, DynamicFieldName(expr.name)), expr)
            return
        if not isinstance(expr, Expression):
            return
        if expr.field is not None:
            expression_owner = getattr(expr, "owner", None)
            owner_model = cast(
                "type[DatabaseObjectRow]",
                expression_owner if isinstance(expression_owner, type) else model_cls,
            )
            if expr.field in getattr(owner_model, "model_fields", {}):
                referenced_fields.setdefault(
                    get_db_column_name(owner_model, DynamicFieldName(expr.field)),
                    field(getattr(owner_model, expr.field)),
                )
        _collect_referenced_fields(getattr(expr, "value", None))
        _collect_referenced_fields(getattr(expr, "left", None))
        _collect_referenced_fields(getattr(expr, "right", None))
        for arg in getattr(expr, "args", ()) or ():
            _collect_referenced_fields(arg)

    order_columns: list[str] = []
    for order_entry in getattr(query_spec, "order_by", ()) or ():
        if not isinstance(order_entry, tuple) or len(order_entry) != 2:
            continue
        order_column = order_entry[0]
        if isinstance(order_column, str) and order_column in model_cls.model_fields:
            db_column = str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(order_column)))
            referenced_fields.setdefault(db_column, field(getattr(model_cls, order_column)))
            order_columns.append(db_column)
        else:
            _collect_referenced_fields(order_column)
            if isinstance(order_column, Field):
                owner = order_column.owner if isinstance(getattr(order_column, "owner", None), type) else model_cls
                order_columns.append(get_db_column_name(owner, DynamicFieldName(order_column.name)))
            elif isinstance(order_column, Expression) and order_column.field is not None:
                expression_owner = getattr(order_column, "owner", None)
                owner_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow] = expression_owner if isinstance(expression_owner, type) else model_cls
                order_columns.append(get_db_column_name(owner_model, DynamicFieldName(order_column.field)))

    required_columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*public_columns, *order_columns)))
    missing_columns = set(required_columns) - selected_aliases
    if not missing_columns:
        return query_spec

    for field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
        db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
        if str(db_column) in missing_columns and field_name not in selected_aliases:
            referenced_fields.setdefault(str(db_column), field(getattr(model_cls, field_name)))

    for query_filter in getattr(query_spec, "filters", ()) or ():
        _collect_referenced_fields(getattr(query_filter, "expression", None))
    _collect_referenced_fields(getattr(query_spec, "permission_grammar", None))
    for join in getattr(query_spec, "joins", ()) or ():
        _collect_referenced_fields(getattr(join, "on_left", None))
        _collect_referenced_fields(getattr(join, "on_right", None))
        _collect_referenced_fields(getattr(join, "on_predicate", None))

    support_fields = tuple(
        referenced_fields[column] for column in required_columns if column in missing_columns and column in referenced_fields
    )
    if not support_fields:
        return query_spec
    original_tables = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "select_column_tables", ()) or ())
    support_tables = tuple(str(get_table_name(support_field.owner)) for support_field in support_fields)

    def _projection_owner_table(column: Any) -> str | None:
        projection = _simple_select_projection_field(model_cls, column, 0)
        if projection is None:
            return None
        owner_model, field_name, _output_column = projection
        if field_name in model_cls.model_fields and (not isinstance(column, AliasedField) or model_cls.__name__ in column.alias):
            owner_model = model_cls
        return str(get_table_name(owner_model))

    query_tables = {
        str(get_table_name(model_cls)),
        *(str(get_table_name(join.target_model)) for join in getattr(query_spec, "joins", ()) or ()),
    }
    selected_tables = tuple(
        original_tables[index]
        if (index < len(original_tables) and original_tables[index] is not None and original_tables[index] in query_tables)
        else _projection_owner_table(column)
        for index, column in enumerate(select_columns)
    )
    return _replace_query_spec(
        query_spec,
        select_columns=(*select_columns, *support_fields),
        select_column_tables=(*selected_tables, *support_tables),
    )


def _query_spec_requires_full_model_materialization_guard(query_spec: Any) -> bool:
    select_columns = getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None)
    return any(isinstance(column, str) or isinstance(column, Field) for column in select_columns or ())


def _query_spec_without_duplicate_projection_fields(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> Any:
    """Remove repeated projections of the same source field under the same name."""
    select_columns = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", ()) or ())
    select_column_tables = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "select_column_tables", ()) or ())
    retained_columns: list[Any] = []
    retained_tables: list[Any] = []
    seen: set[tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], str, str]] = set()
    seen_output_aliases: set[str] = set()
    for index, column in enumerate(select_columns):
        projection = _simple_select_projection_field(model_cls, column, index)
        output_alias = (
            projection[2]
            if projection is not None
            else str(column.alias)
            if isinstance(column, AliasedExpression | AliasedField)
            else None
        )
        if (projection is not None and projection in seen) or (output_alias is not None and output_alias in seen_output_aliases):
            continue
        if projection is not None:
            seen.add(projection)
        if output_alias is not None:
            seen_output_aliases.add(output_alias)
        retained_columns.append(column)
        if select_column_tables:
            retained_tables.append(select_column_tables[index] if index < len(select_column_tables) else None)
    if len(retained_columns) == len(select_columns):
        return query_spec
    return _replace_query_spec(
        query_spec,
        select_columns=tuple(retained_columns),
        select_column_tables=tuple(retained_tables) if select_column_tables else select_column_tables,
    )


@pure_lazy
def _projection_storage_owner(
    owner_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_name: DynamicFieldName,
) -> type[DatabaseObjectRow]:
    """Resolve storage metadata without changing the field's relation owner."""
    if field_name in owner_model.model_fields:
        return owner_model
    matches = {
        field_plan.owner_cls
        for field_plan in build_read_metadata_plan_lazy(owner_model).field_plans
        if field_plan.field_name == field_name
    }
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Ambiguous polymorphic projection field {owner_model.__name__}.{field_name}")
    storage_owner = matches.pop()
    assert issubclass(storage_owner, DatabaseObjectRow)
    return storage_owner


@pure_lazy
def _simple_select_projection_field(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    column: Any,
    index: int,
) -> tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], DynamicFieldName, SqlColumnName] | None:
    if isinstance(column, AliasedField):
        owner = column.field.owner if isinstance(getattr(column.field, "owner", None), type) else model_cls
        owner_model = _projection_storage_owner(
            cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow]", owner),
            DynamicFieldName(column.field.name),
        )
        return owner_model, column.field.name, SqlColumnName(column.alias)
    if isinstance(column, AliasedExpression):
        expression = column.expression
        if expression.field is None or expression.function is not None or expression.operator is not None:
            return None
        owner = getattr(expression, "owner", None)
        relation_owner = cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow]", owner if isinstance(owner, type) else model_cls)
        owner_model = _projection_storage_owner(relation_owner, DynamicFieldName(expression.field))
        return owner_model, DynamicFieldName(expression.field), SqlColumnName(column.alias)
    if isinstance(column, Field):
        owner = column.owner if isinstance(getattr(column, "owner", None), type) else model_cls
        relation_owner = cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow]", owner)
        source_name = DynamicFieldName(column.name)
        owner_model = _projection_storage_owner(relation_owner, source_name)
        output_column = get_db_column_name(owner_model, source_name)
        return owner_model, column.name, output_column
    if isinstance(column, Expression):
        if column.field is None or column.function is not None or column.operator is not None:
            return None
        owner = getattr(column, "owner", None)
        relation_owner = cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow]", owner if isinstance(owner, type) else model_cls)
        source_name = DynamicFieldName(column.field)
        owner_model = _projection_storage_owner(relation_owner, source_name)
        output_column = get_db_column_name(owner_model, source_name)
        return owner_model, source_name, output_column
    if isinstance(column, str):
        source_name = DynamicFieldName(column)
        if source_name in model_cls.model_fields:
            return model_cls, source_name, get_db_column_name(model_cls, source_name)
        matches = {
            (field_plan.owner_cls, field_plan.field_name, field_plan.db_column)
            for field_plan in build_read_metadata_plan_lazy(model_cls).field_plans
            if field_plan.field_name == source_name or field_plan.db_column == source_name
        }
        if len(matches) > 1:
            msg = f"Ambiguous polymorphic projection field {model_cls.__name__}.{source_name}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if matches:
            owner_model, logical_name, db_column = matches.pop()
            assert issubclass(owner_model, DatabaseObjectRow)
            return owner_model, DynamicFieldName(logical_name), SqlColumnName(db_column)
        return model_cls, source_name, SqlColumnName(source_name)
    return None


@pure_lazy
def _query_spec_projection_models_by_table(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
) -> dict[str, type[DatabaseObjectRow]]:
    models: list[type[DatabaseObjectRow]] = [model_cls]
    for join in getattr(query_spec, "joins", ()) or ():
        target_model = getattr(join, "target_model", None)
        if isinstance(target_model, type):
            models.append(cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow]", target_model))
    models_by_table: dict[str, type[DatabaseObjectRow]] = {}
    for candidate in models:
        table_name = str(get_table_name(candidate))
        models_by_table[table_name] = candidate
        models_by_table[derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(table_name))).tip] = candidate
        models_by_table[derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(table_name))).staged] = candidate
        models_by_table[derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(table_name))).sparse] = candidate
    return models_by_table


def _simple_select_projection_columns(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
    select_columns = getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None)
    if not select_columns:
        return None
    projected: list[str] = []
    for index, column in enumerate(select_columns):
        field_projection = _simple_select_projection_field(model_cls, column, index)
        if field_projection is None:
            return None
        owner_model, field_name, output_column = field_projection
        if field_name not in getattr(owner_model, "model_fields", {}):
            return None
        projected.append(output_column)
    if any(
        column in projected
        for column in (
            "branch_id",
            "sys_valid_from_revision_id",
            "sys_valid_to_revision_id",
        )
    ):
        data_columns = tuple(
            column
            for column in projected
            if column
            not in {
                "branch_id",
                "sys_valid_from_revision_id",
                "sys_valid_to_revision_id",
            }
        )
        system_columns = (
            "sys_id",
            "sys_created_at",
            "sys_updated_at",
            "sys_revision_id",
            "sys_staged_commit_id",
            "sys_deleted",
        )
        return tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                (
                    *(column for column in system_columns if column in projected or column != "sys_id"),
                    *data_columns,
                ),
            ),
        )
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(projected)) or None


def _physical_db_column_for_filter_field(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field: Any,
) -> str | None:
    """Resolve a filter's field reference to a physical DB column name.

    Framework/graph columns such as ``graph_sys_id`` are filterable via
    ``field(Model.graph_sys_id)`` but are not user-declared ``model_fields``
    (graph nodes declare the ``graph_id`` field whose physical column is
    ``graph_sys_id``). When a filter references such a physical column the
    compiler still materializes it in the CTE output, so the publication
    contract must account for it too or the data-modifying CTE publication
    invariant rejects the plan. Returns ``None`` when the reference is not a
    physical column of the model.
    """
    field_name = str(field)
    if field_name in returnable_db_columns(model_cls):
        return field_name
    return None


def _collect_expression_field_columns(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    expr: Any,
    columns: list[str],
    published_columns: dict[tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], str], str],
) -> None:
    if not isinstance(expr, Expression):
        return
    if expr.field is not None:
        owner = getattr(expr, "owner", None)
        owner_model = cast("type[DatabaseObjectRow]", owner if isinstance(owner, type) else model_cls)
        if expr.field in getattr(owner_model, "model_fields", {}):
            columns.append(
                published_columns.get(
                    (owner_model, expr.field),
                    get_db_column_name(owner_model, DynamicFieldName(expr.field)),
                )
            )
        else:
            physical_column = _physical_db_column_for_filter_field(owner_model, expr.field)
            if physical_column is not None:
                columns.append(physical_column)
    for child in (getattr(expr, "left", None), getattr(expr, "right", None), *(getattr(expr, "args", None) or ())):
        _collect_expression_field_columns(model_cls, child, columns, published_columns)


def _query_spec_filter_support_columns(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Collect physical DB columns referenced by a query spec's filters.

    These are the "support" columns the compiled CTE materializes so filter and
    permission predicates can be evaluated (and, for server-ref-bound filters
    such as ``graph_sys_id``, late-bound). The publication contract must include
    them so it covers the compiled output shape, otherwise the data-modifying CTE
    publication invariant rejects the plan.
    """
    if query_spec is None:
        return ()
    support_columns: list[str] = []
    joined_models = {join.target_model for join in query_spec.joins}
    read_shape = build_read_metadata_plan(model_cls)
    published_columns = {
        (field_plan.owner_cls, field_plan.field_name): field_plan.cte_output_column
        for field_plan in read_shape.field_plans
        if field_plan.owner_cls not in joined_models
    }
    for query_filter in getattr(query_spec, "filters", ()) or ():
        expression = getattr(query_filter, "expression", None)
        if expression is None:
            column = getattr(query_filter, "column", None)
            if isinstance(column, str):
                if column in getattr(model_cls, "model_fields", {}):
                    support_columns.append(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(column)))
                else:
                    physical_column = _physical_db_column_for_filter_field(model_cls, column)
                    if physical_column is not None:
                        support_columns.append(physical_column)
        else:
            _collect_expression_field_columns(model_cls, expression, support_columns, published_columns)
    for order_entry in getattr(query_spec, "order_by", ()) or ():
        order_expression = order_entry[0] if isinstance(order_entry, tuple) and order_entry else order_entry
        if isinstance(order_expression, str):
            if order_expression in getattr(model_cls, "model_fields", {}):
                support_columns.append(
                    get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(order_expression)),
                )
            else:
                physical_column = _physical_db_column_for_filter_field(
                    model_cls,
                    order_expression,
                )
                if physical_column is not None:
                    support_columns.append(physical_column)
        else:
            _collect_expression_field_columns(
                model_cls,
                order_expression,
                support_columns,
                published_columns,
            )
    _collect_expression_field_columns(
        model_cls,
        getattr(query_spec, "permission_grammar", None),
        support_columns,
        published_columns,
    )
    return tuple(
        column for column in dict.fromkeys(support_columns) if column not in {"sys_revision_id", "sys_deleted", "sys_staged_commit_id"}
    )


def _graph_identity_projection_columns(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return tuple(
        str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
        for field_name in ("graph_sys_id", "source_sys_id", "target_sys_id")
        if field_name in model_cls.model_fields
    )


def _physical_query_spec_support_columns(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Return predicate and ordering columns that exist in the SQL row shape."""
    physical_columns = {str(column) for column in get_db_column_map(model_cls).values()}
    for join in getattr(query_spec, "joins", ()) or ():
        physical_columns.update(str(column) for column in get_db_column_map(join.target_model).values())
    physical_columns.update(
        {
            "branch_id",
            "branch_ord",
            "branch_hash32",
            "graph_hash32",
            "sys_valid_from_seq",
            "sys_valid_to_seq",
        },
    )
    from l1000_schema.dynamic_field_utils import is_dynamic_property_field

    if _query_spec_has_aggregate_projection(query_spec):
        return ()
    support_columns: list[str] = []
    for selected_column in getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", ()) or ():
        if isinstance(selected_column, str) and is_dynamic_property_field(
            model_cls,
            DynamicFieldName(selected_column),
        ):
            support_columns.append("properties")
    for column in _query_spec_filter_support_columns(model_cls, query_spec):
        column_name = str(column)
        if column_name == "sys_deleted":
            continue
        if column_name in physical_columns:
            support_columns.append(column_name)
        elif is_dynamic_property_field(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(column_name)):
            support_columns.append("properties")
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(support_columns))


def _runtime_projection_columns(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
    selected_columns = _simple_select_projection_columns(model_cls, query_spec)
    if selected_columns is None:
        return None
    support_columns = _query_spec_filter_support_columns(model_cls, query_spec)
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*selected_columns, *support_columns)))


@pure_lazy
def _tuple_projection_alias_fields(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
) -> dict[str, tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], str]]:
    """Resolve closed tuple aliases to their declared model fields."""
    models: list[type[DatabaseObjectRow]] = [model_cls]
    for subtype in get_all_concrete_subtypes(model_cls):
        if isinstance(subtype, type) and issubclass(subtype, DatabaseObjectRow):
            models.append(subtype)
    for source_model in getattr(query_spec, "polymorphic_source_models", ()) or ():
        if isinstance(source_model, type) and hasattr(source_model, "model_fields"):
            models.append(source_model)
    for join in getattr(query_spec, "joins", ()) or ():
        target_model = getattr(join, "target_model", None)
        if isinstance(target_model, type) and hasattr(target_model, "model_fields"):
            models.append(target_model)

    resolved: dict[str, tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], str]] = {}
    for column in columns:
        if column.startswith("_tuple_base_"):
            field_name = column.removeprefix("_tuple_base_")
            owner = next(
                (candidate for candidate in models if field_name in candidate.model_fields),
                None,
            )
            if owner is not None:
                resolved[column] = owner, field_name
            continue
        if not column.startswith("_tuple_join_field_"):
            continue
        remainder = column.removeprefix("_tuple_join_field_")
        for candidate in models:
            prefix = f"{candidate.__name__}_"
            if remainder.startswith(prefix):
                field_name = remainder.removeprefix(prefix)
                if field_name in candidate.model_fields:
                    resolved[column] = candidate, field_name
                    break
    return resolved


@pure_lazy
def _tuple_projection_alias_type_hints(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
    """Type tuple-projection aliases when only their closed output names remain."""
    hint_sources = [
        model_field_sql_column_type_hints(owner, {field_name: column})
        for column, (owner, field_name) in _tuple_projection_alias_fields(
            model_cls,
            query_spec,
            columns,
        ).items()
    ]
    if not hint_sources:
        return None
    return combine_sql_column_type_hints(columns, *hint_sources)


@pure_lazy
def _simple_select_projection_type_hints(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
    select_columns = getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None)
    if not select_columns:
        return None
    hint_sources: list[SqlColumnTypeHints] = []
    columns: list[str] = []
    projection_models_by_table = _query_spec_projection_models_by_table(model_cls, query_spec)
    select_column_tables = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "select_column_tables", ()) or ())
    declared_output_aliases = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "projection_output_aliases", ()) or ())
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import (
        _expression_function_type_hints,
        _function_output_type_hints,
    )

    comparison_operators = {"=", "==", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=", "eq", "ne", "lt", "le", "gt", "ge"}
    declared_output_aliases = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "projection_output_aliases", ()) or ())
    for index, column in enumerate(select_columns):
        if isinstance(column, AliasedExpression):
            if column.expression.logical_op is not None or column.expression.operator in comparison_operators:
                columns.append(column.alias)
                hint_sources.append(SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({column.alias})))
                continue
            if column.expression.function is not None:
                columns.append(column.alias)
                hint_sources.append(
                    _expression_function_type_hints(model_cls, column.expression, column.alias),
                )
                continue
        field_projection = _simple_select_projection_field(model_cls, column, index)
        if field_projection is None:
            continue
        owner_model, field_name, output_column = field_projection
        if index < len(declared_output_aliases):
            output_column = SqlColumnName(declared_output_aliases[index])
        if index < len(select_column_tables):
            table_name = select_column_tables[index]
            table_owner = projection_models_by_table.get(str(table_name)) if table_name is not None else None
            if table_owner is not None and field_name in getattr(table_owner, "model_fields", {}):
                owner_model = table_owner
        columns.append(output_column)
        if field_name not in getattr(owner_model, "model_fields", {}):
            from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name

            if any(str(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)) == field_name for config in get_large_column_configs(owner_model)):
                hint_sources.append(SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=frozenset({output_column})))
                continue
            from l1000_schema.dynamic_field_utils import get_json_get_type_hint

            json_function = get_json_get_type_hint(owner_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            if json_function is not None:
                hint_sources.append(
                    _function_output_type_hints(json_function, output_column),
                )
            continue
        hint_sources.append(model_field_sql_column_type_hints(owner_model, {field_name: output_column}))
    if not hint_sources:
        return None
    projection_columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))
    combined = combine_sql_column_type_hints(projection_columns, *hint_sources)
    from l2070_batching.publication import hinted_columns

    missing = tuple(column for column in projection_columns if column not in hinted_columns(combined))
    if not missing:
        return combined
    support_hints = _joined_projection_support_type_hints(model_cls, query_spec, missing)
    if support_hints is None:
        return combined
    return combine_sql_column_type_hints(projection_columns, combined, support_hints)


@pure_lazy
def _joined_projection_support_type_hints(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
    """Resolve support-column types from the base model and typed joins."""
    models: list[type[DatabaseObjectRow]] = [model_cls]
    for source_model in getattr(query_spec, "polymorphic_source_models", ()) or ():
        if isinstance(source_model, type) and hasattr(source_model, "model_fields"):
            models.append(source_model)
    projection_model = getattr(query_spec, "projection_model_cls", None)
    if isinstance(projection_model, type) and hasattr(projection_model, "model_fields"):
        models.append(projection_model)
    for join in getattr(query_spec, "joins", ()):
        target_model = getattr(join, "target_model", None)
        if isinstance(target_model, type) and hasattr(target_model, "model_fields"):
            models.append(target_model)
    by_owner: dict[type[DatabaseObjectRow], dict[str, str]] = {}
    column_maps = [(owner, get_db_column_map(owner)) for owner in models]
    for column in columns:
        for owner, column_map in column_maps:
            for field_name, physical_name in column_map.items():
                if physical_name == column:
                    by_owner.setdefault(owner, {})[field_name] = column
                    break
            else:
                continue
            break
    hints = [model_field_sql_column_type_hints(owner, mapping) for owner, mapping in by_owner.items()]
    if hints:
        combined = combine_sql_column_type_hints(columns, *hints)
        from l2070_batching.publication import hinted_columns

        missing = tuple(column for column in columns if column not in hinted_columns(combined))
    else:
        combined = None
        missing = columns
    if missing:
        framework_hints = framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints().filtered(set(missing))
        if framework_hints.has_any():
            hints.append(framework_hints)
    if not hints:
        return None
    return combine_sql_column_type_hints(columns, *hints)


def _query_spec_with_large_column_pointer_projection(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> Any:
    select_columns = getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None)
    if not select_columns:
        return query_spec
    selected_names = _selected_projection_field_names(query_spec)
    augmented_columns = list(select_columns)
    added_column_count = 0
    projection_changed = False
    selected_large_columns = {
        str(config.column)
        for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
        if str(config.column) in selected_names or str(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)) in selected_names
    }
    if selected_large_columns and "sys_id" not in selected_names:
        augmented_columns.append(Expression(field="sys_id"))
        added_column_count += 1
    for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        pointer_name = large_column_pointer_name(config.column)
        if str(config.column) not in selected_names and str(pointer_name) not in selected_names:
            continue
        pointer_is_model_field = pointer_name in model_cls.model_fields
        if pointer_name in selected_names:
            for index, column in enumerate(augmented_columns):
                is_pointer_projection = (
                    (isinstance(column, str) and column == pointer_name)
                    or (isinstance(column, Field) and column.name == DynamicFieldName(pointer_name))
                    or (
                        isinstance(column, AliasedField)
                        and (column.name == DynamicFieldName(pointer_name) or column.alias == SchemaObjectName(pointer_name))
                    )
                    or (
                        isinstance(column, Expression)
                        and column.field == pointer_name
                        and column.function is None
                        and column.operator is None
                    )
                )
                if is_pointer_projection:
                    output_alias = column.alias if isinstance(column, AliasedField) else SchemaObjectName(pointer_name)
                    augmented_columns[index] = (
                        AS(
                            get_model_field(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(pointer_name)),
                            output_alias,
                        )
                        if pointer_is_model_field
                        else Expression(field=pointer_name).as_(output_alias)
                    )
                    projection_changed = True
            continue
        augmented_columns.append(
            AS(
                get_model_field(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(pointer_name)),
                SchemaObjectName(pointer_name),
            )
            if pointer_is_model_field
            else Expression(field=pointer_name)
        )
        added_column_count += 1
    if added_column_count == 0 and not projection_changed:
        return query_spec
    select_column_tables = getattr(query_spec, "select_column_tables", None)
    if select_column_tables:
        select_column_tables = (
            *tuple(select_column_tables),
            *(get_table_name(model_cls) for _ in range(added_column_count)),
        )
    return replace(
        query_spec,
        select_columns=augmented_columns,
        select_column_tables=select_column_tables,
    )


def _normalize_first_query_spec(
    query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
    *,
    strict_one: bool,
    step_name: str,
) -> QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow]:
    required_spec = _require_query_spec(query_spec, step_name=step_name)
    if required_spec.limit is not None:
        return required_spec
    target_limit = 2 if strict_one else 1
    return replace(required_spec, limit=target_limit)


def _count_query_spec(
    query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
    *,
    step_name: str,
) -> QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow]:
    required_spec = _require_query_spec(query_spec, step_name=step_name)
    if not required_spec.distinct:
        required_spec = replace(
            required_spec,
            select_columns=None,
            select_column_tables=(),
        )
    return replace(required_spec, order_by=[], limit=None, offset=None)


def build_versioned_query_from_spec_standard_post_op(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    *,
    query_spec: Any,
    returns_raw_rows: bool,
    include_deleted: bool,
    numeric_computed_aliases: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
    input_relation: DeclaredResultRelation | None = None,
) -> CompiledPostOp:
    """Return raw rows or inline-hydrated models for versioned SELECTs."""
    if returns_raw_rows:
        return row_dicts_post_op()
    # Compilation owns the model relation. Reaching model hydration without it
    # is an internal construction error, not a runtime result-shaping branch.
    assert input_relation is not None, "Model hydration requires a declared input relation"
    return CompiledPostOp.materialize(
        ResultMaterializationSpec(
            behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_ARRAY,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            input_relation=input_relation,
            raw_mode=False,
            # Keep versioned projection metadata closed inside the post-op spec;
            # do not recover it from runtime refs.
            literal_payload={
                "returns_raw_rows": False,
                "include_deleted": include_deleted,
                "numeric_computed_aliases": numeric_computed_aliases,
                "projection_output_aliases": (),
            },
        ),
    )


def _resolved_mapping_rows(value: object) -> list[Mapping[str, object]]:
    if value is None or isinstance(value, CteReference):
        return []
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return [value]
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
        rows: list[Mapping[str, object]] = []
        for item in value:
            if isinstance(item, Mapping):
                rows.append(item)
        return rows
    return []


def _normalize_query_revision_source(
    revision_source: object,
    *,
    step_name: str,
) -> tuple[RevisionId | None, ServerPlanRefId | None]:
    if revision_source is None:
        return None, None
    if isinstance(revision_source, ServerPlanRefId):
        return None, revision_source
    if isinstance(revision_source, RevisionId):
        return revision_source, None
    if isinstance(revision_source, str):
        return None, ServerPlanRefId(revision_source)
    try:
        revision_shape: PlanningServerValueShape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            revision_source,
            site=step_name,
        )
    except TypeError:
        return None, None
    if revision_shape.symbolic_ref_id is not None:
        return None, revision_shape.symbolic_ref_id
    return None, None

def _post_process_project_versioned_first_value(
    config: _ProjectVersionedFirstValueConfig,
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    _hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> object | None:
    rows = _resolved_mapping_rows(runtime_refs.get(str(config.source_ref)))
    if config.strict_one and len(rows) > 1:
        msg = f"Multiple results: execute_one() returned more than one result ({len(rows)}+ rows)"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if not rows:
        return None
    raw_val = rows[0].get(config.column_projection)
    if raw_val is None and config.source_column_projection is not None:
        raw_val = rows[0].get(config.source_column_projection)
    if raw_val is None:

    return _coerce_projected_value(config.model_cls, config.column_projection, raw_val)


def _source_column_for_first_projection(
    query_spec: Any,
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    column_projection: str | None,
) -> str | None:
    if column_projection is None:
        return None
    for selected in getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", ()) or ():
        alias = getattr(selected, "alias", None)
        if alias != column_projection:
            continue
        if isinstance(selected, AliasedField):
            return str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(selected.name)))
        if isinstance(selected, AliasedExpression):
            expression = selected.expression
            field_name = getattr(expression, "field", None)
            if isinstance(field_name, str):
                return str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
    return None


def _versioned_first_value_type_hints(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    *,
    output_column: str,
    source_column: str | None,
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    candidate_columns = (source_column, output_column)
    for candidate_column in candidate_columns:
        if candidate_column is None:
            continue
        for field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
            if candidate_column in {field_name, get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))}:
                return model_field_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, {field_name: output_column})
    if source_column is None:
        return SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({output_column}))
    msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {model_cls.__name__}.{output_column}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


class _ProjectVersionedFirstValueStep(MaybeSqlRelationPublisherStep[object | None]):
