        columns = (self._config.column_projection,)
        column_type_hints = _versioned_first_value_type_hints(
            self._config.model_cls, output_column=self._config.column_projection, source_column=self._config.source_column_projection
        )
        if columns is None:
            if column_type_hints is not None and column_type_hints.has_any():
                msg = f"{type(self).__name__} declares SQL column type hints without an explicit cte_output_columns() contract."
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        source_column = self._config.source_column_projection
        projection_lineage = tuple(
            (column, str(source_column) if len(contract_columns) == 1 and source_column is not None else column)
            for column in contract_columns
        )
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.projection_over_model(
                source_model_cls=self._config.model_cls,
                projection_lineage=projection_lineage,
            ),
            relation_role=VERSIONED_SEMANTIC_RESULT_ROLE,
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(
        self: _ProjectVersionedFirstValueStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[object | None]:
        source_ref = str(self._config.source_ref)
        source_column = self._config.source_column_projection or self._config.column_projection
        binding = _find_cte_scalar_binding(
            ServerPlanRefId(source_ref),
            ctx,
            default_field=source_column,
        )
        if binding is None:
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"compile-time first-value projection for {source_ref!r} without a published CTE binding",
                blocked_path="runtime projection of versioned first-value scalar before SQL consumers can see it",
                result_contract="versioned first-value projections must publish a SQL-visible scalar binding before compilation",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Lower first-value projections into explicit SQL projection steps.",
                    "Keep first-value scalar publication SQL-visible through ctx.cte_refs.",
                    "Do not resolve first-value scalars in Python during compile().",
                ),
            )
        source_cte_name, bound_source_column = binding
        source_field = bound_source_column
        auxiliary_ctes = collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.dependencies(), source_cte_name)
        output_column = self._config.column_projection
        __opa002_grammar_1830 = SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides(
            source_cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(source_cte_name),
            source_columns=(output_column,),
            overrides={
                output_column: SqlCteFieldRef(
                    ServerPlanRefId(source_cte_name),
                    SqlColumnName(source_field),
                ),
            },
            column_type_hints=self.cte_column_type_hints(),
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_1830,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
                self._config.column_projection,
                default_value=None,
                use_default_on_empty=True,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=(auxiliary_ctes or None),
        )

def _lower_revision_prereq_ref(
    *,
    owner_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    revision_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,

    if revision_ref_id == prereq_ref_id:

            prereq_ref_id,
            config=_VersionedRevisionPrereqConfig(source_ref=revision_ref_id),
        ),
    ], prereq_ref_id

def build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,

    revision_prereqs, published_revision_ref_id = _lower_revision_prereq_ref(
        owner_ref_id=ref_id,

    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute_aggregate import (
        _json_object_agg_key_expressions,
    )

    resolved_config = replace(config, revision_ref_id=published_revision_ref_id)

        ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_json_object_agg_null_key_assertion") if _json_object_agg_key_expressions(config.query_spec) else None

            VersionedJsonObjectAggNullKeyAssertionStep(
                assertion_ref_id,
                model_cls,
                resolved_config,
            ),
        )
    return [
        *revision_prereqs,
        *assertion_steps,
        VersionedQueryFromSpecStep(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            replace(
                resolved_config,
                after_refs=(

                model_cls,
                str(aggregation.function),
                (aggregation.expression if aggregation.expression is not None else getattr(aggregation, "source_expression", None)),
                str(aggregation.alias),
            )
            for aggregation in (getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", ()) or ())
        ]
        column_type_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
            projection_columns,
            column_type_hints,
            *grouped_projection_hints,
            *aggregate_projection_hints,
        )
    needs_recursive_with = branch_cte_ref is not None
    # Keep ancestry CTEs attached to their query grammar. Promoting them to
    # CompiledStep auxiliary CTEs makes their visibility depend on the batch
    # strategy; compound execution may place the query in a later statement.
    split_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] = []
    if public_columns and output_shape is not None:
        projection_public_columns = tuple(column for column in public_columns if not column.startswith("__nera_inline_large_column__"))
        selected_projection_fields = _selected_projection_field_names(query_spec)
        required_large_column_pointers = tuple(
            str(large_column_pointer_name(config.column))
            for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
            if str(config.column) in selected_projection_fields
        )
        projection_public_columns = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys((*projection_public_columns, *required_large_column_pointers)),
        )
        projection = extract_statement_projection(grammar)
        polymorphic_sources = tuple(
            source_model
            for source_model in (getattr(compile_query_spec, "polymorphic_source_models", None) or ())
            if isinstance(source_model, type) and issubclass(source_model, DatabaseObjectRow)
        )
        has_multitable_polymorphic_source = (
            declared_multitable_public_projection
            or any(get_table_name(source_model) != get_table_name(model_cls) for source_model in polymorphic_sources)
            or any(
                field.owner_cls is not None and field.owner_cls is not model_cls and issubclass(field.owner_cls, model_cls)
                for field in output_shape.fields
            )
            or compile_query_spec.source_read_projection is not None
        )
        actual_columns = (
            tuple(str(column) for column in output_shape.cte_output_columns)
            if has_multitable_polymorphic_source
            else tuple(str(column) for column in projection.columns)
            if projection is not None and projection.is_exact and projection.columns
            else tuple(str(column) for column in output_shape.cte_output_columns)
        )
        from l2070_batching.compilation import _declared_projection_columns

        projected_columns = _declared_projection_columns(grammar)
        visible_actual_columns = actual_columns if raw_mode else tuple(projected_columns) if projected_columns else actual_columns
        force_raw_public_projection = raw_mode and bool(
            getattr(query_spec, "projection_output_aliases", ()) or (),
        )
        if force_raw_public_projection or projection_public_columns != tuple(visible_actual_columns):
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_cte_helpers import SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import SqlWithSingleCte
            from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlGrammarKind

            public_cte_base = f"{step_name.replace('(', '_').replace(')', '').replace('.', '_')}_public_rows"
            public_cte_name = SqlGrammarKind(_bounded_sql_relation_name(public_cte_base))
            public_output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
                tuple(synthetic_output_field(column, role="versioned_public_rows") for column in projection_public_columns),
            )
            public_hints = _compiled_output_shape_type_hints(
                model_cls,
                public_output_shape,
                compile_query_spec,
            )
            if public_hints is not None and column_type_hints is not None:
                public_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    projection_public_columns,
                    public_hints,
                    column_type_hints.filtered(set(projection_public_columns)),
                )
            if public_hints is not None and (getattr(query_spec, "group_by", None) or getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", None)):
                grouped_projection_hints = [
                    _group_by_alias_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, column, index)
                    for index, column in enumerate(getattr(query_spec, "group_by", ()) or ())
                ]
                aggregate_projection_hints = [
                    _aggregate_alias_sql_column_type_hints(
                        model_cls,
                        str(aggregation.function),
                        (
                            aggregation.expression
                            if aggregation.expression is not None
                            else getattr(aggregation, "source_expression", None)
                        ),
                        str(aggregation.alias),
                    )
                    for aggregation in (getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", ()) or ())
                ]
                public_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    projection_public_columns,
                    public_hints,
                    *grouped_projection_hints,
                    *aggregate_projection_hints,
                )
            if public_hints is None:
                public_hints = column_type_hints.filtered(set(projection_public_columns)) if column_type_hints is not None else None
            if public_hints is None:
                raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                    site_name=step_name,
                    trigger="raw public-row projection has no SQL column type hints",
                    blocked_path="untyped raw public rows publication",
                    result_contract="raw public rows must publish complete SQL column type hints.",
                    implementation_requirements=(
                        "Carry source column_type_hints through versioned query compilation.",
                        "Declare SQL type hints for every public row projection column.",
                        "Do not infer public row types from runtime raw rows.",
                    ),
                )
            from l2070_batching.publication import hinted_columns, PublicationSourceKind

            missing_hint_columns = set(projection_public_columns) - hinted_columns(public_hints)
            framework_public_hints = framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints().filtered(
                missing_hint_columns,
            )
            if framework_public_hints.has_any():
                public_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    projection_public_columns,
                    public_hints,
                    framework_public_hints,
                )
            missing_hint_columns = set(projection_public_columns) - hinted_columns(public_hints)
            aggregate_hints: list[SqlColumnTypeHints] = []
            for aggregation in tuple(getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", ()) or ()):
                alias = str(getattr(aggregation, "alias", ""))
                if alias not in missing_hint_columns:
                    continue
                aggregate_hints.append(
                    _aggregate_alias_sql_column_type_hints(
                        model_cls,
                        str(aggregation.function),
                        (
                            aggregation.expression
                            if aggregation.expression is not None
                            else getattr(aggregation, "source_expression", None)
                        ),
                        alias,
                    ),
                )
            if aggregate_hints:
                public_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    projection_public_columns,
                    public_hints,
                    *aggregate_hints,
                )
            selected_projection_hints = _simple_select_projection_type_hints(model_cls, query_spec)
            if selected_projection_hints is not None:
                public_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    projection_public_columns,
                    public_hints,
                    selected_projection_hints.filtered(set(projection_public_columns)),
                )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
                inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints,
            )

            inline_large_column_hints = inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls).filtered(
                set(projection_public_columns),
            )
            if inline_large_column_hints.has_any():
                public_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    projection_public_columns,
                    public_hints,
                    inline_large_column_hints,
                )
            public_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                projection_public_columns,
                public_hints,
                SqlColumnTypeHints(
                    uuid_columns=frozenset({"branch_id"} & set(projection_public_columns)),
                    bigint_columns=frozenset({"branch_ord"} & set(projection_public_columns)),
                ),
            )
            tuple_alias_hints = _tuple_projection_alias_type_hints(
                model_cls,
                query_spec,
                projection_public_columns,
            )
            if tuple_alias_hints is not None:
                public_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    projection_public_columns,
                    public_hints,
                    tuple_alias_hints,
                )
            assert public_hints is not None
            model_native_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, projection_public_columns)
            native_storage_columns = (
                model_native_hints.postgres_bit_columns | model_native_hints.postgres_vector_columns
                if model_native_hints is not None
                else frozenset()
            )
            if model_native_hints is not None and native_storage_columns:
                public_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    projection_public_columns,
                    public_hints.filtered(set(projection_public_columns) - native_storage_columns),
                    model_native_hints.filtered(set(native_storage_columns)),
                )
            assert public_hints is not None
            public_hints.require_complete(projection_public_columns)
            actual_column_set = set(visible_actual_columns)
            polymorphic_subtypes = tuple(get_all_concrete_subtypes(model_cls))
            source_model_fields: list[tuple[type, tuple[str, ...]]] = []
            for source_model in (model_cls, *polymorphic_subtypes):
                raw_model_fields = getattr(source_model, "model_fields", None)
                assert isinstance(raw_model_fields, dict)
                assert all(isinstance(field_name, str) for field_name in raw_model_fields)
                source_model_fields.append((source_model, tuple(raw_model_fields)))
            read_field_plans = build_read_metadata_plan(model_cls).field_plans
            model_field_db_sources = {
                field_plan.field_name: field_plan.db_column
                for field_plan in read_field_plans
                if field_plan.db_column != field_plan.field_name
            }
            model_db_field_sources = {
                field_plan.db_column: field_plan.field_name
                for field_plan in read_field_plans
                if field_plan.db_column != field_plan.field_name
            }
            projection_alias_sources = (
                dict(zip(projection_public_columns, visible_actual_columns, strict=True))
                if force_raw_public_projection and len(projection_public_columns) == len(visible_actual_columns)
                else {}
            )
            if force_raw_public_projection:
                for output_column in projection_public_columns:
                    if output_column in actual_column_set:
                        projection_alias_sources[output_column] = output_column
                select_columns = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", ()) or ())
                output_aliases = _selected_projection_output_aliases(query_spec, model_cls)
                for index, selected_column in enumerate(select_columns):
                    if index >= len(output_aliases):
                        break
                    selected_field = _simple_select_projection_field(model_cls, selected_column, index)
                    if selected_field is None:
                        continue
                    owner_model, field_name, _ = selected_field
                    source_column = str(get_db_column_name(owner_model, field_name))
                    if source_column in actual_column_set:
                        projection_alias_sources[output_aliases[index]] = source_column
                for output_column, (owner, alias_field_name) in _tuple_projection_alias_fields(
                    model_cls,
                    query_spec,
                    projection_public_columns,
                ).items():
                    if output_column in actual_column_set:
                        continue
                    source_column = str(
                        get_db_column_name(owner, DynamicFieldName(alias_field_name)),
                    )
                    if source_column in actual_column_set:
                        projection_alias_sources[output_column] = source_column
            base_model_fields = frozenset(source_model_fields[0][1])
            subtype_only_public_columns = {
                field_name
                for _, subtype_fields in source_model_fields[1:]
                for field_name in subtype_fields
                if field_name not in base_model_fields
            }
            single_table_subtype_public_columns = {
                field_name
                for subtype, subtype_fields in source_model_fields[1:]
                if getattr(subtype, "_enforce_single_table", True)
                for field_name in subtype_fields
                if field_name not in base_model_fields
            }
            overrides: dict[str, SqlRenderable] = {}
            identity_db_column = str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")))
            reads_staged_overlay = _resolve_compile_materialization_policy(
                compile_query_spec,
                effective_ctx,
                revision_id_override=prepared.revision_id_override,
            ).uses_staged_overlay
            for column in projection_public_columns:
                if column == identity_db_column and identity_db_column != "sys_id" and not reads_staged_overlay:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName("sys_id"),
                        qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"),
                    )
                    continue
                projected_source_column = projection_alias_sources.get(column)
                if projected_source_column is not None and projected_source_column != column:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName(projected_source_column),
                        qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"),
                    )
                    continue
                db_source_column = model_field_db_sources.get(column)
                if db_source_column is not None and db_source_column in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName(db_source_column),
                        qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"),
                    )
                    continue
                logical_source_column = model_db_field_sources.get(column)
                if logical_source_column is not None and logical_source_column in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName(logical_source_column),
                        qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"),
                    )
                    continue
                if column in {"sys_staged_commit_id", "staged_commit_id"}:
                    overrides[column] = SqlParam(None)
                    continue
                if column == "sys_revision_id" and "sys_valid_from_revision_id" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"),
                        qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"),
                    )
                    continue
                if column == "revision_id" and "sys_valid_from_revision_id" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"),
                        qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"),
                    )
                    continue
                if column in actual_column_set:
                    continue
                from l1000_schema.dynamic_field_utils import get_json_get_type_hint

                dynamic_json_function = get_json_get_type_hint(
                    model_cls,
                    DynamicFieldName(column),
                )
                if dynamic_json_function is not None and "properties" in actual_column_set:
                    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlJsonPath
                    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_json import (
                        JsonAccessKind,
                        SqlJsonAccess,
                    )

                    dynamic_json_kind = {
                        "JSON_GET": JsonAccessKind.GET,
                        "JSON_GET_TEXT": JsonAccessKind.GET_TEXT,
                        "JSON_GET_INT": JsonAccessKind.GET_INT,
                        "JSON_GET_FLOAT": JsonAccessKind.GET_FLOAT,
                        "JSON_GET_BOOL": JsonAccessKind.GET_BOOL,
                    }.get(dynamic_json_function, JsonAccessKind.GET)
                    overrides[column] = SqlJsonAccess(
                        dynamic_json_kind,
                        SqlColumnRef(
                            SqlColumnName("properties"),
                            qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"),
                        ),
                        SqlJsonPath(f"$.{column}"),
                    )
                    continue
                if column == "branch_id" and branch_override is not None:
                    overrides[column] = branch_override
                elif column == "branch_ord":
                    overrides[column] = SqlInlineLiteral(0)
                elif column == "sys_valid_from_revision_id" and "sys_revision_id" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_revision_id"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
                elif column == "sys_valid_from_revision_id" and "revision_id" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_id"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
                elif column == "sys_valid_from_revision_id":
                    overrides[column] = SqlParam(None)
                elif column == "sys_valid_from_seq":
                    overrides[column] = SqlInlineLiteral(0)
                elif column == "created_at" and "sys_created_at" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_created_at"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
                elif column == "updated_at" and "sys_updated_at" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_updated_at"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
                elif column == "revision_id" and "sys_revision_id" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_revision_id"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
                elif column == "revision_id" and "sys_valid_from_revision_id" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
                elif column == "sys_revision_id" and "revision_id" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_id"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
                elif column == "sys_revision_id" and "sys_valid_from_revision_id" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
                elif column in {"revision_id", "sys_revision_id"}:
                    overrides[column] = SqlParam(None)
                elif column == "deleted" and "sys_deleted" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
                elif column == "sys_deleted" and "deleted" in actual_column_set:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("deleted"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"))
                elif column == "deleted":
                    overrides[column] = SqlInlineLiteral(False)
                elif column in {"sys_valid_to_revision_id", "sys_valid_to_seq"}:
                    overrides[column] = SqlParam(None)
                elif column == "sys_deleted":
                    overrides[column] = SqlInlineLiteral(False)
                elif column in {
                    "branch_hash32",
                    "graph_hash32",
                    "source_hash32",
                    "target_hash32",
                }:
                    overrides[column] = SqlInlineLiteral(0)
                elif column in single_table_subtype_public_columns:
                    overrides[column] = SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName(column),
                        qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"),
                    )
                elif column in subtype_only_public_columns:
                    overrides[column] = SqlParam(None)
                else:
                    raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                        site_name=step_name,
                        trigger=f"raw public-row projection is missing contract column {column!r}",
                        blocked_path="implicit NULL public-row projection fallback",
                        result_contract=(
                            "raw public-row projections must emit every contract column directly "
                            "or provide an explicit typed override for system columns."
                        ),
                        implementation_requirements=(
                            "Add the missing column to the versioned query projection.",
                            "If the column is synthetic, add an explicit typed override for it here.",
                            "Do not fill missing publication columns with NULL.",
                        ),
                    )
            public_projection: SqlRenderable = SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides(
                source_cte_name=public_cte_name,
                source_columns=projection_public_columns,
                overrides=overrides,
                column_type_hints=public_hints,
            )
            if query_spec.order_by:
                from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_order_by_codegen import (
                    render_query_spec_order_by_items,
                )
                from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlOrderByClause
                from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSuffixedQuery

                outer_order_items = render_query_spec_order_by_items(query_spec, model_cls)
                if outer_order_items:
                    public_projection = SqlSuffixedQuery(
                        public_projection,
                        SqlOrderByClause(outer_order_items),
                    )
            grammar = SqlWithSingleCte(
                cte_name=public_cte_name,
                cte_body=grammar,
                inner=public_projection,
            )
            output_shape = public_output_shape
            column_type_hints = public_hints
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None = _dedupe_auxiliary_ctes(
        [
            *(_collect_auxiliary_ctes_from_consumed(consumed_ctes) or []),
            *(dependency_auxiliary_ctes or []),
            *split_ctes,
        ],
    )
    if auxiliary_ctes:
        needs_recursive_with = True
        if isinstance(grammar, SupportsLeadingCtes):
            grammar = grammar.with_leading_ctes(auxiliary_ctes)
            auxiliary_ctes = None
    if output_shape is not None and column_type_hints is not None:
        terminal_alias_hints: list[SqlColumnTypeHints] = []
        terminal_group_by_columns = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "group_by", ()) or ())
        terminal_aggregations = tuple(getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", ()) or ())
        terminal_alias_hints.extend(
            _group_by_alias_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, column, index) for index, column in enumerate(terminal_group_by_columns)
        )
        terminal_alias_hints.extend(
            _aggregate_alias_sql_column_type_hints(
                model_cls,
                str(aggregation.function),
                (aggregation.expression if aggregation.expression is not None else getattr(aggregation, "source_expression", None)),
                str(aggregation.alias),
            )
            for aggregation in terminal_aggregations
        )
        if terminal_alias_hints:
            column_type_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                output_shape.cte_output_columns,
                column_type_hints,
                *terminal_alias_hints,
            )
    if output_shape is not None and column_type_hints is not None:
        column_type_hints = column_type_hints.filtered(set(output_shape.cte_output_columns))
    compiled = CompiledStep(
        grammar=grammar,
        params=ir.params,
        needs_returning=True,
        closed_post_op=closed_post_op,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        needs_recursive_with=needs_recursive_with,
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=(
            _all_public_result_relation(output_shape)
            if raw_mode and output_shape is not None
            else ir.result_relation or (DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape) if output_shape is not None else None)
        ),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
    )
    selected_projection_fields = _selected_projection_field_names(query_spec)
    selected_large_column_fields = {
        str(config.column) for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls) if str(config.column) in selected_projection_fields
    }
    publishes_inline_large_column_columns = bool(
        public_columns and any(column.startswith("__nera_inline_large_column__") for column in public_columns)
    )
    needs_inline_large_column_hydration = (bool(selected_large_column_fields) or publishes_inline_large_column_columns) and not bool(
        getattr(query_spec, "defer_large_columns", False)
    )
    if (not raw_mode or needs_inline_large_column_hydration) and not bool(
        getattr(query_spec, "defer_large_columns", False),
    ):
        compiled = wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns(
            compiled,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            force_inline=needs_inline_large_column_hydration,
        )
    return compiled


def _apply_versioned_query_column_masking(
    ir: SqlStepIR,
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> SqlStepIR:
    """Apply reader-visible column masking to a versioned query relation."""
    masking_info = getattr(query_spec, "column_masking", None)
    masking_user = getattr(query_spec, "column_masking_user_grammar", None)
    if masking_info is None or not isinstance(masking_user, SqlRenderable):
        return ir
    if ir.output_shape is None:
        return ir

    owner_field, private_fields = masking_info
    alias = "versioned_visible"
    field_policy = build_sql_field_reference_policy(
        get_db_column=lambda field_name: get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)),
        table_alias=alias,
        column_masking=(owner_field, private_fields),
        column_masking_user_grammar=masking_user,
    )
    private_field_by_column = {get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)): field_name for field_name in private_fields}
    select_items: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for column in ir.output_shape.cte_output_columns:
        field_name = private_field_by_column.get(SqlColumnName(column))
        if field_name is None:
            select_items.append(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=alias),
            )
            continue
        select_items.append(
            SqlSelectAlias(
                field_policy.observable_field(
                    field_name,
                    db_col=column,
                    qualifier=alias,
                ),
                alias=SqlAliasName(column),
            ),
        )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlCte

    leading_ctes, inner, recursive = _split_leading_ctes(ir.grammar)
    grammar: SqlRenderable = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(select_items),
        from_clause=SqlFrom(
            SqlWrappedSubquery(inner, alias=SqlAliasName(alias)),
        ),
    )
    if leading_ctes:
        grammar = SqlCte(leading_ctes, grammar, recursive=recursive)
    return replace(ir, grammar=grammar)


def _compile_versioned_query_ir(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    effective_ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    branch_id_override: SqlRenderable | None,
    revision_id_override: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    step_name: str = "_compile_versioned_query_ir",
    raw_mode: bool = False,
    policy_authority_scope: PolicyAuthorityCompilationScope | None = None,
    preserve_attached_permission: bool = False,
    permission_action: PermissionAction = PermissionAction("read"),
    preferred_source: PublishedVersionSource | None = None,
) -> SqlStepIR:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
        attach_runtime_permission_grammar,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_versioned import (
        compile_versioned_query,
        _graph_predicate_context,
        _graph_predicate_revision_value,
        _versioned_query_ancestor_cte_name,
        wrap_versioned_with_computed,
    )

    if query_spec is None:
        return compile_versioned_query(
            None,
            model_cls,
            effective_ctx,
            branch_id_override=branch_id_override,
            revision_id_override=revision_id_override,
            raw_mode=raw_mode,
            require_branch_id_override=True,
            ancestor_cte_name=_versioned_query_ancestor_cte_name(step_name),
            policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
            preferred_source=preferred_source,
        )
    resolved_user_id = _resolve_query_permission_user_cte(
        query_spec=query_spec,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        ctx=effective_ctx,
        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
        step_name=step_name,
        permission_action=permission_action,
    )
    effective_ctx = replace(
        effective_ctx,
        query_user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
        query_versioned_scope=(branch_id_override, revision_id_override),
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
        versioned_permission_branch_id_expr,
    )

    if preserve_attached_permission:
        from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_spec import query_has_attached_permission_grammar

        if not query_has_attached_permission_grammar(query_spec):
            msg = "Preserved versioned permission state requires attached permission grammar"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        attached_query_spec = query_spec
    else:
        attached_query_spec = attach_runtime_permission_grammar(
            query_spec,
            model_cls,
            effective_ctx,
            resolved_user_id=resolved_user_id,
            action=permission_action,
            fallback_branch_id_sql=(
                branch_id_override if branch_id_override is not None else versioned_permission_branch_id_expr(effective_ctx)
            ),
        )
    from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_spec import QuerySpec

    if not isinstance(attached_query_spec, QuerySpec):
        msg = (
            "Versioned query compilation requires a canonical QuerySpec after permission binding. "
            f"Got {type(attached_query_spec).__name__}."
        )
        raise TypeError(msg)
    query_spec = attached_query_spec
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.versioned_tombstone_projection import (
        VersionedTombstoneProjectionContract,
    )

    tombstone_contract = VersionedTombstoneProjectionContract(
        include_deleted=query_spec.include_deleted,
    )
    include_deleted = tombstone_contract.includes_tombstone_metadata
    query_spec = tombstone_contract.with_model_projection(
        query_spec,
        model_cls,
        selected_field_names=frozenset(DynamicFieldName(name) for name in _selected_projection_field_names(query_spec)),
        has_computed_columns=_query_spec_has_computed_columns(query_spec),
    )

    if not _query_spec_has_computed_columns(query_spec):
        return _apply_versioned_query_column_masking(
            compile_versioned_query(
                query_spec,
                model_cls,
                effective_ctx,
                include_deleted=include_deleted,
                branch_id_override=branch_id_override,
                revision_id_override=revision_id_override,
                raw_mode=raw_mode,
                require_branch_id_override=True,
                ancestor_cte_name=_versioned_query_ancestor_cte_name(step_name),
                policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
                preferred_source=preferred_source,
            ),
            query_spec,
            model_cls,
        )
    group_by_columns = tuple(query_spec.group_by)
    inner_projection_columns: list[Any] = [
        _group_by_inner_projection(column, index, model_cls) for index, column in enumerate(group_by_columns)
    ]
    seen_projection_keys = {_projection_identity(column) for column in group_by_columns}
    for aggregate_column in _aggregate_inner_projection_columns(query_spec):
        identity = _projection_identity(aggregate_column)
        if identity in seen_projection_keys:
            continue
        seen_projection_keys.add(identity)
        inner_projection_columns.append(aggregate_column)
    base_spec = replace(
        query_spec,
        select_columns=inner_projection_columns if inner_projection_columns else None,
        select_column_tables=tuple(_group_by_projection_table_name(column, model_cls) for column in inner_projection_columns),
        aggregations=[],
        window_functions=[],
        group_by=[],
        having=[],
        order_by=[],
        limit=None,
        offset=None,
    )
    base_ir = _apply_versioned_query_column_masking(
        compile_versioned_query(
            base_spec,
            model_cls,
            effective_ctx,
            include_deleted=include_deleted,
            branch_id_override=branch_id_override,
            revision_id_override=revision_id_override,
            raw_mode=raw_mode,
            require_branch_id_override=True,
            ancestor_cte_name=_versioned_query_ancestor_cte_name(step_name),
            policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
            preferred_source=preferred_source,
        ),
        base_spec,
        model_cls,
    )
    output_shape = _computed_query_output_shape(
        base_ir.output_shape,
        query_spec,
        model_cls,
    )
    column_type_hints = _compiled_output_shape_type_hints(model_cls, output_shape, query_spec)
    if column_type_hints is None:
        msg = f"{step_name} computed versioned query output requires explicit SQL column type hints."
        raise TypeError(msg)
    aggregate_hints = [
        _aggregate_alias_sql_column_type_hints(
            model_cls,
            str(aggregation.function),
            (aggregation.expression if aggregation.expression is not None else getattr(aggregation, "source_expression", None)),
            str(aggregation.alias),
        )
        for aggregation in (getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", ()) or ())
    ]
    if output_shape is None:
        msg = "Computed versioned query must compile an output shape."
        raise TypeError(msg)
    if aggregate_hints:
        aggregate_aliases = {str(aggregation.alias) for aggregation in (getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", ()) or ())}
        column_type_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
            output_shape.cte_output_columns,
            column_type_hints.filtered(
                set(output_shape.cte_output_columns) - aggregate_aliases,
            ),
            *aggregate_hints,
        )
    graph_revision = _graph_predicate_revision_value(
        effective_ctx,
        revision_id=revision_id_override,
        branch_id=branch_id_override,
    )
    graph_context = (
        _graph_predicate_context(
            graph_revision,
            ctx=effective_ctx,
            branch_id=branch_id_override,
        )
        if effective_ctx.branch_tip_materialized
        else _graph_predicate_context(graph_revision)
    )
    with graph_context:
        computed_grammar = wrap_versioned_with_computed(
            base_ir.grammar,
            query_spec,
            model_cls,
            planning_catalog=effective_ctx.planning_catalog,
            compilation_context=effective_ctx,
            policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
            base_output_columns=(
                tuple(str(column) for column in base_ir.output_shape.cte_output_columns) if base_ir.output_shape is not None else None
            ),
        )
    return SqlStepIR(
        grammar=computed_grammar,
        params=base_ir.params,
        needs_returning=base_ir.needs_returning,
        external_params_first=base_ir.external_params_first,
        provenance_manifest=base_ir.provenance_manifest,
        allow_empty_provenance_manifest=base_ir.allow_empty_provenance_manifest,
        use_savepoint_recovery=base_ir.use_savepoint_recovery,
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
    )


def _build_versioned_delete_where_expr(query_spec: Any, ctx: CompilationContext) -> Any:
    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.query_grammar import QueryGrammarBuilder

    required_spec = query_spec
    if required_spec is None:
        return None
    where_clause = QueryGrammarBuilder(
        required_spec,
        planning_catalog=ctx.planning_catalog,
    ).build_where_clause()
    return where_clause.condition if where_clause is not None else None


class VersionedQueryFromSpecStep[T](MaybeSqlRelationPublisherStep[Sequence[T]]):
    """L0: Versioned multi-row query from a query_spec.

    Delegates to ``compile_versioned_query()`` in compile.
    """

    def __init__(
        self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._query_spec = config.query_spec
        self._branch_id = config.branch_id
        self._branch_ref_id = config.branch_ref_id
        self._revision_id, self._revision_ref_id = _normalize_query_revision_source(
            config.revision_ref_id if config.revision_ref_id is not None else config.revision_id,
            step_name=f"{type(self).__name__}({self.ref_id})",
        )
        self._user_id_ref_id = config.user_id_ref_id
        self._raw_mode = config.raw_mode
        self._after_refs = frozenset(config.after_refs)
        self._always_publish_executor_binding = config.always_publish_executor_binding
        self._publication_read_flavor = config.publication_read_flavor
        self._prefer_current_tip = config.prefer_current_tip
        self._preferred_source = config.preferred_source
        self._branch_route_context = config.branch_route_context
        self._returns_raw_rows = _query_spec_returns_raw_rows(self._query_spec, self._raw_mode)
        # Capture the filter/permission support columns before later lowering
        # passes can rewrite server-ref-bound predicates (e.g. ``graph_sys_id``)
        # out of ``query_spec.filters``. Those columns stay in the compiled CTE
        # output, so the publication contract must keep covering them.
        self._aggregations_snapshot: tuple[Any, ...] = tuple(getattr(self._query_spec, "aggregations", ()) or ())
        self._group_by_snapshot: tuple[Any, ...] = tuple(getattr(self._query_spec, "group_by", ()) or ())
        self._has_aggregate_projection_snapshot = bool(
            self._aggregations_snapshot or _query_spec_has_aggregate_projection(self._query_spec)
        )
        self._filter_support_columns_snapshot = _query_spec_filter_support_columns(model_cls, self._query_spec)
        self._has_graph_projection_scope_snapshot = bool(
            getattr(self._query_spec, "joins", ()) or getattr(self._query_spec, "filters", ())
        )
        if not self._returns_raw_rows and _query_spec_requires_full_model_materialization_guard(self._query_spec):
            _query_spec_for_model_materialization(self._query_spec, self._model_cls)
        deps: set[str] = set()
        _add_runtime_dependency_ref(deps, self._branch_ref_id)
        _add_runtime_dependency_ref(deps, self._revision_ref_id)
        effective_user_id_ref_id = self._user_id_ref_id if _query_needs_permission_user_ref(self._query_spec, self._model_cls) else None
        _add_runtime_dependency_ref(deps, effective_user_id_ref_id)
        deps.update(
            _collect_spec_deps_for_user_ref(
                self._query_spec,
                unbound_user_ref_id=(ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_resolve_uid") if effective_user_id_ref_id is None else None),
            ),
        )
        _discard_self_and_ancestor_deps(deps, self.ref_id)
        self._sql_visible_dependencies = frozenset(deps)
        deps.update(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs)
        _discard_self_and_ancestor_deps(deps, self.ref_id)
        self._dependencies = frozenset(deps)

    def branch_route_compile_context(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep[T]) -> _GraphCompileContextConfig | None:
        """Return the graph route recipe that owns this versioned query."""
        return self._branch_route_context

    def with_preferred_source(
        self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep[T],
        source: PublishedVersionSource,
    ) -> VersionedQueryFromSpecStep[T]:
        """Return a correction recipe bound to one checked published source."""
        from copy import copy

        corrected = copy(self)
        corrected._preferred_source = source
        route_context = self._branch_route_context
        if route_context is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_graph import _GraphCompileContextConfig

            if not isinstance(route_context, _GraphCompileContextConfig):
                raise TypeError("Versioned query branch route context is invalid")
            corrected._branch_route_context = replace(
                route_context,
                predicted_source=source,
            )
        return corrected

    @property
    def level(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> int:
        if _revision_ref_needs_prereq_lowering(self.ref_id, self._revision_ref_id):
            return 1
        if _versioned_query_requires_prereq_lowering(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            query_spec=self._query_spec,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
        ):
            return 1
        return 0

    def step_tags(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        tags = {"read", "query", "execute", "versioned"}
        if self._raw_mode:
            tags.add("raw")
        return frozenset(tags)

    def is_read_only(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def preserves_raw_numeric_transport(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> bool:
        return self._returns_raw_rows and not self._query_spec.aggregations

    def coerces_numeric_string_transport(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> bool:
        return bool(self._query_spec.aggregations)

    def raw_terminal_result_columns(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        """Exclude filter and ordering support columns from projected results."""
        selected_aliases = _selected_projection_output_aliases(self._query_spec, self._model_cls)
        if getattr(self._query_spec, "select_columns", None) and selected_aliases:
            support_columns = _physical_query_spec_support_columns(
                self._model_cls,
                self._query_spec,
            )
            if self._revision_id is not None or self._revision_ref_id is not None:
                support_columns = (*support_columns, "sys_deleted")
            contract_columns = self.cte_publication_contract().columns
            if contract_columns:
                return contract_columns
            return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*selected_aliases, *support_columns)))
        return None

    def publishes_replayable_statement_local_relation(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def result_cardinality(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def tables_read(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return _versioned_storage_tables(self._model_cls)

    def tables_written(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def requires_prior_statement_visibility_after_writes(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.tables_read()

    def dependencies(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._dependencies

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._sql_visible_dependencies

    def executor_visible_dependencies(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._branch_ref_id)}) if self._branch_ref_id is not None else frozenset()

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> bool:
        return self._branch_ref_id is not None

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> bool:
        return self._branch_ref_id is not None and not self._prefer_current_tip

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> bool:
        return self.requires_materialized_inputs()

    def supports_ordered_materialized_input_dispatch(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> bool:
        return self._branch_ref_id is not None and not self._prefer_current_tip

    def _publishes_inline_large_column_transport(
        self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep,
        columns: tuple[str, ...],
    ) -> bool:
        """Whether compile wraps this SELECT with inline large-column transport.

        ``compile_versioned_query_from_spec_terminal`` inlines the spilled manifest
        for every non-deferred read that projects a large column, so the published
        contract has to carry the alias columns too. Otherwise the contract
        projection drops them again and the post-op is handed a pointer-only row
        it cannot hydrate.
        """
        configs = get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls)
        if not configs:
            return False
        projected = set(columns)
        return any(
            {
                str(config.column),
                str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column))),
                str(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)),
                str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)))),
            }
            & projected
            for config in configs
        )

    def cte_publication_contract(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
            inline_large_column_alias_columns,
            inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints,
        )

        contract_query_spec = self._query_spec

        def _legacy_cte_output_columns() -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
            selected_aliases = _selected_projection_output_aliases(
                contract_query_spec,
                self._model_cls,
            )
            if self._raw_mode and selected_aliases and not self._has_aggregate_projection_snapshot:
                selected_fields = _selected_projection_field_names(contract_query_spec)
                selected_large_columns = tuple(
                    config for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls) if str(config.column) in selected_fields
                )
                if selected_aliases:
                    is_graph_element = any(
                        base.__name__ in {"GraphNode", "GraphEdge"} and base.__module__.startswith("l9600_graphs")
                        for base in self._model_cls.__mro__
                    )
                    graph_hash_columns = (
                        ("branch_hash32", "graph_hash32") if is_graph_element and not self._has_graph_projection_scope_snapshot else ()
                    )
                    return tuple(
                        dict.fromkeys(
                            (
                                *selected_aliases,
                                *(("sys_id", "content") if "_tuple_base_content" in selected_aliases else ()),
                                *graph_hash_columns,
                                *_physical_query_spec_support_columns(
                                    self._model_cls,
                                    contract_query_spec,
                                ),
                                *(("sys_deleted",) if self._revision_id is not None or self._revision_ref_id is not None else ()),
                                *(str(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)) for config in selected_large_columns),
                                *(inline_large_column_alias_columns(self._model_cls) if selected_large_columns else ()),
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
            if self._aggregations_snapshot:
                group_columns = tuple(
                    _group_by_output_alias(column, index, self._model_cls) for index, column in enumerate(self._group_by_snapshot)
                )
                aggregate_columns = tuple(str(aggregation.alias) for aggregation in self._aggregations_snapshot)
                return (*group_columns, *aggregate_columns)
            if self._has_aggregate_projection_snapshot:
                return selected_aliases or None
            runtime_projection_columns = _runtime_projection_columns(self._model_cls, contract_query_spec)
            if runtime_projection_columns and not (self._raw_mode and self._publication_read_flavor == READ_FLAVOR_SPARSE_HISTORICAL):
                selected_field_names = _selected_projection_field_names(contract_query_spec)
                runtime_projection_columns = tuple(
                    dict.fromkeys(
                        (
                            *runtime_projection_columns,
                            *(
                                large_column_pointer_name(config.column)
                                for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls)
                                if str(config.column) in selected_field_names
                            ),
                            *(
                                inline_large_column_alias_columns(self._model_cls)
                                if any(str(config.column) in selected_field_names for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls))
                                else ()
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                )
                if self._publication_read_flavor == READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS:
                    runtime_projection_columns = tuple(
                        dict.fromkeys(
                            (
                                *runtime_projection_columns,
                                "sys_revision_id",
                                "sys_staged_commit_id",
                                "sys_deleted",
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                if not selected_field_names and (self._revision_ref_id is not None or self._branch_ref_id is not None):
                    runtime_projection_columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*runtime_projection_columns, "branch_id")))
                if self._revision_id is not None or self._revision_ref_id is not None:
                    runtime_projection_columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*runtime_projection_columns, "sys_deleted")))
                    explicitly_selected_version_columns = {
                        db_column
                        for field_name, db_column in (
                            ("revision_id", "sys_revision_id"),
                            ("staged_commit_id", "sys_staged_commit_id"),
                        )
                        if field_name in selected_field_names
                    }
                    return tuple(
                        column
                        for column in runtime_projection_columns
                        if column not in {"sys_revision_id", "sys_staged_commit_id"} or column in explicitly_selected_version_columns
                    )
                logical_runtime_columns = tuple(
                    column
                    for column in runtime_projection_columns
                    if not is_framework_physical_db_column(self._model_cls, SqlColumnName(column))
                )
                is_graph_element = any(
                    base.__name__ in {"GraphNode", "GraphEdge"} and base.__module__.startswith("l9600_graphs")
                    for base in self._model_cls.__mro__
                )
                if is_graph_element and not self._has_graph_projection_scope_snapshot:
                    return tuple(
                        dict.fromkeys(
                            (*logical_runtime_columns, "branch_hash32", "graph_hash32"),
                        ),
                    )
                return logical_runtime_columns
            selected_columns = _simple_select_projection_columns(self._model_cls, contract_query_spec)
            if selected_columns is not None:
                selected_field_names = _selected_projection_field_names(contract_query_spec)
                selected_columns = tuple(
                    dict.fromkeys(
                        (
                            *selected_columns,
                            *(
                                large_column_pointer_name(config.column)
                                for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls)
                                if str(config.column) in selected_field_names
                            ),
                            *(
                                (
                                    str(config.column)
                                    for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls)
                                    if str(config.column) in selected_field_names
                                )
                                if self._publication_read_flavor == READ_FLAVOR_SPARSE_HISTORICAL
                                else inline_large_column_alias_columns(self._model_cls)
                                if any(str(config.column) in selected_field_names for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls))
                                else ()
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                )
                if self._revision_ref_id is not None or self._branch_ref_id is not None:
                    return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*selected_columns, "sys_deleted")))
                if self._revision_id is not None:
                    return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*selected_columns, "sys_deleted")))
                logical_columns = tuple(
                    column for column in selected_columns if not is_framework_physical_db_column(self._model_cls, SqlColumnName(column))
                )
                is_graph_element = any(
                    base.__name__ in {"GraphNode", "GraphEdge"} and base.__module__.startswith("l9600_graphs")
                    for base in self._model_cls.__mro__
                )
                if is_graph_element and not self._has_graph_projection_scope_snapshot:
                    return tuple(
                        dict.fromkeys(
                            (*logical_columns, "branch_hash32", "graph_hash32"),
                        ),
                    )
                return logical_columns
            if contract_query_spec.window_functions and not contract_query_spec.group_by:
                from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.versioned_tombstone_projection import (
                    TOMBSTONE_MODEL_FIELD,
                    VersionedTombstoneProjectionContract,
                )

                tombstone_contract = VersionedTombstoneProjectionContract(
                    include_deleted=contract_query_spec.include_deleted,
                )
                excluded_fields = ["revision_id", "staged_commit_id"]
                if not tombstone_contract.includes_tombstone_metadata:
                    excluded_fields.append(str(TOMBSTONE_MODEL_FIELD))
                base_columns = returnable_db_columns(
                    self._model_cls,
                    excluded_fields=tuple(excluded_fields),
                    include_polymorphic=False,
                )
                base_columns = tuple(
                    str(column) for column in tombstone_contract.public_output_columns(SqlColumnName(column) for column in base_columns)
                )
                window_columns = tuple(str(alias) for _window_expr, alias in getattr(contract_query_spec, "window_functions", ()))
                return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*base_columns, *window_columns)))
            if _query_spec_has_computed_columns(contract_query_spec):
                computed_shape = _computed_query_output_shape(
                    None,
                    contract_query_spec,
                    self._model_cls,
                )
                if computed_shape is None:
                    return None
                return tuple(str(column) for column in computed_shape.cte_output_columns)
            if self._revision_id is not None or self._revision_ref_id is not None:
                projection = build_read_metadata_plan(self._model_cls).projection_for(
                    self._publication_read_flavor or READ_FLAVOR_SPARSE_HISTORICAL,
                )
                projected_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in output_shape_from_read_projection(projection).cte_output_columns)
                if self._publication_read_flavor == READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS:
                    projected_columns = tuple(
                        {
                            "sys_valid_from_revision_id": "sys_revision_id",
                            "revision_id": "sys_revision_id",
                            "staged_commit_id": "sys_staged_commit_id",
                            "deleted": "sys_deleted",
                        }.get(column, column)
                        for column in projected_columns
                    )
                internal_columns = {
                    "branch_id",
                    "branch_hash32",
                    "graph_hash32",
                    "branch_ord",
                    "sys_valid_from_seq",
                    "sys_valid_to_seq",
                }
                declared_model_columns = {
                    str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))) for field_name in self._model_cls.model_fields
                }
                if "branch_ord" in declared_model_columns and not is_framework_physical_db_column(
                    self._model_cls, SqlColumnName("branch_ord")
                ):
                    internal_columns.remove("branch_ord")
                if self._publication_read_flavor == READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS:
                    internal_columns = {
                        *internal_columns,
                        "sys_valid_from_revision_id",
                        "sys_valid_to_revision_id",
                    }
                system_columns = (
                    "sys_id",
                    "sys_created_at",
                    "sys_updated_at",
                    "sys_revision_id",
                    "sys_staged_commit_id",
                    "sys_deleted",
                )
                data_columns = tuple(
                    column
                    for column in projected_columns
                    if column not in internal_columns
                    and column not in system_columns
                    and column not in {"revision_id", "staged_commit_id", "deleted"}
                )
                base_columns = tuple(
                    dict.fromkeys(
                        (
                            *(column for column in system_columns if column in projected_columns),
                            *data_columns,
                            *(
                                inline_large_column_alias_columns(self._model_cls)
                                if not getattr(contract_query_spec, "defer_large_columns", False)
                                else ()
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                )
                window_columns = tuple(str(alias) for _window_expr, alias in getattr(contract_query_spec, "window_functions", ()))
                return tuple(
                    column
                    for column in (*base_columns, *window_columns)
                    if not is_framework_physical_db_column(self._model_cls, SqlColumnName(column))
                )
            if _query_spec_has_computed_columns(contract_query_spec):
                return None
            read_flavor = self._publication_read_flavor or (
                READ_FLAVOR_SPARSE_HISTORICAL
                if self._revision_id is not None or self._revision_ref_id is not None
                else READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS
            )
            projection = build_read_metadata_plan(self._model_cls).projection_for(read_flavor)
            base_columns = output_shape_from_read_projection(projection).cte_output_columns
            if not getattr(contract_query_spec, "defer_large_columns", False):
                base_columns = tuple(
                    dict.fromkeys((*base_columns, *inline_large_column_alias_columns(self._model_cls))),
                )
            if read_flavor == READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS:
                query_row_excluded_columns = {
                    "sys_valid_from_revision_id",
                    "sys_valid_from_seq",
                    "sys_valid_to_revision_id",
                    "sys_valid_to_seq",
                }
                query_row_column_map = {
                    "sys_valid_from_revision_id": "sys_revision_id",
                    "staged_commit_id": "sys_staged_commit_id",
                    "deleted": "sys_deleted",
                }
                return tuple(
                    dict.fromkeys(
                        query_row_column_map.get(column, column) for column in base_columns if column not in query_row_excluded_columns
                    ),
                )
            return tuple(column for column in base_columns if column not in {"sys_revision_id", "sys_staged_commit_id", "sys_deleted"})

        raw_columns = _legacy_cte_output_columns()
        if raw_columns is not None and not self._has_aggregate_projection_snapshot:
            # Filter/permission predicate columns are materialized in the compiled
            # CTE output even when the projection branch above derives its base
            # shape from a read-flavor projection (which omits framework/graph
            # columns like ``graph_sys_id``). They can also be lowered out of the
            # live query spec's filter list by later passes (e.g. a server-ref
            # bound ``graph_sys_id`` predicate rewritten into a staged overlay
            # join) while still remaining in the compiled output shape. Merge the
            # support columns collected from both the current spec and the
            # construction-time snapshot so the publication contract keeps
            # covering the compiled output shape.
            physical_model_columns = {
                *(str(column) for column in get_db_column_map(self._model_cls).values()),
                "branch_id",
                "branch_ord",
                "branch_hash32",
                "graph_hash32",
                "sys_valid_from_seq",
                "sys_valid_to_seq",
            }
            filter_support_columns = tuple(
                dict.fromkeys(
                    (
                        *_physical_query_spec_support_columns(self._model_cls, contract_query_spec),
                        *(column for column in self._filter_support_columns_snapshot if column in physical_model_columns),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            missing_support_columns = tuple(column for column in filter_support_columns if column not in raw_columns)
            if missing_support_columns:
                raw_columns = (*raw_columns, *missing_support_columns)
        columns = (
            tuple(
                dict.fromkeys(raw_columns),
            )
            if (
                raw_columns is not None
                and self._revision_id is None
                and self._revision_ref_id is not None
                and self._publication_read_flavor != READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS
            )
            else raw_columns
        )
        if columns is None and self._always_publish_executor_binding:
            columns = self._metadata_semantic_publication_columns()
        if columns is not None and self._publication_read_flavor == READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS and "branch_id" not in columns:
            columns = (*columns, "branch_id")
        if (
            self._raw_mode
            and columns is not None
            and (self._revision_id is not None or self._revision_ref_id is not None)
            and not getattr(contract_query_spec, "select_columns", None)
            and not getattr(contract_query_spec, "group_by", None)
            and not getattr(contract_query_spec, "aggregations", None)
            and not getattr(contract_query_spec, "window_functions", None)
            and not _query_spec_has_computed_columns(contract_query_spec)
            and "sys_deleted" not in columns
        ):
            columns = (*columns, "sys_deleted")
        if columns is not None and self._publishes_inline_large_column_transport(columns):
            columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*columns, *inline_large_column_alias_columns(self._model_cls))))

        def _model_hints_with_framework_columns(
            model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
            columns: tuple[str, ...],
        ) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
            from l2070_batching.publication import hinted_columns

            model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, columns)
            model_columns = hinted_columns(model_hints) if model_hints is not None else frozenset()
            framework_hints = framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints().filtered(
                set(columns) - model_columns,
            )
            framework_columns = hinted_columns(framework_hints)
            missing_columns = set(columns) - framework_columns - model_columns
            fts_hash_columns = {"sys_fts_hash_short", "sys_fts_hash_high"} & missing_columns
            branch_support_columns = {"branch_id", "branch_ord"} & missing_columns
            extra_hints: list[SqlColumnTypeHints] = []
            if model_hints is not None and model_hints.has_any():
                extra_hints.append(model_hints)
            if framework_hints.has_any():
                extra_hints.append(framework_hints)
            if branch_support_columns:
                extra_hints.append(
                    SqlColumnTypeHints(
                        uuid_columns=frozenset({"branch_id"} & branch_support_columns),
                        bigint_columns=frozenset({"branch_ord"} & branch_support_columns),
                    ),
                )
                missing_columns -= branch_support_columns
            if fts_hash_columns:
                extra_hints.append(
                    sql_column_type_hints_for_declared_sql_types(
                        {SqlColumnName(column): RawSqlText("BIGINT") for column in sorted(fts_hash_columns)},
                    ),
                )
                missing_columns -= fts_hash_columns
            inline_hints = inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls).filtered(
                missing_columns,
            )
            if inline_hints.has_any():
                extra_hints.append(inline_hints)
            if not extra_hints:
                return None
            return combine_sql_column_type_hints(columns, *extra_hints)

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...] | None) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            if columns is None:
                return SqlColumnTypeHints()
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.polymorphism.multitable_cte import (
                align_multitable_read_projection,
            )
            from l2070_batching.planning_catalog import build_read_metadata_plan_for_sources
            from l2070_batching.publication import hinted_columns

            source_models = tuple(getattr(contract_query_spec, "polymorphic_source_models", ()) or ())
            if source_models and not self._aggregations_snapshot:
                read_flavor = self._publication_read_flavor or READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS
                source_projection = align_multitable_read_projection(
                    build_read_metadata_plan_for_sources(
                        self._model_cls,
                        source_models,
                    ).projection_for(read_flavor),
                    source_models,
                )
                source_hints = source_projection.sql_column_type_hints().filtered(set(columns))
                source_columns = hinted_columns(source_hints)
                if source_columns:
                    remaining_columns = tuple(column for column in columns if column not in source_columns)
                    if not remaining_columns:
                        return source_hints
                    remaining_hints = _model_hints_with_framework_columns(
                        self._model_cls,
                        remaining_columns,
                    )
                    if remaining_hints is not None and hinted_columns(remaining_hints) == set(remaining_columns):
                        return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                            columns,
                            source_hints,
                            remaining_hints,
                        )
            projection_model_cls = getattr(contract_query_spec, "projection_model_cls", None)
            if isinstance(projection_model_cls, type):
                projection_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(projection_model_cls, columns)
                if projection_hints is None:
                    msg = f"Could not resolve projection model hints for {projection_model_cls.__name__}"
                    raise TypeError(msg)
                from l2070_batching.publication import hinted_columns

                support_columns = tuple(column for column in columns if column not in hinted_columns(projection_hints))
                if not support_columns:
                    return projection_hints
                support_hints = _model_hints_with_framework_columns(
                    self._model_cls,
                    support_columns,
                )
                if support_hints is None:
                    msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._model_cls.__name__} support columns {support_columns!r}"
                    raise TypeError(msg)
                return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                    columns,
                    projection_hints,
                    support_hints,
                )
            if self._aggregations_snapshot:
                group_hints = [
                    _group_by_alias_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, column, index)
