def _build_skip_compute_payload_rows(
    *,
    source_rows: SqlRenderable,
    source_alias: SqlTableName,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
    branch_id: BranchId | None,
    revision_id: RevisionId | None,
    canonical_model_hint: str | None = None,
    require_algorithm_established: bool = False,
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    del table_name, branch_id, revision_id

    vector_alias = SqlTableName("__emb_existing_vector")
    index_config = get_vector_config(model_cls, index_name)
    vector_table_name = "sys_embedding_vectors"
    if index_config is not None:
        strategy = index_config.content_store_strategy
        if strategy != ContentStoreStrategy.GLOBAL and not (
            strategy == ContentStoreStrategy.PER_MODEL and canonical_model_hint is None
        ):
            vector_table_name = get_embedding_vector_table_name(
                strategy=strategy,
                model_id=canonical_model_hint,
                source_table_name=get_table_name(model_cls),
                field_name=index_name,
            )
    vector_source: SqlRenderable = SqlAliasedTableRef(
        SqlTableName(vector_table_name), SqlAliasName(str(vector_alias)),
    )
    if (
        index_config is not None
        and index_config.content_store_strategy == ContentStoreStrategy.PER_MODEL
        and canonical_model_hint is None
    ):
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.embedding_store_scope import (
            owned_per_model_embedding_storage,
        )

        columns = ("sys_id", "content_hash_short", "content_hash_high", "model_id")
        stores = owned_per_model_embedding_storage(planning_catalog)
        selects = [
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name)) for name in columns]),
                from_=SqlAliasedTableRef(
                    SqlTableName(get_table_name(vector_cls)), SqlAliasName("v")
                ),
            )
            for _model_id, vector_cls, _ref_cls in stores
        ]
        if not selects:
            column_types = (
                ("sys_id", _UUID_CAST_TARGET),
                ("content_hash_short", _BIGINT_CAST_TARGET),
                ("content_hash_high", _BIGINT_CAST_TARGET),
                ("model_id", _TEXT_CAST_TARGET),
            )
            selects = [SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([
                    SqlSelectAlias(SqlCast(SqlParam(None), target), SqlAliasName(name))
                    for name, target in column_types
                ]),
                where=SqlBinaryOp(SqlParam(1), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(0)),
            )]
        vector_source = SqlSubqueryTableRef(
            selects[0] if len(selects) == 1 else SqlUnionAll(selects), vector_alias,
        )
    vector_conditions = [
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_short"), qualifier=vector_alias),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_short"), qualifier=source_alias),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_high"), qualifier=vector_alias),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_high"), qualifier=source_alias),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("model_id"), qualifier=vector_alias),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("model_hint"), qualifier=source_alias),
        ),
    ]
    skip_compute_whens: list[tuple[SqlRenderable, SqlRenderable]] = []
    if require_algorithm_established:
        algorithm_established_expr = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("algorithm_established"), qualifier=str(source_alias))
        skip_compute_whens.append(
            (
                sql_or(
                    SqlIsNull(algorithm_established_expr),
                    SqlBinaryOp(algorithm_established_expr, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(False)),
                ),
                SqlParam(False),
            ),
        )
    skip_compute_whens.extend(
        [
            (
                SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("model_hint"), qualifier=source_alias)),
                SqlParam(False),
            ),
            (
                SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_short"), qualifier=source_alias)),
                SqlParam(False),
            ),
            (
                SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_high"), qualifier=source_alias)),
                SqlParam(False),
            ),
            (
                SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=str(vector_alias))),
                SqlParam(False),
            ),
        ],
    )
    skip_compute_expr = SqlCase(
        whens=skip_compute_whens,
        else_=SqlParam(True),
    )
    return SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_object_id"), qualifier=source_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("source_object_id"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content"), qualifier=source_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("content"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("model_hint"), qualifier=source_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("model_hint"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("precision_hint"), qualifier=source_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("precision_hint"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_short"), qualifier=source_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("content_hash_short"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_high"), qualifier=source_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("content_hash_high"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(skip_compute_expr, SqlAliasName("skip_compute")),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__order_sys_id"), qualifier=source_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("__order_sys_id"),
                ),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(source_rows, source_alias),
        joins=[
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.LEFT,
                vector_source,
                sql_and(*vector_conditions),
            ),
        ],
    )


def _build_embedding_queue_payload_source_rows(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
    branch_id: BranchId | None,
    revision_id: RevisionId | None,
    metadata_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    write_source_query: SqlRenderable,
    canonical_model_hint: str | None,
    preserve_rows_without_metadata: bool = False,
    include_vector_lookup: bool = True,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Build the canonical SQL relation for embedding content and hash values."""
    source_alias = SqlTableName("__emb_source_rows")
    metadata_alias = SqlTableName("__emb_meta")
    payload_content_part_alias = SqlTableName("__emb_payload_content_parts")
    payload_content_alias = SqlTableName("__emb_payload_content")
    payload_digest_alias = SqlTableName("__emb_payload_digest")

    source_object_id_expr = SqlCast(
        SqlColumnRef(
            SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))),
            qualifier=source_alias,
        ),
        _TEXT_CAST_TARGET,
    )
    fields = get_embedding_source_fields(model_cls, index_name)
    content_part_exprs = _build_embedding_content_part_exprs(
        parameter_transport=ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        index_name=index_name,
        source_alias=source_alias,
    )
    hash_field_parts = [
        _build_source_hash_field_parts(
            parameter_transport=ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            field_name=field_name,
            source_alias=source_alias,
        )
        for field_name in fields
    ]
    hash_digest_alias_names = [SqlAliasName(f"hash_digest_{idx}") for idx in range(len(hash_field_parts))]
    hash_null_alias_names = [SqlAliasName(f"hash_is_null_{idx}") for idx in range(len(hash_field_parts))]
    hash_payload_expr = _build_hash_payload_expr(
        fields=fields,
        index_name=index_name,
        field_digest_exprs=[
            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(alias_name),
                qualifier=payload_content_part_alias,
            )
            for alias_name in hash_digest_alias_names
        ],
        field_is_null_exprs=[
            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(alias_name),
                qualifier=payload_content_part_alias,
            )
            for alias_name in hash_null_alias_names
        ],
    )
    dynamic_model_hint_expr = _build_dynamic_model_hint_expr(metadata_alias)
    model_hint_expr = SqlParam(canonical_model_hint) if canonical_model_hint is not None else dynamic_model_hint_expr
    precision_hint: str | None = None
    index_config = get_vector_config(model_cls, index_name)
    if index_config is not None and index_config.precision_hint is not None:
        precision_hint = index_config.precision_hint.value
    precision_hint_expr: SqlRenderable = NULL if precision_hint is None else SqlParam(precision_hint)

    content_part_alias_names = [SqlAliasName(f"content_part_{idx}") for idx in range(len(content_part_exprs))]
    payload_content_part_rows = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(source_object_id_expr, SqlAliasName("source_object_id")),
                *[
                    SqlSelectAlias(content_part_expr, alias_name)
                    for content_part_expr, alias_name in zip(content_part_exprs, content_part_alias_names, strict=True)
                ],
                *[
                    SqlSelectAlias(field_digest_expr, digest_alias)
                    for (field_digest_expr, _), digest_alias in zip(
                        hash_field_parts,
                        hash_digest_alias_names,
                        strict=True,
                    )
                ],
                *[
                    SqlSelectAlias(field_is_null_expr, null_alias)
                    for (_, field_is_null_expr), null_alias in zip(
                        hash_field_parts,
                        hash_null_alias_names,
                        strict=True,
                    )
                ],
                SqlSelectAlias(model_hint_expr, SqlAliasName("model_hint")),
                SqlSelectAlias(precision_hint_expr, SqlAliasName("precision_hint")),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_nonce"), qualifier=metadata_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("content_hash_nonce"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("algorithm_established"), qualifier=str(metadata_alias)),
                    SqlAliasName("algorithm_established"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))),
                        qualifier=source_alias,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName("__order_sys_id"),
                ),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(write_source_query, source_alias),
        joins=[
            SqlJoin(
                JoinKind.LEFT if preserve_rows_without_metadata else JoinKind.CROSS,
                SqlSubqueryTableRef(
                    _build_metadata_source_query(
                        ctx=ctx,
                        metadata_ref=metadata_ref,
                        table_name=table_name,
                        index_name=index_name,
                    ),
                    metadata_alias,
                ),
                SqlParam(True) if preserve_rows_without_metadata else None,
            ),
        ],
    )
    content_expr = _build_embedding_content_from_fields(
        parameter_transport=ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport,
        field_exprs=[
            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(alias_name),
                qualifier=payload_content_part_alias,
            )
            for alias_name in content_part_alias_names
        ],
    )
    payload_content_rows = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_object_id"), qualifier=payload_content_part_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("source_object_id"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(content_expr, SqlAliasName("content")),
                SqlSelectAlias(hash_payload_expr, SqlAliasName("hash_payload")),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("model_hint"), qualifier=payload_content_part_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("model_hint"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("precision_hint"), qualifier=payload_content_part_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("precision_hint"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlCast(
                        SqlColumnRef(
                            SqlColumnName("content_hash_nonce"),
                            qualifier=payload_content_part_alias,
                        ),
                        _BYTEA_CAST_TARGET,
                    )
                    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS
                    else SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName("content_hash_nonce"),
                        qualifier=payload_content_part_alias,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName("content_hash_nonce"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName("algorithm_established"),
                        qualifier=payload_content_part_alias,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName("algorithm_established"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__order_sys_id"), qualifier=payload_content_part_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("__order_sys_id"),
                ),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(payload_content_part_rows, payload_content_part_alias),
    )
    content_digest_expr = SqlCase(
        whens=[
            (
                SqlIsNull(
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName("content_hash_nonce"),
                        qualifier=payload_content_alias,
                    ),
                ),
                NULL,
            ),
        ],
        else_=SqlSaltedSha256Digest(
            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName("content_hash_nonce"),
                qualifier=payload_content_alias,
            ),
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("hash_payload"), qualifier=payload_content_alias),
        ),
    )
    payload_digest_rows = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_object_id"), qualifier=payload_content_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("source_object_id"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content"), qualifier=payload_content_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("content"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("model_hint"), qualifier=payload_content_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("model_hint"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("precision_hint"), qualifier=payload_content_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("precision_hint"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(content_digest_expr, SqlAliasName("content_digest")),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName("algorithm_established"),
                        qualifier=payload_content_alias,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName("algorithm_established"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__order_sys_id"), qualifier=payload_content_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("__order_sys_id"),
                ),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(payload_content_rows, payload_content_alias),
    )
    content_hash_short_expr = SqlCase(
        whens=[
            (
                SqlIsNull(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_digest"), qualifier=payload_digest_alias),
                ),
                NULL,
            ),
        ],
        else_=SqlDigestSliceBigInt(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_digest"), qualifier=payload_digest_alias),
            0,
        ),
    )
    content_hash_high_expr = SqlCase(
        whens=[
            (
                SqlIsNull(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_digest"), qualifier=payload_digest_alias),
                ),
                NULL,
            ),
        ],
        else_=SqlDigestSliceBigInt(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_digest"), qualifier=payload_digest_alias),
            8,
        ),
    )
    digest_rows_with_hashes = SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_object_id"), qualifier=payload_digest_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("source_object_id"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content"), qualifier=payload_digest_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("content"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("model_hint"), qualifier=payload_digest_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("model_hint"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("precision_hint"), qualifier=payload_digest_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("precision_hint"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(content_hash_short_expr, SqlAliasName("content_hash_short")),
                SqlSelectAlias(content_hash_high_expr, SqlAliasName("content_hash_high")),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(
                        SqlColumnName("algorithm_established"),
                        qualifier=payload_digest_alias,
                    ),
                    SqlAliasName("algorithm_established"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__order_sys_id"), qualifier=payload_digest_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("__order_sys_id"),
                ),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(payload_digest_rows, payload_digest_alias),
    )
    if not include_vector_lookup:
        return digest_rows_with_hashes
    return _build_skip_compute_payload_rows(
        source_rows=digest_rows_with_hashes,
        source_alias=SqlTableName("__emb_payload_hashes"),
        model_cls=model_cls,
        table_name=table_name,
        index_name=index_name,
        branch_id=branch_id,
        revision_id=revision_id,
        canonical_model_hint=canonical_model_hint,
        require_algorithm_established=canonical_model_hint is not None,
        planning_catalog=ctx.planning_catalog,
    )


def _build_materialized_write_source_query_for_index(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    object_ids: Sequence[SysId],
) -> SqlRenderable:
    return SqlSelect(
        select=SqlSelectList([SqlStar()]),
        from_=SqlTableIdent(get_table_name(model_cls)),
        where=SqlWhereClause(
            SqlIn(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")))),
                [SqlParam(object_id) for object_id in object_ids],
            ),
        ),
    )


def _build_materialized_write_source_query_from_rows(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
    rows: Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> SqlRenderable:
    source_fields = list(get_embedding_source_fields(model_cls, index_name))
    large_column_pointers = (
        large_column_pointer_name(config.column) for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls) if config.column in source_fields
    )
    projections = [
        "sys_id",
        *dict.fromkeys(
            (
                *("properties" if is_dynamic_property_field(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) else field_name for field_name in source_fields),
                *large_column_pointers,
            ),
        ),
    ]
    selects: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for row in rows:
        aliases = [
            SqlSelectAlias(
                SqlParam(get_field_value(row, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) if field_name != "sys_id" else row.sys_id),
                SqlAliasName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))),
            )
            for field_name in projections
        ]
        selects.append(SqlSelect(select=SqlSelectList(aliases)))
    if not selects:
        msg = "rows must be non-empty"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return selects[0] if len(selects) == 1 else SqlUnionAll(selects)


def _field_annotation_contains(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_name: str,
    target_type: type[object],
) -> bool:
    annotation = _resolved_field_annotation(model_cls, field_name)
    if annotation is None:
        return False
    return _annotation_contains_type(annotation, target_type)


def _index_source_fields_require_materialized_queue_path(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
) -> bool:
    large_column_names = {config.column for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)}
    return any(
        (
            is_dynamic_property_field(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            or field_name in large_column_names
            or (
                (annotation := _resolved_field_annotation(model_cls, field_name)) is not None
                and (is_blob_column(annotation) or _annotation_contains_type(annotation, bytes))
            )
        )
        for field_name in get_embedding_source_fields(model_cls, index_name)
    )


def _build_source_column_expr(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_name: str,
    source_alias: SqlTableName,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if is_dynamic_property_field(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)):
        return SqlJsonAccess(
            JsonAccessKind.GET_TEXT,
            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("properties"))),
                qualifier=source_alias,
            ),
            SqlJsonPath(f"$.{field_name}"),
        )
    return SqlColumnRef(
        SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))),
        qualifier=source_alias,
    )


def _build_source_payload_text_expr(
    *,
    parameter_transport: DmlParameterTransport,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_name: str,
    source_alias: SqlTableName,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    return _build_source_text_expr(
        parameter_transport=parameter_transport,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        field_name=field_name,
        source_alias=source_alias,
        sqlite_bytes_func_name="nera_utf8_text_or_null",
    )


def _build_source_text_expr(
    *,
    parameter_transport: DmlParameterTransport,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_name: str,
    source_alias: SqlTableName,
    sqlite_bytes_func_name: str,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    source_expr = _build_source_column_expr(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        field_name=field_name,
        source_alias=source_alias,
    )
    if _field_annotation_contains(model_cls, field_name, bool):
        return SqlCase(
            whens=[
                (SqlIsNull(source_expr), NULL),
                (SqlBinaryOp(source_expr, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(True)), SqlInlineLiteral("True")),
            ],
            else_=SqlInlineLiteral("False"),
        )
    if _field_annotation_contains(model_cls, field_name, bytes):
        if parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.STRING_UUIDS:
            return SqlFuncCall(sqlite_bytes_func_name, [source_expr])
        if parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
            return SqlFuncCall("encode", [source_expr, SqlParam("base64")])
        return SqlFuncCall("HEX", [source_expr])
    return SqlCast(source_expr, _TEXT_CAST_TARGET)


def _build_source_hash_field_parts(
    *,
    parameter_transport: DmlParameterTransport,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_name: str,
    source_alias: SqlTableName,
) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, SqlRenderable]:
    from l5200_vector_index.embedding_content_hash import compute_embedding_field_digest

    source_expr = _build_source_hash_text_expr(
        parameter_transport=parameter_transport,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        field_name=field_name,
        source_alias=source_alias,
    )
    null_digest = SqlInlineLiteral(compute_embedding_field_digest(None))
    source_digest = SqlCase(
        whens=[(SqlIsNull(source_expr), null_digest)],
        else_=SqlSha256HexDigest(source_expr),
    )
    large_columns = {config.column for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)}
    if field_name not in large_columns:
        return source_digest, SqlIsNull(source_expr)

    pointer_expr = SqlColumnRef(
        get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(ContentColumnName(field_name)))),
        qualifier=source_alias,
    )
    digest_expr = SqlCase(
        whens=[(SqlIsNull(pointer_expr), source_digest)],
        else_=SqlFuncCall("LOWER", [SqlCast(pointer_expr, _TEXT_CAST_TARGET)]),
    )
    return digest_expr, sql_and(SqlIsNull(pointer_expr), SqlIsNull(source_expr))


def _build_source_hash_text_expr(
    *,
    parameter_transport: DmlParameterTransport,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_name: str,
    source_alias: SqlTableName,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if _field_annotation_contains(model_cls, field_name, bytes):
        return _build_source_column_expr(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            field_name=field_name,
            source_alias=source_alias,
        )
    return _build_source_text_expr(
        parameter_transport=parameter_transport,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        field_name=field_name,
        source_alias=source_alias,
        sqlite_bytes_func_name="nera_py_str_bytes",
    )


def _build_embedding_content_part_exprs(
    *,
    parameter_transport: DmlParameterTransport,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
    source_alias: SqlTableName,
) -> list[SqlRenderable]:
    return [
        _build_source_payload_text_expr(
            parameter_transport=parameter_transport,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            field_name=field_name,
            source_alias=source_alias,
        )
        for field_name in get_embedding_source_fields(model_cls, index_name)
    ]


def _build_embedding_content_from_fields(
    *,
    parameter_transport: DmlParameterTransport,
    field_exprs: Sequence[SqlRenderable],
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if not field_exprs:
        return NULL

    if parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
        return SqlCase(
            whens=[
                (
                    sql_and(*(SqlIsNull(field_expr) for field_expr in field_exprs)),
                    NULL,
                ),
            ],
            else_=SqlFuncCall(
                "CONCAT_WS",
                [
                    SqlInlineLiteral("\n"),
                    *field_exprs,
                ],
            ),
        )

    combined_expr = SqlFuncCall(
        "CONCAT",
        [
            SqlCase(
                whens=[(SqlIsNull(field_expr), SqlInlineLiteral(""))],
                else_=SqlFuncCall("CONCAT", [field_expr, SqlInlineLiteral("\n")]),
            )
            for field_expr in field_exprs
        ],
    )
    combined_length_expr = SqlFuncCall("LENGTH", [combined_expr])
    return SqlCase(
        whens=[
            (
                sql_and(*(SqlIsNull(field_expr) for field_expr in field_exprs)),
                NULL,
            ),
        ],
        else_=SqlFuncCall(
            "SUBSTR",
            [
                combined_expr,
                SqlInlineLiteral(1),
                SqlBinaryOp(combined_length_expr, BinaryOp.SUB, SqlInlineLiteral(1)),
            ],
        ),
    )


def _build_hash_payload_expr(
    *,
    fields: Sequence[str],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
    field_exprs: Sequence[SqlRenderable] | None = None,
    field_digest_exprs: Sequence[SqlRenderable] | None = None,
    field_is_null_exprs: Sequence[SqlRenderable] | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    from l5200_vector_index.embedding_content_hash import (
        compute_embedding_field_digest,
        get_embedding_hash_field_names,
    )

    if field_digest_exprs is None or field_is_null_exprs is None:
        if field_exprs is None or field_digest_exprs is not None or field_is_null_exprs is not None:
            msg = "Hash payload requires raw fields or complete digest/null-marker pairs"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        null_digest = SqlInlineLiteral(compute_embedding_field_digest(None))
        field_digest_exprs = tuple(
            SqlCase(
                whens=[(SqlIsNull(field_expr), null_digest)],
                else_=SqlSha256HexDigest(field_expr),
            )
            for field_expr in field_exprs
        )
        field_is_null_exprs = tuple(SqlIsNull(field_expr) for field_expr in field_exprs)
    elif field_exprs is not None:
        msg = "Hash payload cannot combine raw fields with precomputed digests"
        raise ValueError(msg)

    if len(fields) != len(field_digest_exprs) or len(fields) != len(field_is_null_exprs):
        msg = (
            "Hash payload field mismatch: "
            f"{len(fields)} fields, {len(field_digest_exprs)} digests, "
            f"and {len(field_is_null_exprs)} null markers"
        )
        raise ValueError(msg)
    field_aliases = get_embedding_hash_field_names(list(fields))

    payload_parts: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlInlineLiteral("embedding_hash_v2"),
        SqlInlineLiteral(index_name),
    ]
    for field_alias, field_digest_expr, field_is_null_expr in zip(
        field_aliases,
        field_digest_exprs,
        field_is_null_exprs,
        strict=True,
    ):
        null_marker_expr = SqlCase(
            whens=[(field_is_null_expr, SqlInlineLiteral("1"))],
            else_=SqlInlineLiteral("0"),
        )
        payload_parts.append(
            SqlFuncCall(
                "CONCAT",
                [
                    SqlInlineLiteral(f"{field_alias}:"),
                    null_marker_expr,
                    SqlInlineLiteral(":"),
                    field_digest_expr,
                ],
            ),
        )
    return SqlFuncCall("CONCAT_WS", [SqlInlineLiteral("|"), *payload_parts])


def _build_metadata_source_query(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    metadata_ref: str | None,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    metadata_cte = None if metadata_ref is None else ctx.cte_refs.get(metadata_ref)
    metadata_projection = SqlSelectList(
        [
            SqlSelectAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("algorithm_established")), SqlAliasName("algorithm_established")),
            SqlSelectAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("provider")), SqlAliasName("provider")),
            SqlSelectAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("model")), SqlAliasName("model")),
            SqlSelectAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash_nonce")), SqlAliasName("content_hash_nonce")),
        ],
    )
    if metadata_cte is not None and (metadata_cte.auxiliary_query is not None or "." not in str(metadata_cte.ref_id)):
        return SqlSelect(
            select=metadata_projection,
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(metadata_cte.ref_id)),
        )
    return SqlSelect(
        select=metadata_projection,
        from_=SqlTableIdent(get_table_name(EmbeddingMetadata)),
        where=sql_and(
            SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("table_name")), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(table_name)),
            SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("field_name")), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(index_name)),
        ),
        limit=1,
    )


def _resolve_materialized_model_hint(
    *,
    metadata: EmbeddingMetadata | None,
    canonical_model_hint: str | None,
) -> str | None:
    """Reuse the canonical metadata property semantics for materialized writes."""
    if canonical_model_hint is not None:
        return canonical_model_hint
    if metadata is not None:
        metadata_model_id = metadata.model_id
        if metadata_model_id is not None:
            model_id: str = metadata_model_id
            return model_id
    return None


def _build_latest_queue_sequence_expr(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    metadata_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    metadata_cte = resolve_sql_visible_relation(ctx, metadata_ref)
    if metadata_cte is not None and (metadata_cte.columns is None or "next_sequence_id" in metadata_cte.columns):
        metadata_source = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("next_sequence_id"))]),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(metadata_cte.ref_id)),
            limit=1,
        )
    else:
        metadata_source = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("next_sequence_id"))]),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(get_table_name(EmbeddingMetadata)),
            where=SqlWhereClause(
                sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("table_name")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(table_name),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("field_name")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(index_name),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            limit=1,
        )
    next_sequence = SqlSubquery(metadata_source)
    return SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", [next_sequence, SqlParam(1)]),
        BinaryOp.SUB,
        SqlParam(1),
    )


def _max_queue_sequence_expr() -> SqlRenderable:
    return SqlFuncCall(
        "COALESCE",
        [
            SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.MAX, SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sequence_id"))),
            SqlParam(0),
        ],
    )


def _queue_table_index_conditions(

def _compile_update_embedding_metadata_queued_state_step(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
    queue_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    queue_message_ids: Sequence[QueueMessageId],
) -> CompiledStep[None]:
    queue_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(queue_ref))
    queue_table_batch_conditions = _queue_table_index_conditions(model_cls, index_name)
    max_sequence_uses_queue_table_batch = False
    queued_state_shape = ctx.backend_profile.providers.vector_maintenance_provider.queued_state_sql_shape()
    mysql_family = queued_state_shape is EmbeddingQueuedStateSqlShape.MYSQL_SCALAR_SUBQUERY
    sqlite_backend = queued_state_shape is EmbeddingQueuedStateSqlShape.SQLITE_SCALAR_SUBQUERY
    if queue_cte is not None:
        max_sequence_uses_queue_table_batch = True
        max_sequence_source_query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        _max_queue_sequence_expr(),
                        SqlAliasName("max_sequence"),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(get_table_name(QueueMessage)),
            where=SqlWhereClause(
                sql_and(*queue_table_batch_conditions),
            ),
        )
        queue_cte = None
    elif queue_cte is not None:
        max_sequence_source_query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        _max_queue_sequence_expr(),
                        SqlAliasName("max_sequence"),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(queue_cte.ref_id)),
        )
    elif queue_message_ids:
        max_sequence_source_query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        _max_queue_sequence_expr(),
                        SqlAliasName("max_sequence"),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(get_table_name(QueueMessage)),
            where=SqlIn(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                [SqlParam(message_id) for message_id in queue_message_ids],
            ),
        )
    else:
        max_sequence_uses_queue_table_batch = True
        max_sequence_source_query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        _max_queue_sequence_expr(),
                        SqlAliasName("max_sequence"),
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(get_table_name(QueueMessage)),
            where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*queue_table_batch_conditions)),
        )

    sequence_alias = SqlTableName("__emb_sequence_state")
    max_sequence_source = SqlSubqueryTableRef(
        max_sequence_source_query,
        sequence_alias,
    )
    raw_max_sequence_expr: SqlRenderable = (
        SqlSubquery(max_sequence_source_query)
        if mysql_family or sqlite_backend
        else SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("max_sequence"), qualifier=sequence_alias)
    )
    max_sequence_expr: SqlRenderable = (
        SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", [raw_max_sequence_expr, SqlParam(0)]) if mysql_family else raw_max_sequence_expr
    )
    where_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("table_name")),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(get_table_name(model_cls)),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("field_name")),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(index_name),
        ),
    ]
    if sqlite_backend and queue_cte is not None:
        where_conditions.append(
            SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList([SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(1), SqlAliasName("__exists"))]),
                    from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(queue_cte.ref_id)),
                    limit=1,
                ),
            ),
        )
    if max_sequence_uses_queue_table_batch:
        where_conditions.append(
            SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList([SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(1), SqlAliasName("__exists"))]),
                    from_=SqlTableIdent(get_table_name(QueueMessage)),
                    where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*queue_table_batch_conditions)),
                    limit=1,
                ),
            ),
        )
    compiled = CompiledStep[None](
        grammar=SqlUpdate(
            table=SqlTableIdent(get_table_name(EmbeddingMetadata)),
            set_items=[
                SqlSetItem(SqlColumnName("last_queued_at"), SqlFuncCall("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP", [])),
                SqlSetItem(SqlColumnName("last_queued_sequence"), max_sequence_expr),
                SqlSetItem(
                    SqlColumnName("next_sequence_id"),
                    SqlBinaryOp(max_sequence_expr, BinaryOp.ADD, SqlParam(1)),
                ),
            ],
            from_=None if mysql_family or sqlite_backend else max_sequence_source,
            where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*where_conditions)),
        ),
        needs_returning=False,
    )
    if sqlite_backend and queue_cte is not None and queue_cte.auxiliary_query is not None:
        return replace(compiled, auxiliary_ctes=((queue_cte.ref_id, queue_cte.auxiliary_query),))
    if queue_cte is None or compiled.grammar is None:
        return compiled
    gated = _copy_compiled_step_with_grammar(
        compiled,
        gate_grammar_for_cte(compiled.grammar, queue_cte.ref_id),
    )
    if queue_cte.auxiliary_query is not None:
        gated = replace(
            gated,
            auxiliary_ctes=((queue_cte.ref_id, queue_cte.auxiliary_query),),
        )
    return gated


def _collect_embedding_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *ref_ids: str | None,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None:
    """Collect auxiliary_query CTE definitions for dependency refs.

    Single-step strategies (not DataModifyingCte) do not auto-include CTE
    bindings from ``ctx.cte_refs``; steps that reference published CTEs in
    their grammar must surface ``auxiliary_query`` explicitly via
    ``CompiledStep.auxiliary_ctes`` so the WITH clause is emitted alongside
    the dependent statement.
    """
    if ctx.cte_refs is None:
        return None
    seen: set[str] = set()
    defs: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] = []
    for ref_id in ref_ids:
        if ref_id is None or ref_id in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(ref_id)
        binding = resolve_sql_visible_relation(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(ref_id))
        if binding is None or binding.auxiliary_query is None:
            continue
        defs.append((binding.ref_id, binding.auxiliary_query))
    return defs or None


def _compile_embedding_queue_insert_step(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    index_name: SqlIndexName,
    event_type: str,
    queue_batch_ref: EmbeddingQueueBatchRef,
    revision_id: RevisionId | None,
    branch_id: BranchId | None,
    write_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    metadata_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    previous_queue_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    previous_rows_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    object_ids: Sequence[SysId],
    source_rows: Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow],
    canonical_model_hint: str | None,
) -> CompiledStep[list[QueueMessageId]]:
    write_source_query = _build_embedding_queue_write_source_query(
        ctx=ctx,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        index_name=index_name,
        write_ref=write_ref,
        previous_rows_ref=previous_rows_ref,
        object_ids=object_ids,
        source_rows=source_rows,
    )
    if write_source_query is None:
        return _compile_zero_queue_insert_step()

    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    payload_source_rows = _build_embedding_queue_payload_source_rows(
        ctx=ctx,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        table_name=SqlTableName(table_name),
        index_name=index_name,
        branch_id=branch_id,
        revision_id=revision_id,
        metadata_ref=metadata_ref,
        write_source_query=write_source_query,
        canonical_model_hint=canonical_model_hint,
    )
    if previous_queue_ref is not None:
        compiled = _compile_embedding_queue_insert_after_previous_payload_rows(
            ctx=ctx,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            index_name=index_name,
            metadata_ref=metadata_ref,
            event_type=event_type,
            queue_batch_ref=queue_batch_ref,
            revision_id=revision_id,
            branch_id=branch_id,
            previous_queue_ref=previous_queue_ref,
            payload_source_rows=payload_source_rows,
            payload_source_alias=SqlTableName("__emb_payload_source"),
            projected_alias=SqlTableName("__emb_queue_rows"),
        )
    else:
        compiled = _compile_embedding_queue_insert_after_payload_rows(
            ctx=ctx,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            index_name=index_name,
            metadata_ref=metadata_ref,
            event_type=event_type,
            queue_batch_ref=queue_batch_ref,
            revision_id=revision_id,
            branch_id=branch_id,
            payload_source_rows=payload_source_rows,
            payload_source_alias=SqlTableName("__emb_payload_source"),
            projected_alias=SqlTableName("__emb_queue_rows"),
        )
    auxiliary_ctes = _collect_embedding_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(
        ctx,
        str(write_ref),
        str(metadata_ref),
        str(previous_queue_ref) if previous_queue_ref is not None else None,
        str(previous_rows_ref) if previous_rows_ref is not None else None,
    )
    if auxiliary_ctes:
        compiled = replace(compiled, auxiliary_ctes=tuple(auxiliary_ctes))
    return compiled


class _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """Persist queue-watermark metadata after SQL-native enqueue."""

    def __init__(
        self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._index_name = config.index_name
        self._queue_ref = config.queue_ref
        self._after_refs = config.after_refs
        self._queue_message_ids: list[QueueMessageId] = []
        self._max_sequence: int | None = None

    @property
    def level(self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def step_tags(self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "update", "embedding", "metadata"})

    def tables_read(self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({get_table_name(EmbeddingMetadata), get_table_name(QueueMessage)})

    def tables_written(self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({get_table_name(EmbeddingMetadata)})

    def dependencies(self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        if self._after_refs:
            return frozenset(self._after_refs)
        return frozenset({self._queue_ref})

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep) -> bool:
        return bool(self._after_refs)

    def compile(
        self: _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        self._max_sequence = None
        self._queue_message_ids = []
        return _compile_update_embedding_metadata_queued_state_step(
            ctx,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            index_name=SqlIndexName(self._index_name),
            queue_ref=self._queue_ref,
            queue_message_ids=self._queue_message_ids,
        )


class _ResolveMaterializedEmbeddingMetadataStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[EmbeddingMetadata | None]):
    """Project the authoritative metadata row from a raw metadata upsert result."""

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _ResolveMaterializedEmbeddingMetadataStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = tuple(
            get_db_column_name(EmbeddingMetadata, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in EmbeddingMetadata.model_fields
        )
        column_type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(
            EmbeddingMetadata,
            tuple(get_db_column_name(EmbeddingMetadata, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in EmbeddingMetadata.model_fields),
        )
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = EmbeddingMetadata
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _ResolveMaterializedEmbeddingMetadataConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = config.source_ref

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "embedding", "metadata", "materialize"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({get_table_name(EmbeddingMetadata)})

    def cte_rewritable_read_tables(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.tables_read()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[EmbeddingMetadata | None]:

class _PrepareMaterializedEmbeddingQueueRowsStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[list[_MaterializedPreparedQueueRow]]):
    """Pure preparer for materialized embedding queue payload rows."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _PrepareMaterializedEmbeddingQueueRowsConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._index_name = config.index_name
        self._write_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId = ServerPlanRefId(config.write_ref_id)
        self._metadata_ref = config.metadata_ref
        self._after_refs = config.after_refs
        self._previous_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(config.previous_rows_ref) if config.previous_rows_ref is not None else None
        self._source_rows = tuple(config.source_rows)
        self._materialize_inputs = config.materialize_inputs

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return self._materialize_inputs

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self) -> bool:
        return self._materialize_inputs

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "embedding", "queue", "prepare"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({get_table_name(self._model_cls), get_table_name(EmbeddingMetadata)})

    def cte_rewritable_read_tables(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset() if self._materialize_inputs else self.tables_read()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = {self._metadata_ref, *self._after_refs}
        if not self._source_rows:
            deps.add(self._write_ref_id)
        if self._previous_rows_ref is not None:
            deps.add(self._previous_rows_ref)
        return frozenset(deps)

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _PrepareMaterializedEmbeddingQueueRowsStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = (
            "__order_sys_id",
            "source_object_id",
            "model_hint",
            "precision_hint",
            "content_hash_short",
            "content_hash_high",
            "content",
            "skip_compute",
        )
        column_type_hints = _embedding_prepared_queue_row_type_hints()
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _PrepareMaterializedEmbeddingQueueRowsStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(
        self,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[list[_MaterializedPreparedQueueRow]]:
        write_ref = str(self._write_ref_id)
        metadata_ref = str(self._metadata_ref)
        write_cte = None if self._source_rows else resolve_sql_visible_relation(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(write_ref))
        metadata_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(metadata_ref)
        previous_cte = (
            None if self._previous_rows_ref is None else resolve_sql_visible_relation(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(self._previous_rows_ref))
        )
        source_query = None
        if self._source_rows:
            source_query = _build_materialized_write_source_query_from_rows(
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                index_name=SqlIndexName(self._index_name),
                rows=self._source_rows,
            )
        if source_query is None and not isinstance(write_cte, CteReference):
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=f"{type(self).__name__}.compile",
                trigger=f"write ref {write_ref!r} has no SQL-visible rowset",
                blocked_path=("_PrepareMaterializedEmbeddingQueueRowsStep cannot prepare queue rows from Python write results."),
                result_contract=("materialized embedding queue prepare rows must compile from SQL write rows and SQL metadata rows."),
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Ensure the write step publishes a SQL-visible CTE before materialized queue preparation.",
                    "Keep content extraction, hashing, and unchanged-row filtering in SQL.",
                ),
            )
        if self._previous_rows_ref is not None and not isinstance(previous_cte, CteReference):
            previous_ref = str(self._previous_rows_ref)
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=f"{type(self).__name__}.compile",
                trigger=f"previous rows ref {previous_ref!r} has no SQL-visible rowset",
                blocked_path=("_PrepareMaterializedEmbeddingQueueRowsStep cannot filter unchanged rows from Python previous results."),
                result_contract=("materialized embedding queue unchanged-row filtering must compare SQL current and previous rows."),
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Ensure previous row selection publishes a SQL-visible CTE before queue preparation.",
                    "Keep source-field change detection in SQL.",
                ),
            )
        auxiliary_ctes = _collect_auxiliary_ctes(
            *(
                ((metadata_cte,) if isinstance(metadata_cte, CteReference) else ())
                if source_query is not None
                else tuple(cte for cte in (write_cte, metadata_cte, previous_cte) if isinstance(cte, CteReference))
            ),
        )
        __opa002_grammar_3162 = _build_prepared_materialized_queue_rows_stmt(
            ctx=ctx,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            index_name=SqlIndexName(self._index_name),
            write_cte=write_cte if isinstance(write_cte, CteReference) else None,
            write_source_query=source_query,
            metadata_ref=self._metadata_ref,
            previous_cte=previous_cte,
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract()
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_3162,
            closed_post_op=raw_rows_post_op(),
            needs_returning=True,
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
            allow_empty_provenance_manifest=True,
        )


def _compile_delete_embedding_refs_runtime(

            ref_id,
            ctx,
            ref_model_cls=ref_model_cls,
            model_cls=model_cls,

            trigger_ref=trigger_ref,
            revision_id=revision_id,
            branch_id=branch_id,

    compiled = _compile_delete_embedding_refs_step(
        ref_id,
        ctx,
        ref_model_cls=ref_model_cls,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        index_name=index_name,
        object_ids=object_ids,
        should_delete=should_delete,
        revision_id=revision_id,
        branch_id=branch_id,
    )
    return _gate_compiled_step_for_trigger_cte(
        compiled,
        ctx,
        trigger_ref=trigger_ref,

    )

class EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """L4: Auto-queue embedding tasks after a write operation.

    Injected by InsertManyIntent.lower() / InsertIntent.lower() when the
    model has @vector_indexed fields. Lowers into a metadata shell upsert,
    an authoritative metadata read, and then a queue insert step.
    """

    def __init__(
        self: EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        *,
        config: _EmbeddingAutoQueueConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        if config.source_rows and not config.after_refs:
            msg = "Literal embedding queue source rows require an exact write-completion producer in after_refs."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self._model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow] = model_cls
        self._write_ref_id = config.write_ref_id
        self._event_type = config.event_type
        self._index_names = config.index_names
        self._previous_rows_ref = config.previous_rows_ref
        self._revision_id = config.revision_id
        self._branch_id = config.branch_id
        self._materialized_write_ref = config.materialized_write_ref
        self._source_rows = config.source_rows
        self._after_refs = config.after_refs

    @property
    def level(self: EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent) -> int:
        return 3

    def result_cardinality(self: EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self: EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent) -> bool:
        return False

    def step_tags(self: EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "embedding", "queue", "intent"})

    def tables_read(self: EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = {str(ref_id) for ref_id in self._after_refs}
        if not self._source_rows:
            deps.add(str(self._write_ref_id))
        if self._previous_rows_ref is not None:
            deps.add(str(self._previous_rows_ref))
        return frozenset(deps)

    def compile(
        self: EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        del ctx
        raise TypeError("L4 EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent must be lowered before compile")

    def lower(
        self: EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent,
        ctx: LoweringContext,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import (
            QueryFirstRawStep,
            _QueryFirstRawStepConfig,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.write_side_effect_intents import (
            RecordQueueEventIntent,
            _RecordQueueEventConfig,
        )

        indexes = {name: config for name, config in get_vector_indexes(self._model_cls).items() if config.auto_queue}
        index_names = (
            tuple(name for name in self._index_names if name in indexes) if self._index_names is not None else tuple(indexes.keys())
        )
        if not index_names:
            return [ReturnValueStep(self.ref_id, False)]

        table_name = get_table_name(self._model_cls)
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        last_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        deferred_event_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        deferred_event_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        revision_id: RevisionId | None = self._revision_id
        if revision_id is None and ctx.revision_id is not None:
            revision_id = RevisionId(ctx.revision_id)
        branch_id: BranchId | None = self._branch_id
        if branch_id is None and ctx.branch_id is not None:
            branch_id = BranchId(ctx.branch_id)
        previous_queue_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None

        for index_name in index_names:
            prefix = f"{self.ref_id}_{index_name}"

            meta_ensure_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{prefix}_meta_ensure")
            meta_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{prefix}_meta")
            queue_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{prefix}_queue")
            queue_rows_ref = queue_ref
            event_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{prefix}_queue_event")
            metadata_update_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{prefix}_metadata_queued_state")
            metadata_update_boundary_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{prefix}_metadata_update_boundary")
            prepared_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{prefix}_prepared_rows")
            metadata_nonce = secrets.token_bytes(16)
            materialized_queue_path = (
                bool(self._source_rows)
                or self._previous_rows_ref is not None
                or ctx.backend_profile.traits.versioned_staging_transport is VersionedStagingTransport.MATERIALIZED_RELATION
                or self._materialized_write_ref
                or _index_source_fields_require_materialized_queue_path(
                    self._model_cls,
                    SqlIndexName(index_name),
                )
            )
            write_ref_dependencies = frozenset() if self._source_rows else frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(self._write_ref_id)})
            metadata_after_refs = write_ref_dependencies
            if (
                ctx.backend_profile.traits.permission_user_transport is PermissionUserTransport.MATERIALIZED_VALUE
                and write_ref_dependencies
            ):
                metadata_boundary_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{prefix}_meta_boundary")
                steps.append(BarrierStep(metadata_boundary_ref, depends_on=write_ref_dependencies))
                metadata_after_refs = frozenset({metadata_boundary_ref})
            queue_order_ref = None
            steps.extend(
                [
                    UpsertRawResultStep(
                        meta_ensure_ref,
                        EmbeddingMetadata,
                        _UpsertStepConfig(
                            instance=EmbeddingMetadata(
                                table_name=table_name,
                                field_name=index_name,
                                algorithm_established=False,
                                content_hash_nonce=metadata_nonce,
                                next_sequence_id=1,
                                next_expected_sequence=1,
                            ),
                            conflict_columns=("table_name", "field_name"),
                            on_conflict=(
                                {}
                                if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_conflict_transport is DmlConflictTransport.INSERTED_VALUES
                                else {
                                    "content_hash_nonce": COALESCE(
                                        field(EmbeddingMetadata.content_hash_nonce),
                                        EXCLUDED(field(EmbeddingMetadata.content_hash_nonce)),
                                    ),
                                }
                            ),
                            after_refs=metadata_after_refs,
                        ),
                    ),
                ],
            )
            if materialized_queue_path:
                if (
                    ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_bulk_transport is not DmlBulkTransport.PAYLOAD_AWARE_BOUND_VALUES
                    or ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_result_transport is not DmlResultTransport.RETURNING_RELATION
                    and not ctx.sql_render_dialect().supports_returning()
                ):
                    steps.append(
                        QueryFirstRawStep(
                            meta_ref,
                            EmbeddingMetadata,
                            _QueryFirstRawStepConfig(
                                query_spec=_build_query_spec(
                                    EmbeddingMetadata,
                                    (field(EmbeddingMetadata.table_name) == table_name)
                                    & (field(EmbeddingMetadata.field_name) == index_name),
                                ),
                                after_refs=frozenset({meta_ensure_ref}),
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                else:
                    steps.append(
                        _ResolveMaterializedEmbeddingMetadataStep(
                            meta_ref,
                            config=_ResolveMaterializedEmbeddingMetadataConfig(
                                source_ref=meta_ensure_ref,
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                steps.append(
                    _PrepareMaterializedEmbeddingQueueRowsStep(
                        prepared_rows_ref,
                        model_cls=self._model_cls,
                        config=_PrepareMaterializedEmbeddingQueueRowsConfig(
                            index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                            write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(self._write_ref_id),
                            metadata_ref=meta_ref,
                            after_refs=self._after_refs,
                            previous_rows_ref=self._previous_rows_ref,
                            revision_id=revision_id,
                            branch_id=branch_id,
                            source_rows=self._source_rows,
                            materialize_inputs=(
                                ctx.backend_profile.traits.permission_user_transport is PermissionUserTransport.MATERIALIZED_VALUE
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            queue_metadata_ref = meta_ref if materialized_queue_path else meta_ensure_ref
            queue_insert_step: ServerPlanStep[Any]
            if materialized_queue_path and queue_order_ref is not None:
                queue_insert_step = _MaterializedEmbeddingQueueInsertAfterPreviousStep(
                    queue_ref,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    config=_MaterializedEmbeddingQueueInsertAfterPreviousConfig(
                        index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                        prepared_rows_ref=prepared_rows_ref,
                        metadata_ref=meta_ref,
                        previous_queue_ref=queue_order_ref,
                        event_type=self._event_type,
                        revision_id=revision_id,
                        branch_id=branch_id,
                    ),
                )
            elif materialized_queue_path:
                queue_insert_step = _MaterializedEmbeddingQueueInsertStep(
                    queue_ref,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    config=_MaterializedEmbeddingQueueInsertConfig(
                        index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                        prepared_rows_ref=prepared_rows_ref,
                        metadata_ref=meta_ref,
                        event_type=self._event_type,
                        revision_id=revision_id,
                        branch_id=branch_id,
                    ),
                )
            elif queue_order_ref is not None:
                queue_insert_step = _EmbeddingQueueBulkInsertAfterPreviousStep(
                    queue_ref,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    config=_BulkEmbeddingQueueInsertAfterPreviousConfig(
                        index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                        write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(self._write_ref_id),
                        metadata_ref=queue_metadata_ref,
                        previous_queue_ref=queue_order_ref,
                        previous_rows_ref=self._previous_rows_ref,
                        event_type=self._event_type,
                        revision_id=revision_id,
                        branch_id=branch_id,
                        source_rows=self._source_rows,
                    ),
                )
            else:
                queue_insert_step = _EmbeddingQueueBulkInsertStep(
                    queue_ref,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    config=_BulkEmbeddingQueueInsertConfig(
                        index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                        write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(self._write_ref_id),
                        metadata_ref=queue_metadata_ref,
                        previous_rows_ref=self._previous_rows_ref,
                        event_type=self._event_type,
                        revision_id=revision_id,
                        branch_id=branch_id,
                        source_rows=self._source_rows,
                    ),
                )
            steps.extend(
                [
                    queue_insert_step,
                    BarrierStep(
                        metadata_update_boundary_ref,
                        depends_on=frozenset({queue_ref}),
                    ),
                    _UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep(
                        metadata_update_ref,
                        model_cls=self._model_cls,
                        config=_UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateConfig(
                            index_name=SqlIndexName(index_name),
                            queue_ref=queue_ref,
                            after_refs=frozenset({metadata_update_boundary_ref}),
                        ),
                    ),
                ],
            )
            deferred_event_steps.extend(
                RecordQueueEventIntent(
                    event_ref,
                    _RecordQueueEventConfig(
                        queue_name=EMBEDDING_QUEUE.name,
                        event_type="ENQUEUE",
                        write_ref_id=queue_rows_ref,
                        source_kind="queue_rows",
                    ),
                ).lower(ctx),
            )
            previous_queue_ref = queue_ref
            deferred_event_refs.append(event_ref)
            last_refs.append(metadata_update_ref)

        steps.extend(deferred_event_steps)
        last_refs.extend(deferred_event_refs)
        steps.append(BarrierStep(_plan_ref(self.ref_id), depends_on=_plan_refs(frozenset(last_refs))))
        return steps

    ) -> None:
