def _extend_with_inline_large_column_contract(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
    column_type_hints: SqlColumnTypeHints,
) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    if not get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        return columns, column_type_hints
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
        inline_large_column_alias_columns,
        inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints,
    )

    configs = get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
    pointer_columns = {
        str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)))) for config in configs
    }
    # The inline aliases carry a spilled payload only. A value that stayed under the spill
    # threshold lives in the model's own value column with every alias NULL, so the transport
    # projection has to keep the value and pointer columns alongside the aliases.
    base_columns = tuple(columns)
    extended_columns = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            (*base_columns, *pointer_columns, *inline_large_column_alias_columns(model_cls)),
        ),
    )
    return (
        extended_columns,
        combine_sql_column_type_hints(
            extended_columns,
            column_type_hints.filtered(set(base_columns)),
            SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=frozenset(pointer_columns & set(extended_columns))),
            inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls),
        ),
    )


def _strip_update_hydration_column(row: dict[str, object], column: str | SqlColumnName) -> None:
    column_name = str(column)
    row.pop(column_name, None)
    row.pop(column, None)
    if column_name == "sys_staged_commit_id":
        row.pop("staged_commit_id", None)
    elif column_name == "sys_revision_id":
        row.pop("revision_id", None)
    elif column_name == "sys_deleted":
        row.pop("deleted", None)


def _update_hydration_strip_column_names(columns: Sequence[str | SqlColumnName]) -> frozenset[str]:
    names: set[str] = set()
    for column in columns:
        column_name = str(column)
        names.add(column_name)
        if column_name == "sys_staged_commit_id":
            names.add("staged_commit_id")
        elif column_name == "sys_revision_id":
            names.add("revision_id")
        elif column_name == "sys_deleted":
            names.add("deleted")
    return frozenset(names)


def _validate_planned_model_cte_metadata(
    *,
    step_name: str,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
    planned_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
) -> None:
    if model_cls is planned_model_cls:
        return
    msg = f"{step_name} planned CTE metadata is stale. The model source changed after step construction."
    raise StaleCtePublicationContractError(msg)


def _raw_result_from_runtime_payload(payload: object) -> RawResult:
    if payload is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(payload, Mapping):
        return [dict(payload)]
    if isinstance(payload, Sequence) and not isinstance(payload, str | bytes | bytearray):
        return cast("RawResult", payload)
    return [{"value": payload}]


def _resolved_raw_payload(resolved: Mapping[str, object], source_ref: ServerPlanRefId) -> RawResult:
    source_key = str(source_ref)
    if source_key in resolved:
        return _raw_result_from_runtime_payload(resolved[source_key])
    if source_key.endswith(".raw"):
        base_key = source_key.removesuffix(".raw")
        if base_key in resolved:
            return _raw_result_from_runtime_payload(resolved[base_key])
    return []


def row_hydration_raw_payload_source_ref(step: ServerPlanStep[Any]) -> ServerPlanRefId | None:
    return step.raw_payload_source_ref()


def _hydrate_row[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    model_cls: type[T],
    row: dict[str, Any],
    hydrator: Hydrator = LOCAL_MODEL_HYDRATOR,
    schema_context: RevisionSchemaContext | None = None,
) -> T:
    from l2070_batching.hydrator import MaterializationHydrator, ModelHydrator

    if (
        schema_context is None
        and isinstance(hydrator, MaterializationHydrator | RuntimeHydrator)
        and isinstance(hydrator.base_hydrator, ModelHydrator)
        and not hydrator.model_has_large_columns(model_cls)
    ):
        return cast(T, hydrator(model_cls, row))

    row = dict(row)
    for physical_name, field_name in (
        ("sys_created_at", "created_at"),
        ("sys_updated_at", "updated_at"),
        ("sys_revision_id", "revision_id"),
        ("sys_staged_commit_id", "staged_commit_id"),
        ("sys_deleted", "deleted"),
    ):
        if physical_name not in row:
            continue
        value = row.pop(physical_name)
        if field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
            row[field_name] = value
    from impl.common.l2400_blob_serialization import normalize_sql_binary_fields

    row = normalize_sql_binary_fields(model_cls, row)
    if any(key.startswith("__nera_inline_large_column__") for key in row):
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
            hydrate_inline_large_column_row_dicts,
        )

        row = hydrate_inline_large_column_row_dicts(model_cls, [row])[0]
    else:
        row = _hydrate_pointer_row_with_runtime_sql(model_cls, row, hydrator)
    if hydrator is not None:
        if isinstance(hydrator, RuntimeHydrator) and schema_context is None and not isinstance(hydrator.base_hydrator, ModelHydrator):
            runtime_schema_context = (
                revision_schema_context_for_model(model_cls, hydrator.txn) if hasattr(hydrator.txn, "_revision_schema_context") else None
            )
            return ModelHydrator()(
                model_cls,
                dict(row),
                sql_conn=hydrator.sql_conn,
                schema_context=runtime_schema_context,
            )
        if schema_context is not None:
            if isinstance(hydrator, RuntimeHydrator) and isinstance(
                hydrator.base_hydrator,
                ModelHydrator,
            ):
                return hydrator.hydrate_model_with_schema_context(
                    model_cls,
                    dict(row),
                    schema_context,
                )
            if isinstance(hydrator, ModelHydrator):
                return hydrator(model_cls, dict(row), schema_context=schema_context)
            return _hydrate_row_without_runtime(
                model_cls,
                row,
                schema_context=schema_context,
            )
        if callable(hydrator):
            try:
                return cast(T, hydrator(model_cls, dict(row)))
            except ValidationError as exc:
                try:
                    return cast(
                        T,
                        convert_row_to_model(
                            model_cls,
                            dict(row),
                            select_columns=list(row.keys()),
                        ),
                    )
                except ValidationError:
                    raise exc
    return _hydrate_row_without_runtime(
        model_cls,
        row,
        schema_context=schema_context,
    )


def _hydrate_pointer_row_with_runtime_sql[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    model_cls: type[T],
    row: dict[str, Any],
    hydrator: Hydrator = LOCAL_MODEL_HYDRATOR,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(hydrator, RuntimeHydrator) or hydrator.sql_conn is None:
        return dict(row)
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import _hydrate_large_column_rows
    from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name

    row_dict = dict(row)
    pending_hashes: set[str] = set()
    for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        if config.delta_storage is not None and config.delta_storage.enabled:
            continue
        inline_prefix = f"__nera_inline_large_column__{config.column}__"
        if any(str(key).startswith(inline_prefix) for key in row_dict):
            continue
        pointer = row_dict.get(large_column_pointer_name(config.column))
        if pointer is not None and row_dict.get(config.column) is None:
            pending_hashes.add(str(pointer))
    if not pending_hashes:
        return row_dict

    from l2070_batching.post_op_phase import in_post_op_execution

    if in_post_op_execution():
        msg = (
            "defer_large_columns cannot materialize a required full row from pointer-only "
            "post-op input; compile inline large-column transport columns instead."
        )
        raise ValueError(msg)

    sql_conn = hydrator.sql_conn
    store_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    chunk_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for content_hash in pending_hashes:
        manifest_rows = sql_conn._read_storage_chunk_manifest_rows(
            model_cls,
            ContentHashValue(content_hash),
        )
        if manifest_rows is None:
            continue
        store_row, manifest_chunk_rows = manifest_rows
        store_row = dict(store_row)
        store_row["content_hash"] = content_hash
        store_rows.append(store_row)
        for manifest_chunk_row in manifest_chunk_rows:
            chunk_row = dict(manifest_chunk_row)
            chunk_row["content_hash"] = content_hash
            chunk_rows.append(chunk_row)
    return _hydrate_large_column_rows(
        model_cls,
        [row_dict],
        store_rows,
        chunk_rows,
        hydrate_large_columns=True,
    )[0]


def _hydrate_row_without_runtime[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    model_cls: type[T],
    row: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    sql_conn: _SqlConnectionCore | None = None,
    schema_context: RevisionSchemaContext | None = None,
) -> T:
    return cast(
        T,
        convert_row_to_model(
            model_cls,
            dict(row),
            conn=sql_conn,
            hydrate_large_columns=sql_conn is not None,
            schema_context=schema_context,
        ),
    )


def _dict_from_keyed_row(row: object) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    keys = getattr(row, "keys", None)
    if not callable(keys):
        return None
    row_any = cast(Any, row)
    try:
        row_keys = cast(Iterable[object], keys())
        return {str(key): row_any[key] for key in row_keys}
    except (AttributeError, IndexError, KeyError, TypeError):
        return None


def _revision_schema_context_from_hydrator(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    hydrator: object,
) -> RevisionSchemaContext:
    if not model_needs_revision_schema_context(model_cls):
        from l3200_metadata.schema_evolution import RevisionSchemaContext

        return RevisionSchemaContext()
    txn = getattr(hydrator, "txn", None)
    if txn is None or not hasattr(txn, "_revision_schema_context"):
        msg = "Versioned row hydration requires an explicit RevisionSchemaContext"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return revision_schema_context_for_model(model_cls, txn)


def _hydrate_stripped_row_or_none[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    model_cls: type[T],
    row: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    hydrator: Hydrator = LOCAL_MODEL_HYDRATOR,
) -> T | None:
    if not _row_has_model_columns(model_cls, row):
        return None
    try:
        return _hydrate_row(model_cls, row, hydrator)
    except ValidationError:
        return None


def _hydrate_resolved_row_or_construct_partial[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    model_cls: type[T],
    row: dict[str, Any],
    hydrator: Hydrator = LOCAL_MODEL_HYDRATOR,
) -> T:
    unresolved_pointer = any(
        row.get(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)))) is not None
        and row.get(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column))) is None
        for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
    )
    if unresolved_pointer:
        return cast(
            T,
            convert_row_to_model(
                model_cls,
                dict(row),
                select_columns=list(row.keys()),
                hydrate_large_columns=False,
            ),
        )
    try:
        return _hydrate_row(model_cls, row, hydrator)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        if any(error.get("type") != "missing" for error in exc.errors()):
            raise
        return cast(
            T,
            convert_row_to_model(
                model_cls,
                dict(row),
                select_columns=list(row.keys()),
            ),
        )


def _row_has_model_columns[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    model_cls: type[T],
    row: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> bool:
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    valid_columns = set(model_cls.model_fields)
    valid_columns.update(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(name)) for name in model_cls.model_fields)
    return any(key in valid_columns for key in row)


def _hydratable_source_columns(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    source_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    valid_columns = set(model_cls.model_fields)
    valid_columns.update(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(name)) for name in model_cls.model_fields)
    hydratable_columns = tuple(column for column in source_columns if column in valid_columns)
    if not hydratable_columns:
        msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} hydration source has no model columns"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return hydratable_columns


def _dependency_ref_for_runtime_subref(ref_id: ServerPlanRefId) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    """Preserve the exact producer or projection ref used at runtime."""
    return ref_id


def _resolved_sequence_or_empty(value: object) -> list[object]:
    from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference

    if value is None or isinstance(value, CteReference):
        return []
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
        return list(cast("Sequence[object]", value))
    return []


def _runtime_source_or_raw(
    source_ref: str,
    raw_result: RawResult,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> object:
    """Resolve a runtime source ref, falling back to raw rows ONLY if unresolved.

    A resolved empty sequence is the producer's authoritative result (e.g. a
    tombstone filter dropping every row) and must never be overridden by the
    step's own unfiltered raw rows. Only an absent ref or an executor
    placeholder (``CteReference``/``PlanEffect``) may fall back.
    """
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.grammar_plan_types import PlanEffect
    from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference

    if source_ref not in runtime_refs:
        return raw_result
    value = runtime_refs[source_ref]
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (CteReference, PlanEffect)):
        return raw_result
    return value


def _unwrap_executor_value_rows(rows: list[object]) -> list[object]:
    if len(rows) != 1:
        return rows
    first = rows[0]
    if not isinstance(first, Mapping) or set(first) != {"__executor_value__"}:
        return rows
    unwrapped = first["__executor_value__"]
    sequence = _resolved_sequence_or_empty(unwrapped)
    return sequence if sequence else [unwrapped]


def _is_empty_row_sentinel(value: object) -> bool:
    return isinstance(value, Mapping) and not value


def _is_empty_row_sentinel_for_model(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow], value: object) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return False
    if not value:
        return True
    model_fields = getattr(model_cls, "model_fields", {})
    return bool(model_fields) and not any(key in model_fields for key in value)


def _resolved_model_row_or_none[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    model_cls: type[T],
    value: object,
    *,
    hydrator: Hydrator = LOCAL_MODEL_HYDRATOR,
) -> T | None:
    if isinstance(value, model_cls):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        if _is_empty_row_sentinel_for_model(model_cls, value):
            return None
        return _hydrate_resolved_row_or_construct_partial(model_cls, value, hydrator)
    keyed_row = _dict_from_keyed_row(value)
    if keyed_row is not None:
        if _is_empty_row_sentinel_for_model(model_cls, keyed_row):
            return None
        return _hydrate_resolved_row_or_construct_partial(model_cls, keyed_row, hydrator)
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
        first = next(iter(value), None)
        if isinstance(first, model_cls):
            return first
        if isinstance(first, dict):
            if _is_empty_row_sentinel_for_model(model_cls, first):
                return None
            return _hydrate_resolved_row_or_construct_partial(model_cls, first, hydrator)
        keyed_first = _dict_from_keyed_row(first)
        if keyed_first is not None:
            if _is_empty_row_sentinel_for_model(model_cls, keyed_first):
                return None
            return _hydrate_resolved_row_or_construct_partial(model_cls, keyed_first, hydrator)
        return None
    return None


def _runtime_ref_value(runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object], ref_id: str | None) -> object:
    if ref_id is None:
        return None
    value = runtime_refs.get(ref_id)
    if value is not None or "." not in ref_id:
        return value
    base_ref, suffix = ref_id.rsplit(".", 1)
    if suffix in {"meta", "queue_rows", "raw", "rows"}:
        return runtime_refs.get(base_ref)
    return None


def _project_model_row_dict(
    row: DatabaseObjectRow | None,
    *,
    returning_columns: Sequence[str | SqlColumnName] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if row is None:
        return None
    data = dict(row.model_dump(mode="python"))
    if returning_columns is not None:
        allowed_columns = {str(column) for column in returning_columns}
        return {key: value for key, value in data.items() if key in allowed_columns}
    return data


def _normalize_deleted_count(value: object) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return int(value)
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return max(0, value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping) and len(value) == 1:
        return _normalize_deleted_count(next(iter(value.values())))
    rows = _resolved_sequence_or_empty(value)
    if len(rows) == 1:
        row_dict = _dict_from_keyed_row(rows[0])
        if row_dict is not None and len(row_dict) == 1:
            return _normalize_deleted_count(next(iter(row_dict.values())))
    return len(rows)


def _delete_permission_denial_returns_false(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> bool:
    """Application SystemOnly tables can hide protected rows as absent."""
    try:
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
        from l4000_permissions.lazy_permission_support import is_system_only_permission_scheme
    except ImportError:
        return False
    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    return not table_name.startswith("sys_") and is_system_only_permission_scheme(model_cls)


def _delete_permission_denial_should_raise(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> bool:
    try:
        from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import get_query_permission_plan
    except ImportError:
        return True
    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_cls, action="delete")
    return permission_plan is not None and permission_plan.filter_rows


def _post_process_normalize_deleted_count(
    source_ref: str,
    raw_result: RawResult,
    _hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> dict[str, int]:
    source_value = runtime_refs.get(source_ref)
    if source_value is None or isinstance(source_value, CteReference):
        source_value = raw_result
    return {"count": _normalize_deleted_count(source_value)}


def _post_process_hydrate_resolved_rows[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    model_cls: type[T],
    source_ref: str,
    raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> list[T]:
    source_value = _runtime_source_or_raw(source_ref, raw_result, runtime_refs)
    hydrated: list[T] = []
    materialized_ids: set[str] = set()

    def _append_hydrated(row: T) -> None:
        row_key = _sys_id_lookup_key(getattr(row, "sys_id", None))
        if row_key in materialized_ids:
            return
        materialized_ids.add(row_key)
        hydrated.append(row)

    for row in _resolved_sequence_or_empty(source_value):
        if isinstance(row, model_cls):
            _append_hydrated(row)
            continue
        if isinstance(row, dict):
            if _is_empty_row_sentinel_for_model(model_cls, row):
                continue
            row_data = dict(row)
            for column in _HYDRATED_CTE_FRAMEWORK_COLUMNS:
                row_data.pop(column, None)
            hydrated_row = _hydrate_row(
                model_cls,
                _hydrate_pointer_row_with_runtime_sql(model_cls, row_data, hydrator),
                hydrator,
            )
            _append_hydrated(hydrated_row)
            continue
        resolved_row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, row, hydrator=hydrator)
        if resolved_row is not None:
            _append_hydrated(resolved_row)
    return hydrated


def _post_process_hydrate_raw_rows[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    model_cls: type[T],
    source_ref: str,
    raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
) -> list[T]:
    return _post_process_hydrate_resolved_rows(
        model_cls,
        source_ref,
        raw_result,
        hydrator,
        {source_ref: raw_result},
    )


def _post_process_hydrate_first_resolved_row[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    source_ref: str,
    model_cls: type[T],
    raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
    dispatch_insert_subscription: InsertSubscriptionDispatch = InsertSubscriptionDispatch(False),
) -> T | None:
    source_value = _runtime_source_or_raw(source_ref, raw_result, runtime_refs)
    if isinstance(source_value, model_cls):
        return source_value
    rows = [
        row
        for row in _resolved_sequence_or_empty(source_value)
        if not (isinstance(row, dict) and _is_empty_row_sentinel_for_model(model_cls, row))
    ]
    hydrated_row: T | None = None
    if rows:
        for row in rows:
            if isinstance(row, dict):
                hydrated_row = _hydrate_row(
                    model_cls,
                    dict(row),
                    hydrator,
                )
            else:
                hydrated_row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, row, hydrator=hydrator)
            if hydrated_row is not None:
                break
    else:
        hydrated_row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, source_value, hydrator=hydrator)
    del dispatch_insert_subscription
    return hydrated_row


def _post_process_hydrate_first_raw_row[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    source_ref: str,
    model_cls: type[T],
    raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
) -> T | None:
    return _post_process_hydrate_first_resolved_row(
        source_ref,
        model_cls,
        raw_result,
        hydrator,
        {source_ref: raw_result},
    )


def _post_process_hydrate_strict_first_resolved_row[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    source_ref: str,
    model_cls: type[T],
    raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> T | None:
    source_value = _runtime_source_or_raw(source_ref, raw_result, runtime_refs)
    if isinstance(source_value, model_cls):
        return source_value
    raw_rows: list[object] = []
    for row in _resolved_sequence_or_empty(source_value):
        if isinstance(row, model_cls):
            raw_rows.append(row)
            continue
        if isinstance(row, dict):
            if not _is_empty_row_sentinel_for_model(model_cls, row):
                raw_rows.append(row)
            continue
        keyed_row = _dict_from_keyed_row(row)
        if keyed_row is not None and not _is_empty_row_sentinel_for_model(model_cls, keyed_row):
            raw_rows.append(keyed_row)
    if len(raw_rows) > 1:
        msg = f"Multiple results: execute_one() returned more than one result ({len(raw_rows)}+ rows)"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if not raw_rows:
        return None
    first = raw_rows[0]
    if isinstance(first, dict):
        return _hydrate_row(
            model_cls,
            _hydrate_pointer_row_with_runtime_sql(model_cls, dict(first), hydrator),
            hydrator,
        )
    return _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, first, hydrator=hydrator)


def _post_process_hydrate_strict_first_raw_row[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    source_ref: str,
    model_cls: type[T],
    raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
) -> T | None:
    return _post_process_hydrate_strict_first_resolved_row(
        source_ref,
        model_cls,
        raw_result,
        hydrator,
        {source_ref: raw_result},
    )


def _post_process_materialize_queue_message_ids(
    source_ref: str,
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    _hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> list[QueueMessageId]:
    from l4100_queue.queue_message import QueueMessageId

    raw_value = runtime_refs.get(source_ref, [])
    values = _resolved_sequence_or_empty(raw_value)
    if values:
        pass
    elif isinstance(raw_value, Sequence) and not isinstance(raw_value, str | bytes | bytearray):
        values = list(cast("Sequence[object]", raw_value))
    elif raw_value is None:
        values = []
    else:
        values = [raw_value]
    message_ids: list[QueueMessageId] = []
    for value in values:
        if isinstance(value, QueueMessageId):
            message_ids.append(value)
            continue
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            sys_id = value.get("sys_id")
            if isinstance(sys_id, QueueMessageId):
                message_ids.append(sys_id)
            elif sys_id is not None:
                message_ids.append(QueueMessageId(sys_id))
            continue
        sys_id = getattr(value, "sys_id", None)
        if isinstance(sys_id, QueueMessageId):
            message_ids.append(sys_id)
        elif sys_id is not None:
            message_ids.append(QueueMessageId(sys_id))
    return message_ids


def _resolve_deleted_result_from_values[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    *,
    source_value: object,
    selected_value: object,
    dispatch_with_runtime: DispatchWithRuntimeFlag,
    model_cls: type[T],
    fallback_txn: object | None,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
) -> bool:
    delete_count = _normalize_deleted_count(source_value)
    deleted = delete_count > 0
    old_row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, selected_value, hydrator=hydrator)
    if not deleted and old_row is not None and source_value == [] and not dispatch_with_runtime:
        return True
    if (
        not deleted
        and old_row is not None
        and source_value == []
        and dispatch_with_runtime
        and not _delete_permission_denial_returns_false(model_cls)
        and not _delete_permission_denial_should_raise(model_cls)
    ):
        return True
    if (
        not deleted
        and old_row is not None
        and dispatch_with_runtime
        and not _delete_permission_denial_returns_false(model_cls)
        and _delete_permission_denial_should_raise(model_cls)
    ):
        from l1100_exceptions.exceptions import PermissionError as DbPermissionError

        sys_id_val = getattr(old_row, "sys_id", "?")
        raise DbPermissionError(
            f"Cannot delete {model_cls.__name__} with sys_id={sys_id_val}: permission denied",
        )
    return deleted


def _post_process_resolve_deleted_count_result(
    source_ref: str,

    source_value = runtime_refs.get(source_ref)
    if source_value is None or isinstance(source_value, CteReference):

    return _normalize_deleted_count(source_value) > 0

def _post_process_resolve_deleted_row_result[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    source_ref: str,
    selected_ref: str | None,
    dispatch_with_runtime: DispatchWithRuntimeFlag,
    model_cls: type[T],
    fallback_txn: object | None,
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> bool:
    delete_count = _normalize_deleted_count(runtime_refs.get(source_ref))
    deleted = delete_count > 0
    old_row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(
        model_cls,
        _runtime_ref_value(runtime_refs, selected_ref),
        hydrator=hydrator,
    )
    if (
        not deleted
        and old_row is not None
        and dispatch_with_runtime
        and not _delete_permission_denial_returns_false(model_cls)
        and _delete_permission_denial_should_raise(model_cls)
    ):
        from l1100_exceptions.exceptions import PermissionError as DbPermissionError

        sys_id_val = getattr(old_row, "sys_id", "?")
        raise DbPermissionError(
            f"Cannot delete {model_cls.__name__} with sys_id={sys_id_val}: permission denied",
        )
    if deleted and old_row is not None and dispatch_with_runtime:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
            dispatch_write_subscription_from_runtime,
        )

        dispatch_write_subscription_from_runtime(
            model_cls,
            "DELETE",
            old_row,
            hydrator,
            fallback_txn=fallback_txn,
        )
    return deleted


def _post_process_resolve_deleted_row_dict_result[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    source_value: object,
    selected_value: object,
    model_cls: type[T],
    returning_columns: Sequence[str | SqlColumnName] | None,
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    delete_count = _normalize_deleted_count(source_value)
    if delete_count <= 0:
        return None
    selected_row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(
        model_cls,
        selected_value,
        hydrator=hydrator,
    )
    if selected_row is not None:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
            dispatch_write_subscription_from_runtime,
        )

        dispatch_write_subscription_from_runtime(
            model_cls,
            "DELETE",
            selected_row,
            hydrator,
        )
    result = _project_model_row_dict(selected_row, returning_columns=returning_columns)
    return None if result is None else dict(result)


def _post_process_resolve_deleted_row_dict_sequence[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    source_value: object,
    selected_value: object,
    model_cls: type[T],
    returning_columns: list[str] | None,
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    _hydrator: Hydrator,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    selected_rows = _resolved_sequence_or_empty(selected_value)
    row_dicts = [
        _project_model_row_dict(
            _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, value, hydrator=_hydrator),
            returning_columns=returning_columns,
        )
        for value in selected_rows
    ]
    projected = [row for row in row_dicts if row is not None]
    if projected:
        return projected
    delete_count = _normalize_deleted_count(source_value)
    if delete_count <= 0:
        return []
    return projected[:delete_count] if delete_count < len(projected) else projected


def _hydrate_update_result_from_values[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    *,
    source_value: object,
    selected_value: object,
    fallback_value: object,
    model_cls: type[T],
    strip_columns: Sequence[str | SqlColumnName],
    require_when_selected: RequireWhenSelectedFlag,
    dispatch_with_old_row: DispatchWithOldRowFlag,
    fallback_txn: object | None,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
    require_existing: RequireExistingFlag = RequireExistingFlag(False),
) -> T | None:
    raw_rows = _resolved_sequence_or_empty(source_value)
    if isinstance(selected_value, dict):
        selected_row = dict(selected_value)
        for column in _HYDRATED_CTE_FRAMEWORK_COLUMNS:
            if selected_row.get(column) is None:
                _strip_update_hydration_column(selected_row, column)
        selected_value = selected_row
    if isinstance(selected_value, dict) and get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
            hydrate_inline_large_column_row_dicts,
        )

        selected_value = hydrate_inline_large_column_row_dicts(
            model_cls,
            [selected_value],
        )[0]
    try:
        old_row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, selected_value, hydrator=hydrator)
    except ValidationError:
        old_row = None
    if old_row is not None and bool(getattr(old_row, "deleted", False)):
        old_row = None
    fallback_row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, fallback_value, hydrator=hydrator) if fallback_value is not None else None
    raw_rows = _unwrap_executor_value_rows(raw_rows)
    first = raw_rows[0] if raw_rows else None
    update_strip_columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*strip_columns, *_HYDRATED_CTE_FRAMEWORK_COLUMNS)))
    source_row: T | None = None
    row: T | None
    if isinstance(first, dict):
        stripped_first = dict(first)
        for col in update_strip_columns:
            _strip_update_hydration_column(stripped_first, col)
        row = None
        if old_row is not None and _row_has_model_columns(model_cls, stripped_first):
            merged_row = dict(old_row.model_dump(mode="python"))
            for col in update_strip_columns:
                _strip_update_hydration_column(merged_row, col)
            from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

            for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
                db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column))
                pointer_column = get_db_column_name(
                    model_cls,
                    DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)),
                )
                if pointer_column in stripped_first:
                    # A published pointer owns the new value, including NULL.
                    # Keeping preimage content would mask the returned spill payload.
                    continue
                if stripped_first.get(config.column) is None:
                    stripped_first.pop(config.column, None)
                if stripped_first.get(db_column) is None:
                    stripped_first.pop(db_column, None)
            merged_row.update(stripped_first)
            try:
                row = _hydrate_row(model_cls, merged_row, hydrator)
            except ValidationError:
                row = None
        if row is None:
            row = _hydrate_stripped_row_or_none(
                model_cls,
                stripped_first,
                hydrator=hydrator,
            )
        if row is None:
            try:
                source_row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, source_value, hydrator=hydrator)
            except ValidationError:
                source_row = None
            row = source_row or fallback_row
    else:
        source_row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, source_value, hydrator=hydrator)
        if isinstance(first, model_cls):
            row = first
        else:
            row = fallback_row

    if row is not None and bool(getattr(row, "deleted", False)):
        row = None

    required_error: str | None = None
    if require_existing and not raw_rows and old_row is None and fallback_row is None:
        # require_existing fires the not-found error even when the selected-row
        # permission check was bypassed (tables without object-level schemes);
        # the permission-denied branch below stays gated on require_when_selected.
        sys_id_val = getattr(source_row, "sys_id", "?")
        required_error = f"Cannot update {model_cls.__name__} with sys_id={sys_id_val}: row does not exist"
    elif require_when_selected and not raw_rows and old_row is not None:
        from l1100_exceptions.exceptions import PermissionError as DbPermissionError

        sys_id_val = getattr(old_row, "sys_id", "?")
        raise DbPermissionError(
            f"Cannot update {model_cls.__name__} with sys_id={sys_id_val}: permission denied",
        )
    elif row is None and require_when_selected and (old_row is not None or source_row is not None):
        sys_id_val = getattr(old_row or source_row, "sys_id", "?")
        required_error = f"Cannot update {model_cls.__name__} with sys_id={sys_id_val}: row does not exist"
    elif row is None and old_row is not None:
        row = old_row
    if required_error is not None:
        from l1100_exceptions.exceptions import OperationalError

        raise OperationalError(required_error)
    if row is not None and old_row is not None and dispatch_with_old_row:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
            dispatch_write_subscription_from_runtime,
        )
        from l2070_batching.plan_flush_operation import (
            NestedLazyFlushWhileExecutingServerPlanError,
        )

        try:
            dispatch_write_subscription_from_runtime(
                model_cls,
                "UPDATE",
                row,
                hydrator,
                old_row=old_row,
                fallback_txn=fallback_txn,
            )
        except NestedLazyFlushWhileExecutingServerPlanError:
            pass
    return row


def _post_process_prepare_update_row[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    source_ref: str,
    model_cls: type[T],
    patch_updates: Mapping[str, object],
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> T | None:
    selected_value = _runtime_ref_value(runtime_refs, source_ref)
    old_row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, selected_value, hydrator=hydrator)
    if old_row is None:
        return None
    updated: T = old_row.model_copy(update=dict(patch_updates))
    actual_model = type(updated)
    from impl.common.l3100_derived_column_polyfill import compute_derived_columns

    computed_data = compute_derived_columns(actual_model, dict(updated.model_dump(mode="python")))
    updated = actual_model(**computed_data)
    txn = getattr(hydrator, "txn", None)
    plan = getattr(txn, "_plan", None)
    hook_registry = getattr(plan, "_auto_api_hook_registry", None)
    if hook_registry is None:
        return updated
    from l9900_auto_api.hooks import HookRegistry, WriteOperation
    from l1300_session.session import SessionId

    if not isinstance(hook_registry, HookRegistry):
        return updated
    updated = cast(T, hook_registry.run_before_update(actual_model, old_row, updated))
    session_id = getattr(txn, "session_id", None)
    if isinstance(session_id, SessionId):
        updated = cast(
            T,
            hook_registry.run_before_write(
                actual_model,
                updated,
                session_id,
                WriteOperation.UPDATE,
            ),
        )
    return updated

        strip_columns=strip_columns,

        dispatch_with_old_row=DispatchWithOldRowFlag(False),
        fallback_txn=fallback_txn,
        hydrator=hydrator,
    )


def _post_process_hydrate_selected_update_result[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    source_ref: str,
    selected_ref: str,
    runtime_source_ref: str,
    model_cls: type[T],
    strip_columns: Sequence[str | SqlColumnName],
    require_when_selected: RequireWhenSelectedFlag,
    dispatch_with_old_row: DispatchWithOldRowFlag,
    fallback_txn: object | None,
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
    require_existing: RequireExistingFlag = RequireExistingFlag(False),
) -> T | None:
    if _raw_result:
        row = dict(cast("Mapping[str, object]", _raw_result[0]))
        if any(key.startswith(_SELECTED_UPDATE_PREIMAGE_PREFIX) for key in row):
            source_row: dict[str, object] = {}
            selected_row: dict[str, object] = {}
            for key, value in row.items():
                if key.startswith(_SELECTED_UPDATE_PREIMAGE_PREFIX):
                    selected_row[key.removeprefix(_SELECTED_UPDATE_PREIMAGE_PREFIX)] = value
                else:
                    source_row[key] = value
            source_value: object = [source_row] if source_row.get("sys_id") is not None else []
            selected_value: object = selected_row if selected_row.get("sys_id") is not None else None
            return _hydrate_update_result_from_values(
                source_value=source_value,
                selected_value=selected_value,
                fallback_value=None,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                strip_columns=strip_columns,
                require_when_selected=require_when_selected,
                dispatch_with_old_row=dispatch_with_old_row,
                fallback_txn=fallback_txn,
                hydrator=hydrator,
                require_existing=require_existing,
            )
    selected_runtime_ref = selected_ref
    if selected_runtime_ref not in runtime_refs and selected_runtime_ref.endswith(".hydrated"):
        selected_runtime_ref = selected_runtime_ref.removesuffix(".hydrated")
    if selected_runtime_ref not in runtime_refs:
        if not _raw_result:
            raise KeyError(selected_ref)
        if not any(
            key.startswith(_SELECTED_UPDATE_PREIMAGE_PREFIX) for row in _raw_result for key in dict(cast("Mapping[str, object]", row))
        ):
            raise KeyError(selected_ref)
        fallback_selected_value: object = None
        if _raw_result:
            row = dict(cast("Mapping[str, object]", _raw_result[0]))
            fallback_selected_row: dict[str, object] = {}
            for key, value in row.items():
                if key.startswith(_SELECTED_UPDATE_PREIMAGE_PREFIX):
                    fallback_selected_row[key.removeprefix(_SELECTED_UPDATE_PREIMAGE_PREFIX)] = value
            if fallback_selected_row.get("sys_id") is not None:
                fallback_selected_value = fallback_selected_row
        return _hydrate_update_result_from_values(
            source_value=_raw_result,
            selected_value=fallback_selected_value,
            fallback_value=None,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            strip_columns=strip_columns,
            require_when_selected=require_when_selected,
            dispatch_with_old_row=dispatch_with_old_row,
            fallback_txn=fallback_txn,
            hydrator=hydrator,
            require_existing=require_existing,
        )
    source_runtime_ref = runtime_source_ref
    return _hydrate_update_result_from_values(
        source_value=_raw_result if _raw_result else runtime_refs.get(source_runtime_ref),
        selected_value=runtime_refs[selected_runtime_ref],
        fallback_value=None,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        strip_columns=strip_columns,
        require_when_selected=require_when_selected,
        dispatch_with_old_row=dispatch_with_old_row,
        fallback_txn=fallback_txn,
        hydrator=hydrator,
        require_existing=require_existing,
    )


def materialize_selected_update_result_from_raw(
    spec: SelectedUpdateResultDecoderSpec,
    raw: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
) -> object:
    """Hydrate a selected-update result from source and preimage SQL columns."""

    source_value: object = []
    selected_value: object = None
    if raw:
        row = dict(cast("Mapping[str, object]", raw[0]))
        source_row: dict[str, object] = {}
        selected_row: dict[str, object] = {}
        for key, value in row.items():
            if key.startswith(_SELECTED_UPDATE_PREIMAGE_PREFIX):
                selected_row[key.removeprefix(_SELECTED_UPDATE_PREIMAGE_PREFIX)] = value
            else:
                source_row[key] = value
        if source_row.get("sys_id") is not None:
            source_value = [source_row]
        if selected_row.get("sys_id") is not None:
            selected_value = selected_row
    return _hydrate_update_result_from_values(
        source_value=source_value,
        selected_value=selected_value,
        fallback_value=None,
        model_cls=spec.model_cls,
        strip_columns=spec.strip_columns,
        require_when_selected=RequireWhenSelectedFlag(spec.require_when_selected),
        dispatch_with_old_row=DispatchWithOldRowFlag(spec.dispatch_with_old_row),
        fallback_txn=None,
        hydrator=hydrator,
        require_existing=RequireExistingFlag(spec.require_existing),
    )


def _index_selected_rows_by_sys_id[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    model_cls: type[T],
    selected_value: object,
    *,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
) -> dict[object, T]:
    indexed: dict[object, T] = {}
    for selected in _resolved_sequence_or_empty(selected_value):
        row = _resolved_model_row_or_none(model_cls, selected, hydrator=hydrator)
        if row is not None:
            indexed[_sys_id_lookup_key(getattr(row, "sys_id"))] = row
    return indexed


def _sys_id_lookup_key(value: object) -> str:
    try:
        unwrap_to_str = object.__getattribute__(value, "unwrap_to_str")
    except AttributeError:
        unwrap_to_str = None
    if callable(unwrap_to_str):
        return str(unwrap_to_str())
    return str(value)


def _post_process_hydrate_selected_update_sequence[T: DatabaseObjectRow](
    source_ref: str,
    selected_ref: str,
    model_cls: type[T],
    strip_columns: Sequence[str | SqlColumnName],
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> list[T]:
    if selected_ref not in runtime_refs:
        raise KeyError(selected_ref)
    raw_rows = _unwrap_executor_value_rows(
        _resolved_sequence_or_empty(_raw_result if _raw_result else runtime_refs.get(source_ref)),
    )
    selected_by_id = _index_selected_rows_by_sys_id(
        model_cls,
        runtime_refs[selected_ref],
        hydrator=hydrator,
    )
    materialized: list[T] = []
    materialized_ids: set[str] = set()

    def _append_materialized(row: T) -> None:
        row_id = getattr(row, "sys_id", None)
        row_key = _sys_id_lookup_key(row_id)
        if row_key in materialized_ids:
            return
        materialized_ids.add(row_key)
        materialized.append(row)

    for raw_row in raw_rows:
        if isinstance(raw_row, model_cls):
            _append_materialized(raw_row)
            continue
        if not isinstance(raw_row, Mapping):
            keyed_row = _dict_from_keyed_row(raw_row)
            if keyed_row is None:
                msg = f"Selected update sequence expected dict row, got {type(raw_row).__name__}"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            raw_dict = keyed_row
        else:
            raw_dict = dict(raw_row)
        if _is_empty_row_sentinel_for_model(model_cls, raw_dict):
            continue
        for col in strip_columns:
            _strip_update_hydration_column(raw_dict, col)
        old_row = selected_by_id.get(_sys_id_lookup_key(raw_dict.get("sys_id")))
        if old_row is None and len(selected_by_id) == 1:
            old_row = next(iter(selected_by_id.values()))
        if old_row is not None and _row_has_model_columns(model_cls, raw_dict):
            merged = dict(old_row.model_dump(mode="python"))
            for col in strip_columns:
                _strip_update_hydration_column(merged, col)
            from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs
            from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

            for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
                db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column))
                if raw_dict.get(config.column) is None:
                    raw_dict.pop(config.column, None)
                if raw_dict.get(db_column) is None:
                    raw_dict.pop(db_column, None)
            merged.update(raw_dict)
            _append_materialized(_hydrate_row_without_runtime(model_cls, merged))
            continue
        hydrated_raw_dict = _hydrate_pointer_row_with_runtime_sql(model_cls, raw_dict, hydrator)
        _append_materialized(_hydrate_row(model_cls, hydrated_raw_dict, hydrator))
    if not materialized and selected_by_id:
        materialized.extend(selected_by_id.values())
    return materialized


def hydrate_first_versioned_upsert_row(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    raw_result: RawResult,
) -> object:
    if raw_result:
        row_dict = dict(raw_result[0])
        row_dict.pop("sys_staged_commit_id", None)
        row_dict.pop("sys_revision_id", None)
        row_dict.pop("sys_deleted", None)
        row_dict.pop("staged_commit_id", None)
        row_dict.pop("revision_id", None)
        row_dict.pop("deleted", None)
        return _hydrate_row_without_runtime(model_cls, row_dict)
    return None


class _NormalizeDeletedCountStepCteRow(BaseModel):
    count: int


class NormalizeDeletedCountStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[dict[str, int]]):
    """Publish delete results in a canonical ``{\"count\": int}`` shape."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        after_refs: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId] = (),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._after_refs = tuple(after_refs)
        self._source_ref_is_step_id = True

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "delete", "normalize"})

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def semantic_publication_columns(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return ("count",)

    def semantic_publication_type_hints(self) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        return SqlColumnTypeHints(integer_columns=frozenset({"count"}))

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_runtime_sequential_batch(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def is_executor_owned_runtime_step(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self) -> bool:
        # The canonical {"count": int} row is an explicit reduction of the
        # consumed delete rows (schema.cardinality_compatible).
        return True

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
        from l4100_queue.queue_message import QueueMessage

        # Keep queue-id normalization on the same publication seam as its
        # producer so the dependency optimizer does not treat it as a pure
        # dependency-only shim and back-edge it behind a later queue writer.
        return frozenset({get_table_name(QueueMessage)})

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(
            {
                _dependency_ref_for_runtime_subref(self._source_ref),
                *(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs),
            },
        )

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.dependencies()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: NormalizeDeletedCountStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("count",)
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(integer_columns=frozenset({"count"}))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _NormalizeDeletedCountStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[dict[str, int]]:
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
            tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in contract.columns),
        )
        source_key = str(self._source_ref)
        source_candidate = ctx.cte_refs.get(source_key)
        if not isinstance(source_candidate, CteReference):
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"delete-count source {source_key!r} has no SQL-visible CTE binding",
                blocked_path="APPLY/runtime normalization of delete counts",
                result_contract='Normalize delete counts from a SQL-visible relation publishing "count" or rows to count.',
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the delete result as a CTE before normalization.",
                    'If the producer returns rows, project COUNT(*) AS "count" in SQL.',
                    "Do not normalize delete counts from executor runtime refs in post-op.",
                ),
            )
        source_columns = source_candidate.columns
        count_column = source_candidate.scalar_value_column
        if count_column is not None and source_candidate.scalar_control_kind is ScalarControlKind.AFFECTED_COUNT:
            return _source_cte_compiled_step(
                ctx,
                self._source_ref,
                closed_post_op=CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                    ResultMaterializationSpec(
                        behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_OBJECT,
                        raw_mode=True,
                    ),
                ),
                columns=(count_column.to_row_key(),),
                limit=1,
            )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlFrom, SqlSelectAlias, SqlSelectList, SqlTableAlias
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import AggregateKind
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlAggregate
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

        count_expr = (
            SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")))
            if "sys_id" in source_columns
            else SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT_STAR)
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            count_expr,
                            SqlAliasName("count"),
                        )
                    ],
                ),
                from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(source_candidate.ref_id)))),
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            auxiliary_ctes=(
                [(source_candidate.ref_id, source_candidate.auxiliary_query)] if source_candidate.auxiliary_query is not None else None
            ),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_OBJECT,
                    raw_mode=True,
                ),
            ),
        )

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> dict[str, int]:
        return {"count": _normalize_deleted_count(resolved.get(str(self._source_ref), []))}


class _HydrateResolvedRowsBase[T: DatabaseObjectRow, ResultT](MaybeSqlRelationPublisherStep[list[ResultT]]):
    def include_in_sql_callback_rendering(self: _HydrateResolvedRowsBase[T, ResultT]) -> bool:
        return False

    """Convert resolved raw row dicts into typed rows without terminal SQL hydration."""

    optimizer_projection_owned = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[T],
        after_refs: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId] = (),
        runtime_only: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._dispatch_insert_subscription = InsertSubscriptionDispatch(False)
        self._after_refs = tuple(after_refs)
        self._runtime_only = runtime_only
        self._cte_output_columns = _model_field_cte_output_columns(self._model_cls)
        self._cte_column_type_hints = _model_cte_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, self._cte_output_columns)
        self._cte_output_columns, self._cte_column_type_hints = _extend_with_inline_large_column_contract(
            self._model_cls,
            self._cte_output_columns,
            self._cte_column_type_hints,
        )
        self._executor_visible_output_columns = _model_field_cte_output_columns(self._model_cls)
        self._semantic_publication_type_hints = _model_cte_column_type_hints(
            self._model_cls,
            self._executor_visible_output_columns,
        )
        self._cte_metadata_model_cls = self._model_cls
        self._transport_contract_override: CtePublicationContract | None = None

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        tags = {"read", "hydrate"}
        return frozenset(tags)

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY if self._runtime_only or get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls) else StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def emits_sql_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return False if self._runtime_only or get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls) else True

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return False if self._runtime_only or get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls) else True

    def is_executor_owned_runtime_step(self) -> bool:
        return self._runtime_only or bool(get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls))

    def publishes_decoded_value_as_executor_value(self) -> bool:
        """Keep executor-owned hydrated models opaque to SQL row publication."""
        return self.is_executor_owned_runtime_step()

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return not self._runtime_only and not get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls)

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return self.execution_role() is StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return self._runtime_only or bool(get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls))

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def executor_publication_projection_columns(self: _HydrateResolvedRowsBase[T, ResultT]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Publish only declared fields, not physical versioning transport metadata."""
        return self.cte_publication_contract().columns

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _HydrateResolvedRowsBase) -> CtePublicationContract:
        _validate_planned_model_cte_metadata(
            step_name=type(self).__name__,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            planned_model_cls=self._cte_metadata_model_cls,
        )
        columns = tuple(
            column
            for column in self._cte_output_columns
            if column not in _HYDRATED_CTE_FRAMEWORK_COLUMNS
            and column not in _private_large_column_pointer_columns(self._model_cls)
            and column not in _FTS_GENERATED_TRANSPORT_COLUMNS
        )
        column_type_hints = self._cte_column_type_hints.filtered(set(columns))
        if "_fts_rank" in columns and "__fts_rank" not in columns:
            hinted = (
                column_type_hints.jsonb_columns
                | column_type_hints.uuid_columns
                | column_type_hints.timestamptz_columns
                | column_type_hints.date_columns
                | column_type_hints.bool_columns
                | column_type_hints.integer_columns
                | column_type_hints.bigint_columns
                | column_type_hints.double_columns
                | column_type_hints.text_columns
                | column_type_hints.bytea_columns
            )
            if "__fts_rank" in hinted:
                column_type_hints = column_type_hints.rename_column("__fts_rank", "_fts_rank")
        from l2070_batching.cte_contracts import projection_over_model_contract

        return projection_over_model_contract(
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            source_model_cls=self._model_cls,
            projection_lineage=tuple((column, column) for column in columns),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=None,
        )

    @property
    def published_model_cls(self) -> type[T]:
        return self._model_cls

    def semantic_publication_columns(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return self._executor_visible_output_columns

    def semantic_publication_type_hints(self) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        return self._semantic_publication_type_hints

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependency_ref = _dependency_ref_for_runtime_subref(self._source_ref)
        if self._runtime_only and "." in dependency_ref:
            dependency_ref = ServerPlanRefId(dependency_ref.rsplit(".", 1)[0])
        if dependency_ref == str(self.ref_id):
            dependency_ref = ServerPlanRefId(self._source_ref)
        return frozenset(
            {
                dependency_ref,
                *(str(ref_id) for ref_id in self._after_refs),
            },
        )

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependency_ref = _dependency_ref_for_runtime_subref(self._source_ref)
        if dependency_ref == str(self.ref_id):
            dependency_ref = ServerPlanRefId(self._source_ref)
        return frozenset({dependency_ref})

    def executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.dependencies()

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_contract(self) -> BatchPostprocessReductionContract | None:
        return None

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_source_ref(self) -> str | None:
        return None if get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls) else str(self._source_ref)

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_contract_for_relation(
        self,
        input_relation: DeclaredResultRelation,
    ) -> BatchPostprocessReductionContract | None:
        if get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls):
            return None
        return BatchPostprocessReductionContract(
            source_ref=str(self._source_ref),
            raw_source_label=str(self._source_ref),
            closed_post_op=CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_ARRAY,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    input_relation=input_relation,
                ),
            ),
            dependency_ref_ids=(str(self._source_ref),),
        )

    def raw_payload_source_ref(self) -> ServerPlanRefId | None:
        return self._source_ref

    def imported_dependency_refs(self) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
        return frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(self._source_ref)})

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[ResultT]]:
        if ctx.planning_catalog is not None:
            plan_catalog = ctx.planning_catalog.ensure_model(self._model_cls)
            read_shape = plan_catalog.read_metadata_for_model(self._model_cls)
            projection = read_shape.projection_for(READ_FLAVOR_HYDRATED_SELECT_ONE)
            catalog_column_set = frozenset(field.cte_output_column for field in projection.fields)
            self._cte_output_columns = tuple(
                column
                for column in self._cte_output_columns
                if column in catalog_column_set
                or column in _HYDRATED_CTE_FRAMEWORK_COLUMNS
                or column in _FTS_GENERATED_TRANSPORT_COLUMNS
                or column in _private_large_column_pointer_columns(self._model_cls)
                or column == "__inserted"
            )
            self._cte_column_type_hints = _model_cte_column_type_hints(
                self._model_cls,
                self._cte_output_columns,
            )
            self._executor_visible_output_columns = tuple(
                column for column in self._cte_output_columns if column not in _HYDRATED_CTE_FRAMEWORK_COLUMNS
            )
            self._semantic_publication_type_hints = _model_cte_column_type_hints(
                self._model_cls,
                self._executor_visible_output_columns,
            )
            self._cte_output_columns, self._cte_column_type_hints = _extend_with_inline_large_column_contract(
                self._model_cls,
                self._cte_output_columns,
                self._cte_column_type_hints,
            )
            self._cte_publication_contract_cache_valid = False
            self._publication_contract_cache_valid = False
        if self._runtime_only or get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls):
            contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
            assert contract is not None
            output_shape = output_shape_from_cte_publication_contract(contract)
            return CompiledStep(
                output_shape=output_shape,
                column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
                result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            )
        source_cte_ref = _lookup_source_cte_ref(ctx, self._source_ref)
        if isinstance(source_cte_ref, CteReference):
            publish_cte_binding(ctx, source_cte_ref, str(self.ref_id))
            if isinstance(source_cte_ref.auxiliary_query, SqlPublishedRowsQuery):
                contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
                assert contract is not None
                output_shape = output_shape_from_cte_publication_contract(contract)
                return CompiledStep(
                    output_shape=output_shape,
                    result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
                    column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
                )
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        assert contract is not None
        return _source_cte_compiled_step(
            ctx,
            self._source_ref,
            closed_post_op_factory=lambda input_relation: CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_ARRAY,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    input_relation=input_relation,
                )
            ),
            columns=contract.columns,
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
        )
