    def _result_mapping_columns(self) -> tuple[DynamicFieldName, ...] | None:
        return None

    def _extend_contract_with_inline_large_columns(self: _HydrateFirstResolvedRowBase[T, ResultT]) -> None:
        """Declare the inline manifest aliases published for large-column models.

        When the model spills large columns, ``compile`` wraps the SQL so the
        published rows carry the inline manifest aliases next to the model
        columns. Their SQL types come from the content-store DDL contract.
        """
        self._cte_output_columns, self._cte_column_type_hints = _extend_with_inline_large_column_contract(
            self._model_cls,
            self._cte_output_columns,
            self._cte_column_type_hints,
        )

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "hydrate", "first"})

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY if self._runtime_only_materialization else StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def is_executor_owned_runtime_step(self) -> bool:
        return self._executor_runtime_materialization

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return not self._runtime_only_materialization

    def supports_ordered_sql_statement_batch(self) -> bool:
        return not self._runtime_only_materialization

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        if self._runtime_only_materialization:
            return frozenset()
        return self.dependencies()

    def ordered_statement_sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.sql_visible_dependencies()

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return self._runtime_only_materialization

    def allows_later_sql_transport(self) -> bool:
        """Delay closed row hydration while independent SQL joins its producer request."""
        return True

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return not self._runtime_only_materialization

    def emits_sql_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return None

    def raw_payload_source_ref(self) -> ServerPlanRefId | None:
        return self._source_ref

    def executor_publication_projection_columns(self: _HydrateFirstResolvedRowBase[T, ResultT]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Publish only the producer-declared model projection."""
        return self.cte_publication_contract().columns

    def imported_dependency_refs(self: _HydrateFirstResolvedRowBase[T, ResultT]) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
        """Import the raw SQL product, not this hydrated result reference."""
        return frozenset({self._source_ref}) if not self._runtime_only_materialization else frozenset()

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self: _HydrateFirstResolvedRowBase[T, ResultT]) -> bool:
        return self._runtime_only_materialization

    def publication_products(self: _HydrateFirstResolvedRowBase[T, ResultT]) -> StepPublicationProducts:
        """Publish raw SQL transport while returning the hydrated terminal value."""
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        if not contract.publishes_relation:
            return StepPublicationProducts(
                sql=NoSqlBinding(),
                runtime=NoRuntimePublication(),
            )
        if contract.relation_contract is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} SQL publication requires explicit lineage"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        return StepPublicationProducts(
            sql=ExecutedSqlRowsBinding(
                ref_id=self.ref_id,
                relation=RelationContract(
                    columns=contract.columns,
                    column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
                    optional_columns=contract.optional_columns,
                    empty_result_allowed=contract.empty_result_allowed,
                ),
                lineage=contract.relation_contract,
            ),
            runtime=NoRuntimePublication(),
        )

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _HydrateFirstResolvedRowBase) -> CtePublicationContract:
        if self._runtime_only_materialization:
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()

        def _legacy_cte_output_columns() -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
            _validate_planned_model_cte_metadata(
                step_name=type(self).__name__,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                planned_model_cls=self._cte_metadata_model_cls,
            )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.versioned_tombstone_projection import (
                VersionedTombstoneProjectionContract,
            )

            tombstone_contract = VersionedTombstoneProjectionContract(
                include_deleted=self._include_deleted,
            )
            preserved_framework_columns = tombstone_contract.retained_hydration_framework_columns
            return tuple(
                column
                for column in self._cte_output_columns
                if (column not in _HYDRATED_CTE_FRAMEWORK_COLUMNS or column in preserved_framework_columns)
                if column not in _FTS_GENERATED_TRANSPORT_COLUMNS
            )

        columns = _legacy_cte_output_columns()

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...] | None) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            _validate_planned_model_cte_metadata(
                step_name=type(self).__name__,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                planned_model_cls=self._cte_metadata_model_cls,
            )
            return self._cte_column_type_hints

        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns).filtered(set(columns or ()))
        if columns is None:
            if column_type_hints is not None and column_type_hints.has_any():
                msg = f"{type(self).__name__} declares SQL column type hints without an explicit cte_output_columns() contract."
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            class_name=f"{self._model_cls.__name__}MaterializedSequenceRow",
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        )
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        from l2070_batching.cte_contracts import projection_over_model_contract

        return projection_over_model_contract(
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            source_model_cls=self._model_cls,
            projection_lineage=tuple((column, column) for column in contract_columns),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
            optional_columns=frozenset(contract_columns) - {"sys_id"},
        )

    def semantic_publication_columns(self: _HydrateFirstResolvedRowBase[T, ResultT]) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        if self._runtime_only_materialization:
            return tuple(
                column
                for column in self._cte_output_columns
                if column not in _HYDRATED_CTE_FRAMEWORK_COLUMNS
                if column not in _private_large_column_pointer_columns(self._model_cls)
            )
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        if not contract.publishes_relation:
            return None
        return contract.columns

    def semantic_publication_type_hints(self: _HydrateFirstResolvedRowBase[T, ResultT]) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
        if self._runtime_only_materialization:
            columns = self.semantic_publication_columns()
            assert columns is not None
            return self._cte_column_type_hints.filtered(set(columns))
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        if not contract.publishes_relation:
            return None
        return contract.column_type_hints

    @property
    def published_model_cls(self) -> type[T]:
        return self._model_cls

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return not self._runtime_only_materialization

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependency_ref = _dependency_ref_for_runtime_subref(self._source_ref)
        if dependency_ref == str(self.ref_id):
            dependency_ref = ServerPlanRefId(self._source_ref)
        return frozenset({dependency_ref, *(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs)})

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[ResultT | None]:
        if self._runtime_only_materialization:
            columns = self.semantic_publication_columns()
            column_type_hints = self.semantic_publication_type_hints()
            assert columns is not None
            assert column_type_hints is not None
            output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
                tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in columns),
            )
            return CompiledStep(
                output_shape=output_shape,
                result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
                column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            )
        from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs

        uses_large_columns = bool(get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls))

        def _model_post_op(input_relation: DeclaredResultRelation) -> CompiledPostOp:
            return CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_OBJECT,
                    model_cls=None if self._result_mapping_columns() is not None else self._model_cls,
                    input_relation=input_relation,
                    raw_mode=self._result_mapping_columns() is not None,
                    select_columns=(
                        None
                        if self._result_mapping_columns() is None
                        else tuple(str(column) for column in self._result_mapping_columns() or ())
                    ),
                ),
            )

        def _inline_post_op() -> CompiledPostOp:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
                InlineLargeColumnQueryMaterializationConfig,
            )

            return CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_OBJECT,
                    inline_large_column_query_config=InlineLargeColumnQueryMaterializationConfig(
                        model_cls=self._model_cls,
                        defer_large_columns=False,
                        result_mode="first",
                        raw_mode=self._result_mapping_columns() is not None,
                        projected_columns=(
                            None
                            if self._result_mapping_columns() is None
                            else tuple(str(column) for column in self._result_mapping_columns() or ())
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )

        source_cte_ref = _lookup_source_cte_ref(ctx, self._source_ref)
        if uses_large_columns and not isinstance(source_cte_ref, CteReference):
            self._runtime_only_materialization = True
            self._cte_publication_contract_cache_valid = False
            self._publication_contract_cache_valid = False
            return CompiledStep(
                output_shape=None,
                column_type_hints=None,
                result_relation=None,
                closed_post_op=_inline_post_op(),
            )
        if isinstance(source_cte_ref, CteReference):
            publish_cte_binding(ctx, source_cte_ref, str(self.ref_id))
        source_columns = source_cte_ref.columns if isinstance(source_cte_ref, CteReference) else None
        source_has_large_column_pointers = False
        source_has_inline_large_column_aliases = False
        large_column_pointer_columns = tuple(
            get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)))
            for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls)
        )
        if source_columns is not None:
            source_column_set = set(source_columns)
            source_has_large_column_pointers = all(pointer_column in source_column_set for pointer_column in large_column_pointer_columns)
            source_has_inline_large_column_aliases = any(
                column.startswith("__nera_inline_large_column__") for column in source_column_set
            )
        should_inline_large_columns = (
            uses_large_columns
            and not source_has_inline_large_column_aliases
            and (source_columns is None or source_has_large_column_pointers)
        )
        should_hydrate_inline_large_columns = uses_large_columns and (
            should_inline_large_columns or source_has_inline_large_column_aliases
        )
        if source_columns is not None:
            source_column_set = set(source_columns)
            source_contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
            assert source_contract is not None
            selected_columns = tuple(column for column in source_contract.columns if column in source_column_set)
        else:
            source_contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
            if source_contract is None:
                msg = "row hydration source CTE does not expose a publication contract"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            selected_columns = tuple(source_contract.columns)
        include_pointer_columns = source_has_large_column_pointers and not source_has_inline_large_column_aliases
        if should_inline_large_columns and include_pointer_columns:
            selected_columns = tuple(
                dict.fromkeys((*selected_columns, *large_column_pointer_columns)),
            )
            self._cte_column_type_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                selected_columns,
                self._cte_column_type_hints,
                SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=frozenset(large_column_pointer_columns)),
            )
        elif should_inline_large_columns:
            selected_columns = tuple(column for column in selected_columns if column not in set(large_column_pointer_columns))
        self._include_deleted = self._include_deleted or "sys_deleted" in selected_columns
        self._cte_output_columns = tuple(selected_columns)
        self._cte_column_type_hints = self._cte_column_type_hints.filtered(set(selected_columns))
        if "sys_deleted" in selected_columns and "sys_deleted" not in self._cte_column_type_hints.bool_columns:
            self._cte_column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
                jsonb_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.jsonb_columns,
                uuid_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.uuid_columns,
                timestamptz_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.timestamptz_columns,
                date_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.date_columns,
                time_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.time_columns,
                numeric_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.numeric_columns,
                bool_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.bool_columns | frozenset({"sys_deleted"}),
                integer_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.integer_columns,
                bigint_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.bigint_columns,
                double_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.double_columns,
                text_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.text_columns,
                bytea_columns=self._cte_column_type_hints.bytea_columns,
            )
        self._cte_publication_contract_cache_valid = False
        self._publication_contract_cache_valid = False
        publication_contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        if publication_contract is None:
            msg = "row hydration CTE does not expose a publication contract"
            raise ValueError(msg)

        compiled = _source_cte_compiled_step(
            ctx,
            self._source_ref,
            closed_post_op=_inline_post_op() if should_hydrate_inline_large_columns else None,
            closed_post_op_factory=None if should_hydrate_inline_large_columns else _model_post_op,
            columns=selected_columns,
            column_type_hints=self._cte_column_type_hints,
            limit=1,
        )
        if not should_inline_large_columns:
            return compiled
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
            wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns,
        )

        wrapped = wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns(
            compiled,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            force_inline=True,
            include_pointer_columns=include_pointer_columns,
        )
        if wrapped.output_shape is not None and wrapped.column_type_hints is not None:
            self._cte_output_columns = wrapped.output_shape.cte_output_columns
            self._cte_column_type_hints = wrapped.column_type_hints
            self._cte_publication_contract_cache_valid = False
            self._publication_contract_cache_valid = False
        return wrapped

    def execute_runtime(
        self,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: Hydrator = LOCAL_MODEL_HYDRATOR,
    ) -> ResultT | None:
        row = _post_process_hydrate_first_resolved_row(
            str(self._source_ref),
            self._model_cls,
            (),
            hydrator,
            resolved,
            self._dispatch_insert_subscription,
        )
        if row is None:
            return None
        mapping_columns = self._result_mapping_columns()
        if mapping_columns is None:
            return cast("ResultT", row)
        mapping = {str(column): getattr(row, column) for column in mapping_columns}
        return cast("ResultT", mapping)

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_contract(self) -> BatchPostprocessReductionContract | None:
        return None

    def reduces_available_result_with_replayable_relation(self: _HydrateFirstResolvedRowBase[T, ResultT]) -> bool:
        return True

    def batch_result_labels(self: _HydrateFirstResolvedRowBase[T, ResultT]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Keep the hydrated model bound to this terminal, not its raw source."""
        return (str(self.ref_id),)

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_source_ref(self) -> str | None:
        return str(self._source_ref)

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_contract_for_relation(
        self,
        input_relation: DeclaredResultRelation,
    ) -> BatchPostprocessReductionContract:
        return BatchPostprocessReductionContract(
            source_ref=str(self._source_ref),
            raw_source_label=str(self._source_ref),
            closed_post_op=CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_OBJECT,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    input_relation=input_relation,
                    literal_payload={
                        "include_deleted": self._include_deleted or "sys_deleted" in self._cte_output_columns,
                    },
                ),
            ),
            dependency_ref_ids=(str(self._source_ref),),
        )

class HydrateStrictFirstResolvedRowStep[T: DatabaseObjectRow](SqlRelationPublisherStep[T | None]):
    def include_in_sql_callback_rendering(self: HydrateStrictFirstResolvedRowStep[T]) -> bool:
        return False

    """Return exactly one hydrated row from a resolved raw-row sequence."""

    def cte_publication_contract(self: HydrateStrictFirstResolvedRowStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = _model_field_cte_output_columns(self._model_cls)
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.versioned_tombstone_projection import (
            VersionedTombstoneProjectionContract,
        )

        tombstone_contract = VersionedTombstoneProjectionContract(
            include_deleted=self._include_deleted,
        )
        preserved_framework_columns = tombstone_contract.retained_hydration_framework_columns
        columns = tuple(
            column for column in columns if (column not in _HYDRATED_CTE_FRAMEWORK_COLUMNS or column in preserved_framework_columns)
        )
        column_type_hints = _model_cte_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, columns)
        columns, column_type_hints = _extend_with_inline_large_column_contract(
            self._model_cls,
            columns,
            column_type_hints,
        )
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        projection_model = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            contract_columns,
            column_type_hints,
        )
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=projection_model,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(projection_model),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[T],
        include_deleted: bool,
        required_value_error_message: RequiredErrorMessage | None = None,
        cte_prefix: HydrationCtePrefix = HydrationCtePrefix.STANDARD,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        if not isinstance(cte_prefix, HydrationCtePrefix):
            msg = f"HydrateStrictFirstResolvedRowStep.cte_prefix requires HydrationCtePrefix, got {type(cte_prefix).__name__}."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if required_value_error_message == "":
            raise ValueError("A required-value hydration error message must be non-empty.")
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._include_deleted = include_deleted
        self._dispatch_insert_subscription = InsertSubscriptionDispatch(False)
        self._required_value_error_message = required_value_error_message
        self._cte_prefix = cte_prefix

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "hydrate", "first", "strict"})

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def semantic_publication_columns(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return self.cte_publication_contract().columns

    def semantic_publication_type_hints(self) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        return self.cte_publication_contract().column_type_hints

    def raw_payload_source_ref(self) -> ServerPlanRefId | None:
        return self._source_ref

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependency_ref = _dependency_ref_for_runtime_subref(self._source_ref)
        if dependency_ref == str(self.ref_id):
            dependency_ref = ServerPlanRefId(self._source_ref)
        return frozenset({dependency_ref})

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[T | None]:
        from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs

        uses_large_columns = bool(get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls))
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        assert contract is not None
        contract_columns = contract.columns

        compiled = _source_cte_compiled_step(
            ctx,
            self._source_ref,
            closed_post_op_factory=lambda input_relation: CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_OBJECT,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    input_relation=input_relation,
                    strict_one=True,
                    terminal_object_empty=(
                        TerminalObjectEmptySpec(
                            kind=TerminalObjectEmptyKind.VALUE_ERROR,
                            message=self._required_value_error_message,
                        )
                        if self._required_value_error_message is not None
                        else None
                    ),
                )
            ),
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
            limit=2,
            cte_prefix=self._cte_prefix,
        )
        if not uses_large_columns:
            return compiled
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
            wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns,
        )

        return wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns(
            compiled,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            force_inline=True,
        )

    def execute_runtime(
        self,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: Hydrator = LOCAL_MODEL_HYDRATOR,
    ) -> T | None:
        raw = _resolved_raw_payload(resolved, self._source_ref)
        return _post_process_hydrate_strict_first_resolved_row(
            str(self._source_ref),
            self._model_cls,
            raw,
            hydrator,
            resolved,

class MaterializeQueueMessagesStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[list["DatabaseObjectRow"]]):

class MaterializeQueueMessageIdsStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[list["QueueMessageId"]]):

        return True

    def raw_payload_source_ref(self) -> ServerPlanRefId | None:
        return self._source_ref

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_source_ref(self) -> str | None:
        return str(self._source_ref)

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_contract_for_relation(
        self,
        input_relation: DeclaredResultRelation,
    ) -> BatchPostprocessReductionContract | None:
        return BatchPostprocessReductionContract(
            source_ref=str(self._source_ref),
            raw_source_label=str(self._source_ref),
            closed_post_op=CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_ARRAY,
                    column="sys_id",
                    input_relation=input_relation,
                    scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.QUEUE_MESSAGE_ID,
                ),
            ),
        )

    def batch_result_labels(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return (str(self.ref_id),)

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
        from l4100_queue.queue_message import QueueMessage

        # This step is part of the queue publication seam for the insert that
        # produced ``source_ref``. Treat it as queue-affine so the dependency
        # optimizer keeps it ordered with that writer instead of synthesizing a
        # later queue-writer back-edge through the dependency-only path.
        return frozenset({get_table_name(QueueMessage)})

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({_dependency_ref_for_runtime_subref(self._source_ref)})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: MaterializeQueueMessageIdsStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("sys_id",)
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"}))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _MaterializeQueueMessageIdsStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.literal_mapping(columns=columns),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def executor_publication_projection_columns(self: MaterializeQueueMessageIdsStep) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return ("sys_id",)

    def publication_products(self) -> StepPublicationProducts:
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        assert contract.relation_contract is not None
        return StepPublicationProducts(
            sql=ExecutedSqlRowsBinding(
                ref_id=self.ref_id,
                relation=RelationContract(
                    columns=contract.columns,
                    column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
                ),
                lineage=contract.relation_contract,
            ),
            runtime=NoRuntimePublication(),
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[QueueMessageId]]:
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        source_cte_ref = _lookup_source_cte_ref(ctx, self._source_ref)
        if isinstance(source_cte_ref, CteReference):
            published_binding = CteReference(
                source_cte_ref.ref_id,
                source_tables=source_cte_ref.source_tables,
                columns=contract.columns,
                column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
                relation_role=source_cte_ref.relation_role,
                auxiliary_query=source_cte_ref.auxiliary_query,
                ephemeral=source_cte_ref.ephemeral,
            )
            publish_cte_binding(ctx, published_binding, str(self.ref_id))
        return _source_cte_compiled_step(
            ctx,
            self._source_ref,
            columns=contract.columns,
            closed_post_op=CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_ARRAY,
                    column="sys_id",
                    scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.QUEUE_MESSAGE_ID,
                ),
            ),
        )

    def execute_runtime(
        self,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: Hydrator = LOCAL_MODEL_HYDRATOR,
    ) -> list[QueueMessageId]:
        return _post_process_materialize_queue_message_ids(
            str(self._source_ref),
            cast("Sequence[dict[str, Any]]", resolved.get(str(self._source_ref), [])),
            hydrator,
            resolved,
        )

        self._dispatch_with_old_row = dispatch_with_old_row
        self._require_existing = require_existing
        self._after_refs = after_refs

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "update", "hydrate"})

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def supports_ordered_sql_statement_batch(self: HydrateSelectedUpdateResultStep[T]) -> bool:
        return not get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls)

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return bool(get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls))

    def sql_imported_dependency_refs(self) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
        if not get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls):
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset({self._source_ref, self._selected_ref})

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def emits_sql_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return None

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def runtime_result_is_terminal_scalar(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        return _selected_update_cte_publication_contract(type(self).__name__, self._model_cls)

    def executor_publication_projection_columns(self: HydrateSelectedUpdateResultStep[T]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Project the producer-owned transport columns from hydrated driver rows."""
        return self.cte_publication_contract().columns

    def publication_products(self: HydrateSelectedUpdateResultStep[T]) -> StepPublicationProducts:
        """Publish the executed SQL transport, not the hydrated runtime result."""
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        if contract.relation_contract is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} SQL publication requires explicit lineage"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        return StepPublicationProducts(
            sql=ExecutedSqlRowsBinding(
                ref_id=self.ref_id,
                relation=RelationContract(
                    columns=contract.columns,
                    column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
                    optional_columns=contract.optional_columns,
                    empty_result_allowed=contract.empty_result_allowed,
                ),
                lineage=contract.relation_contract,
            ),
            runtime=NoRuntimePublication(),
        )

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(
            {
                str(self._source_ref),
                _dependency_ref_for_runtime_subref(self._selected_ref),
                *(str(ref_id) for ref_id in self._after_refs),
            },
        )

    def ordered_statement_sql_visible_dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Return relations that the hydration statement reads by CTE name."""
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref), str(self._selected_ref)})

    def ordered_transport_inlines_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[T | None]:
        source_key = str(self._source_ref)
        source_candidate = _lookup_source_cte_ref(ctx, self._source_ref)
        if not isinstance(source_candidate, CteReference):
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"selected-update source {source_key!r} has no SQL-visible CTE binding",
                blocked_path="empty compiled step plus runtime selected-update hydration",
                result_contract="Selected-update hydration must decode from a SQL-visible transport relation.",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the update result rows as a CTE before hydration.",
                    "Publish the selected preimage rows as a CTE before hydration.",
                    "Do not pass selected/update rows through runtime refs in post-op.",
                ),
            )
        return _selected_update_result_compiled_step(
            ctx,
            self._source_ref,
            self._selected_ref,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            strip_columns=tuple(str(column) for column in self._strip_columns),
            require_when_selected=bool(self._require_when_selected),
            require_existing=bool(self._require_existing),
            dispatch_with_old_row=bool(self._dispatch_with_old_row),
            limit=1,
        )

    def raw_payload_source_ref(self) -> ServerPlanRefId | None:
        # Ordinary rows can reuse the update transport for runtime hydration.
        # The SQL publication still owns its separate source/preimage relation.
        if get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls):
            return None
        return self._source_ref

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_contract(self) -> BatchPostprocessReductionContract | None:
        return None

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_source_ref(self) -> str | None:
        return None

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_contract_for_relation(
        self,
        input_relation: DeclaredResultRelation,
    ) -> BatchPostprocessReductionContract | None:
        del input_relation
        # The selected preimage is part of the typed SQL transport relation.
        # Reducing this step to the update-returning source alone discards that
        # relation and forces the executor to recover it from runtime refs.
        return None

    def execute_runtime(
        self,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: Hydrator = LOCAL_MODEL_HYDRATOR,
    ) -> T | None:
        return _post_process_hydrate_selected_update_result(
            str(self._source_ref),
            str(self._selected_ref),
            str(self._source_ref),
            self._model_cls,
            self._strip_columns,
            self._require_when_selected,
            self._dispatch_with_old_row,
            None,
            [],
            hydrator,
            resolved,
            require_existing=self._require_existing,
        )

class MaterializeResolvedModelSequenceStep[T: DatabaseObjectRow](SqlRelationPublisherStep[list[T]]):
    def include_in_sql_callback_rendering(self: MaterializeResolvedModelSequenceStep[T]) -> bool:
        return False

    """Materialize resolved rows into typed models, allowing typed passthrough."""

    optimizer_projection_owned = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[T],
        expected_count: ExpectedRowCount | None = None,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
        omit_version_transport_columns: bool = False,
        source_is_executor_owned: bool = False,
        inline_large_columns: bool = False,
        source_columns: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._expected_count = expected_count
        self._after_refs = after_refs
        self._source_is_executor_owned = source_is_executor_owned
        self._inline_large_columns = inline_large_columns
        self._cte_output_columns = source_columns or _model_field_cte_output_columns(self._model_cls)
        if omit_version_transport_columns:
            self._cte_output_columns = tuple(
                column for column in self._cte_output_columns if column not in {"sys_revision_id", "sys_staged_commit_id"}
            )
        inline_column_type_hints: tuple[SqlColumnTypeHints, ...] = ()
        if self._inline_large_columns:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
                inline_large_column_alias_columns,
                inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints,
            )

            trailing_branch = ("branch_id",) if "branch_id" in self._cte_output_columns else ()
            self._cte_output_columns = tuple(column for column in self._cte_output_columns if column != "branch_id")
            inline_columns = tuple(
                column for column in inline_large_column_alias_columns(self._model_cls) if column not in self._cte_output_columns
            )
            self._cte_output_columns = (*self._cte_output_columns, *inline_columns, *trailing_branch)
            inline_column_type_hints = (inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls),)
        self._cte_column_type_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
            self._cte_output_columns,
            _model_cte_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, self._cte_output_columns),
            *inline_column_type_hints,
        )
        self._cte_metadata_model_cls = self._model_cls

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "hydrate", "materialize"})

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def is_executor_owned_runtime_step(self) -> bool:
        return self._source_is_executor_owned

    def emits_sql_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        if self._source_is_executor_owned:
            return None
        return True

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def raw_payload_source_ref(self) -> ServerPlanRefId | None:
        return self._source_ref

    def batch_result_alias_labels(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Alias the producer-owned raw result during compound postprocessing."""
        return (str(self._source_ref),)

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_contract(self) -> BatchPostprocessReductionContract | None:
        return None

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_source_ref(self) -> str | None:
        return str(self._source_ref) if self._source_is_executor_owned else None

    def batch_postprocess_reduction_contract_for_relation(
        self,
        input_relation: DeclaredResultRelation,
    ) -> BatchPostprocessReductionContract | None:
        if not self._source_is_executor_owned:
            return None
        return BatchPostprocessReductionContract(
            source_ref=str(self._source_ref),
            raw_source_label=str(self._source_ref),
            closed_post_op=CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_ARRAY,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    input_relation=input_relation,
                ),
            ),
        )

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return not self._source_is_executor_owned and not self._inline_large_columns

    def cte_publication_contract(self: MaterializeResolvedModelSequenceStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        def _legacy_cte_output_columns() -> tuple[str, ...]:
            _validate_planned_model_cte_metadata(
                step_name=type(self).__name__,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                planned_model_cls=self._cte_metadata_model_cls,
            )
            return self._cte_output_columns

        columns = _legacy_cte_output_columns()

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...] | None) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            _validate_planned_model_cte_metadata(
                step_name=type(self).__name__,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                planned_model_cls=self._cte_metadata_model_cls,
            )
            return self._cte_column_type_hints

        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            class_name=f"{self._model_cls.__name__}MaterializedSequenceRow",
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        )
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=contract_model_cls,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.model(self._model_cls),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def publication_contract(self) -> PublicationContract:
        if "." not in str(self._source_ref) or self._inline_large_columns:
            return super().publication_contract()
        _validate_planned_model_cte_metadata(
            step_name=type(self).__name__,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            planned_model_cls=self._cte_metadata_model_cls,
        )
        return PublicationContract(
            source_kind=PublicationSourceKind.RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_VALUE,
            transport=None,
            semantic=RelationContract(
                columns=self._cte_output_columns,
                column_type_hints=self._cte_column_type_hints,
            ),
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=None,
        )

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependency_ref = _dependency_ref_for_runtime_subref(self._source_ref)
        if dependency_ref == str(self.ref_id):
            dependency_ref = ServerPlanRefId(self._source_ref)
        return frozenset({dependency_ref}) | frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in self._after_refs)

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[T]]:
        source_key = str(self._source_ref)
        cte_ref = _lookup_source_cte_ref(ctx, self._source_ref)
        if not isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference):
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"row hydration source {source_key!r} has no SQL-visible CTE binding",
                blocked_path="runtime raw-row hydration fallback or stale base-ref substitution",
                result_contract="model-sequence materialization must read the requested SQL-visible source relation.",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the authoritative raw/prepared source rows as a CTE before model materialization.",
                    "Preserve the model row publication contract on that CTE.",
                    "Do not hydrate from a hidden runtime raw-row value or from a base ref for a dotted source.",
                ),
            )

        if self._inline_large_columns:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
                InlineLargeColumnQueryMaterializationConfig,
                wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns,
            )

            compiled = _source_cte_compiled_step(
                ctx,
                self._source_ref,
                closed_post_op=CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                    ResultMaterializationSpec(
                        behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_OBJECT,
                        inline_large_column_query_config=InlineLargeColumnQueryMaterializationConfig(
                            model_cls=self._model_cls,
                            defer_large_columns=False,
                            result_mode="many",
                            raw_mode=False,
                            projected_columns=None,
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )
            return wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns(
                compiled,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                force_inline=True,
            )

        return _source_cte_compiled_step(
            ctx,
            self._source_ref,
            closed_post_op_factory=lambda input_relation: CompiledPostOp.materialize(
                ResultMaterializationSpec(
                    behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_ARRAY,
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    input_relation=input_relation,
                )
            ),
        )

    def execute_runtime(
        self,
        resolved: ResolvedRefs,
        hydrator: Hydrator = LOCAL_MODEL_HYDRATOR,
    ) -> list[T]:
        return _post_process_hydrate_resolved_rows(
            self._model_cls,
            str(self._source_ref),
            (),
            hydrator,
            resolved,
        )

def _ctx(**overrides: Any) -> LoweringContext:
    backend_type = overrides.pop("backend_type", BackendType.SQLITE)
    dialect: SqlDialect
    if backend_type is BackendType.SQLITE:
        dialect = SqliteDialect()
    elif backend_type is BackendType.POSTGRES:
        dialect = PostgresDialect()
    else:
        dialect = MySQLDialect()
    backend_profile = overrides.pop("backend_profile", make_backend_profile(backend_type, dialect=dialect))
    overrides.setdefault("dialect", dialect)
    overrides.setdefault("planning_catalog", build_planning_catalog())
    overrides.setdefault("session_id", SessionId.system())
    return LoweringContext(
        backend_type=backend_type,
        backend_profile=backend_profile,
        is_write_transaction=True,
        **overrides,
    )

    *,

    queue_insert_auth_serialized: str | None = None,
    cte_refs: Mapping[str, CteReference] | None = None,

) -> CompilationContext:

    all_cte_refs = dict(cte_refs or {})

    return CompilationContext(
        backend_type=BackendType.POSTGRES,
        dialect=d,
        supports_data_modifying_ctes=True,
        backend_profile=make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES, dialect=d),
        planning_catalog=build_planning_catalog(),
        cte_refs=all_cte_refs,
        materialized_pipeline=MaterializedPipeline(materialized_pipeline or {}),
        sql_handle=sql_connection,
        queue_insert_auth_serialized=queue_insert_auth_serialized,

def test_insert_many_embedding_auto_queue_orders_write_metadata_and_queue_steps() -> None:
    rows = [
        _EmbeddingWriteLoweringDoc(sys_id=SysId.new(), content="alpha"),
        _EmbeddingWriteLoweringDoc(sys_id=SysId.new(), content="beta"),
    ]
    steps = lower_steps(
        [
            InsertManyIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId("insert_many_docs"),
                _EmbeddingWriteLoweringDoc,
                ServerRefs.object_sequence(rows),
                ServerRefs.scalar(_shape_insert_many_intent_config(_EmbeddingWriteLoweringDoc, rows)),
            ),
        ],
        ctx=_ctx(
            backend_type=BackendType.POSTGRES,
            embedding_write_infra_factory=lambda: True,
        ),
    )

    ref_ids = [step.ref_id for step in steps]
    assert any(ref_id.endswith("_meta_ensure") for ref_id in ref_ids)
    assert not any(type(step).__name__ == "_ResolveEmbeddingMetadataStep" for step in steps)
    assert not any(ref_id.endswith("_meta.materialized") for ref_id in ref_ids)

    pg_opt_ctx = make_optimization_context(
        profile=make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES),
    )
    optimized = optimize_steps(steps, ctx=pg_opt_ctx)
    semantic_steps = [step for step in optimized if type(step).__name__ != "ApplySqlSessionContextStep"]

    def _leaf_steps(step: ServerPlanStep[Any]) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        if isinstance(step, PhysicalStatementGroup):
            return [leaf for child in step.children for leaf in _leaf_steps(child)]
        return [step]

    flattened_semantic_steps = [leaf for step in semantic_steps for leaf in _leaf_steps(step)]
    semantic_step_names = [type(step).__name__ for step in flattened_semantic_steps]
    assert set(semantic_step_names) >= {
        "InsertManyRawResultStep",
        "UpsertRawResultStep",
        "_PrepareMaterializedEmbeddingQueueRowsStep",
        "_MaterializedEmbeddingQueueInsertStep",
        "_UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep",
        "_QueueEventDispatchStep",
        "BarrierStep",
    }
    queue_step = next(step for step in flattened_semantic_steps if type(step).__name__ == "_MaterializedEmbeddingQueueInsertStep")
    prepare_step = next(step for step in flattened_semantic_steps if type(step).__name__ == "_PrepareMaterializedEmbeddingQueueRowsStep")
    metadata_update_step = next(
        step for step in flattened_semantic_steps if type(step).__name__ == "_UpdateEmbeddingMetadataQueuedStateStep"
    )
    event_step = next(step for step in flattened_semantic_steps if type(step).__name__ == "_QueueEventDispatchStep")
    metadata_boundary = next(step for step in flattened_semantic_steps if str(step.ref_id).endswith("_metadata_update_boundary"))
    completion_barrier = next(
        step for step in flattened_semantic_steps if type(step).__name__ == "BarrierStep" and step is not metadata_boundary
    )

    assert "insert_many_docs" in prepare_step.dependencies()
    assert "insert_many_docs.raw" not in prepare_step.dependencies()
    assert str(queue_step.ref_id) in metadata_boundary.dependencies()
    assert str(metadata_boundary.ref_id) in metadata_update_step.dependencies()
    assert str(queue_step.ref_id) in event_step.dependencies()
    assert {str(metadata_update_step.ref_id), str(event_step.ref_id)} <= completion_barrier.dependencies()

    optimized = optimize_steps(steps)

    def _leaf_names(step: ServerPlanStep[Any]) -> list[str]:
        children = step.physical_group_children()
        if not children:
            return [type(step).__name__]
        return [name for child in children for name in _leaf_names(child)]

    optimized_names = [name for step in optimized for name in _leaf_names(step)]
    object_ids_index = optimized_names.index("_ResolveObjectIdsStep")

        set_embedding_intent(

            SysId.new(),

def _flatten_batched_steps(
    steps: Sequence[object],
) -> tuple[ServerPlanStep[Any], ...]:
    flattened: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    for step in steps:
        assert isinstance(step, ServerPlanStep)
        flattened.append(step)
        if isinstance(step, PhysicalStatementGroup):
            flattened.extend(_flatten_batched_steps(step.children))
    return tuple(flattened)


def _assert_embedding_hash_sql_deps_are_produced(steps: Sequence[object]) -> None:
    flattened = _flatten_batched_steps(steps)
    hash_steps = [step for step in flattened if isinstance(step, _ResolveVisibleEmbeddingContentHashStep)]
    assert hash_steps
    PublicationLivenessState.from_steps(
        cast("Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]", flattened),
    ).verify_sql_visible_dependencies()

    """Reject MATCH...AGAINST when staged rows require an unindexed overlay."""
    has_staged_visibility = ctx.staged_commit_id is not None or ctx.is_write_transaction
    uses_indexed_match = ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.MATCH_AGAINST
    if has_staged_visibility and uses_indexed_match and ctx.has_native_fts:
        msg = (
            "MariaDB native versioned FTS cannot search staged writes because MATCH requires "
            "indexed physical columns; commit the writes before searching"
        )
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)

def _compile_permission_where_with_resolved_user(
    *,
    model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    session_id: Any,
    resolved_user_id: ResolvedPermissionUserId | SqlRenderable,
    table_alias: str,
    missing_user_message: str,
    version_anchor: PermissionVersionAnchor,
    compilation_context: CompilationContext,
    session_id_sql: SqlRenderable | None,
    session_vars: Mapping[str | tuple[type, str], SqlRenderable] | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    """Build permission SQL from an explicit CTE-backed or concrete user source."""
    from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import get_query_permission_plan

    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_type)
    typed_session_id = _normalize_literal_session_id(session_id)
    if permission_plan is None or not permission_plan.filters_session(typed_session_id):
        return None
    if permission_plan.requires_user_id and resolved_user_id is None:
        raise RuntimeError(missing_user_message)

    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.protocols import SqlRenderable
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlFrom, SqlSelectList
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlSubquery
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
    from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
        compile_versioned_permission_where_with_user_id_sql,
    )
    from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference
    from l4000_permissions.rbac_ids import UserId

    if isinstance(resolved_user_id, SqlRenderable):
        user_id_expr: SqlRenderable = resolved_user_id
    elif isinstance(resolved_user_id, CteReference):
        user_id_expr = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("user_id"))]),
                from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(resolved_user_id.ref_id))),
                limit=1,
            ),
        )
    else:
        user_id_expr = SqlParam(
            resolved_user_id.unwrap_to_str() if isinstance(resolved_user_id, UserId) else None,
        )

    permission_where: SqlRenderable | None = compile_versioned_permission_where_with_user_id_sql(
        model_type,
        user_id_expr,
        table_alias,
        version_anchor=version_anchor,
        session_id_sql=session_id_sql,
        session_vars=session_vars,
        compilation_context=compilation_context,
    )
    return permission_where

def _build_postgres_natural_query_text_expr(query_expr: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlFuncCall, SqlTrimExpr
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam

    stripped_operators = SqlTrimExpr(query_expr)
    for token in ("&", "|", "!", ":", "*", "(", ")", "<", ">"):
        stripped_operators = SqlFuncCall(
            "REPLACE",
            [
                stripped_operators,
                SqlParam(token),
                SqlParam(" "),
            ],
        )
    normalized_whitespace = SqlFuncCall(
        "REGEXP_REPLACE",
        [
            SqlTrimExpr(stripped_operators),
            SqlParam(r"\s+"),
            SqlParam(" "),
            SqlParam("g"),
        ],
    )
    return SqlFuncCall(
        "REPLACE",
        [
            SqlTrimExpr(normalized_whitespace),
            SqlParam(" "),
            SqlParam(" | "),
        ],
    )


def _build_postgres_boolean_query_text_expr(query_expr: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlFuncCall
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam

    normalized = query_expr
    for source, target in (
        (" AND ", " & "),
        (" OR ", " | "),
        (" NOT ", " ! "),
    ):
        normalized = SqlFuncCall(
            "REPLACE",
            [
                normalized,
                SqlParam(source),
                SqlParam(target),
            ],
        )
    return normalized


def _build_postgres_prefix_query_text_expr(query_expr: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam

    if isinstance(query_expr, SqlParam):
        terms = [match.group(0) for match in re.finditer(r"\w+", str(query_expr.value), flags=re.UNICODE)]
        return SqlParam(FtsQueryText(" & ".join(f"{term}:*" for term in terms)))
    return _build_postgres_boolean_query_text_expr(query_expr)


def _build_postgres_tsquery_expr(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_expr: SqlRenderable,
    mode: FTSSearchMode | None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts._expressions_fts import SqlTsQueryMode, SqlTsQueryParamExpr
    from l5100_fts.fts_query import FTSSearchMode

    if mode == FTSSearchMode.NATURAL:
        return SqlTsQueryParamExpr(
            language=SqlGrammarKind(_fts_language_for_model(model_cls)),
            query_expr=_build_postgres_natural_query_text_expr(query_expr),
            mode=SqlTsQueryMode.BOOLEAN,
        )
    if mode == FTSSearchMode.BOOLEAN:
        return SqlTsQueryParamExpr(
            language=SqlGrammarKind(_fts_language_for_model(model_cls)),
            query_expr=_build_postgres_boolean_query_text_expr(query_expr),
            mode=SqlTsQueryMode.BOOLEAN,
        )
    if mode == FTSSearchMode.PREFIX:
        return SqlTsQueryParamExpr(
            language=SqlGrammarKind(_fts_language_for_model(model_cls)),
            query_expr=_build_postgres_prefix_query_text_expr(query_expr),
            mode=SqlTsQueryMode.BOOLEAN,
        )
    return SqlTsQueryParamExpr(
        language=SqlGrammarKind(_fts_language_for_model(model_cls)),
        query_expr=query_expr,
        mode=SqlGrammarKind(_tsquery_mode_from_search_mode(mode)),
    )

) -> SqlRenderable:

def _compile_terminal_search_projection(
    *,
    grammar: SqlRenderable,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    inline_large_columns: bool,
    query_spec: QuerySpec[Any] | None = None,
    raw_mode: bool = True,
) -> CompiledStep[object]:
    from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    closed_post_op = row_dicts_post_op()
    __opa002_grammar_444 = grammar
    columns = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            (
                *(str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))) for field_name in model_cls.model_fields),
                *(
                    str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column))))
                    for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )
    published_columns = (*columns, "_fts_rank")
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
        tuple(synthetic_output_field(column, role="fts_terminal") for column in published_columns),
    )
    model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, columns)
    column_type_hints = (
        None
        if model_hints is None
        else combine_sql_column_type_hints(
            published_columns,
            model_hints,
            SqlColumnTypeHints(double_columns=frozenset({"_fts_rank"})),
        )
    )
    if column_type_hints is None:
        msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {model_cls.__name__} FTS terminal projection."
        # FTS terminal projection preserves explicit SQL type metadata.
        raise ProgrammingError(msg)
    compiled = CompiledStep(
        output_shape=output_shape,
        grammar=__opa002_grammar_444,
        needs_returning=True,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        closed_post_op=closed_post_op,
    )
    if inline_large_columns:
        compiled = wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns(
            compiled,
            model_cls=model_cls,
        )
        if query_spec is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
                inline_large_column_query_post_op,
            )

            compiled = replace(
                compiled,
                closed_post_op=inline_large_column_query_post_op(
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    query_spec=query_spec,
                    result_mode="many",
                    raw_mode=raw_mode,
                ),
            )
    return cast(CompiledStep[object], compiled)

def _searched_fields_are_private_only(
    field_names: Sequence[str],
    private_fields: Sequence[str],
) -> bool:
    private_field_set = frozenset(private_fields)
    searched = frozenset(field_names)
    return bool(searched) and not searched.isdisjoint(private_field_set) and searched.issubset(private_field_set)


def _effective_fts_fields_for_column_visibility(
    field_names: Sequence[str],
    masking_info: tuple[str, list[str]] | None,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if masking_info is None:
        return tuple(field_names)
    _owner_field, private_fields = masking_info
    private_field_set = frozenset(private_fields)
    searched = tuple(field_names)
    public_fields = tuple(field_name for field_name in searched if field_name not in private_field_set)
    private_requested = any(field_name in private_field_set for field_name in searched)
    if private_requested and public_fields:
        return public_fields
    return searched


def _combine_where_clauses(
    left: SqlRenderable | None,
    right: SqlRenderable | None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    if left is None:
        return right
    if right is None:
        return left
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import sql_and

    return sql_and(left, right)


def _native_fts_private_field_owner_filter(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_names: Sequence[str],
    masking_info: tuple[str, list[str]] | None,
    user_id_expr: SqlRenderable | None,
    table_alias: str,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    if masking_info is None:
        return None
    owner_field, private_fields = masking_info
    if not _searched_fields_are_private_only(field_names, private_fields):
        return None
    assert user_id_expr is not None

    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    return SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(owner_field))), qualifier=table_alias),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        user_id_expr,
    )


def _wrap_native_fts_projection_with_column_masking(
    *,
    grammar: SqlRenderable,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    masking_info: tuple[str, list[str]] | None,
    user_id_expr: SqlRenderable | None,
    rank_alias: str = "_fts_rank",
) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
        SqlItemList,
        SqlOrderByClause,
        SqlOrderByItem,
        SqlSelectAlias,
        SqlSubqueryTableRef,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import OrderDirection
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.field_reference_policy import build_sql_field_reference_policy
    from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    source_alias = "fts_rows"
    field_policy = (
        build_sql_field_reference_policy(
            get_db_column=lambda field_name: get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)),
            table_alias=source_alias,
            column_masking=masking_info,
            column_masking_user_grammar=user_id_expr,
        )
        if masking_info is not None and user_id_expr is not None
        else None
    )
    select_items: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for field_name in model_cls.model_fields:
        db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
        if field_policy is not None:
            projected_field = field_policy.observable_field(field_name, db_col=db_column)
        else:
            projected_field = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_column), qualifier=source_alias)
        select_items.append(SqlSelectAlias(projected_field, SqlAliasName(db_column)))
    for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls):
        pointer_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)))
        select_items.append(
            SqlSelectAlias(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(pointer_column), qualifier=source_alias),
                SqlAliasName(pointer_column),
            ),
        )
    select_items.append(
        SqlSelectAlias(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(rank_alias), qualifier=source_alias),
            SqlAliasName(rank_alias),
        ),
    )
    return SqlSelect(
        SqlItemList(select_items),
        SqlSubqueryTableRef(grammar, SqlTableName(source_alias)),
        order_by=SqlOrderByClause(
            [
                SqlOrderByItem(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(rank_alias), qualifier=source_alias),
                    OrderDirection.DESC,
                ),
            ],
        ),
    )


def _native_query_input_column_name(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    column: object,
) -> str:
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    expression = getattr(column, "expression", None)
    if expression is not None:
        column = expression
    if isinstance(column, tuple):
        column = column[0]
    field_name = getattr(column, "field", None) or getattr(column, "name", None)
    if field_name is None:
        field_name = str(column)
    return str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(str(field_name))))


def _wrap_native_fts_query_shape(
    *,
    grammar: SqlRenderable,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_inputs: _VersionedFtsQueryInputs | None,
    limit: int | None,
    offset: int,
    rank_alias: str = "_fts_rank",
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if query_inputs is None:
        return grammar

    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
        SqlItemList,
        SqlOrderByClause,
        SqlOrderByItem,
        SqlSelectAlias,
        SqlSubqueryTableRef,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import OrderDirection
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
    from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    source_alias = "fts_shaped"
    selected_columns: tuple[str, ...]
    if query_inputs.select_columns is None:
        selected_columns = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                (
                    *(str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))) for field_name in model_cls.model_fields),
                    *(
                        str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column))))
                        for config in get_large_column_configs(model_cls)
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
    else:
        selected_columns = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(_native_query_input_column_name(model_cls, select_column) for select_column in query_inputs.select_columns),
        )
    select_items: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlSelectAlias(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name), qualifier=source_alias),
            SqlAliasName(column_name),
        )
        for column_name in selected_columns
    ]
    select_items.append(
        SqlSelectAlias(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(rank_alias), qualifier=source_alias),
            SqlAliasName(rank_alias),
        ),
    )

    order_items: list[SqlRenderable] = [
        SqlOrderByItem(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(rank_alias), qualifier=source_alias),
            OrderDirection.DESC,
        ),
    ]
    for order_entry in query_inputs.order_by:
        order_column = _native_query_input_column_name(model_cls, order_entry)
        direction_value = str(order_entry[1] if isinstance(order_entry, tuple) else getattr(order_entry, "direction", "ASC"))
        order_items.append(
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(order_column), qualifier=source_alias),
                OrderDirection.DESC if direction_value.upper() == "DESC" else OrderDirection.ASC,
            ),
        )

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.search_cursor_sql import build_search_cursor_where

    cursor_where = build_search_cursor_where(
        query_inputs.to_query_spec(model_cls=model_cls),
        score_column=rank_alias,
        source_alias=source_alias,
        model_cls=model_cls,
    )

    return SqlSelect(
        SqlItemList(select_items),
        SqlSubqueryTableRef(grammar, SqlTableName(source_alias)),
        where=cursor_where,
        order_by=SqlOrderByClause(order_items),
        limit=limit,
        offset=None if cursor_where is not None else offset if offset > 0 else None,
    )

    )
