def _build_postgres_field_scoped_tsvector_expr(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_names: Sequence[str],
    table_alias: str,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlJsonPath
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts.ddl_fts import SqlPgToTsVector
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts.fts_types import TsVectorConfig
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlFuncCall
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_json import JsonAccessKind, SqlJsonAccess
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
    from impl.common.l5165_fts_spill_support.spill_support import map_postgres_fts_language
    from l1000_schema.column_utils import get_db_column_name
    from l1000_schema.dynamic_field_utils import is_dynamic_property_field
    from l5100_fts.fts_config import get_fts_config

    config = get_fts_config(model_cls)
    assert config is not None, f"{model_cls.__name__} must be FTS-configured before compiling FTS"
    language_name = map_postgres_fts_language(config.languages[0] if config.languages else "en")
    language = TsVectorConfig.from_string(language_name)
    empty_string = SqlParam("")
    space_literal = SqlParam(" ")
    field_exprs: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for field_name in field_names:
        if is_dynamic_property_field(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)):
            field_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlJsonAccess(
                JsonAccessKind.GET_TEXT,
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("properties"), qualifier=table_alias),
                SqlJsonPath(f"$.{field_name}"),
            )
        else:
            field_expr = SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))),
                qualifier=table_alias,
            )
        field_exprs.append(
            SqlFuncCall(
                "COALESCE",
                [
                    field_expr,
                    empty_string,
                ],
            ),
        )
    interleaved: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for index, expr in enumerate(field_exprs):
        if index > 0:
            interleaved.append(space_literal)
        interleaved.append(expr)
    return SqlPgToTsVector(language, SqlFuncCall("CONCAT", interleaved))


def _build_postgres_symbolic_versioned_fts_components(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_names: Sequence[str],
    table_alias: str,
    query_expr: SqlRenderable,
    content_table_type: Literal["tip", "sparse"] = "sparse",
    source_has_fts_vector: bool = True,
) -> SqlFTSComponents:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts._expressions_fts import (
        SqlTsRankExpr,
        SqlTsVectorMatchExpr,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts.fts_expressions import (
        SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
    from l5100_fts.fts_components import SqlFTSComponents, SqlFTSJoinStyle
    from l5100_fts.fts_naming import fts_versioned_column_name

    from l5100_fts.fts_config import get_fts_config

    config = get_fts_config(model_cls)
    configured_fields = () if config is None else tuple(config.fields)
    if source_has_fts_vector and tuple(field_names) == configured_fields:
        fts_vector: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(
            fts_versioned_column_name(str(get_table_name(model_cls)), content_table_type),
            qualifier=table_alias,
        )
    else:
        fts_vector = _build_postgres_field_scoped_tsvector_expr(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            field_names=field_names,
            table_alias=table_alias,
        )
    match_expr = SqlTsVectorMatchExpr(fts_vector, query_expr)
    return SqlFTSComponents(
        join_clause=None,
        where_clause=match_expr,
        rank_expression=SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr(
            SqlTsRankExpr(fts_vector, query_expr),
            backend="postgresql",
        ),
        join_style=SqlFTSJoinStyle.WHERE_ONLY,
        rank_alias="__fts_rank",
    )


def _build_versioned_fts_components(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    field_names: Sequence[str],
    sparse_table_name: str,
    query_expr: SqlRenderable,
    table_alias: str,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    content_table_type: Literal["tip", "sparse"] | None = None,
    fts_mode: FTSSearchMode | None = None,
    sqlite_literal_query_text: str | None = None,
    sqlite_literal_fts_query: str | None = None,
    source_revision_column: str = "sys_revision_id",
) -> SqlFTSComponents:
    from l5100_fts.fts_config import get_fts_config
    from l5000_search_index_policy import versioned_table_type_enabled

    config = get_fts_config(model_cls)
    resolved_content_table_type: Literal["tip", "sparse"] = (
        content_table_type if content_table_type is not None else "tip" if sparse_table_name.endswith("_tip") else "sparse"
    )
    if (
        sparse_table_name.endswith("_sparse")
        and config is not None
        and ctx.branch_id is None
        and getattr(ctx, "lazy_branch", None) is None
        and not versioned_table_type_enabled(
            config.index_policy.scope,
            "sparse",
            normal_schema_setup=False,
        )
    ):
        from l1000_schema.index_policy import BranchIndexMaterializationError

        msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} FTS index policy does not materialize history for explicit revision reads."
        raise BranchIndexMaterializationError(msg)
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.TEXT_SEARCH_VECTOR:
        return _build_postgres_symbolic_versioned_fts_components(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            field_names=field_names,
            table_alias=table_alias,
            query_expr=query_expr,
            content_table_type=resolved_content_table_type,
        )
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.TABLE_MATCH:
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.backend_profiles import _build_sqlite_fts_query_string
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts.fts_expressions import (
            FtsQueryText,
            SqlFts5Bm25Call,
            SqlFts5MatchCondition,
            SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr,
            SqlFts5TableAlias,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, sql_and
        from l5100_fts.fts_components import SqlFTSComponents, SqlFTSJoinStyle
        from l5100_fts.fts_naming import fts_versioned_table_name
        from l5100_fts.fts_query import FTSSearchMode as _FTSSearchMode

        mode = fts_mode if fts_mode is not None else _FTSSearchMode.NATURAL
        sqlite_query = sqlite_literal_fts_query
        if sqlite_query is None and sqlite_literal_query_text is not None:
            sqlite_query = _build_sqlite_fts_query_string(
                sqlite_literal_query_text,
                list(field_names),
                mode,
            )
        if sqlite_query is None:
            msg = "SQLite versioned FTS payload requires a literal query string at compile time for native FTS lowering"
            raise NotImplementedError(msg)
        table_type = resolved_content_table_type
        content_revision_column = source_revision_column
        base_table_name = get_versioned_table_names(model_cls).base
        fts_table = SqlTableName(str(fts_versioned_table_name(base_table_name, table_type)))
        fts_revision_column = "sys_valid_from_revision_id" if table_type == "sparse" else "sys_revision_id"
        return SqlFTSComponents(
            join_clause=SqlFts5TableAlias(fts_table),
            where_clause=sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("f")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=table_alias),
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(fts_revision_column), qualifier=SqlAliasName("f")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(content_revision_column), qualifier=table_alias),
                ),
                SqlFts5MatchCondition(fts_table, FtsQueryText(sqlite_query)),
            ),
            rank_expression=SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr(
                SqlFts5Bm25Call(fts_table),
                backend="sqlite",
            ),
            join_style=SqlFTSJoinStyle.JOIN_ON_CONDITION,
            rank_alias="__fts_rank",
        )
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.MATCH_AGAINST:
        dynamic_json_fts = False
        try:
            from l9600_graphs.dynamic_types import DynamicEdgeBase, DynamicNodeBase

            dynamic_json_fts = issubclass(model_cls, DynamicNodeBase | DynamicEdgeBase)
        except ImportError:
            dynamic_json_fts = False
        if dynamic_json_fts:
            from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlFrom, SqlSelectList, SqlTableAlias, SqlWhereClause
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlExists, SqlIn, sql_and
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
            from impl.common.l5150_fts_polyfill.tokenizers.porter import PorterStemTokenizer
            from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
            from l5100_fts.fts_components import SqlFTSComponents, SqlFTSJoinStyle
            from l5100_fts.lazy_fts_support import polyfill_table_names_lazy

            literal_query_text = sqlite_literal_query_text
            if literal_query_text is None:
                msg = "MariaDB dynamic versioned FTS requires literal query text for polyfill lookup"
                raise NotImplementedError(msg)
            tokens = PorterStemTokenizer().tokenize(literal_query_text)
            index_table_name, _metadata_table_name, _idf_table_name = polyfill_table_names_lazy(
                get_table_name(model_cls),
            )
            index_alias = SqlAliasName("polyfill_fts")
            conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("content_hash"), qualifier=index_alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_fts_content_hash"), qualifier=SqlAliasName(table_alias)),
                ),
                SqlIn(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("token"), qualifier=index_alias),
                    [SqlParam(token) for token in tokens],
                ),
            ]
            if field_names:
                conditions.append(
                    SqlIn(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("field_name"), qualifier=index_alias),
                        [SqlParam(field_name) for field_name in field_names],
                    ),
                )
            match_exists = SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
                    from_clause=SqlFrom(
                        SqlTableAlias(
                            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(index_table_name)),
                            index_alias,
                        ),
                    ),
                    where=SqlWhereClause(sql_and(*conditions)),
                    limit=1,
                ),
            )
            return SqlFTSComponents(
                join_clause=None,
                where_clause=match_exists,
                rank_expression=SqlParam(1.0),
                join_style=SqlFTSJoinStyle.WHERE_ONLY,
                rank_alias="__fts_rank",
            )
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts.fts_expressions import SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr
        from impl.common.l5100_fts.mariadb_native import (
            build_mariadb_native_fts_expressions,
            resolve_mariadb_native_fts_fields,
        )
        from l5100_fts.fts_components import SqlFTSComponents, SqlFTSJoinStyle
        from l5100_fts.fts_query import FTSSearchMode as _FTSSearchMode

        literal_query_text = sqlite_literal_query_text
        if literal_query_text is None:
            msg = "MariaDB versioned FTS payload requires a literal query string at compile time for MATCH AGAINST lowering"
            raise NotImplementedError(msg)
        mode = fts_mode if fts_mode is not None else _FTSSearchMode.NATURAL
        match_fields = tuple(field_names) or (() if config is None else tuple(config.fields))
        configured_fields = match_fields if config is None else tuple(config.fields)
        resolved_fields = resolve_mariadb_native_fts_fields(
            model_cls,
            tuple(DynamicFieldName(field_name) for field_name in match_fields),
            tuple(DynamicFieldName(field_name) for field_name in configured_fields),
        )
        expressions = build_mariadb_native_fts_expressions(
            query=literal_query_text,
            fields=resolved_fields.requested,
            configured_fields=resolved_fields.configured,
            mode=mode,
            qualifier=SqlAliasName(table_alias),
        )
        return SqlFTSComponents(
            join_clause=None,
            where_clause=expressions.match_condition,
            rank_expression=SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr(expressions.rank_expression, backend="mariadb"),
            join_style=SqlFTSJoinStyle.WHERE_ONLY,
            rank_alias="__fts_rank",
        )
    msg = (
        "VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep symbolic FTS components are currently implemented "
        "for PostgreSQL and SQLite only. Other backends need backend-specific lowering that "
        "still targets SqlVersionedFtsPayloadSelect."
    )
    raise NotImplementedError(msg)


def _normalize_requested_revision_ids(
    *,
    requested_revision_ids: Sequence[object],
    revision_ref_ids: Sequence[ServerPlanRefId],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> tuple[object, ...]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._sql_visible_refs import resolve_sql_visible_ref
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlFrom, SqlSelectList
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlSubquery
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnName, SqlColumnRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

    requested_revision_values: list[object] = []
    for revision_ref_id in revision_ref_ids:
        binding = resolve_sql_visible_ref(
            ctx,
            revision_ref_id,
            default_field="revision_id",
        )
        if binding is not None:
            field_name = binding.field_name
            binding_columns = binding.binding.columns
            if binding_columns is not None and field_name not in binding_columns:
                field_name = next(
                    (column for column in ("revision_id", "tip_revision_id", "tip_revision_sys_id") if column in binding_columns),
                    field_name,
                )
            requested_revision_values.append(
                SqlSubquery(
                    SqlSelect(
                        select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(field_name))]),
                        from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(binding.cte_name))),
                        limit=1,
                    ),
                ),
            )
            continue
        raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
            site_name="_normalize_requested_revision_ids",
            trigger=f"requested revision ref {revision_ref_id!r} has no CTE binding during compile()",
            blocked_path="planner-time requested revision materialization for versioned FTS payload compilation",
            result_contract="requested revision ids must arrive as literal sequences or SQL-visible revision refs",
            implementation_requirements=(
                "Publish requested revision ids through explicit revision CTE refs before compile().",
                "Keep literal revision-id sequences on the constructor-owned literal path.",
                "Do not resolve requested revision refs from ctx.materialized_pipeline during compile().",
            ),
        )

    if requested_revision_values:
        return tuple(requested_revision_values)
    return tuple(unwrap_literal_sql_value(value) for value in requested_revision_ids)


def _resolve_permission_user_source(
    *,
    user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> ResolvedPermissionUserId:
    from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference

    if user_id_ref_id is None:
        return None
    cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(user_id_ref_id))
    if isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference):
        if "user_id" not in cte_ref.columns:
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name="_resolve_permission_user_source",
                trigger=f"permission user ref {user_id_ref_id!r} does not publish a user_id column",
                blocked_path="permission-aware FTS SQL cannot infer user identity from a weak CTE binding",
                result_contract="permission-aware FTS compilation must consume a declared user_id column.",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish SessionUserIdStep output with columns=('user_id',) and complete type hints.",
                    "Do not pass name-only or wrong-shaped CTE bindings for FTS permission checks.",
                ),
            )
        return cte_ref
    raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
        site_name="_resolve_permission_user_source",
        trigger=f"permission user ref {user_id_ref_id!r} has no CTE binding during compile()",
        blocked_path="planner-time permission user materialization for FTS compilation",
        result_contract="permission-aware FTS compilation must consume schema or validated authority context, or a SQL-visible user id ref",
        implementation_requirements=(
            "Publish permission user ids through explicit CTE-backed refs before compile().",
            "Keep schema bootstrap and validated resource authority on explicit paths.",
            "Do not resolve permission user refs from ctx.materialized_pipeline during compile().",
        ),
    )
    raise AssertionError("unreachable")


def _resolve_materialized_fts_query_string(query_ref: ScalarServerRef[FtsQueryText]) -> str | None:
    """Return a concrete FTS5 query string when available without ServerRef probing."""
    del query_ref
    return None


class VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[object]):
    """Compile versioned sparse-table FTS into a canonical ``SearchPayload``."""

    def __init__(
        self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _VersionedFtsPayloadConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        config_payload = config
        self._query_ref = config_payload.query_source
        self._literal_query_text = config_payload.literal_query_text
        self._literal_sqlite_fts_query = config_payload.literal_sqlite_fts_query
        self._field_names = config_payload.field_names
        self._mode = config_payload.mode
        self._query_inputs = config_payload.query_inputs
        self._limit = config_payload.limit
        self._offset = config_payload.offset
        self._requested_revision_ids = _deduplicate_literal_revision_requests(config_payload.requested_revision_ids)
        self._revision_ref_ids = config_payload.revision_ref_ids
        self._raw_mode = config_payload.raw_mode
        self._defer_large_columns = config_payload.defer_large_columns
        self._session_id = config_payload.session_id
        self._user_id_ref_id = config_payload.user_id_ref_id
        self._branch_id = config_payload.branch_id
        self._branch_ref_id = config_payload.branch_ref_id
        self._policy_check_ref_id = config_payload.policy_check_ref_id
        self._branch_table = config_payload.branch_table
        self._branch_columns = _VersionedFtsBranchColumns(
            branch_id=config_payload.branch_id_column,
            tip_revision=config_payload.branch_tip_revision_column,
            deleted=config_payload.branch_deleted_column,
            tip_materialization=config_payload.branch_tip_materialization_column,
        )
        self._policy_materializations = config_payload.policy_materializations
        self._permission_context_ref = config_payload.permission_context_ref
        self._permission_context_type = config_payload.permission_context_type
        self._score_projection = config_payload.score_projection

    @property
    def level(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "fts", "search", "versioned", "payload"})

    def tables_read(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name

        table_name = get_table_name(self._model_cls)
        return frozenset(
            {
                table_name,
                derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(table_name))).sparse,
                derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(table_name))).tip,
                f"sys_{table_name}_sparse_fts",
                f"sys_{table_name}_sparse_fts_vector",
                *(() if self._branch_table is None else (self._branch_table,)),
            },
        )

    def tables_written(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = set(self._query_ref.dependencies())
        deps.update(self._revision_ref_ids)
        if self._user_id_ref_id is not None:
            deps.add(self._user_id_ref_id)
        if self._branch_ref_id is not None:
            deps.add(self._branch_ref_id)
        if self._policy_check_ref_id is not None:
            deps.add(self._policy_check_ref_id)
        if self._permission_context_ref is not None:
            deps.add(self._permission_context_ref)
        return frozenset(deps)

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def requires_standalone_physical_request(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def _sparse_payload_columns(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

        projection = build_read_metadata_plan(self._model_cls).projection_for(
            READ_FLAVOR_SPARSE_HISTORICAL,
        )
        selected_output_columns = self._selected_payload_columns()
        columns = [column for column in (selected_output_columns or projection.cte_output_columns) if column != "branch_id"]
        for column in self._query_shape_payload_columns():
            if column not in columns:
                columns.append(column)
        explicitly_selected_large_columns: set[str] = set()
        if selected_output_columns is not None:
            selected_column_set = set(selected_output_columns)
            for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls):
                large_column = str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column)))
                pointer_column = str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column))))
                if large_column in selected_column_set:
                    explicitly_selected_large_columns.add(large_column)
                    if pointer_column not in columns:
                        columns.append(pointer_column)
        if self._defer_large_columns:
            excluded_columns: set[str] = set()
            for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls):
                large_column = str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column)))
                if large_column in explicitly_selected_large_columns:
                    continue
                excluded_columns.add(str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)))))
                excluded_columns.add(str(large_column_pointer_name(config.column)))
            columns = [column for column in columns if column not in excluded_columns]
        declared_projection_columns = set().union(*projection.declared_sql_column_type_hints().as_tuple())
        for sparse_column in (
            "branch_ord",
            "sys_valid_from_seq",
            "sys_valid_to_seq",
        ):
            if sparse_column in declared_projection_columns and sparse_column not in columns:
                columns.append(sparse_column)
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))

    def _deferred_large_payload_columns(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        if not self._defer_large_columns:
            return ()
        from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

        selected_columns = self._selected_payload_columns()
        if selected_columns is not None:
            selected_column_set = set(selected_columns)
            return tuple(
                str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column)))
                for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls)
                if str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column))) not in selected_column_set
            )
        return tuple(
            str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column)))
            for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls)
        )

    def _explicitly_selects_large_payload_column(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> bool:
        selected_columns = self._selected_payload_columns()
        if selected_columns is None:
            return False
        from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

        selected_column_set = set(selected_columns)
        return any(
            str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(config.column))) in selected_column_set
            for config in get_large_column_configs(self._model_cls)
        )

    def _field_payload_column(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep, field_ref: object) -> str | None:
        from l1000_schema.column_utils import get_db_column_name

        field_name = field_ref if isinstance(field_ref, str) else getattr(field_ref, "name", None)
        if field_name is None:
            field_name = getattr(field_ref, "field_name", None)
        if field_name is None:
            field_name = getattr(field_ref, "_name", None)
        if field_name == "id":
            field_name = "sys_id"
        if not isinstance(field_name, str) or field_name not in self._model_cls.model_fields:
            return None
        return str(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))

    def _selected_payload_columns(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        if self._query_inputs is None or self._query_inputs.select_columns is None:
            return None
        columns: list[str] = []
        for selected in self._query_inputs.select_columns:
            column = self._field_payload_column(selected)
            if column is not None:
                columns.append(column)
        if not columns:
            return ()
        if "sys_id" not in columns:
            columns.insert(0, "sys_id")
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))

    def _query_shape_payload_columns(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        if self._query_inputs is None:
            return ()
        columns: list[str] = []
        for order_entry in self._query_inputs.order_by:
            if isinstance(order_entry, tuple) and order_entry:
                column = self._field_payload_column(order_entry[0])
                if column is not None:
                    columns.append(column)
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))

    def _order_by_payload_columns(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
        if self._query_inputs is None:
            return ()
        order_columns: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        for order_entry in self._query_inputs.order_by:
            if not isinstance(order_entry, tuple) or len(order_entry) != 2:
                continue
            column = self._field_payload_column(order_entry[0])
            if column is None:
                continue
            direction = str(order_entry[1]).upper()
            if direction not in {"ASC", "DESC"}:
                direction = "ASC"
            order_columns.append((column, direction))
        return tuple(order_columns)

    def _published_payload_columns(
        self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep,
        *,
        include_inline_manifest: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        columns = list(self._sparse_payload_columns())
        columns.extend(
            (
                "__requested_revision_id",
                "__requested_revision_ordinal",
                "__fts_revision_rn",
                "__fts_object_rn",
                "__fts_rank",
            ),
        )
        if include_inline_manifest and not self._defer_large_columns:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
                inline_large_column_alias_columns,
            )

            columns.extend(inline_large_column_alias_columns(self._model_cls))
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))

    def cte_publication_contract(self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        if self._score_projection:
            columns = ("object_id", "branch_id", "rank")
            return CtePublicationContract(
                publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
                columns=columns,
                column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                    uuid_columns=frozenset({"object_id", "branch_id"}),
                    double_columns=frozenset({"rank"}),
                ),
                relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(_VersionedFtsScoreProjectionRow),
                relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
                source_tables=self.tables_read(),
            )
        return self._publication_contract(include_inline_manifest=True)

    def _publication_contract(
        self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep,
        *,
        include_inline_manifest: bool,
    ) -> CtePublicationContract:
        def _legacy_cte_output_columns() -> tuple[str, ...]:
            """Publish model columns plus the FTS rank metadata column.

            The FTS payload grammar projects ``__fts_rank`` alongside the model's
            data columns. Declaring it here ensures the JSON-aggregation batching
            strategy preserves the rank when fusing this step with siblings; without
            this declaration, the strategy would trim projections to model fields
            only and silently drop the relevance score.
            """
            return self._published_payload_columns(
                include_inline_manifest=include_inline_manifest,
            )

        columns = _legacy_cte_output_columns()

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...]) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            projection = build_read_metadata_plan(self._model_cls).projection_for(
                READ_FLAVOR_SPARSE_HISTORICAL,
            )

            model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, columns)
            if model_hints is None:
                msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._model_cls.__name__} FTS rows"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            declared_hints = [
                model_hints,
                projection.declared_sql_column_type_hints(),
                SqlColumnTypeHints(
                    bigint_columns=frozenset({"sys_fts_hash_high", "sys_fts_hash_short"}),
                    double_columns=frozenset({"__fts_rank"}),
                    integer_columns=frozenset(
                        {
                            "__requested_revision_ordinal",
                            "__fts_revision_rn",
                            "__fts_object_rn",
                        },
                    ),
                    text_columns=frozenset({"sys_fts_content_hash"}),
                    uuid_columns=frozenset({"__requested_revision_id"}),
                ),
            ]
            if include_inline_manifest:
                from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
                    inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints,
                )

                declared_hints.append(
                    inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls),
                )
            covered: set[str] = set()
            for hint in declared_hints:
                covered |= set().union(*hint.as_tuple())
            framework_hints = framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints().filtered(
                set(columns) - covered,
            )
            if framework_hints.has_any():
                declared_hints.append(framework_hints)
            return combine_sql_column_type_hints(columns, *declared_hints)

        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints,
        )
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.projection_over_model(
                source_model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
                projection_lineage=tuple((str(column), str(column)) for column in columns),
            ),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(
        self: VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[object]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_query_steps import (
            _compile_branch_inputs,
            _effective_branch_id,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._query_helper_compile import (
            _collect_auxiliary_ctes_from_consumed,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_cte_helpers import (
            SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_noop import SqlNoOpStatement
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_cte import (
            SqlVersionedFtsPayloadSelect,
            VersionedFtsBranchColumns,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.search_cursor_sql import wrap_search_cursor_page
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SQL_EXPR_NULL, SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlColumnRef
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import sql_and
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledStep as CompiledStepFactory
        from l3250_migrations.versioned_table_helpers import VersionedTableType, get_auxiliary_table_name

        sparse_table_name = (
            get_auxiliary_table_name(self._model_cls, VersionedTableType.SPARSE)
            if _SPARSE_REVISION_MODEL_FIELD in self._model_cls.model_fields
            else get_table_name(self._model_cls)
        )

        from l7000_versioned_schema.read_source_policy import (
            is_current_branch_read,
            persisted_tip_materialization,
        )
        from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import BranchTipMaterialization

        use_tip_content = (
            is_current_branch_read(ctx)
            and not self._requested_revision_ids
            and persisted_tip_materialization(ctx) is not BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS
        )
        content_source: SqlRenderable | None = None
        if use_tip_content:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlSubquery, SqlFuncCall
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SQL_EXPR_NULL, SqlStar, SqlParam
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectAlias
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

            sparse_table_name = get_auxiliary_table_name(self._model_cls, VersionedTableType.TIP)
            content_source = SqlSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    [
                        SqlStar(),
                        SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(False), SqlAliasName("sys_deleted")),
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_revision_id")),
                            SqlAliasName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"),
                        ),
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlFuncCall(
                                "NULLIF",
                                [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_revision_id"))] * 2,
                            ),
                            SqlAliasName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"),
                        ),
                        *(SqlSelectAlias(SQL_EXPR_NULL, SqlAliasName(column)) for column in ("sys_valid_from_seq", "sys_valid_to_seq")),
                    ],
                    from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(sparse_table_name)),
                ),
            )

        requested_revision_ids = _normalize_requested_revision_ids(
            requested_revision_ids=self._requested_revision_ids,
            revision_ref_ids=self._revision_ref_ids,
            ctx=ctx,
        )
        compile_branch_id, branch_cte_ref = (
            (self._branch_id, None)
            if self._branch_id is not None
            else _compile_branch_inputs(
                ctx,
                str(self._branch_ref_id) if self._branch_ref_id is not None else None,
            )
        )
        branch_id = _effective_branch_id(
            ctx,
            compile_branch_id,
            branch_cte_ref,
            str(self._branch_ref_id) if self._branch_ref_id is not None else None,
        )
        assert branch_id is not None

        sqlite_literal_query_text = self._literal_query_text
        sqlite_literal_fts_query = self._literal_sqlite_fts_query
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.TABLE_MATCH:
            if sqlite_literal_query_text is None:
                sqlite_literal_query_text = _resolve_materialized_fts_query_string(self._query_ref)
            if sqlite_literal_query_text is None and sqlite_literal_fts_query is None:
                raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                    site_name="VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep.compile",
                    trigger=(
                        "SQLite versioned FTS payload compilation requires a "
                        "precomputed literal FTS5 query string but received only a "
                        "symbolic query ref"
                    ),
                    blocked_path="compile-time SQLite versioned FTS5 query shaping from symbolic FTS input",
                    result_contract=(
                        "SQLite versioned FTS payload compilation must receive an explicit FTS5 query string on the literal path"
                    ),
                    implementation_requirements=(
                        "Shape SQLite FTS5 query strings in _lazy() for literal Python query inputs.",
                        "Keep symbolic query refs on backends that support SQL-visible query expressions.",
                        "Do not recover SQLite FTS5 query strings from materialized runtime state during compile().",
                    ),
                )
            candidate_sqlite_query = sqlite_literal_fts_query or sqlite_literal_query_text
            assert candidate_sqlite_query is not None
            if not candidate_sqlite_query.strip():
                return CompiledStepFactory(
                    grammar=SqlNoOpStatement(),
                    needs_returning=True,
                    closed_post_op=literal_post_op([]),
                )

        if self._literal_query_text is not None:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts.fts_expressions import FtsQueryText
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam

            query_expr = _build_postgres_tsquery_expr(
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                query_expr=SqlParam(FtsQueryText(self._literal_query_text)),
                mode=self._mode,
            )
        else:
            query_expr = _build_versioned_fts_query_expr(
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                query_ref=self._query_ref,
                mode=self._mode,
                ctx=ctx,
            )
        from l5100_fts.fts_query import FTSSearchMode

        effective_fts_mode = self._mode
        effective_literal_query_text = sqlite_literal_query_text
        if (
            self._score_projection
            and ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.MATCH_AGAINST
            and self._mode is FTSSearchMode.NATURAL
            and sqlite_literal_query_text is not None
        ):
            effective_fts_mode = FTSSearchMode.BOOLEAN
            effective_literal_query_text = " ".join(re.findall(r"\w+", sqlite_literal_query_text))
        fts_components = _build_versioned_fts_components(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            field_names=self._field_names,
            sparse_table_name=sparse_table_name,
            content_table_type="tip" if use_tip_content else "sparse",
            query_expr=query_expr,
            table_alias="s",
            ctx=ctx,
            fts_mode=effective_fts_mode,
            sqlite_literal_query_text=effective_literal_query_text,
            sqlite_literal_fts_query=sqlite_literal_fts_query,
        )
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport in {FtsSqlTransport.TABLE_MATCH, FtsSqlTransport.MATCH_AGAINST}:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.hybrid_document_rank import hybrid_document_rank
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts.fts_expressions import SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr

            assert self._literal_query_text is not None, "Document-local versioned FTS ranking requires literal query text"
            document_rank = hybrid_document_rank(
                self._model_cls,
                ctx,
                query=self._literal_query_text,
                fields=tuple(self._field_names),
                mode=self._mode or FTSSearchMode.NATURAL,
                table_name=sparse_table_name,
                table_alias="s",
                content_table_type="tip" if use_tip_content else "sparse",
            )
            fts_components = replace(
                fts_components,
                rank_expression=SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr(
                    document_rank,
                    backend="polyfill" if ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.TABLE_MATCH else "mariadb",
                ),
            )
        extra_where = _build_versioned_fts_extra_where(
            query_inputs=self._query_inputs,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            planning_catalog=ctx.planning_catalog,
            table_alias="s",
        )
        session_vars: SessionVariableSqlBindings | None = None
        if self._permission_context_ref is not None and self._permission_context_type is not None:
            from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
                _sql_session_context_bindings,
            )

            session_vars = _sql_session_context_bindings(
                self._permission_context_type,
                self._permission_context_ref,
            )
        permission_where = _build_versioned_fts_permission_where(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            session_id=self._session_id,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
            table_alias="s",
            ctx=replace(ctx, branch_tip_materialized=True) if use_tip_content else ctx,
            requested_revision_ids=() if use_tip_content else requested_revision_ids,
            session_vars=session_vars,
        )
        if extra_where is None:
            combined_where = permission_where
        elif permission_where is None:
            combined_where = extra_where
        else:
            combined_where = sql_and(extra_where, permission_where)
        cursor_query_spec = self._query_inputs.to_query_spec(model_cls=self._model_cls) if self._query_inputs is not None else None
        has_search_cursor = cursor_query_spec is not None and (
            getattr(cursor_query_spec, "cursor_after", None) is not None or getattr(cursor_query_spec, "cursor_before", None) is not None
        )
        if self._score_projection and ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.MATCH_AGAINST:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_versioned import _as_sql_rhs
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_dml_simple import SqlCteFieldRef
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
                SqlFrom,
                SqlOrderByClause,
                SqlOrderByItem,
                SqlSelectAlias,
                SqlSelectList,
                SqlTableAlias,
                SqlWhereClause,
            )
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp, OrderDirection
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlSubquery
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlIsNull, sql_and, sql_or
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

            sparse_alias = SqlAliasName("s")
            validity_conditions: list[SqlRenderable] = [
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    _as_sql_rhs(branch_id),
                ),
            ]
            if not use_tip_content:
                revision_expr = _as_sql_rhs(requested_revision_ids[0])
                validity_conditions.extend(
                    [
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
                            BinaryOp.LE,
                            revision_expr,
                        ),
                        sql_or(
                            SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), qualifier=sparse_alias)),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
                                BinaryOp.GT,
                                revision_expr,
                            ),
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlParam(False),
                        ),
                    ]
                )
            if isinstance(fts_components.rank_expression, SqlParam):
                validity_conditions.append(fts_components.where_clause)
            if combined_where is not None:
                validity_conditions.append(combined_where)
            validity_where = sql_and(*validity_conditions)
            payload_grammar: SqlRenderable = SqlSelect(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=sparse_alias),
                        SqlAliasName("object_id"),
                    ),
                    SqlSelectAlias(_as_sql_rhs(branch_id), SqlAliasName("branch_id")),
                    SqlSelectAlias(fts_components.rank_expression, SqlAliasName("rank")),
                ],
                from_=SqlTableAlias(
                    SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(sparse_table_name)),
                    sparse_alias,
                ),
                where=SqlWhereClause(validity_where),
                having=SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("rank")),
                    BinaryOp.GT,
                    SqlParam(0),
                ),
                order_by=SqlOrderByClause(
                    [SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("rank")), OrderDirection.DESC)],
                ),
                limit=None if has_search_cursor else self._limit,
                offset=None if has_search_cursor else self._offset if self._offset > 0 else None,
            )
        else:
            payload_grammar = SqlVersionedFtsPayloadSelect(
                sparse_table=SqlTableName(sparse_table_name),
                content_source=content_source,
                requested_revision_ids=requested_revision_ids,
                branch_id=branch_id,
                branch_table=self._branch_table,
                branch_columns=VersionedFtsBranchColumns(
                    branch_id=self._branch_columns.branch_id,
                    tip_revision=self._branch_columns.tip_revision,
                    deleted=self._branch_columns.deleted,
                    tip_materialization=self._branch_columns.tip_materialization,
                ),
                policy_materializations=self._policy_materializations,
                fts_where=fts_components.where_clause,
                fts_rank_expr=fts_components.rank_expression,
                fts_join=fts_components.join_clause,
                fts_join_style=fts_components.join_style.value,
                extra_where=combined_where,
                limit=None if has_search_cursor else self._limit,
                offset=None if has_search_cursor else self._offset if self._offset > 0 else None,
                payload_columns=self._sparse_payload_columns(),
                null_payload_columns=self._deferred_large_payload_columns(),
                order_by_columns=self._order_by_payload_columns(),
            )
        if requested_revision_ids and not self._score_projection and ctx.versioning_domain is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_fts_visible_payload import (
                visible_fts_payload,
                combine_visible_fts_payloads,
            )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_versioned import _as_sql_rhs

            from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_spec import QuerySpec

            visible_spec = (
                self._query_inputs.to_query_spec(model_cls=self._model_cls)
                if self._query_inputs is not None
                else QuerySpec(
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    table=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
                    select_columns=None,
                    distinct=False,
                    joins=[],
                    filters=[],
                    order_by=(),
                    limit=None,
                    offset=None,
                    group_by=[],
                    aggregations=[],
                    having=[],
                    window_functions=[],
                )
            )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioning_intent_steps import _collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes

            snapshot_dependencies = _collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, *self.dependencies())
            visible_fts_components = fts_components
            if ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.TEXT_SEARCH_VECTOR:
                from l1000_schema.dynamic_field_utils import is_dynamic_property_field

                visible_fts_components = _build_postgres_symbolic_versioned_fts_components(
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    field_names=self._field_names,
                    table_alias="s",
                    query_expr=query_expr,
                    content_table_type="tip" if use_tip_content else "sparse",
                    source_has_fts_vector=not any(
                        is_dynamic_property_field(
                            self._model_cls,
                            DynamicFieldName(field_name),
                        )
                        for field_name in self._field_names
                    ),
                )
            payloads: list[SqlRenderable] = []
            for ordinal, requested_revision in enumerate(requested_revision_ids):
                snapshot_permission = _build_versioned_fts_permission_where(
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    session_id=self._session_id,
                    user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
                    table_alias="s",
                    ctx=ctx,
                    requested_revision_ids=[requested_revision],
                    session_vars=session_vars,
                )
                snapshot_where = (
                    sql_and(extra_where, snapshot_permission)
                    if extra_where is not None and snapshot_permission is not None
                    else extra_where
                    if snapshot_permission is None
                    else snapshot_permission
                )
                payloads.append(
                    visible_fts_payload(
                        model=self._model_cls,
                        spec=visible_spec,
                        ctx=ctx,
                        revision=_as_sql_rhs(requested_revision),
                        branch=_as_sql_rhs(branch_id),
                        components=visible_fts_components,
                        extra_where=snapshot_where,
                        columns=self._sparse_payload_columns(),
                        null_columns=self._deferred_large_payload_columns(),
                        order_columns=self._order_by_payload_columns(),
                        limit=None if has_search_cursor or len(requested_revision_ids) > 1 else self._limit,
                        offset=None if has_search_cursor or len(requested_revision_ids) > 1 else self._offset,
                        ordinal=ordinal,
                        dependencies=snapshot_dependencies,
                    )
                )
            payload_grammar = (
                payloads[0]
                if len(payloads) == 1
                else combine_visible_fts_payloads(
                    payloads,
                    columns=self._sparse_payload_columns(),
                    order_columns=self._order_by_payload_columns(),
                    limit=None if has_search_cursor else self._limit,
                    offset=None if has_search_cursor else self._offset,
                )
            )
        auxiliary_ctes = _collect_auxiliary_ctes_from_consumed(
            [
                binding
                for binding in (
                    branch_cte_ref,
                    *(ctx.cte_refs.get(str(revision_ref_id)) for revision_ref_id in self._revision_ref_ids),
                    (
                        _resolve_permission_user_source(user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id, ctx=ctx)
                        if self._user_id_ref_id is not None
                        else None
                    ),
                )
                if isinstance(binding, CteReference)
            ],
        )
        if self._permission_context_ref is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import (
                _permission_context_ref_auxiliary_ctes,
            )

            auxiliary_ctes = [
                *(auxiliary_ctes or ()),
                *_permission_context_ref_auxiliary_ctes(
                    self._permission_context_ref,
                    ctx,
                ),
            ]
        if auxiliary_ctes is not None:
            if self._score_projection and ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.MATCH_AGAINST:
                from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlCte

                payload_grammar = SqlCte(list(auxiliary_ctes), payload_grammar)
            else:
                if isinstance(payload_grammar, SqlVersionedFtsPayloadSelect):
                    payload_grammar = payload_grammar.with_leading_ctes(auxiliary_ctes)
                else:
                    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlCte

                    payload_grammar = SqlCte(list(auxiliary_ctes), payload_grammar)
            auxiliary_ctes = None
        base_grammar: SqlRenderable = payload_grammar
        if cursor_query_spec is not None:
            base_grammar = wrap_search_cursor_page(
                base_grammar,
                cursor_query_spec,
                score_column="_fts_rank",
                source_alias="fts_payload_page",
                limit=self._limit,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
            )
        publication_contract = (
            self.cte_publication_contract() if self._score_projection else self._publication_contract(include_inline_manifest=False)
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(publication_contract)
        if self._score_projection:
            return CompiledStep(
                grammar=base_grammar,
                needs_returning=True,
                closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
                output_shape=output_shape,
                result_relation=result_relation,
                column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            )
        published_columns = output_shape.cte_output_columns if output_shape is not None else None
        assert published_columns is not None
        wrapper_cte_name = f"{self.ref_id}_payload_rows"
        overrides: dict[str, SqlRenderable] = {}
        if _CANONICAL_VERSIONED_REVISION_ALIAS in published_columns:
            overrides[_CANONICAL_VERSIONED_REVISION_ALIAS] = SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"),
                qualifier=SqlAliasName("src"),
            )
        if "sys_staged_commit_id" in published_columns:
            overrides["sys_staged_commit_id"] = SQL_EXPR_NULL
        grammar = SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides(
            source_cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(wrapper_cte_name),
            source_columns=tuple(SqlAliasName(column) for column in published_columns),
            overrides=overrides,
        )
        compiled = CompiledStepFactory(
            grammar=grammar,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            auxiliary_ctes=[(wrapper_cte_name, base_grammar)],
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        )
        if not self._defer_large_columns or self._raw_mode:
            compiled = wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns(
                compiled,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
            )
        return cast(CompiledStep[object], compiled)

def _require_session_scalar_ref(session_id: object | None) -> ScalarServerRef[SessionId]:
    if isinstance(session_id, ScalarServerRef):
        return cast(ScalarServerRef[SessionId], session_id)
    if isinstance(session_id, SessionId):
        return ServerRefs.scalar(session_id)
    if isinstance(session_id, str):
        return ServerRefs.scalar(SessionId(session_id))
    msg = "session user resolution requires a concrete session id"
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _requires_session_user_resolution(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    session_id: object | None,
) -> bool:
    from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import get_query_permission_plan

    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_cls)
    if permission_plan is None or not permission_plan.requires_user_id:
        return False
    if isinstance(session_id, ScalarServerRef):
        return permission_plan.filter_rows
    return permission_plan.filters_session(_normalize_literal_session_id(session_id))


def _build_versioned_fts_session_user_resolution(
    *,
    owner_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
) -> tuple[list[ServerPlanStep[Any]], ServerPlanRefId | None]:
    if not _requires_session_user_resolution(model_cls, ctx.session_id):
        return [], None
    user_id_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{owner_ref_id}_resolve_uid")
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import (
        SessionUserIdStep as ResolveSessionUserIdStep,
    )

    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.ONE

    _model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]
    _config: _VersionedFtsSearchConfig

    def __init__(self, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)

    @classmethod
    def build(
        cls,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],

    ) -> _BaseVersionedFtsSearchIntent:
        intent = cls(ref_id)
        intent._model_cls = model_cls
        intent._config = config
        return intent

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name

        return frozenset({get_table_name(self._model_cls)})

    def _reject_unsupported_staged_native_search(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> None:
        reject_unsupported_mariadb_staged_native_fts(ctx)

    def _build_payload_step(
        self,
        *,
        payload_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        requested_revision_ids: tuple[object, ...],
        user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
        branch_id: BranchId | None,
        branch_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
        revision_ref_ids: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...],
        policy_check_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
        branch_table: SqlTableName | None = None,
        branch_id_column: SqlColumnName = SqlColumnName("sys_id"),
        branch_tip_revision_column: SqlColumnName = SqlColumnName("tip_revision_sys_id"),
        branch_deleted_column: SqlColumnName = SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"),
        branch_tip_materialization_column: SqlColumnName = SqlColumnName("tip_materialization"),
        policy_materializations: tuple[_FtsPolicyMaterialization, ...] = (),
    ) -> VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep:
        return VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep(
            payload_ref,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            config=_VersionedFtsPayloadConfig(
                query_source=self._config.query_source,
                literal_query_text=self._config.literal_query_text,
                literal_sqlite_fts_query=self._config.literal_sqlite_fts_query,
                field_names=self._config.field_names,
                mode=self._config.mode,
                query_inputs=self._config.query_inputs,
                limit=self._config.limit,
                offset=self._config.offset,
                requested_revision_ids=requested_revision_ids,
                raw_mode=self._config.raw_mode,
                defer_large_columns=self._config.defer_large_columns,
                session_id=self._config.session_id,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                branch_id=branch_id.unwrap_to_str() if branch_id is not None else None,
                branch_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(branch_ref_id) if branch_ref_id is not None else None,
                revision_ref_ids=revision_ref_ids,
                policy_check_ref_id=policy_check_ref_id,
                branch_table=branch_table,
                branch_id_column=branch_id_column,
                branch_tip_revision_column=branch_tip_revision_column,
                branch_deleted_column=branch_deleted_column,
                branch_tip_materialization_column=branch_tip_materialization_column,
                policy_materializations=policy_materializations,
                permission_context_ref=self._config.permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=self._config.permission_context_type,
            ),
        )

    def _build_policy_gate(
        self,
        *,
        ctx: LoweringContext,
        workload: IndexWorkload,
        branch_id: BranchId | None,
        branch_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    ) -> tuple[
        list[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
        ServerPlanRefId | None,
        tuple[_FtsPolicyMaterialization, ...],
    ]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.index_policy_context import (
            build_branch_index_context_steps,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.index_policy_assert import (
            BranchIndexPolicyAssertStep,
        )
        from l5100_fts.fts_config import (
            fts_explicit_revision_workload,
            get_fts_config,
            get_fts_index_policy_adapter,
            resolve_fts_index_policy,
        )
        from l1000_schema.index_policy import IndexMaterializationMode

        fts_config = get_fts_config(self._model_cls)
        if fts_config is None:
            return [], None, ()
        resolved_workload = fts_explicit_revision_workload(fts_config) if workload is IndexWorkload.EXPLICIT_REVISION_READ else workload
        policy_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.index_policy")
        branch_steps, branch_context = build_branch_index_context_steps(
            owner_ref_id=self.ref_id,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            ctx=ctx,
            branch_id=branch_id,
            branch_ref_id=branch_ref_id,
        )
        if resolved_workload is IndexWorkload.CURRENT_BRANCH_READ:
            adapter = get_fts_index_policy_adapter(fts_config)
            supported = adapter.generic_policy.materialization_modes(include_on_demand_history=False)
            materializations: list[_FtsPolicyMaterialization] = []
            if IndexMaterializationMode.DENSE_TIP in supported:
                materializations.append(_FtsPolicyMaterialization.MATERIALIZED)
            if IndexMaterializationMode.SPARSE_CURRENT in supported:
                materializations.append(_FtsPolicyMaterialization.TIPLESS)
            if not materializations:
                materializations.append(_FtsPolicyMaterialization.DENIED)
            return (branch_steps, None, tuple(materializations))
        decision = resolve_fts_index_policy(
            fts_config,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            workload=resolved_workload,
            branch_context=branch_context.to_public_request_context(),
            backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
        )
        return (
            [
                *branch_steps,
                BranchIndexPolicyAssertStep(
                    policy_ref_id,
                    decision=decision,
                    branch_context=branch_context,
                ),
            ],
            policy_ref_id,
            (),
        )


def _coerce_revision_source_ref(
    value: LazyResult[RevisionId] | ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
) -> ScalarServerRef[RevisionId]:
    if isinstance(value, ScalarServerRef):
        return value
    return ServerRefs.scalar(value)


class _VersionedFtsExplicitRevisionsResultsIntent(_BaseVersionedFtsSearchIntent):
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.MANY

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        self._reject_unsupported_staged_native_search(ctx)
        if not self._config.requested_revision_ids and not self._config.requested_revision_ref_ids:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import StaticValueAfterDepsStep

            return [StaticValueAfterDepsStep(self.ref_id, [], [])]

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.resolve_branch_steps import ResolveBranchForRevisionStep

        first_requested_revision_source = self._config.first_requested_revision_source
        assert first_requested_revision_source is not None
        steps, user_id_ref_id = _build_versioned_fts_session_user_resolution(
            owner_ref_id=self.ref_id,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            ctx=ctx,
        )
        branch_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
        if ctx.branch_id is None:
            branch_table = ctx.branch_table
            if branch_table is None:
                from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name

                domain = getattr(self._model_cls, "__versioning_domain__", None)
                branch_model = getattr(domain, "branch_model", None)
                if branch_model is not None:
                    branch_table = get_table_name(branch_model)
            if branch_table is None:
                msg = "VersionedFtsSearchIntent requires branch metadata to resolve requested revisions"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            branch_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.resolve_branch")
            steps.append(
                ResolveBranchForRevisionStep(
                    branch_ref_id,
                    first_requested_revision_source,
                    SqlTableName(branch_table),
                    branch_id_column=ctx.branch_id_column,
                    tip_revision_column=ctx.branch_tip_revision_column,
                    deleted_column=ctx.branch_deleted_column,
                    current_branch_source=(
                        ctx.lazy_branch if ctx.lazy_branch is not None else BranchId(ctx.branch_id) if ctx.branch_id is not None else None
                    ),
                ),
            )
        payload_ref = ServerPlanRefId(_versioned_fts_payload_ref_id(self.ref_id))
        policy_steps, policy_check_ref_id, policy_materializations = self._build_policy_gate(
            ctx=ctx,
            workload=IndexWorkload.EXPLICIT_REVISION_READ,
            branch_id=BranchId(ctx.branch_id) if ctx.branch_id is not None else None,
            branch_ref_id=branch_ref_id,
        )
        steps.extend(policy_steps)
        steps.append(
            self._build_payload_step(
                payload_ref=payload_ref,
                requested_revision_ids=self._config.requested_revision_ids,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                branch_id=BranchId(ctx.branch_id) if ctx.branch_id is not None else None,
                branch_ref_id=branch_ref_id,
                revision_ref_ids=self._config.requested_revision_ref_ids,
                policy_check_ref_id=policy_check_ref_id,
                policy_materializations=policy_materializations,
            ),
        )
        steps.extend(
            _build_search_payload_results_steps(
                ref_id=self.ref_id,
                payload_ref=payload_ref,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
            ),
        )
        return steps

class VersionedFtsSearchIntent(IntentStep[object]):
    """Factory that selects a concrete versioned FTS intent family."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "fts", "search", "versioned", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.ONE
    intent_read_only = True

    @classmethod
    def build(
        cls,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _VersionedFtsSearchConfig,
    ) -> IntentStep[object]:
        if not config.explicit_revision_selection:
            concrete_cls: type[_BaseVersionedFtsSearchIntent]
            if config.projection == "with_meta":
                concrete_cls = _VersionedFtsCurrentBranchWithMetaIntent
            else:
                concrete_cls = _VersionedFtsCurrentBranchResultsIntent
        elif config.projection == "with_meta":
            concrete_cls = _VersionedFtsExplicitRevisionsWithMetaIntent
        else:
            concrete_cls = _VersionedFtsExplicitRevisionsResultsIntent
        return concrete_cls.build(ref_id, model_cls=model_cls, config=config)

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        del ctx
        msg = "VersionedFtsSearchIntent factory should never be lowered directly"
        raise AssertionError(msg)
