def _build_postgres_native_fts_grammar(
    *,
    query_expr: SqlRenderable,
    field_names: list[str],
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    limit: int | None,
    offset: int,
    extra_where: SqlRenderable | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    """Build a SqlFtsSearchQuery for PostgreSQL native FTS (non-versioned)."""
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts._expressions_fts import (
        SqlToTsVectorExpr,
        SqlTsRankExpr,
        SqlTsVectorMatchExpr,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts.fts_expressions import (
        SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts.fts_types import TsVectorConfig
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts.stmt_fts import SqlFtsSearchQuery
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import sql_and
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name
    from l5100_fts.fts_naming import fts_column_name

    tsquery_expr = query_expr

    tsvector_expr: SqlRenderable
    if field_names:
        field_exprs = [
            f'"{_native_table_alias()}"."{get_db_column_name(model_type, DynamicFieldName(field_name))}"' for field_name in field_names
        ]
        tsvector_expr = SqlToTsVectorExpr(TsVectorConfig.ENGLISH, field_exprs)
    else:
        tsvector_expr = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(fts_column_name(table_name)))
    ts_rank_expr = SqlTsRankExpr(tsvector_expr, tsquery_expr)
    normalized_rank_expr = SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr(ts_rank_expr, backend="postgresql")
    match_expr = SqlTsVectorMatchExpr(tsvector_expr, tsquery_expr)
    where_expr = sql_and(match_expr, extra_where) if extra_where is not None else match_expr
    return SqlFtsSearchQuery(
        table=SqlTableName(table_name),
        ts_rank_expr=normalized_rank_expr,
        match_expr=where_expr,
        table_alias=SqlAliasName(_native_table_alias()),
        limit=limit,
        offset=offset,
    )


def _build_mariadb_native_fts_grammar(
    *,
    query_text: str,
    field_names: list[str],
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    mode: FTSSearchMode,
    limit: int | None,
    offset: int,
    extra_where: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    rank_override: SqlRenderable | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Build a native MariaDB MATCH...AGAINST search query."""
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.fts.fts_expressions import SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
        SqlOrderByClause,
        SqlOrderByItem,
        SqlSelectAlias,
        SqlSelectList,
        SqlTableAlias,
        SqlWhereClause,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlStar
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import sql_and
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
    from impl.common.l5100_fts.mariadb_native import (
        build_mariadb_native_fts_expressions,
        resolve_mariadb_native_fts_fields,
    )
    from l5100_fts.fts_config import get_fts_config
    from l5100_fts.fts_query import FTSSearchMode

    fts_config = get_fts_config(model_type)
    match_fields = field_names or ([] if fts_config is None else list(fts_config.fields))
    configured_fields = match_fields if fts_config is None else fts_config.fields
    resolved_fields = resolve_mariadb_native_fts_fields(
        model_type,
        tuple(DynamicFieldName(field_name) for field_name in match_fields),
        tuple(DynamicFieldName(field_name) for field_name in configured_fields),
    )
    expressions = build_mariadb_native_fts_expressions(
        query=query_text,
        fields=resolved_fields.requested,
        configured_fields=resolved_fields.configured,
        mode=mode,
        qualifier=SqlAliasName(_native_table_alias()),
    )
    rank_alias = SqlAliasName("_fts_rank")
    rank_expr = SqlFtsRankNormalizationExpr(
        rank_override if rank_override is not None else expressions.rank_expression,
        backend="mariadb",
    )
    match_condition = expressions.match_condition
    where_expr = sql_and(match_condition, extra_where) if extra_where is not None else match_condition
    return SqlSelect(
        SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlStar(),
                SqlSelectAlias(rank_expr, rank_alias),
            ],
        ),
        SqlTableAlias(
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(table_name)),
            SqlAliasName(_native_table_alias()),
        ),
        where=SqlWhereClause(where_expr),
        order_by=SqlOrderByClause([SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(rank_alias)), "DESC")]),
        limit=limit,
        offset=offset if offset > 0 else None,
    )


def _deduplicate_literal_revision_requests(revisions: tuple[object, ...]) -> tuple[object, ...]:
    """Keep each literal snapshot's last occurrence without resolving symbolic refs."""
    seen: set[str] = set()
    retained: list[object] = []
    for revision in reversed(revisions):
        if isinstance(revision, str | RevisionId):
            key = str(revision)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
        retained.append(revision)
    return tuple(reversed(retained))


def _build_versioned_fts_permission_where(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    session_id: SessionId | None,
    user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    table_alias: str,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    requested_revision_ids: Sequence[object] = (),
    session_vars: Mapping[str | tuple[type, str], SqlRenderable] | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    versioning_domain = cast(Any, ctx).versioning_domain
    if versioning_domain is None:
        versioning_domain = getattr(model_cls, "__versioning_domain__", None)
    if versioning_domain is None:
        versioning_domain = require_versioning_domain(
            ctx,
            site="_build_versioned_fts_permission_where",
        )
    session_id_obj = SessionId(session_id) if isinstance(session_id, str) else session_id
    from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import get_query_permission_plan

    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_cls)
    if session_id_obj is None:
        from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
            compile_permission_deny_all,
        )

        return compile_permission_deny_all() if permission_plan is not None and permission_plan.filter_rows else None
    if permission_plan is None or not permission_plan.filters_session(session_id_obj):
        return None
    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import VersionedObjectRow

    if not permission_plan.filter_rows and not issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
        return None
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import session_user_id_expr

    resolved_user_id = (
        session_user_id_expr(session_id_obj, ctx)
        if user_id_ref_id is None
        else _resolve_permission_user_source(user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id, ctx=ctx)
    )
    if len(requested_revision_ids) > 1:
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
        from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
            RowValidityPermissionAnchor,
        )

        version_anchor: PermissionVersionAnchor = RowValidityPermissionAnchor(
            domain=versioning_domain,
            revision_id_sql=SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"),
                qualifier=table_alias,
            ),
        )
    elif requested_revision_ids:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.protocols import SqlRenderable
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam
        from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
            PinnedRevisionPermissionAnchor,
        )

        requested_revision_id = requested_revision_ids[0]
        revision_id_sql = requested_revision_id if isinstance(requested_revision_id, SqlRenderable) else SqlParam(requested_revision_id)
        version_anchor = PinnedRevisionPermissionAnchor(
            domain=versioning_domain,
            revision_id_sql=revision_id_sql,
        )
    else:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
            versioned_permission_anchor,
        )

        version_anchor = versioned_permission_anchor(ctx, domain=versioning_domain)
    return _compile_permission_where_with_resolved_user(
        model_type=model_cls,
        session_id=session_id_obj,
        resolved_user_id=resolved_user_id,
        table_alias=table_alias,
        missing_user_message="versioned FTS permission compilation requires a published session-user ref",
        version_anchor=version_anchor,
        compilation_context=ctx,
        session_id_sql=session_id_expr(ctx.session_id, ctx),
        session_vars=session_vars,
    )

def _merged_cte_staged_commit_scope(ctx: CompilationContext) -> str | None:
    """Return staged-commit scope for merged CTEs that require current-write isolation."""
    staged_commit_id = getattr(ctx, "staged_commit_id", None)
    return None if staged_commit_id is None else str(staged_commit_id)


def _merged_cte_staged_visibility_filter(ctx: CompilationContext) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    """Return the staged-row visibility predicate for merged tip+staged reads."""
    existing = getattr(ctx, "staged_visibility_filter", None)
    if existing is not None:
        return cast("SqlRenderable", existing)
    if not ctx.is_write_transaction:
        return None

    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.staged_visibility_filter import (
        SqlStagedVisibilityFilter,
    )
    from l1400_types import StagedVisibility

    visibility = getattr(ctx, "staged_visibility", None) or StagedVisibility.TRANSACTION
    staged_commit_id = _merged_cte_staged_commit_scope(ctx)
    connection_id = getattr(ctx, "connection_id", None)
    branch_id: str | SqlRenderable | None = getattr(ctx, "branch_id", None)
    if branch_id is None and ctx.lazy_branch is not None:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import lower_scalar_server_ref

        branch_id = lower_scalar_server_ref(
            ctx.lazy_branch,
            ctx,
            default_field="branch_id",
        )
    staged_commits_table: str | None = None
    domain = getattr(ctx, "versioning_domain", None)
    if domain is not None:
        staged_commit_model = getattr(domain, "staged_commit_model", None)
        if staged_commit_model is not None:
            staged_commits_table = get_table_name(staged_commit_model)
    if visibility is StagedVisibility.CONNECTION and (connection_id is None or staged_commits_table is None):
        # A callback plan rebuilt after an eager terminal can retain only part
        # of its broader connection scope. Use the strictly narrower transaction
        # scope; with no staged-commit ID, it correctly exposes no staged rows.
        visibility = StagedVisibility.TRANSACTION
    return SqlStagedVisibilityFilter(
        visibility=visibility,
        staged_commit_id=staged_commit_id,
        connection_id=None if connection_id is None else str(connection_id),
        branch_id=branch_id,
        staged_commits_table=staged_commits_table,
    )


def _graph_predicate_context(
    revision_id: SqlRenderable | str | None,
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext | None = None,
    branch_id: SqlRenderable | str | None = None,
) -> AbstractContextManager[None]:
    """Bind branded revision and optional materialized-tip graph context."""
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.graph.graph_predicates import (
        graph_predicate_context_for_revision,
    )

    from l7000_versioned_schema.read_source_policy import is_current_branch_read, persisted_tip_materialization

    revision = revision_id if isinstance(revision_id, SqlRenderable) or revision_id is None else SysIdValue(revision_id)
    tip_branch_id: SqlRenderable | None = None
    if ctx is not None and not ctx.is_write_transaction and is_current_branch_read(ctx):
        from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import BranchTipMaterialization

        if persisted_tip_materialization(ctx) is not BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS:
            branch = branch_id if branch_id is not None else ctx.branch_id
            if branch is None:
                raise TypeError("Current graph predicates require a published branch identity")
            tip_branch_id = _as_sql_rhs(branch)
    return graph_predicate_context_for_revision(revision, tip_branch_id=tip_branch_id)


def _graph_predicate_revision_value(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    revision_id: SqlRenderable | str | None = None,
    branch_id: SqlRenderable | str | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable | str | None:
    prefer_independent_branch_tip = (
        ctx.backend_profile.traits.graph_revision_source_transport is GraphRevisionSourceTransport.INDEPENDENT_BRANCH_TIP
        and revision_id is not None
        and isinstance(revision_id, SqlRenderable)
        and ctx.explicit_revision_id is None
        and ctx.branch_id is not None
        and not isinstance(ctx.branch_id, SqlRenderable)
    )
    if revision_id is not None and not prefer_independent_branch_tip:
        return revision_id
    if prefer_independent_branch_tip:
        branch_id = str(ctx.branch_id)
    if ctx.revision_id is not None and not prefer_independent_branch_tip:
        return ctx.revision_id
    if ctx.explicit_revision_id is not None:
        return ctx.explicit_revision_id
    branch_table = getattr(ctx, "branch_table", None)
    if branch_table is None and ctx.versioning_domain is not None:
        branch_model = getattr(ctx.versioning_domain, "branch_model", None)
        if branch_model is not None:
            branch_table = get_table_name(branch_model)
    if branch_id is None or branch_table is None:
        return None
    branch_id_column = getattr(ctx, "branch_id_column", "sys_id")
    branch_tip_revision_column = getattr(ctx, "branch_tip_revision_column", "tip_revision_sys_id")
    branch_deleted_column = getattr(ctx, "branch_deleted_column", "sys_deleted")
    branch_qualifier = SqlAliasName(str(branch_table))
    branch_matches = SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_id_column), qualifier=branch_qualifier),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        _as_sql_rhs(branch_id),
    )
    branch_visible = SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_deleted_column), qualifier=branch_qualifier),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        SqlParam(False),
    )
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_tip_revision_column), qualifier=branch_qualifier)],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(branch_table)),
            where=sql_and(branch_matches, branch_visible),
            limit=1,
        ),
    )


def _branch_id_for_revision_subquery(ctx: CompilationContext, revision_id: str | SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Resolve the owning branch for a revision selector."""
    domain = require_versioning_domain(ctx, site="compile_versioned_query revision branch")
    index_model = domain.revision_branch_index_model
    index_table = get_table_name(index_model)
    revision_column = str(get_db_column_name(index_model, DynamicFieldName("revision_sys_id")))
    branch_column = str(get_db_column_name(index_model, DynamicFieldName("branch_sys_id")))
    return SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_column))]),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(index_table)),
            where=SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(revision_column)),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                _as_sql_rhs(revision_id),
            ),
            limit=1,
        ),
    )

def _extract_table_name_str(ref: Any) -> str:
    """Extract a raw table name string from a grammar object.

    Handles SqlTableName (branded str), SqlTableIdent (has _name),
    SqlTableAlias (has _source), and falls back to str conversion.
    """
    if isinstance(ref, str):
        return ref
    if hasattr(ref, "_name") and isinstance(ref._name, str):
        return ref._name
    if hasattr(ref, "_source"):
        return _extract_table_name_str(ref._source)
    return str(ref)

def _resolve_compile_materialization_policy(
    query_spec: Any,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    revision_id_override: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    include_deleted: bool = False,
    raw_mode: bool = False,
    preferred_source: PublishedVersionSource | None = None,
) -> VersionedMaterializationPolicy:
    """Resolve the one policy record consumed by all versioned query compilers."""
    prefer_tip_strategy = ctx.prefer_tip_strategy
    prefer_staged_overlay = ctx.prefer_tip_merged
    from l7000_versioned_schema.read_source_policy import is_current_branch_read, persisted_tip_materialization

    effective_revision = revision_id_override if revision_id_override is not None else ctx.revision_id
    has_historical_revision = (ctx.explicit_revision_id is not None and not prefer_staged_overlay) or (
        effective_revision is not None and not prefer_staged_overlay and not prefer_tip_strategy and not is_current_branch_read(ctx)
    )
    policy = resolve_versioned_materialization_policy(
        VersionedMaterializationInputs(
            tip_materialization=persisted_tip_materialization(ctx),
            branchpoint_materialization=None,
            prefer_tip_strategy=prefer_tip_strategy,
            prefer_staged_overlay=prefer_staged_overlay,
            has_staged_writes=ctx.staged_commit_id is not None,
            has_explicit_revision=has_historical_revision,
            include_deleted=include_deleted,
            has_joins=bool(query_spec is not None and getattr(query_spec, "joins", None)),
            raw_mode=raw_mode,
            has_projection=bool(getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None)),
        ),
    )
    if preferred_source is None:
        return policy
    permission_source = PermissionReadSource.TIP if preferred_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP else PermissionReadSource.SPARSE
    return replace(
        policy,
        tip_materialization=(
            BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED if preferred_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP else policy.tip_materialization
        ),
        published_source=preferred_source,
        staged_visibility=StagedVisibility.PUBLISHED_ONLY,
        permission_source=permission_source,
        use_direct_tip_fast_path=(
            preferred_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP
            and not include_deleted
            and not bool(query_spec is not None and getattr(query_spec, "joins", None))
            and not raw_mode
            and not bool(getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None))
        ),
    )


def _read_shape_with_declared_sources(
    catalog: PlanningCatalog,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
) -> Any:
    """Complete cached read metadata from the query producer's source family."""
    read_shape = catalog.read_metadata_for_model(model_cls)
    declared_source_models = tuple(
        source_model
        for source_model in (getattr(query_spec, "polymorphic_source_models", None) or ())
        if isinstance(source_model, type) and issubclass(source_model, DatabaseObjectRow)
    )
    source_models = declared_source_models or read_shape.multitable_source_models
    if source_models != read_shape.multitable_source_models:
        return build_read_metadata_plan_for_sources(model_cls, source_models)
    return read_shape


def _read_projection_for_query(
    catalog: PlanningCatalog,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: Any,
    *,
    flavor: str,
) -> VersionedReadProjection:
    """Use the exact physical-source projection published for this query."""
    source_projection = getattr(query_spec, "source_read_projection", None)
    if source_projection is not None:
        return cast(VersionedReadProjection, source_projection)
    return cast(
        VersionedReadProjection,
        _read_shape_with_declared_sources(catalog, model_cls, query_spec).projection_for(flavor),
    )


def _inject_multitable_polymorphic_ctes(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    include_deleted: bool = False,
    branch_id_override: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    revision_id_override: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    materialization_policy: VersionedMaterializationPolicy,
) -> Any:
    """Augment plain versioned QuerySpecs with multitable polymorphic UNION CTEs."""
    if query_spec is None:
        return query_spec
    existing_ctes: tuple[tuple[str, SqlRenderable], ...] = getattr(query_spec, "sql_cte_definitions", ()) or ()
    if query_spec.source_read_projection is not None:
        return query_spec
    txn = getattr(ctx, "txn", None)
    if txn is None:
        return query_spec

    from impl.common.l7245_versioned_backends.registry import versioned_backend_registry

    catalog = require_planning_catalog(ctx, site="_inject_multitable_polymorphic_ctes")
    read_shape = _read_shape_with_declared_sources(catalog, model_cls, query_spec)
    source_models = read_shape.multitable_source_models
    if not source_models:
        return query_spec
    if all(get_table_name(source_model) == get_table_name(model_cls) for source_model in source_models):
        return query_spec

    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.polymorphism.multitable_cte import (
        align_multitable_read_projection,
    )

    backend = versioned_backend_registry.get("sparse", txn)
    use_merged_tables = revision_id_override is None and materialization_policy.uses_staged_overlay
    if use_merged_tables:
        published_materialize = (
            backend._get_or_create_tip_model
            if materialization_policy.published_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP
            else backend._get_or_create_sparse_model
        )
        published_flavor = (
            READ_FLAVOR_TIP_MERGED
            if materialization_policy.published_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP
            else READ_FLAVOR_SPARSE_HISTORICAL
        )
        published_materialized = build_materialized_multitable_read_projection(
            read_shape,
            flavor=published_flavor,
            materialize_model=published_materialize,
        )
        assert published_materialized is not None
        published_model = published_materialized.output_model_cls
        published_sources = published_materialized.source_models
        published_cte_name = build_multitable_polymorphic_cte_name(get_table_name(published_model))
        published_projection = align_multitable_read_projection(
            published_materialized.projection,
            published_sources,
        )
        published_cte_definition = build_multitable_polymorphic_cte_definition(
            published_model,
            published_sources,
            cte_name=SqlCteName(published_cte_name),
            read_projection=published_projection,
        )

        staged_materialized = build_materialized_multitable_read_projection(
            read_shape,
            flavor=READ_FLAVOR_STAGED_MERGED,
            materialize_model=backend._get_or_create_staged_model,
        )
        assert staged_materialized is not None
        staged_model = staged_materialized.output_model_cls
        staged_sources = staged_materialized.source_models
        staged_cte_name = build_multitable_polymorphic_cte_name(get_table_name(staged_model))
        staged_projection = align_multitable_read_projection(
            staged_materialized.projection,
            staged_sources,
        )
        staged_cte_definition = build_multitable_polymorphic_cte_definition(
            staged_model,
            staged_sources,
            cte_name=SqlCteName(staged_cte_name),
            read_projection=staged_projection,
        )

        definitions = tuple(definition for definition in (published_cte_definition, staged_cte_definition) if definition is not None)
        if not definitions:
            return query_spec
        return dc_replace(
            query_spec,
            table=(published_cte_name if published_cte_definition is not None else getattr(query_spec, "table", None)),
            staged_table=(staged_cte_name if staged_cte_definition is not None else getattr(query_spec, "staged_table", None)),
            sql_cte_definitions=(*existing_ctes, *definitions),
            source_read_projection=published_projection,
        )

    # Source selection is policy-owned. Query shape only determines how the
    # selected physical model is projected into the polymorphic CTE.
    use_tip_models = materialization_policy.published_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP and (
        branch_id_override is not None or ctx.branch_id is not None or getattr(ctx, "lazy_branch", None) is not None
    )
    materialize = backend._get_or_create_tip_model if use_tip_models else backend._get_or_create_sparse_model
    flavor = READ_FLAVOR_TIP_MERGED if use_tip_models else READ_FLAVOR_SPARSE_HISTORICAL
    materialized = build_materialized_multitable_read_projection(
        read_shape,
        flavor=flavor,
        materialize_model=materialize,
    )
    assert materialized is not None
    materialized_model = materialized.output_model_cls
    materialized_sources = materialized.source_models
    cte_name = build_multitable_polymorphic_cte_name(get_table_name(materialized_model))
    materialized_projection = align_multitable_read_projection(
        materialized.projection,
        materialized_sources,
    )
    cte_definition = build_multitable_polymorphic_cte_definition(
        materialized_model,
        materialized_sources,
        cte_name=SqlCteName(cte_name),
        read_projection=materialized_projection,
    )
    staged_materialized = build_materialized_multitable_read_projection(
        read_shape,
        flavor=READ_FLAVOR_STAGED_MERGED,
        materialize_model=backend._get_or_create_staged_model,
    )
    assert staged_materialized is not None
    staged_model = staged_materialized.output_model_cls
    staged_cte_name = build_multitable_polymorphic_cte_name(get_table_name(staged_model))
    staged_projection = align_multitable_read_projection(
        staged_materialized.projection,
        staged_materialized.source_models,
    )
    staged_cte_definition = build_multitable_polymorphic_cte_definition(
        staged_model,
        staged_materialized.source_models,
        cte_name=SqlCteName(staged_cte_name),
        read_projection=staged_projection,
    )
    definitions = tuple(definition for definition in (cte_definition, staged_cte_definition) if definition is not None)
    if not definitions:
        return query_spec
    return dc_replace(
        query_spec,
        table=cte_name if cte_definition is not None else getattr(query_spec, "table", None),
        staged_table=staged_cte_name if staged_cte_definition is not None else getattr(query_spec, "staged_table", None),
        sql_cte_definitions=(*existing_ctes, *definitions),
        source_read_projection=materialized_projection,
    )


def _model_has_type_name_field(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> bool:
    """Return whether the model exposes a ``type_name`` discriminator column."""
    model_fields = getattr(model_cls, "model_fields", None)
    return isinstance(model_fields, dict) and "type_name" in model_fields


def _model_has_dynamic_type_name_storage(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> bool:
    """Return whether the model uses dynamic-type ``type_name`` storage semantics."""
    from l1400_types import GraphQLTypeName
    from l9600_graphs.dynamic_types import DynamicTypeRegistry

    is_dynamic: bool = DynamicTypeRegistry.is_dynamic_type_name(GraphQLTypeName(model_cls.__name__))
    return is_dynamic


def _visible_published_ancestor_cte_name(visible_published_name: str) -> SqlCteName:
    suffix = crc32(visible_published_name.encode()).to_bytes(4).hex()
    return SqlCteName(f"vp_ancestors_{suffix}")


def _versioned_query_ancestor_cte_name(step_name: str) -> SqlCteName:
    suffix = crc32(step_name.encode()).to_bytes(4).hex()
    return SqlCteName(f"vq_ancestors_{suffix}")


def _validated_type_filter_column(query_spec: Any) -> str:
    """Return a supported discriminator column name for explicit type filters."""
    type_filter_column = getattr(query_spec, "type_filter_column", "type_name")
    if type_filter_column is None:
        return "type_name"
    if type_filter_column not in {"type_id", "type_name"}:
        msg = f"Unsupported type_filter_column for versioned query compilation: {type_filter_column!r}"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return type_filter_column


def _is_primary_key_lookup_query_shape(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> bool:
    """Return True when a query is a plain sys_id lookup or sys_id IN lookup."""
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    if query_spec is None:
        return False
    if getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None) is not None:
        return False
    if getattr(query_spec, "distinct", False):
        return False
    if getattr(query_spec, "joins", None):
        return False
    if getattr(query_spec, "order_by", None):
        return False
    if getattr(query_spec, "offset", None) is not None:
        return False
    if getattr(query_spec, "group_by", None):
        return False
    if getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", None):
        return False
    if getattr(query_spec, "having", None):
        return False
    if getattr(query_spec, "window_functions", None):
        return False

    filters = getattr(query_spec, "filters", None) or ()
    if not filters:
        return False

    def _filter_field_name(value: object) -> object:
        name = getattr(value, "name", None)
        if isinstance(name, str):
            return name
        field_name = getattr(value, "field_name", None)
        if isinstance(field_name, str):
            return field_name
        return value

    sys_id_names = {"sys_id", get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))}
    supported_pk_ops = {"=", "==", "IN"}
    for filter_item in filters:
        expr = getattr(filter_item, "expression", None)
        if expr is not None:
            expr_field = _filter_field_name(getattr(expr, "field", None))
            if expr_field not in sys_id_names:
                left_expr = getattr(expr, "left", None)
                expr_field = _filter_field_name(getattr(left_expr, "field", left_expr))
            if expr_field in sys_id_names and getattr(expr, "operator", None) in supported_pk_ops:
                return True
            continue
        if (
            _filter_field_name(getattr(filter_item, "column", None)) in sys_id_names
            and getattr(
                filter_item,
                "operator",
                None,
            )
            in supported_pk_ops
        ):
            return True
    return False


def _normalize_versioned_query_spec_type_filter(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> Any:
    """Drop auto-generated type-id hints when versioned compilation can rebuild them safely.

    Dynamic models keep explicit caller-provided discriminator hints intact so
    versioned count/read compilation preserves the narrowed subtype set chosen
    upstream instead of replacing it with a generic fallback condition.
    """
    if (
        query_spec is None
        or getattr(query_spec, "type_filter_types", None) is None
        or not _model_has_type_name_field(model_cls)
        or _model_has_dynamic_type_name_storage(model_cls)
    ):
        if query_spec is not None and getattr(query_spec, "type_filter_types", None) is not None:
            _validated_type_filter_column(query_spec)
        return query_spec

    return _replace_query_spec_attrs(
        query_spec,
        type_filter_types=None,
        type_filter_column=None,
    )


def _replace_query_spec_attrs(
    query_spec: Any,
    /,
    **updates: object,
) -> Any:
    """Return a query-spec-like object with the provided attributes replaced."""
    if is_dataclass(query_spec) and not isinstance(query_spec, type):
        return dc_replace(query_spec, **updates)

    try:
        spec_dict = vars(query_spec).copy()
    except TypeError as exc:
        msg = f"Cannot replace attributes on unsupported query spec type {type(query_spec).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg) from exc

    spec_dict.update(updates)
    if isinstance(query_spec, SimpleNamespace):
        return SimpleNamespace(**spec_dict)

    query_spec_type = type(query_spec)
    try:
        return query_spec_type(**spec_dict)
    except TypeError as exc:
        msg = f"Cannot replace attributes on unsupported query spec type {query_spec_type.__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg) from exc


def _query_sql_cte_definitions(
    query_spec: object,
) -> tuple[tuple[str, SqlRenderable], ...]:
    """Return SQL-only CTE definitions attached to a query spec."""
    from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_spec import get_query_sql_cte_definitions

    cte_definitions: tuple[tuple[str, SqlRenderable], ...] = get_query_sql_cte_definitions(query_spec)
    return cte_definitions


def _cte_definitions_need_recursive(ctes: Sequence[SqlCteDefinitionInput]) -> bool:
    def _cte_query(definition: SqlCteDefinitionInput) -> SqlRenderable:
        if isinstance(definition, SqlCteDefinition):
            return definition.query
        return definition[1]

    return any(
        (isinstance(cte_definition, SqlCteDefinition) and cte_definition.recursive)
        or bool(getattr(_cte_query(cte_definition), "_recursive", False))
        for cte_definition in ctes
    )


def _cte_definitions_as_pairs(
    ctes: Sequence[SqlCteDefinitionInput],
) -> tuple[tuple[str, SqlRenderable], ...]:
    return tuple(
        (
            str(cte_definition.name),
            (SqlRecursiveCteBody(cte_definition.query) if cte_definition.recursive else cte_definition.query),
        )
        if isinstance(cte_definition, SqlCteDefinition)
        else cte_definition
        for cte_definition in ctes
    )


def _wrap_query_renderable_with_ctes(
    query_spec: Any,
    grammar: SqlRenderable,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Wrap a rendered query with any SQL-only auxiliary CTEs from the spec."""
    cte_definitions = _query_sql_cte_definitions(query_spec)
    if not cte_definitions:
        return grammar
    if isinstance(grammar, SqlVersionedMergedCte):
        return grammar.with_leading_ctes(cte_definitions)
    split_for_outer_cte = getattr(grammar, "split_for_outer_cte", None)
    if callable(split_for_outer_cte):
        inner_ctes, inner_main = cast(
            "tuple[list[SqlCteDefinitionInput], SqlRenderable]",
            split_for_outer_cte(),
        )
        needs_recursive = (
            bool(getattr(grammar, "_recursive", False))
            or _cte_definitions_need_recursive(cte_definitions)
            or _cte_definitions_need_recursive(inner_ctes)
        )
        return SqlCte(
            [*cte_definitions, *inner_ctes],
            inner_main,
            recursive=needs_recursive,
        )
    return SqlCte(cte_definitions, grammar)


def _wrap_sql_step_ir_with_query_ctes(
    query_spec: Any,
    ir: SqlStepIR,
) -> SqlStepIR:
    """Attach query-spec SQL CTEs to the final rendered SQL statement."""
    wrapped_grammar = _wrap_query_renderable_with_ctes(query_spec, ir.grammar)
    if wrapped_grammar is ir.grammar:
        return ir
    return dc_replace(ir, grammar=wrapped_grammar)


def _versioned_auxiliary_table_name(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    table_type: VersionedTableType,
) -> str:
    try:
        return str(get_auxiliary_table_name(model_cls, table_type))
    except TypeError:
        # Planner-only grammar tests use structural stand-ins for versioned rows.
        return f"{get_table_name(model_cls)}_{table_type.value}"


def _query_source_table_name(query_spec: Any, default_table_name: str) -> str:
    """Return the effective SQL source table or synthetic CTE name."""
    if not _query_sql_cte_definitions(query_spec):
        return default_table_name
    table_name = getattr(query_spec, "table", None)
    if table_name is not None and str(table_name):
        return str(table_name)
    return default_table_name


def _query_staged_source_table_name(
    query_spec: Any,
    default_table_name: str,
) -> str:
    """Return the effective staged SQL source table or synthetic CTE name."""
    if not _query_sql_cte_definitions(query_spec):
        return default_table_name
    table_name = getattr(query_spec, "staged_table", None)
    if table_name is not None and str(table_name):
        return str(table_name)
    return default_table_name


def _build_polymorphic_type_condition(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    *,
    qualifier: str | None = None,
) -> Any | None:
    """Build a discriminator predicate that matches by ``type_name``."""
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam

    ptype_names = collect_polymorphic_type_names(model_cls) if _model_has_type_name_field(model_cls) else set()
    if not ptype_names:
        return None

    return SqlIn(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("type_name"), qualifier),
        [SqlParam(name) for name in ptype_names],
    )


def _as_sql_rhs(value: Any) -> Any:
    """Use grammar objects directly and parameterize plain values."""

    return value if isinstance(value, SqlRenderable) else SqlParam(value)


def _require_sql_value(value: object, *, field_name: str) -> SqlRenderable:
    if value is None:
        msg = f"compile_versioned_query: no {field_name} available"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    if isinstance(value, SqlRenderable):
        return value
    return SqlParam(value)


def _require_branch_sql_value(ctx: CompilationContext, value: object) -> SqlRenderable:
    if value is None:
        msg = "compile_versioned_query: no branch_id available"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    if isinstance(value, SqlRenderable):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        binding = resolve_sql_visible_ref(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(value), default_field="branch_id")
        if binding is not None:
            return SqlCteFieldRef(SqlCteStepName(binding.cte_name), SqlColumnName(binding.field_name))
    unwrap = getattr(value, "unwrap_to_str", None)
    branch_value = str(unwrap() if callable(unwrap) else value)
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
        return SqlCast(SqlParam(SysIdValue(branch_value)), _UUID_CAST_TARGET)
    return SqlParam(branch_value)


def _rewrite_permission_qualifiers(
    value: Any,
    *,
    from_qualifier: str | None,
    to_qualifier: str | None,
    branch_id_expr: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    seen: dict[int, Any] | None = None,
) -> Any:
    """Clone a grammar subtree while rebinding table qualifiers.

    This keeps versioned compile pure by avoiding any permission recompilation or
    session lookup I/O during ``compile()``.
    """
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.grammar_bases import SqlDmlBase
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlSubquery
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlStar
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

    if seen is None:
        seen = {}
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool, bytes, UUID)):
        return value

    value_id = id(value)
    if value_id in seen:
        return seen[value_id]

    if from_qualifier is None and isinstance(value, (SqlSelect, SqlSubquery)):
        seen[value_id] = value
        return value

    if isinstance(value, SqlColumnRef):
        qualifier = to_qualifier if value._qualifier == from_qualifier else value._qualifier
        if qualifier == "merged" and str(value._column) == "branch_id" and branch_id_expr is not None:
            seen[value_id] = branch_id_expr
            return branch_id_expr
        column = (
            SqlColumnName("sys_revision_id")
            if qualifier == "merged" and str(value._column) == "sys_valid_from_revision_id"
            else value._column
        )
        rewritten = SqlColumnRef(
            column,
            qualifier,
            plain_text_hint=value._plain_text_hint,
            trigger_prefix=value._trigger_prefix,
        )
        seen[value_id] = rewritten
        return rewritten

    if isinstance(value, SqlStar):
        qualifier = to_qualifier if value._qualifier == from_qualifier else value._qualifier
        rewritten_star = SqlStar(qualifier)
        seen[value_id] = rewritten_star
        return rewritten_star

    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        rewritten_tuple = tuple(
            _rewrite_permission_qualifiers(
                item,
                from_qualifier=from_qualifier,
                to_qualifier=to_qualifier,
                branch_id_expr=branch_id_expr,
                seen=seen,
            )
            for item in value
        )
        seen[value_id] = rewritten_tuple
        return rewritten_tuple

    if isinstance(value, list):
        rewritten_list: list[Any] = []
        seen[value_id] = rewritten_list
        rewritten_list.extend(
            _rewrite_permission_qualifiers(
                item,
                from_qualifier=from_qualifier,
                to_qualifier=to_qualifier,
                branch_id_expr=branch_id_expr,
                seen=seen,
            )
            for item in value
        )
        return rewritten_list

    if isinstance(value, dict):
        rewritten_dict: dict[Any, Any] = {}
        seen[value_id] = rewritten_dict
        for key, item in value.items():
            rewritten_dict[key] = _rewrite_permission_qualifiers(
                item,
                from_qualifier=from_qualifier,
                to_qualifier=to_qualifier,
                branch_id_expr=branch_id_expr,
                seen=seen,
            )
        return rewritten_dict

    slots: list[str] = []
    for cls in type(value).__mro__:
        cls_slots = getattr(cls, "__slots__", ())
        if isinstance(cls_slots, str):
            slots.append(cls_slots)
        else:
            slots.extend(cls_slots)
    if not slots:
        return value

    clone = object.__new__(type(value))
    seen[value_id] = clone
    for slot in slots:
        if slot in {"__dict__", "__weakref__"} or not hasattr(value, slot):
            continue
        attr = getattr(value, slot)
        if from_qualifier is None and isinstance(value, SqlIn) and slot == "_values" and isinstance(attr, (SqlDmlBase, SqlCte)):
            object.__setattr__(clone, slot, attr)
            continue
        if to_qualifier is not None and to_qualifier.endswith("_tip"):
            if slot in {"_graph_revision_db_col", "_graph_valid_to_revision_db_col", "_outer_revision_db_col", "_outer_revision_expr"}:
                object.__setattr__(clone, slot, None)
                continue
            if slot == "_graph_tip_table" and isinstance(attr, SqlTableName) and str(attr).endswith("_sparse"):
                object.__setattr__(clone, slot, SqlTableName(to_qualifier))
                continue
        if slot in {"_table_alias", "table_alias"} and isinstance(attr, str) and attr == from_qualifier and to_qualifier is not None:
            object.__setattr__(clone, slot, type(attr)(to_qualifier) if type(attr) is not str else to_qualifier)
            continue
        object.__setattr__(
            clone,
            slot,
            _rewrite_permission_qualifiers(
                attr,
                from_qualifier=from_qualifier,
                to_qualifier=to_qualifier,
                branch_id_expr=branch_id_expr,
                seen=seen,
            ),
        )
    return clone


def _rebind_permission_grammar_for_versioned_source(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    *,
    table_alias: str | None,
    branch_id_expr: SqlRenderable | None = None,
) -> Any:
    """Rewrite permission grammar to the actual versioned SQL source.

    Query builders attach permission grammar early, before versioned compilation
    rewrites the source table from ``base`` to ``base_sparse`` or the merged
    versioned view. Reusing the precompiled base-table-qualified grammar in the
    versioned SQL path produces invalid references like ``base_table.col`` where
    the final query only exposes ``base_table_sparse`` or unqualified merged
    columns.
    """
    if query_spec is None or getattr(query_spec, "permission_grammar", None) is None:
        return query_spec

    if is_dataclass(query_spec) and not isinstance(query_spec, type):
        field_names = {field.name for field in dc_fields(query_spec)}
        if "query_spec" in field_names and "permission_grammar" not in field_names:
            return dc_replace(
                query_spec,
                query_spec=_rebind_permission_grammar_for_versioned_source(
                    getattr(query_spec, "query_spec"),
                    model_cls,
                    table_alias=table_alias,
                    branch_id_expr=branch_id_expr,
                ),
            )

    permission_grammar_source = getattr(query_spec, "permission_grammar")
    permission_grammar = _rewrite_permission_qualifiers(
        permission_grammar_source,
        from_qualifier=get_table_name(model_cls),
        to_qualifier=table_alias,
        branch_id_expr=branch_id_expr,
    )
    if (
        is_dataclass(query_spec)
        and not isinstance(query_spec, type)
        and any(field.name == "permission_grammar" for field in dc_fields(query_spec))
    ):
        return dc_replace(query_spec, permission_grammar=permission_grammar)
    try:
        spec_dict = vars(query_spec).copy()
    except TypeError as exc:
        msg = f"Cannot rebind versioned permission grammar for unsupported query spec type {type(query_spec).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg) from exc
    spec_dict["permission_grammar"] = permission_grammar
    return SimpleNamespace(**spec_dict)


def compile_versioned_query(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    include_deleted: bool = False,
    branch_id_override: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    revision_id_override: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    raw_mode: bool = False,
    preserve_revision_override: bool = False,
    require_branch_id_override: bool = False,
    ancestor_cte_name: str = "_visible_ancestors",
    policy_authority_scope: PolicyAuthorityCompilationScope | None = None,
    preferred_source: PublishedVersionSource | None = None,
) -> SqlStepIR:
    """Compile a versioned model query to SqlStepIR.

    For read transactions (revision_id set): queries the sparse table with
    revision validity window filtering.

    For write transactions (no revision_id): generates a SqlVersionedMergedCte
    that merges staged and tip tables with ROW_NUMBER deduplication.

    Supports filters, order-by, limit, and offset from the query spec.

    ``branch_id_override`` takes precedence over ``ctx.branch_id``. ServerPlan
    terminal callers must set ``require_branch_id_override`` so branch identity
    cannot be recovered from ambient compilation context.
    """
    context_revision_id = ctx.revision_id
    is_current = getattr(context_revision_id, "is_current", None)
    context_revision_is_current = bool(callable(is_current) and is_current())
    effective_revision_id = (
        revision_id_override
        if revision_id_override is not None
        else None
        if context_revision_is_current
        else _require_sql_value(context_revision_id, field_name="revision_id")
        if context_revision_id is not None
        else None
    )
    if require_branch_id_override and branch_id_override is None and effective_revision_id is None:
        msg = "ServerPlan terminal versioned query compilation requires explicit branch_id_override"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    lazy_branch = getattr(ctx, "lazy_branch", None)
    if branch_id_override is not None:
        effective_branch_id = branch_id_override
    elif ctx.branch_id is not None:
        effective_branch_id = _require_branch_sql_value(ctx, ctx.branch_id)
    elif lazy_branch is not None:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import (
            lower_scalar_server_ref,
        )

        effective_branch_id = lower_scalar_server_ref(lazy_branch, ctx, default_field="branch_id")
    elif effective_revision_id is not None:
        effective_branch_id = _branch_id_for_revision_subquery(ctx, effective_revision_id)
    else:
        effective_branch_id = _require_branch_sql_value(ctx, ctx.branch_id)

    materialization_policy = _resolve_compile_materialization_policy(
        query_spec,
        ctx,
        revision_id_override=revision_id_override,
        include_deleted=include_deleted,
        raw_mode=raw_mode,
        preferred_source=preferred_source,
    )
    ctx = replace(
        ctx,
        branch_tip_materialized=materialization_policy.tip_materialization is BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED,
    )
    reads_tipless_published_state = materialization_policy.tip_materialization is BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS
    # SQL lowering consumes this closed decision. It must not independently
    # reinterpret staged visibility or published source selection.
    graph_predicate_revision_id = _graph_predicate_revision_value(
        ctx,
        revision_id=effective_revision_id,
        branch_id=effective_branch_id,
    )
    read_prefers_published_tip = (
        materialization_policy.published_source is PublishedVersionSource.TIP
        and materialization_policy.staged_visibility is StagedVisibility.PUBLISHED_ONLY
        and effective_branch_id is not None
    )
    use_tip_merged_for_branch_anchor = materialization_policy.uses_staged_overlay
    if read_prefers_published_tip and ctx.branch_tip_materialized and not preserve_revision_override:
        revision_id_override = None
        effective_revision_id = None
    if use_tip_merged_for_branch_anchor and ctx.branch_tip_materialized and not preserve_revision_override:
        revision_id_override = None
        effective_revision_id = None
    query_spec = _inject_multitable_polymorphic_ctes(
        query_spec,
        model_cls,
        ctx,
        include_deleted=include_deleted,
        branch_id_override=branch_id_override,
        revision_id_override=revision_id_override,
        materialization_policy=materialization_policy,
    )
    has_joins = bool(query_spec is not None and getattr(query_spec, "joins", None))
    pre_lowering_support_projection_columns = _query_support_projection_columns(query_spec, model_cls)
    cte_where_exprs = _prepare_versioned_filter_lowering(query_spec, ctx)
    pre_lowering_support_projection_columns = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            (
                *pre_lowering_support_projection_columns,
                *_sql_grammar_projection_columns(cte_where_exprs),
            ),
        ),
    )
    # The policy owns all direct-tip exclusions (joins, projections, raw rows,
    # tombstones, and staged overlays). This branch selects mechanics only.
    use_published_tip_read = (
        materialization_policy.use_direct_tip_fast_path
        and revision_id_override is None
        and (effective_branch_id is not None or ctx.branch_id is not None)
    )
    if use_published_tip_read:
        return _wrap_sql_step_ir_with_query_ctes(
            query_spec,
            _compile_tip_read_query(
                query_spec,
                model_cls,
                ctx,
                include_deleted=include_deleted,
                branch_id=effective_branch_id,
                cte_where_exprs=cte_where_exprs,
                policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
            ),
        )

    if (
        effective_revision_id is not None
        and raw_mode
        and not getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None)
        and not has_joins
        and not reads_tipless_published_state
        and not use_tip_merged_for_branch_anchor
        and revision_id_override is None
        and context_revision_is_current
        and (effective_branch_id is not None or ctx.branch_id is not None)
    ):
        return _wrap_sql_step_ir_with_query_ctes(
            query_spec,
            _compile_tip_read_query(
                query_spec,
                model_cls,
                ctx,
                include_deleted=include_deleted,
                branch_id=effective_branch_id,
                revision_id=effective_revision_id,
                cte_where_exprs=cte_where_exprs,
                ancestor_cte_name=SqlCteName(ancestor_cte_name),
                policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
            ),
        )

    if effective_revision_id is not None and not use_tip_merged_for_branch_anchor:
        return _wrap_sql_step_ir_with_query_ctes(
            query_spec,
            _compile_versioned_read_query(
                query_spec,
                model_cls,
                ctx,
                include_deleted=include_deleted,
                branch_id=effective_branch_id,
                revision_id=effective_revision_id,
                cte_where_exprs=cte_where_exprs,
                ancestor_cte_name=SqlCteName(ancestor_cte_name),
                policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
            ),
        )

    if has_joins and effective_revision_id is not None:
        return _wrap_sql_step_ir_with_query_ctes(
            query_spec,
            _compile_versioned_read_query(
                query_spec,
                model_cls,
                ctx,
                include_deleted=include_deleted,
                branch_id=effective_branch_id,
                revision_id=effective_revision_id,
                cte_where_exprs=cte_where_exprs,
                policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
            ),
        )

    has_expression_projection = any(
        isinstance(column, AliasedExpression) for column in (getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None) or ())
    )
    if has_joins or has_expression_projection:
        return _wrap_sql_step_ir_with_query_ctes(
            query_spec,
            _compile_versioned_merged_query_with_joins(
                query_spec,
                model_cls,
                ctx,
                include_deleted=include_deleted,
                branch_id=effective_branch_id,
                cte_where_exprs=cte_where_exprs,
                policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
            ),
        )

    base_table = get_table_name(model_cls)
    uses_sparse_published_source = (
        include_deleted or reads_tipless_published_state or (effective_revision_id is not None and not use_tip_merged_for_branch_anchor)
    )
    published_table_suffix = "_sparse" if uses_sparse_published_source else "_tip"
    published_table_type = VersionedTableType.SPARSE if uses_sparse_published_source else VersionedTableType.TIP
    tip_table = SqlTableName(
        _query_source_table_name(
            query_spec,
            _versioned_auxiliary_table_name(model_cls, published_table_type),
        ),
    )
    staged_table = SqlTableName(
        _query_staged_source_table_name(
            query_spec,
            _versioned_auxiliary_table_name(model_cls, VersionedTableType.STAGED),
        ),
    )

    query_spec_ctes: tuple[Any, ...] = getattr(query_spec, "sql_cte_definitions", ()) or ()
    catalog = require_planning_catalog(ctx, site="_compile_versioned_query_with_merged_cte")
    read_shape = _read_shape_with_declared_sources(catalog, model_cls, query_spec)
    projection = read_shape.projection_for(READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS)
    projection_column_attr = "cte_output_column" if query_spec_ctes else "db_column"
    projection_data_fields = tuple(getattr(projection, "data_fields"))
    projection_meta_physical = {"revision_id", "sys_revision_id", "staged_commit_id", "sys_staged_commit_id", "sys_deleted"}
    projection_data_columns = tuple(
        str(column)
        for field in projection_data_fields
        if str(column := getattr(field, projection_column_attr)) not in projection_meta_physical
    )
    projection_data_columns = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            (
                *projection_data_columns,
                *(
                    str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)))
                    for field_name in getattr(model_cls, "model_fields", {})
                    if str(get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))) not in projection_meta_physical
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )
    available_projection_columns = {column for column in projection_data_columns}
    select_columns = tuple(cast(Sequence[Any], getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", ()) or ()))
    selected_projection_pairs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    selected_projection_valid = True
    for column in select_columns:
        output = _projection_output_alias(column, model_cls)
        source = _projection_source_column(column, model_cls)
        if not output or not source:
            selected_projection_valid = False
            break
        if output in projection_meta_physical:
            continue
        if output not in available_projection_columns:
            selected_projection_valid = False
            break
        selected_projection_pairs.append((output, source))
    if selected_projection_valid:
        selected_projection_columns = tuple(output for output, _source in selected_projection_pairs)
        selected_projection_source_columns = tuple(source for _output, source in selected_projection_pairs)
    else:
        selected_projection_columns = ()
        selected_projection_source_columns = ()
    materialization_support_projection_columns = ("branch_id",) if query_spec is not None else ()
    support_projection_columns = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            column
            for column in (
                *pre_lowering_support_projection_columns,
                *_query_support_projection_columns(query_spec, model_cls),
                *materialization_support_projection_columns,
            )
            if column in available_projection_columns or column in materialization_support_projection_columns
        ),
    )
    merged_projection_pairs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    seen_merged_projection_columns: set[str] = set()
    if selected_projection_columns:
        for output_column, source_column in zip(selected_projection_columns, selected_projection_source_columns, strict=True):
            if output_column in seen_merged_projection_columns:
                continue
            seen_merged_projection_columns.add(output_column)
            merged_projection_pairs.append((output_column, source_column))
        for support_column in support_projection_columns:
            if support_column in seen_merged_projection_columns:
                continue
            seen_merged_projection_columns.add(support_column)
            merged_projection_pairs.append((support_column, support_column))
    elif support_projection_columns:
        for output_column in projection_data_columns:
            if output_column in seen_merged_projection_columns:
                continue
            seen_merged_projection_columns.add(output_column)
            merged_projection_pairs.append((output_column, output_column))
        for support_column in support_projection_columns:
            if support_column in seen_merged_projection_columns:
                continue
            seen_merged_projection_columns.add(support_column)
            merged_projection_pairs.append((support_column, support_column))
    merged_projection_columns = tuple(output for output, _source in merged_projection_pairs)
    merged_projection_source_columns = tuple(source for _output, source in merged_projection_pairs)
    merged_projection = versioned_merged_projection_from_catalog(
        projection,
        selected_columns=(tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in merged_projection_columns) or None),
        selected_source_columns=(tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in merged_projection_source_columns) or None),
        use_cte_output_columns=bool(query_spec_ctes),
    )

    # Extract WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT, OFFSET from query_spec
    where_renderable: Any = None
    order_renderable: Any = None
    limit_val: int | None = getattr(query_spec, "limit", None)
    offset_val: int | None = getattr(query_spec, "offset", None) or None

    # Permission grammar attached earlier is qualified against the base table.
    # Rebind it to the merged versioned source before building the WHERE clause.
    query_spec = _normalize_versioned_query_spec_type_filter(
        _rebind_permission_grammar_for_versioned_source(
            query_spec,
            model_cls,
            table_alias="merged",
            branch_id_expr=effective_branch_id,
        ),
        model_cls,
    )
    # Build WHERE from query_spec filters via QueryGrammarBuilder
    has_permission_grammar = query_spec is not None and getattr(query_spec, "permission_grammar", None) is not None
    if query_spec is not None and (getattr(query_spec, "filters", None) or has_permission_grammar):
        from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.query_grammar import QueryGrammarBuilder

        with _graph_predicate_context(graph_predicate_revision_id, ctx=ctx, branch_id=effective_branch_id):
            where_clause = QueryGrammarBuilder(
                query_spec,
                planning_catalog=ctx.planning_catalog,
                compilation_context=ctx,
                policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
            ).build_where_clause()
        if where_clause is not None:
            where_renderable = where_clause.condition

    # Combine base WHERE with CTE subquery expressions
    if cte_where_exprs:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import _combine_where

        where_renderable = _combine_where(where_renderable, cte_where_exprs)

    # Build ORDER BY from query_spec
    if query_spec is not None and getattr(query_spec, "order_by", None):
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_order_by_codegen import (
            render_query_spec_order_by,
        )

        order_renderable = render_query_spec_order_by(query_spec, model_cls)

    # Polymorphic type filter
    type_filter_col: str | None = None
    type_filter_ids: list[str | int] | None = None
    raw_type_filter_types = getattr(query_spec, "type_filter_types", None) if query_spec is not None else None
    if raw_type_filter_types is not None:
        type_filter_ids = list(raw_type_filter_types)
        type_filter_col = _validated_type_filter_column(query_spec)
    elif not (query_spec is not None and query_spec.source_read_projection is not None):
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import sql_and

        type_condition = _build_polymorphic_type_condition(model_cls)
        if type_condition is not None:
            where_renderable = sql_and(where_renderable, type_condition) if where_renderable is not None else type_condition

    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import RevisionId

    sys_id_col, branch_col, staged_commit_id_col, revision_id_col, deleted_col = _get_versioned_column_names(model_cls)
    if where_renderable is not None:
        where_renderable = _rewrite_sparse_revision_predicate_columns(
            where_renderable,
            sparse_table=_query_source_table_name(
                query_spec,
                _versioned_auxiliary_table_name(model_cls, VersionedTableType.SPARSE),
            ),
            revision_column=SqlColumnName(revision_id_col),
            identity_column=SqlColumnName(sys_id_col),
        )
    published_sparse_revision_id = (
        RevisionId(effective_revision_id)
        if published_table_suffix == "_sparse" and isinstance(effective_revision_id, str)
        else (effective_revision_id if published_table_suffix == "_sparse" else None)
    )
    published_source_is_visible = False
    leading_ctes: tuple[SqlCteDefinitionInput, ...] = ()
    published_sparse_branch_index_table: SqlTableName | None = None
    if published_table_suffix == "_sparse":
        domain = require_versioning_domain(ctx, site="compile_versioned_query")
        published_sparse_branch_index_table = get_table_name(domain.revision_branch_index_model)
    if published_table_suffix == "_sparse" and published_sparse_revision_id is not None:
        source_table_name = str(tip_table)
        visible_published_name = safe_index_name(
            f"{source_table_name}_visible_published_{ancestor_cte_name}",
        )
        visible_published_source = SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned(
            table=SqlTableName(source_table_name),
            revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
            branch_id=effective_branch_id,
            revision_id=published_sparse_revision_id,
            include_deleted=include_deleted,
            ancestor_cte_name=SqlCteName(_visible_published_ancestor_cte_name(visible_published_name)),
            # A concrete multitable subtype still reads a sparse table. Only a
            # synthetic polymorphic UNION owns the complete framework shape.
            # See docs/design/SERVERPLAN_ARCHITECTURE.md.
            include_framework_aliases=not (query_spec is not None and query_spec.source_read_projection is not None),
        )
        ancestry_ctes, visible_body = visible_published_source.split_for_outer_cte()
        source_definitions = tuple(
            definition for definition in (getattr(query_spec, "sql_cte_definitions", ()) or ()) if str(definition[0]) == source_table_name
        )
        if source_definitions:
            visible_body = SqlOwnedSparseSourceScope(
                SqlCte(source_definitions, visible_body),
            )
        leading_ctes = (
            *ancestry_ctes,
            (SqlCteName(visible_published_name), visible_body),
        )
        tip_table = SqlTableName(visible_published_name)
        published_sparse_revision_id = None
        published_source_is_visible = True
    where_support_columns = (
        projection_data_columns
        if has_permission_grammar
        else tuple(column for column in _sql_grammar_projection_columns(where_renderable) if column in available_projection_columns)
    )
    if where_support_columns:
        assert merged_projection.source_columns is not None
        projection_pairs = list(zip(merged_projection.data_columns, merged_projection.source_columns, strict=True))
        projected_outputs = {output for output, _source in projection_pairs}
        projection_pairs.extend(
            (SqlColumnName(column), SqlColumnName(column)) for column in where_support_columns if column not in projected_outputs
        )
        merged_projection = versioned_merged_projection_from_catalog(
            projection,
            selected_columns=tuple(output for output, _source in projection_pairs),
            selected_source_columns=tuple(source for _output, source in projection_pairs),
        )
    published_revision_source_column = "sys_valid_from_revision_id" if published_table_suffix == "_sparse" else revision_id_col
    cte = SqlVersionedMergedCte(
        tip_table=tip_table,
        staged_table=staged_table,
        read_projection=merged_projection,
        branch_id=effective_branch_id,
        staged_commit_id=_merged_cte_staged_commit_scope(ctx),
        branch_column=SqlColumnName(branch_col),
        staged_commit_id_column=SqlColumnName(staged_commit_id_col),
        revision_id_column=SqlColumnName(revision_id_col),
        tip_revision_source_column=SqlColumnName(published_revision_source_column),
        deleted_column=SqlColumnName(deleted_col),
        include_deleted=include_deleted,
        where_clause=where_renderable,
        order_by=order_renderable,
        limit=limit_val,
        offset=offset_val if offset_val else None,
        type_filter_column=SqlColumnName(type_filter_col) if type_filter_col is not None else None,
        type_filter_ids=type_filter_ids,
        leading_ctes=leading_ctes,
        staged_visibility_filter=_merged_cte_staged_visibility_filter(ctx),
        published_sparse_revision_id=published_sparse_revision_id,
        published_sparse_open_row=(
            published_table_suffix == "_sparse" and published_sparse_revision_id is None and not published_source_is_visible
        ),
        published_sparse_branch_index_table=published_sparse_branch_index_table,
        published_source_is_visible=published_source_is_visible,
    )

    declared_output_columns = (
        tuple(dict.fromkeys((*selected_projection_columns, *support_projection_columns)))
        if selected_projection_columns
        else tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                (
                    *projection_data_columns,
                    "branch_id",
                    "sys_revision_id",
                    "sys_staged_commit_id",
                    "sys_deleted",
                ),
            ),
        )
    )
    output_shape = output_shape_from_read_projection(
        projection,
        declared_outputs=declared_output_columns,
    )
    if "branch_id" in support_projection_columns and "branch_id" not in output_shape.cte_output_columns:
        output_shape = output_shape.with_fields(
            (
                CompiledOutputField(
                    output_name="branch_id",
                    output_column="branch_id",
                    source_db_column="branch_id",
                    role="versioned_support",
                    model_field_name=None,
                    owner_cls=None,
                    is_model_backed=False,
                    include_in_json=False,
                    include_in_hydration=False,
                ),
            ),
        )

    model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, output_shape.cte_output_columns)
    if model_hints is None:
        model_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints()
    column_type_hints = combine_sql_column_type_hints(
        output_shape.cte_output_columns,
        model_hints,
        projection.declared_sql_column_type_hints(),
        framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
    )
    result_relation = DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape)
    return _wrap_sql_step_ir_with_query_ctes(
        query_spec,
        SqlStepIR(
            grammar=cte,
            needs_returning=True,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        ),
    )


def _compile_tip_read_query(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    include_deleted: bool = False,
    branch_id: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    revision_id: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    cte_where_exprs: list[Any] | None = None,
    ancestor_cte_name: str = "_visible_ancestors",
    policy_authority_scope: PolicyAuthorityCompilationScope | None = None,
) -> SqlStepIR:
    """Compile a branch-tip read against published tip tables only."""
    del ancestor_cte_name
    effective_branch = branch_id if branch_id is not None else _require_branch_sql_value(ctx, ctx.branch_id)

    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.query.stmt_dynamic import SqlSelectStarDynamic
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, sql_and
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name

    base_table = get_table_name(model_cls)
    source_table_name = _query_source_table_name(
        query_spec,
        _versioned_auxiliary_table_name(model_cls, VersionedTableType.TIP),
    )
    tip_table = SqlTableName(source_table_name)

    query_spec = _normalize_versioned_query_spec_type_filter(
        _rebind_permission_grammar_for_versioned_source(
            query_spec,
            model_cls,
            table_alias=str(tip_table),
        ),
        model_cls,
    )
    extra_where: Any = None
    has_permission_grammar = query_spec is not None and getattr(query_spec, "permission_grammar", None) is not None
    if query_spec is not None and (getattr(query_spec, "filters", None) or has_permission_grammar):
        from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.query_grammar import QueryGrammarBuilder

        with _graph_predicate_context(
            _graph_predicate_revision_value(ctx, revision_id=revision_id, branch_id=effective_branch),
            ctx=ctx,
            branch_id=effective_branch,
        ):
            where_clause = QueryGrammarBuilder(
                query_spec,
                planning_catalog=ctx.planning_catalog,
                compilation_context=ctx,
                policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
            ).build_where_clause()
        if where_clause is not None:
            extra_where = where_clause.condition

    if cte_where_exprs:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import _combine_where

        extra_where = _combine_where(extra_where, cte_where_exprs)

    if not (query_spec is not None and query_spec.source_read_projection is not None):
        type_condition = _build_polymorphic_type_condition(model_cls)
        if type_condition is not None:
            extra_where = sql_and(extra_where, type_condition) if extra_where is not None else type_condition

    branch_where = SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
        BinaryOp.EQ,
        _as_sql_rhs(effective_branch),
    )
    combined_where: Any = branch_where
    if extra_where is not None:
        combined_where = sql_and(combined_where, extra_where)

    order_renderable: Any = None
    if query_spec is not None and getattr(query_spec, "order_by", None):
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.sql_order_by_codegen import render_query_spec_order_by

        order_renderable = render_query_spec_order_by(query_spec, model_cls)

    limit_val: int | None = getattr(query_spec, "limit", None) if query_spec is not None else None
    offset_val: int | None = (getattr(query_spec, "offset", None) or None) if query_spec is not None else None

    if query_spec is not None and (
        getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None)
        or getattr(query_spec, "group_by", None)
        or getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", None)
        or getattr(query_spec, "window_functions", None)
    ):
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import _rebuild_where_like
        from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.query_grammar import QueryGrammarBuilder

        sparse_projection = (
            require_planning_catalog(ctx, site="versioned_tip_graph_read_query.publication_relation")
            .read_metadata_for_model(model_cls)
            .projection_for(READ_FLAVOR_SPARSE_HISTORICAL)
        )
        sparse_output_shape = output_shape_from_read_projection(sparse_projection)
        sparse_result_relation = DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(sparse_output_shape)
        tombstone_fields = tuple(field for field in sparse_projection.fields if field.role == READ_ROLE_DELETED_METADATA)
        if len(tombstone_fields) != 1:
            msg = (
                f"{model_cls.__name__} sparse publication relation must declare exactly one tombstone field, got {len(tombstone_fields)}"
            )
            raise TypeError(msg)
        query_spec = _query_spec_with_published_tip_tombstone_projection(
            query_spec,
            model_cls,
            producer_relation=sparse_result_relation,
            tombstone_output_column=tombstone_fields[0].cte_output_column,
        )
        query_spec = _query_spec_with_group_by_order_aliases(query_spec, model_cls)
        tip_spec = _replace_query_spec_attrs(query_spec, table=source_table_name) if hasattr(query_spec, "table") else query_spec
        with _graph_predicate_context(
            _graph_predicate_revision_value(ctx, revision_id=revision_id, branch_id=effective_branch),
            ctx=ctx,
            branch_id=effective_branch,
        ):
            builder = QueryGrammarBuilder(
                tip_spec,
                planning_catalog=ctx.planning_catalog,
                policy_authority_scope=policy_authority_scope,
            )
            builder._table = source_table_name
            stmt: Any = builder.build_select_stmt()
        stmt._where = _rebuild_where_like(getattr(stmt, "_where", None), combined_where)
        output_shape = _versioned_read_query_output_shape(ctx, query_spec, model_cls)
        projection = _read_projection_for_query(
            require_planning_catalog(
                ctx,
                site="versioned_tip_graph_read_query.column_type_hints",
            ),
            model_cls,
            query_spec,
            flavor=READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS,
        )
        return SqlStepIR(
            grammar=stmt,
            needs_returning=True,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=_versioned_read_column_type_hints(
                model_cls,
                output_shape.cte_output_columns,
                projection,
            ),
        )

    stmt = SqlSelectStarDynamic(
        table=tip_table,
        where=combined_where,
        order_by=order_renderable,
        limit=limit_val,
        offset=offset_val,
    )
    projection = _read_projection_for_query(
        require_planning_catalog(
            ctx,
            site="versioned_tip_read_query.output_shape",
        ),
        model_cls,
        query_spec,
        flavor=READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS,
    )
    output_shape = _published_tip_output_shape(projection)
    return SqlStepIR(
        grammar=stmt,
        needs_returning=True,
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=_versioned_read_column_type_hints(
            model_cls,
            output_shape.cte_output_columns,
            projection,
        ),
    )


def _compile_versioned_read_query(
    query_spec: Any,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    include_deleted: bool = False,
    branch_id: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    revision_id: SqlRenderable | None = None,
    cte_where_exprs: list[Any] | None = None,
    ancestor_cte_name: str = "_visible_ancestors",
