class ExecuteGraphBindingsStep(_BaseExecuteGraphStep[list[GraphBindingRow]]):
    optimizer_projection_owned = True

    def result_cardinality(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def step_tags(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        tags = {"read", "graph", "query", "bindings"}
        if self._pattern.order_by:
            tags.add("ordered_result")
        return frozenset(tags)

    def json_aggregation_order_by(
        self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep,
    ) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
        """Preserve graph row order inside backends that aggregate transport JSON."""
        recursive_path = (
            self._pattern.paths[0]
            if len(self._pattern.paths) == 1
            and (self._pattern.paths[0].quantifier.min_hops != 1 or self._pattern.paths[0].quantifier.max_hops != 1)
            else None
        )
        columns: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        for clause in self._pattern.order_by:
            field_path = clause.expression
            if not isinstance(field_path, str):
                continue
            output_column = field_path
            if "." in field_path:
                variable_name, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
                if (
                    recursive_path is not None
                    and variable_name == recursive_path.edge.variable
                    and field_name
                    in {
                        "sys_id",
                        "graph_sys_id",
                        "source_sys_id",
                        "target_sys_id",
                        "type_name",
                    }
                ):
                    edge_projection = next(
                        (
                            projection
                            for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection) and projection.edge_variable == variable_name
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    output_column = (
                        _binding_edge_alias(edge_projection.binding_name, field_name)
                        if edge_projection is not None
                        else f"__pt_{variable_name}_{field_name}"
                    )
                elif (
                    recursive_path is not None
                    and variable_name == recursive_path.edge.variable
                    and field_name
                    not in {
                        "sys_id",
                        "graph_sys_id",
                        "source_sys_id",
                        "target_sys_id",
                        "type_name",
                    }
                ):
                    output_column = f"__pt_{variable_name}_{field_name}"
                elif recursive_path is not None and variable_name == recursive_path.target.variable:
                    scalar_projection = next(
                        (
                            projection
                            for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection) and projection.field_path == field_path
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    output_column = (
                        scalar_projection.binding_name
                        if scalar_projection is not None
                        else get_db_column_name(recursive_path.target.node_type, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
                    )
                elif field_name == "sys_id":
                    projection = next(
                        (
                            candidate
                            for candidate in self._pattern.binding_projections
                            if (isinstance(candidate, NodeBindingProjection) and candidate.node_variable == variable_name)
                            or (isinstance(candidate, EdgeBindingProjection) and candidate.edge_variable == variable_name)
                        ),
                        None,
                    )
                    if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                        output_column = _binding_node_sys_id_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                        )
                    elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                        output_column = _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            "sys_id",
                        )
                    else:
                        output_column = f"__order_{variable_name}__{field_name}"
                else:
                    output_column = f"__order_{variable_name}__{field_name}"
            columns.append((output_column, str(clause.direction)))
        return tuple(columns)

    def _cte_output_columns(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        columns: list[str] = []
        for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                columns.append(_binding_node_sys_id_alias(projection.binding_name))
            elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                columns.extend(
                    (
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "graph_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "source_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "target_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "type_name"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            PROJECTED_EDGE_SOURCE_KEY_COLUMN,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            elif isinstance(projection, DepthBindingProjection):
                columns.append(projection.binding_name)
            elif isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection):
                columns.append(projection.binding_name)
        columns.extend(column_name for column_name, _direction in self.json_aggregation_order_by())
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns)) if columns else None

    def cte_column_type_hints(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
        columns = self._cte_output_columns()
        if columns is None:
            return None
        jsonb_columns: set[str] = set()
        uuid_columns: set[str] = set()
        timestamptz_columns: set[str] = set()
        date_columns: set[str] = set()
        bool_columns: set[str] = set()
        integer_columns: set[str] = set()
        bigint_columns: set[str] = set()
        double_columns: set[str] = set()
        text_columns: set[str] = set()
        bytea_columns: set[str] = set()
        hint_targets = (
            ("jsonb_columns", jsonb_columns),
            ("uuid_columns", uuid_columns),
            ("timestamptz_columns", timestamptz_columns),
            ("date_columns", date_columns),
            ("bool_columns", bool_columns),
            ("integer_columns", integer_columns),
            ("bigint_columns", bigint_columns),
            ("double_columns", double_columns),
            ("text_columns", text_columns),
            ("bytea_columns", bytea_columns),
        )
        variable_models: dict[str, type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = {
            variable: node.node_type for variable, node in self._nodes.items()
        }
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(self._pattern):
            variable_models[path.source.variable] = path.source.node_type
            variable_models[path.target.variable] = path.target.node_type
            for step in _iter_path_expression_steps(path.expression):
                if step.source_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.source_binding] = step.source_type
                if step.target_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.target_binding] = step.target_type
                if step.edge_binding is not None:
                    variable_models[step.edge_binding] = step.edge_types[0]

        def add_field_hint(output_column: str, field_path: str) -> bool:
            if "." not in field_path:
                return False
            variable, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
            model_cls = variable_models.get(variable)
            if model_cls is None or field_name not in model_cls.model_fields:
                return False
            db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            source_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, (db_column,))
            if source_hints is None:
                return False
            for attribute, target in hint_targets:
                if db_column in getattr(source_hints, attribute):
                    target.add(output_column)
                    return True
            return False

        for projection in self._pattern.binding_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, NodeBindingProjection):
                uuid_columns.add(_binding_node_sys_id_alias(projection.binding_name))
            elif isinstance(projection, EdgeBindingProjection):
                uuid_columns.update(
                    {
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "graph_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "source_sys_id"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "target_sys_id"),
                    },
                )
                text_columns.update(
                    {
                        _binding_edge_alias(projection.binding_name, "type_name"),
                        _binding_edge_alias(
                            projection.binding_name,
                            PROJECTED_EDGE_SOURCE_KEY_COLUMN,
                        ),
                    },
                )
            elif isinstance(projection, DepthBindingProjection):
                integer_columns.add(projection.binding_name)
            elif isinstance(projection, ScalarBindingProjection) and not add_field_hint(
                projection.binding_name,
                projection.field_path,
            ):
                text_columns.add(projection.binding_name)

        order_columns = self.json_aggregation_order_by()
        string_order_clauses = tuple(clause for clause in self._pattern.order_by if isinstance(clause.expression, str))
        for clause, (column_name, _direction) in zip(
            string_order_clauses,
            order_columns,
            strict=True,
        ):
            typed_columns = set().union(*(target for _attribute, target in hint_targets))
            if column_name in typed_columns:
                continue
            if not isinstance(clause.expression, str) or not add_field_hint(
                column_name,
                clause.expression,
            ):
                text_columns.add(column_name)

        return SqlColumnTypeHints(
            jsonb_columns=frozenset(jsonb_columns),
            uuid_columns=frozenset(uuid_columns),
            timestamptz_columns=frozenset(timestamptz_columns),
            date_columns=frozenset(date_columns),
            bool_columns=frozenset(bool_columns),
            integer_columns=frozenset(integer_columns),
            bigint_columns=frozenset(bigint_columns),
            double_columns=frozenset(double_columns),
            text_columns=frozenset(text_columns),
            bytea_columns=frozenset(bytea_columns),
        )

    def executor_publication_projection_columns(
        self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep,
    ) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
        """Publish result and ordering columns required by batched transport."""
        return self._cte_output_columns()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        # Graph bindings publish CTE contracts, so the helper names reflect the
        # SQL-visible publication invariant rather than runtime binding shape.
        columns = self._cte_output_columns()
        column_type_hints = self.cte_column_type_hints()
        if columns is None:
            if column_type_hints is not None and column_type_hints.has_any():
                msg = f"{type(self).__name__} declares SQL column type hints without an explicit cte_output_columns() contract."
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=GraphBindingRow,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(GraphBindingRow),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(self: ExecuteGraphBindingsStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[GraphBindingRow]]:
        dispatched = self._compile_persisted_policy_dispatch(ctx)
        if dispatched is not None:
            return dispatched
        from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledStep as CompiledStepFactory

        builder = self._build_graph_query_builder(ctx)
        compile_plans = self._build_traversal_compile_plans(
            ctx,
            nested_scope=GraphNestedPatternScope.INCLUDE_NESTED,
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStepFactory(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=builder._build_bindings_grammar(compile_plans=compile_plans),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=graph_bindings_post_op(
                _graph_binding_materialization_spec(
                    nodes=self._nodes,
                    pattern=self._pattern,
                ),
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=self._collect_auxiliary_ctes(ctx),
            needs_recursive_with=True,
        )


class ExecuteGraphAggregateStep(_BaseExecuteGraphStep[list[dict[str, object]]]):
    def result_cardinality(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def step_tags(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "graph", "query", "aggregate"})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        group_field_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
        for group_field in self._pattern.group_by:
            field_name = str(group_field).rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
            group_field_counts[field_name] = group_field_counts.get(field_name, 0) + 1

        aggregation_aliases = {aggregation.alias for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations}
        group_leaf_names = {str(group_field).rsplit(".", 1)[-1] for group_field in self._pattern.group_by}

        def aggregation_output_name(alias: str) -> str:
            return f"aggregate_{alias}" if alias in group_leaf_names else alias

        def output_name(raw: object) -> str:
            value = str(raw)
            if "." not in value and value in aggregation_aliases:
                return aggregation_output_name(value)
            field_name = value.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
            if (group_field_counts.get(field_name, 0) > 1 or field_name in aggregation_aliases) and "." in value:
                variable_name = value.split(".", 1)[0]
                return f"{variable_name}_{field_name}"
            return field_name

        if self._pattern.overview_aggregation is not None:
            columns = tuple(self._pattern.overview_aggregation.output_columns)
        elif self._pattern.select_fields:
            columns = tuple(select_field.alias or output_name(select_field.expression) for select_field in self._pattern.select_fields)
        else:
            columns = tuple(
                [output_name(field) for field in self._pattern.group_by]
                + [aggregation.alias for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations],
            )
        columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))
        if not columns:
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()

        aggregation_columns = {
            aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias)
            for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations
            if aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias) in columns
        }
        group_columns = set(columns) - aggregation_columns
        typed_columns: dict[str, set[str]] = {
            attribute: set()
            for attribute in (
                "jsonb_columns",
                "uuid_columns",
                "timestamptz_columns",
                "date_columns",
                "time_columns",
                "numeric_columns",
                "bool_columns",
                "integer_columns",
                "bigint_columns",
                "double_columns",
                "text_columns",
                "bytea_columns",
            )
        }
        variable_models: dict[str, type[GraphNode[Any]] | type[GraphEdge[Any]]] = {
            variable: node.node_type for variable, node in self._nodes.items()
        }
        for path in _iter_graph_pattern_paths(self._pattern):
            variable_models[path.source.variable] = path.source.node_type
            variable_models[path.target.variable] = path.target.node_type
            if path.edge.variable is not None:
                variable_models[path.edge.variable] = path.edge.edge_type

        def add_field_type(output_column: str, field_path: str) -> str | None:
            if "." not in field_path:
                return None
            variable_name, field_name = field_path.split(".", 1)
            model_cls = variable_models.get(variable_name)
            if model_cls is None:
                return None
            db_column = get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))
            source_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, (db_column,))
            if source_hints is None:
                return None
            for attribute, target in typed_columns.items():
                if db_column in getattr(source_hints, attribute):
                    target.add(output_column)
                    return attribute
            return None

        for group_field in self._pattern.group_by:
            output_column = output_name(group_field)
            if add_field_type(output_column, group_field) is None:
                typed_columns["text_columns"].add(output_column)
        hinted_group_columns = set().union(*typed_columns.values())
        typed_columns["text_columns"].update(group_columns - hinted_group_columns)

        for aggregation in self._pattern.aggregations:
            output_column = aggregation_output_name(aggregation.alias)
            if output_column not in aggregation_columns:
                continue
            function = aggregation.function.upper()
            if function == "COUNT":
                typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add(output_column)
                continue
            if function in {"AVG", "STDDEV", "VARIANCE"}:
                typed_columns["double_columns"].add(output_column)
                continue
            source_attribute = add_field_type(output_column, aggregation.expression) if isinstance(aggregation.expression, str) else None
            if source_attribute is None:
                typed_columns["double_columns"].add(output_column)
            elif function == "SUM" and source_attribute == "integer_columns":
                typed_columns["integer_columns"].discard(output_column)
                typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add(output_column)

        if self._pattern.overview_aggregation is not None:
            typed_columns["text_columns"].update({"kind", "type_name"})
            typed_columns["bigint_columns"].add("count")
            typed_columns["text_columns"].discard("count")
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(
            bigint_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bigint_columns"]),
            double_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["double_columns"]),
            jsonb_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["jsonb_columns"]),
            uuid_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["uuid_columns"]),
            timestamptz_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["timestamptz_columns"]),
            date_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["date_columns"]),
            time_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["time_columns"]),
            numeric_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["numeric_columns"]),
            bool_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bool_columns"]),
            integer_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["integer_columns"]),
            text_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["text_columns"]),
            bytea_columns=frozenset(typed_columns["bytea_columns"]),
        ).filtered(set(columns))
        source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        _contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            columns,
            column_type_hints,
        )
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(_contract_model_cls),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=None if source_tables is None else frozenset(str(table) for table in source_tables),
        )

    def compile(self: ExecuteGraphAggregateStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
        dispatched = self._compile_persisted_policy_dispatch(ctx)
        if dispatched is not None:
            return dispatched
        from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledStep as CompiledStepFactory

        builder = self._build_graph_query_builder(ctx)
        compile_plans = self._build_traversal_compile_plans(ctx)
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStepFactory(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=builder._build_aggregate_grammar(compile_plans=compile_plans),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            auxiliary_ctes=self._collect_auxiliary_ctes(ctx),
            needs_recursive_with=True,
        )


def _graph_intent_dependency_contract(
    *,
    dependencies: frozenset[str],
    sql_visible: frozenset[str],
    auth_scope: frozenset[str],
) -> StepDependencyContract:
    return StepDependencyContract(
        consumed_refs=frozenset(
            ConsumedRef(
                ref=ref,
                source=DependencySource.GRAPH_CONFIG,
                required_for=frozenset(
                    {
                        DependencyUse.ORDERING,
                        *((DependencyUse.SQL_VISIBLE,) if ref in sql_visible else ()),
                        *((DependencyUse.AUTH_SCOPE,) if ref in auth_scope else ()),
                    },
                ),
            )
            for ref in dependencies
        ),
        transport=TransportDependencyPolicy.TRANSPORTABLE,
        materialization=MaterializationDependencyPolicy.NONE,
        reason="graph visibility and relation dependencies are explicit",
    )


class SelectVisibleGraphIntent[GraphT: Graph[Any]](
    VersionedSelectOneIntent[GraphT],
):
    """Permission-filtered graph-row producer with explicit visibility facts."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        graph_type: type[GraphT],
        config: ScalarServerRef[_VersionedSelectOneConfig],
        *,
        snapshot_revision_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id, model_cls=graph_type, config=config)
        self.graph_type = graph_type
        self.snapshot_revision_ref = snapshot_revision_ref

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        dependencies = set(super().dependencies())
        if self.snapshot_revision_ref is not None:
            dependencies.add(str(self.snapshot_revision_ref))
        return frozenset(dependencies)

    def graph_visibility_contract(self) -> GraphVisibilityProducerContract:
        graph_id_ref = self.sys_id.ref_id
        revision_ref = self.snapshot_revision_ref if self.snapshot_revision_ref is not None else self.revision_id.ref_id
        branch_ref = None if self.branch_id is None else self.branch_id.ref_id
        if graph_id_ref is None or revision_ref is None:
            msg = "graph visibility inputs must be symbolic refs"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return GraphVisibilityProducerContract(
            role=GraphVisibilityProducerRole.VISIBLE_GRAPH_ROWS,
            graph_type=self.graph_type,
            output_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw_rows"),
            source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(graph_id_ref),
            graph_id_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.raw_rows.sys_id"),
            revision_ref=ServerPlanRefId(revision_ref),
            branch_anchor_ref=(None if branch_ref is None else ServerPlanRefId(branch_ref)),
        )

class _RequirePermittedGraphRowIntentConfig:

    error_message: str

class RequirePermittedGraphRowStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[object]):
    """SQL-visible graph guard that preserves the permitted graph relation."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        error_message: str,
        publication_contract: CtePublicationContract,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._error_message = error_message
        self._publication_contract = publication_contract

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"validation", "permission", "graph", "sql_projection"})

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return None

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        source_tables = self._publication_contract.source_tables
        if source_tables is None:
            raise ValueError("Graph validation publication must declare its source tables")
        return source_tables

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref)})

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        return self._publication_contract

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[object]:
        delegate = RequirePermittedRowStep[object](
            self.ref_id,
            config=_RequirePermittedRowConfig(
                source_ref=self._source_ref,
                error_message=self._error_message,
                columns=tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in self._publication_contract.columns),
            ),
        )
        compiled = delegate.compile(ctx)
        from l2070_batching.compilation import compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract

        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self._publication_contract,
        )
        return replace(
            compiled,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        )

def _find_replay_loop(steps: list[Any]) -> ReplayLoopStep:
    replay = next((step for step in steps if isinstance(step, ReplayLoopStep)), None)
    if replay is not None:
        return replay
    for step in steps:
        if isinstance(step, ConditionalStep):
            nested = next((child for child in step.then_plan.steps if isinstance(child, ReplayLoopStep)), None)
            if nested is not None:
                return nested
    raise AssertionError("ReplayLoopStep not found")


def _materialized_replay_steps(
    replay: ReplayLoopStep,
    resolved: ResolvedRefs,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    chain = resolved.get(str(replay._chain_ref_id))
    fork = resolved.get(str(replay._fork_ref_id))
    source_branch_id = resolved.get(str(replay._source_branch_id_ref_id))
    target_branch_id = resolved.get(str(replay._target_branch_id_ref_id))
    target_tip = resolved.get(str(replay._target_tip_ref_id))
    assert isinstance(chain, list)
    assert isinstance(fork, RevisionId)
    assert isinstance(source_branch_id, BranchId | str)
    assert isinstance(target_branch_id, BranchId | str)
    assert isinstance(target_tip, RevisionId | str)
    return _build_replay_terminal_steps(
        domain=replay._domain,
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(replay.ref_id),
        chain=chain,
        fork=fork,
        source_branch_id=source_branch_id,
        target_branch_id=target_branch_id,
        target_tip=target_tip,
        revision_table=str(replay._revision_table),
        revision_parents_table=str(replay._revision_parents_table),
        branch_table=str(replay._branch_table),
        index_table=str(replay._index_table),
        session_id_raw=str(replay._session_id),
        table_names=[str(table) for table in replay._table_names],
        sparse_tables=[str(table) for table in replay._sparse_tables],
        tip_tables=[str(table) for table in replay._tip_tables],
        data_columns_by_table=[[str(column) for column in columns] for columns in replay._data_columns_by_table],
        revision_metadata=dict(replay._revision_metadata),
    )

def test_merge_intent_lowers_with_explicit_gate_subgraph() -> None:
    steps = list(_merge_intent(ref_id="merge_intent", domain=_domain(), strategy="theirs").lower(_ctx()))

    step_ids = _step_ids(steps)
    conditional_steps = [step for step in steps if isinstance(step, ConditionalStep)]

    assert "merge.is_utd" in step_ids
    assert "merge.is_ff" in step_ids
    assert "merge.is_diverged" in step_ids
    assert "merge.is_three_way" in step_ids
    conditional_ids = {str(step.ref_id) for step in conditional_steps}
    assert "merge.result_utd" in step_ids
    assert "merge.result_utd" in conditional_ids
    assert "merge.cond_diverged" in conditional_ids
    assert "merge.cond_ff" not in conditional_ids
    assert "merge.cond_three_way" not in conditional_ids
    assert "merge.result_ff" in step_ids
    assert "merge.result_ff" in conditional_ids
    assert "merge.result_conflict" in step_ids
    assert "merge.result_conflict" in conditional_ids
    assert "merge.result_three_way" in step_ids
    assert "merge.result_three_way" in conditional_ids
    assert steps[-1].ref_id == "merge_intent"

    conditional_by_id: dict[str, ConditionalStep] = {str(step.ref_id): step for step in conditional_steps}
    assert conditional_by_id["merge.result_utd"].can_batch() is False
    assert conditional_by_id["merge.result_conflict"].can_batch() is False
    assert conditional_by_id["merge.cond_diverged"].can_batch() is True

def test_three_way_no_ff_gate_compile_carries_branch_result_binding_spec() -> None:
    steps = list(_merge_intent(ref_id="merge_intent", domain=_domain(), strategy="three-way-no-ff").lower(_ctx()))
    gate = next(step for step in steps if step.ref_id == "merge.result_three_way")
    cte_refs: dict[str, CteReference] = {}
    for upstream in steps[: steps.index(gate)]:
        contract = upstream.cte_publication_contract()
        if contract is None or not contract.columns:
            continue
        cte_refs[str(upstream.ref_id)] = CteReference(
            ServerPlanRefId(upstream.ref_id),
            columns=contract.columns,
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
            scalar_control_kind=contract.scalar_control_kind,
            scalar_value_column=contract.scalar_value_column,
        )
    ctx = make_compilation_context(
        profile=make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES),
        cte_refs=cte_refs,
    )

    compiled = compile_sql_step(gate, ctx)

    assert compiled.batch_result_plan is not None
    assert compiled.batch_result_plan.result_aliases == (
        (
            "merge.result_three_way",
            "merge.result_three_way__body",
            "merge.result_three_way_default",
        ),
    )
    assert compiled.result_relation is not None
    assert compiled.output_shape is not None
    expected_columns = (
        "status",
        "operation_id",
        "base_revision_id",
        "source_revision_id",
        "target_revision_id",
        "result_revision_id",
        "inserted",
        "updated",
        "deleted",
        "conflicts",
    )
    assert compiled.result_relation.terminal_materialization_shape == expected_columns
    assert compiled.output_shape.cte_output_columns == expected_columns

class _ValidationBoundaryContractStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    def __init__(self, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId, replacement: ServerPlanStep[None] | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._replacement = replacement

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def after_prerequisite_validation_boundary(self) -> ServerPlanStep[None]:
        return self._replacement if self._replacement is not None else self

def test_replay_loop_builds_sqlite_revision_and_parent_insert_shapes() -> None:
    intent_ref = "rebase_compile_fusion"
    replay = _find_replay_loop(
        list(
            RebaseIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId(intent_ref),
                domain=_domain(),
                workspace_id=ServerRefs.scalar(WorkspaceId("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001")),
                source_branch_name=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchName("feature")),
                target_branch_name=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchName("main")),
                session_id=_session_id_ref(),
                revision_metadata=_message_metadata("Rebase 'feature' onto 'main'"),
            ).lower(_ctx()),
        ),
    )
    terminal_steps = _materialized_replay_steps(
        replay,
        _resolved_replay_refs(
            intent_ref,
            chain=[RevisionId("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000906")],
        ),
    )

    revision_step = next(step for step in terminal_steps if str(step.ref_id).endswith(".rev.0"))
    parent_step = next(step for step in terminal_steps if str(step.ref_id).endswith(".parent.0"))
    guards = [step for step in terminal_steps if ".permission.0." in str(step.ref_id)]
    assert guards
    assert all(terminal_steps.index(guard) < terminal_steps.index(revision_step) for guard in guards)
    assert str(guards[-1].ref_id) in revision_step.dependencies()
    assert str(revision_step.ref_id) in parent_step.dependencies()

    revision_compiled = revision_step.compile(_compile_ctx())
    parent_compiled = parent_step.compile(_compile_ctx())

    assert revision_compiled.grammar is not None
    revision_sql = render_grammar_sql(revision_compiled.grammar, SqliteDialect())
    revision_parsed = parse_sql(revision_sql, dialect="sqlite")
    revision_insert = revision_parsed.find(sqlglot_exp.Insert)
    assert revision_insert is not None
    assert "mril_revisions" in revision_sql
    assert "parent_revision_sys_id" in revision_sql

    assert parent_compiled.grammar is not None
    parent_sql = render_grammar_sql(parent_compiled.grammar, SqliteDialect())
    parent_parsed = parse_sql(parent_sql, dialect="sqlite")
    parent_insert = parent_parsed.find(sqlglot_exp.Insert)
    assert parent_insert is not None
    assert "sys_revision_parents" in parent_sql
    assert "parent_revision_sys_id" in parent_sql

    if "staged_commit_id" not in model_cls.model_fields:
        return
    msg = "UpsertManyRawResultStep cannot compile for versioned models yet"
    raise NotImplementedError(msg)


def _require_concrete_upsert_many_instances(instances: object) -> Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow]:
    from l2055_lazy_result.lazy_result import LazyResult
    from l2070_batching.server_ref import ObjectSequenceServerRef

    if isinstance(instances, (LazyResult, ObjectSequenceServerRef)):
        msg = (
            "UpsertManyRawResultStep.compile() no longer resolves lazy/server payloads from "
            "compile-time materialization; rebuild bulk upsert on explicit prerequisite refs"
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    resolved_instances = cast("Sequence[DatabaseObjectRow]", instances)
    if not any(collect_instance_deps(instance) for instance in resolved_instances):
        return resolved_instances
    msg = (
        "UpsertManyRawResultStep.compile() no longer resolves embedded ServerRef values from "
        "compile-time materialization; publish prerequisite refs before bulk upsert compile()."
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_literal_assignment_override_count(
    literal_assignment_overrides: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]] | None,
    row_plans: Sequence[_ResolvedWriteRowPlan],
) -> None:
    if literal_assignment_overrides is None or len(literal_assignment_overrides) == len(row_plans):
        return
    msg = (
        "literal_assignment_overrides must match the resolved upsert row count: "
        f"rows={len(row_plans)}, overrides={len(literal_assignment_overrides)}"
    )
    raise ValueError(msg)


type _UpsertRowMetadataName = Literal["supplemental rows", "authored return rows"]


def _require_upsert_row_metadata_count(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    metadata_name: _UpsertRowMetadataName,
    metadata_count: int,
    row_count: int,
) -> None:
    """Reject partially aligned physical metadata before SQL construction."""
    if metadata_count == row_count:
        return
    msg = (
        f"{model_cls.__name__} bulk upsert {metadata_name} must match its candidate count: "
        f"candidates={row_count}, {metadata_name}={metadata_count}"
    )
    raise ValueError(msg)


def _authored_return_values_by_column(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    assignments: Sequence[AuthoredReturnAssignments],
    returning_columns: Sequence[SqlColumnName],
) -> tuple[dict[SqlColumnName, DatabaseValue], ...]:
    """Validate and index authored logical values for SQL result projection."""
    allowed_columns = frozenset(returning_columns)
    expected_signature = tuple(assignment.column for assignment in assignments[0]) if assignments else ()
    indexed_rows: list[dict[SqlColumnName, DatabaseValue]] = []
    for row_index, row_assignments in enumerate(assignments):
        signature = tuple(assignment.column for assignment in row_assignments)
        if signature != expected_signature:
            msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} authored return columns must be uniform across candidates: candidate={row_index}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        indexed: dict[SqlColumnName, DatabaseValue] = {}
        for assignment in row_assignments:
            if assignment.column not in allowed_columns:
                msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} cannot project unknown authored return column {str(assignment.column)!r}"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            if assignment.column in indexed:
                msg = f"{model_cls.__name__} has duplicate authored return column {str(assignment.column)!r} for candidate {row_index}"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            indexed[assignment.column] = assignment.value
        indexed_rows.append(indexed)
    return tuple(indexed_rows)


def _require_uniform_upsert_many_columns(
    row_plans: Sequence[_ResolvedWriteRowPlan],
) -> None:
    canonical_columns = row_plans[0].columns
    for row_plan in row_plans[1:]:
        if row_plan.columns == canonical_columns:
            continue
        msg = (
            "UpsertManyStep requires a uniform write column signature across all rows. "
            f"expected={canonical_columns!r}, actual={row_plan.columns!r}"
        )
        raise ValueError(msg)

    )

def _build_custom_update(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    on_conflict: _ConflictUpdateMap | None,
    *,
    db_column_source: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None = None,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable | None]] | None:
    """Build custom update expressions from on_conflict dict."""
    if on_conflict is None:
        return None
    assert isinstance(on_conflict, Mapping)

    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.expression_grammar import ExpressionToGrammar
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name
    from l1000_schema.typed_field import Expression
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import is_writable_field

    db_source = db_column_source or model_cls
    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    converter = ExpressionToGrammar(db_source, table_alias=table_name)
    custom_update: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable | None]] = []
    for field_name, expr in on_conflict.items():
        candidate_name = getattr(field_name, "name", None)
        py_field_name = candidate_name if isinstance(candidate_name, str) else str(field_name)
        if not is_writable_field(db_source, py_field_name):
            continue
        db_col: str = get_db_column_name(db_source, DynamicFieldName(py_field_name))
        if expr is None:
            custom_update.append((db_col, None))
            continue
        if isinstance(expr, Expression):
            custom_update.append((db_col, converter.convert(expr)))
            continue
        custom_update.append((db_col, None))
    return custom_update


def _build_conflict_where(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    on_conflict_where: object | None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    """Build an optional conflict-side WHERE clause from an expression."""
    if on_conflict_where is None:
        return None

    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.expression_grammar import ExpressionToGrammar
    from l1000_schema.typed_field import Expression

    if isinstance(on_conflict_where, Expression):
        table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
        converter = ExpressionToGrammar(model_cls, table_alias=table_name)
        conflict_where: SqlRenderable | None = converter.convert(on_conflict_where)
        return conflict_where
    if isinstance(on_conflict_where, SqlRenderable):
        return on_conflict_where

    msg = f"on_conflict_where must be an Expression or SqlRenderable, got {type(on_conflict_where).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _build_change_detection_conflict_where(
    *,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    columns: Sequence[str],
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    """Build a NULL-safe SQL predicate that updates only changed conflict rows."""
    if not columns:
        return None
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_upsert import (
        SqlUpsertExcludedValue,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, sql_or

    comparisons = tuple(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=SqlTableName(table_name)),
            BinaryOp.IS_DISTINCT_FROM,
            SqlUpsertExcludedValue(SqlColumnName(column)),
        )
        for column in columns
    )
    return sql_or(*comparisons)


def _build_mysql_change_detection_set_items(
    *,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    update_col_names: Sequence[str],
    change_detection_cols: Sequence[str],
) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, ...] | None:
    """Build MySQL-family conditional assignments for change-detection upserts."""
    if not change_detection_cols:
        return None
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_upsert import (
        SqlUpsertExcludedValue,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSetItem
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp, UnaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCase
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlUnaryOp, sql_and

    unchanged_checks = tuple(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=SqlTableName(table_name)),
            BinaryOp.IS_NOT_DISTINCT_FROM,
            SqlUpsertExcludedValue(SqlColumnName(column)),
        )
        for column in change_detection_cols
    )
    changed_condition = SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, sql_and(*unchanged_checks))
    return tuple(
        SqlSetItem(
            SqlColumnName(column),
            SqlCase(
                whens=((changed_condition, SqlUpsertExcludedValue(SqlColumnName(column))),),
                else_=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier=SqlTableName(table_name)),
                dialect_conditional=True,
            ),
        )
        for column in update_col_names
    )


def _none_if_sql_true_literal(expr: SqlRenderable | None, dialect: Any) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    if expr is None:
        return None
    rendered = expr.render(dialect)
    if rendered._params:
        return expr
    sql = rendered._sql.strip().upper()
    if sql in {"TRUE", "1"}:
        return None
    tokens = sql.replace("(", " ").replace(")", " ").split()
    if tokens and all(token in {"TRUE", "AND"} for token in tokens) and any(token == "TRUE" for token in tokens):
        return None
    return expr


def _cte_binding_returning_output_shape(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    columns: Sequence[str],
) -> CompiledOutputShape:
    """Return the physical DB columns exposed by ``INSERT ... RETURNING *``."""

    db_to_field = {
        get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)): field_name for field_name in cached_model_fields(model_cls)
    }
    bytea_columns = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, tuple(columns))
    bytea_names = bytea_columns.bytea_columns if bytea_columns is not None else frozenset()
    return CompiledOutputShape(
        tuple(
            CompiledOutputField(
                output_name=column,
                output_column=column,
                source_db_column=column,
                model_field_name=db_to_field.get(SqlColumnName(column), column),
                owner_cls=model_cls,
                is_binary=column in bytea_names,
            )
            for column in columns
        ),
    )


def _conflict_key_positions(
    columns: Sequence[str],
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> tuple[int, ...] | None:
    """Return conflict-key column positions when all keys are present."""
    if not all(column in columns for column in conflict_columns):
        return None
    return tuple(columns.index(column) for column in conflict_columns)

def _unique_conflict_targets_from_model(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog,
    write_plan: _WriteMetadataPlan,
) -> set[tuple[str, ...]]:
    table_shape = planning_catalog.table_for_model(model_cls)
    table_config = table_shape.table_config

    def _db_columns(columns: Sequence[object]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        result: list[str] = []
        for column in columns:
            if not isinstance(column, str):
                continue
            result.append(write_plan.field_to_db_column.get(column, column))
        return tuple(result)

    targets: set[tuple[str, ...]] = {tuple(write_plan.default_conflict_db_columns)}
    for field_name, field_info in cached_model_fields(model_cls).items():
        field_extra = field_info.json_schema_extra
        if isinstance(field_extra, dict) and field_extra.get("unique") is True:
            targets.add((write_plan.field_to_db_column.get(field_name, field_name),))
    primary_key = table_config.primary_key
    if primary_key is not None:
        primary_key_columns = _db_columns(getattr(primary_key, "columns", ()))
        if primary_key_columns:
            targets.add(primary_key_columns)
    for index in table_config.indexes:
        if not getattr(index, "unique", False):
            continue
        if getattr(index, "where", None) is not None or getattr(index, "expressions", None):
            continue
        index_columns = _db_columns(getattr(index, "columns", ()))
        if index_columns:
            targets.add(index_columns)
    for constraint in table_config.constraints:
        if not getattr(constraint, "unique", False):
            continue
        constraint_columns = _db_columns(getattr(constraint, "columns", ()))
        if constraint_columns:
            targets.add(constraint_columns)
    for field_name, field_info in model_cls.model_fields.items():
        json_schema_extra = field_info.json_schema_extra
        if not isinstance(json_schema_extra, Mapping):
            continue
        if not bool(json_schema_extra.get("unique")):
            continue
        targets.add((write_plan.field_to_db_column.get(field_name, get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))),))
    return targets


def _require_declared_unique_conflict_target(
    *,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog,
    write_plan: _WriteMetadataPlan,
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> None:
    conflict_target = tuple(conflict_columns)
    if conflict_target == (get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")),):
        return
    declared_targets = _unique_conflict_targets_from_model(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        planning_catalog=planning_catalog,
        write_plan=write_plan,
    )
    if any(
        len(declared_target) == len(conflict_target) and frozenset(declared_target) == frozenset(conflict_target)
        for declared_target in declared_targets
    ):
        # Conflict-target inference is based on the indexed column set. SQL
        # callers can name a composite unique target in either column order.
        return
    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    msg = (
        f"Upsert conflict columns for {table_name} are not backed by a declared primary key, "
        f"unique index, or unique constraint: {conflict_target!r}. Declare "
        "Index(..., unique=True) or UniqueConstraint(...) on the model before using "
        "upsert_many/insert_if_absent_many with these conflict columns."
    )
    raise ValueError(msg)


def retained_upsert_candidate_indices(
    row_plans: Sequence[_ResolvedWriteRowPlan],
    conflict_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    """Return global last-winner indexes for one explicit conflict target."""
    return retained_upsert_candidate_indices_for_targets(row_plans, (conflict_columns,))


def retained_upsert_candidate_indices_for_targets(
    row_plans: Sequence[_ResolvedWriteRowPlan],
    conflict_targets: Sequence[Sequence[str]],
) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    """Return last-winner indexes across all targetless unique constraints."""
    if len(row_plans) < 2:
        return tuple(range(len(row_plans)))
    target_positions: list[tuple[int, ...]] = []
    for conflict_target in conflict_targets:
        positions = _conflict_key_positions(row_plans[0].columns, conflict_target)
        if positions is None:
            msg = f"Conflict target columns are missing from the resolved write row: {tuple(conflict_target)!r}."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        target_positions.append(positions)
    if not target_positions:
        msg = "Candidate resolution requires at least one declared conflict target."
        raise ValueError(msg)

    seen_keys: list[set[tuple[Hashable, ...]]] = [set() for _positions in target_positions]
    retained_reversed: list[int] = []
    for index in range(len(row_plans) - 1, -1, -1):
        row_plan = row_plans[index]
        keys = tuple(
            None
            if any(row_plan.values[position] is None for position in positions)
            else _row_plan_conflict_key(row_plan.values, positions)
            for positions in target_positions
        )
        if any(key is not None and key in seen for key, seen in zip(keys, seen_keys, strict=True)):
            continue
        retained_reversed.append(index)
        for key, seen in zip(keys, seen_keys, strict=True):
            if key is not None:
                seen.add(key)
    return tuple(reversed(retained_reversed))


def _row_plan_conflict_key(
    values: Sequence[object],
    conflict_positions: Sequence[int],
) -> tuple[Hashable, ...]:
    """Project a stable, hashable key from resolved row-plan values."""
    return tuple(_hashable_conflict_key_component(values[position]) for position in conflict_positions)


def _hashable_conflict_key_component(value: object) -> Hashable:
    from datetime import UTC, datetime

    from l2070_batching.server_ref import (
        ServerRef,
        inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning,
    )

    if isinstance(value, ServerRef):
        shape: PlanningServerValueShape = inspect_server_value_shape_for_planning(
            value,
            site="upsert_many.conflict_key",
        )
        if shape.symbolic_ref_id is not None:
            return ("server_ref", str(shape.symbolic_ref_id))
        msg = "upsert_many conflict keys require ServerRef values with ref_ids"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    for method_name in ("unwrap_to_uuid", "unwrap_to_int", "unwrap_to_str", "unwrap_to_sql"):
        unwrap = getattr(value, method_name, None)
        if callable(unwrap):
            return _hashable_conflict_key_component(unwrap())
    if isinstance(value, UUID):
        return ("uuid", str(value))
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is not None and value.utcoffset() is not None:
            return ("aware_datetime", value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat())
        return ("naive_datetime", value.isoformat())
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return tuple(
            sorted(
                ((_hashable_conflict_key_component(key), _hashable_conflict_key_component(item)) for key, item in value.items()),
                key=repr,
            ),
        )
    if isinstance(value, list | tuple):
        return tuple(_hashable_conflict_key_component(item) for item in value)
    if isinstance(value, set | frozenset):
        return tuple(sorted((_hashable_conflict_key_component(item) for item in value), key=repr))
    if isinstance(value, Hashable):
        return value
    msg = f"Upsert conflict key value type {type(value).__name__!r} has no stable hashable representation."
    raise TypeError(msg)
