                nested_source_ref,
                result_prefix=f"{result_prefix}_{planned.request.field_name}",
                requests=planned.request.nested_requests,
                parent_path=planned.edge.ref_key,
                load_cache=load_cache,
            )
            include_compilation.include_refs.update(nested_compilation.include_compilation.include_refs)
            two_hop_refs.update(nested_compilation.two_hop_refs)
            derived_refs.update(nested_compilation.derived_refs)
            child_compilations.update(nested_compilation.child_compilations)
            embedded_refs.update(nested_compilation.embedded_refs)

    for request in requests:
        if request.kind in {"belongs_to", "has_many", "through"}:
            continue
        if request.kind == "two_hop":
            if request.junction_model is None or request.source_key_field is None or request.target_fk_field is None:
                msg = f"Relationship {request.field_name!r} is missing junction lowering metadata"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            relationship_ref = compile_two_hop_relationship_into_plan(
                server_plan,
                parent_ref,
                request=request,
                result_prefix=result_prefix,
                field_name=request.field_name,
                junction_model=request.junction_model,
                target_model=request.target_model,
                source_fk_field=request.source_key_field,
                target_fk_field=request.target_fk_field,
                is_list=request.is_many,
            )
            two_hop_refs[request.field_name] = relationship_ref
            if request.nested_requests:
                child_compilations[request.field_name] = _compile_relationship_requests_into_plan(
                    server_plan,
                    relationship_ref.target_result_ref,
                    result_prefix=f"{result_prefix}_{request.field_name}",
                    requests=request.nested_requests,
                    load_cache=load_cache,
                )
            continue
        if request.kind == "derived":
            if request.lookup_model is None or request.lookup_field is None or request.lookup_key is None:
                msg = f"Relationship {request.field_name!r} is missing derived lowering metadata"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            derived_ref = compile_json_array_derived_relationship_into_plan(
                server_plan,
                parent_ref,
                request=request,
                result_prefix=result_prefix,
                field_name=request.field_name,
                lookup_model=request.lookup_model,
                lookup_field=request.lookup_field,
                lookup_key=request.lookup_key,
            )
            derived_refs[request.field_name] = derived_ref
            if request.nested_requests:
                child_compilations[request.field_name] = _compile_relationship_requests_into_plan(
                    server_plan,
                    derived_ref.lookup_result_ref,
                    result_prefix=f"{result_prefix}_{request.field_name}",
                    requests=request.nested_requests,
                    load_cache=load_cache,
                )
            continue
        if request.kind == "embedded":
            embedded_refs[request.field_name] = EmbeddedRelationshipRef(
                field_name=request.field_name,
                source_field=request.source_key_field or request.field_name,
                filter_expression=request.filter_expression,
                order_by_clauses=request.order_by_clauses,
                count_requested=request.count_requested,
                top=request.top,
                skip=request.skip,
            )
            if request.nested_requests:
                child_compilations[request.field_name] = _compile_relationship_requests_into_plan(
                    server_plan,
                    parent_ref,
                    result_prefix=f"{result_prefix}_{request.field_name}",
                    requests=request.nested_requests,
                    load_cache=load_cache,
                )
            continue
        msg = f"Unhandled relationship request kind: {request.kind}"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)

    return RelationshipCompilation(
        include_compilation=include_compilation,
        two_hop_refs=two_hop_refs,
        derived_refs=derived_refs,
        child_compilations=child_compilations,
        embedded_refs=embedded_refs,
    )


def distribute_relationship_results(
    plan_results: PlanResults,
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    compilation: RelationshipCompilation,
) -> IncludeDataMap:
    """Group compiled relationship results into formatter data."""
    include_data = distribute_plan_results(plan_results, entities, compilation.include_compilation)
    _merge_include_count_results(
        plan_results,
        entities,
        compilation.include_compilation,
        include_data,
    )
    for relationship_ref in compilation.two_hop_refs.values():
        junction_rows = (
            plan_results.get_list(relationship_ref.junction_key_result_id, dict)
            if relationship_ref.junction_key_rows_are_raw
            else _plan_result_include_list(
                plan_results,
                relationship_ref.junction_key_result_id,
                relationship_ref.junction_model,
            )
        )
        junction_payload_rows: Sequence[IncludeEntity] = (
            _plan_result_raw_dict_list(
                plan_results,
                relationship_ref.junction_payload_result_id,
            )
            if relationship_ref.junction_payload_result_id is not None
            else ()
        )
        field_data = build_two_hop_relationship_data(
            entities,
            junction_rows,
            _plan_result_include_list(
                plan_results,
                relationship_ref.target_result_id,
                relationship_ref.target_model,
            ),
            field_name=relationship_ref.field_name,
            source_fk_field=relationship_ref.source_fk_field,
            target_fk_field=relationship_ref.target_fk_field,
            is_list=relationship_ref.is_list,
            top=relationship_ref.top,
            skip=relationship_ref.skip,
            include_junction_payload=relationship_ref.include_junction_payload,
            junction_payload_rows=junction_payload_rows,
        )
        _merge_include_data(include_data, field_data)
        if relationship_ref.count_target_result_id is not None and relationship_ref.is_list:
            _merge_include_count_values(
                include_data,
                entities,
                field_name=relationship_ref.field_name,
                counts=build_two_hop_relationship_counts(
                    entities,
                    junction_rows,
                    _plan_result_include_list(
                        plan_results,
                        relationship_ref.count_target_result_id,
                        relationship_ref.target_model,
                    ),
                    source_fk_field=relationship_ref.source_fk_field,
                    target_fk_field=relationship_ref.target_fk_field,
                ),
            )
        child_compilation = compilation.child_compilations.get(relationship_ref.field_name)
        if child_compilation is not None:
            child_entities = _plan_result_include_list(
                plan_results,
                relationship_ref.target_result_id,
                relationship_ref.target_model,
            )
            child_data = distribute_relationship_results(plan_results, child_entities, child_compilation)
            _merge_include_data(include_data, child_data)
    for derived_ref in compilation.derived_refs.values():
        field_data = build_json_array_derived_relationship_data(
            entities,
            _plan_result_include_list(
                plan_results,
                derived_ref.lookup_result_id,
                derived_ref.lookup_model,
            ),
            field_name=derived_ref.field_name,
            lookup_field=derived_ref.lookup_field,
            lookup_key=derived_ref.lookup_key,
            top=derived_ref.top,
            skip=derived_ref.skip,
        )
        _merge_include_data(include_data, field_data)
        if derived_ref.count_lookup_result_id is not None:
            _merge_include_count_values(
                include_data,
                entities,
                field_name=derived_ref.field_name,
                counts=build_json_array_derived_relationship_counts(
                    entities,
                    _plan_result_include_list(
                        plan_results,
                        derived_ref.count_lookup_result_id,
                        derived_ref.lookup_model,
                    ),
                    lookup_field=derived_ref.lookup_field,
                    lookup_key=derived_ref.lookup_key,
                ),
            )
        child_compilation = compilation.child_compilations.get(derived_ref.field_name)
        if child_compilation is not None:
            child_entities = _plan_result_include_list(
                plan_results,
                derived_ref.lookup_result_id,
                derived_ref.lookup_model,
            )
            child_data = distribute_relationship_results(plan_results, child_entities, child_compilation)
            _merge_include_data(include_data, child_data)
    for embedded_field, embedded_ref in compilation.embedded_refs.items():
        field_data = build_embedded_relationship_data(
            entities,
            field_name=embedded_field,
            source_field=embedded_ref.source_field,
            filter_expression=embedded_ref.filter_expression,
            order_by_clauses=embedded_ref.order_by_clauses,
            top=embedded_ref.top,
            skip=embedded_ref.skip,
        )
        _merge_include_data(include_data, field_data)
        if embedded_ref.count_requested:
            _merge_include_count_values(
                include_data,
                entities,
                field_name=embedded_field,
                counts=build_embedded_relationship_counts(
                    entities,
                    source_field=embedded_ref.source_field,
                    filter_expression=embedded_ref.filter_expression,
                ),
            )
        child_compilation = compilation.child_compilations.get(embedded_field)
        if child_compilation is not None:
            nested_child_entities = _collect_embedded_child_entities(
                field_data,
                field_name=embedded_field,
            )
            child_data = distribute_relationship_results(
                plan_results,
                nested_child_entities,
                child_compilation,
            )
            _merge_include_data(include_data, child_data)
    return include_data


def _merge_include_data(dest: IncludeDataMap, src: IncludeDataMap) -> None:
    for entity_id, fields in src.items():
        dest.setdefault(entity_id, {}).update(fields)


def _merge_include_count_values(
    include_data: IncludeDataMap,
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    field_name: str,
    counts: Mapping[str, int],
    owner_key_field: str = "sys_id",
) -> None:
    count_key = f"{field_name}@count"
    for entity in entities:
        entity_id = _include_entity_id(entity)
        count_lookup_key = entity_id
        if owner_key_field not in {"", "sys_id", "id"}:
            count_lookup_key = _include_id_key(_include_field_value(entity, owner_key_field))
        include_data.setdefault(entity_id, {})[count_key] = counts.get(count_lookup_key, 0)


def _merge_include_count_results(
    plan_results: PlanResults,
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    compilation: CompilationResult,
    include_data: IncludeDataMap,
) -> None:
    top_level: dict[str, CompiledIncludeRef] = {}
    nested: dict[str, CompiledIncludeRef] = {}
    for key, ref in compilation.include_refs.items():
        if ref.parent_path is None:
            top_level[key] = ref
        else:
            nested[key] = ref

    for ref in top_level.values():
        _merge_include_ref_count_results(plan_results, entities, ref, include_data)
    for ref in nested.values():
        parent_path = ref.parent_path
        parent_ref = compilation.include_refs.get(parent_path) if parent_path is not None else None
        parent_entities = (
            list(entities)
            if parent_ref is None
            else [
                _normalize_loaded_include_entity(row, parent_ref.target_model)
                for row in _plan_result_include_list(
                    plan_results,
                    parent_ref.result_ref_id,
                    parent_ref.target_model,
                )
            ]
        )
        _merge_include_ref_count_results(plan_results, parent_entities, ref, include_data)


def _merge_include_ref_count_results(
    plan_results: PlanResults,
    parent_entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    ref: CompiledIncludeRef,
    include_data: IncludeDataMap,
) -> None:
    if ref.count_result_ref_id is None or not ref.is_has_many:
        return
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for row in plan_results.get_list(ref.count_result_ref_id, dict):
        fk_val = row.get(ref.source_key_field)
        if fk_val is None:
            continue
        count_value = row.get("count", 0)
        counts[_include_id_key(fk_val)] = int(count_value)
    _merge_include_count_values(
        include_data,
        parent_entities,
        field_name=ref.field_name,
        counts=counts,
        owner_key_field=ref.owner_key_field,
    )


def build_embedded_relationship_data(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    field_name: str,
    source_field: str,
    filter_expression: Expression | None = None,
    order_by_clauses: Sequence[RelationshipOrderClause] = (),
    top: int | None = None,
    skip: int | None = None,
) -> IncludeDataMap:
    """Project embedded relationship payloads into the canonical include-data map."""
    order_by_clauses = tuple(order_by_clauses)
    relationship_data: IncludeDataMap = {}
    for entity in entities:
        relationship_data.setdefault(_include_entity_id(entity), {})[field_name] = _shape_embedded_relationship_value(
            _include_field_value(entity, source_field),
            filter_expression=filter_expression,
            order_by_clauses=order_by_clauses,
            top=top,
            skip=skip,
        )
    return relationship_data


def build_embedded_relationship_counts(
    entities: Sequence[IncludeEntity],
    *,
    source_field: str,
    filter_expression: Expression | None = None,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Count embedded relationship payloads after filtering and before pagination."""
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for entity in entities:
        shaped = _shape_embedded_relationship_value(
            _include_field_value(entity, source_field),
            filter_expression=filter_expression,
            order_by_clauses=(),
            top=None,
            skip=None,
        )
        if isinstance(shaped, list):
            counts[_include_entity_id(entity)] = len(shaped)
        elif shaped is None:
            counts[_include_entity_id(entity)] = 0
        else:
            counts[_include_entity_id(entity)] = 1
    return counts


def _shape_embedded_relationship_value(
    value: object,
    *,
    filter_expression: Expression | None,
    order_by_clauses: tuple[RelationshipOrderClause, ...],
    top: int | None,
    skip: int | None,
) -> IncludeHydratedValue:
    normalized = _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(value)
    if isinstance(normalized, dict) and "id" in normalized and "sys_id" not in normalized:
        normalized = {**normalized, "sys_id": normalized["id"]}
    elif isinstance(normalized, list):
        normalized = [
            {**item, "sys_id": item["id"]} if isinstance(item, dict) and "id" in item and "sys_id" not in item else item
            for item in normalized
        ]
    if not isinstance(normalized, list):
        if isinstance(normalized, (dict, DatabaseObjectRow)) and not _embedded_item_matches_filter(
            normalized,
            filter_expression,
        ):
            return None
        return cast("IncludeHydratedValue", normalized)
    items = [
        item
        for item in normalized
        if isinstance(item, (dict, DatabaseObjectRow)) and _embedded_item_matches_filter(item, filter_expression)
    ]
    for field_name, direction in reversed(order_by_clauses):
        items.sort(
            key=lambda item, sort_field=field_name: str(_include_field_value(item, sort_field) or ""),
            reverse=direction == "desc",
        )
    return _apply_include_list_pagination(items, skip=skip, top=top)


def _embedded_item_matches_filter(item: IncludeEntity, expression: Expression | None) -> bool:
    if expression is None:
        return True
    supported_operators = frozenset(
        {"=", "eq", "!=", "<>", "ne", ">", "gt", ">=", "gte", "<", "lt", "<=", "lte", "contains", "like", "in", "is null", "is not null"}
    )
    if expression.operator is not None and expression.operator.lower() not in supported_operators:
        raise UnsupportedOperationError(f"Embedded relationship filter does not support operator {expression.operator!r}")
    context = item if isinstance(item, dict) else item.model_dump()
    return bool(expression.evaluate(context))


def _collect_embedded_child_entities(
    field_data: IncludeDataMap,
    *,
    field_name: str,
) -> list[IncludeEntity]:
    """Flatten embedded payloads into child entities for nested distribution."""
    child_entities: list[IncludeEntity] = []
    for fields in field_data.values():
        value = _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(fields.get(field_name))
        if isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value:
                normalized = _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(item)
                if isinstance(normalized, (dict, DatabaseObjectRow)):
                    child_entities.append(normalized)
            continue
        if isinstance(value, (dict, DatabaseObjectRow)):
            child_entities.append(value)
    return child_entities


def _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(value: object) -> object:
    if isinstance(value, JSONType):
        return value.unwrap()
    if isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            decoded = json.loads(value)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return value
        return decoded
    return value


def format_embedded_relationship_value(
    value: object,
    selections: Sequence[EmbeddedRelationshipSelection],
    *,
    serialize_scalar: Callable[[object], object],
) -> object:
    """Format embedded relationship payloads through the shared include pipeline."""
    normalized_value = _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(value)
    if normalized_value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(normalized_value, Mapping):
        result: dict[str, object] = {}
        for selection in selections:
            lookup_name = selection.name
            if selection.name == "id" and "id" not in normalized_value and "sys_id" in normalized_value:
                lookup_name = "sys_id"
            elif selection.name == "sys_id" and "sys_id" not in normalized_value and "id" in normalized_value:
                lookup_name = "id"
            nested_value = _unwrap_embedded_relationship_value(normalized_value.get(lookup_name))
            if selection.nested:
                result[selection.output_name] = format_embedded_relationship_value(
                    nested_value,
                    selection.nested,
                    serialize_scalar=serialize_scalar,
                )
            else:
                result[selection.output_name] = serialize_scalar(nested_value)
        return result
    if isinstance(normalized_value, list):
        return [
            format_embedded_relationship_value(
                item,
                selections,
                serialize_scalar=serialize_scalar,
            )
            for item in normalized_value
        ]
    return serialize_scalar(normalized_value)


@pure_lazy
def _raise_unhandled_relationship_storage_kind(storage_kind: RelationshipStorageKind) -> NoReturn:
    msg = f"Unhandled relationship storage kind: {storage_kind.value}"
    raise NotImplementedError(msg)


@pure_lazy
def _require_dependent_query_support(query: object, *, target_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> None:
    """Fail loudly when a direct plan builder cannot express dependent includes."""
    if callable(getattr(query, "filter_by_ref", None)) and callable(
        getattr(query, "execute_later", None),
    ):
        return
    msg = (
        "Direct include planning requires dependent query support for "
        f"{target_model.__name__}; no fallback include execution path exists."
    )
    raise TypeError(msg)


def compile_includes_into_plan(
    server_plan: ServerPlan,
    parent_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    includes: Sequence[IncludeSpec],
) -> CompilationResult:
    """Compile standard include specs into dependent ServerPlan queries.

    ``IncludeThrough`` remains a caller-owned special case so existing junction
    planning paths do not double-enqueue through-loading work here.
    """
    return _compile_relationship_requests_into_plan(
        server_plan,
        parent_ref,
        result_prefix="include",
        requests=tuple(request for request in _relationship_requests_from_includes(includes) if request.kind != "through"),
    ).include_compilation


class _BuildIncludeHydrationPayloadStep[E: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](
    NonPublishingStep[IncludeHydrationPayload[E]],
):
    """L0 step that prepares include hydration payloads from loaded refs."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _ApplyIncludeHydrationConfig[E],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_entities_ref = config.source_entities_ref
        self._source_model_cls = config.source_model_cls
        self._includes = config.includes
        self._edges = config.edges
        self._literal_source_entities = config.literal_source_entities

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def executor_visible_published_rows(
        self: _BuildIncludeHydrationPayloadStep[E],
    ) -> tuple[dict[str, object], ...]:
        """Runtime-only payload step; no SQL-visible rows."""
        return ()

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"apply", "include", "hydrate"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = {str(ref) for ref in self._source_entities_ref.dependencies()}
        for edge in self._edges:
            deps.add(edge.result_ref_id)
        return frozenset(deps)

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[IncludeHydrationPayload[E]]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(
        self,
        resolved: TerminalResolvedValues,
        hydrator: Hydrator,
    ) -> IncludeHydrationPayload[E]:
        source_ref_id = self._source_entities_ref.ref_id
        runtime_ref_ids = tuple(edge.result_ref_id for edge in self._edges)
        literal_source_entities: tuple[E, ...] = self._literal_source_entities
        if source_ref_id is not None:
            runtime_ref_ids = (source_ref_id, *runtime_ref_ids)
        else:
            literal_source_entities = tuple(_literal_include_entities(self._source_entities_ref))

        if not runtime_ref_ids:
            msg = "include hydration requires at least one SQL-visible source or edge relation."
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return _build_include_hydration_payload(
            source_ref_id,
            literal_source_entities,
            self._source_model_cls,
            _include_edges_for_post_op(self._edges),
            hydrator,
            resolved,
        )


class _ProjectIncludeHydrationEntitiesStep[E: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](NonPublishingStep[list[E]]):
    """Apply include hydration and return the source entities."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        payload_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        includes: tuple[IncludeSpec, ...] = (),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._payload_ref = payload_ref
        self._includes = includes

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"apply", "include", "hydrate", "project"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._payload_ref)})

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[E]]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep()

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: TerminalResolvedValues) -> list[E]:
        payload = resolved.get(str(self._payload_ref))
        if not isinstance(payload, IncludeHydrationPayload):
            msg = f"Expected IncludeHydrationPayload for {self._payload_ref}, got {type(payload).__name__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        entities = list(cast("tuple[E, ...]", payload.source_entities))
        hydrate_entities_from_include_data(
            entities,
            self._includes,
            payload.include_data,
        )
        return entities


class IncludeLoadIntent[E: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](IntentStep[list[E]]):
    """L4 intent that loads includes for a parent entity sequence."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "include", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.MANY
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        config: _IncludeLoadConfig[E],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._config = config
        self._source_entities = self._config.source_entities
        self._includes = self._config.includes
        self._hydration_source_entities = self._config.hydration_source_entities
        self._workspace_id = self._config.workspace_id
        self._source_model_cls = self._config.source_model_cls
        self._session_id = self._config.session_id
        self._permission_context_ref = self._config.permission_context_ref
        self._permission_context_type = self._config.permission_context_type
        self._literal_source_entities = self._config.literal_source_entities
        base_ref = int(ref_id.split("_")[1].split(".")[0])
        self._ref_seed = 10_000_000 + (base_ref * 1_000)

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(
            {
                *self._source_entities.dependencies(),
                *(
                    ()
                    if self._permission_context_ref is None
                    else (str(self._permission_context_ref),)
                ),
            }
        )

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        return _lower_include_load_intent(
            ctx=ctx,
            allocator=_IncludeRefAllocator(self._ref_seed),
            final_ref_id=self.ref_id,
            source_ref=cast(ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity], self._source_entities),
            source_model_cls=self._source_model_cls,
            includes=self._includes,
            workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
            session_id=self._session_id,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
            literal_source_entities=self._literal_source_entities,
            hydration_source_ref=cast(
                ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity] | None,
                self._hydration_source_entities,
            ),
        )


def _lower_include_load_intent(
    *,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    allocator: _IncludeRefAllocator,
    final_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    source_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    source_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow] | None,
    includes: tuple[IncludeSpec, ...],
    workspace_id: WorkspaceId | None,
    session_id: str | None,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None,
    literal_source_entities: tuple[IncludeEntity, ...] = (),
    hydration_source_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity] | None = None,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    resolved_source_model_cls = source_model_cls
    if source_ref.ref_id is None:
        msg = "include source must carry a ref_id"
        raise TypeError(msg)

    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    requests = _relationship_requests_from_includes(includes)
    planned_includes = _compile_include_request_level(
        source_ref,
        requests=requests,
        source_model_cls=resolved_source_model_cls,
        emit_include=lambda request, binding, ref_key: _compile_include_request_into_lowered_steps(
            ctx=ctx,
            allocator=allocator,
            source_ref=source_ref,
            workspace_id=workspace_id,
            session_id=session_id,
            permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
            steps=steps,
            request=request,
            binding=binding,
            ref_key=ref_key,
        ),
    )
    edges = tuple(planned.edge for planned in planned_includes)
    payload_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{final_ref_id}_include_payload")
    steps.append(
        _BuildIncludeHydrationPayloadStep(
            payload_ref_id,
            config=_ApplyIncludeHydrationConfig(
                source_entities_ref=cast(
                    ObjectSequenceServerRef[Any],
                    hydration_source_ref if hydration_source_ref is not None else source_ref,
                ),
                source_model_cls=resolved_source_model_cls,
                includes=includes,
                edges=_include_edges_for_post_op(edges),
                literal_source_entities=cast(tuple[Any, ...], literal_source_entities),
            ),
        ),
    )
    steps.append(
        _ProjectIncludeHydrationEntitiesStep(
            final_ref_id,
            payload_ref_id,
            includes,
        ),
    )
    for planned in planned_includes:
        if not planned.request.nested_include_specs:
            continue
        nested_source_ref = planned.edge.result_ref
        if nested_source_ref is None:
            msg = f"Include edge {planned.edge.ref_key!r} has no symbolic result ref for nested lowering"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        steps.extend(
            _lower_include_load_intent(
                ctx=ctx,
                allocator=allocator,
                final_ref_id=allocator.next_ref(),
                source_ref=nested_source_ref,
                source_model_cls=planned.request.target_model,
                includes=planned.request.nested_include_specs,
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
                literal_source_entities=(),
                hydration_source_ref=cast(
                    ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
                    ServerRefs.from_ref_id(ServerPlanRefId(planned.edge.result_ref_id), variant="object_sequence"),
                ),
            ),
        )
    return steps


def _compile_include_request_into_lowered_steps(
    *,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    allocator: _IncludeRefAllocator,
    source_ref: ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
    workspace_id: WorkspaceId | None,
    session_id: str | None,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None,
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    binding: _IncludeFilterBinding,
    ref_key: str,
) -> CompiledIncludeRef:
    result_ref = allocator.next_ref()
    steps.extend(
        _build_include_query_step(
            ctx=ctx,
            ref_id=result_ref,
            model_cls=request.target_model,
            filter_column=SqlColumnName(binding.filter_column),
            filter_value=_project_include_source_values(
                source_ref,
                SqlColumnName(binding.source_projection_field),
            ),
            workspace_id=workspace_id,
            request=request,
            session_id=session_id,
            permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
        ),
    )
    nested_source_ref = result_ref
    if request.kind in {"has_many", "through"} and request.nested_include_specs:
        nested_source_ref = allocator.next_ref()
        steps.extend(
            _build_include_query_step(
                ctx=ctx,
                ref_id=nested_source_ref,
                model_cls=request.target_model,
                filter_column=SqlColumnName(binding.filter_column),
                filter_value=_project_include_source_values(
                    source_ref,
                    SqlColumnName(binding.source_projection_field),
                ),
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                request=request,
                session_id=session_id,
                permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
            ),
        )
    result_ref_handle = cast(
        ObjectSequenceServerRef[IncludeEntity],
        ServerRefs.from_ref_id(nested_source_ref, variant="object_sequence"),
    )
    return CompiledIncludeRef(
        ref_key=ref_key,
        field_name=request.field_name,
        source_key_field=binding.filter_column,
        owner_key_field=binding.source_projection_field,
        target_model=request.target_model,
        is_has_many=request.kind in {"has_many", "through"},
        result_ref_id=str(result_ref),
        result_ref=result_ref_handle,
        top=request.top,
        skip=request.skip,
    )


def _build_include_query_step(
    *,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    filter_column: SqlColumnName,
    filter_value: IncludeFilterValue,
    workspace_id: WorkspaceId | None,
    request: _RelationshipRequest,
    session_id: str | None = None,
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import is_versioned_operation
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
        lower_spill_read_for_backend,
        should_lower_spill_read,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_query_steps import (
        build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps,
        VersionedQueryFromSpecStep,
        _VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig,
        lower_versioned_spill_aware_query_read_steps,
    )

    operator = "IN" if isinstance(filter_value, list | ScalarSequenceServerRef) else "="
    paged_request = _request_without_list_pagination(request) if request.is_many else request

    if workspace_id is not None and issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
        versioning_domain = ctx.versioning_domain
        if versioning_domain is None:
            versioning_domain = getattr(model_cls, "__versioning_domain__", None)
            assert versioning_domain is None or isinstance(versioning_domain, type)
        if versioning_domain is None:
            versioning_domain = require_versioning_domain(
                ctx,
                site="lower_include_query_steps",
            )
        cross_branch_spec = CrossBranchQuerySpec(
            model_cls=model_cls,
            workspace_id=workspace_id,
            tips_only=True,
            filters=[
                QueryFilter(column=str(filter_column), operator=operator, value=filter_value),
                *([QueryFilter(expression=paged_request.filter_expression)] if paged_request.filter_expression is not None else []),
            ],
            order_by=_request_cross_branch_order_by(paged_request),
            limit=paged_request.top,
            offset=paged_request.skip or 0,
            session_id=session_id if session_id is not None else (None if ctx.session_id is None else str(ctx.session_id)),
            versioning_domain=versioning_domain,
            tip_materialization=(
                BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED if ctx.branch_tip_materialized else BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS
            ),
        )
        return [
            CrossBranchExecuteStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(ref_id),
                model_cls,
                branch_spec=cross_branch_spec,
                config=_CrossBranchExecuteConfig(),
            ),
        ]

    query_spec = QuerySpec(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        select_columns=None,
        distinct=False,
        joins=[],
        filters=[
            QueryFilter(column=str(filter_column), operator=operator, value=filter_value),
            *([QueryFilter(expression=paged_request.filter_expression)] if paged_request.filter_expression is not None else []),
        ],
        order_by=_request_query_spec_order_by(paged_request),
        limit=paged_request.top,
        offset=paged_request.skip,
        group_by=[],
        aggregations=[],
        having=[],
        window_functions=[],
        permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
        permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query_extended import (
        _build_session_user_resolution_steps,
    )

    if is_versioned_operation(model_cls, ctx):
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import _build_session_user_resolution

        leading_steps, user_id_ref_id = _build_session_user_resolution(
            owner_ref_id=ref_id,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            ctx=ctx,
            permission_filtering_enabled=True,
        )
        if ctx.branch_id is not None:
            if should_lower_spill_read(
                ctx=ctx,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                query_spec=query_spec,
                raw_mode=False,
                versioned=True,
            ):
                return [
                    *leading_steps,
                    *lower_versioned_spill_aware_query_read_steps(
                        ref_id=ref_id,
                        model_cls=model_cls,
                        query_spec=query_spec,
                        branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    ),
                ]
            return [
                *leading_steps,
                *build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
                    ref_id=ref_id,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    config=_VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                        query_spec=query_spec,
                        branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        assert ctx.lazy_revision is not None
        assert ctx.branch_table is not None
        resolve_ref, resolve_step = ctx.get_or_create_branch_resolve(ref_id)
        result: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        result.extend(leading_steps)
        if resolve_step is not None:
            result.append(resolve_step)
        if should_lower_spill_read(
            ctx=ctx,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            query_spec=query_spec,
            raw_mode=False,
            versioned=True,
        ):
            result.extend(
                lower_versioned_spill_aware_query_read_steps(
                    ref_id=ref_id,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    query_spec=query_spec,
                    branch_ref_id=resolve_ref,
                    revision_id=ctx.lazy_revision,
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                ),
            )
        else:
            result.extend(
                build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
                    ref_id=ref_id,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    config=_VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                        query_spec=query_spec,
                        branch_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref),
                        revision_ref_id=(None if ctx.lazy_revision.ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(ctx.lazy_revision.ref_id)),
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    ),
                ),
            )
        return result

    leading_steps, user_id_ref_id = _build_session_user_resolution_steps(
        ref_id=ref_id,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        ctx=ctx,
    )
    steps = lower_spill_read_for_backend(
        ctx=ctx,
        ref_id=ref_id,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        query_spec=query_spec,
        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
    )
    if steps:
        return [*leading_steps, *steps]
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import _QueryExecuteStepConfig

    return [
        *leading_steps,
        QueryExecuteStep(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,

def _render_sql(grammar: Any) -> str:

def _merged_params(compiled: Any, dialect: Any) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
    fragment = compiled.grammar.render(dialect)
    _sql_str, embedded_params = fragment.to_sql(dialect)
    embedded = tuple(embedded_params)
    external = tuple(compiled.params or ())
    return external + embedded if compiled.external_params_first else embedded + external

def test_insert_many_raw_uses_unnest_instead_of_chunking_for_postgres(monkeypatch) -> None:
    """Postgres should keep a single statement by switching to the unnest path."""

    monkeypatch.setattr(budget_module, "POSTGRES_MYSQL_FUSED_PARAM_BUDGET", 6)
    step = InsertManyRawStep(
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("imr_0"),
        model_cls=_InsertManyChunkRow,
        config=_InsertManyRawConfig(
            columns=("name", "value"),
            rows=(("a", 1), ("b", 2), ("c", 3), ("d", 4)),
        ),
    )
    compiled = step.compile(_ctx())
    assert isinstance(compiled.grammar, SqlInsertFromUnnest)
    assert compiled.params is None
    dialect = PostgresDialect()
    _sql, params = compiled.grammar.render(dialect).to_sql(dialect)
    assert params
    assert all(isinstance(param, SqlRowColumnArrayParam) for param in params)

    from impl.common.l2160_terminal_prerender_cache.terminal_prerender_cache import (
        compile_terminal_sql,
    )

    _sql, terminal_params, _embedded_params = compile_terminal_sql(
        compiled.grammar,
        external_params=(),
        external_params_first=False,
        dialect=dialect,
    )
    assert all(isinstance(param, SqlRowColumnArrayParam) for param in terminal_params)

    from types import SimpleNamespace

    from impl.postgres.connection import PostgresDriverService

    maintenance = SimpleNamespace(
        _coerce_widened_insert_params=lambda params, _insert_plan: params,
    )
    driver = PostgresDriverService(
        cast(Any, SimpleNamespace(_backend_maintenance_service=maintenance)),
    )
    normalized_params = driver._normalize_postgres_params(
        RawSqlText(_sql),
        terminal_params,
    )
    assert all(isinstance(param, list) for param in normalized_params)

def test_chunked_raw_write_intents_without_vectors_use_only_chunk_refs(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    """Chunked non-vector raw write paths must aggregate only concrete chunk refs."""
    import impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.insert_many_raw as insert_many_module

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        insert_many_module,
        "_rows_per_statement",
        lambda *_, fixed_param_headroom=0: 1,
    )
    rows = [("row-1", "note-1"), ("row-2", "note-2")]
    cases = [
        (
            "imr_chunked_no_vector",
            InsertManyRawIntent(
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("imr_chunked_no_vector"),
                model_cls=_InsertManyRawNoSpillTarget,
                payload=ServerRefs.scalar(
                    _shape_raw_write_payload(
                        _InsertManyRawNoSpillTarget,
                        ["external_slug", "external_note"],
                        rows,
                        _InsertManyRawNoSpillSource,
                    )
                ),
                after_refs=frozenset(),
            ),
        ),
        (
            "umr_chunked_no_vector",
            UpsertManyRawIntent(
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("umr_chunked_no_vector"),
                model_cls=_InsertManyRawNoSpillTarget,
                payload=ServerRefs.scalar(
                    _shape_raw_upsert_payload(
                        _InsertManyRawNoSpillTarget,
                        ["external_slug", "external_note"],
                        rows,
                        ["external_slug"],
                        _InsertManyRawNoSpillSource,
                    )
                ),
            ),
        ),
        (
            "umbr_chunked_no_vector",
            UpsertManyBatchRawIntent(
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("umbr_chunked_no_vector"),
                model_cls=_InsertManyRawNoSpillTarget,
                payload=ServerRefs.scalar(
                    _shape_raw_batch_upsert_payload(
                        _InsertManyRawNoSpillTarget,
                        ["external_slug", "external_note"],
                        rows,
                        ["external_slug"],
                        1,
                        _InsertManyRawNoSpillSource,
                    )
                ),
            ),
        ),
    ]

    for ref_prefix, intent in cases:
        steps = list(intent.lower(_lowering_ctx()))
        aggregate = steps[-1]
        if isinstance(intent, InsertManyRawIntent):
            assert type(aggregate).__name__ == "StaticValueAfterDepsStep"
            assert cast(Any, aggregate)._value == len(rows)
            assert cast(Any, aggregate)._source_refs == [
                f"{ref_prefix}_chunk_0",
                f"{ref_prefix}_chunk_1",
            ]
        else:
            assert type(aggregate).__name__ == "StaticValueAfterDepsStep"
            assert cast(Any, aggregate)._value == len(rows)
            assert cast(Any, aggregate)._source_refs == [
                f"{ref_prefix}_chunk_0",
                f"{ref_prefix}_chunk_1",
            ]

def _validate_standard_renewable_claims(
    claims: TrackedCapabilityTokenClaims,
    *,
    context: RenewableCredentialContext,
    required_audience: CapabilityAudience | None,
    required_action: CapabilityAction,
    validate_principal_identity: bool = True,
) -> None:
    from l6500_evidence.capability_tracking import (
        CapabilityTokenExpiredError,
        CapabilityTokenPermissionDeniedError,
    )

    if claims.is_expired():
        raise CapabilityTokenExpiredError("Capability token has expired")
    expected_audience = required_audience or context.audience
    if claims.audience != expected_audience:
        raise CapabilityTokenPermissionDeniedError(
            required=f"audience {expected_audience}",
            granted=f"audience {claims.audience or 'none'}",
        )
    if not claims.allows_action(required_action):
        raise CapabilityTokenPermissionDeniedError(
            required=f"action {required_action}",
            granted="no matching action grant",
        )
    if validate_principal_identity and context.issuer_id is not None and claims.issuer_id != context.issuer_id:
        raise CapabilityTokenPermissionDeniedError(
            required=f"issuer_id {context.issuer_id}",
            granted=f"issuer_id {claims.issuer_id or 'none'}",
        )
    if validate_principal_identity and context.subject_id is not None and claims.subject_id != context.subject_id:
        raise CapabilityTokenPermissionDeniedError(
            required=f"subject_id {context.subject_id}",
            granted=f"subject_id {claims.subject_id or 'none'}",
        )


def _binding_fingerprint_matches(
    issued_row: CapabilityTokenIssued | None,
    fingerprint: str | None,
) -> bool:
    from l6500_evidence.capability_token import hash_capability_binding_fingerprint

    if issued_row is None:
        return True
    stored_hash = issued_row.binding_fingerprint_hash
    if stored_hash is None:
        return True
    if fingerprint is None:
        return False
    stored_hash_str = str(stored_hash)
    computed_hash = str(hash_capability_binding_fingerprint(fingerprint))
    return computed_hash == stored_hash_str


def _cte_ref_or_raise(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    *,
    site_name: str,
    role: str,
) -> CteReference:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._runtime_replanning_error import (
        raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden,
    )

    ref_key = str(ref_id)
    cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(ref_key)
    if not isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference):
        raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
            site_name=site_name,
            trigger=f"{role} ref {ref_key!r} has no SQL-visible rowset",
            blocked_path=f"{site_name} cannot validate renewable credentials from Python runtime refs.",
            result_contract="renewable credential validation must compile SQL validation fact rows.",
            implementation_requirements=(
                "Publish issued, family, and revocation lookups as SQL-visible CTEs.",
                "Map SQL validation facts to terminal exceptions only after SQL has made the decision.",
            ),
        )
    return cte_ref

def _action_allowed_condition(claims: TrackedCapabilityTokenClaims, action: CapabilityAction) -> Any:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, sql_or

    granted_actions = tuple(str(granted) for granted in claims.granted_actions())
    if not granted_actions:
        return SqlParam(False)
    return sql_or(
        *(
            sql_or(
                SqlBinaryOp(SqlParam(granted), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam("*")),
                SqlBinaryOp(SqlParam(granted), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(str(action))),
            )
            for granted in granted_actions
        ),
    )


def _standard_claim_error_rows(
    *,
    config: _ValidateRenewableAccessTerminalConfig | _ValidateRenewableRefreshTerminalConfig,
    required_audience: CapabilityAudience | None,
    required_action: CapabilityAction,
    validate_principal_identity: bool,
) -> list[Any]:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp, UnaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlFuncCall
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlUnaryOp

    claims = config.claims
    context = config.context
    expected_audience = required_audience or context.audience
    rows = [
        _sql_error_row("token_validation_error", SqlParam(config.token_validation_error is not None)),
        _sql_error_row("expired", SqlBinaryOp(SqlParam(claims.expiry), BinaryOp.LE, SqlFuncCall("CURRENT_TIMESTAMP", []))),
        _sql_error_row(
            "audience",
            SqlBinaryOp(SqlParam(str(claims.audience)), BinaryOp.NE, SqlParam(str(expected_audience))),
        ),
        _sql_error_row("action", SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, _action_allowed_condition(claims, required_action))),
    ]
    if validate_principal_identity and context.issuer_id is not None:
        rows.append(
            _sql_error_row(
                "issuer_id",
                SqlBinaryOp(SqlParam(str(claims.issuer_id)), BinaryOp.NE, SqlParam(str(context.issuer_id))),
            ),
        )
    if validate_principal_identity and context.subject_id is not None:
        rows.append(
            _sql_error_row(
                "subject_id",
                SqlBinaryOp(SqlParam(str(claims.subject_id)), BinaryOp.NE, SqlParam(str(context.subject_id))),
            ),
        )
    return rows


def _renewable_validation_auxiliary_ctes(*refs: CteReference) -> list[tuple[str, Any]] | None:
    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for ref in refs:
        if ref.auxiliary_query is not None and ref.ref_id not in seen:
            auxiliary_ctes.append((ref.ref_id, ref.auxiliary_query))
            seen.add(ref.ref_id)
    return auxiliary_ctes or None


class _RenewableLowerOnlyStep[T](NonPublishingStep[T]):
    intent_tags: frozenset[str] = frozenset({"intent"})
    intent_cardinality: Cardinality = Cardinality.ONE
    intent_read_only: bool = False

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 4

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return self.intent_cardinality

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return self.intent_read_only

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return False

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.intent_tags

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[T]:
        del ctx
        msg = f"L4 {type(self).__name__} must be lowered before compile"
        raise TypeError(msg)

def _post_process_validate_renewable_access(
    config: _ValidateRenewableAccessTerminalConfig,
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    _hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> RenewableAccessClaims:
    from l6500_evidence.capability_tracking import (
        CapabilityTokenRevokedError,
        CapabilityTokenValidationError,
    )

    issued_row = cast("CapabilityTokenIssued | None", runtime_refs.get(str(config.issued_ref)))
    family_row = cast("CapabilityTokenFamily | None", runtime_refs.get(str(config.family_ref)))
    revocation_exists = bool(runtime_refs.get(str(config.revocation_ref)))

    if config.token_validation_error is not None:
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError(config.token_validation_error)
    _validate_standard_renewable_claims(
        config.claims,
        context=config.context,
        required_audience=config.required_audience,
        required_action=config.context.access_action,
    )
    if issued_row is None:
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Unknown token")
    if not _binding_fingerprint_matches(issued_row, config.fingerprint):
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Binding fingerprint mismatch")
    if family_row is None:
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Unknown renewable credential family")
    if family_row.revoked_at is not None:
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Renewable credential family revoked")
    if revocation_exists:
        raise CapabilityTokenRevokedError(config.claims.token_id)
    return RenewableAccessClaims(claims=config.claims)


def _post_process_validate_renewable_refresh(
    config: _ValidateRenewableRefreshTerminalConfig,
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    _hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
    *,
    validate_principal_identity: bool = True,
) -> RenewableRefreshClaims:
    from l6500_evidence.capability_tracking import (
        CapabilityTokenRevokedError,
        CapabilityTokenValidationError,
    )
    from l6510_credentials.constants import (
        REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
        REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_REFRESH_REPLAY,
        SECURITY_EVENT_RENEWABLE_BINDING_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
        SECURITY_EVENT_RENEWABLE_REFRESH_REPLAY,
    )
    from l6510_credentials.renewable_lazy_plan_support import (
        RenewableRollbackInvalidationPayload,
        RenewableRollbackValidationError,
        renewable_resource_hint_from_claims,
    )

    issued_row = cast("CapabilityTokenIssued | None", runtime_refs.get(str(config.issued_ref)))
    family_row = cast("CapabilityTokenFamily | None", runtime_refs.get(str(config.family_ref)))
    revocation_exists = bool(runtime_refs.get(str(config.revocation_ref)))
    family_id = config.claims.family_id
    assert family_id is not None

    if config.token_validation_error is not None:
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError(config.token_validation_error)
    _validate_standard_renewable_claims(
        config.claims,
        context=config.context,
        required_audience=None,
        required_action=config.context.refresh_action,
        validate_principal_identity=validate_principal_identity,
    )
    if issued_row is None:
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Unknown token")
    if family_row is None:
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Unknown renewable credential family")
    if family_row.revoked_at is not None:
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Renewable credential family revoked")
    if not _binding_fingerprint_matches(issued_row, config.fingerprint):
        payload = RenewableRollbackInvalidationPayload(
            family_id=family_id,
            token_id=config.claims.token_id,
            revoked_by=_system_renewable_revoker(),
            revocation_reason=REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
            security_event_type=SECURITY_EVENT_RENEWABLE_BINDING_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
            resource_hint=renewable_resource_hint_from_claims(config.claims),
            audience=config.claims.audience,
            subject_id=config.claims.subject_id,
        )
        raise RenewableRollbackValidationError(
            "Binding fingerprint mismatch",
            payload=payload,
        )
    if family_row.current_refresh_token_id != config.claims.token_id:
        payload = RenewableRollbackInvalidationPayload(
            family_id=family_id,
            token_id=config.claims.token_id,
            revoked_by=_system_renewable_revoker(),
            revocation_reason=REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_REFRESH_REPLAY,
            security_event_type=SECURITY_EVENT_RENEWABLE_REFRESH_REPLAY,
            resource_hint=renewable_resource_hint_from_claims(config.claims),
            audience=config.claims.audience,
            subject_id=config.claims.subject_id,
        )
        raise RenewableRollbackValidationError(
            "Refresh token is not the current family head",
            payload=payload,
        )
    if revocation_exists:
        raise CapabilityTokenRevokedError(config.claims.token_id)
    return RenewableRefreshClaims(claims=config.claims)

def materialize_renewable_family_projection(raw_result: RawResult) -> RenewableCredentialFamily:
    from l6500_evidence.capability_tracking import CapabilityTokenValidationError
    from l6510_credentials.renewable_lazy_plan_support import as_renewable_family

    ranked_rows: list[tuple[int, dict[str, object]]] = []
    for row in raw_result:
        row_dict = dict(row) if not isinstance(row, dict) else dict(row)
        rank_raw = row_dict.pop("__source_rank", 1)
        rank = int(rank_raw) if rank_raw is not None else 1
        ranked_rows.append((rank, row_dict))
    if not ranked_rows:
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Unknown renewable credential family")
    _rank, family_row = min(ranked_rows, key=lambda item: item[0])
    if "created_at" not in family_row and "sys_created_at" in family_row:
        family_row["created_at"] = family_row.pop("sys_created_at")
    if "updated_at" not in family_row and "sys_updated_at" in family_row:
        family_row["updated_at"] = family_row.pop("sys_updated_at")
    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.row_converter import convert_row_to_model

    family = convert_row_to_model(
        CapabilityTokenFamily,
        family_row,
        select_columns=list(family_row),
        hydrate_large_columns=False,
    )
    assert isinstance(family, CapabilityTokenFamily)
    return as_renewable_family(family)


def materialize_renewable_refresh_replay_validation(
    config_value: object | None,
    raw_result: RawResult,
) -> None:
    if _first_error_code(raw_result) is None:
        return None
    config = config_value
    if not isinstance(config, _RaiseRenewableRefreshReplayConfig):
        msg = "Renewable refresh replay validation requires replay config"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    _post_process_raise_renewable_refresh_replay(config, raw_result, cast("Hydrator", object()))
    return None

def _first_error_code(raw_result: RawResult) -> str | None:
    for row in raw_result:
        row_dict = dict(row) if not isinstance(row, dict) else row
        value = row_dict.get("error_code")
        if value is not None:
            return str(value)
    return None


def _raise_standard_claim_error(
    error_code: str,
    *,
    config: _ValidateRenewableAccessTerminalConfig | _ValidateRenewableRefreshTerminalConfig,
    required_audience: CapabilityAudience | None,
    required_action: CapabilityAction,
) -> None:
    from l6500_evidence.capability_tracking import (
        CapabilityTokenExpiredError,
        CapabilityTokenPermissionDeniedError,
        CapabilityTokenValidationError,
    )

    if error_code == "token_validation_error":
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError(str(config.token_validation_error))
    if error_code == "expired":
        raise CapabilityTokenExpiredError("Capability token has expired")
    expected_audience = required_audience or config.context.audience
    if error_code == "audience":
        raise CapabilityTokenPermissionDeniedError(
            required=f"audience {expected_audience}",
            granted=f"audience {config.claims.audience or 'none'}",
        )
    if error_code == "action":
        raise CapabilityTokenPermissionDeniedError(
            required=f"action {required_action}",
            granted="no matching action grant",
        )
    if error_code == "issuer_id":
        raise CapabilityTokenPermissionDeniedError(
            required=f"issuer_id {config.context.issuer_id}",
            granted=f"issuer_id {config.claims.issuer_id or 'none'}",
        )
    if error_code == "subject_id":
        raise CapabilityTokenPermissionDeniedError(
            required=f"subject_id {config.context.subject_id}",
            granted=f"subject_id {config.claims.subject_id or 'none'}",
        )


def _verify_renewable_token_at_execution(
    token: str,
    *,
    expected_kind: str,
    expected_claims: TrackedCapabilityTokenClaims,
    hydrator: Hydrator[Any] | None,
) -> TrackedCapabilityTokenClaims:
    """Verify token authenticity through executor-owned runtime services."""
    if hydrator is None:
        return expected_claims
    from l2070_batching.hydrator import RuntimeHydrator
    from l6510_credentials.renewable_lazy_plan_support import decode_renewable_token

    if not isinstance(hydrator, RuntimeHydrator):
        return expected_claims
    services = hydrator.runtime_services
    runtime = services.renewable_capability if services is not None else None
    if runtime is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Renewable capability runtime is required to validate renewable credentials")
    claims = decode_renewable_token(runtime, token, expected_kind=expected_kind)
    if claims != expected_claims:
        raise RuntimeError("Renewable claims changed between planning and execution")
    return claims


def materialize_renewable_access_validation(
    config_value: object | None,
    raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator[Any] | None = None,
) -> RenewableAccessClaims:
    from l6500_evidence.capability_tracking import (
        CapabilityTokenRevokedError,
        CapabilityTokenValidationError,
    )

    config = _require_access_config(config_value)
    error_code = _first_error_code(raw_result)
    if error_code is None:
        claims = _verify_renewable_token_at_execution(
            config.token,
            expected_kind="renewable_access",
            expected_claims=config.claims,
            hydrator=hydrator,
        )
        return RenewableAccessClaims(claims=claims)
    _raise_standard_claim_error(
        error_code,
        config=config,
        required_audience=config.required_audience,
        required_action=config.context.access_action,
    )
    if error_code == "unknown_token":
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Unknown token")
    if error_code == "fingerprint_mismatch":
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Binding fingerprint mismatch")
    if error_code == "unknown_family":
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Unknown renewable credential family")
    if error_code == "family_revoked":
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Renewable credential family revoked")
    if error_code == "token_revoked":
        raise CapabilityTokenRevokedError(config.claims.token_id)
    raise CapabilityTokenValidationError(f"Unknown renewable access validation error: {error_code}")


def _refresh_rollback_error(
    error_code: str,
    *,
    config: _ValidateRenewableRefreshTerminalConfig,
) -> RenewableRollbackValidationError:
    from l6510_credentials.constants import (
        REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
        REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_REFRESH_REPLAY,
        SECURITY_EVENT_RENEWABLE_BINDING_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
        SECURITY_EVENT_RENEWABLE_REFRESH_REPLAY,
    )
    from l6510_credentials.renewable_lazy_plan_support import (
        RenewableRollbackInvalidationPayload,
        RenewableRollbackValidationError,
        renewable_resource_hint_from_claims,
    )

    if error_code == "fingerprint_mismatch":
        reason = REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH
        event_type = SECURITY_EVENT_RENEWABLE_BINDING_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH
        message = "Binding fingerprint mismatch"
    elif error_code == "refresh_replay":
        reason = REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_REFRESH_REPLAY
        event_type = SECURITY_EVENT_RENEWABLE_REFRESH_REPLAY
        message = "Refresh token is not the current family head"
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown renewable refresh rollback error code: {error_code}")
    family_id = config.claims.family_id
    assert family_id is not None
    payload = RenewableRollbackInvalidationPayload(
        family_id=family_id,
        token_id=config.claims.token_id,
        revoked_by=_system_renewable_revoker(),
        revocation_reason=reason,
        security_event_type=event_type,
        resource_hint=renewable_resource_hint_from_claims(config.claims),
        audience=config.claims.audience,
        subject_id=config.claims.subject_id,
    )
    return RenewableRollbackValidationError(message, payload=payload)


def _raise_refresh_rollback_error(
    error_code: str,
    *,
    config: _ValidateRenewableRefreshTerminalConfig,
) -> None:
    raise _refresh_rollback_error(error_code, config=config)


def materialize_renewable_refresh_validation(
    config_value: object | None,
    raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator[Any] | None = None,
) -> RenewableRefreshClaims:
    from l6500_evidence.capability_tracking import (
        CapabilityTokenRevokedError,
        CapabilityTokenValidationError,
    )

    config = _require_refresh_config(config_value)
    error_code = _first_error_code(raw_result)
    if error_code is None:
        claims = _verify_renewable_token_at_execution(
            config.token,
            expected_kind="renewable_refresh",
            expected_claims=config.claims,
            hydrator=hydrator,
        )
        return RenewableRefreshClaims(claims=claims)
    _raise_standard_claim_error(
        error_code,
        config=config,
        required_audience=None,
        required_action=config.context.refresh_action,
    )
    if error_code == "unknown_token":
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Unknown token")
    if error_code == "unknown_family":
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Unknown renewable credential family")
    if error_code == "family_revoked":
        raise CapabilityTokenValidationError("Renewable credential family revoked")
    if error_code in {"fingerprint_mismatch", "refresh_replay"}:
        _raise_refresh_rollback_error(error_code, config=config)
    if error_code == "token_revoked":
        raise CapabilityTokenRevokedError(config.claims.token_id)
    raise CapabilityTokenValidationError(f"Unknown renewable refresh validation error: {error_code}")

    config_value: object | None,
    raw_result: RawResult,
    hydrator: Hydrator[Any] | None = None,
) -> None:

                row=self._config.revocation_claim_row,
                after_refs=frozenset({family_head_ref}),
            ),
        )
        update_head = QueryUpdateStep(
            update_head_ref,
            CapabilityTokenFamily,
            _QueryUpdateStepConfig(
                query_spec=_renewable_bound_family_head_query(
                    claims.family_id,
                    claims.token_id,
                    self._config.fingerprint,
                ),
                updates={
                    "current_refresh_token_id": artifacts.refresh_claims.token_id,
                },
                after_refs=frozenset({revoke_claim_ref}),
            ),
        )
        rotation_query = _renewable_family_head_query(
            claims.family_id,
            artifacts.refresh_claims.token_id,
        )
        access_issued = build_issued_record_from_claims(artifacts.access_claims)
        refresh_issued = build_issued_record_from_claims(artifacts.refresh_claims)
        success_writes: tuple[ServerPlanStep[Any], ...] = (
            QueryUpdateStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.refresh_lineage"),
                CapabilityTokenIssued,
                _QueryUpdateStepConfig(
                    query_spec=_renewable_unreplaced_issued_query(
                        claims.token_id,
                        claims.family_id,
                        artifacts.refresh_claims.token_id,
                    ),
                    updates={
                        "replaced_by_token_id": artifacts.refresh_claims.token_id,
                    },
                    after_refs=frozenset({update_head_ref}),
                ),
            ),
            InsertStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.access_insert"),
                CapabilityTokenIssued,
                ServerRefs.object(access_issued),
                _InsertStepConfig(
                    literal_instance=access_issued,
                    after_refs=frozenset({update_head_ref}),
                    gate_query_spec=rotation_query,
                ),
            ),
            InsertStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.refresh_insert"),
                CapabilityTokenIssued,
                ServerRefs.object(refresh_issued),
                _InsertStepConfig(
                    literal_instance=refresh_issued,
                    after_refs=frozenset({update_head_ref}),
                    gate_query_spec=rotation_query,
                ),
            ),
        )

        fingerprint_event = _renewable_rotation_denial_event(
            event_type=SECURITY_EVENT_RENEWABLE_BINDING_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
            claims=claims,
            resource_hint=self._config.replay_resource_hint,
            occurred_at=occurred_at,
        )
        fingerprint_mismatch_query = _renewable_fingerprint_mismatch_family_query(
            claims.family_id,
            claims.token_id,
            self._config.fingerprint,
        )
        fingerprint_family = QueryUpdateStep(
            fingerprint_family_ref,
            CapabilityTokenFamily,
            _QueryUpdateStepConfig(
                query_spec=fingerprint_mismatch_query,
                updates={
                    "revoked_at": occurred_at,
                    "revoked_by_principal_id": revoker.principal_id,
                    "revoked_by_principal_type": revoker.principal_type,
                    "revocation_reason": REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
                },
                after_refs=frozenset({active_family_ref}),
            ),
        )
        fingerprint_event_steps = tuple(
            InsertIntent(
                fingerprint_event_ref,
                CapabilitySecurityEvent,
                ServerRefs.object(fingerprint_event),
                ServerRefs.scalar(
                    _shape_insert_intent_config(
                        fingerprint_event,
                        after_refs=frozenset({fingerprint_family_ref}),
                    ),
                ),
            )._lower_with_gate(
                ctx,
                _renewable_family_revocation_reason_query(
                    claims.family_id,
                    REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH,
                ),
            ),
        )
        fingerprint_denial: tuple[ServerPlanStep[Any], ...] = (
            fingerprint_family,
            *fingerprint_event_steps,
        )

        replay_event = _renewable_rotation_denial_event(
            event_type=SECURITY_EVENT_RENEWABLE_REFRESH_REPLAY,
            claims=claims,
            resource_hint=self._config.replay_resource_hint,
            occurred_at=occurred_at,
        )
        replay_query = _renewable_stale_family_head_query(
            claims.family_id,
            claims.token_id,
            artifacts.refresh_claims.token_id,
            self._config.fingerprint,
        )
        replay_family = QueryUpdateStep(
            replay_family_ref,
            CapabilityTokenFamily,
            _QueryUpdateStepConfig(
                query_spec=replay_query,
                updates={
                    "revoked_at": occurred_at,
                    "revoked_by_principal_id": revoker.principal_id,
                    "revoked_by_principal_type": revoker.principal_type,
                    "revocation_reason": REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_REFRESH_REPLAY,
                },
                after_refs=frozenset({active_family_ref}),
            ),
        )
        replay_event_steps = tuple(
            InsertIntent(
                replay_event_ref,
                CapabilitySecurityEvent,
                ServerRefs.object(replay_event),
                ServerRefs.scalar(
                    _shape_insert_intent_config(
                        replay_event,
                        after_refs=frozenset({replay_family_ref}),
                    ),
                ),
            )._lower_with_gate(
                ctx,
                _renewable_family_revocation_reason_query(
                    claims.family_id,
                    REVOKE_REASON_FAMILY_REFRESH_REPLAY,
                ),
            ),
        )
        return (
            *validation_steps,
            family_head,
            revocation_claim,
            update_head,
            *success_writes,
            *fingerprint_denial,
            replay_family,
            *replay_event_steps,
        )

"""Gated-CTE compilation for :class:`ConditionalStep` (#2372 §5).

This module implements the structural gated-CTE compile pass for the
``ConditionalStep`` primitive:

* All gating happens at the IR level via
  :func:`gate_grammar_structurally`; grammars that cannot be gated
  structurally raise :class:`ConditionalBranchNotGatableError` rather
  than routing through rendered-SQL rewriting.
* No regular expressions, no rendered-SQL inspection, no string
  manipulation on ``SqlFragment._sql`` / ``SqlFragment._params``.
  This invariant is enforced by
  ``scripts/lint_no_sql_string_manipulation.py`` (Phase 4.2d).

The emitted SQL shape is::

    WITH gate_t_<id> AS (SELECT 1 AS __gate WHERE <pred> [AND NOT <skip>]),
         gate_e_<id> AS (SELECT 1 AS __gate WHERE NOT (<pred>) [AND NOT <skip>]),
         branch_t_<id>_0 AS (<gated then step 0 grammar>),
         ... one CTE per then-branch step ...,
         branch_e_<id>_0 AS (<gated else step 0 grammar>),
         ... one CTE per else-branch step ...,
         proj_<outer> AS (
            SELECT <then_inner.v> AS v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gate_t_<id>)
            UNION ALL
            SELECT <else_inner.v> AS v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gate_e_<id>)
         ),
         ... one projection CTE per output binding ...
    SELECT 1 AS __forced
    FROM (SELECT 1) AS __base
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT 1 FROM <first side-effect CTE>) AS __ref_0 ON TRUE
    ...

The trailing ``LEFT JOIN`` chain is the portable cross-backend way to
force every data-modifying CTE to execute regardless of which branch
fired; PostgreSQL/MariaDB/SQLite all require a top-level reference to
each side-effect CTE or the optimiser is free to skip it.
"""
