def _build_local_queue_sequence_offset_expr(
    prepared_cte: CteReference,
    source_alias: str,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Normalize plan-wide offsets for one ordered insert statement."""
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlTableAlias
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import AggregateKind, BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlAggregate, SqlFuncCall, SqlSubquery
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlLiteral
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

    minimum_alias = SqlAliasName("queue_values_for_minimum_offset")
    minimum_offset = SqlFuncCall(
        "COALESCE",
        [
            SqlSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlAggregate(
                        AggregateKind.MIN,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__sequence_offset"), qualifier=minimum_alias),
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(
                        SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(prepared_cte.ref_id)),
                        minimum_alias,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            SqlLiteral(1),
        ],
    )
    source_offset = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__sequence_offset"), qualifier=source_alias)
    return SqlBinaryOp(
        SqlBinaryOp(source_offset, BinaryOp.SUB, minimum_offset),
        BinaryOp.ADD,
        SqlLiteral(1),
    )


def _build_latest_queue_sequence_expr(
    *,
    queue_name: QueueName,
    message_type: QueueInsertMessageModel,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlTableAlias
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import AggregateKind, BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlAggregate, SqlFuncCall, SqlSubquery
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlLiteral, SqlParam
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

    queue_alias = SqlAliasName("queue_messages_for_sequence")
    return SqlFuncCall(
        "COALESCE",
        [
            SqlSubquery(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlAggregate(
                        AggregateKind.MAX,
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sequence_id"), qualifier=queue_alias),
                    ),
                    from_=SqlTableAlias(
                        SqlTableIdent(get_table_name(message_type)),
                        queue_alias,
                    ),
                    where=SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("queue_name"), qualifier=queue_alias),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(queue_name),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            SqlLiteral(0),
        ],
    )

def _prepared_queue_source_columns(
    *,
    insert_columns: list[str],
    db_columns: Sequence[str],
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Columns published by queue prepare rows before sequence allocation."""
    return tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            [
                *(column for field_name, column in zip(insert_columns, db_columns, strict=True) if field_name != "sequence_id"),
                "__sequence_offset",
            ],
        ),
    )


def _queue_source_column_sql_types(
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
    hints: SqlColumnTypeHints,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    sql_types: list[str] = []
    for column in columns:
        if column in hints.jsonb_columns:
            sql_types.append("JSONB")
        elif column in hints.uuid_columns:
            sql_types.append("UUID")
        elif column in hints.timestamptz_columns:
            sql_types.append("TIMESTAMPTZ")
        elif column in hints.date_columns:
            sql_types.append("DATE")
        elif column in hints.bool_columns:
            sql_types.append("BOOLEAN")
        elif column in hints.integer_columns:
            sql_types.append("INTEGER")
        elif column in hints.bigint_columns:
            sql_types.append("BIGINT")
        elif column in hints.double_columns:
            sql_types.append("DOUBLE PRECISION")
        elif column in hints.bytea_columns:
            sql_types.append("BYTEA")
        elif column in hints.text_columns:
            sql_types.append("TEXT")
        else:
            msg = f"Queue prepared source column {column!r} has no SQL type hint."
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return tuple(sql_types)


def _typed_queue_source_column_sql_types(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
    hints: SqlColumnTypeHints,
) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is not DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
        return None
    return _queue_source_column_sql_types(columns, hints)


def _queue_message_column_type_hints(
    message_type: QueueInsertMessageModel,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    column_type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(message_type, columns)
    if column_type_hints is None:
        msg = f"Queue message model {message_type.__name__} has no SQL type hints."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    payload_json_column = "payload_json"
    return SqlColumnTypeHints(
        jsonb_columns=column_type_hints.jsonb_columns - frozenset({payload_json_column}),
        uuid_columns=column_type_hints.uuid_columns,
        timestamptz_columns=column_type_hints.timestamptz_columns,
        date_columns=column_type_hints.date_columns,
        time_columns=column_type_hints.time_columns,
        numeric_columns=column_type_hints.numeric_columns,
        bool_columns=column_type_hints.bool_columns,
        integer_columns=column_type_hints.integer_columns,
        bigint_columns=column_type_hints.bigint_columns,
        double_columns=column_type_hints.double_columns,
        text_columns=column_type_hints.text_columns | frozenset({payload_json_column}),
        bytea_columns=column_type_hints.bytea_columns,
    )


class _PrepareQueueInsertRowsStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[list[dict[str, object]]]):
    """Publish queue insert payload rows as an executor-visible relation."""

    optimizer_projection_owned = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        target: _QueueEnqueueTarget,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._target = target
        self._prepared = _prepare_queue_insert(target)
        source_column_names = tuple(str(column) for column in self._prepared.source_columns)
        self._prepared_rows = [dict(zip(source_column_names, row, strict=True)) for row in self._prepared.rows]

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "queue", "prepare", "insert"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def _cte_output_columns(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return tuple(self._prepared.source_columns)

    def _cte_column_type_hints(self) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        return _prepared_queue_column_type_hints(
            self._target.message_type,
            tuple(self._prepared.source_columns),
        )

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = self._cte_output_columns()
        column_type_hints = self._cte_column_type_hints()
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        from l2070_batching.cte_contracts import projection_over_model_contract

        return projection_over_model_contract(
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            source_model_cls=self._target.message_type,
            projection_lineage=tuple(
                (str(column), "literal:sequence_offset" if column == "__sequence_offset" else str(column)) for column in columns
            ),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def semantic_publication_columns(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return self.cte_publication_contract().columns

    def semantic_publication_type_hints(self) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        return self.cte_publication_contract().column_type_hints

    def executor_visible_published_rows(self) -> Sequence[Mapping[str, object]]:
        return self._prepared_rows

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._projected_row_source import (
            build_projected_row_select,
        )
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import (
            CompiledOutputShape,
            DeclaredResultRelation,
            synthetic_output_field,
        )

        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=build_projected_row_select(
                rows=self._prepared.rows,
                db_columns=self._prepared.source_columns,
                ctx=ctx,
                column_types=_typed_queue_source_column_sql_types(
                    ctx,
                    tuple(self._prepared.source_columns),
                    contract.column_type_hints,
                ),
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            output_shape=CompiledOutputShape(
                tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in contract.columns),
            ),
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(
                CompiledOutputShape(
                    tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in contract.columns),
                ),
            ),
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
        )


class _QueueSettlementCountAssertionStep(ServerPlanStep[None]):
    """Require every requested queue settlement to match its active claim."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        settlement_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        expected_count: QueueSettlementExpectedCount,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._settlement_ref = settlement_ref
        self._expected_count = expected_count

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._settlement_ref})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "queue", "claim", "assertion"})

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import (
            SqlAliasName,
            SqlColumnName,
            SqlTableName,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_error_gate import (
            count_equals_assertion_query,
            expected_count_assertion_post_op,
            sql_assertion_column_type_hints,
            sql_assertion_output_shape,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectList, SqlTableAlias
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
        from l1100_exceptions import QueueClaimLostError
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import DeclaredResultRelation

        # Settlement effects must fail in the same transaction as the row-count gate.
        # See docs/design/SERVERPLAN_ARCHITECTURE.md.
        binding = ctx.cte_refs[str(self._settlement_ref)]
        alias = SqlAliasName("settled")
        count_query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("count"), qualifier=alias)]),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(binding.ref_id)), alias=alias),
        )
        count_detail = f"expected {self._expected_count} active row(s)"
        claim_detail = f"{count_detail} for {self._settlement_ref}"
        error_message = f"Queue claim was lost before settlement: {claim_detail}"
        auxiliary_query = binding.auxiliary_query
        if auxiliary_query is None:
            auxiliary_ctes = None
        else:
            auxiliary_ctes = [(binding.ref_id, auxiliary_query)]
        shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=count_equals_assertion_query(
                count_query,
                self._expected_count,
                error_message=error_message,
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=expected_count_assertion_post_op(
                error_message,
                exc_type=QueueClaimLostError,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
            output_shape=shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(shape),
            column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
        )


class _QueueInsertPermissionEffectMode(Enum):
    """Control authorization and materialization for queue insert effects."""

    STANDARD = "standard"
    TRUSTED_INLINE = "trusted_inline"
    TRUSTED_MATERIALIZED = "trusted_materialized"


class _QueueInsertPermissionAssertionStep(ServerPlanStep[None]):
    """Reject queue payload rows that do not satisfy insert authorization."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        prepared_rows: _PreparedQueueInsert,
        message_type: QueueInsertMessageModel,
        after_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        effect_mode: _QueueInsertPermissionEffectMode = _QueueInsertPermissionEffectMode.STANDARD,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._prepared_rows = prepared_rows
        self._message_type = message_type
        self._after_ref = after_ref
        self._effect_mode = effect_mode

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset((self._after_ref,) if self._after_ref is not None else ())

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
        from l4000_permissions.permission_registry import get_permission_scheme

        if self._effect_mode is not _QueueInsertPermissionEffectMode.STANDARD:
            return frozenset()
        scheme = get_permission_scheme(self._message_type)
        if scheme is None:
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset(get_table_name(model_type) for model_type in scheme.get_required_tables())

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "queue", "permission", "insert"})

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self) -> bool:
        return self._effect_mode is _QueueInsertPermissionEffectMode.TRUSTED_MATERIALIZED

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlGrammarKind
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._projected_row_source import (
            build_projected_row_select,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.runtime_ref_projection import (
            _compile_permission_where,
            _object_write_denial_message,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_error_gate import (
            no_rows_assertion_query,
            sql_assertion_column_type_hints,
            sql_assertion_output_shape,
            sql_assertion_post_op,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_cte_helpers import (
            SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlUnaryOp, UnaryOp
        from l1100_exceptions.exceptions import PermissionError as DbPermissionError
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import DeclaredResultRelation

        # Authorization stays on prepared source rows inside the insert plan.
        # See docs/design/PERMISSION_SERVERPLAN_SQL_LOWERING.rst.
        where = (
            None
            if self._effect_mode is not _QueueInsertPermissionEffectMode.STANDARD
            else _compile_permission_where(
                self._message_type,
                ctx,
                table_alias="src",
                action="insert",
            )
        )
        shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        if where is None:
            return CompiledStep(
                closed_post_op=literal_post_op(None),
                output_shape=shape,
                result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(shape),
                column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
            )
        source_name = SqlGrammarKind("__queue_permission_rows")
        hints = _prepared_queue_column_type_hints(
            self._message_type,
            tuple(self._prepared_rows.source_columns),
        )
        source_query = build_projected_row_select(
            rows=self._prepared_rows.rows,
            db_columns=self._prepared_rows.source_columns,
            ctx=ctx,
            column_types=_typed_queue_source_column_sql_types(
                ctx,
                tuple(self._prepared_rows.source_columns),
                hints,
            ),
        )
        denied_rows = SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides(
            source_cte_name=source_name,
            source_columns=tuple(self._prepared_rows.source_columns),
            overrides={},
            where_conditions=(SqlUnaryOp(UnaryOp.NOT, where),),
            column_type_hints=hints,
        )
        error_message = _object_write_denial_message(self._message_type, ctx)
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=no_rows_assertion_query(denied_rows, error_message=error_message),
            needs_returning=True,
            auxiliary_ctes=[(str(source_name), source_query)],
            closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(error_message, exc_type=DbPermissionError),
            output_shape=shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(shape),
            column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
        )


def _prepared_queue_column_type_hints(
    message_type: QueueInsertMessageModel,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
    model_columns = tuple(column for column in columns if column != "__sequence_offset")
    model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(message_type, model_columns)
    if model_hints is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Queue message model {message_type.__name__} has no SQL type hints.")
    return SqlColumnTypeHints(
        jsonb_columns=model_hints.jsonb_columns - frozenset({"payload_json"}),
        uuid_columns=model_hints.uuid_columns,
        timestamptz_columns=model_hints.timestamptz_columns,
        date_columns=model_hints.date_columns,
        time_columns=model_hints.time_columns,
        numeric_columns=model_hints.numeric_columns,
        bool_columns=model_hints.bool_columns,
        integer_columns=model_hints.integer_columns | frozenset({"__sequence_offset"}),
        bigint_columns=model_hints.bigint_columns,
        double_columns=model_hints.double_columns,
        text_columns=model_hints.text_columns | frozenset({"payload_json"}),
        bytea_columns=model_hints.bytea_columns,
    )

class _QueueEventDispatchStep(ServerPlanStep[list[QueueMessage]]):
    """Dispatch queue subscription events after SQL-visible queue rows resolve."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        event_type: QueueEventType,
        message_type: type[QueueMessage] = QueueMessage,
        writer_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._source_ref: ServerPlanRefId = source_ref
        self._writer_ref = writer_ref
        self._event_type: QueueEventType = event_type
        self._message_type = message_type

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"queue", "event", "dispatch"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        refs = {str(self._source_ref)}
        if self._writer_ref is not None:
            refs.add(str(self._writer_ref))
        return frozenset(refs)

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self) -> bool:
        return False

    def publishes_decoded_value_as_executor_value(self) -> bool:
        """Keep hydrated queue rows opaque at the terminal API boundary."""
        return True

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[QueueMessage]]:
        del ctx
        return CompiledStep(
            lifecycle_effects=(ResultBoundLifecycleEffects(self._lifecycle_effects_from_result),),
        )

    def execute_runtime(self, resolved: TerminalResolvedValues) -> object:
        return self._messages_from_resolved(resolved)

    def _messages_from_resolved(self, resolved: TerminalResolvedValues) -> list[QueueMessage]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.row_hydration import _resolved_raw_payload

        result = _resolved_raw_payload(resolved, self._source_ref)
        messages: list[QueueMessage] = []
        if isinstance(result, Sequence) and not isinstance(result, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
            for item in result:
                if isinstance(item, self._message_type):
                    messages.append(item)
                elif isinstance(item, Mapping):
                    if set(item) == {"__executor_value__"}:
                        nested = item.get("__executor_value__")
                        if isinstance(nested, Sequence) and not isinstance(nested, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
                            for nested_item in nested:
                                if isinstance(nested_item, QueueMessage):
                                    messages.append(nested_item)
                                elif isinstance(nested_item, Mapping):
                                    messages.append(
                                        self._message_from_mapping(
                                            _QueueMessageRowPayload(nested_item),
                                        ),
                                    )
                        continue
                    messages.append(
                        self._message_from_mapping(
                            _QueueMessageRowPayload(item),
                        ),
                    )
        return messages

    def _lifecycle_effects_from_result(
        self,
        result: object,
    ) -> Sequence[_DispatchDirectQueueMessageEventsEffect]:
        messages: list[QueueMessage] = []
        if isinstance(result, Sequence) and not isinstance(result, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
            for item in cast("Sequence[object]", result):
                if isinstance(item, QueueMessage):
                    messages.append(item)
                elif isinstance(item, Mapping):
                    messages.append(self._message_from_mapping(_QueueMessageRowPayload(item)))
        return (
            _DispatchDirectQueueMessageEventsEffect(

class _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep(ServerPlanStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]):
    """Execute a query terminal only after explicit dependency refs complete."""

    def __init__(
        self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        child_step: ServerPlanStep[Any] | None = None,
        model_cls: type[Any] | None = None,
        query_spec: object | None = None,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] | None = None,
        raw_mode: QueryExecuteRawMode = QueryExecuteRawMode.STANDARD,
        permission_action: PermissionAction | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(_ref_id(ref_id))
        self._child_step = child_step
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._query_spec = query_spec
        self._after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = (
            frozenset(_ref_id(after_ref) for after_ref in after_refs) if after_refs is not None else frozenset()
        )
        self._raw_mode = raw_mode
        self._permission_action = permission_action

    @property
    def level(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "query", "after_deps"})

    def is_read_only(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def result_cardinality(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def tables_read(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        child_tables = self._child_step.tables_read() if self._child_step is not None else frozenset()
        if child_tables:
            return child_tables
        if self._model_cls is None:
            return frozenset()
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name

        return frozenset({get_table_name(self._model_cls)})

    def tables_written(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def requires_materialized_inputs(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep) -> bool:
        return bool(self._after_refs)

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep) -> bool:
        return bool(self._after_refs)

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        model_cls = self._model_cls
        query_spec = self._query_spec
        if model_cls is None and self._child_step is not None:
            model_cls = getattr(self._child_step, "_model_cls", None)
            query_spec = getattr(self._child_step, "_query_spec", query_spec)

        def _raw_query_contract() -> CtePublicationContract | None:
            if model_cls is None:
                return None
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute_raw import (
                QueryExecuteRawStep,
                _QueryExecuteRawStepConfig,
            )

            return QueryExecuteRawStep(
                self.ref_id,
                cast("Any", model_cls),
                _QueryExecuteRawStepConfig(
                    query_spec=cast("Any", query_spec),
                    permission_action=self._permission_action,
                ),
            ).cte_publication_contract()

        raw_contract = _raw_query_contract()
        columns = raw_contract.columns if raw_contract is not None else None

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...] | None) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            if model_cls is None:
                return SqlColumnTypeHints()
            assert raw_contract is not None
            return raw_contract.column_type_hints

        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if columns is None:
            if column_type_hints is not None and column_type_hints.has_any():
                msg = f"{type(self).__name__} declares SQL column type hints without an explicit cte_output_columns() contract."
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        assert raw_contract is not None
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        _contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            contract_columns,
            column_type_hints,
        )
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_contract=raw_contract.relation_contract,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep) -> bool:
        return self._raw_mode is QueryExecuteRawMode.RAW

    def dependencies(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = set(self._after_refs)
        if self._child_step is not None:
            deps.update(ServerPlanRefId(dep) for dep in self._child_step.dependencies())
        elif self._query_spec is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._resolve import collect_query_spec_deps

            deps.update(ServerPlanRefId(dep) for dep in collect_query_spec_deps(self._query_spec))
        return frozenset(deps)

    def compile(self: _QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import (
            build_query_execute_standard_post_op,
            compile_sql_query_execute_step,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute_raw import (
            QueryExecuteRawStep,
            _QueryExecuteRawStepConfig,
        )

        if self._child_step is None:
            if self._model_cls is None:
                msg = "_QueryExecuteAfterDepsStep requires child_step or model_cls"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            if self._raw_mode is QueryExecuteRawMode.RAW:
                return cast(
                    "CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]",
                    QueryExecuteRawStep(
                        self.ref_id,
                        cast("Any", self._model_cls),
                        _QueryExecuteRawStepConfig(
                            query_spec=cast("Any", self._query_spec),
                            permission_action=self._permission_action,
                        ),
                    ).compile(ctx),
                )
            compiled = compile_sql_query_execute_step(
                cast("Any", self._model_cls),
                cast("Any", self._query_spec),
                ctx,
                raw_mode=False,
                resolved_user_id=None,
                closed_post_op=build_query_execute_standard_post_op(
                    cast("Any", self._model_cls),
                    raw_mode=False,
                ),
                step_name=type(self).__name__,
                permission_action=self._permission_action,
            )
            return cast("CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]", compiled)

        child = self._child_step
        child_model_cls = getattr(child, "_model_cls", None)
        child_query_spec = getattr(child, "_query_spec", None)
        child_raw_mode_value = getattr(child, "_raw_mode", self._raw_mode)
        if isinstance(child_raw_mode_value, QueryExecuteRawMode):
            child_raw_mode = child_raw_mode_value
        elif isinstance(child_raw_mode_value, bool):
            child_raw_mode = QueryExecuteRawMode.RAW if child_raw_mode_value else QueryExecuteRawMode.STANDARD
        else:
            msg = f"Unsupported deferred query raw mode: {type(child_raw_mode_value).__name__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if child_raw_mode is QueryExecuteRawMode.RAW:
            return cast(
                "CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]",
                QueryExecuteRawStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    cast("Any", child_model_cls),
                    _QueryExecuteRawStepConfig(
                        query_spec=child_query_spec,
                        user_id_ref_id=getattr(child, "_user_id_ref_id", None),
                        permission_action=self._permission_action,
                    ),
                ).compile(ctx),
            )
        user_id_ref_id = getattr(child, "_user_id_ref_id", None)
        compiled = compile_sql_query_execute_step(
            cast("Any", child_model_cls),
            child_query_spec,
            ctx,
            raw_mode=False,
            resolved_user_id=resolved_permission_user_id_from_ref(user_id_ref_id, ctx),
            closed_post_op=build_query_execute_standard_post_op(
                cast("Any", child_model_cls),
                raw_mode=False,
            ),
            step_name=type(self).__name__,
            permission_action=self._permission_action,
        )
        return cast("CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]", compiled)

def _coerce_generation(value: object) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return int(value)
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return int(value)
    msg = f"Expected int-like generation, got {type(value).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _build_load_cache_generations_stmt(tags: Sequence[str]) -> SqlDynamicSelectStmt:
    return SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
        from_table=_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TABLE,
        columns=[_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL, _CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL],
        where_conditions=[
            SqlIn(
                SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL),
                [SqlParam(tag) for tag in tags],
            ),
        ],
    )


def _coerce_cache_lookup_result(value: object, *, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId) -> _CacheLookupResult:
    if not isinstance(value, _CacheLookupResult):
        msg = f"Expected _CacheLookupResult for {ref_id}, got {type(value).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return value


def _coerce_generation_map(value: object) -> dict[str, int]:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return {str(tag): _coerce_generation(generation) for tag, generation in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
        generations: dict[str, int] = {}
        for row in value:
            if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
                continue
            tag = row.get("tag")
            generation = row.get("generation")
            if tag is None or generation is None:
                continue
            generations[str(tag)] = _coerce_generation(generation)
        return generations
    return {}


def _normalize_rows(raw_result: RawResult) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    return [dict(row) for row in raw_result]


def _build_load_cache_generations_from_cte_stmt(
    tags_cte: CteReference,
    *,
    fill_mode: CacheMissingGenerationMode,
) -> SqlSelect:
    tags_alias = SqlAliasName("cache_tags")
    generations_alias = SqlAliasName("cache_generations")
    generation_expr: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(
        _CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL,
        qualifier=generations_alias,
    )
    if fill_mode is CacheMissingGenerationMode.FILL_MISSING:
        generation_expr = SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", [generation_expr, SqlParam(0)])
    return SqlSelect(
        select_list=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL, qualifier=tags_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("tag"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(generation_expr, SqlAliasName("generation")),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(tags_cte.ref_id)), tags_alias),
        joins=[
            SqlJoin(
                join_type=(JoinKind.LEFT if fill_mode is CacheMissingGenerationMode.FILL_MISSING else JoinKind.INNER),
                table=SqlTableAlias(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TABLE_IDENT, generations_alias),
                condition=SqlJoinOnEq(
                    generations_alias,
                    _CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL,
                    tags_alias,
                    _CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL,
                ),
            ),
        ],
    )


def _cache_generation_updated_at_expr(
    expr: SqlRenderable,
    transport: CacheGenerationTransport,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if transport is CacheGenerationTransport.CTE_UPSERT:
        return cast("SqlRenderable", SqlCast(expr, _TIMESTAMPTZ_CAST_TARGET))
    return expr


def _build_insert_cache_generations_from_rows_cte_stmt(
    rows_cte_name: str,
    *,
    transport: CacheGenerationTransport,
) -> SqlInsert:
    on_conflict: SqlOnConflict | None = None
    if transport is CacheGenerationTransport.CTE_UPSERT:
        on_conflict = SqlOnConflict(
            (_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL,),
            ConflictAction.DO_UPDATE,
            set_items=(
                SqlSetItem(
                    _CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL,
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(
                            _CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL,
                            qualifier=_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TABLE,
                        ),
                        BinaryOp.ADD,
                        SqlParam(1),
                    ),
                ),
                SqlSetItem(
                    _CACHE_GENERATIONS_UPDATED_AT_COL,
                    SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_UPDATED_AT_COL, qualifier=SqlAliasName("excluded")),
                ),
            ),
        )
    return SqlInsert(
        table=_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TABLE_IDENT,
        columns=SqlColumnNameList(
            [
                _CACHE_GENERATIONS_SYS_ID_COL,
                _CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL,
                _CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL,
                _CACHE_GENERATIONS_UPDATED_AT_COL,
            ],
        ),
        values=SqlSelect(
            select_list=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_SYS_ID_COL),
                    SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL),
                    SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL),
                    _cache_generation_updated_at_expr(
                        SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_UPDATED_AT_PAYLOAD_COL),
                        transport,
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(rows_cte_name)),
        ),
        on_conflict=on_conflict,
    )


def _cache_generation_set_column(
    column: SqlColumnName,
    *,
    qualify_target_columns: bool,
) -> SqlColumnName | SqlColumnRef:
    if not qualify_target_columns:
        return column
    return SqlColumnRef(column, qualifier=_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TABLE)


def _build_update_cache_generations_from_rows_cte_stmt(
    rows_cte: CteReference,
    *,
    transport: CacheGenerationTransport,
    qualify_target_columns: bool = False,
) -> SqlUpdate:
    rows_table = SqlTableName(rows_cte.ref_id)
    rows_qualifier = SqlTableName(f"{rows_cte.ref_id}_source") if rows_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else rows_table
    rows_source = (
        SqlSubqueryTableRef(rows_cte.auxiliary_query, rows_qualifier)
        if rows_cte.auxiliary_query is not None
        else SqlTableIdent(rows_table)
    )
    return SqlUpdate(
        table=_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TABLE_IDENT,
        set_items=[
            SqlSetItem(
                _cache_generation_set_column(
                    _CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL,
                    qualify_target_columns=qualify_target_columns,
                ),
                SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL, qualifier=rows_qualifier),
            ),
            SqlSetItem(
                _cache_generation_set_column(
                    _CACHE_GENERATIONS_UPDATED_AT_COL,
                    qualify_target_columns=qualify_target_columns,
                ),
                _cache_generation_updated_at_expr(
                    SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_UPDATED_AT_PAYLOAD_COL, qualifier=rows_qualifier),
                    transport,
                ),
            ),
        ],
        from_=rows_source,
        where=SqlJoinOnEq(
            _CACHE_GENERATIONS_TABLE,
            _CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL,
            rows_qualifier,
            _CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL,
        ),
    )


def _build_prepare_cache_generation_rows_stmt(
    *,
    generations_cte: CteReference,
    invalidation_tags_cte_name: str,
    row_kind: CachePreparedRowKind,
    prepared_at: datetime,
    transport: CacheGenerationTransport,
    invalidation_rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]],
) -> SqlSelect:
    invalidation_alias = SqlAliasName("cache_invalidation_tags")
    generations_alias = SqlAliasName("loaded_generations")
    generation_expr: SqlRenderable
    if row_kind is CachePreparedRowKind.INSERT:
        generation_expr = SqlCast(SqlParam(1), _BIGINT_CAST_TARGET)
    else:
        generation_expr = SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlCast(
                SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL, qualifier=generations_alias),
                _BIGINT_CAST_TARGET,
            ),
            BinaryOp.ADD,
            SqlCast(SqlParam(1), _BIGINT_CAST_TARGET),
        )
    select_items: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    if row_kind is CachePreparedRowKind.INSERT:
        select_items.append(
            SqlSelectAlias(
                SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_SYS_ID_COL, qualifier=invalidation_alias),
                SqlAliasName("sys_id"),
            ),
        )
    select_items.extend(
        [
            SqlSelectAlias(
                SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL, qualifier=invalidation_alias),
                SqlAliasName("tag"),
            ),
            SqlSelectAlias(generation_expr, SqlAliasName("generation")),
            SqlSelectAlias(
                _cache_generation_updated_at_expr(SqlParam(prepared_at), transport),
                SqlAliasName("updated_at"),
            ),
        ],
    )
    joins = [
        SqlJoin(
            join_type=(JoinKind.LEFT if row_kind is CachePreparedRowKind.INSERT else JoinKind.INNER),
            table=SqlTableAlias(
                SqlTableIdent(
                    SqlTableName(
                        _CACHE_GENERATIONS_TABLE if transport is CacheGenerationTransport.INLINE_ROWS_UPDATE else generations_cte.ref_id
                    )
                ),
                generations_alias,
            ),
            condition=SqlJoinOnEq(
                generations_alias,
                _CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL,
                invalidation_alias,
                _CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL,
            ),
        ),
    ]
    where = None
    if row_kind is CachePreparedRowKind.INSERT and transport is not CacheGenerationTransport.CTE_UPSERT:
        where = SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL, qualifier=generations_alias))
    invalidation_source: SqlRenderable
    if transport is not CacheGenerationTransport.INLINE_ROWS_UPDATE:
        invalidation_source = SqlTableAlias(
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(invalidation_tags_cte_name)),
            invalidation_alias,
        )
    else:
        invalidation_source = SqlSubqueryTableRef(
            SqlRequestInputRowsQuery(
                columns=("sys_id", "tag"),
                rows=[dict(row) for row in invalidation_rows],
                type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                    uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"}),
                    text_columns=frozenset({"tag"}),
                ),
            ),
            SqlTableName(str(invalidation_alias)),
        )
    return SqlSelect(
        select_list=SqlSelectList(select_items),
        from_=invalidation_source,
        joins=joins,
        where=where,
    )

def _coerce_prepared_cache_commit(
    value: object,
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
) -> PreparedCacheCommit:
    from impl.common.l1000_cache.transaction import PreparedCacheCommit

    if not isinstance(value, PreparedCacheCommit):
        if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, str | bytes | bytearray):
            return materialize_prepared_cache_commit(cast(RawResult, value))
        msg = f"Expected PreparedCacheCommit for {ref_id}, got {type(value).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return value


def _build_prepared_cache_commit(
    *,
    generations: Mapping[str, int],
    invalidation_tags: Sequence[str],
    write_tags: Sequence[str],
) -> PreparedCacheCommit:
    from impl.common.l1000_cache.transaction import PreparedCacheCommit

    bumped_generations: dict[str, int] = {}
    insert_rows: dict[str, int] = {}
    update_rows: dict[str, int] = {}
    for tag in invalidation_tags:
        current = generations.get(tag, 0)
        new_generation = current + 1
        bumped_generations[tag] = new_generation
        if tag not in generations:
            insert_rows[tag] = new_generation
        else:
            update_rows[tag] = new_generation
    write_generations = {tag: bumped_generations.get(tag, generations.get(tag, 0)) for tag in write_tags}
    return PreparedCacheCommit(
        bumped_generations=bumped_generations,
        write_generations=write_generations,
        insert_generations=insert_rows,
        update_generations=update_rows,
        prepared_at=datetime.now(UTC),
    )


def _build_prepared_cache_generation_rows(
    prepared: PreparedCacheCommit,
    *,
    row_kind: CachePreparedRowKind,
) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    from l1000_cache import CacheGenerationRowId

    source = prepared.insert_generations if row_kind is CachePreparedRowKind.INSERT else prepared.update_generations
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for tag, generation in sorted(source.items()):
        row: dict[str, object] = {
            "tag": tag,
            "generation": generation,
            "updated_at": prepared.prepared_at,
        }
        if row_kind is CachePreparedRowKind.INSERT:
            row["sys_id"] = CacheGenerationRowId.new()
        rows.append(row)
    return rows


def _post_process_resolve_cache_get(
    lookup_ref: str,
    generations_ref: str,
    pending_delete: dict[str, tuple[str, str] | None],
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    _hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> object | None:
    lookup = _coerce_cache_lookup_result(
        runtime_refs.get(lookup_ref),
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(lookup_ref),
    )
    generations = _coerce_generation_map(runtime_refs.get(generations_ref))
    stale_lookup = lookup.value is None and any(
        lookup.tag_generations.get(tag, 0) < lookup.validation_generations.get(tag, 0) for tag in lookup.tags
    )
    stale_db = lookup.needs_db_validation and any(lookup.tag_generations.get(tag, 0) < generations.get(tag, 0) for tag in lookup.tags)
    if stale_lookup or stale_db:
        pending_delete["entry"] = (lookup.cache_name, lookup.key)
        return None
    pending_delete["entry"] = None
    return lookup.value

def _sql_truthy(value: object) -> bool:
    if value is True or value == 1:
        return True
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.lower() in {"1", "t", "true", "y", "yes"}
    return False


def materialize_cache_get_resolution(
    spec: ResultMaterializationSpec,
    raw_result: RawResult,
) -> CacheGetResolution:
    del spec
    row = dict(raw_result[0]) if raw_result else {}
    if _sql_truthy(row.get("is_stale")):
        cache_name = row.get("delete_cache_name")
        key = row.get("delete_key")
        if cache_name is None or key is None:
            msg = "SQL cache stale fact did not include delete coordinates"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return CacheGetResolution(value=None, stale_delete=(str(cache_name), str(key), {}))
    return CacheGetResolution(value=None)


def materialize_populate_local_cache_payload(
    spec: ResultMaterializationSpec,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> PopulateLocalCachePayload:
    """Materialize local-cache population payload from declared generation refs."""
    payload = spec.literal_payload
    if not isinstance(payload, Mapping):
        msg = "populate local cache post-op requires a literal payload"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    generations_ref = payload.get("generations_ref")
    if not isinstance(generations_ref, str):
        msg = "populate local cache post-op requires a generations_ref"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    tags_value = payload.get("tags", ())
    tags = tuple(str(tag) for tag in tags_value) if isinstance(tags_value, tuple) else ()
    generations = _coerce_generation_map(runtime_refs.get(generations_ref))
    if any(generations.get(tag, 0) == 0 for tag in tags):
        from impl.common.l1000_cache import get_cache_manager

        snapshot = get_cache_manager().local_generation_snapshot
        if snapshot is not None:
            generations = {tag: max(generations.get(tag, 0), int(snapshot.get(tag, 0))) for tag in tags}
    return PopulateLocalCachePayload(
        tag_generations={tag: generations.get(tag, 0) for tag in tags},
    )


def _build_prepared_cache_commit_stmt(
    *,
    generations_cte: CteReference,
    touched_tags_cte_name: str,
    prepared_at: datetime,
) -> SqlSelect:
    tags_alias = SqlAliasName("cache_commit_tags")
    generations_alias = SqlAliasName("cache_generations")
    generation = SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL, qualifier=generations_alias)
    current_generation = SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", [generation, SqlParam(0)])
    is_invalidation = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("is_invalidation"), qualifier=tags_alias)
    next_generation = SqlCase(
        [
            (
                is_invalidation,
                SqlBinaryOp(current_generation, BinaryOp.ADD, SqlParam(1)),
            ),
        ],
        else_=current_generation,
    )
    generation_exists = SqlCase(
        [
            (
                SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL, qualifier=generations_alias)),
                SqlParam(0),
            ),
        ],
        else_=SqlParam(1),
    )
    return SqlSelect(
        select_list=SqlSelectList(
            [
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL, qualifier=tags_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("tag"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(next_generation, SqlAliasName("generation")),
                SqlSelectAlias(is_invalidation, SqlAliasName("is_invalidation")),
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("is_write"), qualifier=tags_alias),
                    SqlAliasName("is_write"),
                ),
                SqlSelectAlias(generation_exists, SqlAliasName("exists_in_db")),
                SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(prepared_at), SqlAliasName("prepared_at")),
            ],
        ),
        from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(touched_tags_cte_name)), tags_alias),
        joins=[
            SqlJoin(
                join_type=JoinKind.LEFT,
                table=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(generations_cte.ref_id)), generations_alias),
                condition=SqlJoinOnEq(
                    tags_alias,
                    _CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL,
                    generations_alias,
                    _CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL,
                ),
            ),
        ],
    )


def materialize_prepared_cache_commit(raw_result: RawResult) -> PreparedCacheCommit:
    from impl.common.l1000_cache.transaction import PreparedCacheCommit

    bumped_generations: dict[str, int] = {}
    insert_generations: dict[str, int] = {}
    update_generations: dict[str, int] = {}
    write_generations: dict[str, int] = {}
    prepared_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    for raw_row in raw_result:
        row = dict(raw_row)
        tag = str(row["tag"])
        generation = _coerce_generation(row["generation"])
        row_prepared_at = row.get("prepared_at")
        if isinstance(row_prepared_at, datetime):
            prepared_at = row_prepared_at
        if _sql_truthy(row.get("is_invalidation")):
            bumped_generations[tag] = generation
            if _sql_truthy(row.get("exists_in_db")):
                update_generations[tag] = generation
            else:
                insert_generations[tag] = generation
        if _sql_truthy(row.get("is_write")):
            write_generations[tag] = generation
    return PreparedCacheCommit(
        bumped_generations=bumped_generations,
        write_generations=write_generations,
        insert_generations=insert_generations,
        update_generations=update_generations,
        prepared_at=prepared_at,
    )


def _post_process_build_prepared_cache_commit(
    generations_ref: str,
    invalidation_tags: tuple[str, ...],
    write_tags: tuple[str, ...],
    _raw_result: RawResult,
    _hydrator: Hydrator,
    runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object],
) -> PreparedCacheCommit:
    generations = _coerce_generation_map(runtime_refs.get(generations_ref))
    return _build_prepared_cache_commit(
        generations=generations,
        invalidation_tags=invalidation_tags,
        write_tags=write_tags,
    )


def _tags_tuple(value: object, *, name: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
        msg = f"{name} must be a tuple of tags"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return tuple(str(tag) for tag in value)


def _fill_mode(value: object) -> CacheMissingGenerationMode:
    if isinstance(value, CacheMissingGenerationMode):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return CacheMissingGenerationMode(value)
    msg = "fill_mode must be CacheMissingGenerationMode or string"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _generation_map_from_raw(
    raw_result: RawResult,
    *,
    literal_tags: tuple[str, ...],
    fill_mode: CacheMissingGenerationMode,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    if not raw_result:
        return dict.fromkeys(literal_tags, 0) if fill_mode is CacheMissingGenerationMode.FILL_MISSING else {}
    generations = {str(row["tag"]): int(row["generation"]) for row in raw_result}
    if fill_mode is CacheMissingGenerationMode.FILL_MISSING and literal_tags:
        return {tag: generations.get(tag, 0) for tag in literal_tags}
    return generations


def _materialize_cache_lookup(*, cache_name: CacheName, key: CacheKey) -> _CacheLookupResult:
    from impl.common.l1000_cache import get_cache_manager
    from impl.common.l1000_cache.cache import CacheConsistency

    manager = get_cache_manager()
    cache = manager.get_cache(str(cache_name))
    consistency = cache.config.consistency
    entry = cache.get_with_generation(str(key))
    if entry is None:
        return _CacheLookupResult(
            cache_name=str(cache_name),
            key=str(key),
            value=None,
            tags=(),
            tag_generations={},
            validation_generations={},
            consistency=consistency.value,
            needs_db_validation=False,
        )
    value, tag_generations_raw, tags_raw = entry
    tag_generations = {
        str(tag): _coerce_generation(generation) for tag, generation in cast(Mapping[object, object], tag_generations_raw).items()
    }
    tags = tuple(str(tag) for tag in cast(Sequence[object], tags_raw))
    validation_generations: dict[str, int] = {}
    needs_db_validation = False
    if consistency is CacheConsistency.EVENTUAL:
        snapshot = manager.local_generation_snapshot
        if snapshot is None:
            value = None
        else:
            max_staleness = cache.config.max_staleness_seconds or 30.0
            validation_generations = {tag: int(snapshot.get(tag, 0)) for tag in tags}
            if any(tag_generations.get(tag, 0) < validation_generations.get(tag, 0) for tag in tags):
                value = None
            needs_db_validation = bool(tags) or snapshot.age_seconds() > max_staleness
    elif consistency is CacheConsistency.STRONG:
        validation_generations = dict(tag_generations)
        needs_db_validation = bool(tags)
    else:
        validation_generations = dict(tag_generations)
    return _CacheLookupResult(
        cache_name=str(cache_name),
        key=str(key),
        value=value,
        tags=tags,
        tag_generations=tag_generations,
        validation_generations=validation_generations,
        consistency=consistency.value,
        needs_db_validation=needs_db_validation,
    )

def _build_update_cache_generations_stmt(
    rows: Sequence[tuple[str, int]],
    *,
    timestamp: datetime | None = None,
) -> SqlUpdate:
    tag_ref = SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TAG_COL)
    now = datetime.now(UTC) if timestamp is None else timestamp
    generation_case = SqlCase(
        [(SqlParam(tag), SqlParam(generation)) for tag, generation in rows],
        else_=SqlColumnRef(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL),
        subject=tag_ref,
    )
    set_items = [
        SqlSetItem(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_GENERATION_COL, generation_case),
        SqlSetItem(_CACHE_GENERATIONS_UPDATED_AT_COL, SqlParam(now)),
    ]
    return SqlUpdate(
        table=_CACHE_GENERATIONS_TABLE_IDENT,
        set_items=set_items,
        where=SqlIn(tag_ref, [SqlParam(tag) for tag, _generation in rows]),
    )

class SqlBootstrapInterrogationTransport(SqlDmlBase):
    """Static SQL transport for the closed bootstrap interrogation boundary."""

    __slots__ = ("_request",)

    def __init__(self: SqlBootstrapInterrogationTransport, request: BootstrapInterrogationRequest) -> None:
        self._request = request

    @property
    def request(self: SqlBootstrapInterrogationTransport) -> BootstrapInterrogationRequest:
        return self._request

    def render(
        self: SqlBootstrapInterrogationTransport,
        dialect: SqlDialect,
    ) -> SqlFragment:
        return _bootstrap_interrogation_select(self._request).render(dialect)

def _literal_interrogation_select(
    row: BootstrapInterrogationRow,
    *,
    row_source: SqlSubqueryTableRef | None = None,
    payload_query: SqlDmlBase | None = None,
    hash_query: SqlDmlBase | None = None,
) -> SqlSelect:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast, SqlSubquery
    from l1000_schema.typed_field import SqlCastTargetType

    return SqlSelect(
        SqlSelectList(
            (
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(row.fact_kind.value), SqlAliasName("fact_kind")),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(row.table_name), SqlAliasName("table_name")),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(row.column_name), SqlAliasName("column_name")),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(row.index_name), SqlAliasName("index_name")),
                SqlColumnAlias(
                    SqlSubquery(hash_query) if hash_query is not None else SqlParam(row.hash_value),
                    SqlAliasName("hash_value"),
                ),
                SqlColumnAlias(
                    SqlCast(SqlSubquery(payload_query), SqlCastTargetType("TEXT"))
                    if payload_query is not None
                    else SqlParam(row.payload_json),
                    SqlAliasName("payload_json"),
                ),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(row.presence.value), SqlAliasName("presence")),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(str(row.source_ref or "")), SqlAliasName("source_ref")),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(row.schema_generation), SqlAliasName("schema_generation")),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(row.schema_version), SqlAliasName("schema_version")),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(row.contract_fingerprint), SqlAliasName("contract_fingerprint")),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(row.physical_surface_hash), SqlAliasName("physical_surface_hash")),
                SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(row.physical_surface_version), SqlAliasName("physical_surface_version")),
            ),
        ),
        from_=row_source,
    )


def bootstrap_interrogation_select(
    request: BootstrapInterrogationRequest,
) -> SqlBootstrapInterrogationTransport:
    """Build the closed SQL program for bootstrap interrogation rows."""

    return SqlBootstrapInterrogationTransport(request)


def _bootstrap_interrogation_select(
    request: BootstrapInterrogationRequest,
) -> SqlSetOp:
    """Build one static statement from source-proven relation-presence facts."""

    extension_override = request.backend_fingerprint_extension_override
    fingerprint_query = None
    if extension_override is not None:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.bootstrap_program import SqlPostgresBootstrapBackendFingerprint

        fingerprint_query = SqlPostgresBootstrapBackendFingerprint(
            absent=request.backend_fingerprint,
            present=extension_override[1],
            extension=extension_override[0],
        )
    optional_reads: list[SqlSelect] = []
    if request.observe_fts_nonce:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.bootstrap_fts_nonce import SqlPostgresFtsNonceSnapshot

        optional_reads.append(
            _literal_interrogation_select(
                BootstrapInterrogationRow(
                    fact_kind=BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.FTS_ARTIFACT,
                    table_name="sys_fts_nonce",
                    index_name="database_hash_nonce",
                ),
                payload_query=SqlPostgresFtsNonceSnapshot(),
            )
        )
    if request.schema_state_table_present:
        optional_reads.append(_schema_state_select())
    if request.schema_version_table_present:
        optional_reads.append(_schema_version_select())
    if request.cache_generation_table_present:
        optional_reads.append(_cache_generation_select())
    if request.manifest_table_present:
        optional_reads.append(_manifest_select(request))
    if request.proof_table_present:
        optional_reads.append(_proof_select(request))
    if request.seed_table_present:
        optional_reads.append(_seed_select(request))
    if request.polymorphic_type_table_present:
        optional_reads.append(_polymorphic_type_select())
    immutable_row_reads: tuple[SqlSelect, ...] = ()
    if request.required_immutable_rows:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.bootstrap_sql_assertion import (
            _bootstrap_assertion_query,
        )

        immutable_row_reads = tuple(
            _literal_interrogation_select(
                BootstrapInterrogationRow(
                    fact_kind=BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.IMMUTABLE_ROW,
                    hash_value=str(facts_hash),
                    table_name=str(payload.table_name),
                ),
                row_source=SqlSubqueryTableRef(
                    _bootstrap_assertion_query(
                        BootstrapSqlAssertion(
                            kind=BootstrapAssertionKind.ROW_CONTENT_MATCHES,
                            severity=BootstrapAssertionSeverity.HARD_FAILURE,
                            payload=payload,
                        )
                    ),
                    SqlTableName("immutable_row_content"),
                ),
            )
            for facts_hash, payload in request.required_immutable_rows
        )
    return SqlSetOp(
        SetOpKind.UNION_ALL,
        (
            _physical_interrogation_select(request),
            *immutable_row_reads,
            *optional_reads,
            _literal_interrogation_select(
                BootstrapInterrogationRow(
                    fact_kind=BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.BACKEND,
                    hash_value=str(request.backend_fingerprint),
                ),
                hash_query=fingerprint_query,
            ),
            _literal_interrogation_select(
                BootstrapInterrogationRow(
                    fact_kind=BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.TRANSITION,
                    hash_value=str(request.transition_artifact_hash),
                    payload_json=request.transition_artifact_payload_json,
                    presence=(BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT if request.transition_artifact_present else BootstrapFactPresence.ABSENT),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )


def _bootstrap_interrogation_table_names(
    request: BootstrapInterrogationRequest,
) -> tuple[SqlTableName, ...]:
    """Return desired and control relations for catalog discovery."""

    return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*request.table_names, *_BOOTSTRAP_CONTROL_TABLES)))


def _physical_interrogation_select(request: BootstrapInterrogationRequest) -> SqlBootstrapPhysicalInterrogation:
    from l1000_schema.table_registry import get_table_config
    from l3200_metadata.polymorphic_types import PolymorphicTypeRecord

    indexes_by_table = {str(table): tuple(str(index) for index in indexes) for table, indexes in request.required_indexes_by_table}
    control_table = str(_POLYMORPHIC_TYPE_TABLE)
    indexes_by_table[control_table] = tuple(
        dict.fromkeys(
            (
                *indexes_by_table.get(control_table, ()),
                *(index.name for index in get_table_config(PolymorphicTypeRecord).indexes if index.name is not None),
            )
        )
    )
    return SqlBootstrapPhysicalInterrogation(
        table_names=tuple(str(table_name) for table_name in _bootstrap_interrogation_table_names(request)),
        columns_by_table=tuple(
            (str(table_name), tuple(str(column_name) for column_name in column_names))
            for table_name, column_names in request.required_columns_by_table
        ),
        indexes_by_table=tuple(indexes_by_table.items()),
        primary_keys_by_table=request.required_primary_key_columns_by_table,
        named_artifacts_by_kind=(
            *(
                (
                    BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.GENERATED_COLUMN.value,
                    tuple(
                        (str(table_name), str(column_name))
                        for table_name, column_names in request.required_generated_columns_by_table
                        for column_name in column_names
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            *(
                (
                    BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.CONSTRAINT.value,
                    tuple(
                        (str(table_name), str(constraint_name))
                        for table_name, constraint_names in request.required_constraints_by_table
                        for constraint_name in constraint_names
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            *(
                (
                    BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.TRIGGER.value,
                    tuple(
                        (str(table_name), str(trigger_name))
                        for table_name, trigger_names in request.required_triggers_by_table
                        for trigger_name in trigger_names
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            *(
                (
                    f"fts_{artifact_kind}",
                    ((str(table_name), str(artifact_name)),),
                )
                for artifact_kind, table_name, artifact_name in request.required_fts_artifacts
            ),
            *(
                (
                    BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.VECTOR_ARTIFACT.value,
                    tuple(
                        (str(table_name), str(artifact_name))
                        for table_name, artifact_names in request.required_vector_artifacts_by_table
                        for artifact_name in artifact_names
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            *(
                (
                    BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.LARGE_COLUMN_ARTIFACT.value,
                    tuple(
                        (str(table_name), str(artifact_name))
                        for table_name, artifact_names in request.required_large_column_artifacts_by_table
                        for artifact_name in artifact_names
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            (
                BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.BACKEND_CAPABILITY.value,
                tuple((None, str(capability)) for capability in request.required_backend_capabilities),
            ),
            (
                BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.BACKEND_EXTENSION.value,
                tuple(
                    (None, str(extension))
                    for extension in dict.fromkeys(
                        (
                            *(name for name, _version in request.required_backend_extensions),
                            *request.observed_backend_extensions,
                        )
                    )
                ),
            ),
        ),
        trigger_scan_tables=tuple(str(table_name) for table_name in request.trigger_scan_tables),
        vector_configurations=request.required_vector_configurations,
        fts_artifact_columns=tuple(
            (BootstrapArtifactKind(f"fts_{kind}"), table_name, artifact_name, columns)
            for kind, table_name, artifact_name, columns in request.required_fts_artifact_columns
        ),
        presence=BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT.value,
        include_column_metadata=not request.read_only_validation or request.require_column_type_metadata,
        validate_data_artifacts=request.read_only_validation,
        backend_extensions=tuple(
            (str(extension_name), extension_version) for extension_name, extension_version in request.required_backend_extensions
        ),
    )

        ),
        from_=SqlTableIdent(_SEED_TABLE),

class BootstrapInterrogationStep(NonPublishingStep[BootstrapObservation]):
    """Terminal step for the single bootstrap interrogation boundary."""

    def __init__(
        self: BootstrapInterrogationStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        request: BootstrapInterrogationRequest,
        plan_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._request = request
        self._plan_ref = plan_ref

    @property
    def level(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"bootstrap", "interrogation", "transaction_control"})

    def is_bootstrap_interrogation(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def is_read_only(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> bool:
        return self._request.read_only_validation

    def is_bootstrap_observation_intent(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def is_optimizer_closed_observation(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def normalize_execution_error(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep, error: Exception) -> Exception:
        """Classify absent validation anchors without optimizer diagnostics."""
        from l1100_exceptions.exceptions import (
            ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError,
            ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason,
            TableNotFoundError,
        )

        if not self._request.read_only_validation or not isinstance(error, TableNotFoundError):
            return error
        from l1400_types.type_surface_contracts import BootstrapTableName, DatabaseIdentity

        missing_tables = () if error.table_name is None else (BootstrapTableName(str(error.table_name)),)
        return ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError(
            reason=ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason.NOT_BOOTSTRAPPED,
            database_identity=DatabaseIdentity("database"),
            expected_schema_hash=SchemaFingerprintHash(str(self._request.schema_state_hash)),
            missing_tables=missing_tables,
            original_exception=error,
        )

    def execution_role(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def supports_ordered_sql_statement_batch(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def preserve_prebatched_group(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def result_cardinality(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def dependencies(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_read(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(str(table_name) for table_name in _bootstrap_interrogation_table_names(self._request))

    def tables_written(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def internal_plan_state(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> Mapping[str, PlanPayloadValue]:
        return cast(
            "Mapping[str, PlanPayloadValue]",
            {
                "manifest_key": str(self._request.manifest_key),
                "plan_hash": str(self._request.plan_hash),
                "tables": tuple(str(table_name) for table_name in _bootstrap_interrogation_table_names(self._request)),
            },
        )

    def internal_plan_ref_state(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> Mapping[str, PlanPayloadValue]:
        return self.internal_plan_state()

    def compile(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[BootstrapObservation]:
        preamble = ctx.sql_render_dialect().bootstrap_admission_preamble
        interrogation: SqlRenderable = SqlBootstrapInterrogationTransport(self._request)
        if (
            ctx.backend_profile.traits.has_usearch_sql_runtime
            and BackendCapability.VECTOR_INDEX_NATIVE_USEARCH in ctx.backend_profile.capabilities
        ):
            validation_name = SqlTableName("nera_bootstrap_native_validation")
            validation_column = SqlColumnName("valid")
            validation_value = SqlSelect(
                SqlSelectList((SqlColumnRef(validation_column),)),
                from_=SqlTableIdent(validation_name),
            )
            interrogation = SqlWith(
                (
                    SqlCteDefinition(
                        validation_name,
                        SqliteUSearchValidateDatabase(),
                        columns=(validation_column,),
                        materialized=True,
                    ),
                ),
                body=SqlSelect(
                    SqlSelectList((SqlStar(),)),
                    from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(interrogation, SqlTableName("validated_bootstrap")),
                    where=SqlBinaryOp(SqlSubquery(validation_value), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(1)),
                ),
            )
        output_shape = bootstrap_interrogation_output_shape()
        column_type_hints = bootstrap_interrogation_type_hints()
        column_type_hints.require_complete(_INTERROGATION_COLUMNS)
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=SqlStatementBatch(
                (*preamble, interrogation),
                category=(SqlStatementBatchCategory.ORDERED_SEMANTIC if preamble else SqlStatementBatchCategory.REQUEST_BATCH_BOUNDARY),
                needs_returning_per_stmt=(*(False for _statement in preamble), True),
                collect_results_per_stmt=(*(False for _statement in preamble), True),
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=raw_rows_post_op(),
        )

    def materialize_rows(
        self: BootstrapInterrogationStep,
        raw_rows: list[dict[str, JsonValue]],
    ) -> BootstrapObservation:
        """Decode the rows returned by the closed interrogation statement."""
        if not raw_rows:
            raise ValueError("Bootstrap interrogation returned no physical facts")
        return decode_bootstrap_interrogation_rows(
            raw_rows,
            root_ref=ServerPlanRefId(self.ref_id),
            plan_ref=self._plan_ref,
            request=self._request,
        )

    def materialize(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> BootstrapObservation:
        raw_rows = resolved.get(str(self.ref_id), ())
        if raw_rows == ():
            return self.materialize_rows([])
        if not isinstance(raw_rows, list):
            msg = f"Bootstrap interrogation returned {type(raw_rows).__name__}, expected a row list"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        assert all(isinstance(row, dict) for row in raw_rows)
        assert all(isinstance(key, str) for row in raw_rows for key in row)
        return self.materialize_rows(raw_rows)

    def execute_runtime_rows(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep) -> tuple[BootstrapInterrogationRow, ...]:
        msg = "bootstrap interrogation runtime rows are forbidden; extend the SQL observation step instead"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)

    def execute_runtime(self: BootstrapInterrogationStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> BootstrapObservation:
        return self.materialize(resolved)

                            for constraint_name in constraint_names
