def decode_reconciliation_interrogation_rows(
    raw_rows: object,
    *,
    root_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    observed_trigger_tables: Sequence[SqlTableName],
) -> SchemaStateSnapshot:
    """Decode normalized transport rows into shared reconciliation snapshot facts."""
    observed_trigger_tables = tuple(observed_trigger_tables)

    rows = tuple(_coerce_interrogation_row(row) for row in _coerce_row_sequence(raw_rows))
    table_payloads = {
        row.table_name: (_payload_dict(row.payload_json) if row.payload_json else {})
        for row in rows
        if row.fact_kind is BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.TABLE and row.table_name
    }
    column_payloads = {
        (row.table_name, row.column_name): (_payload_dict(row.payload_json) if row.payload_json else {})
        for row in rows
        if row.fact_kind is BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.COLUMN and row.table_name and row.column_name
    }
    index_payloads = {
        (row.table_name, row.index_name): (_payload_dict(row.payload_json) if row.payload_json else {})
        for row in rows
        if row.fact_kind is BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.INDEX and row.table_name and row.index_name
    }
    constraint_payloads = {
        (row.table_name, row.index_name): (_payload_dict(row.payload_json) if row.payload_json else {})
        for row in rows
        if row.fact_kind is BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.CONSTRAINT and row.table_name and row.index_name
    }
    trigger_rows = tuple(
        row for row in rows if row.fact_kind is BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.TRIGGER and row.table_name and row.index_name
    )
    trigger_payloads: dict[tuple[str, str], ManagedTriggerObservationPayload] = {}
    for row in trigger_rows:
        identity = (
            _required_str(row.table_name, "trigger table_name"),
            _required_str(row.index_name, "trigger name"),
        )
        if identity in trigger_payloads:
            msg = f"duplicate trigger observation for {identity!r}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if row.payload_json is None:
            msg = f"trigger observation payload is missing for {identity!r}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        trigger_payloads[identity] = decode_managed_trigger_observation_payload(
            row.payload_json,
        )
    return SchemaStateSnapshot(
        table_facts=tuple(
            SchemaTableFact(
                table_name=SqlTableName(row.table_name),
                exists=row.presence is BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT,
                source=SchemaFactSource.RECONCILIATION_OBSERVATION,
                source_ref=root_ref,
                row_count_estimate=_optional_int(
                    table_payloads[str(row.table_name)].get("row_count_estimate"),
                ),
                row_presence=(
                    SchemaFactPresence.PRESENT
                    if (has_rows := _optional_bool(table_payloads[str(row.table_name)].get("has_rows"))) is True
                    else SchemaFactPresence.ABSENT
                    if has_rows is False
                    else SchemaFactPresence.UNKNOWN
                ),
            )
            for row in rows
            if row.fact_kind is BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.TABLE and row.table_name
        ),
        column_facts=tuple(
            SchemaColumnFact(
                table_name=SqlTableName(row.table_name),
                column_name=SqlColumnName(row.column_name),
                exists=row.presence is BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT,
                source=SchemaFactSource.RECONCILIATION_OBSERVATION,
                source_ref=root_ref,
                data_type=optional_branded_text(
                    _optional_str(column_payloads[(row.table_name, row.column_name)].get("data_type")),
                    IntrospectedSqlTypeName,
                ),
                nullable=_optional_bool(
                    column_payloads[(row.table_name, row.column_name)].get("nullable"),
                ),
                default_value=optional_branded_text(
                    _optional_str(column_payloads[(row.table_name, row.column_name)].get("default_value")),
                    GeneratedSqlExpressionText,
                ),
                generated=_optional_bool(
                    column_payloads[(row.table_name, row.column_name)].get("generated"),
                ),
            )
            for row in rows
            if row.fact_kind is BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.COLUMN and row.table_name and row.column_name
        ),
        index_facts=tuple(
            SchemaIndexFact(
                table_name=SqlTableName(row.table_name),
                index_name=SqlIndexName(row.index_name),
                exists=row.presence is BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT,
                source=SchemaFactSource.RECONCILIATION_OBSERVATION,
                source_ref=root_ref,
                column_names=_index_columns_from_payload(row.payload_json) or (),
                unique=_optional_bool(index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("unique")),
                where_sql=optional_branded_text(
                    _optional_str(index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("where_clause"))
                    or _index_where_from_definition(
                        _optional_str(index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("definition")),
                    ),
                    GeneratedSqlExpressionText,
                ),
                column_sort_orders=tuple(
                    SqlOrderDirection(value)
                    for value in _optional_plain_string_tuple(
                        index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("sort_orders"),
                    )
                ),
                expressions=tuple(
                    GeneratedSqlExpressionText(value)
                    for value in _optional_plain_string_tuple(
                        index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("expressions"),
                    )
                ),
                include_columns=_optional_string_tuple(
                    index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("include_columns"),
                )
                or (),
                index_type=SqlIndexTypeName(
                    _optional_str(index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("index_type")) or "",
                ),
                constraint_owned=bool(
                    _optional_bool(index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("constraint_owned")),
                ),
                specialized_owned=bool(
                    _optional_bool(index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("specialized_owned")),
                ),
                is_valid=_optional_bool(index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("is_valid")) is not False,
                is_ready=_optional_bool(index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("is_ready")) is not False,
                nulls_not_distinct=bool(
                    _optional_bool(index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("nulls_not_distinct")),
                ),
                prefix_lengths=tuple(
                    SqlIndexPrefixLength(value or 0)
                    for value in _optional_int_tuple(
                        index_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("prefix_lengths"),
                    )
                ),
            )
            for row in rows
            if row.fact_kind is BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.INDEX and row.table_name and row.index_name and row.index_name != "*"
        ),
        constraint_facts=tuple(
            SchemaConstraintFact(
                table_name=SqlTableName(row.table_name),
                constraint_name=SqlConstraintName(row.index_name),
                constraint_type=SqlConstraintKindName(
                    _optional_str(
                        constraint_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("constraint_type"),
                    )
                    or "CHECK"
                ),
                definition=optional_branded_text(
                    _optional_str(constraint_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)].get("definition")),
                    GeneratedSqlExpressionText,
                ),
                exists=row.presence is BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT,
                source=SchemaFactSource.RECONCILIATION_OBSERVATION,
                source_ref=root_ref,
            )
            for row in rows
            if row.fact_kind is BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.CONSTRAINT and row.table_name and row.index_name
        ),
        trigger_facts=tuple(
            _schema_trigger_fact_from_row(
                row,
                trigger_payloads[(row.table_name, row.index_name)],
                root_ref=root_ref,
            )
            for row in rows
            if row.fact_kind is BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.TRIGGER and row.table_name and row.index_name
        ),
        observed_trigger_tables=observed_trigger_tables,
    )


def _schema_trigger_fact_from_row(
    row: BootstrapInterrogationRow,
    payload: ManagedTriggerObservationPayload,
    *,
    root_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
) -> SchemaTriggerFact:
    """Decode one complete trigger observation row."""
    table_name = _required_str(row.table_name, "trigger table_name")
    trigger_name = _required_str(row.index_name, "trigger name")
    function = payload.function
    return SchemaTriggerFact(
        table_name=SqlTableName(table_name),
        trigger_name=SqlTriggerName(trigger_name),
        exists=row.presence is BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT,
        source=SchemaFactSource.RECONCILIATION_OBSERVATION,
        source_ref=root_ref,
        timing=payload.timing,
        events=payload.events,
        definition=payload.definition,
        enabled=payload.enabled,
        function_schema=(function.schema_name if isinstance(function, ManagedTriggerFunctionObservation) else None),
        function_name=(function.function_name if isinstance(function, ManagedTriggerFunctionObservation) else None),
        function_definition=(function.definition if isinstance(function, ManagedTriggerFunctionObservation) else None),
        function_reference_count=(function.reference_count if isinstance(function, ManagedTriggerFunctionObservation) else None),
    )


def _polymorphic_type_fact(
    row: BootstrapInterrogationRow,
    source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
) -> BootstrapPolymorphicTypeFact:
    if not row.table_name or not row.column_name or not row.index_name or row.hash_value is None:
        raise ValueError("Polymorphic observation requires a complete durable identity")
    return BootstrapPolymorphicTypeFact(
        base_table=SqlTableName(row.table_name),
        type_name=row.column_name,
        type_id=int(row.hash_value),
        python_class=row.index_name,
        source_ref=source_ref,
    )


def decode_bootstrap_interrogation_rows(
    raw_rows: object,
    *,
    root_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    plan_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    request: BootstrapInterrogationRequest,
) -> BootstrapObservation:
    """Decode normalized transport rows into typed observation facts."""

    rows = tuple(_coerce_interrogation_row(row) for row in _coerce_row_sequence(raw_rows))
    fact_refs = bootstrap_interrogation_fact_refs(root_ref)
    transition_rows = tuple(row for row in rows if row.fact_kind == BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.TRANSITION and row.hash_value)
    ddl_lockdown_presence = (
        BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT
        if any(
            row.fact_kind == BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.TABLE
            and row.table_name == str(_DDL_LOCKDOWN_TABLE)
            and row.presence == BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT
            for row in rows
        )
        else BootstrapFactPresence.ABSENT
    )
    backend_rows = tuple(row for row in rows if row.fact_kind == BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.BACKEND)
    schema_state_rows = tuple(row for row in rows if row.fact_kind == BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.SCHEMA_STATE and row.hash_value)
    if not schema_state_rows:
        schema_state_rows = (
            BootstrapInterrogationRow(
                fact_kind=BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.SCHEMA_STATE,
                hash_value="absent-schema-state",
                presence=BootstrapFactPresence.ABSENT,
                schema_generation=0,
                schema_version=0,
            ),
        )
    manifest_rows = tuple(
        row
        for row in rows
        if row.fact_kind == BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.MANIFEST and row.presence == BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT and row.hash_value
    )
    schema_version_rows = tuple(
        row
        for row in rows
        if row.fact_kind == BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.SCHEMA_VERSION
        and row.presence == BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT
        and row.schema_version is not None
    )
    current_schema_version = schema_state_rows[0].schema_version
    state_version_rows = tuple(row for row in schema_version_rows if row.schema_version == current_schema_version)
    desired_hash_version_rows = tuple(row for row in schema_version_rows if row.hash_value == str(request.schema_state_hash))
    authority_schema_version_row = (
        state_version_rows[0]
        if len(state_version_rows) == 1
        else desired_hash_version_rows[0]
        if len(desired_hash_version_rows) == 1
        else None
    )
    cache_generation_rows = tuple(
        row
        for row in rows
        if row.fact_kind == BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.CACHE_GENERATION
        and row.presence == BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT
        and row.column_name == "schema:global"
        and row.schema_generation is not None
    )
    cache_generation = cache_generation_rows[0].schema_generation if len(cache_generation_rows) == 1 else None
    return BootstrapObservation(
        requested_backend_extensions=tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                (
                    *(name for name, _version in request.required_backend_extensions),
                    *request.observed_backend_extensions,
                )
            )
        ),
        interrogation_plan=BootstrapInterrogationPlan(
            plan_ref=plan_ref,
            expected_fact_refs=fact_refs.all_refs,
            fact_refs=fact_refs,
        ),
        table_facts=tuple(
            BootstrapTableFact(
                table_name=SqlTableName(row.table_name),
                source=BootstrapObservationSource.INTERROGATION_PLAN,
                source_ref=fact_refs.table_ref,
            )
            for row in rows
            if row.fact_kind == BootstrapInterrogationRowKind.TABLE and row.presence == BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT and row.table_name
        ),
        column_facts=tuple(
            BootstrapColumnFact(
                table_name=SqlTableName(row.table_name),
                column_name=SqlColumnName(row.column_name),
                source=BootstrapObservationSource.INTERROGATION_PLAN,

def _coerce_row_sequence(raw_rows: object) -> tuple[object, ...]:
    if raw_rows is None:
        return ()
    if isinstance(raw_rows, tuple):
        return raw_rows
    if isinstance(raw_rows, list):
        return tuple(raw_rows)
    return (raw_rows,)


def _coerce_interrogation_row(raw_row: object) -> BootstrapInterrogationRow:
    if isinstance(raw_row, BootstrapInterrogationRow):
        return raw_row
    if not isinstance(raw_row, Mapping) and callable(getattr(raw_row, "keys", None)):
        raw_row_any = cast(Any, raw_row)
        raw_row = {str(key): raw_row_any[key] for key in raw_row_any.keys()}
    if not isinstance(raw_row, Mapping):
        msg = f"Unsupported bootstrap interrogation row: {type(raw_row).__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    raw_kind = raw_row.get("fact_kind")
    return BootstrapInterrogationRow(
        fact_kind=BootstrapInterrogationRowKind(str(raw_kind)),
        table_name=_optional_str(raw_row.get("table_name")),
        column_name=_optional_str(raw_row.get("column_name")),
        index_name=_optional_str(raw_row.get("index_name")),
        hash_value=_optional_str(raw_row.get("hash_value")),
        payload_json=_optional_json_text(raw_row.get("payload_json")),
        presence=BootstrapFactPresence(str(raw_row.get("presence") or BootstrapFactPresence.PRESENT.value)),
        source_ref=(ServerPlanRefId(raw_row["source_ref"]) if raw_row.get("source_ref") else None),
        schema_generation=_optional_int(raw_row.get("schema_generation")),
        schema_version=_optional_int(raw_row.get("schema_version")),
        contract_fingerprint=_optional_str(raw_row.get("contract_fingerprint")),
        physical_surface_hash=_optional_str(raw_row.get("physical_surface_hash")),
        physical_surface_version=_optional_int(raw_row.get("physical_surface_version")),
    )


def _optional_json_text(value: object) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value or None
    if isinstance(value, Mapping | list):
        return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True)
    msg = f"bootstrap interrogation JSON payload has invalid type {type(value).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _optional_str(value: object) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    text = str(value)
    return text or None


def _optional_int(value: object) -> int | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return int(value)
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if not value:
            return None
        try:
            return int(value)
        except ValueError:
            return None
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return int(value)
    return None


def _index_columns_from_payload(payload_json: str | None) -> tuple[SqlColumnName, ...] | None:
    payload = _payload_dict(payload_json)
    if "columns_by_ordinal" not in payload:
        return _optional_string_tuple(payload.get("columns"))
    ordinals = payload["columns_by_ordinal"]
    if not isinstance(ordinals, Mapping):
        raise ValueError("Index column ordinals must be a mapping")
    columns: dict[int, SqlColumnName] = {}
    for ordinal, column in ordinals.items():
        if not isinstance(ordinal, str) or not ordinal.isdecimal() or not isinstance(column, str):
            raise ValueError("Index column ordinals require positive integer keys and string columns")
        position = int(ordinal)
        if position < 1 or position in columns:
            raise ValueError("Index column ordinals must be positive and unique")
        columns[position] = SqlColumnName(column)
    if set(columns) != set(range(1, len(columns) + 1)):
        raise ValueError("Index column ordinals must be contiguous")
    return tuple(columns[position] for position in range(1, len(columns) + 1))


def _index_where_from_definition(definition: str | None) -> str | None:
    if definition is None:
        return None
    match = re.search(r"\bWHERE\b\s+(.+)$", definition, flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
    return match.group(1).strip() if match else None


def _optional_plain_string_tuple(value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
        return ()
    return tuple(item for item in value if isinstance(item, str))


def _optional_int_tuple(value: object) -> tuple[int | None, ...]:
    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
        return ()
    return tuple(_optional_int(item) for item in value)


def _optional_string_tuple(value: object) -> tuple[SqlColumnName, ...] | None:
    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
        return None
    columns: list[SqlColumnName] = []
    for item in value:
        if not isinstance(item, str):
            return None
        columns.append(SqlColumnName(item))
    return tuple(columns)


def _optional_bool(value: object) -> bool | None:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return bool(value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        normalized = value.strip().lower()
        if normalized in {"true", "t", "yes", "y", "1"}:
            return True
        if normalized in {"false", "f", "no", "n", "0"}:
            return False
    return None


def _required_str(value: str | None, field_name: str) -> str:
    if value is None or not value:
        msg = f"bootstrap interrogation row is missing {field_name}"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return value


def _required_int(value: int | None, field_name: str) -> int:
    if value is None:
        msg = f"bootstrap interrogation row is missing {field_name}"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return value


def _validated_json_value(value: object) -> JsonValue:
    if value is None or isinstance(value, str | int | float | bool):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, tuple | list):
        return tuple(_validated_json_value(item) for item in value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        validated: dict[str, JsonValue] = {}
        for key, item in value.items():
            if not isinstance(key, str):
                raise TypeError("Bootstrap payload has a non-string mapping key")
            validated[key] = _validated_json_value(item)
        return validated
    msg = f"Bootstrap payload has unsupported value type {type(value).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)


def _payload_dict(payload_json: str | None) -> Mapping[str, JsonValue]:
    if not payload_json:
        return {}
    try:
        raw = json.loads(payload_json)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return {}
    validated = _validated_json_value(raw)
    if isinstance(validated, Mapping):
        return validated
    return {}


def _proof_required_tables(payload_json: str | None) -> tuple[SqlTableName, ...]:
    if not payload_json:
        return ()
    raw_tables = _payload_dict(payload_json).get("required_tables")
    if not isinstance(raw_tables, tuple):
        return ()
    tables: list[SqlTableName] = []
    for table_name in raw_tables:
        if not isinstance(table_name, str):
            return ()
        if table_name:
            tables.append(SqlTableName(table_name))
    return tuple(tables)


def _validated_transition_artifact_hash(payload_json: str | None, row_hash: str | None) -> BootstrapFactsHash:
    if not payload_json:
        return BootstrapFactsHash(str(row_hash))
    payload = _payload_dict(payload_json)
    transition_kind = payload.get("transition_kind")
    key = payload.get("key")
    backend_fingerprint = payload.get("backend_fingerprint")
    observed_fingerprint = payload.get("observed_fingerprint")
    desired_fingerprint = payload.get("desired_fingerprint")
    if not all(
        isinstance(value, str) and value for value in (transition_kind, backend_fingerprint, observed_fingerprint, desired_fingerprint)
    ):
        return BootstrapFactsHash(str(row_hash))
    assert isinstance(backend_fingerprint, str)
    assert isinstance(observed_fingerprint, str)
    assert isinstance(desired_fingerprint, str)
    assert isinstance(transition_kind, str)
    backend_fingerprint_text = backend_fingerprint
    observed_fingerprint_text = observed_fingerprint
    desired_fingerprint_text = desired_fingerprint
    transition_kind_text = transition_kind
    artifact = TransitionCacheArtifact(
        key=str(key) if isinstance(key, str) else "",
        backend_fingerprint=backend_fingerprint_text,
        observed_fingerprint=observed_fingerprint_text,
        desired_fingerprint=desired_fingerprint_text,
        transition_kind=transition_kind_text,
        ddl_effects=_transition_ddl_effects(payload_json),
        created_tables=_transition_created_tables(payload_json),
        diagnostics={},
        created_indexes=_transition_created_indexes(payload_json),
    )
    computed_hash = transition_artifact_content_hash(artifact)
    if row_hash and str(row_hash) != computed_hash:
        msg = f"bootstrap transition artifact payload hash mismatch: row={row_hash!r} payload={computed_hash!r}"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return BootstrapFactsHash(computed_hash)


def _transition_schema_fingerprint(
    payload_json: str | None,
    field_name: str,
    fallback: SchemaFingerprintHash,
) -> SchemaFingerprintHash:
    if not payload_json:
        return fallback
    value = _payload_dict(payload_json).get(field_name)
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
        return fallback
    return SchemaFingerprintHash(value)


def _transition_created_tables(payload_json: str | None) -> tuple[SqlTableName, ...]:
    if not payload_json:
        return ()
    payload = _payload_dict(payload_json)
    raw_created_tables = payload.get("created_tables")
    if not isinstance(raw_created_tables, tuple):
        return ()
    created_tables: list[SqlTableName] = []
    for table_name in raw_created_tables:
        if not isinstance(table_name, str):
            return ()
        if table_name:
            created_tables.append(SqlTableName(table_name))
    return tuple(created_tables)


def _transition_ddl_effects(payload_json: str | None) -> tuple[CachedDdlEffect, ...]:
    if not payload_json:
        return ()
    payload = _payload_dict(payload_json)
    raw_effects = payload.get("ddl_effects")
    if not isinstance(raw_effects, Sequence) or isinstance(raw_effects, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
        return ()
    effects: list[CachedDdlEffect] = []
    for raw_effect in raw_effects:
        if not isinstance(raw_effect, Mapping):
            return ()
        sql = raw_effect.get("sql")
        params = raw_effect.get("params")
        ref_id = raw_effect.get("ref_id")
        if not isinstance(sql, str):
            return ()
        if not isinstance(params, Sequence) or isinstance(params, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
            return ()
        if ref_id is not None and not isinstance(ref_id, str):
            return ()
        effects.append(CachedDdlEffect(sql=sql, params=tuple(_json_scalar(param) for param in params), ref_id=ref_id))
    return tuple(effects)


def _json_scalar(value: object) -> str | int | float | bool | None:
    if value is None or isinstance(value, str | int | float | bool):
        return value
    return str(value)


def _transition_created_indexes(payload_json: str | None) -> tuple[SqlIndexName, ...]:
    if not payload_json:
        return ()
    payload = _payload_dict(payload_json)
    raw_created_indexes = payload.get("created_indexes")
    if not isinstance(raw_created_indexes, tuple):
        return ()
    created_indexes: list[SqlIndexName] = []
    for index_name in raw_created_indexes:
        if not isinstance(index_name, str):
            return ()
        if index_name:
            created_indexes.append(SqlIndexName(index_name))
    return tuple(created_indexes)

        return READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS

def _can_use_versioned_fts_meta_fast_path(query_spec: object) -> bool:
    from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_spec import query_has_explicit_permission_bypass

    # Plain row-shaped ``filters`` are intentionally NOT disqualifying: the
    # versioned FTS intent composes them with the MATCH via
    # ``_build_versioned_fts_extra_where`` (``sql_and(match_expr, extra_where)``).
    # Excluding them here routed filtered FTS-only queries to a fallback terminal
    # that dropped the MATCH entirely (returning an unranked filtered scan).
    # The remaining clauses are genuinely unsupported by the FTS extra-where
    # builder (it raises on joins/group_by/aggregations/having/window). Route
    # projection and secondary ordering are supported by the native FTS payload
    # terminal and must not fall back to generic query execution.
    has_extra_clauses = bool(
        getattr(query_spec, "joins", None)
        or getattr(query_spec, "group_by", None)
        or getattr(query_spec, "aggregations", None)
        or getattr(query_spec, "having", None)
        or getattr(query_spec, "window_functions", None)
    )
    has_incompatible_flags = (
        bool(getattr(query_spec, "distinct", False))
        or bool(getattr(query_spec, "include_deleted", False))
        or query_has_explicit_permission_bypass(query_spec)
    )
    return not has_extra_clauses and not has_incompatible_flags

def _require_seeded_config[T](config: T | ServerRef[T], owner: str) -> T:
    if not isinstance(config, ServerRef):
        return config
    config_ref_id = config.ref_id
    if config_ref_id is None:
        msg = f"{owner} requires a seeded config ref"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    found, config_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(None, ServerPlanRefId(config_ref_id))
    if not found:
        msg = f"{owner} requires a seeded config ref"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    return cast("T", config_value)


def _session_id_ref(session_id: object | None) -> ScalarServerRef[SessionId] | LazySessionSqlSource | None:
    if session_id is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(session_id, LazySessionSqlSource):
        return session_id
    if isinstance(session_id, ScalarServerRef):
        return session_id
    if isinstance(session_id, LazyResult):
        return ServerRefs.scalar(session_id)
    return ServerRefs.scalar(session_id if isinstance(session_id, SessionId) else SessionId(str(session_id)))

        or getattr(query_spec, "group_by", None),
    )


def _should_hydrate_search_payload(query_spec: object) -> bool:
    has_explicit_projection = getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None) is not None and bool(
        getattr(query_spec, "preserve_non_join_projection", False)
    )
    return not has_explicit_projection and not bool(getattr(query_spec, "joins", None))


def _payload_search_ref_id(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    *,
    should_hydrate_payload: bool,
) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    suffix = "_payload_raw" if should_hydrate_payload else "_payload"
    return ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}{suffix}")


def _requires_session_user_resolution(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    session_id: PlanningSessionId | None,
    *,
    action: PermissionAction = PermissionAction("read"),
) -> bool:
    from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import (
        get_query_permission_plan,
    )

    if session_id is None:
        return False
    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_cls, action=action)
    return permission_plan is not None and permission_plan.requires_user_id


def _build_session_user_resolution_steps(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
) -> tuple[list[ServerPlanStep[Any]], ServerPlanRefId | None]:
    if not _requires_session_user_resolution(model_cls, ctx.session_id):
        return [], None
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

    user_id_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_resolve_uid")
    session_ref = _session_id_ref(ctx.session_id)
    assert session_ref is not None
    return [SessionUserIdStep(user_id_ref_id, session_ref, after_refs=after_refs)], user_id_ref_id


def _lower_query_execute_with_meta_search_via_provider(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: object,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    search_mode: str,
    is_versioned: bool,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Invoke the typed backend-profile read-side search lowering hook."""
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_search_lowering import (
        provider_for_search_mode,
    )
    from l5200_vector_index.search_plan_payload import serialize_dense_query_vector_for_plan

    provider = cast(
        _SearchLoweringProvider,
        provider_for_search_mode(
            ctx=ctx,
            search_mode=cast(Any, search_mode),
            is_versioned=is_versioned,
        ),
    )
    plan_query_spec = serialize_dense_query_vector_for_plan(
        cast("QuerySpec[Any]", query_spec),
    )
    return provider.lower_query_execute_with_meta_search(
        ref_id=ref_id,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        query_spec=plan_query_spec,
        ctx=ctx,
        search_mode=search_mode,
        is_versioned=is_versioned,
    )


def _append_search_payload_projection_steps(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    payload_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    should_hydrate_payload: bool,
    build_projection_step: _SearchPayloadProjectionFactory,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.row_hydration import HydrateResolvedRowsStep
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.search_payload import (
        ExtractSearchMetaRowsStep,
        MaterializeSearchPayloadStep,
    )

    final_ref = ServerPlanRefId(ref_id)
    if not should_hydrate_payload:
        split_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_payload_split")
        materialized_payload_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_payload_materialized")
        return [
            ExtractSearchMetaRowsStep(split_ref, source_ref=payload_ref),
            MaterializeSearchPayloadStep(
                materialized_payload_ref,
                rows_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{split_ref}.rows"),
                meta_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{split_ref}.meta"),
            ),
            build_projection_step(final_ref, materialized_payload_ref),
        ]

    split_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_payload_split")
    split_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{split_ref}.rows")
    hydrated_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_payload_rows")
    meta_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{split_ref}.meta")
    materialized_payload_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_payload")
    return [
        ExtractSearchMetaRowsStep(split_ref, source_ref=payload_ref),
        HydrateResolvedRowsStep(
            hydrated_rows_ref,
            source_ref=split_rows_ref,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            runtime_only=True,
        ),
        MaterializeSearchPayloadStep(
            materialized_payload_ref,
            rows_ref=hydrated_rows_ref,
            meta_ref=meta_ref,
        ),
        build_projection_step(final_ref, materialized_payload_ref),
    ]


def _lower_query_execute_search_payload_via_provider(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: object,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    search_mode: str,
    is_versioned: bool,
    build_projection_step: _SearchPayloadProjectionFactory,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    should_hydrate_payload = _should_hydrate_search_payload(query_spec) and not (is_versioned and search_mode == "fts_only")
    payload_ref = _payload_search_ref_id(
        ref_id,
        should_hydrate_payload=should_hydrate_payload,
    )
    steps = list(
        _lower_query_execute_with_meta_search_via_provider(
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(payload_ref),
            model_cls=model_cls,
            query_spec=query_spec,
            ctx=ctx,
            search_mode=search_mode,
            is_versioned=is_versioned,
        ),
    )
    steps.extend(
        _append_search_payload_projection_steps(
            ref_id=ref_id,
            payload_ref=payload_ref,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            should_hydrate_payload=should_hydrate_payload,
            build_projection_step=build_projection_step,
        ),
    )
    return steps

class QueryExistsIntent(IntentStep[bool]):
    """L4: Check if any results exist."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "query", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.SCALAR
    intent_read_only = True
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]
    query_spec: Any

    def __init__(
        self: QueryExistsIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _QueryExistsConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.query_spec = config.query_spec
        self.after_refs = config.after_refs
        self.staged_commit_id = config.staged_commit_id
        self.materialize_after = config.materialize_after
        self.permission_action = config.permission_action

    def lower(self: QueryExistsIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep]:
        from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.subqueries import query_has_semantic_subquery
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import is_versioned_operation
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import (
            _query_permission_needs_user_resolution,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

        leading_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        user_id_ref_id: str | None = None
        if query_has_semantic_subquery(self.query_spec) or (
            _requires_session_user_resolution(
                self.model_cls,
                ctx.session_id,
                action=self.permission_action,
            )
            and (self.permission_action != PermissionAction("read") or _query_permission_needs_user_resolution(self.query_spec))
        ):
            user_id_ref_id = f"{self.ref_id}_resolve_uid"
            session_ref = _session_id_ref(ctx.session_id)
            assert session_ref is not None
            leading_steps.append(SessionUserIdStep(ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id), session_ref))

        if is_versioned_operation(self.model_cls, ctx):
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_query_steps import (
                build_versioned_query_exists_from_spec_steps,
                VersionedQueryExistsFromSpecStep,
                _VersionedQueryScalarFromSpecConfig,
            )

            allow_batch = versioned_scalar_query_allow_batch(ctx)
            if ctx.branch_id is not None:
                return [
                    *leading_steps,
                    *build_versioned_query_exists_from_spec_steps(
                        ref_id=self.ref_id,
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        config=_VersionedQueryScalarFromSpecConfig(
                            query_spec=self.query_spec,
                            staged_commit_id=self.staged_commit_id,
                            branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                            revision_id=ctx_revision_id(ctx),
                            user_id_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id) if user_id_ref_id is not None else None,
                            allow_batch=allow_batch,
                            after_refs=self.after_refs,
                            permission_action=self.permission_action,
                        ),
                    ),
                ]

            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.resolve_branch_steps import (
                ResolveBranchForRevisionStep,
            )

            assert ctx.lazy_revision is not None
            assert ctx.branch_table is not None

            resolve_ref = self.ref_id + "_resolve_branch"
            lazy_revision_ref = ctx_lazy_revision_ref(ctx)
            exists_revision_literal, exists_revision_ref_id = ctx_revision_source(ctx)
            return [
                *leading_steps,
                ResolveBranchForRevisionStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref),
                    ctx_lazy_revision_ref(ctx),
                    SqlTableName(ctx.branch_table),
                    branch_id_column=ctx.branch_id_column,
                    tip_revision_column=ctx.branch_tip_revision_column,
                    deleted_column=ctx.branch_deleted_column,
                ),
                *build_versioned_query_exists_from_spec_steps(
                    ref_id=self.ref_id,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    config=_VersionedQueryScalarFromSpecConfig(
                        query_spec=self.query_spec,
                        staged_commit_id=self.staged_commit_id,
                        branch_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref),
                        revision_id=exists_revision_literal,
                        revision_ref_id=exists_revision_ref_id,
                        user_id_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id) if user_id_ref_id is not None else None,
                        allow_batch=allow_batch,
                        after_refs=self.after_refs,
                        permission_action=self.permission_action,
                    ),
                ),
            ]

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_count import QueryExistsStep, _QueryExistsStepConfig

        return [
            *leading_steps,
            QueryExistsStep(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                _QueryExistsStepConfig(
                    query_spec=self.query_spec,
                    after_refs=self.after_refs,
                    user_id_ref_id=(None if user_id_ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id)),
                    materialize_after=self.materialize_after,
                    permission_action=self.permission_action,
                ),
            ),
        ]


@pure_lazy
def _query_reads_published_cte(query_spec: object) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(query_spec, QuerySpec):
        return False
    source = query_spec.source
    while isinstance(source, AliasedSource):
        source = source.source
    return isinstance(source, CteSource)

    error_cls: type[Exception]

    published_cte_authorized: bool = False
    expect_empty: bool = True
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()
    # The terminal owns this action so normal reads cannot inherit a wider policy.
    # See docs/design/TYPED_APPLICATION_SESSION_CONTEXT.rst, "Action Assertions".
    permission_action: PermissionAction = PermissionAction("read")
    require_registered_action_policy: bool = False


class QueryAssertRowsIntent(IntentStep[None]):
    """L4: Require or forbid rows in a typed query relation."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "query", "assertion", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.ONE
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _QueryAssertRowsConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.query_spec = config.query_spec
        self.error_cls = config.error_cls
        self.error_message = config.error_message
        self.published_cte_authorized = config.published_cte_authorized
        self.expect_empty = config.expect_empty
        self.after_refs = config.after_refs
        self.permission_action = config.permission_action
        self.require_registered_action_policy = config.require_registered_action_policy
        self._precondition = False

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.intent_tags | (frozenset({"precondition"}) if self._precondition else frozenset())

    def before_mutation(self) -> QueryAssertRowsIntent:
        """Keep this SQL assertion before the mutation that consumes it."""
        result = copy(self)
        result._precondition = True
        return result

    def with_commit_validation_anchor(self, anchor: ServerPlanRefId) -> QueryAssertRowsIntent:
        result = copy(self)
        # The publication anchor transitively orders all precommit work. Replacing
        # earlier ordering refs also prevents template-local refs from escaping
        # their imported fragment when this validation moves to the commit tail.
        result.after_refs = frozenset({anchor})
        return result

    def prevents_sql_owned_database_commit(self: QueryAssertRowsIntent) -> bool:
        """Keep commit outside SQL until the lowered assertion row is decoded."""
        return True

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._resolve import collect_query_spec_deps

        return frozenset(collect_query_spec_deps(self.query_spec)) | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self.after_refs)

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import is_versioned_operation

        if self.require_registered_action_policy:
            from l1100_exceptions.exceptions import PermissionCompilationError
            from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import _try_get_permission_scheme

            if _try_get_permission_scheme(self.model_cls) is None:
                msg = f"Action assertion for {self.model_cls.__name__} requires a registered permission scheme"
                raise PermissionCompilationError(msg)

        if is_versioned_operation(self.model_cls, ctx):
            from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.subqueries import query_has_semantic_subquery
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import get_versioned_staging_ctx
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import (
                _query_permission_needs_user_resolution,
            )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_query_steps import (
                _VersionedQueryAssertRowsFromSpecConfig,
                build_versioned_query_assert_rows_from_spec_steps,
            )

            leading_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
            user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
            if query_has_semantic_subquery(self.query_spec) or (
                _requires_session_user_resolution(
                    self.model_cls,
                    ctx.session_id,
                    action=self.permission_action,
                )
                and (self.permission_action != PermissionAction("read") or _query_permission_needs_user_resolution(self.query_spec))
            ):
                user_id_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_resolve_uid")
                session_ref = _session_id_ref(ctx.session_id)
                assert session_ref is not None
                leading_steps.append(SessionUserIdStep(user_id_ref_id, session_ref))

            staging = get_versioned_staging_ctx(self.model_cls, ctx) if self._precondition else None
            assertion_config = _VersionedQueryAssertRowsFromSpecConfig(
                query_spec=self.query_spec,
                staged_commit_id=staging.staged_commit_id_raw if staging is not None else None,
                revision_id=ctx_revision_id(ctx),
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                allow_batch=versioned_scalar_query_allow_batch(ctx),
                after_refs=self.after_refs,
                permission_action=self.permission_action,
                error_cls=self.error_cls,
                error_message=self.error_message,
                expect_empty=self.expect_empty,
            )
            if ctx.branch_id is not None:
                return [
                    *leading_steps,
                    *build_versioned_query_assert_rows_from_spec_steps(
                        ref_id=self.ref_id,
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        config=replace(assertion_config, branch_id=ctx.branch_id),
                    ),
                ]

            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.resolve_branch_steps import (
                ResolveBranchForRevisionStep,
            )

            assert ctx.lazy_revision is not None
            assert ctx.branch_table is not None
            resolve_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_resolve_branch")
            revision_literal, revision_ref_id = ctx_revision_source(ctx)
            return [
                *leading_steps,
                ResolveBranchForRevisionStep(
                    resolve_ref,
                    ctx_lazy_revision_ref(ctx),
                    SqlTableName(ctx.branch_table),
                    branch_id_column=ctx.branch_id_column,
                    tip_revision_column=ctx.branch_tip_revision_column,
                    deleted_column=ctx.branch_deleted_column,
                ),
                *build_versioned_query_assert_rows_from_spec_steps(
                    ref_id=self.ref_id,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    config=replace(
                        assertion_config,
                        branch_ref_id=resolve_ref,
                        revision_id=revision_literal,
                        revision_ref_id=revision_ref_id,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        if self.published_cte_authorized and not _query_reads_published_cte(self.query_spec):
            msg = "published CTE authorization requires a CTE query source"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        query_spec = self.query_spec
        if self.published_cte_authorized:
            query_spec = replace(
                query_spec,
                permission_state=QueryPermissionState.BYPASS,
            )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_assert_no_rows import (
            QueryAssertNoRowsStep,
            QueryAssertRowsStep,
        )

        step_class = QueryAssertNoRowsStep if self.expect_empty else QueryAssertRowsStep
        return [
            step_class(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                query_spec=query_spec,
                error_cls=self.error_cls,
                error_message=self.error_message,
                expect_empty=self.expect_empty,
                after_refs=self.after_refs,
                permission_action=self.permission_action,
            ),
        ]

        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[Any],
        config: _QueryExecuteRawConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.query_spec = config.query_spec
        self.raw_access_authorized = config.raw_access_authorized
        self.snapshot_after_refs = config.snapshot_after_refs
        self.preserve_snapshot = config.preserve_snapshot
        self.direct_raw_terminal = config.direct_raw_terminal
        self.published_cte_authorized = config.published_cte_authorized

    def returns_raw_rows_terminal(self: QueryExecuteRawIntent) -> bool:
        return True

    def dependencies(self: QueryExecuteRawIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._resolve import collect_query_spec_deps

        return frozenset(collect_query_spec_deps(self.query_spec)) | self.snapshot_after_refs

    def sql_snapshot_source_ref(self: QueryExecuteRawIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId | None:
        return self.ref_id if self.preserve_snapshot else None

    def lower(self: QueryExecuteRawIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import is_versioned_operation

        if is_versioned_operation(self.model_cls, ctx) and not self.published_cte_authorized:
            if self.preserve_snapshot:
                raise ValueError("Captured JSON snapshots do not yet support versioned queries")
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_query_steps import (
                build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps,
                _VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig,
            )

            raw_mode = True
            policy = None if ctx.is_write_transaction else ctx.lazy_branch_tip_materialization
            policy_dependencies = frozenset({policy.ref_id}) if policy is not None and policy.ref_id is not None else frozenset()
            if ctx.branch_id is not None:
                return [
                    *build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
                        ref_id=self.ref_id,
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        config=_VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                            query_spec=self.query_spec,
                            branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                            raw_mode=raw_mode,
                            after_refs=policy_dependencies,
                        ),
                    ),
                ]
            if ctx.lazy_branch is not None:
                revision_literal, revision_ref_id = ctx_revision_source(ctx)
                branch_ref = ctx_lazy_branch_ref(ctx)
                branch_ref_id = branch_ref.ref_id
                if branch_ref_id is None:
                    msg = "lazy branch ref must have a ServerPlan ref id for versioned query lowering"
                    raise RuntimeError(msg)
                return [
                    *build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
                        ref_id=self.ref_id,
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        config=_VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                            query_spec=self.query_spec,
                            branch_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(branch_ref_id),
                            revision_id=revision_literal,
                            revision_ref_id=revision_ref_id,
                            raw_mode=raw_mode,
                            after_refs=policy_dependencies,
                        ),
                    ),
                ]

            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.resolve_branch_steps import (
                ResolveBranchForRevisionStep,
            )

            assert ctx.lazy_revision is not None
            assert ctx.branch_table is not None
            resolve_ref = self.ref_id + "_resolve_branch"
            lazy_revision_ref = ctx_lazy_revision_ref(ctx)
            revision_literal, revision_ref_id = ctx_revision_source(ctx)
            return [
                ResolveBranchForRevisionStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref),
                    lazy_revision_ref,
                    SqlTableName(ctx.branch_table),
                    branch_id_column=ctx.branch_id_column,
                    tip_revision_column=ctx.branch_tip_revision_column,
                    deleted_column=ctx.branch_deleted_column,
                ),
                *build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
                    ref_id=self.ref_id,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    config=_VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                        query_spec=self.query_spec,
                        branch_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref),
                        revision_id=revision_literal,
                        revision_ref_id=revision_ref_id,
                        raw_mode=raw_mode,
                    ),
                ),
            ]

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import (
            QueryExecuteStep,
            _QueryExecuteStepConfig,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute_aggregate import (
            _JsonObjectAggNullKeyAssertionStep,
            _json_object_agg_key_expressions,
        )

        query_spec = self.query_spec
        if self.published_cte_authorized and not _query_reads_published_cte(query_spec):
            msg = "published CTE authorization requires a CTE query source"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if self.raw_access_authorized and self.published_cte_authorized and isinstance(query_spec, QuerySpec):
            query_spec = replace(
                query_spec,
                permission_state=QueryPermissionState.BYPASS,
            )
        assertion_ref_id = (
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_json_object_agg_null_key_assertion") if _json_object_agg_key_expressions(query_spec) else None
        )
        assertion_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        if assertion_ref_id is not None:
            assertion_steps.append(
                _JsonObjectAggNullKeyAssertionStep(
                    ref_id=assertion_ref_id,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    query_spec=query_spec,
                    user_id_ref_id=None,
                ),
            )
        after_refs = self.snapshot_after_refs | (frozenset({assertion_ref_id}) if assertion_ref_id is not None else frozenset())
        if self.preserve_snapshot:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.captured_json import CaptureJsonStep, snapshot_table
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.grammar_execute import GrammarEffectStep, _GrammarExecuteConfig
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlDropTemporaryTableIfExists

            drop_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_snapshot_reset")
            capture_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_snapshot_capture")
            table = snapshot_table(self.ref_id)
            assertion_steps.extend(
                [
                    GrammarEffectStep(
                        drop_ref,
                        SqlDropTemporaryTableIfExists(table),
                        _GrammarExecuteConfig(
                            reads=frozenset(),
                            writes=frozenset({table.name}),
                            after_refs=after_refs,
                        ),
                    ),
                    CaptureJsonStep(
                        capture_ref,
                        source=QueryExecuteStep(
                            self.ref_id,
                            self.model_cls,
                            _QueryExecuteStepConfig(query_spec=query_spec, raw_mode=True, after_refs=after_refs),
                        ),
                        source_ref=self.ref_id,
                        after_ref=drop_ref,
                    ),
                ]
            )
            after_refs = frozenset({capture_ref})
        return [
            *assertion_steps,
            QueryExecuteStep(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                    query_spec=query_spec,
                    raw_mode=True,
                    after_refs=after_refs,
                    preserve_snapshot=self.preserve_snapshot,
                ),
            ),
        ]


@pure_lazy

class QueryExecuteWithMetaIntent[T](IntentStep[tuple[Sequence[T], Sequence[Any]]]):
    """L4: Execute with search metadata.

    This intent is the read-side backend-specific lowering seam for vector and
    hybrid search. Wrapper intents such as ``VectorQueryIntent`` must remain
    thin adapters into this intent rather than growing their own
    backend-specific branching.
    """

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "query", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.ONE
    intent_read_only = True
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]
    query_spec: QuerySpec[T]

    def __init__(
        self: QueryExecuteWithMetaIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _QueryExecuteWithMetaConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.query_spec = config.query_spec

    def lower(
        self: QueryExecuteWithMetaIntent,
        ctx: LoweringContext,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep]:
        return _lower_query_execute_with_meta(
            ref_id=self.ref_id,
            model_cls=self.model_cls,
            query_spec=self.query_spec,
            ctx=ctx,
        )
