def _lower_query_execute_with_meta_plain_only(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: QuerySpec[Any],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    is_versioned: bool,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
        lower_spill_read_for_backend,
        should_lower_spill_read,
    )

    computed_raw_mode = _query_returns_raw_rows(query_spec)
    inner_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_inner")
    if is_versioned:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import _build_session_user_resolution
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.resolve_branch_steps import ResolveBranchForRevisionStep
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_query_steps import (
            VersionedQueryFromSpecStep,
            _VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig,
            lower_versioned_spill_aware_query_read_steps,
        )

        leading_steps, user_id_ref_id = _build_session_user_resolution(
            owner_ref_id=inner_ref,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            ctx=ctx,
            permission_filtering_enabled=not getattr(query_spec, "skip_permission_filtering", False),
        )
        if ctx.branch_id is not None:
            if not should_lower_spill_read(
                ctx=ctx,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                query_spec=query_spec,
                raw_mode=computed_raw_mode,
                versioned=True,
            ):
                return [
                    *leading_steps,
                    VersionedQueryFromSpecStep(
                        inner_ref,
                        model_cls,
                        _VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                            query_spec=query_spec,
                            branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                            user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                            raw_mode=computed_raw_mode,
                        ),
                    ),
                    *_append_empty_meta_projection_steps(ref_id=ref_id, source_ref=inner_ref),
                ]
            return [
                *leading_steps,
                *lower_versioned_spill_aware_query_read_steps(
                    ref_id=inner_ref,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    query_spec=query_spec,
                    branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                ),
                *_append_empty_meta_projection_steps(ref_id=ref_id, source_ref=inner_ref),
            ]

        assert ctx.lazy_revision is not None
        assert ctx.branch_table is not None
        resolve_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_resolve_branch")
        revision_literal, revision_ref_id = ctx_revision_source(ctx)
        if not should_lower_spill_read(
            ctx=ctx,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            query_spec=query_spec,
            raw_mode=computed_raw_mode,
            versioned=True,
        ):
            return [
                *leading_steps,
                ResolveBranchForRevisionStep(
                    resolve_ref,
                    ctx_lazy_revision_ref(ctx),
                    SqlTableName(ctx.branch_table),
                    branch_id_column=ctx.branch_id_column,
                    tip_revision_column=ctx.branch_tip_revision_column,
                    deleted_column=ctx.branch_deleted_column,
                ),
                VersionedQueryFromSpecStep(
                    inner_ref,
                    model_cls,
                    _VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                        query_spec=query_spec,
                        branch_ref_id=resolve_ref,
                        revision_id=revision_literal,
                        revision_ref_id=revision_ref_id,
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                        raw_mode=computed_raw_mode,
                    ),
                ),
                *_append_empty_meta_projection_steps(ref_id=ref_id, source_ref=inner_ref),
            ]
        return [
            *leading_steps,
            ResolveBranchForRevisionStep(
                resolve_ref,
                ctx_lazy_revision_ref(ctx),
                SqlTableName(ctx.branch_table),
                branch_id_column=ctx.branch_id_column,
                tip_revision_column=ctx.branch_tip_revision_column,
                deleted_column=ctx.branch_deleted_column,
            ),
            *lower_versioned_spill_aware_query_read_steps(
                ref_id=inner_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                query_spec=query_spec,
                branch_ref_id=resolve_ref,
                revision_id=revision_literal if revision_ref_id is None else revision_ref_id,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
            ),
            *_append_empty_meta_projection_steps(ref_id=ref_id, source_ref=inner_ref),
        ]

    leading_steps, user_id_ref_id = _build_session_user_resolution_steps(
        ref_id=ref_id,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        ctx=ctx,
    )
    spill_steps = lower_spill_read_for_backend(
        ctx=ctx,
        ref_id=inner_ref,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        query_spec=query_spec,
        result_mode="many",
        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
    )
    if not spill_steps:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import (
            QueryExecuteStep,
            _QueryExecuteStepConfig,
        )

        spill_steps = [
            QueryExecuteStep(
                inner_ref,
                model_cls,
                _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                    query_spec=query_spec,
                    raw_mode=computed_raw_mode,
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    return [
        *leading_steps,
        *spill_steps,
        *_append_empty_meta_projection_steps(ref_id=ref_id, source_ref=inner_ref),
    ]


def _lower_query_execute_with_meta(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: QuerySpec[Any],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import is_versioned_operation

    search_op = query_spec.search_op
    if search_op.mode == "invalid_hybrid":
        raise ValueError(invalid_hybrid_message())
    is_versioned = is_versioned_operation(model_cls, ctx)
    if search_op.is_search:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import _coerce_optional_session_id
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_search_lowering import lower_search_query
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.search_payload import ProjectSearchPayloadWithMetaStep

        should_hydrate_payload = getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None) is None and not bool(getattr(query_spec, "joins", None))
        return list(
            lower_search_query(
                ref_id=ref_id,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                query_spec=query_spec,
                ctx=ctx,
                is_versioned=is_versioned,
                projection="with_meta",
                session_id=_coerce_optional_session_id(ctx.session_id),
                raw_mode=should_hydrate_payload,
                should_hydrate_payload=should_hydrate_payload,
                build_projection_step=lambda final_ref, payload_ref: ProjectSearchPayloadWithMetaStep(
                    final_ref,
                    payload_ref,
                ),
            ),
        )
    return _lower_query_execute_with_meta_plain_only(
        ref_id=ref_id,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        query_spec=query_spec,
        ctx=ctx,
        is_versioned=is_versioned,
    )


def _append_empty_meta_projection_steps(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.return_value import ReturnValueStep
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.search_payload import (
        MaterializeSearchPayloadStep,
        ProjectSearchPayloadWithMetaStep,
    )

    empty_meta_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_empty_meta")
    payload_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_payload")
    return [
        ReturnValueStep(empty_meta_ref, ()),
        MaterializeSearchPayloadStep(payload_ref, rows_ref=source_ref, meta_ref=empty_meta_ref),
        ProjectSearchPayloadWithMetaStep(ref_id, payload_ref),
    ]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _QueryUpdateReturningConfig:
    query_spec: Any
    updates: dict[str, Any]
    returning_projections: tuple[object, ...] | None = None
    pre_write_after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()


def _first_versioned_returning_expression_field(expression: Any) -> str | None:
    field_name = getattr(expression, "field", None)
    if field_name is not None:
        return str(field_name)
    left = getattr(expression, "left", None)
    if left is not None:
        left_field = _first_versioned_returning_expression_field(left)
        if left_field is not None:
            return left_field
    right = getattr(expression, "right", None)
    if right is not None:
        right_field = _first_versioned_returning_expression_field(right)
        if right_field is not None:
            return right_field
    for arg in getattr(expression, "args", ()):
        arg_field = _first_versioned_returning_expression_field(arg)
        if arg_field is not None:
            return arg_field
    return None


class _ProjectVersionedUpdatedRowsStep(ServerPlanStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]):
    """Project versioned updated rows for raw tuple-returning mutation results."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        returning_projections: tuple[object, ...],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._source_ref = source_ref
        self._returning_projections = returning_projections

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"query", "update", "versioned", "projection"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._source_ref)})

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def _publication_columns(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name
        from l1000_schema.typed_field import AliasedExpression, AliasedField, Expression, Field

        columns: list[str] = []
        for projection in self._returning_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, (AliasedExpression, AliasedField)):
                columns.append(projection.alias)
            elif isinstance(projection, Field):
                columns.append(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(projection.name)))
            elif isinstance(projection, Expression):
                if projection.field is None or projection.function is not None or projection.operator is not None:
                    msg = "Bare expression projections must be aliased before versioned update-returning lowering"
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                columns.append(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(projection.field)))
            else:
                msg = f"Unsupported versioned update-returning projection: {type(projection).__name__}"
                raise TypeError(msg)
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(columns))

    def _projection_lineage(self) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name
        from l1000_schema.typed_field import AliasedExpression, AliasedField, Expression, Field

        lineage: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
        for projection in self._returning_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, AliasedField):
                lineage.append((projection.alias, get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(projection.name))))
            elif isinstance(projection, AliasedExpression):
                source_field = _first_versioned_returning_expression_field(projection.expression)
                source = (
                    get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(source_field))
                    if source_field is not None
                    else f"expression:{projection.alias}"
                )
                lineage.append((projection.alias, source))
            elif isinstance(projection, Field):
                column = get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(projection.name))
                lineage.append((column, column))
            elif isinstance(projection, Expression):
                if projection.field is None or projection.function is not None or projection.operator is not None:
                    msg = "Bare expression projections must be aliased before versioned update-returning lowering"
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                column = get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(projection.field))
                lineage.append((column, column))
            else:
                msg = f"Unsupported versioned update-returning projection: {type(projection).__name__}"
                raise TypeError(msg)
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(lineage))

    def _publication_column_type_hints(self) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name
        from l1000_schema.typed_field import AliasedExpression, AliasedField
        from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import (
            combine_sql_column_type_hints,
            model_sql_column_type_hints,
        )

        output_columns = self._publication_columns()
        model_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, output_columns)
        if model_hints is None:
            msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._model_cls.__name__}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        projection_hints: list[SqlColumnTypeHints] = []
        for projection in self._returning_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, AliasedField):
                source_column = get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(projection.name))
                projection_hints.append(model_hints.rename_column(source_column, projection.alias))
            elif isinstance(projection, AliasedExpression):
                source_field = _first_versioned_returning_expression_field(projection.expression)
                if source_field is None:
                    msg = f"Cannot infer SQL type hint for aliased expression {projection.alias!r}"
                    raise TypeError(msg)
                source_column = get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(source_field))
                projection_hints.append(model_hints.rename_column(source_column, projection.alias))
        return combine_sql_column_type_hints(output_columns, model_hints, *projection_hints)

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = self._publication_columns()
        column_type_hints = self._publication_column_type_hints()
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=cte_projection_row_model(
                f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
                columns,
                column_type_hints,
            ),
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.projection_over_model(
                source_model_cls=self._model_cls,
                projection_lineage=self._projection_lineage(),
            ),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None,
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: Any) -> Any:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._auxiliary_ctes import collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_cte_helpers import SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
        from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.expression_grammar import ExpressionToGrammar
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name
        from l1000_schema.typed_field import AliasedExpression, AliasedField, Expression, Field
        from l2070_batching.output_shape import CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, synthetic_output_field
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledStep, CteReference
        from l2070_batching.post_op import row_dicts_post_op

        cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._source_ref))
        if not isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference):
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                trigger=f"versioned updated-row projection source {self._source_ref!r} has no SQL-visible CTE",
                blocked_path="runtime-ref projection for versioned update-returning rows",
                result_contract="versioned update-returning projections must read a SQL-visible updated-row relation.",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish updated rows as a CTE before projection.",
                    "Apply returning projections through SQL over that CTE.",
                    "Do not reconstruct update-returning rows from materialized runtime refs.",
                ),
            )

        converter = ExpressionToGrammar(self._model_cls, table_alias="src")
        overrides: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for projection in self._returning_projections:
            if isinstance(projection, AliasedExpression):
                overrides[projection.alias] = converter.convert(projection.expression)
            elif isinstance(projection, AliasedField):
                overrides[projection.alias] = SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(projection.name))),
                    "src",
                )
            elif isinstance(projection, Field):
                continue
            elif isinstance(projection, Expression):
                if projection.field is None or projection.function is not None or projection.operator is not None:
                    msg = "Bare expression projections must be aliased before versioned update-returning lowering"
                    raise ValueError(msg)
            else:
                msg = f"Unsupported versioned update-returning projection: {type(projection).__name__}"
                raise ValueError(msg)

        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        output_columns = contract.columns
        output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in output_columns))
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides(
                source_cte_name=SqlGrammarKind(cte_ref.ref_id),
                source_columns=output_columns,
                overrides=overrides,
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            auxiliary_ctes=collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self._source_ref),
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        )


class QueryUpdateReturningIntent[T](IntentStep[list[T]]):
    """L4: Update with RETURNING."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "update", "query", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.MANY
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]
    query_spec: Any
    updates: dict[str, Any]

    def __init__(
        self: QueryUpdateReturningIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _QueryUpdateReturningConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.query_spec = config.query_spec
        self.updates = config.updates
        self.returning_projections = config.returning_projections
        self.pre_write_after_refs = config.pre_write_after_refs

    def tables_written(self: QueryUpdateReturningIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(get_table_name(self.model_cls))})

    def sequence_result_source_ref(self: QueryUpdateReturningIntent) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        return ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.updated_rows")

    def publication_result_ref(self) -> ServerPlanRefId:
        """Return the exact SQL-visible updated-row relation."""
        return self.sequence_result_source_ref()

    def affected_count_source_contract(self: QueryUpdateReturningIntent) -> AffectedCountSourceContract:
        validation_precedes_producer = issubclass(self.model_cls, VersionedObjectRow)
        return AffectedCountSourceContract(
            sql_ref=self.sequence_result_source_ref(),
            producer_ref=self.ref_id,
            scheduling_dependency_ref=(self.sequence_result_source_ref() if validation_precedes_producer else self.ref_id),
            representation=AffectedCountSourceRepresentation.ROW_RELATION,
            ordered_statement_mode=AffectedCountOrderedStatementMode.DRIVER_COUNT_WITHOUT_SQL_RELATION,
            validation_precedes_producer=validation_precedes_producer,
            requires_atomic_cte_region=not validation_precedes_producer,
        )

    def add_affected_count_validation_dependency(
        self: QueryUpdateReturningIntent,
        validation_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> None:
        if self.affected_count_source_contract().validation_precedes_producer:
            self.pre_write_after_refs = self.pre_write_after_refs | frozenset({validation_ref})

    def additional_batch_binding_ref_ids(self: QueryUpdateReturningIntent) -> tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...]:
        return (
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_updated_count"),
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.updated_rows"),
        )

    def lower(self: QueryUpdateReturningIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.embedding_auto_queue_intent import (
            EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent,
            _EmbeddingAutoQueueConfig,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute import (
            QueryExecuteStep,
            _QueryExecuteStepConfig,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_update import (
            QueryUpdateReturningStep,
            _QueryUpdateReturningStepConfig,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep
        from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import get_vector_indexes

        leading_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        user_id_ref_id: str | None = None
        if _requires_session_user_resolution(self.model_cls, ctx.session_id):
            user_id_ref_id = f"{self.ref_id}_resolve_uid"
            session_ref = _session_id_ref(ctx.session_id)
            assert session_ref is not None
            leading_steps.append(SessionUserIdStep(ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id), session_ref))

        user_id_ref = None if user_id_ref_id is None else ServerPlanRefId(user_id_ref_id)
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import (
            get_versioned_staging_ctx,
            is_versioned_model,
            is_versioned_operation,
        )

        if is_versioned_model(self.model_cls) and (is_versioned_operation(self.model_cls, ctx) or ctx.is_versioned):
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import (
                CountSequenceItemsStep,
                ReturnSourceAfterDepsConfig,
                ReturnSourceAfterDepsStep,
            )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import (
                _ApplyQueryUpdatesToRowsConfig,
                _ApplyQueryUpdatesToRowsStep,
                _versioned_query_branch_and_revision_inputs,
            )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_versioning_extended import (
                VersionedUpdateManyBatchIntent,
                _VersionedBatchSourceOrder,
                _VersionedUpdateManyBatchConfig,
                versioned_write_raw_rows_source_ref,
            )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_query_steps import (
                build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps,
                _VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig,
            )
            from l2070_batching.server_ref import ObjectSequenceServerRef, ServerRefs

            sc = get_versioned_staging_ctx(self.model_cls, ctx)
            if sc is None:
                msg = "Versioned query update_returning requires versioned staging context"
                raise RuntimeError(msg)
            branch_steps, branch_id, branch_ref_id, revision_id, revision_ref_id = _versioned_query_branch_and_revision_inputs(
                ctx=ctx,
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_resolve_branch"),
            )
            selected_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.selected_rows")
            returned_updated_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.updated_rows")
            updated_count_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_updated_count")
            full_updated_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.write_rows")
            write_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.write")
            written_raw_ref = versioned_write_raw_rows_source_ref(ServerPlanRefId(f"{write_ref}_batch_return"))
            selection_branch_id = branch_id
            selection_branch_ref_id = branch_ref_id
            selection_revision_id = revision_id
            selection_revision_ref_id = revision_ref_id
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import (
                _context_revision_ref_id_for_read,
                _query_spec_for_versioned_update_selection,
                _query_spec_has_json_function_filter,
            )

            update_selection_query_spec = _query_spec_for_versioned_update_selection(self.query_spec)
            original_has_json_filter = _query_spec_has_json_function_filter(self.query_spec)
            selection_has_json_filter = _query_spec_has_json_function_filter(update_selection_query_spec)
            if (original_has_json_filter or selection_has_json_filter) and not ctx.branch_tip_materialized:
                historical_revision_ref_id = _context_revision_ref_id_for_read(
                    ctx,
                    ctx_lazy_revision_ref(ctx),
                    _resolve_context_revision_literal(ctx),
                )
                if historical_revision_ref_id is None and ctx.branch_id is not None and ctx.branch_table is not None:
                    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.resolve_branch_steps import ResolveBranchTipRevisionStep
                    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import BranchId

                    historical_revision_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_resolve_tip_for_json")
                    branch_steps = [
                        *branch_steps,
                        ResolveBranchTipRevisionStep(
                            historical_revision_ref_id,
                            branch_id=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchId(ctx.branch_id)),
                            branch_table=SqlTableName(ctx.branch_table),
                            branch_id_column=ctx.branch_id_column,
                            tip_revision_column=ctx.branch_tip_revision_column,
                        ),
                    ]
                if historical_revision_ref_id is None and selection_branch_ref_id is not None and ctx.branch_table is not None:
                    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.resolve_branch_steps import ResolveBranchTipRevisionStep
                    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import BranchId

                    historical_revision_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_resolve_tip_for_json")
                    branch_steps = [
                        *branch_steps,
                        ResolveBranchTipRevisionStep(
                            historical_revision_ref_id,
                            branch_id=ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
                                selection_branch_ref_id,
                                variant="scalar",
                                type_hint=BranchId,
                            ),
                            branch_table=SqlTableName(ctx.branch_table),
                            branch_id_column=ctx.branch_id_column,
                            tip_revision_column=ctx.branch_tip_revision_column,
                        ),
                    ]
                if historical_revision_ref_id is not None:
                    selection_revision_id = None
                    selection_revision_ref_id = historical_revision_ref_id
            effective_updates = dict(self.updates)
            spill_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_staging import (
                build_large_column_spill_steps,
                copy_large_column_pointer_assignments,
                prepare_large_column_spill_plan_from_tuples,
            )
            from l1000_schema.typed_field import Expression, Field
            from l2070_batching.sql_renderable import SqlRenderable

            large_column_configs = get_large_column_configs(self.model_cls)
            copy_large_column_pointer_assignments(self.model_cls, effective_updates)
            for config in large_column_configs:
                column = str(config.column)
                if column not in effective_updates:
                    continue
                value = effective_updates[column]
                if isinstance(value, (Expression, Field, SqlRenderable)):
                    continue
                pointer = large_column_pointer_name(config.column)
                if value is None:
                    effective_updates[pointer] = None
                    continue
                rows, spill_plan = prepare_large_column_spill_plan_from_tuples(
                    self.model_cls,
                    [column, pointer],
                    [(value, None)],
                    backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
                )
                rewritten = rows[0]
                effective_updates[column] = rewritten[0]
                effective_updates[pointer] = rewritten[1]
                if spill_plan.rows or spill_plan.delta_rows:
                    spill_steps.extend(
                        build_large_column_spill_steps(
                            self.model_cls,
                            spill_plan,
                            write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.{column}.spill"),
                        ),
                    )
            spill_after_refs = frozenset(ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id) for step in spill_steps)
            requires_large_column_return_hydration = bool(get_large_column_configs(self.model_cls))
            selection_steps = list(
                build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
                    ref_id=selected_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    config=_VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                        query_spec=update_selection_query_spec,
                        branch_id=selection_branch_id,
                        branch_ref_id=selection_branch_ref_id,
                        revision_id=selection_revision_id,
                        revision_ref_id=selection_revision_ref_id,
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref,
                        raw_mode=True,
                        publication_read_flavor=_versioned_query_publication_flavor_for_context(ctx),
                    ),
                )
            )
            selection_publisher = next(step for step in reversed(selection_steps) if step.ref_id == selected_ref)
            selection_contract = selection_publisher.cte_publication_contract()
            if selection_contract is None:
                msg = "Versioned query update selection must publish a CTE contract"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            updated_rows_step = _ApplyQueryUpdatesToRowsStep(
                full_updated_ref,
                config=_ApplyQueryUpdatesToRowsConfig(
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    source_ref=selected_ref,
                    updates=effective_updates,
                    returning_projections=self.returning_projections,
                    source_columns=selection_contract.columns,
                ),
            )
            returned_updated_rows_step = _ApplyQueryUpdatesToRowsStep(
                returned_updated_ref,
                config=_ApplyQueryUpdatesToRowsConfig(
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    source_ref=selected_ref,
                    updates=effective_updates,
                    returning_projections=self.returning_projections,
                    source_columns=selection_contract.columns,
                ),
            )
            updated_source_columns = updated_rows_step.cte_publication_contract().columns
            returned_source_columns = tuple(
                column for column in returned_updated_rows_step.cte_publication_contract().columns if column != "branch_id"
            )
            hydrated_returned_ref = (
                ServerPlanRefId(self.ref_id)
                if requires_large_column_return_hydration and self.returning_projections is None
                else ServerPlanRefId(f"{returned_updated_ref}.hydrated")
            )
            returned_hydration_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
            if requires_large_column_return_hydration:
                from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.row_hydration import MaterializeResolvedModelSequenceStep

                returned_hydration_steps.append(
                    MaterializeResolvedModelSequenceStep(
                        hydrated_returned_ref,
                        source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(returned_updated_ref),
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        after_refs=(frozenset({write_ref}) if self.returning_projections is None else frozenset()),
                        inline_large_columns=True,
                        source_columns=returned_source_columns,
                    ),
                )
            return [
                *leading_steps,
                *branch_steps,
                *spill_steps,
                *selection_steps,
                updated_rows_step,
                returned_updated_rows_step,
                CountSequenceItemsStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(updated_count_ref),
                    source_ref=full_updated_ref,
                ),
                *VersionedUpdateManyBatchIntent(
                    write_ref,
                    self.model_cls,
                    cast(
                        ObjectSequenceServerRef[Any],
                        ServerRefs.from_ref_id(full_updated_ref, variant="object_sequence"),
                    ),
                    cast(
                        "Any",
                        _VersionedUpdateManyBatchConfig(
                            staging_ctx=sc,
                            source_order=_VersionedBatchSourceOrder.UNORDERED,
                            after_refs=frozenset(
                                {full_updated_ref, updated_count_ref, *spill_after_refs, *self.pre_write_after_refs},
                            ),
                            source_existence_prevalidated=True,
                            user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref,
                            source_columns=updated_source_columns,
                        ),
                    ),
                ).lower(ctx),
                *returned_hydration_steps,
                *(
                    ()
                    if requires_large_column_return_hydration and self.returning_projections is None
                    else (
                        ReturnSourceAfterDepsStep[list[Any]](
                            ServerPlanRefId(self.ref_id),
                            ReturnSourceAfterDepsConfig(
                                source_ref=(returned_updated_ref if self.returning_projections is not None else written_raw_ref),
                                after_refs=(write_ref,),
                                model_cls=None if self.returning_projections is not None else self.model_cls,
                                sequence_value=True,
                                dynamic_source_contract=True,
                            ),
                        ),
                    )
                ),
            ]

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_staging import copy_large_column_pointer_assignments
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.write_side_effect_intents import (
            RecordTableEventIntent,
            _RecordTableEventConfig,
            _has_matching_table_subscriptions,
        )

        effective_updates = dict(self.updates)
        copy_large_column_pointer_assignments(self.model_cls, effective_updates)
        supports_returning = ctx.sql_render_dialect().supports_returning()
        has_subscriptions = ctx.emit_table_event_intents and _has_matching_table_subscriptions(
            self.model_cls,
            "UPDATE",
        )

        if get_vector_indexes(self.model_cls) and supports_returning and not has_subscriptions:
            selected_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_selected_rows")
            updated_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.updated_rows")
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import ReturnSourceAfterDepsConfig, ReturnSourceAfterDepsStep

            steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
                *leading_steps,
                QueryExecuteStep(
                    selected_rows_ref,
                    self.model_cls,
                    _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                        query_spec=self.query_spec,
                        raw_mode=True,
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref,
                    ),
                ),
                QueryUpdateReturningStep(
                    updated_rows_ref,
                    self.model_cls,
                    _QueryUpdateReturningStepConfig(
                        query_spec=self.query_spec,
                        updates=effective_updates,
                        after_refs=frozenset({selected_rows_ref, *self.pre_write_after_refs}),
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
            steps.append(
                EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent(
                    ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_emb_queue"),
                    self.model_cls,
                    config=_EmbeddingAutoQueueConfig(
                        write_ref_id=updated_rows_ref,
                        event_type="UPDATE",
                        previous_rows_ref=selected_rows_ref,
                    ),
                ),
            )
            steps.append(
                ReturnSourceAfterDepsStep[list[Any]](
                    ServerPlanRefId(self.ref_id),
                    ReturnSourceAfterDepsConfig(
                        source_ref=updated_rows_ref,
                        after_refs=(updated_rows_ref,),
                        model_cls=None if self.returning_projections is not None else self.model_cls,
                        sequence_value=True,
                        dynamic_source_contract=True,
                    ),
                ),
            )
            return steps

        if (
            not supports_returning
            or has_subscriptions
            or self.returning_projections is not None
            or bool(get_vector_indexes(self.model_cls))
        ):
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import ReturnSourceAfterDepsConfig, ReturnSourceAfterDepsStep
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.update import (
                SelectedRowsUpdateRawResultStep,
                _SelectedRowsUpdateStepConfig,
            )
            from l2070_batching.server_ref import ObjectServerRef

            from dataclasses import replace

            selected_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.selected_rows")
            updated_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.updated_rows")
            selected_updates = dict(effective_updates)
            for config in get_large_column_configs(self.model_cls):
                if config.column in selected_updates and selected_updates[config.column] is None:
                    selected_updates[large_column_pointer_name(config.column)] = None
            result_ref = updated_ref
            projection_steps: list[_ProjectVersionedUpdatedRowsStep] = []
            if self.returning_projections is not None:
                result_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.projected_rows")
                projection_steps.append(
                    _ProjectVersionedUpdatedRowsStep(
                        result_ref,
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        source_ref=updated_ref,
                        returning_projections=self.returning_projections,
                    )
                )
            hydrate_large_column_result = self.returning_projections is None and bool(get_large_column_configs(self.model_cls))
            permission_context_ref = getattr(self.query_spec, "permission_context_ref", None)
            permission_context_type = getattr(self.query_spec, "permission_context_type", None)
            if (permission_context_ref is None) != (permission_context_type is None):
                msg = "Query update-returning permission context ref and model type must be provided together"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            steps = [
                *leading_steps,
                QueryExecuteStep(
                    selected_ref,
                    self.model_cls,
                    _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                        query_spec=replace(self.query_spec, select_columns=None, projection_output_aliases=None),
                        raw_mode=True,
                        after_refs=self.pre_write_after_refs,
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref,
                    ),
                ),
                SelectedRowsUpdateRawResultStep(
                    updated_ref,
                    self.model_cls,
                    _SelectedRowsUpdateStepConfig(
                        instance=ObjectServerRef(
                            None,
                            selected_ref,
                            type_hint=self.model_cls,
                        ),
                        selected_rows_ref=selected_ref,
                        patch_updates=selected_updates,
                        apply_update_rules=False,
                        materialize_selected_rows=True,
                        permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
                        permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
                    ),
                ),
                *projection_steps,
            ]
            if hydrate_large_column_result:
                from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.row_hydration import MaterializeResolvedModelSequenceStep

                steps.append(
                    MaterializeResolvedModelSequenceStep(
                        ServerPlanRefId(self.ref_id),
                        source_ref=updated_ref,
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        after_refs=frozenset({updated_ref}),
                        inline_large_columns=True,
                    )
                )
            else:
                steps.append(
                    ReturnSourceAfterDepsStep[list[Any]](
                        ServerPlanRefId(self.ref_id),
                        ReturnSourceAfterDepsConfig(
                            source_ref=result_ref,
                            after_refs=(result_ref,),
                            model_cls=None if self.returning_projections is not None else self.model_cls,
                            sequence_value=True,
                            dynamic_source_contract=self.returning_projections is not None,
                        ),
                    )
                )
            if get_vector_indexes(self.model_cls):
                steps.append(
                    EmbeddingAutoQueueIntent(
                        ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_emb_queue"),
                        self.model_cls,
                        config=_EmbeddingAutoQueueConfig(
                            write_ref_id=updated_ref,
                            event_type="UPDATE",
                            previous_rows_ref=selected_ref,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            if has_subscriptions:
                steps.extend(
                    RecordTableEventIntent(
                        ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_subscription_dispatch"),
                        self.model_cls,
                        _RecordTableEventConfig(
                            event_type="UPDATE",
                            write_ref_id=updated_ref,
                            old_rows_ref=selected_ref,
                        ),
                    ).lower(ctx)
                )
            return steps

        updated_rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.updated_rows")
        update_step = QueryUpdateReturningStep(
            updated_rows_ref,
            self.model_cls,
            _QueryUpdateReturningStepConfig(
                query_spec=self.query_spec,
                updates=effective_updates,
                after_refs=self.pre_write_after_refs,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref,
            ),
        )
        if get_large_column_configs(self.model_cls):
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.row_hydration import MaterializeResolvedModelSequenceStep

            return [
                *leading_steps,
                update_step,
                MaterializeResolvedModelSequenceStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(self.ref_id),
                    source_ref=updated_rows_ref,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    after_refs=frozenset({updated_rows_ref}),
                    inline_large_columns=True,
                ),
            ]
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import ReturnSourceAfterDepsConfig, ReturnSourceAfterDepsStep

        return [
            *leading_steps,
            update_step,

                    source_ref=updated_rows_ref,
                    after_refs=(updated_rows_ref,),
                    model_cls=None if self.returning_projections is not None else self.model_cls,
                    sequence_value=True,
                    dynamic_source_contract=True,
                ),
            ),
        ]

class KeysetPaginateIntent[T](IntentStep[Any]):
    """L4: Keyset pagination."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "query", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.ONE
    intent_read_only = True
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]
    query_spec: Any
    limit: int
    after: Any
    before: Any

    def __init__(
        self: KeysetPaginateIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _KeysetPaginateConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.query_spec = config.query_spec
        self.limit = config.limit
        self.after = config.after
        self.before = config.before
        self.after_refs = config.after_refs

    def schema_model_dependencies(self: KeysetPaginateIntent) -> tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], ...]:
        """Declare the paginated row model required by read-through routing."""
        return (self.model_cls,)

    def lower(self: KeysetPaginateIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_paginate import PaginationLimit, QueryKeysetPaginateStep

        leading_steps, user_id_ref_id = _build_session_user_resolution_steps(
            ref_id=self.ref_id,
            model_cls=self.model_cls,
            ctx=ctx,
            after_refs=self.after_refs,
        )
        return [
            *leading_steps,
            QueryKeysetPaginateStep(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                self.query_spec,
                PaginationLimit(self.limit),
                self.after,
                self.before,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                after_refs=self.after_refs,

def _require_seeded_scalar[T](
    ref: ScalarServerRef[T],
    *,
    owner: str,
    field_name: str,
    expected_type: type[T],
    ctx: object | None = None,
) -> T:
    ref_id = ref.ref_id
    if ref_id is None:
        msg = f"{owner} requires a seeded {field_name} ref"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    found, value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(ref_id))
    if not found:
        msg = f"{owner} requires a seeded {field_name} ref"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    if not isinstance(value, expected_type):
        msg = f"{owner} requires seeded {field_name} to be {expected_type.__name__}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return value

        field_name="tip_materialization",

        ctx=ctx,

def _gate_steps_by_condition(
    *,
    condition_ref: str,
    steps: Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.conditional_builders import (
        build_one_sided_conditional,
    )

    if not steps:
        return []
    if len(steps) > 1:
        result_step = steps[-1]
        return [
            build_one_sided_conditional(
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(result_step.ref_id),
                condition_ref=ServerPlanRefId(condition_ref),
                if_true_steps=list(steps),
                result_ref=ServerPlanRefId(result_step.ref_id),
                default_value=None,
            ),
        ]
    return [
        build_one_sided_conditional(
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id),
            condition_ref=ServerPlanRefId(condition_ref),
            if_true_steps=[step],
            result_ref=ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id),
            default_value=None,
        )
        for step in steps
    ]


def _lower_current_tip_branch_create_flow(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    branch_name: ScalarServerRef[BranchName],
    workspace_id: ScalarServerRef[WorkspaceId],
    from_revision_result_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    from_revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    tip_materialization: ScalarServerRef[BranchTipMaterialization],
    branchpoint_materialization: ScalarServerRef[BranchPointMaterialization],
    permission_context: ObjectServerRef[ResolvedSessionContext],
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.merge_three_way_steps import (
        _InvertBoolConfig,
        _InvertBoolStep,
    )

    has_tip_ref = _child_ref_id(ref_id, "has_tip")
    no_tip_ref = _child_ref_id(ref_id, "no_tip")
    seeded_ref = _child_ref_id(ref_id, "seeded_create")
    empty_ref = _child_ref_id(ref_id, "empty_create")

    seeded_steps = _gate_steps_by_condition(
        condition_ref=str(has_tip_ref),
        steps=list(
            CreateSeededBranchIntent(
                seeded_ref,
                domain=domain,
                branch_name=branch_name,
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                from_revision_id=from_revision_id,
                tip_materialization=tip_materialization,
                branchpoint_materialization=branchpoint_materialization,
                permission_context=permission_context,
            ).lower(ctx),
        ),
    )
    empty_steps = _gate_steps_by_condition(
        condition_ref=str(no_tip_ref),
        steps=list(
            CreateEmptyBranchIntent(
                empty_ref,
                domain=domain,
                branch_name=branch_name,
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                tip_materialization=tip_materialization,
                from_revision_id=cast("ScalarServerRef[RevisionId]", None),
                permission_context=permission_context,
            ).lower(ctx),
        ),
    )

    return [
        _HasValueStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(has_tip_ref),
            _RefIdConfig(ref_id=from_revision_result_ref),
        ),
        *seeded_steps,
        _InvertBoolStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(no_tip_ref),
            _InvertBoolConfig(source_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(has_tip_ref)),
        ),
        *empty_steps,
        _SelectResolveOrCreateBranchIdStep(
            _plan_ref(ref_id),
            _SelectResolveOrCreateBranchIdConfig(
                condition_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(has_tip_ref),
                resolved_branch_id_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(seeded_ref),
                created_branch_id_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(empty_ref),
            ),
        ),
    ]

_SEEDED_BRANCH_COPY_MODEL_PLAN_CACHE: ObjectCache[tuple[tuple[SqlTableName, type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]]], ...]] = ObjectCache(
    CacheConfig(eviction_policy="lru"),
    name="seeded_branch_copy_model_plan",
    max_entries=128,
)


def _versioning_domain_cache_key(domain: type[VersioningDomain]) -> str:
    return f"{domain.__module__}.{domain.__qualname__}:{id(domain)}"


def _seeded_branch_copy_model_plan(
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
) -> tuple[tuple[SqlTableName, type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]]], ...]:
    from impl.common.l7050_versioned_schema_builder.polymorphic_field_helper import (
        _get_table_root_class,
    )

    cache_key = _versioning_domain_cache_key(domain)
    cached = _SEEDED_BRANCH_COPY_MODEL_PLAN_CACHE.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached
    models_by_table: dict[
        SqlTableName,
        list[type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]]],
    ] = {}
    for model in topological_sort_versioned_models(domain.all_versioned_models()):
        if not has_table_config(model):
            continue
        base_table = get_table_name(model)
        models_by_table.setdefault(base_table, []).append(model)

    planned: list[tuple[SqlTableName, type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]]]] = []
    for base_table, table_models in models_by_table.items():
        copy_model = _get_table_root_class(table_models[0])
        if copy_model is None or not issubclass(copy_model, VersionedObjectRow):
            msg = (
                f"Seeded branch copy requires a versioned table root for {base_table!s}; the domain registered {table_models[0].__name__}"
            )
            raise TypeError(msg)
        incompatible_models = [
            model.__name__
            for model in table_models
            if not issubclass(model, copy_model)
            and (model.__module__, model.__qualname__) != (copy_model.__module__, copy_model.__qualname__)
        ]
        if incompatible_models:
            msg = (
                f"Seeded branch copy table {base_table!s} has models outside "
                f"the {copy_model.__name__} hierarchy: {', '.join(incompatible_models)}"
            )
            raise ValueError(msg)
        planned.append((base_table, copy_model))
    result = tuple(planned)
    _SEEDED_BRANCH_COPY_MODEL_PLAN_CACHE.set(cache_key, result)
    return result


def _domain_requires_materialized_branch_copy(domain: type[VersioningDomain]) -> bool:
    """Return whether non-graph versioned FKs require branch-copy boundaries."""
    from impl.common.l7100_versioned_operations.fk_field_resolver import iter_model_fks
    from l9600_graphs.graph import GraphEdge, GraphNode

    return any(
        fk.is_versioned_target
        and not issubclass(model, (GraphNode, GraphEdge))
        and not issubclass(fk.target_model, (GraphNode, GraphEdge))
        for _, model in _seeded_branch_copy_model_plan(domain)
        for fk in iter_model_fks(model)
    )


def _append_seeded_branch_anchor_steps(
    *,
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    workspace_id: ScalarServerRef[WorkspaceId],
    from_revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    new_branch_id: BranchId,
    tip_materialization: BranchTipMaterialization | ScalarServerRef[BranchTipMaterialization],
    branchpoint_materialization: BranchPointMaterialization,
    anchor_sys_id: SysId | None = None,
) -> None:
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_ops_steps import (
        _branch_metadata_columns,
        RecordBranchPointsStep,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.commit_branch_steps import (
        UpsertRevisionBranchAnchorStep,
        _UpsertRevisionBranchAnchorConfig,
    )

    tip_materialization_value = _resolve_tip_materialization_for_lowering(tip_materialization)
    parent_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(ref_id)
    depends_on = frozenset({parent_ref_id})
    index_table = str(get_table_name(domain.revision_branch_index_model))
    revision_parents_table = str(get_table_name(domain.revision_parent_model))
    branch_table = str(get_table_name(domain.branch_model))
    steps.append(
        UpsertRevisionBranchAnchorStep(
            ref_id=_plan_ref(f"{ref_id}:seed_anchor"),
            index_table=SqlTableName(index_table),
            revision_id=from_revision_id,
            branch_ref=cast("Any", new_branch_id),
            config=_UpsertRevisionBranchAnchorConfig(
                anchor_reason=RevisionAnchorReason.BRANCH_TIP,
                anchor_depth=0,
                depends_on=depends_on,
                sys_id=anchor_sys_id,
            ),
        ),
    )
    if branchpoint_materialization is BranchPointMaterialization.MATERIALIZED:
        steps.append(
            RecordBranchPointsStep(
                _plan_ref(f"{ref_id}:record_branch_points"),
                index_table=SqlTableName(index_table),
                branch_table=SqlTableName(branch_table),
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                revision_id=from_revision_id,
                exclude_branch_id=cast("Any", new_branch_id),
                branch_columns=_branch_metadata_columns(domain),
                depends_on=depends_on,
            ),
        )


def _append_seeded_branch_copy_steps(
    *,
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    workspace_id: ScalarServerRef[WorkspaceId],
    from_revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    new_branch_id: BranchId,
    tip_materialization: BranchTipMaterialization,
    branchpoint_materialization: BranchPointMaterialization,
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None,
) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_ops_steps import (
        CopySparseDataStep,
        CopySparseTipDataStep,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.commit_branch_steps import ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep
    from l9600_graphs.graph import GraphEdge, GraphNode

    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name

    parent_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(ref_id)
    depends_on = frozenset({parent_ref_id})
    index_table = str(get_table_name(domain.revision_branch_index_model))
    revision_parents_table = str(get_table_name(domain.revision_parent_model))
    tip_materialization_value = tip_materialization
    _append_seeded_branch_anchor_steps(
        steps=steps,
        domain=domain,
        ref_id=ref_id,
        workspace_id=workspace_id,
        from_revision_id=from_revision_id,
        new_branch_id=new_branch_id,
        tip_materialization=tip_materialization,
        branchpoint_materialization=branchpoint_materialization,
    )
    completion_dependencies: set[ServerPlanRefId] = {
        _plan_ref(f"{ref_id}:seed_anchor"),
    }
    if branchpoint_materialization is BranchPointMaterialization.MATERIALIZED:
        completion_dependencies.add(_plan_ref(f"{ref_id}:record_branch_points"))

    domain_models = tuple(domain.all_versioned_models())
    has_graph_models = any(isinstance(model, type) and issubclass(model, (GraphNode, GraphEdge)) for model in domain_models)
    from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import get_vector_indexes
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

    copy_model_plan = _seeded_branch_copy_model_plan(domain)
    requires_materialized_output = _domain_requires_materialized_branch_copy(domain)
    for source_table, model in copy_model_plan:
        for index_name, vector_config in get_vector_indexes(model).items():
            if vector_config.indexes_all_revisions:
                continue
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.merge_embedding_refs import (
                CopyForkEmbeddingRefsStep,
                merge_embedding_ref_tables,
            )

            for ref_table in merge_embedding_ref_tables(
                str(source_table),
                index_name,
                vector_config.content_store_strategy,
                planning_catalog=planning_catalog,
            ):
                copy_ref = _plan_ref(f"{ref_id}.fork_embedding_refs.{source_table}.{index_name}.{ref_table}")
                steps.append(
                    CopyForkEmbeddingRefsStep(
                        copy_ref,
                        ref_table=ref_table,
                        branch_table=SqlTableName(get_table_name(domain.branch_model)),
                        tip_column=SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("tip_revision_sys_id"))),
                        source_table=str(source_table),
                        index_name=index_name,
                        source_revision=from_revision_id,
                        target_branch=new_branch_id,
                        after_refs=frozenset({_plan_ref(f"{ref_id}:seed_anchor")}),
                    )
                )
                completion_dependencies.add(copy_ref)

    copy_sparse_branchpoint = branchpoint_materialization != BranchPointMaterialization.INHERITED
    if not copy_sparse_branchpoint and tip_materialization_value != BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED and not has_graph_models:
        return frozenset(completion_dependencies)

    copy_depends_on = frozenset({_plan_ref(f"{ref_id}:seed_anchor")})
    for base_table, model in copy_model_plan:
        sparse_table = derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(base_table))))).sparse
        if copy_sparse_branchpoint:
            steps.append(
                CopySparseDataStep(
                    _plan_ref(f"{ref_id}_copy_sparse_{base_table}"),
                    sparse_table=SqlTableName(sparse_table),
                    idx_table=SqlTableName(index_table),
                    from_revision_id=from_revision_id,
                    new_branch_id=cast("Any", new_branch_id),
                    model=model,
                    depends_on=copy_depends_on,
                ),
            )
            copy_depends_on = frozenset({_plan_ref(f"{ref_id}_copy_sparse_{base_table}")})
            completion_dependencies.update(copy_depends_on)
        copy_graph_auxiliary_tip = isinstance(model, type) and issubclass(model, (GraphNode, GraphEdge))
        if tip_materialization_value == BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED or copy_graph_auxiliary_tip:
            steps.append(
                CopySparseTipDataStep(
                    _plan_ref(f"{ref_id}_copy_tip_{base_table}"),
                    tip_table=SqlTableName(
                        derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(base_table))))).tip
                    ),
                    sparse_table=SqlTableName(sparse_table),
                    idx_table=SqlTableName(index_table),
                    revision_parents_table=SqlTableName(revision_parents_table),
                    from_revision_id=from_revision_id,
                    new_branch_id=cast("Any", new_branch_id),
                    model=model,
                    depends_on=copy_depends_on,
                    requires_materialized_output=requires_materialized_output,
                    versioning_domain=domain,
                ),
            )
            copy_depends_on = frozenset({_plan_ref(f"{ref_id}_copy_tip_{base_table}")})
            completion_dependencies.update(copy_depends_on)

    if has_graph_models:
        reconcile_ref = _plan_ref(f"{ref_id}_reconcile_graph_auxiliary")
        steps.append(
            ReconcileGraphAuxiliaryTablesStep(
                reconcile_ref,
                domain=domain,
                branch_ref=cast("Any", new_branch_id),
                depends_on=copy_depends_on,
            ),
        )
        completion_dependencies.add(reconcile_ref)

    return frozenset(completion_dependencies)

def _lower_genesis_branch_create_flow(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    branch_name: ScalarServerRef[BranchName],
    workspace_id: ScalarServerRef[WorkspaceId],
    revision_id: RevisionId,
    branch_id: BranchId | None = None,
    anchor_sys_id: SysId | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[ServerPlanStep[Any]], BranchId]:
    """Lower the initial domain branch creation without seeded copy steps."""
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    lookup_ref = _plan_ref(f"{ref_id}:existing_branch")
    require_missing_ref = _plan_ref(f"{ref_id}:require_missing")
    steps.append(
        _FetchBranchByNameStep(
            lookup_ref,
            _FetchBranchByNameConfig(
                branch_model=domain.branch_model,
                branch_name=branch_name,
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
            ),
        ),
    )
    steps.append(
        _RequireMissingBranchRowStep(
            require_missing_ref,
            _RequireMissingBranchRowConfig(
                branch_model=domain.branch_model,
                branch_row_ref_id=lookup_ref,
                error_message="Branch already exists",
            ),
        ),
    )
    insert_branch = InsertBranchRowStep(
        _plan_ref(ref_id),
        _InsertBranchRowConfig(
            branch_model=domain.branch_model,
            branch_name=branch_name,
            workspace_id=workspace_id,
            from_revision_id=revision_id,
            versioning_domain=domain,
            tip_materialization=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED),
            branchpoint_materialization=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchPointMaterialization.MATERIALIZED),
            depends_on=frozenset({require_missing_ref}),
            branch_id=branch_id,
            requires_materialized_output=_domain_requires_materialized_branch_copy(domain),
        ),
    )
    steps.append(insert_branch)
    _append_seeded_branch_anchor_steps(
        steps=steps,
        domain=domain,
        ref_id=ref_id,
        workspace_id=workspace_id,
        from_revision_id=ServerRefs.scalar(revision_id),
        new_branch_id=insert_branch.branch_id,
        tip_materialization=BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED,
        branchpoint_materialization=BranchPointMaterialization.MATERIALIZED,
        anchor_sys_id=anchor_sys_id,
    )
    return steps, insert_branch.branch_id


def _require_literal_branchpoint_materialization(
    branchpoint_materialization: BranchPointMaterialization | ScalarServerRef[BranchPointMaterialization],
    *,
    site: str,
    ctx: object | None = None,
) -> BranchPointMaterialization:
    if isinstance(branchpoint_materialization, BranchPointMaterialization):
        return branchpoint_materialization
    return _require_seeded_scalar(
        branchpoint_materialization,
        owner=site,
        field_name="branchpoint_materialization",
        expected_type=BranchPointMaterialization,
        ctx=ctx,
    )

class CreateSeededBranchIntent(IntentStep[BranchId]):
    """L4: Create a branch from an explicit seed revision and workspace."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "branch", "intent"})

    def __init__(
        self: CreateSeededBranchIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch_name: ScalarServerRef[BranchName],
        workspace_id: ScalarServerRef[WorkspaceId],
        from_revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
        tip_materialization: ScalarServerRef[BranchTipMaterialization],
        branchpoint_materialization: ScalarServerRef[BranchPointMaterialization],
        permission_context: ObjectServerRef[ResolvedSessionContext],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._domain = domain
        self._branch_name = branch_name
        self._workspace_id = workspace_id
        self._from_revision_id = from_revision_id
        self._tip_materialization = tip_materialization
        self._branchpoint_materialization = branchpoint_materialization
        self._permission_context_ref, self._permission_context_type = optional_object_relation_parts(permission_context)
        self._branch_id = BranchId.new()

    def dependencies(self: CreateSeededBranchIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        if self._permission_context_ref is None:
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset({self._permission_context_ref})

    @property
    def branch_id(self: CreateSeededBranchIntent) -> BranchId:
        return self._branch_id

    def lower(self: CreateSeededBranchIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        lookup_ref = _plan_ref(f"{self.ref_id}:existing_branch")
        require_missing_ref = _plan_ref(f"{self.ref_id}:require_missing")
        steps.append(
            _FetchBranchByNameStep(
                lookup_ref,
                _FetchBranchByNameConfig(
                    branch_model=self._domain.branch_model,
                    branch_name=self._branch_name,
                    workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
                ),
            ),
        )
        steps.append(
            _RequireMissingBranchRowStep(
                require_missing_ref,
                _RequireMissingBranchRowConfig(
                    branch_model=self._domain.branch_model,
                    branch_row_ref_id=lookup_ref,
                    error_message="Branch already exists",
                ),
            ),
        )
        resolved_tip_materialization = _resolve_tip_materialization_for_lowering(
            self._tip_materialization,
            ctx=ctx,
        )
        resolved_branchpoint_materialization = _resolve_literal_branchpoint_materialization_ref(
            self._branchpoint_materialization,
            ctx=ctx,
        )
        insert_branch_ref = _plan_ref(f"{self.ref_id}:insert_branch")
        guard_ref = _plan_ref(f"{self.ref_id}:insert_authority")
        read_guard_ref = _plan_ref(f"{self.ref_id}:source_revision_read")
        insert_branch = InsertBranchRowStep(
            insert_branch_ref,
            _InsertBranchRowConfig(
                branch_model=self._domain.branch_model,
                branch_name=self._branch_name,
                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
                from_revision_id=self._from_revision_id,
                versioning_domain=self._domain,
                branch_id=self._branch_id,
                tip_materialization=ServerRefs.scalar(resolved_tip_materialization),
                branchpoint_materialization=resolved_branchpoint_materialization,
                depends_on=frozenset({require_missing_ref, guard_ref, read_guard_ref}),
                requires_authorization_boundary=True,
                requires_materialized_output=_domain_requires_materialized_branch_copy(self._domain),
            ),
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_insert_permission import BranchInsertAuthorityStep

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_mutation_permission import RevisionReadPermissionStep

        steps.append(
            BranchInsertAuthorityStep(
                guard_ref,
                model=self._domain.branch_model,
                proposal=insert_branch,
                session_id=None,
                after=frozenset({require_missing_ref}),
                permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
            )
        )
        steps.append(
            RevisionReadPermissionStep(
                read_guard_ref,
                model=self._domain.revision_model,
                revision_id=self._from_revision_id,
                session_id=None,
                permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
            )
        )
        steps.append(insert_branch)
        new_branch_id = insert_branch.branch_id
        branchpoint_materialization = _require_literal_branchpoint_materialization(
            resolved_branchpoint_materialization,
            site="CreateSeededBranchIntent.branchpoint_materialization",
            ctx=ctx,
        )
        completion_dependencies = _append_seeded_branch_copy_steps(
            steps=steps,
            domain=self._domain,
            ref_id=insert_branch_ref,
            workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
            from_revision_id=self._from_revision_id,
            new_branch_id=new_branch_id,
            tip_materialization=resolved_tip_materialization,
            branchpoint_materialization=branchpoint_materialization,
            planning_catalog=ctx.planning_catalog,
        )
        steps.append(
            _SeededBranchMaterializationCompleteStep(
                _plan_ref(self.ref_id),
                branch_id=new_branch_id,
                depends_on=completion_dependencies,
            ),
        )
        return steps

class InitializeDomainIntent(IntentStep[InitializeDomainResult]):

        self: InitializeDomainIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _InitializeDomainConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._config = config

    def lower(self: InitializeDomainIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.commit_branch_steps import (
            InsertInitialRevisionStep,
            _InsertInitialRevisionConfig,
        )

        domain = self._config.domain
        revision_ref = _child_ref_id(self.ref_id, "revision")
        branch_ref = _child_ref_id(self.ref_id, "branch")
        from l2000_connection.schema_transaction import deterministic_bootstrap_versioning_domain_ids

        bootstrap_ids = deterministic_bootstrap_versioning_domain_ids(
            domain=domain,
            branch_name=_require_seeded_scalar(
                self._config.branch_name,
                owner=type(self).__name__,
                field_name="branch_name",
                expected_type=BranchName,
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            workspace_id=_require_seeded_scalar(
                self._config.workspace_id,
                owner=type(self).__name__,
                field_name="workspace_id",
                expected_type=WorkspaceId,
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
        )
        revision_id = bootstrap_ids.revision_id
        branch_steps, branch_id = _lower_genesis_branch_create_flow(
            ref_id=branch_ref,
            domain=domain,
            branch_name=self._config.branch_name,
            workspace_id=self._config.workspace_id,
            revision_id=revision_id,
            branch_id=bootstrap_ids.branch_id,
            anchor_sys_id=bootstrap_ids.revision_branch_index_id,
        )
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [
            InsertInitialRevisionStep(
                ref_id=revision_ref,
                revision_table_name=get_table_name(domain.revision_model),
                revision_model_cls=domain.revision_model,
                revision_id=revision_id,
                session_id=self._config.session_id,
                config=_InsertInitialRevisionConfig(
                    revision_metadata=dict(self._config.revision_metadata),
                ),
            ),
            *branch_steps,
            _BuildInitializeDomainResultStep(
                self.ref_id,
                revision_id=revision_id,
                branch_id=branch_id,
                revision_ref_id=revision_ref,
                branch_ref_id=branch_ref,
            ),
        ]
        return steps
