                permission_context=_absent_permission_context_ref(),
            ).lower(ctx),
        )
        exists_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_exists"
        extract_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_extract_branch_id"
        use_existing_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_use_existing"
        not_exists_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_not_exists"
        create_cond_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_create_if_missing"
        create_steps = _gate_steps_by_condition(
            condition_ref=not_exists_ref,
            steps=list(
                CreateEmptyBranchIntent(
                    ServerPlanRefId(create_cond_ref),
                    domain=self._domain,
                    branch_name=self._branch_name,
                    workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
                    from_revision_id=cast(
                        "ScalarServerRef[RevisionId]",
                        None,
                    ),
                    tip_materialization=cast(
                        "ScalarServerRef[BranchTipMaterialization]",
                        BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED,
                    ),
                    permission_context=_absent_permission_context_ref(),
                ).lower(ctx),
            ),
        )

        return [
            *resolve_steps,
            _HasValueStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(exists_ref),
                _RefIdConfig(ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref)),
            ),
            build_one_sided_conditional(
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(use_existing_ref),
                condition_ref=ServerPlanRefId(exists_ref),
                if_true_steps=[
                    _ExtractBranchIdStep(
                        ServerPlanRefId(extract_ref),
                        _RefIdConfig(ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref)),
                    ),
                ],
                result_ref=ServerPlanRefId(extract_ref),
                default_value=None,
            ),
            _InvertBoolStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(not_exists_ref),
                _InvertBoolConfig(source_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(exists_ref)),
            ),
            *create_steps,
            _SelectResolveOrCreateBranchIdStep(
                _plan_ref(self.ref_id),
                _SelectResolveOrCreateBranchIdConfig(
                    condition_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(exists_ref),
                    resolved_branch_id_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(use_existing_ref),
                    created_branch_id_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(create_cond_ref),
                ),
            ),
        ]


class ResolveOrCreateSeededBranchIntent(IntentStep[BranchId]):
    """L4: Resolve an existing branch or create it from a seed revision."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "branch", "resolve", "intent"})

    def __init__(
        self: ResolveOrCreateSeededBranchIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch_name: ScalarServerRef[BranchName],
        workspace_id: ScalarServerRef[WorkspaceId],
        from_revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
        tip_materialization: ScalarServerRef[BranchTipMaterialization],
        branchpoint_materialization: ScalarServerRef[BranchPointMaterialization],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._domain = domain
        self._branch_name = branch_name
        self._workspace_id = workspace_id
        self._from_revision_id = from_revision_id
        self._tip_materialization = tip_materialization
        self._branchpoint_materialization = branchpoint_materialization

    def lower(self: ResolveOrCreateSeededBranchIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from l1400_types import ServerPlanRefId
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.conditional_builders import (
            OneSidedConditionalStep,
        )

        resolve_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_resolve"
        resolve_steps = list(
            ResolveBranchByNameIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref),
                domain=self._domain,
                branch_name=self._branch_name,
                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
                permission_context=_absent_permission_context_ref(),
            ).lower(ctx),
        )
        exists_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_exists"
        extract_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_extract_branch_id"
        create_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_create_if_missing"
        extract_step = _ExtractBranchIdStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(extract_ref),
            _RefIdConfig(ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref)),
        )
        create_steps = list(
            CreateSeededBranchIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId(create_ref),
                domain=self._domain,
                branch_name=self._branch_name,
                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
                from_revision_id=self._from_revision_id,
                tip_materialization=self._tip_materialization,
                branchpoint_materialization=self._branchpoint_materialization,
                permission_context=_absent_permission_context_ref(),
            ).lower(ctx),
        )

        return [
            *resolve_steps,
            _HasValueStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(exists_ref),
                _RefIdConfig(ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref)),
            ),
            OneSidedConditionalStep(
                _plan_ref(self.ref_id),
                condition_ref=ServerPlanRefId(exists_ref),
                if_true_steps=(extract_step,),
                else_steps=create_steps,
                output_bindings={
                    _plan_ref(self.ref_id): (
                        ServerPlanRefId(extract_ref),
                        ServerPlanRefId(create_ref),
                    ),
                },
            ),
        ]

def test_insert_revision_reuses_metadata_db_column_cache(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    calls: list[tuple[type[BaseRevision], str]] = []
    original = commit_branch_steps.get_db_column_name

    def counting_get_db_column_name(model_cls: type[BaseRevision], field_name: DynamicFieldName) -> str:
        calls.append((model_cls, field_name))
        return original(model_cls, field_name)

    monkeypatch.setattr(commit_branch_steps, "get_db_column_name", counting_get_db_column_name)

        ServerPlanRefId("insert_revision"),

            revision_metadata={"message": "cached"},
            legacy_parent_mode=_LegacyRevisionParentMode.BRANCH_TIP,
        ),
    )
    calls_after_init = list(calls)

    step.cte_publication_contract()
    step.planning_fingerprint()
    step.compile(_ctx())

    assert calls_after_init == [
        (_CommitMetadataHashRevision, "sys_id"),
        (_CommitMetadataHashRevision, "parent_revision_sys_id"),
        (_CommitMetadataHashRevision, "parent_type"),
        (_CommitMetadataHashRevision, "timestamp"),
        (_CommitMetadataHashRevision, "session_id"),
        (_CommitMetadataHashRevision, "revision_compact_id"),
        (_CommitMetadataHashRevision, "message"),
    ]
    assert calls == calls_after_init

def test_publication_admission_compiles_once_per_unchanged_context(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    step = SpeculativePublicationGuardStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("speculative_guard"),
        all_base_table_names=("widgets", "notes"),
        speculative_base_table_names=("widgets",),
        branch_table_name=SqlTableName("sys_branches"),
        branch_tip_column_name=SqlColumnName("tip_revision_sys_id"),
        branch_id_column_name=SqlColumnName("sys_id"),
        scope=ExplicitSparsePublish(
            branch_id=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchId.new()),
            staged_commit_ids=(StagedCommitId.new(),),
        ),
        new_revision_id=RevisionId.new(),
    )
    original = SpeculativePublicationGuardStep.compile_admission
    compile_count = 0

    def counted_compile_admission(
        guarded_step: SpeculativePublicationGuardStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        nonlocal compile_count
        compile_count += 1
        return original(guarded_step, ctx)

    monkeypatch.setattr(SpeculativePublicationGuardStep, "compile_admission", counted_compile_admission)
    ctx = _ctx()

    first = _compile_publication_admission_once(step, ctx)
    second = _compile_publication_admission_once(step, ctx)

    assert first is second
    assert compile_count == 1

    ctx.cte_refs["unrelated"] = cte_ref(
        ServerPlanRefId("unrelated_cte"),
        columns=("value",),
        column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=frozenset({"value"})),
    )
    unrelated_rebound = _compile_publication_admission_once(step, ctx)
    assert unrelated_rebound is first
    assert compile_count == 1

    ctx.staged_source_cte_by_table["notes_staged"] = ServerPlanRefId("notes_overlay")
    rebound = _compile_publication_admission_once(step, ctx)

    assert rebound is not first
    assert compile_count == 2

@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["equal", "different", "null", "missing"])
def test_verify_branch_tip_executes_uuid_comparison(case: str) -> None:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.tests.testkit import make_compilation_context
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_cte_helpers import SqlExecutedRowsQuery
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlCte
    from impl.common.l2200_sql_dialect.sql_dialect import SqliteDialect
    from l2070_batching.hydrator import DictHydrator

    expected = RevisionId.new().unwrap_to_str()
    actual = expected if case == "equal" else RevisionId.new().unwrap_to_str()
    fetch_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(uuid_columns=frozenset({"current_tip_revision_id"}))
    expected_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(uuid_columns=frozenset({"value"}))
    fetched = SqlExecutedRowsQuery(
        columns=("current_tip_revision_id",),
        rows=[] if case == "missing" else [{"current_tip_revision_id": None if case == "null" else actual}],
        type_hints=fetch_hints,
    )
    expected_rows = SqlExecutedRowsQuery(
        columns=("value",),
        rows=[{"value": expected}],
        type_hints=expected_hints,
    )
    step = VerifyBranchTipMatchStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("verify"),
        fetch_ref=ServerPlanRefId("fetch"),
        expected_tip_revision_id=ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
            ServerPlanRefId("seed_7"),
            variant="scalar",
            type_hint=RevisionId,
        ),
    )
    compiled = step.compile(
        make_compilation_context(
            cte_refs={
                "fetch": cte_ref(ServerPlanRefId("fetch_rows"), columns=("current_tip_revision_id",), column_type_hints=fetch_hints),
                "seed_7": cte_ref(ServerPlanRefId("expected_rows"), columns=("value",), column_type_hints=expected_hints),
            }
        )
    )
    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    sql, params = (
        SqlCte(
            [("fetch_rows", fetched), ("expected_rows", expected_rows)],
            compiled.grammar,
        )
        .render(SqliteDialect())
        .to_sql(SqliteDialect())
    )
    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    try:
        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(sql, params).fetchall()]
    finally:
        connection.close()
    assert compiled.closed_post_op is not None
    assert compiled.closed_post_op(rows, DictHydrator()) is (case == "equal")

def _gate_steps_by_condition[StepsItemT](
    *,
    condition_ref: ServerPlanRefId | str,
    steps: Sequence[ServerPlanStep[StepsItemT]],
    force_initial_boundary: bool = False,
    allow_ordered_output_transport: bool = False,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.conditional_builders import (
        build_one_sided_conditional,
    )

    return [
        build_one_sided_conditional(
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id),
            condition_ref=ServerPlanRefId(condition_ref),
            if_true_steps=[step],
            result_ref=ServerPlanRefId(step.ref_id),
            default_value=None,
            force_prior_step_boundary=force_initial_boundary and index == 0,
            allow_ordered_output_transport=allow_ordered_output_transport,
        )
        for index, step in enumerate(steps)
    ]


def _permission_context_parts(
    context: ObjectServerRef[ResolvedSessionContext],
) -> tuple[ServerPlanRefId | None, type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None]:
    ref_id, context_type = optional_object_relation_parts(context)
    if context_type is not None and not issubclass(context_type, ResolvedSessionContext):
        msg = "Permission context intent input must declare ResolvedSessionContext"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return ref_id, context_type

def _require_seeded_scalar[T](ref: ScalarServerRef[T], *, owner: str, field_name: str) -> T:
    ref_id = ref.ref_id
    if ref_id is None:
        msg = f"{owner} requires a seeded {field_name} ref"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    found, value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(None, ServerPlanRefId(ref_id))
    if not found:
        msg = f"{owner} requires a seeded {field_name} ref"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    return cast("T", value)


def _append_branch_tip_update_tail(
    *,
    ref_prefix: str,
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    branch_id_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
    new_revision_ref: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    initial_dependencies: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
    requires_authorization_boundary: bool = False,
) -> tuple[list[ServerPlanStep[Any]], frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]]:
    """Build the shared branch-tip mutation tail after prerequisite publication."""

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.commit_branch_steps import (
        DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep,
        UpdateBranchTipStep,
        UpsertRevisionBranchAnchorStep,
        _DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorConfig,
        _UpsertRevisionBranchAnchorConfig,
    )

    branch_table = _branch_table(domain)
    index_table = _index_table(domain)
    current_dependencies = initial_dependencies
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []

    demote = DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorStep(
        ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_demote"),
        index_table,
        branch_id_ref,
        config=_DemoteOldBranchTipAnchorConfig(
            requires_authorization_boundary=requires_authorization_boundary,
            branch_table_name=branch_table,
            revision_parents_table_name=_revision_parents_table(domain),
            branch_id_column=SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))),
            tip_revision_column=SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("tip_revision_sys_id"))),
        ),
        depends_on=current_dependencies,
    )
    steps.append(demote)
    current_dependencies = frozenset({demote.ref_id})

    update = UpdateBranchTipStep(
        ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_update"),
        branch_id_ref,
        new_revision_ref,
        branch_table,
        branch_id_column=SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))),
        tip_revision_column=SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("tip_revision_sys_id"))),
        depends_on=current_dependencies,
    )
    steps.append(update)
    current_dependencies = frozenset({update.ref_id})

    upsert = UpsertRevisionBranchAnchorStep(
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_upsert_anchor"),
        index_table=index_table,
        revision_id=new_revision_ref,
        branch_ref=branch_id_ref,
        config=_UpsertRevisionBranchAnchorConfig(
            anchor_reason=RevisionAnchorReason.BRANCH_TIP,
            anchor_depth=0,
            depends_on=current_dependencies,
        ),
    )
    steps.append(upsert)
    current_dependencies = frozenset({upsert.ref_id})
    return steps, current_dependencies


def build_branch_tip_update_steps(
    *,
    ref_prefix: str,
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    branch_id_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
    new_revision_ref: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    initial_dependencies: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] | None = None,
    requires_authorization_boundary: bool = False,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Build the branch-tip mutation subgraph without optimistic locking."""

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_ops_steps import (
        InvalidateRevisionTagsOnCommitStep,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.cache_steps import CacheName

    current_dependencies: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = initial_dependencies or frozenset()
    steps, current_dependencies = _append_branch_tip_update_tail(
        ref_prefix=ref_prefix,
        domain=domain,
        branch_id_ref=branch_id_ref,
        new_revision_ref=new_revision_ref,
        initial_dependencies=current_dependencies,
        requires_authorization_boundary=requires_authorization_boundary,
    )
    steps.append(
        InvalidateRevisionTagsOnCommitStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_invalidate_pagination_cache"),
            cache_name=CacheName("pagination"),
            new_revision_id=new_revision_ref,
            depends_on=current_dependencies,
        ),
    )
    return steps


def build_branch_tip_update_with_expected_tip_steps(
    *,
    ref_prefix: str,
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    branch_id_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
    new_revision_ref: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    expected_tip_ref: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    initial_dependencies: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] | None = None,
    requires_authorization_boundary: bool = False,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
    """Build the branch-tip mutation subgraph with optimistic locking."""

    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_ops_steps import (
        BranchOptimisticLockStep,
        InvalidateRevisionTagsWithPreviousOnCommitStep,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.cache_steps import CacheName

    current_dependencies: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = initial_dependencies or frozenset()
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
    optlock = BranchOptimisticLockStep(
        ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_optlock"),
        _branch_table(domain),
        branch_id_ref,
        expected_tip_ref,
        branch_id_column=SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))),
        tip_revision_column=SqlColumnName(
            get_db_column_name(domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("tip_revision_sys_id")),
        ),
        depends_on=current_dependencies,
    )
    steps.append(optlock)
    current_dependencies = frozenset({optlock.ref_id})
    tail_steps, current_dependencies = _append_branch_tip_update_tail(
        ref_prefix=ref_prefix,
        domain=domain,
        branch_id_ref=branch_id_ref,
        new_revision_ref=new_revision_ref,
        initial_dependencies=current_dependencies,
        requires_authorization_boundary=requires_authorization_boundary,
    )
    steps.extend(tail_steps)

    steps.append(
        InvalidateRevisionTagsWithPreviousOnCommitStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_prefix}_invalidate_pagination_cache"),
            cache_name=CacheName("pagination"),
            new_revision_id=new_revision_ref,
            previous_revision_id=expected_tip_ref,
            depends_on=current_dependencies,
        ),
    )
    return steps

class DeleteBranchIntent(IntentStep[None]):
    """L4: Soft-delete a branch by setting its deleted flag."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "branch", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.NONE

    def __init__(
        self: DeleteBranchIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch_id: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
        *,
        session_id: SessionId,
        permission_context: ObjectServerRef[ResolvedSessionContext],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._session_id = session_id
        self._domain = domain
        self._permission_context_ref, self._permission_context_type = _permission_context_parts(permission_context)
        self._branch_id_ref = branch_id

    def dependencies(self: DeleteBranchIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        context_dependencies = frozenset() if self._permission_context_ref is None else frozenset({self._permission_context_ref})
        return self._branch_id_ref.dependencies() | context_dependencies

    def lower(
        self: DeleteBranchIntent,
        ctx: LoweringContext,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_ops_steps import (
            SoftDeleteBranchStep,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.validate_exists import (
            ValidateExistsByIdStep,
            ValidationErrorMessage,
        )
        from l1100_exceptions.exceptions import BranchNotFoundError

        table = _branch_table(self._domain)
        branch_id = self._branch_id_ref

        validate = ValidateExistsByIdStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_validate"),
            table,
            SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))),
            branch_id,
            ValidationErrorMessage("The lazily resolved branch does not exist"),
            exception_cls=BranchNotFoundError,
        )

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_mutation_permission import BranchDeletePermissionStep

        guard = BranchDeletePermissionStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}__branch_delete_permission"),
            model=self._domain.branch_model,
            branch_id=branch_id,
            session_id=self._session_id,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        soft_delete = SoftDeleteBranchStep(
            self.ref_id,
            table,
            branch_id,
            id_column=SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))),
            deleted_column=SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._domain.branch_model, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))),
            after=frozenset({validate.ref_id, guard.ref_id}),
        )

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_versioning_extended import (
            _register_lowered_commit_dependency_ref,
        )

        _register_lowered_commit_dependency_ref(
            ctx,
            semantic_ref=self.ref_id,
            dependency_ref=soft_delete.ref_id,
        )
        return [validate, guard, soft_delete]

class EnsureEmptyBranchIntent(IntentStep[BranchInfo]):
    """L4: Idempotently ensure an empty branch exists."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "branch", "intent"})

    def __init__(
        self: EnsureEmptyBranchIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch_name: ScalarServerRef[BranchName],
        workspace_id: ScalarServerRef[WorkspaceId],
        from_revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
        tip_materialization: ScalarServerRef[BranchTipMaterialization],
        branchpoint_materialization: ScalarServerRef[BranchPointMaterialization],
        permission_context: ObjectServerRef[ResolvedSessionContext],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._domain = domain
        self._branch_name = branch_name
        self._workspace_id = workspace_id
        self._from_revision_id = from_revision_id
        self._tip_materialization = tip_materialization
        self._branchpoint_materialization = branchpoint_materialization
        self._permission_context_ref, self._permission_context_type = _permission_context_parts(permission_context)

    def dependencies(self: EnsureEmptyBranchIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        if self._permission_context_ref is None:
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset({self._permission_context_ref})

    def lower(
        self: EnsureEmptyBranchIntent,
        ctx: Any,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.merge_three_way_steps import (
            _InvertBoolConfig,
            _InvertBoolStep,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioning_intent_steps import (
            _BuildBranchInfoConfig,
            _BuildBranchInfoStep,
            _FetchBranchByNameConfig,
            _FetchBranchByNameStep,
            _HasValueStep,
            _InsertBranchRowConfig,
            _RefIdConfig,
            InsertBranchRowStep,
        )

        branch_id_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_branch_id"
        resolve_ref = f"{branch_id_ref}_resolve"
        create_ref = f"{branch_id_ref}_create_if_missing"
        exists_ref = f"{branch_id_ref}_exists"
        not_exists_ref = f"{branch_id_ref}_not_exists"
        insert_guard_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_insert_authority")
        read_guard_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_existing_read_authority")

        insert_branch = InsertBranchRowStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(create_ref),
            _InsertBranchRowConfig(
                branch_model=self._domain.branch_model,
                branch_name=self._branch_name,
                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
                from_revision_id=self._from_revision_id,
                versioning_domain=self._domain,
                tip_materialization=self._tip_materialization,
                branchpoint_materialization=self._branchpoint_materialization,
                depends_on=frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(not_exists_ref), insert_guard_ref, read_guard_ref}),
                requires_authorization_boundary=True,
            ),
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_insert_permission import BranchInsertAuthorityStep

        insert_guard = BranchInsertAuthorityStep(
            insert_guard_ref,
            model=self._domain.branch_model,
            proposal=insert_branch,
            session_id=None,
            after=frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(not_exists_ref), read_guard_ref}),
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        create_steps = _gate_steps_by_condition(
            condition_ref=not_exists_ref,
            steps=[insert_guard, insert_branch],
            allow_ordered_output_transport=(
                ctx.backend_profile.traits.same_plan_write_transport is SamePlanWriteTransport.ORDERED_STATEMENTS
                and ctx.backend_profile.traits.request_scalar_transport is not RequestScalarTransport.NONE
            ),
        )
        read_guard_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_existing_read_authority")
        create_steps = (
            _existing_branch_read_guard(
                self._domain,
                self._branch_name,
                self._workspace_id,
                read_guard_ref,
                self._permission_context_ref,
                self._permission_context_type,
            )
            + create_steps
        )

        return [
            _FetchBranchByNameStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref),
                _FetchBranchByNameConfig(
                    branch_model=self._domain.branch_model,
                    branch_name=self._branch_name,
                    workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
                ),
            ),
            _HasValueStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(exists_ref),
                _RefIdConfig(ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref)),
            ),
            _InvertBoolStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(not_exists_ref),
                _InvertBoolConfig(source_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(exists_ref)),
            ),
            *create_steps,

class EnsureSeededBranchIntent(IntentStep[BranchInfo]):
    """L4: Idempotently ensure a seeded branch exists."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "branch", "intent"})

    def __init__(
        self: EnsureSeededBranchIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch_name: ScalarServerRef[BranchName],
        from_revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
        workspace_id: ScalarServerRef[WorkspaceId],
        tip_materialization: ScalarServerRef[BranchTipMaterialization],
        branchpoint_materialization: ScalarServerRef[BranchPointMaterialization],
        permission_context: ObjectServerRef[ResolvedSessionContext],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._domain = domain
        self._branch_name = branch_name
        self._from_revision_id = from_revision_id
        self._workspace_id = workspace_id
        self._tip_materialization = tip_materialization
        self._branchpoint_materialization = branchpoint_materialization
        self._permission_context_ref, self._permission_context_type = _permission_context_parts(permission_context)

    def dependencies(self: EnsureSeededBranchIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        if self._permission_context_ref is None:
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset({self._permission_context_ref})

    def lower(
        self: EnsureSeededBranchIntent,
        ctx: Any,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_versioning import (
            _append_seeded_branch_copy_steps,
            _require_literal_branchpoint_materialization,
            _resolve_literal_branchpoint_materialization_ref,
            _resolve_tip_materialization_for_lowering,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.merge_three_way_steps import (
            _InvertBoolConfig,
            _InvertBoolStep,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioning_intent_steps import (
            _BuildBranchInfoConfig,
            _BuildBranchInfoStep,
            _FetchBranchByNameConfig,
            _FetchBranchByNameStep,
            _HasValueStep,
            _InsertBranchRowConfig,
            _RefIdConfig,
            InsertBranchRowStep,
        )
        from l2070_batching.server_ref import ServerRefs

        branch_id_ref = f"{self.ref_id}_branch_id"
        resolve_ref = f"{branch_id_ref}_resolve"
        create_ref = f"{branch_id_ref}_create_if_missing"
        exists_ref = f"{branch_id_ref}_exists"
        not_exists_ref = f"{branch_id_ref}_not_exists"
        insert_guard_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_insert_authority")
        source_guard_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_source_read_authority")
        read_guard_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_existing_read_authority")
        resolved_tip_materialization = _resolve_tip_materialization_for_lowering(
            self._tip_materialization,
        )
        resolved_branchpoint_materialization = _resolve_literal_branchpoint_materialization_ref(
            self._branchpoint_materialization,
        )
        insert_branch = InsertBranchRowStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(create_ref),
            _InsertBranchRowConfig(
                branch_model=self._domain.branch_model,
                branch_name=self._branch_name,
                workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
                from_revision_id=self._from_revision_id,
                versioning_domain=self._domain,
                tip_materialization=ServerRefs.scalar(resolved_tip_materialization),
                branchpoint_materialization=resolved_branchpoint_materialization,
                depends_on=frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(not_exists_ref), insert_guard_ref, source_guard_ref, read_guard_ref}),
                requires_authorization_boundary=True,
            ),
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_insert_permission import BranchInsertAuthorityStep
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_mutation_permission import RevisionReadPermissionStep

        insert_guard = BranchInsertAuthorityStep(
            insert_guard_ref,
            model=self._domain.branch_model,
            proposal=insert_branch,
            session_id=None,
            after=frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(not_exists_ref), read_guard_ref}),
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        source_guard = RevisionReadPermissionStep(
            source_guard_ref,
            model=self._domain.revision_model,
            revision_id=self._from_revision_id,
            session_id=None,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        raw_create_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [insert_guard, source_guard, insert_branch]
        branchpoint_materialization = _require_literal_branchpoint_materialization(
            resolved_branchpoint_materialization,
            site="EnsureSeededBranchIntent.branchpoint_materialization",
        )
        completion_dependencies = _append_seeded_branch_copy_steps(
            steps=raw_create_steps,
            domain=self._domain,
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(create_ref),
            workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
            from_revision_id=self._from_revision_id,
            new_branch_id=insert_branch.branch_id,
            tip_materialization=resolved_tip_materialization,
            branchpoint_materialization=branchpoint_materialization,
        )
        # Keep the branch-existence result stable after the insert. See the
        # predicate-capture contract in docs/design/NER1689_MARIADB_GRAPH_BOOTSTRAP.rst.
        gate_condition_ref = not_exists_ref
        predicate_capture_steps: list[ServerPlanStep[bool]] = []
        from l9600_graphs.graph import GraphEdge, GraphNode

        has_graph_models = any(
            isinstance(model, type) and issubclass(model, (GraphNode, GraphEdge)) for model in self._domain.all_versioned_models()
        )
        requires_transaction_predicate_capture = (
            has_graph_models
            and not ctx.backend_profile.traits.supports_data_modifying_ctes
            and ctx.backend_profile.traits.request_scalar_transport is RequestScalarTransport.NONE
        )
        if requires_transaction_predicate_capture:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.capture_predicate import CapturePredicateStep

            captured_predicate_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"mcp_{insert_branch.branch_id}")
            predicate_capture_steps.append(
                CapturePredicateStep(
                    captured_predicate_ref,
                    predicate_ref=ServerPlanRefId(not_exists_ref),
                )
            )
            gate_condition_ref = str(captured_predicate_ref)
        create_steps = _gate_steps_by_condition(
            condition_ref=gate_condition_ref,
            steps=raw_create_steps,
            force_initial_boundary=ctx.backend_profile.traits.supports_data_modifying_ctes,
            allow_ordered_output_transport=(
                ctx.backend_profile.traits.same_plan_write_transport is SamePlanWriteTransport.ORDERED_STATEMENTS
                and ctx.backend_profile.traits.request_scalar_transport is not RequestScalarTransport.NONE
            ),
        )
        read_guard_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_existing_read_authority")
        create_steps = (
            _existing_branch_read_guard(
                self._domain,
                self._branch_name,
                self._workspace_id,
                read_guard_ref,
                self._permission_context_ref,
                self._permission_context_type,
            )
            + create_steps
        )

        return [
            _FetchBranchByNameStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref),
                _FetchBranchByNameConfig(
                    branch_model=self._domain.branch_model,
                    branch_name=self._branch_name,
                    workspace_id=self._workspace_id,
                ),
            ),
            _HasValueStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(exists_ref),
                _RefIdConfig(ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref)),
            ),
            _InvertBoolStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(not_exists_ref),
                _InvertBoolConfig(source_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(exists_ref)),
            ),
            *predicate_capture_steps,
            *create_steps,
            _BuildBranchInfoStep(
                self.ref_id,
                _BuildBranchInfoConfig.resolve_or_create(
                    condition_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(exists_ref),
                    resolved_branch_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref),
                    created_branch_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(create_ref),
                    created_branch_id=insert_branch.branch_id,
                    from_revision_id=self._from_revision_id,
                    tip_materialization=self._tip_materialization,
                    extra_dependencies=completion_dependencies | frozenset({read_guard_ref}),
                ),
            ),
        ]

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.validate_exists import (

            build_branch_tip_update_steps(

                branch_id_ref=self._branch_id_ref,
                new_revision_ref=self._new_revision_id_ref,
                initial_dependencies=frozenset(step.ref_id for step in steps),
                requires_authorization_boundary=True,

        steps.append(StaticValueAfterDepsStep(self.ref_id, None, [steps[-1].ref_id]))

        return steps

class DeleteRevisionIntent(IntentStep[None]):
    """L4: Delete a revision and its associated data."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "revision", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.NONE

    def __init__(
        self: DeleteRevisionIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._domain = domain
        self._revision_id = _require_seeded_scalar(
            revision_id,
            owner=type(self).__name__,
            field_name="revision_id",
        )

    def lower(
        self: DeleteRevisionIntent,
        ctx: Any,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_ops_steps import (
            DeleteRevisionDataStep,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.grammar_execute import (
            GrammarEffectStep,
            _GrammarExecuteConfig,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.validate_exists import (
            ValidateExistsStep,
            ValidateZeroCountStep,
            ValidationErrorMessage,
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_dml_simple import SqlDeleteWithWhere
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_validate import SqlCountWhere
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
        from l1400_types import ServerPlanRefId

        rev_table = _revision_table(self._domain)
        branch_table = _branch_table(self._domain)
        revision_id = self._revision_id
        rev_id_raw = str(revision_id)
        p = self.ref_id

        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []

        steps.append(
            ValidateExistsStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}_rev_exists"),
                SqlCountWhere(
                    rev_table,
                    SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._domain.revision_model, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))),
                    revision_id,
                ),
                ValidationErrorMessage(f"Revision {revision_id} does not exist"),
                exception_cls=_programming_error(),
            ),
        )

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_ops_steps import CountBranchesAtRevisionStep

        steps.append(
            ValidateZeroCountStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}_no_branches"),
                CountBranchesAtRevisionStep.build_grammar(
                    branch_table,
                    revision_id,
                ),
                ValidationErrorMessage(
                    f"Cannot delete revision {revision_id}: branches point to it. Use force=True to update branch references.",
                ),
                exception_cls=_integrity_error(),
            ),
        )

        for model in self._domain.all_versioned_models():
            model_table = get_table_name(model)
            steps.append(
                DeleteRevisionDataStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}_del_{model_table}"),
                    SqlTableName(model_table),
                    revision_id,
                ),
            )

        steps.append(
            GrammarEffectStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(self.ref_id),
                SqlDeleteWithWhere(
                    table=SqlTableIdent(rev_table),
                    where=SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(rev_id_raw),
                    ),
                ),
                config=_GrammarExecuteConfig(
                    reads=frozenset(),
                    writes=frozenset({rev_table}),
                ),
            ),
        )

        return steps

                ),
                ValidationErrorMessage(f"Revision {revision_id} does not exist"),
                exception_cls=_programming_error(),
            ),
            ForceMoveBlockedBranchesStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}_force_move"),
                branch_table,
                rev_table,
                revision_id,
            ),
        ]

        for model in self._domain.all_versioned_models():
            model_table = get_table_name(model)
            steps.append(
                DeleteRevisionDataStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}_del_{model_table}"),
                    SqlTableName(model_table),
                    revision_id,
                ),
            )

        steps.append(
            GrammarEffectStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(self.ref_id),
                SqlDeleteWithWhere(
                    table=SqlTableIdent(rev_table),
                    where=SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(rev_id_raw),
                    ),
                ),
                config=_GrammarExecuteConfig(
                    reads=frozenset(),
                    writes=frozenset({rev_table}),
                ),
            ),
        )

        return steps

class DiscardStagedCommitsIntent(IntentStep[DiscardResult]):
    """L4: Discard all staged commits without publishing them."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "staged_commit", "intent"})

    def __init__(
        self: DiscardStagedCommitsIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        permission_context: ObjectServerRef[ResolvedSessionContext],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._domain = domain
        self._permission_context = permission_context
        self._permission_context_ref, self._permission_context_type = optional_object_relation_parts(
            permission_context,
        )

    def dependencies(self: DiscardStagedCommitsIntent) -> frozenset[str]:
        if self._permission_context_ref is None:
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset({self._permission_context_ref})

    def lower(
        self: DiscardStagedCommitsIntent,
        ctx: Any,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.branch_ops_steps import (
            DeleteAuthorizedStagedDataBySubqueryStep,
            DeleteAuthorizedStagedRecordsStep,
            DiscardResultCollectorStep,
            ListStagedCommitsStep,
            _StagedCommitBranchPolicy,
        )

        sc_table = _staged_commit_table(self._domain)
        p = self.ref_id

        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        branch_policy = _StagedCommitBranchPolicy(
            _branch_table(self._domain),
            self._domain.branch_model,
            self._permission_context,
        )

        list_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}_list")
        steps.append(
            ListStagedCommitsStep(
                list_ref,
                sc_table,
                self._domain.staged_commit_model,
                for_update=True,
                branch_table=_branch_table(self._domain),
                branch_model=self._domain.branch_model,
                permission_context=self._permission_context,
            ),
        )

        list_dep: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset({list_ref})
        data_delete_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        for model in self._domain.all_versioned_models():
            model_table = get_table_name(model)
            staged_table = derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(model_table))).staged
            del_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}_del_{model_table}")
            data_delete_refs.append(del_ref)
            steps.append(
                DeleteAuthorizedStagedDataBySubqueryStep(
                    del_ref,
                    SqlTableName(staged_table),
                    sc_table,
                    branch_policy=branch_policy,
                    depends_on=list_dep,
                ),
            )

        delete_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}_del_commits")
        steps.append(
            DeleteAuthorizedStagedRecordsStep(
                delete_ref,
                sc_table,
                branch_policy=branch_policy,
                depends_on=list_dep,
            ),
        )

        steps.append(
            DiscardResultCollectorStep(
                self.ref_id,
                list_ref=list_ref,
                data_delete_refs=data_delete_refs,
                extra_dependencies=frozenset({delete_ref}),
            ),
        )

        return steps

        authority = MetadataAuthorityStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}:branch_write_authority"),
            model=self._domain.branch_model,
            row_id=self._branch_id,
            session_id=None,
            action="update",
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        steps.append(authority)
        list_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}_list")
        steps.append(
            ListStagedCommitsByBranchStep(
                list_ref,
                sc_table,
                self._domain.staged_commit_model,
                branch_id=self._branch_id,
                for_update=True,
                authorization_dependencies=frozenset({authority.ref_id}),
            ),
        )
        list_dep: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset({list_ref})
        data_delete_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = []
        for model in self._domain.all_versioned_models():
            model_table = get_table_name(model)
            staged_table = derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(model_table))).staged
            del_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}_del_{model_table}")
            data_delete_refs.append(del_ref)
            steps.append(
                DeleteStagedDataByBranchSubqueryStep(
                    del_ref,
                    SqlTableName(staged_table),
                    sc_table,
                    branch_id=self._branch_id,
                    depends_on=list_dep,
                )
                if requires_standalone_subqueries
                else DeleteStagedDataBySubqueryStep(
                    del_ref,
                    SqlTableName(staged_table),
                    SqlTableName(list_ref),
                    depends_on=list_dep,
                ),
            )
        record_delete_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{p}_delete_records")
        steps.append(
            DeleteStagedRecordsByBranchStep(
                record_delete_ref,
                sc_table,
                branch_id=self._branch_id,
                depends_on=frozenset(data_delete_refs),
            )
            if requires_standalone_subqueries
            else DeleteStagedRecordsFromSourceStep(
                record_delete_ref,
                sc_table,
                list_ref,
            ),
        )
        steps.append(
            DiscardResultCollectorStep(
                self.ref_id,
                list_ref,
                data_delete_refs,
            ),
        )
        return steps

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _SessionValidationCommitEffectFactory:
    """Bind the post-op ``ValidatedSessionState`` result to the commit effect."""

    def __call__(self, result: object) -> tuple[PipelineLifecycleEffect, ...]:
        if not isinstance(result, ValidatedSessionState) or not result.cacheable:
            return ()
        return (
            SessionValidationCommitEffect(
                session_id=result.session_id,
                state=result,
            ),
        )


def _cache_validated_session_state(
    target: object | None,
    session_id: SessionId,
    state: ValidatedSessionState,
) -> None:
    """Persist successful validation on the explicit connection cache target."""
    validated_sessions = getattr(target, "_validated_sessions", None)
    validated_user_ids = getattr(target, "_validated_session_user_ids", None)
    if not isinstance(validated_sessions, dict) or not isinstance(validated_user_ids, dict):
        return

    session_id_sql = session_id.unwrap_to_sql()
    validated_sessions[session_id_sql] = state.expires_at
    validated_user_ids[session_id_sql] = None if state.user_id is None else state.user_id.unwrap_to_str()


def _mark_validated_session_state(
    target: object | None,
    state: ValidatedSessionState,
) -> None:
    """Publish validation state to the explicit transaction state target."""
    if target is None:
        return
    object.__setattr__(target, "_session_validated_in_enter", True)
    object.__setattr__(
        target,
        "_nera_validated_session_user_id",
        None if state.user_id is None else state.user_id.unwrap_to_str(),
    )
    object.__setattr__(
        target,
        "_nera_validated_session_type",
        state.session_type,
    )


def _session_type_for(session_id: SessionId) -> SqlSessionType:
    """Return the logical session type used by backend guards."""
    return SqlSessionType(
        "system" if session_id.is_schema_session() else "user",
    )


class ApplySqlSessionContextStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """Tell the connection which session it is acting as.

    Emits backend-specific SQL -- ``set_config`` on Postgres, ``SET
    @session_id`` on MariaDB, a UDF call on SQLite -- so that session state is
    established by ordinary plan execution rather than beside it.
    ``on_commit`` records plan-local preamble satisfaction only.

    Two things about this step are load-bearing and neither is visible from
    the code alone.

    **It must run after validation, and until recently it did not.**
    ``SessionValidationOptimizer`` places ``SessionValidationStep`` ahead of
    this one so that the connection adopts an identity only after the row
    behind it has been read. On writes the violation used to be more than an
    ordering slip: ``_enter_sql_write_sync`` applied the context directly in
    ``__enter__``, outside the plan entirely, so the assignment could not be
    reordered and could not be observed by any test that inspected the plan.
    That call is gone and this step is now the only thing that applies session
    context. Do not reintroduce an eager application for convenience; if
    something needs the state earlier than the preamble, the preamble is what
    should move.

    **The identifier comes out of the validated relation, not out of Python.**
    When a ``SessionValidationStep`` published a relation into this flush, this
    step reads ``sys_id`` back from it rather than binding ``ctx.session_id``.
    The difference looks cosmetic on a concrete session, where the two values are
    equal anyway, and it is not: equal-because-Python-passed-the-same-literal is
    a property of this module, while equal-by-construction is a property of the
    transaction. Only the second survives a session whose identifier is not a
    Python value at all, which is what ``authenticated_session_lazy`` hands over,
    and the fallback below is what keeps the system and schema sentinels working
    -- they are never validated, so there is no relation to read.

    MySQL keeps the literal. ``SET @session_id = ...`` cannot reference a CTE
    defined for the statement, exactly as ``SetRlsContextStep`` already
    discovered for ``SET @nera_user_id``, so the sourcing there has to wait for
    that assignment to move inside a statement that can carry one.
    """

    def __init__(
        self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        preamble_memo: SqlPreambleMemo | None = None,
        preamble_ref_id: SqlPreambleRefName | None = None,
        session_validation_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        ordering_validation_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._preamble_memo = preamble_memo
        self._preamble_ref_id = preamble_ref_id
        self._session_validation_ref = session_validation_ref
        self._ordering_validation_ref = ordering_validation_ref

    @property
    def level(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def compile(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        if ctx.session_id is None:
            return CompiledStep()

        # A session that is still a query is statically a user session, and it is
        # not a guess: ``authenticated_session_lazy`` names that contract, and the
        # gate enforces it in SQL by refusing any row that is system-typed or
        # carries no user. So the Python branch that would otherwise inspect the
        # identifier has nothing left to decide.
        source = session_sql_source_or_none(ctx.session_id)
        scalar_source = ctx.session_id if isinstance(ctx.session_id, ScalarServerRef) else None
        session_id_obj = None if source is not None or scalar_source is not None else SessionId(str(ctx.session_id))
        session_type = SqlSessionType("user") if session_id_obj is None else _session_type_for(session_id_obj)

        validated_sys_id, consumed_cte = self._validated_session_id_expression(ctx)
        if validated_sys_id is not None:
            session_id_expr: SysIdValue | SqlRenderable = validated_sys_id
        elif source is not None:
            session_id_expr = source.session_id_expression(ctx)
        elif scalar_source is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import (
                lower_scalar_server_ref,
            )

            session_id_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(scalar_source, ctx)
        else:
            assert session_id_obj is not None
            session_id_expr = SysIdValue(session_id_obj.unwrap_to_sql())

        context_grammar: SqlRenderable = SqlApplySessionContext(session_id_expr, session_type)

        auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, object]] | None = None
        output_shape: CompiledOutputShape | None = None
        result_relation: DeclaredResultRelation | None = None
        column_type_hints: SqlColumnTypeHints | None = None
        lifecycle_effects: tuple[Any, ...] = (
            MarkSqlPreambleRefSatisfiedEffect(
                preamble_memo=self._preamble_memo,
                preamble_ref_id=self._preamble_ref_id,
            ),
            MarkSqlPreambleSessionContextAppliedEffect(),
        )
        closed_post_op = None
        if consumed_cte is not None and consumed_cte.auxiliary_query is not None:
            auxiliary_ctes = [(consumed_cte.ref_id, consumed_cte.auxiliary_query)]
            from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectList
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlSubquery
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnAlias, SqlColumnRef
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

            validation_columns = tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in consumed_cte.columns)
            output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
                tuple(synthetic_output_field(str(column)) for column in validation_columns),
            )
            result_relation = DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape)
            column_type_hints = consumed_cte.column_type_hints
            context_grammar = SqlSelect(
                select_list=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        *(SqlColumnRef(column) for column in validation_columns),
                        SqlColumnAlias(SqlSubquery(context_grammar), SqlAliasName("__session_context_applied")),
                    ],
                ),
                from_=SqlTableName(consumed_cte.ref_id),
            )
            closed_post_op = session_validation_post_op(
                model_cls=SessionAuthValidationRow,
            )
            validation_effects: tuple[Any, ...] = (
                ResultBoundLifecycleEffects(
                    factory=_SessionValidationCommitEffectFactory(),
                ),
                MarkSqlPreambleSessionValidatedEffect(),
            )
            lifecycle_effects = (*validation_effects, *lifecycle_effects)

        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=context_grammar,
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            needs_returning=closed_post_op is not None,
            closed_post_op=closed_post_op,
            lifecycle_effects=lifecycle_effects,
        )

    def dependent_read_cte_publication_contract(
        self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep,
    ) -> CtePublicationContract:
        """Describe the relation used to fuse MariaDB session setup with reads."""
        return semantic_row_contract(
            columns=("session_id", "session_type"),
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                uuid_columns=frozenset({"session_id"}),
                text_columns=frozenset({"session_type"}),
            ),
            row_cls=SessionContextPublicationRow,
            relation_role="session_context",
        )

    def compile_dependent_read_cte_relation(
        self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        """Compile MariaDB session setup as a row in the enclosing read statement."""
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.session_context_transport is not SessionContextTransport.SESSION_VARIABLES:
            raise TypeError("Session-context relation compilation requires session-variable transport")
        if ctx.session_id is None:
            return CompiledStep()

        source = session_sql_source_or_none(ctx.session_id)
        scalar_source = ctx.session_id if isinstance(ctx.session_id, ScalarServerRef) else None
        session_id_obj = None if source is not None or scalar_source is not None else SessionId(str(ctx.session_id))
        session_type = SqlSessionType("user") if session_id_obj is None else _session_type_for(session_id_obj)
        validated_sys_id, _consumed_cte = self._validated_session_id_expression(
            ctx,
            allow_session_variables=True,
        )
        if validated_sys_id is not None:
            session_id_expr: SysIdValue | SqlRenderable = validated_sys_id
        elif source is not None:
            session_id_expr = source.session_id_expression(ctx)
        elif scalar_source is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import (
                lower_scalar_server_ref,
            )

            session_id_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(scalar_source, ctx)
        else:
            assert session_id_obj is not None
            session_id_expr = SysIdValue(session_id_obj.unwrap_to_sql())

        contract = self.dependent_read_cte_publication_contract()
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            contract,
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=SqlApplySessionContextRelation(session_id_expr, session_type),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            needs_returning=True,
            lifecycle_effects=(
                MarkSqlPreambleRefSatisfiedEffect(
                    preamble_memo=self._preamble_memo,
                    preamble_ref_id=self._preamble_ref_id,
                ),
                MarkSqlPreambleSessionContextAppliedEffect(),
            ),
        )

    def _validated_session_id_expression(
        self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
        *,
        allow_session_variables: bool = False,
    ) -> tuple[SqlRenderable | None, CteReference | None]:
        """The ``sys_id`` of the validated session, as SQL, when one is available.

        Returns ``(None, None)`` whenever the identifier has to stay a literal,
        which covers three distinct cases and they are worth separating:

        * no validation ref was passed, so this is a plan the optimizer built
          without a validation step -- the system and schema sentinels;
        * a ref was passed but the relation is not in this flush, so referencing
          it would render a CTE name that the statement does not define;
        * the backend is MySQL-family, where the assignment is a ``SET`` and
          cannot carry a ``WITH`` clause at all.
        """
        if self._session_validation_ref is None:
            return None, None
        if (
            ctx.backend_profile.traits.session_context_transport is SessionContextTransport.SESSION_VARIABLES
            and not allow_session_variables
        ):
            return None, None
        validation_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._session_validation_ref))
        if not isinstance(validation_cte, CteReference):
            return None, None

        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlCteStepName
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_dml_simple import SqlCteFieldRef

        return SqlCteFieldRef(SqlCteStepName(validation_cte.ref_id), SqlColumnName("sys_id")), validation_cte

    def dependencies(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Depend on validation when this step reads its relation.

        Ordering is already what ``SessionValidationOptimizer`` emits, so this
        is not what puts validation first. It is what stops a later
        rearrangement from silently separating the two: without it, a reordering
        would produce a statement referencing a CTE that no longer precedes it,
        and the failure would be a SQL error far from its cause.
        """
        validation_ref = self._ordering_validation_ref or self._session_validation_ref
        if validation_ref is None:
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset({str(validation_ref)})

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Keep validation as an ordering edge, not a gate around session-state SQL."""
        return frozenset()

    def tables_read(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def physical_tables_written(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def step_tags(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"infrastructure", "sql_session_context"})

    def is_sql_session_preamble(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def applies_sql_session_context(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def result_cardinality(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def has_physical_table_writes(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def execution_role(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def supports_ordered_sql_statement_batch(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def ordered_statement_sql_visible_dependencies(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        """The validation edge orders transport; a standalone context statement uses the same session ID."""
        return frozenset()

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def emits_sql_for_accounting(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> bool | None:
        return True

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self: ApplySqlSessionContextStep) -> bool | None:
        return False

class ApplySqlSessionAndQueueAuthStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """Apply concrete MySQL-family session and queue state in one preamble statement."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        session_id: SessionId,
        token: QueueAuthToken | None,
        preamble_memo: SqlPreambleMemo | None,

        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._session_id = session_id
        self._token = token
        self._preamble_memo = preamble_memo

    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        if (
            ctx.backend_profile.traits.session_context_transport is not SessionContextTransport.SESSION_VARIABLES
            or ctx.backend_profile.traits.queue_auth_transport is not QueueAuthTransport.SESSION_VARIABLE
        ):
            msg = "Combined session/queue preamble requires session-variable transport"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        session_type = _session_type_for(self._session_id)
        token = None if self._token is None else SqlSessionValue(self._token)
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=SqlApplySessionAndQueueAuthState(
                SysIdValue(self._session_id.unwrap_to_sql()),
                session_type,
                token,
            ),
            lifecycle_effects=(
                MarkSqlPreambleRefSatisfiedEffect(
                    preamble_memo=self._preamble_memo,
                    preamble_ref_id=SqlPreambleRefName("__apply_sql_session_context"),
                ),
                MarkSqlPreambleRefSatisfiedEffect(
                    preamble_memo=self._preamble_memo,
                    preamble_ref_id=SqlPreambleRefName("__apply_sql_queue_auth"),
                ),
                MarkSqlPreambleSessionContextAppliedEffect(),
            ),
        )

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def physical_tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()
