def _staged_commit_scope_filter(
    *,
    staged_commit_column: SqlColumnName,
    staged_commit_id: StagedCommitId,
    branch_sql_value: SqlRenderable,
    staged_visibility: StagedVisibility,
    staged_commit_table_name: SqlTableName | None,
    connection_id_param: SqlParam | None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Select staged rows visible to the deleting write scope."""
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.query.stmt_dynamic import SqlDynamicSelectStmt
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlIn, sql_and

    staged_commit_ref = SqlColumnRef(staged_commit_column)
    if staged_visibility is StagedVisibility.TRANSACTION:
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            staged_commit_ref,
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            SqlParam(staged_commit_id),
        )
    if staged_commit_table_name is None:
        msg = "Connection-scoped FK cascade requires the staged-commit table name"
        raise ProgrammingError(msg)
    if connection_id_param is None:
        msg = "Connection-scoped FK cascade requires a connection ID parameter"
        raise ProgrammingError(msg)

    visible_commits = SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
        from_table=staged_commit_table_name,
        columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
        where_conditions=[
            sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    branch_sql_value,
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("connection_id")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    connection_id_param,
                ),
            ),
        ],
    )
    return SqlIn(staged_commit_ref, visible_commits)


def _lazy_revision_dependencies(lazy_revision: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId] | None) -> frozenset[str]:
    if lazy_revision is None:
        return frozenset()
    from l2055_lazy_result.lazy_param import lazy_param_deps

    return lazy_param_deps(lazy_revision)


class RestrictCheckStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[None]):
    """L0: Check RESTRICT constraint — count children, raise if any exist.

    Compiles to a SQL assertion over the versioned merged CTE for the child model,
    filtered by the parent FK.
    """

    def __init__(
        self: RestrictCheckStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        parent_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        child_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        lazy_branch: VersionedBranchSource,
        config: _RestrictCheckConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._parent_model_cls = parent_model_cls
        self._child_model_cls = child_model_cls
        self._child_fk_field = config.child_fk_field
        self._parent_sys_id_raw = config.parent_sys_id_raw
        self._parent_sys_ids_raw = config.parent_sys_ids_raw
        self._parent_value_column = config.parent_value_column
        self._parent_id_subquery = config.parent_id_subquery
        self._parent_id_source_ref = config.parent_id_source_ref
        self._lazy_revision = config.lazy_revision
        self._published_tip_materialized_fact = config.branch_tip_materialized
        self._lazy_branch = lazy_branch

    @property
    def level(self: RestrictCheckStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: RestrictCheckStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self: RestrictCheckStep) -> bool:
        return self._parent_id_source_ref is not None

    def step_tags(self: RestrictCheckStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "validation", "grammar"})

    def is_read_only(self: RestrictCheckStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self: RestrictCheckStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        names = get_versioned_table_names(self._child_model_cls)
        return frozenset({names.staged, names.tip, names.sparse, "sys_revision_parents"})

    def tables_written(self: RestrictCheckStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: RestrictCheckStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = versioned_branch_dependencies(self._lazy_branch) | _lazy_revision_dependencies(
            self._lazy_revision,
        )
        if self._parent_id_source_ref is None:
            return deps
        return deps | frozenset({str(self._parent_id_source_ref)})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: RestrictCheckStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        output_shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        column_type_hints = sql_assertion_column_type_hints()
        columns = output_shape.cte_output_columns
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = SqlAssertionResultRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def imported_dependency_refs(self: RestrictCheckStep) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
        if self._parent_id_source_ref is None:
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset({self._parent_id_source_ref})

    def compile(self: RestrictCheckStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        """Compile to a versioned count query with FK filter."""
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._auxiliary_ctes import (
            collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_versioned import (
            _merged_cte_staged_commit_scope,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_projection import catalog_versioned_merged_projection
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned import SqlVersionedMergedCte
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, sql_and
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

        child_table_names = get_versioned_table_names(self._child_model_cls)
        db_fk_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName(self._child_fk_field))
        sys_id_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName("sys_id"))
        branch_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName("branch_id"))
        staged_commit_id_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id"))
        revision_id_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName("revision_id"))
        deleted_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))
        branch_sql_value = lower_versioned_branch_source(
            self._lazy_branch,
            ctx,
            site=f"{type(self).__name__}.compile",
        )

        original_parent_id_subquery = self._parent_id_subquery
        parent_id_subquery = original_parent_id_subquery
        parent_value_ctes: list[CompiledAuxiliaryCteInput] = []
        parent_value_recursive = False
        if self._parent_value_column != SqlColumnName("sys_id"):
            parent_id_subquery, parent_value_ctes, parent_value_recursive = _parent_value_subquery(
                ctx=ctx,
                parent_model_cls=self._parent_model_cls,
                parent_value_column=self._parent_value_column,
                parent_sys_id_raw=self._parent_sys_id_raw,
                parent_sys_ids_raw=self._parent_sys_ids_raw,
                parent_id_source_ref=self._parent_id_source_ref,
                lazy_branch=self._lazy_branch,
                branch_tip_materialized=self._published_tip_materialized_fact,
                lazy_revision=self._lazy_revision,
                cte_suffix=f"{self.ref_id}_parent_value",
            )
        elif original_parent_id_subquery is None and self._parent_id_source_ref is not None and ctx.cte_refs is not None:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.query.stmt_dynamic import SqlDynamicSelectStmt

            source_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._parent_id_source_ref))
            if source_cte is not None:
                parent_id_subquery = SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                    from_table=SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id),
                    columns=[self._parent_value_column],
                )
        where_fk: SqlRenderable
        if parent_id_subquery is not None:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlIn

            where_fk = SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_fk_col)), parent_id_subquery)
        else:
            where_fk = SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_fk_col)),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(self._parent_sys_id_raw),
            )
        child_type_filter = _child_type_filter(self._child_model_cls)
        if child_type_filter is not None:
            where_fk = sql_and(child_type_filter, where_fk)
        use_sparse_source = _uses_sparse_branch_source(
            ctx,
            branch_tip_materialized=self._published_tip_materialized_fact,
        )
        published_table_name = str(child_table_names.sparse if use_sparse_source else child_table_names.tip)
        leading_ctes: list[CompiledAuxiliaryCteInput] = list(parent_value_ctes)
        published_source_is_visible = False
        published_sparse_revision_id = _published_sparse_revision_id_if_needed(
            ctx,
            use_sparse_source=use_sparse_source,
        )
        sparse_revision_source = _sparse_revision_source(ctx) if use_sparse_source else None
        published_sparse_open_row = _uses_open_sparse_rows_if_needed(
            ctx,
            use_sparse_source=use_sparse_source,
        )
        if use_sparse_source and sparse_revision_source is not None:
            source_table, child_source_ctes, needs_branch_filter = _visible_sparse_source(
                ctx=ctx,
                sparse_table_name=published_table_name,
                branch_id=branch_sql_value,
                cte_suffix=f"{self.ref_id}_restrict",
                lazy_revision=self._lazy_revision,
            )
            leading_ctes.extend(child_source_ctes)
            published_table_name = str(source_table)
            published_source_is_visible = not needs_branch_filter
            published_sparse_revision_id = None
            published_sparse_open_row = False
        dependency_auxiliary_ctes = collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(
            ctx,
            self.dependencies(),
        )
        if (
            ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_conflict_transport is DmlConflictTransport.INSERTED_VALUES
            and leading_ctes
            and dependency_auxiliary_ctes is not None
        ):
            leading_ctes = [*dependency_auxiliary_ctes, *leading_ctes]
            dependency_auxiliary_ctes = None
        query = SqlVersionedMergedCte(
            tip_table=SqlTableName(published_table_name),
            staged_table=child_table_names.staged,
            read_projection=catalog_versioned_merged_projection(
                self._child_model_cls,
                [
                    sys_id_col,
                    db_fk_col,
                    *((SqlColumnName("type_name"),) if child_type_filter is not None else ()),
                ],
            ),
            branch_id=branch_sql_value,
            staged_commit_id=_merged_cte_staged_commit_scope(ctx),
            branch_column=SqlColumnName(branch_col),
            staged_commit_id_column=SqlColumnName(staged_commit_id_col),
            revision_id_column=SqlColumnName(revision_id_col),
            tip_revision_source_column=SqlColumnName(
                "sys_valid_from_revision_id" if use_sparse_source else revision_id_col,
            ),
            deleted_column=SqlColumnName(deleted_col),
            include_deleted=False,
            where_clause=where_fk,
            leading_ctes=leading_ctes,
            leading_ctes_recursive=bool(leading_ctes),
            published_sparse_revision_id=published_sparse_revision_id,
            published_sparse_open_row=published_sparse_open_row,
            published_source_is_visible=published_source_is_visible,
        )

        output_shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=no_rows_assertion_query(
                query,
                error_message=(
                    f"Cannot delete {self._parent_model_cls.__name__} "
                    f"(sys_id={self._parent_sys_id_raw}): {self._child_model_cls.__name__} "
                    "child rows reference it via "
                    f"{self._child_fk_field} (RESTRICT)"
                ),
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(
                (
                    f"Cannot delete {self._parent_model_cls.__name__} "
                    f"(sys_id={self._parent_sys_id_raw}): {self._child_model_cls.__name__} "
                    "child rows reference it via "
                    f"{self._child_fk_field} (RESTRICT)"
                ),
                exc_type=IntegrityError,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=dependency_auxiliary_ctes,
            needs_recursive_with=parent_value_recursive or bool(leading_ctes),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
        )


class _CascadeTombstoneStepCteRow(BaseModel):
    count: int


class CascadeTombstoneStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[int]):
    """L0: Create tombstones for all children (CASCADE).

    Compiles to INSERT INTO child_staged SELECT ... FROM tip
    WHERE parent_id = ? (or parent_id IN subquery), with deleted=TRUE.
    One SQL statement for ALL children at this level.

    For multi-level cascade, parent_id_subquery provides an SQL subquery
    that finds all parent IDs from the level above (e.g., SELECT sys_id
    FROM parent_tip WHERE grandparent_id = ?).

    When ``additional_fk_fields`` is provided (e.g., a GraphEdge with both
    ``source_sys_id`` and ``target_sys_id`` pointing to the same parent),
    the WHERE clause becomes ``(fk1 = ? OR fk2 = ?)`` to avoid producing
    duplicate tombstones for self-loop edges.
    """

    def cte_publication_contract(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("count",)
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(integer_columns=frozenset({"count"}))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _CascadeTombstoneStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def __init__(
        self: CascadeTombstoneStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        child_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        lazy_branch: VersionedBranchSource,
        config: _CascadeTombstoneConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._child_model_cls = child_model_cls
        self._child_fk_field = config.child_fk_field
        self._parent_sys_id_raw = config.parent_sys_id_raw
        self._parent_model_cls = config.parent_model_cls
        self._parent_sys_ids_raw = config.parent_sys_ids_raw
        self._staged_table_name = config.staged_table_name
        self._parent_value_column = config.parent_value_column
        self._parent_id_subquery = config.parent_id_subquery
        self._tip_table_name = config.tip_table_name
        self._data_columns = list(config.data_columns)
        self._lazy_branch = lazy_branch
        self._staged_commit_id_raw = config.staged_commit_id_raw
        self._additional_fk_fields = list(config.additional_fk_fields) if config.additional_fk_fields is not None else None
        self._parent_id_source_ref = config.parent_id_source_ref
        self._parent_value_source_ref = config.parent_value_source_ref
        self._excluded_child_id_source_ref = config.excluded_child_id_source_ref
        self._excluded_child_sys_id_raw = config.excluded_child_sys_id_raw
        self._lazy_revision = config.lazy_revision
        self._force_tip_source = config.force_tip_source
        self._published_tip_materialized_fact = config.branch_tip_materialized
        self._after_refs = config.after_refs
        self._staged_visibility = config.staged_visibility
        self._staged_commit_table_name = config.staged_commit_table_name
        self._connection_id_param = config.connection_id_param
        self._sparse_ancestor_cte_name = config.sparse_ancestor_cte_name

    @property
    def level(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def cte_relation_role(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> str | None:
        return "count_only"

    def step_tags(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "delete", "grammar"})

    def is_read_only(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def tables_read(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        sparse_table_name = get_versioned_table_names(self._child_model_cls).sparse
        return frozenset(
            {self._staged_table_name, self._tip_table_name, sparse_table_name, "sys_revision_parents"},
        )

    def tables_written(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staged_table_name})

    def _relation_refs(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
        return frozenset(
            ref
            for ref in (
                self._parent_id_source_ref,
                self._parent_value_source_ref,
                self._excluded_child_id_source_ref,
            )
            if ref is not None
        )

    def dependencies(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = (
            versioned_branch_dependencies(self._lazy_branch)
            | _lazy_revision_dependencies(self._lazy_revision)
            | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs)
        )
        return deps | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._relation_refs())

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return (
            versioned_branch_dependencies(self._lazy_branch)
            | _lazy_revision_dependencies(self._lazy_revision)
            | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._relation_refs())
        )

    def imported_dependency_refs(self: CascadeTombstoneStep) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
        return self._relation_refs()

    def compile(self: CascadeTombstoneStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[int]:
        """Compile to INSERT INTO child_staged SELECT FROM tip WHERE fk = ?.

        When multiple FK fields target the same parent (e.g., GraphEdge with
        source_sys_id + target_sys_id), the WHERE clause ORs them to avoid
        duplicate tombstones for self-loop edges.
        """
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._auxiliary_ctes import collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_insert_select import SqlInsertFromSelect
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlIn, sql_and, sql_or
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

        # Target: child staged table
        target_table = self._staged_table_name
        branch_sql_value = lower_versioned_branch_source(
            self._lazy_branch,
            ctx,
            site=f"{type(self).__name__}.compile",
        )

        # Columns: branch_id, sys_id, staged_commit_id, deleted, ...data_cols
        staged_commit_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id"))
        deleted_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))
        target_columns = ["branch_id", "sys_id", staged_commit_col, deleted_col] + self._data_columns

        # SELECT: sys_id from source, params for branch/commit/deleted, data cols from source
        select_exprs: list[SqlRenderable] = [
            branch_sql_value,  # branch_id
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),  # sys_id from merged CTE
            SqlParam(self._staged_commit_id_raw),  # staged_commit_id
            SqlParam(True),  # deleted = TRUE
        ] + [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(col)) for col in self._data_columns]

        use_sparse_source = _uses_sparse_branch_source(
            ctx,
            branch_tip_materialized=self._published_tip_materialized_fact,
            force_tip_source=self._force_tip_source,
        )
        sparse_revision_expr = _sparse_revision_source(ctx, self._lazy_revision) if use_sparse_source else None
        sparse_table = get_versioned_table_names(self._child_model_cls).sparse

        # Build the incident predicate before sparse visibility. Winner
        # resolution must process only child identities that can match this
        # cascade, rather than every child row in the branch ancestry.
        fk_fields = self._additional_fk_fields if self._additional_fk_fields else [self._child_fk_field]
        deleted_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.query.stmt_dynamic import SqlDynamicSelectStmt

        original_parent_id_subquery = self._parent_id_subquery
        parent_id_subquery = original_parent_id_subquery
        inline_parent_id_source = False
        parent_value_ctes: list[CompiledAuxiliaryCteInput] = []
        parent_value_recursive = False
        if self._parent_value_source_ref is not None:
            resolved_parent_source = _source_column_subquery(
                ctx=ctx,
                source_ref=self._parent_value_source_ref,
                column=SqlColumnName("sys_id"),
                replay=_SourceRelationReplay.WHEN_REQUIRED_BY_TRANSPORT,
            )
            parent_id_subquery = resolved_parent_source.subquery
            inline_parent_id_source = resolved_parent_source.is_inline_replay
        elif self._parent_value_column != SqlColumnName("sys_id"):
            parent_id_subquery, parent_value_ctes, parent_value_recursive = _parent_value_subquery(
                ctx=ctx,
                parent_model_cls=self._parent_model_cls,
                parent_value_column=self._parent_value_column,
                parent_sys_id_raw=self._parent_sys_id_raw,
                parent_sys_ids_raw=self._parent_sys_ids_raw,
                parent_id_source_ref=self._parent_id_source_ref,
                lazy_branch=self._lazy_branch,
                branch_tip_materialized=self._published_tip_materialized_fact,
                lazy_revision=self._lazy_revision,
                cte_suffix=f"{self.ref_id}_parent_value",
                parent_staged_commit_id=self._staged_commit_id_raw,
            )
        elif original_parent_id_subquery is None and self._parent_id_source_ref is not None:
            resolved_parent_source = _source_column_subquery(
                ctx=ctx,
                source_ref=self._parent_id_source_ref,
                column=self._parent_value_column,
                replay=_SourceRelationReplay.WHEN_REQUIRED_BY_TRANSPORT,
            )
            parent_id_subquery = resolved_parent_source.subquery
            inline_parent_id_source = resolved_parent_source.is_inline_replay

        def _fk_filter_for_field(
            field_name: str,
            *,
            qualifier: SqlTableName | None = None,
        ) -> SqlRenderable:
            db_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))

            col_expr = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_col), qualifier)
            if parent_id_subquery is not None and original_parent_id_subquery is not None:
                return sql_or(
                    SqlIn(col_expr, parent_id_subquery),
                    SqlIn(col_expr, original_parent_id_subquery),
                )
            if parent_id_subquery is not None:
                return SqlIn(col_expr, parent_id_subquery)
            return SqlBinaryOp(col_expr, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(self._parent_sys_id_raw))

        if len(fk_fields) == 1:
            fk_filter = _fk_filter_for_field(fk_fields[0])
            sparse_candidate_filter = _fk_filter_for_field(
                fk_fields[0],
                qualifier=sparse_table,
            )
        else:
            fk_filter = sql_or(*[_fk_filter_for_field(field) for field in fk_fields])
            sparse_candidate_filter = sql_or(
                *[_fk_filter_for_field(field, qualifier=sparse_table) for field in fk_fields],
            )

        source_table = self._tip_table_name
        source_ctes: list[CompiledAuxiliaryCteInput] = []
        needs_branch_filter = True
        if use_sparse_source:
            source_table, source_ctes, needs_branch_filter = _visible_sparse_source(
                ctx=ctx,
                sparse_table_name=str(sparse_table),
                branch_id=branch_sql_value,
                cte_suffix=f"{self.ref_id}_cascade",
                lazy_revision=self._lazy_revision,
                extra_where=sparse_candidate_filter,
                ancestor_cte_name=self._sparse_ancestor_cte_name,
            )

        child_type_filter = _child_type_filter(self._child_model_cls)
        if child_type_filter is not None:
            fk_filter = sql_and(child_type_filter, fk_filter)

        # Any row already staged in the visible write scope is the effective child version.
        # Exclude its older published version even when the staged row is live,
        # because an update can move the FK away from the deleted parent.
        staged_override_subquery = SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
            from_table=self._staged_table_name,
            columns=[SqlColumnName("sys_id")],
            where_conditions=[
                sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        branch_sql_value,
                    ),
                    _staged_commit_scope_filter(
                        staged_commit_column=SqlColumnName(staged_commit_col),
                        staged_commit_id=self._staged_commit_id_raw,
                        branch_sql_value=branch_sql_value,
                        staged_visibility=self._staged_visibility,
                        staged_commit_table_name=self._staged_commit_table_name,
                        connection_id_param=self._connection_id_param,
                    ),
                ),
            ],
        )
        not_staged_by_commit = SqlIn(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
            staged_override_subquery,
            negated=True,
        )

        where_parts: list[SqlRenderable] = [fk_filter, not_staged_by_commit]
        inline_excluded_child_source = False
        if self._excluded_child_id_source_ref is not None:
            resolved_excluded_source = _source_column_subquery(
                ctx=ctx,
                source_ref=self._excluded_child_id_source_ref,
                column=SqlColumnName("sys_id"),
                replay=_SourceRelationReplay.REQUIRED,
            )
            inline_excluded_child_source = resolved_excluded_source.is_inline_replay
            where_parts.append(
                SqlIn(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                    resolved_excluded_source.subquery,
                    negated=True,
                ),
            )
        if self._excluded_child_sys_id_raw is not None:
            where_parts.append(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                    BinaryOp.NE,
                    SqlParam(self._excluded_child_sys_id_raw),
                ),
            )
        if needs_branch_filter:
            where_parts.insert(
                0,
                SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, branch_sql_value),
            )
        where = sql_and(*where_parts)
        if use_sparse_source and needs_branch_filter:
            where = sql_and(where, *_active_sparse_filters(ctx))

        grammar = SqlInsertFromSelect(
            target_table=target_table,
            target_columns=target_columns,
            source_table=source_table,
            select_exprs=select_exprs,
            where=where,
        )

        __opa002_grammar_745 = grammar
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_745,
            closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
                "count",
                default_value=0,
                use_default_on_empty=True,
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=_combine_auxiliary_ctes(
                collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(
                    ctx,
                    self.sql_visible_dependencies()
                    - {
                        str(ref)
                        for ref, inline in (
                            (
                                self._parent_value_source_ref or self._parent_id_source_ref,
                                inline_parent_id_source
                                or (self._parent_value_column != SqlColumnName("sys_id") and self._parent_value_source_ref is None),
                            ),
                            (self._excluded_child_id_source_ref, inline_excluded_child_source),
                        )
                        if ref is not None and inline
                    },
                ),
                (
                    None
                    if inline_parent_id_source
                    or (self._parent_value_column != SqlColumnName("sys_id") and self._parent_value_source_ref is None)
                    else _visible_auxiliary_ctes(
                        ctx,
                        self._parent_value_source_ref or self._parent_id_source_ref,
                    )
                ),
                _branch_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self._lazy_branch),
                _expression_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, branch_sql_value),
                _expression_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, sparse_revision_expr),
                parent_value_ctes,
                source_ctes,
            ),
            needs_recursive_with=parent_value_recursive or bool(source_ctes),
        )


class DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """Remove child rows that exist only in the current staged write set."""

    def __init__(
        self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        child_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        lazy_branch: VersionedBranchSource,

    ) -> None:

        self._parent_sys_id_raw = config.parent_sys_id_raw
        self._parent_model_cls = config.parent_model_cls
        self._parent_sys_ids_raw = config.parent_sys_ids_raw
        self._staged_table_name = config.staged_table_name
        self._lazy_branch = lazy_branch
        self._parent_value_column = config.parent_value_column
        self._parent_id_subquery = config.parent_id_subquery
        self._additional_fk_fields = list(config.additional_fk_fields) if config.additional_fk_fields is not None else None
        self._parent_id_source_ref = config.parent_id_source_ref
        self._parent_value_source_ref = config.parent_value_source_ref
        self._excluded_child_id_source_ref = config.excluded_child_id_source_ref
        self._excluded_child_sys_id_raw = config.excluded_child_sys_id_raw
        self._lazy_revision = config.lazy_revision
        self._published_tip_materialized_fact = config.branch_tip_materialized
        self._after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()
        self._staged_commit_id_raw = config.staged_commit_id_raw
        self._staged_visibility = config.staged_visibility
        self._staged_commit_table_name = config.staged_commit_table_name
        self._connection_id_param = config.connection_id_param

    @property
    def level(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "delete", "grammar", "staged"})

    def is_read_only(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def tables_read(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staged_table_name})

    def tables_written(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._staged_table_name})

    def _relation_refs(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
        return frozenset(
            ref
            for ref in (
                self._parent_id_source_ref,
                self._parent_value_source_ref,
                self._excluded_child_id_source_ref,
            )
            if ref is not None
        )

    def dependencies(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = (
            versioned_branch_dependencies(self._lazy_branch)
            | _lazy_revision_dependencies(self._lazy_revision)
            | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs)
        )
        return deps | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._relation_refs())

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return (
            versioned_branch_dependencies(self._lazy_branch)
            | _lazy_revision_dependencies(self._lazy_revision)
            | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._relation_refs())
        )

    def imported_dependency_refs(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep) -> frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]:
        return self._relation_refs()

    def compile(self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

        deleted_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))
        return self._compile_update(
            ctx,
            update_column=SqlColumnName(deleted_col),
            update_value=True,
        )

    def _compile_update(
        self: DeleteMatchingStagedChildrenStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
        *,
        update_column: SqlColumnName,
        update_value: SqlParameterValue,
    ) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.query.stmt_dynamic import SqlDynamicSelectStmt
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlIn, sql_and, sql_or
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSetItem, SqlWhereClause
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlUpdate
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

        branch_sql_value = lower_versioned_branch_source(
            self._lazy_branch,
            ctx,
            site=f"{type(self).__name__}.compile",
        )
        original_parent_id_subquery = self._parent_id_subquery
        parent_id_subquery = original_parent_id_subquery
        inline_parent_id_source = False
        parent_value_ctes: list[CompiledAuxiliaryCteInput] = []
        parent_value_recursive = False
        if self._parent_value_source_ref is not None:
            resolved_parent_source = _source_column_subquery(
                ctx=ctx,
                source_ref=self._parent_value_source_ref,
                column=SqlColumnName("sys_id"),
                replay=_SourceRelationReplay.WHEN_REQUIRED_BY_TRANSPORT,
            )
            parent_id_subquery = resolved_parent_source.subquery
            inline_parent_id_source = resolved_parent_source.is_inline_replay
        elif self._parent_value_column != SqlColumnName("sys_id"):
            parent_id_subquery, parent_value_ctes, parent_value_recursive = _parent_value_subquery(
                ctx=ctx,
                parent_model_cls=self._parent_model_cls,
                parent_value_column=self._parent_value_column,
                parent_sys_id_raw=self._parent_sys_id_raw,
                parent_sys_ids_raw=self._parent_sys_ids_raw,
                parent_id_source_ref=self._parent_id_source_ref,
                lazy_branch=self._lazy_branch,
                branch_tip_materialized=self._published_tip_materialized_fact,
                lazy_revision=self._lazy_revision,
                cte_suffix=f"{self.ref_id}_parent_value",
                parent_staged_commit_id=self._staged_commit_id_raw,
            )
        elif original_parent_id_subquery is None and self._parent_id_source_ref is not None:
            resolved_parent_source = _source_column_subquery(
                ctx=ctx,
                source_ref=self._parent_id_source_ref,
                column=self._parent_value_column,
                replay=_SourceRelationReplay.WHEN_REQUIRED_BY_TRANSPORT,
            )
            parent_id_subquery = resolved_parent_source.subquery
            inline_parent_id_source = resolved_parent_source.is_inline_replay

        fk_fields = self._additional_fk_fields if self._additional_fk_fields else [self._child_fk_field]

        def _fk_filter_for_field(field_name: str) -> SqlRenderable:
            db_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name))

            col_expr = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(db_col))
            if parent_id_subquery is not None and original_parent_id_subquery is not None:
                return sql_or(
                    SqlIn(col_expr, parent_id_subquery),
                    SqlIn(col_expr, original_parent_id_subquery),
                )
            if parent_id_subquery is not None:
                return SqlIn(col_expr, parent_id_subquery)
            return SqlBinaryOp(col_expr, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(self._parent_sys_id_raw))

        fk_filter = (
            _fk_filter_for_field(fk_fields[0])
            if len(fk_fields) == 1
            else sql_or(
                *[_fk_filter_for_field(field) for field in fk_fields],
            )
        )
        child_type_filter = _child_type_filter(self._child_model_cls)
        if child_type_filter is not None:
            fk_filter = sql_and(child_type_filter, fk_filter)
        staged_commit_col = SqlColumnName(
            get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id")),
        )
        where = sql_and(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                branch_sql_value,
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(staged_commit_col),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(self._staged_commit_id_raw),
            ),
            fk_filter,
        )
        inline_excluded_child_source = False
        if self._excluded_child_id_source_ref is not None:
            resolved_excluded_source = _source_column_subquery(
                ctx=ctx,
                source_ref=self._excluded_child_id_source_ref,
                column=SqlColumnName("sys_id"),
                replay=_SourceRelationReplay.REQUIRED,
            )
            inline_excluded_child_source = resolved_excluded_source.is_inline_replay
            where = sql_and(
                where,
                SqlIn(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                    resolved_excluded_source.subquery,
                    negated=True,
                ),
            )
        if self._excluded_child_sys_id_raw is not None:
            where = sql_and(
                where,
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                    BinaryOp.NE,
                    SqlParam(self._excluded_child_sys_id_raw),
                ),
            )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=SqlUpdate(
                table=SqlTableIdent(self._staged_table_name),
                set_items=[SqlSetItem(update_column, SqlParam(update_value))],
                where=SqlWhereClause(where),
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=_combine_auxiliary_ctes(
                (
                    None
                    if inline_parent_id_source
                    else _visible_auxiliary_ctes(
                        ctx,
                        self._parent_value_source_ref or self._parent_id_source_ref,
                    )
                ),
                (None if inline_excluded_child_source else _visible_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self._excluded_child_id_source_ref)),
                _branch_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self._lazy_branch),
                _expression_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, branch_sql_value),
                parent_value_ctes,
            ),
            needs_recursive_with=parent_value_recursive,
        )

    def compile(self: SetNullStagingStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[int]:

        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName

        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.query.stmt_dynamic import SqlDynamicSelectStmt
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_insert_select import SqlInsertFromSelect
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlIn, sql_and
        from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name

        deleted_col = get_db_column_name(self._child_model_cls, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))

                lazy_revision=self._lazy_revision,
                cte_suffix=f"{self.ref_id}_parent_value",
                parent_staged_commit_id=self._staged_commit_id_raw,
            )
        elif self._parent_id_source_ref is not None and ctx.cte_refs is not None:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.query.stmt_dynamic import SqlDynamicSelectStmt

            source_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(self._parent_id_source_ref))
            if source_cte is not None:
                parent_id_subquery = SqlDynamicSelectStmt(

def _count_sql_groups(result: list[ServerPlanStep[object]]) -> int:
    compilable_tags = frozenset(
        {
            "select_one",
            "select_many",
            "grammar",
            "query",
            "insert",
            "update",
            "delete",
            "scalar",
            "exists",
            "validation",
        },
    )
    return sum(1 for step in result if isinstance(step, PhysicalStatementGroup) or (step.step_tags() & compilable_tags))


def _assert_single_group(steps: list[ServerPlanStep[object]]) -> None:
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        result = list(optimize_v2_steps(steps, _sqlite_opt_ctx()))
    batch_warnings = [w for w in caught if "BATCHING" in str(w.message)]
    sql_groups = _count_sql_groups(result)
    step_names = [type(step).__name__ for step in result]
    assert not batch_warnings, (
        "Versioned delete pipeline emitted batching warnings. "
        f"groups={sql_groups}, steps={step_names}, warnings={[str(w.message) for w in batch_warnings]}"
    )
    assert sql_groups == 1, f"Versioned delete pipeline must compile to one SQL group. got groups={sql_groups}, steps={step_names}"

def _render_optimized_postgres_sql(steps: list[ServerPlanStep[object]]) -> str:
    """Compile optimized Postgres groups and return their SQL surfaces."""
    optimized = list(optimize_v2_steps(steps, _postgres_opt_ctx()))
    ctx = make_compilation_context(
        profile=make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES),
        branch_id=BranchId.new().unwrap_to_str(),
        session_id=None,
    )
    compilable_tags = {
        "select_one",
        "select_many",
        "grammar",
        "query",
        "insert",
        "update",
        "delete",
        "scalar",
        "exists",
        "validation",
    }
    rendered: list[str] = []
    for step in optimized:
        if not isinstance(step, PhysicalStatementGroup) and not step.step_tags() & compilable_tags:
            continue
        compiled = step.compile(ctx)
        if compiled.grammar is None:
            continue
        sql, _params = render_to_sql(compiled.grammar, PostgresDialect())
        rendered.append(sql)
    return "\n".join(rendered)

def test_versioned_delete_many_child_ids_sparse_ancestry_sets_needs_recursive_with() -> None:
    """Ancestry CTEs emitted by the child-ids step are self-referencing and
    require the outer WITH clause to be RECURSIVE. Without the flag Postgres
    fails with ``relation "_visible_ancestors" does not exist``."""
    step = _VersionedDeleteManyChildIdsStep(
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("delete_parent_many_child_ids_recursive"),
        child_model_cls=_VdilGraphEdgeStaged,
        child_fk_field=_VersionedDeleteChildFkFieldName("sys_id"),
        parent_sys_id_raw=SysId.new(),
        parent_id_source_ref=None,
        staging_ctx=_staging_ctx(_domain()),
    )

    compiled = step.compile(
        make_compilation_context(
            profile=make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES),
            branch_tip_materialized=False,
            revision_id=RevisionId.new().unwrap_to_str(),
        ),
    )

    auxiliary_names = [str(name) for name, _query in compiled.auxiliary_ctes or ()]
    assert any("ancestors" in name for name in auxiliary_names), auxiliary_names
    assert compiled.needs_recursive_with is True


def test_versioned_delete_many_child_ids_sparse_ancestry_threads_branch_dependency_cte() -> None:
    """The ancestry CTEs reference the lowered branch/revision publication CTE,
    so standalone execution (e.g. SQLite) must include that dependency binding
    in the WITH clause before the ancestry CTEs."""
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_cte_helpers import SqlPublishedRowsQuery
    from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import SqlColumnTypeHints

    lazy_branch = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_0"),
        variant="scalar",
        type_hint=BranchId,
    )
    base_staging_ctx = _staging_ctx(_domain())
    staging_ctx = replace(base_staging_ctx, lazy_branch=lazy_branch)
    branch_auxiliary_query = SqlPublishedRowsQuery(
        columns=("branch_id",),
        rows=[{"branch_id": str(BranchId.new())}],
        type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(uuid_columns=frozenset({"branch_id"})),
    )

    step = _VersionedDeleteManyChildIdsStep(
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("delete_parent_many_child_ids_branch_dep"),
        child_model_cls=_VdilGraphEdgeStaged,
        child_fk_field=_VersionedDeleteChildFkFieldName("sys_id"),
        parent_sys_id_raw=SysId.new(),
        parent_id_source_ref=None,
        staging_ctx=staging_ctx,
    )

    compiled = step.compile(
        make_compilation_context(
            profile=make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES),
            branch_tip_materialized=False,
            revision_id=RevisionId.new().unwrap_to_str(),
            cte_refs={
                "step_0": cte_ref(
                    ServerPlanRefId("step_0_cte"),
                    columns=("branch_id",),
                    auxiliary_query=branch_auxiliary_query,
                    column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(uuid_columns=frozenset({"branch_id"})),
                ),
            },
        ),
    )

    auxiliary_names = [str(name) for name, _query in compiled.auxiliary_ctes or ()]
    assert "step_0_cte" in auxiliary_names, auxiliary_names
    ancestors_index = next(index for index, name in enumerate(auxiliary_names) if "ancestors" in name)
    assert auxiliary_names.index("step_0_cte") < ancestors_index

def test_generic_delete_many_intent_routes_to_versioned_lowering() -> None:
    clear_fk_map_cache()
    domain = _domain()
    ctx = _postgres_lowering_ctx()
    ctx = replace(ctx, staging_ctx_factory=lambda _model_cls: _staging_ctx(domain))

    intent = DeleteManyIntent(
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("delete_many_versioned_generic"),
        model_cls=_VdilParent,
        config=ServerRefs.scalar(
            _DeleteManyPayload(
                sys_ids=(SysId.new(), SysId.new()),
                after_refs=frozenset(),
            ),
        ),
    )

    steps = intent.lower(ctx)
    step_types = [type(step).__name__ for step in steps]

    assert "MatchVersionedRowsByKeyToLiteralSequenceStep" in step_types
    assert "DeleteStagedForCommitStep" in step_types
    assert "_VersionedDeleteManyBySourceTombstoneStep" in step_types
    assert steps[-1].ref_id == "delete_many_versioned_generic.tombstone"

    after_refs_intent = DeleteManyIntent(
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("delete_many_versioned_after_refs"),
        model_cls=_VdilParent,
        config=ServerRefs.scalar(
            _DeleteManyPayload(
                sys_ids=(SysId.new(), SysId.new()),
                after_refs=frozenset({ServerPlanRefId("table_perm")}),
            ),
        ),
    )

    after_refs_steps = after_refs_intent.lower(ctx)

    assert after_refs_steps
    assert after_refs_steps[0].dependencies() == frozenset({"table_perm"})
    # The external gate (``table_perm``) is applied to every step in the lowered
    # delete via ``_DependencyRemapStep``, so the count step depends on it in
    # addition to its count-source steps. (Previously the in-place ``_after_refs``
    # attribute was silently dropped by steps that didn't surface it.)
    final_dependencies = after_refs_steps[-1].dependencies()
    assert len(final_dependencies) == 6
    steps_by_ref = {str(step.ref_id): step for step in after_refs_steps}
    pending = list(final_dependencies)
    dependency_closure: set[str] = set()
    while pending:
        dependency = pending.pop()
        if dependency in dependency_closure:
            continue
        dependency_closure.add(dependency)
        dependency_step = steps_by_ref.get(dependency)
        if dependency_step is not None:
            pending.extend(dependency_step.dependencies())
    assert "table_perm" in dependency_closure
    assert after_refs_steps[-1].dependencies() == frozenset(
        {
            "table_perm",
            "delete_many_versioned_after_refs_delete_staged",
            "delete_many_versioned_after_refs_fk0_restrict",
            "delete_many_versioned_after_refs_matched_source_ids",
            "delete_many_versioned_after_refs_resolve_uid",
            "delete_many_versioned_after_refs",
        },
    )

def test_metadata_signatures_guard_each_complete_shape_once() -> None:
    script = r"""\
import os
os.environ["NERA_PURE_LAZY_RUNTIME_TRIPWIRES"] = "1"
from contextlib import contextmanager
import l2055_lazy_result.purity as purity
original_guard = purity._guard_lazy_runtime_inputs
calls = 0
@contextmanager
def counting_guard(args, kwargs):
    global calls
    calls += 1
    with original_guard(args, kwargs) as guarded:
        yield guarded
purity._guard_lazy_runtime_inputs = counting_guard
import l2070_batching.planning_catalog as planning_catalog
from l1300_session.session import Session
calls = 0
planning_catalog._write_metadata_schema_signature(Session)
print(calls)
calls = 0
planning_catalog._read_metadata_schema_signature(Session)
print(calls)
"""
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-c", script],
        cwd=Path(__file__).parents[5],
        env=os.environ.copy(),
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )

    assert result.stdout.splitlines() == ["1", "1"]

def test_upsert_raw_result_step_threads_auxiliary_cte_into_with_clause() -> None:
    """When payload_ref has an auxiliary_query, it must be attached as a WITH clause.

    Mirrors the pattern fixed in SelectedRowsUpdateRawResultStep (1ec96e8e0):
    when the pipeline splits the payload-preparation step and the terminal upsert
    across separate SQL groups, the executor republishes the upstream payload as
    an auxiliary CTE via ``CteReference(auxiliary_query=...)``. Compile reads the
    CTE name as the source relation but must also ask ``materialize_ir()`` to
    emit the corresponding ``WITH`` clause.
    """
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_cte_helpers import SqlPublishedRowsQuery
    from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import SqlColumnTypeHints

    auxiliary = SqlPublishedRowsQuery(
        columns=("sys_id", "id", "label"),
        rows=[{"sys_id": "00000000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000aa", "id": 1, "label": "widget"}],
        type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
            uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"}),
            integer_columns=frozenset({"id"}),
            text_columns=frozenset({"label"}),
        ),
    )
    step = UpsertRawResultStep(
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("step_upsert.raw"),
        model_cls=_WriteMetadataAutoRow,
        config=_UpsertStepConfig(
            payload_ref=ServerPlanRefId("step_upsert.payload"),
            conflict_columns=("label",),
        ),
    )

    ctx = CompilationContext(
        backend_type=BackendType.POSTGRES,
        backend_profile=make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES),
        dialect=PostgresDialect(),
        supports_data_modifying_ctes=True,
        planning_catalog=build_planning_catalog(),
        cte_refs={
            "step_upsert.payload": cte_ref(
                ServerPlanRefId("published_0"),
                columns=("sys_id", "id", "label"),
                auxiliary_query=auxiliary,
                ephemeral=False,
                column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                    integer_columns=frozenset({"id"}), text_columns=frozenset({"label"}), uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"})
                ),
            ),
        },
    )
    from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import model_sql_column_type_hints

    assert ctx.cte_refs["step_upsert.payload"].column_type_hints == model_sql_column_type_hints(
        _WriteMetadataAutoRow,
        ("sys_id", "id", "label"),
    )
    compiled = step.compile(ctx)

    assert compiled.auxiliary_ctes is not None
    assert compiled.auxiliary_ctes == (("published_0", auxiliary),)
    materialized = compiled.materialize_ir()
    assert materialized is not None
    sql = _render_sql(cast(Any, materialized).grammar)
    assert 'WITH "published_0" AS MATERIALIZED (' in sql
    assert 'INSERT INTO "write_metadata_auto_rows"' in sql
    assert 'FROM "published_0"' in sql
    assert 'ON CONFLICT ("label")' in sql


def test_upsert_many_raw_result_step_threads_auxiliary_cte_into_with_clause() -> None:
    """When instances_ref has an auxiliary_query, it must be attached as a WITH clause.

    Mirrors the pattern fixed in SelectedRowsUpdateRawResultStep (1ec96e8e0) and
    the single-row UpsertRawResultStep. When the pipeline splits the payload
    sequence prerequisite and the terminal bulk upsert across separate SQL groups,
    the executor republishes the upstream rows as an auxiliary CTE. Compile must
    consume that CTE as the INSERT source and thread the auxiliary_query into
    ``CompiledStep.auxiliary_ctes`` so the final grammar emits
        ``WITH "published_N" AS MATERIALIZED (...) INSERT INTO ... FROM "published_N" ...``.
    """
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_cte_helpers import SqlPublishedRowsQuery
    from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import SqlColumnTypeHints

    auxiliary = SqlPublishedRowsQuery(
        columns=("sys_id", "id", "label"),
        rows=[
            {"sys_id": "00000000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000aa", "id": 1, "label": "a"},
            {"sys_id": "00000000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000bb", "id": 2, "label": "b"},
        ],
        type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
            uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"}),
            integer_columns=frozenset({"id"}),
            text_columns=frozenset({"label"}),
        ),
    )
    step = UpsertManyRawResultStep(
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("step_upsert_many.raw"),
        model_cls=_WriteMetadataAutoRow,
        config=_UpsertManyStepConfig(
            instances_ref=ServerPlanRefId("step_upsert_many.payload"),
            conflict_columns=("label",),
        ),
    )

    ctx = CompilationContext(
        backend_type=BackendType.POSTGRES,
        backend_profile=make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES),
        dialect=PostgresDialect(),
        supports_data_modifying_ctes=True,
        planning_catalog=build_planning_catalog(),
        cte_refs={
            "step_upsert_many.payload": cte_ref(
                ServerPlanRefId("published_0"),
                columns=("sys_id", "id", "label"),
                auxiliary_query=auxiliary,
                ephemeral=False,
                column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                    integer_columns=frozenset({"id"}), text_columns=frozenset({"label"}), uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"})
                ),
            ),
        },
    )
    compiled = step.compile(ctx)

    assert compiled.auxiliary_ctes is not None
    assert compiled.auxiliary_ctes == (("published_0", auxiliary),)
    materialized = compiled.materialize_ir()
    assert materialized is not None
    sql = _render_sql(cast(Any, materialized).grammar)
    assert 'WITH "published_0" AS MATERIALIZED (' in sql
    assert 'INSERT INTO "write_metadata_auto_rows"' in sql
    assert 'FROM "published_0"' in sql
    assert 'ON CONFLICT ("label")' in sql

def _require_cte_ref(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    source_ref: str,
    *,
    operation_name: ConnectionOperationName,
    runtime_fallback_name: str,
    require_columns: bool = False,
) -> Any:
    def _is_addressable_cte(cte_ref: CteReference) -> bool:
        ref_name = str(cte_ref.ref_id).strip('"')
        if not ref_name.startswith("published_"):
            return True
        return not cte_ref.ephemeral and cte_ref.auxiliary_query is not None

    source_cte = ctx.cte_refs.get(source_ref)
    if isinstance(source_cte, CteReference) and _is_addressable_cte(source_cte) and (source_cte.columns or not require_columns):
        return source_cte
    msg = (
        f"{operation_name} requires a SQL-visible ServerPlan relation for "
        f"{source_ref!r}; {runtime_fallback_name} is not an allowed fallback."
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_single_column_cte(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    source_ref: str,
    *,
    operation_name: ConnectionOperationName,
    runtime_fallback_name: str,
) -> Any:
    source_cte = _require_cte_ref(
        ctx,
        source_ref,
        operation_name=operation_name,
        runtime_fallback_name=runtime_fallback_name,
        require_columns=True,
    )
    if len(source_cte.columns) == 1:
        return source_cte
    msg = f"{operation_name} requires {source_ref!r} to declare exactly one CTE column."
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_parallel_sources(source_refs: Sequence[str], unknown_names: Sequence[str]) -> None:
    if len(source_refs) == len(unknown_names):
        return
    msg = "Table-exists merge requires one SQL source ref per unknown table name."
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_single_output_column(columns: Sequence[str], *, operation_name: ConnectionOperationName) -> str:
    if len(columns) == 1:
        return columns[0]
    msg = f"{operation_name} requires exactly one output column."
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_runtime_ref(runtime_refs: Mapping[str, object], ref_id: ServerPlanRefId) -> object:
    if ref_id.startswith("seed_"):
        found_seed, seed_value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(None, ref_id)
        if found_seed:
            return seed_value
    if ref_id not in runtime_refs:
        msg = f"Missing runtime ref {ref_id!r} for post-execution projection."
        raise KeyError(msg)
    return runtime_refs[ref_id]

def sql_table_exists_many_compiled_step(
    source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    known_results: Mapping[SqlTableName, bool],
    unknown_names: Sequence[SqlTableName],
) -> CompiledStep[dict[str, bool]]:
    _require_parallel_sources(source_refs, unknown_names)
    items: list[tuple[Any, str]] = []
    result_columns: list[str] = []
    auxiliary_ctes: list[list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None] = []
    for index, source_ref in enumerate(source_refs):
        expr, source_auxiliary_ctes = _require_single_column_scalar_subquery(source_ref, ctx=ctx)
        column = f"exists_{index}"
        items.append((expr, column))

    column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset(result_columns))

        output_shape=output_shape,
        grammar=__opa002_grammar_250,
        needs_returning=True,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        auxiliary_ctes=_merge_auxiliary_ctes(*auxiliary_ctes),
        closed_post_op=table_exists_many_post_op(

def _validated_relation_ctes(
    source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    operation_name: ConnectionOperationName,
    runtime_fallback_name: str,
) -> tuple[list[Any], tuple[str, ...]]:
    def _source_cte(source_ref: str) -> CteReference | None:
        for candidate_ref in (source_ref, f"{source_ref}.raw"):
            candidate = ctx.cte_refs.get(candidate_ref)
            if isinstance(candidate, CteReference):
                return candidate
        return None

    if not source_refs:
        msg = f"{operation_name} requires at least one SQL-visible source relation."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    cte_refs: list[CteReference] = []
    for source_ref in source_refs:
        source_cte = _source_cte(source_ref)
        if source_cte is None:
            msg = (
                f"{operation_name} requires SQL-visible ServerPlan relations for "
                f"all sources; {source_ref!r} is not a CTE and {runtime_fallback_name} "
                "is not an allowed fallback."
            )
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        if not source_cte.columns:
            msg = f"{operation_name} requires {source_ref!r} to declare CTE columns."
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        cte_refs.append(source_cte)
    columns = cte_refs[0].columns
    assert columns is not None
    for source_ref, source_cte in zip(source_refs[1:], cte_refs[1:], strict=True):
        if source_cte.columns is None or set(source_cte.columns) != set(columns):
            msg = (
                f"{operation_name} requires identical CTE columns; {source_ref!r} declares {source_cte.columns!r}, expected {columns!r}."
            )
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return cte_refs, columns


def sql_flatten_relations_compiled_step(
    source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    result_ref_id: str,
) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
    del result_ref_id

    cte_refs, columns = _validated_relation_ctes(
        source_refs,
        ctx=ctx,
        operation_name=ConnectionOperationName("Flatten relation reduction"),
        runtime_fallback_name="runtime flattening",
    )
    selects = [
        SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
            SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id),
            columns=[SqlColumnName(column) for column in columns],
        )
        for source_cte in cte_refs
    ]
    auxiliary_ctes = _merge_auxiliary_ctes(
        *(
            [(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else None
            for source_cte in cte_refs
        ),
    )
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in columns))
    column_type_hints = cte_refs[0].column_type_hints.filtered(set(columns)).require_complete(columns)
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=selects[0] if len(selects) == 1 else SqlSetOp(SetOpKind.UNION_ALL, selects),
        needs_returning=True,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
    )


def sql_collect_relations_compiled_step(
    source_refs: Sequence[str],
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    result_ref_id: str,
    drop_none: bool = False,
) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, object]]]:
    del result_ref_id

    class _SqlOrderedCollectUnion(SqlRenderable):
        __slots__ = ("_columns", "_drop_none", "_source_cte_names")

        def __init__(
            self,
            source_cte_names: Sequence[SqlTableName],
            columns: Sequence[SqlColumnName],
            *,
            drop_none: bool,
        ) -> None:
            self._source_cte_names = tuple(source_cte_names)
            self._columns = tuple(columns)
            self._drop_none = drop_none

        def render(self, dialect: Any) -> SqlFragment:
            ordinal_name = SqlQuotedIdentifier("__collect_ordinal").render(dialect)
            collect_alias = SqlQuotedIdentifier("__collect").render(dialect)
            public_cols = SQL_EMPTY
            for index, column in enumerate(self._columns):
                if index > 0:
                    public_cols = public_cols + _SQL_COMMA_SPACE
                public_cols = public_cols + SqlQuotedIdentifier(column).render(dialect)
            body = SQL_EMPTY
            for index, source_cte_name in enumerate(self._source_cte_names):
                if index > 0:
                    body = body + _SQL_UNION_ALL_SPACE
                body = body + _SQL_SELECT_SPACE + SqlIntegerLiteral(index).render(dialect) + _SQL_AS_SPACE + ordinal_name
                for column in self._columns:
                    body = body + _SQL_COMMA_SPACE + SqlQuotedIdentifier(column).render(dialect)
                body = body + _SQL_FROM_SPACE + SqlQuotedIdentifier(source_cte_name).render(dialect)
                if self._drop_none and len(self._columns) == 1:
                    body = body + _SQL_WHERE_SPACE + SqlQuotedIdentifier(self._columns[0]).render(dialect) + _SQL_IS_NOT_NULL
            return (
                _SQL_SELECT_SPACE
                + public_cols
                + _SQL_COLLECT_FROM_OPEN
                + body
                + _SQL_CLOSE_PAREN_AS
                + collect_alias
                + _SQL_ORDER_BY_SPACE
                + ordinal_name
            )

    cte_refs, columns = _validated_relation_ctes(
        source_refs,
        ctx=ctx,
        operation_name=ConnectionOperationName("Collect relation reduction"),
        runtime_fallback_name="runtime collection",
    )
    auxiliary_ctes = _merge_auxiliary_ctes(
        *(
            [(source_cte.ref_id, source_cte.auxiliary_query)] if source_cte.auxiliary_query is not None else None
            for source_cte in cte_refs
        ),
    )
    source_cte_names = tuple(SqlTableName(source_cte.ref_id) for source_cte in cte_refs)
    column_names = tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in columns)
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in columns))
    column_type_hints = cte_refs[0].column_type_hints.filtered(set(columns)).require_complete(columns)
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=_SqlOrderedCollectUnion(source_cte_names, column_names, drop_none=drop_none),
        needs_returning=True,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
    )
