@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _InsertStepConfig[T: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]:
    lazy_instance: LazyResult[T] | None = None
    literal_instance: T | None = None
    source_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()
    dependency_only: bool = False
    supplemental_values: _SupplementalWriteValues = ()
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None
    gate_query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]] | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _InsertSource[T: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]:
    instance: ObjectServerRef[T]
    lazy_instance: LazyResult[T] | None
    literal_instance: T | None
    source_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]
    dependency_only: bool
    supplemental_values: _SupplementalWriteValues
    permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None
    permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None
    gate_query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]] | None

    @property
    def requires_deferred_replanning(self) -> bool:
        return self.literal_instance is None and self.source_ref_id is not None

    @classmethod
    def from_config(
        cls,
        instance: ObjectServerRef[T],
        config: _InsertStepConfig[T],
    ) -> _InsertSource[T]:
        instance_ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(instance.ref_id) if instance.ref_id is not None else None
        return cls(
            instance=instance,
            lazy_instance=config.lazy_instance,
            literal_instance=config.literal_instance,
            source_ref_id=config.source_ref_id or instance_ref_id,
            after_refs=config.after_refs,
            dependency_only=config.dependency_only,
            supplemental_values=config.supplemental_values,
            permission_context_ref=config.permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=config.permission_context_type,
            gate_query_spec=config.gate_query_spec,
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_literal(
        cls,
        instance: ObjectServerRef[T],
        literal_instance: T,
        *,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    ) -> _InsertSource[T]:
        return cls(
            instance=instance,
            lazy_instance=None,
            literal_instance=literal_instance,
            source_ref_id=None,
            after_refs=after_refs,
            dependency_only=False,
            supplemental_values=(),
            permission_context_ref=None,
            permission_context_type=None,
            gate_query_spec=None,
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_object_ref(
        cls,
        instance: ObjectServerRef[T],
        *,
        source_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        lazy_instance: LazyResult[T] | None = None,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    ) -> _InsertSource[T]:
        return cls(
            instance=instance,
            lazy_instance=lazy_instance,
            literal_instance=None,
            source_ref_id=source_ref_id,
            after_refs=after_refs,
            dependency_only=False,
            supplemental_values=(),
            permission_context_ref=None,
            permission_context_type=None,
            gate_query_spec=None,
        )


def _raise_insert_must_lower() -> None:
    msg = "InsertStep lowers to InsertRawResultStep + SelectOneRawStep + HydrateFirstResolvedRowStep"
    raise NotImplementedError(msg)


def _require_cte_bound_insert_columns(
    db_columns: list[str],
    *,
    source_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
) -> list[str]:
    if db_columns:
        return db_columns
    msg = f"InsertRawResultStep source {source_ref!r} does not expose writable columns for {model_cls.__name__}"
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _require_literal_insert_instance[T: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](
    instance: T | None,
) -> T:
    if instance is not None:
        return instance
    msg = "InsertRawResultStep requires a concrete literal instance once runtime replanning is excluded"
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


class _InsertStepMixin[T: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]:
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId
    _model_cls: type[T]
    _instance: ObjectServerRef[T]
    _lazy_instance: LazyResult[T] | None
    _literal_instance: T | None
    _source_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None
    _after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId]
    _dependency_only: bool
    _requires_deferred_replanning: bool
    _supplemental_values: _SupplementalWriteValues
    _permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None
    _permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None
    _dependencies_cache: frozenset[str] | None

    def _init_insert_state(
        self,
        model_cls: type[T],
        source: _InsertSource[T],
    ) -> None:
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._instance = source.instance
        self._lazy_instance = source.lazy_instance
        self._literal_instance = source.literal_instance
        self._source_ref_id = source.source_ref_id
        self._after_refs = source.after_refs
        self._dependency_only = source.dependency_only
        self._requires_deferred_replanning = source.requires_deferred_replanning
        self._supplemental_values = source.supplemental_values
        self._permission_context_ref = source.permission_context_ref
        self._permission_context_type = source.permission_context_type
        self._gate_query_spec = source.gate_query_spec
        self._compiled_publication_columns: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
        self._dependencies_cache = None

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        """Return False - inserts modify data."""
        return False

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        """Return ONE - insert returns a single row."""
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        """Use APPLY when the inserted instance still depends on prior refs."""
        return StepExecutionRole.APPLY if self.dependencies() else StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def emits_sql_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return True

    def counts_as_sql_group_for_accounting(self) -> bool | None:
        return True

    def consumes_executor_visible_dependencies(self) -> bool:
        return bool(self.dependencies())

    def tables_read(self: _InsertStepMixin[T]) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Insert FK reads are exposed through catalog-backed optimizer facts."""
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Return the table name this step writes to."""
        return frozenset({get_table_name(self._model_cls)})

    def foreign_key_checks(
        self: _InsertStepMixin[T],
        planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None,
    ) -> frozenset[ForeignKeyCheckFact]:
        instance = self._literal_instance if self._literal_instance is not None else self._instance
        return foreign_key_checks_for_instance(self._model_cls, instance, planning_catalog)

    def foreign_key_read_tables(
        self: _InsertStepMixin[T],
        planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None,
    ) -> frozenset[str]:
        return insert_fk_read_tables(self._model_cls, planning_catalog)

    def write_key_facts(
        self: _InsertStepMixin[T],
        planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None,
    ) -> frozenset[WriteKeyFact]:
        instance = self._literal_instance if self._literal_instance is not None else self._instance
        return write_key_facts_for_instance(
            self.ref_id,
            self._model_cls,
            instance,
            planning_catalog,
        )

    def ordered_statement_sql_visible_dependencies(self: _InsertStepMixin[T]) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Return only values that cannot be repeated inside the insert statement."""
        dependencies = set(self.dependencies())
        dependencies.difference_update(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs)
        if self._literal_instance is not None and self._source_ref_id is not None:
            source_ref = str(self._source_ref_id)
            dependencies = {
                dependency for dependency in dependencies if dependency != source_ref and not dependency.startswith(f"{source_ref}.")
            }
        return frozenset(dependencies)

    def dependencies(self: _InsertStepMixin[T]) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Return the immutable dependency snapshot for this insert step."""
        if self._dependencies_cache is not None:
            return self._dependencies_cache
        deps: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
        from l2055_lazy_result.lazy_param import server_value_deps

        deps = deps | frozenset(str(dep) for dep in collect_instance_deps(self._instance))
        deps = deps | frozenset(str(dep) for dep in server_value_deps(self._instance))
        if self._literal_instance is not None:
            deps = deps | frozenset(str(dep) for dep in collect_instance_deps(self._literal_instance))
        if self._lazy_instance is not None:
            from l2055_lazy_result.lazy_param import lazy_param_deps

            deps = deps | frozenset(str(dep) for dep in lazy_param_deps(self._lazy_instance))
        if self._permission_context_ref is not None:
            deps = deps | frozenset({str(self._permission_context_ref)})
        self._dependencies_cache = deps | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs)
        return self._dependencies_cache


def insert_requires_concrete_polymorphic_readback(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
    instance: DatabaseObjectRow[Any] | None,
) -> bool:
    """Return whether a concrete subtype needs an authoritative selected readback."""
    if instance is None:
        return False
    concrete_type = type(instance)
    return concrete_type is not model_cls and issubclass(concrete_type, model_cls)


def _requires_polymorphic_schema_prewrite(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]]) -> bool:
    from l1050_polymorphism.type_registry import get_polymorphic_base_class

    root_cls = get_polymorphic_base_class(model_cls) or model_cls
    return bool(
        getattr(root_cls, "__polymorphic__", False) and getattr(root_cls, "__polymorphic_strategy__", "single_table") == "single_table",
    )


def _compile_runtime_gated_insert_raw(
    step: InsertRawResultStep[Any],
) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    del step
    return raise_runtime_replanning_forbidden(
        step_name="InsertRawResultStep",
        trigger="the inserted row still depends on unresolved pipeline values",
        blocked_path=("compile() would need to recover a concrete object instance from runtime refs before emitting the final INSERT."),
        result_contract="return inserted raw rows as list[dict[str, Any]] for the current ref_id.",
        implementation_requirements=(
            "Publish any object or field prerequisites through explicit plan-visible steps before this terminal insert.",
            "Compile the final INSERT exactly once from a concrete row or explicit SQL-visible ref bindings.",
            "Do not read ctx.materialized_pipeline to recover runtime row values during compile().",
            "Do not create nested steps or invoke nested execution after compile returns.",
        ),
    )


def _compile_cte_bound_insert_raw(
    step: InsertRawResultStep[Any],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]] | None:
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import get_write_metadata_plan_from_catalog
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._query_helper_compile import (
        _collect_auxiliary_ctes_from_consumed,
        raw_rows_post_op,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_dml_simple import (
        SqlColumnListFragment,
        SqlInsertFromSelectStmt,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlReturningClause, SqlSelectAlias
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCast
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
    from l2070_batching.output_shape import (
        CompiledOutputShape,
        DeclaredResultRelation,
        synthetic_output_field,
    )
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import physical_table_publication_columns

    source_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None
    if step._source_ref_id is not None:
        source_ref = step._source_ref_id
    if source_ref is None:
        return None

    source_binding = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(source_ref))
    if not isinstance(source_binding, CteReference):
        return None

    plan = get_write_metadata_plan_from_catalog(ctx.planning_catalog, step._model_cls)
    if source_binding.columns is None:
        db_columns = [field_plan.db_column for field_plan in plan.field_plans]
    else:
        source_columns = set(source_binding.columns)
        db_columns = [field_plan.db_column for field_plan in plan.field_plans if field_plan.db_column in source_columns]
    db_columns = _require_cte_bound_insert_columns(
        db_columns,
        source_ref=source_ref,
        model_cls=step._model_cls,
    )

    column_refs = [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column_name)) for column_name in db_columns]
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import cast_postgres_expr_for_db_column

    select_columns = SqlColumnListFragment(
        [
            SqlSelectAlias(
                cast_postgres_expr_for_db_column(
                    backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
                    write_plan=plan,
                    db_column=column_name,
                    expr=column_ref,
                ),
                alias=SqlAliasName(column_name),
            )
            for column_name, column_ref in zip(db_columns, column_refs, strict=True)
        ],
    )
    supports_returning = ctx.sql_render_dialect().supports_insert_returning()
    needs_result = not step._dependency_only
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
        filter_columns_to_existing_schema,
    )

    publication_columns = filter_columns_to_existing_schema(
        ctx.schema_column_cache,
        get_table_name(step._model_cls),
        physical_table_publication_columns(step._model_cls, include_shared_subtypes=False),
    )
    step._compiled_publication_columns = publication_columns
    returning: SqlReturningClause | None = None
    if supports_returning and needs_result:
        returning_node = SqlReturningClause(
            [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in publication_columns],
        )
        assert isinstance(returning_node, SqlReturningClause)
        returning = returning_node
    __opa002_grammar_348 = SqlInsertFromSelectStmt(
        target=get_table_name(step._model_cls),
        columns=SqlColumnListFragment(column_refs),
        source=SqlTableName(source_binding.ref_id),
        select_columns=select_columns,
        returning=returning,
    )
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape(
        tuple(synthetic_output_field(column) for column in publication_columns),
    )
    column_type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(step._model_cls, publication_columns)
    assert column_type_hints is not None
    column_type_hints.require_complete(output_shape.cte_output_columns)
    auxiliary_ctes = _collect_auxiliary_ctes_from_consumed([source_binding])
    return CompiledStep(
        output_shape=output_shape,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        grammar=__opa002_grammar_348,
        needs_returning=supports_returning and needs_result,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
        closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op() if needs_result else literal_post_op(None),
    )


def insert_publishes_returning_rows(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[Any]],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
) -> bool:
    """Whether ``<insert>.raw`` carries the inserted rows rather than a readback.

    Large columns spill outside the RETURNING relation, so those inserts always
    resolve their visible rows through the ``<insert>.selected`` readback even on
    backends that support RETURNING.
    """
    from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs
    from l2070_batching.backend_profile import DmlResultTransport

    return ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_result_transport is DmlResultTransport.RETURNING_RELATION and not get_large_column_configs(
        model_cls
    )


class InsertStep[T: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](_InsertStepMixin[T], NonPublishingStep[T]):
    def insert_batch_candidate(self: InsertStep[T]) -> InsertBatchCandidate | None:
        return InsertBatchCandidate(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            instance=self._instance,
            literal_instance=self._literal_instance,
        )

    """ServerPlan step for inserting a single record."""

    def __init__(
        self: InsertStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[T],
        instance: ObjectServerRef[T],
        config: _InsertStepConfig[T] | None = None,
        *,
        source: _InsertSource[T] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        resolved_source = source or _InsertSource.from_config(instance, config or _InsertStepConfig())
        self._init_insert_state(
            model_cls,
            resolved_source,
        )

    @property
    def level(self: InsertStep) -> int:
        return 1

    def step_tags(self: InsertStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Return semantic tags for this step."""
        return frozenset({"write", "insert"})

    def lower(self: InsertStep, ctx: LoweringContext) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.row_hydration import (
            HydrateFirstResolvedRowStep,
            InsertSubscriptionDispatch,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.select_one_raw import SelectOneProjectionColumn, SelectOneRawStep
        from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import insert_readback_columns
        from l2070_batching.server_ref import ServerRefs

        raw_ref = f"{self.ref_id}.raw"
        selected_ref = f"{self.ref_id}.selected"
        ctx._lowering_cache[f"select_one_raw_ref:{self.ref_id}"] = ServerPlanRefId(raw_ref)
        raw_instance: ObjectServerRef[T] = self._instance
        requires_readback = not insert_publishes_returning_rows(self._model_cls, ctx) or insert_requires_concrete_polymorphic_readback(
            self._model_cls,
            self._literal_instance,
        )
        raw_dependency_only = self._dependency_only or requires_readback
        raw_source = _InsertSource(
            instance=raw_instance,
            lazy_instance=self._lazy_instance,
            literal_instance=self._literal_instance,
            source_ref_id=self._source_ref_id,
            after_refs=self._after_refs,
            dependency_only=raw_dependency_only,
            supplemental_values=self._supplemental_values,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
            gate_query_spec=self._gate_query_spec,
        )
        if self._literal_instance is not None:
            sys_id_ref = ServerRefs.scalar(self._literal_instance.sys_id)
            readback_model_cls = type(self._literal_instance)
        else:
            sys_id_ref = raw_instance.field("sys_id")
        readback_model_cls = self._model_cls
        if self._literal_instance is not None:
            literal_model_cls = type(self._literal_instance)
            if issubclass(literal_model_cls, self._model_cls):
                readback_model_cls = literal_model_cls
        if self._literal_instance is None and self._source_ref_id is None:
            msg = "InsertStep requires an explicit source_ref_id when no literal instance is configured"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        raw_step = InsertRawResultStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(raw_ref),
            readback_model_cls,
            raw_instance,
            source=raw_source,
        )
        if self._dependency_only:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.collect_results import (
                StaticValueAfterDepsStep,
            )

            return [
                raw_step,
                StaticValueAfterDepsStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(self.ref_id),
                    None,
                    [raw_ref],
                ),
            ]
        if not requires_readback:
            return [
                raw_step,
                HydrateFirstResolvedRowStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(raw_ref),
                    model_cls=readback_model_cls,
                    dispatch_insert_subscription=InsertSubscriptionDispatch(True),
                    runtime_only_materialization=True,
                ),
            ]
        return [
            raw_step,
            SelectOneRawStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(selected_ref),
                readback_model_cls,
                sys_id_ref,
                permission_state_override=QueryPermissionState.BYPASS,
                after_refs=frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(raw_ref)}),
                projection_columns=tuple(SelectOneProjectionColumn(column) for column in insert_readback_columns(readback_model_cls)),
            ),
            HydrateFirstResolvedRowStep(
                self.ref_id,
                source_ref=ServerPlanRefId(selected_ref),
                model_cls=readback_model_cls,
                dispatch_insert_subscription=InsertSubscriptionDispatch(True),
                runtime_only_materialization=not bool(get_large_column_configs(readback_model_cls)),
            ),
        ]

    def compile(self: InsertStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[T]:
        del ctx
        _raise_insert_must_lower()
        raise AssertionError("unreachable")


class InsertRawResultStep[T: DatabaseObjectRow[Any]](
    _InsertStepMixin[T],
    MaybeSqlRelationPublisherStep[list[dict[str, Any]]],
):
    """Terminal raw-row insert step."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[T],
        instance: ObjectServerRef[T],
        config: _InsertStepConfig[T] | None = None,
        *,
        source: _InsertSource[T] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        resolved_source = source or _InsertSource.from_config(instance, config or _InsertStepConfig())
        self._init_insert_state(
            model_cls,
            resolved_source,
        )

    @property
    def level(self: InsertRawResultStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self: InsertRawResultStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "insert", "raw"})

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: InsertRawResultStep) -> bool:
        return super().supports_sql_batch_transport()

    def scheduling_effects(self: InsertRawResultStep) -> frozenset[SchedulingEffect]:
        if _requires_polymorphic_schema_prewrite(self._model_cls):
            return frozenset({SchedulingEffect.REQUIRES_POLYMORPHIC_SCHEMA_PREWRITE})
        return frozenset()

    def supports_ordered_sql_statement_batch(self: InsertRawResultStep) -> bool:
        return (
            self._dependency_only
            or (self._literal_instance is not None and self._source_ref_id is not None)
            or not self.supports_sql_batch_transport()
        )

    def _publication_columns(self: InsertRawResultStep) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        if self._dependency_only:
            return ()
        if self._compiled_publication_columns is not None:
            return self._compiled_publication_columns
        return physical_table_publication_columns(self._model_cls, include_shared_subtypes=False)

    def cte_publication_contract(self: InsertRawResultStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = self._publication_columns()
        if not columns:
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...] | None) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            from l5100_fts.fts_naming import is_fts_vector_column_name

            columns = columns or ()
            hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, columns)
            if hints is None:
                msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._model_cls.__name__} insert rows"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            # Backend-managed FTS tsvector adjuncts are not model fields; the
            # producer declares them TEXT explicitly rather than relying on any
            # name inference in the generic hint combiner. Framework-owned write
            # columns (audit timestamps, versioning adjuncts) resolve through the
            # framework's declared physical column contract.
            adjunct_columns = frozenset(
                column
                for column in columns
                if is_fts_vector_column_name(SqlColumnName(column)) and hints.cast_target_for_column(column) is None
            )
            from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import (
                combine_sql_column_type_hints,
                framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints,
            )
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.large_column_read import (
                inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints,
            )

            return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                tuple(columns),
                hints,
                SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=adjunct_columns),
                framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
                inline_large_column_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls),
            )

        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = cte_projection_row_model(
            f"{type(self).__name__}CteRow",
            columns,
            column_type_hints,
        )
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.model(_contract_model_cls),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return not self._dependency_only and self._compiled_publication_columns != ()

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self) -> bool:
        return not self._dependency_only and self._compiled_publication_columns != ()

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        if self._source_ref_id is not None:
            return StepExecutionRole.SQL
        return super().execution_role()

    def lower(self: InsertRawResultStep, ctx: LoweringContext) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import filter_columns_to_existing_schema
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name

        self._compiled_publication_columns = tuple(
            str(column)
            for column in filter_columns_to_existing_schema(
                ctx.schema_column_cache,
                get_table_name(self._model_cls),
                physical_table_publication_columns(
                    self._model_cls,
                    include_shared_subtypes=False,
                ),
            )
        )
        return [self]

    def preprocess(self: InsertRawResultStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> None:
        del resolved

    def compile(self: InsertRawResultStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_insert import compile_insert_grammar

        cte_bound_insert = _compile_cte_bound_insert_raw(self, ctx)
        if cte_bound_insert is not None:
            return cte_bound_insert
        if self._requires_deferred_replanning:
            return _compile_runtime_gated_insert_raw(self)
        instance = _require_literal_insert_instance(self._literal_instance)
        from l2070_batching.compilation import (
            compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract,
        )

        output = compile_insert_grammar(
            self._model_cls,
            instance,
            ctx,
            needs_result=not self._dependency_only,
            supplemental_values=self._supplemental_values,
        )
        assert output is not None
        self._compiled_publication_columns = output.publication_columns
        ir = output.ir
        if ir.output_shape is not None:
            self._compiled_publication_columns = ir.output_shape.cte_output_columns
        if not ir.needs_returning:
            self._compiled_publication_columns = ()
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        closed_post_op = row_dicts_post_op() if not self._dependency_only else literal_post_op(None)
        __opa002_grammar_603 = ir.grammar
        from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import get_query_permission_plan
        from l1300_session.session import SessionId

        permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(self._model_cls, action="insert")
        literal_session = ctx.session_id if isinstance(ctx.session_id, SessionId) else None
        needs_insert_gate = (
            permission_plan is not None
            and permission_plan.filter_rows
            and (literal_session is None or permission_plan.filters_session(literal_session))
        )
        if self._literal_instance is not None and needs_insert_gate:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.runtime_ref_projection import (
                runtime_object_write_permission_literal_assertion_compiled_step,
            )
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_compound_write import (
                SqlStatementBatch,
            )
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.grammar_bases import SqlDmlBase, SqlInlineQueryGatedDmlBase
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_cte import SqlInsertWithCte
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.protocols import SqlRenderable
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_conditional_gate import gate_grammar_structurally
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlCteDefinition, SqlStatementLocalWith
            from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlCteName

            def _gate_insert_grammar(
                grammar: SqlRenderable,
                gate_query: SqlRenderable,
            ) -> tuple[SqlRenderable, bool]:
                if isinstance(grammar, SqlInlineQueryGatedDmlBase):
                    return grammar.gated_on_query(gate_query), True
                if isinstance(grammar, SqlInsertWithCte):
                    gated_inner, changed = _gate_insert_grammar(grammar._select, gate_query)
                    return SqlInsertWithCte(grammar._with_clause, gated_inner), changed
                if isinstance(grammar, SqlStatementBatch):
                    changed = False
                    statements: list[SqlRenderable] = []
                    for statement in grammar.statements:
                        gated_statement, statement_changed = _gate_insert_grammar(statement, gate_query)
                        statements.append(gated_statement)
                        changed = changed or statement_changed
                    return (
                        SqlStatementBatch(
                            statements,
                            category=grammar.category,
                            params_per_stmt=grammar.params_per_stmt,
                            external_params_first=grammar.external_params_first_per_stmt,
                            needs_returning_per_stmt=grammar.needs_returning_per_stmt,
                            collect_results_per_stmt=grammar.collect_results_per_stmt,
                            savepoint_recovery_per_stmt=grammar.savepoint_recovery_per_stmt,
                            result_labels_per_stmt=grammar.result_labels_per_stmt,
                            statement_kinds_per_stmt=grammar.statement_kinds_per_stmt,
                        ),
                        changed,
                    )
                if isinstance(grammar, SqlDmlBase):
                    gate_name = SqlCteName("__insert_permission_gate")
                    gated = gate_grammar_structurally(grammar, gate_name)
                    return (
                        SqlStatementLocalWith(
                            (SqlCteDefinition(gate_name, gate_query),),
                            gated,
                        ),
                        True,
                    )
                return grammar, False

            permission = runtime_object_write_permission_literal_assertion_compiled_step(
                instance,
                ctx=ctx,
                result_ref_id=f"{self.ref_id}.insert_gate",
                permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
                permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                action="insert",
            )
            permission_query = permission.grammar
            if permission_query is not None:
                if permission.auxiliary_ctes:
                    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlCte

                    permission_query = SqlCte(
                        permission.auxiliary_ctes,
                        permission_query,
                        recursive=permission.needs_recursive_with,
                    )
                from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectList, SqlSubqueryTableRef
                from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlLiteral
                from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

                permission_alias = SqlTableName("insert_permission")
                admission_query = SqlSelect(
                    select_list=SqlSelectList([SqlLiteral(1)]),
                    from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(permission_query, permission_alias),
                    where=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("ok"), str(permission_alias)),
                )
                __opa002_grammar_603, gated = _gate_insert_grammar(
                    __opa002_grammar_603,
                    admission_query,
                )
                assert gated, f"Insert grammar {type(__opa002_grammar_603).__name__} cannot carry its permission predicate"
        if self._gate_query_spec is not None:
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import compile_query_grammar
            from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlCteName
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_conditional_gate import (
                gate_grammar_structurally,
            )
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.grammar_bases import (
                SqlDmlBase,
                SqlInlineQueryGatedDmlBase,
            )
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import (
                SqlCteDefinition,
                SqlStatementLocalWith,
            )

            gate_model = self._gate_query_spec.model_cls
            gate = compile_query_grammar(
                self._gate_query_spec,
                gate_model,
                ctx,
                is_count=False,
                needs_returning=False,
            )
            gate_grammar = gate.grammar
            assert gate_grammar is not None
            if isinstance(__opa002_grammar_603, SqlInlineQueryGatedDmlBase):
                __opa002_grammar_603 = __opa002_grammar_603.gated_on_query(gate_grammar)
            elif isinstance(__opa002_grammar_603, SqlDmlBase):
                gate_name = SqlCteName("__configured_insert_gate")
                __opa002_grammar_603 = SqlStatementLocalWith(
                    (SqlCteDefinition(gate_name, gate_grammar),),
                    gate_grammar_structurally(__opa002_grammar_603, gate_name),
                )
            else:
                assert isinstance(__opa002_grammar_603, SqlDmlBase)
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectList
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CompiledSqlPublication, NoCompiledSqlPublication, compiled_repeatable_sql_publication

        publication: CompiledSqlPublication = NoCompiledSqlPublication()
        if contract.columns and not any(
            isinstance(info.json_schema_extra, dict) and info.json_schema_extra.get("autoincrement")
            for info in self._model_cls.model_fields.values()
        ):
            publication = compiled_repeatable_sql_publication(
                ref_id=self.ref_id,
                contract=contract,
                query=SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in contract.columns]),
                    from_=get_table_name(self._model_cls),
                    where=SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(instance.sys_id)),
                ),
            )
        if not contract.columns:
            output_shape = None
            result_relation = None
            column_type_hints = None
        else:
            output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
                contract,
            )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_603,
            compiled_sql_publication=publication,
            params=ir.params,
            needs_returning=(ir.needs_returning and not self._dependency_only),
            external_params_first=ir.external_params_first,
            provenance_manifest=ir.provenance_manifest,
            allow_empty_provenance_manifest=ir.allow_empty_provenance_manifest,
            use_savepoint_recovery=ir.use_savepoint_recovery,
            auxiliary_ctes=output.auxiliary_ctes,
            closed_post_op=closed_post_op,
        )

                column for column in columns if column in {"sys_id", "branch_id", "sys_revision_id", "sys_staged_commit_id"}

"""Dialect-level conformance for :func:`compile_conditional_step`.

Compiles a :class:`ConditionalStep` to its SQL IR and renders the
result against every SQL dialect that is expected to support gated
CTEs in Phase 4.2 (sqlite, postgres, mariadb).  The assertions
verify only the invariants we care about at this layer:

* ``compile_conditional_step`` runs without raising on each dialect.
* The rendered SQL is non-empty and mentions the gate CTE names and
  the forcing ``SELECT`` - a smoke test that the assembled grammar
  is structurally well-formed.

These are *conformance* tests in the sense that Phase 4.2 defines:
they exercise the compile path end-to-end for each SQL dialect that
Phase 4.2 targets, without depending on a running database server.
Executor integration (running the generated SQL) belongs with the
backend-specific SQL executor tests.
"""

class _FakePlan:
    def __init__(self: _FakePlan) -> None:
        self._next_ref_id: int = 0
        self.seeded_constants: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def _allocate_ref_id(self: _FakePlan, kind: str) -> str:
        prefix = {"step": "step_", "seed": "seed_", "output": "out_"}[kind]
        ref_id = f"{prefix}{self._next_ref_id}"
        self._next_ref_id += 1
        return ref_id


def _make_bool_ref(plan: _FakePlan, value: bool) -> ScalarServerRef[bool]:
    return allocate_ref(  # type: ignore[return-value]
        plan,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        kind="seed",
        variant="scalar",
        type_hint=bool,
        seed_value=value,
    )


def _result_output_contract() -> tuple[CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, SqlColumnTypeHints]:
    output_shape = CompiledOutputShape((synthetic_output_field("__result"),))
    return (
        output_shape,
        DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        SqlColumnTypeHints(integer_columns=frozenset({"__result"})),
    )


class _SelectLeafStep(ServerPlanStep[None]):
    """Leaf that compiles to ``SELECT 1`` - structurally gatable."""

    def __init__(self: _SelectLeafStep, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | str) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)

    def step_tags(self: _SelectLeafStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    @property
    def level(self: _SelectLeafStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def compile(self: _SelectLeafStep, ctx: Any) -> Any:
        del ctx
        grammar = SqlSelect(
            select_list=SqlItemList([SqlSelectAlias(SqlLiteral(1), SqlAliasName("__result"))]),
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = _result_output_contract()
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
        )

    def result_cardinality(self: _SelectLeafStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def is_read_only(self: _SelectLeafStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def tables_read(self: _SelectLeafStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _SelectLeafStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: _SelectLeafStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()


class _NonTransportLeafStep(_SelectLeafStep):

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _RecordingLifecycleEffect(PipelineLifecycleEffect):
    events: list[str]
    value: str
    phase: PipelineLifecyclePhase

    def apply(self) -> None:
        self.events.append(self.value)


def _matching_conditioned_effects(
    compiled: CompiledStep[None],
    *,
    phase: PipelineLifecyclePhase,
    label: str,
) -> tuple[_RecordingLifecycleEffect, ...]:
    return tuple(
        cast(_RecordingLifecycleEffect, effect.effect)
        for effect in compiled.lifecycle_effects
        if isinstance(effect, ResultConditionedLifecycleEffect) and effect.phase == phase and effect.label == label
    )


def _apply_fired_conditioned_effects(
    compiled: CompiledStep[None],
    fired_labels: set[str],
    *,
    phase: PipelineLifecyclePhase,
) -> None:
    for effect in compiled.lifecycle_effects:
        if isinstance(effect, ResultConditionedLifecycleEffect) and effect.phase == phase and effect.label in fired_labels:
            cast(_RecordingLifecycleEffect, effect.effect).apply()


class _HookedSelectLeafStep(_SelectLeafStep):

        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._events = events

    def compile(self: _HookedSelectLeafStep, ctx: Any) -> Any:
        compiled = super().compile(ctx)
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=compiled.grammar,
            output_shape=compiled.output_shape,
            result_relation=compiled.result_relation,
            column_type_hints=compiled.column_type_hints,
            lifecycle_effects=(
                _RecordingLifecycleEffect(
                    self._events,
                    f"commit:{self.ref_id}",
                    PipelineLifecyclePhase.AFTER_COMMIT_LOCAL,
                ),
                _RecordingLifecycleEffect(
                    self._events,
                    f"rollback:{self.ref_id}",

        )

        if_true_steps=[ReturnValueStep(StepRefId("result"), True)],

        [ReturnValueStep(StepRefId("result"), True)],
        else_steps,

    default_physical = SqlConditionalStep.from_semantic(

        same_plan_write_transport=SamePlanWriteTransport.ORDERED_STATEMENTS,

    )

    assert not default_physical.supports_ordered_sql_statement_batch()
    assert rewritten_conditional.allows_ordered_output_transport()
    assert not opted_in_physical.requires_standalone_physical_request()

    class _CollidingCallbackLeafStep(_SelectLeafStep):
        def __init__(
            self: _CollidingCallbackLeafStep,
            ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | str,
            events: list[str],
        ) -> None:
            super().__init__(ref_id)
            self._events = events

        def compile(self: _CollidingCallbackLeafStep, ctx: Any) -> Any:
            compiled = super().compile(ctx)
            label = str(self.ref_id)
            return CompiledStep(
                grammar=compiled.grammar,
                lifecycle_effects=(
                    _RecordingLifecycleEffect(
                        self._events,
                        "direct",
                        PipelineLifecyclePhase.AFTER_COMMIT_LOCAL,
                    ),
                    ResultConditionedLifecycleEffect(
                        PipelineLifecyclePhase.AFTER_COMMIT_LOCAL,
                        label,
                        _RecordingLifecycleEffect(
                            self._events,
                            "conditioned",
                            PipelineLifecyclePhase.AFTER_COMMIT_LOCAL,
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            )

    plan = _FakePlan()

def test_literal_source_json_typing_depends_on_schema_not_runtime_values() -> None:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_versioned_upsert import _render_source_rows_subquery
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_json import SqlJsonLiteral

    typed_rows = [
        tuple(SqlJsonLiteral(value) if column in json_columns else value for column, value in zip(source_columns, row, strict=True))

            dialect=dialect,
            source_columns=source_columns,
            source_rows=typed_rows,

def test_json_aggregated_versioned_fts_keeps_query_text_params_in_tsquery_slots() -> None:
    rid = RevisionId(uuid.UUID("018f1234-5678-7abc-8def-123456789abc"))
    branch_id = BranchId(uuid.UUID("018f1234-5678-7abc-8def-123456789abd"))
    profile = make_backend_profile(
        BackendType.POSTGRES,
        capabilities=frozenset({BackendCapability.FULL_TEXT_SEARCH}),
    )
    tip_step = ResolveBranchTipRevisionStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_0"),
        branch_id=ServerRefs.scalar(branch_id),
        branch_table=SqlTableName("sys_branches"),
    )
    payload_step = VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_1"),
        model_cls=_VnativeFtsCompileModel,
        config=_VersionedFtsPayloadConfig(
            query_source=cast(Any, ServerRefs.scalar(rid)),
            literal_query_text="azimuthal",
            field_names=("title",),
            mode=FTSSearchMode.NATURAL,
            query_inputs=None,
            limit=5,
            offset=0,
            requested_revision_ids=(rid,),
            raw_mode=False,
            defer_large_columns=False,
            session_id=None,
            branch_id="branch-1",
            branch_ref_id=None,
            revision_ref_ids=(),
        ),
    )
    strategy = JsonAggregationCodegen()
    ctx = make_compilation_context(
        profile=profile,
        branch_id=str(branch_id),
        txn=object(),
    )

    ir = strategy.compile_batch([tip_step, payload_step], ctx)
    dialect = PostgresDialect()
    sql_text, params, _embedded = compile_terminal_sql(
        ir.grammar,
        external_params=ir.params or (),
        external_params_first=ir.external_params_first,
        dialect=dialect,
    )

    assert "to_tsquery" in sql_text
    english_param_positions = [index for index, param in enumerate(params[:-1]) if param == "english"]
    assert english_param_positions
    assert all(params[index + 1] == "azimuthal" for index in english_param_positions)
    assert branch_id.unwrap_to_uuid() in params
    assert rid.unwrap_to_uuid() in params

_SQL_DATABASE = SqlFragment.static("DATABASE()")
_SQL_TABLE_SCHEMA = SqlFragment.static("table_schema")

_SQL_INDEX_NAME = SqlFragment.static("indexname")

_SQL_NAME = SqlFragment.static("name")

_SQL_TRUE_PREDICATE = SqlFragment.static("1 = 1")
_SQL_PRAGMA_TABLE_XINFO_OPEN = SqlFragment.static("pragma_table_xinfo(")
_SQL_PRAGMA_INDEX_LIST_OPEN = SqlFragment.static("pragma_index_list(")

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _SqlCollatedExpression:
    """Apply one validated schema collation to an expression."""

    expression: SqlRenderable
    collation: SqlCollationName

    def render(self: _SqlCollatedExpression, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        return self.expression.render(dialect) + _SQL_COLLATE + SqlQuotedIdentifier(self.collation).render(dialect)

    def collect_render_params(self: _SqlCollatedExpression, dialect: SqlDialect) -> tuple[object, ...]:
        return self.render(dialect).collect_render_params(dialect)

    def structural_fingerprint(self: _SqlCollatedExpression, dialect: SqlDialect) -> tuple[object, ...] | None:
        return self.render(dialect).structural_fingerprint(dialect)


_SQL_TABLENAME = SqlFragment.static("tablename")
_SQL_ONE_LIMIT = SQL_LIMIT + SqlFragment.static(" 1")
_SQL_GROUP_BY_ONE_HAVING = SqlFragment.static(" GROUP BY 1 HAVING ")
_SQL_IN_OPEN = SqlFragment.static(" IN (")


def _identifier(value: str, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
    return SqlQuotedIdentifier(value).render(dialect)


def _table_identifier(value: str, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
    parts = tuple(part for part in value.split(".") if part)
    if len(parts) <= 1:
        return _identifier(value, dialect)
    rendered = _identifier(parts[0], dialect)
    for part in parts[1:]:
        rendered = rendered + _SQL_DOT + _identifier(part, dialect)
    return rendered


def _param(value: object, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
    return SqlParam(value).render(dialect)


def _select_ok_from_where(
    *,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    where: SqlFragment,
    dialect: SqlDialect,
) -> SqlFragment:
    return (
        SQL_SELECT
        + _SQL_1
        + SQL_AS
        + _identifier("ok", dialect)
        + _assertion_status_columns(dialect)
        + SQL_FROM
        + _table_identifier(table_name, dialect)
        + SQL_WHERE
        + where
        + _SQL_ONE_LIMIT
    )


def _eq(column_name: SqlColumnName, value: object, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
    return _identifier(column_name, dialect) + _SQL_EQ + _param(value, dialect)


def _assertion_status_columns(dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
    return (
        _SQL_COMMA_SPACE
        + _param(None, dialect)
        + SQL_AS
        + _identifier("error_code", dialect)
        + _SQL_COMMA_SPACE
        + _param(None, dialect)
        + SQL_AS
        + _identifier("message", dialect)
    )


def _and(*parts: SqlFragment) -> SqlFragment:
    if not parts:
        return _SQL_TRUE_PREDICATE
    result = parts[0]
    for part in parts[1:]:
        result = result + _SQL_AND + part
    return result


class _BootstrapSqlAssertionQuery(SqlDmlBase):
    """Render a SQL assertion query for one bootstrap fact."""

    __slots__ = ("_column_name", "_index_name", "_source_table_name", "_table_name", "_values")
    _kind: ClassVar[BootstrapAssertionKind]

    def __init__(
        self: _BootstrapSqlAssertionQuery,
        *,
        table_name: SqlTableName | None = None,
        column_name: SqlColumnName | None = None,
        index_name: SqlIndexName | None = None,
        values: tuple[object, ...] = (),
        source_table_name: SqlTableName | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._table_name = table_name
        self._source_table_name = source_table_name
        self._column_name = column_name
        self._index_name = index_name
        self._values = values

    def render(self: _BootstrapSqlAssertionQuery, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        if self._kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.TABLE_EXISTS:
            assert self._table_name is not None
            return _table_exists_query(self._table_name, dialect)
        if self._kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.COLUMN_EXISTS:
            assert self._table_name is not None
            assert self._column_name is not None
            return _column_exists_query(self._table_name, self._column_name, dialect)
        if self._kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.INDEX_EXISTS:
            assert self._table_name is not None
            assert self._index_name is not None
            return _index_exists_query(self._table_name, self._index_name, dialect)
        if self._kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.SCHEMA_GENERATION_MATCHES:
            return _select_ok_from_where(
                table_name=self._source_table_name or SqlTableName("sys_schema_state"),
                where=_and(
                    _eq(SqlColumnName("state_key"), "current", dialect),
                    _eq(SqlColumnName("schema_hash_v2"), self._values[0], dialect),
                ),
                dialect=dialect,
            )
        if self._kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.MANIFEST_WRITTEN:
            return _select_ok_from_where(
                table_name=self._source_table_name or SqlTableName("sys_bootstrap_manifests"),
                where=_and(
                    _eq(SqlColumnName("manifest_key"), self._values[0], dialect),
                    _eq(SqlColumnName("plan_hash"), self._values[1], dialect),
                ),
                dialect=dialect,
            )
        if self._kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.PROOF_FACT_WRITTEN:
            return _select_ok_from_where(
                table_name=self._source_table_name or SqlTableName("sys_bootstrap_proof_scopes"),
                where=_eq(SqlColumnName("proof_hash"), self._values[0], dialect),
                dialect=dialect,
            )
        if self._kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.PROOF_FACTS_WRITTEN:
            return _proof_batch_written_query(
                self._values,
                dialect,
                table_name=self._source_table_name or SqlTableName("sys_bootstrap_proof_scopes"),
            )
        if self._kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.SEED_FACT_WRITTEN:
            return _select_ok_from_where(
                table_name=self._source_table_name or SqlTableName("sys_bootstrap_seed_facts"),
                where=_eq(SqlColumnName("seed_hash"), self._values[0], dialect),
                dialect=dialect,
            )
        if self._kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.SEED_FACTS_WRITTEN:
            return _seed_batch_written_query(
                self._values,
                dialect,
                table_name=self._source_table_name or SqlTableName("sys_bootstrap_seed_facts"),
            )
        if self._kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.TRANSITION_REPLAY_VALID:
            return (
                SQL_SELECT
                + _SQL_1
                + SQL_AS
                + _identifier("ok", dialect)
                + _assertion_status_columns(dialect)
                + SQL_WHERE
                + _param(self._values[0], dialect)
                + _SQL_EQ
                + _param(self._values[0], dialect)
                + _SQL_AND
                + _param(self._values[1], dialect)
                + _SQL_EQ
                + _param(self._values[1], dialect)
            )
        msg = f"Unsupported bootstrap SQL assertion kind: {self._kind.value}"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)

class _ColumnStorageMatchesQuery(_BootstrapSqlAssertionQuery):
    """Require every declared catalog type before publishing dependent data."""

    _kind = BootstrapAssertionKind.COLUMN_STORAGE_MATCHES

    @property
    def bootstrap_statement_phase(self: _ColumnStorageMatchesQuery) -> SqlBootstrapStatementPhase:
        return SqlBootstrapStatementPhase.PRECONDITION

    @property
    def bootstrap_precondition_error(self: _ColumnStorageMatchesQuery) -> str:
        return "Bootstrap precondition failed: column_storage_matches"

    def __init__(self: _ColumnStorageMatchesQuery, payload: BootstrapColumnStorageAssertion) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._payload = payload

    def render(self: _ColumnStorageMatchesQuery, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        requirement = self._payload.requirement
        if dialect.backend_type is not requirement.backend:
            raise ValueError("Storage assertion backend differs from its execution backend")
        columns: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        alternatives: list[SqlFragment] = []
        observed_type = SqlJsonAccess("GET_TEXT", SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("payload_json")), SqlJsonPath("$.data_type"))
        for table, column, expected_type in requirement.columns:
            columns.setdefault(str(table), []).append(str(column))
            alternatives.append(
                _SQL_OPEN_PAREN
                + _and(
                    _eq(SqlColumnName("table_name"), str(table), dialect),
                    _eq(SqlColumnName("column_name"), str(column), dialect),
                    _SQL_UPPER_OPEN
                    + observed_type.render(dialect)
                    + _SQL_CLOSE_PAREN
                    + _SQL_EQ
                    + _param(str(expected_type).upper(), dialect),
                )
                + _SQL_CLOSE_PAREN
            )
        predicate = alternatives[0]
        for alternative in alternatives[1:]:
            predicate = predicate + _SQL_OR + alternative
        extension_predicates = _SQL_EMPTY
        for name, version in requirement.extensions:
            extension_predicates = (
                extension_predicates
                + _SQL_AND
                + _SQL_EXISTS_OPEN
                + (
                    SQL_SELECT
                    + _SQL_1
                    + SQL_FROM
                    + _SQL_EXTENSION_SOURCE
                    + SQL_WHERE
                    + _and(
                        _eq(SqlColumnName("extname"), str(name), dialect),
                        _eq(SqlColumnName("extversion"), version, dialect),
                    )
                )
                + _SQL_CLOSE_PAREN
            )
        source = SqlBootstrapPhysicalInterrogation(
            table_names=(),
            columns_by_table=tuple((name, tuple(names)) for name, names in sorted(columns.items())),
            indexes_by_table=(),
            presence="present",
            include_column_metadata=True,
        )
        return (
            SQL_SELECT
            + _SQL_1
            + SQL_AS
            + _identifier("ok", dialect)
            + _assertion_status_columns(dialect)
            + SQL_FROM
            + _SQL_OPEN_PAREN
            + source.render(dialect)
            + _SQL_CLOSE_PAREN
            + SQL_AS
            + _identifier("required_storage", dialect)
            + SQL_WHERE
            + _eq(SqlColumnName("presence"), "present", dialect)
            + _SQL_AND
            + _SQL_OPEN_PAREN
            + predicate
            + _SQL_CLOSE_PAREN
            + extension_predicates
            + _SQL_GROUP_BY_ONE_HAVING
            + _SQL_COUNT_ALL
            + _SQL_EQ
            + _param(len(requirement.columns), dialect)
        )


@pure_lazy
def bootstrap_row_set_predicate(
    requirement: BootstrapRowSetRequirement,
    *,
    proposed_row: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId] | None = None,
) -> SqlBinaryOp:
    """Count the prospective population using database comparison semantics."""
    source: SqlRenderable = SqlTableIdent(requirement.table_name)
    collations_by_name = dict(requirement.collations)
    if proposed_row is not None and get_table_name(type(proposed_row)) == requirement.table_name:
        model = type(proposed_row)
        field_by_column = {cached_db_column_name(model, DynamicFieldName(name)): name for name in model.model_fields}
        names = tuple(name for name, _ in requirement.predicates)
        try:
            field_names = tuple(DynamicFieldName(field_by_column[name]) for name in names)
        except KeyError as error:
            raise ValueError("Row-set scope names an unknown target column") from error
        from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_row_content import bootstrap_immutable_content_for_planning

        content = bootstrap_immutable_content_for_planning(proposed_row, field_names)
        proposed_columns: list[SqlSelectAlias] = []
        for name, field_name, (_, value) in zip(names, field_names, content, strict=True):
            if isinstance(value, BootstrapBinaryContent):
                raise ValueError("Row-set scope requires scalar target columns")
            expression: SqlRenderable = SqlParam(value)
            field_extra = model.model_fields[str(field_name)].json_schema_extra
            collation = field_extra.get("collation") if isinstance(field_extra, dict) else None
            if type(collation) is str:
                typed_collation = SqlCollationName(collation)
                collations_by_name[name] = typed_collation
                expression = _SqlCollatedExpression(expression, typed_collation)
            proposed_columns.append(SqlSelectAlias(expression, SqlAliasName(name)))
        remaining = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlSelectAlias(SqlColumnRef(name), SqlAliasName(name)) for name in names]),
            from_=source,
            where=SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), BinaryOp.NE, SqlParam(proposed_row.sys_id)),
        )
        source = SqlSubqueryTableRef(
            SqlUnionAll((remaining, SqlSelect(select=SqlSelectList(proposed_columns)))),
            SqlTableName("bootstrap_prospective_population"),
        )
    scope_predicates: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for name, value in requirement.predicates:
        column: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(name)
        collation = collations_by_name.get(name)
        if collation is not None:
            column = _SqlCollatedExpression(column, collation)
        scope_predicates.append(SqlIsNull(column) if value is None else SqlBinaryOp(column, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(value)))
    scope = sql_and(*scope_predicates)
    count = SqlSubquery(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())]),
            from_=source,
            where=scope,
        )
    )
    return SqlBinaryOp(count, BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(int(requirement.expected_count)))


@pure_lazy
def bootstrap_required_row_predicate(payload: BootstrapRowContentAssertion) -> SqlExists:
    """Require complete persisted parent content at the dependent write boundary."""
    return SqlExists(_RowContentMatchesQuery(payload))


@pure_lazy
def bootstrap_row_content_tables(payload: BootstrapRowContentAssertion) -> frozenset[str]:
    """Retain all direct and transitive reads used by an immutable row assertion."""
    return frozenset(
        {
            str(payload.table_name),
            *(str(table) for requirement in payload.storage_requirements for table, _, _ in requirement.columns),
            *(str(requirement.table_name) for requirement in payload.row_set_requirements),
            *(table for required in payload.required_rows for table in bootstrap_row_content_tables(required)),
        }
    )


class _RowContentMatchesQuery(_BootstrapSqlAssertionQuery):
    """Observe the stored row rather than the publication statement output."""

    _kind = BootstrapAssertionKind.ROW_CONTENT_MATCHES

    def __init__(self: _RowContentMatchesQuery, payload: BootstrapRowContentAssertion) -> None:
        super().__init__(table_name=payload.table_name)
        self._payload = payload

    def render(self: _RowContentMatchesQuery, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        predicates = [_eq(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), self._payload.row_id, dialect)]
        for name, value in self._payload.expected_values:
            if isinstance(value, BootstrapBinaryContent):
                predicates.append(SqlSha256HexDigest(SqlColumnRef(name)).render(dialect) + _SQL_EQ + _param(value.sha256, dialect))
            else:
                predicates.append(_identifier(name, dialect) + _SQL_IS_NULL if value is None else _eq(name, value, dialect))
        for required in self._payload.required_rows:
            predicates.append(bootstrap_required_row_predicate(required).render(dialect))
        for population in self._payload.row_set_requirements:
            predicates.append(bootstrap_row_set_predicate(population).render(dialect))
        for requirement in self._payload.storage_requirements:
            if requirement.backend is dialect.backend_type:
                query = _ColumnStorageMatchesQuery(BootstrapColumnStorageAssertion(requirement, self._payload.source_ref))
                predicates.append(_SQL_EXISTS_OPEN + query.render(dialect) + _SQL_CLOSE_PAREN)
        return _select_ok_from_where(
            table_name=self._payload.table_name,
            where=_and(*predicates),
            dialect=dialect,
        )


class _ExistingRowContentCompatibleQuery(_RowContentMatchesQuery):
    """Reject conflicting persisted rows before bootstrap metadata publication."""

    _kind = BootstrapAssertionKind.EXISTING_ROW_CONTENT_COMPATIBLE

    @property
    def bootstrap_statement_phase(self: _ExistingRowContentCompatibleQuery) -> SqlBootstrapStatementPhase:
        return SqlBootstrapStatementPhase.PRECONDITION

    @property
    def bootstrap_precondition_error(self: _ExistingRowContentCompatibleQuery) -> str:
        return "Bootstrap precondition failed: existing_row_content_matches"

    def render(self: _ExistingRowContentCompatibleQuery, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        existing = SqlSelect(
            SqlParam(1),
            SqlTableIdent(self._payload.table_name),
            where=SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(self._payload.row_id)),
        )
        return SqlSelect(
            SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(1), SqlAliasName("ok")),
                    SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(None), SqlAliasName("error_code")),
                    SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(None), SqlAliasName("message")),
                ]
            ),
            where=SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlExists(existing, negated=True),
                BinaryOp.OR,
                SqlExists(_RowContentMatchesQuery(self._payload)),
            ),
        ).render(dialect)


def _bootstrap_assertion_query(
    assertion: BootstrapSqlAssertion,
    *,
    source_table_name: SqlTableName | None = None,
) -> _BootstrapSqlAssertionQuery:
    payload = assertion.payload
    if assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.COLUMN_STORAGE_MATCHES:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapColumnStorageAssertion)
        return _ColumnStorageMatchesQuery(payload)
    if assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.EXISTING_ROW_CONTENT_COMPATIBLE:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapRowContentAssertion)
        return _ExistingRowContentCompatibleQuery(payload)
    if assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.ROW_CONTENT_MATCHES:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapRowContentAssertion)
        return _RowContentMatchesQuery(payload)
    if assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.TABLE_EXISTS:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapTableAssertion)
        return _TableExistsQuery(table_name=payload.table_name)
    if assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.COLUMN_EXISTS:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapColumnAssertion)
        return _ColumnExistsQuery(
            table_name=payload.table_name,
            column_name=payload.column_name,
        )
    if assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.INDEX_EXISTS:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapIndexAssertion)
        return _IndexExistsQuery(
            table_name=payload.table_name,
            index_name=payload.index_name,
        )
    query_type: type[_BootstrapSqlAssertionQuery]
    values: tuple[object, ...]
    if assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.SCHEMA_GENERATION_MATCHES:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapSchemaGenerationAssertion)
        query_type = _SchemaGenerationMatchesQuery
        values = (str(payload.schema_hash),)
    elif assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.MANIFEST_WRITTEN:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapManifestAssertion)
        query_type = _ManifestWrittenQuery
        values = (str(payload.manifest_key), str(payload.plan_hash))
    elif assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.PROOF_FACT_WRITTEN:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapProofAssertion)
        query_type = _ProofFactWrittenQuery
        values = (str(payload.proof_hash),)
    elif assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.PROOF_FACTS_WRITTEN:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapProofBatchAssertion)
        query_type = _ProofFactsWrittenQuery
        values = tuple(str(proof_hash) for proof_hash in payload.proof_hashes)
    elif assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.SEED_FACT_WRITTEN:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapSeedAssertion)
        query_type = _SeedFactWrittenQuery
        values = (str(payload.seed_hash),)
    elif assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.SEED_FACTS_WRITTEN:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapSeedBatchAssertion)
        query_type = _SeedFactsWrittenQuery
        values = tuple(str(seed_hash) for seed_hash in payload.seed_hashes)
    elif assertion.kind is BootstrapAssertionKind.TRANSITION_REPLAY_VALID:
        assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapTransitionReplayAssertion)
        query_type = _TransitionReplayValidQuery
        values = (str(payload.observed_hash), str(payload.desired_hash))
    else:
        msg = f"Unsupported bootstrap SQL assertion kind: {assertion.kind.value}"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    return query_type(values=values, source_table_name=source_table_name)

def _fact_batch_written_query(
    hashes: tuple[object, ...],
    *,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    hash_column: str,
    count_distinct: SqlFragment,
    dialect: SqlDialect,
) -> SqlFragment:
    unique_hashes = tuple(dict.fromkeys(str(fact_hash) for fact_hash in hashes))
    if not unique_hashes:
        return SQL_SELECT + _SQL_1 + SQL_AS + _identifier("ok", dialect) + _assertion_status_columns(dialect)
    params = _param(unique_hashes[0], dialect)
    for fact_hash in unique_hashes[1:]:
        params = params + _SQL_COMMA_SPACE + _param(fact_hash, dialect)
    return (
        SQL_SELECT
        + _SQL_1
        + SQL_AS
        + _identifier("ok", dialect)
        + _assertion_status_columns(dialect)
        + SQL_FROM
        + _table_identifier(table_name, dialect)
        + SQL_WHERE
        + _identifier(hash_column, dialect)
        + _SQL_IN_OPEN
        + params
        + _SQL_CLOSE_PAREN
        + _SQL_GROUP_BY_ONE_HAVING
        + count_distinct
        + _SQL_EQ
        + _param(len(unique_hashes), dialect)
        + _SQL_ONE_LIMIT
    )


class BootstrapColumnStorageLockStep(UtilityEffectStep):
    """Hold PostgreSQL source locks through the schema publication boundary."""

    def __init__(
        self: BootstrapColumnStorageLockStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        requirement: BootstrapColumnStorageRequirement,
        dependency_refs: frozenset[str],
    ) -> None:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.ddl.ddl_relation_lock import SqlLockTablesAccessShare

        super().__init__(ref_id, SqlLockTablesAccessShare(tuple(table for table, _, _ in requirement.columns)))
        self._dependency_refs = dependency_refs
        self._source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table, _, _ in requirement.columns)

    def dependencies(self: BootstrapColumnStorageLockStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._dependency_refs

    def tables_read(self: BootstrapColumnStorageLockStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._source_tables


class BootstrapSqlAssertionStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[None]):
    def requires_assertion_statement_transport(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> bool:
        return True

    """Run one hard bootstrap SQL assertion."""

    def __init__(
        self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        assertion: BootstrapSqlAssertion,
        *,
        dependency_refs: tuple[ServerPlanRefId, ...] = (),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._assertion = assertion
        self._dependency_refs = tuple(dependency_refs)

    @property
    def level(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def step_tags(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"bootstrap", "sql_assertion"})

    def dependencies(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in self._dependency_refs)

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_read(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        payload = self._assertion.payload
        if isinstance(payload, BootstrapColumnStorageAssertion):
            return frozenset(str(table) for table, _, _ in payload.requirement.columns)
        if isinstance(payload, BootstrapRowContentAssertion):
            return bootstrap_row_content_tables(payload)
        if isinstance(
            payload, BootstrapTableAssertion | BootstrapColumnAssertion | BootstrapIndexAssertion | BootstrapRowContentAssertion
        ):
            return frozenset({str(payload.table_name)})
        if isinstance(payload, BootstrapSchemaGenerationAssertion):
            return frozenset({"sys_schema_state"})
        if isinstance(payload, BootstrapManifestAssertion):
            return frozenset({"sys_bootstrap_manifests"})
        if isinstance(payload, BootstrapProofAssertion | BootstrapProofBatchAssertion):
            return frozenset({"sys_bootstrap_proof_scopes"})
        if isinstance(payload, BootstrapSeedAssertion | BootstrapSeedBatchAssertion):
            return frozenset({"sys_bootstrap_seed_facts"})
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def requires_prior_statement_visibility_after_writes(
        self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep,
    ) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Assertions observe committed statement effects, not the writer's CTE output."""
        return self.tables_read()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("ok", "error_code", "message")
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({"ok"}), text_columns=frozenset({"error_code", "message"}))
        column_type_hints.require_complete(columns)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.literal_mapping(columns=columns),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
        )

    def compile(self: BootstrapSqlAssertionStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            contract,
        )
        payload = self._assertion.payload
        payload_details = ", ".join(
            f"{name}={value}"
            for name, value in (
                (field.name, getattr(payload, field.name))
                for field in fields(payload)
                if field.name in {"table_name", "column_name", "index_name", "manifest_key", "scope_name"}
            )
        )
        del ctx
        source_binding: CteReference | None = None
        message = f"Bootstrap SQL assertion failed: {self._assertion.kind.value}"
        if payload_details:
            message = f"{message} ({payload_details})"
        assertion_query = _bootstrap_assertion_query(
            self._assertion,
            source_table_name=(None if source_binding is None else SqlTableName(source_binding.ref_id)),
        )
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_compound_write import (
            SqlStatementBatch,
            SqlStatementBatchCategory,
        )

        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=SqlStatementBatch(
                [assertion_query],
                category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.ORDERED_SEMANTIC,
                needs_returning_per_stmt=[True],
                collect_results_per_stmt=[True],
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(message, exc_type=ProgrammingError),
            auxiliary_ctes=(
                None
                if source_binding is None or source_binding.auxiliary_query is None
                else [(source_binding.ref_id, source_binding.auxiliary_query)]
            ),
        )
