def _branch_id_from_compile_context(compile_context: _GraphCompileContextConfig) -> str | None:
    if compile_context.branch_anchor_ref_id is not None or compile_context.branch_anchor_literal is None:
        return None
    branch_anchor_literal = compile_context.branch_anchor_literal
    if isinstance(branch_anchor_literal, BranchId):
        branch_id: str = branch_anchor_literal.unwrap_to_str()
        return branch_id
    return str(branch_anchor_literal)


def _traversal_pattern(config: GraphTraversalReadConfig) -> tuple[GraphQueryPattern, Mapping[str, NodePattern]]:
    def branch_pattern(
        edge_type: type[GraphEdge[Any]],
    ) -> GraphQueryPattern:
        return GraphQueryPattern(
            paths=[
                PathPattern(
                    source=NodePattern(
                        "start",
                        config.node_base_model,
                        {"sys_id": config.start_id},
                    ),
                    target=NodePattern("target", config.node_base_model),
                    edge=EdgePattern("edge", edge_type),
                    direction=config.direction,
                    quantifier=config.quantifier,
                ),
            ],
            binding_projections=[
                NodeBindingProjection(binding_name="source", node_variable="start"),
                NodeBindingProjection(binding_name="target", node_variable="target"),
                EdgeBindingProjection(binding_name="edge", edge_variable="edge"),
                DepthBindingProjection(binding_name="depth"),
            ],
            limit=config.limit,
        )

    if not config.edge_types:
        msg = "Auto API graph traversal requires at least one edge model"
        raise ValueError(msg)

    nodes = {
        "start": NodePattern(
            "start",
            config.node_base_model,
            {"sys_id": config.start_id},
        ),
        "target": NodePattern("target", config.node_base_model),
    }
    branches = tuple(branch_pattern(edge_type) for edge_type in config.edge_types)
    if len(branches) == 1:
        pattern = branches[0]
    else:
        pattern = GraphQueryPattern(
            union_blocks=[UnionBlock(branches=branches)],
            binding_projections=[
                NodeBindingProjection(binding_name="source", node_variable="start"),
                NodeBindingProjection(binding_name="target", node_variable="target"),
                EdgeBindingProjection(binding_name="edge", edge_variable="edge"),
                DepthBindingProjection(binding_name="depth"),
            ],
            limit=config.limit,
        )
    return pattern, nodes


class GraphTraversalReadIntent(IntentStep[object]):
    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "graph", "versioned", "intent", "traversal"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.ONE
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(self, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId, config: GraphTraversalReadConfig) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._config = config

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"*"})

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        del ctx
        pattern, nodes = _traversal_pattern(self._config)
        rows_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.graph_bindings")
        traversal_step = ExecuteGraphBindingsStep(
            rows_ref,
            config=_GraphExecuteConfig(
                graph_id_ref=self._config.graph_id_ref,
                compile_context=self._config.compile_context,
                graph_type=Graph,
                result_node_type=self._config.node_base_model,
                pattern=pattern,
                nodes=nodes,
                current_path=None,
            ),
        )
        publication_gate = self.publication_gate_requirement()
        if publication_gate is not None:
            traversal_step.require_publication_gate(publication_gate)
        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = [traversal_step]
        source_names: list[str] = ["rows"]
        source_refs: list[ServerPlanRefId] = [rows_ref]
        versioned_node_models = _metadata_candidate_models_for_traversal(self._config)
        if versioned_node_models:
            endpoint_ids_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.endpoint_ids")
            metadata_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}.metadata")
            steps.append(
                ProjectScalarSequenceFromRowsStep(
                    endpoint_ids_ref,
                    source_ref=rows_ref,
                    field_names=(SqlColumnName("__bind_edge_source_sys_id"), SqlColumnName("__bind_edge_target_sys_id")),
                ),
            )
            steps.append(
                VersionedResolveTypeMapStep(
                    metadata_ref,
                    _VersionedResolveTypeMapConfig(
                        object_ids=ServerRefs.from_ref_id(endpoint_ids_ref, variant="scalar_sequence", type_hint=SysId),
                        candidate_models=versioned_node_models,
                        graph_id=None,
                        branch_id=_branch_id_from_compile_context(self._config.compile_context),
                        branch_ref_id=self._config.compile_context.branch_anchor_ref_id,
                        revision_id=(
                            self._config.compile_context.revision_literal
                            if isinstance(self._config.compile_context.revision_literal, RevisionId)
                            else None
                        ),
                        revision_ref_id=self._config.compile_context.revision_ref_id,
                        preferred_source=self._config.compile_context.predicted_source,
                    ),
                ),
            )
            if publication_gate is not None:
                steps[-1].require_publication_gate(publication_gate)
            source_names.append("metadata")
            source_refs.append(metadata_ref)
        steps.append(
            AutoApiGraphPayloadStep(
                self.ref_id,
                tuple(
                    AutoApiTerminalSourceRef(AutoApiTerminalSourceName(name), ref_id)
                    for name, ref_id in zip(source_names, source_refs, strict=True)
                ),
                kwargs=dict(self._config.literal_kwargs),
            ),
        )
        return steps

# comparing one copy of the old name with another.
_VALIDATION_REF = str(SESSION_VALIDATION_REF)
_VALIDATION_CTE_ALIAS = "__validated_session_row"


class _AlwaysPermittedScheme(SelfOwnershipScheme):
    """A scheme that is present and enforcing but whose policy admits everyone.

    Not a contrivance: a scheme that resolves to ``PERMISSION_TRUE`` for some
    action is how "this table is readable by anyone signed in" is spelled, and
    the compiler already recognises it -- ``compile_dml_permission_filter``
    returns no filter at all in that case.
    """

    def get_policy_expression(
        self: _AlwaysPermittedScheme,
        model_class: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
        *,
        action: str = "read",
    ) -> Expression[bool, Any]:
        del model_class, action
        return PERMISSION_TRUE()


@register_permissions(scheme_factory=lambda: _AlwaysPermittedScheme(owner_field="owner_id"))
@register_table(plural="always_permitted_ladder_rows", singular="always_permitted_ladder_row")
class _AlwaysPermittedRow(DatabaseObjectRow):
    owner_id: str = Field(default="")
    name: str = Field(default="")


def _always_permitted_query_spec() -> QuerySpec[Any]:
    """A read of the always-permitted table, with permissions left on."""
    return QuerySpec(
        model_cls=_AlwaysPermittedRow,
        table="always_permitted_ladder_rows",
        select_columns=None,
        distinct=False,
        joins=[],
        filters=[QueryFilter(expression=field(_AlwaysPermittedRow.name) == "widget")],
        order_by=[("name", SqlOrderDirection("ASC"))],
        limit=None,
        offset=None,
        group_by=[],
        aggregations=[],
        having=[],
        window_functions=[],
        permission_state=QueryPermissionState.AUTO,
    )


def _rls_sql(backend_type: BackendType, dialect: object) -> str:
    """Compile the RLS context step against a published validation CTE."""
    profile = make_backend_profile(backend_type, dialect=cast(Any, dialect))
    contract = SessionValidationStep(
        SESSION_VALIDATION_REF, SessionId(str(_TEST_SESSION_ID)),
    ).cte_publication_contract()
    ctx = make_compilation_context(
        profile,
        session_id=_TEST_SESSION_ID,
        cte_refs={
            _VALIDATION_REF: cte_ref(
                ServerPlanRefId(_VALIDATION_REF),
                columns=contract.columns,
                column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
                source_tables=contract.source_tables,
            )
        },
    )
    step = SetRlsContextStep(ServerPlanRefId("rls"), ServerPlanRefId(_VALIDATION_REF))

    compiled = step.compile(ctx)

    assert compiled.grammar is not None, f"{backend_type.name} compiled to nothing, so the assertion below proves nothing"
    sql, _params = render_to_sql(compiled.grammar, cast(Any, dialect))
    return sql


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("backend_type", "dialect"),
    [
        (BackendType.POSTGRES, PostgresDialect()),
        (BackendType.SQLITE, SqliteDialect()),
        (BackendType.MARIADB, MySQLDialect()),
    ],
    ids=["postgres", "sqlite", "mariadb"],
)
def test_the_rls_context_takes_its_user_from_the_row_already_read(
    backend_type: BackendType,
    dialect: object,
) -> None:
    """Setting the RLS user reads the validated row, not the table again.

    Postgres and SQLite always did: both render ``SELECT user_id FROM
    "__session_validation"``. The MySQL family used to render

        SET @nera_user_id = (SELECT `user_id` FROM `sys_sessions` WHERE `sys_id` = %s LIMIT 1)

    which asks the table for a column the same transaction read one statement
    earlier.

    It was not a missing reference but an unusable statement. The validated row
    reaches a statement as a CTE definition prepended to it, and ``SET @v = ...``
    is not a query, so MariaDB rejects the prefix outright -- verified against
    MariaDB 11, which answers ``ERROR 1064 ... near 'SET @b = (SELECT ...)'``.
    The fix is the sibling assignment form, ``SELECT <expr> INTO @nera_user_id``,
    which is a query and takes the prefix; see
    ``SqlMysqlSelectIntoUserIdRlsContext`` for why the value is wrapped as a
    scalar subquery rather than selected ``FROM`` the relation.

    Written as one parametrised contract rather than a MySQL-specific test so
    that the backends state the same target, and so that a change which breaks
    Postgres or SQLite is caught here rather than quietly redefining it.
    """
    sql = _rls_sql(backend_type, dialect)

    assert _VALIDATION_REF in sql, f"the validated row is not referenced at all: {sql}"
    assert "sys_sessions" not in sql, f"the session table is read again to set the RLS user: {sql}"


def test_a_policy_that_admits_everyone_needs_no_user_resolved() -> None:
    """A ``PERMISSION_TRUE`` policy resolves no user.

    Lowering decides whether to add ``SessionUserIdStep`` -- a statement of its
    own against ``sys_sessions`` -- from the model's scheme. Asking only whether
    a scheme exists and can filter is the weaker question: a scheme can be
    present, enforcing, and still admit everyone for this action, in which case
    the compiler drops the filter entirely and the resolved user is a round trip
    spent on a value no SQL mentions.

    The question is answerable at this point -- the scheme is in hand and the
    action is known -- which is what makes this a lowering fix rather than an
    optimizer one, unlike rung 2.
    """
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import QueryExecuteIntent, _QueryExecuteConfig
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

    intent = QueryExecuteIntent(
        ServerPlanRefId("always_permitted"),
        _AlwaysPermittedRow,
        _QueryExecuteConfig(query_spec=_always_permitted_query_spec()),
    )

    steps = intent.lower(
        LoweringContext(
            backend_type=BackendType.POSTGRES,
            dialect=PostgresDialect(),
            backend_profile=make_backend_profile(BackendType.POSTGRES),
            session_id=_TEST_SESSION_ID,
        ),
    )

    resolutions = [step for step in steps if isinstance(step, SessionUserIdStep)]
    assert resolutions == [], f"lowered a user resolution for a policy that admits everyone: {steps}"


def _session_ref() -> Any:
    """A reference to the session identifier, as lowering supplies one."""
    from l2070_batching.server_ref import ServerRefs

    return ServerRefs.scalar(SessionId(str(_TEST_SESSION_ID)))


def _compiled_sql(step: Any, ctx: Any) -> tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]:
    """Render a step's statement and the names of the CTEs it declares."""
    compiled = step.compile(ctx)
    assert compiled.grammar is not None, f"{type(step).__name__} compiled to nothing"
    sql, _params = render_to_sql(cast(SqlRenderable, compiled.grammar), cast(Any, SqliteDialect()))
    declared = tuple(str(name) for name, _query in (compiled.auxiliary_ctes or ()))
    return sql, declared


def _validated_row_ctx(*, in_scope: bool, with_definition: bool = True) -> Any:
    """A SQLite compilation context, optionally publishing the validated row.

    ``with_definition`` distinguishes the two ways a published relation arrives:
    carrying the query that must be added to this statement's ``WITH`` scope, or
    already in scope because the batch declared it once for every child.
    """
    contract = SessionValidationStep(
        SESSION_VALIDATION_REF, SessionId(str(_TEST_SESSION_ID)),
    ).cte_publication_contract()
    refs = (
        {
            _VALIDATION_REF: cte_ref(
                ServerPlanRefId(_VALIDATION_REF),
                columns=contract.columns,
                auxiliary_query=(
                    SqlExecutedRowsQuery(
                        columns=contract.columns, rows=[], type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
                    ) if with_definition else None
                ),
                column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
                source_tables=contract.source_tables,
            ),
        }
        if in_scope
        else {}
    )
    return make_compilation_context(
        make_backend_profile(BackendType.SQLITE, dialect=cast(Any, SqliteDialect())),
        session_id=_TEST_SESSION_ID,
        cte_refs=refs,
    )

def test_the_user_id_step_projects_the_validated_row_when_this_flush_published_it() -> None:
    """Given the validated relation, the step reads it instead of the table.

    This is the compile-time half of rung 2 in the round-trip ladder, which can
    only observe the statement that comes out of it. Both halves are needed: the
    count says a second read is gone, this says where the column came from
    instead, and a change that satisfied the count by dropping the filter would
    fail here.

    The relation's definition is declared as an auxiliary CTE, because a
    projection of a name no ``WITH`` clause defines is a SQL error. That
    declaration is the reason this branch is safe to take at all.
    """
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

    step = SessionUserIdStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("resolve_uid"),
        _session_ref(),
        session_validation_ref=ServerPlanRefId(_VALIDATION_REF),
    )

    sql, declared = _compiled_sql(step, _validated_row_ctx(in_scope=True))

    assert f'FROM "{_VALIDATION_CTE_ALIAS}"' in sql, f"the validated row is not what was read: {sql}"
    assert "sys_sessions" not in sql, f"the session table is read again for a column already in hand: {sql}"
    assert declared == (_VALIDATION_CTE_ALIAS,), f"the relation was named without being declared: {declared}"
    assert _VALIDATION_REF in step.dependencies(), "the step must wait for the relation it reads"


def test_the_user_id_step_reads_the_table_when_no_validated_row_is_in_scope() -> None:
    """Without the relation, the step is self-contained -- and must be.

    The fallback is not a leftover. A long transaction validates the session on
    its first flush and memoises that; later flushes emit no validation step, so
    the relation is not in scope in their statements. A step that named it anyway
    would fail with a SQL error rather than run slowly, which is why the optimizer
    only hands out the ref in the flush that publishes it.

    Both shapes of absence are covered, because they arrive from different
    places: no ref at all (this flush does not validate) and a ref whose relation
    the context does not carry (a compile-only or synthetic context).
    """
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

    without_ref = SessionUserIdStep(ServerPlanRefId("resolve_uid"), _session_ref())
    with_a_ref_nothing_published = SessionUserIdStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("resolve_uid"),
        _session_ref(),
        session_validation_ref=ServerPlanRefId(_VALIDATION_REF),
    )

    for step in (without_ref, with_a_ref_nothing_published):
        sql, declared = _compiled_sql(step, _validated_row_ctx(in_scope=False))

        assert 'FROM "sys_sessions"' in sql, f"the step must read the table when it cannot read the validated row: {sql}"
        assert _VALIDATION_REF not in sql, f"a relation nothing published was named: {sql}"
        assert declared == (), f"nothing should be declared for a self-contained lookup: {declared}"


def test_the_user_id_step_names_a_batch_scoped_relation_without_redeclaring_it() -> None:
    """A relation already in the statement's scope is referenced, not redefined.

    ``CteReference.auxiliary_query`` is ``None`` when the batch has declared the
    relation once for all its children. Declaring it again here would put a second
    definition of the same name in one ``WITH`` clause.
    """
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

    step = SessionUserIdStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("resolve_uid"),
        _session_ref(),
        session_validation_ref=ServerPlanRefId(_VALIDATION_REF),
    )

    sql, declared = _compiled_sql(step, _validated_row_ctx(in_scope=True, with_definition=False))

    assert f'FROM "{_VALIDATION_REF}"' in sql, sql
    assert declared == (), f"redeclared a relation the batch already defines: {declared}"

def test_session_context_executes_authentication_projection() -> None:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_context_resolution import LookupSessionContextStep
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_validation import _session_lookup_columns

    ctx = _validated_row_ctx(in_scope=True)
    ref = ctx.cte_refs[_VALIDATION_REF]
    auth_row = {
        "sys_id": str(_TEST_SESSION_ID),
        "session_type": "user",
        "sys_closed_at": None,
        "expires_at": None,
        "revoked_at": None,
        "user_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000101",
        "effective_user_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000101",
        "source": "api",
        "parent_session_id": None,
        "parent_closed_at": None,
        "parent_expires_at": None,
        "parent_user_id": None,
        "parent_source": None,
    }
    source = SqlExecutedRowsQuery(
        columns=ref.columns, rows=[auth_row], type_hints=ref.column_type_hints,
    )
    step = LookupSessionContextStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("session_context"), session_id=_session_ref(),
        session_validation_ref=SESSION_VALIDATION_REF,

    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    sql, params = SqlCte([(_VALIDATION_CTE_ALIAS, source)], compiled.grammar).render(
        SqliteDialect(),
    ).to_sql(SqliteDialect())
    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    try:
        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(sql, params).fetchall()]
    finally:
        connection.close()

def _optimize(steps: tuple[Any, ...], **ctx_overrides: Any) -> list[Any]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.optimizers.session_validation import SessionValidationOptimizer
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.tests.testkit import make_optimization_context

    ctx = make_optimization_context(
        make_backend_profile(BackendType.SQLITE, dialect=cast(Any, SqliteDialect())),
        session_id=SessionId(str(_TEST_SESSION_ID)),
        **ctx_overrides,
    )
    return list(SessionValidationOptimizer().optimize(steps, ctx))


def test_the_optimizer_re_sources_body_steps_in_the_flush_that_validates() -> None:
    """The ref is handed out by the one component that knows it is safe to.

    Lowering cannot do this: it runs before the optimizer decides whether the
    session will be validated in this flush, so a step re-sourced there could name
    a relation that never gets published. The optimizer decides and rewrites in the
    same pass, and the rewrite is a copy under the same ref -- same publication
    contract, same post-op -- so consumers are untouched.
    """
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

    optimized = _optimize((SessionUserIdStep(ServerPlanRefId("resolve_uid"), _session_ref()),))

    (resolve_uid,) = [step for step in optimized if isinstance(step, SessionUserIdStep)]
    assert _VALIDATION_REF in resolve_uid.dependencies(), (
        f"the body step was left reading the table in a flush that validates: {resolve_uid.dependencies()}"
    )
    sql, _declared = _compiled_sql(resolve_uid, _validated_row_ctx(in_scope=True))
    assert "sys_sessions" not in sql, sql


def test_the_optimizer_leaves_body_steps_alone_when_validation_is_already_satisfied() -> None:
    """A later flush publishes no relation, so its steps must not name one.

    The memo records that the session validated earlier in this transaction, which
    is exactly the case where the relation is *not* in scope: the preamble is not
    re-emitted, so there is no ``__session_validation`` in the statements this
    flush sends. Re-sourcing here would turn a saved round trip into a SQL error.
    """
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep
    from l2070_batching.optimizer import SqlPreambleMemo

    optimized = _optimize(
        (SessionUserIdStep(ServerPlanRefId("resolve_uid"), _session_ref()),),
        sql_preamble_memo=SqlPreambleMemo(frozenset({ServerPlanRefId(_VALIDATION_REF)})),
    )

    (resolve_uid,) = [step for step in optimized if isinstance(step, SessionUserIdStep)]
    assert _VALIDATION_REF not in resolve_uid.dependencies(), "the step waits for a relation this flush does not publish"
    sql, _declared = _compiled_sql(resolve_uid, _validated_row_ctx(in_scope=False))
    assert 'FROM "sys_sessions"' in sql, sql

def _ref_id(value: ServerPlanRefId | str) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    if isinstance(value, ServerPlanRefId):
        return value
    return ServerPlanRefId(value)


def _remember_query_prerender_info(
    stmt: SqlRenderable,
    *,
    query_spec: QuerySpec[Any] | None,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    mode: Literal["count", "exists"],
) -> SqlRenderable:
    if query_spec is None:
        return stmt
    from impl.common.l2155_query_prerender_cache import analyze_query_prerenderability
    from l1400_types.type_surface_contracts import (
        QueryPrerenderSeam,
        QueryPrerenderShapeKey,
    )
    from impl.common.l2200_sql_dialect.sql_connection import (
        AttributedSqlRenderable,
        QueryPrerenderInfo,
        QueryPrerenderShapeMetadata,
    )

    analysis = analyze_query_prerenderability(
        query_spec,
        mode=mode,
        dialect=ctx.sql_render_dialect(),
    )
    info = QueryPrerenderInfo.from_shape(
        QueryPrerenderShapeMetadata(
            exact_shape_key=QueryPrerenderShapeKey(analysis.exact_shape_key),
            family_shape_key=QueryPrerenderShapeKey(analysis.family_shape_key),
            mode=mode,
            seam=QueryPrerenderSeam("query_spec"),
        ),
        prerender_cache_hit=False,
        prerender_supported=analysis.is_prerenderable,
    )
    if isinstance(stmt, AttributedSqlRenderable):
        return AttributedSqlRenderable(inner=stmt.inner, prerender_info=info)
    return AttributedSqlRenderable(inner=stmt, prerender_info=info)


def _collect_query_scalar_deps(
    query_spec: QuerySpec[Any] | None,
    *,
    branch_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
) -> frozenset[str]:
    deps = {str(ref_id) for ref_id in after_refs}
    if branch_ref_id is not None:
        deps.add(str(branch_ref_id))
    if user_id_ref_id is not None:
        deps.add(str(user_id_ref_id))
    if query_spec is None:
        return frozenset(deps)
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._resolve import collect_query_spec_deps

    deps.update(collect_query_spec_deps(query_spec))
    return frozenset(deps)


def _strip_scalar_irrelevant_ordering(
    query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow]:
    if not getattr(query_spec, "order_by", None):
        return query_spec

    return replace(query_spec, order_by=[])


def _permission_user_auxiliary_ctes(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    user_id_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | None,
) -> list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None:
    if user_id_ref_id is None or ctx.cte_refs is None:
        return None
    from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference

    cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(user_id_ref_id))
    if not isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference) or cte_ref.auxiliary_query is None:
        return None
    return [(cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query)]


def _merge_auxiliary_ctes(
    *cte_groups: Sequence[CompiledAuxiliaryCteInput] | None,
) -> list[CompiledAuxiliaryCteInput] | None:
    merged: list[CompiledAuxiliaryCteInput] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for cte_group in cte_groups:
        if cte_group is None:
            continue
        for definition in cte_group:
            ref_id = definition[0] if isinstance(definition, tuple) else str(definition.name)
            if ref_id in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(ref_id)
            merged.append(definition)
    return merged or None

class QueryCountStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[int]):
    """Step for counting query results."""

    def can_join_session_preamble_statement_batch(self: QueryCountStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def __init__(
        self: QueryCountStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _QueryCountStepConfig,
    ) -> None:
        """Initialize QueryCountStep.

        Args:
            ref_id: Unique identifier for this step
            model_cls: The DatabaseObjectRow subclass to query
            query_spec: The QuerySpec object from the current system
            branch_ref_id: Optional ref to ResolveBranchForRevisionStep result
        """
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._query_spec = config.query_spec
        self._branch_ref_id = config.branch_ref_id
        self._user_id_ref_id = config.user_id_ref_id
        self._dependencies = _collect_query_scalar_deps(
            self._query_spec,
            branch_ref_id=self._branch_ref_id,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
            after_refs=config.after_refs,
        )
        self._resolved_branch_id: str | None = None
        self._resolved_user_id: ResolvedPermissionUserId = None

    @property
    def level(self: QueryCountStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self: QueryCountStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Return tags identifying this step type."""
        return frozenset({"read", "query", "count"})

    def is_read_only(self: QueryCountStep) -> bool:
        """Return True - this step only reads data."""
        return True

    def result_cardinality(self: QueryCountStep) -> Cardinality:
        """Return SCALAR - this step returns a single count value."""
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self: QueryCountStep) -> bool:
        """Declare that COUNT reduces row-valued filter dependencies."""
        return True

    def tables_read(self: QueryCountStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        """Return the table name this step reads from."""

        raw_routes.append((graph_id, member_kind))
    return [

            model_cls,
            event_type,
            ServerPlanRefId("write"),
            relation_contract=_exact_notification_relation_contract(model_cls),
            old_rows_ref=ServerPlanRefId("old") if event_type == "UPDATE" else None,

def _values_cte(
    name: str,
    rows: Sequence[tuple[str, str, str, str, str]],
) -> tuple[str, tuple[object, ...]]:
    placeholders = ", ".join("(?, ?, ?, ?, ?)" for _row in rows)
    return (
        f'"{name}" ("sys_id", "graph_sys_id", "label", "branch_id", "revision_id") AS (VALUES {placeholders})',
        tuple(value for row in rows for value in row),
    )


def _execute(
    step: _TransactionalTableNotificationStep,
    *,
    write_rows: Sequence[tuple[str, str, str, str, str]],
    old_rows: Sequence[tuple[str, str, str, str, str]] = (),
    rollback: bool = False,
    graph_sparse_rows: dict[str, tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]] | None = None,
) -> list[ChangeHintEnvelope]:
    compiled = step.compile(_context(include_old=bool(old_rows)))
    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    dialect = cast("SqlDialect", SqliteDialect())
    sql, params = compiled.grammar.render(dialect).to_sql(dialect)
    write_cte, write_params = _values_cte("write", write_rows)
    ctes = [write_cte]
    relation_params = list(write_params)
    if old_rows:
        old_cte, old_params = _values_cte("old", old_rows)
        ctes.append(old_cte)
        relation_params.extend(old_params)
    sqlite_params = tuple(value.isoformat() if isinstance(value, datetime) else value for value in params)
    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    connection.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE sys_notifications ("
        "sys_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, channel TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, publication_id TEXT, envelope_index INTEGER, envelope_count INTEGER)",
    )
    default_graph_rows = {
        graph_table: tuple((row[1], row[3]) for row in write_rows)
        for graph_table in (
            "phase5_publication_graphs",
            "phase5_primary_graphs",
            "phase5_secondary_graphs",
        )
    }
    default_graph_rows.update(graph_sparse_rows or {})
    for graph_table, graph_rows in default_graph_rows.items():
        connection.execute(
            f'CREATE TABLE "{graph_table}_sparse" ('
            "sys_id TEXT NOT NULL, branch_id TEXT NOT NULL, sys_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL, "
            "sys_valid_to_revision_id TEXT)",
        )
        connection.executemany(
            f'INSERT INTO "{graph_table}_sparse" (sys_id, branch_id, sys_deleted, sys_valid_to_revision_id) VALUES (?, ?, 0, NULL)',
            graph_rows,
        )
    connection.commit()
    connection.execute("BEGIN")
    connection.execute(f"WITH {', '.join(ctes)} {sql}", (*relation_params, *sqlite_params))
    if rollback:
        connection.rollback()
    else:
        connection.commit()
    envelopes: list[ChangeHintEnvelope] = []
    for (payload,) in connection.execute("SELECT payload FROM sys_notifications ORDER BY sys_id"):
        hint = parse_subscription_hint(str(payload))
        assert isinstance(hint, ChangeHintEnvelope)
        envelopes.append(hint)
    return envelopes

    return (
        str(SysId.new()),

        "visible",
        str(SysId.new()),
        str(SysId.new()),
    )

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("staged_indexes", "tombstone_indexes", "requested", "expected"),
    [([], [], 5, 0), ([0], [], 5, 1), ([], [1], 5, 1),
     ([0], [0], 5, 1), ([0, 1], [1, 2], 5, 3), ([0, 1], [1, 2], 2, 2)],
)
def test_delete_count_executes_identity_union(
    staged_indexes: list[int], tombstone_indexes: list[int], requested: int, expected: int,
) -> None:
    identities = [SysId.new().unwrap_to_str() for _ in range(3)]
    hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"}))
    staged = SqlExecutedRowsQuery(
        columns=("sys_id",), rows=[{"sys_id": identities[i]} for i in staged_indexes],
        type_hints=hints,
    )
    tombstones = SqlExecutedRowsQuery(
        columns=("sys_id",), rows=[{"sys_id": identities[i]} for i in tombstone_indexes],
        type_hints=hints,
    )
    ctx = _sqlite_ctx()
    ctx.cte_refs["staged"] = cte_ref(
        ServerPlanRefId("staged_rows"), columns=("sys_id",),
        column_type_hints=hints, auxiliary_query=staged,
    )
    ctx.cte_refs["tombstones"] = cte_ref(
        ServerPlanRefId("tombstone_rows"), columns=("sys_id",),
        column_type_hints=hints, auxiliary_query=tombstones,
    )
    step = _VersionedDeleteCountStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("count"), _VersionedDeleteCountConfig(
            staged_delete_ref=ServerPlanRefId("staged"),
            tombstone_ref=ServerPlanRefId("tombstones"), num_requested=requested,
        ),
    )
    compiled = step.compile(ctx)
    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    sql, params = SqlCte(
        [("staged_rows", staged), ("tombstone_rows", tombstones)], compiled.grammar,
    ).render(SqliteDialect()).to_sql(SqliteDialect())
    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    try:
        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        rows = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute(sql, params).fetchall()]
    finally:
        connection.close()
    assert compiled.closed_post_op is not None
    assert compiled.closed_post_op(rows, DictHydrator()) == expected

def test_tombstone_grammar_step_counts_returned_rows() -> None:
    """Tombstone inserts wrap RETURNING rows in a COUNT(*) aggregate column.

    The compiled grammar materializes the inserted row count as a single ``count``
    column (``SELECT COUNT(*) ... FROM <tombstone>_rows``), and the post-op reads
    that column rather than counting raw RETURNING rows in Python.
    """
    step = TombstoneGrammarStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("insert_tombstone"),
        stmt=SqlRawExpression("SELECT 1"),
        config=_TombstoneGrammarConfig(
            tombstone_sys_ids=(
                SysId("00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001"),
                SysId("00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002"),
            ),
            tip_table=SqlTableName("widgets_tip"),
            data_columns=("name",),
            lazy_branch=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchId.new()),
            staged_commit_id_raw=StagedCommitId("00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000003"),
            reads=frozenset({SqlTableName("widgets_tip")}),
            writes=frozenset({SqlTableName("widgets_staged")}),
        ),
    )

    compiled = step.compile(_ctx())
    assert compiled.needs_returning is True
    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    sql, _params = compiled.grammar.render(PostgresDialect()).to_sql(PostgresDialect())
    assert "COUNT(*)" in sql.upper()
    assert "insert_tombstone_rows" in sql
    assert compiled.closed_post_op is not None
    assert compiled.closed_post_op([{"count": 2}], _identity_hydrator) == 2

        ServerPlanRefId("gated_tombstone"),

    *,
    model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    backend_capabilities: set[BackendCapability] | frozenset[BackendCapability],
) -> ExecutableSearchCapabilities:
    supports_native_fts = get_fts_config(model) is not None and BackendCapability.FULL_TEXT_SEARCH in backend_capabilities
    supports_vector_provider = bool(get_vector_indexes(model)) and BackendCapability.VECTOR_INDEX in backend_capabilities
    supports_hybrid_provider = supports_native_fts and supports_vector_provider
    cursor_terminals: list[SearchLoweringTerminal] = []
    if supports_native_fts:
        cursor_terminals.append("native_fts")
    if supports_vector_provider:
        cursor_terminals.append("provider_vector")
    if supports_hybrid_provider:
        cursor_terminals.append("provider_hybrid")
    return ExecutableSearchCapabilities(
        supports_fts=supports_native_fts,
        supports_vector=supports_vector_provider,
        supports_hybrid=supports_hybrid_provider,
        supports_search_cursor=bool(cursor_terminals),
        cursor_terminals=tuple(cursor_terminals),
    )


# search-architecture-adapter: forbid-non-planner-terminal-selection codemod=single-lowerer delete-target=plan_search_lowering owns search terminal selection
def plan_search_lowering(
    *,
    query_spec: QuerySpec[object],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    is_versioned: bool,
    projection: SearchLoweringProjection,
) -> SearchLoweringStrategy:
    semantic_plan = query_spec.canonical_plan(with_meta=projection == "with_meta")
    storage: SearchLoweringStorage = "versioned" if is_versioned else "unversioned"
    if semantic_plan.search.mode == "none":
        terminal: SearchLoweringTerminal = "none"
    elif semantic_plan.search.mode == "fts_only":
        terminal = "native_fts" if is_versioned or ctx.has_native_fts else "polyfill_fts"
    elif semantic_plan.search.mode == "vector_only":
        terminal = "provider_vector"
    elif semantic_plan.search.mode == "hybrid":
        terminal = "provider_hybrid"
    else:
        msg = "fts_search() + vector_search() requires with_rrf() to combine results. Use .with_rrf() to enable Reciprocal Rank Fusion."
        raise ValueError(msg)
    supports_cursor_key = bool(semantic_plan.page.cursor_key) or semantic_plan.search.is_search
    if terminal == "polyfill_fts" and semantic_plan.page.mode == "cursor":
        supports_cursor_key = False
    return SearchLoweringStrategy(
        storage=storage,
        terminal=terminal,
        projection=projection,
        uses_native_search_score=terminal != "none",
        supports_cursor_key=supports_cursor_key,
        supports_invalidation_dependencies=bool(semantic_plan.live.dependency_tables) or semantic_plan.search.is_search,
    )


# search-architecture-adapter: forbid-non-planner-terminal-selection codemod=single-lowerer delete-target=provider_search_mode_for_strategy maps planner strategy to provider mode
def provider_search_mode_for_strategy(strategy: SearchLoweringStrategy) -> SearchProviderMode:
    if strategy.terminal == "provider_vector":
        return "vector_only"
    if strategy.terminal == "provider_hybrid":
        return "hybrid"
    msg = f"Provider search payload lowering does not support {strategy.terminal!r}"
    raise ValueError(msg)


# search-architecture-adapter: forbid-non-planner-terminal-selection codemod=single-lowerer delete-target=provider_for_search_lowering maps planner strategy to provider
def provider_for_search_lowering(
    *,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    strategy: SearchLoweringStrategy,
) -> Any:
    providers = ctx.backend_profile.providers
    if strategy.terminal == "provider_vector":
        return providers.vector_candidate_provider
    if strategy.terminal == "provider_hybrid":
        return providers.hybrid_search_provider
    msg = f"Provider search lowering does not support {strategy.terminal!r}"
    raise ValueError(msg)


# search-architecture-adapter: forbid-non-planner-terminal-selection codemod=single-lowerer delete-target=provider_for_search_mode provider-mode facade
def provider_for_search_mode(
    *,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    search_mode: SearchProviderMode,
    is_versioned: bool,
    projection: SearchLoweringProjection = "with_meta",
) -> Any:
    terminal: SearchLoweringTerminal = "provider_vector" if search_mode == "vector_only" else "provider_hybrid"
    return provider_for_search_lowering(
        ctx=ctx,
        strategy=SearchLoweringStrategy(
            storage="versioned" if is_versioned else "unversioned",
            terminal=terminal,
            projection=projection,
            uses_native_search_score=True,
            supports_cursor_key=True,
            supports_invalidation_dependencies=True,
        ),
    )


def lower_unversioned_fts_search(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: QuerySpec[object],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    session_id: SessionId | None,
    projection: Literal["results", "with_meta"],
    raw_mode: bool,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[object]]:
    """Lower unversioned FTS through the shared FTS route planner."""
    semantic_plan = canonical_query_plan_from_query_spec(
        query_spec,
        with_meta=projection == "with_meta",
        raw_rows=raw_mode,
    )
    if semantic_plan.search.mode != "fts_only":
        msg = f"lower_unversioned_fts_search expected fts_only search, got {semantic_plan.search.mode!r}"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if not ctx.has_native_fts and semantic_plan.page.mode == "cursor":
        msg = "FTS cursor pagination requires native FTS support; polyfill FTS only supports offset/limit pages"
        raise NotImplementedError(msg)
    fts_query = semantic_plan.search.fts_query
    if fts_query is None:
        msg = "FTS lowering requires a search query"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    fts_fields = semantic_plan.search.fts_fields
    mode = semantic_plan.search.fts_mode or FTSSearchMode.NATURAL
    return RouteFtsSearchIntent.build(
        ref_id,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        config=_RouteFtsSearchConfig(
            query_source=ServerRefs.scalar(FtsQueryText(fts_query)),
            literal_query_text=fts_query,
            literal_sqlite_fts_query=_build_fts5_query(
                fts_query,
                list(fts_fields),
                mode,
            ),
            field_names=fts_fields,
            mode=mode,
            query_inputs=_normalize_versioned_fts_query_inputs(query_spec),
            limit=semantic_plan.page.limit,
            offset=semantic_plan.page.offset,
            session_id=session_id,
            projection="with_meta" if projection == "with_meta" else "results",
            raw_mode=raw_mode,
            defer_large_columns=semantic_plan.result_shape.defer_large_columns,
        ),
    ).lower(ctx)


def lower_versioned_fts_search(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: QuerySpec[object],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    projection: SearchLoweringProjection,
    raw_mode: bool,
    should_hydrate_payload: bool,
    build_projection_step: _SearchPayloadProjectionFactory | None = None,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[object]]:
    """Lower versioned FTS through the shared FTS search intent.

    The storage-specific split is kept here so query execution intents do not
    carry independent versioned FTS branches.
    """
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._query_intent_shared import ctx_revision_id
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_fts_search import (
        VersionedFtsSearchIntent,
        VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep,
        _build_search_payload_results_steps,
        _build_versioned_fts_session_user_resolution,
        reject_unsupported_mariadb_staged_native_fts,
        _VersionedFtsPayloadConfig,
        _VersionedFtsSearchConfig,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import _coerce_optional_session_id
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query_extended import (
        _append_search_payload_projection_steps,
    )

    reject_unsupported_mariadb_staged_native_fts(ctx)
    strategy = plan_search_lowering(
        query_spec=query_spec,
        ctx=ctx,
        is_versioned=True,
        projection=projection,
    )
    if strategy.terminal != "native_fts":
        msg = f"Versioned FTS expected native_fts terminal strategy, got {strategy.terminal!r}"
        raise ValueError(msg)

    semantic_plan = canonical_query_plan_from_query_spec(
        query_spec,
        with_meta=projection == "with_meta",
        raw_rows=raw_mode,
    )
    fts_query = semantic_plan.search.fts_query
    fts_fields = semantic_plan.search.fts_fields
    fts_mode = semantic_plan.search.fts_mode or FTSSearchMode.NATURAL
    if fts_query is None or not fts_fields:
        msg = "Versioned FTS lowering requires fts_query and fts_fields"
        raise ValueError(msg)

    revision_id = ctx_revision_id(ctx)
    if revision_id is None and ctx.lazy_revision is not None and ctx.lazy_revision.ref_id is not None:
        from l2070_batching.seeded_constants import read_seeded_constant_from_ctx

        found_revision, seeded_revision = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(
            ctx,
            ServerPlanRefId(ctx.lazy_revision.ref_id),
        )
        if found_revision:
            if isinstance(seeded_revision, RevisionId):
                revision_id = seeded_revision
            elif hasattr(seeded_revision, "unwrap_to_str"):
                revision_id = RevisionId(str(seeded_revision.unwrap_to_str()))
    revision_source = revision_id if revision_id is not None else ctx.lazy_revision
    session_id = _coerce_optional_session_id(ctx.session_id)
    if revision_source is None:
        return list(
            VersionedFtsSearchIntent.build(
                ref_id,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                config=_VersionedFtsSearchConfig(
                    query_source=ServerRefs.scalar(FtsQueryText(fts_query)),
                    literal_query_text=fts_query,
                    literal_sqlite_fts_query=_build_fts5_query(
                        fts_query,
                        list(fts_fields),
                        fts_mode,
                    ),
                    field_names=tuple(fts_fields),
                    mode=fts_mode,
                    query_inputs=_normalize_versioned_fts_query_inputs(query_spec),
                    explicit_revision_selection=False,
                    requested_revision_ids=(),
                    requested_revision_ref_ids=(),
                    first_requested_revision_source=None,
                    limit=semantic_plan.page.limit,
                    offset=semantic_plan.page.offset,
                    session_id=session_id,
                    raw_mode=raw_mode,
                    defer_large_columns=semantic_plan.result_shape.defer_large_columns,
                    projection=projection,
                ),
            ).lower(ctx),
        )

    raw_payload_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_payload_raw")
    payload_ref = raw_payload_ref
    steps: list[ServerPlanStep[object]] = []
    session_user_steps, user_id_ref_id = _build_versioned_fts_session_user_resolution(
        owner_ref_id=raw_payload_ref,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        ctx=ctx,
    )
    steps.extend(session_user_steps)
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_fts_branch_input import (
        versioned_fts_branch_input,
    )

    branch_input = versioned_fts_branch_input(
        ctx=ctx,
        resolution_ref=ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_resolve_branch"),
        revision_source=ServerRefs.scalar(revision_source),
    )
    if branch_input.resolution_step is not None:
        steps.append(branch_input.resolution_step)
    steps.append(
        VersionedFtsSearchPayloadStep(
            raw_payload_ref,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            config=_VersionedFtsPayloadConfig(
                query_source=ServerRefs.scalar(FtsQueryText(fts_query)),
                literal_query_text=fts_query,
                literal_sqlite_fts_query=_build_fts5_query(
                    fts_query,
                    list(fts_fields),
                    fts_mode,
                ),
                field_names=tuple(fts_fields),
                mode=fts_mode,
                query_inputs=_normalize_versioned_fts_query_inputs(query_spec),
                limit=semantic_plan.page.limit,
                offset=semantic_plan.page.offset,
                requested_revision_ids=((revision_id,) if revision_id is not None else ()),
                revision_ref_ids=(
                    (ServerPlanRefId(ctx.lazy_revision.ref_id),)
                    if revision_id is None and ctx.lazy_revision is not None and ctx.lazy_revision.ref_id is not None
                    else ()
                ),
                raw_mode=should_hydrate_payload,
                defer_large_columns=semantic_plan.result_shape.defer_large_columns,
                session_id=session_id,
                user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                branch_id=(branch_input.branch_id.unwrap_to_str() if branch_input.branch_id is not None else None),
                branch_ref_id=branch_input.branch_ref_id,
            ),
        ),
    )
    if projection == "with_meta":
        if build_projection_step is None:
            msg = "Versioned FTS with_meta lowering requires a projection step factory"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        steps.extend(
            _append_search_payload_projection_steps(
                ref_id=ref_id,
                payload_ref=payload_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
                should_hydrate_payload=should_hydrate_payload,
                build_projection_step=build_projection_step,
            ),
        )
    else:
        steps.extend(
            _build_search_payload_results_steps(
                ref_id=ref_id,
                payload_ref=payload_ref,
                model_cls=model_cls,
            ),
        )
    return steps


def lower_search_query(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: QuerySpec[object],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    is_versioned: bool,
    projection: SearchLoweringProjection,
    raw_mode: bool,
    session_id: SessionId | None,
    should_hydrate_payload: bool,
    build_projection_step: _SearchPayloadProjectionFactory | None = None,
) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[object]]:
    """Shared dispatch point for canonical search lowering."""
    strategy = plan_search_lowering(
        query_spec=query_spec,
        ctx=ctx,
        is_versioned=is_versioned,
        projection=projection,
    )
    if strategy.terminal == "native_fts" and is_versioned:
        return lower_versioned_fts_search(
            ref_id=ref_id,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            query_spec=query_spec,
            ctx=ctx,
            projection=projection,
            raw_mode=raw_mode,
            should_hydrate_payload=should_hydrate_payload,
            build_projection_step=build_projection_step,
        )
    if strategy.terminal in {"native_fts", "polyfill_fts"} and not is_versioned:
        return lower_unversioned_fts_search(
            ref_id=ref_id,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            query_spec=query_spec,
            ctx=ctx,
            session_id=session_id,
            projection=projection,
            raw_mode=raw_mode,
        )
    if strategy.terminal in {"provider_vector", "provider_hybrid"}:
        if build_projection_step is None:
            msg = f"{strategy.terminal} lowering requires a projection step factory"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return lower_provider_search_payload(
            ref_id=ref_id,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            query_spec=query_spec,
            ctx=ctx,
            is_versioned=is_versioned,
            projection=projection,
            build_projection_step=build_projection_step,
        )
    msg = f"Query is not a searchable canonical query: {strategy.terminal!r}"
    raise ValueError(msg)


# search-architecture-adapter: forbid-non-planner-terminal-selection codemod=single-lowerer delete-target=lower_provider_search_payload lowers planned provider payloads
def lower_provider_search_payload(
    *,
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    query_spec: QuerySpec[object],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    is_versioned: bool,
    projection: SearchLoweringProjection,
    build_projection_step: _SearchPayloadProjectionFactory,
) -> list[ServerPlanStep[object]]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query_extended import (
        _lower_query_execute_search_payload_via_provider,
    )

    strategy = plan_search_lowering(
        query_spec=query_spec,
        ctx=ctx,
        is_versioned=is_versioned,
        projection=projection,
    )
    return _lower_query_execute_search_payload_via_provider(
        ref_id=ref_id,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        query_spec=query_spec,
        ctx=ctx,
        search_mode=provider_search_mode_for_strategy(strategy),
        is_versioned=is_versioned,
        build_projection_step=build_projection_step,
    )

"""DiffBytesIntent — L4 intent for computing blob diffs between revisions.

Approach C (interim): fetches both blob revisions via VersionedReadSelectOneStep,
then computes the diff in Python post_op. Fast-paths when blobs are identical.

See https://github.com/neralabs/nera-data-layer/issues/1769 for the planned
pure-SQL approach with content-defined chunking.
"""

class _BlobDiffProjectionRow(BaseModel):
    from_blob: bytes | None
    to_blob: bytes | None
    from_revision_id: RevisionId
    to_revision_id: RevisionId


def _post_process_compute_blob_diff_row(
    raw_result: RawResult,
    block_size: int,
) -> BlobDiff:
    from l7250_versioned_operations.diff_types import BlobDiff as BlobDiffType
    from impl.common.l2500_binary_diff.calculator import DiffCalculator

    if not raw_result:
        msg = "ComputeBlobDiffStep expected one SQL-visible blob diff projection row."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    row = dict(raw_result[0])
    from_blob = _normalize_blob_value(row.get("from_blob"))
    to_blob = _normalize_blob_value(row.get("to_blob"))
    from_hash = hashlib.sha256(from_blob).hexdigest()
    to_hash = hashlib.sha256(to_blob).hexdigest()

    def _resolve_revision(column: str) -> RevisionId:
        value = row.get(column)
        if value is None:
            msg = f"ComputeBlobDiffStep missing SQL-projected revision column {column!r}"
            raise RuntimeError(msg)
        return RevisionId(str(value))

    from_rev = _resolve_revision("from_revision_id")
    to_rev = _resolve_revision("to_revision_id")

    if from_hash == to_hash:
        return BlobDiffType(
            from_revision_id=from_rev,
            to_revision_id=to_rev,
            from_size=len(from_blob),
            to_size=len(to_blob),
            from_hash=from_hash,
            to_hash=to_hash,
            chunks=[],
        )

    calculator = DiffCalculator(block_size=block_size)
    chunks = calculator.calculate_diff(from_blob, to_blob)
    return BlobDiffType(
        from_revision_id=from_rev,
        to_revision_id=to_rev,
        from_size=len(from_blob),
        to_size=len(to_blob),
        from_hash=from_hash,
        to_hash=to_hash,
        chunks=chunks,
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _BlobDiffRowMaterializer:
    block_size: int

    def materialize(self: _BlobDiffRowMaterializer, raw: RawResult, hydrator: Hydrator[object]) -> object:
        del hydrator
        return _post_process_compute_blob_diff_row(raw, self.block_size)


def _blob_diff_post_op(*, block_size: int) -> CompiledPostOp:
    return CompiledPostOp.materialize(
        ResultMaterializationSpec(
            behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_OBJECT,
            blob_diff_block_size=block_size,
        ),
    )


_SQL_DOT = SqlFragment.static(".")
_SQL_AS = SqlFragment.static(" AS ")
_SQL_COMMA = SqlFragment.static(", ")
_SQL_FROM_BASE = SqlFragment.static(" FROM (SELECT 1) AS ")
_SQL_LEFT_JOIN = SqlFragment.static(" LEFT JOIN ")
_SQL_ON_TRUE = SqlFragment.static(" ON 1=1")
_SQL_LIMIT_1 = SqlFragment.static(" LIMIT 1")


class _BlobDiffProjectionQuery(SqlRenderable):
    """Project two SQL-visible blob rows and revision literals into one result row."""

    __slots__ = (
        "_column",
        "_from_cte",
        "_from_revision_id",
        "_to_cte",
        "_to_revision_id",
    )

    def __init__(
        self: _BlobDiffProjectionQuery,
        *,
        from_cte: str,
        to_cte: str,
        column: str,
        from_revision_id: RevisionId,
        to_revision_id: RevisionId,
    ) -> None:
        self._from_cte = from_cte
        self._to_cte = to_cte
        self._column = column
        self._from_revision_id = from_revision_id
        self._to_revision_id = to_revision_id

    def render(self: _BlobDiffProjectionQuery, dialect: SqlDialect) -> SqlFragment:
        from_alias = SqlAliasName("from_row")
        to_alias = SqlAliasName("to_row")
        return (
            SQL_SELECT
            + self._qualified_column(from_alias, "from_blob", dialect)
            + _SQL_COMMA
            + self._qualified_column(to_alias, "to_blob", dialect)
            + _SQL_COMMA
            + SqlParam(str(self._from_revision_id)).render(dialect)
            + _SQL_AS
            + SqlQuotedIdentifier("from_revision_id").render(dialect)
            + _SQL_COMMA
            + SqlParam(str(self._to_revision_id)).render(dialect)
            + _SQL_AS
            + SqlQuotedIdentifier("to_revision_id").render(dialect)
            + _SQL_FROM_BASE
            + SqlQuotedIdentifier("__base").render(dialect)
            + _SQL_LEFT_JOIN
            + SqlQuotedIdentifier(self._from_cte).render(dialect)
            + _SQL_AS
            + SqlQuotedIdentifier(from_alias).render(dialect)
            + _SQL_ON_TRUE
            + _SQL_LEFT_JOIN
            + SqlQuotedIdentifier(self._to_cte).render(dialect)
            + _SQL_AS
            + SqlQuotedIdentifier(to_alias).render(dialect)
            + _SQL_ON_TRUE
            + _SQL_LIMIT_1
        )

    def _qualified_column(
        self: _BlobDiffProjectionQuery,
        alias: SqlAliasName,
        output_name: str,
        dialect: SqlDialect,
    ) -> SqlFragment:
        return (
            SqlQuotedIdentifier(alias).render(dialect)
            + _SQL_DOT
            + SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlColumnName(self._column)).render(dialect)
            + _SQL_AS
            + SqlQuotedIdentifier(output_name).render(dialect)
        )


def _require_cte_ref(ctx: CompilationContext, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId) -> CteReference:
    cte_ref = ctx.cte_refs.get(str(ref_id))
    if not isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference):
        msg = f"{ref_id!s} must be SQL-visible before blob diff projection."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return cte_ref


def _require_seeded_revision(ctx: CompilationContext, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId) -> RevisionId:
    found, value = read_seeded_constant_from_ctx(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(ref_id))
    if not found:
        msg = f"Blob diff revision ref {ref_id!s} must be a seeded SQL projection value."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    return value if isinstance(value, RevisionId) else RevisionId(str(value))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _BlobDiffConfigPayload:
    column: str
    from_revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId]
    to_revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId] | None
    default_to_revision_id: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId]
    block_size: int
    type_ids: tuple[str, ...] | None


def _shape_blob_diff_config_payload(

class DiffBytesIntent(IntentStep["BlobDiff"]):
    """L4: Compute blob diff between two revisions.

    Lowers to two VersionedReadSelectOneSteps (one per revision) plus a
    ComputeBlobDiffStep that reads the resolved objects and computes the diff.
    """

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "diff", "intent"})
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(
        self: DiffBytesIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        sparse_model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        sys_id: ScalarServerRef[SysId],
        config: _BlobDiffConfigPayload,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._domain = domain
        self._sparse_model_cls = sparse_model_cls
        self._sys_id = sys_id
        self._config = config

    def lower(self: DiffBytesIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlTableName
        from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_spec import QueryPermissionState
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.resolve_branch_steps import (
            ResolveBranchForRevisionStep,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_select_one import (
            VersionedReadSelectOneRawStep,
            _VersionedReadSelectOneConfig,
            build_versioned_select_one_query_spec,
            lower_versioned_spill_aware_select_one_steps,
        )

        steps: list[ServerPlanStep[Any]] = []
        config = self._config
        to_revision_id = _effective_to_revision_id(config)
        sv = self._sys_id
        sparse_table_name = get_table_name(self._sparse_model_cls)
        branch_table = get_table_name(self._domain.branch_model)

        # Step 1: Resolve branch for from_revision
        from_resolve_ref = self.ref_id + "_from_resolve"
        steps.append(
            ResolveBranchForRevisionStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(from_resolve_ref),
                config.from_revision_id,
                branch_table,
            ),
        )

        # Step 2: Select object at from_revision
        from_select_ref = self.ref_id + "_from_select"
        query_spec = build_versioned_select_one_query_spec(
            self._model_cls,
            sys_id=self._sys_id,
            permission_state_override=QueryPermissionState.BYPASS,
        )
        steps.extend(
            lower_versioned_spill_aware_select_one_steps(
                ctx=ctx,
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(from_select_ref),
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                query_spec=query_spec,
                raw_step=VersionedReadSelectOneRawStep(
                    ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{from_select_ref}.raw"),
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    sys_id=sv,
                    config=_VersionedReadSelectOneConfig(
                        sparse_table_name=sparse_table_name,
                        branch_ref_id=from_resolve_ref,
                        revision_ref=config.from_revision_id,
                        type_ids=(None if config.type_ids is None else tuple(config.type_ids)),
                        permission_bypass=True,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        # Step 3: Resolve branch for to_revision
        to_resolve_ref = self.ref_id + "_to_resolve"
        steps.append(
            ResolveBranchForRevisionStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(to_resolve_ref),
                to_revision_id,
                branch_table,
            ),
        )

        # Step 4: Select object at to_revision
        to_select_ref = self.ref_id + "_to_select"
        query_spec = build_versioned_select_one_query_spec(
            self._model_cls,
            sys_id=self._sys_id,
            permission_state_override=QueryPermissionState.BYPASS,
        )
        steps.extend(
            lower_versioned_spill_aware_select_one_steps(
                ctx=ctx,
                ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(to_select_ref),
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
                query_spec=query_spec,
                raw_step=VersionedReadSelectOneRawStep(
                    ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{to_select_ref}.raw"),
                    model_cls=self._model_cls,
                    sys_id=sv,
                    config=_VersionedReadSelectOneConfig(
                        sparse_table_name=sparse_table_name,
                        branch_ref_id=to_resolve_ref,
                        revision_ref=to_revision_id,
                        type_ids=(None if config.type_ids is None else tuple(config.type_ids)),
                        permission_bypass=True,
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        # Step 5: Compute diff from resolved objects
        steps.append(
            ComputeBlobDiffStep(
                self.ref_id,
                config=config,
                from_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{from_select_ref}.raw_rows"),
                to_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(f"{to_select_ref}.raw_rows"),
            ),
        )

        return steps

class ComputeBlobDiffStep(NonPublishingStep["BlobDiff"]):
    """L0: Compute blob diff from two already-fetched objects.

    Terminal domain materializer over SQL-selected blob rows. Fast-paths when
    content is identical.
    """

    def __init__(
        self: ComputeBlobDiffStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        config: _BlobDiffConfigPayload,
        from_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        to_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._config = config
        self._column = config.column
        self._from_ref_id = from_ref_id
        self._to_ref_id = to_ref_id
        self._block_size = config.block_size
        self._from_blob: bytes = b""
        self._to_blob: bytes = b""

    @property
    def level(self: ComputeBlobDiffStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: ComputeBlobDiffStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self: ComputeBlobDiffStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: ComputeBlobDiffStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def step_tags(self: ComputeBlobDiffStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read"})

    def tables_read(self: ComputeBlobDiffStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: ComputeBlobDiffStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: ComputeBlobDiffStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        to_revision_ref = _effective_to_revision_id(self._config)
        return frozenset(
            {
                self._from_ref_id,
                self._to_ref_id,
                *self._config.from_revision_id.dependencies(),
                *to_revision_ref.dependencies(),
            },
        )

    def _blob_diff_result_contract(self: ComputeBlobDiffStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("from_blob", "to_blob", "from_revision_id", "to_revision_id")
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(
                bytea_columns=frozenset({"from_blob", "to_blob"}),
                uuid_columns=frozenset({"from_revision_id", "to_revision_id"}),
            ),
            model_cls=_BlobDiffProjectionRow,
        )

    def compile(self: ComputeBlobDiffStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[BlobDiff]:
        from_revision_ref = self._config.from_revision_id
        to_revision_ref = _effective_to_revision_id(self._config)
        from_revision_ref_id = from_revision_ref.ref_id
        to_revision_ref_id = to_revision_ref.ref_id
        assert from_revision_ref_id is not None
        assert to_revision_ref_id is not None
        from_cte = _require_cte_ref(ctx, self._from_ref_id)
        to_cte = _require_cte_ref(ctx, self._to_ref_id)
        auxiliary_ctes = [
            (cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query) for cte_ref in (from_cte, to_cte) if cte_ref.auxiliary_query is not None
        ]
        __opa002_grammar_447 = _BlobDiffProjectionQuery(
            from_cte=from_cte.ref_id,
            to_cte=to_cte.ref_id,
            column=self._column,
            from_revision_id=_require_seeded_revision(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(from_revision_ref_id)),
            to_revision_id=_require_seeded_revision(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(to_revision_ref_id)),
        )
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self._blob_diff_result_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_447,
            needs_returning=True,
            auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes or None,
            closed_post_op=_blob_diff_post_op(block_size=self._block_size),
        )


def _normalize_blob_value(blob_value: object) -> bytes:
    """Normalize a SQL-projected blob value to bytes.

    Accepts canonical hydrated ``bytes`` (and buffer API types), PostgreSQL-style
    ``\\x`` hex text via ``normalize_sql_binary_value``, and base64 ``str`` used
    by Neo4j blob transport. Other string shapes are rejected so diff math never
    treats pointer text or arbitrary Unicode as blob content.
    """

    from impl.common.l2400_blob_serialization.blob_serialization import normalize_sql_binary_value

    if blob_value is None:
        return b""
    if isinstance(blob_value, (bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
        return bytes(blob_value)
    normalized = normalize_sql_binary_value(blob_value)
    if isinstance(normalized, bytes):
        return normalized
    if isinstance(blob_value, str):
        try:
            return base64.b64decode(blob_value, validate=True)
        except (ValueError, binascii.Error):
            pass
    msg = f"blob diff projection expected bytes (or supported SQL/Neo4j encoding); got {type(blob_value).__name__}"
    raise TypeError(msg)

        column_type_hints=compiled.column_type_hints.filtered(set(actual_columns)),
    )

    violations = check_compiled_step_contract(step, compiled)

def test_projected_query_contract_includes_graph_filter_support_columns() -> None:
    """Filter predicate columns are materialized in the compiled CTE output, so the
    publication contract must cover them even when they are framework/graph columns
    (``graph_sys_id``) rather than part of the selected projection.

    Regression: a natural-key existence read (``graph_sys_id`` + ``cache_key``)
    projected to ``sys_id`` inside a data-modifying plan tripped the publication
    invariant because the contract omitted ``graph_sys_id``.
    """
    step = _graph_scoped_projection_step(_graph_scoped_projection_spec())

    contract = step.cte_publication_contract()

    assert contract is not None
    assert "sys_id" in contract.columns
    assert "graph_sys_id" in contract.columns
    assert "cache_key" in contract.columns


def test_projected_query_contract_survives_filter_lowering_mutation() -> None:
    """Later lowering passes can rewrite a server-ref-bound ``graph_sys_id``
    predicate out of ``query_spec.filters`` (e.g. into a staged overlay join)
    while the compiled CTE output still materializes the column.

    Regression: the contract was re-derived from the mutated spec at
    publication time and dropped ``graph_sys_id``, violating the
    data-modifying CTE publication invariant. The construction-time snapshot
    must keep the contract covering the compiled output shape.
    """
    spec = _graph_scoped_projection_spec()
    step = _graph_scoped_projection_step(spec)

    # Simulate the lowering pass: the graph predicate is rewritten out of the
    # live filter list after step construction (QuerySpec is frozen, but the
    # filter list itself is mutated in place by lowering).
    spec.filters[:] = [query_filter for query_filter in spec.filters if getattr(query_filter, "expression", None) is None]

    contract = step.cte_publication_contract()

    assert contract is not None
    assert "graph_sys_id" in contract.columns

class _EmitSysIdLiteralStep(ServerPlanStep[SysId]):
    def __init__(self, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId | str, *, value: SysId) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._value = value

    @property
    def level(self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"literal", "scalar", "sql"})

    def tables_read(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def cte_publication_contract(self: _EmitSysIdLiteralStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("sys_id",)
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"}))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.literal_mapping(
                columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            ),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[SysId]:
        del ctx
        compiled = compile_scalar_literal("sys_id", self._value.unwrap_to_str())
        value = self._value
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )

        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=compiled.grammar,
            needs_returning=compiled.needs_returning,
            closed_post_op=literal_post_op(value),
        )

_MODEL_DB_COLUMNS_CACHE_NAME = "grammar_bridge_model_db_columns"
_MODEL_SCHEME_INFO_CACHE_NAME = "grammar_bridge_model_scheme_info"
_CACHE_CREATION_LOCK = Lock()


def _get_model_db_columns_cache() -> WeakLocalMetadataCache[type[object], tuple[str, ...]]:
    manager = get_cache_manager()
    try:
        cache = manager.get_cache(_MODEL_DB_COLUMNS_CACHE_NAME)
    except KeyError:
        pass
    else:
        if isinstance(cache, WeakLocalMetadataCache):
            return cast(WeakLocalMetadataCache[type[object], tuple[str, ...]], cache)

    with _CACHE_CREATION_LOCK:
        manager = get_cache_manager()
        try:
            cache = manager.get_cache(_MODEL_DB_COLUMNS_CACHE_NAME)
        except KeyError:
            WeakLocalMetadataCache[type[object], tuple[str, ...]](
                name=_MODEL_DB_COLUMNS_CACHE_NAME,
                invalidation_policy=LocalMetadataInvalidationPolicy.SCHEMA_GENERATION,
            )
            cache = get_cache_manager().get_cache(_MODEL_DB_COLUMNS_CACHE_NAME)
    assert isinstance(cache, WeakLocalMetadataCache)
    return cast(WeakLocalMetadataCache[type[object], tuple[str, ...]], cache)
