def _iter_slots(value: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    slots = getattr(type(value), "__slots__", ())
    if isinstance(slots, str):
        return (slots,)
    if isinstance(slots, tuple):
        return slots
    return tuple(slots)


def _collect_table_names(value: object, seen: set[int], tables: set[str]) -> None:
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (bytes, int, float, bool)):
        return
    if isinstance(value, SqlTableName):
        tables.add(str(value))
        return
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return
    obj_id = id(value)
    if obj_id in seen:
        return
    seen.add(obj_id)

    if isinstance(value, SqlIdentifier) and is_identifier_kind(value, SqlIdentifierKind.TABLE):
        tables.add(str(value._name))
        return
    if isinstance(value, SqlQuotedIdentifier):
        tables.add(str(value.name))
        return

    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for item in value.values():
            _collect_table_names(item, seen, tables)
        return

    if isinstance(value, Sequence):
        for item in value:
            _collect_table_names(item, seen, tables)
        return

    for slot in _iter_slots(value):
        if slot.startswith("__"):
            continue
        try:
            nested = getattr(value, slot)
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        _collect_table_names(nested, seen, tables)

    value_dict = getattr(value, "__dict__", None)
    if isinstance(value_dict, dict):
        for nested in value_dict.values():
            _collect_table_names(nested, seen, tables)


def infer_read_tables_from_stmt(stmt: object) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Best-effort table discovery for grammar-based read bridge steps."""
    # Projections and predicates can read tables through scalar subqueries even
    # when the statement has a direct FROM table and no joins.
    tables: set[str] = set()
    _collect_table_names(stmt, set(), tables)
    return tuple(sorted(tables))


def _session_id_to_str(session_id: object) -> str:
    unwrap_to_sql = getattr(session_id, "unwrap_to_sql", None)
    if callable(unwrap_to_sql):
        return str(unwrap_to_sql())
    unwrap_to_str = getattr(session_id, "unwrap_to_str", None)
    if callable(unwrap_to_str):
        return str(unwrap_to_str())
    return str(session_id)


def _optional_scalar_to_str(value: object | None) -> str | None:
    """Convert branded or scalar context values to stable strings."""
    if value is None:
        return None
    unwrap_to_sql = getattr(value, "unwrap_to_sql", None)
    if callable(unwrap_to_sql):
        return str(unwrap_to_sql())
    unwrap_to_str = getattr(value, "unwrap_to_str", None)
    if callable(unwrap_to_str):
        return str(unwrap_to_str())
    return str(value)


def _get_cached_model_db_columns(model_cls: type[object]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    cache = _get_model_db_columns_cache()
    cached = cache.get_for_key(model_cls)
    if cached is not None:
        cached_columns: tuple[str, ...] = cached
        return cached_columns
    columns = get_model_db_columns(model_cls)
    cache.set_for_key(model_cls, columns)
    return columns


def _get_cached_model_scheme_info(model_cls: type[object]) -> tuple[str, bool]:
    cache = _get_model_scheme_info_cache()
    cached = cache.get_for_key(model_cls)
    if cached is not None:
        cached_scheme_info: tuple[str, bool] = cached
        return cached_scheme_info
    from l2070_batching.permission_provenance import _normalize_scheme_kind
    from l4000_permissions.permission_registry import get_permission_scheme

    scheme = get_permission_scheme(model_cls)
    scheme_info = ("public", False) if scheme is None else (_normalize_scheme_kind(scheme), True)
    cache.set_for_key(model_cls, scheme_info)
    return scheme_info


def _get_bridge_provenance_proof_inputs(
    model_cls: type[object],
    *,
    session_id: str | None,
    txn: object | None,
) -> tuple[str, Literal["none", "system", "user"], PermissionManifestProofKind, str | None]:
    from l2070_batching.permission_provenance import _get_user_id_for_session

    scheme_kind, has_scheme = _get_cached_model_scheme_info(model_cls)
    if not has_scheme:
        return "public", "none" if session_id is None else "user", "public", None
    if session_id is None:
        return scheme_kind, "none", "unsigned", None
    if is_system_or_schema_session(session_id):
        return scheme_kind, "system", "system-grant", None
    user_id = None if txn is None else _get_user_id_for_session(session_id, txn)
    return scheme_kind, "user", "permission", user_id


def _build_cached_bridge_manifest_entry(
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    model_cls: type[object],
    action: Literal["select", "insert", "update", "delete"],
    columns_read: tuple[str, ...],
    columns_masked: tuple[str, ...],
    columns_written: tuple[str, ...],
    row_scope_kind: str,
    stmt_cls_name: str,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    session_id_str: str | None,
    branch_id_str: str | None,
    revision_id_str: str | None,
    secret: bytes | None,
    proof_kind: PermissionManifestProofKind,
    scheme_kind: str,
    session_kind: Literal["none", "system", "user"],
    user_id: str | None,
) -> PermissionProvenanceManifestEntry:
    """Cache bridge manifest entries for repeated statement/table patterns."""
    cache_key = (
        model_cls,
        action,
        columns_read,
        columns_masked,
        columns_written,
        row_scope_kind,
        stmt_cls_name,
        table_name,
        session_id_str,
        branch_id_str,
        revision_id_str,
        secret,
        proof_kind,
        scheme_kind,
        session_kind,
        user_id,
    )
    cached = ctx.provenance_manifest_cache.get(cache_key)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached
    entry = build_permission_provenance_manifest_entry(
        model_cls,
        action=action,
        columns_read=columns_read,
        columns_masked=columns_masked,
        columns_written=columns_written,
        row_scope_kind=row_scope_kind,
        row_scope_descriptor={
            "kind": row_scope_kind,
            "stmt_cls": stmt_cls_name,
            "table_name": table_name,
        },
        session_id=session_id_str,
        branch_id=BranchId(branch_id_str) if branch_id_str is not None else None,
        revision_id=RevisionId(revision_id_str) if revision_id_str is not None else None,
        secret=secret,
        proof_kind=proof_kind,
        scheme_kind=scheme_kind,
        session_kind=session_kind,
        user_id=user_id,
    )
    ctx.provenance_manifest_cache[cache_key] = entry
    return entry


def build_select_bridge_manifest(
    *,
    stmt: object,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    row_scope_kind: str,
    model_cls: type[object] | None = None,
    read_tables: Sequence[str] | None = None,
) -> tuple[tuple[PermissionProvenanceManifestEntry, ...], bool]:
    """Build select provenance for grammar fetch/select bridge steps."""
    if not ctx.requires_permission_provenance_manifest():
        return (), True

    table_names = list(read_tables if read_tables is not None else infer_read_tables_from_stmt(stmt))
    if model_cls is not None:
        model_table = get_table_name(model_cls)
        if model_table not in table_names:
            table_names.append(model_table)
    table_names = sorted(set(table_names))
    stmt_cls_name = type(stmt).__name__
    session_id_str = _optional_scalar_to_str(ctx.session_id)
    branch_id_str = _optional_scalar_to_str(ctx.branch_id)
    revision_id_str = _optional_scalar_to_str(ctx.revision_id)

    manifests: list[tuple[PermissionProvenanceManifestEntry, ...]] = []
    for table_name in table_names:
        resolved_model = (

            model_cls
            if model_cls is not None and get_table_name(model_cls) == table_name
            else _planning_model_for_table(ctx, SqlTableName(table_name))

        )
        if resolved_model is None:
            continue
        scheme_kind, session_kind, proof_kind, user_id = _get_bridge_provenance_proof_inputs(
            resolved_model,
            session_id=session_id_str,
            txn=None,
        )
        manifests.append(
            (
                _build_cached_bridge_manifest_entry(
                    ctx=ctx,
                    model_cls=resolved_model,
                    action="select",
                    columns_read=_get_cached_model_db_columns(resolved_model),
                    columns_masked=(),
                    columns_written=(),
                    row_scope_kind=row_scope_kind,
                    stmt_cls_name=stmt_cls_name,
                    table_name=SqlTableName(table_name),
                    session_id_str=session_id_str,
                    branch_id_str=branch_id_str,
                    revision_id_str=revision_id_str,
                    secret=ctx.permission_provenance_secret,
                    proof_kind=proof_kind,
                    scheme_kind=scheme_kind,
                    session_kind=session_kind,
                    user_id=user_id,
                ),
            ),
        )
    allow_empty = not manifests and (
        not table_names
        or _allows_empty_infrastructure_manifest(table_names, _planning_models(ctx))
        or is_system_or_schema_session(_session_id_to_str(ctx.session_id))
    )
    return merge_permission_manifests(*manifests), allow_empty


def _infer_write_action(
    stmt: object,
    *,
    reads: bool,
    writes: bool,
) -> Literal["select", "insert", "update", "delete"]:
    if not writes:
        return "select"
    cls_name = type(stmt).__name__.lower()
    if "delete" in cls_name:
        return "delete"
    if "update" in cls_name:
        return "update"
    if reads:
        return "update"
    return "insert"


def _allows_empty_execute_manifest(stmt: object) -> bool:
    """Return True when a statement is schema/transaction control, not data access."""
    if isinstance(stmt, (SqlDdlBase, SqlDdlUtilityBase, SqlTransactionControlBase)):
        return True

    cls_name = type(stmt).__name__
    return cls_name.startswith(("SqlCreate", "SqlAlter", "SqlDrop")) or cls_name in {
        "SqlBegin",
        "SqlCommit",
        "SqlRollback",
        "SqlSavepoint",
        "SqlReleaseSavepoint",
        "SqlRollbackToSavepoint",
    }


def _planning_model_for_table(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
) -> type[object] | None:
    catalog = ctx.planning_catalog
    if catalog is not None:
        table_shape = catalog.tables_by_name.get(table_name)
        return table_shape.model_cls if table_shape is not None else None
    return get_model_for_table(SqlTableName(table_name))


def _is_database_row_model(
    model_cls: type[object],
) -> TypeGuard[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]]:
    return issubclass(model_cls, DatabaseObjectRow)


def _planning_models(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...] | None:
    catalog = ctx.planning_catalog
    if catalog is None:
        return None
    return tuple(model_cls for model_cls in catalog.tables if _is_database_row_model(model_cls))


def _allows_empty_infrastructure_manifest(
    touched_tables: Sequence[str],
    planning_models: tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ...] | None,
) -> bool:
    """Return True when all touched tables are internal infrastructure tables."""
    if not touched_tables:
        return False
    registered_models = planning_models or tuple(get_registered_tables())
    unregistered_infrastructure_tables = frozenset({"versioned_large_columns"})
    return all(
        table_name in unregistered_infrastructure_tables or is_infrastructure_table(SqlTableName(table_name), registered_models)
        for table_name in touched_tables
    )


def build_execute_bridge_manifest(
    *,
    stmt: object,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    reads: frozenset[str],
    writes: frozenset[str],
    row_scope_kind: str,
) -> tuple[tuple[PermissionProvenanceManifestEntry, ...], bool]:
    """Build provenance for generic execute-only grammar bridge steps."""
    if not ctx.requires_permission_provenance_manifest():
        return (), True

    if reads or writes:
        read_tables = sorted(set(reads))
        write_tables = sorted(set(writes))
    else:
        inferred_reads, inferred_writes = infer_reads_writes_from_stmt(stmt)
        read_tables = sorted(inferred_reads)
        write_tables = sorted(inferred_writes)
    touched_tables = sorted(set(read_tables).union(write_tables))

    if _allows_empty_execute_manifest(stmt):
        return (), True

    stmt_cls_name = type(stmt).__name__
    session_id_str = _optional_scalar_to_str(ctx.session_id)
    branch_id_str = _optional_scalar_to_str(ctx.branch_id)
    revision_id_str = _optional_scalar_to_str(ctx.revision_id)
    manifests: list[tuple[PermissionProvenanceManifestEntry, ...]] = []
    for table_name in touched_tables:
        model_cls = _planning_model_for_table(ctx, SqlTableName(table_name))
        if model_cls is None:
            continue
        action = _infer_write_action(
            stmt,
            reads=table_name in read_tables,
            writes=table_name in write_tables,
        )
        model_columns = _get_cached_model_db_columns(model_cls)
        scheme_kind, session_kind, proof_kind, user_id = _get_bridge_provenance_proof_inputs(
            model_cls,
            session_id=session_id_str,
            txn=None,
        )
        manifests.append(
            (
                _build_cached_bridge_manifest_entry(
                    ctx=ctx,
                    model_cls=model_cls,
                    action=action,
                    columns_read=model_columns if action in {"select", "update", "delete"} else (),
                    columns_masked=(),
                    columns_written=model_columns if action in {"insert", "update"} else (),
                    row_scope_kind=row_scope_kind,
                    stmt_cls_name=stmt_cls_name,
                    table_name=SqlTableName(table_name),
                    session_id_str=session_id_str,
                    branch_id_str=branch_id_str,
                    revision_id_str=revision_id_str,
                    secret=ctx.permission_provenance_secret,
                    proof_kind=proof_kind,
                    scheme_kind=scheme_kind,
                    session_kind=session_kind,
                    user_id=user_id,
                ),
            ),
        )
    allow_empty = not manifests and (
        not touched_tables
        or _allows_empty_infrastructure_manifest(touched_tables, _planning_models(ctx))
        or is_system_or_schema_session(_session_id_to_str(ctx.session_id))
    )
    return merge_permission_manifests(*manifests), allow_empty

class _RecordingPermissionScheme(ConcretePermissionScheme[object]):
    table_checks: list[tuple[object, type[DatabaseObjectRow]]] = []
    object_checks: list[tuple[object, DatabaseObjectRow]] = []

    @classmethod
    def reset(cls) -> None:
        cls.table_checks = []
        cls.object_checks = []

    def resolve_context_lazy(self, session_id, txn, **kwargs):  # type: ignore[no-untyped-def]
        del session_id, txn, kwargs
        raise AssertionError("runtime projection receives an already-resolved context")

    def get_policy_expression(self, model_class, *, action: str = "read"):  # type: ignore[no-untyped-def]
        del model_class, action
        return PERMISSION_TRUE()

    def check_write_permission(self, context: object, model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> None:
        self.table_checks.append((context, model_cls))

    def check_object_write_permission(self, context: object, obj: DatabaseObjectRow) -> None:
        self.object_checks.append((context, obj))


@register_permissions(scheme_factory=_RecordingPermissionScheme)
@register_table(plural="collect_permission_rows", singular="collect_permission_row")
class _CollectPermissionRow(DatabaseObjectRow):
    name: str = Field(default="")

class ProcessConnectionTarget(BaseModel):
    """A test-owned connection description; credentials stay outside evidence archives."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")
    backend: BackendType
    params: BackendConnectionParams
    include_admin_session: bool = False


def persist_generation(directory: Path, name: str, fitted: matching.H14ProjectionFitResult) -> None:
    """Store immutable tensor bytes once, separately from generation metadata."""
    (directory / f"{name}.artifact.json").write_text(fitted.artifact.model_dump_json())
    for digest, payload in fitted.blobs().items():
        path = directory / f"tensor-{digest}.bin"
        if path.exists():
            assert path.read_bytes() == payload
        else:
            path.write_bytes(payload)


def load_generation(directory: Path, name: str) -> matching.H14ProjectionBootstrapContributor:
    """Reconstruct and verify all four tensor references without fitting."""
    artifact = matching.H14ProjectionArtifact.model_validate_json(
        (directory / f"{name}.artifact.json").read_text(),
    )
    fitted = matching.H14ProjectionFitResult(
        artifact=artifact,
        mean_payload=(directory / f"tensor-{artifact.mean_tensor.digest}.bin").read_bytes(),
        rotation_payload=(directory / f"tensor-{artifact.rotation_tensor.digest}.bin").read_bytes(),
        threshold_payload=(directory / f"tensor-{artifact.threshold_tensor.digest}.bin").read_bytes(),
        residual_payload=(directory / f"tensor-{artifact.residual_tensor.digest}.bin").read_bytes(),
    )
    return matching.H14ProjectionBootstrapContributor(fitted=fitted)


def run_stage(directory: Path, mode: str, checkpoint: str) -> None:
    started = time.perf_counter()

    def observe(stage: str) -> None:
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "stage": stage,
                    "mode": mode,
                    "checkpoint": checkpoint,
                    "pid": os.getpid(),
                    "elapsed_seconds": time.perf_counter() - started,
                }
            ),
            flush=True,
        )

    observe("start")
    target_path = directory / "connection.json"
    target = (
        ProcessConnectionTarget.model_validate_json(target_path.read_text())
        if target_path.exists()
        else ProcessConnectionTarget(backend=BackendType.SQLITE, params={"db_path": str(directory / "migration.sqlite")})
    )
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import DatabaseObjectRow

    recovery_models: tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], ...] = (H14RecoveryLeft, H14RecoveryRight)
    if target.include_admin_session:
        from data_layer.admin import AdminSession

        recovery_models = (*recovery_models, AdminSession)
    connection = create_connection_from_params(str(target.backend), dict(target.params))
    connection.connect()
    observe("connected")
    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    core = DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor()
    manifest = "h14-process-recovery"

    def record_plan(contributor: matching.H14ProjectionBootstrapContributor) -> None:
        if not os.environ.get("NERA_PHASE7_PLAN_DIAGNOSTICS"):
            return
        from dataclasses import asdict
        from l3200_metadata.hashing import (
            _schema_contract_fingerprint_payload_uncached,
            _compute_schema_hash_uncached,
            _normalize_type,
            cached_model_fields,
        )

        plan = coordinator.build_engine_plan(
            manifest_key=manifest,
            model_classes=recovery_models,
            contributors=(core, contributor),
            dialect=connection.get_dialect(),
        )
        (directory / f"{mode}_plan.json").write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "plan_hash": plan.plan_hash,
                    "schema_hash": plan.schema_hash_v2,
                    "contract": plan.contract_fingerprint,
                    "physical": asdict(plan.physical_contract),
                    "primitives": [asdict(item.identity) for item in plan.desired_primitives],
                    "uncached_schema_hash": _compute_schema_hash_uncached(plan.model_classes),
                    "raw_types": {
                        f"{model.__module__}.{model.__qualname__}": {
                            name: _normalize_type(info.annotation) for name, info in cached_model_fields(model).items()
                        }
                        for model in plan.model_classes
                    },
                    "models": {
                        f"{model.__module__}.{model.__qualname__}": _schema_contract_fingerprint_payload_uncached(model)
                        for model in plan.model_classes
                    },
                },
                sort_keys=True,
                indent=2,
                default=str,
            )
        )

    try:
        if mode == "initialize":
            previous, replacement = h14_migration_generations()
            record_plan(previous)
            for name, contributor in (("previous", previous), ("replacement", replacement)):
                persist_generation(directory, name, contributor.fitted)
            coordinator.run(connection, manifest_key=manifest, model_classes=recovery_models, contributors=(core, previous))
            session = connection.session(SessionId.schema())
            session.write(fn=lambda txn: seed_recovery_sources(txn, previous.fitted))
            assert session.write(
                fn=lambda txn: matching.cleanup_matching_artifacts_for_deleted_branch(
                    txn,
                    matching.MatchArtifactScopeValue(f"unused:{SysId.new()}"),
                )
            ) == matching.MatchArtifactReferenceDeletionCount(0)
            session.read(fn=lambda txn: assert_recovery_matches(txn, previous.fitted.artifact))
            observe("initialized")
            return
        previous, replacement = (load_generation(directory, name) for name in ("previous", "replacement"))

        record_plan(previous)

        def migrate() -> None:
            with connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
                result = replacement.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_artifact=previous.fitted.artifact)
                if mode == "interrupt" and checkpoint == "before_execute":
                    kill_at_checkpoint()
                resolve_terminal_sync(schema, "serverplan_test", result)
            observe("migrated")

        def reconcile() -> None:
            coordinator.run(connection, manifest_key=manifest, model_classes=recovery_models, contributors=(core, replacement))
            observe("reconciled")

        def kill_at_checkpoint() -> None:
            observe("kill_checkpoint")
            (directory / "checkpoint.json").write_text(json.dumps({"checkpoint": checkpoint, "pid": os.getpid()}))
            kill_signal = signal.SIGTERM if os.name == "nt" else signal.SIGKILL
            os.kill(os.getpid(), kill_signal)
            raise AssertionError("Process termination returned")

        if mode == "interrupt":
            if checkpoint in {"partial_tensors", "committed_partial_tensors"}:
                original_execute = PlanExecutor._execute_preprocessed_step
                completed = 0
                tensor_table = get_table_name(matching.MatchingProjectionTensorRow)

                def execute(
                    executor: PlanExecutor,
                    step: ServerPlanStep[Any],
                    resolved: dict[str, Any],
                    success_lifecycle_actions: list[PendingLifecycleAction],
                    failure_lifecycle_actions: list[PendingLifecycleAction],
                    accounting: PipelineAccounting,
                ) -> Any:
                    nonlocal completed
                    tensor_write = tensor_table in step.tables_written()
                    if tensor_write and completed == 1:
                        if checkpoint == "committed_partial_tensors":
                            # Model a durable partial generation from a non-atomic publisher.
                            connection._commit()
                        kill_at_checkpoint()
                    result = original_execute(executor, step, resolved, success_lifecycle_actions, failure_lifecycle_actions, accounting)
                    if tensor_write:
                        completed += 1
                    return result

                with patch.object(PlanExecutor, "_execute_preprocessed_step", execute):
                    migrate()
                raise AssertionError("Tensor checkpoint was not reached")
            migrate()
            if checkpoint in {"after_reconcile", "before_source_commit", "after_source_commit"}:
                reconcile()
            if checkpoint in {"before_source_commit", "after_source_commit"}:

                def maintain(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
                    maintain_recovery_sources(txn, replacement.fitted)
                    if checkpoint == "before_source_commit":
                        kill_at_checkpoint()

                connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=maintain)
            kill_at_checkpoint()

        assert mode == "recover"
        session = connection.session(SessionId.schema())
        committed_partial_tensor: matching.MatchingProjectionTensorRow | None = None

        def inspect_recovered_rows(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> None:
            nonlocal committed_partial_tensor
            tensors, bindings = resolve_terminal_sync(
                txn,
                "serverplan_test",
                lazy_tuple(
                    txn.query(matching.MatchingProjectionTensorRow)
                    .filter(
                        field(matching.MatchingProjectionTensorRow.artifact_id) == replacement.fitted.artifact.artifact_id,
                    )
                    .execute_lazy(),
                    txn.query(matching.MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow)
                    .filter(
                        field(matching.MatchingProjectionCodeBindingRow.artifact_id) == replacement.fitted.artifact.artifact_id,
                    )
                    .execute_lazy(),
                ),
            )
            assert (
                len(tensors)
                == {
                    "before_execute": 0,
                    "partial_tensors": 0,
                    "committed_partial_tensors": 1,
                    "after_migration": 4,
                    "after_reconcile": 4,
                    "before_source_commit": 4,
                    "after_source_commit": 4,
                }[checkpoint]
            ), (target.backend, checkpoint, len(tensors))
            if checkpoint == "committed_partial_tensors":
                committed_partial_tensor = tensors[0]
            assert len(bindings) == (3 if checkpoint == "after_source_commit" else 0)

        session.read(fn=inspect_recovered_rows)

        contracts = {
            contributor.fitted.artifact.artifact_id: build_read_only_bootstrap_contract(
                coordinator.build_engine_plan(
                    manifest_key=manifest,
                    model_classes=recovery_models,
                    contributors=(core, contributor),
                    dialect=connection.get_dialect(),
                ),
            )
            for contributor in (previous, replacement)
        }

        def admitted(contributor: matching.H14ProjectionBootstrapContributor, *, verify_matches: bool = False) -> bool:
            contract = contracts[contributor.fitted.artifact.artifact_id]
            try:
                reader = open_validated_read_only_connection(target.backend, target.params, contract=contract)
            except ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError as error:
                print(
                    json.dumps(
                        {
                            "stage": "admission_rejected",
                            "reason": str(error.reason),
                            "detail": str(error.detail),
                            "expected_plan": str(error.expected_plan_hash),
                            "observed_plan": str(error.observed_plan_hash),
                            "missing_artifacts": error.missing_artifacts,
                            "mismatched_proofs": error.mismatched_proofs,
                            "mismatched_seeds": error.mismatched_seeds,
                        }
                    ),
                    flush=True,
                )
                return False
            try:
                if verify_matches:
                    reader.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=lambda txn: assert_recovery_matches(txn, contributor.fitted.artifact))
            finally:
                reader.close()
            return True

        assert admitted(previous, verify_matches=True) is (
            checkpoint in {"before_execute", "partial_tensors", "committed_partial_tensors"}
        )
        assert admitted(replacement) is (checkpoint in {"after_reconcile", "before_source_commit", "after_source_commit"})
        observe("pre_retry_admission")
        with patch("l5250_matching.h14_api.fit_h14", side_effect=AssertionError("Recovery must not refit")) as refit:
            migrate()
            reconcile()
            assert admitted(replacement)
            assert not admitted(previous)
            if checkpoint == "after_source_commit":
                assert admitted(replacement, verify_matches=True)
            else:
                try:
                    session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, recovery_spec(replacement.fitted.artifact)))
                except matching.MatchArtifactError as error:
                    assert error.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH
                else:
                    raise AssertionError("Replacement matching accepted predecessor-bound source codes")
            session.write(fn=lambda txn: maintain_recovery_sources(txn, replacement.fitted))
            assert admitted(replacement, verify_matches=True)

            def read_retained_state(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> Sequence[matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow]:
                previous_fit, replacement_fit, activations = resolve_terminal_sync(
                    txn,
                    "serverplan_test",
                    lazy_tuple(
                        matching.load_h14_projection_lazy(txn, previous.fitted.artifact.artifact_id),
                        matching.load_h14_projection_lazy(txn, replacement.fitted.artifact.artifact_id),
                        txn.query(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow).execute_lazy(),
                    ),
                )
                assert previous_fit == previous.fitted
                assert replacement_fit == replacement.fitted
                if committed_partial_tensor is not None:
                    retained = txn.select_one(matching.MatchingProjectionTensorRow, committed_partial_tensor.sys_id)
                    assert retained == committed_partial_tensor
                return activations

            before_retry = session.read(fn=read_retained_state)
            migrate()
            reconcile()
            assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.query(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow).execute()) == before_retry
            assert admitted(replacement, verify_matches=True)
            refit.assert_not_called()
        observe("recovered")
        (directory / "recovered.json").write_text(json.dumps({"pid": os.getpid(), "checkpoint": checkpoint}))
    finally:
        connection.close()


def run_logged_stage(directory_name: str, mode: str, checkpoint: str) -> None:
    """Execute in a fresh worker with a closed, test-owned output file."""
    from contextlib import redirect_stderr, redirect_stdout
    import traceback

    directory = Path(directory_name)
    with (directory / f"{mode}.log").open("w", buffering=1) as output, redirect_stdout(output), redirect_stderr(output):
        try:
            with bootstrap_session():
                run_stage(directory, mode, checkpoint)
        except BaseException:
            traceback.print_exc()
            raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    with bootstrap_session():
        run_stage(
            Path(os.environ["NERA_PHASE7_KILL_DIRECTORY"]), os.environ["NERA_PHASE7_KILL_MODE"], os.environ["NERA_PHASE7_KILL_CHECKPOINT"]
        )

def test_sqlite_commit_delta_query_classifies_final_rows_and_deduplicates_repeated_writes() -> None:
    branch_id = BranchId.new()
    revision_id = RevisionId.new()

    compiled = step.compile(context)
    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    assert context.dialect is not None
    sql, params = render_to_sql(compiled.grammar, context.dialect)

    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    connection.execute(
        """CREATE TABLE documents_staged (
            sys_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            branch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            sys_staged_commit_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            sys_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            sys_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL,
            title TEXT,
            score INTEGER
        )""",
    )
    connection.execute(
        """CREATE TABLE documents_sparse (
            sys_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            branch_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            sys_valid_from_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            sys_valid_to_revision_id TEXT,
            sys_deleted INTEGER NOT NULL,
            title TEXT,
            score INTEGER
        )""",
    )
    staged_rows = [
        ("insert", 0, "new", 1, "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
        ("update", 0, "intermediate", 1, "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
        ("update", 0, "new", 2, "2026-01-01T00:00:01Z"),
        ("same", 0, "same", None, "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
        ("delete", 1, "old", 1, "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
        ("missing-delete", 1, "gone", 1, "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
    ]
    connection.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO documents_staged VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        [
            (
                row_id,
                str(branch_id),
                str(staged_commit_id),
                updated_at,
                deleted,
                title,
                score,
            )
            for row_id, deleted, title, score, updated_at in staged_rows
        ],
    )
    prior_rows = [
        ("update", "old", 1, 0),
        ("same", "same", None, 0),
        ("delete", "old", 1, 0),
    ]
    connection.execute(
        "INSERT INTO documents_staged VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (
            "other-branch",
            str(BranchId.new()),
            str(staged_commit_id),
            "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
            0,
            "private",
            9,
        ),
    )
    connection.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO documents_sparse VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        [
            (
                row_id,
                str(branch_id),
                str(RevisionId.new()),
                str(revision_id),
                deleted,
                title,
                score,
            )
            for row_id, title, score, deleted in prior_rows
        ],
    )
    connection.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO documents_sparse VALUES (?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?)",
        [
            (row_id, str(branch_id), str(revision_id), deleted, title, score)
            for row_id, deleted, title, score, _updated_at in staged_rows
            if row_id != "update" or title == "new"
        ],
    )

    rows = connection.execute(sql, tuple(str(value) for value in params)).fetchall()

    assert sorted((row[0], row[1]) for row in rows) == [
        ("delete", "delete"),
        ("insert", "insert"),
        ("update", "update"),
    ]
    update = next(row for row in rows if row[0] == "update")
    assert update[4:] == ("old", "new", 1, 2)

    "source_id",
    "source_table",
    "field_name",
    "content_hash_short",
    "content_hash_high",

class CopyForkEmbeddingRefsStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """Retain branch-local embeddings when a child adopts a populated tip."""

    def __init__(
        self: Self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        ref_table: SqlTableName,
        branch_table: SqlTableName,
        tip_column: SqlColumnName,
        source_table: str,
        index_name: str,
        source_revision: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
        target_branch: BranchId,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._ref_table = ref_table
        self._branch_table = branch_table
        self._tip_column = tip_column
        self._source_table = source_table
        self._index_name = index_name
        self._source_revision = source_revision
        self._target_branch = target_branch
        self._after_refs = after_refs
        self._identity_seed = SysId.new()

    @property
    def level(self: Self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: Self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def step_tags(self: Self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "branch", "embedding"})

    def dependencies(self: Self) -> frozenset[str]:
        revision_ref = self._source_revision.ref_id
        return frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs) | (
            frozenset({str(revision_ref)}) if revision_ref is not None else frozenset()
        )

    def tables_read(self: Self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._ref_table), str(self._branch_table)})

    def tables_written(self: Self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._ref_table)})

    def is_read_only(self: Self) -> bool:
        return False

    def compile(self: Self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        refs = SqlAliasName("fork_embedding_ref")
        branch = SqlAliasName("fork_source_branch")
        payload = SqlAliasName("fork_embedding_payload")

        def col(alias: SqlAliasName, name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), qualifier=alias)

        columns = _EMBEDDING_REF_PAYLOAD_COLUMNS
        selected = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [SqlSelectAlias(col(refs, name), SqlAliasName(name)) for name in columns]
            ),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(self._ref_table), alias=refs),
            joins=[
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.INNER,
                    SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(self._branch_table), alias=branch),
                    sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(col(branch, "sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, col(refs, "branch_id")),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            col(branch, str(self._tip_column)),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            lower_scalar_source(self._source_revision, ctx, default_field="v"),
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            ],
            where=sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(col(refs, "source_table"), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(self._source_table)),
                SqlBinaryOp(col(refs, "field_name"), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(self._index_name)),
                SqlIsNull(col(refs, "revision_id")),
            ),
            distinct=True,
        )
        ordinal = SqlWindow(
            SqlFuncCall("ROW_NUMBER", []),
            order_by=[
                SqlOrderByItem(col(payload, "source_id"), OrderDirection.ASC),
                SqlOrderByItem(col(payload, "chunk_id"), OrderDirection.ASC),
            ],
        )
        source = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlUuidFromParentAndOrdinal(SqlParam(str(self._identity_seed)), ordinal),
                    SqlCast(SqlParam(self._target_branch), parse_cast_target_type("UUID")),
                    SqlCast(SqlParam(None), parse_cast_target_type("UUID")),
                    *(col(payload, name) for name in columns),
                ]
            ),
            from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(selected, SqlTableName(str(payload))),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=SqlInsert(
                SqlTableIdent(self._ref_table),
                columns=SqlColumnList(
                    [
                        SqlColumnName(name)
                        for name in ("sys_id", "branch_id", "revision_id", *columns)
                    ]
                ),
                source=source,
            )
        )


def merge_embedding_ref_tables(
    source_table: str,
    index_name: str,
    strategy: ContentStoreStrategy,
    *, planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None,
) -> tuple[SqlTableName, ...]:
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
    from l5200_vector_index.content_addressable_models import (
        get_embedding_ref_table_name,
    )

    if strategy is ContentStoreStrategy.PER_MODEL:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.embedding_store_scope import (
            owned_per_model_embedding_storage,
        )

        return tuple(
            get_table_name(ref_cls)
            for _, _, ref_cls in owned_per_model_embedding_storage(planning_catalog)
        )
    return (
        SqlTableName(
            get_embedding_ref_table_name(source_table, strategy=strategy, field_name=index_name)
        ),
    )


def build_merge_embedding_ref_steps(
    model_cls: type[VersionedObjectRow[SysId]],
    config: _ApplyMergeInsertConfig,
    *,
    prefix: str,
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog | None = None,
) -> list[CopyMergeEmbeddingRefsStep]:
    from hashlib import sha256
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
    from l5200_vector_index.vector_config import get_vector_indexes

    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    steps: list[CopyMergeEmbeddingRefsStep] = []
    for index_name, vector_config in get_vector_indexes(model_cls).items():
        for ref_table in merge_embedding_ref_tables(
            table_name, index_name, vector_config.content_store_strategy,
            planning_catalog=planning_catalog,
        ):
            identity = sha256(f"{prefix}\0{index_name}\0{ref_table}".encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
            retire_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"merge_refs_retire_{identity}")
            steps.append(
                RetireMergeEmbeddingRefsStep(
                    retire_ref,
                    config,
                    ref_table=ref_table,
                    source_table=table_name,
                    index_name=index_name,
                    indexed_columns=config.data_columns,
                )
            )
            steps.append(
                CopyMergeEmbeddingRefsStep(
                    ServerPlanRefId(f"merge_refs_copy_{identity}"),
                    replace(config, after_refs=config.after_refs | frozenset({retire_ref})),
                    ref_table=ref_table,
                    source_table=table_name,
                    index_name=index_name,
                    indexed_columns=config.data_columns,
                )
            )
    return steps


class CopyMergeEmbeddingRefsStep(_ApplyMergeInsertStep):
    """Publish references for merged rows whose indexed content matches the source snapshot."""

    def __init__(
        self: Self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        config: _ApplyMergeInsertConfig,
        *,
        ref_table: SqlTableName,
        source_table: str,
        index_name: str,
        indexed_columns: tuple[str, ...],
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id, config)
        self._ref_table = ref_table
        self._source_table = source_table
        self._index_name = index_name
        self._indexed_columns = indexed_columns
        self._identity_seed = SysId.new()

    def tables_read(self: Self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return super().tables_read() | frozenset({str(self._ref_table)})

    def tables_written(self: Self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._ref_table)})

    def step_tags(self: Self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "merge", "embedding", "refs"})

    def compile(self: Self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import lower_scalar_source

        diff = _build_m3w_three_way_diff_cte(
            ctx,
            lca_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(self._lca_ref_id),
            source_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(self._source_ref_id),
            target_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(self._target_ref_id),
            sparse_table=self._sparse_table,
            data_columns=self._data_columns,
            revision_table=self._revision_table,
            revision_parents_table=self._revision_parents_table,
        )
        definitions, _ = diff.split_for_outer_cte()
        snapshot = definitions[4]
        refs = SqlAliasName("embedding_ref")
        old = SqlAliasName("source_row")
        new = SqlAliasName("merged_row")

        def col(alias: SqlAliasName, name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), qualifier=alias)

        revision = SqlCast(
            lower_scalar_source(self._merge_revision_id, ctx, default_field="v"),
            parse_cast_target_type("UUID"),
        )
        target_branch = _m3w_target_sys_sql(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(self._target_ref_id))
        copied = _EMBEDDING_REF_PAYLOAD_COLUMNS
        projected = [SqlSelectAlias(col(refs, name), SqlAliasName(name)) for name in copied]
        ordinal = SqlWindow(
            SqlFuncCall("ROW_NUMBER", []),
            order_by=[
                SqlOrderByItem(col(refs, "sys_id"), OrderDirection.ASC),
            ],
        )
        select = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlUuidFromParentAndOrdinal(SqlParam(str(self._identity_seed)), ordinal),
                    SqlCase(
                        whens=[(SqlIsNull(col(refs, "branch_id")), SqlParam(None))],
                        else_=target_branch,
                    ),
                    SqlCase(
                        whens=[(SqlIsNull(col(refs, "revision_id")), SqlParam(None))],
                        else_=revision,
                    ),
                    *projected,
                ]
            ),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(self._ref_table), alias=refs),
            joins=[
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.INNER,
                    SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(snapshot.name)), alias=old),
                    sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(col(refs, "source_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, col(old, "sys_id")),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                col(refs, "revision_id"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                col(old, "sys_valid_from_revision_id"),
                            ),
                            BinaryOp.OR,
                            sql_and(
                                SqlIsNull(col(refs, "revision_id")),
                                SqlBinaryOp(
                                    col(refs, "branch_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, col(old, "branch_id")
                                ),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.INNER,
                    SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(self._sparse_table)), alias=new),
                    sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(col(new, "sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, col(old, "sys_id")),
                        SqlBinaryOp(col(new, "branch_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, target_branch),
                        SqlBinaryOp(col(new, "sys_valid_from_revision_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, revision),
                        *(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                SqlBinaryOp(col(new, name), BinaryOp.EQ, col(old, name)),
                                BinaryOp.OR,
                                sql_and(SqlIsNull(col(new, name)), SqlIsNull(col(old, name))),
                            )
                            for name in self._indexed_columns
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ],
            where=sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(col(refs, "source_table"), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(self._source_table)),
                SqlBinaryOp(col(refs, "field_name"), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(self._index_name)),
                SqlBinaryOp(col(new, "sys_deleted"), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(False)),
            ),
        )
        statement = SqlInsert(
            SqlTableIdent(self._ref_table),
            columns=SqlColumnList(
                [SqlColumnName(name) for name in ("sys_id", "branch_id", "revision_id", *copied)]
            ),
            source=select,
        )
        ctes = [
            SqlCteDefinition(
                definition.name,
                definition.query,
                columns=definition.columns,
                recursive=definition.recursive,
                dependency_names=definition.dependency_names,
            )
            for definition in definitions
        ]
        return CompiledStep(grammar=SqlWith(ctes, statement, recursive=True), needs_returning=False)


class RetireMergeEmbeddingRefsStep(CopyMergeEmbeddingRefsStep):
    """Retire tip-local references replaced by a merge, retaining historical references."""

    def compile(self: Self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        target_branch = _m3w_target_sys_sql(ctx, ServerPlanRefId(self._target_ref_id))
        revision = SqlCast(
            lower_scalar_source(self._merge_revision_id, ctx, default_field="v"),
            parse_cast_target_type("UUID"),
        )
        replaced = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"))]),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(self._sparse_table)),
            where=sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, target_branch),
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, revision
                ),
            ),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=SqlDelete(
                SqlTableIdent(self._ref_table),
                where=sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_table")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(self._source_table),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("field_name")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(self._index_name),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, target_branch
                    ),
                    SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_id"))),
                    SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_id")), replaced),
                ),
            ),
            needs_returning=False,
        )

) -> _TransactionalTableNotificationStep:
    return _TransactionalTableNotificationStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("event_remote_notification"),
        _ExactNotificationDoc,
        event_type,
        ServerPlanRefId("write"),
        relation_contract=_exact_notification_relation_contract(_ExactNotificationDoc),
    )


def _compilation_context(
    backend_type: BackendType,
    *,
    include_write: bool = True,
    include_old: bool = False,
) -> CompilationContext:
    cte_refs = {}
    columns = ("sys_id", "content")
    column_type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(_ExactNotificationDoc, columns)
    assert column_type_hints is not None
    if include_write:
        cte_refs["write"] = typed_cte_reference(
            ServerPlanRefId("write"),
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            source_tables=frozenset({"exact_notification_docs"}),
        )
    if include_old:
        cte_refs["old"] = typed_cte_reference(
            ServerPlanRefId("old"),
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            source_tables=frozenset({"exact_notification_docs"}),
        )
    return make_compilation_context(
        profile=make_backend_profile(backend_type),
        cte_refs=cte_refs,
    )


def _dialect(backend_type: BackendType) -> SqlDialect:
    concrete = SqliteDialect() if backend_type is BackendType.SQLITE else PostgresDialect()
    return cast("SqlDialect", concrete)


def _render(step: _TransactionalTableNotificationStep, backend_type: BackendType) -> tuple[str, tuple[object, ...]]:
    compiled = step.compile(_compilation_context(backend_type))
    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    dialect = _dialect(backend_type)
    sql, params = compiled.grammar.render(dialect).to_sql(dialect)
    return sql, tuple(params)


def _values_cte(name: str, rows: Sequence[tuple[str, str]]) -> tuple[str, tuple[object, ...]]:
    if not rows:
        return f'"{name}" ("sys_id", "content") AS (SELECT NULL, NULL WHERE 0)', ()
    placeholders = ", ".join("(?, ?)" for _row in rows)
    return f'"{name}" ("sys_id", "content") AS (VALUES {placeholders})', tuple(value for row in rows for value in row)


def _execute_sqlite(
    step: _TransactionalTableNotificationStep,
    *,
    write_rows: Sequence[tuple[str, str]],
    old_rows: Sequence[tuple[str, str]] = (),
    rollback: bool = False,
) -> list[str]:
    ctx = _compilation_context(
        BackendType.SQLITE,
        include_old=bool(old_rows),
    )
    compiled = step.compile(ctx)
    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    dialect = _dialect(BackendType.SQLITE)
    sql, params = compiled.grammar.render(dialect).to_sql(dialect)
    write_cte, write_params = _values_cte("write", write_rows)
    ctes = [write_cte]
    cte_params = list(write_params)
    if old_rows:
        old_cte, old_params = _values_cte("old", old_rows)
        ctes.append(old_cte)
        cte_params.extend(old_params)

    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    connection.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE sys_notifications (sys_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, channel TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, publication_id TEXT, envelope_index INTEGER, envelope_count INTEGER)"
    )
    connection.execute("BEGIN")
    sqlite_params = tuple(value.isoformat() if isinstance(value, datetime) else value for value in params)
    connection.execute(f"WITH {', '.join(ctes)} {sql}", (*cte_params, *sqlite_params))
    if rollback:
        connection.rollback()
    else:
        connection.commit()
    return [str(row[0]) for row in connection.execute("SELECT payload FROM sys_notifications ORDER BY sys_id")]


def _decoded_envelope(payload: str) -> ChangeHintEnvelope:
    hint = parse_subscription_hint(payload)
    assert isinstance(hint, ChangeHintEnvelope)
    return hint

def test_exact_update_lowering_preserves_old_and_new_result_relations() -> None:
    intent = RecordTableEventIntent(
        ServerPlanRefId("event"),
        _ExactNotificationDoc,
        _RecordTableEventConfig(
            event_type="UPDATE",
            write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("write"),
            old_rows_ref=ServerPlanRefId("old"),
        ),
    )

    lowered = list(intent.lower(_lowering_context()))

    assert len(lowered) == 2
    local = next(step for step in lowered if isinstance(step, _TableEventSubscriptionLifecycleStep))
    durable = next(step for step in lowered if isinstance(step, _TransactionalTableNotificationStep))
    assert local.dependencies() == frozenset({"write", "old"})
    assert durable.dependencies() == frozenset({"write", "old"})
    assert local.tables_written() == frozenset()
    assert durable.tables_written() == frozenset({"sys_notifications"})
    compiled_local = local.compile(_compilation_context(BackendType.SQLITE, include_old=True))
    assert tuple(effect.phase for effect in compiled_local.lifecycle_effects) == (PipelineLifecyclePhase.BEFORE_COMMIT_TRANSACTIONAL,)

    all_step = AllMaterializedRevisionIdsStep(

    anchored_step = AnchoredMaterializedRevisionIdsStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("anchored_materialized_revisions"),

        config=_AnchoredMaterializedRevisionIdsConfig(
            reasons=(RevisionAnchorReason.BRANCH_TIP,),
        ),

    all_compiled = all_step.compile(_compile_ctx())
    anchored_compiled = anchored_step.compile(_compile_ctx())

    assert all_compiled.grammar is not None
    assert anchored_compiled.grammar is not None
    all_sql, _ = render_to_sql(all_compiled.grammar, PostgresDialect())
    anchored_sql, _ = render_to_sql(anchored_compiled.grammar, PostgresDialect())
    assert '"sys_id"' in all_sql
    assert '"revision_sys_id"' in anchored_sql
    assert all_compiled.runtime_ref_ids == ()
    assert anchored_compiled.runtime_ref_ids == ()
    assert all_compiled.closed_post_op is not None
    assert anchored_compiled.closed_post_op is not None

    assert isinstance(all_spec, ResultMaterializationSpec)
    assert all_spec.behavior is not None
    assert all_spec.column == "sys_id"

    assert anchored_spec.behavior is not None
    assert anchored_spec.column == "revision_sys_id"
    assert materialize_compiled_post_op(
        all_compiled.closed_post_op,
        [{"sys_id": all_revision_id.unwrap_to_str()}],

    )
    session = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema())

    def active() -> matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow:
        rows = session.read(
            fn=lambda txn: txn.query(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow)
            .filter(
                field(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow.deployment_scope) == str(previous.fitted.artifact.fit_scope.deployment),
            )
            .execute()
        )
        assert len(rows) == 1
        return rows[0]

    original = active()

    def migrate() -> None:
        with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
            result = replacement.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_artifact=previous.fitted.artifact)
            assert resolve_terminal_sync(schema, "serverplan_test", result) is None

    if interruption == "before_execute":
        with pytest.raises(_InterruptedMigration):
            with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
                replacement.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_artifact=previous.fitted.artifact)
                raise _InterruptedMigration("before caller execution")
        assert active() == original
    elif interruption == "after_commit":
        with pytest.raises(_InterruptedMigration):
            migrate()
            raise _InterruptedMigration("after committed outcome, before caller acknowledgement")
        assert active().artifact_id == replacement.fitted.artifact.artifact_id
    migrate()
    current = active()
    assert current.artifact_id == replacement.fitted.artifact.artifact_id
    assert current.created_at == original.created_at
    old = session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.load_h14_projection(txn, previous.fitted.artifact.artifact_id))
    new = session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.load_h14_projection(txn, replacement.fitted.artifact.artifact_id))
    assert old == previous.fitted
    assert new == replacement.fitted
    migrate()
    assert active() == current

@pytest.mark.parametrize("predecessor_state", ["missing", "stale"])
def test_h14_schema_migration_rejects_unmatched_predecessor_and_recovers(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    predecessor_state: str,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    previous, replacement = _generations()
    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    coordinator.run(
        db_connection, manifest_key=previous.key, model_classes=(), contributors=(DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(), previous)
    )
    session = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema())
    activation = session.read(
        fn=lambda txn: txn.query(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow)
        .filter(
            field(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow.deployment_scope) == str(previous.fitted.artifact.fit_scope.deployment),
        )
        .execute()
    )[0]
    expected = previous.fitted.artifact
    if predecessor_state == "missing":
        session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.delete_by_id(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow, activation.sys_id))
    else:
        expected = reidentified_h14_artifact(
            expected,
            {
                "training_fingerprint": matching.ProjectionTrainingFingerprint("f" * 64),
            },
        )
    with pytest.raises(ProgrammingError, match="row_content_matches"):
        with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
            resolve_terminal_sync(schema, "serverplan_test", replacement.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_artifact=expected))
    stored = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow, activation.sys_id))
    assert stored == (None if predecessor_state == "missing" else activation)
    coordinator.run(
        db_connection, manifest_key=previous.key, model_classes=(), contributors=(DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(), previous)
    )
    with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
        resolve_terminal_sync(
            schema, "serverplan_test", replacement.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_artifact=previous.fitted.artifact)
        )
    assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.load_h14_projection(txn, replacement.fitted.artifact.artifact_id)) == replacement.fitted


@pytest.mark.parametrize("identical", [False, True])
def test_concurrent_h14_schema_migrations_require_one_predecessor(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    connection_factory: Callable[[], SyncDatabaseConnection],
    identical: bool,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    previous, first = _generations()
    second_artifact = reidentified_h14_artifact(
        first.fitted.artifact,
        {
            "training_fingerprint": matching.ProjectionTrainingFingerprint("d" * 64),
        },
    )
    second = (
        first
        if identical
        else matching.H14ProjectionBootstrapContributor(
            fitted=validated_model_update(first.fitted, {"artifact": second_artifact}),
        )
    )
    LazyBootstrapCoordinator().run(
        db_connection,
        manifest_key=previous.key,
        model_classes=(),
        contributors=(DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(), previous),
    )
    ready = Barrier(2, timeout=15)

    def migrate(candidate: matching.H14ProjectionBootstrapContributor) -> bool:
        ready.wait()
        for attempt in range(2):
            connection = connection_factory()
            connection.connect()
            try:
                with bootstrap_session():
                    with connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
                        resolve_terminal_sync(
                            schema,
                            "serverplan_test",
                            candidate.migrate_from_lazy(
                                schema,
                                previous_artifact=previous.fitted.artifact,
                            ),
                        )
                return True
            except ConcurrentWriteConflictError:
                if attempt == 1:
                    raise
            except ProgrammingError as error:
                assert "row_content_matches" in str(error)
                return False
            finally:
                connection.close()
        raise AssertionError("Concurrent H14 migration retry did not complete")

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(migrate, candidate) for candidate in (first, second)]
        outcomes = [future.result(timeout=25) for future in futures]
    assert sum(outcomes) == (2 if identical else 1)
    winner = first if outcomes[0] else second
    session = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema())
    activations = session.read(
        fn=lambda txn: txn.query(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow)
        .filter(
            field(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow.deployment_scope) == str(previous.fitted.artifact.fit_scope.deployment),
        )
        .execute()
    )
    assert len(activations) == 1
    assert activations[0].artifact_id == winner.fitted.artifact.artifact_id
    assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.load_h14_projection(txn, winner.fitted.artifact.artifact_id)) == winner.fitted
    assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.load_h14_projection(txn, previous.fitted.artifact.artifact_id)) == previous.fitted


@pytest.mark.parametrize("completed_tensors", [0, 3])
def test_h14_schema_migration_recovers_after_partial_tensor_transport(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    completed_tensors: int,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    previous, replacement = _generations()
    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    coordinator.run(
        db_connection, manifest_key=previous.key, model_classes=(), contributors=(DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(), previous)
    )
    session = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema())
    activation = session.read(
        fn=lambda txn: txn.query(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow)
        .filter(
            field(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow.deployment_scope) == str(previous.fitted.artifact.fit_scope.deployment),
        )
        .execute()
    )[0]
    original_execute = PlanExecutor._execute_preprocessed_step
    tensor_table = get_table_name(matching.MatchingProjectionTensorRow)
    completed = 0
    interrupted = False

    def execute_with_interruption(
        executor: PlanExecutor,
        step: ServerPlanStep[Any],
        resolved: dict[str, Any],
        success_lifecycle_actions: list[PendingLifecycleAction],
        failure_lifecycle_actions: list[PendingLifecycleAction],
        accounting: PipelineAccounting,
    ) -> Any:
        nonlocal completed, interrupted
        tensor_write = tensor_table in step.tables_written()
        if tensor_write and completed == completed_tensors:
            interrupted = True
            raise _InterruptedMigration("before next tensor transport")
        result = original_execute(executor, step, resolved, success_lifecycle_actions, failure_lifecycle_actions, accounting)
        if tensor_write:
            completed += 1
        return result

    with monkeypatch.context() as patches:
        patches.setattr(PlanExecutor, "_execute_preprocessed_step", execute_with_interruption)
        with pytest.raises(_InterruptedMigration, match="before next tensor transport"):
            with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
                resolve_terminal_sync(
                    schema, "serverplan_test", replacement.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_artifact=previous.fitted.artifact)
                )
    assert interrupted
    assert completed == completed_tensors
    assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow, activation.sys_id)) == activation
    with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
        resolve_terminal_sync(
            schema, "serverplan_test", replacement.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_artifact=previous.fitted.artifact)
        )
    current = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow, activation.sys_id))
    assert current is not None
    assert current.artifact_id == replacement.fitted.artifact.artifact_id
    assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.load_h14_projection(txn, previous.fitted.artifact.artifact_id)) == previous.fitted
    assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.load_h14_projection(txn, replacement.fitted.artifact.artifact_id)) == replacement.fitted

        ("same-id-history", 1),
