        ("same-id-history", 128),
    ],
)
def test_native_selected_validation_work(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    axis: str,
    value: int,
) -> None:
    backend = (
        BackendType.SQLITE
        if isinstance(db_connection, SyncSqliteConnection)
        else (BackendType.POSTGRES if isinstance(db_connection, SyncPostgresConnection) else BackendType.MARIADB)
    )
    assert isinstance(db_connection, SyncSqliteConnection | SyncPostgresConnection | SyncMariaDBConnection)
    profile = make_backend_profile(backend)
    ctx = replace(make_compilation_context(profile), branch_tip_materialized=True)
    dialect = ctx.dialect
    assert dialect is not None
    identity_type = "UUID" if backend is BackendType.POSTGRES else "CHAR(36)"
    tables = {
        "nw_nodes_sparse": (
            "branch_id",
            "sys_id",
            "graph_sys_id",
            "sys_valid_from_seq",
            "sys_valid_to_seq",
            "sys_deleted",
        ),
        "nw_nodes_staged": ("branch_id", "sys_id", "graph_sys_id", "sys_staged_commit_id", "sys_deleted"),
        "nw_edges_sparse": (
            "branch_id",
            "sys_id",
            "graph_sys_id",
            "source_sys_id",
            "target_sys_id",
            "sys_valid_from_revision_id",
            "sys_valid_to_revision_id",
            "sys_deleted",
        ),
        "nw_edges_staged": (
            "branch_id",
            "sys_id",
            "graph_sys_id",
            "source_sys_id",
            "target_sys_id",
            "sys_staged_commit_id",
            "sys_deleted",
            "payload",
        ),
        "sys_revision_physical_keys": ("sys_id", "revision_sys_id"),
        "sys_revision_parents": ("revision_sys_id", "parent_revision_sys_id"),
    }
    for name, columns in tables.items():

        def column_type(column: str) -> str:
            if column == "sys_deleted":
                return "BOOLEAN"
            if column.endswith("_seq") or (name == "sys_revision_physical_keys" and column == "sys_id"):
                return "BIGINT"
            if column == "payload":
                return "TEXT" if backend is not BackendType.MARIADB else "LONGTEXT"
            return identity_type

        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlConstraint
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import ConstraintKind

        from l7000_versioned_schema.auxiliary_index_resolution import SPARSE_HISTORY_PRIMARY_KEY

        primary_constraints = (
            (SqlConstraint(ConstraintKind.PRIMARY_KEY, tuple(SqlColumnName(column) for column in SPARSE_HISTORY_PRIMARY_KEY)),)
            if name == "nw_edges_sparse"
            else ()
        )
        execute_raw_sql_for_tests(
            db_connection,
            SqlCreateTable(
                SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(name)),
                SqlTableBody(
                    (
                        *(SqlColumnDef(SqlColumnName(column), SqlTypeName(column_type(column))) for column in columns),
                        *primary_constraints,
                    )
                ),
            ),
        )
        index_columns = ("branch_id", "sys_staged_commit_id") if name.endswith("_staged") else ("branch_id", "sys_id")
        if not name.startswith("sys_revision_"):
            execute_raw_sql_for_tests(
                db_connection,
                SqlCreateIndex(
                    SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlIndexName(name + "_lookup")),
                    SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(name)),
                    tuple(SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlColumnName(c)) for c in index_columns),
                ),
            )
    from l7000_versioned_schema.auxiliary_index_resolution import sparse_history_indexes
    from l7000_versioned_schema.index_policy import HistoryIndexPolicy
    from l1400_types import DynamicFieldName

    for index in sparse_history_indexes(
        policy=HistoryIndexPolicy(),
        idx_name_fn=lambda suffix: SqlIndexName("nw_history_" + suffix),
        branch_key_column=SqlColumnName("branch_id"),
        valid_from_column=SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"),
        valid_to_column=SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"),
        valid_from_only_column=SqlColumnName("sys_valid_from_revision_id"),
        valid_to_only_column=SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"),
        include_ancestry_lookup_index=False,
        columns=frozenset(DynamicFieldName(column) for column in tables["nw_edges_sparse"]),
    ):
        execute_raw_sql_for_tests(
            db_connection,
            SqlCreateIndex(
                SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlIndexName(index.name)),
                SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("nw_edges_sparse")),
                tuple(SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in index.columns),
            ),
        )
    if backend is BackendType.MARIADB:
        for sql in (
            "ALTER TABLE nw_nodes_sparse CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
            "ALTER TABLE nw_nodes_staged CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
            "ALTER TABLE nw_edges_sparse CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
            "ALTER TABLE nw_edges_staged CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
            "ALTER TABLE sys_revision_physical_keys CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
            "ALTER TABLE sys_revision_parents CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
        ):
            execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, _TestSqlWrapper(sql))
    for endpoint in ("source_sys_id", "target_sys_id"):
        execute_raw_sql_for_tests(
            db_connection,
            SqlCreateIndex(
                SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlIndexName("nw_" + endpoint)),
                SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("nw_edges_sparse")),
                tuple(SqlQuotedIdentifier(SqlColumnName(c)) for c in ("branch_id", "graph_sys_id", endpoint, "sys_id")),
            ),
        )
    branch, selected, foreign = BranchId.new(), StagedCommitId.new(), StagedCommitId.new()
    old_revision, revision = sorted((RevisionId.new(), RevisionId.new()))
    b, r, old, s, f, graph = str(branch), str(revision), str(old_revision), str(selected), str(foreign), str(SysId.new())
    selected_count = value if axis == "selected-edges" else 128 if axis == "endpoints" else 1
    endpoint_count = value if axis == "endpoints" else 2
    endpoints = [str(SysId.new()) for _ in range(endpoint_count)]
    payload = "x" * value if axis == "payload" else ""
    rows: dict[str, list[tuple[object, ...]]] = {
        "sys_revision_physical_keys": [(1, old), (2, r)],
        "nw_nodes_sparse": [(b, node, graph, 2, None, False) for node in endpoints],
        "nw_nodes_staged": [],
        "nw_edges_sparse": [],
        "nw_edges_staged": [
            (b, str(SysId.new()), graph, endpoints[(2 * i) % endpoint_count], endpoints[(2 * i + 1) % endpoint_count], s, False, payload)
            for i in range(selected_count)
        ],
    }
    if axis == "unrelated-nodes":
        rows["nw_nodes_sparse"].extend((b, str(SysId.new()), graph, 2, None, False) for _ in range(value))
    if axis in {"unrelated-edges", "visible-and-foreign-staging"}:
        rows["nw_edges_sparse"].extend(
            (b, str(SysId.new()), graph, str(SysId.new()), str(SysId.new()), r, None, False) for _ in range(value)
        )
    if axis == "visible-and-foreign-staging":
        rows["nw_edges_staged"].extend((b, str(SysId.new()), graph, endpoints[0], endpoints[1], f, False, "") for _ in range(value))
    if axis == "same-id-history":
        identity = rows["nw_edges_staged"][0][1]
        boundaries = sorted(RevisionId.new() for _ in range(value + 2))
        # All obsolete windows precede the publication cutoff.
        revision = boundaries.pop()
        r = str(revision)
        rows["sys_revision_physical_keys"] = [(1, old), (2, r)]
        rows["nw_edges_sparse"].extend(
            (b, identity, graph, endpoints[0], endpoints[1], str(start), str(end), False)
            for start, end in zip(boundaries, boundaries[1:], strict=False)
        )
    rows["sys_revision_parents"] = [(r, old)]
    if axis in {"closed-history", "future-history"}:
        from_revision, to_revision = (old, r) if axis == "closed-history" else (str(RevisionId.new()), None)
        rows["nw_edges_sparse"].extend(
            (b, str(SysId.new()), graph, endpoints[0], endpoints[1], from_revision, to_revision, False) for _ in range(value)
        )
        # Delete a node after also removing its sole live incident edge: valid final graph.
        edge_id = str(SysId.new())
        rows["nw_edges_sparse"].append((b, edge_id, graph, endpoints[0], endpoints[1], r, None, False))
        rows["nw_edges_staged"] = [(b, edge_id, graph, endpoints[0], endpoints[1], s, True, "")]
        rows["nw_nodes_staged"] = [(b, endpoints[0], graph, s, True)]
    for name, values in rows.items():
        for start in range(0, len(values), 128):
            execute_raw_sql_for_tests(
                db_connection,
                SqlInsert(
                    SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(name)),
                    columns=SqlColumnNameList(tuple(SqlColumnName(c) for c in tables[name])),
                    values=SqlValuesClause(tuple(SqlValuesRow(tuple(SqlParam(v) for v in row)) for row in values[start : start + 128])),
                ),
            )
    scope = PublishScopeDescriptor(kind="explicit", branch_scope_token=BranchScopeToken("native-work"), staged_commit_ids=(s,))
    step = CheckDanglingEdgesBatchStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("native_work"),
        lazy_branch=ServerRefs.scalar(branch),
        config=_BatchedDanglingEdgeValidationConfig(
            entries=(
                _BatchedDanglingEdgeEntry(
                    edge_sparse_table=SqlTableName("nw_edges_sparse"),
                    edge_staged_table=SqlTableName("nw_edges_staged"),
                    edge_base_table=SqlTableName("nw_edges"),
                    publish_scope=scope,
                ),
            ),
            node_sparse_tables=(SqlTableName("nw_nodes_sparse"),),
            node_staged_tables=(SqlTableName("nw_nodes_staged"),),
            revision_id_raw=revision,
        ),
    )
    compiled = step.compile(ctx)
    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    instructions = 0

    def progress() -> int:
        nonlocal instructions
        instructions += 100
        return 0

    raw = db_connection._conn if isinstance(db_connection, SyncSqliteConnection) else None
    if raw is not None:
        assert isinstance(raw, sqlite3.Connection)
        raw.set_progress_handler(progress, 100)
    try:
        violations = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, compiled.grammar)
    finally:
        if raw is not None:
            raw.set_progress_handler(None, 0)
    assert not violations, "The final selected graph is valid on every growth axis"
    if backend is BackendType.SQLITE:
        print({"backend": backend.value, "phase": "dangling-validation", "axis": axis, "value": value, "instructions": instructions})
        assert instructions <= 50_000 + 25_000 * (selected_count - 1), "Unrelated or obsolete rows widened native validation work"
    else:
        if backend is BackendType.MARIADB:
            statement_sql, params = compiled.grammar.render(dialect).to_sql(dialect)
            sql = "ANALYZE FORMAT=JSON " + statement_sql
        else:
            sql, params = (dialect.render_explain_prefix(True, "JSON") + compiled.grammar.render(dialect)).to_sql(dialect)
        record = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, _TestSqlWrapper(sql, params))[0][0]
        analyzed = json.loads(record) if isinstance(record, str) else record
        work = 0.0
        pending: list[object] = [analyzed]
        while pending:
            node = pending.pop()
            if isinstance(node, dict):
                if backend is BackendType.POSTGRES:
                    if float(node.get("Rows Removed by Filter", 0)) > 1000:
                        print(
                            {
                                "operator": node.get("Node Type"),
                                "relation": node.get("Relation Name"),
                                "alias": node.get("Alias"),
                                "removed_rows": node["Rows Removed by Filter"],
                            }
                        )
                    work += float(node.get("Actual Rows", 0)) * float(node.get("Actual Loops", 0))
                    work += float(node.get("Rows Removed by Filter", 0)) * float(node.get("Actual Loops", 0))
                else:
                    work += float(node.get("r_rows", 0) or 0) * float(node.get("r_loops", 0) or 0)
                pending.extend(node.values())
            elif isinstance(node, list):
                pending.extend(node)
        assert work > 0, "An executed native plan is required, not optimizer estimates"
        print({"backend": backend.value, "phase": "dangling-validation", "axis": axis, "value": value, "executed_rows": work})
        assert work <= 1000 + 100 * selected_count, "Native validation visits rows outside its selected work bound"

class _NativeIndex:
    def __init__(self: _NativeIndex) -> None:
        self.calls: list[tuple[NDArray[np.uint64], NDArray[np.float32]]] = []
        self.removed: list[int] = []
        self.memory_usage = 0

    def add(self: _NativeIndex, keys: NDArray[np.uint64], vectors: NDArray[np.float32]) -> None:

def _run_isolated_native_budget_check(*, measured: bool) -> None:
    from nera_usearch_native import memory_budget_limit

    original_limit = memory_budget_limit()
    target = _assert_measured_memory_budget if measured else _assert_native_process_memory_budget
    child = get_context("spawn").Process(target=target, daemon=True)
    child.start()
    try:
        child.join(timeout=30)
        if child.is_alive():
            raise TimeoutError("The isolated native budget check did not finish")
        assert child.exitcode == 0
    finally:
        if child.is_alive():
            child.kill()
            child.join()
        child.close()
    assert memory_budget_limit() == original_limit

from __future__ import annotations

from data_layer_testing.bootstrap_authority import bootstrap_session

import asyncio
from collections.abc import Callable

import pytest

from conform.conftest import async_peer_connection_factory as async_peer_connection_factory

from conform.l5200_vector_index.test_usearch_cross_branch_all_revisions import (

from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.tests.test_usearch_compaction_metadata import (
    TEST_BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY as TEST_BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY,
    TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES as _TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES,
    TEST_BOOTSTRAP_CONTRIBUTORS as TEST_BOOTSTRAP_CONTRIBUTORS,
    TEST_BOOTSTRAP_VERSIONING_DOMAINS as TEST_BOOTSTRAP_VERSIONING_DOMAINS,
)
from l1100_exceptions import IntegrityError, NativeSearchIntegrityError, TransactionCancelledError
from l2000_connection.connection_plan_workflows import (

from l5200_vector_index.usearch_compaction_build import build_usearch_compaction_outputs
from l5200_vector_index.usearch_compaction_plan import plan_usearch_compaction_metadata, select_compaction_from_metadata
from l5200_vector_index.usearch_compaction_publication import prepare_compaction_publication_rows

from l5200_vector_index.usearch_run_models import USearchCompactionCursor, USearchRun, USearchRunMember

TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES = (*_TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES, USearchCompactionCursor)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("asynchronous", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "mode",
    [
        "commit",
        "rollback",
        "stale",
        "empty",
        "foreign_epoch",
        "member_insert_failure",
        "foreign_lock",
        "snapshot",
        "replay",
        "cancelled",
        "race",
    ],
)
def test_compaction_write_plan_preserves_transactional_authority(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    mode: str,
    asynchronous: bool,
    request: pytest.FixtureRequest,
    async_peer_connection_factory: Callable[[SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection], AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection],
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    _, branch = create_test_revision(
        db_connection,
        USearchScopeDomain,
        workspace_id=WorkspaceId.default(),
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
    )
    for number in range(2):
        _write_document(
            db_connection,
            branch,
            connection_id=ConnectionId(f"publish-{number}"),
            title=f"publish-{number}",
            embedding=[float(number + 1), 1.0],
        )

    def authority(
        txn: SyncReadTransaction,
    ) -> tuple[
        USearchIndexBlobBase,
        list[USearchRun],
        list[USearchRunMember],
        list[USearchCompactionCursor],
    ]:
        return (
            txn.query(USearchScopeIndex).execute()[0],
            list(txn.query(USearchRun).execute()),
            list(txn.query(USearchRunMember).execute()),
            list(txn.query(USearchCompactionCursor).execute()),
        )

    header, runs, members, cursors = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=authority)
    assert cursors == []

    def metadata_plan(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> dict[str, object]:
        return plan_usearch_compaction_metadata(txn, USearchScopeIndex, header.sys_id)

    metadata = execute_read_plan_workflow(
        db_connection,
        SyncReadPlanWorkflow[dict[str, object]](
            session_id=SessionId.schema(),
            build=metadata_plan,
        ),
    )
    policy = USearchCompactionPolicy(level_zero_run_trigger=2)
    selection = select_compaction_from_metadata(metadata, artifact_id=header.sys_id, policy=policy, cursors={})
    assert selection is not None
    outputs = build_usearch_compaction_outputs(
        {
            "runs": runs,
            "keys": [{"run_id": str(member.run_id), "native_key": member.native_key} for member in members],
        },
        selection,
        policy,
    )
    assert outputs is not None
    replacements = prepare_compaction_publication_rows(selection, policy, outputs, members)
    if mode == "stale":
        _write_document(
            db_connection,
            branch,
            connection_id=ConnectionId("publish-stale"),
            title="publish-stale",
            embedding=[3.0, 1.0],
        )
    if mode == "empty":
        replacements = ()
    elif mode == "foreign_epoch":
        output_run, output_members = replacements[0]
        replacements = ((output_run.model_copy(update={"published_epoch": 100}), output_members),)
    elif mode == "member_insert_failure":
        output_run, output_members = replacements[0]
        replacements = (
            (
                output_run,
                (
                    output_members[0].model_copy(update={"sys_id": members[0].sys_id}),
                    *output_members[1:],
                ),
            ),
        )
    before = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=authority)

    def search_titles(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> list[str]:
        rows = (
            txn.cross_branch(USearchScopeDocument, WorkspaceId.default())
            .vector_search(
                "content",
                [1.0, 0.0],
                k=2,
            )
            .limit(2)
            .execute()
        )
        return [row.title for row in rows]

    before_titles = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=search_titles)

    source_table = "usearch_per_field_documents" if mode == "foreign_lock" else "usearch_scope_documents"

    def publication(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> LazyResult[int]:
        result = plan_compaction_publication(
            txn,
            USearchScopeIndex,
            selection,
            replacements,
            source_table=source_table,
            index_name="content",
            cancelled=mode == "cancelled",
        )
        if mode == "rollback":
            txn.rollback_lazy()
        return result

    workflow = SyncWritePlanWorkflow[int](
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
        build=publication,
        commit=mode != "rollback",
    )
    publication_connection = db_connection

    async def async_execute_authorized(connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection) -> int:
        peer = async_peer_connection_factory(connection)
        try:
            await peer.connect_async()

            def async_publication(txn: AsyncWriteTransaction) -> LazyResult[int]:
                result = plan_compaction_publication(
                    txn,
                    USearchScopeIndex,
                    selection,
                    replacements,
                    source_table=source_table,
                    index_name="content",
                    cancelled=mode == "cancelled",
                )
                if mode == "rollback":
                    txn.rollback_lazy()
                return result

            result = await run_write_planning_workflow_async(
                peer,
                AsyncWritePlanningWorkflow[int](
                    session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                    build=async_publication,
                    commit=mode != "rollback",
                ),
            )

            async def async_search_titles(txn: AsyncReadTransaction) -> list[str]:
                rows = (
                    await txn.cross_branch(USearchScopeDocument, WorkspaceId.default())
                    .vector_search(
                        "content",
                        [1.0, 0.0],
                        k=2,
                    )
                    .limit(2)
                    .execute_async()
                )
                return [row.title for row in rows]

            assert await peer.session(SessionId.schema()).read_async(async_search_titles) == before_titles
            return result
        finally:
            await peer.close_async()

    async def async_execute(connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection) -> int:
        with bootstrap_session():
            return await async_execute_authorized(connection)

    def execute(connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection | None = None) -> int:
        target = publication_connection if connection is None else connection
        return asyncio.run(async_execute(target)) if asynchronous else run_write_plan_workflow(target, workflow)

    if mode in {"stale", "empty", "foreign_epoch", "foreign_lock"}:
        with pytest.raises(NativeSearchIntegrityError):
            execute()
    elif mode == "cancelled":
        with pytest.raises(TransactionCancelledError):
            execute()
    elif mode == "member_insert_failure":
        with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
            execute()
    elif mode == "race":
        from conform.bootstrap_families.search import SEARCH_V1
        from data_layer_testing.helpers.bootstrap import bootstrap_test_module_schema_for_tests
        from data_layer_testing.helpers.connection import create_fresh_connection

        ready = Barrier(2)

        def open_contender(worker: int) -> SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection:
            contender = create_fresh_connection(db_connection, request)
            contender.connect()
            with bootstrap_session():
                bootstrap_test_module_schema_for_tests(
                    contender,
                    module_manifest_key=f"compaction-race-writer-{worker}",
                    tables=(*SEARCH_V1.schema.tables, *TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES),
                    versioning_domains=TEST_BOOTSTRAP_VERSIONING_DOMAINS,
                    contributors=TEST_BOOTSTRAP_CONTRIBUTORS,
                )
            return contender

        def compete(contender: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection) -> str:
            with bootstrap_session():
                ready.wait(timeout=30)
                try:
                    execute(contender)
                except NativeSearchIntegrityError:
                    return "stale"
                return "committed"

        executors = [ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) for _ in range(2)]
        contenders = [next(executor.map(open_contender, (worker,))) for worker, executor in enumerate(executors)]
        outcomes: list[str] = []

        def compete_and_record(contender: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection) -> None:
            outcomes.append(compete(contender))

        try:
            for executor, contender in zip(executors, contenders, strict=True):
                executor.submit(compete_and_record, contender)
            for executor in executors:
                executor.shutdown(wait=True)
        finally:
            for contender in contenders:
                contender.close()

        assert sorted(outcomes) == ["committed", "stale"]
    elif mode == "snapshot":
        from conform.bootstrap_families.search import SEARCH_V1
        from data_layer_testing.helpers.bootstrap import bootstrap_test_module_schema_for_tests
        from data_layer_testing.helpers.connection import create_fresh_connection

        publication_connection = create_fresh_connection(db_connection, request)
        publication_connection.connect()
        with publication_connection:
            bootstrap_test_module_schema_for_tests(
                publication_connection,
                module_manifest_key="compaction-snapshot-writer",
                tables=(*SEARCH_V1.schema.tables, *TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES),
                versioning_domains=TEST_BOOTSTRAP_VERSIONING_DOMAINS,
                contributors=TEST_BOOTSTRAP_CONTRIBUTORS,
            )

            def old_reader(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> None:
                old_header, old_runs, old_members, old_cursors = authority(txn)
                old_titles = search_titles(txn)
                assert execute() == 1
                retained_header, retained_runs, retained_members, retained_cursors = authority(txn)
                assert retained_header == old_header
                assert sorted(retained_runs, key=lambda row: str(row.sys_id)) == sorted(old_runs, key=lambda row: str(row.sys_id))
                assert sorted(retained_members, key=lambda row: str(row.sys_id)) == sorted(old_members, key=lambda row: str(row.sys_id))
                assert retained_cursors == old_cursors == []
                assert search_titles(txn) == old_titles

            db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=old_reader)
    else:
        assert execute() == 1
        if mode == "replay":
            with pytest.raises(NativeSearchIntegrityError):
                execute()
    assert db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=search_titles) == before_titles
    after_header, after_runs, after_members, after_cursors = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=authority)
    if mode in {"commit", "snapshot", "replay", "race"}:
        assert after_header.artifact_epoch == header.artifact_epoch + 1
        assert len(after_cursors) == 1
        assert after_cursors[0].artifact_id == header.sys_id
        assert after_cursors[0].source_level == selection.source_level
        assert after_cursors[0].next_native_key == selection.next_cursor
        assert after_cursors[0].publication_epoch == after_header.artifact_epoch
        assert after_header.num_nodes == header.num_nodes
        active = [run for run in after_runs if run.retired_epoch is None]
        assert {run.sys_id for run in active} == {run.sys_id for run, _ in replacements}
        assert {run.sys_id for run in runs}.issubset(run.sys_id for run in after_runs)
        assert {member.sys_id for member in members}.issubset(member.sys_id for member in after_members)
        assert all(
            run.retired_epoch == after_header.artifact_epoch
            for run in after_runs
            if run.sys_id in {original.sys_id for original in runs}
        )
    else:
        assert after_header == before[0]
        assert sorted(after_runs, key=lambda run: str(run.sys_id)) == sorted(before[1], key=lambda run: str(run.sys_id))
        assert sorted(after_members, key=lambda member: str(member.sys_id)) == sorted(before[2], key=lambda member: str(member.sys_id))
        assert after_cursors == before[3] == []

def _execute(conn: sqlite3.Connection, stmt: SqlRenderable) -> sqlite3.Cursor:
    sql, params = render_to_sql(stmt, SqliteDialect())
    driver_params = tuple(str(value) if isinstance(value, RowId | UUID | StagedCommitId | BranchId | RevisionId) else value for value in params)
    return conn.execute(sql, driver_params)


def _create(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str, columns: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
    _execute(conn, SqlCreateTable(
        SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(name)),
        SqlTableBody(tuple(
            SqlColumnDef(SqlColumnName(c), SqlTypeName("INTEGER" if c == "sys_deleted" else "TEXT"))
            for c in columns
        )),
    ))


def _insert(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str, columns: tuple[str, ...], rows: Sequence[tuple[object, ...]]) -> None:
    stmt = SqlInsert(
        SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(name)),
        columns=SqlColumnNameList(tuple(SqlColumnName(c) for c in columns)),
        values=SqlValuesClause((SqlValuesRow(tuple(SqlParam(None) for _ in columns)),)),
    )
    sql, _ = render_to_sql(stmt, SqliteDialect())
    conn.executemany(sql, rows)

def _validator(
    branch: BranchId, staged: StagedCommitId,
    type_filters: tuple[tuple[str, ...], ...] = (("Contains",),),
    *, dense_keys: bool = False,
    profile: ServerPlanBackendProfile | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    scope = PublishScopeDescriptor(
        kind="explicit", branch_scope_token=BranchScopeToken("publication-test"),
        staged_commit_ids=(str(staged),),
    )
    step = CheckBranchTipDanglingEdgesBatchStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("publication_candidates"),
        config=_BatchedBranchTipDanglingEdgeValidationConfig(
            entries=tuple(_BatchedBranchTipDanglingEdgeEntry(
                edge_tip_table=SqlTableName("edges_tip"),
                edge_sparse_table=SqlTableName("edges_sparse"),
                edge_staged_table=SqlTableName("edges_staged"),
                edge_base_table=SqlTableName("edges"),
                publish_scope=scope,
                type_name_filter=type_filter,
            ) for type_filter in type_filters),
            node_staged_tables=(SqlTableName("nodes_staged"),),
            branch_table=SqlTableName("branches"),
        ),
        lazy_branch=ServerRefs.scalar(branch),
    )
    ctx = make_compilation_context(profile or make_backend_profile(BackendType.SQLITE))
    if dense_keys:
        from unittest.mock import Mock
        from l2070_batching.planning_catalog import GraphAccessPathShape, GraphEndpointAccess, PlanningCatalog

        shape = Mock(spec=GraphAccessPathShape)
        shape.source_endpoint = GraphEndpointAccess("source_sys_id", "dense_node_key", "source_node_key")
        shape.target_endpoint = GraphEndpointAccess("target_sys_id", "dense_node_key", "target_node_key")
        catalog = Mock(spec=PlanningCatalog)
        catalog.graph_access_for_table.return_value = shape
        ctx = replace(ctx, planning_catalog=catalog)
    compiled = step.compile(ctx)
    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    return compiled.grammar


@pytest.mark.parametrize("change", ["edge", "source", "target", "empty"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("missing_endpoint", [False, True])
def test_complete_validator_probes_final_edge_identities(
    fixture_db: sqlite3.Connection, change: str, missing_endpoint: bool,
) -> None:
    branch, staged = BranchId.new(), StagedCommitId.new()
    b = str(branch)
    edge: tuple[object, ...] = (b, "changed", "graph", "source", "target", "Contains")
    edges = [edge, *[(b, f"unrelated-{i}", "graph", "other-source", "other-target", "Contains") for i in range(1_000)]]
    _insert(fixture_db, "edges_tip", EDGE_COLUMNS, edges)
    _insert(fixture_db, "sys_graph_visible_nodes_tip", VISIBLE_COLUMNS, [
        (b, "graph", node) for node in ("source", "target", "other-source", "other-target")
        if not missing_endpoint or node != "source"
    ])
    if change == "edge":
        _insert(fixture_db, "edges_staged", STAGED_COLUMNS, [(*edge, str(staged), 0, 0)])
    elif change != "empty":
        _insert(fixture_db, "nodes_staged", NODE_COLUMNS, [(b, change, "graph", str(staged), 0, 1)])
    stmt = _validator(branch, staged)
    expected = [("edges", "dangling", "source", "target")] if missing_endpoint and change != "empty" else []
    assert _execute(fixture_db, stmt).fetchall() == expected
    dialect = SqliteDialect()
    sql, params = (dialect.render_explain_prefix(False, None) + stmt.render(dialect)).to_sql(dialect)
    bound = tuple(str(value) if isinstance(value, RowId | UUID | StagedCommitId | BranchId) else value for value in params)
    plan = [row[-1] for row in fixture_db.execute(sql, bound)]
    assert any(detail.startswith("SEARCH e_0 ") and "AND sys_id=?" in detail for detail in plan), plan


def test_subtypes_share_selected_row_normalization(fixture_db: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    branch, staged = BranchId.new(), StagedCommitId.new()
    b = str(branch)
    edges: list[tuple[object, ...]] = [
        (b, "contains", "graph", "missing", "target", "Contains"),
        (b, "located", "graph", "missing", "target", "LocatedIn"),
    ]
    _insert(fixture_db, "edges_tip", EDGE_COLUMNS, edges)
    _insert(fixture_db, "edges_staged", STAGED_COLUMNS, [(*row, str(staged), 0, 0) for row in edges])
    stmt = _validator(branch, staged, (("Contains",), ("LocatedIn",)))
    assert _execute(fixture_db, stmt).fetchall() == [("edges", "dangling", "missing", "target")]
    sql, _ = render_to_sql(stmt, SqliteDialect())
    # Window ranking needs only one scan per selected physical table.
    assert sql.count('FROM "edges_staged"') == 1, sql
    assert sql.count('FROM "nodes_staged"') == 1, sql
    read_columns: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

    def authorize(
        action: int, table_name: str | None, column: str | None,
        database: str | None, trigger: str | None,
    ) -> int:
        del database, trigger
        if action == sqlite3.SQLITE_READ:
            assert table_name is not None and column is not None
            read_columns.add((table_name, column))
        return sqlite3.SQLITE_OK

    fixture_db.set_authorizer(authorize)
    try:
        _execute(fixture_db, stmt).fetchall()
    finally:
        fixture_db.set_authorizer(None)
    assert ("nodes_staged", "unneeded_payload") not in read_columns

class QueryAssertRowsStep(QueryExecuteStep[dict[str, Any]]):
    """Check a typed relation's presence through a SQL assertion result."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[Any],
        *,
        query_spec: QuerySpec[Any],
        error_cls: type[Exception],
        error_message: str,
        expect_empty: bool = True,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
        require_rows: bool = False,
        permission_action: PermissionAction = PermissionAction("read"),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                query_spec=query_spec,
                raw_mode=True,
                after_refs=after_refs,
            ),
        )
        self._expect_empty = expect_empty and not require_rows
        self._require_rows = require_rows or not expect_empty
        self._permission_action = permission_action
        self._assertion_error_cls = error_cls
        self._assertion_error_message = error_message

    def native_query_assertion_steps(
        self: QueryAssertRowsStep,
        *,
        additional_after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    ) -> tuple[QueryAssertionPredicateStep, SqlQueryAssertStep]:
        from l2070_batching.semantic_plan import PlanGenerationId, PlanNamespaceId, SemanticPlanBuilder

        builder = SemanticPlanBuilder(
            namespace=PlanNamespaceId("query_assertion"),
            generation=PlanGenerationId(sha256(str(self.ref_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:32]),
        )
        predicate_ref = builder.allocate_ref(kind="step")
        assert self._query_spec is not None
        predicate = QueryAssertionPredicateStep(
            predicate_ref,
            self._model_cls,
            query_spec=self._query_spec,
            error_cls=self._assertion_error_cls,
            error_message=self._assertion_error_message,
            expect_empty=self._expect_empty,
            after_refs=self._after_refs | additional_after_refs,
            permission_action=self._permission_action,
        )
        assertion = SqlQueryAssertStep(
            self.ref_id,
            predicate_ref=ServerRefs.from_ref_id(predicate_ref, variant="scalar", type_hint=bool),
            error_cls=self._assertion_error_cls,
            error_message=self._assertion_error_message,
            ordering_tables=self.tables_read() | self.tables_written(),
        )
        return predicate, assertion

    def native_assertion_expansion(
        self: QueryAssertRowsStep,
        optimization_ctx: object,
    ) -> tuple[ServerPlanStep[Any], ...] | None:
        """Build admission, predicate, and guard steps through the step contract."""
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_gate import (
            SessionAdmissionRule,
            session_requires_gating,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.sql_session_admission import (
            SqlSessionAdmissionAssertStep,
        )
        from l2070_batching.optimizer import OptimizationContext
        from l2070_batching.semantic_plan import PlanGenerationId, PlanNamespaceId, SemanticPlanBuilder

        assert isinstance(optimization_ctx, OptimizationContext)
        assert self._query_spec is not None
        source = optimization_ctx.session_id_source if optimization_ctx.session_id_source is not None else optimization_ctx.session_id
        admission_steps: list[SqlSessionAdmissionAssertStep] = []
        if source is not None and session_requires_gating(source):
            builder = SemanticPlanBuilder(
                namespace=PlanNamespaceId("query_admission"),
                generation=PlanGenerationId(sha256(str(self.ref_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:32]),
            )
            after_refs = tuple(ServerPlanRefId(ref) for ref in sorted(self.dependencies()))
            for rule in SessionAdmissionRule:
                admission = SqlSessionAdmissionAssertStep(
                    builder.allocate_ref(kind="step"),
                    source,
                    rule,
                    after_refs=after_refs,
                )
                admission_steps.append(admission)
                after_refs = (admission.ref_id,)
        # Native query assertions are commit guards. On read-only plans they would disable the
        # independent-read transport without protecting a commit. See the Architecture section in
        # docs/design/NER1697_MARIADB_GUARDED_BRANCH_DELETE.rst.
        if (
            not optimization_ctx.is_write_transaction
            or not optimization_ctx.backend_profile.traits.native_query_assertion_aborts_before_commit
        ):
            # Keep predicate acquisition and decoding contiguous. A dependent mutation can make a
            # replay stale. See docs/design/PR2786_POST_MERGE_CI_FAILURE_SURVEY.rst, section 2.
            direct_assertion = DirectQueryAssertRowsStep(
                self.ref_id,
                self._model_cls,
                query_spec=self._query_spec,
                error_cls=self._assertion_error_cls,
                error_message=self._assertion_error_message,
                expect_empty=self._expect_empty,
                require_rows=self._require_rows,
                after_refs=self._after_refs | (frozenset({admission_steps[-1].ref_id}) if admission_steps else frozenset()),
                permission_action=self._permission_action,
            )
            return (*admission_steps, direct_assertion)
        predicate, assertion = self.native_query_assertion_steps(
            additional_after_refs=(frozenset({admission_steps[-1].ref_id}) if admission_steps else frozenset()),
        )
        return (*admission_steps, predicate, assertion)

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "query", "assertion", "grammar"})

    def requires_assertion_statement_transport(self) -> bool:
        return True

    def prevents_sql_owned_database_commit(self: QueryAssertRowsStep) -> bool:
        """Keep commit outside SQL until the assertion row is decoded."""
        return True

    def _native_assertion_aborts_before_commit(
        self: QueryAssertRowsStep,
        backend_profile: ServerPlanBackendProfile,
    ) -> bool:
        return backend_profile.traits.native_query_assertion_aborts_before_commit

    def native_assertion_error(self: QueryAssertRowsStep) -> Exception:
        """Preserve the typed query assertion when native transport aborts."""
        return self._assertion_error_cls(self._assertion_error_message)

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def executor_publication_projection_columns(self: QueryAssertRowsStep) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        """Project query source columns to the assertion result relation."""
        return self.cte_publication_contract().columns

    def cte_publication_contract(self) -> CtePublicationContract:
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=("ok", "error_code", "message"),
            column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(SqlAssertionResultRow),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=self.tables_read() or None,
        )

    def assertion_query(self, source: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
        return (rows_exist_assertion_query if self._require_rows else no_rows_assertion_query)(
            source,
            error_message=self._assertion_error_message,
        )

    def compile(self, ctx: Any) -> CompiledStep[Any]:
        return self._compile_assertion_row(ctx)

    def _compile_assertion_row(self: QueryAssertRowsStep, ctx: Any) -> CompiledStep[Any]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
            compile_query_grammar,
            attach_runtime_permission_grammar,
        )

        from l2070_batching.planning_catalog import output_shape_for_synthetic_columns

        query_output_shape = output_shape_for_synthetic_columns(
            self._cte_output_columns,
        )
        query_spec = attach_runtime_permission_grammar(
            self._query_spec,
            self._model_cls,
            ctx,
            action=self._permission_action,
        )
        compiled = compile_query_grammar(
            query_spec,
            self._model_cls,
            ctx,
            is_count=False,
            output_shape=query_output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(query_output_shape),
            column_type_hints=self._cte_column_type_hints,
        )
        grammar = compiled.grammar
        assert grammar is not None
        assertion_grammar = self.assertion_query(grammar)
        from l2070_batching.execution_limits import single_sql_request_is_required

        if single_sql_request_is_required() and ctx.backend_profile.traits.requires_assertion_transport_query:
            from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.expr_assertion import (
                SqlAssertionTransportQuery,
            )

            assertion_grammar = SqlAssertionTransportQuery(
                assertion_grammar,
                label=f"query_assertion:{self.ref_id}",
            )
        output_shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=assertion_grammar,
            params=compiled.params,
            needs_returning=True,
            external_params_first=compiled.external_params_first,
            runtime_ref_ids=compiled.runtime_ref_ids,
            auxiliary_ctes=compiled.auxiliary_ctes,
            closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(
                self._assertion_error_message,
                exc_type=self._assertion_error_cls,
            ),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
        )


class DirectQueryAssertRowsStep(QueryAssertRowsStep):
    """Execute and check a volatile query assertion at one statement boundary."""

    def native_assertion_expansion(
        self: DirectQueryAssertRowsStep,
        optimization_ctx: object,
    ) -> None:
        del optimization_ctx
        return None


class QueryAssertionPredicateStep(QueryAssertRowsStep):
    """Publish the query guard's Boolean decision for native assertion transport."""

    def native_assertion_expansion(
        self: QueryAssertionPredicateStep,
        optimization_ctx: object,
    ) -> None:
        del optimization_ctx
        return None

    def requires_assertion_statement_transport(self: QueryAssertionPredicateStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def is_session_gate_exempt(self: QueryAssertionPredicateStep) -> bool:
        """Admission assertions precede this native predicate when gating is required."""
        return True

    def result_cardinality(self: QueryAssertionPredicateStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def declares_consumed_rows_reduction(self: QueryAssertionPredicateStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def cte_publication_contract(self: QueryAssertionPredicateStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        from l2070_batching.cte_contracts import result_value_contract
        from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import SqlColumnTypeHints

        return result_value_contract(
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({"__result"})),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=self.tables_read() or None,
        )

    def compile(self: QueryAssertionPredicateStep, ctx: Any) -> CompiledStep[Any]:
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_dml_simple import SqlWrappedSubquery
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectAlias, SqlSelectList
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
        from l2070_batching.planning_catalog import output_shape_for_synthetic_columns
        from l2070_batching.post_op import ScalarCoercionKind, scalar_column_post_op

        compiled = self._compile_assertion_row(ctx)
        assert compiled.grammar is not None
        alias = SqlAliasName("__query_assertion")
        output_shape = output_shape_for_synthetic_columns(("__result",))
        return replace(
            compiled,
            grammar=SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList(
                    [
                        SqlSelectAlias(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("ok"), qualifier=alias),
                            SqlAliasName("__result"),
                        ),
                    ]
                ),
                from_=SqlWrappedSubquery(compiled.grammar, alias=alias),
            ),
            closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op("__result", scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.BOOL),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=self.cte_publication_contract().column_type_hints,
        )

"""TombstoneFromTipStep — INSERT INTO staged SELECT ... FROM tip.

Direct SQL tombstone creation without a pre-read. Compiles to a single
INSERT ... SELECT that copies the row from the tip table into staged
with sys_deleted=1 and the current staged_commit_id.

Unlike StageTombstoneStep (which requires reading the object into Python
first), this step executes entirely in SQL. It cannot tombstone rows
that only exist in staging (not yet committed to tip), but that case
is irrelevant for ServerRef-based deletes within a plan — the row
was just inserted into staging by a previous step and hasn't been
committed to tip yet.

For the ServerRef delete pattern (insert → delete_by_id via ServerRef),
the inserted row IS in staging. But the tip table may also have a
prior committed version. The QueryDeleteStep before this step clears
any existing staged row, then this step creates the tombstone from tip.
If the tip row doesn't exist, the INSERT inserts 0 rows (no-op).
"""

def _compile_tombstone_from_tip(
    step: TombstoneFromTipStep,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
) -> CompiledStep[bool]:
    from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference
    from l2070_batching.server_ref import ScalarServerRef
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import (
        SqlAliasName,
        SqlColumnName,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import lower_scalar_server_ref
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._query_helper_compile import (
        _collect_auxiliary_ctes_from_consumed,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.ddl.ddl_misc import SqlBooleanLiteral
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.versioning.stmt_insert_select import SqlInsertFromSelect
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlFrom, SqlSelectList, SqlWhereClause
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlIsNull, sql_and
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlExists
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect

    staged_commit_col = get_db_column_name(step._staged_model, DynamicFieldName("staged_commit_id"))
    deleted_col = get_db_column_name(step._staged_model, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))
    tip_model_fields = getattr(step._tip_model, "model_fields", {})
    branch_col = get_db_column_name(step._tip_model, DynamicFieldName("branch_id")) if "branch_id" in tip_model_fields else "branch_id"
    use_sparse_source = step._sparse_table_name is not None and (not ctx.branch_tip_materialized or ctx.revision_id is not None)

    target_table = step._staged_table_name
    source_table = step._sparse_table_name if use_sparse_source and step._sparse_table_name is not None else step._tip_table_name
    source_alias = SqlAliasName("tip_src")

    target_cols: list[str] = []
    select_exprs: list[Any] = []
    writable_columns = (
        None
        if include_generated_storage_columns(ctx)
        else frozenset(
            writable_db_columns(
                step._staged_model,
                excluded_fields=(),
                include_polymorphic=False,
            ),
        )
    )

    for col in step._common_columns:
        col_name = str(col)
        if (
            col_name in {staged_commit_col, deleted_col, "revision_id", "sys_revision_id"}
            or col_name.startswith("sys_valid_")
            or col_name in _GRAPH_HASH32_COLUMN_NAMES
        ):
            continue
        if writable_columns is not None and col_name not in writable_columns:
            continue
        target_cols.append(col_name)
        select_exprs.append(SqlColumnRef(col, str(source_alias)))

    target_cols.append(staged_commit_col)
    select_exprs.append(SqlParam(step._staged_commit_id_raw.unwrap_to_uuid()))

    target_cols.append(deleted_col)
    select_exprs.append(SqlBooleanLiteral(True))
    select_expr_by_target_col = dict(zip(target_cols, select_exprs, strict=True))
    conflict_columns = (branch_col, "sys_id", staged_commit_col)
    distinct_on = (select_expr_by_target_col["sys_id"],) if "sys_id" in select_expr_by_target_col else None
    branch_expr = (
        SqlParam(step._literal_branch)
        if step._literal_branch is not None
        else lower_scalar_server_ref(step._lazy_branch, ctx, default_field="branch_id")
    )

    where: Any = sql_and(
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), str(source_alias)),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            lower_scalar_server_ref(step._sys_id, ctx),
        ),
        SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_col), str(source_alias)),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            branch_expr,
        ),
    )
    if use_sparse_source:
        where = sql_and(
            where,
            SqlIsNull(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_valid_to_revision_id"), str(source_alias)),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_deleted"), str(source_alias)),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlBooleanLiteral(False),
            ),
        )
    elif "deleted" in tip_model_fields:
        where = sql_and(
            where,
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(step._tip_model, DynamicFieldName("deleted"))),
                    str(source_alias),
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlBooleanLiteral(False),
            ),
        )

    current_staged_exists = SqlExists(
        SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
            from_clause=SqlFrom(SqlTableIdent(target_table)),
            where=SqlWhereClause(
                sql_and(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        lower_scalar_server_ref(step._sys_id, ctx),
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(branch_col)),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        branch_expr,
                    ),
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(staged_commit_col)),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlParam(step._staged_commit_id_raw.unwrap_to_uuid()),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        negated=True,
    )
    where = sql_and(where, current_staged_exists)

    stmt = SqlInsertFromSelect(
        target_table=target_table,
        target_columns=target_cols,
        source_table=source_table,
        select_exprs=select_exprs,
        where=where,
        source_alias=source_alias,
        returning=SqlReturningClause([SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam(1), SqlAliasName("count"))]),
        conflict_columns=conflict_columns,
        update_columns=(deleted_col,),
        distinct=True,
        distinct_on=distinct_on,
    )

    consumed: list[CteReference] = []
    for candidate in (step._sys_id, step._lazy_branch):
        if isinstance(candidate, ScalarServerRef) and candidate.ref_id is not None:
            binding = ctx.cte_refs.get(candidate.ref_id)
            if isinstance(binding, CteReference):
                consumed.append(binding)
                continue
            base_ref, _, _ = candidate.ref_id.partition(".")
            if base_ref and base_ref != candidate.ref_id:
                base_binding = ctx.cte_refs.get(base_ref)
                if isinstance(base_binding, CteReference):
                    consumed.append(base_binding)

    auxiliary_ctes = _collect_auxiliary_ctes_from_consumed(consumed)
    __opa002_grammar_229 = stmt
    contract = step.cte_publication_contract()
    output_shape = output_shape_from_cte_publication_contract(contract)
    return CompiledStep(
        output_shape=output_shape,
        grammar=__opa002_grammar_229,
        needs_returning=True,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
        column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
        closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
            "count",
            default_value=False,
            use_default_on_empty=True,
            scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.BOOL,
        ),
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes,
    )


class _TombstoneFromTipStepCteRow(BaseModel):
    count: int


class TombstoneFromTipStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[bool]):
    """L0: Insert tombstone into staged via INSERT ... SELECT FROM tip.

    Compiles to::

        INSERT INTO staged_table (col1, col2, ..., sys_staged_commit_id, sys_deleted)
        SELECT col1, col2, ..., ?, 1
        FROM tip_table
        WHERE sys_id = ? AND branch_id = ?
    """

    def __init__(
        self: TombstoneFromTipStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        sys_id: ScalarServerRef[SysId],
        staged_table_name: SqlTableName,
        sparse_table_name: SqlTableName | None,
        tip_table_name: SqlTableName,
        staged_commit_id_raw: StagedCommitId,
        lazy_branch: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
        common_columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...],
        staged_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        tip_model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        literal_branch: BranchId | None = None,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._sys_id = sys_id
        self._staged_table_name = staged_table_name
        self._sparse_table_name = sparse_table_name
        self._tip_table_name = tip_table_name
        self._staged_commit_id_raw = staged_commit_id_raw
        self._lazy_branch = lazy_branch
        self._literal_branch = literal_branch
        self._common_columns = common_columns
        self._staged_model = staged_model
        self._tip_model = tip_model
        self._after_refs = after_refs

    def dependencies(self: TombstoneFromTipStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self.sql_visible_dependencies() | frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self._after_refs)

    def sql_visible_dependencies(self: TombstoneFromTipStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        branch_deps = frozenset() if self._literal_branch is not None else self._lazy_branch.dependencies()
        return self._sys_id.dependencies() | branch_deps

    @property
    def level(self: TombstoneFromTipStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: TombstoneFromTipStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: TombstoneFromTipStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def step_tags(self: TombstoneFromTipStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "insert", "grammar"})

    def tables_read(self: TombstoneFromTipStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        sparse_table = () if self._sparse_table_name is None else (str(self._sparse_table_name),)
        return frozenset((str(self._tip_table_name), *sparse_table))

    def tables_written(self: TombstoneFromTipStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._staged_table_name)})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: TombstoneFromTipStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("count",)
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bigint_columns=frozenset({"count"}))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _TombstoneFromTipStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: TombstoneFromTipStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def staged_write_descriptor(self: TombstoneFromTipStep) -> PendingStagedWrite | None:
        return PendingStagedWrite(
            source_key=StagedSourceKey(
                staged_table_name=str(self._staged_table_name),
                branch_scope_token=opaque_scope_token(self._lazy_branch),
            ),
            staged_commit_id_raw=self._staged_commit_id_raw.unwrap_to_sql(),
            write_kind="tombstone",
        )

    def compile(
        self: TombstoneFromTipStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[bool]:
        return _compile_tombstone_from_tip(self, ctx)

def test_commit_publish_lowering_limits_publish_work_to_exact_touched_tables() -> None:
    touched_table = "commit_publish_planner_budget_rows_3"

    lowered = _lowered_publish_steps_for_touched_tables(frozenset({touched_table}))

    def _base_table(table_name: object) -> str:
        value = str(table_name)
        for suffix in ("_staged", "_sparse", "_tip", "_log"):
            if value.endswith(suffix):
                return value.removesuffix(suffix)
        return value

    touched_base_tables = frozenset({touched_table, "commit_publish_planner_budget_revisions"})
    table_offenders: dict[str, list[dict[str, object]]] = {}
    for step in lowered:
        if type(step).__name__ == "SpeculativePublicationGuardStep":
            continue
        step_tables = step.tables_read() | step.tables_written()
        for table_name in step_tables:
            base_table = _base_table(table_name)
            if base_table in touched_base_tables:
                continue
            if not base_table.startswith("commit_publish_planner_budget_"):
                continue
            table_offenders.setdefault(base_table, []).append(
                {
                    "step_type": type(step).__name__,
                    "ref_id": str(step.ref_id),
                    "tables_read": sorted(str(table) for table in step.tables_read()),
                    "tables_written": sorted(str(table) for table in step.tables_written()),
                },
            )
    table_facts = frozenset(_base_table(table_name) for step in lowered for table_name in (step.tables_read() | step.tables_written()))
    assert touched_table in table_facts
    expected_untouched_tables = {
        f"commit_publish_planner_budget_rows_{idx}" for idx in range(8) if f"commit_publish_planner_budget_rows_{idx}" != touched_table
    }
    assert expected_untouched_tables.isdisjoint(table_offenders), table_offenders
    expected_infrastructure_tables = {
        "commit_publish_planner_budget_domain_branches",
        "commit_publish_planner_budget_domain_staged_commits",
        "commit_publish_planner_budget_revisions",
    }
    assert set(table_offenders).issubset(expected_infrastructure_tables), table_offenders

class _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelation(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    def __init__(
        self: _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelation,
        name: SqlTableName,
        query: SqlSelect,
        *,
        batched: bool = False,
        fail_after_creation: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ServerPlanRefId("capture_temporary_probe"))
        self.name = name
        self.query = query
        self.batched = batched
        self.fail_after_creation = fail_after_creation

    @property
    def level(self: _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelation) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelation) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def tables_read(self: _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelation) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelation) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self.name})

    def is_read_only(self: _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelation) -> bool:
        return False

    def compile(self: _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelation, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        del ctx
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_compound_write import SqlStatementBatch, SqlStatementBatchCategory

        create = SqlCreateTemporaryTableAsSelect(self.name, self.query, transaction_owned=True)
        ordered_batch = SqlStatementBatch(
            [
                create,
                SqlSelect(
                    select=SqlStar(),
                    from_=SqlTableIdent(
                        SqlTableName("absent_publication_resource_test_table") if self.fail_after_creation else self.name,
                    ),
                ),
            ],
            category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.ORDERED_SEMANTIC,
            collect_results_per_stmt=[False, False],
        )
        # Compound code generation nests semantic batches. The outer batch must
        # not hide transaction-owned relations from the executor.
        grammar = (
            SqlStatementBatch(
                [ordered_batch],
                category=SqlStatementBatchCategory.ORDERED_SEMANTIC,
                collect_results_per_stmt=[False],
            )
            if self.batched
            else create
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=grammar,
            closed_post_op=literal_post_op(None),
            allow_empty_provenance_manifest=True,
        )


class _ReadOutcome(StrEnum):
    SUCCESS = "success"
    FAILURE = "failure"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


class _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelationInRead(_CreateOwnedTemporaryRelation):
    """Create connection-local state without declaring an application write."""

    def tables_written(
        self: _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelationInRead,
    ) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def is_read_only(self: _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelationInRead) -> bool:
        return True

    def scheduling_effects(
        self: _CreateOwnedTemporaryRelationInRead,
    ) -> frozenset[SchedulingEffect]:
        return frozenset({SchedulingEffect.REQUIRES_EXECUTOR_TEMPORARY_RELATION})

@pytest.mark.parametrize("fail", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("batched", [False, True])
def test_owned_temporary_relation_released_at_transaction_terminal(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    fail: bool,
    batched: bool,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    name = SqlTableName("publication_owned_temp_probe")
    captured = SqlSelect(select=[SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam("captured"), SqlAliasName("marker"))])
    read = SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(name))
    persistent = SqlSelect(select=[SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam("persistent"), SqlAliasName("marker"))])
    execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlCreateTable(SqlTableIdent(name), as_select=persistent))
    execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlCommit())
    callbacks = 0

    def write(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        nonlocal callbacks
        callbacks += 1
        plan = txn.plan()
        assert isinstance(plan, BaseServerPlan)
        plan.add_step(_CreateOwnedTemporaryRelation(name, captured, batched=batched))
        plan.execute()
        assert fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, read)[0][0] == "captured"
        if fail:
            raise RuntimeError("injected publication failure")

    if fail:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected publication failure"):
            db_connection.session(system_session_id).write(fn=write)
    else:
        db_connection.session(system_session_id).write(fn=write)
    assert callbacks == 1
    assert isinstance(db_connection, TransactionTemporaryRelationOwner)
    assert not db_connection._has_transaction_temporary_relations()
    assert fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, read)[0][0] == "persistent", (
        "A transaction terminal leaked its owned temporary relation"
    )

type ScopedReadModels = tuple[
    type[PolymorphicObjectRow[SysId]],
    type[PolymorphicObjectRow[SysId]],
    type[PolymorphicObjectRow[SysId]],
]


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def scoped_read_models() -> Iterator[ScopedReadModels]:
    @register_table(plural="scoped_read_rows", singular="scoped_read_row")
    class ScopedReadRow(PolymorphicObjectRow[SysId], concrete_base=True):
        value: str

    class OwnedReadSubtype(ScopedReadRow):
        owned_value: str | None = None

    class UnownedReadSubtype(ScopedReadRow):
        unowned_value: str | None = None

    try:
        yield ScopedReadRow, OwnedReadSubtype, UnownedReadSubtype
    finally:
        for model in (UnownedReadSubtype, OwnedReadSubtype, ScopedReadRow):
            unregister_table(model)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("backend", [BackendType.SQLITE, BackendType.POSTGRES, BackendType.MARIADB])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("terminal", ["dependency_ref", "first", "many", "one"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("include_sibling", [False, True])
def test_select_one_default_publication_excludes_unowned_subtype_fields(
    backend: BackendType, scoped_read_models: ScopedReadModels, terminal: str,
    include_sibling: bool,
) -> None:
    base_model, owned_model, unowned_model = scoped_read_models
    profile = make_backend_profile(backend)
    catalog = build_planning_catalog(
        [base_model, owned_model, *([unowned_model] if include_sibling else [])],
        backend_type=backend,
    )
    read_metadata = catalog.read_metadata_for_model(base_model)
    expected = read_metadata.projection_for(READ_FLAVOR_QUERY_ROWS).cte_output_columns
    assert "owned_value" in expected
    assert ("unowned_value" in expected) is include_sibling
    assert base_model not in read_metadata.polymorphic_subtypes
    assert (unowned_model in read_metadata.polymorphic_subtypes) is include_sibling
    context_lowering = make_lowering_context(profile, planning_catalog=catalog)
    if terminal == "dependency_ref":
        intent = SelectOneIntent[PolymorphicObjectRow[SysId]](
            ServerPlanRefId("scoped_select_one"),
            base_model,
            ServerRefs.scalar(SysId.new()),
            _SelectOneConfig(
                permission_bypass=True,
                publish_raw_rows=True,
                raw_rows_owner="dependency_ref",
            ),
        )
        steps = intent.lower(context_lowering)
    else:
        query_spec = build_select_one_query_spec(
            base_model, sys_id=SysId.new(), permission_grammar=None,
        )
        if terminal == "many":
            many_intent = QueryExecuteIntent[PolymorphicObjectRow[SysId]](
                ServerPlanRefId("scoped_many"), base_model,
                _QueryExecuteConfig(query_spec=query_spec, raw_mode=True),
            )
            steps = many_intent.lower(context_lowering)
        elif terminal == "one":
            one_intent = QueryExecuteOneIntent[PolymorphicObjectRow[SysId]](
                ServerPlanRefId("scoped_one"), base_model,
                _QuerySingleResultConfig(query_spec=query_spec, raw_mode=True),
            )
            steps = one_intent.lower(context_lowering)
        else:
            first_intent = QueryFirstIntent[PolymorphicObjectRow[SysId]](
                ServerPlanRefId("scoped_first"), base_model,
                _QuerySingleResultConfig(query_spec=query_spec, raw_mode=True),
            )
            steps = first_intent.lower(context_lowering)
        assert query_spec.default_projection_columns is None
    raw_step = next(step for step in steps if isinstance(step, SqlRelationPublisherStep))
    assert raw_step.cte_publication_contract().columns == expected
    context = make_compilation_context(profile, planning_catalog=catalog)
    compiled = raw_step.compile(context)
    assert compiled.output_shape is not None
    assert compiled.output_shape.cte_output_columns == expected
    ir = compiled.materialize_ir()
    assert ir is not None
    assert context.dialect is not None
    sql, _params = render_to_sql(ir.grammar, context.dialect)
    assert ("unowned_value" in sql) is include_sibling
    assert "owned_value" in sql


@pytest.mark.parametrize("backend", [BackendType.SQLITE, BackendType.POSTGRES, BackendType.MARIADB])

    backend: BackendType, scoped_large_read_models: ScopedReadModels,
) -> None:
    base_model, owned_model, _unowned_model = scoped_large_read_models

    query_spec = build_select_one_query_spec(
        base_model, sys_id=SysId.new(), permission_grammar=None,
    )
    steps = QueryExecuteIntent[PolymorphicObjectRow[SysId]](
        ServerPlanRefId("scoped_large_read"), base_model,
        _QueryExecuteConfig(query_spec=query_spec, raw_mode=False),
    ).lower(make_lowering_context(profile, planning_catalog=catalog))

        step.cte_publication_contract()
        for step in steps

    assert all("unowned_value" not in contract.columns for contract in contracts)

    backend: BackendType, scoped_read_models: ScopedReadModels,
) -> None:
    base_model, owned_model, _unowned_model = scoped_read_models
    catalog = build_catalog_delta_for_models([base_model, owned_model], backend_type=backend)
    registry = get_type_registry(base_model)

    try:
        registry._test_unregister(owned_model.__name__)

def test_pressure_contract_reports_run_and_byte_dimensions_together() -> None:
    policy = USearchCompactionPolicy(
        level_zero_run_trigger=2,
        level_zero_byte_trigger=100,
        level_zero_stop_runs=3,
        level_zero_stop_bytes=200,
    )
    with pytest.raises(NativeSearchBudgetExceededError) as caught:
        validate_usearch_append_pressure(level_zero_runs=4, level_zero_bytes=201, policy=policy)
    assert caught.value.exceeded_dimensions == {
        PhysicalLimit.NATIVE_ACTIVE_RUNS: (4, 3),
        PhysicalLimit.NATIVE_COMPACTION_BACKLOG_BYTES: (201, 200),
    }


@pytest.mark.parametrize("dimension", ["runs", "bytes"])
def test_public_append_stops_before_level_zero_backlog_exceeds_policy(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection, dimension: str, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    _, branch = create_test_revision(
        db_connection,
        USearchScopeDomain,
        workspace_id=WorkspaceId.default(),
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
    )
    original = get_usearch_compaction_policy()
    try:
        _write_document(
            db_connection,
            branch,
            connection_id=ConnectionId(f"pressure-{dimension}-0"),
            title="pressure-0",
            embedding=[1.0, 0.0],
        )

        def active_runs(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> list[USearchRun]:
            return [run for run in txn.query(USearchRun).execute() if run.retired_epoch is None]

        first = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=active_runs)
        assert len(first) == 1
        first_bytes = len(first[0].payload)
        if dimension == "runs":
            policy = USearchCompactionPolicy(
                level_zero_run_trigger=2,
                level_zero_byte_trigger=1,
                level_zero_stop_runs=3,
                level_zero_stop_bytes=1024 * 1024,
            )
            allowed = 3
        else:
            policy = USearchCompactionPolicy(
                level_zero_run_trigger=2,
                level_zero_byte_trigger=1,
                level_zero_stop_runs=100,
                level_zero_stop_bytes=first_bytes + 1,
            )
            allowed = 1
        configure_usearch_compaction_policy(policy)
        if dimension == "runs":
            for number in (1, 2):
                _write_document(
                    db_connection,
                    branch,
                    connection_id=ConnectionId(f"pressure-runs-{number}"),
                    title=f"pressure-{number}",
                    embedding=[float(number + 1), 0.0],
                )
        with pytest.raises(NativeSearchBudgetExceededError):
            _write_document(
                db_connection,
                branch,
                connection_id=ConnectionId(f"pressure-{dimension}-blocked"),
                title="pressure-blocked",
                embedding=[3.0, 0.0],
            )
        assert len(db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=active_runs)) == allowed
    finally:
        configure_usearch_compaction_policy(original)


def test_public_query_never_starts_compaction(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    _, branch = create_test_revision(
        db_connection,
        USearchScopeDomain,
        workspace_id=WorkspaceId.default(),
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
    )
    _write_document(
        db_connection,
        branch,
        connection_id=ConnectionId("query-no-compaction"),
        title="query-no-compaction",
        embedding=[1.0, 0.0],
    )

    def forbidden(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> None:
        del args, kwargs
        raise AssertionError("A public query started compaction")

    monkeypatch.setattr(_native, "compact_runs", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(_native, "compact_runs_partitioned", forbidden)

    def search(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> list[str]:
        rows = (
            txn.cross_branch(USearchScopeDocument, WorkspaceId.default())
            .vector_search(
                "content",
                [1.0, 0.0],
                k=1,
            )
            .execute()
        )
        return [row.title for row in rows]

    assert db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=search) == ["query-no-compaction"]
