@pytest.mark.parametrize("commit", [False, True])
def test_reclamation_deletes_members_before_retired_payloads_and_obeys_rollback(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection, commit: bool, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    _, branch = create_test_revision(
        db_connection,
        USearchScopeDomain,
        workspace_id=WorkspaceId.default(),
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
    )
    _write_document(
        db_connection,
        branch,
        connection_id=ConnectionId(f"reclaim-{commit}"),
        title="reclaim",
        embedding=[1.0, 0.0],
    )

    def retire(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> SysId:
        run = txn.query(USearchRun).execute()[0]
        txn.update(USearchRun, run.model_copy(update={"retired_epoch": run.published_epoch + 1}))
        return run.artifact_id

    artifact_id = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=retire)

    def reclaim(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> LazyResult[int]:
        result = plan_usearch_run_reclamation(
            txn,
            artifact_id,
            oldest_retained_epoch=3,
        )
        if not commit:
            txn.rollback_lazy()
        return result

    removed = run_write_plan_workflow(
        db_connection,
        SyncWritePlanWorkflow[int](
            session_id=SessionId.schema(),
            build=reclaim,
            commit=commit,
        ),
    )
    assert removed == 1

    def remaining(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> tuple[int, int]:
        return len(txn.query(USearchRun).execute()), len(txn.query(USearchRunMember).execute())

    assert db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=remaining) == ((0, 0) if commit else (1, 1))


def test_reclamation_preserves_active_and_retained_epoch_runs(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    _, branch = create_test_revision(
        db_connection,
        USearchScopeDomain,
        workspace_id=WorkspaceId.default(),
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
    )
    for number in range(3):
        _write_document(
            db_connection,
            branch,
            connection_id=ConnectionId(f"reclaim-floor-{number}"),
            title=f"reclaim-floor-{number}",
            embedding=[float(number + 1), 0.0],
        )

    def retire(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> SysId:
        runs = sorted(txn.query(USearchRun).execute(), key=lambda run: run.published_epoch)
        txn.update(USearchRun, runs[0].model_copy(update={"retired_epoch": 2}))
        txn.update(USearchRun, runs[1].model_copy(update={"retired_epoch": 4}))
        return runs[0].artifact_id

    artifact_id = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=retire)

    def reclaim(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> LazyResult[int]:
        return plan_usearch_run_reclamation(txn, artifact_id, oldest_retained_epoch=3)

    assert (
        run_write_plan_workflow(
            db_connection,
            SyncWritePlanWorkflow[int](
                session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                build=reclaim,
                commit=True,
            ),
        )
        == 1
    )

    def remaining(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> tuple[list[int | None], list[int]]:
        runs = sorted(txn.query(USearchRun).execute(), key=lambda run: run.published_epoch)
        members = sorted(member.native_key for member in txn.query(USearchRunMember).execute())
        return [run.retired_epoch for run in runs], members

    assert db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=remaining) == ([4, None], [2, 3])

            versioning_domains=TEST_BOOTSTRAP_VERSIONING_DOMAINS,
            contributors=TEST_BOOTSTRAP_CONTRIBUTORS,
        )

        def old_reader(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> None:
            old_runs = list(txn.query(USearchRun).execute())
            old_members = list(txn.query(USearchRunMember).execute())
            artifact_id = old_runs[0].artifact_id

            def retire(writer_txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
                run = writer_txn.query(USearchRun).execute()[0]
                writer_txn.update(
                    USearchRun,
                    run.model_copy(update={"retired_epoch": run.published_epoch + 1}),
                )

            writer.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=retire)

            def reclaim(writer_txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> LazyResult[int]:
                return plan_usearch_run_reclamation(
                    writer_txn,
                    artifact_id,
                    oldest_retained_epoch=3,
                )

            assert (
                run_write_plan_workflow(
                    writer,
                    SyncWritePlanWorkflow[int](
                        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
                        build=reclaim,
                        commit=True,
                    ),
                )
                == 1
            )
            assert list(txn.query(USearchRun).execute()) == old_runs
            assert list(txn.query(USearchRunMember).execute()) == old_members

        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=old_reader)
    finally:
        writer.close()

    def current(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> tuple[int, int]:
        return len(txn.query(USearchRun).execute()), len(txn.query(USearchRunMember).execute())

    assert db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=current) == (0, 0)

class _DeferredMetadataPermissionError(DbPermissionError, BatchResultCompletionRequired):
    """Defer permission refusal until earlier batch assertions are decoded."""

    def __init__(self, message: str = "") -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self._completed: dict[str, object] = {}
        self._receipt: NativePipelineExecutionReceipt | None = None

    def capture_completed_batch_results(self, completed: Mapping[str, object]) -> None:
        self._completed.update(completed)

    def completed_batch_results(self) -> Mapping[str, object]:
        return self._completed

    def capture_pipeline_execution_receipt(self, receipt: NativePipelineExecutionReceipt) -> None:
        self._receipt = receipt

    def pipeline_execution_receipt(self) -> NativePipelineExecutionReceipt | None:
        return self._receipt


class MetadataPolicyAssertionStep(ReturnValueStep[None]):
    def __init__(
        self: MetadataPolicyAssertionStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        session_id: SessionId | None,
        action: Literal["read", "delete", "update"],
        permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id, None)
        self._model = model
        self._actor = session_id
        self._action = action
        self._permission_context_ref = permission_context_ref
        self._permission_context_type = permission_context_type

    def execution_role(self: MetadataPolicyAssertionStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: MetadataPolicyAssertionStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def scheduling_effects(self: MetadataPolicyAssertionStep) -> frozenset[SchedulingEffect]:
        return frozenset()

    @abstractmethod
    def _target_filter(self: MetadataPolicyAssertionStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> SqlRenderable:
        """Select the metadata rows that require authority."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    def tables_read(self: MetadataPolicyAssertionStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({get_table_name(self._model)})

    def _permission_context_dependencies(self: MetadataPolicyAssertionStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        if self._permission_context_ref is None:
            return frozenset()
        return frozenset({self._permission_context_ref})

    def compile(self: MetadataPolicyAssertionStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        table = get_table_name(self._model)
        actor = self._actor if self._actor is not None else compilation_session_id(ctx)
        if actor is None:
            raise PermissionCompilationError("Metadata authorization requires an originating session")
        plan = get_query_permission_plan(self._model, action=self._action)
        denied: SqlRenderable
        if (
            isinstance(actor, SessionId)
            and (actor.is_schema_session())
            and plan is not None
            and not plan.filters_session(actor)
            and self._permission_context_ref is None
        ):
            denied = SqlParam(False)
        else:
            session_vars = permission_session_vars_from_context(
                ctx,
                self._permission_context_ref,
                self._permission_context_type,
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                result_contract="authorize metadata from the bound session context",
            )
            predicate = compile_permission_where_with_user_expr(
                self._model,
                None if session_vars is not None else actor,
                session_user_id_expr(actor, ctx),
                table_alias=str(table),
                action=self._action,
                session_id_sql=session_id_expr(actor, ctx),
                session_vars=session_vars,
                compilation_context=ctx,
            )
            denied = SqlParam(True) if predicate is None else sql_not(SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", [predicate, SqlParam(False)]))
        violations = SqlSelect(
            select=[SqlParam(1)],
            from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(table)),
            where=sql_and(
                self._target_filter(ctx),
                denied,
            ),
        )
        message = f"Metadata operation requires {self._action.upper()} authority on {table}"
        shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=no_rows_assertion_query(violations, error_message=message),
            output_shape=shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(shape),
            needs_returning=True,
            column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
            closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(
                message,
                exc_type=(
                    _DeferredMetadataPermissionError
                    if ctx.uses_bound_transaction_principal
                    else DbPermissionError
                ),
            ),
            auxiliary_ctes=collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.dependencies()),
        )


class MetadataAuthorityStep(MetadataPolicyAssertionStep):
    def __init__(
        self: MetadataAuthorityStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        row_id: SysId | ScalarServerRef[SysId],
        session_id: SessionId | None,
        action: Literal["read", "delete", "update"],
        permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(
            ref_id,
            model=model,
            session_id=session_id,
            action=action,
            permission_context_ref=permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=permission_context_type,
        )
        self._row_id = row_id

    def dependencies(self: MetadataAuthorityStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        row_dependencies = self._row_id.dependencies() if isinstance(self._row_id, ScalarServerRef) else frozenset()
        return row_dependencies | self._permission_context_dependencies()

    def _target_filter(self: MetadataAuthorityStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> SqlRenderable:
        return SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(self._model, DynamicFieldName("sys_id")))),
            BinaryOp.EQ,
            lower_scalar_source(self._row_id, ctx),
        )

@pytest.mark.parametrize("ambient_system", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("policy_case", ["unknown", "insert-only-collision", "insert-into-missing-target", "deleted-source-unreadable"])
def test_policy_denials_reject_replay(policy_case: str, ambient_system: bool) -> None:
    actor = SessionId.new()
    branch = BranchId.new()
    spec = _RevertDiffCteSpec(
        sparse_table="unused",
        data_columns=("name",),
        from_revision="before",
        to_revision="after",
        diff_branch_id=branch,
        old_diff_branch_id=branch,
        diff_uses_write_branch=True,
        old_diff_uses_write_branch=True,
        revision_table="sys_revisions",
        revision_parents_table="sys_revision_parents",
    )
    step = ReplayPermissionStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("guard"),
        model=_ReplayOwnedRow,
        domain=VersioningDomain,
        diff_spec=spec,
        branch=branch,
        session=actor,
        after=ServerPlanRefId("ensure"),
    )
    target = SqlSelect(
        select=[SqlSelectAlias(SqlParam("object"), SqlAliasName("sys_id"))], where=SqlParam(policy_case != "insert-into-missing-target")
    )

    class Target:
        grammar = target

    def policy_for(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> SqlParam:
        denied_action = "read" if policy_case == "deleted-source-unreadable" else "update"
        return SqlParam(None if policy_case == "unknown" else kwargs["action"] != denied_action)

    with (
        patch(
            "impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_diff_revert._build_revert_diff_cte",
            return_value=_FixedDiff(
                "DELETED"
                if policy_case == "deleted-source-unreadable"
                else "MODIFIED"
                if policy_case == "insert-into-missing-target"
                else "ADDED"
            ),
        ),
        patch("impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.replay_permission.compile_versioned_query", return_value=Target()),
        patch("impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.replay_permission.compile_permission_where_with_user_expr", side_effect=policy_for),
    ):
        compiled = step.compile(make_compilation_context(session_id=SessionId.system() if ambient_system else actor))
    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    dialect = SqliteDialect()
    target_renders: list[SqlSelect] = []
    original_render = SqlSelect.render

    def render(query: SqlSelect, dialect: SqliteDialect):
        if query is target:
            target_renders.append(query)
        return original_render(query, dialect)

    with patch.object(SqlSelect, "render", autospec=True, side_effect=render):
        sql, params = compiled.grammar.render(dialect).to_sql(dialect)
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(":memory:")) as connection, connection:
        connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        values = tuple(str(value) if isinstance(value, SessionId | BranchId | UUID) else value for value in params)
        row = connection.execute(sql, values).fetchone()
    assert row is not None
    assert bool(row["ok"]) == (policy_case == "insert-into-missing-target")
    assert len(target_renders) == 1

def _graph_walk_node_columns(node_model: type[GraphNode[Any]]) -> tuple[SqlColumnName, ...]:
    columns = tuple(
        get_polymorphic_db_column_name(node_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in get_all_select_columns(node_model)
    )
    if any(item is not node_model for item in get_all_concrete_subtypes(node_model)) and "type_name" not in columns:
        columns = (*columns, SqlColumnName("type_name"))
    return columns


def _graph_walk_metadata_columns(node_model: type[GraphNode[Any]]) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    occupied: set[str] = set(_graph_walk_node_columns(node_model))
    selected: list[str] = []
    for base_name in ("__walk_score", "__walk_iterations", "__walk_termination"):
        candidate = base_name
        while candidate in occupied:
            candidate = f"_{candidate}"
        occupied.add(candidate)
        selected.append(candidate)
    score_column, iterations_column, termination_column = selected
    return score_column, iterations_column, termination_column


def _graph_walk_post_op(node_model: type[GraphNode[Any]]) -> CompiledPostOp:
    result_type = GraphWalkResult.__class_getitem__(node_model)
    score_type = GraphNodeScore.__class_getitem__(node_model)
    assert isinstance(result_type, type) and isinstance(score_type, type)
    return CompiledPostOp.materialize(
        ResultMaterializationSpec(
            behavior=PostOpBehavior.TERMINAL_OBJECT,
            structured_result=StructuredResultSpec(
                result_cls=result_type,
                fields=(
                    StructuredResultField(
                        "rows",
                        "rows",
                        ScalarCoercionKind.JSON,
                        structured_array=StructuredArraySpec(
                            StructuredResultSpec(
                                result_cls=score_type,
                                fields=(
                                    StructuredResultField("node", "node", model_cls=node_model),
                                    StructuredResultField("score", "score"),
                                ),
                            )
                        ),
                    ),
                    StructuredResultField("iterations", "iterations"),
                    StructuredResultField("termination", "termination"),
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )


class GraphWalkScoreStep[NodeT: GraphNode[Any]](QueryExecuteStep[dict[str, object]]):
    """Publish ordered score rows and hydrate one closed graph-walk result."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        node_model: type[NodeT],
        node_relation_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        program: GraphWalkRelationProgram,
        result_limit: int | None,
        permission_dependency_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId],
        origin: GraphWalkIntentOrigin,
    ) -> None:
        self._walk_node_model = node_model
        self._walk_origin = origin
        self._walk_metadata_columns = _graph_walk_metadata_columns(node_model)
        score_query = build_graph_walk_score_query(
            node_model=node_model,
            node_relation_ref=node_relation_ref,
            program=program,
            result_limit=result_limit,
        )
        query_spec = build_graph_walk_envelope_query(
            node_model=node_model,
            score_query=score_query,
            metadata_columns=self._walk_metadata_columns,
            ref_id=ref_id,
        )
        super().__init__(
            ref_id,
            cast("type[Any]", node_model),
            _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                query_spec=cast("Any", query_spec),
                raw_mode=True,
                permission_dependency_refs=permission_dependency_refs,
            ),
        )

    def result_cardinality(self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def step_tags(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        tags = {
            "read",
            "query",
            "execute",
            "graph",
            "algorithm",
            "personalized-random-walk",
        }
        if self._walk_origin is GraphWalkIntentOrigin.PAGERANK:
            tags.add("pagerank")
        return frozenset(tags)

    def cte_relation_role(self) -> str:
        return "graph_walk_score"

    def compile(self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[Sequence[dict[str, object]]]:
        compiled = super().compile(ctx)
        return replace(
            compiled,
            closed_post_op=_graph_walk_post_op(self._walk_node_model),
        )


def build_graph_walk_score_query[NodeT: GraphNode[Any]](
    *,
    node_model: type[NodeT],
    node_relation_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
    program: GraphWalkRelationProgram,
    result_limit: int | None,
) -> QuerySpec[NodeT]:
    """Join the database-selected rank to selected nodes before hydration."""
    node_columns = _graph_walk_node_columns(node_model)
    score_output_column, iterations_output_column, termination_output_column = _graph_walk_metadata_columns(node_model)
    nodes = cte_source(node_model, node_relation_ref, columns=node_columns)
    rank_name = "walk_selected_rank"
    selected_rank_query = program.selected_rank_query
    rank_model: type[WalkRankRow] | type[WalkSelectedRankRow]
    rank_query: QuerySpec[WalkRankRow] | QuerySpec[WalkSelectedRankRow]
    rank_source_columns: tuple[str, ...]
    rank_columns = (
        "node_id",
        "iteration",
        "incoming_mass",
        "dangling_mass",
        "restart_contribution",
        "propagated_contribution",
        "score",
    )
    if selected_rank_query is None:
        rank_model = WalkRankRow
        rank_query = program.final_rank_query
        rank_source_columns = rank_columns
    else:
        rank_model = WalkSelectedRankRow
        rank_query = selected_rank_query
        rank_source_columns = ("node_id", "iteration", "score", "termination")
    rank = cte_source(
        rank_model,
        rank_name,
        columns=rank_source_columns,
    )
    node_id = PlanColumnRef(nodes, node_model, "sys_id")
    rank_node_id = PlanColumnRef(rank, rank_model, "node_id")
    rank_iteration = PlanColumnRef(rank, rank_model, "iteration")
    rank_score = PlanColumnRef(rank, rank_model, "score")
    rank_termination = (
        GraphWalkTermination.FIXED_ITERATIONS.value if selected_rank_query is None else PlanColumnRef(rank, rank_model, "termination")
    )
    rank_join = JoinClause(
        target_model=rank_model,
        on_left=None,
        on_right=None,
        join_type="INNER",
        target_source=rank,
        left_source=nodes,
    )
    rank_join.on_predicate = PlanPredicate(node_id, "=", rank_node_id)
    return QuerySpec(
        model_cls=node_model,
        source=nodes,
        select_columns=cast(
            "Any",
            (
                *(PlanAliasedExpression(PlanColumnRef(nodes, node_model, column), column) for column in node_columns),
                PlanAliasedExpression(rank_score, score_output_column),
                PlanAliasedExpression(rank_iteration, iterations_output_column),
                PlanAliasedExpression(rank_termination, termination_output_column),
            ),
        ),
        distinct=False,
        joins=cast("Any", (rank_join,)),
        filters=cast("Any", ()),
        order_by=cast("Any", ((rank_score, "DESC"), (rank_node_id, "ASC"))),
        limit=result_limit,
        offset=None,
        group_by=cast("Any", ()),
        aggregations=cast("Any", ()),
        having=cast("Any", ()),
        window_functions=cast("Any", ()),
        ctes=(
            QueryCteDefinition(
                rank_name,
                rank_query,
                columns=rank_source_columns,
                materialized=True,
            ),
        ),
        preserve_non_join_projection=True,
        projection_output_aliases=(
            *node_columns,
            score_output_column,
            iterations_output_column,
            termination_output_column,
        ),
        permission_state=QueryPermissionState.BYPASS,
    )


def build_graph_walk_envelope_query[NodeT: GraphNode[Any]](
    *,
    node_model: type[NodeT],
    score_query: QuerySpec[NodeT],
    metadata_columns: tuple[str, str, str],
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
) -> QuerySpec[NodeT]:
    """Aggregate selected scores into one header, including an empty graph."""
    from l1000_schema.typed_field import CAST, Expression, JSON_AGG, JSON_BUILD_OBJECT
    from l2060_query_builder.window import WindowFunction, WindowSpec
    from l2070_batching.server_ref import physical_server_plan_ref_alias

    node_columns = _graph_walk_node_columns(node_model)
    score_column, iterations_column, termination_column = metadata_columns
    columns = (*node_columns, *metadata_columns)
    ordinal = "__walk_ordinal"
    while ordinal in columns:
        ordinal = f"_{ordinal}"
    ordered_columns = (*columns, ordinal)
    ordered = replace(
        score_query,
        window_functions=[
            *(score_query.window_functions or ()),
            (WindowFunction(name="ROW_NUMBER").over(WindowSpec(order_by=list(score_query.order_by or ()))), ordinal),
        ],
        projection_output_aliases=ordered_columns,
    )
    name = str(physical_server_plan_ref_alias(ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}.score_rows")))
    source = cte_source(node_model, name, columns=ordered_columns)
    node_args: list[Expression[Any]] = []
    for column in node_columns:
        node_args.extend((Expression(value=column), Expression(field=column)))
    entry = JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
        "node",
        JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(*node_args),
        "score",
        Expression(field=score_column),
    )
    rows = JSON_AGG(entry, order_by=Expression(field=ordinal))
    iterations = Expression(
        function="COALESCE",
        args=[Expression(function="MAX", args=[Expression(field=iterations_column)]), 0],
    )
    termination = Expression(
        function="COALESCE",
        args=[Expression(function="MAX", args=[Expression(field=termination_column)]), GraphWalkTermination.EMPTY_GRAPH.value],
    )
    return QuerySpec(
        model_cls=node_model,
        source=source,
        select_columns=[
            rows.as_(SchemaObjectName("rows")),
            CAST(iterations, "BIGINT").as_(SchemaObjectName("iterations")),
            termination.as_(SchemaObjectName("termination")),
        ],
        distinct=False,
        joins=[],
        filters=[],
        order_by=[],
        limit=None,
        offset=None,
        group_by=[],
        aggregations=[],
        having=[],
        window_functions=[],
        ctes=(QueryCteDefinition(name, ordered, columns=ordered_columns, materialized=True),),
        preserve_non_join_projection=True,
        projection_output_aliases=("rows", "iterations", "termination"),
        projection_model_cls=GraphWalkEnvelopeRow,
        permission_state=QueryPermissionState.BYPASS,
    )


__all__ = [
    "GraphWalkScoreStep",
    "build_graph_walk_score_query",
]

def _lower_intent_case(
    intent_case: str,
    scenario: _PermissionScenario,
) -> tuple[list[ServerPlanStep[Any]], _PermissionTerminal, ServerPlanRefId]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.insert_from_query import (
        _InsertFromQueryConfig,
        _VersionedInsertFromQueryIntent,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query import (
        QueryCountIntent,
        QueryExecuteIntent,
        QueryExecuteOneIntent,
        QueryExecuteRequiredOneIntent,
        QueryFirstIntent,
        QueryFirstValueIntent,
        SelectOneIntent,
        SelectOneRequiredIntent,
        _QueryExecuteConfig,
        _QueryFirstValueConfig,
        _QuerySingleResultConfig,
        _SelectOneConfig,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_query_extended import (
        QueryExistsIntent,
        _QueryExistsConfig,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

    model_cls = scenario.model_cls
    ref_id = ServerPlanRefId(f"{intent_case}_{scenario.name}")
    spec = _query_spec(model_cls)
    ctx = _ctx(scenario.session_id)
    permission_owner_ref = ref_id

    if intent_case == "execute":
        intent: Any = QueryExecuteIntent(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            _QueryExecuteConfig(query_spec=spec),
        )
    elif intent_case == "first_value":
        intent = QueryFirstValueIntent(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            _QueryFirstValueConfig(query_spec=spec, column="name"),
        )
    elif intent_case == "first":
        intent = QueryFirstIntent(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            _QuerySingleResultConfig(query_spec=spec, raw_mode=False),
        )
    elif intent_case == "execute_one":
        intent = QueryExecuteOneIntent(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            _QuerySingleResultConfig(query_spec=spec, raw_mode=False),
        )
    elif intent_case == "execute_required_one":
        intent = QueryExecuteRequiredOneIntent(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            _QuerySingleResultConfig(query_spec=spec, raw_mode=False),
        )
        permission_owner_ref = ref_id
    elif intent_case == "count":
        intent = QueryCountIntent(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            _QueryExecuteConfig(query_spec=spec),
        )
    elif intent_case == "exists":
        intent = QueryExistsIntent(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            _QueryExistsConfig(query_spec=spec),
        )
    elif intent_case in {"select_one_write", "select_one_read", "select_one_required"}:
        select_one = SelectOneIntent(
            ref_id,
            model_cls,
            ServerRefs.scalar(SysId.new()),
            _SelectOneConfig(),
        )
        if intent_case == "select_one_required":
            intent = SelectOneRequiredIntent(
                ref_id,
                model_cls,
                ServerRefs.scalar(SysId.new()),
            )
            permission_owner_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{ref_id}_inner")
        else:
            intent = select_one
        if intent_case == "select_one_write":
            ctx = _select_one_write_ctx(scenario.session_id)
        elif intent_case == "select_one_required":
            ctx = _select_one_write_ctx(scenario.session_id)
        elif intent_case == "select_one_read":
            ctx = _ctx(scenario.session_id, select_one_read=True)
    elif intent_case == "insert_from_query":
        intent = _VersionedInsertFromQueryIntent(
            ref_id,
            config=_InsertFromQueryConfig(
                model_cls=model_cls,
                source_model=model_cls,
                exprs=(),
                order_by=(),
                limit=None,
                offset=None,
                replacements=(),
                excluded_fields=(),
                source_query_spec=spec,
            ),
        )
    else:
        raise AssertionError(f"Unhandled intent case: {intent_case}")

    steps = list(intent.lower(ctx))
    terminals = [
        step
        for step in steps
        if not isinstance(step, SessionUserIdStep)
        and isinstance(step, _PermissionTerminal)
        and step.ref_id == permission_owner_ref
    ]
    assert len(terminals) == 1, (
        f"{intent_case} must lower to exactly one primary permission-consuming terminal; "
        f"got {[type(step).__name__ for step in steps]}"
    )
    return steps, terminals[0], ServerPlanRefId(f"{permission_owner_ref}_resolve_uid")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("scenario", _PERMISSION_SCENARIOS, ids=lambda scenario: scenario.name)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("intent_case", _INTENT_CASES)
def test_versioned_query_intent_permission_prerequisites_are_scheme_authoritative(
    intent_case: str,
    scenario: _PermissionScenario,
) -> None:
    """The registered scheme, not the session UUID or lowerer, decides permission shape."""
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.session_user_id import SessionUserIdStep

    scheme = get_permission_scheme(scenario.model_cls)
    assert type(scheme) is scenario.scheme_cls

    steps, terminal, expected_user_ref = _lower_intent_case(intent_case, scenario)
    user_steps = [step for step in steps if isinstance(step, SessionUserIdStep)]

    if not scenario.needs_user_prerequisite:
        assert user_steps == []
        assert terminal._user_id_ref_id is None
        assert str(expected_user_ref) not in terminal.dependencies()
        assert str(expected_user_ref) not in terminal.sql_visible_dependencies()
    else:
        assert len(user_steps) == 1
        user_step = next(step for step in user_steps if step.ref_id == expected_user_ref)
        assert terminal._user_id_ref_id == expected_user_ref
        assert str(expected_user_ref) in terminal.dependencies()
        assert str(expected_user_ref) in terminal.sql_visible_dependencies()
        assert user_step.tables_read() == frozenset({"sys_sessions"})
        assert user_step.always_publishes_executor_visible_binding() is True
        assert user_step.supports_sql_batch_transport() is True
        assert user_step.requires_prior_step_boundary() is False

        contract = user_step.cte_publication_contract()
        assert contract is not None
        assert contract.columns == ("user_id",)
        assert contract.column_type_hints.uuid_columns == frozenset({"user_id"})
        assert contract.model_cls is not None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("intent_case", _INTENT_CASES)
def test_versioned_query_intent_lowering_does_not_classify_session_ids(
    intent_case: str,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    """Lowering must consume a scheme-owned decision instead of recognizing reserved UUIDs."""

    def reject_session_id_shortcut(*_args: Any, **_kwargs: Any) -> bool:
        raise AssertionError("permission lowering must not classify session IDs")

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "l2050_transaction.permission_scheme_introspection.is_system_or_schema_session",
        reject_session_id_shortcut,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement.is_system_or_schema_session",
        reject_session_id_shortcut,
    )
    steps, terminal, expected_user_ref = _lower_intent_case(
        intent_case,
        _PERMISSION_SCENARIOS[0],
    )

    assert not any(str(step.ref_id) == str(expected_user_ref) for step in steps)
    assert terminal._user_id_ref_id is None

class PublishSnapshotEmbeddingRefsStep(NonPublishingStep[None]):
    """Retire or copy references atomically with one published source revision."""

    def __init__(
        self: Self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        ref_table: SqlTableName,
        source_table: SqlTableName,
        index_name: str,
        sparse_table: SqlTableName,
        data_columns: tuple[str, ...],
        source_branch: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
        target_branch: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
        source_revision: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId] | None,
        base_revision: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId] | None,
        target_revision: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId] | None,
        result_revision: ScalarServerRef[RevisionId],
        revision_table: SqlTableName,
        revision_parents_table: SqlTableName,
        after_ref: ServerPlanRefId,
        retire: bool,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._ref_table = ref_table
        self._source_table = source_table
        self._index_name = index_name
        self._sparse_table = sparse_table
        self._data_columns = data_columns
        self._target_branch = target_branch
        self._result_revision = result_revision
        self._after_ref = after_ref
        self._retire = retire
        self._identity = SysId.new()
        self._revision_table = revision_table
        self._revision_parents_table = revision_parents_table
        self._revision_tables = frozenset({str(revision_table), str(revision_parents_table)})
        self._source_branch = source_branch
        self._source_revision = source_revision
        self._base_revision = base_revision
        self._target_revision = target_revision

    @property
    def level(self: Self) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: Self) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.NONE

    def dependencies(self: Self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._after_ref)}) | frozenset(
            dependency
            for value in (
                self._source_branch,
                self._target_branch,
                self._source_revision,
                self._base_revision,
                self._target_revision,
                self._result_revision,
            )
            if value is not None
            for dependency in value.dependencies()
        )

    def tables_read(self: Self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._revision_tables | frozenset({str(self._ref_table), str(self._sparse_table)})

    def tables_written(self: Self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self._ref_table)})

    def is_read_only(self: Self) -> bool:
        return False

    def step_tags(self: Self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "versioning", "embedding"})

    def compile(self: Self, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        def col(alias: str, name: str) -> SqlColumnRef:
            return SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), qualifier=SqlAliasName(alias))

        revision = SqlCast(
            lower_scalar_source(self._result_revision, ctx, default_field="v"),
            parse_cast_target_type("UUID"),
        )
        branch = SqlCast(
            lower_scalar_source(self._target_branch, ctx, default_field="v"),
            parse_cast_target_type("UUID"),
        )
        replaced = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList([col("new", "sys_id")]),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(self._sparse_table), SqlAliasName("new")),
            where=sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(col("new", "branch_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, branch),
                SqlBinaryOp(col("new", "sys_valid_from_revision_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, revision),
            ),
        )
        if self._retire:
            return CompiledStep(
                grammar=SqlDelete(
                    SqlTableIdent(self._ref_table),
                    where=sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_table")),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlParam(str(self._source_table)),
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("field_name")),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlParam(self._index_name),
                        ),
                        SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, branch),
                        SqlIsNull(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("revision_id"))),
                        SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("source_id")), replaced),
                    ),
                ),
                needs_returning=False,
            )
        parent_revision = SqlSubquery(
            SqlSelect(
                select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("parent_revision_sys_id"))]),
                from_=SqlTableIdent(self._revision_table),
                where=SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), BinaryOp.EQ, revision),
            )
        )
        diff = SqlThreeWayDiffCte(
            lca_revision_raw=parent_revision
            if self._base_revision is None
            else lower_scalar_source(self._base_revision, ctx, default_field="v"),
            source_tip_raw=parent_revision
            if self._source_revision is None
            else lower_scalar_source(self._source_revision, ctx, default_field="v"),
            target_tip_raw=parent_revision
            if self._target_revision is None
            else lower_scalar_source(self._target_revision, ctx, default_field="v"),
            sparse_table=self._sparse_table,
            source_branch_id_raw=lower_scalar_source(self._source_branch, ctx, default_field="v"),
            target_branch_id_raw=branch,
            data_columns=list(self._data_columns),
            revision_table=self._revision_table,
            revision_parents_table=self._revision_parents_table,
        )
        definitions, snapshot_table = diff.split_source_snapshot()
        copied = _EMBEDDING_REF_PAYLOAD_COLUMNS
        source = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlSelectList(
                [
                    SqlUuidFromParentAndOrdinal(
                        SqlParam(str(self._identity)), SqlWindow(SqlFuncCall("ROW_NUMBER", []))
                    ),
                    SqlCase(
                        whens=[(SqlIsNull(col("ref", "branch_id")), SqlParam(None))], else_=branch
                    ),
                    SqlCase(
                        whens=[(SqlIsNull(col("ref", "revision_id")), SqlParam(None))],
                        else_=revision,
                    ),
                    *(col("ref", name) for name in copied),
                ]
            ),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(self._ref_table), SqlAliasName("ref")),
            joins=[
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.INNER,
                    SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(snapshot_table), SqlAliasName("old")),
                    sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(col("ref", "source_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, col("old", "sys_id")),
                        sql_or(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                col("ref", "revision_id"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                col("old", "sys_valid_from_revision_id"),
                            ),
                            sql_and(
                                SqlIsNull(col("ref", "revision_id")),
                                SqlBinaryOp(
                                    col("ref", "branch_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, col("old", "branch_id")
                                ),
                            ),
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
                SqlJoin(
                    JoinKind.INNER,
                    SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(self._sparse_table), SqlAliasName("new")),
                    sql_and(
                        SqlBinaryOp(col("new", "sys_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, col("old", "sys_id")),
                        SqlBinaryOp(col("new", "branch_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, branch),
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            col("new", "sys_valid_from_revision_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, revision
                        ),
                        *(
                            sql_or(
                                SqlBinaryOp(col("new", name), BinaryOp.EQ, col("old", name)),
                                sql_and(SqlIsNull(col("new", name)), SqlIsNull(col("old", name))),
                            )
                            for name in self._data_columns
                        ),
                    ),
                ),
            ],
            where=sql_and(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    col("ref", "source_table"), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(str(self._source_table))
                ),
                SqlBinaryOp(col("ref", "field_name"), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(self._index_name)),
                SqlBinaryOp(col("new", "sys_deleted"), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlParam(False)),
                SqlExists(
                    SqlSelect(
                        select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]),
                        from_=SqlTableAlias(
                            SqlTableIdent(self._ref_table), SqlAliasName("published")
                        ),
                        where=sql_and(
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                col("published", "source_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, col("new", "sys_id")
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                col("published", "source_table"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlParam(str(self._source_table)),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(
                                col("published", "field_name"),
                                BinaryOp.EQ,
                                SqlParam(self._index_name),
                            ),
                            SqlBinaryOp(col("published", "revision_id"), BinaryOp.EQ, revision),
                        ),
                    ),
                    negated=True,
                ),
            ),
        )
        statement = SqlInsert(
            SqlTableIdent(self._ref_table),
            columns=SqlColumnList(
                [SqlColumnName(name) for name in ("sys_id", "branch_id", "revision_id", *copied)]
            ),
            source=source,
        )
        ctes = [
            SqlCteDefinition(
                definition.name,
                definition.query,
                columns=definition.columns,
                recursive=definition.recursive,
                dependency_names=definition.dependency_names,
            )
            for definition in definitions
        ]
        return CompiledStep(grammar=SqlWith(ctes, statement, recursive=True), needs_returning=False)

"""INSERT SELECT filters retain their published authorization inputs.

Main lowers scalar refs to typed scalar subqueries. Missing publications fail
before execution. The adapter retains exact dotted dependency identities.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.protocols import SqlRenderable

import re

import pytest
from l1100_exceptions import ProgrammingError
from pydantic import Field as PydanticField

from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.insert_from_query import (
    InsertFromQueryReturningRawStep,
    InsertFromQueryStep,
    _build_filter_condition,
    _build_where_clause,
    _InsertFromQueryConfig,
    _PrepareInsertFromQueryRowsStep,
    insert_from_query_filter_deps,
)
from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.tests.testkit import cte_ref, make_compilation_context
from l1000_schema.schema_def import DatabaseObjectRow
from l1000_schema.table_registry import register_table
from l1000_schema.typed_field import field
from l1400_types import ServerPlanRefId, SysId
from l2070_batching.compilation import CompilationContext
from l2070_batching.server_ref import ScalarServerRef, ServerRefs
from l2060_query_builder.query_contracts import QueryFilter
from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.plan_expression import PlanPredicate
from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.expression_grammar import ExpressionToGrammar
from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import SqlColumnTypeHints

# The step's own ref ids are opaque strings, so the tests pick one and publish a CTE under it.
_PRODUCER_REF = "step_3"
_GATE_COLUMN = "allowed_owner"


def test_plan_predicate_must_be_bound_before_insert_filter_lowering() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(
        TypeError,
        match="bind it to a SQL-visible source relation before INSERT planning",
    ):
        _build_filter_condition(
            PlanPredicate(True, "=", True),
            _RefFilterRow,
            ExpressionToGrammar(_RefFilterRow),
        )


@register_table(
    plural="insert_from_query_ref_filter_rows",
    singular="insert_from_query_ref_filter_row",
)
class _RefFilterRow(DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]):
    owner_id: str = PydanticField(default="")
    name: str = PydanticField(default="")


def _bare_ref() -> ScalarServerRef[str]:
    """A ref naming a producer step's whole result, e.g. from a scalar-valued lazy read."""
    return ServerRefs.from_ref_id(ServerPlanRefId(_PRODUCER_REF), variant="scalar", type_hint=str)


def _projected_ref() -> ScalarServerRef[str]:
    """A ref naming one field of a producer step's row, as ``.field(...)`` on a lazy read yields.

    This is the shape a real gate produces, and it resolves against the *parent* step's published
    CTE rather than one published under the dotted id -- so it is worth pinning separately from
    :func:`_bare_ref`.
    """
    return ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
        ServerPlanRefId(f"{_PRODUCER_REF}.{_GATE_COLUMN}"),
        variant="scalar",
        type_hint=str,
    )


def _ctx_with_published_producer() -> CompilationContext:
    return make_compilation_context(
        cte_refs={
            _PRODUCER_REF: cte_ref(
                ServerPlanRefId(_PRODUCER_REF), columns=(_GATE_COLUMN,), column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(text_columns=frozenset({"allowed_owner"}))
            )
        },
    )


def _sql_and_params(where: SqlRenderable, ctx: CompilationContext) -> tuple[str, tuple[object, ...]]:
    assert ctx.dialect is not None
    fragment = where.render(ctx.dialect)
    sql, params = fragment.to_sql(ctx.dialect)
    return sql, tuple(params)


def _render(where: SqlRenderable, ctx: CompilationContext) -> str:
    return _sql_and_params(where, ctx)[0]


def _params(where: SqlRenderable, ctx: CompilationContext) -> tuple[object, ...]:
    return _sql_and_params(where, ctx)[1]


def _assert_gated_by_cte_subquery(where: SqlRenderable, ctx: CompilationContext) -> None:
    """Assert the ref became a subquery over the producer's CTE and left no parameter behind."""
    sql = _render(where, ctx)
    assert re.search(rf'"owner_id" (?:=|IN) \(SELECT .*FROM "{_PRODUCER_REF}"\)', sql), (
        f"the ref must lower to a subquery over the producer CTE, got: {sql}"
    )
    assert _params(where, ctx) == (), (
        f"a resolved ref must contribute no bind parameter; leftovers mean it is still being "
        f"compared against a value nothing fills: {_params(where, ctx)!r}"
    )


def test_a_bare_ref_filter_resolves_to_a_cte_in_subquery() -> None:
    """The shape an authorization gate takes: filter the source on a server-resolved identity."""
    filter_spec = QueryFilter(expression=field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == _bare_ref())
    ctx = _ctx_with_published_producer()

    where = _build_where_clause([filter_spec], _RefFilterRow, ctx)

    assert where is not None
    _assert_gated_by_cte_subquery(where, ctx)


def test_a_projected_ref_filter_resolves_against_the_parent_cte() -> None:
    """``.field(...)`` refs are what callers actually write, and they resolve via the parent step."""
    filter_spec = QueryFilter(expression=field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == _projected_ref())
    ctx = _ctx_with_published_producer()

    where = _build_where_clause([filter_spec], _RefFilterRow, ctx)

    assert where is not None
    _assert_gated_by_cte_subquery(where, ctx)
    assert f'"{_GATE_COLUMN}"' in _render(where, ctx), (
        "the subquery must select the projected field, not an arbitrary column of the parent CTE"
    )


def test_a_ref_nested_in_a_conjunction_resolves_without_dropping_the_other_conjunct() -> None:
    """Gated filters are rarely alone, and resolving the ref must not discard its neighbours.

    Resolution works by pulling ref filters out of the filter list and re-adding them as CTE
    grammar, so a conjunction is where an over-eager extraction would quietly drop the literal
    half -- widening the set of rows the INSERT copies while still looking gated.
    """
    gated = (field(_RefFilterRow.name) == "a-literal-name") & (field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == _bare_ref())
    ctx = _ctx_with_published_producer()

    where = _build_where_clause([QueryFilter(expression=gated)], _RefFilterRow, ctx)

    assert where is not None
    sql = _render(where, ctx)
    assert f'FROM "{_PRODUCER_REF}"' in sql, f"the gate must still be applied: {sql}"
    assert '"name"' in sql, f"the literal conjunct must survive resolution of the ref: {sql}"
    assert "a-literal-name" in _params(where, ctx), f"the literal conjunct must still bind its value, got params {_params(where, ctx)!r}"


def test_a_ref_in_the_column_value_filter_shape_resolves() -> None:
    """The other filter shape reaches SqlParam directly, so it needs its own resolution."""
    ctx = _ctx_with_published_producer()

    where = _build_where_clause(
        [QueryFilter(column="owner_id", operator="=", value=_bare_ref())],
        _RefFilterRow,
        ctx,
    )

    assert where is not None
    _assert_gated_by_cte_subquery(where, ctx)


def test_a_ref_without_a_published_cte_raises_a_clear_error() -> None:
    """A plan ref with no SQL-visible binding must fail loudly rather than compile to nothing.

    Reaching here means the producer step was not ordered before this one, which
    ``insert_from_query_filter_deps`` exists to prevent. Resolution deliberately does not fall back
    to any other lowering: it trips the shared runtime-replanning guard, whose error names the ref
    because that is the only way to tell which dependency went undeclared.
    """
    filter_spec = QueryFilter(expression=field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == _bare_ref())

    with pytest.raises(ProgrammingError, match=rf"{_PRODUCER_REF}.*without a published CTE binding"):
        _build_where_clause([filter_spec], _RefFilterRow, make_compilation_context())


def test_a_literal_filter_still_binds_a_parameter() -> None:
    """Resolving plan-ref filters must not cost the ordinary literal case its normal lowering."""
    filter_spec = QueryFilter(expression=field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == 'a-literal-owner')
    ctx = make_compilation_context()

    where = _build_where_clause([filter_spec], _RefFilterRow, ctx)

    assert where is not None
    assert "SELECT" not in _render(where, ctx), "a literal filter must not grow a subquery"
    assert "a-literal-owner" in _params(where, ctx)


def test_no_filters_still_means_no_where_clause() -> None:
    assert _build_where_clause([], _RefFilterRow, make_compilation_context()) is None


def test_filter_deps_collects_a_bare_ref() -> None:
    """dependencies() must name the ref so the planner orders the producer step first."""
    filter_spec = QueryFilter(expression=field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == _bare_ref())

    assert insert_from_query_filter_deps([filter_spec]) == frozenset({_PRODUCER_REF})


def test_filter_deps_collects_a_projected_ref_by_its_dotted_id() -> None:
    """The dotted id is what the planner keys on, so it must be declared verbatim, not truncated."""
    filter_spec = QueryFilter(expression=field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == _projected_ref())

    assert insert_from_query_filter_deps([filter_spec]) == frozenset({f"{_PRODUCER_REF}.{_GATE_COLUMN}"})


def test_filter_deps_finds_a_ref_nested_in_a_conjunction() -> None:
    """A dependency missed inside an AND would leave the producer unordered and compilation failing."""
    gated = (field(_RefFilterRow.name) == "a-literal-name") & (field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == _bare_ref())

    assert insert_from_query_filter_deps([QueryFilter(expression=gated)]) == frozenset({_PRODUCER_REF})


def test_filter_deps_is_empty_for_literal_filters() -> None:
    filter_spec = QueryFilter(expression=field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == 'a-literal-owner')

    assert insert_from_query_filter_deps([filter_spec]) == frozenset()


def _config_with(*filters: QueryFilter) -> _InsertFromQueryConfig:
    return _InsertFromQueryConfig(
        model_cls=_RefFilterRow,
        source_model=_RefFilterRow,
        exprs=tuple(filters),
        order_by=(),
        limit=None,
        offset=None,
        replacements=(),
        excluded_fields=(),
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "step_cls",
    [InsertFromQueryStep, InsertFromQueryReturningRawStep, _PrepareInsertFromQueryRowsStep],
)
def test_every_insert_from_query_step_declares_its_filter_refs(step_cls: type) -> None:
    """Each of the three compile paths needs the dependency, and each declares it separately.

    ``execute()``, ``execute_returning()`` and the non-RETURNING fallback compile the same filters
    through three different classes. A dependency declared on only some of them leaves the others
    compiling before the producer publishes its CTE, which fails rather than degrading -- so the
    wiring is asserted per class instead of trusting one representative.
    """
    filter_spec = QueryFilter(expression=field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == _bare_ref())
    ref_id = ServerPlanRefId("step_9")
    if step_cls is InsertFromQueryReturningRawStep:
        step = step_cls(ref_id, _config_with(filter_spec), result_ref_id=ref_id)
    else:
        step = step_cls(ref_id, _config_with(filter_spec))

    assert step.dependencies() == frozenset({_PRODUCER_REF})


def test_resolving_a_ref_filter_reports_the_cte_binding_it_consumed() -> None:
    """The consumed binding must be reported so the statement can carry its own ``WITH`` prefix.

    A resolved ref points at a relation some other step defined. Batching may put that definition
    in the same statement, but it may equally emit this INSERT alone -- and then the reference
    dangles. Reporting what was consumed is how the compiled step knows which auxiliary queries to
    re-declare, so this pins the reporting rather than only the WHERE clause it accompanies.
    """
    filter_spec = QueryFilter(expression=field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == _bare_ref())
    ctx = _ctx_with_published_producer()
    consumed: list[object] = []

    where = _build_where_clause([filter_spec], _RefFilterRow, ctx, consumed)

    assert where is not None
    assert consumed, "a resolved ref filter must report the CTE binding it resolved against"


def test_a_literal_filter_consumes_no_cte_binding() -> None:
    """Without this, every filtered insert would drag along an unnecessary ``WITH`` prefix."""
    filter_spec = QueryFilter(expression=field(_RefFilterRow.owner_id) == 'a-literal-owner')
    consumed: list[object] = []

    _build_where_clause([filter_spec], _RefFilterRow, make_compilation_context(), consumed)

    assert consumed == []

@pytest.mark.parametrize("async_surface", [False, True])
def test_native_migration_reconciliation_retires_old_admission(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    backend_config: Mapping[str, JsonValue],
    async_surface: bool,
    record_property: Callable[[str, object], None],
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    backend, params = _backend_target(db_connection, backend_config)
    previous = matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor(spec=_spec())
    replacement = matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor(spec=_batch_spec())
    core = DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor()
    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    manifest_key = "phase7:native-migrated-admission"
    coordinator.run(db_connection, manifest_key=manifest_key, model_classes=(), contributors=(core, previous))
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=_seed_native)
    old_contract = build_read_only_bootstrap_contract(
        coordinator.build_engine_plan(
            manifest_key=manifest_key,
            model_classes=(),
            contributors=(core, previous),
            dialect=db_connection.get_dialect(),
        )
    )
    new_contract = build_read_only_bootstrap_contract(
        coordinator.build_engine_plan(
            manifest_key=manifest_key,
            model_classes=(),
            contributors=(core, replacement),
            dialect=db_connection.get_dialect(),
        )
    )

    def open_reader(contract: ReadOnlyBootstrapContract) -> None:
        spec = previous.spec if contract is old_contract else replacement.spec

        def check(result: matching.MatchResult[Phase7PackedDenseLeft, Phase7PackedDenseRight]) -> None:
            assert isinstance(result, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
            assert [(edge.left.label, edge.right.label, edge.score.canonical) for edge in result.edges] == [
                ("left", "right-2", 2.0),
            ]

        async def open_async() -> None:
            with bootstrap_session() as async_session_id:
                reader = await open_validated_read_only_connection_async(backend, params, contract=contract)

                async def execute(
                    txn: AsyncReadTransaction,
                ) -> matching.MatchResult[Phase7PackedDenseLeft, Phase7PackedDenseRight]:
                    return await matching.match_async(txn, spec)

                try:
                    result = await reader.session(async_session_id).read_async(fn=execute)
                    check(result)
                finally:
                    await reader.close_async()

        if async_surface:
            asyncio.run(open_async())
        else:
            reader = open_validated_read_only_connection(backend, params, contract=contract)
            try:
                check(reader.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, spec)))
            finally:
                reader.close()

    open_reader(old_contract)
    with pytest.raises(ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError):
        open_reader(new_contract)
    with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
        resolve_terminal_sync(schema, "serverplan_test", replacement.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_spec=previous.spec))
    with pytest.raises(ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError):
        open_reader(old_contract)
    with pytest.raises(ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError):
        open_reader(new_contract)
    coordinator.run(db_connection, manifest_key=manifest_key, model_classes=(), contributors=(core, replacement))
    open_reader(new_contract)
    with pytest.raises(ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError):
        open_reader(old_contract)
    with pytest.raises(ProgrammingError, match="row_content_matches"):
        coordinator.run(db_connection, manifest_key=manifest_key, model_classes=(), contributors=(core, previous))
    open_reader(new_contract)
    record_property(
        "phase7_factors",
        json.dumps(
            {
                "family": "native_dense",
                "artifact_generation": "superseded",
                "execution_surface": "async" if async_surface else "sync",
            }
        ),
    )

def test_batched_large_column_spill_uses_single_upsert_statement_for_duplicates() -> None:
    step = BatchedLargeColumnSpillStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("spill"),
        SqlTableName("content_store"),
        config=_BatchedLargeColumnSpillConfig(
            rows=[
                (ContentHashValue("hash-a"), 1, False, b"a", 0, 0, "none", 0, 1),
                (ContentHashValue("hash-b"), 1, False, b"b", 0, 0, "none", 0, 1),
                (ContentHashValue("hash-a"), 1, False, b"a", 0, 0, "none", 0, 1),
            ],
            write_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("write-1"),
        ),
    )

    compiled = step.compile(_pg_ctx())

    assert isinstance(compiled.grammar, SqlStatementBatch)
    assert compiled.grammar.category is SqlStatementBatchCategory.BUDGET_SPLIT
    assert [type(statement) for statement in compiled.grammar.statements] == [
        SqlBatchedContentStoreRefCountUpdate,
        SqlPostgresBatchedContentStoreInsertMissing,
    ]
    update_sql, update_params = compiled.grammar.statements[0].render(PostgresDialect()).to_sql(PostgresDialect())
    insert_sql, insert_params = compiled.grammar.statements[1].render(PostgresDialect()).to_sql(PostgresDialect())
    sql = f"{update_sql};\n{insert_sql}"
    params = (*update_params, *insert_params)
    assert update_sql.count("(%s, %s)") == 2
    assert insert_sql.count("(%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)") == 2
    assert 'UPDATE "content_store"' in update_sql
    assert "FROM (VALUES" in update_sql
    assert "payload" not in update_sql
    assert "WHERE NOT EXISTS" in insert_sql
    assert "ON CONFLICT (content_hash) DO UPDATE SET" in sql
    assert 'ref_count = "content_store".ref_count + EXCLUDED.ref_count' in sql
    assert not any(isinstance(param, bytes) for param in update_params)
    assert any(isinstance(param, bytes) for param in insert_params)
    assert params == (
        "hash-a",
        2,
        "hash-b",
        1,
        "hash-a",
        1,
        False,
        b"a",
        0,
        0,
        "none",
        0,
        1,
        2,
        "hash-b",
        1,
        False,
        b"b",
        0,
        0,
        "none",
        0,
        1,
        1,
    )

    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection, system_session_id: SessionId

    _, runs, _, _ = _authority(db_connection)
    ordered = sorted(runs, key=lambda run: run.published_epoch)
    input_budget = sum(len(run.payload) for run in ordered[:3])
    policy = _POLICY.model_copy(
        update={
            "max_compaction_bytes": input_budget,

        }

    first = _compact(db_connection, header.sys_id, policy=policy)

    second = _compact(db_connection, header.sys_id, policy=policy)

    assert set(first.input_run_ids).isdisjoint(second.input_run_ids)
    assert second.publication_epoch == first.publication_epoch + 1
    assert second.next_cursor > first.next_cursor
    _, _, _, cursors = _authority(db_connection)
    assert len(cursors) == 1
    assert cursors[0].next_native_key == second.next_cursor
    assert cursors[0].publication_epoch == second.publication_epoch

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _PendingStagedSourceConfig:
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]
    source_key: StagedSourceKey
    columns: Sequence[str]
    db_columns: Sequence[str]
    rows: Sequence[tuple[Any, ...]]
    db_column_source: type[DatabaseObjectRow]
    depends_on: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()
    return_value: object | None = None
    return_value_is_set: bool = False


def _require_same_statement_pending_staged_source(ctx: CompilationContext) -> None:
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.versioned_staging_transport is VersionedStagingTransport.SAME_STATEMENT_RELATION:
        return
    msg = "PendingStagedSourceStep currently requires PostgreSQL because the first fusion pass is scoped to data-modifying CTE backends"
    raise NotImplementedError(msg)


class PendingStagedSourceStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[object]):
    """Expose pending staged rows as a logical CTE-backed relation."""

    def __init__(
        self: PendingStagedSourceStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: _PendingStagedSourceConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = config.model_cls
        self._source_key = config.source_key
        self._columns = tuple(config.columns)
        self._db_columns = tuple(config.db_columns)
        self._rows = tuple(config.rows)
        self._db_column_source = config.db_column_source
        self._dependencies = frozenset(str(ref_id) for ref_id in config.depends_on)
        self._return_value = config.return_value
        self._return_value_is_set = config.return_value_is_set
        self._row_facts: RawRowFacts | None = None

    @property
    def level(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "grammar", "staged_source"})

    def tables_read(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def execution_role(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def _raw_row_facts(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> RawRowFacts:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._raw_row_facts import build_raw_row_facts

        row_facts = self._row_facts
        if row_facts is None:
            row_facts = build_raw_row_facts(self._rows)
            self._row_facts = row_facts
        return row_facts

    def dependencies(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._dependencies | self._raw_row_facts().dependency_refs

    def cte_publication_contract(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = tuple(self._db_columns)

        def _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns: tuple[str, ...] | None) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
            assert columns is not None
            hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(self._db_column_source, columns)
            if hints is None:
                msg = f"Could not resolve SQL column type hints for {self._db_column_source.__name__}"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            return combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                columns,
                hints,
                framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints(),
            ).require_complete(columns)

        column_type_hints = _legacy_cte_column_type_hints(columns)
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        contract_columns = tuple(str(column) for column in columns)
        _contract_source_tables = frozenset({str(self._source_key.staged_table_name)})
        from l2070_batching.cte_contracts import projection_over_model_contract

        return projection_over_model_contract(
            columns=contract_columns,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            source_model_cls=self._db_column_source,
            projection_lineage=tuple((column, column) for column in contract_columns),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def semantic_publication_columns(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return self.cte_publication_contract().columns

    def semantic_publication_type_hints(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> SqlColumnTypeHints:
        return self.cte_publication_contract().column_type_hints

    def executor_visible_published_rows(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> Sequence[Mapping[str, object]] | None:
        return [dict(zip(self._db_columns, row, strict=True)) for row in self._rows]

    def provided_staged_sources(self: PendingStagedSourceStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._source_key.staged_table_name}) if self._rows else frozenset()

    def compile(self: PendingStagedSourceStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[object]:
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.backend_type import BackendType
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlTypeName
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._projected_row_source import (
            build_postgres_raw_bulk_rows,
            postgres_raw_bulk_column_types,
        )
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._raw_row_facts import build_raw_row_facts
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.insert_many_raw import (
            _write_plan_from_context,
        )
        from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.query_grammar import QueryGrammarBuilder
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_conditions import SqlFalseCondition
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.query.stmt_dynamic import SqlDynamicSelectStmt
        from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
        from l2060_query_builder.plan_composition import param, query, unnest

        result_post_op = literal_post_op(
            self._return_value if self._return_value_is_set else len(self._rows),
        )

        if not self._rows:
            output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
                self.cte_publication_contract(),
            )
            return CompiledStep(
                output_shape=output_shape,
                result_relation=result_relation,
                column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
                grammar=SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
                    from_table=SqlTableName(self._source_key.staged_table_name),
                    columns=[SqlColumnName(column) for column in self.cte_publication_contract().columns],
                    where_conditions=[SqlFalseCondition()],
                ),
                needs_returning=True,
                closed_post_op=result_post_op,
            )
        _require_same_statement_pending_staged_source(ctx)
        write_plan = _write_plan_from_context(ctx, self._db_column_source)
        cached_columns = None
        if ctx.schema_column_cache is not None:
            cached_columns = ctx.schema_column_cache.get(self._source_key.staged_table_name)
        if cached_columns is None:
            columns = self._columns
            db_columns = self._db_columns
            rows = self._rows
        else:
            keep_indices = tuple(idx for idx, db_column in enumerate(self._db_columns) if db_column in cached_columns)
            columns = tuple(self._columns[idx] for idx in keep_indices)
            db_columns = tuple(self._db_columns[idx] for idx in keep_indices)
            rows = tuple(tuple(row[idx] for idx in keep_indices) for row in self._rows)
        column_types = postgres_raw_bulk_column_types(
            self._db_column_source,
            columns,
            write_plan=write_plan,
        )
        if column_types is None:
            msg = f"PendingStagedSourceStep could not determine PostgreSQL array types for {get_table_name(self._model_cls)}"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        row_facts = self._raw_row_facts() if rows is self._rows else build_raw_row_facts(rows)
        row_source = build_postgres_raw_bulk_rows(
            rows=rows,
            db_columns=db_columns,
            column_types=column_types,
            ctx=ctx,
            row_facts=row_facts,
        )
        if row_source.select_source is not None:
            __opa002_grammar_212 = row_source.select_source
            output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
                self.cte_publication_contract(),
            )
            return CompiledStep(
                output_shape=output_shape,
                result_relation=result_relation,
                column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
                grammar=__opa002_grammar_212,
                needs_returning=True,
                closed_post_op=result_post_op,
            )
        assert row_source.array_params is not None
        staged_rows = unnest(
            *(param(array_param) for array_param in row_source.array_params),
            types=tuple(SqlTypeName(column_type) for column_type in column_types),
            columns=tuple(db_columns),
            alias=f"{self.ref_id}_staged_src",
        )
        grammar = QueryGrammarBuilder(
            query(staged_rows).project(*(staged_rows.column(column) for column in db_columns)).to_query_spec(),
            compilation_context=ctx,
        )
        select_stmt = grammar.build_select_stmt()
        __opa002_grammar_231 = select_stmt
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_231,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=result_post_op,
        )

def _executor_for_store_result() -> PlanExecutor:
    executor = PlanExecutor.__new__(PlanExecutor)
    executor._published_cte_counter = 0
    executor._compilation_ctx = cast(
        CompilationContext,
        SimpleNamespace(cte_refs={}, txn=None),
    )
    return executor


def _liveness_at_store_point(
    steps: Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
    store_step: ServerPlanStep[Any],
) -> PublicationLivenessState:
    state = PublicationLivenessState.from_steps(steps)
    for step in steps:
        state.consume_step(step)
        if step is store_step:
            return state
    raise AssertionError(f"store step {store_step.ref_id!s} not in step sequence")


def _store_result_at(
    executor: PlanExecutor,
    step: ServerPlanStep[Any],
    result: Any,
    resolved: dict[str, Any],
    steps: Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]],
) -> None:
    PlanExecutor._store_result(
        executor,
        step,
        result,
        resolved,
        _liveness_at_store_point(steps, step),
    )


def _record_publish_calls(executor: PlanExecutor) -> list[tuple[str, Any]]:
    calls: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []

    def _publish(
        self: PlanExecutor,
        step: ServerPlanStep[Any],
        result: Any,
        resolved: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        del self, resolved
        calls.append((str(step.ref_id), result))

    executor._publish_executor_visible_binding = MethodType(_publish, executor)  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    return calls

async def test_cancellation_during_publication_releases_rows_and_connection(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    async_db_connection: AsyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    assert isinstance(async_db_connection, AsyncSqlConnection)
    with disable_sync_in_async_check():
        _seed(db_connection)
    reached_insert = asyncio.Event()
    resume = asyncio.Event()
    original = async_db_connection._execute_direct_internal_async

    async def pause_after_insert(
        stmt: SqlRenderable,
        *,
        params: SqlParamTuple | None = None,
        external_params_first: bool = False,
        fetch_mode: Literal["none", "one", "all"] = "none",
        use_savepoint_recovery: bool = True,
        track_rtt: bool = True,
    ) -> DatabaseRow | list[DatabaseRow] | None:
        result = await original(
            stmt,
            params=params,
            external_params_first=external_params_first,
            fetch_mode=fetch_mode,
            use_savepoint_recovery=use_savepoint_recovery,
            track_rtt=track_rtt,
        )
        if isinstance(stmt, SqlInsert):
            reached_insert.set()
            await resume.wait()
        return result

    async def search(txn: AsyncReadTransaction) -> None:
        rows = (
            await txn.cross_branch(USearchScopeDocument, WorkspaceId.default())
            .vector_search(
                "content",
                [1.0, 0.0],
                k=1,
            )
            .execute_async()
        )
        assert [row.title for row in rows] == ["lifetime"]

    session = async_db_connection.session(system_session_id)
    with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
        patch.setattr(async_db_connection, "_execute_direct_internal_async", pause_after_insert)
        async def _run_search() -> None:
            with bootstrap_session():
                await run_async_read(session, search)

        task = asyncio.create_task(_run_search())
        reached = asyncio.create_task(reached_insert.wait())
        try:
            done, _ = await asyncio.wait((task, reached), return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
            if task in done:
                await task
                pytest.fail("native score insertion was not observed before search completion")
            assert reached in done
            task.cancel()
            with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await task
        finally:
            reached.cancel()
            resume.set()
            if not task.done():
                task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(task, reached, return_exceptions=True)

    async def probe(txn: AsyncReadTransaction) -> None:
        await txn.cross_branch(USearchScopeDocument, WorkspaceId.default()).execute_async()
        for table in (NATIVE_SCORE_TABLE, NATIVE_ELIGIBILITY_TABLE):
            rows = await async_db_connection._execute_direct_internal_async(
                SqlSelect(select=SqlSelectList([SqlParam(1)]), from_=SqlTableIdent(table), limit=1),
                fetch_mode="all",
            )
            assert not rows

    await run_async_read(session, probe)
    await run_async_read(session, search)

    assert isinstance(db_connection, SyncSqlConnection)
