def _row(
    payload: bytes,
    *,
    offset: int,
    requested_offset: int,
    requested_length: int,
    original_size: int | None = None,
) -> _DeltaLargeColumnRangeRow:
    digest = ContentHash.from_sha256(hashlib.sha256(payload).digest())
    return _DeltaLargeColumnRangeRow({
        "byte_offset": offset,
        "byte_length": len(payload),
        "chunk_hash_short": digest.short,
        "chunk_hash_high": digest.high,
        "payload": payload.hex(),
        "requested_offset": requested_offset,
        "requested_length": requested_length,
        "original_size": original_size if original_size is not None else offset + len(payload),
    })

def _runs(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> list[USearchRun]:
    return list(txn.query(USearchRun).execute())


def _members(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> list[USearchRunMember]:
    return list(txn.query(USearchRunMember).execute())


@pytest.mark.parametrize("updates", [1, 3])
def test_public_writes_publish_immutable_level_zero_runs(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection, updates: int, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    _, branch = create_test_revision(
        db_connection,
        USearchScopeDomain,
        workspace_id=WorkspaceId.default(),
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
    )
    retained: dict[str, tuple[bytes, str, str]] = {}
    assigned: dict[str, int] = {}
    for index in range(updates):
        _write_document(
            db_connection,
            branch,
            connection_id=ConnectionId(f"p3-run-{index}"),
            title=f"run-document-{index}",
            embedding=[float(index + 1), 1.0],
        )
        runs = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=_runs)
        members = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=_members)
        assert len(runs) == index + 1, "Each changed content batch must publish a new immutable run"
        by_id = {str(run.sys_id): run for run in runs}
        for run_id, original in retained.items():
            run = by_id[run_id]
            assert (run.payload, run.payload_sha256, run.membership_sha256) == original
        for run in runs:
            assert run.level == 0
            assert run.retired_epoch is None
            assert run.member_count == 1
            assert run.payload_sha256 == sha256(run.payload).hexdigest()
            retained[str(run.sys_id)] = (run.payload, run.payload_sha256, run.membership_sha256)
        assert len(members) == index + 1
        assert len({member.native_key for member in members}) == index + 1
        for member in members:
            identity = str(member.embedding_vector_id)
            if identity in assigned:
                assert member.native_key == assigned[identity]
            assigned[identity] = member.native_key
            assert str(member.run_id) in by_id
        assert sorted(assigned.values()) == list(range(1, index + 2))

    def search(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> list[USearchScopeDocument]:
        return list(
            txn.cross_branch(USearchScopeDocument, WorkspaceId.default()).vector_search("content", [1.0, 1.0], k=updates).execute()
        )

    found = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=search)
    assert {row.title for row in found} == {f"run-document-{index}" for index in range(updates)}

            versioning_domains=TEST_BOOTSTRAP_VERSIONING_DOMAINS,
            contributors=TEST_BOOTSTRAP_CONTRIBUTORS,
        )

            rebuild_vector_index(txn, USearchScopeDocument, "content")

        def read_old(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> None:
            assert _runs(txn) == original
            writer.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=rebuild)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("interrupt", [False, True])
def test_legacy_database_migration_preserves_authority_and_durable_keys(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection, interrupt: bool, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    _, branch = create_test_revision(
        db_connection,
        USearchScopeDomain,
        workspace_id=WorkspaceId.default(),
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
    )
    _write_document(
        db_connection,
        branch,
        connection_id=ConnectionId("p3-legacy-source"),
        title="legacy-source",
        embedding=[1.0, 0.0],
    )

    def install_legacy(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> tuple[str, int]:
        run = txn.query(USearchRun).execute()[0]
        head = txn.query(USearchScopeIndex).execute()[0]
        txn.update(
            USearchScopeIndex,
            head.model_copy(
                update={
                    "index_blob": run.payload,
                    "blob_sha256": run.payload_sha256,
                    "storage_format": "legacy-blob-v1",
                    "next_native_key": 100,
                }
            ),
        )
        member = txn.query(USearchArtifactMember).execute()[0]
        txn.update(
            USearchArtifactMember,
            member.model_copy(
                update={
                    "content_hash_short": None,
                    "content_hash_high": None,
                    "embedding_sha256": "",
                }
            ),
        )
        for membership in txn.query(USearchRunMember).execute():
            txn.delete_by_id(USearchRunMember, membership.sys_id)
        txn.delete_by_id(USearchRun, run.sys_id)
        return str(member.embedding_vector_id), int(member.native_key)

    identity, key = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=install_legacy)

    def snapshot(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], ...]:
        return (
            tuple(sorted(repr(row.model_dump()) for row in txn.query(USearchScopeIndex).execute())),
            tuple(sorted(row.model_dump_json() for row in txn.query(USearchArtifactMember).execute())),
            tuple(sorted(row.model_dump_json(exclude={"payload"}) for row in txn.query(USearchRun).execute())),
            tuple(sorted(row.model_dump_json() for row in txn.query(USearchRunMember).execute())),
        )

    before = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=snapshot)

    def migrate(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        rebuild_vector_index(txn, USearchScopeDocument, "content")
        if interrupt:
            raise RuntimeError("interrupt legacy migration")

    if interrupt:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="interrupt legacy migration"):
            db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=migrate)
        assert db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=snapshot) == before
        return
    db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=migrate)
    runs = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=_runs)
    members = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=_members)
    assert len(runs) == len(members) == 1
    assert str(members[0].embedding_vector_id) == identity
    assert members[0].native_key == key

    def counter(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> int:
        return txn.query(USearchScopeIndex).execute()[0].next_native_key

    assert db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=counter) == 100

def _should_inline_large_columns(query_spec: object) -> bool:
    return (
        getattr(query_spec, "select_columns", None) is None
        and not bool(getattr(query_spec, "joins", None))
        and not bool(getattr(query_spec, "defer_large_columns", False))
    )


class FtsQueryExecuteWithMetaStep[T](QueryExecuteStep[T]):
    """Unversioned FTS terminal that returns raw row dicts."""

    def step_tags(self: FtsQueryExecuteWithMetaStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "query", "execute", "fts_meta"})

    def compile(self: FtsQueryExecuteWithMetaStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[Sequence[T]]:
        compiled = compile_sql_query_execute_step(
            self._model_cls,
            self._query_spec,
            ctx,
            raw_mode=True,
            resolved_user_id=_resolve_query_user_id(
                resolved_user_id=self._resolved_user_id,
                user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
                ctx=ctx,
            ),
            closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
            step_name=type(self).__name__,
        )
        if _should_inline_large_columns(self._query_spec):
            compiled = wrap_compiled_sql_with_inline_large_columns(
                compiled,
                model_cls=self._model_cls,
            )
        return cast("CompiledStep[Sequence[T]]", compiled)

class VersionedQueryFromSpecFtsMetaStep[T](VersionedQueryFromSpecStep[T]):
    """Versioned FTS terminal that returns raw row dicts."""

    _resolved_branch_id: str | None
    _branch_cte_ref: Any
    _resolved_revision_id: str | None

    def step_tags(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecFtsMetaStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "query", "execute", "versioned", "fts_meta"})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecFtsMetaStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        base_contract = super().cte_publication_contract()
        if base_contract is None:
            return CtePublicationContract.non_publishing()
        support_columns = ("sys_revision_id", "sys_staged_commit_id", "sys_deleted")
        columns = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*base_contract.columns, *support_columns)))
        missing_hint_columns = set(columns) - hinted_columns(base_contract.column_type_hints)
        framework_hints = framework_physical_column_sql_column_type_hints().filtered(missing_hint_columns)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=columns,
            column_type_hints=combine_sql_column_type_hints(
                columns,
                base_contract.column_type_hints,
                framework_hints,
            ),
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.projection_over_model(
                source_model_cls=self._model_cls,
                projection_lineage=tuple((column, column) for column in columns),
            ),
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=base_contract.source_tables,
        )

    def lower(self: VersionedQueryFromSpecFtsMetaStep, ctx: LoweringContext) -> list[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        revision_prereqs, published_revision_ref_id = _lower_revision_prereq_ref(
            owner_ref_id=self.ref_id,
            revision_ref_id=self._revision_ref_id,
        )
        user_id_steps, user_id_ref_id = _build_permission_user_ref_steps(
            ref_id=self.ref_id,
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            query_spec=self._query_spec,
            ctx=ctx,
            existing_user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
        )
        if published_revision_ref_id == self._revision_ref_id and user_id_ref_id == self._user_id_ref_id:
            return [self]
        return [
            *revision_prereqs,
            *user_id_steps,
            VersionedQueryFromSpecFtsMetaStep(
                self.ref_id,
                self._model_cls,
                _VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                    query_spec=self._query_spec,
                    branch_id=self._branch_id,
                    branch_ref_id=self._branch_ref_id,
                    revision_id=self._revision_id,
                    revision_ref_id=published_revision_ref_id,
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                    raw_mode=self._raw_mode,
                    after_refs=self._after_refs,
                ),
            ),
        ]

    def compile(
        self: VersionedQueryFromSpecFtsMetaStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[Sequence[T]]:
        model_cls = self._model_cls
        resolved_revision_id = _effective_query_revision_override(
            self._revision_id,
            self._revision_ref_id,
            ctx,
            step_name=f"{type(self).__name__}({self.ref_id})",
        )
        resolved_branch_id: str | None
        branch_cte_ref: Any
        if self._branch_id is not None:
            resolved_branch_id, branch_cte_ref = self._branch_id, None
        elif self._branch_ref_id is not None:
            resolved_branch_id, branch_cte_ref = _compile_branch_inputs(ctx, self._branch_ref_id)
        elif resolved_revision_id is not None:
            resolved_branch_id, branch_cte_ref = None, None
        else:
            resolved_branch_id, branch_cte_ref = _compile_branch_inputs(ctx, self._branch_ref_id)

        return compile_versioned_query_from_spec_terminal(
            query_spec=self._query_spec,
            model_cls=model_cls,
            ctx=ctx,
            resolved_branch_id=resolved_branch_id,
            branch_cte_ref=branch_cte_ref,
            branch_ref_id=self._branch_ref_id,
            resolved_revision_id=resolved_revision_id,
            revision_ref_id=self._revision_ref_id,
            require_revision_override=self._revision_id is not None or self._revision_ref_id is not None,
            user_id_ref_id=self._user_id_ref_id,
            closed_post_op=build_versioned_query_from_spec_standard_post_op(
                model_cls,
                query_spec=self._query_spec,
                returns_raw_rows=True,
                include_deleted=bool(getattr(self._query_spec, "include_deleted", False)),
            ),
            step_name=type(self).__name__,
        )

class AggregateIntent(IntentStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]):
    """L4: Execute an aggregate query (GROUP BY + aggregate functions)."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "aggregate", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.MANY
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(
        self: AggregateIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        config: _AggregateIntentConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = model_cls
        self.query_spec = config.query_spec

    def lower(self: AggregateIntent, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._versioned_routing import is_versioned_operation

        query_spec = self.query_spec
        leading_steps, user_id_ref_id = _build_read_session_user_resolution(
            ref_id=self.ref_id,
            model_cls=self.model_cls,
            query_spec=query_spec,
            ctx=ctx,
        )
        if is_versioned_operation(self.model_cls, ctx):
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_query_steps import (
                build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps,
                VersionedQueryFromSpecStep,
                _VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig,
            )

            if ctx.branch_id is not None:
                revision_id = ctx_revision_id(ctx)
                return [
                    *leading_steps,
                    *build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
                        ref_id=self.ref_id,
                        model_cls=self.model_cls,
                        config=_VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                            query_spec=query_spec,
                            branch_id=ctx.branch_id,
                            revision_id=revision_id,
                            user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                            raw_mode=True,
                            prefer_current_tip=revision_id is None,
                        ),
                    ),
                ]

            assert ctx.lazy_revision is not None
            assert ctx.branch_table is not None

            resolve_ref_raw, resolve_step = ctx.get_or_create_branch_resolve(str(self.ref_id))
            resolve_ref = ServerPlanRefId(resolve_ref_raw)
            agg_revision_literal = _resolve_context_revision_literal(ctx)
            assert ctx.lazy_revision.ref_id is not None
            agg_revision_ref_id = None
            return [
                *leading_steps,
                *([] if resolve_step is None else [resolve_step]),
                *build_versioned_query_from_spec_steps(
                    ref_id=self.ref_id,
                    model_cls=self.model_cls,
                    config=_VersionedQueryFromSpecConfig(
                        query_spec=query_spec,
                        branch_ref_id=resolve_ref,
                        revision_id=agg_revision_literal,
                        revision_ref_id=agg_revision_ref_id,
                        user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                        raw_mode=True,
                        prefer_current_tip=agg_revision_literal is None,
                    ),
                ),
            ]

        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute_aggregate import (
            QueryExecuteAggregateStep,
            _QueryExecuteAggregateStepConfig,
        )

        return [
            *leading_steps,
            QueryExecuteAggregateStep(
                self.ref_id,
                self.model_cls,
                _QueryExecuteAggregateStepConfig(
                    query_spec=query_spec,
                    user_id_ref_id=user_id_ref_id,
                ),
            ),
        ]

"""First-class authorization gates for ServerPlan writes.

The problem this solves
=======================

A route that authorizes a write has two obvious options, and both are wrong.

*Check first, then write.* Reading the caller's permission is a database round
trip, and the mutation is a second one. The Auto API budget allows one per
request, and the exception mechanism for exceeding it expires -- the wrong
instrument for a control that must hold forever. Worse, ordering is not atomicity:
a permission revoked between the check and the write is not observed.

*Write, then check.* The write has already committed by the time the caller is
told they were not allowed to make it. That is not an authorization control.

The established third answer is the **in-plan gate**: every write depends on a ref
that resolves to a real value for an authorized caller and to NULL for everyone
else. An insert takes a NOT NULL column from it, so an unauthorized insert cannot
form a valid row; an update filters on it, so an unauthorized update matches
nothing. The decision and the mutation are evaluated together, server-side, in one
statement. This is strictly stronger than checking first, because there is no
window between the two.

What this module adds
=====================

The in-plan gate refuses correctly but says nothing about *why*. A NOT NULL
violation and a zero-row update look exactly like an ordinary bad request, so the
route has to re-read the caller's role on the error path purely to choose between
403 and 404 -- paying, on the denial path, the round trip the pattern exists to
avoid, and reconstructing a decision the database already made.

``RequireAuthorizationGateStep`` makes the gate explicit to the planner. It
compiles to an assertion evaluated in SQL alongside the mutation, emitting
``AssertionResultCode.POLICY_DENIED`` when the gate ref is NULL, which the post-op
raises as a typed permission error. The route catches a type; nothing is inferred
and nothing is re-read.

Why it costs nothing
====================

The step lowers the gate ref to a scalar subquery over the CTE that computed it,
so it fuses into the same statement batch as the mutation. It deliberately does
*not* require materialized inputs: a step that did would be a batching barrier,
forcing the planner to flush and read the gate value back into Python before
building the mutation -- reintroducing the very round trip this exists to avoid.
``tests/test_authorization_gate_step.py`` asserts that property directly, because
it is easy to lose in a later refactor and invisible until a route starts failing
its budget.

What it does not do
===================

It does not decide who is authorized. The gate ref does that, and the caller owns
it. This step only ensures a NULL gate fails the plan loudly and legibly instead
of silently degrading into a constraint error.

.. seealso::

    * ``docs/guides/auto_api_serverplan_1rtt.rst`` - the round-trip budget
    * ``docs/design/ner-742-azure-secret-custody-tdd-plan.md`` - phase A1c
    * ``api/nera_api/teamspace_auth.py`` - the teamspace gate refs
"""

DEFAULT_GATE_DENIAL_MESSAGE = "Caller is not authorized to perform this operation"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _AuthorizationGateConfig:
    gate_ref: ServerPlanRefId
    denial_message: str
    exception_cls: type[Exception]


class RequireAuthorizationGateStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[bool]):
    """Fail the plan with a typed denial when an authorization gate ref is NULL.

    The gate ref is held as a ref *id* rather than as a ``ServerRef`` object on
    purpose. Resolving a ``ServerRef`` clears its symbolic id, and this step needs
    that id at compile time to find the CTE the gate was computed in.
    """

    __slots__ = ("_denial_message", "_exception_cls", "_gate_ref")

    def __init__(
        self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        config: _AuthorizationGateConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._gate_ref = config.gate_ref
        self._denial_message = config.denial_message
        self._exception_cls = config.exception_cls

    @property
    def level(self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "grammar", "validate", "authorization"})

    def is_read_only(self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def result_cardinality(self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def tables_read(self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        # Declaring the gate ref as a dependency is what orders this step after the
        # query that computes it, so the CTE exists by the time compile() looks for
        # it.
        return frozenset({str(self._gate_ref)})

    def preprocess(self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep, resolved: ResolvedRefs) -> None:
        # Nothing to resolve in Python. Doing so here would pull the gate value out
        # of SQL and defeat the point; see the module docstring.
        pass

    def cte_publication_contract(self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        output_shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        column_type_hints = sql_assertion_column_type_hints()
        columns = output_shape.cte_output_columns
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=SqlAssertionResultRow,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=None,
            relation_contract=CteRelationContract.semantic_row(SqlAssertionResultRow),
        )

    def compile(self: RequireAuthorizationGateStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[bool]:
        gate_expr = lower_scalar_server_ref(
            ServerRefs.from_ref_id(self._gate_ref, variant="scalar", type_hint=object),
            ctx,
        )
        output_shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=authorization_gate_assertion_query(
                gate_expr,
                error_message=self._denial_message,
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=authorization_gate_post_op(
                self._denial_message,
                exc_type=self._exception_cls,
            ),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(output_shape),
            column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
            auxiliary_ctes=collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.dependencies()),
        )


@pure_lazy
def _gate_ref_id(gate: object) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    """Extract the plan ref id a gate was published under.

    A gate has to come from a plan step. A literal would be decided in Python
    before the plan ran, which is the pre-flight check this pattern replaces.
    """
    if isinstance(gate, LazyResult | ServerRef):
        dependencies = tuple(sorted(gate.dependencies()))
    else:
        msg = "An authorization gate must be a LazyResult or ServerRef published by a plan step"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    if len(dependencies) != 1:
        msg = (
            "An authorization gate must resolve to exactly one plan ref; "
            f"got {len(dependencies)}. Project the gate to a single scalar first."
        )
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return ServerPlanRefId(dependencies[0])


@pure_lazy
def require_authorization_gate_lazy(
    txn: LazyReadTransaction,
    gate: object,
    *,
    denial_message: str = DEFAULT_GATE_DENIAL_MESSAGE,
    exception_cls: type[Exception] = DataLayerPermissionError,
) -> LazyResult[bool]:
    """Fail this plan with a typed denial if ``gate`` resolves to NULL.

    ``gate`` is a ref that is non-NULL exactly when the caller is authorized --
    typically a lookup of the caller's role or membership whose emptiness *is* the
    refusal.

    Declare this in the same plan as the writes it guards. The assertion is
    evaluated in SQL alongside them, so the denial and the mutation cannot
    disagree, and neither costs an extra round trip.

    ``denial_message`` reaches the caller, so it should describe the policy rather
    than the mechanism.
    """
    plan = txn._get_transaction_plan_lazy()
    return txn._add_intent(
        RequireAuthorizationGateStep(
            ServerPlanRefId(plan._next_ref()),
            _AuthorizationGateConfig(
                gate_ref=_gate_ref_id(gate),
                denial_message=denial_message,
                exception_cls=exception_cls,
            ),
        ),
    )


__all__ = [
    "DEFAULT_GATE_DENIAL_MESSAGE",
    "RequireAuthorizationGateStep",
    "require_authorization_gate_lazy",
]

"""Compile permission policies with the dedicated permission compiler."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, cast

from l1000_schema.large_column import get_large_column_configs, large_column_pointer_name
from l1000_schema.table_registry import get_schema_models_for_table
from l1100_exceptions.exceptions import PermissionCompilationError
from l1300_session.session import SessionId
from l1400_types import DynamicFieldName
from l2055_lazy_result.purity import pure_lazy

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Collection

    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.protocols import SqlRenderable
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import DatabaseObjectRow
    from l2050_transaction.transaction import (
        LazyReadTransaction,
        LazyWriteTransaction,
        ReadTransaction,
        WriteTransaction,
    )
    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import VersioningDomain


def check_table_access(model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow], session_id: SessionId) -> None:
    """No-op for reads — all permission enforcement is via SQL WHERE clauses.

    SystemOnlyScheme compiles to ``WHERE 1=0`` (PERMISSION_FALSE), returning
    zero rows.  Other schemes compile to ownership/RBAC subqueries.  The
    database enforces the policy, not Python-side raises.
    """


_COLUMN_MASKING_INFRA_FIELDS = frozenset(
    {
        "sys_id",
        "object_id",
        "branch_id",
        "workspace_id",
        "created_at",
        "updated_at",
        "type_id",
        "type_name",
        "revision_id",
        "staged_commit_id",
        "deleted",
        "sys_created_at",
        "sys_updated_at",
        "sys_revision_id",
        "sys_staged_commit_id",
        "sys_deleted",
        "sys_valid_from_revision_id",
        "sys_valid_to_revision_id",
    },
)


@pure_lazy
def compile_permission_expression(
    model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    session_id: SessionId,
    txn: ReadTransaction | WriteTransaction | LazyReadTransaction | LazyWriteTransaction,
    *,
    action: str = "read",
    table_alias: str | None = None,
    versioning_domain: type[VersioningDomain] | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    """Get the model's permission SQL filter (unqualified columns)."""
    return _compile(
        model_type,
        session_id,
        table_alias=table_alias,
        txn=txn,
        action=action,
        versioning_domain=versioning_domain,
    )


@pure_lazy
def require_permission_compile_txn(
    txn: ReadTransaction | WriteTransaction | LazyReadTransaction | LazyWriteTransaction | None,
) -> ReadTransaction | WriteTransaction | LazyReadTransaction | LazyWriteTransaction:
    """Require a non-None transaction-backed compiler context for permission lowering."""
    if txn is None:
        msg = (
            "compile_permission_expression() requires a transaction-backed permission compiler; "
            "refusing to lower permission expressions through the generic expression compiler"
        )
        raise PermissionCompilationError(msg)
    return txn


def get_column_masking_info(
    model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    session_id: SessionId | None,
    *,
    catalog_models: Collection[type[DatabaseObjectRow]] | None = None,
) -> tuple[str, list[str]] | None:
    """Return (owner_field, private_columns) if column masking is needed, else None.

    For SelfOwnershipScheme with column_filter_for_others, the database returns
    all rows plus an ``__is_owner`` indicator column.  The post_op uses this
    to null-out private columns for non-owned rows.
    """
    from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import (
        _try_get_permission_scheme_for_planning,
        get_query_permission_plan,
    )

    scheme = _try_get_permission_scheme_for_planning(model_type)
    if scheme is None:
        return None

    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_type)
    if permission_plan is not None and not permission_plan.filter_rows:
        return None

    if not getattr(scheme, "supports_column_visibility", False):
        return None
    if not getattr(scheme, "_column_filter_for_others", False):
        return None

    if catalog_models is None:
        msg = f"Column masking for {model_type.__name__} requires an authoritative planning catalog"
        raise PermissionCompilationError(msg)

    from _internal.type_utils import is_optional_type
    from l1000_schema.column_visibility import ColumnVisibility, get_field_visibility

    owner_field: str = getattr(scheme, "_owner_field", "sys_id")
    private_field_definitions: dict[str, list[tuple[type[DatabaseObjectRow], Any]]] = {}
    schema_models = get_schema_models_for_table(model_type)
    owned_models = set(catalog_models)
    schema_models = tuple(schema_model for schema_model in schema_models if schema_model is model_type or schema_model in owned_models)
    for schema_model in schema_models:
        for field_name, field_info in schema_model.model_fields.items():
            if field_name == owner_field or field_name in _COLUMN_MASKING_INFRA_FIELDS:
                continue
            if get_field_visibility(schema_model, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) == ColumnVisibility.PUBLIC:
                continue
            private_field_definitions.setdefault(field_name, []).append(
                (schema_model, field_info),
            )

    private_columns: list[str] = []
    for field_name, definitions in private_field_definitions.items():
        non_nullable_definition = next(
            (
                (schema_model, field_info)
                for schema_model, field_info in definitions
                if field_info.annotation is None or not is_optional_type(field_info.annotation)
            ),
            None,
        )
        if non_nullable_definition is None:
            private_columns.append(field_name)
            continue
        schema_model, _field_info = non_nullable_definition
        msg = (
            f"{schema_model.__name__}.{field_name} is private but non-nullable; "
            "SelfOwnership column masking can only hide nullable private fields. "
            "Make the field nullable or use strict row filtering for this scheme."
        )
        raise PermissionCompilationError(msg)

    if not private_columns:
        return None

    private_field_names = set(private_columns)
    private_columns.extend(
        large_column_pointer_name(config.column)
        for config in get_large_column_configs(model_type)
        if config.column in private_field_names
    )
    return (owner_field, private_columns)


@pure_lazy
def _compile(
    model_type: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    session_id: SessionId,
    *,
    table_alias: str | None,
    txn: ReadTransaction | WriteTransaction | LazyReadTransaction | LazyWriteTransaction,
    action: str = "read",
    versioning_domain: type[VersioningDomain] | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
    from l4000_permissions.permission_enforcement import (
        _try_get_permission_scheme_for_planning,
        get_query_permission_plan,
    )

    scheme = _try_get_permission_scheme_for_planning(model_type)
    if scheme is None:
        return None

    permission_plan = get_query_permission_plan(model_type, action=action)
    if permission_plan is not None and not permission_plan.filter_rows:
        return None

    policy_expr = scheme.get_policy_expression(model_type, action=action)
    if policy_expr is None:
        return None

    txn = require_permission_compile_txn(txn)

    # Lazy/server-plan compile phases must stay pure: compile the permission
    # expression against a SQL user-id subquery instead of resolving the
    # session eagerly during lowering/compile.
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.query.stmt_dynamic import SqlDynamicSelectStmt
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlSubquery
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
    from impl.common.l7300_cross_branch.permission_expression_compiler import (
        compile_permission_where_with_user_id_sql,
        compile_versioned_permission_where_with_user_id_sql,
        permission_version_anchor_from_txn,
    )
    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import VersionedObjectRow

    alias = table_alias or get_table_name(model_type)
    user_id_sql = SqlSubquery(
        SqlDynamicSelectStmt(
            from_table=SqlTableName("sys_sessions"),
            columns=[SqlColumnName("user_id")],
            where_conditions=[
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlParam(session_id.unwrap_to_sql()),
                ),
            ],
            limit=1,
        ),
    )
    if issubclass(model_type, VersionedObjectRow):
        if versioning_domain is None:
            msg = f"Permission compilation for {model_type.__name__} requires an explicit versioning_domain from the planning context"
            raise PermissionCompilationError(msg)
        return cast(
            "SqlRenderable | None",
            compile_versioned_permission_where_with_user_id_sql(
                cast("Any", model_type),
                user_id_sql,
                alias,
                action=action,
                version_anchor=permission_version_anchor_from_txn(versioning_domain, txn),
                session_id_sql=SqlParam(session_id.unwrap_to_sql()),
            ),
        )
    return cast(
        "SqlRenderable | None",
        compile_permission_where_with_user_id_sql(
            cast("Any", model_type),
            user_id_sql,
            alias,
            action=action,
            session_id_sql=SqlParam(session_id.unwrap_to_sql()),
        ),
    )

def _create_sys_sessions_table(db: sqlite3.Connection, lookup_columns: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
    declared_columns = ["sys_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY"]

    declared_columns.extend(
        [
            "drift_uuid TEXT",

        tuple(values.values()),
    )

@pytest.mark.parametrize("async_surface", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("shared_manifest", [False, True])
def test_migrated_h14_admission_rejects_predecessor_and_accepts_replacement(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    backend_config: Mapping[str, JsonValue],
    async_surface: bool,
    shared_manifest: bool,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    backend, params = _backend_target(db_connection, backend_config)
    previous, replacement = _generations()
    replacement_manifest_key = previous.key if shared_manifest else replacement.key
    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    core = DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor()

    def plan(contributor: matching.H14ProjectionBootstrapContributor) -> BootstrapEnginePlan:
        return coordinator.build_engine_plan(
            manifest_key=(previous.key if shared_manifest else contributor.key),
            model_classes=(),
            contributors=(core, contributor),
            dialect=db_connection.get_dialect(),
        )

    old_plan = plan(previous)
    coordinator.run(
        db_connection,
        manifest_key=previous.key,
        model_classes=(),
        contributors=(core, previous),
        engine_plan=old_plan,
    )
    rebuilt_old_plan = plan(previous)
    assert rebuilt_old_plan.desired_primitives == old_plan.desired_primitives
    assert rebuilt_old_plan.plan_hash == old_plan.plan_hash
    new_plan = plan(replacement)
    old_contract = build_read_only_bootstrap_contract(old_plan)
    new_contract = build_read_only_bootstrap_contract(new_plan)

    def open_reader(expected: ReadOnlyBootstrapContract) -> None:
        async def open_async() -> None:
            reader = await open_validated_read_only_connection_async(backend, params, contract=expected)
            await reader.close_async()

        if async_surface:
            asyncio.run(open_async())
        else:
            reader = open_validated_read_only_connection(backend, params, contract=expected)
            reader.close()

    open_reader(old_contract)
    with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
        resolve_terminal_sync(
            schema, "serverplan_test", replacement.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_artifact=previous.fitted.artifact)
        )
    rebuilt_new_plan = plan(replacement)
    assert rebuilt_new_plan.desired_primitives == new_plan.desired_primitives
    assert rebuilt_new_plan.plan_hash == new_plan.plan_hash
    with pytest.raises(ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError) as failure:
        open_reader(old_contract)
    assert failure.value.reason is ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason.CONTRACT_MISMATCH
    with pytest.raises(ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError) as unpublished:
        open_reader(new_contract)
    assert unpublished.value.reason is (
        ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason.PROOF_MISMATCH if shared_manifest else ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason.NOT_BOOTSTRAPPED
    )
    coordinator.run(db_connection, manifest_key=replacement_manifest_key, model_classes=(), contributors=(core, replacement))
    open_reader(new_contract)
    with pytest.raises(ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError) as retired:
        open_reader(old_contract)
    assert retired.value.reason is (
        ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason.PROOF_MISMATCH if shared_manifest else ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason.CONTRACT_MISMATCH
    )
    with pytest.raises(ProgrammingError, match="row_content_matches"):
        coordinator.run(db_connection, manifest_key=previous.key, model_classes=(), contributors=(core, previous))
    open_reader(new_contract)
    session = db_connection.session(system_session_id)
    assert (
        session.read(
            fn=lambda txn: matching.load_h14_projection(
                txn,
                previous.fitted.artifact.artifact_id,
            )
        )
        == previous.fitted
    )
    assert (
        session.read(
            fn=lambda txn: matching.load_h14_projection(
                txn,
                replacement.fitted.artifact.artifact_id,
            )
        )
        == replacement.fitted
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("async_surface", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("damage", ["tensor", "extra", "missing", "activation"])
def test_h14_schema_contributor_validates_persisted_generation_on_open(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    backend_config: Mapping[str, JsonValue],
    async_surface: bool,
    damage: str,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    backend, params = _backend_target(db_connection, backend_config)
    artifact, blobs = h14_fixture()
    fitted = matching.H14ProjectionFitResult(
        artifact=artifact,
        mean_payload=blobs[artifact.mean_tensor.digest],
        rotation_payload=blobs[artifact.rotation_tensor.digest],
        threshold_payload=blobs[artifact.threshold_tensor.digest],
        residual_payload=blobs[artifact.residual_tensor.digest],
    )
    contributor = matching.H14ProjectionBootstrapContributor(fitted=fitted)
    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    contributors = (DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(), contributor)
    writer = create_connection_from_params(str(backend), dict(params))
    try:
        coordinator.run(writer, manifest_key="h14-schema-admission", model_classes=(), contributors=contributors)
        contract = build_read_only_bootstrap_contract(
            coordinator.build_engine_plan(
                manifest_key="h14-schema-admission",
                model_classes=(),
                contributors=contributors,
                dialect=writer.get_dialect(),
            )
        )

        async def open_async() -> None:
            reader = await open_validated_read_only_connection_async(backend, params, contract=contract)
            await reader.close_async()

        def open_reader() -> None:
            if async_surface:
                asyncio.run(open_async())
            else:
                reader = open_validated_read_only_connection(backend, params, contract=contract)
                reader.close()

        open_reader()
        session = writer.session(system_session_id)
        tensors = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.query(matching.MatchingProjectionTensorRow).execute())
        activations = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.query(matching.MatchingProjectionActivationRow).execute())
        assert len(tensors) == 4
        assert len(activations) == 1
        tensor = tensors[0]
        activation = activations[0]
        extra = validated_model_update(tensor, {"sys_id": SysId.new(), "role": "unexpected"})
        if damage == "tensor":
            changed = validated_model_update(tensor, {"payload": b"corrupt"})
            session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.update(type(tensor), changed))
        elif damage == "extra":
            session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.insert(type(tensor), extra))
        elif damage == "missing":
            session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.delete_by_id(type(tensor), tensor.sys_id))
        else:
            changed_activation = validated_model_update(activation, {"physical_type": "unknown-profile"})
            session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.update(type(activation), changed_activation))
        try:
            with pytest.raises(ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError) as caught:
                open_reader()
            assert caught.value.reason is ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason.CONTRACT_MISMATCH
        finally:
            if damage == "extra":
                session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.delete_by_id(type(tensor), extra.sys_id))
            elif damage == "missing":
                session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.insert(type(tensor), tensor))
            elif damage == "tensor":
                session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.update(type(tensor), tensor))
            else:
                session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.update(type(activation), activation))
        open_reader()
    finally:
        writer.close()

def test_branch_input_rejects_sibling_publication(column: str, reference: str) -> None:
    """A sibling scalar must not replace an absent branch producer."""
    hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(uuid_columns=frozenset({column}))
    sibling = cte_ref(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_1.other_branch"),
        columns=(column,),
        column_type_hints=hints,
        auxiliary_query=SqlPublishedRowsQuery(
            columns=(column,),
            rows=[{column: (BranchId.new() if column == "branch_id" else RevisionId.new()).unwrap_to_str()}],
            type_hints=hints,
        ),
    )
    ctx = make_compilation_context(cte_refs={"step_1.other_branch": sibling})
    with pytest.raises(ProgrammingError, match="has no CTE binding"):
        _compile_branch_inputs(ctx, reference)
    with pytest.raises(ProgrammingError, match="without a published CTE binding"):
        effective_versioned_branch_id(
            ctx=ctx, resolved_branch_id=None, branch_cte_ref=None, branch_ref_id=reference,
        )

)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("route", ["direct", "contributor"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("changed_payload", [b"\xff\x00\x80", b"\xfe\x00\x80", b""])
def test_immutable_binary_publication_preserves_authoritative_bytes(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    route: str,
    changed_payload: bytes,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    expected = ImmutableBinaryRow(label="tensor", digest="unchanged-label", payload=b"\xff\x00\x80")

    def publish(row: ImmutableBinaryRow) -> None:
        with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
            if route == "direct":
                resolve_terminal_sync(
                    schema,
                    "serverplan_test",
                    schema.ensure_bootstrap_immutable_row_lazy(
                        BootstrapImmutableRowPrimitivePayload.from_row(
                            ImmutableBinaryRow,
                            row,
                            immutable_fields=_IMMUTABLE_FIELDS,
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            else:

                class Contributor:
                    key = "immutable-binary-content"
                    version = "1"
                    contract_fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(
                        row.model_dump_json(include={"sys_id", "label", "digest"}).encode() + row.payload,
                    ).hexdigest()

                    def contribute(self: Contributor, state: BootstrapPrimitiveState) -> None:
                        state.ensure_immutable_row(
                            ImmutableBinaryRow,
                            row=row,
                            immutable_fields=_IMMUTABLE_FIELDS,
                        )

                coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
                engine = coordinator.build_engine_plan(
                    manifest_key="immutable-binary-content",
                    model_classes=(),
                    contributors=(Contributor(),),
                    include_core=False,
                )
                data = coordinator._data_primitive_plan_for_plan(engine, execute_data_primitives=True)
                assert len(data.data_mutations) == 1
                resolve_terminal_sync(
                    schema, "serverplan_test", coordinator._install_data_mutation_contract(schema, data.data_mutations[0], ())
                )

    publish(expected)
    session = db_connection.session(system_session_id)
    stored = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(ImmutableBinaryRow, expected.sys_id))
    assert stored is not None
    assert stored.payload == expected.payload
    publish(expected)
    changed = ImmutableBinaryRow(
        sys_id=expected.sys_id,
        label=expected.label,
        digest=expected.digest,
        payload=changed_payload,
    )
    if changed_payload == expected.payload:
        publish(changed)
    else:
        with pytest.raises(ProgrammingError, match="row_content_matches"):
            publish(changed)
    assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(ImmutableBinaryRow, expected.sys_id)) == stored


@pytest.mark.parametrize("wrong_predecessor", [False, True])
def test_immutable_binary_replacement_checks_predecessor_bytes_and_completed_retry(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    wrong_predecessor: bool,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    previous = ImmutableBinaryRow(label="tensor", digest="unchanged-label", payload=b"\xff\x00\x80")
    replacement = ImmutableBinaryRow(
        sys_id=previous.sys_id,
        label=previous.label,
        digest=previous.digest,
        payload=b"\xfd\x00\x80",
    )
    with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
        resolve_terminal_sync(
            schema,
            "serverplan_test",
            schema.ensure_bootstrap_immutable_row_lazy(
                BootstrapImmutableRowPrimitivePayload.from_row(
                    ImmutableBinaryRow,
                    previous,
                    immutable_fields=_IMMUTABLE_FIELDS,
                ),
            ),
        )
    session = db_connection.session(system_session_id)
    stored = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(ImmutableBinaryRow, previous.sys_id))
    assert stored is not None
    predecessor = ImmutableBinaryRow(
        sys_id=previous.sys_id,
        label=previous.label,
        digest=previous.digest,
        payload=b"\xfe\x00\x80" if wrong_predecessor else previous.payload,
    )

    def replace() -> None:
        with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
            resolve_terminal_sync(
                schema,
                "serverplan_test",
                schema.replace_bootstrap_immutable_row_lazy(
                    BootstrapImmutableRowPrimitivePayload.from_row(
                        ImmutableBinaryRow,
                        replacement,
                        immutable_fields=_IMMUTABLE_FIELDS,
                    ),
                    previous_declaration=BootstrapImmutableRowPrimitivePayload.from_row(
                        ImmutableBinaryRow,
                        predecessor,
                        immutable_fields=_IMMUTABLE_FIELDS,
                    ),
                ),
            )

    if wrong_predecessor:
        with pytest.raises(ProgrammingError, match="row_content_matches"):
            replace()
        assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(ImmutableBinaryRow, previous.sys_id)) == stored
    else:
        replace()
        persisted = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(ImmutableBinaryRow, previous.sys_id))
        assert persisted is not None
        assert persisted.payload == replacement.payload
        assert persisted.created_at == stored.created_at
        replace()
        assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(ImmutableBinaryRow, previous.sys_id)) == persisted


def test_immutable_binary_declaration_copies_caller_content(system_session_id: SessionId) -> None:
    row = ImmutableBinaryRow(label="tensor", digest="unchanged-label", payload=b"\xff\x00\x80")
    state = BootstrapPrimitiveState()
    state.ensure_immutable_row(ImmutableBinaryRow, row=row, immutable_fields=_IMMUTABLE_FIELDS)

    assert isinstance(payload, BootstrapImmutableRowPrimitivePayload)
    snapshot = payload.row
    assert isinstance(snapshot, ImmutableBinaryRow)
    assert snapshot.payload == b"\xff\x00\x80"

def test_immutable_binary_fact_hash_tracks_bytes_but_not_framework_timestamps(system_session_id: SessionId) -> None:
    original = ImmutableBinaryRow(label="tensor", digest="unchanged-label", payload=b"\xff\x00\x80")

    def declared_hash(row: ImmutableBinaryRow) -> BootstrapFactsHash:
        state = BootstrapPrimitiveState()
        state.ensure_immutable_row(ImmutableBinaryRow, row=row, immutable_fields=_IMMUTABLE_FIELDS)
        return state.desired_primitives[0].identity.fact_hash

@pytest.mark.parametrize("parent_change", ["retarget", "tombstone", "future-incident"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("tipless", [False, True])
def test_fork_incident_publication_ignores_parent_windows_after_fork(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection, parent_change: str, tipless: bool,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    conn = db_connection
    session = SessionId.schema()
    domain = graph.CASCADE_DOMAIN
    parent, graph_id, alice, bob, charlie, edge_ab, edge_bc, _ = graph.setup_test_graph(
        conn, domain, graph.CascadeTestGraph, graph.CascadeTestNode, graph.CascadeTestEdge, session,
    )
    base = select_branch_tip_revision(conn, domain, parent)
    selector = ConnectionId("incident-fork-cutoff")

    def fork(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> BranchId:
        child = txn.create_branch("incident-child", from_revision_id=base,
            tip_materialization=BranchTipMaterialization.TIPLESS if tipless else BranchTipMaterialization.MATERIALIZED)
        txn.commit()
        return child

    child = conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=parent, connection_id=selector, fn=fork)

    def change_parent(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> RevisionId:
        if parent_change == "retarget":
            txn.query(graph.CascadeTestEdge).filter(field(graph.CascadeTestEdge.sys_id) == edge_ab).update(target_sys_id=charlie)
        elif parent_change == "tombstone":
            txn.delete_by_id(graph.CascadeTestEdge, edge_ab)
        else:
            txn.insert(graph.CascadeTestEdge, graph.CascadeTestEdge(graph_sys_id=graph_id, source_sys_id=bob, target_sys_id=alice, label="after-fork"))
        return txn.commit_branch(message="Parent change after child fork")

    parent_tip = conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=parent, connection_id=selector, fn=change_parent)

    def snapshot(txn: SyncVersionedReadTransaction) -> tuple[bool, list[tuple[str, str, str]]]:
        edges = txn.query(graph.CascadeTestEdge).execute()
        return txn.select_one(graph.CascadeTestNode, bob) is not None, sorted((str(edge.sys_id), str(edge.source_sys_id), str(edge.target_sys_id)) for edge in edges)

    ancestors = SqlCteName("fork_reachable_revisions")
    cutoff_query = SqlWith([
        lower_revision_ancestry_cte(cte_name=ancestors, seed=base,
            revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"), max_depth=None, track_depth=False),
    ], incident_ancestor_cutoff_query(
        SqlSelect(select=[SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("rev_id"))], from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(str(ancestors)))),
        SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(str(get_table_name(domain.revision_branch_index_model))))),
        SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_revision_physical_keys"))),
        cte_prefix=SqlTableName("fork_incident"),
    ), recursive=True)
    cutoffs = {str(row["branch_id"]): row["cutoff_seq"] for row in fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(conn, cutoff_query)}
    keys = {str(row["revision_sys_id"]): row["sys_id"] for row in fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(conn,
        SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_revision_physical_keys"))))}
    assert cutoffs[str(parent)] == keys[str(base)]
    assert cutoffs[str(parent)] != keys[str(parent_tip)]
    endpoint_query = SqlSelect(select=[SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(value,
        cast_type=SqlTypeName("UUID") if isinstance(conn, SyncPostgresConnection) else None), SqlAliasName(name))
        for name, value in (("graph_sys_id", graph_id), ("node_sys_id", bob))])
    candidate_query = incident_history_candidate_query(
        SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_graph_incident_postings"))),
        cutoff_query, endpoint_query, edge_table=SqlTableName("cascade_test_edges"),
        cte_prefix=SqlTableName("fork_incident_candidates"), lateral_probes=isinstance(conn, SyncPostgresConnection),
    )
    candidates = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(conn, candidate_query)
    assert {(str(row["sys_id"]), str(row["candidate_graph_sys_id"]), str(row["candidate_node_sys_id"]))
            for row in candidates} == {(str(edge_ab), str(graph_id), str(bob)), (str(edge_bc), str(graph_id), str(bob))}

    def establish_coverage(branch_id: BranchId) -> None:
        def rebuild(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
            plan = txn.plan()
            assert isinstance(plan, BaseServerPlan)
            plan.add_step(RebuildIncidentPostingsStep(
                ServerPlanRefId(f"rebuild_{branch_id}"), sparse_table=SqlTableName("cascade_test_edges_sparse"),
                edge_table=SqlTableName("cascade_test_edges"), branch_ref=ServerRefs.scalar(branch_id),
            ))
            plan.execute()
        conn.session(session).write(fn=rebuild)

    establish_coverage(parent)
    establish_coverage(child)

    parent_before = conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, revision=parent_tip, fn=snapshot)
    fork_before = conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, revision=base, fn=snapshot)
    assert fork_before[0] and len(fork_before[1]) == 3
    assert conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=child, fn=snapshot) == fork_before

    def remove(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> RevisionId:
        txn.delete_by_id(graph.CascadeTestNode, bob)
        return txn.commit_branch(message="Delete child incident node")

    published = conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=child, connection_id=selector, fn=remove)
    present, child_edges = conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, revision=published, fn=snapshot)
    assert not present
    winners = SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned(
        table=SqlTableName("cascade_test_edges_sparse"), revision_parents_table=SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents"),
        branch_id=child, revision_id=published, include_deleted=True,
        ancestor_cte_name=SqlCteName("child_authoritative_ancestors"),
    )
    assert fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(conn, recheck_incident_winners_query(candidate_query, winners,
        output_columns=(SqlColumnName("sys_id"),), cte_prefix=SqlTableName("child_incident_recheck"))) == []
    assert len(child_edges) == 1
    assert all(str(bob) not in (source, target) for _, source, target in child_edges)
    assert conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=parent, fn=snapshot) == parent_before
    assert conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, revision=base, fn=snapshot) == fork_before

@pytest.mark.parametrize("history_rows", [64, 4096, 32768])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("operation", ["lookup", "history-candidates", "delete-window"])
def test_historical_cutoff_probe_has_fixed_executed_work(db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, history_rows: int, operation: str) -> None:
    assert isinstance(db_connection, SyncSqliteConnection | SyncPostgresConnection | SyncMariaDBConnection)
    backend = BackendType.SQLITE if isinstance(db_connection, SyncSqliteConnection) else (
        BackendType.POSTGRES if isinstance(db_connection, SyncPostgresConnection) else BackendType.MARIADB
    )
    dialect = make_compilation_context(make_backend_profile(backend)).dialect
    assert dialect is not None
    native = db_connection._conn if isinstance(db_connection, SyncSqliteConnection) else None
    branch, graph, endpoint, target = (str(value) for value in (BranchId.new(), SysId.new(), SysId.new(), SysId.new()))
    edge = str(SysId.new())
    columns = tuple(SqlColumnName(name) for name in (
        "branch_id", "graph_sys_id", "direction", "endpoint_sys_id", "bucket_level", "bucket_number",
        "edge_table_name", "sys_id", "valid_from_seq", "valid_to_seq", "source_sys_id", "target_sys_id",
    ))
    for start in range(1, history_rows + 1, 256):
        execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlInsert(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_graph_incident_postings")),
            columns=SqlColumnNameList(columns), values=SqlValuesClause([
                SqlValuesRow([SqlParam(value) for value in (
                    branch, graph, 0, endpoint, 0, point, "sample_edges", edge, point, point + 1, endpoint, target,
                )]) for point in range(start, min(start + 256, history_rows + 1))
            ])))
    point = history_rows // 2
    cutoffs = SqlSelect(select=[SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(value, cast_type=SqlTypeName("UUID")
        if backend is BackendType.POSTGRES and name in {"branch_id", "graph_sys_id", "endpoint_sys_id"} else None), SqlAliasName(name)) for name, value in dict(
        branch_id=branch, graph_sys_id=graph, direction=0, endpoint_sys_id=endpoint, cutoff_seq=point,
    ).items()])
    query = incident_posting_lookup_query(
        SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_graph_incident_postings"))), cutoffs,
        identity_columns=(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), SqlColumnName("valid_from_seq")), cte_prefix=SqlTableName("historical"),
        lateral_probes=backend is BackendType.POSTGRES,
    )
    if operation == "history-candidates":
        def uuid_param(value: str) -> SqlParam:
            return SqlParam(value, cast_type=SqlTypeName("UUID") if backend is BackendType.POSTGRES else None)

        query = incident_history_candidate_query(
            SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_graph_incident_postings"))),
            SqlSelect(select=[SqlColumnAlias(uuid_param(branch), SqlAliasName("branch_id")),
                              SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(point), SqlAliasName("cutoff_seq"))]),
            SqlSelect(select=[SqlColumnAlias(uuid_param(graph), SqlAliasName("graph_sys_id")),
                              SqlColumnAlias(uuid_param(endpoint), SqlAliasName("node_sys_id"))]),
            edge_table=SqlTableName("sample_edges"), cte_prefix=SqlTableName("historical_candidates"),
            lateral_probes=backend is BackendType.POSTGRES,
        )
    if operation == "delete-window":
        window = SqlSelect(select=[SqlColumnAlias(SqlParam(value, cast_type=SqlTypeName("UUID")
            if backend is BackendType.POSTGRES and name in {"branch_id", "sys_id"} else None), SqlAliasName(name))
            for name, value in dict(branch_id=branch, sys_id=edge, valid_from_seq=point).items()])
        query = replace_incident_window_postings(window, edge_table=SqlTableName("sample_edges"),
            joined_delete=backend is BackendType.MARIADB).statements[0]
    sql, params = render_to_sql(query, dialect)
    instructions = 0

    def progress() -> int:
        nonlocal instructions
        instructions += 100
        return 0

    if native is not None:
        assert isinstance(native, sqlite3.Connection)
        native.set_progress_handler(progress, 100)
        try:
            rows = native.execute(sql, params).fetchall()
        finally:
            native.set_progress_handler(None, 0)
        expected: list[tuple[object, ...]] = [(edge, point)] if operation == "lookup" else [(edge, graph, endpoint)] if operation == "history-candidates" else []
        assert [tuple(row) for row in rows] == expected
        if operation == "delete-window":
            assert native.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_graph_incident_postings").fetchone()[0] == history_rows - 1
        assert instructions <= 10000, f"historical posting lookup executed {instructions} instructions"
    else:
        if operation != "delete-window":
            result = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, query)
            if operation == "lookup":
                assert [(str(row["sys_id"]), row["valid_from_seq"]) for row in result] == [(edge, point)]
            else:
                assert [(str(row["sys_id"]), str(row["candidate_graph_sys_id"]), str(row["candidate_node_sys_id"]))
                        for row in result] == [(edge, graph, endpoint)]
        prefix = "ANALYZE FORMAT=JSON " if backend is BackendType.MARIADB else "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON) "
        record = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, _TestSqlWrapper(prefix + sql, params))[0][0]
        pending: list[object] = [json.loads(record) if isinstance(record, str) else record]
        work = 0.0
        while pending:
            node = pending.pop()
            if isinstance(node, dict):
                if backend is BackendType.POSTGRES:
                    work += (float(node.get("Actual Rows", 0)) + float(node.get("Rows Removed by Filter", 0))
                             + float(node.get("Rows Removed by Join Filter", 0))) * float(node.get("Actual Loops", 0))
                else:
                    work += float(node.get("r_rows", 0) or 0) * float(node.get("r_loops", 0) or 0)
                pending.extend(node.values())
            elif isinstance(node, list):
                pending.extend(node)
        if operation == "delete-window":
            count = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlSelect(
                select=[SqlAggregate(AggregateKind.COUNT, SqlStar())],
                from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_graph_incident_postings")),
            ))[0][0]
            assert count == history_rows - 1
        assert work > 0
        assert work <= 1000, f"historical posting lookup visited {work} rows"

        search=None,
        select_columns=None if columns is None else [column for column in columns],
        order_by=(),
        limit=None,
        offset=None,
    )
    source = compile_versioned_query(
        query,
        model,
        ctx,
        revision_id_override=SqlParam(revision) if isinstance(revision, str) else revision,
        branch_id_override=branch,
        raw_mode=True,
        preserve_revision_override=True,
    ).grammar
    definitions: list[SqlCteDefinition] = []
    if isinstance(source, (SqlWith, SqlSelectStarSparseAncestryVersioned)):
        definitions, source = source.split_for_outer_cte()
    definitions.append(SqlCteDefinition(name, source))
    return definitions


def compile_visible_hybrid_fts(
    model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    spec: QuerySpec,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    branch_id: str | None,
    branch_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
    user_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None,
) -> CompiledStep[object]:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioned_hybrid_search import (
        _authorized_search_spec,
        _compile_branch_inputs,
        _effective_branch_id,
        _require_hybrid_revision_id,
        _require_hybrid_fts_inputs,
        _score_prereq_type_hints,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.hybrid_document_rank import hybrid_document_rank
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_fts_search import _build_versioned_fts_components, _build_postgres_tsquery_expr
    from l2070_batching.backend_profile import FtsSqlTransport
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.versioning_intent_steps import _collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlFrom, SqlJoin, SqlSelectAlias, SqlTableAlias
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp, OrderDirection
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, sql_and
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlOrderByItem
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
    from l2070_batching.post_op import row_dicts_post_op
    from l2070_batching.server_ref import ScalarServerRef
    from l2070_batching.step import CompiledOutputShape, DeclaredResultRelation, synthetic_output_field
    from l5100_fts.fts_components import SqlFTSJoinStyle
    from l5100_fts.fts_query import FTSSearchMode

    resolved, binding = (
        (branch_id, None) if branch_id is not None else _compile_branch_inputs(ctx, str(branch_ref) if branch_ref is not None else None)
    )
    branch = _effective_branch_id(ctx, resolved, binding, branch_ref_id=str(branch_ref) if branch_ref is not None else None)
    branch_sql = SqlParam(branch) if isinstance(branch, str) else branch
    revision = _require_hybrid_revision_id(ctx, "hybrid visible FTS", branch_id=branch_sql, branch_source_ref_id=branch_ref)
    authorized = _authorized_search_spec(spec, model, ctx, user_ref)
    definitions = visible_hybrid_source(model, authorized, ctx, revision=revision, branch=branch_sql, name="hybrid_fts_visible")
    text, fields = _require_hybrid_fts_inputs(spec, versioned=True)
    sparse_table = derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(str(get_table_name(model))))).sparse
    query_expr = (
        _build_postgres_tsquery_expr(model_cls=model, query_expr=SqlParam(text), mode=spec.search_op.fts_mode)
        if ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.TEXT_SEARCH_VECTOR
        else SqlParam(text)
    )
    components = _build_versioned_fts_components(
        model_cls=model,
        field_names=fields,
        sparse_table_name=sparse_table,
        query_expr=query_expr,
        table_alias="s",
        ctx=ctx,
        fts_mode=spec.search_op.fts_mode,
        sqlite_literal_query_text=text,
        source_revision_column="sys_valid_from_revision_id",
    )
    joins = [
        SqlJoin(
            "INNER",
            table=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("hybrid_fts_visible")), SqlAliasName("visible")),
            on=sql_and(
                *(
                    SqlBinaryOp(
                        SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier="s"),
                        BinaryOp.EQ,
                        SqlColumnRef(
                            SqlColumnName("sys_revision_id" if column == "sys_valid_from_revision_id" else column),
                            qualifier="visible",
                        ),
                    )
                    for column in ("sys_id", "sys_valid_from_revision_id")
                )
            ),
        )
    ]
    condition: SqlRenderable | None = components.where_clause
    if components.join_style == SqlFTSJoinStyle.JOIN_ON_CONDITION:
        assert components.join_clause is not None
        joins.append(SqlJoin("INNER", table=components.join_clause, on=condition))
        condition = None
    else:
        assert components.join_style is SqlFTSJoinStyle.WHERE_ONLY, "Versioned hybrid requires native per-document matching"
    rank = hybrid_document_rank(
        model,
        ctx,
        query=text,
        fields=fields,
        mode=spec.search_op.fts_mode or FTSSearchMode.NATURAL,
        table_name=sparse_table,
        table_alias="s",
        source_revision_column="sys_valid_from_revision_id",
    )
    grammar = SqlSelect(
        select=[
            SqlSelectAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier="s"), SqlAliasName("object_id")),
            SqlSelectAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), qualifier="s"), SqlAliasName("branch_id")),
            SqlSelectAlias(rank, SqlAliasName("rank")),
        ],
        from_=SqlFrom(SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(sparse_table)), SqlAliasName("s"))),
        joins=joins,
        where=condition,
        order_by=[
            SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("rank")), OrderDirection.DESC),
            SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier="s"), OrderDirection.ASC),
        ],
        limit=spec.search_op.rrf_fts_candidates,
    )
    columns = ("object_id", "branch_id", "rank")
    shape = CompiledOutputShape(tuple(synthetic_output_field(column, role="hybrid_fts_scores") for column in columns))
    dependency_refs = [str(ref) for ref in (branch_ref, user_ref) if ref is not None]
    if isinstance(ctx.lazy_revision, ScalarServerRef):
        dependency_refs.extend(ctx.lazy_revision.dependencies())
    return CompiledStep(
        grammar=SqlCte(definitions, grammar),
        needs_returning=True,
        output_shape=shape,
        result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(shape),
        column_type_hints=_score_prereq_type_hints(columns),
        auxiliary_ctes=_collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, *dependency_refs),
        closed_post_op=row_dicts_post_op(),
    )

    for name, columns in tables:

        execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlCreateTable(
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(name)), SqlTableBody((
                *(SqlColumnDef(SqlColumnName(column), SqlTypeName(
                    "BOOLEAN" if column == "sys_deleted" else "BIGINT" if column.endswith("_seq") else uuid_type,
                )) for column in columns),
                *primary_constraints,
            )),
        ))
    execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlCreateTable(
        SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_revision_physical_keys")), SqlTableBody((
            SqlColumnDef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), SqlTypeName("BIGINT")),
            SqlColumnDef(SqlColumnName("revision_sys_id"), SqlTypeName(uuid_type)),
        )),
    ))
    execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlCreateTable(
        SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_revision_parents")), SqlTableBody((
            SqlColumnDef(SqlColumnName("revision_sys_id"), SqlTypeName(uuid_type)),
            SqlColumnDef(SqlColumnName("parent_revision_sys_id"), SqlTypeName(uuid_type)),
        )),
    ))
    if backend is BackendType.MARIADB:
        for ddl in (
            "ALTER TABLE probe_edges_sparse CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
            "ALTER TABLE probe_edges_staged CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
            "ALTER TABLE probe_nodes_sparse CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
            "ALTER TABLE probe_nodes_staged CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
            "ALTER TABLE sys_revision_physical_keys CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
            "ALTER TABLE sys_revision_parents CONVERT TO CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin",
        ):
            execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, _TestSqlWrapper(ddl))
    branch, revision, staged = BranchId.new(), RevisionId.new(), StagedCommitId.new()
    source, target, graph, edge = (SysId.new() for _ in range(4))
    try:
        execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlInsert(
            SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_revision_physical_keys")),
            columns=SqlColumnNameList((SqlColumnName("sys_id"), SqlColumnName("revision_sys_id"))),
            values=SqlValuesClause((SqlValuesRow((SqlParam(1), SqlParam(str(revision)))),)),
        ))
        if endpoint_storage == "sparse":
            execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlInsert(
                SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("probe_nodes_sparse")),
                columns=SqlColumnNameList(tuple(SqlColumnName(c) for c in node_columns)),
                values=SqlValuesClause(tuple(SqlValuesRow(tuple(SqlParam(v) for v in (
                    str(branch), str(node), 1, None, False,
                ))) for node in (source, target) if not missing_endpoint or node != source)),
            ))
        for name, columns, rows in (
            ("probe_nodes_staged", node_staged, [
                (str(branch), str(node), str(graph), str(staged), False)
                for node in (source, target) if endpoint_storage == "staged" and (not missing_endpoint or node != source)
            ]),
            ("probe_edges_staged", staged_columns, [
                (str(branch), str(edge), str(graph), str(source), str(target), str(staged), False),
            ]),
        ):
            if not rows:
                continue
            execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlInsert(
                SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(name)), columns=SqlColumnNameList(tuple(SqlColumnName(c) for c in columns)),
                values=SqlValuesClause(tuple(SqlValuesRow(tuple(SqlParam(v) for v in row)) for row in rows)),

            node_sparse_tables=(SqlTableName("probe_nodes_sparse"),), node_staged_tables=(SqlTableName("probe_nodes_staged"),), revision_id_raw=revision,
        ))
        compiled = step.compile(replace(make_compilation_context(make_backend_profile(backend)), branch_tip_materialized=True))
        assert compiled.grammar is not None
        violations = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, compiled.grammar)

        for ddl in ("DROP TABLE sys_revision_parents", "DROP TABLE sys_revision_physical_keys", "DROP TABLE probe_nodes_staged", "DROP TABLE probe_nodes_sparse", "DROP TABLE probe_edges_staged", "DROP TABLE probe_edges_sparse"):

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest
