@pytest.mark.parametrize("rollback", [False, True])
def test_squash_inherited_graph_preserves_tombstones_and_old_reads(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    rollback: bool,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    conn = db_connection
    session = SessionId.schema()
    domain = graph.CASCADE_DOMAIN
    parent, _, _, bob, _, edge_ab, _, _ = graph.setup_test_graph(
        conn,
        domain,
        graph.CascadeTestGraph,
        graph.CascadeTestNode,
        graph.CascadeTestEdge,
        session,
    )
    selector = ConnectionId("squash-lifecycle")

    def boundary(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> RevisionId:
        return txn.commit_branch(message="Fork boundary", allow_empty=True)

    base = conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=parent, connection_id=selector, fn=boundary)

    def fork(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> BranchId:
        child = txn.create_branch("inherited-child", from_revision_id=base)
        txn.commit()
        return child

    child = conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=parent, connection_id=selector, fn=fork)

    def remove(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> RevisionId:
        txn.delete_by_id(graph.CascadeTestNode, bob)
        return txn.commit_branch(message="Delete inherited node")

    deleted = conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=child, connection_id=selector, fn=remove)

    def advance(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> RevisionId:
        return txn.commit_branch(message="Retain deletion", allow_empty=True)

    before = conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=child, connection_id=selector, fn=advance)

    def visible(txn: SyncVersionedReadTransaction) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
        return txn.select_one(graph.CascadeTestNode, bob) is not None, txn.select_one(graph.CascadeTestEdge, edge_ab) is not None

    assert conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=child, fn=visible) == (False, False)
    assert conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, revision=base, fn=visible) == (True, True)
    assert conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=parent, fn=visible) == (True, True)

    def squash(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> RevisionId:
        revision = txn.squash_branch(base_revision_id=base, message="Collapse child history")
        if rollback:
            raise RuntimeError("injected squash rollback")
        return revision

    if rollback:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected squash rollback"):
            conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=child, connection_id=selector, fn=squash)
        after = before
    else:
        after = conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=child, connection_id=selector, fn=squash)
        assert after != before
    assert conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=child, fn=visible) == (False, False)
    assert conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, revision=after, fn=visible) == (False, False)
    assert conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, revision=deleted, fn=visible) == (False, False)
    assert conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, revision=base, fn=visible) == (True, True)
    assert conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=parent, fn=visible) == (True, True)


def test_squash_replaces_covered_incident_postings_for_rewritten_windows(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    conn, session, domain = db_connection, SessionId.schema(), graph.CASCADE_DOMAIN
    parent, _, _, _, charlie, edge_ab, _, _ = graph.setup_test_graph(
        conn,
        domain,
        graph.CascadeTestGraph,
        graph.CascadeTestNode,
        graph.CascadeTestEdge,
        session,
    )
    selector = ConnectionId("squash-posting-lifecycle")

    def boundary(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> RevisionId:
        return txn.commit_branch(message="Squash posting boundary", allow_empty=True)

    base = conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=parent, connection_id=selector, fn=boundary)

    def fork(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> BranchId:
        child = txn.create_branch("posting-squash-child", from_revision_id=base)
        txn.commit()
        return child

    child = conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=parent, connection_id=selector, fn=fork)

    def select_edge(txn: SyncVersionedReadTransaction) -> graph.CascadeTestEdge | None:
        return txn.select_one(graph.CascadeTestEdge, edge_ab)

    child_edge = conn.read_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=child, fn=select_edge)
    assert isinstance(child_edge, graph.CascadeTestEdge)

    def retarget(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> RevisionId:
        updated = txn.update(
            graph.CascadeTestEdge,
            child_edge.model_copy(update={"target_sys_id": charlie}),
        )
        assert isinstance(updated, graph.CascadeTestEdge)
        assert updated.target_sys_id == charlie
        return txn.commit_branch(message="Retarget before squash")

    conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=child, connection_id=selector, fn=retarget)

    def rebuild(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        plan = txn.plan()
        assert isinstance(plan, BaseServerPlan)
        plan.add_step(
            RebuildIncidentPostingsStep(
                ServerPlanRefId("rebuild_squash_postings"),
                sparse_table=SqlTableName("cascade_test_edges_sparse"),
                edge_table=SqlTableName("cascade_test_edges"),
                branch_ref=ServerRefs.scalar(child),
            )
        )
        plan.execute()

    conn.session(session).write(fn=rebuild)

    def squash(txn: SyncVersionedWriteTransaction) -> RevisionId:
        return txn.squash_branch(base_revision_id=base, message="Rewrite covered edge window")

    conn.write_version(session_id=session, domain=domain, branch=child, connection_id=selector, fn=squash)

    sparse = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(conn, SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("cascade_test_edges_sparse"))))
    postings = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(
        conn, SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("sys_graph_incident_postings")))
    )
    sparse_windows = {
        (str(row["sys_id"]), row["sys_valid_from_seq"], row["sys_valid_to_seq"])
        for row in sparse
        if str(row["branch_id"]) == str(child) and not row["sys_deleted"] and row["sys_valid_from_seq"] is not None
    }
    posting_windows = {
        (str(row["sys_id"]), row["valid_from_seq"], row["valid_to_seq"])
        for row in postings
        if str(row["branch_id"]) == str(child) and row["edge_table_name"] == "cascade_test_edges"
    }
    assert posting_windows == sparse_windows

Compiles to SELECT EXISTS(...) or similar, producing a bool result
that can be used as a predicate ref for ``ConditionalStep``.

from __future__ import annotations

class _ExistsCheckStepCteRow(BaseModel):
    exists: bool = Field(json_schema_extra={"db_column": "__exists"})


class ExistsCheckStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[bool]):
    """L0: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM table WHERE conditions).

    Produces a bool result. Used as a predicate ref for ``ConditionalStep``.
    """

    def cte_publication_contract(self: ExistsCheckStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("__exists",)
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({"__exists"}))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _ExistsCheckStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
            scalar_control_kind=ScalarControlKind.EXISTS,
            scalar_value_column=LockedColumnName("__exists"),
        )

    def __init__(
        self: ExistsCheckStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
        where_columns: Mapping[SqlColumnName, object],
    ) -> None:
        """Create an EXISTS check.

        Args:
            ref_id: Step reference ID
            table_name: Table to check
            where_columns: Column name -> parameter value pairs for WHERE
        """
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._table_name: SqlTableName = table_name
        self._where_columns: tuple[tuple[SqlColumnName, object], ...] = tuple(where_columns.items())

    @property
    def level(self: ExistsCheckStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: ExistsCheckStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.SCALAR

    def is_read_only(self: ExistsCheckStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def step_tags(self: ExistsCheckStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "exists", "grammar"})

    def tables_read(self: ExistsCheckStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self._table_name})

    def tables_written(self: ExistsCheckStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self: ExistsCheckStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[bool]:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_dml_simple import SqlSimpleSelect
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.query.stmt_dynamic import SqlSelectExistsFromSubquery
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.sql_fragment import SqlFragment
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlWhereClause
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, sql_and

        conditions: list[Any] = []
        for col_name, col_value in self._where_columns:
            conditions.append(
                SqlBinaryOp(
                    SqlColumnRef(col_name),
                    BinaryOp.EQ,
                    SqlParam(col_value),
                ),
            )

        where_expr: Any = conditions[0]
        for cond in conditions[1:]:
            where_expr = sql_and(where_expr, cond)

        subquery = SqlSimpleSelect(
            table=self._table_name,
            columns=SqlFragment.static("1"),
            clauses=SqlWhereClause(where_expr),
        )
        grammar = SqlSelectExistsFromSubquery(
            subquery,
        )

        __opa002_grammar_119 = grammar
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_119,
            needs_returning=True,
            closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
                "__exists",
                default_value=False,
                use_default_on_empty=True,
                scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.BOOL,
            ),
        )


class NotExistsCheckStep(ExistsCheckStep):
    """L0: SELECT NOT EXISTS(...). Negation of ExistsCheckStep.

    Uses ``SqlSelectNotExistsFromTable`` so the ``__exists`` column is
    True when no matching row exists. This is critical for CTE batching:
    the gate CTE reads ``__exists`` directly from SQL, so the negation
    must be in the grammar, not in a Python post_op.
    """

    def step_tags(self: NotExistsCheckStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "exists", "grammar"})

    def compile(self: NotExistsCheckStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[bool]:

def require_insert_columns_after_schema_filter(
    *,
    table_name: SqlTableName,
    columns: Sequence[str],
    operation: str = "Insert",
) -> None:
    """Reject INSERT plans whose write columns were fully filtered away."""
    if columns:
        return
    msg = (
        f"{operation} into {table_name!r} has no writable columns after schema filtering. "
        "This is an upstream schema projection/cache invariant failure: the compiler was "
        "given authoritative schema metadata that removed every model-derived write column."
    )
    raise ValueError(msg)


def compile_insert_grammar(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    instance: DatabaseObjectRow,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    needs_result: bool = True,
    supplemental_values: _SupplementalWriteValues = (),
) -> InsertCompileOutput | None:
    """Compile a single-row INSERT to SqlStepIR.

    Inserts into the base table. Versioned inserts are handled by the
    versioned intent/step hierarchy and never reach this function.

    Returns SqlStepIR with grammar and params, or None if compilation fails.
    """
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name
    from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference
    from l2070_batching.server_ref import ScalarServerRef, ServerRef
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName, SqlTypeName
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
        extract_columns_and_values_from_plan,
        filter_columns_and_values_to_existing_schema,
        filter_columns_to_existing_schema,
        get_write_metadata_plan_from_catalog,
        postgres_cast_type_for_db_column,
    )
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_server_ref import (
        get_scalar_server_ref_binding,
        lower_scalar_server_ref,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import (
        SqlColumnNameList,
        SqlReturningClause,
        SqlValuesClause,
        SqlValuesRow,
    )
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlInsert

    table_name = get_table_name(model_cls)
    table = SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName(table_name))
    write_plan = get_write_metadata_plan_from_catalog(ctx.planning_catalog, model_cls)
    columns, values = extract_columns_and_values_from_plan(
        write_plan,
        instance,
        backend_type=ctx.backend_type,

    filtered_columns, filtered_values = filter_columns_and_values_to_existing_schema(

        columns,
        values,
    )
    columns = list(filtered_columns)
    values = list(filtered_values)
    require_insert_columns_after_schema_filter(table_name=SqlTableName(table_name), columns=columns)

    col_list = SqlColumnNameList([SqlColumnName(c) for c in columns])
    value_exprs: list[Any] = []
    consumed_cte_aliases: set[str] = set()
    postgres_json_columns: set[str] = set()
    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_params.sql_param_normalization import normalize_postgres_json_bind_value
        from impl.common.l2300_json_serialization.json_serialization import get_json_columns
        from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import model_sql_column_type_hints

        postgres_json_columns = {field_plan.db_column for field_plan in write_plan.field_plans if field_plan.is_json}
        postgres_json_columns.update(get_json_columns(model_cls))
        type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(model_cls, tuple(columns))
        if type_hints is not None:
            postgres_json_columns.update(type_hints.jsonb_columns)

        def _postgres_insert_param(column: str, value: object) -> SqlParam:
            cast_type = postgres_cast_type_for_db_column(write_plan, column)
            if cast_type == "UUID":
                return SqlParam(value, SqlTypeName(cast_type))
            if column not in postgres_json_columns or value is None:
                return SqlParam(value)
            return SqlParam(normalize_postgres_json_bind_value(value))

    else:

        def _postgres_insert_param(column: str, value: object) -> SqlParam:
            del column
            return SqlParam(value)

    for column, value in zip(columns, values, strict=True):
        if isinstance(value, ServerRef):
            if not isinstance(value, ScalarServerRef):
                msg = f"INSERT column {column!r} requires a scalar ServerRef value"
                raise TypeError(msg)
            binding = get_scalar_server_ref_binding(value, ctx)
            if binding is not None:
                consumed_cte_aliases.add(binding.cte_name)
            value_exprs.append(lower_scalar_server_ref(value, ctx))
        else:
            value_exprs.append(_postgres_insert_param(column, value))
    value_row = SqlValuesRow(value_exprs)
    values_clause = SqlValuesClause([value_row])
    supports_returning: bool = ctx.sql_render_dialect().supports_insert_returning()
    from l2070_batching.write_column_policy import physical_table_publication_columns

    publication_columns = (
        filter_columns_to_existing_schema(
            ctx.schema_column_cache,
            SqlTableName(table_name),
            physical_table_publication_columns(model_cls, include_shared_subtypes=False),
        )
        if needs_result
        else ()
    )
    returning: SqlReturningClause | None = None
    if supports_returning and needs_result:
        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef

        returning = SqlReturningClause(
            [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)) for column in publication_columns],
        )

    grammar = SqlInsert(
        table=table,
        columns=col_list,
        values=values_clause,
        returning=returning,
    )

    auxiliary_ctes: list[tuple[str, Any]] = []
    seen_aliases: set[str] = set()
    for cte_ref in ctx.cte_refs.values():
        if not isinstance(cte_ref, CteReference):
            continue
        if cte_ref.ref_id not in consumed_cte_aliases:
            continue
        if cte_ref.auxiliary_query is None:
            continue
        if cte_ref.ref_id in seen_aliases:
            continue
        seen_aliases.add(cte_ref.ref_id)
        auxiliary_ctes.append((cte_ref.ref_id, cte_ref.auxiliary_query))

    ir = SqlStepIR(
        grammar=grammar,
        params=None,
        needs_returning=supports_returning and needs_result,
    )
    return InsertCompileOutput(
        ir=ir,
        auxiliary_ctes=auxiliary_ctes if auxiliary_ctes else None,
        publication_columns=publication_columns,
    )

@pure_lazy

    *,
    step_name: str,
    trigger: str,
    blocked_path: str,
    result_contract: str,
    implementation_requirements: Sequence[str],
) -> Never:
    lines = [
        f"{step_name} cannot compile while {trigger}.",
        "",
        "This code path still depends on execution-time Python orchestration.",
        "Compilation must finish with an explicit step graph and fully determined SQL/apply IR.",
        "Only the executor may materialize or resolve references during execution.",
        ("Planner code must not create new steps, resolve fresh values, or invoke nested execution after compile returns."),
        (
            "If later logic needs a concrete value, the plan must publish "
            "an explicit ref-producing step so the executor resolves it and "
            "post-processing consumes that published result."
        ),
        (
            "Any conditional logic, result rehydration, or follow-on SQL "
            "needed after an intermediate result must be expressed as "
            "explicit steps in the plan rather than eager Python execution."
        ),
        "Tripwires must fail any future attempt to reintroduce execution-time replanning or late reference resolution on this path.",
        "",
        "Architecturally consistent replacement required:",
    ]
    lines.extend(f"{index}. {requirement}" for index, requirement in enumerate(implementation_requirements, start=1))
    lines.extend(
        [
            "",
            f"Result contract to preserve: {result_contract}",
            f"Blocked path: {blocked_path}",
            "",
            "Do not reintroduce execution-time replanning here.",
        ],
    )
    raise ProgrammingError("\n".join(lines))

@pytest.mark.parametrize("backend_type", [BackendType.POSTGRES, BackendType.SQLITE])

    selected = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_0"),
        variant="object",
        type_hint=_LargeColumnScalarPublicationDoc,
    )
    content_ref = selected.field("content")
    steps = lower_steps(
        [
            SelectOneIntent(
                ServerPlanRefId("step_0"),

                ServerRefs.scalar(SysId.new()),
                _SelectOneConfig(permission_grammar=None),
            ),

                _QueryExecuteConfig(query_spec=_marker_query_spec(content_ref)),
            ),
        ],
        ctx=make_lowering_context(make_backend_profile(backend_type)),

    profile = make_backend_profile(backend_type)

    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    dialect = profile.dialect
    assert dialect is not None
    _sql, params = compiled.grammar.render(dialect).to_sql(dialect)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("interrupted", [False, True])
def test_native_schema_migration_recovers_before_publication_and_retries(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    interrupted: bool,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    original = _spec()
    replacement = _batch_spec()
    old_contributor = matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor(spec=original)
    new_contributor = matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor(spec=replacement)
    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    coordinator.run(
        db_connection,
        manifest_key="phase7:native-migration",
        model_classes=(),
        contributors=(DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(), old_contributor),
    )
    session = db_connection.session(system_session_id)
    before = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.query(matching.MatchingNativeExactPlanRow).execute())
    assert len(before) == 1
    if interrupted:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="interrupted before publication"):
            with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
                new_contributor.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_spec=original)
                raise RuntimeError("interrupted before publication")
        assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(type(before[0]), before[0].sys_id)) == before[0]
    with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
        assert resolve_terminal_sync(schema, "serverplan_test", new_contributor.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_spec=original)) is None
    after = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(type(before[0]), before[0].sys_id))
    assert after is not None
    assert after.plan_identity == replacement.native_exact_choice.plan_identity
    with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
        resolve_terminal_sync(schema, "serverplan_test", new_contributor.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_spec=original))
    assert session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(type(before[0]), before[0].sys_id)) == after
    coordinator.run(
        db_connection,
        manifest_key="phase7:native-migration",
        model_classes=(),
        contributors=(DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(), new_contributor),
    )
    result = session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, replacement))
    assert isinstance(result, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    assert not result.edges


def test_native_schema_migration_recovers_after_execution_before_exit(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    original = _spec()
    replacement = _batch_spec()
    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    coordinator.run(
        db_connection,
        manifest_key="phase7:uncertain-native-migration",
        model_classes=(),
        contributors=(DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(), matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor(spec=original)),
    )
    target = matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor(spec=replacement)
    previous = _row(original)
    desired = _row(replacement)
    session = db_connection.session(system_session_id)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="interrupted after execution"):
        with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
            resolve_terminal_sync(schema, "serverplan_test", target.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_spec=original))
            raise RuntimeError("interrupted after execution")
    observed = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(type(previous), previous.sys_id))
    assert observed is not None
    fields = set(type(previous).model_fields) - set(ApplicationObjectRow.model_fields)
    assert observed.model_dump(include=fields) in (
        previous.model_dump(include=fields),
        desired.model_dump(include=fields),
    )
    with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
        resolve_terminal_sync(schema, "serverplan_test", target.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_spec=original))
    completed = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(type(previous), previous.sys_id))
    assert completed is not None
    assert completed.model_dump(include=fields) == desired.model_dump(include=fields)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("identical", [False, True])
def test_concurrent_native_schema_replacements_require_one_predecessor(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    connection_factory: Callable[[], SyncDatabaseConnection],
    identical: bool,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    original = _spec()
    first = _batch_spec()
    second = (
        first
        if identical
        else validated_model_update(
            original,
            {
                "work_limits": validated_model_update(original.work_limits, {"max_left_rows": matching.MatchRowCountLimit(3)}),
            },
        )
    )
    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    coordinator.run(
        db_connection,
        manifest_key="phase7:concurrent-schema-migration",
        model_classes=(),
        contributors=(DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(), matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor(spec=original)),
    )
    candidates = (matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor(spec=first), matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor(spec=second))
    ready = Barrier(2, timeout=15)

    def migrate(candidate: matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor[Phase7PackedDenseLeft, Phase7PackedDenseRight]) -> bool:
        connection = connection_factory()
        connection.connect()
        try:
            ready.wait()
            with connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
                result = candidate.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_spec=original)
                resolve_terminal_sync(schema, "serverplan_test", result)
            return True
        except ProgrammingError as error:
            assert "row_content_matches" in str(error)
            return False
        finally:
            connection.close()

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(migrate, candidate) for candidate in candidates]
        outcomes = [future.result(timeout=25) for future in futures]
    assert sum(outcomes) == (2 if identical else 1)
    session = db_connection.session(system_session_id)
    rows = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.query(matching.MatchingNativeExactPlanRow).execute())
    assert len(rows) == 1
    winner = first if outcomes[0] else second
    assert rows[0].plan_identity == _row(winner).plan_identity
    result = session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, winner))
    assert isinstance(result, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    assert not result.edges

class _MinimalQuerySpec:
    def __init__(self, filters: list[QueryFilter] | tuple[QueryFilter, ...]) -> None:
        self.filters = filters
        self.order_by: list[tuple[str, str]] | None = None
        self.group_by: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
        self.select_columns: list[Any] | None = None


class _ExplodingDynamicShape:
    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> object:
        if name in {"field", "function", "logical_op"}:
            msg = f"dynamic expression probe touched {name}"
            raise AssertionError(msg)
        raise AttributeError(name)


def _pending_lazy_result() -> LazyResult[Any]:

def test_resolve_query_spec_server_refs_handles_lazy_and_filter_shapes(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    server_ref: object = ServerRefs.from_ref_id("step_0", variant="scalar")
    expression = Expression(field="name", operator="=", value=server_ref)
    query_spec = _MinimalQuerySpec([QueryFilter(expression=cast(Any, LazyResult.of(expression)))])

    def _fail_resolve(self: LazyResult[Any]) -> Any:
        msg = "resolve() must not be used while rewriting query-spec refs"
        raise AssertionError(msg)

    monkeypatch.setattr(LazyResult, "resolve", _fail_resolve)

    resolve_query_spec_server_refs(query_spec, ResolvedRefs({"step_0": "alice"}))

    assert query_spec.filters[0].expression is expression
    assert expression.value == "alice"
    assert query_spec.filters[0].server_ref_dependencies == ("step_0",)

    empty_tuple_spec = _MinimalQuerySpec(())
    resolve_query_spec_server_refs(empty_tuple_spec, ResolvedRefs({}))
    assert empty_tuple_spec.filters == ()

    unchanged_order_by = [("name", "asc")]
    unchanged_group_by = ("kind",)
    unchanged_sequence_spec = _MinimalQuerySpec([])
    unchanged_sequence_spec.order_by = unchanged_order_by
    unchanged_sequence_spec.group_by = unchanged_group_by
    resolve_query_spec_server_refs(unchanged_sequence_spec, ResolvedRefs({}))
    assert unchanged_sequence_spec.order_by is unchanged_order_by
    assert unchanged_sequence_spec.group_by is unchanged_group_by

    not_equal_spec = _MinimalQuerySpec(
        [QueryFilter(column="name", operator="!=", value=server_ref)],
    )
    resolve_query_spec_server_refs(not_equal_spec, ResolvedRefs({"step_0": ("alice", "bob")}))
    assert not_equal_spec.filters[0].value == ("alice", "bob")
    assert not_equal_spec.filters[0].operator == "NOT IN"

    nested_spec = _MinimalQuerySpec(
        [QueryFilter(column="payload", operator="=", value={"name": server_ref})],
    )
    resolve_query_spec_server_refs(nested_spec, ResolvedRefs({"step_0": "alice"}))
    assert nested_spec.filters[0].value == {"name": "alice"}

@pytest.mark.parametrize("closed_request", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("fail", [False, True])
def test_capture_latest_selected_rows_keeps_tombstones_and_excludes_foreign_staging(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, fail: bool, closed_request: bool,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    source = SqlTableName("capture_source_staged")
    captured = SqlTableName("capture_selected_rows")
    columns = tuple(
        SqlColumnName(name)
        for name in ("branch_id", "sys_id", "sys_staged_commit_id", "sys_updated_at", "sys_deleted", "payload")
    )
    uuid_type = "UUID" if isinstance(db_connection, SyncPostgresConnection) else "VARCHAR(36)"
    execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlCreateTable(SqlTableIdent(source), SqlTableBody(tuple(
        SqlColumnDef(
            column,
            SqlTypeName(
                "BOOLEAN" if column == "sys_deleted" else "TEXT" if column in {"payload", "sys_updated_at"} else uuid_type
            ),
        )
        for column in columns
    ))))
    branch, peer = BranchId.new(), BranchId.new()
    first, latest, foreign = StagedCommitId.new(), StagedCommitId.new(), StagedCommitId.new()
    live_id, deleted_id = SysId.new(), SysId.new()
    rows = (
        (branch, live_id, first, "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", False, "old"),
        (branch, live_id, latest, "2026-01-01T00:00:01Z", False, "selected"),
        (branch, live_id, foreign, "2026-01-01T00:00:02Z", False, "foreign"),
        (branch, deleted_id, first, "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", False, "delete-me"),
        (branch, deleted_id, latest, "2026-01-01T00:00:01Z", True, "tombstone"),
        (peer, live_id, latest, "2026-01-01T00:00:01Z", False, "peer"),
    )
    execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlInsert(
        SqlTableIdent(source), columns=SqlColumnNameList(columns),
        values=SqlValuesClause(tuple(SqlValuesRow(tuple(SqlParam(value) for value in row)) for row in rows)),
    ))
    execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlCommit())
    callbacks = 0

    def write(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        nonlocal callbacks
        callbacks += 1
        plan = txn.plan()
        assert isinstance(plan, BaseServerPlan)
        branch_ref = ServerRefs.scalar(branch)
        selector = _StagedCommitSelector.explicit_ids(staged_commit_ids=(first, latest))
        contract = PublicationSelectionContract(
            identity=PublicationSelectionIdentity(
                owner_ref=ServerPlanRefId("publication_attempt"), source_table=source,
                scope=_scope_descriptor_from_selector(branch_ref, selector),
                partition_columns=(SqlColumnName("branch_id"), SqlColumnName("sys_id")),
                physical_schema=SchemaFingerprintHash("capture_fixture_v1"),
            ), columns=frozenset(columns),
        )
        plan.add_step(CapturePublicationRowsStep(
            ServerPlanRefId("capture_rows"), selection=contract, temporary_table=captured,
            branch_ref=branch_ref, selector=selector,
        ))
        if closed_request:
            peer_ref = ServerRefs.scalar(peer)
            peer_contract = PublicationSelectionContract(
                identity=PublicationSelectionIdentity(
                    owner_ref=ServerPlanRefId("peer_attempt"), source_table=source,
                    scope=_scope_descriptor_from_selector(peer_ref, selector),
                    partition_columns=contract.identity.partition_columns,
                    physical_schema=contract.identity.physical_schema,
                ), columns=contract.columns,
            )
            plan.add_step(CapturePublicationRowsStep(
                ServerPlanRefId("capture_peer"), selection=peer_contract,
                temporary_table=SqlTableName("capture_peer_rows"), branch_ref=peer_ref, selector=selector))
        with require_ordered_closed_request_region() if closed_request else nullcontext():
            plan.execute()
        selected = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(captured)))
        assert {row["payload"] for row in selected} == {"selected", "tombstone"}
        assert sum(bool(row["sys_deleted"]) for row in selected) == 1
        if fail:
            raise RuntimeError("injected capture failure")

    if fail:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected capture failure"):
            db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=write)
    else:
        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=write)
    assert callbacks == 1
    assert isinstance(db_connection, TransactionTemporaryRelationOwner)
    assert not db_connection._has_transaction_temporary_relations()
    remaining = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(source)))
    assert len(remaining) == len(rows)
    with pytest.raises(TableNotFoundError):
        fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(captured)))
    # A failed catalog probe aborts PostgreSQL's transaction. End that read
    # transaction before checking the second relation; publication already ended.
    if isinstance(db_connection, SyncPostgresConnection):
        execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlRollback())
    if closed_request:
        with pytest.raises(TableNotFoundError):
            fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("capture_peer_rows"))))
        if isinstance(db_connection, SyncPostgresConnection):
            execute_raw_sql_for_tests(db_connection, SqlRollback())

    """CTX-P023: A context consumer cannot reference an absent producer."""
    admitted = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_98"),
        variant="object",
        type_hint=ResolvedSessionContext,
    )
    principal = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_99"),
        variant="scalar",
        type_hint=_PrincipalId,
    )
    intent = create_project_session_context_step(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_1"),
        _ApplicationSessionContext,
        admitted_context=admitted,
        bindings=(
            session_context_binding(
                _ApplicationSessionContext.principal_id,
                principal,
            ),
        ),
    )
    publisher, _assertion, _validated = intent.lower(make_lowering_context())

    with pytest.raises(ProgrammingError, match="step_98"):
        publisher.compile(make_compilation_context())

    """Cover CTX-P014, CTX-P015, and CTX-P016."""
    admitted = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_1"),
        variant="object",
        type_hint=ResolvedSessionContext,
    )
    principal = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_2.principal_id"),
        variant="scalar",
        type_hint=_PrincipalId,
    )
    intent = create_project_session_context_step(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_3"),
        _ApplicationSessionContext,
        admitted_context=admitted,
        bindings=(
            session_context_binding(
                _ApplicationSessionContext.principal_id,
                principal,
            ),
        ),
    )
    publisher, assertion, validated = intent.lower(make_lowering_context())
    assert assertion.dependencies() == frozenset({str(publisher.ref_id)})

    application_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(
        _ApplicationSessionContext,
        application_columns,
    )
    assert canonical_hints is not None
    assert application_hints is not None
    compiled = publisher.compile(
        make_compilation_context(
            cte_refs={
                "step_1": typed_cte_reference(
                    ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("step_1"),
                    auxiliary_query=None,

            }
        )
    )

    assert compiled.grammar is not None
    assert compiled.closed_post_op is not None
    result = materialize_compiled_post_op(
        compiled.closed_post_op,
        [
            {
                "session_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",

                "effective_user_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003",
                "session_type": "user",
                "is_system_session": False,
                "principal_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004",
            }
        ],
        _hydrate_context,
    )

    assert result == {
        "session_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
        "user_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
        "effective_user_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003",
        "session_type": "user",
        "is_system_session": False,

"""Document-local lexical scores for permission-aware hybrid retrieval."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Literal

from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlJsonPath, SqlTableName
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.base import SqlRenderable
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlFrom

from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlCase, SqlFuncCall
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_json import JsonAccessKind, SqlJsonAccess
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlInlineLiteral
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp, SqlExists, sql_and
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
from impl.common.l5150_fts_polyfill.boolean_parser import AndExpr, BooleanExpr, NotExpr, OrExpr, PhraseExpr, TermExpr, parse_boolean_query
from l1000_schema.column_utils import get_db_column_name
from l1000_schema.dynamic_field_utils import is_dynamic_property_field
from l1000_schema.schema_def import DatabaseObjectRow
from l1400_types import DynamicFieldName
from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import VersionedObjectRow
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlParam
from l2070_batching.backend_profile import CrossBranchFtsCompileRequest, FtsSqlTransport
from l2070_batching.compilation import CompilationContext
from l5100_fts.fts_components import SqlFTSJoinStyle
from l5100_fts.fts_query import FTSSearchMode


class _RankBooleanTokenizer:
    def tokenize(self, text: str) -> list[str]:
        return [text] if text else []


def lexical_rank_queries(query: str, mode: FTSSearchMode) -> tuple[tuple[str, FTSSearchMode], ...]:
    """Return positive matching clauses without corpus statistics."""
    if mode == FTSSearchMode.PHRASE:
        return ((query, mode),)
    if mode == FTSSearchMode.BOOLEAN:
        clauses: list[tuple[str, FTSSearchMode]] = []

        def collect(expr: BooleanExpr | None, *, positive: bool = True) -> None:
            if isinstance(expr, TermExpr) and positive:
                if expr.term.endswith("*"):
                    clauses.append((expr.term.removesuffix("*"), FTSSearchMode.PREFIX))
                else:
                    clauses.append((expr.term, FTSSearchMode.NATURAL))
            elif isinstance(expr, PhraseExpr) and positive:
                clauses.append((" ".join(expr.terms), FTSSearchMode.PHRASE))
            elif isinstance(expr, (AndExpr, OrExpr)):
                collect(expr.left, positive=positive)
                collect(expr.right, positive=positive)
            elif isinstance(expr, NotExpr):
                collect(expr.expr, positive=not positive)

        collect(parse_boolean_query(query, _RankBooleanTokenizer().tokenize))
        return tuple(dict.fromkeys(clauses))
    clause_mode = FTSSearchMode.PREFIX if mode == FTSSearchMode.PREFIX else FTSSearchMode.NATURAL
    return tuple((term, clause_mode) for term in dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r"[^\W_]+", query.lower())))


def hybrid_document_rank(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    query: str,
    fields: tuple[str, ...],
    mode: FTSSearchMode,
    table_name: str,
    table_alias: str,
    source_revision_column: str = "sys_revision_id",
    content_table_type: Literal["tip", "sparse"] = "sparse",
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Score native clause matches using only the candidate document's text."""
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.backend_profiles import _build_cross_branch_compile_sql_fts_components

    clauses = lexical_rank_queries(query, mode)
    coverage: SqlRenderable = SqlInlineLiteral(0.0)
    for text, clause_mode in clauses:
        if issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
            from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_fts_search import (
                _build_versioned_fts_components,
                _build_postgres_tsquery_expr,
            )

            query_expr = (
                _build_postgres_tsquery_expr(model_cls=model_cls, query_expr=SqlParam(text), mode=clause_mode)
                if ctx.backend_profile.traits.fts_sql_transport is FtsSqlTransport.TEXT_SEARCH_VECTOR
                else SqlParam(text)
            )
            components = _build_versioned_fts_components(
                model_cls=model_cls,
                field_names=fields,
                sparse_table_name=table_name,
                query_expr=query_expr,
                table_alias=table_alias,
                ctx=ctx,
                fts_mode=clause_mode,
                sqlite_literal_query_text=text,
                source_revision_column=source_revision_column,
                content_table_type=content_table_type,
            )
        else:
            components = _build_cross_branch_compile_sql_fts_components(
                backend_type=ctx.backend_type,
                model_type=model_cls,
                compile_request=CrossBranchFtsCompileRequest(
                    query=text,
                    columns=fields,
                    mode=clause_mode,
                    table_name=SqlTableName(table_name),
                    table_alias=table_alias,
                    use_content_hash=False,
                    use_polyfill=False,
                ),
            )
        condition = components.where_clause
        if components.join_style == SqlFTSJoinStyle.FTS_TABLE_SYS_ID_JOIN:
            source = components.join_clause
            assert isinstance(source, SqlRenderable)
            condition = SqlExists(
                SqlSelect(
                    select=[SqlInlineLiteral(1)],
                    from_=SqlFrom(source),
                    where=sql_and(
                        condition,
                        SqlBinaryOp(
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=SqlAliasName("f")),
                            BinaryOp.EQ,
                            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier=table_alias),
                        ),
                    ),
                )
            )
        elif components.join_style == SqlFTSJoinStyle.JOIN_ON_CONDITION:
            source = components.join_clause
            assert isinstance(source, SqlRenderable)
            condition = SqlExists(SqlSelect(select=[SqlInlineLiteral(1)], from_=SqlFrom(source), where=condition))
        elif components.join_style != SqlFTSJoinStyle.WHERE_ONLY:
            raise NotImplementedError("Hybrid document ranking requires native document matching")
        coverage = SqlBinaryOp(coverage, BinaryOp.ADD, SqlCase([(condition, SqlInlineLiteral(1.0))], else_=SqlInlineLiteral(0.0)))
    length: SqlRenderable = SqlInlineLiteral(1.0)
    for name in fields:
        field_name = DynamicFieldName(name)
        if is_dynamic_property_field(model_cls, field_name):
            column: SqlRenderable = SqlJsonAccess(
                JsonAccessKind.GET_TEXT,
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("properties"), qualifier=table_alias),
                SqlJsonPath(f"$.{name}"),
            )
        else:
            column = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(get_db_column_name(model_cls, field_name)), qualifier=table_alias)
        length = SqlBinaryOp(length, BinaryOp.ADD, SqlFuncCall("LENGTH", [SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", [column, SqlInlineLiteral("")])]))
    return SqlBinaryOp(coverage, BinaryOp.DIV, length)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("payload_units", (1, 65537))
@pytest.mark.parametrize("node_count", (0, 3))
@pytest.mark.parametrize("result_limit", (None, 2))
def test_walk_sql_emits_one_header_and_ordered_node_score_objects(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, node_count: int, result_limit: int | None, payload_units: int, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.graph_walk_score import build_graph_walk_envelope_query

    graph_id = GraphId.new()
    nodes = tuple(
        EnvelopeNode(
            sys_id=NodeId(f"00000000-0000-0000-0000-{index:012d}"),
            graph_sys_id=graph_id,
            name="high" if index == 2 else "tie",
            payload=b"\xff\x00" * payload_units,
            text_payload="目标 café '\"\\\n" * payload_units,
        )
        for index in (3, 1, 2)
    )
    node_columns = _graph_walk_node_columns(EnvelopeNode)
    source = values_source(
        EnvelopeNode,
        "input_nodes",
        columns=node_columns,
        rows=tuple(tuple(getattr(node, get_python_field_name(EnvelopeNode, column)) for column in node_columns) for node in nodes),
    )
    score = case_when(
        PlanPredicate(PlanColumnRef(source, EnvelopeNode, "name"), "=", "high"),
        0.5,
        else_=0.25,
    )
    metadata = ("__walk_score", "__walk_iterations", "__walk_termination")
    flat = QuerySpec(
        model_cls=EnvelopeNode,
        source=source,
        select_columns=[
            *(PlanAliasedExpression(PlanColumnRef(source, EnvelopeNode, column), column) for column in node_columns),
            PlanAliasedExpression(score, metadata[0]),
            PlanAliasedExpression(3, metadata[1]),
            PlanAliasedExpression("fixed_iterations", metadata[2]),
        ],
        distinct=False,
        joins=[],
        filters=[] if node_count else [QueryFilter(expression=PlanPredicate(False, "=", True))],
        order_by=[(score, SqlOrderDirection("DESC")), (PlanColumnRef(source, EnvelopeNode, "sys_id"), SqlOrderDirection("ASC"))],
        limit=result_limit,
        offset=None,
        group_by=[],
        aggregations=[],
        having=[],
        window_functions=[],
        preserve_non_join_projection=True,
        projection_output_aliases=(*node_columns, *metadata),
        permission_state=QueryPermissionState.BYPASS,
    )
    envelope = build_graph_walk_envelope_query(
        node_model=EnvelopeNode,
        score_query=flat,
        metadata_columns=metadata,
        ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("walk.envelope"),
    )

    def _execute(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> object:
        backend, _profile = create_backend_executor(txn, session_id=SessionId.schema(), is_write_transaction=False)
        step = QueryExecuteStep(
            ServerPlanRefId("envelope"),
            EnvelopeNode,
            _QueryExecuteStepConfig(query_spec=envelope, raw_mode=True),
        )
        result = run_pipeline(
            [step],
            backend,
            DEFAULT_PIPELINE,
            ModelHydrator(),
            lowering_ctx=backend.get_lowering_context(),
        )
        return result.resolved["envelope"]

    result = db_connection.session(system_session_id).read(fn=_execute)
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    assert len(result) == 1
    header = result[0]
    assert isinstance(header, dict)
    assert set(header) == {"rows", "iterations", "termination"}
    assert header["iterations"] == (3 if node_count else 0)
    assert header["termination"] == ("fixed_iterations" if node_count else "empty_graph")
    rows = header["rows"]
    if isinstance(rows, str):
        rows = json.loads(rows)
    assert isinstance(rows, list)
    expected = sorted(nodes[:node_count], key=lambda node: (node.name != "high", str(node.sys_id)))[:result_limit]
    assert len(rows) == len(expected)
    for entry, node in zip(rows, expected, strict=True):
        assert isinstance(entry, dict)
        assert set(entry) == {"node", "score"}
        assert entry["score"] == (0.5 if node.name == "high" else 0.25)
        payload = entry["node"]
        assert isinstance(payload, dict)
        assert set(payload) == set(node_columns)
        hydrated = ModelHydrator()(EnvelopeNode, payload)
        assert hydrated.sys_id == node.sys_id
        assert hydrated.name == node.name
        assert hydrated.active is node.active
        binary_matches = hydrated.payload == node.payload
        assert binary_matches, (len(hydrated.payload), len(node.payload), hydrated.payload[:80])
        assert hydrated.text_payload == node.text_payload

    materialized = materialize_compiled_post_op(_graph_walk_post_op(EnvelopeNode), result, ModelHydrator())
    assert isinstance(materialized, GraphWalkResult)
    assert materialized.iterations == header["iterations"]
    assert materialized.termination.value == header["termination"]
    assert len(materialized.rows) == len(expected)
    for item, node in zip(materialized.rows, expected, strict=True):
        assert isinstance(item.node, EnvelopeNode)
        assert item.node.sys_id == node.sys_id
        binary_matches = item.node.payload == node.payload
        assert binary_matches, (len(item.node.payload), len(node.payload), item.node.payload[:80])
        assert item.node.text_payload == node.text_payload
        assert item.score == (0.5 if node.name == "high" else 0.25)

class BranchInsertAuthorityStep(ReturnValueStep[None]):
    def __init__(
        self: BranchInsertAuthorityStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        model: type[BaseBranch],
        proposal: InsertBranchRowStep,
        session_id: SessionId | None,
        after: frozenset[str],
        permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id, None)
        self._model = model
        self._proposal = proposal
        self._session_id = session_id
        self._after = after
        self._permission_context_ref = permission_context_ref
        self._permission_context_type = permission_context_type

    def dependencies(self: BranchInsertAuthorityStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        context_dependencies = frozenset() if self._permission_context_ref is None else frozenset({self._permission_context_ref})
        return self._after | self._proposal.proposed_value_dependencies() | context_dependencies

    def tables_read(self: BranchInsertAuthorityStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return self._proposal.tables_read()

    def execution_role(self: BranchInsertAuthorityStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: BranchInsertAuthorityStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def _requires_materialized_conditional_output(self: BranchInsertAuthorityStep) -> bool:
        """Materialize application session context before branch insertion."""
        return self._permission_context_ref is not None

    def scheduling_effects(self: BranchInsertAuthorityStep) -> frozenset[SchedulingEffect]:
        return frozenset({SchedulingEffect.SQL_GROUP_BOUNDARY_AFTER})

    def compile(self: BranchInsertAuthorityStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[None]:
        actor = self._session_id if self._session_id is not None else compilation_session_id(ctx)
        if actor is None:
            raise PermissionCompilationError("Branch creation requires an originating session")
        plan = get_query_permission_plan(self._model, action="insert")
        denied: SqlRenderable
        if (
            isinstance(actor, SessionId)
            and (actor.is_schema_session())
            and plan is not None
            and not plan.filters_session(actor)
            and self._permission_context_ref is None
        ):
            denied = SqlParam(False)
        else:
            session_vars = permission_session_vars_from_context(
                ctx,
                self._permission_context_ref,
                self._permission_context_type,
                site_name=type(self).__name__,
                result_contract="authorize branch creation from the bound session context",
            )
            predicate = compile_permission_where_with_user_expr(
                self._model,
                None if session_vars is not None else actor,
                session_user_id_expr(actor, ctx),
                table_alias="proposal",
                action="insert",
                session_id_sql=session_id_expr(actor, ctx),
                session_vars=session_vars,
                compilation_context=ctx,
            )
            denied = SqlParam(True) if predicate is None else sql_not(SqlFuncCall("COALESCE", [predicate, SqlParam(False)]))
        proposed_values = self._proposal.proposed_insert_values(ctx)
        proposal_type_hints = model_sql_column_type_hints(
            self._model,
            tuple(column for column, _value in proposed_values),
        )
        proposal = SqlSelect(
            select=[
                SqlSelectAlias(
                    SqlCast(value, cast_target)
                    if ctx.backend_profile.traits.dml_parameter_transport is DmlParameterTransport.EXPLICIT_STORAGE_CASTS
                    and proposal_type_hints is not None
                    and (cast_target := proposal_type_hints.cast_target_for_column(column)) is not None
                    else value,
                    SqlAliasName(column),
                )
                for column, value in proposed_values
            ],
        )
        violations = SqlSelect(
            select=[SqlParam(1)],
            from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(proposal, SqlTableName("proposal")),
            where=denied,
        )
        message = "Branch creation requires branch INSERT authority"
        shape = sql_assertion_output_shape()
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=no_rows_assertion_query(violations, error_message=message),
            output_shape=shape,
            result_relation=DeclaredResultRelation.from_output_shape(shape),
            needs_returning=True,
            column_type_hints=sql_assertion_column_type_hints(),
            closed_post_op=sql_assertion_post_op(message, exc_type=DbPermissionError),
            # Preserve SQL-visible authorization inputs across statement groups. See
            # docs/design/SERVERPLAN_LINTER_DRIVEN_REFACTOR.md.
            auxiliary_ctes=collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.dependencies()),
        )

def visible_fts_payload(
    *,
    model: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
    spec: QuerySpec,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    revision: SqlRenderable,
    branch: SqlRenderable,
    components: SqlFTSComponents,
    extra_where: SqlRenderable | None,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
    null_columns: tuple[str, ...],
    order_columns: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...],
    limit: int | None,
    offset: int | None,
    ordinal: int = 0,
    dependencies: list[tuple[str, SqlRenderable]] | None = None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlCteDefinition

    definitions = [SqlCteDefinition(name, grammar) for name, grammar in dependencies or ()]
    definitions.extend(visible_hybrid_source(model, spec, ctx, revision=revision, branch=branch, name="fts_visible_snapshot"))
    nulls = {
        *null_columns,
        "branch_ord",
        "sys_staged_commit_id",
        "sys_fts_hash_short",
        "sys_fts_hash_high",
        "sys_valid_from_seq",
        "sys_valid_to_revision_id",
        "sys_valid_to_seq",
    }
    selections: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for column in columns:
        if column in nulls:
            expression: SqlRenderable = SqlInlineLiteral(None)
        else:
            source_column = "sys_revision_id" if column == "sys_valid_from_revision_id" else column
            expression = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(source_column), qualifier="s")
        selections.append(SqlSelectAlias(expression, SqlAliasName(column)))
    selections.extend(
        [
            SqlSelectAlias(revision, SqlAliasName("__requested_revision_id")),
            SqlSelectAlias(SqlInlineLiteral(ordinal), SqlAliasName("__requested_revision_ordinal")),
            SqlSelectAlias(SqlInlineLiteral(1), SqlAliasName("__fts_revision_rn")),
            SqlSelectAlias(SqlInlineLiteral(1), SqlAliasName("__fts_object_rn")),
            SqlSelectAlias(components.rank_expression, SqlAliasName("__fts_rank")),
        ]
    )
    joins: list[SqlJoin] = []
    where: SqlRenderable | None = components.where_clause
    if components.join_style == SqlFTSJoinStyle.JOIN_ON_CONDITION:
        assert components.join_clause is not None
        joins.append(SqlJoin("INNER", components.join_clause, where))
        where = None
    elif components.join_style != SqlFTSJoinStyle.WHERE_ONLY:
        raise NotImplementedError("Ancestry-visible FTS requires typed native matching")
    if extra_where is not None:
        where = sql_and(where, extra_where) if where is not None else extra_where
    order = [SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__fts_rank")), OrderDirection.DESC)]
    order.extend(
        SqlOrderByItem(
            SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column), qualifier="s"), OrderDirection.DESC if direction == "DESC" else OrderDirection.ASC
        )
        for column, direction in order_columns
    )
    order.append(SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier="s"), OrderDirection.ASC))
    return SqlCte(
        definitions,
        SqlSelect(
            select=selections,
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("fts_visible_snapshot")), SqlAliasName("s")),
            joins=joins,
            where=where,
            order_by=SqlOrderByClause(order),
            limit=limit,
            offset=offset,
        ),
    )


def combine_visible_fts_payloads(
    payloads: list[SqlRenderable],
    *,
    columns: tuple[str, ...],
    order_columns: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...],
    limit: int | None,
    offset: int | None,
) -> SqlRenderable:
    """Choose the last requested matching snapshot per identity before pagination."""
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_cte_helpers import SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSubqueryTableRef
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_compound import SqlWindow
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlStar
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.set_operations import SqlUnionAll
    from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlCteDefinition

    union = SqlUnionAll(
        [
            SqlSelect(select=[SqlStar()], from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(payload, SqlTableName(f"fts_snapshot_{index}")))
            for index, payload in enumerate(payloads)
        ]
    )
    output_columns = (
        *columns,
        "__requested_revision_id",
        "__requested_revision_ordinal",
        "__fts_revision_rn",
        "__fts_object_rn",
        "__fts_rank",
    )
    ranked = SqlSelectFromCteWithOverrides(
        source_cte_name=SqlGrammarKind("fts_snapshot_union"),
        source_columns=output_columns,
        overrides={
            "__fts_object_rn": SqlWindow(
                func_name="ROW_NUMBER",
                partition_by=[SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"))],
                order_by=[SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__requested_revision_ordinal")), OrderDirection.DESC)],
            )
        },
    )
    order = [SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__fts_rank")), OrderDirection.DESC)]
    order.extend(
        SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)), OrderDirection.DESC if direction == "DESC" else OrderDirection.ASC)
        for column, direction in order_columns
    )
    order.extend(
        [
            SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__requested_revision_ordinal")), OrderDirection.DESC),
            SqlOrderByItem(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), OrderDirection.ASC),
        ]
    )
    final = SqlSelect(
        select=[SqlStar()],
        from_=SqlTableIdent(SqlTableName("fts_snapshot_ranked")),
        where=SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("__fts_object_rn")), BinaryOp.EQ, SqlInlineLiteral(1)),
        order_by=SqlOrderByClause(order),
        limit=limit,
        offset=offset,
    )
    return SqlCte([SqlCteDefinition("fts_snapshot_union", union), SqlCteDefinition("fts_snapshot_ranked", ranked)], final)

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ValidateRevisionReplicaConfig:
    """Closed expected record for one reused revision."""

    domain: type[VersioningDomain]
    revision_id: RevisionId
    legacy_parent_revision_id: RevisionId | None
    legacy_parent_type: ParentType | None
    timestamp: AwareDatetime
    session_id: SessionId
    revision_metadata: Mapping[str, RevisionMetadataValue]
    parent_revision_ids: tuple[RevisionId, ...]
    parent_relationship_types: tuple[ParentType, ...]
    after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset()


def _query_spec(
    model_cls: type,
    *expressions: object,
    for_update: bool = True,
) -> QuerySpec:
    return QuerySpec(
        model_cls=model_cls,
        select_columns=None,
        distinct=False,
        joins=[],
        filters=[QueryFilter(expression=expression) for expression in expressions],
        order_by=[],
        limit=1,
        offset=None,
        group_by=[],
        aggregations=[],
        having=[],
        window_functions=[],
        for_update=for_update,
    )


class ValidateRevisionReplicaIntent(IntentStep[None]):
    """Lock and validate one authoritative revision and its ordered parents."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "versioned", "validation", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.ONE

    def __init__(
        self,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        config: ValidateRevisionReplicaConfig,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.config = config

    def dependencies(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(str(ref) for ref in self.config.after_refs)

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[HeterogeneousServerPlanStep]:
        del ctx
        config = self.config
        if len(config.parent_revision_ids) != len(config.parent_relationship_types):
            raise ValueError("Expected parent relationship types must match expected parent revisions")
        error_message = (
            f"Upstream revision {config.revision_id} no longer matches "
            "the validated publication record"
        )
        revision_values: dict[
            DynamicFieldName,
            RevisionMetadataValue | RevisionId | SessionId | AwareDatetime | ParentType,
        ] = {
            DynamicFieldName("sys_id"): config.revision_id,
            DynamicFieldName("parent_revision_sys_id"): config.legacy_parent_revision_id,
            DynamicFieldName("parent_type"): config.legacy_parent_type,
            DynamicFieldName("timestamp"): config.timestamp,
            DynamicFieldName("session_id"): config.session_id,
            **{
                DynamicFieldName(name): value
                for name, value in config.revision_metadata.items()
            },
        }
        revision_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_revision")
        steps: list[HeterogeneousServerPlanStep] = [
            QueryAssertRowsStep(
                revision_ref,
                config.domain.revision_model,
                query_spec=_query_spec(
                    config.domain.revision_model,
                    *(col(name) == value for name, value in revision_values.items()),
                ),
                error_cls=ConcurrentBranchUpdateError,
                error_message=error_message,
                expect_empty=False,
                after_refs=config.after_refs,
            ),
        ]
        parent_model = config.domain.revision_parent_model
        revision_filter = col(DynamicFieldName("revision_sys_id")) == config.revision_id
        if not config.parent_revision_ids:
            steps.append(
                QueryAssertNoRowsStep(
                    self.ref_id,
                    parent_model,
                    query_spec=_query_spec(parent_model, revision_filter),
                    error_cls=ConcurrentBranchUpdateError,
                    error_message=error_message,
                    expect_empty=True,
                    after_refs=frozenset({revision_ref}),
                ),
            )
            return steps

        range_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_parent_range")
        steps.append(
            QueryAssertNoRowsStep(
                range_ref,
                parent_model,
                query_spec=_query_spec(
                    parent_model,
                    revision_filter,
                    (col(DynamicFieldName("ordinal")) < 0)
                    | (
                        col(DynamicFieldName("ordinal"))
                        >= len(config.parent_revision_ids)
                    ),
                ),
                error_cls=ConcurrentBranchUpdateError,
                error_message=error_message,
                expect_empty=True,
                after_refs=frozenset({revision_ref}),
            ),
        )
        prior_ref = range_ref
        for ordinal, (parent_id, relationship_type) in enumerate(
            zip(
                config.parent_revision_ids,
                config.parent_relationship_types,
                strict=True,
            ),
        ):
            parent_ref = (
                self.ref_id
                if ordinal == len(config.parent_revision_ids) - 1
                else ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_parent_{ordinal}")
            )
            steps.append(
                QueryAssertRowsStep(
                    parent_ref,
                    parent_model,
                    query_spec=_query_spec(
                        parent_model,
                        revision_filter,
                        col(DynamicFieldName("parent_revision_sys_id")) == parent_id,
                        col(DynamicFieldName("relationship_type"))
                        == relationship_type,
                        col(DynamicFieldName("ordinal")) == ordinal,
                    ),
                    error_cls=ConcurrentBranchUpdateError,
                    error_message=error_message,
                    expect_empty=False,
                    after_refs=frozenset({prior_ref}),
                ),
            )
            prior_ref = parent_ref
        return steps

        assert str(row["run_id"]) == str(run.sys_id)

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "run_count,fault",
    [
        (1, None),
        (2, None),
        (2, "header_count"),
        (2, "run_count"),
        (2, "missing_member"),
        (2, "extra_member"),
        (2, "future_epoch"),
    ],
)
def test_metadata_plan_selects_runs_without_transporting_payloads(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection, run_count: int, fault: str | None, system_session_id: SessionId
) -> None:
    _, branch = create_test_revision(
        db_connection,
        USearchScopeDomain,
        workspace_id=WorkspaceId.default(),
        session_id=SessionId.schema(),
    )
    for number in range(run_count):
        _write_document(
            db_connection,
            branch,
            connection_id=ConnectionId(f"compaction-metadata-{number}"),
            title=f"metadata-{number}",
            embedding=[float(number + 1), 1.0],
        )

    def authority(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> tuple[USearchIndexBlobBase, list[USearchRun]]:
        return txn.query(USearchScopeIndex).execute()[0], list(txn.query(USearchRun).execute())

    header, runs = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=authority)
    if fault is not None:

        def corrupt(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
            if fault == "header_count":
                txn.update(USearchScopeIndex, header.model_copy(update={"num_nodes": header.num_nodes + 1}))
            elif fault == "run_count":
                txn.update(USearchRun, runs[0].model_copy(update={"member_count": runs[0].member_count + 1}))
            elif fault == "future_epoch":
                txn.update(USearchRun, runs[0].model_copy(update={"published_epoch": header.artifact_epoch + 1}))
            else:
                members = list(txn.query(USearchRunMember).execute())
                if fault == "missing_member":
                    txn.delete_by_id(USearchRunMember, members[0].sys_id)
                else:
                    extra = members[1].model_copy(
                        update={
                            "sys_id": type(members[1].sys_id).new(),
                            "run_id": members[0].run_id,
                        }
                    )
                    txn.insert(USearchRunMember, extra)

        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=corrupt)

    def build(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> dict[str, object]:
        return plan_usearch_compaction_metadata(txn, USearchScopeIndex, header.sys_id)

    metadata = execute_read_plan_workflow(
        db_connection,
        SyncReadPlanWorkflow[dict[str, object]](
            session_id=SessionId.schema(),
            build=build,
        ),
    )
    rows = metadata["runs"]
    assert isinstance(rows, list)
    assert len(rows) == run_count
    for row in rows:
        assert isinstance(row, dict)
        assert "payload" not in row
        assert not any(isinstance(value, bytes) for value in row.values())
        if fault is None:
            assert row["member_count"] == row["observed_members"] == 1
    if fault is not None:
        with pytest.raises(NativeSearchIntegrityError):
            select_compaction_from_metadata(
                metadata,
                artifact_id=header.sys_id,
                policy=USearchCompactionPolicy(level_zero_run_trigger=2),
                cursors={},
            )
        return
    selection = select_compaction_from_metadata(
        metadata,
        artifact_id=header.sys_id,
        policy=USearchCompactionPolicy(level_zero_run_trigger=2),
        cursors={},
    )
    if run_count == 1:
        assert selection is None
    else:
        assert selection is not None
        assert selection.artifact_epoch == header.artifact_epoch
        assert {run.run_id for run in selection.input_runs} == {run.sys_id for run in runs}
        assert selection.input_bytes == sum(len(run.payload) for run in runs)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# L0 Step: compiles to grammar, post_op interprets result
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class _TableExistsStepCteRow(BaseModel):
    exists: bool = Field(json_schema_extra={"db_column": "__exists"})


class TableExistsStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[bool]):
    """L0: Check if a table exists via backend-appropriate SQL grammar.

    Compiles to a ``SELECT EXISTS (...)`` query against the system catalog
    (sqlite_master, information_schema, etc.) and returns True/False via post_op.
    """

    def cte_publication_contract(self: TableExistsStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = ("__exists",)
        column_type_hints = SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({"__exists"}))
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = _TableExistsStepCteRow
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def __init__(
        self: TableExistsStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._table_name = table_name

    @property
    def level(self: TableExistsStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def result_cardinality(self: TableExistsStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def is_read_only(self: TableExistsStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def execution_role(self: TableExistsStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def step_tags(self: TableExistsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "schema", "table_exists", "grammar"})

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: TableExistsStep) -> bool:
        """Schema introspection must not be fused into CTE transport."""
        return False

    def scheduling_fingerprint(self: TableExistsStep) -> tuple[object, ...]:
        """Table probes share the same optimizer scheduling shape."""
        return (type(self).__qualname__,)

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self: TableExistsStep) -> bool:
        """Run after any session preamble as a standalone statement."""
        return True

    def tables_read(self: TableExistsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: TableExistsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def compile(self: TableExistsStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[bool]:
        del ctx

        from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_introspection import SqlTableExists

        grammar = SqlTableExists(self._table_name)
        __opa002_grammar_106 = grammar
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(
            self.cte_publication_contract(),
        )
        return CompiledStep(
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            grammar=__opa002_grammar_106,
            closed_post_op=scalar_column_post_op(
                "__exists",
                default_value=False,
                use_default_on_empty=True,
                scalar_coercion=ScalarCoercionKind.BOOL,
            ),
            needs_returning=True,
        )


def _schema_table_exists_step(ref_id: ServerPlanRefId, table_name: SqlTableName) -> TableExistsStep:
    return TableExistsStep(ref_id, table_name)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# L4 Intent: lowers to TableExistsStep
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class TableExistsIntent(IntentStep[bool]):
    """L4: Pure intent to check if a table exists. Lowered to TableExistsStep."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"read", "schema", "table_exists", "intent"})
    intent_cardinality = Cardinality.SCALAR
    intent_read_only = True

    def __init__(
        self: TableExistsIntent,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        table_name: SqlTableName,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.table_name = table_name

    def lower(
        self: TableExistsIntent,
        ctx: LoweringContext,
    ) -> Sequence[ServerPlanStep[Any]]:
        del ctx
        return [_schema_table_exists_step(self.ref_id, self.table_name)]

                    and "graph_key =" in detail
                    for detail in details
                ), details
    print("PUBLICATION_EVIDENCE " + json.dumps({

        "same_graph": same_graph,
