        return True

    def cte_publication_contract(self: SelectManyRawStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        columns = self._compiled_cte_output_columns or tuple(
            get_db_column_name(self._model_cls, DynamicFieldName(field_name)) for field_name in self._model_cls.model_fields
        )
        column_type_hints = (
            self._compiled_cte_column_type_hints or model_sql_column_type_hints(self._model_cls, columns) or SqlColumnTypeHints()
        )
        if columns is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} must publish CTE columns."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if column_type_hints is None:
            msg = f"{type(self).__name__} publishes CTE columns without SQL column type hints."
            raise TypeError(msg)
        _contract_model_cls = self._model_cls
        _contract_source_tables = self.tables_written() or self.tables_read() or None
        if _contract_source_tables is not None:
            _contract_source_tables = frozenset(str(table) for table in _contract_source_tables)
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=tuple(str(column) for column in columns),
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            model_cls=_contract_model_cls,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=_contract_source_tables,
        )

    def __init__(
        self: SelectManyRawStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
        sys_ids: ScalarSequenceServerRef[SysId],
        *,
        after_refs: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] | None = None,
        permission_context_ref: ServerPlanRefId | None = None,
        permission_context_type: type[ResolvedSessionContext] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self._model_cls = model_cls
        self._sys_ids = sys_ids
        self._after_refs = after_refs or frozenset()
        self._permission_context_ref = permission_context_ref
        self._permission_context_type = permission_context_type
        self._compiled_cte_output_columns: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
        self._compiled_cte_column_type_hints: SqlColumnTypeHints | None = None

    @property
    def level(self: SelectManyRawStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def step_tags(self: SelectManyRawStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"read", "select_many", "raw"})

    def is_read_only(self: SelectManyRawStep) -> bool:
        return True

    def result_cardinality(self: SelectManyRawStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.MANY

    def tables_read(self: SelectManyRawStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name

        return frozenset({get_table_name(self._model_cls)})

    def tables_written(self: SelectManyRawStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def dependencies(self: SelectManyRawStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        deps = {str(ref_id) for ref_id in self._after_refs}
        if isinstance(self._sys_ids, ScalarSequenceServerRef):
            deps.update(str(dep) for dep in self._sys_ids.dependencies())
        if self._permission_context_ref is not None:
            deps.add(str(self._permission_context_ref))
        return frozenset(deps)

    def compile(self: SelectManyRawStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.query_execute_raw import (
            QueryExecuteRawStep,
            _QueryExecuteRawStepConfig,
        )

        sys_id_field: Any = field(self._model_cls.sys_id)  # pyright: ignore[reportGeneralTypeIssues]
        query_spec = QuerySpec(
            model_cls=self._model_cls,
            select_columns=None,
            distinct=False,
            joins=[],
            filters=[QueryFilter(expression=sys_id_field.is_in(cast("Any", self._sys_ids)))],
            order_by=[],
            limit=None,
            offset=None,
            group_by=[],
            aggregations=[],
            having=[],
            window_functions=[],
            permission_state=QueryPermissionState.AUTO,
            permission_grammar=None,
            permission_context_ref=self._permission_context_ref,
            permission_context_type=self._permission_context_type,
        )
        compiled = QueryExecuteRawStep[list[dict[str, Any]]](
            self.ref_id,
            self._model_cls,
            _QueryExecuteRawStepConfig(
                query_spec=query_spec,
                hydrate_large_columns=True,
            ),
        ).compile(ctx)
        assert compiled.output_shape is not None
        self._compiled_cte_output_columns = compiled.output_shape.cte_output_columns
        self._compiled_cte_column_type_hints = compiled.column_type_hints
        self._cte_publication_contract_cache_valid = False
        self._publication_contract_cache_valid = False
        return cast(
            "CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]",
            compiled,
        )

@pytest.mark.parametrize("rollback", [False, True])
def test_explicit_incident_rebuild_restores_rows_or_rolls_back(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    rollback: bool,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    branch, _, _, _, _, _, _, _ = graph.setup_test_graph(
        db_connection, graph.CASCADE_DOMAIN, graph.CascadeTestGraph, graph.CascadeTestNode,
        graph.CascadeTestEdge, system_session_id,
    )

    def read(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> list[GraphIncidentPosting]:
        return list(txn.query(GraphIncidentPosting).filter(field(GraphIncidentPosting.branch_id) == branch).execute())

    before = db_connection.session(system_session_id).read(fn=read)
    assert before

    def damage(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        txn.query(GraphIncidentPosting).filter(field(GraphIncidentPosting.branch_id) == branch).delete()

    db_connection.session(system_session_id).write(fn=damage)
    assert db_connection.session(system_session_id).read(fn=read) == []

    def rebuild(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        plan = txn.plan()
        assert isinstance(plan, BaseServerPlan)
        plan.add_step(RebuildIncidentPostingsStep(
            ServerPlanRefId("rebuild_incident"), sparse_table=SqlTableName("cascade_test_edges_sparse"),
            edge_table=SqlTableName("cascade_test_edges"), branch_ref=ServerRefs.scalar(branch),
        ))
        plan.execute()
        if rollback:
            raise RuntimeError("injected incident rebuild rollback")

    if rollback:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected incident rebuild rollback"):
            db_connection.session(system_session_id).write(fn=rebuild)
    else:
        db_connection.session(system_session_id).write(fn=rebuild)
    after = db_connection.session(system_session_id).read(fn=read)
    assert {row.model_dump_json() for row in after} == (set() if rollback else {row.model_dump_json() for row in before})

    def read_coverage(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> list[GraphIncidentPostingCoverage]:
        return list(txn.query(GraphIncidentPostingCoverage)
            .filter(field(GraphIncidentPostingCoverage.branch_id) == branch).execute())

    coverage = db_connection.session(system_session_id).read(fn=read_coverage)
    assert [(row.branch_id, row.edge_table_name) for row in coverage] == ([] if rollback else [(branch, "cascade_test_edges")])

class CapturePublicationRowsStep(AffectedStagedRowsStep):
    """Populate a private selection once without returning its payload to Python."""

    def __init__(
        self: CapturePublicationRowsStep,
        ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
        *,
        selection: PublicationSelectionContract,
        temporary_table: SqlTableName,
        branch_ref: ScalarServerRef[BranchId],
        selector: _StagedCommitSelector,
        depends_on: frozenset[ServerPlanRefId] = frozenset(),
        correction_source: PublicationSelectionIdentity | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if selection.identity.scope != _scope_descriptor_from_selector(branch_ref, selector):
            raise ValueError("Capture selector does not match the publication selection identity")
        if selection.identity.partition_columns != (SqlColumnName("branch_id"), SqlColumnName("sys_id")):
            raise ValueError("Physical staging capture requires branch and object identity partitions")
        if temporary_table == selection.identity.source_table:
            raise ValueError("Capture output must differ from the physical staging source")
        super().__init__(
            ref_id,
            selection.identity.source_table,
            branch_ref,
            selector,
            data_columns=tuple(sorted(selection.columns)),
            depends_on=depends_on,
        )
        if (
            correction_source is not None
            and correction_source.model_copy(update={"scope": selection.identity.scope}) != selection.identity
        ):
            raise ValueError("Publication correction cannot change attempt, table, schema, or partition identity")
        self.selection = selection
        self.temporary_table = temporary_table
        self.correction_source = correction_source

    def step_tags(self: CapturePublicationRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "versioned", "publish", "affected_rows", "selection_capture"})

    def tables_written(self: CapturePublicationRowsStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self.temporary_table})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: CapturePublicationRowsStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        return replace(super().cte_publication_contract(), source_tables=self.tables_read())

    def is_read_only(self: CapturePublicationRowsStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def requires_prior_step_boundary(self: CapturePublicationRowsStep) -> bool:
        """Materialize the temporary selection before dependent SQL consumes it."""
        return True

    def supports_sql_batch_transport(self: CapturePublicationRowsStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def supports_ordered_sql_statement_batch(self: CapturePublicationRowsStep) -> bool:
        """Capture staging rows after preceding writes in the same request."""
        return True

    def publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: CapturePublicationRowsStep) -> bool:
        """The repeatable SQL publication owns the selected rows."""
        return False

    def always_publishes_executor_visible_binding(self: CapturePublicationRowsStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def compile(
        self: CapturePublicationRowsStep,
        ctx: CompilationContext,
    ) -> CompiledStep[list[dict[str, Any]]]:
        compiled = super().compile(ctx)
        query = compiled.grammar
        assert query is not None
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        existing = ctx.publication_selections.get(self.selection.identity)
        if existing is None and self.correction_source is not None:
            existing = ctx.publication_selections.get(self.correction_source)
        if existing is not None and not self.selection.columns <= frozenset(existing.columns):
            raise ValueError("Publication correction changed its captured selection projection")
        table = SqlTableName(existing.ref_id) if existing is not None else self.temporary_table
        publication = compiled_repeatable_sql_publication(
            ref_id=self.ref_id,
            query=SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(table)),
            contract=contract,
        )
        grammar: SqlSelect | SqlCreateTemporaryTableAsSelect = (
            SqlSelect(select=SqlStar(), from_=SqlTableIdent(table), where=SqlParam(False))
            if existing is not None
            else SqlCreateTemporaryTableAsSelect(table, query, transaction_owned=True)
        )
        from l2070_batching.compilation import CteReference

        selected_binding = CteReference(
            ref_id=ServerPlanRefId(table),
            source_tables=contract.source_tables,
            columns=tuple(contract.columns or ()),
            column_type_hints=contract.column_type_hints,
            ephemeral=False,
        )
        ctx.publication_selections[self.selection.identity] = selected_binding
        return replace(
            compiled,
            grammar=grammar,
            compiled_sql_publication=replace(publication, selection_contract=self.selection, physical_selection_table=table),
        )

"""Common versioned routing helpers for intent lowering.

All intents (read and write) use these helpers to determine whether
an operation should be routed through versioned infrastructure.

The universal check is: ``is_versioned_model(model_cls) and ctx.is_versioned``.

For write intents, ``get_versioned_staging_ctx()`` additionally obtains
the staging context (branch, staged_commit_id, etc.) needed to lower
to versioned staging steps.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from l1400_types.type_surface_contracts import SchemaObjectName

from collections.abc import Iterable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Protocol, cast

from l1000_schema.schema_def import DatabaseObjectRow
from l2055_lazy_result.purity import pure_lazy
from l1400_types import DynamicFieldName, SysId
from l2070_batching.compilation import LoweringContext
from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_helpers import (
    _collect_large_column_pointer_db_columns,
)
from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_table_info import VersionedBaseTableName, derive_versioned_table_names

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_transaction import VersionedStagingCtx


class _VersionedStagingContextFactory(Protocol):
    def __call__(
        self: _VersionedStagingContextFactory,
        model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    ) -> VersionedStagingCtx: ...


@pure_lazy
def is_versioned_model(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]]) -> bool:
    """Check if model_cls is a user-facing VersionedObjectRow.

    Returns False for auxiliary tables (_sparse, _staged, _tip)
    to prevent double-wrapping when versioned lowering produces
    queries against implementation tables.
    """
    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import VersionedObjectRow

    if not issubclass(model_cls, VersionedObjectRow):
        return False
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import get_table_name

    table = get_table_name(model_cls)
    return not table.endswith(("_sparse", "_staged", "_tip"))


def is_versioned_operation(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]], ctx: LoweringContext) -> bool:
    """Check if this operation should use versioned routing."""
    if not ctx.is_versioned:
        return False
    if is_versioned_model(model_cls):
        return True
    model_domain = ctx.versioning_domain
    if model_domain is None:
        return False
    all_versioned_models = getattr(model_domain, "all_versioned_models", None)
    if not callable(all_versioned_models):
        return False
    candidates = all_versioned_models()
    if not isinstance(candidates, Iterable):
        return False
    return any(candidate is model_cls for candidate in candidates)


def get_versioned_staging_ctx(
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    ctx: LoweringContext,
) -> VersionedStagingCtx | None:
    """Get VersionedStagingCtx for a versioned write operation.

    Returns None if the operation is not versioned or no staging
    context factory is available (e.g. read-only transaction).
    """
    if not is_versioned_operation(model_cls, ctx):
        return None
    if ctx.staging_ctx_factory is None:
        return None
    staging_ctx_factory = cast("_VersionedStagingContextFactory", ctx.staging_ctx_factory)
    return staging_ctx_factory(model_cls)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VersionedReadInfo:
    """Precomputed versioned table/column info for read operations."""

    base_table: str
    staged_table: str
    tip_table: str
    sparse_table: str
    common_columns: list[str]
    type_ids: list[str] | None


def get_versioned_read_info(model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow]) -> VersionedReadInfo:
    """Compute versioned table names, common columns, and type names for a model.

    Used where no write transaction is available to build a
    :class:`~impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_transaction.VersionedStagingCtx`.
    The merge data-slice authority for writes is
    :func:`l7200_versioned_transactions.physical_merge_columns.physical_data_db_columns_staged_tip_intersection`
    (physical staged/tip models). This path walks the logical ``model_cls`` and
    adds large-column pointer DB names so read plans stay aligned with staging
    where those pointers participate in merged selects.
    """
    from l1000_schema.schema_def import get_db_column_name
    from l1000_schema.table_utils import bounded_identifier_with_suffix, get_table_name
    from l1050_polymorphism.type_filter_helper import collect_polymorphic_type_names
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._compile_versioned import (
        _model_has_type_name_field,
    )

    base_table = get_table_name(model_cls)
    _VERSIONED_EXCLUDE = frozenset({"revision_id", "staged_commit_id", "deleted"})
    _PRIORITY_FIELDS = ("sys_id", "branch_id")

    remaining: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    for f in model_cls.model_fields:
        if f in _VERSIONED_EXCLUDE or f in _PRIORITY_FIELDS:
            continue
        remaining.append((f, get_db_column_name(model_cls, DynamicFieldName(f))))

    seen_remaining = {db_col for _, db_col in remaining}
    for db_col in _collect_large_column_pointer_db_columns(model_cls):
        if db_col in seen_remaining:
            continue
        remaining.append((db_col, db_col))
        seen_remaining.add(db_col)

    # sys_id and branch_id first (matching staging context), then sorted rest
    common_columns: list[str] = ["sys_id", "branch_id"]
    common_columns.extend(db_col for _, db_col in sorted(remaining, key=lambda t: t[0]))

    raw_type_names = collect_polymorphic_type_names(model_cls) if _model_has_type_name_field(model_cls) else ()
    type_ids = list(raw_type_names) if raw_type_names else None

    return VersionedReadInfo(
        base_table=base_table,
        staged_table=derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(base_table))))).staged,
        tip_table=derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(base_table))))).tip,
        sparse_table=derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(base_table))))).sparse,
        common_columns=common_columns,
        type_ids=type_ids,
    )

"""Opaque runtime transport from materialized relations back into typed SQL values."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import fields, is_dataclass, replace
from typing import Any, cast

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, TypeAdapter

from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.plan_expression import PlanAliasedExpression, PlanColumnRef, PlanPredicate
from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_source import (
    CompilerValuesSourceValue,
    CteSource,
    QuerySource,
    ValuesSource,
    _compiler_values_source,
    derived_query_source,
)
from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_spec import QuerySpec
from l2060_query_builder.query_contracts import JoinClause, QueryFilter
from l1400_types import ServerPlanRefId


_DATABASE_VALUE_ADAPTER: TypeAdapter[CompilerValuesSourceValue] = TypeAdapter(
    CompilerValuesSourceValue,
    config=ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True),
)


def bind_materialized_relations(
    value: object,
    *,
    rows_by_ref: Mapping[ServerPlanRefId, object],
) -> object:
    """Replace selected CTE refs with opaque typed VALUES relations."""
    return _rewrite(value, rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo={})


def _rewrite(value: object, *, rows_by_ref: Mapping[ServerPlanRefId, object], memo: dict[int, object]) -> object:
    value_id = id(value)
    result: object
    if value_id in memo:
        return memo[value_id]
    if isinstance(value, ValuesSource):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, CteSource):
        ref_name = ServerPlanRefId(value.cte_name)
        if ref_name in rows_by_ref:
            result = _values_for_source(value, rows_by_ref[ref_name])
            memo[value_id] = result
            return result
        return value
    if isinstance(value, JoinClause):
        join_result = JoinClause(
            target_model=value.target_model,
            on_left=_rewrite(value.on_left, rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo=memo),
            on_right=_rewrite(value.on_right, rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo=memo),
            join_type=value.join_type,
            target_source=_rewrite(value.target_source, rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo=memo),
            target_alias=value.target_alias,
            left_source=_rewrite(value.left_source, rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo=memo),
        )
        join_result.on_predicate = _rewrite(value.on_predicate, rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo=memo)
        join_result.policy_authority_request = getattr(value, "policy_authority_request", None)
        memo[value_id] = join_result
        return join_result
    if isinstance(value, QueryFilter):
        result = QueryFilter(
            column=value.column,
            operator=value.operator,
            value=_rewrite(value.value, rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo=memo),
            expression=_rewrite(value.expression, rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo=memo),
            json_key=value.json_key,
            server_ref_dependencies=value.server_ref_dependencies,
        )
        memo[value_id] = result
        return result
    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        result = tuple(_rewrite(item, rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo=memo) for item in value)
        memo[value_id] = result
        return result
    if isinstance(value, list):
        result = [_rewrite(item, rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo=memo) for item in value]
        memo[value_id] = result
        return result
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        result = {key: _rewrite(item, rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo=memo) for key, item in value.items()}
        memo[value_id] = result
        return result
    if isinstance(value, type) or not is_dataclass(value):
        return value
    replacements = {
        item.name: _rewrite(getattr(value, item.name), rows_by_ref=rows_by_ref, memo=memo) for item in fields(value) if item.init
    }
    result = replace(cast("Any", value), **replacements)
    memo[value_id] = result
    return result


def _values_for_source(source: CteSource, raw_rows: object) -> QuerySource:
    columns = source.columns
    rows = tuple(_row_values(row, columns) for row in _rows(raw_rows))
    if rows:
        return _compiler_values_source(
            source.model_cls,
            SqlTableName(f"runtime_{str(source.cte_name)[:40]}"),
            columns=columns,
            rows=rows,
        )
    sentinel = _compiler_values_source(
        source.model_cls,
        SqlTableName(f"runtime_empty_values_{str(source.cte_name)[:32]}"),
        columns=columns,
        rows=(tuple(None for _column in columns),),
    )
    empty_query = QuerySpec(
        model_cls=source.model_cls,
        source=sentinel,
        select_columns=cast(
            "Any",
            [
                PlanAliasedExpression(
                    PlanColumnRef(sentinel, source.model_cls, column),
                    column,
                )
                for column in columns
            ],
        ),
        distinct=False,
        joins=[],
        filters=[QueryFilter(expression=PlanPredicate(False, "=", True))],
        order_by=[],
        limit=None,
        offset=None,
        group_by=[],
        aggregations=[],
        having=[],
        window_functions=[],
        projection_output_aliases=columns,
    )
    return derived_query_source(
        source.model_cls,
        empty_query,
        alias=f"runtime_empty_{str(source.cte_name)[:36]}",
        columns=columns,
    )


def _rows(value: object) -> tuple[object, ...]:
    if value is None:
        return ()
    if isinstance(value, Sequence) and not isinstance(value, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
        return tuple(value)
    return (value,)


def _row_values(
    row: object,
    columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...],
) -> tuple[CompilerValuesSourceValue, ...]:
    mapping: Mapping[str, object]
    if isinstance(row, BaseModel):
        mapping = row.model_dump()
    elif isinstance(row, Mapping):
        mapping = row
    else:
        mapping = {column: getattr(row, column) for column in columns}
    return tuple(
        _DATABASE_VALUE_ADAPTER.validate_python(mapping.get(column))
        for column in columns
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
from l2070_batching.compilation import LoweringContext

if TYPE_CHECKING:

def ctx_revision_id(ctx: LoweringContext) -> RevisionId | None:
    revision_id = ctx.revision_id
    if revision_id is None or revision_id == "current" or "current" in str(revision_id).lower():
        return None
    is_current = getattr(revision_id, "is_current", None)
    if callable(is_current) and is_current():
        return None
    normalized = RevisionId(revision_id)
    return None if normalized.is_current() or str(normalized) == "current" else normalized


def ctx_lazy_revision_ref(ctx: LoweringContext) -> ScalarServerRef[RevisionId]:
    lazy_revision = ctx.lazy_revision
    assert isinstance(lazy_revision, ScalarServerRef), "LoweringContext.lazy_revision is required"
    return lazy_revision


def ctx_lazy_branch_ref(ctx: LoweringContext) -> ScalarServerRef[BranchId]:
    lazy_branch = ctx.lazy_branch
    assert isinstance(lazy_branch, ScalarServerRef), "LoweringContext.lazy_branch is required"
    return lazy_branch


def _resolve_context_revision_literal(ctx: LoweringContext) -> RevisionId | None:
    """Return the explicitly pinned revision from ``ctx`` when available."""
    if (
        ctx.prefer_tip_strategy
        and ctx.branch_tip_materialized
        and ctx.explicit_revision_id is None
        and (ctx.revision_id is None or ctx.revision_id == "current")
    ):
        return None
    revision_id = ctx_revision_id(ctx)
    if revision_id is not None:
        return revision_id
    if ctx.explicit_revision_id is None:
        return None
    explicit_revision = RevisionId(ctx.explicit_revision_id)
    return None if explicit_revision.is_current() or str(explicit_revision) == "current" else explicit_revision


def ctx_revision_source(ctx: LoweringContext) -> tuple[RevisionId | None, ServerPlanRefId | None]:
    revision_literal = _resolve_context_revision_literal(ctx)
    if revision_literal is not None:
        return revision_literal, None
    if ctx.lazy_revision is None:
        return None, None
    lazy_revision_ref = ctx_lazy_revision_ref(ctx)
    return None, ServerPlanRefId(lazy_revision_ref.ref_id) if lazy_revision_ref.ref_id is not None else None


def versioned_scalar_query_allow_batch(ctx: LoweringContext) -> bool:
    """Return whether versioned scalar reads may safely batch in the current txn."""
    return not (ctx.branch_id is not None and ctx.revision_id is None and ctx.staging_ctx_factory is not None)


def query_spec_has_graph_predicates(
    query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    *,
    planning_catalog: PlanningCatalog,
) -> bool:
    """Return ``True`` when a ``QuerySpec`` contains any ``GRAPH_*`` predicate filter.

    Graph predicates embedded in a versioned WHERE clause need a visible
    revision id to lower into sparse graph traversal subqueries. Tip-read
    paths that would otherwise leave ``CompilationContext.revision_id``
    unset must detect this case and emit a ``ResolveBranchTipRevisionStep``
    so a symbolic revision scalar is available during compile.
    """
    filters = query_spec.filters
    if not filters:
        return False
    model_cls = query_spec.model_cls
    from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.graph_predicate_spec import (
        build_graph_predicate_intent_set_from_query_filters,
    )

    intent_set = build_graph_predicate_intent_set_from_query_filters(
        filters,
        model_cls=model_cls,
        planning_catalog=planning_catalog,
    )
    return bool(intent_set.predicates)


def build_tip_revision_resolve_for_graph_preds(
    owner_ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    ctx: LoweringContext,
    query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
) -> tuple[list[ServerPlanStep[Any]], ServerPlanRefId | None]:
    """Emit a ``ResolveBranchTipRevisionStep`` when tip reads carry GRAPH_* predicates.

    Tip-read query lowering normally skips branch-revision resolution because
    the tip tables are already filtered by ``branch_id``. When the query spec
    embeds ``GRAPH_*`` predicates we still need a concrete revision scalar
    visible to compilation so sparse graph traversal subqueries can filter
    by validity window. Returns ``(extra_steps, revision_ref_id)``; when no
    graph predicates are present or the tip path is unavailable, returns
    ``([], None)``.
    """
    if not query_spec.filters:
        return [], None
    from impl.common.l5200_sql_query.query_grammar import query_spec_needs_planning_catalog

    if not query_spec_needs_planning_catalog(query_spec):
        return [], None
    planning_catalog = ctx.planning_catalog
    if planning_catalog is None:
        msg = "Graph predicate tip-resolution planning requires a PlanningCatalog"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if not query_spec_has_graph_predicates(query_spec, planning_catalog=planning_catalog):
        return [], None
    if ctx.branch_id is None or ctx.branch_table is None:
        return [], None
    from l7000_versioned_schema.versioned_schema import BranchId
    from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlTableName
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.resolve_branch_steps import (
        ResolveBranchTipRevisionStep,
    )

    owner = owner_ref_id if isinstance(owner_ref_id, ServerPlanRefId) else ServerPlanRefId(owner_ref_id)
    tip_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{owner}_resolve_tip_for_graph")
    step = ResolveBranchTipRevisionStep(
        tip_ref,
        branch_id=ServerRefs.scalar(BranchId(ctx.branch_id)),
        branch_table=SqlTableName(ctx.branch_table),
        branch_id_column=ctx.branch_id_column,
        tip_revision_column=ctx.branch_tip_revision_column,
    )
    return [step], tip_ref

def current_replay_graph_sources(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    model: type,
    branch: SqlRenderable,
) -> dict[type, SqlRenderable]:
    sources: dict[type, SqlRenderable] = {}
    for graph_model in find_graph_types_for_model(domain, model):
        spec = QuerySpec(
            model_cls=graph_model,
            select_columns=None,
            distinct=False,
            joins=[],
            filters=[],
            order_by=(),
            limit=None,
            offset=None,
            group_by=[],
            aggregations=[],

        current = compile_versioned_query(spec, graph_model, ctx, branch_id_override=branch, raw_mode=True).grammar
        assert current is not None
        sources[graph_model] = current
    return sources


def replay_graph_sources(
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    *,
    domain: type[VersioningDomain],
    model: type,
    branch: SqlRenderable,
    member_diff: SqlTwoWayDiffCte,
    current_sources: dict[type, SqlRenderable] | None = None,
) -> dict[type, SqlRenderable]:
    sources: dict[type, SqlRenderable] = {}
    current_sources = (
        current_sources if current_sources is not None else current_replay_graph_sources(ctx, domain=domain, model=model, branch=branch)
    )
    for graph_model in find_graph_types_for_model(domain, model):
        table = get_table_name(graph_model)
        from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_merge import _merge_data_columns

        columns = _merge_data_columns(graph_model, frozenset(_SYSTEM_FIELDS))
        namespace = str(
            bounded_identifier_with_suffix(
                SchemaObjectName(str(table)),
                SchemaObjectSuffix("__replay_parent"),
            )
        )
        diff = SqlTwoWayDiffCte(
            old_revision_raw=member_diff._old_revision_raw,
            new_revision_raw=member_diff._new_revision_raw,
            sparse_table=SqlTableName(derive_versioned_table_names(VersionedBaseTableName(str(SchemaObjectName(str(table))))).sparse),
            branch_id_raw=member_diff._new_branch_id_raw,
            old_branch_id_raw=member_diff._old_branch_id_raw,
            data_columns=columns,
            revision_table=SqlTableName(get_table_name(domain.revision_model)),
            revision_parents_table=SqlTableName(get_table_name(domain.revision_parent_model)),
            cte_namespace=namespace,
        )
        definitions, _select = diff.split_for_outer_cte()
        diff_name = SqlTableName(str(diff._cte_name("diff")))
        current = current_sources[graph_model]
        changed_identity = sql_and(
            SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier="changes"),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id"), qualifier="current_graph"),
            ),
            SqlBinaryOp(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("change_type"), qualifier="changes"), BinaryOp.NE, SqlParam("UNCHANGED")),
        )
        retained = SqlSelect(
            [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(name), qualifier="current_graph") for name in ("sys_id", "branch_id", *columns)],
            from_=SqlSubqueryTableRef(current, SqlTableName("current_graph")),
            where=sql_not(
                SqlExists(
                    SqlSelect(
                        [SqlParam(1)],
                        from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlTableIdent(diff_name), SqlAliasName("changes")),
                        where=changed_identity,
                    )
                )
            ),
        )
        proposed = SqlSelect(
            [SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("sys_id")), SqlSelectAlias(branch, SqlAliasName("branch_id"))]
            + [SqlSelectAlias(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(f"new_{column}")), SqlAliasName(column)) for column in columns],
            from_=SqlTableIdent(diff_name),
            where=SqlIn(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("change_type")), [SqlParam("ADDED"), SqlParam("MODIFIED")]),
        )
        sources[graph_model] = SqlWith(
            [
                SqlCteDefinition(SqlCteName(definition._name), definition._query, columns=tuple(definition._columns or ()))
                for definition in definitions
            ],
            SqlUnionAll([retained, proposed]),
            recursive=True,
        )
    return sources

@pytest.mark.parametrize("interrupt_after", ["native", "h14"])
def test_native_and_h14_schema_replacements_share_caller_rollback(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    interrupt_after: str,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    previous_native = matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor(spec=_spec())
    next_native = matching.NativeExactBootstrapContributor(spec=_batch_spec())
    previous_h14, next_h14 = h14_migration_generations()
    core = DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor()
    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    manifest = "phase7:composed-native-h14-replacement"
    source_tables = (H14RecoveryLeft, H14RecoveryRight)
    coordinator.run(
        db_connection,
        manifest_key=manifest,
        model_classes=source_tables,
        contributors=(core, previous_native, previous_h14),
    )
    session = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema())
    session.write(fn=_seed_native)
    session.write(fn=lambda txn: seed_recovery_sources(txn, previous_h14.fitted))
    before = session.read(fn=_metadata)
    assert tuple(len(rows) for rows in before) == (1, 1, 4, 1)

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="interrupt composed metadata replacement"):
        with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
            resolve_terminal_sync(schema, "serverplan_test", next_native.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_spec=previous_native.spec))
            if interrupt_after == "h14":
                resolve_terminal_sync(
                    schema,
                    "serverplan_test",
                    next_h14.migrate_from_lazy(
                        schema,
                        previous_artifact=previous_h14.fitted.artifact,
                    ),
                )
            raise RuntimeError("interrupt composed metadata replacement")

    rolled_back = session.read(fn=_metadata)
    for previous_rows, current_rows in zip(before, rolled_back, strict=True):
        assert {row.sys_id: row for row in current_rows} == {row.sys_id: row for row in previous_rows}
    session.read(fn=lambda txn: assert_recovery_matches(txn, previous_h14.fitted.artifact))
    native_result = session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, previous_native.spec))
    assert isinstance(native_result, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    assert [(edge.left.label, edge.right.label, edge.score.canonical) for edge in native_result.edges] == [("left", "right-2", 2.0)]

    for _ in range(2):
        with db_connection.schema_transaction(SessionId.schema()) as schema:
            resolve_terminal_sync(schema, "serverplan_test", next_native.migrate_from_lazy(schema, previous_spec=previous_native.spec))
            resolve_terminal_sync(
                schema,
                "serverplan_test",
                next_h14.migrate_from_lazy(
                    schema,
                    previous_artifact=previous_h14.fitted.artifact,
                ),
            )
    coordinator.run(
        db_connection,
        manifest_key=manifest,
        model_classes=source_tables,
        contributors=(core, next_native, next_h14),
    )
    after = session.read(fn=_metadata)
    assert tuple(len(rows) for rows in after) == (1, 2, 8, 1)
    for index in (1, 2):
        retained = {row.sys_id: row for row in after[index]}
        assert all(retained[row.sys_id] == row for row in before[index])
    with pytest.raises(matching.MatchArtifactError) as stale:
        session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, recovery_spec(next_h14.fitted.artifact)))
    assert stale.value.context.invariant is matching.MatchInvariant.PERSISTED_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH
    session.write(fn=lambda txn: maintain_recovery_sources(txn, next_h14.fitted))
    session.read(fn=lambda txn: assert_recovery_matches(txn, next_h14.fitted.artifact))
    replacement_result = session.read(fn=lambda txn: matching.match(txn, next_native.spec))
    assert isinstance(replacement_result, matching.TopKPerLeftMatchResult)
    assert [(edge.left.label, edge.right.label, edge.score.canonical) for edge in replacement_result.edges] == [("left", "right-2", 2.0)]

    rows = fetchall_raw_sql_for_tests(
        conn,

            select=SqlSelectList([SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("name"))]),

@pytest.mark.parametrize("failure", [False, True])
def test_publication_releases_scratch_on_success_and_constraint_failure(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    failure: bool,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    if not isinstance(db_connection, SyncSqliteConnection):
        pytest.skip("SQLite native scratch-relation observer")
    original = scenario.commit_test_branch
    completed: list[bool] = []
    leaks: list[frozenset[str]] = []

    def publish(
        conn: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch: BranchId,
        *,
        connection_id: ConnectionId,
        message: str,
    ) -> RevisionId:
        before = _scratch(conn)
        success = False
        try:
            revision = original(conn, domain, branch, connection_id=connection_id, message=message)
            success = True
            return revision
        finally:
            completed.append(success)
            leaks.append(_scratch(conn) - before)

    monkeypatch.setattr(scenario, "commit_test_branch", publish)
    if failure:
        scenario.exercise_deferred_duplicate_failure_preserves_tip_and_can_be_corrected(

            system_session_id,
        )
    assert completed
    assert any(completed)

def test_one_publication_does_not_reselect_physical_staging_per_consumer(
    db_connection: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    if not isinstance(db_connection, SyncSqliteConnection):
        pytest.skip("SQLite native statement observer")
    original = scenario.commit_test_branch
    populations: list[dict[str, int]] = []

    def publish(
        conn: SyncVersionedDatabaseConnection,
        domain: type[VersioningDomain],
        branch: BranchId,
        *,
        connection_id: ConnectionId,
        message: str,
    ) -> RevisionId:
        assert isinstance(conn, SyncSqliteConnection)
        raw = conn._conn
        assert isinstance(raw, sqlite3.Connection)
        read_tables: set[str] = set()
        deleted_tables: set[str] = set()
        statement_reads: Counter[str] = Counter()

        def authorize(action: int, table: str | None, column: str | None, database: str | None, trigger: str | None) -> int:
            del database, trigger
            if table is not None and table.endswith("_staged"):
                if action == sqlite3.SQLITE_READ and column == "sys_staged_commit_id":
                    read_tables.add(table)
                if action == sqlite3.SQLITE_DELETE:
                    deleted_tables.add(table)
            return sqlite3.SQLITE_OK

        def dispatched(sql: str) -> None:
            # The authoritative admission guard is not a publication consumer.
            if "__spub_" in sql or "No staged commits found for branch" in sql:
                read_tables.clear()
                deleted_tables.clear()
                return
            # Deleting the captured staging set is a mutation, not another population.
            statement_reads.update(read_tables - deleted_tables)
            read_tables.clear()
            deleted_tables.clear()

        raw.set_authorizer(authorize)
        raw.set_trace_callback(dispatched)
        try:
            return original(conn, domain, branch, connection_id=connection_id, message=message)
        finally:
            raw.set_trace_callback(None)
            raw.set_authorizer(None)
            populations.append(dict(statement_reads))

    monkeypatch.setattr(scenario, "commit_test_branch", publish)
    scenario.exercise_deferred_publication_retains_selection_history_and_unrelated_graph(
        (db_connection, scenario.CASCADE_DOMAIN),
        0,
        False,
        system_session_id,
    )
    assert populations and any(populations), "The observer must see actual physical staging selection"
    print({"publication_staging_selection_statements": populations})
    assert all(count <= 1 for population in populations for count in population.values()), (
        "Separate publication consumers select the same physical staging source again"
    )

See ``docs/design/NER1689_MARIADB_GRAPH_BOOTSTRAP.rst`` for the predicate-capture contract.

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlCteStepName, SqlTableName
from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._auxiliary_ctes import collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes
from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._runtime_replanning_error import raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden
from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._sql_visible_refs import resolve_sql_visible_ref
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_temporary_relation import SqlCreateTemporaryTableAsSelect
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlSelectAlias, SqlSelectList
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.domain.infra.stmt_dml_simple import SqlCteFieldRef
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.identifiers import SqlTableIdent
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
from l1400_types import ServerPlanRefId
from l2070_batching.cardinality import Cardinality
from l2070_batching.compilation import (
    CompilationContext,
    CompiledStep,
    compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract,
    compiled_repeatable_sql_publication,
)
from l2070_batching.post_op import literal_post_op
from l2070_batching.publication import LockedColumnName, ScalarControlKind
from l2070_batching.sql_column_type_hints import SqlColumnTypeHints
from l2070_batching.step import CtePublicationContract, SqlRelationPublisherStep, StepExecutionRole


class _CapturedPredicateRow(BaseModel):
    value: bool = Field(json_schema_extra={"db_column": "v"})


class CapturePredicateStep(SqlRelationPublisherStep[bool]):
    """Evaluate one predicate before later mutations can alter its inputs."""

    def __init__(self: CapturePredicateStep, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId, *, predicate_ref: ServerPlanRefId) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.predicate_ref = predicate_ref
        digest = hashlib.sha256(str(ref_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        self.temporary_table = SqlTableName(f"mcp_gate_{digest}")

    @property
    def level(self: CapturePredicateStep) -> int:
        return 0

    def dependencies(self: CapturePredicateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({str(self.predicate_ref)})

    def is_read_only(self: CapturePredicateStep) -> bool:
        return False

    def execution_role(self: CapturePredicateStep) -> StepExecutionRole:
        return StepExecutionRole.SQL

    def result_cardinality(self: CapturePredicateStep) -> Cardinality:
        return Cardinality.ONE

    def tables_read(self: CapturePredicateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset()

    def tables_written(self: CapturePredicateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({self.temporary_table})

    def step_tags(self: CapturePredicateStep) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset({"write", "grammar", "predicate_capture"})

    def cte_publication_contract(self: CapturePredicateStep) -> CtePublicationContract:
        return CtePublicationContract(
            publication_source_kind=CtePublicationContract.SQL_NATIVE_RELATION,
            columns=("v",),
            column_type_hints=SqlColumnTypeHints(bool_columns=frozenset({"v"})),
            model_cls=_CapturedPredicateRow,
            relation_role=self.cte_relation_role(),
            source_tables=None,
            scalar_control_kind=ScalarControlKind.TERMINAL_VALUE,
            scalar_value_column=LockedColumnName("v"),
        )

    def compile(self: CapturePredicateStep, ctx: CompilationContext) -> CompiledStep[bool]:
        binding = resolve_sql_visible_ref(
            ctx,
            self.predicate_ref,
            default_field="__result",
        )
        if binding is None:
            raise_missing_cte_fallback_forbidden(
                site_name="CapturePredicateStep.compile",
                trigger=f"predicate {self.predicate_ref!r} has no SQL-visible binding",
                blocked_path="runtime resolution after predicate inputs can change",
                result_contract="the predicate producer must publish one SQL-visible Boolean field",
                implementation_requirements=(
                    "Publish the predicate as an upstream SQL-visible scalar.",
                    "Keep the capture step before all mutations that can change the predicate.",
                ),
            )
            raise AssertionError("unreachable")
        predicate = SqlCteFieldRef(
            SqlCteStepName(binding.cte_name),
            SqlColumnName(binding.field_name),
        )
        capture_query = SqlSelect(select=SqlSelectList((SqlSelectAlias(predicate, SqlAliasName("v")),)))
        published_query = SqlSelect(
            select=SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("v")),
            from_=SqlTableIdent(self.temporary_table),
        )
        contract = self.cte_publication_contract()
        output_shape, result_relation, column_type_hints = compiled_artifacts_from_cte_publication_contract(contract)
        return CompiledStep(
            grammar=SqlCreateTemporaryTableAsSelect(self.temporary_table, capture_query, transaction_owned=True),
            closed_post_op=literal_post_op(True),
            compiled_sql_publication=compiled_repeatable_sql_publication(
                ref_id=self.ref_id,
                query=published_query,
                contract=contract,
            ),
            output_shape=output_shape,
            result_relation=result_relation,
            column_type_hints=column_type_hints,
            auxiliary_ctes=collect_dependency_auxiliary_ctes(ctx, self.dependencies()),
        )

@pytest.mark.parametrize("missing_json_metadata", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("payload", [{"allowed": True}, [1, False], 7, "seven", None])
def test_permission_source_preserves_json_literal_payload(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    backend: BackendType,
    missing_json_metadata: bool,
    payload: object,
) -> None:
    domain = create_versioning_domain(
        name="permission_json_domain", revision_model=PermissionJsonRevision, tables=(PermissionJsonRow,),
    )
    staging = VersionedStagingCtx(
        staged_model=PermissionJsonRow,
        tip_model=PermissionJsonRow,
        common_columns=["sys_id", "branch_id", "payload"],
        type_ids=None,
        lazy_branch=BranchId.new(),
        staged_commit_id_raw="00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001",
        domain=domain,
        connection_id_raw="permission-json-test",
        session_id_raw="00000000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
    )
    profile = make_backend_profile(backend)
    batch = upsert._build_versioned_upsert_batch_plan(
        model_cls=PermissionJsonRow,
        instances=[PermissionJsonRow(payload=payload)],
        staging_ctx=staging,
        ctx=LoweringContext(backend_type=backend, backend_profile=profile, versioning_domain=domain),
        conflict_columns=["sys_id"],
        on_conflict=None,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(upsert, "compile_dml_permission_filter", lambda *args, **kwargs: SqlInlineLiteral(True))
    step = upsert._ValidateVersionedUpsertManyPermissionStep(
        ServerPlanRefId("step_1"),
        model_cls=PermissionJsonRow,
        after_refs=frozenset(),
        staging_ctx=staging,
        batch_plan=batch,
        user_id_ref_id=ServerPlanRefId("step_0"),
    )
    ctx = make_compilation_context(profile=profile, versioning_domain=domain)
    if missing_json_metadata:
        original_hints = upsert.model_sql_column_type_hints

        def without_json_metadata(
            model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow], columns: Sequence[str],
        ) -> SqlColumnTypeHints | None:
            hints = original_hints(model_cls, columns)
            if hints is None:
                return None
            return replace(
                hints,
                jsonb_columns=hints.jsonb_columns - {"payload"},
                text_columns=hints.text_columns | ({"payload"} if "payload" in columns else set()),
            )

        monkeypatch.setattr(upsert, "model_sql_column_type_hints", without_json_metadata)
        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="requires declared JSON metadata"):
            step.compile(ctx)

    compiled = step.compile(ctx)

    assert ctx.dialect is not None
    _, params = compiled.grammar.render(ctx.dialect).to_sql(ctx.dialect)
    if backend is BackendType.SQLITE:
        packed = params[0]
        assert isinstance(packed, str)
        rows = json.loads(packed)
        documents = [None if row[-1] is None else json.loads(row[-1]) for row in rows]
        assert documents == [payload]
    else:
        encoded = None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"))
        assert encoded in params, params
    assert not any(isinstance(value, str) and "SqlJsonLiteral(" in value for value in params)

from impl.common.l2050_sql_types.sql_branded_types import SqlAliasName, SqlColumnName, SqlTableName
from impl.common.l2060_query_spec.query_spec import (
    CursorKeyPart,
    QuerySpec,

    decode_search_cursor,
    search_cursor_key_parts_from_query_spec,
)
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.protocols import SqlRenderable
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.clauses import SqlOrderByClause, SqlOrderByItem, SqlSubqueryTableRef
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.enums import BinaryOp
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_leaf import SqlColumnRef, SqlParam, SqlStar
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.expr_ops import SqlBinaryOp
from impl.common.l2100_sql_grammar.tree.statements import SqlSelect
from l1000_schema.schema_def import DatabaseObjectRow
from l1400_types import CursorToken, SysId
from l2070_batching.planning_catalog import polymorphic_read_column_name


def _and(left: SqlRenderable, right: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    return SqlBinaryOp(left, BinaryOp.AND, right)


def _or(left: SqlRenderable, right: SqlRenderable) -> SqlRenderable:
    return SqlBinaryOp(left, BinaryOp.OR, right)


def _comparison_op(direction: str, *, before: bool) -> str:
    is_desc = direction.upper() == "DESC"
    if before:
        return str(BinaryOp.GT if is_desc else BinaryOp.LT)
    return str(BinaryOp.LT if is_desc else BinaryOp.GT)


def _search_order_column(
    key_part: CursorKeyPart,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> str:
    """Map user order fields while preserving published cursor identity names."""
    if key_part.role != "order":
        return key_part.column
    return polymorphic_read_column_name(model_cls, key_part.column)


def build_search_cursor_where(
    query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    *,
    score_column: str,
    source_alias: str,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> SqlRenderable | None:
    cursor = getattr(query_spec, "cursor_after", None)
    before_cursor = getattr(query_spec, "cursor_before", None)
    if cursor is None and before_cursor is None:
        return None
    cursor = before_cursor if before_cursor is not None else cursor
    token = cursor if isinstance(cursor, CursorToken) else CursorToken(str(cursor))
    include_version_identity = _query_spec_uses_versioned_identity(query_spec)
    values = decode_search_cursor(
        query_spec,
        token,
        score_column=score_column,
        include_version_identity=include_version_identity,
    )
    key_parts = search_cursor_key_parts_from_query_spec(
        query_spec,
        score_column=score_column,
        include_version_identity=include_version_identity,
    )
    if len(values) != len(key_parts):
        msg = f"Decoded search cursor produced {len(values)} values for {len(key_parts)} key parts"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    source = SqlAliasName(source_alias)
    before = before_cursor is not None
    disjunction: SqlRenderable | None = None
    for index, key_part in enumerate(key_parts):
        prefix: SqlRenderable | None = None
        for previous_index in range(index):
            previous_part = key_parts[previous_index]
            equality = SqlBinaryOp(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(_search_order_column(previous_part, model_cls)),
                    qualifier=source,
                ),
                BinaryOp.EQ,
                SqlParam(values[previous_index]),
            )
            prefix = equality if prefix is None else _and(prefix, equality)
        comparison = SqlBinaryOp(
            SqlColumnRef(
                SqlColumnName(_search_order_column(key_part, model_cls)),
                qualifier=source,
            ),
            _comparison_op(key_part.direction, before=before),
            SqlParam(values[index]),
        )
        clause = comparison if prefix is None else _and(prefix, comparison)
        disjunction = clause if disjunction is None else _or(disjunction, clause)
    return disjunction


def build_search_cursor_order_by(
    query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    *,
    score_column: str,
    source_alias: str | None,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> SqlOrderByClause:
    source = SqlAliasName(source_alias) if source_alias is not None else None
    include_version_identity = _query_spec_uses_versioned_identity(query_spec)
    return SqlOrderByClause(
        [
            SqlOrderByItem(
                SqlColumnRef(
                    SqlColumnName(_search_order_column(part, model_cls)),
                    qualifier=source,
                ),
                part.direction,
            )
            for part in search_cursor_key_parts_from_query_spec(
                query_spec,
                score_column=score_column,
                include_version_identity=include_version_identity,
            )
        ],
    )


def wrap_search_cursor_page(
    grammar: SqlRenderable,
    query_spec: QuerySpec[DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]],
    *,
    score_column: str,
    source_alias: str,
    limit: int | None,
    model_cls: type[DatabaseObjectRow],
) -> SqlRenderable:
    where = build_search_cursor_where(
        query_spec,
        score_column=score_column,
        source_alias=source_alias,
        model_cls=model_cls,
    )
    if where is None:
        return grammar
    return SqlSelect(
        [SqlStar(qualifier=source_alias)],
        SqlSubqueryTableRef(grammar, SqlTableName(source_alias)),
        where=where,
        order_by=build_search_cursor_order_by(
            query_spec,
            score_column=score_column,
            source_alias=source_alias,
            model_cls=model_cls,
        ),
        limit=limit,
    )

class MariaDbReturningCapture(BaseModel):
    """SQL parts that capture and replay one MariaDB RETURNING relation."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True, frozen=True)

    initialize: SqlRenderable
    returning_columns: tuple[SqlRenderable, ...]
    query: SqlRenderable


@pure_lazy
def build_mariadb_returning_capture(
    ref_id: ServerPlanRefId,
    columns: tuple[SqlColumnName, ...],
    hints: SqlColumnTypeHints,
) -> MariaDbReturningCapture:
    """Keep an exact INSERT RETURNING receipt in the executing SQL connection."""
    hints.require_complete(columns)
    if not columns:
        msg = (
            f"MariaDB returning capture for {ref_id!r} requires at least one column. "
            "Declare the typed SQL publication columns before compilation."
        )
        raise ValueError(msg)
    name = SqlMariaDbVariableName("nera_returned_" + hashlib.sha256(str(ref_id).encode()).hexdigest()[:48])
    variable = SqlMariaDbVariable(name)
    captured: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    driver_returning: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for column in columns:
        value: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column))
        if column in hints.bytea_columns:
            value = SqlFuncCall(SqlFunctionName("HEX"), (value,))
        elif column in hints.jsonb_columns:
            value = SqlJsonAccess("GET_PATH", value, SqlJsonPath("$"))
        if column in (
            hints.text_columns
            | hints.uuid_columns
            | hints.timestamptz_columns
            | hints.date_columns
            | hints.time_columns
            | hints.bytea_columns
            | hints.numeric_columns
        ):
            value = SqlCast(value, SqlCastTargetType(base_type="TEXT"))
        driver_value: SqlRenderable = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column))
        if column in hints.numeric_columns:
            # MariaDB can report INSERT...SELECT RETURNING numerics as binary floats.
            # Text transport keeps the declared precision for runtime publication.
            driver_value = SqlCast(SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName(column)), SqlCastTargetType(base_type="TEXT"))
        captured.extend((SqlParam(column), value))
        driver_returning.append(driver_value)
    appended = SqlMariaDbVariableAssignment(
        variable,
        SqlMariaDbAppendJsonRow(
            variable,
            SqlFuncCall(SqlFunctionName("JSON_OBJECT"), tuple(captured)),
        ),
    )
    first = SqlSelectAlias(
        SqlCase(
            (
                (
                    SqlFuncCall(SqlFunctionName("JSON_LENGTH"), (appended,)),
                    driver_returning[0],
                ),
            ),
            else_=SqlParam(None),
        ),
        SqlAliasName(columns[0]),
    )
    alias = SqlAliasName("captured_rows")
    row = SqlColumnRef(SqlColumnName("value"), alias)
    projected: list[SqlRenderable] = []
    for column in columns:
        path = SqlJsonPath("$." + json.dumps(column))
        value = SqlJsonAccess("GET_PATH" if column in hints.jsonb_columns else "GET_TEXT", row, path)
        projected_value: SqlRenderable = value
        if column in hints.bytea_columns:
            projected_value = SqlFuncCall(SqlFunctionName("UNHEX"), (value,))
        elif column not in hints.jsonb_columns:
            target = hints.cast_target_for_column(column)
            assert target is not None
            projected_value = SqlCast(value, target)
        projected.append(SqlSelectAlias(projected_value, SqlAliasName(column)))
    return MariaDbReturningCapture(
        initialize=SqlSelect(
            select_list=SqlSelectList(
                (
                    SqlSelectAlias(
                        SqlMariaDbVariableAssignment(
                            variable,
                            SqlFuncCall(SqlFunctionName("JSON_ARRAY")),
                        ),
                        SqlAliasName("initialized"),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        ),
        returning_columns=(
            first,
            *(
                SqlSelectAlias(value, SqlAliasName(column))
                for column, value in zip(columns[1:], driver_returning[1:], strict=True)
            ),
        ),
        query=SqlSelect(
            select_list=SqlSelectList(tuple(projected)),
            from_=SqlTableAlias(SqlJsonArrayElements(variable), alias),
        ),
    )

def test_inline_large_column_lowering_publishes_raw_and_hydrated_refs() -> None:
    steps = lower_spill_aware_query_read_steps(
        ServerPlanRefId("docs"),
        _LargeColumnHydrationContractDoc,
        _query_spec(),
    )
    ref_ids = {str(step.ref_id) for step in steps}

    assert ref_ids == {"docs.raw", "docs.hydrated", "docs"}
    assert len(steps) == 3
    assert str(steps[-1].ref_id) == "docs"
    assert steps[-1].dependencies() == frozenset({"docs.hydrated"})


def test_inline_large_column_hydrated_rows_contract_includes_transport_aliases() -> None:
    steps = lower_spill_aware_query_read_steps(
        ServerPlanRefId("docs"),
        _LargeColumnHydrationContractDoc,
        _query_spec(),
    )
    hydrated = steps[1]

    assert isinstance(hydrated, HydrateResolvedRowsStep)
    contract = hydrated.cte_publication_contract()
    assert contract is not None
    for alias in inline_large_column_alias_columns(_LargeColumnHydrationContractDoc):
        assert alias in contract.columns
    contract.column_type_hints.require_complete(contract.columns)
    # Large-column hydration is executor-owned: spilled values are resolved in
    # Python after the SQL batch, so this step declares no in-batch reduction
    # under either phase of the reduction contract protocol.
    assert hydrated.is_executor_owned_runtime_step()
    assert hydrated.batch_postprocess_reduction_source_ref() is None
    assert hydrated.batch_postprocess_reduction_contract() is None

        result_mode="first",
    )
    hydrated = steps[1]

    assert isinstance(hydrated, HydrateFirstResolvedRowStep)
    assert str(hydrated.ref_id) == "docs.hydrated"
    assert hydrated.result_cardinality() is Cardinality.ONE
    assert str(steps[-1].ref_id) == "docs"
    assert steps[-1].dependencies() == frozenset({"docs.hydrated"})

    columns = (

        "content",
        pointer_column,
        *inline_large_column_alias_columns(_LargeColumnHydrationContractDoc),

    ctx = make_compilation_context(
        cte_refs={
            "docs.raw": typed_cte_reference(
                ServerPlanRefId("docs_raw_cte"),

                column_type_hints=combine_sql_column_type_hints(

                        uuid_columns=frozenset({"sys_id"}),

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib

import pytest

from conform.l5250_matching.model_updates import validated_model_update
from conform.l5250_matching.test_phase7_native_exact_dense import (
    TEST_BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY as TEST_BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY,
    TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES as TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES,
    _spec,
)
from data_layer.connection import BackendType, SyncDatabaseConnection, create_connection_from_params
from data_layer.exceptions import ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError, ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason
from data_layer.metadata import (
    DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor, LazyBootstrapCoordinator,
    build_read_only_bootstrap_contract, open_validated_read_only_connection,
    open_validated_read_only_connection_async,
)
from data_layer.session import SessionId
from impl.sqlite.connection import SyncSqliteConnection
from impl.mariadb.connection import SyncMariaDBConnection
from impl.postgres.connection import SyncPostgresConnection
from l1000_schema.schema_def import ApplicationObjectRow
from l1400_types import DynamicFieldName

from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_state import BootstrapPrimitiveState
from l5250_matching.native_plan_api import _row


def _backend_target(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, backend_config: Mapping[str, JsonValue],
) -> tuple[BackendType, BackendConnectionParams]:
    """Use the fixture's actual database rather than the shared configuration name."""
    config = backend_config["backend"]
    assert isinstance(config, Mapping)
    raw_params = config["config"]
    assert isinstance(raw_params, Mapping)
    params: BackendConnectionParams = dict(raw_params)
    if isinstance(db_connection, SyncSqliteConnection):
        params = {"db_path": str(db_connection._db_path)}
    elif isinstance(db_connection, SyncMariaDBConnection):
        maria_driver = db_connection._conn
        assert maria_driver is not None
        params = {**params, "database": maria_driver.database}
    else:
        assert isinstance(db_connection, SyncPostgresConnection)
        postgres_driver = db_connection._conn
        assert postgres_driver is not None
        params = {**params, "database": postgres_driver.info.dbname}
    return db_connection.backend_type, params


@pytest.mark.parametrize("async_surface", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("damage", ["missing", "dimensions", "version"])
def test_immutable_row_read_only_admission(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    backend_config: Mapping[str, JsonValue],
    system_session_id: SessionId,
    damage: str,
    async_surface: bool,
) -> None:
    backend, params = _backend_target(db_connection, backend_config)
    expected = _row(_spec())
    fields = tuple(
        DynamicFieldName(field_name)
        for field_name in sorted(set(type(expected).model_fields) - set(ApplicationObjectRow.model_fields))
    )

    class Contributor:
        key = "immutable-admission-control"
        version = "1"
        contract_fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(expected.model_dump_json(include={"sys_id", *fields}).encode()).hexdigest()

        def contribute(self: Contributor, state: BootstrapPrimitiveState) -> None:
            state.ensure_immutable_row(type(expected), row=expected, immutable_fields=fields)

    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    contributors = (DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(), Contributor())
    writer = create_connection_from_params(str(backend), dict(params))
    try:
        coordinator.run(writer, manifest_key="phase7:portable-immutable-admission", model_classes=(type(expected),), contributors=contributors)
        contract = build_read_only_bootstrap_contract(coordinator.build_engine_plan(
            manifest_key="phase7:portable-immutable-admission", model_classes=(type(expected),),
            contributors=contributors, dialect=writer.get_dialect(),
        ))

        async def async_open() -> None:
            reader = await open_validated_read_only_connection_async(backend, params, contract=contract)
            await reader.close_async()

        def open_reader() -> None:
            if async_surface:
                asyncio.run(async_open())
            else:
                reader = open_validated_read_only_connection(backend, params, contract=contract)
                reader.close()

        open_reader()
        session = writer.session(system_session_id)
        stored = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(type(expected), expected.sys_id))
        assert stored is not None
        if damage == "missing":
            session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.delete_by_id(type(expected), expected.sys_id))
        else:
            changed = validated_model_update(stored, {"dimensions": stored.dimensions + 1} if damage == "dimensions" else {"cost_model_version": "unknown-version"})
            session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.update(type(expected), changed))
        try:
            with pytest.raises(ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError) as caught:
                open_reader()
            assert caught.value.reason is ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason.CONTRACT_MISMATCH
        finally:
            if damage == "missing":
                session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.insert(type(expected), stored))
            else:
                session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.update(type(expected), stored))
        open_reader()
    finally:
        writer.close()

@pure_lazy
def _embedding_queue_claim_update_query_spec(
    candidate_ids: ScalarSequenceServerRef[QueueMessageId],
) -> QuerySpec[QueueMessage]:
    """Select claim candidates through one direct ServerRef filter contract."""
    spec = _selected_queue_rows_query_spec_lazy(QueueMessage, candidate_ids)
    return replace(
        spec,
        filters=[
            QueryFilter(
                column="sys_id",
                operator="IN",
                value=candidate_ids,

    )


@pure_lazy
def build_embedding_queue_claim_rows_ref(
    plan: BaseServerPlan,
    *,
    queue_name: QueueName,
    count: int,
    claimed_by: str,
    next_ref_fn: Callable[[], str],
    claim_time: datetime | None = None,
) -> ServerPlanRefId:
    resolved_claim_time = claim_time or datetime.now(UTC)
    claim_owner = f"{claimed_by}:{secrets.token_hex(12)}"
    target = _require_queue_claim_target(
        QueueName(queue_name),
        count,
        claim_owner,
        resolved_claim_time,
    )
    candidates_ref = ServerPlanRefId(next_ref_fn())
    claim_update_ref = ServerPlanRefId(next_ref_fn())
    candidate_ids: ScalarSequenceServerRef[QueueMessageId] = ServerRefs.from_ref_id(
        ServerPlanRefId(f"{candidates_ref}.sys_id"),
        variant="scalar_sequence",
        type_hint=QueueMessageId,
    )
    plan.add_step(
        QueryExecuteStep(
            candidates_ref,
            QueueMessage,
            _QueryExecuteStepConfig(
                query_spec=_embedding_queue_claim_query_spec(target),
                raw_mode=False,
                always_publish_executor_binding=True,
            ),
        ),
    )
    plan.add_step(
        QueryUpdateReturningStep(
            claim_update_ref,
            QueueMessage,
            _QueryUpdateReturningStepConfig(

"""Read-only admission hashes persisted binary bytes independently of metadata."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
from collections.abc import Mapping

import pytest

from data_layer.connection import SyncDatabaseConnection, create_connection_from_params
from data_layer.exceptions import ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError, ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason
from data_layer.metadata import (

)
from data_layer.session import SessionId
from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.tests.test_bootstrap_immutable_binary_row import (
    ImmutableBinaryRow,
    TEST_BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY as TEST_BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY,
    TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES as TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES,
)
from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.tests.test_immutable_row_read_only_admission import _backend_target

from l1400_types.type_surface_contracts import JsonValue

from l3200_metadata.bootstrap_state import BootstrapPrimitiveState


@pytest.mark.parametrize("async_surface", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("damage", ["bytes", "empty", "extra"])
def test_immutable_binary_admission_rejects_bytes_with_unchanged_digest_label(
    db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection,
    backend_config: Mapping[str, JsonValue],
    async_surface: bool,
    damage: str,
    system_session_id: SessionId,
) -> None:
    backend, params = _backend_target(db_connection, backend_config)
    expected = ImmutableBinaryRow(label="tensor", digest="unchanged-label", payload=b"\xff\x00\x80")
    expected.label = f"tensor:{expected.sys_id}"

    class Contributor:
        key = "binary-admission-control"
        version = "1"
        contract_fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(
            expected.model_dump_json(include={"sys_id", "label", "digest"}).encode() + expected.payload,
        ).hexdigest()

        def contribute(self: Contributor, state: BootstrapPrimitiveState) -> None:
            state.ensure_immutable_row(
                ImmutableBinaryRow,
                row=expected,
                immutable_fields=(
                    DynamicFieldName("label"),
                    DynamicFieldName("digest"),
                    DynamicFieldName("payload"),
                ),
                row_set_requirements=(
                    BootstrapRowSetRequirement(
                        table_name=SqlTableName(get_table_name(ImmutableBinaryRow)),
                        predicates=((SqlColumnName("label"), expected.label),),
                        expected_count=BootstrapExpectedRowCount(1),
                    ),
                ),
            )

    coordinator = LazyBootstrapCoordinator()
    contributors = (DataLayerCoreBootstrapPrimitiveContributor(), Contributor())
    writer = create_connection_from_params(str(backend), dict(params))
    try:
        coordinator.run(
            writer,
            manifest_key="binary-admission",
            model_classes=(ImmutableBinaryRow,),
            contributors=contributors,
        )
        contract = build_read_only_bootstrap_contract(
            coordinator.build_engine_plan(
                manifest_key="binary-admission",
                model_classes=(ImmutableBinaryRow,),
                contributors=contributors,
                dialect=writer.get_dialect(),
            )
        )

        async def async_open() -> None:
            reader = await open_validated_read_only_connection_async(backend, params, contract=contract)
            await reader.close_async()

        def open_reader() -> None:
            if async_surface:
                asyncio.run(async_open())
            else:
                reader = open_validated_read_only_connection(backend, params, contract=contract)
                reader.close()

        open_reader()
        session = writer.session(system_session_id)
        stored = session.read(fn=lambda txn: txn.select_one(ImmutableBinaryRow, expected.sys_id))
        assert stored is not None
        changed = ImmutableBinaryRow(
            sys_id=stored.sys_id,
            label=stored.label,
            digest=stored.digest,
            payload=b"" if damage == "empty" else b"\xfe\x00\x80",
        )
        extra = ImmutableBinaryRow(label=stored.label, digest="extra-role", payload=b"extra")
        if damage == "extra":
            session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.insert(ImmutableBinaryRow, extra))
        else:
            session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.update(ImmutableBinaryRow, changed))
        try:
            with pytest.raises(ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableError) as caught:
                open_reader()
            assert caught.value.reason is ReadOnlySchemaUnavailableReason.CONTRACT_MISMATCH
        finally:
            if damage == "extra":
                session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.delete_by_id(ImmutableBinaryRow, extra.sys_id))
            else:
                session.write(fn=lambda txn: txn.update(ImmutableBinaryRow, stored))
        open_reader()
    finally:
        writer.close()
