TEST_BOOTSTRAP_FAMILY = CORE_V1
TEST_BOOTSTRAP_TABLES = (GraphIncidentPosting,)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("rollback", [False, True])
def test_posting_storage_roundtrip_and_rollback(db_connection: SyncDatabaseConnection, rollback: bool, system_session_id: SessionId) -> None:
    posting = GraphIncidentPosting(
        sys_id=SysId.new(), branch_id=BranchId.new(), graph_sys_id=SysId.new(),
        direction=IncidentEndpointDirection.SOURCE, endpoint_sys_id=SysId.new(),
        bucket_level=IncidentBucketLevel(62), bucket_number=IncidentBucketNumber(1),
        edge_table_name="sample_edges", valid_from_seq=RevisionCompactId(1 << 62),
        source_sys_id=SysId.new(), target_sys_id=SysId.new(),
    )

    def write(txn: SyncWriteTransaction) -> None:
        txn.insert(GraphIncidentPosting, posting)
        if rollback:
            raise RuntimeError("injected posting rollback")

    if rollback:
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="injected posting rollback"):
            db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=write)
    else:
        db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).write(fn=write)

    def read(txn: SyncReadTransaction) -> list[GraphIncidentPosting]:
        return list(txn.query(GraphIncidentPosting).execute())

    rows = db_connection.session(SessionId.schema()).read(fn=read)
    assert len(rows) == (0 if rollback else 1)
    if rows:
        assert rows[0].model_dump() == posting.model_dump()

from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass

from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.insert_permission import InsertPermissionAssertionStep

from l4000_permissions.rbac_schema import Share


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ReplicateShareConfig:
    """Closed payload for one authorized grant replica."""

    share: Share


class ReplicateShareIntent(IntentStep[Share]):
    """Replicate one grant after the authoritative grantor check succeeds."""

    intent_tags = frozenset({"write", "insert", "permissions", "replication", "intent"})

    def __init__(self, ref_id: ServerPlanRefId, *, config: ReplicateShareConfig) -> None:
        super().__init__(ref_id)
        self.model_cls = Share
        self.config = config

    def lower(self, ctx: LoweringContext) -> Sequence[HeterogeneousServerPlanStep]:
        """Lower to an explicit grantor assertion and a normal typed insert."""
        permission_ref = ServerPlanRefId(f"{self.ref_id}_grantor_permission")
        permission_step = InsertPermissionAssertionStep(
            permission_ref,
            Share,
            instance=self.config.share,
        )
        insert_intent = InsertIntent(
            ref_id=self.ref_id,
            model_cls=Share,
            instance=ServerRefs.object(self.config.share),
            config=ServerRefs.scalar(
                _shape_insert_intent_config(
                    self.config.share,
                    after_refs=frozenset({permission_ref}),
                ),
            ),
        )
        return (permission_step, *insert_intent.lower(ctx))

"""Versioned staging row preparation for lowered write intents.

Callers enqueue raw user/model instances into versioned intents; this module
applies the insert preparation pipeline, trust defaults, and staged-commit
binding at lowering time so lazy plan construction stays declarative.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TypeVar

from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps._prepare_instance import (
    prepare_instance_for_insert_lazy,
)
from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.steps.intent_transaction import VersionedStagingCtx
from l1000_schema.schema_def import DatabaseObjectRow
from l1200_versioned_ids import StagedCommitId
from l1300_session.session import SessionId
from l1400_types import SysId
from l4500_trust.trust_registry import inject_trust_defaults

T = TypeVar("T", bound=DatabaseObjectRow[SysId])


def prepare_versioned_instance_for_staging(
    model_cls: type[T],
    instance: T,
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
) -> T:
    """Return a row ready for versioned staging INSERT/re-stage lowering."""
    prepared_obj = prepare_instance_for_insert_lazy(model_cls, instance)
    return _finish_versioned_instance_for_staging(model_cls, prepared_obj, staging_ctx)


def _finish_versioned_instance_for_staging[T_staged: DatabaseObjectRow[SysId]](
    model_cls: type[T_staged],
    prepared_obj: DatabaseObjectRow,
    staging_ctx: VersionedStagingCtx,
) -> T_staged:
    if not isinstance(prepared_obj, model_cls):
        msg = f"versioned staging preparation returned unexpected type: {type(prepared_obj)!r}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    prepared: T_staged = prepared_obj
    session_id = SessionId(staging_ctx.session_id_raw)
    prepared = inject_trust_defaults(model_cls, prepared, session_id)
    updated = prepared.model_copy(
        update={"staged_commit_id": StagedCommitId(staging_ctx.staged_commit_id_raw)},
    )
    if not isinstance(updated, model_cls):
        msg = f"model_copy returned unexpected type: {type(updated)!r}"
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return updated

"""Tripwire helpers for forbidden execution-time plan recursion."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Never

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from l2070_batching.compilation import CompilationContext
    from l2070_batching.step import ServerPlanStep


def _raise_forbidden_runtime_nested_execution[StepsItemT](
    *,
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    steps: Sequence[ServerPlanStep[StepsItemT]],
    helper_name: str,
) -> Never:
    from impl.common.l2070_server_plan.purity_harness import ServerPlanPurityError

    del ctx
    step_names = ", ".join(type(step).__name__ for step in steps) or "<none>"
    raise ServerPlanPurityError(
        phase="execution",
        path=helper_name,
        operation=(
            "nested plan execution after compile; only the executor may materialize or resolve "
            "references, and any follow-on SQL or conditional logic must be lowered into explicit "
            f"plan steps instead of recursively executing [{step_names}]"
        ),
        kind="execution-time replanning",
    )


def execute_runtime_nested_steps_sync[StepsItemT](
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    steps: Sequence[ServerPlanStep[StepsItemT]],
    *,
    initial_resolved: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    del initial_resolved
    _raise_forbidden_runtime_nested_execution(
        ctx=ctx,
        steps=steps,
        helper_name="execute_runtime_nested_steps_sync",
    )


async def execute_runtime_nested_steps_async[StepsItemT](
    ctx: CompilationContext,
    steps: Sequence[ServerPlanStep[StepsItemT]],
    *,
    initial_resolved: Mapping[str, object] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    del initial_resolved
    _raise_forbidden_runtime_nested_execution(
        ctx=ctx,
        steps=steps,
        helper_name="execute_runtime_nested_steps_async",
    )

def test_recovery_fixture_retains_both_generations_and_unique_tensor_bytes(tmp_path: Path) -> None:

def test_fk_constraints_reused_within_scope_and_rebuilt_after_exit(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    calls = 0
    original = fk._model_type_hints_with_schema_context

    def counted(model: type[UserRole]) -> dict[str, object]:
        nonlocal calls
        calls += 1
        return original(model)

    monkeypatch.setattr(fk, "_model_type_hints_with_schema_context", counted)

        assert calls == 1
    with fk.read_only_fk_analysis_scope():
        assert fk.model_foreign_key_constraints(UserRole) == expected
        assert calls == 2
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="abort"):
        with fk.read_only_fk_analysis_scope():
            assert fk.model_foreign_key_constraints(UserRole) == expected
            assert calls == 3
            raise RuntimeError("abort")
    assert fk.model_foreign_key_constraints(UserRole) == expected

def append_cte_definition_once(
    definitions: list[SqlCteDefinition],
    seen_names: set[str],
    name: str,
    body: SqlRenderable,
) -> None:
    if name in seen_names:
        return
    seen_names.add(name)
    definitions.append(SqlCteDefinition(SqlCteName(name), body))


def insert_cte_definition_once(
    definitions: list[SqlCteDefinition],
    seen_names: set[str],
    index: int,
    name: str,
    body: SqlRenderable,
) -> bool:
    if name in seen_names:
        return False
    seen_names.add(name)
    definitions.insert(index, SqlCteDefinition(SqlCteName(name), body))
    return True

class BaseServerPlan:
    def execute(self, backend: BackendExecutor, executable_plan):
        lowering = backend.get_lowering_context()
        result = run_executable_pipeline(executable_plan, backend, (), lowering_ctx=lowering)
        receipt = backend.native_pipeline_execution_receipt(result.accounting, sql_group_count=1)
        return receipt.flush_count

    async def execute_prepared(self, executor: PlanExecutor, compiled):
        resolved = await executor.execute_prepared_physical_async(compiled)
        accounting = executor.last_accounting()
        batching = executor.last_batching_metrics()
        return resolved, accounting, batching
